Sehen Sie sich dieses Video an, um zu sehen, wie wir bei Roche eine personalisierte Gesundheitsversorgung zur Realität machen. Die mySugr GmbH wurde 2017 von Roche übernommen und unser Büro in Wien gehört zu den weltweiten Standorten von Roche. Sie befinden sich hier im Herzen von Wien, egal ob Sie an einem mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® oder einer anderen Roche-Produkt oder Lösung arbeiten. Lesen Sie hier mehr über die Geschichte von mySugr & Roche . Hier ist, was wir suchen: Roche Diagnostics baute einen neuen strategischen Bereich – Roche Information Solutions (RIS) – auf die Schaffung eines modernen Portfolios von Entscheidungsunterstützungssoftwareprodukten und die Erstellung von Erkenntnissen, die den Umgang mit Patienten verändern. Unsere Herausforderung besteht darin, komplexe Diagnose- und Behandlungsdaten von medizinischen Geräten und IT-Systemen zusammenzubringen und diese Daten intelligent an Kliniker, Forscher und Pflegekräfte zur Verbesserung der Forschungsergebnisse und der Patientenversorgung zu übermitteln, indem sie eine Reihe von klinischen Entscheidungsunterstützungslösungen (CDS) anbieten. Wir arbeiten auch mit klinischen Pflegelösungen, die vom Patienten direkt zugeschnitten sind und sie mit den Werkzeugen befähigen, um ihre Gesundheit zu verwalten. Als Principal Quantitative Scientist werden Sie als wissenschaftliche Leiterin für Real-World Data (RWD) tätig sein, die die Entwicklung und Annahme unserer digitalen Gesundheit, IVD und Medizinprodukte grundlegend prägt. Dies ist eine hohe, unabhängige Rolle, die tiefe Expertise und die Fähigkeit erfordert, kritische Geschäfts- und Regulierungsentscheidungen zu beeinflussen. Ihre Arbeit umfasst strategisch fundierte Analysen mit verschiedenen Datentypen (einschließlich EHR, Ansprüche, Omics und digitale Gesundheitsdaten) in enger Abstimmung mit Datenwissenschaftlern und Biostatisten. Ihre kommende Mission: RWD Strategie und Durchführung (End-to-End Leadership):
• Führen Sie die Konzeption, Planung, Durchführung und Berichterstattung von fortgeschrittenen RWD-Studien mit verschiedenen Forschungs- und kommerziellen Gesundheitsdatenbanken.
• Entwickeln Sie strenge RWD-Studienprotokolle und führen Sie komplexe Analysen, um den Nachweisbedarf des IVD, medizinischen Geräts und des digitalen Gesundheitsportfolios zu unterstützen.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Design, Ausführung und Präsentation von RWE den höchsten wissenschaftlichen und methodischen Standards entsprechen. Strategische Einflussnahme & Adoption
• Aktivieren Sie als RWD-Führer eng mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern wie Product Leads, Medical Affairs und Clinical Development, um sicherzustellen, dass RWD-Projekte direkt kommerziellen, Marktzugang und regulatorischen Anforderungen unterstützen.
• Die Verwendung von Champion RWD zur Ergänzung von klinischen Beweisen und zur aktiven Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten, in denen RWD als primärer Beweismechanismus dienen kann, um regulatorische und Erstattungsziele zu erreichen.
• Zusammenarbeit mit externen Partnern (KOLs, akademischen Institutionen, Gesundheitsbehörden) über das Studiendesign und die Förderung starker Beziehungen zur Erkundung neuer Daten- und Analysemethoden Kompetenz & Mentorship:

• Förderung von Innovation durch die Verbesserung der Arbeitsmethoden (Prozesse, Methoden, Technologie) und den proaktiven Austausch von Lernen mit Kollegen.

Laissez-les construire un avenir plus sain, ensemble! En combinant nos forces uniques, nous redéfinissons les soins de santé par une action durable et l'innovation. Pour un regard en coulisses, regardez cette vidéo pour voir comment nous, à Roche, faisons des soins de santé personnalisés une réalité. La mySugr GmbH a été acquise par Roche en 2017 et notre bureau de Vienne est l'un des sites mondiaux de Roche. Vous serez situé ici, au cœur de Vienne, peu importe si vous travaillez sur un mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® ou tout autre produit ou solution Roche. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur l'histoire de mySugr & Roche ici. Voici ce que nous cherchons: Roche Diagnostics a construit un nouveau domaine stratégique – Roche Information Solutions (RIS) – chargé de créer un portefeuille moderne de logiciels de soutien à la décision et de générer des idées qui changent la façon dont les patients sont pris en charge. Notre défi est de rassembler des données complexes de diagnostic et de traitement des dispositifs médicaux et des systèmes informatiques et de les traiter intelligemment et de les présenter aux cliniciens, aux chercheurs et aux soignants afin d'améliorer les résultats de la recherche et les soins aux patients en offrant une série de solutions de soutien à la décision clinique. Nous travaillons également avec des solutions de soins cliniques qui sont adaptées pour être utilisées directement par le patient et leur donner les outils pour gérer leur santé. En tant que principal scientifique quantitatif, vous agirez comme un chef de file scientifique pour les données du monde réel (RWD), la génération de preuves qui façonne fondamentalement le développement et l'adoption de nos produits de santé numérique, de DIV et d'instruments médicaux. Il s'agit d'un rôle indépendant et à impact élevé qui exige une expertise approfondie et la capacité d'influencer les décisions commerciales et réglementaires essentielles. Votre travail comprendra l'élaboration stratégique d'analyses faisant appel à divers types de données (y compris les DSE, les allégations, les omiques et les données numériques sur la santé) en étroite harmonie avec les scientifiques en données et les biostaticiens. Votre prochaine mission : RWD Stratégie et exécution ( Leadership de bout en bout) :
• Diriger la conceptualisation, la planification, l'exécution et l'établissement de rapports sur les études avancées de la MDR à l'aide de diverses bases de données de recherche et de soins de santé commerciaux.
• Mettre au point des protocoles d'étude rigoureux et mener des analyses complexes pour répondre aux besoins de la DIV, des dispositifs médicaux et de la santé numérique.
• Veiller à ce que la conception, l'exécution et la présentation de RWE respectent les normes scientifiques et méthodologiques les plus élevées. Influence stratégique et adoption
• Agir en tant que chef de file du RWD, en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes interfonctionnelles telles que les chefs de produit, les affaires médicales et le développement clinique, afin de garantir que les projets de RWD soutiennent directement les besoins commerciaux, l'accès aux marchés et la réglementation.
• L'utilisation de Champion RWD pour compléter les preuves cliniques et identifier activement les occasions où RWD peut servir de principal mécanisme de preuve pour atteindre les objectifs de réglementation et de remboursement.
• Collaborer avec des partenaires extérieurs (KOL, établissements universitaires, autorités sanitaires) à la conception d'études et favoriser des relations solides pour explorer de nouveaux éléments de données et des méthodes d'analyse Expertise et mentorat :
• Tirer parti et développer l'expertise en matière de sources de MDR, d'épidémiologie et de méthodes d'inférence causale de pointe.
• Promouvoir l'innovation en améliorant les méthodes de travail (processus, méthodes, technologie) et en partageant activement les enseignements avec les pairs.
• Mentor junior collègues et agir comme un expert en matière d'influence pour l'équipe. Compétences essentielles pour votre mission :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat (préféré) OU d'une maîtrise en sciences quantitatives (p. ex. pharmacoépidémiologie, épidémiologie, biostatistique RWD, pharmacoéconomie, recherche sur l'économie de la santé et les résultats)
• Et plus de 7 ans d'expérience directement liée (industrie, conseil ou autre)
• Expérience éprouvée de l'utilisation de la MDR pour appuyer les présentations réglementaires.
• Une solide expertise en épidémiologie et en méthodes d'inférence causale est nécessaire.
• Forte expérience de l'utilisation de diverses sources RWD pour générer des informations et des preuves .
• Expérience dans le domaine

titleByLocale.fr: (Associate) Gestionnaire, Soutien de laboratoire et ASAT, Produits biologiques

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roles & Responsibilities

Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

Equipment and System Support:

• Act as the QC equipment SME to contribute to project design, construction, and qualification. This includes participating in equipment selection, URS (User Requirement Specification) review, and IOPQ (Installation, Operation, and Performance Qualification) to ensure successful project delivery.

• Support the establishment and development of the QC operation system in alignment with Roche standards. This involves creating a maintenance management system, and an automation strategy(eg. LIMS, Empower, SAP) and implementation to support robust operational readiness.

• Lead the setup of sample and material management processes for QC operations and ensure all necessary processes, documentation (SOPs), and tracking systems are in place for the management of samples and testing materials from day one.

• Support all QC activities during regulatory inspections and audits and participate in the response to regulatory and global quality audits.

• As the experienced SME, proactive drive the continuous improvement in Lab support team by leading the taskforce to identify and implement new technologies to improve the compliance and efficiency in routine QC operations.

Routine Operation:

Safety Management:

• Be the QC SHE SPOC and to maintain strict adherence to Roche's SHE (Safety, Health, Environment) standards and all regulatory guidelines.

• Actively promote a safety-first culture within the team and report any incidents or deviations promptly.

Equipment and Method Lifecycle Management:

• Be responsible for the operation and maintenance of relevant equipment with Roche‘s QMS standards and regulatory guidelines.

• Develop and execute preventive and corrective maintenance programs to maximize equipment availability and optimize life-cycle costs.

• Ensure all computerized systems are maintained in a validated state throughout their operational life.

• Drive operational excellence through the implementation of digital solutions and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Support the integration of new technologies and digital tools to enhance lab efficiency and data management.

• Support the lifecycle management of analytical methods, including implementation, transfer, and periodic review, to ensure compliance with cGMP and Roche standards.

Data Integrity Assurance:

• Ensure the QC data flow generated by lab equipment and maintenance activities are compliance to DI requirements.

• Ensure all data is maintained in accordance with cGMP and company standards for data integrity.

Sample and Material Management:

• Ensure the proper receipt, logging, storage, and traceability of all samples according to established SOPs.

• Conduct Stability，retention sample management with compliance to cGMP.

QC Compliance Assurance:

• Ensure audit readiness by complying with effective standards, regulatory/statutory, and cGMP requirements

• Provide technical support on all lab-related topics during internal and external audits.

Qualification and Experience

Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences and Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

• Strong knowledge of QC operation

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roles & Responsibilities Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness: Equipment and System Support:
• Act as the QC equipment SME to contribute to project design, construction, and qualification. This includes participating in equipment selection, URS (User Requirement Specification) review, and IOPQ (Installation, Operation, and Performance Qualification) to ensure successful project delivery.
• Support the establishment and development of the QC operation system in alignment with Roche standards. This involves creating a maintenance management system, and an automation strategy(eg. LIMS, Empower, SAP) and implementation to support robust operational readiness.
• Lead the setup of sample and material management processes for QC operations and ensure all necessary processes, documentation (SOPs), and tracking systems are in place for the management of samples and testing materials from day one.
• Lead the setup of sample and material management processes for QC operations and ensure all necessary processes, documentation (SOPs), and tracking systems are in place for the management of samples and testing materials from day one.
• Support all QC activities during regulatory inspections and audits and participate in the response to regulatory and global quality audits.
• As the experienced SME, proactive drive the continuous improvement in Lab support team by leading the taskforce to identify and implement new technologies to improve the compliance and efficiency in routine QC operations. Routine Operation: Safety Management:
• Be the QC SHE SPOC and to maintain strict adherence to Roche's SHE (Safety, Health, Environment) standards and all regulatory guidelines.
• Actively promote a safety-first culture within the team and report any incidents or deviations promptly. Equipment and Method Lifecycle Management:
• Be responsible for the operation and maintenance of relevant equipment with Roche‘s QMS standards and regulatory guidelines.
• Develop and execute preventive and corrective maintenance programs to maximize equipment availability and optimize life-cycle costs.
• Ensure all computerized systems are maintained in a validated state throughout their operational life.
• Drive operational excellence through the implementation of digital solutions and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support the integration of new technologies and digital tools to enhance lab efficiency and data management.
• Support the lifecycle management of analytical methods, including implementation, transfer, and periodic review, to ensure compliance with cGMP and Roche standards. Data Integrity Assurance:
• Ensure the QC data flow generated by lab equipment and maintenance activities are compliance to DI requirements.
• Ensure all data is maintained in accordance with cGMP and company standards for data integrity. Sample and Material Management:
• Ensure the proper receipt, logging, storage, and traceability of all samples according to established SOPs.
• Conduct Stability，retention sample management with compliance to cGMP. QC Compliance Assurance:
• Ensure audit readiness by complying with effective standards, regulatory/statutory, and cGMP requirements
• Provide technical support on all lab-related topics during internal and external audits. Qualification and Experience Education/Qualifications
• Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences and Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above
• Strong knowledge of QC operation

jobs.title: Digital Project Coordinator (Enterprise Web Product Project Management)

titleByLocale.it: Digital Project Coordinatore (Enterprise Web Product Project Management)
titleByLocale.en: Digital Project Coordinator (Enterprise Web Product Project Management)
titleByLocale.de: Digital Project Koordinator (Enterprise Web Product Project Management)
titleByLocale.fr: Digital Project Coordinateur (Enterprise Web Product Project Management)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen Roche's digital capabilities globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting, and Creative Design.

As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy, as well as excellent delivery of our various digital operations priorities. You are responsible for supporting and executing different initiatives. You work with relevant stakeholders and consult on how to develop their digital performance further and ensure they leverage the available digital tools in order to meet their overall goals.

A Digital Project Coordinator (Enterprise Web Product Project Management) is a technically-qualified person (expert) who strives to achieve business goals through web presence and digital platforms by supporting stakeholders with providing hands-on delivery coordination and consultative advisory to local markets and global teams. The Digital Project Coordinator (Enterprise Web Product Project Management) is responsible for consulting and partnering with Roche Divisions and/or affiliates in executing the digital strategy by delivering a full suite of objectives across the Roche online presence. The Digital Project Coordinator (Enterprise Web Product Project Management) is a skilled expert in all aspects of digital project management, content management, and tool development across different platforms, and can build out reporting metrics that support the business in continuing their growth to meet KPIs and objectives.

The Opportunity:

• Lead intake, triage, and prioritization of Enterprise Web Product (Adobe Experience Manager) requests in line with business objectives

• Advise stakeholders on the effective use of Enterprise Web Product functionalities and best practices

• Act as the main liaison between BPOs, internal requestors, IT/technical teams, and external partners

• Act as an internal consultant and bridge between business teams and IT, overseeing the process from strategy development to implementation and hypercare

• Share specialist knowledge and building expertise by training stakeholders, mentoring colleagues, and promoting innovative digital practices

• Drive process improvements and governance through process optimization, documentation, and occasional handling of incidents and service requests

Who you are:

• You have 7+ years in IT systems, digital operations, and website management within agencies or large organizations (including healthcare or tech), plus proven success leading large-scale or global digital projects.

• You are skilled in developing digital strategies and action plans, managing agencies and stakeholders, and providing expert consultancy to global business teams.

• You have excellent project management, analytical, and technical skills; effective communicator in English with the ability to engage senior leaders and work in global, cross-functional teams.

• You are quick learner, detail-oriented, passionate about technologies, comfortable working under pressure, and dedicated to continuous improvement.

In exchange, we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments,

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
(Major functions of the position)

Medical Strategy and planning

• Accountable for development, delivery and maintenance of DA medical strategy

• Builds deep understanding of the current and future direction of the assigned DA(s)

• Drive the synthesis and translation of complex scientific data/clinical situations into strategy and solutions to optimize care for patients

• Creates and executes long term medical affairs DA strategy

• Ultimately accountable to provide strategic perspective based on a deep understanding of clinical decision-making to inform decisions about unmet medical needs and the impact of clinical data on clinical practice pattern

• Accountable for team development, delivery and maintenance of strategically aligned Medical Plans (on-market & in portfolio) within assigned DA(s)

• Leads Country Medical Managers and Medical Science Manager(MSM) Leaders working on the same product or DA to develop and execute annual medical plan

• Ensure medical plan is to aligned with global medical plan, DA strategy and brand strategy

• Leads Country Medical Managers to periodical update medical plan to reflect the change of the competitive landscape and critical business strategy change if appropriate

• On time, quality and within budget delivery of the medical plan, either directly or through team member(s)

• Supervises team to actively build up internal cross-functional strategic partnership for assigned DA(s), also including global networking

• Acts as point of contact for any strategic discussion on the assigned DA(s)

• Partner effectively across the medical and strategy network, within China cross functions(Access, CPS, PD China, CiCOR) and with global(PD, PDMA & GPS) colleagues to create and deliver options to support short and long-term goals on the assigned DA(s)

• Upgrades the influence level to the global IMT (International Medical Team)

• Accountable for the scientific & strategic leadership for all other key medical activities for the assigned DA(s), including medical information service, epidemiology/outcome research, medical education, medical publications, pharmacovigilance, and biomarker science, etc. to ensure alignment of the overall medical strategy and optimal execution of the medical plan

• Accountable for the medical and scientific support provided to the commercial activities for the product(s) within assigned DA(s), including medical input in the marketing strategy, external professional interaction, sales training, promotional material generation

Evidence generation

• Medical/scientific accountability for formation and execution of high quality clinical studies and other sources of evidence generation (e.g. RWD ), including but not limited to defining study concepts/synopses, protocol development, medical monitoring, final study reports and preparation of data for publication of study results

• Accountable for close collaboration with regulatory and development teams to provide unmet medical needs assessment and product value proposition to ensure an optimal local registration strategy for the new product and/or new indication(s)

• Accountable for identifies potential medical interest for line extensions according to the scientific rationale and the understanding of the actual and anticipated future medical practice in key markets

Knowledge exchange/Data communication

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Foodlicious ist unser Tagesgeschäft
Aus der Taverne Roche ist in über 30 Jahren ein erfolgreiches Gastronomieunternehmen im Bereich der Gemeinschaftsgastronomie entstanden. Die Tavero AG ist eine 100% Tochtergesellschaft der F. Hoffmann-La Roche.
An den Standorten Basel und Kaiseraugst beschäftigen wir rund 350 Mitarbeitende aus über 37 Nationen.Unser Angebot umfasst sowohl Staff Restaurants, die Vielfalt leben, als auch Fine Dining Restaurants mit gehobener Küche und exzellentem Service. Zusätzlich bieten wir Restaurants mit Köstlichkeiten aus aller Welt, Kaffee in allen Varianten, gezaubert von unseren Baristi, sowie die höchstgelegenen Lounges der Schweiz – traumhafte Afterwork-Spots über den Dächern der Stadt. Grab'n'Go-Angebote von Sushi bis Burger und der erste und einzige Club in der Geschichte von Roche ergänzen unser Angebot.
Zusätzlich bieten wir unseren Gästen Sitzungszimmer- und Eventcatering für bis zu 1.500 Personen an. Die öffentlichen Gastronomien, das Schöpfli im Park und das Chez Jeannot im Museum Tinguely, runden unser Angebot ab.

Per sofort suchen wir eine:n Koch EFZ für unsere Staff Restaurants in Basel.

Hauptaufgaben:

• Termingerechte Bereitstellung und Produktion aller Angebotskomponenten sowie Service im jeweiligen Arbeitsbereich

• Kochen im Frontcooking

• Respektvoller Umgang mit dem Produkt

• Zubereitung nach Rezeptur, inkl. Degustation und kontinuierlichem Verbesserungsprozess

• Einhalten von Hygienebestimmungen (TQM / HACCP)

• Wirtschaftliches Arbeiten um Ziele der Firma zu erreichen

• Verantwortlich für die korrekte und ordentliche Lagerung der Waren in den Kühl, Tiefkühl und Lagerbereichen – tägliche Kontrolle

• Sichere Warenbewirtschaftung sowie interne und externe Bestellungen tätigen

• Tägliches führen der Inventarlisten und Mitarbeit bei der monatlichen Inventur

Anforderungsprofil:

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene Kochausbildung (EFZ)

• Du verfügst über mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung (exkl. Ausbildungsjahre)

• Du hast Erfahrung im Bereich des Frontcooking

• Du bist ein Organisationstalent und hast ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Du besitzt ein Durchsetzungsvermögen

• Du hast eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise und übernimmst Verantwortung

• Teamfähigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich

• Einsatzbereitschaft von MO-FR zwischen 6.00 bis 18.00 Uhr möglich

• Du hast Kenntnisse der Schweizer Lebensmittelgesetzgebung

• Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um deine Kunden kompetent beraten zu können

• In einer digitalen Welt wünschen wir uns zudem, einen sicheren Umgang mit Computerprogrammen (MS Office)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Foodlicious è la nostra attività quotidiana Da oltre 30 anni l'osteria Roche è diventata un'azienda di catering di successo nel settore della ristorazione collettiva. Tavero AG è una filiale al 100% di F. Hoffmann-La Roche. Nelle nostre sedi di Basilea e Kaiseraugst diamo lavoro a circa 350 persone provenienti da oltre 37 nazioni. La nostra offerta comprende sia ristoranti per il personale che abbracciano la diversità, sia ristoranti raffinati con una cucina raffinata e un servizio eccellente. Offriamo anche ristoranti con prelibatezze da tutto il mondo, caffè in tutte le varietà, preparato dai nostri baristi, nonché le lounge più alte della Svizzera: fantastici luoghi dopo il lavoro sopra i tetti della città. Le offerte Grab'n'Go dal sushi agli hamburger e il primo e unico club nella storia di Roche completano la nostra offerta. Offriamo inoltre ai nostri ospiti una sala riunioni e un catering per eventi che possono ospitare fino a 1.500 persone. I ristoranti pubblici, lo Schöpfli nel parco e lo Chez Jeannot nel Museo Tinguely, completano la nostra offerta. Cerchiamo subito uno chef EFZ per i nostri ristoranti aziendali a Basilea. Compiti principali:
• Fornitura e produzione tempestiva di tutti i componenti dell'offerta e del servizio nella rispettiva area di lavoro
• Cottura in front cooking
• Gestione rispettosa del prodotto
• Preparazione secondo ricetta, inclusa degustazione e processo di miglioramento continuo
• Rispetto delle norme igieniche (TQM / HACCP)
• Lavoro economico per raggiungere gli obiettivi aziendali
• Responsabile dello stoccaggio corretto e ordinato delle merci nelle aree refrigerate, congelate e di stoccaggio - controllo quotidiano
• Gestione sicura delle merci e immissione di ordini interni ed esterni
• Elenchi di inventario giornalieri e partecipazione all'inventario mensile Requisiti profilo:
• hai completato la formazione culinaria (EFZ)
• hai almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale (esclusi gli anni di formazione)
• hai esperienza nel settore del front cooking
• hai un talento organizzativo e hai un forte senso di responsabilità
• hai assertività
• lavori in modo indipendente e ti assumi responsabilità
• lavoro di squadra e affidabilità sono per te una certezza
• disponibilità a lavorare da MO-FR tra le 6:00 e le 18:00 possibile
• Conoscete la legislazione svizzera in materia alimentare
• Conoscete bene il tedesco e l'inglese scritto e parlato per poter fornire ai vostri clienti una consulenza competente
• In un mondo digitale vogliamo anche essere in grado di utilizzare con sicurezza i programmi informatici (MS Office) Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo si impegnano a far progredire la scienza, garantendo a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi hanno portato a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e a oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Ci diamo la forza reciproca di esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alte le nostre ambizioni, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita e hanno un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità.

The Position
Medical Science Partner in Roche Central Asia (Ophthalmology)

Role purpose
Leads the development and is accountable for implementation of the medical part of dedicated Therapeutic Area (TA) strategy that ensures better pts outcomes by being timely diagnosed and treated, accelerating pts access through medical\scientific value creation and customer centricity.
Accountability for Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Mongolia and Belarus.
Reports to Science Chapter Lead

Requirements\ qualifications

• High education in Medicine is a must

• Previous working experience in ophthalmology is preferred, but not essential

• Established disease area network and strong stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with HCPs and TAEs is preferred

• Experience in building medical\scientific exchange, communication and value creation

• Expert knowledge of disease area\areas

• Fluent English is a must

• Knowledge in Real World Evidence (RWE), experience in working with agile methodologies is a plus

• Position is based in Almaty or in Astana

Critical capabilities

• Clinical Expertise

• Environmental expertise (patient journey, healthcare system landscape, clinical practice landscape, etc.)

• Growing mindset

• Strategic thinking

• Strong communication skills

• Ability to work effectively in Network (both Roche internal and external)

• Fast learner

• Contribute to developing integrated TA (Ophthalmology) strategy aligned to Global strategy

jobs.title: Head of Medical Excellence
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities

 Drive strategic and organizational alignment
- Drive alignment and coordination of goals, priorities, and efforts for the Medical Affairs Department.
- Establish and maintain a structure for co-creation and co-execution of WBO.
- Develop and support the Medical Affairs team around future-looking vision, mission and strategic initiatives.
- Lead cross-therapeutic areas and functions strategic programs to support Medical Affairs priorities.
 Lead operational efforts to execute medical excellence
- Lead in working across boundaries within the broader organization and cross-functional team to establish excellent ways of working/ process workflows.
- Enable the implementation of strategic priorities with a closed-loop management approach.
- Lead in developing integrated medical plan across Medical Affairs department to prioritize tasks to ensure strategic focus and timely execution of deliverables.
- Enable the operational effectiveness of Medical Affairs to manage complexity and oversee the performance; Responsibility for development & delivery of medical dashboard and associated metrics with cross-functional teams by timely collection, reporting and aligned interpretation of performance metrics and key activities across Medical Affairs department.
- Organize regular meetings and activities, ensuring seamless coordination across value chains.
- Gather and prepare internal and external information for the Medical Affairs Head to facilitate key business decisions and generate important speeches/slides.
 Drive for people excellence
- Drive development of Medical Affairs competencies; Oversight of Medical Affairs professional development and training both in terms of technical as well as soft skills.
People development and management to building up the capacity and capability of medical excellence team by providing coaching and feedback to team members.

Qualification and Experience

Education/Qualifications
- Master’s degree and above with Medical, R&D, Marketing, Access or Corporate strategy experience in Pharmaceutical or related industry. MBA or top consulting firm background is a plus.
- Have experience in people leadership.

Leadership Competencies
- A VACC (visionary, architect, coach, catalyst) leader
- Ability to influence and manage in a matrix organization
- Ability to build an effective team and handle difficult people issues
- Excellent influential, communication and negotiation skills
- Strong cross-functional collaboration capability. Self-motivated

Job Required Competencies
- Strategic agility with innovative approaches
- Deep understanding of medical affairs value to the whole business, customer and patients
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Mandarin and English
- Confident in communication with management team, ability to partner and connect with people from all levels of the medical organization.
- Good strategic agility and analytic capability.
- Have the ability to see the big picture as well as the sensitivity to critical details.
- Track record in project management and problem-solving skills to handle complexity.
- High learning agility and open-minded and able to work under pressure.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Always innovating, we bring together dedicated people and diverse perspectives from across our global network, empowering each other to keep breaking new ground.
We are People Insights & Technology (PI&T), part of the People & Culture (P&C) organization. Our vision is to unleash exponential people & business impact through data driven decisions, surfacing actionable insights and embracing people-centric technology.
As part of the People Insights Area of Practice (AoP), we work as one team to unlock the full potential of our people data and technology, informing Roche decisions through research-based insights.

The Opportunity:

Senior Data Engineer to work on an Agile team with other data and software engineers to develop and maintain robust data pipelines and data management systems. Partners closely with data science and business intelligence teams to understand business needs and co-create solutions in service of downstream products. Brings strong attention to detail and a passion for delivering highly accurate and available data to enable downstream insights and drive business value.

• Delivers enhancements to existing data pipelines and develops new pipelines based on defined requirements with minimal guidance

• Demonstrates strong understanding of data engineering tools and concepts and considered a SME for most, if not all pipelines

• Detail-oriented mindset and co-creates pipelines with secure, well-validated data across multiple system domains with other squad members in a way that aligns with long-term strategy for People Insights

Who You Are:

• 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field. Advanced degrees or certifications in technical or leadership competencies can be advantageous

• Python experience (Pandas preferred)

• CI/CD tools and methodologies (GitLab, branches, code reviews, merge requests, etc)

• Understanding of DataOps Practices

• RDBMS/NoSQL

• Docker experience

• AWS experience preferred (EC2 / Lambda / Glue / S3)

• Snowflake or similar cloud data platform experience preferred

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 115,328.00 and 151,368.00 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company.
We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role.

This posting is for an existing vacancy at Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity
Planning and Financial Management:

• Proactively acquires a deep understanding of the external environment (healthcare system, policies and reforms) to anticipate future trends and formulates a strategic view of market, competition and products erosion in short term and long term

• Localize and define life cycle management strategy for products in charge.

• Develop a deep understanding of key stakeholders, including key accounts, payers, patient advocacy groups, professional associations, and policymakers, and develop development plans for the top clinical opinion leaders for the therapy area.

• Build marketing plans analyzing the relevant markets and defining long- and short-term qualitative and quantitative objectives.

• Where relevant, implement the launch excellence framework to build leading launch plans.

• Translates the brand plan into a strong actionable operational plan with clear goals, actions, accountabilities, and measures across the cross-functional team.

• Sets responsible and challenging goals with appropriate KPIs for the brand that have a clear positive impact on business performance.

• Ensure brand-in-charge performance

Resource Management / Marketing Excellence

• Ensuring the good implementation of tactical plans by collaborating with cross-functional team (Sales Force/Market Access/Medical Affairs/SFE)

• Ensuring supply and healthy stock.

• Optimizing segmentation and targeting strategies for the products under management.

• Build brand communication package implement for activities to make sure quality and brand engagement & reach

• Key in charge for the Brand KPIs (Lead, Lag), sales performance, and A&P

Tactical Market Plan / Implementation

• Achieving Marketing objectives as agreed with management, managing the development and implementation of marketing plans consistent with approval strategy

• Ensuring the achievement of products’ budget in the approved BP and integrated marketing plan.

• Accountable for ensuring compliance’s rules & ethical code when working with healthcare professionals to strengthen the company’s image.

• Ensure all the support for the sales team/MA team comply with relevant acts, legal demand and ethical standards and in line with marketing plan

• Innovation and MCM apply in activities

Who you are

• Bachelor's or master's degree in Health/Science/Pharmaceutical or Medical disciplines

• Multinational companies' experiences in healthcare industry

• At least 3 year experience in Pharma / Diagnostic industry

A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. La tua opportunità Pianificazione e gestione finanziaria:
• Proattivamente acquisisce una profonda comprensione dell'ambiente esterno (sistema sanitario, politiche e riforme) per anticipare le tendenze future e formula una visione strategica del mercato, della concorrenza e dell'erosione dei prodotti a breve termine e a lungo termine
• Localizzare e definire la strategia di gestione del ciclo di vita per i prodotti responsabili.
• Sviluppare una profonda comprensione dei principali stakeholder, tra cui account chiave, payers, gruppi di advocacy pazienti, associazioni professionali e responsabili politici, e sviluppare piani di sviluppo per i migliori leader di opinione clinica per l'area della terapia.
• Costruire piani di marketing analizzando i mercati pertinenti e definendo obiettivi qualitativi e quantitativi a lungo e a breve termine.
• Dove rilevante, implementare il framework di eccellenza di lancio per costruire i principali piani di lancio.
• Traduci il brand plan in un forte piano operativo attuabile con obiettivi chiari, azioni, responsabilità e misure attraverso il team interfunzionale.
• Imposta obiettivi responsabili e stimolanti con i KPI appropriati per il marchio che hanno un chiaro impatto positivo sulle prestazioni aziendali.
• Assicurare prestazioni di marca in carica Gestione risorse / Eccellenza di marketing
• Garantire la buona attuazione dei piani tattici collaborando con il team interfunzionale (Sales Force/Market Access/Medical Affairs/SFE)
• Garantire la fornitura e la scorta sana.
• Ottimizzare le strategie di segmentazione e di targeting per i prodotti in gestione.
• Costruire il pacchetto di comunicazione del marchio per le attività per assicurarsi qualità e impegno del marchio & raggiungere
• Key in carica per i Brand KPI (Lead, Lag), le prestazioni di vendita e A&P Piano di mercato tattico / Attuazione
• Raggiungere obiettivi di marketing concordati con la gestione, la gestione dello sviluppo e l'attuazione di piani di marketing coerenti con la strategia di approvazione
• Garantire il raggiungimento del bilancio dei prodotti nel BP approvato e nel piano di marketing integrato.
• Contabile per garantire le regole di conformità e il codice etico quando si lavora con i professionisti del settore sanitario per rafforzare l’immagine dell’azienda.
• Assicurarsi che tutto il supporto per il team di vendita/MA sia conforme agli atti pertinenti, alla domanda legale e agli standard etici e in linea con il piano di marketing
• Innovazione e MCM si applicano nelle attività Chi sei
• Corso di laurea o master in Scienze della salute / Scienza/Pharmaceutica o discipline mediche
• Esperienze multinazionali nel settore sanitario
• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico / diagnostico Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati all’avanzamento della scienza, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro di parità di opportunità.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Your Opportunity Planning and Financial Management:
• Proactively acquires a deep understanding of the external environment (healthcare system, policies and reforms) to anticipate future trends and formulates a strategic view of market, competition and products erosion in short term and long term
• Localize and define life cycle management strategy for products in charge.
• Develop a deep understanding of key stakeholders, including key accounts, payers, patient advocacy groups, professional associations, and policymakers, and develop development plans for the top clinical opinion leaders for the therapy area.
• Build marketing plans analyzing the relevant markets and defining long- and short-term qualitative and quantitative objectives.
• Where relevant, implement the launch excellence framework to build leading launch plans.
• Translates the brand plan into a strong actionable operational plan with clear goals, actions, accountabilities, and measures across the cross-functional team.
• Sets responsible and challenging goals with appropriate KPIs for the brand that have a clear positive impact on business performance.
• Ensure brand-in-charge performance Resource Management / Marketing Excellence
• Ensuring the good implementation of tactical plans by collaborating with cross-functional team (Sales Force/Market Access/Medical Affairs/SFE)
• Ensuring supply and healthy stock.
• Optimizing segmentation and targeting strategies for the products under management.
• Build brand communication package implement for activities to make sure quality and brand engagement & reach
• Key in charge for the Brand KPIs (Lead, Lag), sales performance, and A&P Tactical Market Plan / Implementation
• Achieving Marketing objectives as agreed with management, managing the development and implementation of marketing plans consistent with approval strategy
• Ensuring the achievement of products’ budget in the approved BP and integrated marketing plan.
• Accountable for ensuring compliance’s rules & ethical code when working with healthcare professionals to strengthen the company’s image.
• Ensure all the support for the sales team/MA team comply with relevant acts, legal demand and ethical standards and in line with marketing plan
• Innovation and MCM apply in activities Who you are
• Bachelor's or master's degree in Health/Science/Pharmaceutical or Medical disciplines
• Multinational companies' experiences in healthcare industry
• At least 3 year experience in Pharma / Diagnostic industry Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Ihre Chance Planung und Finanzmanagement:
• Erwirbt proaktiv ein tiefes Verständnis des externen Umfelds (Gesundheitssystem, Politik und Reformen), um zukünftige Trends zu antizipieren, und formuliert eine strategische Sicht auf kurz- und langfristige Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Produkterosion
• Lokalisieren und definieren Sie die Life-Cycle-Management-Strategie für die verantwortlichen Produkte.
• Entwickeln Sie ein tiefes Verständnis der wichtigsten Stakeholder, einschließlich Key Accounts, Kostenträger, Patientenvertretungsgruppen, Berufsverbände und politische Entscheidungsträger, und entwickeln Sie Entwicklungspläne für die wichtigsten klinischen Meinungsführer für den Therapiebereich.
• Erstellen Sie Marketingpläne, die die relevanten Märkte analysieren und langfristige und kurzfristige qualitative und quantitative Ziele definieren.
• Gegebenenfalls Umsetzung des Exzellenzrahmens für den Start, um führende Startpläne zu erstellen.
• Übersetzt den Markenplan in einen umsetzbaren Betriebsplan mit klaren Zielen, Maßnahmen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Maßnahmen im gesamten funktionsübergreifenden Team.
• Setzt verantwortungsvolle und anspruchsvolle Ziele mit geeigneten KPIs für die Marke, die sich eindeutig positiv auf die Geschäftsentwicklung auswirken.
• Gewährleistung der Brand-in-Charge-Leistung Resource Management / Marketing Excellence
• Sicherstellung der guten Umsetzung taktischer Pläne durch die Zusammenarbeit mit dem funktionsübergreifenden Team (Sales Force / Market Access / Medical Affairs / SFE)
• Versorgung und gesunde Bestände sichern.
• Optimierung von Segmentierungs- und Targetingstrategien für die verwalteten Produkte.
• Erstellen Sie ein Markenkommunikationspaket für Aktivitäten, um Qualität und Markenbindung und -reichweite sicherzustellen
• Verantwortlich für die Marken-KPIs (Lead, Lag), die Verkaufsleistung und A&P Taktischer Marktplan / Umsetzung
• Erreichung der mit dem Management vereinbarten Marketingziele, Verwaltung der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Marketingplänen im Einklang mit der Genehmigungsstrategie
• Sicherstellung der Erreichung des Produktbudgets im genehmigten BP und integrierten Marketingplan.
• Verantwortlich für die Gewährleistung der Compliance-Regeln und des Ethikkodex bei der Zusammenarbeit mit Gesundheitsexperten, um das Image des Unternehmens zu stärken.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die gesamte Unterstützung für das Verkaufsteam / MA-Team den einschlägigen Gesetzen, gesetzlichen Anforderungen und ethischen Standards sowie dem Marketingplan entspricht
• Innovation und MCM gelten in Aktivitäten Wer du bist
• Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in den Disziplinen Gesundheit/Wissenschaft/Pharma oder Medizin
• Erfahrungen multinationaler Unternehmen in der Gesundheitsbranche
• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Pharma- / Diagnoseindustrie Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Weiterentwicklung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Votre opportunité Planification et gestion financière :
• Acquérir une connaissance approfondie de l'environnement extérieur (système de soins de santé, politiques et réformes) pour anticiper les tendances futures et formuler une vision stratégique de l'érosion du marché, de la concurrence et des produits à court et à long terme
• Localiser et définir la stratégie de gestion du cycle de vie des produits en charge.
• Développer une compréhension approfondie des principaux intervenants, y compris les comptes clés, les payeurs, les groupes de défense des patients, les associations professionnelles et les décideurs, et élaborer des plans de développement pour les principaux leaders d'opinion clinique dans le domaine de la thérapie.
• Élaborer des plans de commercialisation analysant les marchés pertinents et définissant des objectifs qualitatifs et quantitatifs à long et à court terme.
• Le cas échéant, mettre en œuvre le cadre d'excellence du lancement pour élaborer des plans de lancement de premier plan.
• Traduit le plan d'image de marque en un solide plan opérationnel réalisable avec des objectifs clairs, des actions, des responsabilités et des mesures à l'échelle de l'équipe interfonctionnelle.
• Définit des objectifs responsables et stimulants avec des ICR appropriés pour la marque qui ont un impact positif évident sur la performance des entreprises.
• Assurer la performance de la marque en charge Gestion des ressources / Excellence en marketing
• Assurer la bonne mise en œuvre des plans tactiques en collaborant avec l'équipe interfonctionnelle (Force de vente/Accès au marché/Affaires médicales/SFE)
• Assurer l'approvisionnement et la santé des stocks.
• Optimiser la segmentation et les stratégies de ciblage des produits sous gestion.
• Construire un paquet de communication de marque implémenter pour les activités pour assurer la qualité et l'engagement de la marque & atteindre
• Clé en charge des ICR de marque (lead, lag), performance des ventes, et A&P Plan tactique du marché / Mise en oeuvre
• Réalisation des objectifs de marketing convenus avec la direction, gestion de l'élaboration et de la mise en oeuvre de plans de marketing conformes à la stratégie d'approbation
• Assurer la réalisation du budget des produits dans le BP approuvé et le plan de commercialisation intégré.
• Responsabilité pour assurer la conformité aux règles & code éthique lors du travail avec les professionnels de la santé pour renforcer l'image de l'entreprise.
• Veiller à ce que tout le soutien apporté à l'équipe commerciale/l'équipe de l'AM soit conforme aux lois pertinentes, aux exigences légales et aux normes éthiques et conforme au plan de marketing
• Innovation et MCM s'appliquent aux activités Qui vous êtes
• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences de la santé/sciences/pharmaceutiques ou médicales
• Expériences des entreprises multinationales dans le secteur de la santé
• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en Pharma / Diagnostic Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Sales Executive - HCM
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.
As a Sales Executive you will manage Account and Ensure Sales Achievement in Assigned Territory & Product lines, assist District Sales Manager in relieving their duties whenever necessary.

Your opportunity

• Manage existing Accounts actively to ensure long-term partnership and customer satisfaction pro-actively

• Develop new accounts with proper and close follow-up of sales opportunity

• Develop and maintains good customer relationships with important and relevant personnel

• Proactive and creative solve problems in managing customers’ complaint by proper investigation and close follow-up in resolving issues (eg: product deliveries/application troubleshooting)

• Coordinate with Distribution partner /Third Party to better serve customers

• Work closely with the Professional Service team to deliver the post-sales service for the maximum customers’ satisfaction.

Who you are

• Have Bachelor in Health/Science

• Have 3 year multinational companies experience in Pharmaceutical/ Diagnostic/ Healthcare industrial sales

• Have effective communication and interpersonal skill

• Have creative problem solving and negotiation skill

• Have customer complaint handling skill

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.de: Projektmanager (m/w/d) für große Automatisierungsprojekte - Metropolregion Berlin
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de projet (m/f/d) pour les grands projets d'automatisation - Région métropolitaine de Berlin

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Stell Dir vor, Du bist der Architekt hinter den Kulissen, der die Vision einer vollautomatisierten Gesundheitsversorgung Realität werden lässt. Bei Roche Diagnostics treiben wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit jeder Mensch die bestmögliche Behandlung erhält. Als Projektmanager bist Du die treibende Kraft, die komplexe Laborsysteme zum Leben erweckt und so einen direkten Einfluss auf die Schnelligkeit und Präzision von Diagnosen für Millionen von Patient:innen weltweit nimmt.

Dein neues Team:
Du wirst Teil unseres Teams Field Force Workflow Solutions im Customer Service Außendienst. Wir sind eine dynamische Gemeinschaft aus Spezialist:innen, die technische Exzellenz, Erfahrung mit Laborprozessen mit einer großen Portion Teamgeist verbindet.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Labordiagnostik durch professionelles Projektmanagement und Workflow-Optimierung:

• Du leitest überregionale Implementierungsprojekte für Automatisierungslösungen und behältst dabei Planung, Steuerung und Kontrolle fest im Griff.

• Du koordinierst Teilprojektleiter:innen sowie externe Partner, um Projektziele termingerecht und in höchster Qualität zu erreichen.

• Du steuerst die Kommunikation zu unseren Kunden und internen Stakeholdern und begleitest Veränderungsprozesse durch aktives Change Management.

• Du wirkst bei technischen Installationen mit, führst Testläufe durch und trainierst Kunden, um ihre Workflows perfekt auf ihre Bedürfnisse abzustimmen.

• Du analysierst abgeschlossene Projekte ("Lessons Learned"), optimierst unsere Prozesse und berätst Kunden als Spezialist:in für Prozessoptimierung.

• Du unterstützt internationale Länderorganisationen bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Standards und Best Practices.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du verstehst es, Menschen für technische Innovationen zu begeistern und behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick:

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen (z. B. Medizintechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik), Biologie, IT oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Projekte sowie sichere Kenntnisse in modernen Projektmanagement-Methoden und -Tools mit.

• Umfangreiche Führungserfahrungen in Matrix-Organisationen helfen Dir dabei, Teams zu motivieren und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

• Du hast ein Verständnis für Abläufe in medizinischen Laboren und begeisterst Dich für Software- sowie Netzwerktechnik.

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, auch auf Management-Ebene (C-Level), und überzeugst durch ein souveränes Auftreten.

• Ein Führerschein Klasse B sowie die Bereitschaft zu (internationalen) Dienstreisen und gelegentlichen Rufbereitschaften sind für Dich selbstverständlich.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser.

Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens: 07.04.2026
(Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist)

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugniss

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Mobile Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior DevOps Mobile Engineer
Sant Cugat del Vallès, Barcelona

The Patient Software Insights group within Roche Information Solutions (RIS) is responsible for a portfolio of software solutions that support healthcare providers and patients across various applications and disease areas.

For a quick look at what we do, check out Roche tech4life .

The Opportunity:
Developing software is great, but developing software with a purpose is even better! As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and QA experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software development practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users' lives at risk!

You will oversee application releases and manage the automation process to support building our applications. Tasks may include scripting, testing, troubleshooting problems, and communicating issues to software engineers.

Who you are:
We seek an experienced, motivated DevOps Mobile Engineer who will work closely with engineers and our product teams. Required skills to accomplish your mission:

• At least 5 years of hands-on experience automating CI/CD pipelines specifically for mobile apps.

• Strong skills with mobile development platforms and tools like Fastlane, Apple App Store Connect, Google Play Console, TestFlight, Firebase, and managing certificates.

• Experience working with Python or a similar language.

• Deep experience in:

• Setting up and maintaining CI systems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).

• Building containers (Containerd, Docker).

• Managing artifact repositories (Nexus, Artifactory).

• Integrating SAST and DAST security tools (SonarQube, Mayhem, Trivy).

• A real enthusiasm for teamwork and helping others across different teams.

• A desire to mentor colleagues and share your knowledge.

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

The following skills significantly strengthen your application:

• Familiarity with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other cloud platforms.

• Experience in building and testing mobile applications (e.g., Device Farm) and feature flags.

• Background in developing digital products such as SaaS, marketplaces, and e-commerce platforms.

• Knowledge of the diabetes or similar healthcare industries.

Here's what you can expect from us:

• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products

• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams

• We welcome technical evangelists, so if you are interested in any thought leadership contributions (blogs, conferences) within the realm of the organization, we are happy to support you.

• Loads of benefits (brand new Apple hardware, fitness, public transport, lunch benefit, language classes, professional training budget,...)

You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, from native mobile development to infrastructure-as-code in our cloud environment, gaining a rich understanding of the specific requirements of medical software, be it security, medical risk management, safe and resilient programming, or certifications and audits.

You will have direct contact with our users, learning about their daily struggles living with diabetes, as well as customers and partners, understanding the unique needs and mechanics of healthcar

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a Team Lead Engineering Manager to lead our Enterprise Identity Management Reliability Team, supporting a mission-critical SailPoint IIQ platform and transforming how identity services operate at scale in a global, highly regulated environment. This platform sits at the core of our Identity Governance strategy, ensuring secure, seamless access for thousands of users across the organization. In this role, you won’t just keep the lights on—you’ll help us redefine how reliability is built and sustained. You will lead the shift from reactive support to a proactive, automation-driven SRE model, improving performance, scalability, and overall user experience. At its core, this role is about building empowered teams, creating reliable systems, and driving meaningful change in how identity services are delivered at scale.

The Opportunity

• Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement

• Support team members in shaping their career paths while removing roadblocks and maintaining a healthy, sustainable pace

• Drive improvements in platform reliability, stability, and performance in a complex, high-volume environment

• Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and implement automation to improve efficiency and scalability

• Partner closely with Product, Security, Infrastructure, and business teams to deliver reliable and secure identity services

• Oversee Managed Service Provider (MSP) performance, ensuring accountability, SLA adherence, and service quality

• Bring structure and clarity to operations through better monitoring, incident management, and continuous optimization

​
Who you are

• Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field.

• 5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering or technical teams

• Experience working in pharma, biotech, or other regulated industries

• Strong experience in Identity & Access Management (SailPoint IIQ is a strong plus)

• Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management (Joiner, Mover, Leaver) and Access Governance in regulated and large-scale environments.

• Solid understanding of running production systems (monitoring, alerting, incident response, performance tuning)

• Experience with tools like Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, or similar observability platforms

• Experience managing SailPoint IIQ upgrades, patches, and regression testing

• Ability to navigate complexity, manage stakeholders, and drive outcomes in a global environment

• Experience working with managed service providers or system integrators

• Professional Information Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM) are a plus.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Principal Design Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Device Development function within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support.
The Device Engineering department combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities.

The Opportunity

• In this role, you will have considerable cross-functional interaction, notably including QA, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Commercial functions. This role reports to the Section Head of Device Engineering and is integrated into Roche’s Device Development function.

• Technical Leadership: Act as a technical expert to successfully bring combination products and medical devices to the market. Lead the evaluation of new and breakthrough technologies.

• Engineering Excellence: Apply advanced engineering theory to establish robust technical product requirements and develop reliable design solutions. Use Digital Twins to verify that devices consistently meet performance requirements across the full product lifecycle. Rigorously assess design robustness and reliability through simulation-based methods, including finite element analysis (FEA), tolerance analysis, and other predictive engineering tools.

• Design for Manufacturing : Leverage deep expertise in injection molding, tool design, and mold flow analysis to ensure designs are optimized for large-scale production.

• Design Control: Author design control documentation (Design Development Plans, URS, Design Inputs/Outputs, Design Verification Plans, and DHF creation/maintenance), conformity assessments, and risk management documentation.

• Project Management: Forecast and plan resource demands for device development projects. Execute projects within the agreed time, quality, and cost constraints, utilizing Lean management principles to drive efficiency and state-of-the-art results.

• Compliance: Apply knowledge of the regulatory landscape to ensure standard compliant designs (e.g., ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO 14971, and 21 CFR 820.30).

Who You Are

• Education: You have a university-level education (engineering degree or related discipline).

• Experience: You have a minimum 10-year proven track record in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development in pharma or other closely regulated environments (cGxP, QSR).

• Specialization: You have hands-on Pen injector / Auto injector development expertise.

• Technical Toolbox: You possess strong engineering expertise including CAD construction, Simulation (FEM, Monte Carlo), reliability engineering, and Material Science.

• Analytical Skills: You have demonstrable knowledge of Tolerance Analysis, statistical techniques, process capability, and manufacturing processes.

• Regulatory Savvy: You have sound knowledge of legislation, industry standards, and experience with Health Authority interactions.

• Methodology: You have a demonstrated application of Lean management principles in a technical development environment.

• Communication: You possess excellent documentation, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Languages: You have an excellent command of the English language; proficiency in German is preferable.
