jobs.title: Senior Intelligence Manager (Measurement)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Group Communications (GC) is responsible for creating a lasting positive image of Roche and representing the company's voice on a Group level. We communicate Roche’s strategy and how we deliver on our purpose of “Doing now what patients need next” to Roche colleagues and external audiences. We drive integrated and global campaigns and provide platforms for communications business partners as well as our affiliates to engage with audiences. We contribute to building trust of key stakeholders, managing Roche’s brand and reputation, and building a favorable environment for our business. We aspire to be innovative, forward-looking, creative, and courageous, representing a strong, integrated corporate brand and audience experience where people can thrive, learn new skills, and create great things together.

The Role
The Senior Intelligence Manager (Measurement) is responsible for defining, enabling, and scaling how Roche measures the impact of its digital communications across internal and external audiences. This role goes beyond performance tracking, focusing on building and enhancing the foundations that make measurement effective, consistent, and scalable while shaping how data is collected, structured, and activated across the organization. You will work across measurement frameworks, data architecture, and emerging discovery ecosystems to ensure Roche not only understands performance but is equipped to continuously improve it.

The Opportunity
As a Senior Intelligence Manager, you will have the chance to shape the future of our digital impact and data architecture.

• Measure and Report Performance: Track Roche’s paid and organic activity across global channels, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights and narratives that inform business strategies.

• Define Measurement Frameworks: Evolve frameworks for both holistic and campaign-specific KPIs to enable benchmarking, optimisation, and long-term organisational learning.

• Design Data Ecosystems: Partner with IT and data engineering to design scalable data pipelines, ensuring automated ingestion and integration of data into centralised environments like data lakes.

• Establish Data Standards: Set best practices for data layers and tracking frameworks to ensure consistent, accurate data collection across all platforms, channels, and markets.

• Drive Research and Insights: Derive insights from social and audience data using analytics, listening, and custom research to build a single source of truth for communications performance.

• Innovate with Emerging Tech: Explore measurement approaches for Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) to improve Roche’s visibility within AI-driven search and discovery environments.

• Enable Global Collaboration: Partner with Internal Communications to align standards and coach colleagues, fostering a culture of data-driven decision-making and technical excellence.

Who You Are
We are looking for a strategic thinker who blends technical expertise with the ability to influence and collaborate across a global organisation.

• Experienced Expert: You possess a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent and a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in social media intelligence or digital analysis.

• Technical Proficient: You are adept at using tools such as Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Google Analytics, Snowflake, and Power BI, with preferred experience in Tableau, Data Studio, or Python.

• Analytical Strategist: You have proven abilities in measurement, critical thinking, and deci

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Group Communications (GC) è responsabile della creazione di un'immagine positiva duratura di Roche e della rappresentazione della voce dell'azienda a livello di Gruppo. Comunichiamo la strategia di Roche e come distribuiamo sul nostro scopo di “fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno accanto” ai colleghi Roche e al pubblico esterno. Noi guidiamo campagne integrate e globali e forniamo piattaforme per i partner commerciali di comunicazione e le nostre affiliate per coinvolgere il pubblico. Contribuiamo a costruire la fiducia dei principali stakeholder, la gestione del marchio e della reputazione di Roche, e la costruzione di un ambiente favorevole per il nostro business. Noi aspiriamo ad essere innovativi, all'avanguardia, creativi e coraggiosi, rappresentando un'esperienza consolidata e integrata del brand aziendale e del pubblico in cui le persone possono prosperare, imparare nuove competenze e creare grandi cose insieme. Il ruolo Il Senior Intelligence Manager (Measurement) è responsabile di definire, abilitare e scalare come Roche misura l'impatto delle sue comunicazioni digitali attraverso il pubblico interno ed esterno. Questo ruolo va oltre il monitoraggio delle prestazioni, concentrandosi sulla costruzione e migliorare le basi che rendono la misurazione efficace, coerente e scalabile durante la modellazione come i dati vengono raccolti, strutturati e attivati in tutta l'organizzazione. Potrai lavorare attraverso i framework di misura, l'architettura dei dati e gli ecosistemi di scoperta emergenti per garantire che Roche non solo comprenda le prestazioni, ma è attrezzato per migliorare continuamente. L'opportunità Come Senior Intelligence Manager, avrai la possibilità di plasmare il futuro del nostro impatto digitale e dell'architettura dei dati.
• Misura e report Performance: Traccia l’attività pagata e organica di Roche nei canali globali, traducendo i dati complessi in chiare e attuabili intuizioni e narrazioni che informano le strategie aziendali.
• Definire i framework di misura: Evolve framework per KPI olistici e specifici per le campagne per consentire il benchmarking, l'ottimizzazione e l'apprendimento organizzativo a lungo termine.
• Design Data Ecosystems: Partner dell'IT e dell'ingegneria dei dati per la progettazione di datadotti scalabili, garantendo l'ingestione automatizzata e l'integrazione dei dati in ambienti centralizzati come data lake.
• Stabilire gli standard di dati: impostare le migliori pratiche per gli strati di dati e i framework di monitoraggio per garantire una raccolta coerente e accurata dei dati su tutte le piattaforme, canali e mercati.
• Drive Research and Insights: approfondimenti di dati sociali e di pubblico utilizzando analisi, ascolto e ricerca personalizzata per costruire un'unica fonte di verità per le prestazioni delle comunicazioni.
• Innovare con Emerging Tech: Esplora gli approcci di misura per l'ottimizzazione del motore Generativo (GEO) per migliorare la visibilità di Roche all'interno di ambienti di ricerca e scoperta basati su AI.
• Abilitare la collaborazione globale: collaborare con le comunicazioni interne per allineare gli standard e i colleghi di coach, promuovere una cultura del processo decisionale e dell'eccellenza tecnica basata sui dati. Chi sei Stiamo cercando un pensatore strategico che fonde competenze tecniche con la capacità di influenzare e collaborare in un'organizzazione globale.
• Esperto esperto: possiedi un diploma di laurea o equivalente e un minimo di 7 anni di esperienza rilevante nell'intelligenza dei social media o nell'analisi digitale.
• Technical Proficient: Lei è abile nell'utilizzo di strumenti come Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Google Analytics, Snowflake e Power BI, con esperienza preferita in Tableau, Data Studio o Python.
• Strategista analitico: hai comprovate capacità di misura, pensiero critico e deci

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Group Communications (GC) ist verantwortlich für die Schaffung eines dauerhaften positiven Images von Roche und vertritt die Stimme des Unternehmens auf Konzernebene. Wir kommunizieren Roches Strategie und wie wir zu unserem Zweck liefern, „das, was Patienten als Nächstes brauchen“, mit Roche-Kollegen und externen Publikum. Wir treiben integrierte und globale Kampagnen an und bieten Plattformen für Kommunikations-Geschäftspartner sowie unsere Partner, um sich mit Publikum zu engagieren. Wir tragen dazu bei, das Vertrauen der wichtigsten Interessenvertreter zu stärken, die Marke und den Ruf von Roche zu verwalten und ein günstiges Umfeld für unser Unternehmen zu schaffen. Wir bemühen uns, innovative, zukunftsweisende, kreative und mutige zu sein, was eine starke, integrierte Unternehmensmarke und Publikumserfahrung darstellt, in der Menschen neue Fähigkeiten erlernen und großartige Dinge gemeinsam schaffen können. Die Rolle Der Senior Intelligence Manager (Measurement) ist dafür verantwortlich, die Auswirkungen seiner digitalen Kommunikation auf interne und externe Publikum zu definieren, zu ermöglichen und zu skalieren. Diese Rolle geht über Performance-Tracking hinaus, konzentriert sich auf den Aufbau und die Verbesserung der Grundlagen, die Messung effektiv, konsistent und skalierbar machen, während die Formgebung, wie Daten gesammelt, strukturiert und aktiviert über die Organisation. Sie werden über Messrahmen, Datenarchitektur und aufstrebende Entdeckungsökosysteme arbeiten, um sicherzustellen, dass Roche nicht nur die Leistung versteht, sondern dazu ausgestattet ist, sie kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Nous menons des campagnes intégrées et mondiales et fournissons des plates-formes aux partenaires commerciaux de la communication ainsi qu'à nos affiliés pour s'engager auprès du public. • Définir des cadres de mesure: Evoluer des cadres pour des ICR holistiques et propres à une campagne afin de permettre l'étalonnage, l'optimisation et l'apprentissage organisationnel à long terme.
• Conception d'écosystèmes de données: partenariat avec l'informatique et l'ingénierie des données pour concevoir des pipelines de données évolutives, assurant l'ingestion automatisée et l'intégration des données dans des environnements centralisés comme les lacs de données.
• Établir des normes en matière de données: définir les meilleures pratiques pour les couches de données et les cadres de suivi afin d'assurer une collecte cohérente et précise des données sur toutes les plateformes, tous les canaux et tous les marchés.

titleByLocale.it: Learning Systems & Solutions Analista - Sostituzione maternità
titleByLocale.en: Learning Systems & Solutions Analyst - Maternity cover
titleByLocale.fr: Learning Systems & Solutions Analyste - Remplacement maternité

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Please note this is a fixed-term maternity cover role.

The Global Learning Services teams focus on executing system data maintenance and administrative activities in Cornerstone and all relevant Learning management systems as well as providing all necessary non-systems related Learning process support. Global Learning Services provides customer service and advisory support to the Learning Community and business partners on global Learning systems and processes and ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business.

The Opportunity:
As a Learning Systems & Solutions Analyst you work closely with internal Global Learning Services, People Support Solutions, Learning IT staff, business leaders and Learning system vendors to effectively meet the Learning technology needs of the organization. Partner with global and local counterparts to represent business needs within the larger global People Support Solutions organization on behalf of Global Learning Services and the wider Learning community. Your responsibilities include supporting and maintaining of the Cornerstone On Demand system, in addition to other interfaced systems used within the People Support Solutions organization and Learning community.

• Serve as a technical/functional point-of-contact for Global Learning Services teams and related business groups. Work with other Technology Analysts, Learning Service Advisors, the Learning Center of Excellence and Global Learning Services teams on the development of new enhanced functionality requests, which includes reviewing enhancements and functionality provided by Cornerstone and other HR Technology/HRIS systems. May require development of training materials/content including coordination and execution.

• Perform varied and complex tasks associated with the support of Roche’s Cornerstone system, as well as support and provide system administration on other learning related systems, i.e. case management system.

• Serve as subject matter expert and provide support to the Learning Center of Excellence and Global Learning Services with a focus on business processes and application support activities including release management, application optimization, system role assignments/access, and incident & problem resolution, gathering requirements and specifications from users, creating specification documents, work with HR, the Learning community and IT teams to configure enhancements in system, and serves as linkage to IT for technical enhancements and investigations.

• Provide troubleshooting support and resolution for People Support Solutions as appropriate for system related issues (i.e. Cornerstone, ServiceNow)

• Partner with local and global teams on the implementation of new systems and initiatives across People Support Solutions

• Support the development of training content and delivery as needed and ensure consistent and reliable service delivery for customers serviced and i mplement processes and initiatives to ensure continuous improvement as well as service enhancement.

• Ensure end to end ownership of resolution, operations according to defined KPIs and SLAs, and ensure regulatory compliance in line with the countries, customers, and regulations.

• Collaborate with peers within the region and globally to ensure the People Support Solutions network provides consistent and effective services to our customers and achieve our People Support Solutions vision by dr

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
规范诊疗
•基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域相关科学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案。
•基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识。
•运用专业知识，向病理科医生传递诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升。

学科建设
•拜访临床及病理医生，维护客户关系，按时按质的完成相关客户洞见，尤其重点专家对于疾病领域洞见的收集并进行总结/分析/反馈。
•组织/协调/整合各类疾病领域学术会议，推动建立疾病领域治疗规范。
•与PI和Sub-PI合作，使符合入组标准的患者及时入组。

团队协作
•主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 多产品资源整合能力
• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限
•3年以上医药行业工作经验
•既往有销售/市场/医学经验
•跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度 /所获资格证书
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Within the Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE), the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization drives the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems. We integrate digital technologies across Research and Early Development to power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making for scientists to ultimately result in outcomes for patients worldwide.

As an engineer for the Automation Core team within the Engineering - Lab Automation team, you will be a key contributor to the architecture and delivery of core automation control and data frameworks in the research labs. You will empower our scientists with reliable, interconnected systems, taking ownership of significant features to ensure the development of scalable and reliable integration solutions.

The Opportunity

To excel in this role, you will bridge the gap between complex software engineering and laboratory research in drug discovery through the following responsibilities:

• Build the Framework: Design and deploy robust and complex, cross-vendor frameworks for integrating with automated systems and workcells in labs.

• Partner with Scientists: Collaborate directly with end-users and product managers to rapidly iterate and translate complex needs into technical solutions.

• Span the Stack: Apply best practices in distributed systems and data engineering, contributing across the technology stack wherever needed.

• Senior Scope: Act as a key contributor by owning significant components of the framework and providing technical guidance to the team

• Principal Scope: Drive the technical roadmap for the core automation control and data frameworks, ensuring alignment with the strategic needs of our drug discovery organizations.

Who You Are

You are a driven engineer who thrives at the intersection of software design and scientific innovation, meeting the following minimum criteria:

• Background: You hold at least a B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with 4+ years of experience as a backend, data or product engineer.

• Core Stack: Strong passion for software engineering with expert-level proficiency in Python and/or Java, with deep expertise in cloud-native architectures (ideally AWS) and distributed systems.

• Innovative Mindset : You are passionate about continuous engagement with end-users and have an interest in modern trends, such as AI-assisted coding and front-end development with TypeScript/JavaScript.

• Leadership & Communication : You are a skilled communicator capable of building trusted partnerships with scientists and defining high-level technical architecture for complex work.

• Principal Experience: 7+ years of progressive software architecture experience specifically within the Biotech/Pharma industry.

• Principal Domain Expertise: Deep, hands-on knowledge of lab workflows, integrated workcells, and automation control systems (e.g., liquid handlers, robotic arms) is essential.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. All'interno del Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE), l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) guida l'ammodernamento dei nostri ecosistemi di calcolo e dati. Integriamo le tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per alimentare la scienza basata sui dati e accelerare il processo decisionale per gli scienziati per portare alla fine i risultati per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. In qualità di ingegnere del team Automation Core all'interno del team Engineering - Lab Automation, sarai un contributore chiave all'architettura e alla consegna del controllo core dell'automazione e dei framework di dati nei laboratori di ricerca. Potenzierà i nostri scienziati con sistemi affidabili e interconnessi, assumendo la proprietà di caratteristiche significative per garantire lo sviluppo di soluzioni di integrazione scalabili e affidabili. L'opportunità Per eccellere in questo ruolo, colmare il divario tra la complessa ingegneria del software e la ricerca di laboratorio nella scoperta della droga attraverso le seguenti responsabilità:
• Costruire il Quadro: Progettare e implementare strutture robuste e complesse per l'integrazione con sistemi automatizzati e celle di lavoro in laboratori.
• Partner con gli scienziati: collaborare direttamente con gli utenti finali e i responsabili dei prodotti per iserare e tradurre rapidamente le esigenze complesse in soluzioni tecniche.
• Span the Stack: Applicare le migliori pratiche nei sistemi distribuiti e nell'ingegneria dei dati, contribuendo in tutto lo stack tecnologico ovunque necessario.
• Senior Scope: Agire come contributore chiave possedendo componenti significativi del quadro e fornendo assistenza tecnica al team
• Principal Scope: Guidare la roadmap tecnica per il controllo dell'automazione di base e i quadri di dati, garantendo l'allineamento con le esigenze strategiche delle nostre organizzazioni di scoperta della droga. Chi sei Sei un ingegnere guidato che prospera all'intersezione della progettazione del software e dell'innovazione scientifica, rispettando i seguenti criteri minimi:
• Sfondo: si tiene almeno un B.S. in Informatica, Ingegneria, o un campo correlato, con 4+ anni di esperienza come backend, data o ingegnere del prodotto.
• Core Stack: Forte passione per l'ingegneria del software con competenza a livello di esperti in Python e/o Java, con profonda esperienza nelle architetture cloud-native (idealmente AWS) e nei sistemi distribuiti.
• Mindset innovativo: sei appassionato di continuo impegno con gli utenti finali e hai un interesse per le tendenze moderne, come codifica AI e sviluppo front-end con TypeScript/JavaScript.
• Leadership & Communication: Lei è un comunicatore esperto in grado di costruire partnership di fiducia con gli scienziati e definire un'architettura tecnica di alto livello per un lavoro complesso.
• Esperienza Principale: 7+ anni di esperienza di architettura software progressiva specificatamente nel settore Biotech/Pharma.
• Principal Domain Expertise: la conoscenza approfondita e pratica dei flussi di lavoro di laboratorio, delle celle di lavoro integrate e dei sistemi di controllo dell'automazione (ad esempio, i gestori liquidi, le braccia robotiche) è essenziale. Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Im Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) treibt die Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) Organisation die Modernisierung unserer Rechen- und Datenökosysteme an. Wir integrieren digitale Technologien in Forschung und Frühentwicklung, um datengetriebene Wissenschaft zu betreiben und die Entscheidungsfindung für Wissenschaftler zu beschleunigen, um letztlich zu Ergebnissen für Patienten weltweit zu führen. Als Ingenieur für das Automation Core-Team im Engineering - Lab Automation-Team werden Sie maßgeblich an der Architektur und Lieferung von Kernautomatisierungssteuerung und Datenrahmen in den Forschungslaboren beteiligt sein. Sie werden unsere Wissenschaftler mit zuverlässigen, vernetzten Systemen befähigen, wobei Sie sich an wichtige Funktionen halten, um die Entwicklung von skalierbaren und zuverlässigen Integrationslösungen zu gewährleisten. • Aufbau des Frameworks: Design und Bereitstellung von robusten und komplexen Cross-Vendor-Rahmen zur Integration mit automatisierten Systemen und Workcells in Labors.
• Partner mit Wissenschaftlern: Direkt mit Endbenutzern und Produktmanagern zusammenarbeiten, um komplexe Bedürfnisse in technische Lösungen zu übersetzen.
• Span the Stack: Best Practices in verteilten Systemen und Datentechnik anwenden und dabei überall auf dem Technologiestapel mitarbeiten.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Au sein du Centre d'excellence en sciences informatiques (CoE), l'organisation Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduit à la modernisation de nos écosystèmes informatiques et de données. Nous intégrons les technologies numériques dans la recherche et le développement précoce pour alimenter la science axée sur les données et accélérer la prise de décisions pour que les scientifiques puissent finalement obtenir des résultats pour les patients du monde entier. En tant qu'ingénieur pour l'équipe Automation Core au sein de l'équipe Engineering - Lab Automation, vous serez un contributeur clé à l'architecture et à la livraison du contrôle d'automatisation de base et des cadres de données dans les laboratoires de recherche. Vous autonomiserez nos scientifiques avec des systèmes fiables et interconnectés, en prenant en charge des fonctionnalités importantes pour assurer le développement de solutions d'intégration évolutives et fiables. L'opportunité Pour exceller dans ce rôle, vous comblerez l'écart entre le génie logiciel complexe et la recherche en laboratoire en matière de découverte de médicaments grâce aux responsabilités suivantes :
• Construisez le cadre : Concevez et déployez des cadres robustes et complexes pour intégrer les systèmes automatisés et les cellules de travail dans les laboratoires.
• Partenariat avec les scientifiques: Collaborer directement avec les utilisateurs finaux et les gestionnaires de produits pour intégrer rapidement et traduire des besoins complexes en solutions techniques.
• Span the Stack: Appliquer les meilleures pratiques dans les systèmes distribués et l'ingénierie des données, en contribuant à travers la pile de technologie chaque fois que nécessaire.
• Portée supérieure: agir en tant que facteur clé en possédant des éléments importants du cadre et en fournissant des conseils techniques à l'équipe
• Domaine d'application principal: Diriger la feuille de route technique pour le contrôle d'automatisation de base et les cadres de données, en assurant l'alignement sur les besoins stratégiques de nos organisations de découverte de drogues. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un ingénieur motivé qui prospère à l'intersection de la conception logicielle et de l'innovation scientifique, répondant aux critères minimums suivants:
• Contexte: Vous possédez au moins un B.S. en informatique, en ingénierie, ou un domaine connexe, avec 4+ années d'expérience en tant que moteur, ingénieur de données ou de produits.
• Core Stack: forte passion pour l'ingénierie logicielle avec une compétence de niveau expert en Python et/ou Java, avec une expertise profonde dans les architectures cloud-natives (idéalement AWS) et les systèmes distribués.
• Mindset innovant : Vous êtes passionné par un engagement continu auprès des utilisateurs finaux et vous intéressez aux tendances modernes, telles que le codage assisté par l'IA et le développement frontal avec TypeScript/JavaScript.

jobs.title: Project Engineer/SME - Commissioning and Qualification
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary
Leads, supports or advises Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) activities related to manufacturing and storage facilities and systems, laboratory buildings and equipment, utilities generating and distributing facilities and systems, generally in conjunction with CAPEX projects. Contributes to Right First Time delivery of those facilities and systems in quality, on time and in budget which is compliant to GMP, Chinese laws and represents Roche in an adequate way.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities

• Directs the planning, organization, and coordination of commissioning and qualification activities of manufacturing and storage facilities and systems, laboratory buildings and equipment, utilities and infrastructure.

• Review of respective Engineering, Commissioning and Qualification documents of CAPEX projects in scope.

• Identification of quality issues in CAPEX projects in scope of work of the Commissioning and Qualification Manager in cooperation with Project Managers and Engineers, analysis of those and mutual development of mitigation measures.

• Develops commissioning and qualification plans and schedules for the respective facilities and systems incl. material, staffing and budgeting.

• Leads and coordinates commissioning and qualification teams and/or participates in such teams.

• Works in cooperation with the Project Manager, Engineering, Automation, User, Suppliers and Quality Unit to achieve a smooth handover of the systems to the owner and operational personnel.

• Contributes to, or leads the development of procedures, guidelines and other documents related to commissioning and qualification as needed or participates in respective teams.

• Participates in quality meetings or contributes to those as delegate of the Engineering.

• Performs and supports coaching, training and development of qualification and commissioning engineers.

• Conduct business in full compliance to Behavior in Business and Behavior in Competition.

Responsibilities:

• Ensures compliance with Roche Quality Standards, with applicable health authorities' requirements and with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) for qualification activities in scope of work of the Qualification Engineer.

• Provides reliable qualification schedules for CAPEX projects based on duly described project scope and requirements.

• Provides reliable commissioning plans and schedules for CAPEX projects based on duly described project scope and requirements.

• Provides realistic cost estimates of qualification and commissioning work based on duly described project scope, requirements and anticipated schedule of the particular project or sub-project.

Experience:

• Field experience in commissioning and qualification activities of diagnostics / pharmaceutical / biotech manufacturing facilities and systems for mid- and large-sized investment projects.

• Solid collaboration and influencing skills and the ability to lead diverse, cross-functional teams in international environments.

• Excellent communication skills in Chinese and English, further languages are beneficial. Proficiency in both spoken and written English.

•

Education & Qualifications:
Master or Bachelor degree in engineering, in natural science or pharmaceutics with long time experience in diagnostics / pharmaceutical / biotech industries.
In depth diagnostics / pharmaceutical / biotech Commissioning and Qualification knowledge. Strong experience in GMP, GEP and application of Quality Systems.

Who we are
A healthier fu

jobs.title: RA Senior Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Responsibilities
Key roles and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

1. Portfolio Management

• Oversee and is accountable for regulatory strategy, risk mitigation and HA interactions of product portfolios, ensuring alignment with organization objectives and regulatory requirements.

• Ensure regulatory activities through the product life cycle, including CTA, initial licensure and later management are appropriately actioned and managed.

• Collaborate with and influence industry associations and Health Authorities on key portfolio and regulatory policy matters

• Act as an advisor for the member of the Portfolio Team to consult with and a subject matter expert in regulatory strategy, and lead/contribute to the generation of regulatory knowledge and insights.

• Accountable for building partnerships with PDR global and key stakeholders from other functions to ensure the strategic business goals/prioritizations alignment, issue escalation and conflict solving.

• Establish fit-for-purpose ways of working and effectiveness of the Portfolio Team

2. People Management

• Ensure the necessary regulatory science knowledge and multiple sub-function domain expertise and resources are available to deliver the work and foster growth and development of the team

• Responsible for leading (VACC), mentoring, and developing a diverse team of professionals within the product and community matrix.

• Role model and supports talent flow within, into, and out of the portfolio team

• Builds an implementable and robust succession plan for the future Portfolio Team Lead

• Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning; boost team members to take ownership of their development and contributions.

• Manage team performance, including goal setting and regular evaluations, ensuring the long-term success of both individuals and the organization.

3. Community Management

• Build, nurture, and lead cross-team communities that drive collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovation across the organization.

• Act as a central point of contact within the community matrix, aligning community initiatives with function goals and ensuring consistent communication and engagement across teams.

• Develop and implement strategies that enhance community cohesion, break down silos, and create an environment where all members can contribute to the organization’s success.

Requirements/qualifications:
The ideal person for this role will have the following experience, skills and attributes:

• Proven experience in drug development, a deep understanding of the regulatory science/requirements, full product lifecycle and the ability to manage complex product portfolios.

• Demonstrated expertise in people management, with a strong track record of leading, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.

• Experience or track record of managing dynamic cross-functional projects/initiatives, which require great collaboration, engagement, and knowledge sharing across diverse teams.

• Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to influence and inspire stakeholders internally and externally, including NMPA and its affiliated organizations.

• The candidate should have a University or higher degree in pharmaceutical or life sciences with 10+ years of experience in R&D based pharmaceutical companies.

• The candidate is open minded and collaborative with a growth mindset and purpose-led.

• Excellent Chin

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione responsabilità I ruoli chiave e le responsabilità includono, ma non sono limitati ai seguenti: 1. Gestione del portafoglio
• Controllare ed è responsabile per la strategia di regolamentazione, la mitigazione dei rischi e le interazioni HA dei portafogli di prodotto, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi organizzativi e i requisiti normativi.
• Assicurare le attività di regolamentazione attraverso il ciclo di vita del prodotto, tra cui CTA, la licenza iniziale e la gestione successiva sono opportunamente attivati e gestiti.
• Collaborare con e influenzare le associazioni del settore e le autorità sanitarie su portafogli chiave e questioni di politica regolamentare
• Agire come consulente per il membro del team Portfolio per consultare e un esperto di materia nella strategia di regolamentazione, e portare/contribuire alla generazione di conoscenze e approfondimenti normativi.
• Contabile per la costruzione di partenariati con gli stakeholder globali e chiave della RDT da altre funzioni per garantire l'allineamento strategico degli obiettivi aziendali/prioritizations, l'escalation e la risoluzione dei conflitti.
• Stabilire modi di lavoro e di efficacia adatti all'uso del Team Portfolio 2. Gestione delle persone
• Assicurare la necessaria conoscenza delle scienze regolamentari e competenze e risorse di dominio sotto-funzione multiple sono disponibili per fornire il lavoro e promuovere la crescita e lo sviluppo del team
• Responsabile per il leader (VACC), mentoring, e lo sviluppo di un team diversificato di professionisti all'interno del prodotto e della matrice comunitaria.
• Modello Role e supporta il flusso di talento all'interno, all'interno e all'esterno del team di portafoglio
• Costruire un piano di successione attuabile e robusto per il futuro Portfolio Team Lead
• Promuovere una cultura della trasparenza, della responsabilità, dell'innovazione e dell'apprendimento continuo; rafforzare i membri del team per prendere possesso del loro sviluppo e dei loro contributi.
• Gestire le prestazioni del team, tra cui l'impostazione degli obiettivi e le valutazioni regolari, garantendo il successo a lungo termine sia delle persone che dell'organizzazione. 3. Gestione della Comunità
• Costruire, coltivare e guidare comunità trasversali che guidano la collaborazione, la condivisione delle conoscenze e l'innovazione in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Agire come punto centrale di contatto all'interno della matrice della comunità, allineare le iniziative della comunità con gli obiettivi di funzione e garantire una comunicazione coerente e un impegno tra le squadre.
• Sviluppare e implementare strategie che migliorano la coesione della comunità, abbattere i silos e creare un ambiente in cui tutti i membri possono contribuire al successo dell’organizzazione. Requisiti/qualifica: La persona ideale per questo ruolo avrà la seguente esperienza, abilità e attributi:
• Esperienza comprovata nello sviluppo della droga, una profonda comprensione della scienza e dei requisiti normativi, del ciclo di vita completo del prodotto e della capacità di gestire portafogli di prodotti complessi.
• Competenza dimostrata nella gestione delle persone, con un forte record di leader, sviluppo e mantenimento di squadre ad alto rendimento.
• Esperienza o track record di gestione di progetti/iniziativi interfunzionali dinamici, che richiedono una grande collaborazione, impegno e condivisione delle conoscenze in diversi team.
• Forte leadership, comunicazione e capacità organizzative, con la capacità di influenzare e ispirare gli stakeholder internamente ed esternamente, tra cui NMPA e le sue organizzazioni affiliate.
• Il candidato dovrebbe avere una laurea in scienze farmaceutiche o di vita con 10 anni di esperienza nelle aziende farmaceutiche basate su R&D.
• Il candidato è aperto e collaborativo con una mentalità di crescita e orientato allo scopo.
• Eccellente mento

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Aufgaben Zu den wichtigsten Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten gehören, sind aber nicht auf folgende beschränkt: 1. Portfolio Management
• Überwachung und Rechenschaftspflicht für Regulierungsstrategien, Risikominderungen und HA-Interaktionen von Produktportfolios, Sicherstellung der Ausrichtung auf Organisationsziele und regulatorische Anforderungen.
• Gewährleistung regulatorischer Aktivitäten durch den Produktlebenszyklus, einschließlich CTA, Erstlizenzierung und spätere Verwaltung werden entsprechend gehandelt und verwaltet.
• Zusammenarbeit und Einfluss von Branchenverbänden und Gesundheitsbehörden auf zentrale Portfolio- und Regulierungsfragen
• Aktivieren Sie als Berater des Portfolio-Teams, um sich mit einem Fachexperten in der Regulierungsstrategie zu beraten und der Generation regulatorischer Kenntnisse und Erkenntnisse beizutragen.
• Berechnungsfähig für den Aufbau von Partnerschaften mit PDR Global und Schlüsselstakeholdern aus anderen Funktionen, um die strategischen Geschäftsziele/Prioritisierungen Ausrichtung, Eskalation und Konfliktlösung zu gewährleisten.
• Schaffung von geeigneten Arbeits- und Effektivitätsmöglichkeiten des Portfolio-Teams 2. Personalmanagement
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass das notwendige regulatorische Wissenschaftswissen und mehrere Subfunktions-Domains zur Verfügung stehen, um die Arbeit zu liefern und Wachstum und Entwicklung des Teams zu fördern
• Verantwortung für führende (VACC), Mentoring und Entwicklung eines vielfältigen Teams von Fachleuten innerhalb der Produkt- und Community-Matrix.
• Rollenmodell und unterstützt Talentfluss innerhalb, in und außerhalb des Portfolio-Teams
• Erstellt einen umsetzbaren und robusten Nachfolgeplan für den zukünftigen Portfolio Team Lead
• Förderung einer Kultur der Transparenz, der Rechenschaftspflicht, der Innovation und des kontinuierlichen Lernens; stärkt die Teammitglieder dabei, sich an ihre Entwicklung und Beiträge zu beteiligen.
• Teamleistung verwalten, einschließlich Zielsetzung und regelmäßige Bewertungen, um den langfristigen Erfolg sowohl von Einzelpersonen als auch von der Organisation sicherzustellen. 3. Gemeinschaftsmanagement
• Aufbauen, Pflegen und Lead Cross-Team-Communities, die Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und Innovation in der gesamten Organisation vorantreiben.
• Aktivieren Sie als zentraler Ansprechpartner innerhalb der Community-Matrix, richten Sie Gemeinschaftsinitiativen mit Funktionszielen aus und gewährleisten Sie eine konsequente Kommunikation und Engagement in Teams.
• Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Strategien, die den Zusammenhalt der Gemeinschaft verbessern, Silos abbrechen und eine Umgebung schaffen, in der alle Mitglieder zum Erfolg der Organisation beitragen können. Anforderungen/ Qualifikationen: Die ideale Person für diese Rolle wird folgende Erfahrung, Fähigkeiten und Attribute haben:
• bewährte Erfahrungen in der Drogenentwicklung, ein tiefes Verständnis der regulatorischen Wissenschaft/Anforderungen, des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus und der Fähigkeit, komplexe Produktportfolios zu verwalten.
• Demonstrantes Know-how im Personalmanagement mit einem starken Erfolg von führenden, entwickelnden und leistungsfähigen Teams.
• Erleben Sie oder verfolgen Sie einen Überblick über das Management dynamischer funktionsübergreifender Projekte/Initiativen, die eine große Zusammenarbeit, Engagement und Wissensaustausch über verschiedene Teams erfordern.
• Starke Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Organisationskompetenzen, mit der Fähigkeit, Akteure intern und extern zu beeinflussen und zu inspirieren, einschließlich NMPA und seinen verbundenen Organisationen.
• Der Kandidat sollte eine Universität oder einen höheren Abschluss in Pharma- oder Life Sciences mit 10+ Jahren Erfahrung in FuE-basierten Pharmaunternehmen haben.
• Der Kandidat ist offen geistig und kollaborativ mit einem Wachstumsgeist und einem gezielten Verhalten.
• Ausgezeichnet Chin
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Responsabilités Les rôles et responsabilités clés comprennent, entre autres, les suivants : 1. Gestion de portefeuille
• Superviser et rendre compte de la stratégie réglementaire, de l'atténuation des risques et des interactions des AP des portefeuilles de produits, en assurant l'alignement sur les objectifs de l'organisation et les exigences réglementaires.
• Veiller à ce que les activités de réglementation tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, y compris le CTA, l'autorisation initiale et la gestion ultérieure soient mises en oeuvre et gérées de manière appropriée.
• Collaborer avec les associations de l'industrie et les autorités sanitaires et les influencer sur les principales questions de portefeuille et de politique réglementaire
• Agir à titre de conseiller auprès du membre de l'équipe du Portefeuille pour qu'il consulte et qu'il soit expert en matière de stratégie réglementaire et qu'il dirige/contribue à la production de connaissances et de connaissances en matière de réglementation.
• Responsable de l'établissement de partenariats avec d'autres parties prenantes du monde et des pays en développement afin d'assurer l'alignement des objectifs stratégiques et des priorités, l'escalade des problèmes et la résolution des conflits.
• Établir des méthodes de travail et d'efficacité adaptées aux besoins de l'équipe du portefeuille 2. Gestion des personnes
• Veiller à ce que les connaissances scientifiques en matière de réglementation et l'expertise et les ressources multiples des sous-fonctions soient disponibles pour assurer le travail et favoriser la croissance et le développement de l'équipe;
• Responsable du leadership (VACC), du mentorat et du développement d'une équipe diversifiée de professionnels au sein de la matrice produit et communautaire.
• Modèle de rôle et soutien de la circulation des talents à l'intérieur, à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de l'équipe de portefeuille
• Constitue un plan de relève robuste et réalisable pour le futur chef d'équipe du portefeuille
• Favoriser une culture de transparence, de responsabilité, d'innovation et d'apprentissage continu; encourager les membres de l'équipe à s'approprier leur développement et leurs contributions.
• Gérer le rendement de l'équipe, y compris l'établissement d'objectifs et les évaluations régulières, en assurant le succès à long terme des individus et de l'organisation. 3. Gestion communautaire
• Créer, entretenir et diriger des communautés d'équipes qui favorisent la collaboration, le partage des connaissances et l'innovation dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Agir en tant que point de contact central au sein de la matrice communautaire, aligner les initiatives communautaires sur les objectifs de fonction et assurer une communication et un engagement cohérents entre les équipes.
• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies qui renforcent la cohésion communautaire, décomposent les silos et créent un environnement où tous les membres peuvent contribuer au succès de l'organisation. Exigences/qualifications: La personne idéale pour ce rôle aura l'expérience, les compétences et les attributs suivants:
• Expérience éprouvée en matière de développement de médicaments, compréhension approfondie de la science et des exigences réglementaires, cycle de vie complet des produits et capacité de gérer des portefeuilles de produits complexes.
• Expertise démontrée dans la gestion des personnes, avec une solide expérience de leadership, de développement et de rétention d'équipes performantes.
• Expérience ou expérience de la gestion de projets/initiatives transfonctionnels dynamiques, qui nécessitent une collaboration, un engagement et un partage des connaissances entre différentes équipes.
• Des compétences solides en leadership, en communication et en organisation, avec la capacité d'influencer et d'inspirer les parties prenantes à l'interne et à l'externe, y compris la NMPA et ses organisations affiliées.
• Le candidat devrait avoir une université ou un diplôme supérieur en sciences pharmaceutiques ou en sciences de la vie avec plus de 10 ans d'expérience dans des sociétés pharmaceutiques basées en R-D.
• Le candidat est ouvert d'esprit et de collaboration avec un esprit de croissance et dirigé par un but.
• Chin excellent

jobs.title: Marketing Enabler - Ophthalmology (Manager level)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love

Your Opportunity

• Co-create with DAN, PPOCs, local Enablers and other functions to build DA/TA integrated strategies and OBP (DA affiliate outcomes: LTO, MTO & STO) - aligned with global and regional strategies.

• Support DAN, PPOCs on building and reviewing business planning, re-define go-to-market model

• Collaborate with PPOCs to engage with local stakeholders/partners to provide and validate local market competition and customers insights

• Support DAN and PPOCs on market research to gain market insights for building strategies

• Lead and collaborate with PPOCs and other stakeholders to conduct the short term, mid term and long term forecasting of business for related TAs

• Co-create with DAN and PPOCs to create promotional materials and build digital marketing contents for both HCPs and patients

• Provide input, develop and adaptation to all promotional materials in local language in alignment with Roche code of conduct and local regulations

• Give advices for email/App/HCP platform campaign content

• Support PPOCs on Email/App/HCP platform campaign deployment

• Provide input for the development of, and develop Digital Integrated Personalized Offerings

• Internal training:

• Provide input and adaptation to all training materials required in local languages.

• Local Marketing Enablers may be required to conduct the training for PPOCs in the local language

• Collaborate with DAN and PPOCs for implementing OBP. Prioritize efforts to DA/TA Work Packages requiring highly localized insights and/or activities

• Promotional & medical events management (i.e. national level events/webinars)

• Collaborate with PPOCs to manage Grant/ Sponsorship/ Donation

• Co-create with PPOCs and other enablers on stakeholders mapping, managing relationships with local HCP organizations

• Lead the access and pricing strategy for all DA related products.

• Collaborate with Access and other functions to develop and deploy pricing strategies (including PN, FPS)

• Lead the deployment of FPS/PSP programs in alignment with DA strategies.

• Collaborate with the Access & Policy Chapter in HTA assessment, reimbursement listing

• Coordinate with local distributors to ensure drug supply to patients (including formulary listing)

• Coordinate with other functions for monthly rolling forecast and supply planning to ensure drug availability.

Who you are

• Must-have University degree in Pharmacy/Medical

• Additional Master / MBA is an advantage

• Additional Master / Bachelor Degree of Marketing is an advantage

• At least 3 years of hands-on experiences in Brand Management of MNC pharmaceuticals

• Excellent commercial/financing abilities and familiar with budgeting/forecasting process

• Competent Market analytics

• Experience in developing/ launching new business(es)/ product(s).

• Product life cycle management: vision & strategies

• Market, HCP & Competitive Insight – applicable level

• Branding & Positioning Management – applicable level

• Marketing Analytics – applicable level

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, f

jobs.title: Market Access and Policy Advisor
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role scope :

• Develop and implement market access strategies/solutions for strategic products covering reimbursement, pricing, pharmacoeconomics/HTA strategy, and policy-related strategy to maximize patient access and portfolio value.

• Shape sustainable pricing strategies from pre-launch through lifecycle management, aligned with overall portfolio and long-term business objectives.

• Prioritize pipeline assets and define access pathways to ensure successful future launches.

• Ensure payer relevant evidence is generated through clinical trials, health economic modeling, real-world evidence studies, systematic literature research and meta-analysis effectively to demonstrate the value comprehensively.

• Translate evidence into compelling value propositions tailored to Taiwan payer and policy environment.

• Identify patient access opportunities and/or issues/barriers and develop access solutions to address them and create access for patients for Roche innovations in self-pay market

• Engage external stakeholders to remove access barriers and deliver value based discussion for Roche products.

• Reimbursement:

• Work cross functionally with PPOC, Marketing, and Medical stakeholders to develop the reimbursement strategy and engagement plan with KOL and advocacy groups.

• Collect data and prepare a dossier for the National Health Insurance Administration (NHIA) submission. Highlight the key evidence and product value proposition for the payer.

• Support policy shaping activities to support patient access as appropriate.

• Lead negotiation and contracting processes to secure an optimal outcome for the company

• Collaborate with the global team and other affiliates through the network to ensure alignment on the access and pricing strategy.

• Contribute to the planning and execution of our policy and health system shaping activities to ensure the system is ready and willing to recognize, value, and reimburse our future innovations.

Qualifications:

• Good compliance track record. No material compliance violation has been identified in the past 5 years.

Education:

• A bachelor degree in the field (pharmacy, nursing, public health, economics, public policy). An advanced (Master’s or doctorate) degree is preferred.

Working Experience:

• Experience working on reimbursement applications and self-pay strategy is preferred

• Some prior commercial experience within the pharmaceutical, medical device, or broader healthcare industry is essential.

• Familiar with NHIA process of medical devices and key stakeholders.

Skills & Knowledge:

• Strong business acumen with ability to think strategically.

• Deep appreciation of science and ability to translate scientific information into strategy. Ability to take evidence and other complex data and convert them into easy to understand deliverables that can support commercial use.

• Possess an understanding of the access landscape, relevant stakeholder groups, value assessment/HTA methods and pricing concepts.

• Possess an understanding of how policies are made within the healthcare system, including identifying key institutions and stakeholders involved and the importance of policy in shaping the healthcare environment.

• A collaborative attitude and ability to manage multiple demands and priorities on time, influence without authority, gain alignment and drive decision making.

• Excellent communication and leadership skills are a must with a strong track record of delivering results in a matrix-based environmen

jobs.title: Product Specialist Trainee (Portuguese speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Product Specialist Trainee, your main responsibility will be to provide specialized remote technical and applications support to users of our analyzers in the Anatomic Pathology and Molecular Biology product lines. You will be responsible for maintaining excellent communication, follow-up, and proactive collaboration with customers to ensure a rapid resolution of any issues or requests raised. This position offers a hybrid work arrangement. You will have the flexibility to work remotely while also having the opportunity to collaborate and engage with colleagues in the office.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide specialized remote technical and applications support to users of our analyzers in the Anatomic Pathology and Molecular Biology product lines

• Maintain excellent communication, follow-up, and proactive collaboration with customers

• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in a timely manner

• Document and escalate complex issues to higher-level support teams when necessary

• Provide training and guidance to customers on the operation and maintenance of our analyzers

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure customer satisfaction

Required Profile:

• Students of Biomedical Engineering, Biomedicine, or Health and Life Sciences.

• Ability to make curricular and/or extracurricular internship agreements

• Fluent in Spanish and English (conversational and good writing skills), Portuguese is a must

• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset

• Strong teamwork and collaboration skills

• Interest in new technologies

• Analytical thinking

What do we offer?

During the internship, you will get an insight into a global company. As a Product Specialist Trainee, you will have the opportunity to gain practical experience and develop your skills in the following areas:

• Learn the functioning of a microbiology and/or anatomical pathology laboratory.

• Receive specific product training on Roche's offerings in these areas.

• Enhance your communication, troubleshooting and customer service skills and expand your network within the company.

• Develop essential core skills such as customer interaction, critical thinking, intercultural collaboration, and resilience.

• Provide remote support to customers and field specialists, assisting with troubleshooting, application usage, and implementing new protocols.

Additionally, you will have the chance to collaborate with cross-functional and collaborate with global teams when necessary. This internship will provide valuable hands-on experience and the opportunity to contribute to customer satisfaction.

You will learn what "Customer centricity" means and how the Global Customer Support of Roche Diagnostics implements this in its daily work.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Maintenance Specialist - 3rd Shift
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Maintenance Specialist, you will perform electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning electro-mechanical equipment used in the manufacturing process. You will dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches or drawings. You’ll use test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts. You will rebuild manufacturing equipment as required. You will also perform equipment modifications as directed by manufacturing engineers. You may use predictive maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies.

The Maintenance Specialist position will entail specialized knowledge of a particular area, system, or equipment and requires specific training and certification. You will apply some advanced skill to the position or specialization. You may adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Your duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks. You will resolve most questions and problems and refer only the most complex issues to higher levels. You will apply basic skills and may develop advanced skills appropriate for the position. Your duties and tasks are standardized. You will work under direct supervision and follow standard procedures to accomplish tasks.
You will also be responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

Responsibilities:

• Performs troubleshooting to determine problems and may be required to do corrective maintenance. Completes preventative maintenance task according to detailed procedures and schedules. May provide emergency call-in support for operations that run during off-hours. Maintain accurate records of all activities.

• Provides technical set-up support for manufacturing areas.

• Performs equipment modifications, including installation, validation support and start-up, of new equipment as well as decommissioning activities.

Requirements:

• High school diploma or equivalency

• 4 years related operations or manufacturing experience

• In-depth knowledge of company policies and procedures

• Basic computer skills

• Must be available to work Sunday -Thursday (10:30pm – 7:00am)

Preferred:

• Associates degree or equivalent military training

• Documented experience troubleshooting and repairing the following types of systems: electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Indianapolis, is 51,500.00 - 95,700.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units to develop novel therapeutics that will have an impact on patient lives. Within the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence, the Computational Biology and Medicine department focuses on furthering our understanding of disease pathogenesis, patient populations, and target biology by having access to the largest Pharma R&D datasets in the world. In partnership with our scientists across Roche, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a highly motivated computational scientist to join our Neuroscience and Rare Diseases therapeutic area. In this role, you will be a key member of an interdisciplinary team dedicated to advancing our understanding of neurological diseases. As Roche continues to build and advance its capabilities in computational and data-driven R&D, this position offers an integral role in our strategy. You will identify novel therapeutic targets and biomarkers by analyzing high-dimensional data. You will collaborate closely with leading laboratory scientists and clinicians, contributing directly to a pipeline of innovative medicines for patients with neurodegenerative and neuroinflammation diseases. You will also be part of the wider Computational Biology and Medicine unit of the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence drawing on the shared experience and expertise of colleagues globally.

Data Analysis & Insight Generation

• Lead the analysis of high-dimensional datasets such as single-cell, spatial, proteomics, metabolomics, and human genetics data to support therapeutic and biomarker development

• Collaborate closely with the AI/ML Foundation Model development teams and apply advanced quantitative methods, supporting drug discovery projects in Neuroscience and Rare Diseases.

• Deliver clear and objective data-driven insights to inform portfolio decision-making

Collaboration & Strategy

• Contribute to the data and analytics strategy for Neuroscience and Rare Diseases efforts in collaboration with partners in the therapeutic area

• Develop effective working relationships with key stakeholders in the disease therapeutic area, laboratory teams, and computational teams

Team & Culture

• Contribute to a collaborative workplace culture of scientific rigor, continuous improvement, and open feedback

• Support the scientific growth of team members by sharing knowledge and expertise

Who you are

You are a dedicated scientist with a strong background in applying computational methods to biological problems. You are motivated by scientific challenges and have a clear interest in translating data into meaningfu

jobs.title: China Technical Regulatory (CMC) Policy Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de file de la politique de réglementation technique de la Chine

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

• Provide Leadership, oversight and execution of technical regulatory policy activities for the Roche Pharma Group relevant to China including the development of Roche policy positions on key topics relevant to Pharma Technical, and effective advocacy of such positions externally.

• Collaborate closely with the regulatory colleagues in China and globally to develop and execute the China regulatory policy roadmap

• Ensure alignment and stakeholder engagement within Pharma Technical Operations, Product Development, Pharma International, governmental affairs as well as external interest groups

Key Responsibilities and Tasks

Identify and enable regulatory policy activities in China such that Roche is globally recognized as an industry leader with health authority agencies and industry peer groups and that significant value is realized in facilitating pipeline development, marketing authorizations and excellence in manufacturing

Build and maintain relationships based on trust and respect with key health authority professionals, relevant academic and opinion leaders and non-profit scientific associations

Establish a strong partnership and networks with internal (i.e. Regulatory, Technical, Quality, Medical,, Gov. Affairs ) and external stakeholders

Ensure the development, execution and communication of the China regulatory policy roadmap

Lead strong cross-functional teams and regional/global regulatory communities of practice to drive policy change in China

Represent Roche technical regulatory policy views in China (and beyond) during external stakeholder engagement

Take leadership in local, regional and/or global associations (e.g. RDPAC, BIO, IFPMA…) and/or governmental organizations (e.g. APEC, ICH) in line with the Roche positions .

Provide leadership and consultancy to Roche Pharma Division leaders on regulatory policy and strategy related topics affecting China

Act as subject matter expert for key technical regulatory policy and strategy areas as assigned, lead the development of specified Global Regulatory Policy positions in close collaboration with SMEs.

Build influencing and advocacy knowledge and capacity and empowers other colleagues to shape the regulatory environment

Core Competencies, Skills
Excellent collaboration skills

Recognized expert in relevant CMC technical/regulatory area with established external credibility as thought leader

Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with global health authorities

Strong team player and communicator

Creates an environment of strong team spirit, good communication, high motivation, inspire cross-functional project teams

Excellent advocacy, communication and presentation skills

Strategic thinking and analytical skills, ability to simplify complex topics and to pull it all together to strategic planning.

Challenges the status quo to drive innovation

Ability to operate successfully in a global matrix environment with shared accountability and responsibilities.

Minimum Qualifications and Experience

Degree in relevant technical area ( Analytical, Biochemistry, Biology, Pharmacy)

At least 10 years of work experience in relevant area or advanced degree (PhD) in relevant technical area combined with a minimum of 5 yrs work experience

Previous experience in Regulatory (Industry or Agency) is preferred

In depth Knowledge of China regulatory environment

Previous participation and proven effectiveness in international regulatory/industry forums is highly preferr
