jobs.title: Laboratory Manager Pathology CAP/CLIA (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we believe precision medicine radically improves lives. Our Global CAP/CLIA laboratories are the "heartbeat" of diagnostic innovation, bridging the gap between early research and life-saving commercial diagnostics. As a Laboratory Manager, you aren't just overseeing a facility; you are leading a team that transforms complex biological data into the insights clinicians need to treat patients with cancer and other life-altering diseases.

We are seeking a high-caliber Laboratory Manager (m/f/d) to oversee our dual-specialty pathology and immunoassay laboratory. This role requires a unique blend of technical expertise in tissue-based diagnostics and immunoassay automated testing.
You will be responsible for the operational excellence of the lab, ensuring that both the Histology/Pathology and Immunoassay/Chemistry departments function at peak efficiency while maintaining total compliance with ISO15189, CAP (College of American Pathologists) and CLIA regulations.

The Opportunity

You will oversee a dual-specialty laboratory at the forefront of the industry. Your leadership will span two critical domains:

• Anatomic Pathology: Managing high-complexity tissue-based diagnostics, including advanced Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ Hybridization (ISH)

• Immunoassay Excellence: Driving peaks of operational efficiency in our automated immunoassay tracks on state-of-the-art cobas® platforms

You will also be a key driver in our Digital Pathology transformation, integrating whole-slide imaging and AI-based image analysis into routine clinical workflows to set new standards for diagnostic precision. Your key responsibilities:

• Visionary Operational Leadership: Supervise the daily "rhythm" of the lab, synchronizing pathology and immunoassay workflows to ensure competitive turnaround times (TAT)

• Guardian of Quality: Maintain an "inspection-ready" culture, serving as the primary lead for CAP/CLIA and ISO 15189 audits

• Champion of People: Lead, mentor, and inspire team of Laboratory scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence

• Strategic Technical Oversight: Manage the validation and implementation of new assays and novel platforms, ensuring every piece of equipment is a high-performing component of our diagnostic system

• Innovate & Improve: Actively identify opportunities for workflow optimization and cost-effective management without ever compromising the quality that defines the Roche name

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Clinical Laboratory Science, Medical Technology, or a related Biological Science. A Master’s (MHA/MBA) or PhD is highly preferred.

• Furthermore, you have 5+ years of experience in a clinical laboratory setting

• Proven expertise in both anatomic pathology and automated immunoassay workflows is a distinct advantage

• The ideal candidate isn't just a technical expert; You are a leader who fosters a culture of quality, safety, and continuous improvement with at least 2 years of experience in a leadership role

• You live the Roche mindset by maintaining a track record of zero-deficiency inspections and a passion for navigating the complexities of emerging global regulations

Your

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a member of Global Customer Support, you will support on-market products, perform advanced second-level troubleshooting, and provide guidance to junior members of the team on troubleshooting techniques and second-level inquiries. You work consistently with cross-functional teams. You lead team members and participate in and/or leads design reviews, and provide direction to junior members of the team on all elements of the project Charter in establishing service requirements on development projects. You create and updates documentation and curriculum, and conduct training for internal personnel. You serves as a technical expert on product(s) and you work on complex projects requiring broad knowledge of products and systems.

The Opportunity:

• Provides on-market support by independently addressing complex Level 2 submissions, applying advanced knowledge of hardware repair and networking principles.

• Updates service manuals, obsoletes outdated documentation, and ensures all published materials are current and accurate.

• Leads design review teams, providing service perspectives and approving design change content while creating necessary deliverables.

• Develops and revises training curricula, delivers training to various groups, and conducts audits to ensure training quality. Responsible for certifying trainers.

• Creates service requirements for development projects, advocates for functional goals, and collaborates with teams to solve complex problems.

• Produces service documentation for internal and external training before Launch Decision and for existing products as needed.

• Utilizes project management fundamentals to ensure timely and quality completion of projects, while representing GCS in relevant meetings and fulfilling additional duties as assigned.

Who you are

• Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Microbiology, Information Technology or related discipline or equivalent work experience. 4 years of progressive experience, with 3 years of specific experience with industry or diagnostics

• 5 years of relevant technical support experience in customer-facing roles, including troubleshooting, training, and working with electromechanical devices.

• Practical experience with Linux commands and navigating log files using the command line interface (CLI).

• Ability to read and understand electrical, mechanical, and assembly drawings, schematics, and service manuals, as well as technical notifications and communications.

• Proficient in using test equipment such as digital multimeters and calibrated gauges, along with hand tools like screwdrivers and wrenches.

• Experience with sequencing instruments and NGS technologies, demonstrating knowledge of sample preparation workflows and Molecular Biology/Biochemistry concepts.

• Possesses good communication, organizational, logical thinking, and presentation skills. Communicates complex and unfamiliar ideas and solutions easily to users with little or no technical knowledge.

• Strong communication, organizational, and logical thinking skills, with the ability to work independently and interact effectively with cross-functional teams while embodying Roche’s cultural beliefs

Travel and Location Requirements: Rotkreuz, CH, Travel time: 30% international.

We are looking forward to receiving your application.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare tod

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Business Analyst Financial Consolidation serves as a crucial bridge between financial reporting requirements and IT solutions. He possesses in-depth knowledge of the business domain, relevant technologies, and organizational strategy to provide holistic, enterprise-wide consulting advice. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, testing, and optimizing the financial consolidation software solutions, ensuring that complex group consolidation processes are efficient, accurate, and compliant. You maintain system integrity, and support the closing process. While maintaining and supporting our current financial consolidation solution is essential, you also largely contribute to consolidation system transformation initiatives.

Description of the area
The ERP Financial Consolidation team supports the financial consolidation process by managing, configuring, and maintaining the software solutions. The team is embarking on a strategic project to replace our legacy Financial Consolidation system (i.e. SAP FC) with the OneStream . This transformation is driven by the upcoming end-of-life for SAP FC and a commitment to leveraging advanced automation and intelligence to enhance financial consolidation, reporting, and analysis across our global operations.

Job Responsibilities:

• Scope: Supports and maintains the Financial Consolidation solutions end-to-end. Oversees initiatives with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale..

• Accountability: Configures the software for, or adapts it to, new accounting requirements, changes in business structure, and new reporting standards (IFRS), in collaboration with Group Consolidation function. Ensures the closing process runs smoothly while actively participating in a helpdesk team providing support to application users. Ensures seamless data flow into and out of the financial consolidation system.

• Collaboration: Collaborates closely with the corresponding business counterparts such as: Group Consolidation, Group Tax and Insurance, Group Accounting and Controlling.

• Impact/Strategy: Drives significant impact on projects by ensuring the delivery of high-value solutions that align with business strategy. Leads the evaluation of strategic solution options, including advanced value analysis and risk assessment, and actively shapes long-term roadmaps.

• Business / Technical ability: Uses in-depth knowledge of the business or technical domain and relevant technologies to inform business strategies.

​
Qualifications

Education / Experience

• 7+ years of hands-on mastery administering, developing and managing financial consolidation systems or implementing EPM projects ( particularly OneStream ) and with a track record of driving improvements and leveraging technology to enhance reporting quality and efficiency.

• In-depth understanding of Financial Consolidation topics, month-end close processes and ability to hold discussions with business counterparts.

• Extensive experience overseeing initiatives with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale, and driving alignment across highly ambiguous spaces.

• Demonstrated advanced knowledge of Business Analysis Advisory/Consultancy concepts and practices.

• Business-focused, results-oriented approach with excellent coordination, exceptional problem-solving, and analytical skills, with a mindset to challenge assumptions, resolve discrepancies and ensure integrity of consolidated results.

jobs.title: Procurement Manager - Corporate Services
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:

This role is within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which manages core procurement activities from category management and sourcing to contracting and content strategy. The group includes communities like Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities, ensuring category expertise and flexibility in procurement delivery.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As a Procurement Manager in Corporate Services, you will apply analytical thinking and specialized knowledge to strategic sourcing and delivery. You will be a vital driver in managing the supplier ecosystem, demonstrating the ability to deconstruct complex cost models and challenge commercial structures to drive value beyond simple price savings. You will collaborate and influence business stakeholders, translating their needs into effective sourcing activities and improving the buying experience. Your work will ensure efficient service delivery and translate sourcing outcomes into automated buying channels and content to improve business adoption and overall efficiency.

As a Procurement Manager in Corporate Services, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter specialist in Congress Meeting and Events, and other Corporate Services categories conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies and tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements.

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and frameworks and project management skills.

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree, preferably in business or a related discipline.

• You have 5+ years procurement experience in strategic sourcing, category strategy building and strategic project execution with general contracting understanding and proficiency or relevant commodity experience.

• You bring proficiency in procurement systems, processes, and general con

Description of the area
The Network & Perimeter Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

Job description
As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Edge Defense), you will play a pivotal role in the end-to-end lifecycle of our perimeter and cloud security products. Your primary focus will be the global engineering, adoption, and optimization of our Edge security stack, including Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), DDoS mitigation, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA). You are a technical "implementer" responsible for designing robust, high-availability architectures that protect our global network from external threats while enabling secure, seamless access to multi-cloud environments. By leveraging an "Automation-First" mindset, you will transform traditional perimeter controls into scalable, code-driven security services, ensuring Roche’s digital boundaries remain resilient in an evolving threat landscape.

Job responsibilities

• Perimeter Defense Mastery: Lead the end-to-end deployment, configuration, and maintenance of Next-Generation Firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet), ensuring high availability (Active/Active & Active/Passive) and optimal inspection performance across global entry points.

• Zero Trust Transition: Architect and implement ZTNA solutions to move beyond legacy VPNs, focusing on granular, application-level access and identity-aware security policies.

• Multi-Cloud Network Security: Engineer and manage cloud-native security controls within AWS, Azure, and GCP, ensuring consistent security posture across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

• DDoS & Threat Mitigation: Design and refine DDoS protection strategies and automated threat prevention policies (SSL decryption, IPS/IDS) to shield critical infrastructure from sophisticated external attacks.

​
2. Product Lifecycle & Evolution

• Lifecycle Governance: Oversee the delivery of Edge solutions from initial design through build, global rollout, and continuous optimization, ensuring that all security controls are reliable, scalable, and documented.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network & Perimeter Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

Job description
As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer for Internal Network Defense, you will be the primary guardian of our internal environment, protecting our most sensitive segments—from manufacturing plants and research labs to warehouses and corporate offices. Your mission is to architect and enforce robust "East-West" segmentation, preventing lateral movement and securing the diverse environments that drive our core business. This is a technical "implementer" role where you will architect, design, build, and operate high-performance security boundaries using a dual-vendor strategy (Palo Alto and Fortinet). Beyond traditional enforcement, you will champion the adoption of AI-driven insights to identify latent risks and define the safe boundaries for automated security workflows, ensuring our internal network is resilient, compliant, and prepared for machine-speed threats.

Job responsibilities

Architecture, Design & AI Ambition

• Segmentation Strategy: Design, develop and document robust network segmentation architectures leveraging Fortinet and Palo Alto firewalls to meet complex business and security requirements.

• AI-Driven Risk Discovery: Actively explore and integrate AI opportunities to analyze internal traffic patterns and identify emerging security risks within complex Manufacturing and Lab environments.

• Automated Guardrails: Define and establish clear boundaries and governance for automated workflows, ensuring that machine-driven policy changes remain within safe, predictable parameters.

• Solution Blueprints: Create detailed network diagrams, technical design documents, and implementation plans for new segmentation environments (Labs, Manufacturing, Research).

​
Implementation & Deployment

• Firewall Engineering: Configure, deploy, and manage Palo Alto Networks (PA-Series, VM-Series) and Fortinet FortiGate firewalls at scale.

• Centralized Management: Utilize Panorama and FortiManager to enforce consistent security policies, NAT rules, VPNs (IPSec/SSL), and advanced routing features.

• Infrastructure Evolution: Lead the migration and upgrade of existing internal firewall infrastructure, ensuring zero-downtime transitions in critical environments.

​
3. Operational Excellence & Visibility

• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the lead engineer for complex network security escalations, performing deep -packet analysis and root-cause investigations to implement long-ter

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network & Perimeter Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

Job Description
As the Lead for Network Security Infrastructure Observability, you will be the primary architect and engineer responsible for the health, availability, and performance of our global security infrastructure. This is a hands-on technical leadership role that requires a solid foundation in Network Security engineering. You will architect, design, build, and operate the monitoring frameworks that ensure our security platforms (Firewalls, NAC, ZTNA) are running at peak operational efficiency. While your focus is on Infrastructure Reliability, success in this role depends on your deep technical understanding of how security controls—such as packet inspection, encryption, and access policies—impact system performance. By bridging the gap between security hardware/software (Palo Alto, Fortinet, ISE) and modern observability toolchains (LogicMonitor, Python, IaC), you will ensure that the organization’s security "engine" is always visible, resilient, and perfectly tuned.

Job Responsibilities

1. Infrastructure Architecture, Design & Build

• Security-Aware Monitoring Architecture: Architect and design a global visibility framework for understanding the key performance, health, and throughput indicators of core security appliances across services such as Edge Firewalls, Network Access Control (NAC), DDoS Mitigation, Network Authentication, Internal Network Segmentation, and VPNs.

• Observability Engineering: Build and deploy the observability toolchain specifically optimized to monitor the hardware and virtualized instances of Palo Alto, Fortinet, and Cisco ISE.

• LogicMonitor Development: Hands-on creation and tuning of DataSources and ConfigSources to capture hardware-level security telemetry (CPU/Data Plane utilization, Session counts, Tunnel health, and HA synchronization).

• Service Health Dashboarding: Design and build real-time operational dashboards that provide a clear view of the health, performance, and compliance status of the global security infrastructure.

​
2. Infrastructure Operations & Evolution

• Global Service Operations: Operate the global monitoring environment, ensuring the continuous health of the observability stack across diverse network segments and security zones.

• Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Leverage APIs and automation (Python/GitLab) to automate the provisioning of monitoring for new security devices, ensuring a "security-first" approach to visibility.

•

This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape. Job Description As the Lead for Network Security Infrastructure Observability, you will be the primary architect and engineer responsible for the health, availability, and performance of our global security infrastructure. This is a hands-on technical leadership role that requires a solid foundation in Network Security engineering. You will architect, design, build, and operate the monitoring frameworks that ensure our security platforms (Firewalls, NAC, ZTNA) are running at peak operational efficiency. While your focus is on Infrastructure Reliability, success in this role depends on your deep technical understanding of how security controls—such as packet inspection, encryption, and access policies—impact system performance. By bridging the gap between security hardware/software (Palo Alto, Fortinet, ISE) and modern observability toolchains (LogicMonitor, Python, IaC), you will ensure that the organization’s security "engine" is always visible, resilient, and perfectly tuned. Job Responsibilities 1. Infrastructure Architecture, Design & Build
• Security-Aware Monitoring Architecture: Architect and design a global visibility framework for understanding the key performance, health, and throughput indicators of core security appliances across services such as Edge Firewalls, Network Access Control (NAC), DDoS Mitigation, Network Authentication, Internal Network Segmentation, and VPNs.
• Observability Engineering: Build and deploy the observability toolchain specifically optimized to monitor the hardware and virtualized instances of Palo Alto, Fortinet, and Cisco ISE.
• LogicMonitor Development: Hands-on creation and tuning of DataSources and ConfigSources to capture hardware-level security telemetry (CPU/Data Plane utilization, Session counts, Tunnel health, and HA synchronization).
• Service Health Dashboarding: Design and build real-time operational dashboards that provide a clear view of the health, performance, and compliance status of the global security infrastructure. ​ 2. Infrastructure Operations & Evolution
• Global Service Operations: Operate the global monitoring environment, ensuring the continuous health of the observability stack across diverse network segments and security zones.
• Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Leverage APIs and automation (Python/GitLab) to automate the provisioning of monitoring for new security devices, ensuring a "security-first" approach to visibility. •

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GPC Training and Service Quality Lead
Department: Global Patient Care (GPC)
Area: Global Customer Support (GCS)
Reports to: GPC Support Lead
Location: Sant Cugat, Spain

About the Role
The Training and Service Quality Lead for Global Patient Care (GPC) plays a pivotal role in shaping service excellence across Roche Diagnostics' customer support network. Leading a dedicated team of Training and Service Quality Specialists, this role ensures the development and implementation of robust training programs and quality assurance frameworks that enable consistent, high-quality, patient-centered care.

Collaborating closely with GPC leadership, you will drive strategies that enhance skill development, align with global service standards, and foster a culture of continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with regulatory and quality standards. Through effective leadership and data-driven insights, you will strengthen the quality and efficiency of interactions with patients and customers, advancing Roche's mission to deliver transformative healthcare solutions.

Your Responsibilities
Strategic Program Development:

• Identify training and service quality improvement opportunities by collaborating with regional Customer Support hubs, Business Implementation Specialists, and other GPC functions to ensure services evolve with business needs

• Design, enhance, or discontinue training and quality programs to uphold service excellence while ensuring compliance with auditable training standards

• Lead projects related to improvements and changes within Global Patient Care to meet evolving business needs

Customer Experience & Operational Excellence:

• Establish and continuously improve a global training and service quality framework to deliver consistent, high-standard customer and patient experiences

• Define and implement operational standards to ensure excellence in Training and Service Quality across all regions

• Implement a robust quality monitoring framework for external Customer Support operations

• Utilize customer satisfaction metrics, feedback, and operational data to identify trends and improvement areas

Training Program Design and Delivery:

• Lead the development and execution of training programs tailored to enhance competencies of frontline teams and specialists

• Ensure training initiatives align with global service delivery objectives and support achievement of organizational KPIs

• Work with external partners to define and implement global training standards

Quality Assurance & Compliance:

• Implement a robust quality assurance framework to monitor and improve interactions with patients and customers

• Ensure compliance with global standards for CRM systems, contact center operations, and regulatory requirements

• Report directly to GPC Leadership to guarantee consistent, high-standard experiences while supporting delivery of Roche's innovative products and digital solutions

KPI Management & Analysis:

• Track, analyze, and report key performance indicators related to training effectiveness and service quality

• Provide actionable insights to leadership teams and regional operations to drive continuous improvement

Team Leadership & Development:

• Foster a culture of excellence, inclusivity, and collaboration while driving team and individual performance

• Lead by example as a VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leader; set clear goals, provide continuous guidance, motivation, coaching, and feedback

• Cultivate an inspiring, in

The Position
Mission
As the GPC Service Performance Lead, you will contribute that Global Patient Care (GPC) business objectives are achieved efficiently by leading a high-performing team of GPC Service Performance Specialists and managing the performance of GPC’s workforce. In this critical management role, you will design and implement staffing and performance models to meet operational demands while aligning performance management with strategic business objectives across an omnichannel environment.

This role involves overseeing detailed volume forecasting, performance planning, and monitoring trends to maximize efficiency and effectiveness across GPC’s global operations.

You will lead a team responsible for designing and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) across all supported channels, validating performance data, and identifying early patterns. You will ensure the GPC Leadership Team is proactively informed when course correction is required, managing the balance between accurately forecast volumes and the desired service levels to ensure a consistent customer experience.

Key Accountabilities

• Develop and implement service performance strategies to meet global operational and efficiency goals.

• Lead and develop a high-performing team of GPC Service Performance Specialists, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.

• Oversee strategic forecasting processes, ensuring accurate volume and capacity planning across all channels.

• Design, maintain, and validate global KPI frameworks to drive improvement and ensure data-driven decision-making.

• Analyze service performance data to identify trends, proactively providing the GPC Leadership Team with insights for operational course correction.

• Partner with internal and external stakeholders to provide channel forecasts and validate partner outcomes align with Roche performance standards (KPIs).

• Strategic Reporting Liaison: Liaise with global reporting teams to drive close collaboration, ensuring that validated, high-quality data is consistently available for GPC Leaders.

• Data Integrity & Governance: Lead the review and validation of reporting outputs to guarantee the highest level of accuracy and integrity across all operational performance metrics.

• Monitor productivity metrics and global performance to identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement and process optimization.

• Proactive participation in or management of projects to develop infrastructure and administration processes within the performance area.

• Cultivate an inspiring and inclusive team environment that promotes diversity, cross-functional collaboration, and overcomes the challenges of a multi-location setup.

• Drive the talent acquisition and hiring process, focusing on selecting and retaining top talent while maintaining a positive work environment.

• Provide proactive feedback and coaching to team members, managing performance evaluations, compensation reviews, and succession planning.

• Ensure team adherence to all P&C and compliance policies, fostering a culture of integrity and accountability.

Key skills and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

• Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international setting and a multi-channel contact center.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche is the world’s #1 provider of companion diagnostics and offers unrivaled experience in developing and commercializing predictive diagnostics that enable personalized treatment strategies for cancer patients. We offer unique opportunities for pathologists interested in playing a role in the development and implementation of new assays critical to our goal of providing more patient access to innovative new therapies. You have an opportunity to work with leading edge technologies, such as Immunohistochemistry, in situ hybridization, immunofluorescence, multiplex assays, digital pathology and more. This position is based onsite in Tucson, AZ

The Opportunity:

• You will provide crucial pathology and slide reading support for assay development, FDA submissions, clinical trials and collaborating with internal and external development teams.

• You will be at the forefront of research and development activities by supporting the development of primary antibodies, detection systems, probes and special stains.

• You will advise on future pathology and medical needs.

• You will be a medical representative on project core teams and contribute to pathology related aspects of specific development projects.

• You will drive continuous improvement in work processes, making a direct impact on the efficiency and effectiveness of our operations.

• You will utilize your expertise to advise on future pathology and medical needs, ensuring that we stay ahead of the curve in our industry

Who you are:

• You have an M.D. or D.O. with US Board Certification in Anatomic Pathology and an active state medical license.

• You are Residency-trained in anatomic pathology with expertise in surgical pathology and a proven ability to assess histopathology, IHC, ISH, and multiplex assays.

• You are experienced in evaluating complex immunohistochemistry assays such as PD-L1, HER2, and Ki-67.

• You are a precision medicine innovator and are Passionate about companion diagnostics (CDx) and the "right drug, right patient, right time" philosophy.

• You are a tech-Forward collaborator: Comfortable utilizing digital pathology scanners, automated algorithms, and advanced staining platforms (VENTANA Benchmark).

• You thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment, working seamlessly with scientists, engineers, and other experts to drive FDA submissions and clinical trial success.

​ Preferred Qualifications:

• Fellowship trained with 1 year of experience in clinical practice or industry.

• Prior experience in immunohistochemistry, cytology, molecular and/or genetics

​
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson, AZ is 174,000-323,100. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance.

This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Relocation benefits are available for this posting

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

pRED Cardiovascular & Metabolism, Immunology (CMI), located in Basel, Switzerland, focuses on the discovery and early development of innovative treatments for specific diseases that affect the lives of millions. In the cardiovascular and metabolism area, we are developing cutting-edge therapies to treat metabolic diseases.

We are currently hiring four experienced PhD-level Discovery Scientists to join our Cardiovascular & Metabolic Disease Research team :
These opportunities include two in vivo-focused and two in vitro-focused positions , offering the chance to contribute to innovative preclinical research in metabolic diseases. We are looking for candidates with strong expertise in in vitro and/or in vivo pharmacology, a solid industry background, and a proven track record in executing preclinical projects in metabolic diseases and immunology.

The opportunity
In this role, you will design and execute experiments and lead projects to evaluate the efficacy and safety of novel therapeutic candidates.

• Lead research projects in the area of metabolic diseases (insulin resistance, obesity) from target ideation to entry into clinical development for both small- and large-molecule modalities.

• Drive the positioning and prioritization of novel metabolic and immunological targets, integrating disease biology, translational biomarkers, and therapeutic modality selection to align with Roche’s CVM pipeline.

• Collaboratively design, execute, and interpret complex preclinical in vitro and in vivo experimental studies for the validation and characterization of targets or therapeutic agents

• Direct, execute, and benchmark novel experiments, work together hand in hand with associates, and transfer standardized assays to associates

• Act as a resource in project teams, and demonstrate clear and professional verbal and written communication

Who You Are
You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. You are looking for a company where you receive the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Working in a multicultural environment motivates you. As a fast learner, you actively drive the quality of the requirements.

• You possess a PhD degree in Life Sciences ; are specialized in Metabolic diseases (insulin resistance, obesity, muscle-/adipose-physiology)

• You have >5 years of research and project leadership experience in the pharmaceutical industry.

• You have demonstrated ability to effectively present scientific data and concepts to colleagues, teams, and management is essential

• Skillfully able to interact effectively with people, both internally and externally

• Vigorous “can do” mentality to succeed in a dynamic and highly collaborative research team

• Depending on your background, this role is embedded in an in vivo–focused or in vitro-focused research team

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity !

jobs.title: Director/Associate Director of Safety, Facilities, and Security

titleByLocale.it: Direttore/Associate Direttore of Safety, Facilities, and Security

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur/Associate Directeur of Safety, Facilities, and Security

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a strategic safety and facilities leader ready to make an impact in a fast-paced biotech environment? We're seeking an experienced Director/Associate Director to join our SBX Technology team as the cornerstone of our site's operational resilience and compliance excellence. In this high-visibility role, you'll lead proactive risk management, oversee critical infrastructure, and drive continuous improvement across safety, facilities, and security—all while maintaining inspection readiness around the clock. If you have 8+ years in large-scale industrial environments, proven management expertise, and the drive to anticipate facility demands, we'd like to hear from you.

The Opportunity

• Manages the SHE, Security, and Facilities maintenance to comply with applicable regulatory and company policies, utilizing industry best practices, and identifying and managing risk.

• Works with building management to maintain critical power systems and emergency generators. Serves as the primary internal lead for building power restoration and temporary generators, ensuring building management and external vendors to maintain 100% operational readiness during extended building outage.

• Works cross-functionally to develop and support facilities projects and implementing new technology processes including remodels, new equipment, and reagents, etc . Manages all moves, construction, upgrades, and maintenance for the site.

• Leads hazard identification - determining and implementing necessary risk assessment programs/processes – as well as related facilities changes.

• Responds to and investigates all SHE, Security and Facility issues. Supports post-incident analysis to determine mitigation strategies to reduce future incident frequency and impact.

• Leads, manages, and continuously improves all relevant safety processes in a large generator environment, including hazardous waste management, dangerous goods shipments, chemical safety assessments, spill safety, exposure monitoring, biosafety programs, etc. Identifies and manages risk and ensures compliance.

• Ensures the site complies with applicable regulatory and company policies and is always “inspection ready”. May lead government and company interactions related to SHE, Security, and Facilities requirements including reporting, notification, facilitating inspections, and ensuring closure of corrective actions.

• Establishes monitoring solutions for critical facilities and lab equipment to enable after-hours monitoring and meaningful alerts.

• Prepares clear response plan documents for safety and facilities scenarios that can be executed by on-site personnel outside of standard business hours. Provides transparent documentation of site fail point areas.

Who you are
Education

• Bachelor or Master’s degree in chemistry, safety, industrial hygiene, or other relevant field.

Experience

• 8 years of progressive experience within a large scale industry such as technical manufacturing, diagnostics, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, oil and gas industry, or other relevant industries.

• 5+ years of management experience.

Core Competencies

• Emergency Response & On-Call Availability: Demonstrated capability to respond effectively to critical safety, facilities, or security incidents (chemical spills, power outages, facility emergencies) with flexibility for after-hours and weekend availability as needed; track record of minimizing business disruption during safety events

• Self-Direction & Organization: Highly sel

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del prodotto HI Enterprise Cloud
titleByLocale.en: Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable du produit HI Enterprise Cloud

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud (Senior Product Leader) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement of a complex product. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape.

Your primary objective is to define the direction for the engineering and service teams to build desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards.

Your main responsabilities:

• Drive the Product Vision: Define and execute the comprehensive strategy and roadmap for the Enterprise Cloud portfolio to accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics.

• Manage the Full Lifecycle: Take accountability for the entire product journey, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to scaling and retirement of complex cloud solutions.

• Lead Cloud Transformation: Orchestrate Roche’s "Cloud-First" strategy by optimizing for speed and release cadence to meet the evolving demands of Enterprise and R&D products.

• Foster Strategic Collaboration: Navigate a broad ecosystem of internal teams, external SaaS vendors, and academic partners to ensure seamless platform integration and API management.

• Ensure Compliance and Excellence: Balance innovation with strict adherence to industry standards, including GxP, while integrating AI capabilities to maintain a competitive advantage.

Who you are:

• Experienced Product Leader: You bring 10+ years in product management or business analysis with a proven history of launching and managing complex technology products.

• Industry Expert: You have 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology sector.

• Proven People Manager: You possess 2+ years of experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing, multidisciplinary technical teams.

• Technically Proficient: You hold a University Degree and have deep knowledge of modern software architecture, Cloud Hyperscalers, and Container as a Service (CaaS).

• Regulatory and Data Savvy: You are well-versed in GxP, FAIR data principles, and data privacy regulations such as GDPR to ensure secure and compliant foundations.

Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Madrid. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

Questo ruolo è fondamentale per trasformare le esigenze scientifiche e aziendali in soluzioni tecnologiche tangibili e ad alto valore. • Leader del prodotto esperto: porti 10+ anni nella gestione del prodotto o nell'analisi aziendale con una comprovata storia di lancio e gestione di prodotti tecnologici complessi.

• Proven People Manager: Possiedi 2+ anni di esperienza leader, mentoring e sviluppo di team tecnici altamente performanti e multidisciplinari.
• Tecnicamente Proficiente: Lei possiede una laurea universitaria e ha una profonda conoscenza dell'architettura moderna del software, di Cloud Hyperscalers e di Container come Servizio (CaaS).
• Normativa e Data Savvy: Lei è ben diversificato nei principi di dati GxP, FAIR e nelle normative sulla privacy dei dati come GDPR per garantire fondazioni sicure e conformi. Ce rôle est essentiel pour transformer les besoins scientifiques et commerciaux en solutions technologiques tangibles et de grande valeur. Vous serez responsable de la définition de la vision, de la stratégie et de la feuille de route du produit, en s'assurant qu'elle s'harmonise avec les objectifs généraux de notre organisation et, en fin de compte, accélère la prestation de diagnostics et de médicaments qui changent la vie aux patients. Ce rôle exige une combinaison distinctive d'enquête scientifique, de compétence technique et de perspicacité commerciale pour naviguer avec succès dans le paysage. Votre objectif principal est de définir l'orientation des équipes d'ingénierie et de service pour construire des produits souhaitables, réalisables, viables et durables qui répondent aux besoins changeants de nos utilisateurs internes tout en maintenant le strict respect des normes pertinentes de l'industrie. Vos principales responsabilités :
• Conduire la vision du produit: Définir et exécuter la stratégie et la feuille de route globales pour le portefeuille Enterprise Cloud afin d'accélérer la livraison de diagnostics changeant la vie.
• Gérer le cycle de vie complet : Rendre compte de l'ensemble du parcours du produit, de l'idée initiale et de la planification stratégique jusqu'à la mise à niveau et à la retraite de solutions cloud complexes.
• Lead Cloud Transformation: Orchestre Roches Stratégie «Cloud-First» en optimisant la vitesse et la cadence de sortie pour répondre aux exigences changeantes des produits Enterprise et R&D.
• Favoriser la collaboration stratégique : Naviguez dans un vaste écosystème d'équipes internes, de fournisseurs externes SaaS et de partenaires universitaires afin d'assurer l'intégration des plateformes et la gestion des API.
• Assurer la conformité et l'excellence : équilibrer l'innovation avec le strict respect des normes de l'industrie, y compris GxP, tout en intégrant les capacités d'IA pour maintenir un avantage concurrentiel. Qui vous êtes :
• Chef de produit expérimenté: Vous apportez 10 ans et plus en gestion de produits ou en analyse commerciale avec une histoire éprouvée de lancement et de gestion de produits technologiques complexes.
• Expert de l'industrie: Vous avez plus de 2 ans d'expérience dans le secteur pharmaceutique, de la biotechnologie ou des technologies de santé réglementées.
• Proven People Manager: Vous possédez plus de 2 ans d'expérience en leadership, en mentorat et en développement d'équipes techniques multidisciplinaires à haut rendement.
• Techniquement compétent: Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire et avez une connaissance approfondie de l'architecture logicielle moderne, Cloud Hyperscalers et Container as a Service (CaaS).
• Regulatory and Data Savvy: Vous êtes bien orienté dans GxP, principes de données FAIR, et les règles de confidentialité des données telles que le RGPD pour assurer des fondations sûres et conformes. Prêt à apporter vos qualités uniques à Roche et faire un impact? Postulez maintenant et rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de façonner l'avenir des soins de santé. Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Madrid. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec notre médicament

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader.
● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker.
● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies.
● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.
● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators.
● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area.

Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
(Major functions of the position)
1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related biomarker
● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy.
● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs.
● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events; Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs, preferences and views of new data.
● Provide scientific support for cross functional partners in medical training, scientific query handling, speaker material preparation.
● Lead the local innovative business model developing, implementation and further optimization, such as the establishment of regional pathology referral center with synergy from Roche diagnostic company and other external diagnostic related company or medical society.
● Contribute to the execution of advisory boards.
2) Data Generation
● Translate insights on local stakeholder needs and value decision drivers into an effective medical strategy, prioritize gaps and hurdles related to the local patient journey.
● Ensure excellence in access evidence planning and generation as part of the medical strategy, incorporating RWE, clinical studies and data inputs for local economic models etc.
● Receive IISs request, work with country medical manager to review of IISs within the company, and following-up with investigators, in accordance to all local laws and regulations.
● Support site feasibility assessments, site development plan, patients enrollment in trials and investigator engagement of Phase I-IIIa clinical studies under the direction of PD of Phase IIIb-IV Medical Affairs clinical studies in collaboration with clinical operations
3) Knowledge exchange
● Translate clinical/scientific evidence into local value messages and communicate those in cross functional collaboration to relevant stakeholders in a tailored manner.
● Exchange scientific data with HCPs; facilitate their needs of up to date scientific data, including but not limited to publications of clinical trials, guidelines, by ensuring they have the best quality vailable information they require.
● Develop and deliver medical training and education program to the target audience.
● Provide inputs to country medical manager on the af

jobs.title: Service Design Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will join the Customer Experience, Research & Strategy team at Roche Diagnostics in Sant Cugat. This team sits at the heart of how Roche understands and designs for the people who rely on diagnostic solutions — from lab professionals to clinicians and patients. The team combines rigorous research with strategic design to shape services and experiences across digital and physical touchpoints.

About the role

As a Service Design intern you will contribute to real research and design projects from day one. Working alongside senior designers and researchers, you will help map the end-to-end experiences of Roche's customers, conduct user research, and explore how conversational interfaces — chatbots, voice assistants, and AI-powered agents — can better serve the needs of healthcare professionals.
Over the course of a full year you will move through the entire design cycle — from discovery and research through to prototyping and delivery — building a rich, evidence-based portfolio in one of the most complex and meaningful design contexts there is.

What you'll do

Research support

• Assist in planning and facilitating user interviews, contextual enquiries, and usability sessions with healthcare professionals

• Help synthesise qualitative findings through affinity mapping and insight frameworks

• Contribute to personas, journey maps, and mental model documentation

• Support the team in maintaining research repositories and knowledge assets

Service design

• Contribute to service blueprints and experience maps that reveal systemic friction

• Participate in co-design workshops with internal teams and external stakeholders

• Help build and iterate on prototypes for concept testing

• Document design decisions and produce artefacts that communicate intent clearly

Conversational design

• Support the design of dialogue flows and conversation scripts for chat and voice interfaces

• Help define tone of voice guidelines for automated interactions in a healthcare context

• Assist in evaluating conversational prototypes with real users and documenting findings

• Research best practices in NLP, intent design, and accessible conversational UX

Collaboration

• Work in cross-functional squads alongside product managers, engineers, and clinical experts

• Present work-in-progress in team reviews and design critiques

• Contribute to team rituals: stand-ups, retrospectives, and design community sessions

• Bring fresh perspective and curiosity to a team that values diverse viewpoints

Who we're looking for

• Currently enrolled in a degree in Service Design, Interaction Design, HCI, UX, or a related field

• Genuine interest in human-centred research — you are curious about people and why they behave as they do

• Exposure to conversational design, dialogue writing, or NLP through coursework or personal projects

• Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to ask good questions in complex environments

• Clear communication in English (working language of the team); Spanish is a plus

• A portfolio or project work demonstrating research and/or design thinking

Nice to have

• Familiarity with tools such as Figma, FigJam, Miro, or Dovetail

• Interest in healthcare, diagnostics, or life sciences

• Exposure to systems thinking, service blueprinting, or design research methods

• Any experience with chatbot platforms or voice assistant design

• Strong visual communication skills — the ability to make complexity legible

What we offer: The internship experience

• A full

jobs.title: Process Technician
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
We are currently looking for two Process Technicians to join our Process Engineering team on a 12-month contract , with the possibility of extension. Both positions will involve the same day-to-day responsibilities outlined below; however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

As a Process Technician you will work closely with the sensor manufacture and packaging teams and will become highly skilled and competent in all aspects of manufacturing (e.g. line operation & packaging, processes and procedures). Be able to diagnose product and process issues quickly and effectively using a logical approach. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring the highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained. Analyse manufacturing data and conduct product / process testing to ensure CTQs are met. Update documentation such as standard operating procedures, work instructions and bills of material.

This is an on-site role based at our Athena Motherwell location. Please note that you will spend approximately 70% of your time working from our Bathgate site, however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

Responsibilities:
Technical:

• Work in close collaboration with manufacturing technicians and engineers to become highly competent in sensor manufacture line operation, processes and procedures

• Support monitoring of product and process data using statistical analysis techniques

• Quick and effective diagnosis and troubleshooting of problems using a methodical approach and report progress in a structured way

• Conduct CTQ testing and material / product analysis techniques

• Investigate and resolve non-conformances and help develop robust OCAP’s and preventative measures

• Support NPD projects through transfer of pilot work to high volume manufacture

• Support validation activities and completion of validation documentation in line with business needs

• Help drive continuous improvement initiatives through engagement of production team on shift

• Ensures highest levels of quality and compliance are maintained

• Lead/support change control updates to manufacturing documentation.

Who you are:

Essential Education/ Qualifications:

• Process Excellence Yellow or Green belt additional advantage.

• Preferably Degree qualified or relevant experience.

• Experience in rotary converting and / or reel to reel printing (rotary screen / flexographic etc.) additional advantage

• Knowledge of Statistical Analysis methods / techniques

Requirements (incl. Key Skills):

• GMP experience

• A hands-on Process Technician with a good level of relevant industry experience (preferably medical device related)

• Experience of optimising product and processes

• High level of computer literacy

• Team player and takes accountability for any manufacturing challenges

• Analyse production data and conduct process / product analysis to ensure CTQs are met

• Strong problem-solving skills and sense of urgency

• Detail orientated and ensures highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained on a daily basis

Recruitment process

Phase I:

• Submission of Cover Letter & CV: Evaluation of technical skills and motivation.

Phase II:

• In-person interview in Athena Motherwell (will be shared with the shortlisted candidates later)

Purpose - our focus in the

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità: Siamo attualmente alla ricerca di due tecnici di processo per aderire al nostro team di Process Engineering in un contratto di 12 mesi, con la possibilità di estensione. Entrambe le posizioni coinvolgeranno le stesse responsabilità quotidiane descritte di seguito; tuttavia, uno dei ruoli richiederà anche di lavorare nella nostra posizione Dumyat. In qualità di tecnico di processo lavorerai a stretto contatto con i team di produzione e confezionamento dei sensori e diventerai altamente qualificato e competente in tutti gli aspetti della produzione (ad esempio il funzionamento della linea e l'imballaggio, i processi e le procedure). Essere in grado di diagnosticare i problemi di prodotto e processo in modo rapido ed efficace utilizzando un approccio logico. Supporta e guida iniziative di miglioramento continuo garantendo al contempo i massimi livelli di qualità e produttività. Analizzare i dati di produzione e condurre i test di prodotto / processo per garantire CTQ sono soddisfatti. Documentazione di aggiornamento come procedure operative standard, istruzioni di lavoro e bollette di materiale. Questo è un ruolo in loco basato sulla nostra sede Athena Motherwell. Si prega di notare che trascorrerete circa il 70% del vostro tempo lavorando dal nostro sito Bathgate, tuttavia, uno dei ruoli richiederà anche di lavorare nella nostra posizione Dumyat. • Lavorare in stretta collaborazione con tecnici e ingegneri di produzione per diventare altamente competenti nel funzionamento, processi e procedure della linea di produzione dei sensori
• Monitoraggio del supporto dei dati dei prodotti e dei processi utilizzando tecniche di analisi statistica
• Diagnosi rapida ed efficace e risoluzione dei problemi utilizzando un approccio metodologico e riferire i progressi in modo strutturato
• Condurre test CTQ e tecniche di analisi dei materiali / prodotti
• Indagare e risolvere non conformità e contribuire a sviluppare misure di prevenzione e di OCAP robuste
• Sostenere i progetti NPD attraverso il trasferimento di lavori pilota alla fabbricazione di volumi elevati
• Supportare le attività di validazione e il completamento della documentazione di validazione in linea con le esigenze aziendali
• Guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso l'impegno del team di produzione a turni
• Garantisce elevati livelli di qualità e conformità sono mantenuti
• Aggiornamenti di controllo delle modifiche di piombo/supporto alla documentazione di produzione. Chi sei: Educazione Essenziale/ Qualifiche:
• Processo Eccellenza Giallo o Verde cintura ulteriore vantaggio.
• Preferibilmente Laurea esperienza qualificata o rilevante.
• Esperienza nella conversione rotante e/o bobina nella stampa a bobina (schermo rotatorio / flessografico ecc.) ulteriore vantaggio
• Conoscenza dei metodi / tecniche di analisi statistica Requisiti (incl. competenze chiave):
• Esperienza GMP
• Un tecnico di processo pratico con un buon livello di esperienza industriale rilevante (preferibilmente dispositivo medico correlato)
• Esperienza di ottimizzazione dei prodotti e dei processi
• Alti livelli di alfabetizzazione del computer
• Giocatore di squadra e tiene conto delle sfide di produzione
• Analizzare i dati di produzione e condurre l'analisi del processo / del prodotto per garantire il raggiungimento di CTQ
• Forte capacità di problem solving e senso di urgenza

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position La possibilité : Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche de deux techniciens de process pour rejoindre notre équipe de Process Engineering sur un contrat de 12 mois, avec la possibilité de prolongation. Les deux postes comprendront les mêmes responsabilités quotidiennes décrites ci-dessous; toutefois, l'un des rôles devra aussi travailler à notre emplacement de Dumyat. En tant que technicien en process, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de fabrication et d'emballage des capteurs et vous deviendrez hautement qualifié et compétent dans tous les aspects de la fabrication (p. ex. fonctionnement et emballage en ligne, processus et procédures). Être en mesure de diagnostiquer les problèmes de produit et de processus rapidement et efficacement en utilisant une approche logique. Appuyer et diriger les initiatives d'amélioration continue tout en assurant le maintien des plus hauts niveaux de qualité et de productivité. Analyser les données de fabrication et effectuer des essais de produits et de procédés pour s'assurer que les CTQ sont respectés. Mettre à jour les documents tels que les procédures opérationnelles normalisées, les instructions de travail et les factures de matériel. C'est un rôle sur place basé sur notre site Athena Motherwell. Veuillez noter que vous passerez environ 70 % de votre temps à partir de notre site de Bathgate, mais que l'un des rôles devra aussi être celui de notre site de Dumyat. Responsabilités : Technique:
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les techniciens de fabrication et les ingénieurs pour devenir très compétents dans le fonctionnement de la ligne de fabrication de capteurs, les processus et les procédures
• Soutenir la surveillance des données sur les produits et les procédés au moyen de techniques d'analyse statistique
• Diagnostic rapide et efficace et dépannage des problèmes en utilisant une approche méthodique et rapporter les progrès de manière structurée
• Effectuer des essais CTQ et des techniques d'analyse des matériaux/produits
• Étudier et résoudre les non-conformités et aider à développer des OCAP et des mesures préventives robustes
• Soutenir les projets de la NPD par le transfert des travaux pilotes à la fabrication à haut volume
• Soutenir les activités de validation et compléter la documentation de validation en fonction des besoins opérationnels
• Aider à mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue par l'engagement de l'équipe de production en équipe
• Assurer le maintien des niveaux de qualité et de conformité les plus élevés
• Mise à jour du contrôle du changement de plomb/support à la documentation de fabrication. Qui vous êtes : Études essentielles / Qualifications :
• Processus Excellence Ceinture jaune ou verte avantage supplémentaire.
• De préférence Expérience qualifiée ou pertinente.
• Expérience en conversion rotative et / ou bobine à l'impression de bobines (écran rotatif / flexographique etc.) avantage supplémentaire
• Connaissance des méthodes et techniques d'analyse statistique Exigences (y compris les compétences clés):
• Expérience BPF
• Un technicien pratique en procédés possédant un bon niveau d'expérience dans l'industrie (de préférence lié à un appareil médical)
• Expérience d'optimisation des produits et des procédés
• Niveau élevé de connaissances en informatique
• Joueur d'équipe et prend la responsabilité de tout défi de fabrication
