jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Reportando al líder de Bids & Contracts en el Área Comercial, tu misión es colaborar de forma decisiva en el proceso integral de participación en licitaciones públicas para operaciones comerciales clave. Como experto de la filial en ofertas complejas, con un profundo conocimiento técnico y alto enfoque comercial , tu función se centra principalmente en asegurar la excelencia técnica y económica en la confección, revisión y presentación de ofertas.

Responsabilidades

• Acompañamiento a ventas : Especialmente en estadios comerciales preliminares visitando Clientes clave para afianzar la relación y garantizar el éxito de las operaciones.

• Asesoramiento experto en operaciones estratégicas: De la mano de ventas complementa las capacidades comerciales para asegurar que se define e implementa una estrategia ganadora que maximice oportunidades y minimice riesgos.

• Revisión exhaustiva de nuestras ofertas para las licitaciones estratégicas seleccionadas, asegurando la competitividad, la sostenibilidad y perfecta redacción.

• Seguimiento exhaustivo de operaciones clave : Monitorizando el proceso integral especialmente desde la fase previa a la publicación hasta la firma del contrato para operaciones complejas (incluyendo aclaraciones, subsanaciones o teniendo un rol clave en la construcción y revisión de los argumentos técnicos para alegaciones o recursos especiales en materia de contratación.

• Análisis holístico de todo el proceso integral de oferta y adjudicación para garantizar el cumplimiento de la estrategia y las simulaciones, lo que le permitirá mantenerse al día con los cambios en el mercado y la competencia. Comparte estos aprendizajes con el resto de la organización para futuras estrategias de licitación.

• Divulgación de los aprendizajes : Ser un referente formativo en ofertas, informando de forma continua de los principales aprendizajes / tendencias / noticias relevantes para otras operaciones. Capacitar al equipo completo de Bids, a la Red Comercial y al resto de la organización sobre la estrategia de ofertas con especial foco a la estrategia técnico-económica.

Requisitos y Habilidades

● Capacidad Analítica para interpretar datos de mercado, pliegos, revisar documentación técnica/económica compleja tanto propia como de la competencia y trabajar bajo presión cumpliendo plazos estrictos.
● Visión Estratégica y organizativa
● Alto nivel de conocimiento técnico y competitivo del mercado IVD y en contratación pública, unidos a una amplia visión comercial y económica

jobs.title: Verification & Validation Test Technician

titleByLocale.it: Tecnico di prova di verifica e convalida

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you someone who finds satisfaction in the details? Do you enjoy the process of systematically checking software to ensure it works perfectly with physical hardware?

In our cross functional and cross Site team, we are looking for a Test Technician with a strong interest in Instrument testing focusing on Software Testing to join our team in Sant Cugat. While you will be working with physical medical instruments, your primary focus will be on the software that drives them—executing test cases, documenting defects, and ensuring the system is reliable for patient use.

Your Role
In this position, you aren't just "clicking buttons"—you are the guardian of software quality. You will be responsible for the consistent execution of test protocols that bridge the gap between digital code and mechanical movement.

Key Responsibilities:

• Software-Centric medical device testing:
• Execute manual test cases focusing on software functionality, with a customer mindset on a medical device.

• Lifecycle Maintenance:
• Create, refine, and update software test cases over the entire life cycle of the medical device.

• Methodical Execution:
• Perform repetitive test cycles with high consistency to ensure software stability across different versions.

• Technical Documentation:
• Document every step of your process. You will record defects and test results with high precision to meet medical regulatory standards.

Your Profile
We are looking for a practical, detail-oriented professional with a genuine passion for technology. If you love troubleshooting, have a high affinity for software, and prefer hands-on execution over theoretical concepts, this is the role for you. Formación Profesional (Grado Medio/Superior), no university degree is required—we value your practical skills, technical curiosity, and drive to learn

Background:
Completed apprenticeship or solid job experience in a technical environment, laboratory, or IT-support setting. E.g. Técnico/a de Pruebas, Tester de Software y Hardware, Técnico de Verificación y Validación (V&V), Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Multiplataforma, Grado en Ingeniería Informática or similar

The "Tester" Mindset:
You are naturally conscientious and thorough. You enjoy a routine-oriented environment and take pride in performing repetitive tasks with 100% accuracy every time.

Software Affinity:
You have a keen interest in how software operates and a desire to build a career in instrument/system testing (no programming skills needed).

Quality First:
You understand that documenting a test is just as important as performing it.

Soft skills:
Ability to actively contribute to team collaboration, inclusion, sharing ideas and good team spirit, as well as mutual trust and respect (project team and sub chapter level)

Languages skills:
Expert Spanish (C1 or better) and expert English (C1 or better) language skills. The project language is English. Local team language is Spanish

Bonus skills:

• Basic understanding of customer workflows in the area of diagnostic instruments (e.g. in coagulation or serum work area)

• Basic skills with testing tools e.g. Retina

• Initial experience with software testing on instrument level

What you can expect from us:

Teamwork with ambitious and passionate people building high-quality products meeting customer’s needs
An agile working environment allowing for collaboration and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams
Fostered collaboration within the project and chapter to build and maintain a tr

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Location: Ohio, Kentucky, Indiana and West Virginia (Ideal candidate to live south west of Cincinnati around the 71/75 corridor)
Travel: 100% in assigned territory.

This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative
diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success, and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

The Opportunity
The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel and demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and/or installation specialist for Roche assigned product lines and provide valued service to your laboratory customers in an assigned territory. This position serves as a technical repair or installation specialist for Roche products for assigned product lines and geographies. Product Responsibility: Clinical chemistry, Immunoassay and lab automation.

• Provides routine technical support to customers on operational and maintenance aspects of system equipment.

• Performs on-site service, repair and/or installation of company product(s). This may include any aspect of field support and is not limited to mechanical/system hardware and software, networking/wireless networking.

• Serves as customer contact on routine technical and service-related problems. Receives training and delivers service within the normal scope of the position. Follows documented practices, policies and procedures in providing repair and installation support.

• Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures. Determines the most cost-effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime.

• Provides analysis, feedback and recommendations on product failure trends and serviceability issues. Documents all activity in a manner compliant with the company's quality procedures. Specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system or equipment. Requires specific training and certification.

• Applies some advanced skills to the position or specialization. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks.

• Resolves most questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

This is a field based role.

Who You Are

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Ba

• Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking
• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy
• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required Preferred Requirements
• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.
• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.
• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is hiring for a greenfield facility in Shanghai and we are looking for Lab Support & ASAT SME, for who takes responsibility for equipment/systems qualification and validation, sample and testing material management and other lab supporting processes. Also provides support during the project, operation readiness and start-up phase and liaises across the design, construction, qualification of the QC area, ensuring they meet the intended standard and regulation requirements.
Strong skill and experience are required to cover two areas: Greenfield project and Routine Operation management.

• The role supports on the equipment/system qualification and validation, sample/material management and QC operation readiness and start up.

• Work independently and with a level of autonomy and authority in efficient execution to ensure on-going compliance against approved global/local procedure documents, current Good Manufacturing Practices, and CN/EU Annex-1 during the product lifecycle.

• Enable and self-motivate, and demonstrate leadership behavior and mindset

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责 / 责任
Routine Operation:

• Perform the qualification, validation, calibration and maintenance activities for relevant equipment with Roche’s QMS and regulatory guidelines.

• Set up master data according to business requirements and ensure data integrity.

• Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements

• Assist Head of Lab Support to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance.

• Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely to internal investigations and regulatory inspectors. Accomplish sample and testing materials management(eg account management, DI assessment), to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time. Report the abnormal status, deviations to supervisors with initiative.

• By identifying abnormal status and unexpected results during routine operation by detailed data, support to alert supervisors to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.

• Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of bioanalytical materials and cell supplies Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Equipment qualification and validation: Support and execute the equipment qualification and validation for the aseptic product.

• Sample and material management: Execute GMP sample management; Execute material inventory management.

• Digital system deployment: Support and ensure on time delivery for QC digital system(eg.LIMS).

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

Job Required Competencies

• 2 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on bioanalytical and bioassay testing. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred

• Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance and physical and chemical testing.

• Experienced in QC new system startup readiness and operation ramp up is preferred.

• ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Fluent communications skills in English

• Project management skills are preferred.

Who we are

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Required:

• Lead multidisciplinary drug discovery project teams from target identification through preclinical candidate selection. Proactively 'invent' future medicines by identifying high-value targets in the obesity and cardiometabolic diseases space.

• Proven expertise in building disease-relevant cellular assays for metabolic disorders using immortalized and/or primary human and animal cells, including co-cultures and/or organoid culture systems

• Capable in design and execution of in vivo studies to characterize the pharmacology of novel targets. Extensive familiarity with in vivo workflows, including experimental design, surgical/dosing techniques, and interpretation of metabolic phenotypic data. This includes evaluating regulation of body weight/composition, glucose and lipid utilization and total energy balance.

• Partner with colleagues in molecular pharmacology, chemistry, and in vivo biology to perform biochemical and molecular assessments on ex vivo samples, ensuring an integral understanding of drug action.

• Requirement for accurate record keeping, independent data analysis, and reporting of data in written and oral formats. Exceptional attention to details with excellent written and verbal communication skills to clearly articulate complex concepts at all levels of the organization.

Desired:

• Deep expertise in the biology of energy balance regulation and the pathophysiology of adipose tissue (white, brown, and beige fat).

• Hands-on experience with functional metabolic assays, including insulin sensitivity and glucose/lipid metabolism, mitochondrial function and cellular respiration (e.g., Seahorse assays), assessment of body composition (e.g., EchoMRI or DEXA).

• Specific experience studying the interplay between adipose tissue and neural biology (e.g., sympathetic innervation of fat or central control of metabolism) is a plus.

Qualifications

• PhD and/or postdoctoral training with a focus on metabolism, physiology, biology or related field with well recognized peer-reviewed publications in metabolic research.

• Proven experience leading drug discovery projects in metabolism discovery within a pharmaceutical or biotechnology setting is highly desired.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur du groupe principal, Affaires réglementaires techniques

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The people leader leads a team of China Technical Partners (CTPs) and CMC professionals that are accountable for China regulatory CMC submissions, through developing and implementing robust end-to-end China filing strategies based on close collaboration with global development teams, China business priorities, China regulatory requirements and landscape. The scope includes the complete Roche portfolio, the global products (small molecules, biologics, new modalities). The focus of this role is to lead and coach the team members in order to accelerate drug access and continuous supply to the patients by ensuring right first-time submissions to Chinese Health Authorities and effective interactions with the Health Authority. The incumbent of the role is responsible to shape the regulatory environment in China in close collaboration with PTR Policy and translate that into innovative regulatory strategies. In line with Roche’s China strategy and the China First initiative, this is a role with a high business impact.
In this position, the people leader is responsible for the management of China Technical Partners (CTPs) and CMC program managers, which includes setting performance objectives, providing timely feedback, and ensuring alignment of short-term development goals with longer-term career goals. Provides guidance and manages work activities of others for specific projects and/or objectives. Demonstrates the fundamentals of effective coaching skills and mentoring. Adapts coaching style to meet the needs of the individual.
The people leader leads cross-functional regulatory initiatives and strategies, defines associated critical steps and resources needed and takes responsibility for implementation of these initiatives and strategies. Proactively communicates with regulatory and cross-functional personnel in support of internal and partner-associated project goals. Collaborates with management in leading communications with HA on projects and initiatives of major complexity. Makes decisions based on cross-functional priorities rather than functional area priorities.

Project People Leader

• Provide leadership to a team of regulatory professionals.

• Responsible for performance management of employees.

• Work with direct reports and ensure that objective and timely feedback is provided to employees, focus on the development of the employee by facilitating regular development discussions and check-ins.

• Provide coaching and mentoring to colleagues for an assigned area of technical regulatory responsibility.

• Work closely with the Portfolio Leader to coordinate resources and priorities at a Portfolio level.

• Regularly follow up and check in the progress of every specific project in the team, enlighten the team to work out submission strategies for different applications and identify regulatory risks and develop migration plans.

• Build and maintain a healthy relationships with internal & external key stakeholders, like NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, Supply Chain, Quality and compliance, PDR China and PTR global,

• Collaborate with internal key stakeholders for development and alignment of technical strategy, maximizing and balancing regulatory and supply needs in China.

QUALIFICATIONS
Education
Master’s Degree in life science disciplines is preferred; Post Graduate Degree is a plus.

Experience

• 8 or more years work experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or related industry and CMC, quality, regulatory or related experience.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il leader della gente guida un team di Cina partner tecnici (CTPs) e professionisti CMC che sono responsabili per le presentazioni CMC di regolamentazione della Cina, attraverso lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di robuste strategie di archiviazione end-to-end Cina basate sulla stretta collaborazione con i team di sviluppo globale, le priorità aziendali della Cina, i requisiti normativi della Cina e il paesaggio. La portata include il portafoglio completo di Roche, i prodotti globali (piccole molecole, biologiche, nuove modalità). L'obiettivo di questo ruolo è quello di guidare e allenare i membri del team al fine di accelerare l'accesso alla droga e la fornitura continua ai pazienti assicurando le giuste presentazioni di prima volta alle autorità sanitarie cinesi e le interazioni efficaci con l'Autorità sanitaria. L'incombente del ruolo è responsabile di modellare l'ambiente normativo in Cina in stretta collaborazione con PTR Policy e tradurlo in strategie normative innovative. In linea con la strategia cinese di Roche e la prima iniziativa della Cina, questo è un ruolo con un alto impatto commerciale. In questa posizione, il leader delle persone è responsabile per la gestione dei partner tecnici cinesi (CTPs) e dei gestori dei programmi CMC, che include l'impostazione degli obiettivi di performance, il feedback tempestivo e l'allineamento degli obiettivi di sviluppo a breve termine con obiettivi di carriera a lungo termine. Fornisce indicazioni e gestisce attività di lavoro di altri per progetti e/o obiettivi specifici. Dimostra i fondamenti delle competenze di coaching efficaci e di mentoring. Adapts stile di coaching per soddisfare le esigenze dell'individuo. Il leader delle persone guida iniziative e strategie di regolamentazione interfunzionali, definisce i passi critici associati e le risorse necessarie e si assume la responsabilità per l'attuazione di queste iniziative e strategie. Proattivamente comunica con personale normativo e interfunzionale a supporto degli obiettivi di progetto interni e associati ai partner. Collabora con la gestione nelle principali comunicazioni con HA su progetti e iniziative di grande complessità. Prende decisioni basate su priorità interfunzionali piuttosto che su priorità di area funzionale. Leader del progetto
• Fornire leadership a un team di professionisti di regolamentazione.
• Responsabile per la gestione delle prestazioni dei dipendenti.
• Lavorare con rapporti diretti e garantire che il feedback oggettivo e tempestivo sia fornito ai dipendenti, concentrarsi sullo sviluppo del dipendente facilitando le discussioni e i check-in di sviluppo regolari.
• Fornire coaching e mentoring ai colleghi per un'area assegnata di responsabilità tecnica di regolamentazione.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il Leader Portfolio per coordinare risorse e priorità a livello Portfolio.
• Seguire regolarmente e controllare i progressi di ogni progetto specifico nel team, illuminare il team per elaborare strategie di presentazione per diverse applicazioni e identificare i rischi normativi e sviluppare piani di migrazione.
• Costruire e mantenere un rapporto sano con gli stakeholder chiave interni ed esterni, come NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, Supply Chain, Qualità e conformità, PDR Cina e PTR globale,
• Collaborare con le parti interessate chiave interne per lo sviluppo e l'allineamento della strategia tecnica, massimizzare e bilanciare le esigenze normative e di fornitura in Cina. QUALIFICA Istruzione Laurea magistrale in scienze della vita è preferito; Laurea post è un plus. Esperienza
• 8 o più anni di esperienza lavorativa nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o relativo settore e CMC, qualità, normazione o relativa esperienza.
• Gestione delle persone precedenti

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Der Menschenführer führt ein Team von China Technical Partners (CTPs) und CMC-Profis, die für China regulatorische CMC-Vorträge verantwortlich sind, durch die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von robusten End-to-End-China-Filing-Strategien basierend auf einer engen Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Entwicklungsteams, China-Geschäftsprioritäten, China-Regelanforderungen und Landschaft. Der Umfang umfasst das komplette Roche-Portfolio, die globalen Produkte (kleine Moleküle, Biologik, neue Modalitäten). Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt darin, die Teammitglieder zu leiten und zu trainieren, um den Drogenzugriff und die kontinuierliche Versorgung der Patienten zu beschleunigen, indem die richtigen Erstanträge an chinesische Gesundheitsbehörden und effektive Interaktionen mit der Gesundheitsbehörde sichergestellt werden. Die Rolle ist dafür verantwortlich, das regulatorische Umfeld in China in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der PTR-Politik zu gestalten und in innovative regulatorische Strategien umzusetzen. Im Einklang mit der China-Strategie von Roche und der China-First-Initiative ist dies eine Rolle mit einem hohen geschäftlichen Einfluss. In dieser Position ist der Personenführer für das Management von China Technical Partners (CTPs) und CMC-Programmmanagern verantwortlich, die Leistungsziele festlegen, zeitnah Feedback liefern und eine Ausrichtung von kurzfristigen Entwicklungszielen mit langfristigen Karrierezielen gewährleisten. Bietet Beratung und verwaltet Arbeitsaktivitäten von anderen für spezifische Projekte und/oder Ziele. Demonstriert die Grundlagen der effektiven Coaching Fähigkeiten und Mentoring. Passt Coaching-Stil, um die Bedürfnisse des Einzelnen zu erfüllen. Der Menschenführer führt funktionsübergreifende regulatorische Initiativen und Strategien, definiert assoziierte kritische Schritte und Ressourcen, die benötigt werden, und übernimmt die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung dieser Initiativen und Strategien. Proaktiv kommuniziert mit regulatorischen und funktionsübergreifenden Mitarbeitern zur Unterstützung interner und partnerschaftlicher Projektziele. Zusammenarbeit mit Management in führenden Kommunikationen mit HA über Projekte und Initiativen großer Komplexität. Entscheidungen auf der Grundlage von funktionsübergreifenden Prioritäten statt funktioneller Schwerpunkte. Projekt People Leader
• Führen Sie ein Team von Regulierungsexperten.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le chef du personnel dirige une équipe de partenaires techniques chinois (PTC) et de professionnels du CMC qui sont responsables des présentations de CMC réglementaires en Chine, en élaborant et en mettant en oeuvre des stratégies de classement de bout en bout de la Chine fondées sur une collaboration étroite avec les équipes de développement mondial, les priorités commerciales de la Chine, les exigences réglementaires de la Chine et le paysage. La portée comprend le portefeuille complet de Roche, les produits mondiaux (petites molécules, produits biologiques, nouvelles modalités). Ce rôle a pour but de diriger et d'entraîner les membres de l'équipe afin d'accélérer l'accès aux médicaments et l'approvisionnement continu des patients en veillant à ce que les premières présentations appropriées aux autorités sanitaires chinoises et les interactions efficaces avec l'autorité sanitaire. Le titulaire du rôle est responsable de façonner l'environnement réglementaire en Chine en étroite collaboration avec la Politique sur les PTR et de la traduire en stratégies réglementaires novatrices. Conformément à la stratégie de la Chine et à l'initiative China First, il s'agit d'un rôle qui a un impact commercial élevé. Dans ce poste, le chef de file est responsable de la gestion des partenaires techniques de la Chine (PTC) et des gestionnaires de programme du MCC, ce qui comprend l'établissement d'objectifs de rendement, la fourniture de rétroaction en temps opportun et l'harmonisation des objectifs de perfectionnement à court terme avec les objectifs de carrière à plus long terme. Fournit des conseils et gère les activités de travail d'autres personnes pour des projets ou des objectifs précis. Démontre les principes fondamentaux de l'efficacité de l'encadrement et du mentorat. Adapte le style de coaching pour répondre aux besoins de l'individu. Le chef des personnes dirige des initiatives et des stratégies de réglementation interfonctionnelles, définit les étapes et les ressources essentielles qui s'y rattachent et assume la responsabilité de la mise en oeuvre de ces initiatives et stratégies. Communiquer de façon proactive avec le personnel de réglementation et le personnel interfonctionnel à l'appui des objectifs des projets internes et associés aux partenaires. Collabore avec la direction pour diriger les communications avec l'AP sur les projets et les initiatives de grande complexité. Prendre des décisions fondées sur des priorités interfonctionnelles plutôt que sur des priorités fonctionnelles. Chef de projet Personnes
• Diriger une équipe de professionnels de la réglementation.
• Responsable de la gestion de la performance des salariés.
• Collaborer avec des rapports directs et veiller à ce que des commentaires objectifs et opportuns soient fournis aux employés, en mettant l'accent sur le perfectionnement de l'employé en facilitant des discussions régulières sur le perfectionnement et des vérifications.
• Fournir un encadrement et un encadrement aux collègues dans un domaine de responsabilité réglementaire technique assigné.
• Collaborer étroitement avec le chef de portefeuille pour coordonner les ressources et les priorités au niveau du portefeuille.
• Suivre et vérifier régulièrement l'avancement de chaque projet spécifique de l'équipe, éclairer l'équipe pour élaborer des stratégies de soumission pour différentes applications, identifier les risques réglementaires et élaborer des plans de migration.
• Établir et maintenir des relations saines avec les principaux acteurs internes et externes, tels que NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, chaîne d'approvisionnement, qualité et conformité, PDR Chine et PTR mondial,
• Collaborer avec les principales parties prenantes internes à l'élaboration et à l'alignement de la stratégie technique, en maximisant et en équilibrage des besoins en matière de réglementation et d'approvisionnement en Chine. QUALIFICATIONS Éducation Masters Le diplôme en sciences de la vie est préféré; le diplôme d'études supérieures est un plus. Expérience
• 8 ans ou plus d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, la biotechnologie ou l'industrie connexe et le CMC, la qualité, la réglementation ou l'expérience connexe.
• Gestion des personnes précédente

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
客户管理
与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息
传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
1. 组织和支持区域专家会议
2．了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
3. 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限
•3年以上医药行业工作经验
•既往有销售/市场/医学经验
•跨职能工作经验为佳

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

titleByLocale.en: Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Operating within an innovation-driven biotech environment, our Technology department (RDT) sits at the intersection of regulatory compliance, quality systems, risk management, and digital transformation. We focus on defining and managing governance frameworks, policies, and processes that ensure our technology platforms—supporting both GxP and non-GxP critical business processes—operate in full compliance with internal standards and external regulations. Our mission is to embed compliance by design, strengthening the quality and risk posture of our systems while simultaneously enabling speed, scalability, and technological innovation. In this collaborative environment, we partner closely with Business Quality, Regulatory, Security, Legal, and Audit functions to advise executives and drive enterprise-wide strategy.

As the Head of Compliance and Quality Governance (Practice Leader), you will be accountable for the entire lifecycle of this critical function, from strategic planning and service design to operational execution and continuous improvement. Operating as a senior escalation and decision authority, you will define the functional vision, strategy, and roadmap, transforming business needs into tangible, high-value capabilities. Leveraging a distinctive combination of deep domain expertise, technical proficiency, and business insight, you will lead multidisciplinary teams to build and deliver desirable, viable, and sustainable functional services that meet the evolving needs of our users while maintaining strict regulatory compliance.

The Opportunity

• Strategy & Vision: Define and own the Technology Compliance & Quality Governance strategy, establishing clear governance frameworks, decision models, and accountabilities while translating global biotech regulations and corporate policies into clear technology outcomes.

• Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve as a trusted partner and senior escalation authority for executives, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Security leadership, representing Technology in executive forums, audits, inspections, and regulatory interactions.

• Functional Management & Delivery: Oversee the end-to-end delivery and lifecycle of defined functions (e.g., QMS), ensuring Technology adherence to GxP, CSV, data integrity, privacy, and global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO) through pragmatic, risk-based interpretations.

• Risk Management & Assurance: Lead enterprise-wide technology risk assessments and compliance maturity evaluations, ensuring timely and effective remediation of findings, deviations, and CAPAs.

• Team Leadership & Development: Build, coach, and develop a high-performing global team of professionals, fostering a culture of accountability and transparency while guiding senior leaders on risk-based decision-making.

• Operational Excellence & Improvement: Define success metrics (KPIs/OKRs) and leverage data analytics to drive informed decisions, immediate operational improvements, and strategic optimizations to achieve business goals.

• Financial & Resource Management: Manage the immediate team's budget and resources, developing detailed business cases—including cost-benefit analyses and resource estimates—for new functional initiatives and significant process changes.

Who You Are

• Experienced Global Leader: You bring 15+ years of IT domain experience, including 10+ years managing global multidisciplinary teams and 10+ years in Technology, Compliance, Quality, or Risk within highly regulated ind

jobs.title: Security Affiliate Manager EMEA-LATAM

titleByLocale.it: Gestione della filiale di sicurezza EMEA-LATAM

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the Role:

The Security Affiliate Manager EMEA-LATAM will support affiliates with their product security needs by designing, coordinating, and governing a security network across our affiliates.

We are looking for someone with expertise in product security and direct experience working with customers in that field.

Your Responsibilities:

• Be an ambassador and evangelist for Roche Diagnostics product security to affiliates.

• Develop strong working relationships with key stakeholders within the regions and around the global organization.

• Design, coordinate, and govern a product security network across our affiliates consisting of colleagues who interface with customers on product security topics.

• Gather intake from affiliates on customer needs and expectations (e.g. data localization, support topics, etc.) to drive global product security & privacy strategy improvements.

• Support affiliates with their product security needs, e.g. hosting training sessions, Q&A’s and other materials to meet customer needs, join affiliates for customer meetings, etc.

• Make relevant product security information on products, services and ecosystem accessible to affiliates.

• Build the bridge between affiliate and global teams, e.g. by facilitating knowledge sharing between those (within PSPO, product teams, etc.), leading cross-functional projects to establish processes, drive implementation of product security changes, etc.

• Create and maintain a knowledge base of the most common product security questions to allow affiliates to respond faster to tenders/questionnaires.

• Gather product security-related metrics and provide report-outs to affiliates and management.

• Strong collaboration within the chapter and other PSPO chapters to ensure affiliate needs are tracked and served. Is considered as a reference for stakeholders and actively shares ideas and expertise and leads/moderates discussions.

• Enable affiliate leaders and customer-facing roles including commercial and service to achieve greater promotion on topics of security with customers.

Your Experience & Skills:

• BA/BS in Information Systems, Computer Science, or relevant area of study, required.

• Expertise in working directly with customers in the product security field is required.

• Commercial mindset.

• Fluent in English on a business level with excellent verbal and written skills; other languages welcome, but not required.

• Demonstrated proficiency in communicating security and privacy strategy, products, and ecosystems.

• Exceptional demonstration, presentation, and interpersonal communication (written and verbal) skills are essential.

• Highly influential relationship builder.

• Experience with compliance standards and regulatory mandates, security and privacy laws, regulations and standards.

• Goal-oriented individual, with proven positive leading in the matrix ability, strong business acumen, strong focus motivating and developing teams.

• EU residence/citizenship preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Technical Services and Operations (TSO) group within DDC is accountable for providing application support (Level 1-3) for hundreds of software solutions. In addition, TSO is responsible for DevOps and Operations for the DDC’ application landscape, both Cloud and On Premise. Finally, TSO provides technical support for systems that offer tools to train large language models (LLMs) and create autonomous agents, as well as ensuring users are effectively enabled to leverage these advanced systems, from LLM training platforms to autonomous agent building tools.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will join the TSO Leadership team and will work closely with DDC colleagues as well as directly with our key stakeholders including Computational Scientists, ML Scientists and Research Scientists. You will also work closely with vendors who provide managed services which form the core of many of the TSO activities.

You are an experienced and hands-on technical expert with the proven ability to lead and deliver enterprise scale technical operations. You will be managing operations for Applications and Software and also contributing as an SRE supporting our Infrastructure. Together with the Technical Operations leadership team, you will integrate expertise across on-premises operations, cloud services, and advanced AI/ML technologies. Your strategic focus will be on ensuring high performance, user enablement, and efficient service delivery while effectively managing relationships with external vendors. This comprehensive approach will drive operational excellence and support the evolving technical needs of our organization.

The Opportunity

• Strategic Planning & Service Integration – Develop and implement strategic plans aligned with organizational goals, integrating managed services, on-premises operations, and cloud initiatives while leveraging AI as a key accelerator.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, i dati e le scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CS CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare il potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e mutevoli per la vita per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. All'interno dell'organizzazione CS CoE, l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduce l'ammodernamento dei nostri ecosistemi computazionali e dati integrando le tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per potenziare gli stakeholder, promuovere la scienza dei dati e accelerare il processo decisionale. Il gruppo Servizi Tecnici e Operazioni (TSO) all'interno di DDC è responsabile per fornire supporto alle applicazioni (Level 1-3) per centinaia di soluzioni software. Inoltre, TSO è responsabile per DevOps e Operazioni per il paesaggio delle applicazioni DDC, sia Cloud che On Premise. Infine, TSO fornisce supporto tecnico per sistemi che offrono strumenti per la formazione di modelli linguistici di grandi dimensioni (LLM) e per la creazione di agenti autonomi, oltre a garantire che gli utenti siano effettivamente abilitati a sfruttare questi sistemi avanzati, dalle piattaforme di formazione LLM agli strumenti di costruzione di agenti autonomi. Come Ingegnere Principale Software, si unirà al team di Leadership TSO e lavorerà a stretto contatto con i colleghi DDC e direttamente con i nostri principali stakeholder, tra cui scienziati computazionali, scienziati ML e scienziati di ricerca. Potrai anche lavorare a stretto contatto con i fornitori che forniscono servizi gestiti che formano il nucleo di molte delle attività TSO. Sei un esperto e pratico esperto tecnico con la comprovata capacità di guidare e fornire operazioni tecniche su scala aziendale. Potrai gestire le operazioni per applicazioni e software e contribuire anche come SRE supportando la nostra infrastruttura. Insieme al team di leadership Technical Operations, integrerai le competenze nelle operazioni on-premise, nei servizi cloud e nelle tecnologie AI/ML avanzate. Il vostro obiettivo strategico sarà quello di garantire prestazioni elevate, l'attivazione degli utenti e la consegna efficiente dei servizi, mentre la gestione efficace dei rapporti con i fornitori esterni. Questo approccio completo guiderà l'eccellenza operativa e sosterrà le esigenze tecniche in evoluzione della nostra organizzazione. L'opportunità
• Strategic Planning & Service Integration – Sviluppare e implementare piani strategici allineati a obiettivi organizzativi, integrando servizi gestiti, operazioni on-premise e iniziative cloud, sfruttando l'IA come acceleratore chiave.
• L'impegno del venditore & Stakeholder – le relazioni del venditore, negoziare i contratti e garantire l'adesione a SLAs.
• Eccellenza operativa & Change Management – Applicare i principi di ingegneria del software alle operazioni per scalare e mantenere sistemi di produzione altamente affidabili, bilanciando il rapido rilascio di nuove funzionalità

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Fortschritte in der KI, Daten und rechnerische Wissenschaften transformieren die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von Drogen. Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisationen von Genentech (gRED) und Pharma (pRED) haben gezeigt, wie diese Technologien die FuE beschleunigen, Daten nutzen und neue Rechenmodelle nutzen, um Auswirkungen zu erzielen. Der nahtlose Datenaustausch und der Zugriff auf Modelle über gRED und pRED sind unerlässlich, um diese Möglichkeiten zu maximieren. Das Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) ist eine strategische, einheitliche Gruppe, deren Ziel es ist, die transformative Kraft von Daten und Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) zu nutzen, um unseren Wissenschaftlern sowohl pRED als auch gRED zu helfen, innovativere und lebensverändernde Medikamente für Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Innerhalb der CS CoE-Organisation führt die Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC)-Organisation die Modernisierung unserer Rechen- und Datenökosysteme durch die Integration digitaler Technologien in Forschung und Frühentwicklung, um Stakeholder zu stärken, datenorientierte Wissenschaft zu fördern und die Entscheidungsfindung zu beschleunigen. Die Gruppe Technical Services and Operations (TSO) innerhalb des DDC ist für die Bereitstellung von Anwendungsunterstützung (Level 1-3) für Hunderte von Softwarelösungen verantwortlich. Darüber hinaus ist die TSO für DevOps und Operations für die Anwendungslandschaft des DDC verantwortlich, sowohl Cloud als auch On Premise. Schließlich bietet die TSO technische Unterstützung für Systeme, die Werkzeuge bieten, um große Sprachmodelle (LLMs) zu trainieren und autonome Agenten zu schaffen, sowie sicherzustellen, dass die Nutzer effektiv in der Lage sind, diese fortschrittlichen Systeme zu nutzen, von LLM Trainingsplattformen bis zu autonomen Agent Building Tools. Als Principal Software Engineer werden Sie dem TSO Leadership Team beitreten und eng mit DDC-Kollegen sowie direkt mit unseren wichtigsten Interessenvertretern wie Computational Scientists, ML Scientists und Research Scientists zusammenarbeiten. Sie arbeiten auch eng mit Anbietern zusammen, die Managed Services anbieten, die den Kern vieler TSO-Aktivitäten bilden. Sie sind ein erfahrener und praktischer technischer Experte mit der bewährten Fähigkeit, technische Operationen im Unternehmensmaßstab zu führen und zu liefern. Sie leiten den Betrieb für Anwendungen und Software und tragen auch als SRE zur Unterstützung unserer Infrastruktur bei. Gemeinsam mit dem Team der Technischen Operations werden Sie Know-how in On-Premises-Betriebe, Cloud-Services und fortschrittliche AI/ML-Technologien integrieren. Ihr strategischer Fokus liegt auf der Sicherstellung von hoher Leistung, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und effizienten Service-Lieferung, während die Beziehungen mit externen Anbietern effektiv verwalten. Dieser umfassende Ansatz wird operative Exzellenz fördern und die sich entwickelnden technischen Bedürfnisse unserer Organisation unterstützen. Die Chance
• Strategische Planung & Service-Integration – Entwickeln und implementieren strategische Pläne, die mit organisatorischen Zielen ausgerichtet sind, die Integration von Managed Services, On-Premises-Operationen und Cloud-Initiativen und die Nutzung von AI als Schlüsselbeschleuniger.
• Vendor & Stakeholder-Verlobung – Vendor-Beziehungen, verhandeln Verträge und sorgen für die Einhaltung von SLAs.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les progrès de l'IA, des données et des sciences informatiques transforment la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Les organismes de recherche et de développement précoce de Genentech (GRED) et de Pharma (PRED) ont démontré comment ces technologies accélèrent la R-D, tirent parti des données et de nouveaux modèles de calcul pour produire des effets. Le partage de données sans soudure et l'accès aux modèles à travers gRED et pRED sont essentiels pour maximiser ces opportunités. Le Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles (CS CoE) est un groupe stratégique unifié dont l'objectif est d'exploiter la puissance transformatrice des données et de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider nos scientifiques dans les domaines pRED et gRED à fournir des médicaments plus innovants et changeants pour les patients du monde entier. Au sein de l'organisation du Conseil de l'Europe, l'organisation Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) dirige la modernisation de nos écosystèmes informatiques et de données en intégrant les technologies numériques dans la recherche et le développement précoce pour autonomiser les parties prenantes, faire progresser la science axée sur les données et accélérer la prise de décisions. Le groupe Services et opérations techniques (TSO) au sein du DDC est responsable de fournir un soutien aux applications (niveau 1-3) pour des centaines de solutions logicielles. En outre, TSO est responsable de DevOps et des opérations pour le paysage d'application DDC, à la fois Cloud et On Premise. Enfin, TSO fournit un soutien technique aux systèmes qui offrent des outils pour former de grands modèles de langue (LLM) et créer des agents autonomes, ainsi que pour veiller à ce que les utilisateurs soient efficacement en mesure de tirer parti de ces systèmes avancés, des plates-formes de formation LLM aux outils de construction d'agents autonomes. En tant qu'ingénieur principal du logiciel, vous vous joindrez à l'équipe de leadership de l'OST et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des collègues de DDC ainsi qu'avec nos principaux intervenants, notamment les scientifiques en informatique, les scientifiques en ML et les chercheurs. Vous travaillerez également en étroite collaboration avec les fournisseurs qui fournissent des services gérés qui constituent le cœur de nombreuses activités du BSF. Vous êtes un expert technique expérimenté et pratique avec la capacité éprouvée de diriger et de livrer des opérations techniques à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Vous gérerez les opérations pour les applications et les logiciels et contribuerez également en tant que SRE soutenant notre infrastructure. Avec l'équipe de direction des opérations techniques, vous intégrerez l'expertise dans les opérations sur site, les services cloud et les technologies avancées d'IA/ML. Votre objectif stratégique sera d'assurer une performance élevée, l'habilitation des utilisateurs et une prestation de services efficace tout en gérant efficacement les relations avec les fournisseurs externes. Cette approche globale favorisera l'excellence opérationnelle et soutiendra l'évolution des besoins techniques de notre organisation. L'opportunité
• Planification stratégique et intégration des services – Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des plans stratégiques alignés sur les objectifs organisationnels, intégrant les services gérés, les opérations sur site et les initiatives en nuage tout en tirant parti de l'IA comme un accélérateur clé.
• Engagement des fournisseurs et des parties prenantes – Relations avec les fournisseurs, négociation des contrats et respect des ALS.
• Excellence opérationnelle et gestion du changement – Appliquer les principes d'ingénierie logicielle aux opérations pour mettre à l'échelle et maintenir des systèmes de production très fiables, en conciliant la sortie rapide de nouvelles fonctionnalités w

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Investigator Relations Technology Informatics Partner

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Site and Investigator Engagement area delivers the comprehensive digital ecosystem and integrated platforms required to manage the end-to-end lifecycle of clinical site interactions, covering efficient study planning, country and site selection, site activation, and patient enrollment forecasting. Additionally, it manages the core technologies to handle complex administrative tasks, including budgeting and negotiation, clinical contracts, payments, and clinical information exchange. The team acts as a strategic liaison connecting Global Pharma Clinical Operations, Country Operations, strategic CROs, and Clinical Sites. Through this alignment, the area architects technology portfolios that foster strong external relationships and drive a unified, partner-centric clinical ecosystem. ​

As an Informatics Partner at this level, you lead strategic and complex cross-functional efforts across countries or domains, aligning initiatives with country-wide priorities and business outcomes. You anticipate and solve complex, systems-level problems, drive innovation, and shape domain vision while managing multiple workstreams with high accountability.

The opportunity:

• Scope/Content Leadership: Leads initiatives across multiple teams, and actively shapes business outcomes. Acts as a subject matter expert, influencing country-wide or cross-functional strategies, and fostering collaborations with stakeholders across organizational levels. Responsible for aligning team or domain objectives with country-wide goals, focusing on strategic projects that drive substantial impact. Frequently manages complex, cross-functional work streams.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads problem-solving at the country-wide or cross-functional level, taking accountability for multiple workstreams or outcomes that influence strategic objectives. Anticipates and mitigates potential issues before they arise, using advanced analysis to address complex problems. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Affairs International (EAi), part of the Roche Pharma CEO Office, ensures the company can shape the policies, funding decisions, and market conditions that determine how healthcare innovation is valued and rewarded. We influence globally where strategic priorities are defined and enable locally where business impact is delivered. Through focused advocacy and a connected global network, EAi builds trusted relationships with governments, multilateral institutions, and global partners, develops third-party advocates, and forges alliances that protect and grow Roche’s business while improving patient access to innovation.

The Opportunity
The Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy is a high-impact strategic expert responsible for designing and driving Roche’s policy strategies across priority Therapeutic Areas (TAs). Reporting to the Global Disease Area Policy Team Lead, you serve as the definitive policy expert, ensuring that the external policy environment and healthcare systems deliver rapid and sustainable access to innovation. This role requires a unique blend of technical policy mastery, commercial acumen and strategic diplomacy to navigate complex supra-national environments, influence senior stakeholders, and orchestrate global-to-local disease area policy alignment without the need for direct hierarchical authority.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive the development and implementation of the global policy strategy portfolio and performance metrics across priority TAs, ensuring full alignment with global, regional, and affiliate functions.

• Define the long-term global disease area policy vision, strategy, objectives and crafting sophisticated policy projects, evidence, tools and positioning that addresses the needs of patients, medical professionals, and the business.

• Act as a primary catalyst for shaping policy environments by architecting external engagement and advocacy frameworks for a broad cross-section of disease area policy and health system stakeholders, while identifying and mitigating barriers to access among governments and NGOs.

• Serve as the primary global point-of-contact for disease area policy, providing timely and expert direction to the business

• Partner strategically across Roche regions and affiliates to ensure consistent application of health policy expertise, enabling local implementation of disease area policy strategies, and to drive the External Affairs mission through the organization.

• Lead the development of portfolio-wide content, analytical tools, and disease area policy strategies that translate complex external policy and healthcare challenges into actionable business insights and tactics.

• Manage high-impact global strategic policy initiatives and project workstreams, ensuring resource transparency and evidence-based recommendations to enable high-level business decision-making.

• Support organizational growth by sharing global health policy expertise and educating cross-functional peers to foster a culture of functional excellence and innovation.

Who You Are

• You hold a Master’s degree, MBA, or equivalent in Political Science, Public Policy, Public Health, Healthcare Management, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in health policy or public affairs within the life sciences sector or government,with a deep mastery and knowledge of disease area policy, health system and access environments.

• A recognized leader with a demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and policymakers
