Durch fokussierte Advocacy und ein vernetztes globales Netzwerk baut EAi vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Regierungen, multilateralen Institutionen und globalen Partnern auf, entwickelt Drittanbieter-Befürworter und forge Allianzen, die das Unternehmen von Roche schützen und wachsen und gleichzeitig den Zugang zu Innovationen verbessern. Die Chance Die Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy ist ein hochprägsamer strategischer Experte, der die politischen Strategien von Roche in vorrangigen Therapeutischen Bereichen (TAs) entwickelt und vorantreibt. Als definitiver politischer Experte, der sicherstellt, dass das außenpolitische Umfeld und die Gesundheitssysteme einen schnellen und nachhaltigen Zugang zu Innovation bieten. Diese Rolle erfordert eine einzigartige Mischung aus technischer Politik-Meisterschaft, kommerzieller acumen und strategischer Diplomatie, um komplexe supranationale Umgebungen zu navigieren, Senior Stakeholder zu beeinflussen und global-to-local Disease Area politische Ausrichtung ohne direkte hierarchische Autorität. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten
• Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Umsetzung des globalen Strategieportfolios und der Performance Metriken über prioritäre TAs aus, um eine vollständige Ausrichtung auf globale, regionale und Affiliate-Funktionen zu gewährleisten.
• Definieren Sie die langfristige globale Strategie, Strategie, Ziele und die Gestaltung von anspruchsvollen politischen Projekten, Beweisen, Werkzeugen und Positionierungen, die sich auf die Bedürfnisse von Patienten, medizinischen Fachleuten und das Geschäft beziehen.
• Aktivieren Sie als primärer Katalysator für die Gestaltung von politischen Umgebungen, indem Sie externes Engagement und Advocacy-Framework für einen breiten Querschnitt von Interessenvertretern im Bereich der Krankheits- und Gesundheitspolitik unter gleichzeitiger Identifizierung und Minderung von Barrieren für den Zugang zwischen Regierungen und NRO darstellen.
• Als primärer globaler Ansprechpartner für die Politik des Krankheitsbereichs dienen und dem Unternehmen zeitnah und kompetente Orientierung geben
• Partner strategisch über Roche-Regionen und Affiliates, um eine konsequente Anwendung der Gesundheitswesen-Expertise zu gewährleisten, die lokale Umsetzung von Krankheitsgebiet-Politikstrategien zu ermöglichen und die Mission für Auswärtige Angelegenheiten durch die Organisation zu fördern.
• Führen Sie die Entwicklung von portfolioweiten Content-, analytischen Tools- und Krankheitsfeldstrategien, die komplexe externe Politik- und Gesundheitsprobleme in handlungsfähige Unternehmens- und Taktiken übersetzen.
• Verwalten hocheffizienter globaler strategischer Initiativen und Projektarbeit, um Ressourcentransparenz und evidenzbasierte Empfehlungen zu gewährleisten, um eine hochrangige Unternehmensentscheidung zu ermöglichen.
• Unterstützung des organisatorischen Wachstums durch den Austausch globaler gesundheitspolitischer Expertise und Ausbildung von funktionsübergreifenden Peers, um eine Kultur funktionaler Exzellenz und Innovation zu fördern. Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen Master-Abschluss, MBA oder gleichwertig in Politikwissenschaft, Public Policy, Public Health, Healthcare Management oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• 8+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Gesundheitspolitik oder öffentlichen Angelegenheiten im Bereich der Lebenswissenschaften oder der Regierung, mit einer tiefen Beherrschung und Kenntnisse der Krankheitsgebietspolitik, des Gesundheitssystems und der Zugangsumgebungen.
• Ein anerkannter Führer mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, Führungskräfte und Politiker zu beeinflussen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position External Affairs International (EAi), qui fait partie du bureau du PDG de Roche Pharma, veille à ce que l'entreprise puisse façonner les politiques, les décisions de financement et les conditions du marché qui déterminent la valeur et la récompense de l'innovation en matière de soins de santé. Nous influons à l'échelle mondiale là où les priorités stratégiques sont définies et nous permettons à l'échelle locale d'avoir un impact sur les entreprises. Grâce à un plaidoyer ciblé et à un réseau mondial connecté, EAi établit des relations de confiance avec les gouvernements, les institutions multilatérales et les partenaires mondiaux, développe des défenseurs tiers et forge des alliances qui protègent et développent les affaires de Roches tout en améliorant l'accès des patients à l'innovation. L'opportunité Le responsable de la politique mondiale, Politique sur les zones de maladies, est un expert stratégique à fort impact chargé de concevoir et d'orienter les stratégies stratégiques de Roche dans les zones thérapeutiques prioritaires. Rendre compte au responsable de l'équipe de la politique mondiale sur les maladies, vous êtes l'expert en politiques définitives, vous assurant que l'environnement politique externe et les systèmes de soins de santé offrent un accès rapide et durable à l'innovation. Ce rôle exige un mélange unique de maîtrise des politiques techniques, de sens commercial et de diplomatie stratégique afin de naviguer dans des environnements supranationaux complexes, d'influencer les principaux intervenants et d'orchestrer l'alignement des politiques mondiales sur les zones de maladies locales sans avoir besoin d'une autorité hiérarchique directe. Principales responsabilités
• Diriger l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre du portefeuille de stratégies politiques mondiales et des indicateurs de performance dans les AT prioritaires, en assurant une alignement complet avec les fonctions mondiales, régionales et affiliées.
• Définir la vision politique, la stratégie, les objectifs et l'élaboration de projets politiques sophistiqués, de données probantes, d'outils et de positionnement qui répondent aux besoins des patients, des professionnels de la santé et des entreprises.
• Agir en tant que principal catalyseur de la mise en place d'un environnement politique en élaborant des cadres d'engagement et de plaidoyer extérieurs pour un large éventail d'acteurs de la politique et du système de santé, tout en identifiant et en atténuant les obstacles à l'accès entre les gouvernements et les ONG.
• Servir de principal point de contact mondial pour la politique en matière de maladies, fournissant une orientation opportune et experte aux entreprises
• Établir des partenariats stratégiques dans les régions de Roche et les filiales afin d'assurer une application cohérente de l'expertise en matière de politique de santé, de permettre la mise en œuvre locale des stratégies de lutte contre la maladie et de conduire la mission Affaires extérieures à travers l'organisation.
• Diriger l'élaboration de contenus à l'échelle du portefeuille, d'outils d'analyse et de stratégies politiques dans le domaine des maladies qui traduisent des politiques extérieures complexes et des défis en matière de soins de santé en idées et tactiques opérationnelles réalisables.
• Gérer les initiatives stratégiques mondiales à haut impact et les axes de travail des projets, en assurant la transparence des ressources et en formulant des recommandations fondées sur des données factuelles pour permettre une prise de décisions de haut niveau.
• Soutenir la croissance organisationnelle en partageant l'expertise mondiale en matière de politique de santé et en éduquant les pairs interfonctionnels pour favoriser une culture d'excellence fonctionnelle et d'innovation. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master, d'un MBA ou d'un équivalent en sciences politiques, politiques publiques, santé publique, gestion des soins de santé ou un domaine connexe.
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience en matière de politique de santé ou d'affaires publiques dans le secteur des sciences de la vie ou au sein du gouvernement, avec une maîtrise et une connaissance approfondies de la politique en matière de maladies, du système de santé et des environnements d'accès.
• Un dirigeant reconnu ayant une capacité démontrée d'influencer les cadres supérieurs et les décideurs

jobs.title: Commercial Finance Partner(Demand Management)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose
This role acts as a "T-shaped" Value Orchestrator. The primary mission is to break down traditional silos between procurement and finance by autonomously leading procurement strategies and end-to-end (E2E) processes. Crucially, this role ensures that the "savings" and "cash flow optimizations" generated from procurement activities are directly reflected in the affiliate's financial planning and budgeting (P&L), thereby maximizing enterprise business value.

Key Responsibilities
1. Procurement Strategy & Vendor Management

• Develop and implement procurement strategies and savings plans to support business objectives and financial targets.

• Execute comprehensive Vendor Management, which includes coordinating supplier selection, onboarding, regular performance evaluations, and maintaining strong, strategic vendor relationships.

• Lead supplier negotiations to secure favorable commercial terms.

• Optimize payment terms to significantly reduce deposit/advance invoices and improve company cash flows.

2. Budgeting & Financial Planning

• Integrate procurement savings and cost optimization plans directly into the affiliate's planning events, including Business Plan (BP), T0, T3, Baseline, as well as Period cost, and M&D budgets.

• Ensure procurement savings initiatives are tightly aligned with and realized in the company’s financial targets and P&L.

3. E2E Process, Governance & SOPs

• Create, maintain, and regularly update Procurement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and formalized purchasing policies to ensure operational efficiency and compliance across all departments.

• Establish and maintain governance frameworks for the full procurement lifecycle and internal controls.

• Continuously evaluate and enhance procurement processes and controls to ensure scalability and effectiveness.

4. Collaboration & Network Orchestration

• Act as the bridge between Finance and Procurement, and collaborate closely with the Supply Chain team to align procurement processes with operational needs.

• Work with the Roche network (other affiliates and global) to find better solutions and share best practices.

5. Compliance & Risk Management

• Perform risk management on supply contracts, proactively identifying and resolving supply or quality issues.

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and external regulations.

Key Requirements

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree or above, preferably in Business Administration, Finance, or related.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain management, or financial planning in Multinational Companies (MNCs).

• Professional Skills: Strong negotiation, analytical, and financial acumen (understanding of budgeting and P&L). Expertise in vendor management, procurement governance, SOP creation, and E2E processes. Familiarity with financial systems (e.g., SAP) is required.

• Attributes & Languages: Proven ability to solve problems, influence cross-functional teams, and build stakeholder relationships. Fluent in both oral and written English and Mandarin. Good compliance track record.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicin

jobs.title: Sr. specialist, Lab Support
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
● Ensure that the following works are effectively executed to support LS and QC related business
确保如下工作被有效执行，以支持QC相关业务
⮚ Roche Global digital system aspect, including but not limit to
罗氏全球数字化系统相关，包括但不限于
● Responsible for the deployment of the end-to-end process for BIOVIA (Electronic Lab Notebook). Drive the implementation of QC electronic analytical records and system integration in a project management approach, including formula development, formula testing, formula validation, formula optimization and integration, as well as system interaction testing and application.
负责BIOVIA (Electronic Lab Notebook) 端到端流程的部署。以项目管理的方式逐步推进QC电子分析记录和系统交互建立，包括配方开发，配方测试，配方确认，配方优化和融合，系统交互测试和应用等
● Utilize QbD thinking to ensure end-to-end compliance of Roche's global digital systems. This includes eliminating GMP and Data Integrity risks, simplifying and optimizing processes, and improving Right-First-Time performance.
运用QbD思维，确保罗氏全球数字化系统端到端流程全面合规。包括消除GMP和Data Integrity风险，简化&优化流程，提高Right-First-Time。
● Roche global digital systems directly associated with testing such as BIOVIA, SingleLIMS，Labx, Empower, SAP. Including creation of user processes, using and maintenance; Creation of Master Data/Method and it's processes, using and maintenance etc.
其他罗氏全球数字化系统，如LIMS，Labx，Empower，SAP等的使用和维护等

⮚ Laboratory testing and related work, including but not limited to:
实验室检测及相关工作，包括但不限于
● Inspect and examine samples from processes such as packaging, excipients, finished product manufacturing, in-process control, environmental monitoring, change control, and customer complaints, providing timely and accurate analytical results and reports, as well as supporting trend analysis.
对包装，辅料，成品生产制造、制程控制，环境监测、变更控制和客户投诉等过程中的样品进行检验和检查，提供及时、准确的分析结果和报告以及支持趋势分析。
● Execute and support laboratory investigations of OOS, OOT, OOE, and other production-related issues, ensuring all analytical processes remain in a controlled state.
执行和支持实验室对OOS, OOT, OOE 及其它生产相关问题的调查，确保所有分析过程处于受控状态。
● Assist the laboratory manager in daily sample management, reference standard management, and stability sample management.
协助实验室经理处理日常样品管理、标准品管理、稳定性样品管理。
● Assist in laboratory GMP self-inspections, audits, and related inspection activities. Track the implementation of improvement plans to ensure the laboratory remains compliant with the latest GMP and DI regulations and Roche requirements.
协助实验室GMP 自查、审计等相关检查活动。跟踪改进实施计划，确保维护实验室满足最新GMP和DI法规和Roche要求。

⮚ Local instrument/equipment aspect, including but not limit to
本地仪器/设备相关，包括但不限于
● Management of the lifecycle process for instrument/equipment and execution of related business operations, including verification/validation of instrument/equipment, periodic review, backup/archive/recovery, internal and external calibration and testing, decommissioning, maintenance and repair, contracts and orders, etc.
仪器/设备生命周期流程的管理和相关业务的执行，如仪器/设备的确认和验证，周期性回顾，备份/归档/恢复，内外部的校准和测试，退役，维护和维修，合同和订单等。

● Complete the other tasks assigned by the leader.
完成上级领导布置的其他任务

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/
• Qualifications教育程度/所获资格证书
● Bachelor of Science Degree or above

jobs.title: Country Chief Accountant - Bulgarian speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The opportunity

As a Country Chief Accountant you will be accountable for the financial statements prepared for the affiliate and will coordinate with RSS (Roche Services & Solutions) Budapest Finance teams (Demand to Pay, Record to Report, Travel and Expense, Compliance) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with the month-end close checklist.

R2R

• Overseeing financial accuracy and internal controls, including ICFR documentation and tools management.

• Conducting balance sheet reconciliation, anomaly rectification, and ensuring timely and quality financial statement reporting / month-end closing, yearly reporting

• Managing accounting aspects such as IFRS 16 Leasing, manual journal entries, and management accounting activities.

• Supervising Accounts Receivables, including billings approval, debtors aging, and sales reporting accuracy.

• Handling cash flow management and treasury matters, including fund forecasting, transfers, and banking transactions.

DtP

• Handling all accounts payable related matters

Master Data

• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc.

Other

• Overseeing statutory tax calculations, reconciliation, reporting, and Tax Consultant liaison, alongside managing external financial audits

• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting

• Serving as central contact for RSS Budapest Finance teams and Finance Managers in the affiliates, addressing financial issues, requests, and advisory needs

Who you are:

• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline, ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role and people management experience

• Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit, and taxation, including local accounting principles as advantage

• Proficiency in accounting software, preferably SAP and MS Office

• Demonstrates effective leadership abilities and advocacy, while empowering colleagues in decision-making

• Proven track record in relationship and stakeholder management across diverse groups, with strong negotiation and influencing skills

• Proficiency in English and Bulgarian

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support fle

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Solution Architect will design business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions to enable Roche’s omnichannel orchestration capabilities. This role focuses on building and scaling an integrated ecosystem leveraging Adobe Experience Platform (RT-CDP, AJO, CJA), ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, data strategy, and governance standards.
You will operate within a complex, multi-solution environment, driving the architecture vision across data, platforms, and activation use cases. The role requires balancing current delivery needs with long-term scalability, while ensuring robust handling of non-functional requirements (NFRs), data privacy, and system performance.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

• Define end-to-end omnichannel architecture aligned with business and enterprise standards

• Establish data models, identity frameworks, and integration patterns

• Manage NFRs (performance, scalability, security, compliance)

Data & Integration

• Integrate CRM, MDM, consent, and web/app event data
Enable unified customer profiles and audience segmentation

• Ensure data quality, governance, and privacy compliance

Platform (Adobe Stack)

• Architect and guide implementation of RT-CDP, AJO, and CJA

• Enable real-time segmentation, journey orchestration, and activation

• Ensure seamless integration with enterprise systems

Real-time & Orchestration

• Design event-driven and streaming architectures

• Enable multi-channel activation (email, paid media, others)

• Establish reusable audience and journey frameworks

Strategy & Delivery

• Define architecture roadmap and support delivery across use cases

• Identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities

• Drive adoption of best practices, patterns, and new technologies

Stakeholder Management

• Collaborate across business, product, and tech teams

• Communicate complex concepts clearly and drive alignment

Qualifications

Experience

• Proven experience in solution architecture within data and martech ecosystems

• Experience with CDPs and omnichannel platforms (Adobe preferred)

• Experience working in global, cross-functional teams

• Certifications on Adobe stack - (AJO, CJA and RT-CDP)

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of:

• Customer data platforms, identity resolution, segmentation

• Event-driven / streaming architectures

• Integration with CRM, MDM, consent systems

• Experience with APIs, cloud data platforms, and data governance concepts (GDPR)

What Success Looks Like

• Scalable omnichannel architecture aligned with enterprise standards

• Reliable data foundation enabling unified profiles and segmentation

• Real-time orchestration and activation across channels

• Measurable business impact through improved customer engagement

• Strong stakeholder alignment through clear communication and effective translation of complex concepts into business value

• Ability to influence and drive adoption of architectural decisions across cross-functional teams

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so w

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Stell Dir vor, Du bist der Architekt hinter den Kulissen, der die Vision einer vollautomatisierten Gesundheitsversorgung Realität werden lässt. Bei Roche Diagnostics treiben wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit jeder Mensch die bestmögliche Behandlung erhält. Als Projektmanager bist Du die treibende Kraft, die komplexe Laborsysteme zum Leben erweckt und so einen direkten Einfluss auf die Schnelligkeit und Präzision von Diagnosen für Millionen von Patient:innen weltweit nimmt.

Dein neues Team:
Du wirst Teil unseres Teams Field Force Workflow Solutions im Customer Service Außendienst. Wir sind eine dynamische Gemeinschaft aus Spezialist:innen, die technische Exzellenz, Erfahrung mit Laborprozessen mit einer großen Portion Teamgeist verbindet.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Labordiagnostik durch professionelles Projektmanagement und Workflow-Optimierung:

• Du leitest überregionale Implementierungsprojekte für Automatisierungslösungen und behältst dabei Planung, Steuerung und Kontrolle fest im Griff.

• Du koordinierst Teilprojektleiter:innen sowie externe Partner, um Projektziele termingerecht und in höchster Qualität zu erreichen.

• Du steuerst die Kommunikation zu unseren Kunden und internen Stakeholdern und begleitest Veränderungsprozesse durch aktives Change Management.

• Du wirkst bei technischen Installationen mit, führst Testläufe durch und trainierst Kunden, um ihre Workflows perfekt auf ihre Bedürfnisse abzustimmen.

• Du analysierst abgeschlossene Projekte ("Lessons Learned"), optimierst unsere Prozesse und berätst Kunden als Spezialist:in für Prozessoptimierung.

• Du unterstützt internationale Länderorganisationen bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Standards und Best Practices.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du verstehst es, Menschen für technische Innovationen zu begeistern und behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick:

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen (z. B. Medizintechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik), Biologie, IT oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Projekte sowie sichere Kenntnisse in modernen Projektmanagement-Methoden und -Tools mit.

• Umfangreiche Führungserfahrungen in Matrix-Organisationen helfen Dir dabei, Teams zu motivieren und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

• Du hast ein Verständnis für Abläufe in medizinischen Laboren und begeisterst Dich für Software- sowie Netzwerktechnik.

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, auch auf Management-Ebene (C-Level), und überzeugst durch ein souveränes Auftreten.

• Ein Führerschein Klasse B sowie die Bereitschaft zu (internationalen) Dienstreisen und gelegentlichen Rufbereitschaften sind für Dich selbstverständlich.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser.

Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens: 10.06.2026
(Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist)

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugniss

jobs.title: Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

titleByLocale.fr: Architecte des données/de l'information - Plateformes de données

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

We are seeking a visionary Data/Information Architect within the RDT Data Platforms function to lead the strategic design and implementation of our AI-driven Master Data Management (MDM) solutions. In this role, you will be the core architect enabling artificial intelligence across our MDM ecosystem, transforming legacy relational master records into intelligent, context-aware, and AI-ready data assets.

The first key priority of this architectural roadmap will focus on the modernization of Healthcare Professional (HCP) and Healthcare Organisation (HCO) master data programs , with a broader scaling strategy across alternative master data domains in future waves. A defining focus of your architectural design will be bridging the gap between traditional MDM platforms and advanced enterprise semantic layers, seamlessly transitioning master datasets into unified knowledge graphs that fuel cutting-edge Generative AI applications.

The Data Management and Data Quality Platforms area serves as the foundational intelligence engine of our global digital enterprise. Our mission is to scale a harmonized, FAIR-compliant master data framework that integrates heavily with an automated, AI-enabled Semantic Layer . By injecting contextual meaning, ontology standards, and relationship graphs into raw master data, we provide the enterprise with a single, high-trust, and discoverable view of our network. Joining this area means taking a leading role in ensuring that healthcare-specific data models remain contextually accurate, highly secure, compliant with global regulatory standards, and completely optimized for state-of-the-art machine learning deployment.

The opportunity:

• AI-Enabled MDM Architecture: Architect, design, and lead the technical execution of modernizing enterprise Master Data Management systems by integrating AI/ML capabilities for data matching, entity resolution, and data enrichment.

• HCP & HCO Program Leadership: Act as the primary technical architect for the foundational Healthcare Professional (HCP), Healthcare Organisation (HCO), and Business Partner/Vendor master data initiatives, ensuring high-fidelity modeling and scalability for subsequent domains.

• Semantic Layer Integration: Define the blueprints and mapping rules required to connect transactional master data with unified semantic layers, ontologies, and enterprise knowledge graphs.

• AI-Ready Data Engineering: Ensure that master data models are fully machine-readable and explicitly struct

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data/Information Architect - Piattaforme dati Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è il luogo in cui l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. In qualità di team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnici orientati al business impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale dell’assistenza sanitaria di domani. La nostra missione è potenziare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all’avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell’intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Spinti dallo scopo e dalla passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale sarà un punto di forza fondamentale per tutta Roche, consentendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, liberando il potenziale umano e promuovendo scoperte che contano davvero per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. In Roche offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità e collaborazione di persona. Per ora, richiediamo che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni di ufficio specifici possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi di collaborazione. Cerchiamo un visionario Data/Information Architect all'interno della funzione RDT Data Platforms per guidare la progettazione strategica e l'implementazione delle nostre soluzioni Master Data Management (MDM) basate sull'intelligenza artificiale. In questo ruolo, sarai l'architetto principale che abilita l'intelligenza artificiale nel nostro ecosistema MDM, trasformando i record anagrafici relazionali legacy in asset di dati intelligenti, sensibili al contesto e pronti per l'intelligenza artificiale. La prima priorità chiave di questa roadmap architetturale si concentrerà sulla modernizzazione dei programmi di dati master degli operatori sanitari (HCP) e delle organizzazioni sanitarie (HCO), con una strategia di scalabilità più ampia attraverso domini di dati master alternativi nelle ondate future. Un obiettivo determinante della progettazione dell'architettura sarà colmare il divario tra le piattaforme MDM tradizionali e i livelli semantici aziendali avanzati, trasformando senza soluzione di continuità i set di dati master in grafici della conoscenza unificati che alimentano applicazioni di intelligenza artificiale generativa all'avanguardia. L'area Data Management e Data Quality Platforms funge da motore di intelligence fondamentale della nostra impresa digitale globale. La nostra missione è quella di scalare un quadro di dati master armonizzato e conforme a FAIR che si integri fortemente con un livello semantico automatizzato e abilitato all'intelligenza artificiale. Inserendo significato contestuale, standard ontologici e grafici relazionali nei dati master grezzi, forniamo all'azienda una visione unica, altamente attendibile e rilevabile della nostra rete. Unirsi a quest’area significa assumere un ruolo di primo piano nel garantire che i modelli di dati specifici del settore sanitario rimangano contestualmente accurati, altamente sicuri, conformi agli standard normativi globali e completamente ottimizzati per l’implementazione del machine learning all’avanguardia. L'opportunità:
• Architettura MDM abilitata all'intelligenza artificiale: architettura, progettazione e guida dell'esecuzione tecnica della modernizzazione dei sistemi di gestione dei dati master aziendali integrando funzionalità AI/ML per la corrispondenza dei dati, la risoluzione delle entità e l'arricchimento dei dati.
• Leadership nei programmi HCP e HCO: agire come architetto tecnico primario per le iniziative di base dei professionisti sanitari (HCP), delle organizzazioni sanitarie (HCO) e dei partner commerciali/fornitori, garantendo modellazione ad alta fedeltà e scalabilità per i domini successivi.
• Integrazione del livello semantico: definire i modelli e le regole di mappatura necessarie per connettere i dati master transazionali con livelli semantici unificati, ontologie e grafici della conoscenza aziendale.
• Ingegneria dei dati pronta per l'intelligenza artificiale: garantisce che i modelli di dati master siano completamente leggibili dalle macchine e strutturati in modo esplicito

Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien voranzutreiben und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der die Digitalisierung eine zentrale Stärke von Roche darstellt. Wir ermöglichen intelligentere Arbeitsweisen, setzen menschliches Potenzial frei und treiben Durchbrüche voran, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wirklich von Bedeutung sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Derzeit verlangen wir von unseren Mitarbeitern, dass sie durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Townhalls, Teambesprechungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Wir suchen einen visionären Daten-/Informationsarchitekten innerhalb der RDT Data Platforms-Funktion, der das strategische Design und die Implementierung unserer KI-gesteuerten Master Data Management (MDM)-Lösungen leitet. In dieser Rolle sind Sie der Hauptarchitekt, der künstliche Intelligenz in unserem gesamten MDM-Ökosystem ermöglicht und ältere relationale Stammdatensätze in intelligente, kontextbezogene und KI-fähige Datenbestände umwandelt. Die erste Hauptpriorität dieser Architektur-Roadmap wird sich auf die Modernisierung der Stammdatenprogramme von Healthcare Professional (HCP) und Healthcare Organization (HCO) konzentrieren, mit einer breiteren Skalierungsstrategie über alternative Stammdatendomänen in zukünftigen Wellen. Ein entscheidender Schwerpunkt Ihres Architekturentwurfs wird darin bestehen, die Lücke zwischen traditionellen MDM-Plattformen und fortschrittlichen semantischen Unternehmensebenen zu schließen und Stammdatensätze nahtlos in einheitliche Wissensgraphen umzuwandeln, die hochmoderne generative KI-Anwendungen vorantreiben. Der Bereich Datenmanagement- und Datenqualitätsplattformen dient als grundlegender Intelligenzmotor unseres globalen digitalen Unternehmens. Unsere Mission ist es, ein harmonisiertes, FAIR-konformes Stammdaten-Framework zu skalieren, das sich stark in eine automatisierte, KI-gestützte semantische Schicht integrieren lässt. Indem wir kontextuelle Bedeutung, Ontologiestandards und Beziehungsdiagramme in Rohstammdaten einfügen, bieten wir dem Unternehmen eine einzige, äußerst vertrauenswürdige und auffindbare Ansicht unseres Netzwerks. Der Beitritt zu diesem Bereich bedeutet, eine führende Rolle dabei zu übernehmen, sicherzustellen, dass gesundheitsspezifische Datenmodelle kontextgenau, hochsicher, mit globalen Regulierungsstandards konform und vollständig für den Einsatz modernster maschineller Lernmethoden optimiert sind. Die Chance:
• KI-gestützte MDM-Architektur: Entwerfen, entwerfen und leiten Sie die technische Ausführung der Modernisierung von Stammdatenverwaltungssystemen für Unternehmen durch die Integration von KI/ML-Funktionen für den Datenabgleich, die Entitätsauflösung und die Datenanreicherung.
• HCP- und HCO-Programmleitung: Fungieren Sie als primärer technischer Architekt für die grundlegenden Stammdateninitiativen für medizinisches Fachpersonal (HCP), Gesundheitsorganisation (HCO) und Geschäftspartner/Anbieter und stellen Sie eine hochpräzise Modellierung und Skalierbarkeit für nachfolgende Bereiche sicher.
• Semantische Layer-Integration: Definieren Sie die Blaupausen und Zuordnungsregeln, die erforderlich sind, um transaktionale Stammdaten mit einheitlichen semantischen Layern, Ontologien und Unternehmenswissensgraphen zu verbinden.
• AI-Ready Data Engineering: Stellen Sie sicher, dass Stammdatenmodelle vollständig maschinenlesbar und explizit strukturierbar sind

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Architecte de données/informations - Plateformes de données Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation rencontre l'objectif. En tant qu’équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues à l’esprit commercial engagés à contribuer à façonner l’avenir numérique des soins de santé de demain. Notre mission est de propulser Roche grâce à des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Animés par un objectif et une passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique constitue une force essentielle dans l’ensemble de Roche, permettant des méthodes de travail plus intelligentes, libérant le potentiel humain et conduisant à des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous proposons un modèle de travail hybride qui allie flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l’instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient présents dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise, tels que des ateliers, des conférences, des assemblées publiques, des réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements collaboratifs. Nous recherchons un architecte de données/information visionnaire au sein de la fonction RDT Data Platforms pour diriger la conception stratégique et la mise en œuvre de nos solutions de gestion des données de référence (MDM) basées sur l'IA. Dans ce rôle, vous serez l'architecte principal permettant l'intelligence artificielle dans notre écosystème MDM, transformant les enregistrements maîtres relationnels existants en actifs de données intelligents, sensibles au contexte et prêts pour l'IA. La première priorité clé de cette feuille de route architecturale se concentrera sur la modernisation des programmes de données de base des professionnels de la santé (HCP) et des organisations de santé (HCO), avec une stratégie de mise à l'échelle plus large dans des domaines de données de base alternatifs dans les vagues futures. Un objectif déterminant de votre conception architecturale sera de combler le fossé entre les plates-formes MDM traditionnelles et les couches sémantiques d'entreprise avancées, en transformant de manière transparente les ensembles de données de base en graphiques de connaissances unifiés qui alimentent les applications d'IA générative de pointe. Le domaine des plates-formes de gestion des données et de qualité des données constitue le moteur d’intelligence fondamental de notre entreprise numérique mondiale. Notre mission est de mettre à l'échelle un cadre de données de référence harmonisé et conforme à la norme FAIR qui s'intègre fortement à une couche sémantique automatisée et activée par l'IA. En injectant une signification contextuelle, des normes d'ontologie et des graphiques de relations dans les données de base brutes, nous fournissons à l'entreprise une vue unique, hautement fiable et découvrable de notre réseau. Rejoindre ce domaine signifie jouer un rôle de premier plan pour garantir que les modèles de données spécifiques aux soins de santé restent contextuellement précis, hautement sécurisés, conformes aux normes réglementaires mondiales et entièrement optimisés pour le déploiement de l'apprentissage automatique de pointe. L'opportunité :
• Architecture MDM basée sur l'IA : concevez, concevez et dirigez l'exécution technique de la modernisation des systèmes de gestion des données de référence d'entreprise en intégrant des fonctionnalités d'IA/ML pour la mise en correspondance des données, la résolution d'entités et l'enrichissement des données.
• Leadership des programmes HCP et HCO : agir en tant qu'architecte technique principal pour les initiatives fondamentales de données de base des professionnels de la santé (HCP), des organisations de santé (HCO) et des partenaires commerciaux/fournisseurs, garantissant une modélisation haute fidélité et une évolutivité pour les domaines ultérieurs.
• Intégration de la couche sémantique : définissez les modèles et les règles de mappage requis pour connecter les données de base transactionnelles aux couches sémantiques, aux ontologies et aux graphiques de connaissances d'entreprise unifiés.
• Ingénierie des données prête pour l'IA : assurez-vous que les modèles de données maîtres sont entièrement lisibles par machine et explicitement structurés.

jobs.title: China Biomarker Studies Asset Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
YOUR TEAM
You will report to the HGR Officer and partner closely with the global biosample operations teams across the enterprise. You will be recognized as a leader and work autonomously in both local as well as global cross functional study teams.
ROLE PURPOSE
As a China Biosample Operations Asset Lead, you will provide biosample operational expertise to one or more cross-functional local or global study teams through all phases and stages in accordance with the appropriate quality standards and applicable local regulations.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• PROVIDE BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS GUIDANCE TO CLINICAL CHINA STUDY TEAMS AND GLOBAL STUDY TEAMS FOR CHINA RELATED ACTIVITIES by planning, coordinating, and overseeing all operational activities required to manage the lifecycle of study samples (collection, processing, analysis, data delivery and final disposition).

• LEAD THE DEVELOPMENT OF A CHINA SPECIFIC BIOMARKER MANAGEMENT PLAN WITHIN CLINICAL STUDIES based on input from scientific and operational stakeholders to execute biosample operational strategies in China

• PROVIDE INPUT TO HGRAC APPLICATION to support Country Study Managers - when applicable - and within Biosample Operations’ remit.

• PARTNER CLOSELY WITH BIOMARKER SCIENTISTS AND BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS PROGRAM LEADS LOCALLY AND GLOBALLY to align study specific activities with program sample collection strategies. Evaluate the operational feasibility of specific testing in China and provide input to global program teams.

• PROVIDE OPERATIONAL INPUT AND RECOMMENDATIONS INTO STUDY RELATED DOCUMENTATION AND PROCESSES (e.g. protocol, ICF, HGRAC applications)

• PRESENT CHINA STUDY SAMPLE COLLECTION STRATEGY AT OPERATIONS TEAM MEETINGS AND CHINA INVESTIGATOR MEETINGS

• CONTRIBUTE TO LOCAL LAB/ REGIONAL VENDOR SELECTION FOR SPECIFIC TESTING in collaboration with Biosample Ops Lead, biomarker scientist, Procurement and based on technology expertise, performance and compliance.

• ESTABLISH BIOSAMPLE ANALYSIS AND DATA DELIVERY MILESTONES AND ENSURE ACCURATE TRACKING AND REPORTING OF BIOSAMPLE METRICS (sample collection, assay status, analyses updates). Provide study level updates to the study and global biomarker teams. Support study teams in addressing local vendor/site sample queries. Actively partner with Data Management to oversee and coordinate data format, and delivery timelines.

• PROVIDE DAY TO DAY OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT OF CHINA BIOSAMPLE VENDORS. Partner with internal/external stakeholders in the central lab set up, providing sample collection and processing instructions. Review central lab documents to ensure alignment with protocol and HGRAC submissions. Perform ongoing biomarker vendor management including development and oversight of scope of work, budget and performance management. Interact with vendors to help evaluate data size for compliance, plan sample shipments, export, storage, define data retention, ensure samples are analysed and data are transferred.

• IDENTIFY AREAS OF BEST PRACTICE AND PROCESS IMPROVEMENTS. Contribute to the development of internal guidelines within Biosample Operations’ remit, based on HGRAC process and local regulations as well as program needs. Partner with relevant stakeholders, both locally and globally, to optimize processes for sample management in China.

• DEMONSTRATE AGILITY AND ABILITY TO PERFORM IN A HIGHLY FAST-PACED, MATRIX ENVIRONMENT WHERE CROSS-TEAM COLLABORATION IS CRUCIAL. Leverage excellent verbal and written communication skills to motivate teams, neg

jobs.title: Medical Software Engineer - Complaint Handling

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere di software medico - Manipolazione di reclami
titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur en logiciel médical - Traitement des plaintes

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a focused investigative detective. Supported by senior experts, you will dive into code and logs to untangle software issues , growing your expertise in both cutting-edge IT and medical compliance frameworks. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

Main tasks:

• You are accountable for handling medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• Independently manage standard cases through their lifecycle, while partnering with senior colleagues to navigate complex or critical safety issues. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as a technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions. You can reference the Roche internal process confidently in discussions to justify decisions. You will consult with senior experts on technical and process-related aspects as needed.

• You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives to stakeholders in close collaboration with senior colleagues

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

Requirements:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.

• 2+ years of work experience in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions is desired

• Solid IT skills, especially the strong foundational ability to navigate and read source code in multiple languages, with an eagerness to learn complex system dependencies quickly

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Ingegnere del Software nella Qualità del Mercato Postale (PMQ), sarete in prima linea nel garantire la qualità e le prestazioni delle Soluzioni Digitali di Roche, la gestione delle lamentele relative ai Sistemi Informativi Ospedalieri/Laboratori (HIS/LIS), reti di dati medici, soluzioni middleware, comunicazione dei dati, app e algoritmi. Unire il Capitolo Soluzioni Digitali significa lavorare in un ambiente software altamente trasversale, dandovi l'opportunità di impegnarsi con tecnologie all'avanguardia e linguaggi di programmazione diversi per il software on-premise e cloud-based. La vostra missione principale sarà quella di agire come detective investigativo concentrato. Supportato da esperti senior, si immergerà in codice e registri per unire i problemi del software, aumentando la vostra esperienza sia nei quadri di conformità IT all'avanguardia e medicale. Mentre la vostra attenzione è sull'analisi della causa principale, non sarete responsabili per le correzioni di bug finali. Questo ruolo è ambientato in un ambiente Agile dove le tue idee e le tue proposte innovative sono altamente apprezzate, contribuendo direttamente a un team focalizzato sul miglioramento continuo. Principali compiti:
• Sei responsabile per la gestione di reclami del software medico, problemi di sicurezza e richieste di prodotti software (su premessa, cloud, mobile, applicazioni,...).
• Gestire in modo indipendente i casi standard attraverso il loro ciclo di vita, mentre collaborare con i colleghi senior per navigare problemi di sicurezza complessi o critici. Per i casi che non possono essere risolti direttamente, si prende la proprietà di aumentare al reparto sviluppo.
• Si agisce come esperto tecnico per la risoluzione dei casi, utilizzando la capacità di leggere e comprendere il codice sorgente per identificare il fattore principale causa di malfunzionamenti software. È possibile fare riferimento al processo interno Roche con fiducia nelle discussioni per giustificare le decisioni. Si consulterà con esperti senior su aspetti tecnici e legati al processo, come necessario.
• Sarà responsabile della comunicazione tempestiva delle informazioni essenziali relative alla qualità e del supporto alle iniziative degli stakeholder in stretta collaborazione con i colleghi senior
• Utilizza le tue capacità di automazione e analisi dei dati per migliorare il processo di gestione dei casi e monitorare proattivamente i dati sulle prestazioni dei prodotti Requisiti:
• Una laurea in informatica o un campo relativo all'IT.
• 2+ anni di esperienza lavorativa nell'area dell'ingegneria del software o funzioni correlate supporto IT è desiderato
• Competenze informatiche solide, in particolare la forte capacità di base di navigare e leggere il codice sorgente in più lingue, con l'ansia di imparare le dipendenze di sistema complesse rapidamente
• Forte capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato)
• Capacità di automazione e esperienza con l'analisi dei dati sono un plus Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Sant Cugat del Vallès. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel en qualité post-commercialisation (PMQ), vous serez à l'avant-garde de la qualité et des performances des solutions numériques de Roches, du traitement des plaintes liées aux systèmes d'information hospitaliers/laboratoires (HIS/LIS), aux réseaux de données médicales, aux solutions intermédiaires, à la communication de données, aux applications et aux algorithmes. Rejoindre le chapitre Solutions numériques signifie travailler dans un environnement logiciel hautement transversal, vous donnant la possibilité de vous engager avec des technologies de pointe et divers langages de programmation pour les logiciels sur site et cloud. Votre mission principale sera d'agir comme un détective d'investigation ciblé. Avec le soutien d'experts chevronnés, vous plongerez dans le code et les journaux pour démêler les problèmes logiciels, développant votre expertise dans les cadres de conformité informatique et médicale de pointe. Bien que votre attention soit sur l'analyse de la cause racine, vous ne serez pas responsable de la correction finale du bug. Ce rôle est établi dans un environnement agile où vos idées et propositions innovantes sont très appréciées, contribuant directement à une équipe axée sur l'amélioration continue. Principales tâches:
• Vous êtes responsable du traitement des plaintes relatives aux logiciels médicaux, des problèmes de sécurité et des demandes de renseignements sur les produits logiciels (sur place, cloud, mobile, applications,...).
• Gérer indépendamment les cas standard tout au long de leur cycle de vie, tout en s'associant à des collègues de haut niveau pour aborder des questions de sécurité complexes ou critiques. Pour les cas qui ne peuvent être résolus directement, vous prenez en main l'escalade vers le département du développement.
• Vous agissez en tant qu'expert technique pour la résolution de cas, en utilisant votre capacité à lire et comprendre le code source pour identifier le facteur de cause racine des dysfonctionnements logiciels. Vous pouvez citer le processus interne de Roche avec confiance dans les discussions pour justifier les décisions. Vous consulterez des experts de haut niveau sur les aspects techniques et liés aux processus au besoin.
• Vous serez responsable de la communication en temps opportun des informations essentielles liées à la qualité et des initiatives d'appui aux parties prenantes, en étroite collaboration avec des collègues de haut niveau
• Vous utilisez vos compétences d'automatisation et d'analyse de données pour améliorer le processus de traitement des cas et surveiller de manière proactive les données sur les performances des produits Exigences:
• Diplôme en informatique ou en informatique.
• 2 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans le domaine de l'ingénierie logicielle ou des fonctions liées au support informatique est souhaitée
• Des compétences informatiques solides, en particulier la forte capacité fondamentale de naviguer et de lire le code source dans plusieurs langues, avec un désir d'apprendre rapidement des dépendances complexes du système
• Fortes compétences en communication en anglais (écrit et parlé)
• Capacités d'automatisation et expérience en matière d'analyse de données Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'emplacement principal est Sant Cugat del Vallès. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de soins de santé qui changent la vie

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Payroll, Time and Benefits Senior Team Lead

What we do:
The People Support Solutions (PSS) organization brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We work closely together as a team to ensure strong employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions.

Your day to day responsibilities:
As a Payroll Time & Benefits Team Lead, you are responsible for leading a Payroll Time & Benefits Operations (PTB) team across multiple countries (a country cluster) and performing all people leadership activities in line with Roche People Practices. You will ensure local PTB performance targets are met at both the team and individual levels, and that regular operations reviews are held internally, as well as externally with relevant stakeholders.

As a Qualified Lead you are:

• Leading and managing the Payroll Time and Benefits Operations (PTB) team by delivering best services and solutions towards the clients.

• Ensuring delivery of services in accordance with agreed performance levels (KPI) and in line with legal/regulations (compliance), continuously driving improvement activities/projects (simplification, standardization, automation) for service excellence and consistent customer experience.

• Working in line with overall People Support Solutions strategy, seeking better/creative solutions to support business needs as well as leveraging advanced technology to continually drive teamwork efficiency and enhance customer experience.

• Leading and facilitating people processes in line with Roche Leadership commitments, People Practices and policies, Roche values.

• Role Modeling our people practices, ensuring that ongoing dialog occurs on the topics of Career, Capabilities, Connections and Contributions.

• Developing team member’s knowledge, skills, capabilities in line with the Roche People Practices to retain and develop talented staff.

• Driving employee retention, engagement and talent management.

• Creating a safe and positive team culture and environment, ensuring the team is demonstrating the right mindset and attitude (trust, growth mindset, customer centricity, E2E accountability, problem solving).

• Ensuring consistent and reliable service delivery for customers serviced, maintaining strong customer satisfaction within the area of responsibility, pro-actively providing feedback/inputs to stakeholders from a service perspective.

• Setting and monitoring team working plan, resource allocations, workload.

• Seeking, identifying and driving continuous service and process improvement (in terms of standardization, automation, and simplification), and service enhancement based on monthly performance, customer feedback.

• Sustaining a win-win relationship with external vendors, as well as monitor the vendor performance through routine and/or project work.

• Collaborating with peers within the region and globally PTB community and achieving our People Support Solutions vision by driving global consistency through collaboration.

• Partnering with other Service teams (e.g. Advisory, People Support, Employee Lifecycle teams) for cross functional end to end service delivery and process improvement.

• Actively contributing to the global PTB program and People & Culture transformation to ensure the defined strategy is successfully implemented within the assigned countries.

What you bring to our team: ​
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist, you will ensure that Roche’s people practices work seamlessly for the business by managing the end-to-end execution of payroll, tax, and social insurance. You will play a vital role in providing advisory support and maintaining data integrity while keeping customer-focused principles at the heart of every interaction.

• Execute end-to-end payroll activities , including data maintenance for tax, social insurance, and local/global benefits administration with high accuracy.

• Provide expert customer service by resolving complex inquiries, managing requests, and troubleshooting issues related to pay, time, and benefits.

• Oversee time and absence management , collaborating with managers to ensure compliance with local policies and accuracy in employee records.

• Manage technical data flows , monitoring Workday integrations and processing mass upload files to ensure vendor accuracy and timely processing.

• Ensure regulatory compliance across various countries and jurisdictions, keeping up-to-date with evolving legal requirements and internal documentation.

• Foster key stakeholder relationships , partnering proactively with P&C Chapters and providing guidance to first-level support teams to enhance service delivery.

• Drive continuous improvement by participating in global projects and implementing initiatives to optimize performance and service quality.

Who You Are
You are a detail-oriented professional with a strong analytical mindset and a passion for customer centricity. You thrive in fast-paced, multicultural environments and take full accountability for delivering consistent, high-quality results across borders.

• Professional Experience: You bring 1–3 years of experience in payroll services and benefits administration , ideally within a Shared Service Center environment.

• Language Skills: You are fluent in German and English

• Technical Proficiency: You have advanced Excel skills (v-lookup, pivot tables) and a solid understanding of the payroll cycle and HR processes.

• Analytical Ability: You have an excellent eye for detail and can navigate complex data structures to resolve errors and ensure accuracy.

• Matrix Collaboration: You have a proven track record of delivering results in a matrix organization and are comfortable working independently with competing priorities.

• Solution Orientation: You demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, utilizing active listening and critical thinking to drive process improvements.

• Growth Mindset: You are adaptable to change, enjoy learning new tools (such as Workday or ServiceNow), and thrive in ambiguous situations.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility : We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

As a Payroll Time Benefits Specialist - French speaking , you are responsible for payroll, time, benefits data maintenance and administrative activities in a timely and accurate manner. • Providing timely responses to customer payroll inquiries by using an internal case management system and proactively identifying and troubleshooting payroll issues to determine root cause and solutions for resolution

• Monitoring data flows to/from Workday to Vendor for accuracy and ensuring integrations are processed timely and resolving any errors ensuring accurately processed

A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Crea il tuo senso di complesse esigenze dei clienti Contribuisci attivamente al futuro della diagnostica e aiuti i pazienti ad essere aiutati più velocemente e più precisamente. In questo ruolo chiave, si trasformano visioni in risultati tangibili e quindi assicurano il nostro comune successo sul mercato. Il tuo nuovo team: diventi parte di un team di vendita dinamico e collegiale in rete in tutta la Germania. Lavoriamo di pari passo con gli esperti: all'interno del servizio e della gestione del conto per trovare le migliori soluzioni per i nostri esigenti gruppi di clienti – dalle cliniche universitarie agli specialisti di laboratorio. Insieme padroneggiamo le sfide con un mix di professionalità e spirito di squadra. Responsabilità | Questo vi aspetta
• Si entra in uno dei nostri clienti chiave nella zona di Berlino.
• Si sviluppano strategie personalizzate e garantire la loro implementazione di successo.
• Pianifica, controlla e monitora lo sviluppo aziendale nella tua zona e conduci analisi competitive sonore.
• Iniziate e conducete attività di vendita interdipartimentali e guidate le squadre nazionali al successo senza controllo diretto.
• Contribuisci attivamente idee all'ulteriore sviluppo delle strategie di business field e lavori con progetti orientati al futuro.
• Come mentore, appoggiate l'incorporazione di nuovi colleghi e assumete la responsabilità di un argomento speciale come la coagulazione o l'offerta. Qualificazioni | Questo ti porta con
• Hai completato gli studi (scienze naturali, ingegneria, medicina o BWL) o una formazione scientifica e tecnica comparabile.
• Porti diversi anni di esperienza di vendita nel settore sanitario e ti conosci bene nel mercato diagnostico e nel suo quadro giuridico.
• Pensi imprenditoriale, gestire progetti complessi e portare esperienza nella leadership all'interno di strutture a matrice.
• Il tuo aspetto è professionale, credibile e vincente. Hai la competenza sociale per integrare le persone e trovare soluzioni insieme. Sei interessato a costruire relazioni con i clienti collaborative e a lungo termine .

Vi offriamo una varietà di migliori manzoni nelle nostre posizioni. Solo con voi possiamo migliorare la vita dei pazienti. Si rende Roche unico con il vostro contributo. Ecco perché offriamo benefici eccezionali che vi aiutano a plasmare la vostra vita, la finanza e la salute come volete. • Profilo attuale del CV o del giorno di lavoro
• I vostri certificati ufficiali (istruzione) e prove Altri documenti non sono attualmente richiesti. Si prega di notare che non è possibile aggiungere ulteriori documenti dopo l'invio della domanda. Iscriviti ora – siamo felici!

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was Dich erwartet:

Die Labordiagnostik ist das Herzstück unseres Gesundheitswesens und von entscheidender Bedeutung für jeden einzelnen Patienten. Schätzungsweise 70 % aller klinischen Entscheidungen basieren auf In-vitro-diagnostischen Tests. Die absolute Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme ist daher die Grundvoraussetzung für sichere Diagnosen und medizinische Weichenstellungen.

Für unser Praktikantenprogramm suchen wir motivierte, technologiebegeisterte und wissbegierige Studierende, die unser Service-Team tatkräftig unterstützen und gemeinsam mit uns den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche Karriere bei Roche legen möchten.

Werde Teil unserer dynamischen Serviceorganisation! Mit viel Energie, Leidenschaft und Innovationsgeist bringen wir die Labordiagnostik in Deutschland voran und gestalten die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mit. Bei uns kannst Du tagtäglich Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein theoretisches und praktisches Wissen einbringen, um komplexe technische Fragestellungen im Team zu lösen.

Als Praktikant:in (m/w/d) begleitest Du unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden bei der Planung, Installation, Wartung und Modifikation unserer Analysensysteme cobas® pro und cobas® pure . Darüber hinaus tauchst Du tief in die IT-Vernetzung unserer Systeme ein. Bei den täglichen Einsätzen in verschiedenen Krankenhaus- und Privatlaboren sind Deine Eigeninitiative, Deine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Dein technisches Geschick gefragt.

Dein perfekter Start: Zu Beginn Deines Praktikums erhältst Du eine fundierte Ausbildung auf unseren Immunologie cobas®-Systemen und wirst während Deines gesamten Außendiensteinsatzes von einem festen Mentor oder einer Mentorin intensiv begleitet.
Du wirst im Raum Hessen oder Rheinland-Pfalz eingesetzt und genießt die Freiheit, Deinen Wohnort innerhalb dieses Gebiets frei zu wählen (idealerweise im Raum Mannheim, Frankfurt, Darmstadt, Mainz, Wiesbaden, Koblenz, Gießen, Kaiserslautern ).

Folgende Schwerpunkte erwarten Dich bei Deinem Praktikum im Service Außendienst:

• Professionelles Training: Du absolvierst im September ein spezialisiertes Wartungstraining an zwei Immunologie-Modulen ( cobas® e402 und cobas® e801 ).

• Praktische Technik: Du stellst Dein handwerkliches und technisches Geschick direkt bei Geräteinstallationen und präventiven Wartungen unter Beweis.

• Problem-Solving: Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Analyse sowie Behebung komplexer technischer und applikativer Fragestellungen und unterstützt unser Team aktiv bei der Ursachenforschung.

• Perspektivenwechsel: Du fokussierst Dich auf die Bereiche Klinische Chemie und Immunologie, hast jedoch jederzeit die Möglichkeit, durch Hospitationen auch andere spannende Unternehmensbereiche kennenzulernen.

• Zukunftsthema IT: IT-Netzwerke und IT-Sicherheit wecken Deinen Ehrgeiz – bei der Installation von Firewalls lernst Du direkt von unseren IT-Spezialisten.

• Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Deine organisatorischen Fähigkeiten ein und übernimmst selbstständig definierte Aufgabenpakete (z. B. die professionelle Einweisung unserer Kunden in die Nutzung unserer Online-Plattform Navify ).

• Kommunikationstalent: Du schärfst Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im direkten Dialog mit unseren Kunden sowie bei der kollegialen Abstimmung im Team.

• Flexibilität: Kleinere Projektaufgaben bearbeitest Du ganz flexibel an einzelnen Tagen im Homeoffice. Die meiste Zeit bist Du jedoch dort, wo unsere Geräte stehen: direkt vor Ort bei unseren Kunden.

• Wachstumsumfeld: Wir bieten Dir ein attraktive

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
