jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Business Analyst Professional - RDT Group Function

We are looking for an experienced Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner to partner with the Business Product Owners in translating compliance requirements into strategic digital solutions. You will drive the strategic vision, roadmap, and delivery of Compliance-related products within Roche . This includes platforms supporting Group Audit and Risk Advisory, Group Compliance spanning global teams across Pharma and Diagnostics. The Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner will play a key role in analyzing complex business processes, identifying optimization opportunities, and enabling automation and digitization of the compliance processes, from review, approval, oversight, to monitoring, review and governance frameworks, ensuring alignment with the "One Roche" philosophy.

Description of the area
About RDT Group Functions Compliance Product in Legal, Compliance & Group Communication sub-function: as a trusted and agile partner, we are empowered to boost global innovative solutions on the group risk, compliance and assurance digital prioritization journey.
The Compliance Product allows Roche to manage global risk, ensure financial and legal compliance and provide assurance of compliant processes and behavior in other words ensuring that the provisions of these regulations are met in practice. As part of the Compliance Product, Roche Digital Technology (RDT) creates, manages and operates solutions which improve processes, efficiency, effectiveness and collaboration especially among Group Compliance communities, Group Audit and Risk Advisory (GA & RA).

The opportunity:

• Drive the detailed discovery, scoping, and analysis of compliance, audit, and risk processes across global teams to target current pain points and maximize optimization opportunities .

• Translate complex business requirements into clear, functional specifications and technical specifications for development teams, bridging the gap between business and tech .

• Develop comprehensive business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and impact assessments for compliance products to systematically quantify and deliver measurable business value .

• Collaborate closely with the Business Product Owner to define compliance product strategies, roadmap priorities, and long-term tech goals like AI-driven solutions .

• Lead vendor selection processes by defining business criteria, conducting fit-for-purpose assessments, and partnering with Procurement to satisfy privacy and data security rules .

• Facilitate global requirements workshops across Compliance, GA&RA, Pharma, and Diagnostics teams to seamlessly harmonize and prioritize cross-functional business needs .

• Own the technical solution definition and requirements management from initial ideation and prototyping through to testing, adoption, and support transitions .

• Ensure all compliance platforms fully align with Roche’s legal, regulatory, data privacy, and security standards while strictly maintaining requirement traceability trails .

Who you are:

• Education & Experience: You possess a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field, combined with previous experience as a Technical Business Analyst or Product Owner.

• Industry Expertise: You have a proven track record working within compliance, audit, risk, or governance environments, ideally within the global corporate, pharmaceutical, or diagnostics industries.

• Analyt

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Business Analyst Professional - Funzione Gruppo RDT Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto Analista tecnico e Proprietario del Prodotto per collaborare con i Proprietari del Prodotto Business nel tradurre i requisiti di conformità in soluzioni digitali strategiche. Potrai guidare la visione strategica, roadmap e la consegna di prodotti correlati a conformità all'interno di Roche. Questo include piattaforme che supportano il Gruppo Audit e Risk Advisory, Compliance di Gruppo che spazia tra i team globali di Pharma e Diagnostics. Il Technical Business Analyst e Product Owner svolgeranno un ruolo chiave nell'analisi di processi aziendali complessi, nell'individuazione delle opportunità di ottimizzazione e nell'automazione e nella digitalizzazione dei processi di conformità, dalla revisione, approvazione, supervisione, al monitoraggio, alla revisione e ai quadri di governance, garantendo l'allineamento con la filosofia "One Roche". Descrizione dell'Area Informazioni su RDT Group Functions Compliance Product in Legal, Compliance & Group Communication sotto-funzione: come partner affidabile e agile, siamo autorizzati a rafforzare soluzioni innovative globali sul rischio di gruppo, sulla conformitÃ e sulla garanzia del viaggio di priorizzazione digitale. Il Prodotto di Compliance consente a Roche di gestire il rischio globale, garantire la conformità finanziaria e legale e garantire processi e comportamenti conformi in altre parole assicurando che le disposizioni di queste normative siano soddisfatte in pratica. Nell'ambito del prodotto Compliance, Roche Digital Technology (RDT) crea, gestisce e gestisce soluzioni che migliorano processi, efficienza, efficacia e collaborazione soprattutto tra le comunità di Compliance Group Audit e Risk Advisory (GA & RA). L'Oportunità: - Guidare la scoperta dettagliata, scoping, e l'analisi di conformità, audit e processi di rischio in team globali per individuare i punti di dolore attuali e massimizzare le opportunità di ottimizzazione. - Traduci i complessi requisiti aziendali in specifiche chiare e funzionali e specifiche tecniche per i team di sviluppo, colmare il divario tra business e tecnologia. - Sviluppare casi aziendali completi, analisi dei costi e valutazioni di impatto per i prodotti di conformità per quantificare sistematicamente e fornire un valore commerciale misurabile. - Collaborare a stretto contatto con il proprietario del prodotto aziendale per definire le strategie di conformità del prodotto, le priorità della roadmap e gli obiettivi tecnologici a lungo termine come soluzioni AI-driven. - Processi di selezione dei fornitori di piombo definendo criteri aziendali, conducendo valutazioni fit-for-purpose e collaborando con Procurement per soddisfare le regole di privacy e sicurezza dei dati. - Facilitare i workshop sui requisiti globali attraverso i team di Compliance, GA&RA, Pharma e Diagnostics per armonizzare e dare priorità alle esigenze aziendali interfunzionali. - Proprio la definizione della soluzione tecnica e la gestione dei requisiti da ideazione iniziale e prototipazione fino a test, adozione e transizioni di supporto. - Assicurare tutte le piattaforme di conformità pienamente allineare con gli standard legali, regolamentari, privacy dei dati e sicurezza di Roche, mantenendo rigorosamente i percorsi di tracciabilità dei requisiti. Chi Sei: - Istruzione & Esperienza: Possiedi una laurea o Master in Informatica, Business Administration, o un campo correlato, combinato con l'esperienza precedente come analista tecnico o proprietario del prodotto. - Esperienza Settoriale: Hai una comprovata esperienza nel campo della conformità, dell'audit, del rischio o della governance, idealmente all'interno delle industrie aziendali, farmaceutiche o diagnostiche globali. - Analitico

descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione Analyste d'affaires professionnel - Fonction de groupe RDT Nous recherchons un analyste technique d'affaires et un propriétaire de produits expérimentés pour nous associer aux propriétaires de produits d'affaires afin de traduire les exigences de conformité en solutions numériques stratégiques. Vous dirigerez la vision stratégique, la feuille de route et la livraison des produits liés à la conformité à Roche. Cela comprend des plateformes d'appui à la vérification de groupe et à l'avis sur les risques, la conformité de groupe couvrant les équipes mondiales à travers Pharma et Diagnostics. L'analyste technique des affaires et le propriétaire du produit joueront un rôle clé dans l'analyse des processus opérationnels complexes, la détermination des possibilités d'optimisation et la facilitation de l'automatisation et de la numérisation des processus de conformité, depuis l'examen, l'approbation, la surveillance, jusqu'aux cadres de surveillance, d'examen et de gouvernance, en passant par l'harmonisation avec la philosophie « One Roche ». Descrizione dell'Area À propos du Groupe RDT Fonctions Conformité Produit dans la sous-fonction juridique, Conformité & Communication du Groupe: en tant que partenaire fiable et agile, nous sommes habilités à stimuler des solutions innovantes au niveau mondial sur le parcours de priorité numérique de risque, de conformité et d'assurance de groupe. Le produit de conformité permet à Roche de gérer le risque mondial, d'assurer la conformité financière et juridique et d'assurer la conformité des processus et des comportements, c'est-à-dire de s'assurer que les dispositions de ces règlements sont respectées dans la pratique. Dans le cadre du produit Conformité, Roche Digital Technology (RDT) crée, gère et exploite des solutions qui améliorent les processus, l'efficience, l'efficacité et la collaboration, en particulier entre les communautés Conformité de Groupe, Audit de Groupe et Avis de Risque (GA & RA). L'Oportunità: - Diriger la découverte détaillée, la détermination de la portée et l'analyse des processus de conformité, d'audit et de risque dans les équipes mondiales afin de cibler les points de douleur actuels et de maximiser les possibilités d'optimisation. - Traduire des exigences opérationnelles complexes en spécifications fonctionnelles claires et techniques pour les équipes de développement, combler l'écart entre les entreprises et les technologies. - Élaborer des analyses de rentabilisation complètes, des analyses coûts-avantages et des analyses d'impact pour les produits de conformité afin de quantifier et de produire systématiquement une valeur opérationnelle mesurable. - Collaborer étroitement avec le propriétaire de produit d'entreprise pour définir les stratégies de conformité des produits, les priorités de la feuille de route et les objectifs technologiques à long terme comme les solutions axées sur l'IA. - Diriger les processus de sélection des fournisseurs en définissant les critères opérationnels, en procédant à des évaluations adaptées à l'usage et en établissant des partenariats avec Approvisionnement pour satisfaire aux règles de confidentialité et de sécurité des données. - Faciliter l'organisation d'ateliers sur les exigences mondiales à l'échelle des équipes Conformité, AG&RA, Pharma et Diagnostics afin d'harmoniser et de prioriser les besoins opérationnels interfonctionnels. - Posséder la définition de la solution technique et la gestion des exigences, de l'idée initiale et du prototypage à l'essai, l'adoption et le soutien des transitions. - Veiller à ce que toutes les plateformes de conformité s'harmonisent pleinement avec les normes légales, réglementaires, de confidentialité des données et de sécurité de Roche, tout en maintenant strictement les pistes de traçabilité des exigences. C'est quoi ? - Istruzione & Esperienza: Vous possédez un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en technologie de l'information, administration des affaires, ou un domaine connexe, combiné avec une expérience antérieure en tant qu'analyste technique des affaires ou propriétaire de produit. - Esperienza Settoriale: Vous avez une expérience éprouvée de travail dans des environnements de conformité, d'audit, de risque ou de gouvernance, idéalement dans les industries mondiales de l'entreprise, pharmaceutique, ou de diagnostic. - Analyse

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity

• Formulate and implement strategic and tactical sales in the assigned territory

• Oversee all necessary commercial activities to fulfill strategic objectives

• Develop relationships with existing clients and maximize revenue potential

• Provide timely and reliable sales reporting via REXIS and in company meetings/ presentations to senior management

• Product Knowledge: Ensure good understanding the product portfolio and competitive advantages of the products

• Develops and leverages relationships with the leadership of key/strategic customers to deliver value-based solutions and achieve business results.

• Tender Management: establishes priorities in the hospitals/groups with product listing for tender submission

• Apply existing marketing activities to ensure awareness of the company among all target groups

• Conduct presentations at small and medium customer sites and work with marketing for key account sites

• Build strong relationships with key accounts and develop a long term strategy how to grow business in key accounts

• Identify and seize opportunities for new business in existing (increase Roche share) and new customers

• Represent Vietnam in regional initiatives, projects and meetings as assigned by senior management

• Work closely with marketing team to ensure accurate forecasting for respective customer segments

• Work closely with Service and Applications to understand potential issues at the customer and work together to ensure high customer satisfaction

• Inform Service and Applications timely about customer needs, e.g. installations, trouble shootings…

• Upskill DSMs and Sales Reps in their team and ensure high performance spirit among the team

Who you are

• Medical Doctor, Pharmaceutical or Biotechnology University Degree

• Multinational companies in a similar industry with sales management at least 5 years is preferred

• Good commercial understanding and understanding of Diagnostics buying cycle

• Sales experience in related industries is required.

• Supervisory/Managerial experience is required

• Languages: Conversant in both English and Vietnamese (conversational & writing)

• Key Account Management Skills

• Effective Communication Skill

• Good Interpersonal Skill

• Creative Problem Solving and Negotiation Skill

• Customer Complaint Handling Skill

• Time Management Skill

• Leadership and Coaching Skill

• Computer skills: <Google WorkSpace, Google Docs Editor, Microsoft Office

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Procurement Analyst (Japanese Speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

As a Procurement Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for procurement matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

The Opportunity:
Job Responsibilities:

• Execute the day-to-day activities according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and best practice. Ensure quality and accurate delivery of services within agreed key performance indicators (KPIs) and as defined in the Service Level Agreement (SLA) and SOPs of the respective business sub-process.

• Follow the instructions of the Managers regarding the daily work coordination.

• Develop knowledge and capability to raise competence to expected levels to meet current and future business needs.

• Contribute process and technical expertise to process improvement initiatives.

• Support on assigned projects or programs.

Key Accountabilities:

• Validate and process (fix & check) Purchase Requisitions to ensure completeness and in compliance with Procurement Policy.

• Convert Purchase Requisitions to Purchase Orders.

• Purchase Order amendment, close and cancellation.

• Manage and resolve internal and external queries.

• Participate in invoice reconciliation process. Work closely with Accounts Payable team to resolve any outstanding invoice reconciliation or mismatch.

• Execute and produce accurate and timely reports.

• Manage and execute the quote collections and multiple source biddings when applicable.

• Review and update SOP, DTP & LP timely.

• Ensure adherence to the Procurement Policy, Directive, Guidelines and Local Procurement SOPs.

• Actively participate in new project, such as ASPIRE/MyBuy and etc. Attend related meetings, trainings, knowledge transfer and etc.

Who you are:

• Degree or Diploma in Business Studies, Finance & Accounting/Commerce, Supply Chain or Procurement equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English and Japanese (N1/N2 level)

• 3-years experience in a centralized purchasing environment and Supply Chain with production planning background.

• Experience of working in a shared service center across a global / large organization will be an added advantage.

• Good negotiation and analytical skills, resourceful in identifying new sources of items requested and results oriented.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Patient Safety Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Our Team: Senior Patient Safety Partner
Are you a pharmacovigilance (PV) professional looking to make a strategic impact on patient safety? We are looking for a Senior Patient Safety Partner to drive excellence in our local PV systems and help shape the future of patient care.

Job Purpose
In this role, you will be the guardian of our local PV system for Spain. Your mission is to ensure we remain fully compliant with Roche global standards and local regulatory requirements, safeguarding our License to Operate. You will lead the execution of International Patient Safety (IPS) strategies, turning global solutions into high-quality local results.

Key Responsibilities

• PV System Excellence: Partner with global and local teams to monitor safety profiles of Roche Products and manage their risks effectively.

• Operational Oversight: Manage critical PV activities including individual case safety reports, Pharmacovigilance Agreements (e.g. Safety Data Exchange Agreement), Risk Management and Safety Communication, Local Studies, Programs and other projects with PV implications (e.g., Interventional Clinical Trials, Non-interventional studies, Market Research Programs, Patient Support Programs, Compassionate Use Programs, Post Trial Access Programs, Digital Activities).

• Local Safety Risk Management

• Identify, analyze and share safety insights by understanding disease areas (Roche portfolio, patient journey), engaging with key stakeholders, and ensuring timely, proactive integration into Affiliate and global strategies.

• Implementation of safety solutions and launch readiness activities: Implement global safety solutions locally within the integrated therapeutic strategy, and execute product safety launch readiness activities.

• Risk management and safety communication: Support the country-level risk management strategy to optimize patient outcomes in collaboration within relevant networks and ensure compliant and transparent PV communications (e.g., DHPCs) to healthcare professionals, patients, and external partners in collaboration with Medical Affairs and the cross-functional team.

• Strengthen cross-functional and cross-country collaboration: Foster strong cross-functional partnerships and represent affiliate safety interests in IPS forums, strategically influencing cross-country initiatives and implementing global solutions into local clinical practice

• Regulatory Influence: Actively shape local PV regulations and ecosystems by collaborating with industry associations and health authorities.

What You Bring

• Education: A degree in life sciences or a healthcare-related field (e.g., PharmD, Medical Doctor, Bachelor in Life Sciences, or Nursing).

• Experience:

• At least 5 years experience in pharmacovigilance, ideally in an affiliate setting

• PV Compliance Expertise: In-depth knowledge of global & local PV regulations and the ability to oversee comprehensive compliance monitoring systems.

• Decision-making ability in the local & global PV ecosystem

• Experienced in collaborating within global and local matrix environments, including proven ability in stakeholder management and influencing

• Advantage : Experience in other affiliate medical functions (e.g., Regulatory, Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, Medical Information) or global functions such as Clinical Safety

Core Competencies & Skills
1. Strategic Leadership & Big-Picture Thinking

• Strategic Planning: Ability to align complex projects with the company’s long-term goals.

• Syst

jobs.title: Medical Software Engineer - Complaint Handling
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS) , medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a focused investigative detective . Supported by senior experts, you will dive into code and logs to untangle software issues, growing your expertise in both cutting-edge IT and medical compliance frameworks. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity:

• You are accountable for handling medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You independently manage standard cases through their lifecycle, while partnering with senior colleagues to navigate complex or critical safety issues. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of transfering to the development department.

• You act as a technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions. You can reference the Roche internal process confidently in discussions to justify decisions. You will consult with senior experts on technical and process-related aspects as needed.

• You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives to stakeholders in close collaboration with senior colleagues

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

Who you are:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.

• 2+ years of work experience in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions is desired

• Solid IT skills, especially the strong foundational ability to navigate and read source code in multiple languages, with an eagerness to learn complex system dependencies quickly

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Automation skills and experience with data analytics are a plus

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM);

• Training, language courses, and diversified career paths are available

• Recharge Days (2 days off per quarter)

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose)

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time)

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice)

• Stock share purchase additions;

• Yearly sales of company equipment and many more!

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS) , medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms. Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software. Your core mission will be to act as a focused investigative detective . Supported by senior experts, you will dive into code and logs to untangle software issues, growing your expertise in both cutting-edge IT and medical compliance frameworks. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement. The Opportunity:
• You are accountable for handling medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).
• You independently manage standard cases through their lifecycle, while partnering with senior colleagues to navigate complex or critical safety issues. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of transfering to the development department.
• You act as a technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions. You can reference the Roche internal process confidently in discussions to justify decisions. You will consult with senior experts on technical and process-related aspects as needed.
• You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives to stakeholders in close collaboration with senior colleagues
• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data Who you are:
• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.
• 2+ years of work experience in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions is desired
• Solid IT skills, especially the strong foundational ability to navigate and read source code in multiple languages, with an eagerness to learn complex system dependencies quickly
• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)
• Automation skills and experience with data analytics are a plus What you get:
• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),
• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;
• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM);
• Training, language courses, and diversified career paths are available
• Recharge Days (2 days off per quarter)
• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose)
• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time)
• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice)
• Stock share purchase additions;
• Yearly sales of company equipment and many more! At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in

titleByLocale.it: Senior Medical Software Ingegnere - Complaint Handling
titleByLocale.en: Senior Medical Software Engineer - Complaint Handling
titleByLocale.de: Senior Medical Software Ingenieur - Complaint Handling
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Medical Software Ingénieur - Complaint Handling

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS) , medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a highly autonomous, deep-dive technical investigator . You masterfully dissect complex, edge-case software failures, bridging the gap between field trouble-shooting and core R&D development teams. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity:

• You are accountable for handling complex medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of transfering to the development department.

• You act as a senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause/causal factor of software malfunctions. You master the Roche internal quality processes and understand their regulatory background to justify decisions.

• You are an interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

• You serve as a trusted technical proxy for the Principal Engineer when required.

Who you are:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.

• 5+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions

• Strong IT skills, especially the ability to read and debug complex source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues

• Good ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty.

• Good ability to present technical work to stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM);

• Training, language courses, and diversified career paths are available

• Recharge Days (2 days off per quarter)

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose)

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time)

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。

A. 目标与计划管理

• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性

• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划

B. 客户管理与区域合作

• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。

C. 团队管理

• 参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划

• 吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展

• 打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景

D. 财务和合规管理

• 分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标

• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者

• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质

• 思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维

• 领导力特质：系统思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养

• 业务及资源规划能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Head of Healthcare Transformation
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose

• The Head of Healthcare Transformation serves as a cornerstone in advancing Roche Diagnostics' commitment to enhancing patient care. By synthesizing clinical evidence, access frameworks, and governmental advocacy with business development, this leader ensures that breakthrough diagnostics gain market entry, clinical recognition, and financial sustainability within Taiwan. This executive role fundamentally evolves the local medical landscape while establishing Roche as a premier partner in the health ecosystem.

• A primary focus involves the evaluation and refinement of healthcare pathways and public policy to foster robust internal and external partnerships, thereby modernizing the local environment to drive substantive commercial growth. Achieving systemic change necessitates the seamless integration of policy shaping, medical insights and reimbursement expertise. Furthermore, you will identify and cultivate emerging business opportunities that respond to shifting clinical trends, overseeing the launch of programs that improve healthcare delivery and ensure the enduring availability of innovative diagnostic tools.

• Possessing a profound sense of purpose, the incumbent will mobilize teams to achieve superior outcomes under the "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan" vision, directly contributing to the execution of the RDTW 1000 days strategic roadmap.

• In this capacity, you will demonstrate an entrepreneurial spirit and system-wide perspective, converting visionary concepts into disciplined, high-impact strategies that secure organizational success across both immediate and future horizons.

• As a member of the RD Taiwan Leadership Team, you will role model VACC behaviors and uphold the LT Purpose Statement. Close collaboration with peers across the Leadership Team is essential to realize the company's broader objectives. This leadership approach centers on cultivating high-performing, customer-centric teams within an agile and continuously evolving organizational culture.

• Ultimately, you must exhibit the determination and resilience required to transform Taiwan's healthcare landscape, embodying the core Roche mission: "Doing what patients need next."

Key Responsibilities:

• Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute an integrated medical, market access & policy strategy aligned with global/regional guidelines and local business objectives.

• Medical Affairs Strategy: Lead the generation and dissemination of scientific evidence, foster strategic relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and medical societies, and ensure scientific accuracy in all activities.

• Market Access & Reimbursement: Drive successful NHI (National Health Insurance) listing and optimal pricing strategies for key diagnostic products, utilizing health economics and outcomes research (HEOR).

• Public Policy & Government Affairs: Proactively monitor the healthcare policy landscape. Engage collaboratively with government authorities (e.g., MOHW, NHIA), industry associations, and patient advocacy groups to shape favorable policies for diagnostic innovations.

• Business Development: Identify, develop, and manage strategic emerging business opportunities and partnerships that promote growth and innovation and ensure the delivery of scalable and impactful healthcare solutions.

• Team Leadership & VACC Culture: Lead, coach, and inspire a cross-functional Medical, Market Access, Policy and Business Development team to unl

jobs.title: Praktikum im Marketing & Produktmanagement Labordiagnostik (m/w/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Stage dans les diagnostics de laboratoire de commercialisation et de gestion de produits (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Abteilung

Im Produktmanagement & Marketing des Bereichs Labordiagnostik der Roche Diagnostics Deutschland GmbH betreuen und vertreiben wir Lösungen für diagnostische Labore im deutschen Markt. Unser Produktportfolio umfasst Analysensysteme und Assays für die Klinische Chemie, Immunologie, Gerinnungs- und Urindiagnostik. Ganzheitliche Konzepte für Labore aller Größenordnungen werden durch innovative Hardware und Software Lösungen zur automatisierten Prä- und Postanalytik, zur Steuerung des Proben- und Datenflusses sowie zur Unterstützung der operativen und medizinischen Entscheidungsfindung realisiert. Im Marketing- und Produktmanagement stellen wir eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Verkauf, Service und Produktentwicklung dar.

Die Position

Bist Du auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum, in dem Du Dich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst? In diesem Praktikum bieten wir Bachelor- und Masterstudierenden die Möglichkeit, die Arbeit im Marketing und Produktmanagement kennenzulernen und aktiv mitzugestalten. Hier werden naturwissenschaftliche Grundlagen mit betriebswirtschaftlichen und technologischen Themen vereint. Mögliche Aufgabenfelder beinhalten:

• Unterstützung bei der Planung und Durchführung von Multi-Channel Marketingkampagnen, Schulungen und Events

• Mitarbeit bei der Einführung von neuen Produkten

• Konzeption von Marketingmaterialien (z.B. Online- und Social Media Marketing, Präsentationen und Broschüren)

• Identifikation, Analyse und Zusammenfassung von wissenschaftlicher Literatur und Studienergebnissen

• Markt- und Potentialanalysen

Qualifikationen

Für Dein Praktikum im Produktmanagement und Marketing bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen und Kenntnisse mit:

• Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie Einsatzbereitschaft runden Dein Profil ab

Die Benefits

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 4 Monate

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

Die Bewerbung

Bitte bewirb Dich ausschließlich online und füge Deiner Bewerbung Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, Zeugniskopien sowie eine aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung in einem Dokument bei.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Solution Architecture Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead

As the Enterprise Architect - Solution Architecture Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead, you will be the principal orchestrator of our global Architecture Community. You will bridge the gap between high-level strategy and practical execution, ensuring our architectural practices are co-created with the very teams that bring them to life. Join us in transforming architecture into a dynamic catalyst for global delivery and innovation.

Description of the area
The Enterprise Architecture Foundations team acts as the backbone of the architecture function, focusing on Community, Ways of Working, and Enablement. We define Enterprise and Solution Architecture practices, oversee our integrated toolchain (including ArchiMEDES/SAP LeanIX, ITONICS, and our AI Architecture Co-Pilot), and build organizational capability through learning curriculums and the Tech University. Our goal is to connect architects across a federated organization, empowering them to design sustainable technology solutions through shared principles and active community engagement.

The Opportunity:

• Lead the continuous maturation of Solution Architecture practices to adapt to evolving business needs and agile delivery models.

• Drive the transition from static documentation to dynamic solution modeling by leveraging our ArchiMEDES platform.

• Design and host global engagement forums, workshops, and community events to foster knowledge sharing and collaboration.

• Serve as the principal facilitator for the Architecture Community, inspiring a shared sense of identity across our global network.

• Partner with federated delivery teams to co-create standards that reduce friction and accelerate high-quality product delivery.

• Collaborate with Tech University to develop learning curriculums and upskill the community on modern solution design.

• Own and evolve the Solution Architect Onboarding Kit to ensure a seamless entry for new joiners into our culture and tools.

• Champion a data-driven approach to architecture, promoting the use of integrated toolchains to support transparent decision-making.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with professional background in solution or enterprise architecture within complex organizations.

• You possess applied experience as a Solution Architect, demonstrating a deep understanding of the practical realities of technology delivery.

• You offer comprehensive expertise in solution architecture methodologies and modern digital platforms like Cloud, Data, and AI.

• You are proficient with architecture modeling platforms (e.g., SAP LeanIX) and can translate enterprise principles into actionable designs.

• You have a proven track record in cultivating, motivating, and facilitating vibrant and active communities of practice.

• You demonstrate a co-creation mindset, viewing practice development as a shared journey rather than a top-down mandate.

• You are a master of influencing and storytelling, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders through empathy and clear communication.

What you get:

• Salary range 23 300 - 43 300 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subs

descriptionByLocale.it: Mansioni Soluzione Architettura Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead Descrizione del ruolo Come Enterprise Architect - Solution Architecture Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead, sarai il principale orchestratore della nostra comunità globale di architettura. Ponteggerai il potenziale tra la strategia di alto livello e l'esecuzione pratica, assicurandoti che le nostre pratiche di architettura siano co-create con i team che le rendono vive. Unisciti a noi per trasformare l'architettura in un catalizzatore dinamico per la consegna globale e l'innovazione. Descrizione dell'area Il team di Enterprise Architecture Foundations agiscono la spina dorsale della funzione di architettura, concentrandosi sulla Comunità, i Modi di Lavorare e l'Enablement. Definiamo le pratiche di Enterprise e Solution Architecture, sovrintendiamo alla nostra catena di strumenti integrati (compresi ArchiMEDES/SAP LeanIX, ITONICS e il nostro AI Architecture Co-Pilot) e costruiamo la capacità organizzativa attraverso i curricula di apprendimento e la Tech University. Il nostro obiettivo è connettere gli architetti in un'organizzazione federata, empowermentli a progettare soluzioni tecnologiche sostenibili attraverso principi condivisi e l'impegno della comunità. Opportunità - Guidare la maturazione continua delle pratiche di Solution Architecture per adattarsi alle esigenze aziendali in evoluzione e ai modelli di consegna agile. - Guidare la transizione dalla documentazione statica al modello di soluzione provvisoria utilizzando la nostra piattaforma ArchiMEDES. - Progettare e ospitare forum di impegno globale, workshop e eventi organizzati per favorire la condivisione delle conoscenze e la collaborazione. - Fare da facilitatore principale per la comunità di architettura, ispirando un senso di identità condiviso nella nostra rete globale. - Collaborare con i team di consegna federati per co-creare gli standard che servono gli attriti e accelerano la consegna dei prodotti di alta qualità. - Collaborare con la Tech University per sviluppare i curricula di apprendimento e aggiornare la comunità sulle moderne progettazioni di soluzione. - Possedere e evolvere il Kit di Onboarding del Solution Architect per garantire un ingresso fluido per i nuovi arrivati nella nostra cultura e negli strumenti. - Promuovere un approccio basato sui dati all'architettura, promuovendo l'uso delle catene di strumenti si integrano per supportare le decisioni trasparenti. Chi sei? - Hai un Bachelor's o Master's Degree con un'esperienza professionale in soluzione o enterprise architecture all'interno di organizzazioni complesse. - Offri un'esperienza applicata come Solution Architect, dimostrando una profonda comprensione delle realtà pratiche della consegna tecnologica. - Offri un'esperienza completa nelle metodologie di soluzione architecture e nelle piattaforme digitali moderne come Cloud, Data e AI. - Sei esperto nelle piattaforme di modellazione dell'architettura (ad esempio SAP LeanIX) e puoi tradurre i principi aziendali in pianificazione azionabili. - Hai un'esperienza comprovata nella coltivazione, motivazione e facilitazione di comunità di pratica attive e vivaci. - Dimostri un mindset di co-creazione, vedendo lo sviluppo delle pratiche come un viaggio condiviso piuttosto che un mandato dall'alto. - Sei un maestro dell'influenza e della narrazione, con la capacità di discernere i senior stakeholder attraverso l'empatia e la comunicazione chiara. Cosa? - Gamma salariale 23 300 - 43 300 PLN lordi basati sul contratto di lavoro. - Bonus annuale basato sulla tua performance. - Budget di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati, ecc.). - Venerdì di ricarica (2 venerdì liberi per trimestre disponibili). - Programma di congedo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Congedo vacanza

• You are a master of influencing and storytelling, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders through empathy and clear communication. What you get:
• Salary range 23 300 - 43 300 PLN gross based on the employment contract.
• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.
• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).
• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).
• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).
• Vacation subs

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Core Lab&POC
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Your key responsibilities
1. Define and execute clinical chemistry and related product marketing plans and perform daily product management tasks.

• Develop and execute product marketing plans and plan of actions

• Develop product key message and sales tools such as brochure, master presentations, advertising films and gimmicks

• Prepare new product launch and manage the product lifecycle from phase in to phase out.

• Price management: distributor prices and delivery prices

• Stock management such as forecast, ordering and allocation during bottleneck

• Manage all regulatory and reimbursement tasks involved during phase in and out

• Support quality issues with S&S and QA

• Monitor and analyze sales performance monthly and yearly

• Coordinate and conduct congress, product seminars and conferences

• Update marketing activities reports regularly

2. Gather market insights through regular customer visits, competitor and market trends monitoring and incorporate these insights into product strategy.

• Conduct market survey

• Gather information about competitors' activities and price strategies to set up counter-proposals

• Visit KOLs and major customers regularly: workshop, product presentation, proposals etc.

3, Align and collaborate with all stakeholders within/outside RDK

• Coordinate training for sales, distributors and all relevant stakeholders

• Cooperate with sales, S&S, SCM, Q&R & MA, DMS, finance etc. regularly

• Liaise with regional and global colleague

• Cooperation with distributors and other business partners.

4. Conduct business in full compliance.

• 100% completion on compliance training

• Well know about updated regulation and compliance information and share to my team

• Meet compliance for all external activities

Who you are

Bachelor Degree in Health/Science disciplines
At least 3 years’ experience as commercial roles(sales or marketing) in healthcare industry
Proficiency in both spoken and written English
Good command of MS office software application and google document, slides, sheet

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Digital Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Digital Sales Specialist

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity

Come join the Roche Digital Solutions sales organization as a Digital Central Lab Consultant where you will be responsible for selling the Roche navify digital portfolio to IHN, hospital, and reference laboratory customers. This field-based position requires consultative sales experience and expertise in lab workflow, IT infrastructure, data flow, informatics, laboratory medicine, laboratory operations, digital applications (i.e. middleware, business intelligence tools, etc.), and Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) to effectively consult with clinical laboratory stakeholders on customized Roche digital solutions and provide strategic recommendations on digital processes. This position engages early in the sales cycle to understand customer needs, deliver customized demos, and design customized digital solutions in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Roche’s and customers’ teams.

Responsibilities

• Generates new customer demand across the full portfolio of Core Lab and Molecular navify products (middleware, connectivity, informatics, apps, etc).

• Engage in strategic digital discussions with key customer buying influences, from technical end users to executive level decision makers.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across sales and implementation teams to define and align on total solution sales strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.

• Conduct laboratory process analysis, develop solution proposal presentations, and deliver recommendations to customers in close alignment with internal stakeholders.

• Deliver software demos and tailored technical presentations to internal and external audiences.

• Adept at translating customer needs into internal action to meet those needs while balancing key business priorities and goals.

• Strong clinical and financial acumen with a demonstrated ability to understand and translate customer needs to effectively position the value of Roche digital solutions.

• Effectively qualify leads and utilize outcomes from workflow analysis and impact studies to provide competitive differentiation and value to the overall customer solution.

• Provides in-depth technical expertise regarding assigned product lines.

• Work cross functionally with internal stakeholders to share information and best practices while remaining actively informed on industry/customer trends that impact business.

• Follow a standardized end-to-end approach that creates evidence-based, differentiated value for the solution portfolio, both inside and outside the walls of the laboratory.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (i.e. Information Technology, Medical Technology, Life Sciences) or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years relevant or equivalent experience (i.e. healthcare digital solutions sales, laboratory diagnostics sales)

• Must be autonomous and organized with effective communication, negotiation, and problem solving skills

• Familiarity with digital solutions, laboratory middleware solutions and hospital LIS systems

• Experience with presenting technical information to large external and internal audiences

Preferred Qualifications

• Preferred experience in the chem

descriptionByLocale.it: Mansioni Specialista di vendita digitale Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Specialista di vendita digitale Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità Unisciti all'organizzazione di vendita Roche Digital Solutions come Digital Central Lab Consultant dove sarai responsabile della vendita del portafoglio digitale Roche Navify ai clienti di IHN, ospedale e laboratorio di riferimento. Questa posizione basata sul campo richiede esperienza di vendita consultiva e competenza nel flusso di lavoro di laboratorio, infrastrutture IT, flusso di dati, informatica, medicina di laboratorio, operazioni di laboratorio, applicazioni digitali (cioè middleware, strumenti di business intelligence, ecc.), e Sistemi Informativi di laboratorio (LIS) per consultare efficacemente gli stakeholder di laboratorio clinici sulle soluzioni digitali Roche personalizzate e fornire raccomandazioni strategiche sui processi digitali. Questa posizione si impegna presto nel ciclo di vendita per comprendere le esigenze dei clienti, fornire demo personalizzati e progettare soluzioni digitali personalizzate in collaborazione con gli stakeholder interfunzionali tra i team di Roche e i clienti. Responsabilità - Genera la nuova domanda del cliente attraverso il portafoglio completo dei prodotti Core Lab e Molecular Navify (middleware, connettività, informatica, applicazioni, ecc). - Impegnarsi nelle discussioni strategiche digitali con influenze chiave di acquisto dei clienti, dagli utenti finali tecnici ai decisori di livello esecutivo. - Collabora con gli stakeholder interni tra i team di vendita e implementazione per definire e allineare le strategie di vendita di soluzioni totali per soddisfare e superare costantemente gli obiettivi di vendita. - Condurre analisi di processo di laboratorio, sviluppare presentazioni di proposte di soluzione e fornire raccomandazioni ai clienti in stretta allineamento con gli stakeholder interni. - Fornire demo software e presentazioni tecniche su misura per il pubblico interno ed esterno. - Adept per tradurre le esigenze del cliente in azione interna per soddisfare tali esigenze, mentre bilanciare le priorità e gli obiettivi aziendali chiave. - Forte acume clinico e finanziario con una capacità dimostrata di comprendere e tradurre le esigenze del cliente per posizionare efficacemente il valore delle soluzioni digitali Roche. - Efficacemente qualificare i cavi e utilizzare i risultati dell'analisi del flusso di lavoro e gli studi di impatto per fornire differenziazione e valore competitivi alla soluzione globale del cliente. - Fornisce competenze tecniche approfondite per quanto riguarda le linee di prodotto assegnate. - Il lavoro intercorre in modo funzionale con gli stakeholder interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche, pur rimanendo attivamente informati sulle tendenze del settore/cliente che influiscono sul business. - Seguire un approccio end-to-end standardizzato che crea valori differenziati e basati su prove per il portafoglio soluzioni, sia all'interno che all'esterno delle pareti del laboratorio. Chi sei? - Corso di laurea in un campo relativo (ossia tecnologia dell'informazione, tecnologia medica, scienze della vita) o esperienza equivalente. - 5+ anni di esperienza rilevante o equivalente (ad es. vendite di soluzioni digitali sanitarie, vendita di diagnostica di laboratorio) - Deve essere autonomo e organizzato con efficaci capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e problem solving - Familiarità con soluzioni digitali, soluzioni di middleware di laboratorio e sistemi LIS ospedalieri - Esperienza con la presentazione di informazioni tecniche a grandi pubblico esterno e interno Qualifiche Preferite - Esperienza preferenziale nella chem

descriptionByLocale.de: Mansion Digital Sales Spezialist Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Digital Sales Spezialist Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Die Chance Kommen Sie als Digital Central Lab Consultant bei der Roche Digital Solutions-Verkaufsorganisation, wo Sie für den Verkauf des digitalen Portfolios von Roche an IHN, Krankenhaus und Referenzlaborkunden verantwortlich sind. Diese feldbasierte Position erfordert konsultierende Vertriebserfahrung und Expertise im Labor-Workflow, IT-Infrastruktur, Datenfluss, Informatik, Labormedizin, Labor-Operationen, Digital-Anwendungen (d.h. Middleware, Business Intelligence Tools, etc.) und Laborinformationssysteme (LIS), um effektiv mit klinischen Labor-Stakeholdern auf maßgeschneiderte Roche-digitale Lösungen zu konsultieren und strategische Empfehlungen zu digitalen Prozessen bereitzustellen. Diese Position beschäftigt sich früh im Verkaufszyklus, um Kundenbedürfnisse zu verstehen, maßgeschneiderte Demos zu liefern und maßgeschneiderte digitale Lösungen in Partnerschaft mit funktionsübergreifenden Interessenvertretern in den Teams von Roche und Kunden zu entwickeln. In den Warenkorb - Erstellt neue Kundennachfrage im gesamten Portfolio von Core Lab und Molecular navify Produkten (Middleware, Konnektivität, Informatik, Apps, etc.). - Engagieren Sie in strategischen digitalen Diskussionen mit wichtigen Kundenkaufeinflüssen, von technischen Endnutzern bis hin zu Führungskräften. - Mit internen Stakeholdern über Vertriebs- und Implementierungsteams zusammenarbeiten, um die Gesamtlösungsverkaufsstrategien zu definieren und auszurichten, um die Vertriebsziele konsequent zu erreichen und zu übertreffen. - Durchführung von Laborprozessanalysen, Entwicklung von Lösungsvorschlägen und Empfehlungen an Kunden in enger Abstimmung mit internen Interessenvertretern. - Liefern Sie Software-Demos und maßgeschneiderte technische Präsentationen auf interne und externe Publikum. - Adept bei der Umsetzung von Kundenbedürfnissen in interne Maßnahmen, um diese Bedürfnisse zu erfüllen, während die wichtigsten Geschäftsprioritäten und Ziele ausgleichen. - Starker klinischer und finanzieller Aufwand mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, den Kunden zu verstehen und zu übersetzen, muss den Wert von Roche Digitallösungen effektiv positionieren. - Effektiv qualifizieren Leads und nutzen Ergebnisse von Workflow-Analysen und Folgenstudien, um wettbewerbsfähige Differenzierung und Wert für die gesamte Kundenlösung zu bieten. - Bietet fundiertes technisches Know-how in Bezug auf zugeordnete Produktlinien. - Arbeiten Sie funktionell mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um Informationen und bewährte Praktiken zu teilen und weiterhin aktiv über Trends in der Industrie/Kunden zu informieren, die das Geschäft beeinflussen. - Folgen Sie einem standardisierten End-to-End-Ansatz, der einen evidenzbasierten, differenzierten Wert für das Lösungsportfolio schafft, sowohl innerhalb als auch außerhalb der Laborwände. Chi Sei - Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich (d.h. Informationstechnologie, Medizintechnik, Life Sciences) oder gleichwertige Erfahrung. - 5+ Jahre relevante oder gleichwertige Erfahrung (d.h. Vertrieb von digitalen Gesundheitslösungen, Vertrieb von Labordiagnostik) - Muss autonom und mit effektiver Kommunikation, Verhandlungen und Problemlösung Fähigkeiten organisiert werden - Vertrautheit mit digitalen Lösungen, Labor Middleware-Lösungen und Krankenhaus LIS-Systemen - Erfahrung mit der Präsentation technischer Informationen für große externe und interne Publikum Qualifiche Präferenz - Bevorzugte Erfahrung im Chem
descriptionByLocale.fr: Mansioni Spécialiste des ventes numériques Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Spécialiste des ventes numériques Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. L'opportunité Venez rejoindre l'organisation de vente de Roche Digital Solutions en tant que consultant de Digital Central Lab où vous serez responsable de la vente du portefeuille numérique de Roche navify à des clients IHN, hôpital et laboratoire de référence. Ce poste sur le terrain exige de l'expérience et de l'expertise en matière de ventes consultatives dans les domaines suivants : flux de travail en laboratoire, infrastructure informatique, flux de données, informatique, médecine de laboratoire, opérations de laboratoire, applications numériques (c.-à-d. intergiciels, outils d'intelligence d'affaires, etc.) et systèmes d'information de laboratoire (SIL) afin de consulter efficacement les intervenants des laboratoires cliniques sur les solutions numériques Roche personnalisées et de formuler des recommandations stratégiques sur les processus numériques. Cette position s'engage dès le début du cycle de vente pour comprendre les besoins des clients, fournir des démos personnalisées et concevoir des solutions numériques personnalisées en partenariat avec des intervenants interfonctionnels dans les équipes de Roche et de clients. Responsabilité - Génére une nouvelle demande cliente dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits Core Lab et Molecular navify (milieux, connectivité, informatique, applications, etc.). - S'engager dans des discussions numériques stratégiques avec des influences clés sur l'achat des clients, des utilisateurs techniques aux décideurs de niveau exécutif. - Collaborer avec les intervenants internes des équipes de vente et de mise en oeuvre afin de définir et d'aligner les stratégies de vente de solutions totales pour atteindre et dépasser systématiquement les objectifs de vente. - Effectuer des analyses de processus en laboratoire, élaborer des propositions de solutions et présenter des recommandations aux clients en étroite harmonie avec les intervenants internes. - Fournir des démos logicielles et des présentations techniques adaptées aux publics internes et externes. - Aider à traduire les besoins des clients en actions internes pour répondre à ces besoins tout en conciliant les priorités et les objectifs opérationnels clés. - Forte concentration clinique et financière avec une capacité démontrée de comprendre et de traduire les besoins des clients pour positionner efficacement la valeur des solutions numériques Roche. - Qualifier efficacement les pistes et utiliser les résultats de l'analyse de flux de travail et des études d'impact pour fournir une différenciation concurrentielle et de la valeur à la solution globale du client. - Fournit une expertise technique approfondie concernant les gammes de produits attribuées. - Travailler de concert avec les intervenants internes pour partager l'information et les pratiques exemplaires tout en restant activement informé des tendances de l'industrie et des clients qui ont une incidence sur les entreprises. - Suivre une approche standard de bout en bout qui crée une valeur factuelle différenciée pour le portefeuille de solutions, tant à l'intérieur qu'à l'extérieur des murs du laboratoire. Chi Sei - Baccalauréat Diplôme dans un domaine connexe (p. ex. technologie de l'information, technologie médicale, sciences de la vie) ou expérience équivalente. - 5 ans d'expérience pertinente ou équivalente (vente de solutions numériques de soins de santé, ventes de diagnostics de laboratoire) - Doit être autonome et organisé avec des compétences de communication, de négociation et de résolution de problèmes efficaces - Familiarité avec les solutions numériques, les solutions intermédiaires de laboratoire et les systèmes LIS hospitaliers - Expérience de la présentation de l'information technique à un large public externe et interne Qualifiche Preferite - Expérience préférée dans la chimie

The Opportunity

Work shift: M-F 2:00pm - 10:30pm

The Facilities Technician II at GenMark Diagnostics, A Member of the Roche Group, is responsible for the overall maintenance, upkeep, and cleanliness of the designated facility, preventative or otherwise. In this position, you are

• Preventative Maintenance & Operations – Perform routine maintenance on HVAC and central plant equipment, conduct daily facility tours, monitor all rooftop and building systems, and make necessary operational adjustments
• Work Request Management & Response – Handle internal customer facility work requests, respond to alarm system alerts 24/7, investigate and document process alarms, and provide on-call coverage
• Equipment & Inventory Support – Maintain spare parts inventory, manage repair parts for work requests, conduct maintenance on specialized systems (water purification, heating/cooling, humidity control, building controls), and support validation protocols
• Quality & Compliance – Ensure all duties comply with ISO, FDA, and regulatory requirements; demonstrate awareness of quality consequences and potential device defects; support Quality Management System implementation
• Coordination & Professional Development – Coordinate contractor/vendor site escorts and training, support cross-functional staff training, collaborate with technicians on daily tasks, and maintain professionalism with internal and external stakeholders

Who you are

• You possess a High School Diploma, or Technical Education with 2 to 4 years of maintenance experience preferably in Biotech, cGMP, medical or health related environment or equivalent.

• You must be available to work any shift and be “on call” via pager and/or cell phone.

• You possess a clean & valid CA driver’s license

Behaviors, Competencies, and Qualities of the ideal applicant.

• Proficiency with power tools and machine shop equipment, knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration systems, and plumbing; ability to read schematics and drawings.

• Experience in high-paced manufacturing environments, routine building and grounds maintenance, and familiarity with welding and precision tools (drill press, hand tools).

• Excellent understanding and application of safety procedures; knowledge of federal regulations including QSR, ISO, and ISO 13485 standards; CMDR familiarity preferred.

• Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work independently; basic computer skills (MS Word, Excel, Access, Google); excellent documentation and record-keeping abilities.

• Strong interpersonal, communication, and cooperation skills; ability to work effectively with diverse teams in regulated environments.

Work Environment
The essential functions of the job are usually performed in an environmentally controlled facility where the noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. This position may involve a combination of office and biotechnology laboratory environments. You may be exposed to hazardous chemicals, blood-borne, pathogens and automated equipment.

While performing the job duties, you are regularly required to sit; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. You are frequently required to stand and walk. You may sometimes be required to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

Relocation benefits are not offered for this job posting

The expected salary range for this position based on California is 53,800.00 - 99,800
