jobs.title: Business Excellence Chapter Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Chapitre sur l'excellence en affaires Chef de file

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
The chapter lead of business excellence serves as the core person for bridging high-level corporate strategy with on-the-ground commercial execution. The Chapter Lead translates the company's strategic vision into tangible commercial projects, manages the strategic initiatives, and ensures cross-functional alignment to deliver measurable business outcomes and drive sustainable revenue growth.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
I. Strategic Planning and development

• Strategy Formulation: Partner with senior leaders to support the annual and long-range company strategy planning process

• Strategic Roadmap: Translate approved corporate and commercial strategies into a defined, prioritized roadmap of projects and initiatives

• Business Case Development: Lead the development of robust business cases for strategic commercial investments, defining expected financial return (ROI), resource requirements, and measurable success criteria.

II. Project Management Office (PMO) Leadership

• Project Execution Oversight: Act as the lead or co-lead for high-priority, complex strategic projects, driving accountability, managing interdependencies, identifying risks, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Performance Reporting: Develop and maintain a comprehensive portfolio dashboard for executive leadership, providing clear, concise status updates on project health, key milestones, budget adherence, and projected impact realization.

III. Commercial Excellence Oversight
A. Channel & Distributor Management:

• Focus on maximizing revenue growth and profitability through the optimization of go-to-market channels and the professional management of distributors and business partners.

• Direct the design, implementation, and governance of sales incentive compensation (IC) plans for the direct sales force and partner reward programs.

• Ensure the implementation of a robust performance review framework and regular commercial compliance audit programs for distributors, reviewing anti-bribery, data privacy, and ethical selling practices.

B. Customer Experience & Operational Processes:

• Lead the function responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing seamless service journeys for clinicians and patients across the product lifecycle.

• Ensure the establishment, documentation, and socialization of robust Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all critical customer-facing and back-office processes, ensuring compliance and efficiency.

• Manage the governance model for external partners , defining and enforcing strict SLAs and KPIs for third-party vendors (e.g., tech support, specialty pharmacies).

C. Sales Analytics & Performance Management :

• Oversee the entire process of sales target setting and management (annual, quarterly, regional, individual).

• Direct the design and maintenance of optimal sales territory structures to maximize market coverage and ensure fair opportunity distribution.

• Drive the development and dissemination of actionable Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and dashboards for sales pipeline health and performance.

jobs.title: Country Medical Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Country Medical Director is a senior leader who easily navigates between science, data and business in service of our vision at Roche. You are an experienced professional with a solid scientific background. You are confident in playing a key role in developing the local medical strategy to enable future success of the organization and you have experience in transforming complex healthcare challenges into clear and compelling actions that benefit patients.

Building relationships and scientific partnerships with our stakeholders is your second nature. Considering the nature of Bosnia and Herzegovina healthcare system, the Medical Director will bring understanding of the operating environment (or comparable market) and its challenges. You come with a strong vision on evidence generation and data enabled healthcare. You are passionate about innovation and can envision how healthcare data and science can have a sustainable impact on the healthcare system.

As a member of the Roche Bosnia and Herzegovina Enabling/Leadership Team, you will be responsible for setting the strategic direction and achieving company objectives within the Affiliate and Medical Chapter, including strategic decision making and empowering teams. You will serve as a role model to the entire organization, lead the functional chapter, and focus on upskilling and coaching team members, while also co-creating organizational strategies and fostering agility and cultural change. Additionally, you will collaborate with other Country Medical Directors, Chapter Heads and Squad Leads to allocate resources and support professional development within the Network, Affiliate and Chapter.

Who are we looking for?

Beyond strong focus on external engagement, strategic partnerships, data and science you have the following responsibilities:

• Shape and develop the overall affiliate medical strategy based on external insights and Roche’s product portfolio developments

• Drive above-brand medical strategy and alignment

• Represents Roche medical authority with key external stakeholders

• As a member of the Enabling /Leadership Team, develop and implement the vision, mission and overarching strategy for Roche Bosnia and Herzegovina and ensure it adheres to the highest scientific and ethical standards and fulfills all regulatory and compliance requirements.

• Ensure excellence in scientific consulting with stakeholders, patient safety, quality, compliance, regulatory, evidence generation and medical information

• Establish and maintain local medical and scientific independence and assurance of medical compliance acting as the local delegate of authority of Roche`s Pharma CMO ensuring business integrity and company reputation.

• Drive early health data gap identification, prioritization and integrated evidence planning inclusion by being actively involved and by collaborating with strong medical enablers

• Bring clinical practice perspective and act as a sparring partner to decide how (and which) data should be used / generated to build the medical narrative in the respective disease areas

• Work closely with local, cross-country and global compliance networks, strong cross-functional partnership with other affiliate (and network) functions and actively engage with Roche global functions and group members.

• Being a servant leader to the entire affiliate and network acting with courage and integrity. Role model creative leadership and network mindset supporting transparency across the organization.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• This role is for a temporary one-year contract with the possibility of extension.
• The successful candidate will be employed by a third-party agency on behalf of Roche.

Hlavním cílem a úkolem této pozice je zajišťovat servisní podporu zákazníkům v rámci České republiky ,převážně v regionu Čechy (instalace, pravidelnou údržbu, opravy, softwarové modifikace) analyzátorů a systémů Roche řady cobas, umístěných v laboratořích nemocnic a komerčních laboratoří. Budete úzce spolupracovat s ostatními odděleními Roche Diagnostics při přípravě a implementacích komplexních projektů laboratorních řešení. Preferované bydliště Praha/Střední Čechy

Hlavní odpovědnosti
• ● Provozovat rutinní servisní podporu na analytických přístrojích Roche v úzké spolupráci s centrem zákaznické podpory a dalšími týmy Professional Services.
• To zahrnuje:
• o Instalace přístrojů v laboratořích nemocnic a komerčních laboratoří
• o Provádění periodické údržby přístrojů - opravovat přístroje na základě požadavků zákazníků
• o Provádění výrobcem předepsané modifikace přístrojů
• o Poslední fází veškerých servisních služeb je konečná zkouška příslušného analyzátoru a potvrzení jeho plné funkčnosti.
• ● Provádět příslušnou dokumentaci v digitální formě (dokumentace servisních aktivit, reportování v globálním CRM systému)
• ● Sledovat servisní bulletiny za účelem zajištění co nejlepší přípravy na servisní proces a zajištění kvalitních služeb
• ● Samostatně si plánovat aktivity, zajišťovat objednávky potřebných náhradních dílů ve spolupráci se servisním zázemím
• ● Dodržovat všechny zákonné normy a interní pravidla společnosti
• Vhodný/á kandidát/ka:
• ● Absolvent/ka vysoké školy technického směru (zaměření na elektroniku nebo IT)
• ● Absolvent/ka střední školy se zaměřením na elektroniku a 3 roky praxe v oblasti zdravotnických přístrojů atp.
• ● Zvládání anglického jazyka na úrovni potřebné pro studium technické dokumentace a absolvování školení v anglickém jazyce
• ● Schopnost plánování a provádění samostatné práce u zákazníků v laboratořích a ochota přizpůsobit se časově
• ● Ochota cestování v rámci regionu
• ● Schopnost týmové spolupráce v rámci oddělení Professional Services a spolupráce s kolegy/němi z jiných oddělení
• ● Řidičský průkaz kat.B podmínkou
• ● Kvalifikační stupeň osoby pro samostatnou činnost dle NV 194/2022 Sb.(dříve §6 vyhl.50)
• ● Prozákaznický přístup, schopnost porozumět potřebám zákazníkům a být jim partnerem
• ● Předchozí pracovní zkušenost v oblasti technické podpory zdravotnických přístrojů je výhodou, ale není podmínkou

jobs.title: Field Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Field Engineering Specialist

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity

The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel and demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and/or installation specialist for Roche assigned product lines and provide valued service to your laboratory customers in an assigned territory. This position serves as a technical repair or installation specialist for Roche products for assigned product lines and geographies.

• Provides routine technical support to customers on operational and maintenance aspects of system equipment.

• Performs on-site service, repair and/or installation of company product(s). This may include any aspect of field support and is not limited to mechanical/system hardware and software, networking/wireless networking.

• Serves as customer contact on routine technical and service-related problems. Receives training and delivers service within the normal scope of the position. Follows documented practices, policies and procedures in providing repair and installation support.

• Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures. Determines the most cost-effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime.

• Provides analysis, feedback and recommendations on product failure trends and serviceability issues. Documents all activity in a manner compliant with the company's quality procedures. Specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system or equipment. Requires specific training and certification.

• Applies some advanced skills to the position or specialization. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks.

• Resolves most questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

This is a field-based role that requires daily travel and up to 25% overnight travel. Our ideal candidate would reside in Connecticut.

Who You Are

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.
• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.
• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

jobs.title: Commissioning & Qualification Manager (m/f/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de la mise en service et des qualifications (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global Engineering executes projects in Pharma Technical Operations (PT), and other divisions within Roche on demand. Within Global Engineering, the Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Manager has overall responsibility for the compliant, in time and in budget delivery of Commissioning & Qualification deliverables. The Commissioning & Qualification Manager reports to the PTT Regional Head of C&Q. Work is self-directed in nature. Projects / initiatives can vary in both length of time and complexity, requiring extensive cross-functional collaboration and agile execution strategies in support of GMP manufacturing operations, affiliates and CMOs. The position requires excellent internal and external collaboration and influencing skills and the ability to lead diverse, cross-functional teams.

Are you ready to lead large-scale engineering projects that deliver life-saving medicines to patients worldwide? Join our Global Engineering team and take overall responsibility for the compliant and timely delivery of Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) for our pharmaceutical technical operations

The Opportunity
As a C&Q Manager, you will act as a Sub-Project Manager within Global Engineering, driving excellence in a dynamic and collaborative team environment.
You will:

• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Motivate and inspire diverse teams during the C&Q phase, setting clear expectations and fostering a "one team" culture.

• Drive Project Success: Manage C&Q project scope to ensure deliverables are met within the approved budget and schedule.

• Ensure Global Compliance: Execute all deliverables in full alignment with the Roche Pharmaceutical Quality Management System (PQS) and international regulatory standards.

• Innovate and Challenge: Identify better ways to accomplish objectives by introducing best practices and innovation for C&Q Capex project management.

• Partner Strategically: Proactively build trustful relationships with key stakeholders and customers to support Roche’s strategic business goals.

Who you are

You bring:

• A University Degree in Engineering, Science, or a related discipline.

• Bachelor with 6-8 years experience, Master with 5-7 years experience in the (bio)pharmaceutical industry, specifically in sterile drug product manufacturing or qualification.

• You have gained particular experience in leading a drug product sterile filling facility commissioning and qualification, leading the commissioning and qualification of packaging and autoinjector assembly, as well as in the commissioning and qualification of cleanroom systems.

• Deep knowledge of C&Q strategies (ASTM E2500), risk-based approaches, and global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH).

• Proficient in both German and English (written and spoken) with the ability to adjust your style to various audiences.

• Travel (20%) may be required to meet the business need, in order to lead the team at the project site/location. Expectation if assigned to a specific project during design or construction it is required to spend most of the time on site.

This is a 100% full time role and locally based in potential future EU sites and / or Mannheim / Penzberg.

Application documents - very pragmatic:
We ask you for a current CV in English and your official (educational) certificates/credentials. Further documents are not mandatory at the moment. Please note before sending your application that no further documents can be added afterwards.
Apply now - we are looking forward to it!

Your contact to us! Wit

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Global Engineering realizza progetti in Pharma Technical Operations (PT), e altre divisioni all'interno di Roche su richiesta. All'interno di Global Engineering, il Manager di Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) ha la responsabilità generale per la conformità, nel tempo e nella consegna di bilancio dei consegnabili Commissioning & Qualification. Il Commissioning & Qualification Manager riporta al PTT Regional Head of C&Q. Il lavoro è autodiretto in natura. Progetti / iniziative possono variare sia in termini di durata che di complessità, richiedendo ampie strategie di collaborazione interfunzionale e di esecuzione agile a supporto delle operazioni di produzione GMP, affiliati e CMO. La posizione richiede un'eccellente collaborazione interna ed esterna e influenza le competenze e la capacità di guidare squadre diverse e interfunzionali. Siete pronti a condurre progetti di ingegneria su larga scala che forniscono farmaci salvavita ai pazienti in tutto il mondo? Unisciti al nostro team di Global Engineering e assumi la responsabilità generale per la fornitura conforme e tempestiva di Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) per le nostre operazioni tecniche farmaceutiche L'opportunità Come C&Q Manager, agirai come Sub-Project Manager all'interno di Global Engineering, guidando l'eccellenza in un ambiente di team dinamico e collaborativo. Lo farai:
• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Motivate e ispira diverse squadre durante la fase C&Q, ponendo chiare aspettative e promuovendo una cultura "una squadra".
• Drive Project Success: Gestisci lo scopo del progetto C&Q per garantire che i responsabili siano soddisfatti all'interno del budget approvato e del calendario.
• Assicurare il Compliance Globale: Eseguire tutti i prodotti in pieno allineamento con il sistema di gestione della qualità farmaceutica Roche (PQS) e gli standard normativi internazionali.
• Innovare e sfida: Identificare modi migliori per raggiungere gli obiettivi introducendo best practice e innovazione per la gestione dei progetti C&Q Capex.
• Partner Strategicamente: Proattivamente costruire relazioni fiduciose con i principali stakeholder e clienti per sostenere gli obiettivi strategici di Roche. Chi sei Tu porti:
• Una laurea in Ingegneria, Scienza o una disciplina relativa.
• Corso di laurea con 6-8 anni di esperienza, Master con 5-7 anni di esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica (bio), in particolare nella produzione o nella qualificazione di prodotti di droga sterili.
• Hai acquisito una particolare esperienza nella guida di un impianto di riempimento sterile del prodotto di droga che commissiona e qualifica, conducendo la messa in servizio e la qualificazione di imballaggio e assemblaggio di autoiniettori, così come nella messa in servizio e nella qualificazione dei sistemi di cleanroom.
• Conoscenza profonda delle strategie C&Q (ASTM E2500), approcci basati sui rischi e normative globali (FDA, EMA, ICH).
• Proficiente sia in tedesco che in inglese (scritto e parlato) con la capacità di regolare il vostro stile a vari pubblico.
• Il viaggio (20%) può essere richiesto per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali, al fine di guidare il team presso il sito/location del progetto. L'aspettativa se assegnata a un progetto specifico durante la progettazione o la costruzione è tenuto a trascorrere la maggior parte del tempo in loco. Questo è un ruolo a tempo pieno al 100% e localmente basato in potenziali futuri siti UE e / o Mannheim / Penzberg. Documenti di applicazione - molto pragmatico: Vi chiediamo un CV corrente in inglese e i vostri certificati/credential ufficiali (educativi). Ulteriori documenti non sono obbligatori al momento. Si prega di notare prima di inviare la domanda che nessun ulteriore documento può essere aggiunto in seguito. Applica ora - non vediamo l'ora! Il tuo contatto con noi! Wit

Au sein de Global Engineering, le gestionnaire de la mise en service et de la qualification (C&Q) assume la responsabilité globale de la conformité, à temps et dans l'exécution du budget des produits livrables de la mise en service et de la qualification. Les projets et les initiatives peuvent varier en fonction du temps et de la complexité, ce qui exige une collaboration interfonctionnelle étendue et des stratégies d'exécution agiles à l'appui des activités de fabrication des BPF, des filiales et des OCM. • Baccalauréat avec 6-8 ans d'expérience, Master avec 5-7 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie (bio)pharmaceutique, en particulier dans la fabrication ou la qualification stérile de produits pharmaceutiques.
• Vous avez acquis une expérience particulière dans la conduite d'une installation de remplissage stérile de produits pharmaceutiques, la mise en service et la qualification de l'emballage et de l'assemblage d'autoinjecteurs, ainsi que dans la mise en service et la qualification des systèmes de salle blanche.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche .

At Roche Diagnostics, we are driven by our vision: innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare, and changing lives. We are excited to see this vision come to life.

The opportunity
Join our team as the Global Strategic Pricing leader in the Diagnostics Global Access & Policy (GA&P) team. You'll play a vital role in developing strategic global pricing guidance for our products and solutions, collaborating closely with global, regional, and local teams to optimize revenues and ensure sustainable access. Be part of shaping our global pricing strategy and policy for a brighter future.
Your impact:

• Lead the design and implementation of global value-based pricing strategies for prioritized pipeline and on-market products, utilizing analytics to assess elasticity, forecast trends, and manage profitability.

• Co-lead the roll-out of pricing strategies, including innovative pricing and contracting solutions, in collaboration with access and commercial stakeholders to drive market access and profitability.

• Act as the main responsible for exception management, providing clear guidance and supporting affiliates with local strategy development to address access barriers.

• Be the key responsible for price monitoring and insights generation using internal databases (e.g., DIAprice, sCORE), delivering actionable insights to affiliates, regions, and IBTs.

• Establish and lead pricing committee meetings, issue price memos, and drive pricing governance, including the maintenance and monitoring of pricing policies, controls, and KPIs (e.g., floor price).

• Conduct and leverage primary and secondary payer, reimbursement, and pricing research to inform global strategy and provide consolidated pricing and reimbursement advice to relevant product teams.

• Partner cross-functionally to inform IBTs and their Product Managers on recommended price setting, ensuring adherence to relevant governance processes.

Who You Are

• Minimum 8-10 years of professional experience with recognized expertise in pricing and reimbursement, preferably in the diagnostics, medical device, or pharmaceutical industry. Affiliate and/or regional experience is a plus.

• Possess a Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field such as business, finance, economics, health economics, life sciences, or public health. An MBA or other Graduate/higher-level Degree is beneficial.

• Deep financial and commercial understanding with in-depth knowledge of the global reimbursement environment, competitive intelligence, and market segmentation for effective global price setting.

• Demonstrated Strategic & Analytical Acumen with strong influencing, negotiation, and Agile leadership skills to excel in a global matrix organization and lead diverse multicultural teams.

• Committed to permanently optimizing processes to increase quality and efficiency standards and implement pricing competence and awareness across the organization through training and support.

Essential Skills

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche . A Roche Diagnostics, siamo guidati dalla nostra visione: innovare la diagnostica, plasmare la salute e cambiare la vita. Siamo entusiasti di vedere questa visione nascere. L'opportunità Unisciti al nostro team come leader Global Strategic Pricing nel team Diagnostics Global Access & Policy (GA&P). Potrai svolgere un ruolo vitale nello sviluppo di una guida strategica globale dei prezzi per i nostri prodotti e le nostre soluzioni, collaborando a stretto contatto con i team globali, regionali e locali per ottimizzare i ricavi e garantire un accesso sostenibile. Essere parte di modellare la nostra strategia globale dei prezzi e la politica per un futuro più luminoso. Il tuo impatto:
• Guidare la progettazione e l'implementazione di strategie globali di prezzi basati sul valore per le pipeline prioritarie e i prodotti on-market, utilizzando analisi per valutare l'elasticità, le tendenze di previsione e gestire la redditività.
• Co-promuovere il roll-out delle strategie di pricing, comprese le soluzioni innovative di pricing e contracting, in collaborazione con gli stakeholder di accesso e commerciali per guidare l'accesso al mercato e la redditività.
• Agire come principale responsabile della gestione delle eccezioni, fornire una chiara guida e sostenere gli affiliati con lo sviluppo di strategia locale per affrontare le barriere di accesso.
• Essere la chiave responsabile per il monitoraggio dei prezzi e la generazione di insight utilizzando database interni (ad esempio, DIAprice, sCORE), fornendo informazioni attuabili a affiliati, regioni e IBT.
• Stabilire e condurre riunioni dei comitati di prezzi, emettere i memo dei prezzi, e guidare la governance dei prezzi, compreso il mantenimento e il monitoraggio delle politiche dei prezzi, dei controlli e dei KPI (ad esempio, prezzo del pavimento).
• Condurre e sfruttare il payer primario e secondario, il rimborso e la ricerca sui prezzi per informare la strategia globale e fornire consulenza consolidata sui prezzi e sui rimborsi ai rispettivi team di prodotto.
• Partner interfunzionalmente per informare gli IBT e i loro Product Manager sull'impostazione dei prezzi consigliati, garantendo l'adesione ai processi di governance rilevanti. Chi sei
• Minimo 8-10 anni di esperienza professionale con competenze riconosciute nei prezzi e nel rimborso, preferibilmente nella diagnostica, dispositivo medico, o industria farmaceutica. Affiliazione e/o esperienza regionale è un plus.
• Possedere una laurea in un campo rilevante come affari, finanza, economia, economia sanitaria, scienze della vita, o la salute pubblica. Un MBA o un altro laureato / diploma di livello superiore è vantaggioso.
• Profonda comprensione finanziaria e commerciale con una conoscenza approfondita dell'ambiente di rimborso globale, dell'intelligenza competitiva e della segmentazione di mercato per un'efficace impostazione dei prezzi globale.
• Acumen Strategico e Analitico Dimostrato con forti influenze, negoziazioni e capacità di leadership Agile per eccellere in un'organizzazione di matrice globale e condurre diverse squadre multiculturali.
• Impegnati a ottimizzare in modo permanente i processi per aumentare gli standard di qualità ed efficienza e implementare le competenze e la consapevolezza dei prezzi in tutta l'organizzazione attraverso la formazione e il supporto. Abilità essenziali
• Acumen strategico e analitico: deve essere in grado di progettare e implementare strategie di prezzi basate sul valore globale, utilizzando analisi per valutare l'elasticità, le tendenze delle previsioni e gestire la redditività. La profonda comprensione finanziaria e commerciale è critica.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche . At Roche Diagnostics, we are driven by our vision: innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare, and changing lives. We are excited to see this vision come to life. The opportunity Join our team as the Global Strategic Pricing leader in the Diagnostics Global Access & Policy (GA&P) team. You'll play a vital role in developing strategic global pricing guidance for our products and solutions, collaborating closely with global, regional, and local teams to optimize revenues and ensure sustainable access. Be part of shaping our global pricing strategy and policy for a brighter future. Your impact:
• Lead the design and implementation of global value-based pricing strategies for prioritized pipeline and on-market products, utilizing analytics to assess elasticity, forecast trends, and manage profitability.
• Co-lead the roll-out of pricing strategies, including innovative pricing and contracting solutions, in collaboration with access and commercial stakeholders to drive market access and profitability.
• Act as the main responsible for exception management, providing clear guidance and supporting affiliates with local strategy development to address access barriers.
• Be the key responsible for price monitoring and insights generation using internal databases (e.g., DIAprice, sCORE), delivering actionable insights to affiliates, regions, and IBTs.
• Establish and lead pricing committee meetings, issue price memos, and drive pricing governance, including the maintenance and monitoring of pricing policies, controls, and KPIs (e.g., floor price).
• Conduct and leverage primary and secondary payer, reimbursement, and pricing research to inform global strategy and provide consolidated pricing and reimbursement advice to relevant product teams.
• Partner cross-functionally to inform IBTs and their Product Managers on recommended price setting, ensuring adherence to relevant governance processes. Who You Are
• Minimum 8-10 years of professional experience with recognized expertise in pricing and reimbursement, preferably in the diagnostics, medical device, or pharmaceutical industry. Affiliate and/or regional experience is a plus.
• Possess a Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field such as business, finance, economics, health economics, life sciences, or public health. An MBA or other Graduate/higher-level Degree is beneficial.
• Deep financial and commercial understanding with in-depth knowledge of the global reimbursement environment, competitive intelligence, and market segmentation for effective global price setting.
• Demonstrated Strategic & Analytical Acumen with strong influencing, negotiation, and Agile leadership skills to excel in a global matrix organization and lead diverse multicultural teams.
• Committed to permanently optimizing processes to increase quality and efficiency standards and implement pricing competence and awareness across the organization through training and support. Essential Skills
• Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Must be able to design and implement global value-based pricing strategies, utilizing analytics to assess elasticity, forecast trends, and manage profitability. Deep financial and commercial understanding is critical.

• Besteht einen Bachelor-Abschluss in einem relevanten Bereich wie Wirtschaft, Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Gesundheitsökonomie, Life Sciences oder öffentliche Gesundheit. Ein MBA oder ein anderer Graduierten/Hochgrad ist vorteilhaft.
• Tiefes finanzielles und kommerzielles Verständnis mit fundierten Kenntnissen über das globale Rückerstattungsumfeld, wettbewerbsfähige Intelligenz und Marktsegmentierung für eine effektive globale Preisgestaltung.
• Demonstrated Strategic & Analytical Acumen mit starken Einfluss-, Verhandlungs- und Agile-Führungsfähigkeiten, um in einer globalen Matrix-Organisation zu exceln und verschiedene multikulturelle Teams zu führen.
• Es wird darauf hingewiesen, die Prozesse permanent zu optimieren, um Qualitäts- und Effizienzstandards zu erhöhen und Preiskompetenz und Bewusstsein in der gesamten Organisation durch Schulung und Unterstützung zu implementieren. Grundlegende Fähigkeiten
• Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Muss in der Lage sein, globale wertebasierte Preisstrategien zu entwerfen und umzusetzen, Analytik zur Beurteilung von Elastizität, Prognosetrends und Rentabilität zu nutzen. Ein tiefes finanzielles und kommerzielles Verständnis ist entscheidend.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui nous fait Roche. Chez Roche Diagnostics, nous sommes animés par notre vision : innover le diagnostic, façonner les soins de santé et changer les vies. Nous sommes heureux de voir cette vision prendre vie. L'opportunité Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que leader de la tarification stratégique mondiale dans l'équipe Diagnostics Global Access & Policy (GA&P). Vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le développement d'orientations stratégiques de tarification mondiale pour nos produits et solutions, en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes mondiales, régionales et locales pour optimiser les revenus et assurer un accès durable. Faites partie de l'élaboration de notre stratégie de tarification mondiale et de notre politique pour un avenir meilleur. Votre impact :
• Diriger la conception et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies mondiales de fixation des prix fondées sur la valeur pour les pipelines prioritaires et les produits sur le marché, en utilisant l'analyse pour évaluer l'élasticité, prévoir les tendances et gérer la rentabilité.
• Codiriger le déploiement de stratégies de tarification, y compris des solutions de tarification et de passation de marchés innovantes, en collaboration avec les acteurs de l'accès et du commerce pour stimuler l'accès au marché et la rentabilité.
• Agir en tant que principal responsable de la gestion des exceptions, fournir des orientations claires et aider les affiliés à élaborer une stratégie locale pour surmonter les obstacles à l'accès.
• Être la principale responsable du suivi des prix et de la production d'informations à l'aide de bases de données internes (par exemple DIAprice, sCORE), fournir des informations exploitables aux filiales, aux régions et aux IBT.
• Établir et diriger les réunions du comité des prix, publier des notes de prix et encourager la gouvernance des prix, y compris le maintien et le suivi des politiques de prix, des contrôles et des KPI (par exemple, le prix plancher).
• Mener et exploiter des recherches sur le payeur primaire et secondaire, le remboursement et les prix pour éclairer la stratégie globale et fournir des conseils consolidés en matière de prix et de remboursement aux équipes de produits concernées.
• Partenaire interfonctionnel pour informer les IBT et leurs responsables de produits sur la fixation des prix recommandée, en assurant le respect des processus de gouvernance pertinents. Qui vous êtes
• Au moins 8 à 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle avec une expertise reconnue en matière de prix et de remboursement, de préférence dans l'industrie du diagnostic, du matériel médical ou pharmaceutique. L'expérience d'affiliation et/ou régionale est un plus.
• Avoir un baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent comme les affaires, les finances, l'économie, l'économie de la santé, les sciences de la vie ou la santé publique. Un MBA ou un autre diplôme d'études supérieures est bénéfique.
• Compréhension financière et commerciale approfondie avec une connaissance approfondie de l'environnement de remboursement mondial, de l'intelligence concurrentielle et de la segmentation du marché pour une fixation efficace des prix mondiaux.
• L'Acumen Stratégique et analytique démontré avec une forte influence, la négociation et Agile compétences de leadership pour exceller dans une organisation matricielle mondiale et diriger diverses équipes multiculturelles.
• S'engage à optimiser en permanence les processus afin d'améliorer les normes de qualité et d'efficacité et de mettre en œuvre les compétences et la sensibilisation en matière de tarification dans l'ensemble de l'organisation par la formation et le soutien. Compétences essentielles
• Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Doit être en mesure de concevoir et de mettre en œuvre des stratégies globales de tarification basées sur la valeur, en utilisant l'analyse pour évaluer l'élasticité, les tendances prévisionnelles et gérer la rentabilité. Une compréhension financière et commerciale approfondie est essentielle.

jobs.title: Head of Quality
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:
As the Operations Quality Site Head for Suzhou, you are fully accountable for the quality of the products manufactured at the site and for ensuring end-to-end compliance with global specifications, local Health Authority regulations, and corporate quality standards. You serve as a key member of the Global perations
Quality Leadership Team (GOQLT) and the Site Leadership Team, modeling Agile behaviors and driving operational excellence.

Main Tasks & 
• Responsibilities:
Drive business results and customer value
a) Responsible for ensuring that manufactured products in Suzhou meet Health Authority regulations, Notified Body requirements, Company standards and expectations. Establish and support inspection readiness to ensure successful outcomes. Prepare adequate and timely responses to any inspection
observations and implement appropriate and thorough corrections, as necessary.
b) Engage and influence the organization to ensure that Product Quality is our focus by ensuring that products manufactured in Suzhou meet regulatory requirements and product specifications. Works directly in a complex, global environment with the chapters and the other Network Leads to deliver high quality
products, ensure our right to operate and continuously improve.
c) Provide leadership and guidance to staff directing Quality functions, manage performance and development of direct reports to ensure achievement of organizational, and departmental goals and a productive environment.
d) Maintain an effective Quality governance and continually improve the governance to meet business and compliance needs. Communicate significant quality or regulatory issues and risks that may impact product quality or regulatory compliance in a timely manner to Executive Management.
e) Develop annual budget, revise forecasts to meet business needs and monitor/control expenditures to assure efficient use of company resources.
f) Appointed as the Site Management Representative and Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) equivalent under China Medical Device GMP regulations and international standards (e.g., ISO 13485:2016). Accountable for ensuring the site’s technical documentation, quality management systems,
and regulatory filings are meticulously drawn up, maintained up-to-date, and fully aligned with NMPA, FDA, and European regulations to safeguard our right to operate.

2. Advance the work of the Network, making tradeoffs and breaking silos
a) Partner with the Operations Site Head on strategic business direction and decisions. Break down silos and improve working effectiveness as an “integrator” across the organization as needed; in particular through collaboration with other Networks Leaders and stakeholders to resolve escalated bottlenecks and
dependencies, as well as rebalance work & help in line with greater strategic priorities.
b) Build and maintain strong partnerships with other site and network leaders to assure alignment around strategic projects and day-to-day activities and to assure mutually successful working relationships.
c) Coordinate with Functional Partners to aggregate upcoming LCTs’ needs and upcoming priorities, to better understand upcoming resource demands on the Network.

Empower and enable the Network
a) Develop and communicate organizational strategies, which ensure the GMP compliance of the site, continuous improvements and achievement of long-term goals.
b) Negotiate with Senior Leadership across the organization to influence decision making.
c) Lead,

jobs.title: Spécialiste SHE (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions:
Dans le cadre de l’application de la réglementation Française, des directives du Groupe et des normes, le spécialiste SHE définit et garantit le bon fonctionnement et le suivi des procédures liées à la Santé, la Sécurité, l’Hygiène et l’Environnement (SHE) afin de prévenir et réduire les risques SHE au sein de l’entreprise.
Par ailleurs, le spécialiste SHE fait vivre la politique SHE du Groupe Roche au sein de la filiale.

Principales Responsabilités:

DU et Prévention des Risques Physiques et Psychosociaux au travail

• De manière générale, le spécialiste SHE est responsable de définir et mettre en oeuvre la politique de gestion et de prévention des risques professionnels au sein de l’entreprise et vis à vis de nos clients, dans le respect des normes et procédures applicables et la diffusion d’une culture de la prévention dans l’entreprise le spécialiste SHE pilote en outre l'organisation SST et guides et serres files (formation, zoning….)

• Il est également responsable de l’analyse et de la prévention des risques inhérents aux postes de travail, que ce soit au siège, en itinérance ou chez nos Clients, en lien avec notre DUERP, afin de mener des actions ciblés (ex : risque routier, geste et posture, EPI, ergonomie, etc)

• Il participe à la détection, la prise en charge et le suivi des potentiels cas de RPS en lien avec les parties prenantes que sont les RH, les élus et le pôle santé

• Il a la responsabilité partagée du suivi de l’accidentologie et la gestion administrative associées (enquête suite à accident, déclaration, tenue des registres, reporting etc…) et d’identifier si besoin les actions correctives immédiates afin de limiter le risque - notamment en lien avec les initiatives groupe

• Il organise des visites périodiques des installations avec les parties prenantes pour s’assurer de la bonne conformité et application des mesures de sécurité du site.

Onboarding des nouveaux collaborateurs et Veille règlementaire

• Organisation des formations SHE : identification des besoins, planification, suivi démarche d'accueil des nouveaux embauchés, mais également suivi et organisation des formations de recyclage (habilitations électriques, SST, etc)

• Est responsable que l’entreprise soit toujours à jour des évolutions réglementaires dans les domaines sécurité des personnes et environnement, dans ses pratiques et procédures ainsi que dans la mise à jour de la plateforme du Groupe.

Gestion des déchets

• Amélioration de nos processus et solutions pour réduire la production de nos déchets sur le site et suivi des déchets chez nos prestataires (notamment DEEE)

Reporting

• Définit et réalise en temps et en heures les reporting associés à son activité

• (reporting SHE, et contribution au rapport RSE, BDES etc...)

RSE interne et Externe

• Participe au comité de pilotage RSE et à l’élaboration du rapport annuel

• Actions de communication sur l’ensemble des activités

• Partie client (plan de prévention)

• Prépare les sujets CSSCT en lien avec son expertise

Audit SHE et SQB

• Mise en place d’audits auprès des fournisseurs critiques (dans le cadre d’une qualification ou d’un suivi : audit documentaire ou physique)

• Participe au Supplier Quality Board (SQB)

Biosafety Officer

• Evaluation et gestion des risques biologiques et chimiques

• Conformité et réglementation : veiller au respect strict des lois locales et internationales

• Sensibiliser, former les collaborateurs aux bonnes pratiques

• Superviser les protocoles de décontamination et d

The Position
您是谁
您负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

您的机会:
A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:
●3年以上医药行业工作经验
●既往有销售/市场/医学经验
●跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书
●医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Employee Experience Operations is focused on delivering professional IT support for our Roche affiliates in the EMEA region and globally as well in cooperation with our service centers in Costa Rica and Malaysia. Our teams consist of English, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish and French speaking Service Desk Specialists from beginners to highly skilled professionals.

Disclosure Note: The final job title is Employee Experience Operations IT Specialist.

The Opportunity

• Provide first-level support for software and hardware incidents and service requests across Mac, Windows, Microsoft Office, and Google environments.

• Engage with users across multiple channels, including phone, chat, and self-service portal.

• Thrive as a key member of a truly AI-powered IT support operations team.

• Champion the end-users' needs, escalating critical situations as required to ensure swift resolution.

• Keep users updated on their request status, guiding them toward the best solutions for their productivity and satisfaction.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• University education in IT or related discipline is preferred

• 1.5 - 2 years of experience in call center, service desk, or IT desk-side support

• Experience with Apple and Microsoft operating systems, Google suite, Microsoft Office products, SAP, corporate networks, and video conferencing systems

• Strong troubleshooting, task prioritization, and problem-solving skills

• Fluency in German and English

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

​ Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions

titleByLocale.it: Assistente a catena di fornitura (1 anno di contratto)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose
To provide essential administrative and operational support to the supply chain and logistics team. This role focuses on executing day-to-day routine tasks, including sales order data entry, basic inventory monitoring, and assisting with shipment follow-ups, to ensure the overall supply chain workflow operates smoothly.

Responsibility & Accountability

• Responsible for sales order intake and planning of delivery schedules to ensure timely delivery and commitment to customers' requests.

• Perform accurate data entry for customer orders into the SAP system.

• Maintain good after-sales service and customer engagement.

• Coordinate with 3PL to ensure that inbound shipments are received and stored on time and achieve the KPI target.

• Follow up and communicate with the global headquarters on shipment and delivery statuses.

• Handle export China shipments under the guidance of senior team members.

• Assist in the inventory movement and monitoring process.

• Assist the team in preparing timely reports on all aspects of the Supply Chain.

• Assist in manipulating SAP data for analysis purposes.

• Assist the team to streamline process flows or practices to improve efficiency by learning and exploring new technology.

• Collaborate with different internal and external stakeholders in various projects.

Requirements:
Education:

• HKDSE (Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education), Form 5/Form 7 graduate, or a Diploma/Certificate in Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience:
0–2 years of working experience in customer service, data entry, or clerical support.

• Fresh graduates with a positive learning attitude are highly welcome.

• Previous experience with SAP or similar ERP systems is an advantage but not strictly required.

Competency:

• Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on data entry accuracy.

• Proficient in MS Office applications (Word, Excel) and Chinese word processing.

• Good basic command of written and spoken English and Mandarin.

• Patient, responsible, and a strong team player able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Global Alliance Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Corporate Business Development (CBD) is dedicated to sourcing innovation outside of the Company by identifying compounds that fit into our pipeline, looking for technologies that can be integrated into our drug discovery process and diagnostics, establishing connections with academic institutions and other life sciences companies and entering into and managing collaborations. Together with R&D this is a key pillar of the Pharma business and our aim is to transform promising innovation into healthcare solutions of the future. Our approach to partnering is open and flexible. We aim to accelerate innovation in China by helping our partners expand their impact on patient health through joint development and delivery of novel therapies; the Global Alliance Management function within Roche is leading all strategic partnerships across the globe and we are proud to be recognized amongst the best in the industry.
We are looking for a Global Alliance Director (GAD) to join our Global Alliance Management team in Shanghai. You shall have the responsibility of managing a portfolio of China based alliances while closely interfacing with Alliance Directors in Basel and San Francisco. You will interact with senior leadership of partner companies and actively liaise with Asia Partnering as well as other Roche functions including PD, GPS, pRED, gRED, CiCor and Dia Partnering. The incumbent for the role shall be strongly connected to the China ecosystem including biotech companies and VCs and act as a facilitator and catalyst for our efforts and partnerships in China. This role will report to Beth Odeh-Frikert and is based in Shanghai.

Your responsibilities shall include:

• Successfully lead and manage a portfolio of China-based alliances.

• Establish and nurture strong, trust-based relationships with Chinese partners to align expectations, anticipate challenges, and effectively resolve operational issues as they arise. Drive alliance governance and operational processes, proactively identify and address key risks and issues, and lead by influence across cross-functional teams. Ensure adherence to contractual obligations and proactively manage conflicts and escalations in the best interest of the alliance.

• Partner closely with Basel and SSF based Global Alliance Directors (GADs) to support their alliance portfolios with Chinese partners. Act as an internal advisor and facilitator for Basel/SSF-led alliances and provide local context to help the global GADs navigate language, cultural nuances and business etiquette.

• Act as a center of expertise for China partnerships and systematically share local market insights, regulatory knowledge and relationship best practices to empower and upskill global GADs in Basel and SSF.

• Actively build and sustain high-value relationships within the Chinese biotech and VC ecosystems to drive collaborative initiatives and identify scalable partnership opportunities

• Identify, lead negotiations and implement necessary contractual amendments, and/or subsequent agreements in coordination with BD, Finance, Legal and all relevant internal stakeholders

• Brief Roche senior management on the strategy and status of assigned China alliances as needed

• Represent Corporate Business Development in public forums (conferences, congresses, other presentation opportunities) in China

In order to be successful in this role, you have:

• Advanced degree (i.e. Master, Diploma, MD, PhD, PharmD) in business, finance or science related field

• Significant

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for an enthusiastic and agile successor for our People Support Solutions Team Lead position within the People Support Solutions German Network . In this role, you will lead a team of HR generalists providing first-line support to our German-based employees, managing a diverse and high-impact portfolio.

The Opportunity

• Lead and inspire a team of HR specialists providing first-line support across the entire German network.

• Manage a diverse portfolio encompassing Employee Lifecycle Management, Compensation, Payroll, Time & Benefits, and Compliance.

• Navigate an extensive stakeholder network , partnering closely with Business & Talent Acquisition Partners and various Project Teams.

• Drive operational excellence by supporting your team in solving complex cases and engaging in demanding professional conversations.

• Benefit from a broad professional scope , moving beyond a single vertical to master a diversified P&C service landscape.

• Empower your team to take E2E accountability, fostering an environment where self-management and initiative are the norms.

• Act as a catalyst for growth , helping team members navigate transformations and reorganizations with confidence.

Who You Are

• A seasoned People Leader with at least 1 year of direct Line Management experience and a passion for developing others.

• Fluent in German (near-native/C1-C2) with the ability to communicate with sophistication and nuance in a regulated business environment.

• Highly proficient in English , enabling you to collaborate effectively within our global corporate structure.

• An empathetic leader who prioritizes empowerment, coaching, and a people-first mindset in your daily leadership practice.

• A strategic navigator comfortable managing complex stakeholder networks and diagnosing organizational needs.

• A disciplined professional with a university degree (HR or Business preferred) and a strong grasp of logical reasoning.

• An agile specialist who may come from a Second Level background but is ready to master the diverse, fast-paced world of Front Line HR.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we commit ourselves to achieving access to medical and diagnostics innovations for all. Together with our regional and country organizations, we are building health systems ready to provide the future of care and make access a reality, thus, enabling people and patients around the world to live their best lives.

This global leadership position is responsible for bringing our diagnostics solutions to the forefront of care and growing access, reimbursement and funding effectively for our established portfolio as well as our ground breaking innovations.
The incumbent will closely collaborate with the global functions in Medical, Commercial, Market Access and Health System Policy enabling our affiliates to effectively co-design and apply the global tools, setting specific access targets in their respective environments and pulling through effective plans for their realization in mutual accountability.
As you are versatile in many environments and wish to impact external access delivery, you will closely accompany affiliates in their efforts to build the health system of tomorrow. Through this lived proximity to market realities, you will enable better global tools and deliverables, always pushing for the next level in furthering our affiliate support.

The Opportunity

Your responsibilities include:

• Market Analysis and Opportunity Identification : Research and analyze access coverage, reimbursement levels, health and payer policies, competitive access landscapes to identify business opportunities enabled through access and assess the probability and impact of affecting positive change.

• Access Insight and Strategy Development : Apply expertise in consolidating and providing relevant access insights and supporting the development and execution of global access strategies and impactful access tools including the Access Reimbursement Toolkit.

• Strategic Access Engagement Leadership : Act as a catalyst and coach for regional and affiliate implementation of global access strategies, identifying gaps, tailoring approaches, and accelerating time to reimbursement and the effective funding for your prioritized products.

• Global-Regional-Affiliate Interface : Create frameworks for efficient transfer of global strategies and catalyze learning, sharing, and collaboration across organizations and territories by leading the Access Nexus pilot of your area - our key interface to the Regions and Countries driving your work in achieving reimbursement and funding.

• Affiliate Support : Support regions and affiliates in executing payer-relevant access approaches, addressing access, reimbursement and funding barriers holistically, and leading projects to enhance local access capabilities with delivering tangible business growth through the realization of access opportunities.

• Shaping Sustainable Healthcare Systems : Support regions and affiliates in building plans and networks that aim for the creation of sustainable Health Care Systems in affecting the regulatory frameworks of payers, Health Technology Assessment bodies and their advising network.

• Requires travel of up to 20%

Who you are

• Master’s degree in business economics, life sciences, public health, marketing, or a related discipline; additional educational programs in market access preferred

• 5+ years of commercial and/or access experience in the diagnostic/pharmaceutical or related industry. Additional experience in related functions such as Strategy, Marketing, or Health Policy preferred.

jobs.title: Director, Customer Support Center
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Director, Customer Support Center

The Opportunity:
As the Director of Customer Support Center for Roche Diagnostics USA, you will lead the evolution of our support ecosystem into a next-generation diagnostic hub. Your primary goal is to minimize instrument downtime by championing Remote-First resolution. By integrating AI-assisted troubleshooting tools with our core platforms, you will empower our frontline experts to solve complex clinical and technical issues with unprecedented speed and accuracy. You will serve as a strategic leader who bridges the gap between high-level business objectives and world-class service delivery.

We are seeking a transformational leader who thrives on variety. You don’t just manage a department; you look for ways to help the entire company win. You are as comfortable leading a cross-functional project as you are implementing a new AI-guided troubleshooting tool, all while ensuring your team feels secure, valued, and empowered in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

Job Facts:

1. Strategic Leadership & Remote Excellence

• Expedited Fix Strategy: Define the roadmap for a proactive support model, utilizing assistive technologies within ServiceMax and Salesforce to increase first-contact resolution and maximize laboratory uptime.

• Operational & Financial Oversight: Direct accountability for expense budgets (P&L), resource planning, and performance data to ensure a cost-effective, high-output operation.

• Omnichannel Innovation: Oversee the optimization of CCaaS platforms (e.g., Genesys) to ensure seamless, data-driven interactions across all customer touchpoints.

2. People-Centric Innovation

• Augmented Support: Oversee the implementation of 'co-pilot' technologies—like predictive error mapping and automated case surfacing—that simplify complex workflows and protect agents from burnout.

• Change Management: Lead with transparency to ensure the team views new digital tools as career-enhancing assets rather than replacements.

• Talent Development: Direct all HR activities, including recruitment, training, and career planning, to build a resilient pipeline of leadership talent.

3. Strategic Business Partnership & Enterprise Impact

• Cross-Functional Synergy: Act as a high-level consultant to internal partners (Sales, Marketing, R&D, and Field Service), aligning support strategies to directly bolster sales objectives and product reliability.

• Commercial Alignment: Partner with Sales leadership to ensure that our service excellence becomes a competitive differentiator and a primary driver of contract renewals.

• Silo-Breaking Leadership: Navigate our matrixed organization to build consensus and lead initiatives that require cooperation across multiple departments to solve systemic customer pain points.

• Dynamic Flexibility: Proactively take on additional responsibilities and pivot resources to support other departments during periods of high demand or special product launches.

4. Compliance & Technical Quality

• Regulatory Stewardship: Ensure every remote-fix protocol and service action strictly adheres to Roche’s quality system and FDA/global regulatory requirements.

• Service Integrity: Maintain a work culture 100% committed to accuracy, ensuring that remote interventions provide the same level of reliability as an on-site visit.

Who You Are (Required Qualifications & Experience):

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Information Technology, Chemistry, Biology, Clinical Laboratory, Business or rel

• Expedited Fix Strategy: Define the roadmap for a proactive support model, utilizing assistive technologies within ServiceMax and Salesforce to increase first-contact resolution and maximize laboratory uptime.
• Operational & Financial Oversight: Direct accountability for expense budgets (P&L), resource planning, and performance data to ensure a cost-effective, high-output operation.
• Omnichannel Innovation: Oversee the optimization of CCaaS platforms (e.g., Genesys) to ensure seamless, data-driven interactions across all customer touchpoints. 2. People-Centric Innovation
• Augmented Support: Oversee the implementation of 'co-pilot' technologies—like predictive error mapping and automated case surfacing—that simplify complex workflows and protect agents from burnout.
• Change Management: Lead with transparency to ensure the team views new digital tools as career-enhancing assets rather than replacements.
• Talent Development: Direct all HR activities, including recruitment, training, and career planning, to build a resilient pipeline of leadership talent. 3. Strategic Business Partnership & Enterprise Impact
• Cross-Functional Synergy: Act as a high-level consultant to internal partners (Sales, Marketing, R&D, and Field Service), aligning support strategies to directly bolster sales objectives and product reliability.
• Commercial Alignment: Partner with Sales leadership to ensure that our service excellence becomes a competitive differentiator and a primary driver of contract renewals.
• Silo-Breaking Leadership: Navigate our matrixed organization to build consensus and lead initiatives that require cooperation across multiple departments to solve systemic customer pain points.
• Dynamic Flexibility: Proactively take on additional responsibilities and pivot resources to support other departments during periods of high demand or special product launches. 4. Compliance & Technical Quality
• Regulatory Stewardship: Ensure every remote-fix protocol and service action strictly adheres to Roche’s quality system and FDA/global regulatory requirements.
• Service Integrity: Maintain a work culture 100% committed to accuracy, ensuring that remote interventions provide the same level of reliability as an on-site visit. Who You Are (Required Qualifications & Experience):
