jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
As a Senior Development Engineer/ Mathematician/ Data Analyst , you will be a vital part of our development team in Spain, focusing on our innovative Blood Gas & Electrolyte Analyzers. You will transform complex physical measurement data into precise, life-saving results through mathematical excellence.

• Robust Algorithms: Develop and refine sophisticated methods, algorithms, and failsafes that extract highly reliable results from physical measurement data. Drive projects from initial conception through to rigorous testing and final completion.

• Model the Future: Create mathematical models and provide expert statistical consulting (including Design of Experiments and Validation) to drive data-driven decision-making and product excellence.

• Bridge Science and Compliance: Implement biometric methods into specification documents, ensuring our products meet the highest health authority requirements and regulatory standards.

• Drive Product Approvals: Support global product launches by developing solid statistical rationales and customized solutions for ongoing product maintenance.

• Unlock Insights: Extract, clean, and visualize large datasets, collaborating with an interdisciplinary team to present actionable insights that drive medical innovation.

• Lead as a Technical Expert: Act as a central point of contact and own the technical solutions, providing the rationale necessary to ensure product quality and scientific integrity.

Who You Are
You are an analytical thinker, solution-oriented who enjoys working in a team at the intersection of engineering, mathematics, physics, and medical technology. You thrive in collaborative, international environments, not hesitant to proactively raise your voice and you are passionate about using your quantitative skills to improve patient care.

• Quantitative Expert: You hold a Master's degree or higher in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field.

• Experience: You ​have 7+ years of professional industry related experience.

• Control Engineering/Signal Processing Specialist: You have deep knowledge of system identification, model-based filtering, and classic or model-predictive control methods.

• Sensor & Modeling Pro: You bring experience in modeling electrochemical sensors and optimizing robust calibration methods to ensure precision.

• Statistical Powerhouse: You are highly proficient in modern statistical software such as MATLAB (preferred), Pyt

You will transform complex physical measurement data into precise, life-saving results through mathematical excellence.
• Robust Algorithms: Develop and refine sophisticated methods, algorithms, and failsafes that extract highly reliable results from physical measurement data. Drive projects from initial conception through to rigorous testing and final completion.
• Model the Future: Create mathematical models and provide expert statistical consulting (including Design of Experiments and Validation) to drive data-driven decision-making and product excellence.
• Bridge Science and Compliance: Implement biometric methods into specification documents, ensuring our products meet the highest health authority requirements and regulatory standards.
• Drive Product Approvals: Support global product launches by developing solid statistical rationales and customized solutions for ongoing product maintenance.
• Unlock Insights: Extract, clean, and visualize large datasets, collaborating with an interdisciplinary team to present actionable insights that drive medical innovation.
• Lead as a Technical Expert: Act as a central point of contact and own the technical solutions, providing the rationale necessary to ensure product quality and scientific integrity. Who You Are You are an analytical thinker, solution-oriented who enjoys working in a team at the intersection of engineering, mathematics, physics, and medical technology. You thrive in collaborative, international environments, not hesitant to proactively raise your voice and you are passionate about using your quantitative skills to improve patient care.
• Quantitative Expert: You hold a Master's degree or higher in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field.
• Experience: You ​have 7+ years of professional industry related experience.
• Control Engineering/Signal Processing Specialist: You have deep knowledge of system identification, model-based filtering, and classic or model-predictive control methods.
• Sensor & Modeling Pro: You bring experience in modeling electrochemical sensors and optimizing robust calibration methods to ensure precision.
• Statistical Powerhouse: You are highly proficient in modern statistical software such as MATLAB (preferred), Pyt

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer Jaen
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• Field Service Engineer (Jaén)
• Misión
En Roche Diagnostics, estamos comprometidos no solo con el avance de soluciones diagnósticas que puedan ayudar a los profesionales sanitarios a tomar decisiones críticas para la salud de sus pacientes, sino también con la mejora de la forma en que estas herramientas esenciales se integran en los sistemas sanitarios de todo el mundo, a un coste menor, sin dejar de obtener los mejores resultados posibles.
En más de 100 países, ofrecemos la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector, combinada con apoyo a la toma de decisiones clínicas, consultoría, diagnóstico digital, gestión de enfermedades, automatización de laboratorios y soluciones de software para proporcionar soluciones integradas a laboratorios, clínicos y sistemas sanitarios.
El Field Service Engineer presta un servicio científico/técnico a los sistemas y soluciones instalados en cliente, garantizando la mayor eficiencia y eficacia en cada una de las actividades asignadas: Instalaciones, mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo, evolutivo y modificaciones. Asegura que el servicio prestado genera ventaja competitiva, convirtiéndose en el elemento diferencial de la propuesta de valor de Roche, y consiguiendo niveles óptimos de satisfacción del cliente.
Responsabilidades Principales
Operaciones Técnicas y Servicio Operativo:
● Excelencia operativa: Ejecutar de forma impecable los procedimientos de mantenimientos preventivos, correctivos, evolutivos, instalaciones y modificaciones de los sistemas asignados, así como que la experiencia del cliente alrededor de todas esas intervenciones sea excelente.
● Monitorización: Incorporar y promover el uso de herramientas digitales en el seguimiento de los clientes asignados para evolucionar hacia un modelo de servicio más eficiente, proactivo y orientado a maximizar la experiencia del cliente.
● Reporte y calidad: Registrar te en el CRM todas las actividades realizadas (remotas o in situ ), garantizando la correcta documentación y actualización de las características técnicas de la instalación según los estándares de la organización.
● Planificación: Asegurar el seguimiento y cumplimiento en tiempo y forma de las modificaciones y mantenimientos mediante el uso del Dashboard de Servicio, en las cuentas asignadas.
Gestión de Cuentas Clave:
● Referencia técnica: Actuar como referente en la gestión del cliente de las cuentas clave de Jaén así como referente a nivel nacional ( cross country ) en el soporte e implementación de las cuentas estratégicas.
● Gestión dedicada (100% enfocada en satisfacción y KPIs): Proporcionar un servicio integral y proactivo, implementando decisiones que optimicen la prestación del servicio e impacten positivamente en la experiencia del cliente.
• Resolución de Problemas y Soporte Proactivo:
• ● Atención al cliente: Establecer y mantener una comunicación excelente y proactiva, informando sobre actualizaciones de reactivos, sistemas y controles de calidad.
• ● Gestión de incidencias: Resolver de forma eficiente quejas y reclamaciones, procesando las modificaciones solicitadas y proporcionando un seguimiento constante hasta la resolución completa.
• ● Sinergia comercial: Trabajar estrechamente con el Área Comercial para abordar las necesidades de los clientes y respaldar las ventas de soluciones y ofertas de servicio.

Requisitos: Formación y Experiencia
• ● Formación Académica: Grado en Ingeniería (Electrónica, Mecánica, Biomédica, Ingeniería Técnica o disciplinas afines).
• ● Experiencia Requerida:

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer Galicia - Temporal
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Buscamos un profesional para proporcionar servicio científico/técnico a sistemas y soluciones implementadas en las instalaciones de clientes en el área de las tecnologías de la información.

¿Quiénes somos?
En Roche, somos pioneros en el campo de la biotecnología y nos dedicamos a mejorar la salud y el bienestar de las personas en todo el mundo. Con un enfoque en la innovación y la excelencia, buscamos talentos excepcionales que se unan a nuestro equipo y contribuyan a nuestros objetivos.

El Field Services presta un servicio científico/técnico a los sistemas y soluciones instalados en cliente garantizando la mayor eficiencia y eficacia en cada una de las actividades asignadas:
Instalaciones, mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo, evolutivo y modificaciones. Asegura que el servicio prestado genera ventaja competitiva convirtiéndose en el elemento diferencial de la propuesta de valor que Roche y consiguiendo niveles óptimos de satisfacción del cliente.

Descripción del puesto:

Proporcionar soporte técnico integral y de alta visibilidad al cliente, incluyendo:

• Instalación y configuración de equipos: Liderar la instalación y configuración de analizadores y soluciones en el laboratorio del cliente, asegurando el cumplimiento de los requisitos y estándares de la compañía.

• Ejecución de mantenimientos (preventivos, correctivos, evolutivos) e instalaciones para alcanzar y mantener un nivel operativo excelente en todos los instrumentos, reactivos y software asignados, y capacitar a los usuarios en su uso.

• Establecer y mantener una comunicación proactiva, seguimiento y colaboración excelente con el cliente, incluyendo la notificación de actualizaciones de reactivos, controles de calidad y la implementación de nuevos protocolos.

• Proporcionar información científica y técnica experta a los clientes sobre el portfolio completo de Roche Diagnostics.

• Gestión y Optimización del workflow: configurar, monitorizar y optimizar continuamente los flujos de trabajo y las rutas de las muestras en las soluciones automatizadas, definiendo prioridades para maximizar la eficiencia operativa de las soluciones y el cumplimiento de los tiempos de respuesta.

• Mejorar y optimizar los procesos de instalación, configuración y formación al usuario, garantizando la sostenibilidad y la satisfacción del cliente mediante el uso de herramientas digitales de la compañía.

• Reporte y documentación rigurosa: Reportar toda la actividad (remota o in situ) en el CRM y asegurar la correcta documentación y actualización de las características técnicas de la instalación en cliente, siguiendo los estándares de calidad de reporte.

• Trabajar estrechamente con el Área Comercial para satisfacer las necesidades del cliente y apoyar activamente la venta de soluciones y las ofertas de servicio de la compañía.

• Maximizar la eficiencia de todas las intervenciones de servicio e implementar un mantenimiento predictivo y proactivo de los equipos a través de la gestión y monitorización remota.

• Monitorizar y analizar los Indicadores Clave de Servicio (KPIs) en las cuentas asignadas para garantizar la excelencia del servicio al cliente.

Información del Puesto:

• Requisitos Educativos: Formación en Grado en Ingeniería técnica, electrónica, biomédica o similar (Ciencias de la Salud)

• Requisitos Especiales:
• Nivel fluido español

• Dominio del inglés

• Residencia preferente: Santiago, se valorarán otras zona s.

• Movilidad geográfica en territorio nacional

• Flexibilidad horaria: turno deslizante

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Buscamos un profesional para proporcionar servicio científico/técnico a sistemas y soluciones implementadas en las instalaciones de clientes en el área de las tecnologías de la información. ¿Quiénes somos? En Roche, somos pioneros en el campo de la biotecnología y nos dedicamos a mejorar la salud y el bienestar de las personas en todo el mundo. Con un enfoque en la innovación y la excelencia, buscamos talentos excepcionales que se unan a nuestro equipo y contribuyan a nuestros objetivos. El Field Services presta un servicio científico/técnico a los sistemas y soluciones instalados en cliente garantizando la mayor eficiencia y eficacia en cada una de las actividades asignadas: Instalaciones, mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo, evolutivo y modificaciones. Asegura que el servicio prestado genera ventaja competitiva convirtiéndose en el elemento diferencial de la propuesta de valor que Roche y consiguiendo niveles óptimos de satisfacción del cliente. Descripción del puesto: Proporcionar soporte técnico integral y de alta visibilidad al cliente, incluyendo:
• Instalación y configuración de equipos: Liderar la instalación y configuración de analizadores y soluciones en el laboratorio del cliente, asegurando el cumplimiento de los requisitos y estándares de la compañía.
• Ejecución de mantenimientos (preventivos, correctivos, evolutivos) e instalaciones para alcanzar y mantener un nivel operativo excelente en todos los instrumentos, reactivos y software asignados, y capacitar a los usuarios en su uso.
• Establecer y mantener una comunicación proactiva, seguimiento y colaboración excelente con el cliente, incluyendo la notificación de actualizaciones de reactivos, controles de calidad y la implementación de nuevos protocolos.
• Proporcionar información científica y técnica experta a los clientes sobre el portfolio completo de Roche Diagnostics.
• Gestión y Optimización del workflow: configurar, monitorizar y optimizar continuamente los flujos de trabajo y las rutas de las muestras en las soluciones automatizadas, definiendo prioridades para maximizar la eficiencia operativa de las soluciones y el cumplimiento de los tiempos de respuesta.
• Mejorar y optimizar los procesos de instalación, configuración y formación al usuario, garantizando la sostenibilidad y la satisfacción del cliente mediante el uso de herramientas digitales de la compañía.
• Reporte y documentación rigurosa: Reportar toda la actividad (remota o in situ) en el CRM y asegurar la correcta documentación y actualización de las características técnicas de la instalación en cliente, siguiendo los estándares de calidad de reporte.
• Trabajar estrechamente con el Área Comercial para satisfacer las necesidades del cliente y apoyar activamente la venta de soluciones y las ofertas de servicio de la compañía.
• Maximizar la eficiencia de todas las intervenciones de servicio e implementar un mantenimiento predictivo y proactivo de los equipos a través de la gestión y monitorización remota.
• Monitorizar y analizar los Indicadores Clave de Servicio (KPIs) en las cuentas asignadas para garantizar la excelencia del servicio al cliente. Información del Puesto:
• Requisitos Educativos: Formación en Grado en Ingeniería técnica, electrónica, biomédica o similar (Ciencias de la Salud)
• Requisitos Especiales:
• Nivel fluido español
• Dominio del inglés
• Residencia preferente: Santiago, se valorarán otras zona s.
• Movilidad geográfica en territorio nacional
• Flexibilidad horaria: turno deslizante

jobs.title: FMI - Chef de Produit Diagnostics & Solutions de Séquençage (d/f/m)

titleByLocale.it: FMI - Soluzioni diagnostiche e di sequenziamento di Product Manager (d/f/m)
titleByLocale.en: IMF - Product Manager Diagnostics & Sequencing Solutions (d/f/m)
titleByLocale.fr: FMI - Chef de Produit Diagnostics & Solutions de Séquençage (d/f/m)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions:
En tant que FMI - Chef de Produit (d/f/m), vous intégrez l’équipe marketing responsable des activités de diagnostic moléculaire au sein de Roche Diagnostic France et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le/la responsable des solutions de séquençage. Vous êtes en charge de la gestion du cycle de vie d’une nouvelle gamme de produits FMI (Fondation médecine) intégrés dans la filiale et des lancements qui complètent cette gamme. Vous êtes le point de contact privilégié pour toutes questions expertes sur les produits de cette gamme. Vous collaborez avec vos homologues au niveau régional/groupe et participez à des projets en lien avec votre expertise.

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous développez un réseau de leaders d’opinion autour de cette gamme

• Vous possédez une connaissance intime des enjeux du marché et des besoins des clients sur cette offre et savez démontrer sa valeur ajoutée

• Vous initiez et gérez des actions de Co marketing en collaboration avec notre partenaire (l'Institut Gustave Roussy) pour donner de la visibilité à ce partenariat et supporter le développement du business

• Vous êtes en charge d’élaborer le plan marketing annuel pour votre gamme et d'en assurez le suivi en lien avec les informations fournies par le groupe

• Vous mettez en place des plans d’actions correctives et tactiques pour garantir une expérience et satisfaction client optimum sur votre gamme

• Vous gérez le cycle de vie des produit/solutions (lancement, prévisions de commandes, plan d’obsolescence ..), en assurez la promotion par des contenus adaptés aux différents supports de communication et mesurez l’impact de ces campagnes.

• Vous suivez l’évolution de la croissance de votre gamme en terme de revenu et proposez des actions correctives si besoin

• Vous produisez des indicateurs clés de performance et les suivez en permanence afin d’ajuster la stratégie marketing et d'accroître la satisfaction client sur le produit

Qui vous êtes:

• Vous avez une formation supérieur scientifique/médicale complétée par une formation management/marketing

• Vous avez une expérience reconnue en marketing produit, techniques marketing et l'établissement de business models

• Vous êtes autonome et possédez des capacités d’innovation, d’anticipation, d’analyse et de synthèse

• Vous démontrez une aisance relationnelle, la capacité de fédérer et d'influencer, vous aimez communiquer à l’écrit et à l’oral

• Une bonne connaissance du marché et des parcours patients en oncologie serait un réel atout

• Enfin, votre niveau d'Anglais est courant

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

Freelancer (20hrs per week)

We are looking for a f reelance Clinical Evaluation Manager who will lead end-to-end clinical evaluation activities for mySugr/Roche products, including systematic literature reviews, data appraisal, and the authoring of regulatory-compliant Clinical Evaluation Reports (CERs) to demonstrate device safety and performance. You will provide expert medical input to medical risk management and vigilance across the full product lifecycle, from development to post-market. Additionally, you will be responsible for facilitating team backlog grooming and prioritisation of deliverables to ensure efficient, scalable working practises.

Essential skills for your mission:

• Experience:

• 1-3 years of experience with regulatory/CER writing for medical devices or in vitro diagnostics

• Education:

• Advanced degree (e.g., MSc, PhD, MD, PharmD, etc) in medicine, life sciences, pharmacology, biomedical engineering, biostatistics/ epidemiology or other related fields

• Skills and Competencies:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines

• Capability to make risk-based decisions

• Technical Proficiency:

• Basic understanding of clinical research and biostatistics

• Proficiency in Google Workspace

• Personal Attributes:

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in an open, collaborative way

• Eagerness to learn and contribute to the achievement of the team and the company

Bonus skills:

• Technical understanding and love for innovative apps and/or software development

• Medical background and/or knowledge of the diabetes industry or other similar health industries

• Knowledge of SAFe Agile ways of working

• Confident speaking in front of others

Who we are and what we care about?

We are committed to providing a healthy, equal and inclusive working environment for our employees to bring true relief to the patient! We care about family friendly career paths, sustainability, a healthy lifestyle and the flexibility of a modern workplace. We maintain a culture of learning and sharing, as well as open and candid feedback. At every level, there are many opportunities to develop and grow - both professionally and personally.

As a healthcare pioneer committed to transforming the lives of billions of people around the globe, we push boundaries to redefine what is possible. We know that early, accurate diagnosis is essential to maintain health, prevent disease and help advance new, targeted treatments and potential cures for the world’s most serious health problems. We have a passion for innovation and a profound commitment to make a lasting impact on society by continuing to improve the standard of care for humankind. Our culture inspires us to create healthcare that is sustainable, efficient and financially viable. Healthcare that is built on people’s needs, strong data and clinical insights. Healthcare that saves lives.

Interested? Great. We’d like to hear from you! Just click that “Apply Now” button and send us your CV in English …. and anything else that you think might impress us.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), we strive for confidence in the integrity of our data and processes, agility, and unrivalled transparency with health authorities, patients, and society.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Quality Lead within our Quality Assurance Process and Affiliate team, you will bring diverse thinking and technical expertise across various quality disciplines to support the Roche/Genentech organisation.

In this pivotal role, you will design and deliver risk-based Quality Assurance strategies, audits, and conclusions for post-approval products, affiliates, and processes. You will act as a trusted partner to senior business stakeholders, guiding cross-functional collaboration to ensure global quality standards are met while navigating complex regulatory landscapes.

• Design and Implement QA Strategies: Partner with business stakeholders to independently define the QA approach, assessing risks and adapting strategies using the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework across GCP, GVP, and Medical Device areas.

• Define and Lead Audits: Determine required audits, leverage data analytics to develop methodologies, and independently manage the end-to-end audit process from preparation to reporting.

• Manage Quality Issues: Independently manage quality issues, tracking systematic findings for process improvement and escalating significant risks to PDQ management.

• Quality Conclusion and Stakeholder Communication: Independently evaluate quality positions to drive compliance action plans. Lead high-level risk presentations and strategic discussions with business stakeholders, Pharma representatives, Legal, and Regulatory Affairs.

• Lead and support Health Authority Inspections: Lead preparation, staff training, and the management of major regulatory inspections (e.g., FDA, EMA), confidently presenting quality strategies and conclusions.

• Drive PDQ Leadership & Mentorship: Contribute to the long-term strategic direction of PDQ, lead compliance projects, and act as a dedicated mentor to develop Quality Leads within the team.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, strategic thinker who thrives in a collaborative, matrixed environment and is passionate about driving Quality outcomes. You possess strong digital and data literacy, allowing you to turn data into insights, and you are comfortable asking challenging questions to support PDQ outcomes.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Extensive Quality Expertise: A strong background in the drug development process and clinical trials, with robust cross-functional experience in GCP, GVP/PV, or Medical Devices/SaMD.

• Inspection Leadership: A proven track record of leading major Health Authority inspections (such as FDA or EMA), including inspection readiness and post-inspection management.

• Analytical & Critical Thinking: Advanced problem-solving skills with a proactive, risk-based mindset and the ability to utilise data and data visualisation tools to drive decisions.

• Influencing & Communication Skills: Exceptional relationship management skills with a proven ability to negotiate effective solutions and influence senior stakeholders.

• Inclusive Leadership: Experience managing projects in global, multicultural teams, with a passion for coaching and mentoring others.

• Academic Qualifications: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a scientific or quality-related field (an advanced degree is preferred).

Location

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, sviluppiamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), ci sforziamo di fiducia nell'integrità dei nostri dati e processi, agilità e trasparenza senza rivali con autorità sanitarie, pazienti e società. L'opportunità In qualità di Senior Quality Lead all'interno del nostro team di Quality Assurance e Affiliazione, avrai diverse competenze tecniche e di pensiero in diverse discipline di qualità per supportare l'organizzazione Roche/Genentech. In questo ruolo fondamentale, progettare e fornire strategie di assicurazione della qualità basate sul rischio, audit e conclusioni per i prodotti post-approvazione, affiliati e processi. Potrai agire come partner affidabile per gli stakeholder aziendali senior, guidando la collaborazione interfunzionale per garantire standard di qualità globali sono soddisfatti durante la navigazione di paesaggi normativi complessi.
• Design e Implement QA Strategie: Partner con gli stakeholder aziendali per definire in modo indipendente l'approccio QA, valutare i rischi e adattare le strategie utilizzando il framework Critical to Quality (CtQ) in aree GCP, GVP e Medical Device.
• Definire e Lead Audits: Determinare gli audit necessari, sfruttare l'analisi dei dati per sviluppare metodologie e gestire in modo indipendente il processo di audit end-to-end dalla preparazione alla reportistica.
• Gestione dei problemi di qualità: gestire in modo indipendente i problemi di qualità, tracciare i risultati sistematici per il miglioramento del processo e aumentare i rischi significativi per la gestione del PDQ.
• Conclusione di qualità e Stakeholder Comunicazione: Valutare in modo indipendente le posizioni di qualità per guidare i piani di azione di conformità. Condurre presentazioni di rischio di alto livello e discussioni strategiche con gli stakeholder aziendali, i rappresentanti di farmaci, gli affari legali e regolamentari.
• Lead and support Health Authority Inspections: preparazione del piombo, formazione del personale, e la gestione di importanti ispezioni normative (ad esempio, FDA, EMA), presentando con fiducia strategie e conclusioni di qualità.
• Guida PDQ Leadership & Mentorship: Contribuisci alla direzione strategica a lungo termine del PDQ, ai progetti di conformità dei lead e funge da mentore dedicato per sviluppare i lead di qualità all'interno del team. Chi sei Sei un proattivo, pensatore strategico che prospera in un ambiente collaborativo, matrice ed è appassionato di guidare i risultati di qualità. Possiedi una forte alfabetizzazione digitale e dei dati, permettendoti di trasformare i dati in insight, e sei a tuo agio a porre domande impegnative per supportare i risultati PDQ. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Esperienza di qualità estesa: uno sfondo forte nel processo di sviluppo del farmaco e studi clinici, con una solida esperienza interfunzionale in GCP, GVP/PV, o dispositivi medici/SaMD.
• Leadership di ispezione: una comprovata traccia di importanti ispezioni dell'Autorità sanitaria (come FDA o EMA), compresa la disponibilità di ispezione e la gestione post-ispezione.
• pensiero analitico e critico: competenze avanzate di problem solving con una mentalità proattiva e basata sul rischio e la capacità di utilizzare strumenti di visualizzazione dati e dati per guidare le decisioni.
• Influencing & Communication Skills: competenze di gestione delle relazioni eccezionali con una comprovata capacità di negoziare soluzioni efficaci e influenzare gli stakeholder senior.
• Leadership Inclusive: esperienza nella gestione di progetti in team globali e multiculturali, con la passione per allenare e sostenere gli altri.
• Qualifiche accademiche: diploma di laurea o equivalente in un campo scientifico o di qualità (è preferito un grado avanzato). Location

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Dans Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), nous nous efforçons de faire confiance à l'intégrité de nos données et de nos processus, à l'agilité et à une transparence inégalée avec les autorités sanitaires, les patients et la société. L'opportunité En tant que responsable principal de la qualité au sein de notre équipe de processus d'assurance de la qualité et d'affiliation, vous apporterez une diversité de réflexion et d'expertise technique dans différentes disciplines de qualité pour soutenir l'organisation Roche/Genentech. Dans ce rôle pivot, vous concevrez et fournirez des stratégies, des vérifications et des conclusions d'assurance de la qualité fondées sur les risques pour les produits, les filiales et les processus post-approbation. Vous agirez en tant que partenaire de confiance auprès des principaux intervenants commerciaux, en guidant la collaboration interfonctionnelle pour assurer le respect des normes de qualité mondiales tout en naviguant dans des paysages réglementaires complexes.
• Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies d'AQ : établir des partenariats avec les intervenants commerciaux pour définir de façon indépendante l'AQ, évaluer les risques et adapter les stratégies à l'aide du cadre essentiel à la qualité (CtQ) dans l'ensemble des secteurs du GCP, du GVP et des instruments médicaux.
• Définir et diriger les audits : Déterminer les audits requis, tirer parti de l'analyse des données pour élaborer des méthodologies et gérer de manière indépendante le processus d'audit de bout en bout, de la préparation à l'établissement de rapports.
• Gérer les problèmes de qualité : gérer les problèmes de qualité de façon indépendante, suivre les constatations systématiques pour améliorer les processus et augmenter les risques importants pour la gestion des PDQ.
• Conclusion sur la qualité et communication avec les parties prenantes: évaluer de manière indépendante les positions de qualité afin d'orienter les plans d'action en matière de conformité. Diriger des présentations de risques de haut niveau et des discussions stratégiques avec les intervenants commerciaux, les représentants des pharmaciens, les Affaires juridiques et réglementaires.
• Diriger et appuyer les inspections des autorités sanitaires : préparation des responsables, formation du personnel et gestion des principales inspections réglementaires (par exemple, FDA, EMA), présentation confiante de stratégies et de conclusions de qualité.
• Diriger le leadership et le mentorat du PDQ : contribuer à l'orientation stratégique à long terme du PDQ, diriger des projets de conformité et agir comme un mentor dévoué pour développer des responsables de qualité au sein de l'équipe. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un penseur proactif et stratégique qui prospère dans un environnement collaboratif et matriciel et qui est passionné par les résultats de qualité. Vous possédez une solide connaissance du numérique et des données, vous permettant de transformer les données en idées, et vous êtes à l'aise de poser des questions difficiles pour soutenir les résultats de la PDQ. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• une vaste expertise en qualité : une solide expérience dans le processus de développement des médicaments et les essais cliniques, avec une solide expérience interfonctionnelle dans le GCP, le GVP/PV, ou les matériels médicaux/saMD.
• leadership en matière d'inspection : une expérience éprouvée des principales inspections des autorités sanitaires (comme la FDA ou l'EMA), y compris la préparation à l'inspection et la gestion après inspection.
• Analyse et réflexion critique: compétences avancées en résolution de problèmes avec un état d'esprit proactif et basé sur le risque et la capacité d'utiliser des outils de visualisation de données et de données pour conduire les décisions.
• Influencer et communiquer : compétences exceptionnelles en gestion des relations avec une capacité éprouvée de négocier des solutions efficaces et d'influencer les acteurs seniors.
• Leadership inclusif: Expérience de la gestion de projets dans des équipes mondiales et multiculturelles, avec une passion pour le coaching et le mentorat.
• Qualifications académiques: un baccalauréat ou l'équivalent dans un domaine scientifique ou lié à la qualité (un diplôme avancé est préféré). Lieu

The Opportunity:

Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• Le rôle implique un support technique de routine, un service sur place, la réparation et l'installation des produits Roche.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
職務の目的
ロシュのパーパスである ”Doing now what patients need next” 、Healthcare Excellence (HCE)　本部のビジョン「RDKKのビジネスを支え、日本の医療課題解決への道を切り拓いていく」を具現化するため、薬事グループは、薬事許認可プロセスマネジメントを通じて許認可を取得/維持することで、我々の検査に患者がアクセスできる環境を確保します。

職務内容
弊社製品（免疫・生化学・遺伝子・病理検査関連の試薬、機器、プログラムなど）の薬事申請担当者として、他の3グループ（クオリティマネジメントグループ、Medical Scientific Affairs、マーケットアクセス・ガバメントアフェアーズグループ）と連携して、以下の業務を行っていただきます。

• 製品導入関連部署（Global Regulatory Team、ビジネスチーム、メディカルチームなど）と連携して、合理的な薬事導入戦略を立案する

• PMDA相談等の実施、行政（厚労省、PMDA）担当者、Global担当者との折衝を通して、論理的かつ合理的な体外診断用医薬品、医療機器（プログラム医療機器を含む）の製造販売の許認可申請および取得、並びに許認可の維持を遂行する

• 社内での薬事関連業務（変更管理、包材・各種資料の確認など）の遂行

• ジュニアスタッフの人財育成

求める経験

• 体外診断用医薬品あるいは医療機器（プログラム医療機器の経験であれば尚可）の薬事申請業務の経験（3年以上）を有すること。

• 経験年数とともに職責を広げ、業務を自律的・主体的に進め、成果を上げた経験。

求める知識・スキル、マインドセット

• 薬事関連法規に関する一般的な知識。

• 生化学、生物学、免疫学、微生物学、工学、農学又は薬学に関連する学位（同等もしくはそれ以上でも可）。生化学・免疫・遺伝子・病理検査、プログラム医療機器に関する知識があれば尚可。

• 生化学、生物学、免疫学、微生物学、工学、農学又は薬学系の科学技術論文、データの解釈ができるスキル。

• 読み書きする英語力は必須。加えて日常会話以上の英語力（ビジネスレベルであれば尚可）。

• 論理的な思考力、並びに文章構成力（正確性を含む）。

• 日常業務に限らず各種プロジェクトにおいても職務グレードによらず、業務/プロジェクトを自律的・主体的に進めることができるリーダーシップ。

• 関連部署とのコミュニケーション力、調整能力。

• 薬事スペシャリストとして、新しい分野を学び、挑戦する意欲があること。

• Growth MindsetとOut of Box Thinking：成長思考を持ち、これまでの経験にとらわれずに革新的な発想ができること。

海外関連部署を含め、他部門とのコミュニケーションを積極的に取り、建設的な発想を論理的、合理的な思考で実現することができる方を求めています。
ヘルスケアのリーディングカンパニーで薬事スペシャリストとして活躍できるポジションです。ロシュ・グローバルとの繋がりも密接であり、グローバルなキャリアを望む方にも、社内留学制度など、グローバル・キャリア・パスをサポートする体制が整備されています。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：Regulatory Affairs Specialist
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり

就業場所 （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする
給与
　　 基本給（月額）：400,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）：22,000円～
　　 時間外固定手当（月額）：68,065円～（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　 ※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
　　 ＜補足＞ ■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）
コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生・その他
社会保険：　健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険

受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙

募集者名 　ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社　(Roche Diagnostics K.K.)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Fluent English ability for frequent communication.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Business Analyst, you will act as a senior Solution Consultant in China Everyday AI and Core Collaboration&Productivity Suite areas, independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity. You will demonstrate a strong understanding of the business domain’s Everyday AI scenarios, related technologies(Google workplace & MS365, and their interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans.
In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective solutions. You are expected to be a tech champion for Everyday AI toolsets and lifting the business users’ expertise, hands-on with no-code/low-code AI products to rapidly build AI workflows and mockups for business validation. Also, you will lead the M365 migration project, specifically analyzing Google Service specific business scenarios to determine migration paths or alternative solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes, methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams, e.g. Everyday AI/Google/M365, without guidance, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Serve as the Solution Owner for China Everyday AI toolsets, defining the evolution of the China Everyday AI toolkit by orchestrating global AI offerings. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks, mentors junior and intermediate BAs, and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems in collaboration and productivity domain, performs thorough domain research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to solution selection, and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals. Interface with business partners to present AI workflow mockups, using rapid prototyping to align expectations and secure buy-in.

• Impact/Strategy: Delivers impact that extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster, contributing to domain goals by ensuring solutions provide demonstrable business value. Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans, influences tactical decisions, and contributes to long-term solution roadmaps.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Works at a solution or product level involving multiple solutions, handling ambiguous requirements and systematically interacting with stakeholders across a broader product environment. Evaluates solution impacts considering both immediate and long-term business implications.

• Business / Technical ability: Demonstrates a deep understanding of business and technical domains, technologies (e.g. Gemini, Copilot, Coze, M365, Google), and their interdependencies. Independently applies to

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Customer Excellence & Digital Transformation Partner, you will play a key role within our Supply Chain organization, combining operational Customer Service responsibilities with a strong focus on digital transformation and process optimization. This is a hybrid position designed for someone who enjoys both hands-on operational work and contributing to a more automated, efficient, and customer-centric future.
You will manage daily Order-to-Cash activities while also helping identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve customer interactions, and support the transition from manual operations to digital-first solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage customer end to end order flow: order management, invoicing, pricing discrepancies, operational incidents and collecting activities within SAP and Order-to-Cash workflows

• Provide customer support through phone and email while ensuring high-quality service and timely issue resolution

• Coordinate with internal stakeholders across Supply Chain, Finance, Logistics, and Commercial teams to ensure smooth operations

• Identify repetitive manual activities and contribute ideas to improve efficiency through automation, digital tools, and AI solutions

• Support digital transformation initiatives by helping customers adopt online ordering, automated workflows, and more agile ways of working

Who You Are

• Experience in Customer Service, Supply Chain, Billing, Order Management, or related operational environments

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with a customer-oriented mindset

• Analytical and proactive profile with interest in process improvement and operational excellence

• Curious about digital transformation, automation, AI, and new technologies applied to business processes

• Comfortable working in dynamic, fast-paced environments with an agile and collaborative mindset

Technical & Digital Skills

• SAP or ERP systems experience is highly valued

• Familiarity with CRM tools and Order-to-Cash processes

• Advanced Excel and strong data accuracy mindset

• Interest or experience in automation, digital workflows, or AI-driven solutions

• Understanding of Agile methodologies and continuous improvement practices

Languages

• Fluent Spanish

• Professional English

• Catalan is a plus

What We Offer
At Roche, you will join an innovative and collaborative environment where operational excellence and digital transformation go hand in hand. This role offers the opportunity to develop both customer-facing and strategic skills while contributing to projects that improve efficiency, automation, and customer experience within a global healthcare organization.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Workforce Optimization Intern (External Workforce)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is part of the Integrated Workforce Strategies Chapter within the People & Culture organization. Our purpose is to enable the business to achieve its ambitious goals while anticipating and adapting to a rapidly changing environment. We elevate the way leaders shape our future workforce by providing data-driven, skills-based workforce planning solutions to the business, such as Strategic Workforce Planning. We are also developing Roche-wide innovative frameworks to support closing our gaps (e.g. borrowing skills by leveraging external partners, bridging skill gaps by flowing skills to the most impactful work). Shaping new planning solutions, creating insights and automating processes as well as working with cross-functional partners offers you great learning opportunities.

The Opportunity

As an intern in the Workforce Optimization team for a 6-month period, your main focus will be learning about External Workforce Management at Roche globally and innovative concepts to manage the external workforce lifecycle process, while deploying solutions to support workforce strategies.

You will analyze data, generate reports and insights, prepare presentations and drive data-driven recommendations for decision making related to the External Workforce at Roche. You will also contribute to the automation of our analytics and implement innovative ideas to create efficiencies in our data & insights world.

Who you are

• You are in your Bachelor or Master studies at a Hungarian University in the field of economics, business administration, HR Management, STEM subjects or similar

• Ideally, you already have had (e.g. previous internship) experience in HR, Procurement and/or project management

• You have a passion for conceptual and data-driven working and are detail-oriented when conducting analysis

• You can address complex problems and develop effective solutions

• You think creatively and you enjoy supporting projects (e.g. workshop preparation, creation of effective presentations)

• You have expertise in Office or Google Suite, esp. Excel or GoogleSheets, Data analysis; experience with SQL is a plus

• You are motivated to work independently in a collaborative and dynamic environment and can adapt to different needs

• You have a can-do attitude and growth mindset

• You demonstrate a high level of social competence and are able to communicate efficiently in English

General information

Start date: July 2026
Possible work locations: Budapest (first location)
Workload: at least 30 hours/week
Duration: 6 months

Skills Needed

• Excel or Google Sheet (required)

• PowerPoint or Google Slide (required)

• Data Analysis &interpretation

• Agile

• Creating processes & frameworks

• Creative Thinking

• English language

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can

jobs.title: Alternant /Stagiaire - Chargé(e) de la Transformation Numérique (f/m/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Alternant /Stagiaire - Chargé(e) de la Transformation Numérique (f/m/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Timkl est une entreprise de services en santé de nouvelle génération née en 2019 d’une démarche soutenue par le groupe Roche , acteur majeur de la santé en France et premier investisseur dans l’innovation santé. Nous proposons une prestation de suivi renforcé pour tous les patients diabétiques sous insulinothérapie par pompe, y compris ceux équipés des systèmes les plus innovants, comme la boucle fermée.

Notre modèle est aujourd’hui accessible sur tout le territoire français hexagonal. Il est co-construit avec les acteurs de soins, parmi lesquels : les pharmaciens, les infirmiers libéraux, les diabétologues et les médecins généralistes.

Tu as le goût du challenge ?
Tu souhaites t' impliquer dans le développement d’un modèle innovant pour améliorer la prise en charge des personnes vivant avec un diabète? Prend part à cette aventure au sein d'une équipe motivée et dynamique.

Présentation de la mission :
Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire / un(e) alternant dynamique pour rejoindre notre équipe en tant que Chargé de la transformation numérique via nos nouveaux outils IA.

Dans le cadre de l’accélération numérique de notre entreprise, tu seras chargé de définir et déployer une approche afin d’améliorer la maîtrise et l’efficience des équipes opérationnelles à l'utilisation de leurs outils et systèmes métier, mais aussi d’identifier comment ces équipes peuvent intégrer les outils d'intelligence artificielle à leur disposition dans leurs processus quotidiens.

L’objectif de ta mission : améliorer nos pratiques actuelles pour accompagner nos professionnels de santé partenaires. (Médecins, Pharmaciens, Centres Hospitaliers)

Quel sera ton impact ?
Dans le cadre de ce stage / alternance, nous te proposons de :

• Collaborer avec les équipes de management, et en collaborer avec nos équipes informatiques, conduire des projets visant à identifier comment optimiser et rendre plus efficaces les activités quotidiennes internes grâce aux outils (incluant IA).

• Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans l’utilisation de nouvelles solutions numériques et outils métiers, en assurant une adoption fluide et efficace.

• Proposer et mettre en place des programmes de formation destinés aux collaborateurs pour les aider à maîtriser les outils numériques.

Ton ADN :

• Tu prépares une formation supérieure bac+4 ou bac+5 ; avec une spécialisation en informatique, systèmes d’information, intelligence artificielle, ou management des technologies.

• Tu as une forte appétence pour les systèmes de gestion de l’information et les outils d’IA (comme les plateformes de machine learning, les outils d’analyse de données, etc.).

• Tu possèdes d’excellentes compétences analytiques, et une capacité à prendre du recul pour comprendre le fonctionnement d’un système

• Tu es rapide, structuré(e), curieux(se) et un bon relationnel,

• On te reconnait une aptitude certaine à vulgariser les outils.

Poste basé à Montbonnot (Isère, 38)
Stage de 6 mois à compter de Septembre 2026 /
Alternance de 12 mois à compter de Septembre 2026

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
● Nous considérons les stagiaires / les alternants comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes.
● Tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de personnes en situation de handicap. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésite pas à nous le signaler en amont de l’entretien.
● Tu che

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is a fixed-term maternity cover position.

The Opportunity:
As an Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English and German

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Infirmier expert Timkl: Secteur PACA (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Timkl est une entreprise de services en santé de nouvelle génération née en 2019 d’une démarche soutenue par le groupe Roche , acteur majeur de la santé en France et premier investisseur dans l’innovation santé. Nous proposons une prestation de suivi renforcé pour tous les patients diabétiques sous insulinothérapie par pompe, y compris ceux équipés des systèmes les plus innovants, comme la boucle fermée.

Notre modèle est aujourd’hui accessible sur tout le territoire français hexagonal. Il est co-construit avec les acteurs de soins, parmi lesquels : les pharmaciens, les infirmiers libéraux, les diabétologues et les médecins généralistes.

1. Finalités du poste:

L’infirmier Coordinateur réalise la formation des professionnels de santé et est leur référent.

• Il assure un support auprès des professionnels de santé pour la prise en charge des patients.

• Il assure également et en collaboration avec le professionnel de santé, la formation technique initiale et continue du patient diabétique sous pompe à insuline.

L’activité d’infirmier coordinateur est un poste clé nécessitant une sensibilité à l’importance du suivi et de l’accompagnement du patient sous pompe dans le respect de la réglementation, de la prescription médicale
ainsi que des process internes.

2- Relations clés :

● Manager direct : Responsable infirmiers

o Travail en transversalité avec :
▪ Responsable des ventes et responsables de Région
▪ Assistantes administratives et commerciales
▪ Gestionnaire administration commerciale
▪ Responsable affaires réglementaires
▪ Responsable formation
▪ Equipe marketing

● Relations externes :
o Pharmaciens et infirmiers d’Etat libéraux
o Prescripteurs
o Infirmiers d'éducation diabète des centres initiateurs
o IPA

Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Disease Area Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Providing Medical Expertise

• Providing deep scientific expertise to form differentiation strategy for company’s pipeline and portfolio.

• Acting as a medical expert throughout all stages of the product lifecycle.

• Leadership in medical portion of the integrated strategy and shaping a scientifically sound value story for products.

Customer Engagement and Insight Collection

• Proactive scientific engagement with therapeutic area experts (TAEs) and other stakeholders in full alignment with the integrated strategy.

• Establishing and maintaining effective professional peer-to-peer relationships.

• Conducting high-quality non-commercial events to disseminate relevant data and build trust among clinicians.

• Systematic collection and analysis of external scientific and clinical insights to translate them into strategic recommendations for cross-functional teams (Squad).

Evidence Generation

• Participating in development and implementation of the local data generation strategy.

• Supporting Non-Interventional Studies (NIS), Investigator-Initiated Studies (IIS), and projects using Real-World Evidence/Data (RWE/RWD).

• Collaboration with Clinical Operations (PDG) regarding strategic clinical trial site selection and engagement.

Health Technology Assessment (HTA) and Access

• Providing scientific expertise and active participation in preparation of HTA dossiers and interactions with regulatory authorities.

• Validation of scientific data integrity and ensuring clinical relevance of HTA submissions.

• Integrating medical perspectives into solutions that support patient journey and expand access to innovations.

Operational Excellence and Compliance

• Ensuring all medical activities are executed in accordance with corporate policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements.

• Strict adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) standards.

• Management of Medical Information enquiries and ensuring correctness of any content generated using Artificial Intelligence.

Education/Qualification:

Education: Full higher education in the field of medicine, pharmacy, or natural sciences (MD, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent).
Experience: Previous work experience in Medical Affairs departments, clinical research, or possession of deep clinical expertise in the relevant therapeutic area.
Languages: Fluent English (required for global cooperation).

Additional Requirements:
Strategic Thinking: Ability to act autonomously and work in complex cross-functional environments.
Digital Literacy: Skills in working with artificial intelligence tools and ability to oversee AI content.
Communication: Ability to articulate complex scientific data and maintain a direct, respectful, peer-to-peer dialogue.
Entrepreneurial Approach: Focus on creating value for patients and the healthcare system without compromising compliance.

jobs.title: Digital Campaign Delivery Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Digital Campaign Delivery Expert in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful execution of digital campaign content projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. Supporting Global Campaign Coordinators, you manage the end-to-end coordination of campaigns across channels, ensuring standards are met. You guide Campaigns Delivery Specialists on complex projects, improve processes, and incorporate stakeholder feedback for continuous improvement. Additionally, you oversee team operations, monitor project statuses, forecast demand, identify risks, and support issue resolution. You also assist the global brand engagement manager with strategic planning to align digital campaign content delivery with future needs.

Who you are
You are an experienced digital marketing project manager, ideally in pharma or life sciences, with strong organizational and problem-solving skills to manage multiple projects, mitigate risks, and meet deadlines. Skilled at building stakeholder relationships and mentoring team members, you foster a collaborative, high-performing environment. With a strategic mindset, you support Global Campaign Coordinators in executing successful campaigns and ensuring operational excellence. In this position you will be focusing on

• Oversee Operational Activities: Coordinate content delivery operations to ensure smooth and efficient processes.

• Initiative Management: Pilot new initiatives and expand organizational services within your expertise.

• Project Monitoring: Lead calls to track project status, identify risks, and connect with global brand teams, engagement managers, and production teams.

• Mentorship: Guide Campaigns delivery specialists, resolve operational issues, mentor junior team members, and assist with onboarding.

• Continuous Improvement: Lead retrospective sessions to foster learning and improvement across therapeutic areas.

• Strategic Support: Assist global brand managers with content creation strategies aligned to organizational objectives.

• Stakeholder Communication: Incorporate feedback, adapt content requests, and facilitate alignment while supporting brand engagement managers in client relations.

​For this position, you bring the following qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

• 5+ years of project management experience, ideally in digital marketing or content creation.

• Strong knowledge of digital marketing, campaign management, problem-solving, multitasking, and proficiency in project management tools and content management systems.

• Exceptional interpersonal skills with experience collaborating effectively with diverse stakeholders and mentoring team members.

• Familiarity with pharmaceutical industry standards, including global and local compliance and regulatory concepts (preferred).

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty

titleByLocale.de: Senior Group Direktor, Safety Development & Processes
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Group Director, Safety Development & Processes

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, our Global Product Development Safety & Risk Management (PDS) department aims to enhance healthcare for patients by elucidating and communicating the safety profile of Roche medicines to optimise their benefit-risk profile.

The Opportunity

The Senior Group Director of Safety Development & Processes (SDP) provides strategic leadership, expertise and oversight for a global team in the design, development, implementation and coordination of activities relating to safety development, innovation, process design and continuous improvement, on behalf of PDS.

As a member of the PVSD Leadership Team, the Senior Group Director leads the global SDP function across 4 global product development sites (Basel in Switzerland, South San Francisco in the USA, Welwyn in the UK, and Mississauga in Canada). The role ensures that safety-critical processes are designed, developed, ‘owned’ and supported in line with business requirements and continuous improvement goals. They ensure that pilots, projects and major programs, intended to improve scientific safety approaches, are delivered or coordinated in line with agreed plans. They are also responsible for ensuring that PDS ‘ways of working’ adapt to changing customer requirements, and that the wider PDS community have access to expert advice in support of their efforts to deliver value to drug development and patient risk management.

The Senior Group Director is responsible for ensuring the SDP team fosters innovation, anticipates and acts on significant new developments or improvements required to PDS ways of working, and provides effective input to future enablement strategies in PDS.

The Senior Group Director leverages the strengths of a diverse global team and creates an inspiring environment where the SDP team members feel empowered to take ownership of deliverables, build knowledge and deploy resources effectively, always striving for continuous improvement and innovation. They are accountable for the implementation and functioning of defined global and/or functional process(es), including the links with associated systems/tools design/development, across the broad safety-related areas of the team's remit.

The SDP team's remit spans the following main areas:

• The design, development, maintenance, oversight, and continuous improvement of the Safety processes in compliance with GVP, GCP, and Medical Device domains.

• Sustaining the organisation’s ability to execute Safety processes through the provision of both technical and scientific expertise.

• The design, development, implementation, and coordination of both strategic and continuous improvement activities that advance PDS’s short and long-term objectives.

• Facilitation and coordination of safety innovation in cohesion with the needs of the Safety processes.

• Provision of niche scientific expertise that potentially benefits the needs of the portfolio.

Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

• Leadership: Provides line-leadership for the global SDP sub-function; coaches members to maximise potential and well-being while sustaining a climate of purpose and urgency

• Strategic Direction: Responsible for defining and articulating vision and strategy for SDP, in alignment with the overarching PVSD, PDS and wider enterprise strategies

• Partnering closely with various functions in Pharma based on emerging business-critical need.

• Accountable for ensuring SDP can anticipate, develop, and support improved/consistent scientific ‘ways of working’,
