jobs.title: Finance Enterprise Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission Statement
Finance Enterprise Partner is a critical role to maximize Revenue and Profitability by acting as a Co-driver and Guardian of the business.
The role's core mission is to provide a holistic, forward-looking financial view of the Japanese In-Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) market, enabling leaders to make faster, better strategic decisions.
Finance Enterprise Partner is not a support function but an active co-pilot of business performance, sitting at the intersection of finance, strategy, and commercial execution to establish a profit-driven company culture to achieve long-term company ambition.

Core Responsibilities
Finance Enterprise Partner will mainly focus on three core pillars:

1. Financial Planning & Analysis
[Planning & Forecasting]

• Lead & facilitate the rolling forecast events: drive annual budget, monthly forecast, and mid-term planning, ensuring strict alignment with commercial strategy.

• Design and maintain comprehensive financial models: incorporate volume, price, product mix and cost assumptions to ensure robust and agile financial planning.

[Performance Monitoring & Visualization]

• Drive performance reviews with clear and actionable visualization: produce executive-level dashboards and visualize performance by portfolio, product, and segment to foster shared understanding and clarify current financial positioning for next actions.

• Own the Gross Margin bridge analysis and prepare financial commentary, KPI scorecards, and forward-looking outlooks to clearly explain variances between actuals, budget, and prior periods with clear business narratives.

[Business Insights & Scenario Planning]

• Provide actionable business insights: proactively identify risks and opportunities in P&L and bring data-driven recommendations, focusing on actionable strategies beyond mere analysis. Translate macro market trends (pricing pressure, tender cycles, aging demographics) into quantified financial impact and scenario analysis.

2. Advanced management decision support
[Strategic Profitability Management]

• Evaluate and challenge current strategies for new and existing businesses. Conduct product-level and customer-level margin analysis to identify revenue growth opportunities, surface dilutive contracts, and prioritize high-value segments.

[Financial modeling for Complex Deals]

• Partner on strategic deals: build deal-level financial models, ROI analyses, pricing frameworks, and risk-adjusted projections. Participate in key customer strategic business reviews, providing top management with value-added financial insights and suggestions, bringing financial credibility to commercial discussions.

[Smart Risk Taking & Problem Solving]

• Enable "Smart Risks" for complex business cases: establish a collaborative system with business members to advance tough and highly complex business cases. Maximize value by providing expert quantitative analysis, consultation, and improvement proposals that drive strategic decisions.

3. Foster Profit-Driven Culture & Establish Organizational Governance
[Profit-Driven Culture]

• Foster financial acumen across the organization: contribute to profitability improvement and cultural change by embedding a mindset where all employees routinely engage in activities for profit improvement as their own responsibility.

[Cross-Functional Value Creation]

• Drive cross-functional financial initiatives: partner with Supply Chain, Commercial Operations, Finance Excellence and other groups to model the financial impa

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position Summary
As the Chief of Staff for the Roche Diagnostics Japan Enabling Team, you will play a key role in the effective functioning and strategic success of the Japan Dia organization. Reporting to the Chapter Lead, ET Office (Dottedly to GM Japan), you will work side by side with the Dia Japan GM and Dia Japan Enabling Team as the “Chief of Staff”.
In this role, you will be involved in the strategic planning processes across the organization through strong collaboration with key stakeholders and network teams. In addition, you will work with the ET to translate vision/ strategy to actionable deliverables and assist them in facilitating effective decision-making. You will follow through and update the ET on progress of these deliverables as well as communication to employees through dashboard or other avenues. You will work with ET to prioritize on agenda and work through the backlog. And you will plan, convene and facilitate ET meetings to ensure objectives are achieved.

You will be responsible to:
● Support Japan Dia GM to develop short- and long-term priorities (business, financial and people) aligned to Roche Dia business objectives, by engaging in strategic planning processes across the organization through strong collaboration with key stakeholders
and network teams.
● As Chief of Staff, support the ET to ensure they are setting and achieving outcomes, while building and maintaining an environment that keeps the team focused on top priorities.
● Convene and facilitate the ET meetings, plan the agenda and support the team in timely, well-informed decision making.
● Design and facilitate effective meetings by prioritizing key objectives, balancing content review with discussion, and moderating dialogue.
● Strengthen ET cohesiveness by working with the P&C and regular exchanges with individual ET members.
● Increase ET effectiveness; Facilitate the formation of ET squads, make accountability clear, track and monitor ET decisions and backlog; hold ET members accountable to decisions and backlog.
● Lead, supported by administrative staff, on all aspects of logistics and planning of ET meetings.
● Collaborate with the GM and subject matter experts to develop communications and presentation materials for various speaking engagements.

Who you are
Professional and Technical Requirements:
- Degree / Masters in life sciences with typically with 3-5+ years of relevant experience in the life science sector in a similar capacity that may be directly comparable to Diagnostics and/or Pharmaceuticals is an advantage.
- Strategy consulting background and skill set would be desirable.
- Strong leadership experience, preferably with experience leading diverse teams and/or highly complex matrix leadership of enterprise-level projects.
- Strong business sense with a solid understanding of the healthcare industry and experience operating in a regulated environment.

Experience, Skills, Knowledge:

- Fully bilingual in Japanese and English in verbal, writing, and reading
- A systems thinker who can connect the dots between functions and processes in terms of broader business implications, including tactical, strategic, and enterprise dependencies.
- A strong collaborator, able to cultivate a strong and trusting relationship with executive leaders, proven experience in stakeholder management.
- Ability to work effectively in ambiguity and manage through change, able to work effectively across cultures and highly matrix organization
- Be detail-oriented with exce

会社概要
当社は、スイスのバーゼルに本拠地を置き、世界100カ国以上でビジネスを展開しているヘルスケアのグローバルカンパニーです。
「医薬品事業」と「診断薬事業」の2つの事業を主軸とし、革新的な薬剤、疾患の早期発見や正確な検査のための診断関連機器・試薬などのソリューションを通じて、幅広い領域で医療に貢献しています。
また、グループの強みを生かして、病気の要因に応じて治療を行う「個別化医療」をグループ戦略の中心に据えています。多くの企業が社外でビジネスパートナーを見つける中、当社は、医療全体を幅広く網羅する製品において自由なコラボレーションができる点で、他社と一線を画しています。このことは、開発初期段階において極めて重要な意味を持ちます。医薬品事業と診断薬事業の双方の広域にわたる深い知識やノウハウを備えている当社は、個別化医療の最先端で活躍し、個別化医療を実現するのに理想的な環境にあります。

募集背景
ますます多様化する医療環境を背景としてメディカルのビジネス貢献の重要性が高まる中、ロシュのVision ”Doing now what patients need next” を実現するため、この度Medical Scientific Affairs（MSA）の人員を募集します。

募集ポジション
職種: Medical Scientific Affairs（MSA）スペシャリスト

職務の目的
ロシュのパーパスである ”Doing now what patients need next” を具現化するため、Healthcare Excellence 本部 (HCE) MSAグループは、臨床上の意思決定の変革および患者アクセスの拡大のため、戦略的にエビデンスと検査需要を創出し、Roche製品とソリューションの臨床実装を促進します。

業務内容
弊社の有する製品は幅広い専門領域（循環器、内分泌・代謝、感染症、Neurology、Critical Care、Oncology、Women's Health等）をカバーしており、MSAグループでは、2つに分けたUnitが、それぞれ複数の疾患領域に対応しています。各人が、そのUnitが担当する疾患領域の中で複数の疾患領域を担当し、ほかのメンバーと協力しながら、チームとして以下の業務を担います。

Clinical Development （臨床開発）

• 会社全体で合意した製品の優先度を踏まえて、適切なタイミングでの製品の確実な上市を目指す。

• 上市後を見据え戦略的に開発を遂行するとともに、ビジネス戦略の策定にも貢献する。

Scientific Interaction （医学的・科学的見地からのKOLエンゲージメントとエビデンス創出）

• 医学専門家とのコミュニケーションを通じて、アンメットメディカルニーズに関わるインサイトを収集する。

• インサイトに基づいて、臨床上の意思決定の変革および患者アクセスの拡大のため、戦略的にエビデンスを創出し、検査の需要を喚起する。

• さらに関連部署と連携もしながら、ロシュ製品の新たな価値の創造と臨床実装の促進・普及を進める。

HCE本部の一翼として、他の3グループ（クオリティマネジメントグループ、薬事グループ、マーケットアクセス・ガバメントアフェアーズグループ）と連携して、HCE本部のビジョン「RDKKのビジネスを支え、日本の医療課題解決への道を切り拓いていく」に貢献します。

必要な能力・マインドセット
【必須】

• 資格・学位：医療系資格（医師、歯科医師、薬剤師、看護師等）又は学位（関係する修士号又は博士号）

• 価値の創造：上記の資格又は学位を活用して医学的な知見に基づく価値の創造を行い、顧客視点で当社の成長に必要な貢献を具体化できること。

• 意欲：新しい分野を学び、挑戦する意欲があること。特に、経験したことのない疾患領域であっても、貪欲に学び、その学びをチームに共有できることを求めています。

• リーダーシップ：日常業務だけでなく、プロジェクトにおいて、職務グレードによらずに、リーダーとなって業務を行うことがあり、こういった場面でリーダーシップを発揮できること。

• Growth MindsetとOut of Box Thinking：成長思考を持ち、これまでの経験にとらわれずに革新的な発想ができること。

• ホリスティックな視点：総合的なメディカル戦略を考え、実行できること。

• コミュニケーションスキル：複数人で一つの疾患領域を担当するため、チームメンバーと協業することを楽しめること。

• 英語力：英語の読み書きができること。

【歓迎】

• 製薬、医療機器、または診断薬企業でのメディカルアフェアーズまたは臨床開発の経験を計３年程度以上あれば歓迎します。なお、未経験でも医療系資格又は学位を有していればキャッチアップすることが可能な環境を用意しており、キャッチアップに努める意欲を生かしていただきたいと考えています。

• ビジネスレベルの英会話が可能であれば歓迎します。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：Medical Scientific Affairs（MSA）スペシャリスト
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり

就業場所 （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする
給与
　　 基本給（月額）：400,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）：22,000円～
　　 時間外固定手当（月額）：68,065円～（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　 ※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
　　 ＜補足＞ ■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）
コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など&

descriptionByLocale.de:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 会社概要 当社は、スイスのバーゼルに本拠地を置き、世界100カ国以上でビジネスを展開しているヘルスケアのグローバルカンパニーです。 「医薬品事業」と「診断薬事業」の2つの事業を主軸とし、革新的な薬剤、疾患の早期発見や正確な検査のための診断関連機器・試薬などのソリューションを通じて、幅広い領域で医療に貢献しています。 また、グループの強みを生かして、病気の要因に応じて治療を行う「個別化医療」をグループ戦略の中心に据えています。多くの企業が社外でビジネスパートナーを見つける中、当社は、医療全体を幅広く網羅する製品において自由なコラボレーションができる点で、他社と一線を画しています。このことは、開発初期段階において極めて重要な意味を持ちます。医薬品事業と診断薬事業の双方の広域にわたる深い知識やノウハウを備えている当社は、個別化医療の最先端で活躍し、個別化医療を実現するのに理想的な環境にあります。 募集背景 ますます多様化する医療環境を背景としてメディカルのビジネス貢献の重要性が高まる中、ロシュのVision ”Doing now what patients need next” を実現するため、この度Medical Scientific Affairs（MSA）の人員を募集します。 募集ポジション 職種: Medical Scientific Affairs（MSA）スペシャリスト 職務の目的 ロシュのパーパスである ”Doing now what patients need next” を具現化するため、Healthcare Excellence 本部 (HCE) MSAグループは、臨床上の意思決定の変革および患者アクセスの拡大のため、戦略的にエビデンスと検査需要を創出し、Roche製品とソリューションの臨床実装を促進します。 業務内容 弊社の有する製品は幅広い専門領域（循環器、内分泌・代謝、感染症、Neurology、Critical Care、Oncology、Women's Health等）をカバーしており、MSAグループでは、2つに分けたUnitが、それぞれ複数の疾患領域に対応しています。各人が、そのUnitが担当する疾患領域の中で複数の疾患領域を担当し、ほかのメンバーと協力しながら、チームとして以下の業務を担います。 Clinical Development （臨床開発）
• 会社全体で合意した製品の優先度を踏まえて、適切なタイミングでの製品の確実な上市を目指す。
• 上市後を見据え戦略的に開発を遂行するとともに、ビジネス戦略の策定にも貢献する。 Scientific Interaction （医学的・科学的見地からのKOLエンゲージメントとエビデンス創出）
• 医学専門家とのコミュニケーションを通じて、アンメットメディカルニーズに関わるインサイトを収集する。
• インサイトに基づいて、臨床上の意思決定の変革および患者アクセスの拡大のため、戦略的にエビデンスを創出し、検査の需要を喚起する。
• さらに関連部署と連携もしながら、ロシュ製品の新たな価値の創造と臨床実装の促進・普及を進める。 HCE本部の一翼として、他の3グループ（クオリティマネジメントグループ、薬事グループ、マーケットアクセス・ガバメントアフェアーズグループ）と連携して、HCE本部のビジョン「RDKKのビジネスを支え、日本の医療課題解決への道を切り拓いていく」に貢献します。 必要な能力・マインドセット 【必須】
• 資格・学位：医療系資格（医師、歯科医師、薬剤師、看護師等）又は学位（関係する修士号又は博士号）
• 価値の創造：上記の資格又は学位を活用して医学的な知見に基づく価値の創造を行い、顧客視点で当社の成長に必要な貢献を具体化できること。
• 意欲：新しい分野を学び、挑戦する意欲があること。特に、経験したことのない疾患領域であっても、貪欲に学び、その学びをチームに共有できることを求めています。
• リーダーシップ：日常業務だけでなく、プロジェクトにおいて、職務グレードによらずに、リーダーとなって業務を行うことがあり、こういった場面でリーダーシップを発揮できること。
• Growth MindsetとOut of Box Thinking：成長思考を持ち、これまでの経験にとらわれずに革新的な発想ができること。
• ホリスティックな視点：総合的なメディカル戦略を考え、実行できること。
• コミュニケーションスキル：複数人で一つの疾患領域を担当するため、チームメンバーと協業することを楽しめること。
• 英語力：英語の読み書きができること。 【歓迎】
• 製薬、医療機器、または診断薬企業でのメディカルアフェアーズまたは臨床開発の経験を計３年程度以上あれば歓迎します。なお、未経験でも医療系資格又は学位を有していればキャッチアップすることが可能な環境を用意しており、キャッチアップに努める意欲を生かしていただきたいと考えています。
• ビジネスレベルの英会話が可能であれば歓迎します。 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pathology Sales Specialist – Tissue Diagnostics

Elevate Healthcare with Cutting-Edge Cellular Pathology Solutions

Join the Roche sales team and be a part of revolutionising healthcare diagnostics in the North UK region. Due to an internal promotion, we're excited to offer a rewarding opportunity for a highly motivated Sales Specialist to advance our leading-edge Cellular Pathology products in the world's most advanced laboratories, including hospital-based and private pathology departments.

About Your Role:

As a Sales Specialist in Tissue Diagnostics, you will be instrumental in shaping the healthcare landscape by promoting our robust product portfolio to key stakeholders in the NHS and private sectors. This position is within the following NHSi Pathology Networks: North 1 South (Teesside), North 2 (North and East Yorkshire) and North 6 (Sheffield Doncaster and Barnsley), North 7 (York, Hull and Scarborough) and reports to the Regional Sales Manager. 
• We offer a fantastic opportunity to drive growth and market presence at an opportune time.

Key 
• Responsibilities:

● Strategic Sales Execution : Lead the sales strategy and execution for our product portfolio, ensuring alignment with customer needs and organisational goals.
● Complex Procurements Management : Coordinate and manage comprehensive procurements, engaging with decision-makers at all levels to ensure successful outcomes.
● Market Insights : Stay ahead of changes in the NHS landscape, including payment structures and procurement processes, to maximise opportunities and mitigate challenges.
● Innovative Strategy Development : Devise strategies to maintain existing Roche affiliations and expand our reach to new sites, enhancing our market footprint.

Your 
• Profile:

● Educational Background : BSc (Hons) / BA Degree or equivalent in a life science or related experience such as a biomedical scientist background. Field sales experience or familiarity with laboratories and Roche Cellular Pathology / Tissue Diagnostics products is preferred.
● Resilience and Creativity : You are resilient, tenacious, and possess a blend of discipline and creativity, essential for navigating and succeeding in a dynamic environment.
● Relationship Building : Skilled in defining customer needs and establishing strong, effective partnerships.
● Digital Proficiency : Adept at using digital sales engagement tools to drive commercial excellence across your territory.

Why Join Roche?

At Roche, our passion for improving patient lives drives everything we do. We're proud of our collaborative culture and continuous innovation. This role not only offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package but also provides continuous support for your professional development. Roche has been ranked number 1 in the UK's Top 25 Best Big Companies to Work For List 2021, reflecting our commitment to our employees and their growth.

Take the Next Step:

If you're driven to make a significant impact in the healthcare industry and thrive in fast-paced, innovative environments, apply now to join our Tissue Diagnostics sales team. Help us transform the future of healthcare diagnostics and build a rewarding career with Roche.
Roche is an equal opportunity employer, dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Apply today and be part of a team that's redefining healthcare.

Who we are

jobs.title: Study Start Up Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose, Objectives and Scope of Position
As a member of the PDG Country Study Start Up Team, your primary focus is to drive and facilitate efficient study start-up processes to contribute to the delivery of clinical trials to patients. You will enable innovative clinical trial delivery, address study start up needs across various therapeutic areas, and ensure seamless trial execution for patients, investigators, and clinical site staff. Collaboration with local country teams, global study teams, and CROs is essential to this role.

Key 
• Responsibilities
This role focuses on the efficient and compliant initiation of Roche-sponsored clinical trials by executing effective start-up strategies while maintaining regulatory compliance. Additionally, this role involves managing amendments throughout the study lifecycle. You will bring subject matter expertise and may work cross functionally in the following areas below:

Study Start Up Strategy & Execution:
Support and execute study start-up strategies for faster site activations, collaborating with internal and external teams, CROs, and sites. Help identify issues, follow regulations/SOPs, and assist with Health Authority/Ethics Committee communication. Track submissions in relevant systems and stay updated on regulatory requirements.

Informed Consent Form (ICF) Management:
Assist in preparing/adapting ICFs, supporting IRB/EC/HA submissions and changes, and archiving approvals.

Clinical Trial Submissions & Regulatory Coordination:
Prepare and manage submission packages for regulatory bodies and health authorities. Assist in responding to RFIs and ensure timely document submission to the TMF. Support study amendments and notifications.

Site Documentation & Compliance:
Collect and verify site documents (CVs, etc.). Assist with translations, patient materials, and biobank details. Learn local document needs and timelines. Support local vendors (excluding CROs) if needed.

Budgeting & Contract Management:
Provide assistance with contract negotiations & execution (confidentiality, indemnity, amendments). Collaborate with internal/external partners on financial/legal compliance. Help update contract system data for planning.

Payment Oversight:
Assist in overseeing site payments, escalations, and reporting via shared service centers and in compliance with site contracts. Help ensure financial/regulatory compliance for local operations. Participate in accrual/purchase order planning and reconciliation.

Qualifications
● Degree (MD, PhD, MA/MS, BA/BS) in life sciences or equivalent. Postgraduate degree or master’s degree highly desirable

Skills and Competencies
● Fluency in written and spoken English is mandatory.
● Fluency in written and spoken language(s) of the host country is mandatory.

IMPACT LEVELS
Acquires basic knowledge to assist with study start-up in clinical trials and drug development, including learning about the clinical trial industry and how trials work. Completes tasks following standard procedures and guidance.
Gains practical skills in clinical trial study start-up by assisting with the execution of country clinical trial start-up activities.
Assists with process improvements and changes by completing assigned tasks. Offers basic input based on observations.
Follows directions for clinical trial study start-up projects. Can organize simple tasks.
Works with other groups within PDG to complete assigned tasks in delivering projects.
Learns about and follows ICH, GCP, and regulatory guidelines for clinic

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
As an intern on the global Early in Career (EiC) team, you will have the opportunity to participate in challenging and impactful business-critical projects. You will be a key member of the Integrated Workforce Strategy (IWS) organization of the Human Resources Department at Roche which encompasses many critical areas of talent attraction, talent pipelining and recruitment. The EiC team is key to executing on the company’s investment in early talent (internships, rotational programs and other entry-level opportunities) for the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region.

The intern will be based in Selangor, Malaysia and support the APAC EiC Partner and Specialist in the daily creation of unparalleled EiC experiences that foster development, networking, and community for interns at Roche and its affiliates.

• Help EiC Partner and Specialist in daily operations and execution of various strategies across the region and/or globe

• Develop university mapping across the region to share Roche opportunities with students

• Maintain the Job Portal Account in Universities across the region

• Support in the analysis of intern data and generating data insights

• Support online and offline university career fair and engagement event management, including event planning, logistic preparation and onsite support

• Research the EiC best practices in across the region and/or globe

Required qualifications:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor or Master’s degree or related experience in HR management, organizational development, communications and or business/related field

• Student organization and/or leadership experience is preferred

• Experience in HR, Marketing or recruiting experience via coursework or previous internship is preferred

• Proficiency in both spoken and written English and Mandarin

• Demonstrated good communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills

• Knowledge of MS Office, Google Suite is a plus

• Available for the internship duration between 3 - 6 months

Program highlights:

• Ownership of challenging and impactful business-critical projects

• Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry

• Lead or participate to design and coordinate program events and initiatives for the EiC candidate experience

• Create new professional & personal development curriculum, including hosting networking opportunities, workshops, and panel discussions

• Participate in volunteer projects, social events, and team-building activities

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Tax Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary :
Responsible for RDSL Tax related operations including Head Office and Branch Offices, to ensure company tax compliance, mitigate company tax risk, and optimize tax savings.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities :

• Perform tax analysis, tax advice, planning and filing

• Communicate with tax authorities in different cities in China periodically and build up good relationship with tax authorities

• Review company internal process and transactions, take actions to control the tax risk

• Monitor TP fluctuations, document and defend TP positions, and manage the rationality of pricing adjustments with local authorities

• Answer Tax related inquiries and provide advice and solutions proactively

• Support company projects/global projects, self-initiate projects for process improvement

• Learn and distribute updated information on tax laws and regulations to finance team and related operation team (include proper training)

• Support Internal Audit / KPMG audit and ensure RDSL tax area meet Internal Audit/KPMG audit/ICFR requirement /KPMG

• Prepare & update Tax related SOP in time SOP Other projects or tasks assigned by line manager

• Conduct business in full compliance including but not limited to Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, Roche Safety, Security Health and Environmental Protection

Basic Requirements of the Job :

Education & Qualifications :

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance

• Accountant certification, CPA/CTA is preferred

• Good computer knowledge: excel/word/PowerPoint

• Good command of English, both oral/written

• SAP experience is a plus

• Familiarity with automation and AI tools

• Open to cross functional projects and opportunities

Experience :

• At least 5 years’ accounting/auditing/tax related experience in multinational or accounting firms

• Familiar with IAS & PRC Accounting Standard /PRC Tax laws , regulations

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. jobs.title: Project Manager (woj. lubelskie)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Roche

Roche Diagnostics is a division of Roche, a science-driven company committed to advancing healthcare and enhancing lives. We are powered by our diverse, talented teams of award-winning scientists, experts, and professionals, all dedicated to innovating and finding better ways to prevent, diagnose, and monitor diseases.

Join a team dedicated to transforming healthcare through innovative laboratory solutions. As Project Manager, you will play a pivotal role in implementing high-quality projects, optimizing customer workflows, and driving operational excellence, positioning Roche as a trusted partner in healthcare innovation. We are seeking a candidate based in the lubelskie voivodeship.

The Opportunity:

• Lead and manage strategic and operational projects for customers in alignment with Roche’s goals

• Collaborate with stakeholders to optimize business processes and enhance customer experiences

• Implement new workflows, laboratory systems, and ICT platforms, ensuring seamless integration

• Support sales and marketing teams with tender opportunities and contribute to customer sales development

• Foster collaboration with internal teams and external partners to strengthen expertise and strategy

Who you are:

• You live in lubelskie voivodeship

• Valid driver’s license and readiness to travel extensively within Poland

• You have minimum 5 years of experience in project management, preferably in healthcare or laboratory settings

• Proficient in modern planning and office software with proven experience in planning tools

• University degree

• Fluent in Polish and English

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

• Excellent interpersonal and communication abilities, with a customer-centric focus

• Demonstrated success in managing complex projects and collaborating across teams

• Knowledge of hospital and laboratory organizational structures is a plus

• A proactive team player with commercial acumen

What you get:

• Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive private medical care for employees and their families, life insurance, and confidential psychological, legal, and financial support through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• Finances & Future: Active support for retirement savings via the Employee Pension Plan (PPE) with a high company contribution, along with annual performance bonuses and jubilee rewards.

• Company Car

• Sports & Integration: MultiSport card co-financing, active internal sports clubs (running, cycling, football), and modern office amenities including relaxation zones and bike infrastructure.

• Growth & Perks: Subsidies for languages, certifications, and postgraduate studies, alongside clear internal career paths within the global structure.

Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche first-hand? Check out our blog!
https://careers.roche.com/global/en/we-are-roche

You have the right to access your data, rectify it, delete it, limit processing, transfer it and - if processing is based on your consent - withdraw this consent at any time. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
職務内容（Responsibilities）
人事データ管理・システム運用

• 給与、税金、社会保険、勤怠、国内外の福利厚生等に関する、人事業務（P&C）プロセスを支えるシステムデータのメンテナンスおよび管理。

• Workdayと外部ベンダー間のデータ連携（インテグレーション）を監視・エラー解消し、正確かつタイムリーな処理を担保。

• 各給与サイクルにおける、一括アップロード（マスアップロード）ファイルの作成・処理・照合。

• カスタマーサービス・社内対応

• 支給、勤怠、福利厚生に関する従業員からの問い合わせ対応、リクエスト管理、トラブルシューティング。

• 国内の勤怠・休暇ポリシーに基づき、従業員の入力内容の正確性を確認するための、各マネージャーやリーダーとの連絡・調整。

• 一次対応を行うP&Cサポートチームへの指導やアドバイスの提供。

• 業務改善・ナレッジ管理

• 最新の業務プロセスを常に把握し、関連文書（ナレッジアーティクル：KA、標準作業手順書：SWI）の更新・ナレッジ共有を主導。

• サービス向上や継続的な業務改善（プロセスの最適化）に向けた施策の提案・実行。

• 必要に応じた各種プロジェクト活動への参加。

• コンプライアンス・成果管理

• 担当国（日本）の法律、顧客要件、社内規制に沿った法令遵守（コンプライアンス）の徹底。

• 定義されたKPIおよびServiceNowのOKRに基づいた、確実なオペレーションの遂行。

• 問題発生時における、最初から最後まで責任を持った対応（エンド・ツー・エンドの当事者意識）の徹底。

• ビジネスニーズに応じた、国内のその他人事務務（給与・勤怠・福利厚生以外）のサポート。

部門間コラボレーション（Cross-Functional Collaboration）
質の高いサービスを継続的に提供するため、国内外の人事メンバーや社内顧客と強固な信頼関係を構築します。地域（リージョン）およびグローバルの同僚と密に連携し、「People Support Solutions」ネットワーク全体で一貫性のある効果的なサービスを提供。コラボレーションを通じて地域間の標準化（一貫性）を推進し、人事部門のビジョン達成に貢献します。
成果物（Outputs & Deliverables）

• People Support Solutions全体のパフォーマンス向上への継続的な貢献。

• 一貫した高品質なサービスと、ホスピタリティ（カスタマーケア）精神の実践による、高い社内顧客満足度の達成（ステークホルダーからのフィードバックにより測定）。

求める人物像（Who you are）
このポジションでは、特定の地域（日本など）の従業員グループを担当するチームに所属し、組織内のさまざまな部門や役職のメンバーと協力しながら業務を遂行します。
求める経験・スキル（Experience）

• 実務経験： 給与計算事務および福利厚生管理における1〜3年の実務経験（シェアードサービスセンター（SSC）やBPO環境での経験をお持ちの方歓迎）。

• 専門知識： 給与計算のサイクルおよびプロセスに関する知識。日本の勤怠・休暇関連の法令や実務知識。

• PCスキル： 高度なExcelスキル（ピボットテーブル、VLOOKUP関数など）。

• 適性・能力：

• 細部への優れた注意力（正確性）とデータ分析能力。

• マトリクス組織（多角的な報告ラインを持つ組織）において成果を出した実績。

• スピード感があり、変化の激しい環境で主体的に動き、複数の優先タスクを効率的に処理できる能力。

• 変化が多く、先の見通しが立ちにくい（アンビギュアスな）多文化・グローバル環境で活躍できる能力。

• 語学力： ビジネスレベルの英語コミュニケーションスキル（読み書き・会話）。

• 歓迎条件： 人事ジェネラリスト（人事全般）としての実務ノウハウ・経験。

求めるコア能力（Core capabilities）

• 顧客中心の思考（カスタマー・セントリシティ）： 日々の業務を通じて相手のニーズを先回りし、文化的背景への配慮や適切な対応ができること。

• 当事者意識（アカウンタビリティ）： 部分最適ではなく「全体への影響」を視野に入れ、確実な成果を出すために周囲のメンバーを巻き込めること。

• 問題解決能力： 周囲の声に耳を傾け、批判的思考（クリティカルシンキング）を用いて業務プロセスの改善につなげられること。

• 成長マインドセット（グロースマインドセット）： 現状維持にとどまらず、新しい学習機会を模索し、フィードバックを素直に受け入れ、自らも周囲に与えられること。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 契約社員
（期間の定めのある雇用：契約期間 2年、 契約更新の可能性はあるが、業務の必要性がある場合に限り、勤務状況、業務遂行能力、健康状態、および当社の経営状況等により判断する。また、通算契約期間は5年を上限とする）
試用期間: なし

業務内容
（雇い入れ直後）：Payroll & Benefits Specialist
（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動なし

就業場所
（雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり
※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 基本給（月額）：350,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　＜補足＞賞与：年1回
　　 諸手当：通勤手当、時間外勤務手当　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生
社会保険：健康

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione
• Payroll, Tempo, Vantaggi Specialist
• Riepilogo della posizione Il team Payroll, Time & Benefits si concentra sul payroll, sui benefici, sulla gestione delle assenze, sul servizio clienti e sul supporto consultivo a dipendenti, manager e partner commerciali che garantiscono il completamento del processo end-to-end in linea con i principi focalizzati sul cliente per garantire che le Roche People Practices lavorino per il business. In qualità di Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist, l'utente è responsabile dell'esecuzione delle attività di manutenzione e di gestione dei dati del sistema HR in modo tempestivo e accurato, a supporto dei processi aziendali P&C nell'area del payroll, dell'imposta, dell'assicurazione sociale, del tempo e di diversi benefici locali e globali. ecc. Contribuisci anche al miglioramento continuo della consegna di P&C People Support Solutions attraverso l'analisi delle interazioni e la collaborazione con altre funzioni P&C all'interno e all'esterno di P&C People Support Solutions. Hai bisogno di una vasta comprensione tra processi e strumenti HR locali, così come gli impatti a valle locali e globali sulla gestione del ciclo di vita dei dipendenti, finanza, approvvigionamento, IT, ecc. Questo è accoppiato con forte focus del cliente, capacità di comunicazione e orientamento della soluzione. responsabilità ● Consegna del servizio ○ Esegui le attività di manutenzione e di gestione dei dati del sistema a sostegno dei processi aziendali P&C nell'area di payroll, fiscale, assicurazione sociale, tempo, diverse amministrazioni locali e globali delle prestazioni, ecc (dettagli si riferiscono al catalogo dei servizi del paese)
• ○ Fornire il servizio clienti sulle attività relative a pagamento, tempo e benefici, come la risoluzione delle richieste, la gestione delle richieste e la risoluzione dei problemi.
• ○ Comprendere e avere conoscenze lavorative sulle politiche locali di tempo/assenza. ○ Corrispondenza con i manager e i leader per confermare l'accuratezza dell'ingresso di tempo/assenza dei dipendenti.
• ○ Gestire, elaborare e conciliare i file di caricamento di massa per tutte le frequenze di pagamento. Monitorare i flussi di dati da/per Workday a Vendor per accuratezza
• ○ Assicurarsi che le integrazioni siano elaborate tempestivamente e risolvono eventuali errori che garantiscono un trattamento accurato
• ○ Assicurare la conformità normativa in linea con i paesi, i clienti e le normative.
• ○ Sviluppare e gestire le relazioni e le comunicazioni chiave degli stakeholder per collaborare in modo mirato ai risultati proattivi e dei clienti.
• ○ Supporta i capitoli P&C nelle attività di manutenzione del sistema.
• ○ Fornire assistenza e consulenza ai team di supporto P&C di primo livello.
• ○ Essere aggiornati sui processi, possedere lo sviluppo della conoscenza sui processi e contribuire all'aggiornamento delle documentazioni rilevanti (KA, SWIs).
• ○ Partecipare alle attività di progetto come richiesto
• ○ Assicurare la fornitura di servizi coerente e affidabile per i clienti serviti.
• processi di implementazione e iniziative per garantire un miglioramento continuo e un miglioramento del servizio.
• ○ Assicurare la cessazione della proprietà della risoluzione
• ○ Assicurare le operazioni secondo KPI e ServiceNow OKRs definiti. ○ Paese di supporto attività non-PTB sulle esigenze aziendali, se applicabile. ● Collaborazione trasversale
• Costruire relazioni con i colleghi P&C e con i clienti per garantire l'efficacia della consegna dei servizi in corso.
• ○ Collaborare con i coetanei all'interno della regione e a livello globale per garantire che la rete People Support Solutions fornisca servizi coerenti ed efficaci ai nostri clienti.
• ○ Ottieni la nostra visione P&C guidando la consistenza locale attraverso la collaborazione. ● uscite e consegne
• ○ Contributo continuo al miglioramento delle prestazioni delle Soluzioni di Supporto Persone
• ○ Raggiungere alta soddisfazione del cliente attraverso una consegna costante e di alta qualità e l'applicazione del principl di assistenza clienti

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position
• Payroll, Zeit, Vorteile Spezialist
• Zusammenfassung der Position Das Team von Payroll, Time & Benefits konzentriert sich auf Lohn-, Nutzen-, Abwesenheits-, Kundendienst- und Beratungsunterstützung für Mitarbeiter, Manager und Geschäftspartner, die eine End-to-End-Prozess-Vervollständigung im Einklang mit kundenorientierten Prinzipien sicherstellen, um die Arbeit der Roche People Practices für das Unternehmen zu gewährleisten. Als Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist, Sie sind verantwortlich für die Durchführung von HR-System-Datenwartung und administrative Aktivitäten in einer zeitnahen und genauen Weise, um P&C-Geschäftsprozesse im Bereich der Lohn-, Steuer-, Sozialversicherung, Zeit und mehrere lokale und globale Vorteile. usw. Sie tragen auch zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Lieferung von P&C People Support Solutions durch Analyse der Interaktionen und Zusammenarbeit mit anderen P&C-Funktionen innerhalb und außerhalb von P&C People Support Solutions bei. Responsabilités ● Prestation des services - Exécuter la maintenance des données du système et les activités administratives à l'appui des processus opérationnels de P&C dans le domaine de la paie, de l'impôt, de l'assurance sociale, du temps, de l'administration de plusieurs prestations locales et mondiales, etc. (les détails se rapportent au catalogue de services par pays)

• Comprendre et avoir une connaissance pratique des politiques de temps/absence locales. o Correspondance avec les gestionnaires et les dirigeants pour confirmer l'exactitude de l'entrée temps/absence des employés.
• Gestion, traitement et rapprochement des fichiers de téléchargement de masse pour toutes les fréquences de paye. Surveiller les flux de données entre/de la journée de travail au fournisseur pour en vérifier l'exactitude
• S'assurer que les intégrations sont traitées en temps opportun et résoudre toutes les erreurs garantissant un traitement précis
• Assurer le respect de la réglementation conformément aux pays, aux clients et aux règlements.
• Développer et gérer les relations et les communications des principaux intervenants avec les partenaires de manière proactive et axée sur les résultats des clients.
• Soutient les chapitres P&C dans les activités de maintenance des systèmes.
• Fournir des conseils et des conseils aux équipes de soutien de premier niveau.
• Être à jour sur les processus, être propriétaire du développement des connaissances sur les processus et contribuer à la mise à jour des documents pertinents (KA, SWI).
• Participation aux activités du projet selon les besoins
• Assurer une prestation de services cohérente et fiable pour les clients desservis.
• Mettre en oeuvre des processus et des initiatives pour assurer une amélioration continue ainsi que l'amélioration des services.
• Assurer la fin de l'appropriation finale de la résolution
• Assurer les opérations selon les KPI définis et les OKR ServiceNow. D ' appuyer les activités menées par les pays qui ne sont pas parties à la Convention sur l ' élimination de toutes les formes de discrimination à l ' égard des femmes, le cas échéant. ● Collaboration interfonctionnelle
• Établir des relations avec les collègues de P&C ainsi qu'avec les clients pour assurer l'efficacité continue de la prestation des services.
• Collaborer avec les pairs de la région et du monde entier pour s'assurer que le réseau People Support Solutions offre des services cohérents et efficaces à nos clients.
• Atteindre notre vision de la P et C en favorisant la cohérence locale par la collaboration. ● Produits et produits livrables
• Contribution continue à l'amélioration des performances des solutions de soutien aux personnes
• Atteindre une satisfaction élevée de la clientèle grâce à une livraison et une application cohérentes et de haute qualité des principes de soins à la clientèle

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Lead IT Expert - RDT Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

The Lead IT Expert (Tech Lead) for DataOps will drive the technical direction of our custom platform engineering solutions. You will not be building standard data pipelines; instead, you will architect, maintain, and evolve DataOps.Roche—the critical CI/CD ecosystem, infrastructure, and deployment tooling that enables hundreds of data engineers to process data safely across our global organization.
This role requires deep expertise in Python, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and modern CI/CD ecosystems to lead massive architectural shifts, including migrating to an orchestrator-agnostic framework and transitioning from GitLab to GitHub. You will ensure the resilience of our platform while seamlessly integrating enterprise tools like Snowflake, Collibra, Monte Carlo, and HashiCorp Vault.

We are a platform team within RDT Data Platforms at Roche, operating under a decentralized Data Mesh architecture. Our core mission is to act as the foundational platform team, delivering the custom DataOps solution to various data product teams across the enterprise. We treat our internal tools, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as a product, empowering these decentralized teams to build, deploy, and scale their data products efficiently and securely within a highly regulated environment. We are currently expanding our mission to serve additional platforms beyond the initial scope, making this a pivotal time for the team.

The Opportunity

• Scope : Lead the technical roadmap for the DataOps.Roche platform. Drive the critical refactoring of our core solution from native GitLab CI structures into an orchestrator-agnostic Python framework. Establish a centralized data modeling service for the broader ecosystem.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Manage and maintain our complex Terraform-based infrastructure, which provisions GitLab/GitHub groups, projects, HashiCorp Vault engines, and dedicated runners. Ensure regulated releases are seamless by maintaining our automated validation processes and custom autovalidate package.

• Stakeholder Management: Act as a product owner for the platform. Liaise with decentralized data product teams to understand developer experience (DevEx) bottlenecks. Guide senior leadership on platform strategy, tooling evaluation, and infrastructure investments.

• Impact/Strategy: Lead high-impact strategic initiatives, including the complex migration from GitLab to GitHub and the evaluation/implementation of Dagster as our next-generation data orchestrator. Identify and integrate applied AI into the DataOps lifecycle to boost developer efficiency.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Manage an enterprise-grade platform integrating multiple major technologies: Snowflake (data platform), Collibra (data catalog), Monte Carlo (observability), HashiCorp Vault (secrets management), and Talend

• Stakeholder Management: Act as a product owner for the platform. Liaise with decentralized data product teams to understand developer experience (DevEx) bottlenecks. Guide senior leadership on platform strategy, tooling evaluation, and infrastructure investments.
• Impact/Strategy: Lead high-impact strategic initiatives, including the complex migration from GitLab to GitHub and the evaluation/implementation of Dagster as our next-generation data orchestrator. Identify and integrate applied AI into the DataOps lifecycle to boost developer efficiency.
• Complexity / (Product Size): Manage an enterprise-grade platform integrating multiple major technologies: Snowflake (data platform), Collibra (data catalog), Monte Carlo (observability), HashiCorp Vault (secrets management), and Talend

jobs.title: （高级）治疗领域专员_血液

titleByLocale.de: (高级)治疗领域专员 血液

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
For over 60 years, Roche has been guided by a profound vision: a future where cancer can be cured. 22.8 million people have been treated with Roche cancer therapy as of 2025. We have had nearly 30 New Molecular Entities (NMEs) approved in our oncology and haematology portfolio.* We are committed to developing innovative medicines and diagnostic solutions that help prevent, stop and cure cancer.

It is an exciting time for Haematology at Roche. This is your chance on a launch product, in a team that has multiple new indications and New Molecule Entities planned for launch over the next 3 - 5 years. To help us achieve this vision we are looking for a dedicated Haematology Specialist Representative to join our dynamic team.

As a Haematology Patient Journey Partner (PJP) , you will play a pivotal role in promoting our exciting portfolio of Haematology treatments to healthcare professionals. You will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with key haematological stakeholders, including haematologists and other respective healthcare professionals/practice staff, to create meaningful solutions that improve patient outcomes.

The territory will focus on key Haematology accounts across NSW and the ACT.

What you will be working on:
You will independently manage territory metrics and targets, showing resilience and confidence when challenging Healthcare Professionals (HCPs). You will work with your team to advance customers through the adoption ladder, drive market growth to meet our patient-focused goals, and contribute to the development of pioneering therapies.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Drive adoption of our Haematology products with healthcare providers across NSW and the ACT.

• Develop and execute territory plans to maximise opportunities to create value for our stakeholders and for Roche to and meet our goals

• Build strong, long-term relationships with haematologist and other healthcare professionals

• Meet customer engagement metrics to optimise communication channels ensuring regular engagement with target customers through face to face meetings, virtual calls, dinner presentation meetings, clinic/practice luncheons and participation in industry events

• Provide expert knowledge on the clinical data and benefits of our treatment

• Collaborate internally with cross-functional teams (marketing, medical etc) to drive business growth and great customer experience

• Monitor and analyse territory performance, market trends and competitor activity to adjust strategies/tactics to improve outcomes

• Gather valuable insights from customers and effectively communicate them to the internal team to help validate and define our strategic initiatives.

• Adhere to company policies and industry regulations, maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and ethics.

Who you are:
You are someone who demonstrates a passion for patient outcomes, enterprise-level thinking, and an entrepreneurial mindset with an excellent understanding of the pharmaceutical industry. You have:

• 5+ years or equivalent level of experience as a specialist pharmaceutical representative or in similar capacity

• In-depth knowledge of the healthcare system and the role of multiple stakeholders within this therapeutic area

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

• Medical Affairs role focused on Ophthalmology

• Sydney-based role ( 12 Months Maximum Term Contract)

• Flexible & agile work environment

The Medical Partner is a trusted, externally focused, and scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key customers over a meaningful period of time, you will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, ensuring that Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas.

The Medical function serves as a critical engine of competitiveness to ensure our innovations reach their full potential for patients with an end-to-end perspective. In this role, you will maximize local and cross-country medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, drive strategic advocacy, champion community engagement, and advance patient access.

What will you be working on:
As a Medical Partner, you will:

• Act as the ultimate scientific expert for our Ophthalmology pipeline and portfolio, proactively contributing strong therapeutic area expertise.

• Lead the medical component of the local strategy.

• Proactively engage externally, including withTherapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and key stakeholders, as an active partner in our engagement strategy.

• Drive proactive, pre-launch end-to-end strategies and tactics that deliver superior experiences, anticipate future medical trends, and shape medical practice.

• Systematically collect, analyze, and translate external scientific insights and clinical practice perspectives into actionable strategic recommendations.

• Systematically identify evidence gaps and solutions to support local medical practice.

Who are you:
You are a qualified Medical Affairs professional with a completed Medical, Pharmaceutical, or Natural Sciences degree (e.g., MD, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent).

You have:

• Demonstrated experience within Medical Affairs as a Medical Adviser or Medical Manager, ideally with deep expertise in the Ophthalmology therapeutic landscape and established relationships with Australian TAEs

• A comprehensive knowledge of the drug development process, clinical trials, R eal-World Evidence (RWE) , and the nuanced Australian medical and regulatory landscape

• A strong working knowledge of the Medicines Australia Code of Conduct , allowing you to conduct comprehensive reviews of materials and resolve compliance issues proactively.

• An entrepreneurial and growth mindset , meaning you love to seek out opportunities, experiment, navigate ambiguity, and challenge the status quo to deliver positive change

• Excellent assertive communication and interpersonal skills, giving you the ability to articulate complex data clearly and build trusted internal and external collaborations

• AI literacy and a digital-forward learner mindset, confidently incorporating digital tools and human-in-the-loop oversight into your daily work.

Full eligibility to live and work in Australia is required for this Sydney-based role as visa and/or relocation support is not available for this role.

We do not accept any unsolicited resumes or enquiries from recruitm

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 职位职责：
• （ 1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （ 2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （ 3 ） 协助 开展学术会议，协助带教人员向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （ 4 ） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

职位要求：
• （ 1 ）在校大学生
• （ 2 ）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （ 3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （ 4 ）熟练运用 Excel 、 PPT 、 Word 等办公应用软件
• （ 5 ）拥有良好的英语书写能力

jobs.title: Digital Content Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen Roche's digital capabilities globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting, and Creative Design.

As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy, as well as excellent delivery of our various digital operations priorities. You are responsible for supporting and executing different initiatives. You work with relevant stakeholders and consult on how to develop their digital performance further and ensure they leverage the available digital tools in order to meet their overall goals.

The Digital Content Specialist is expert in all aspects of digital project management, content management and publishing across different web platforms and is able to build out reporting metrics that supports the business in continuing their growth to meet KPIs and objectives.

The Opportunity:

• Publish and manage content for global websites, ensuring all digital assets are well-structured, easy-to-find, up-to-date, and accurate.

• Work with multiple key global stakeholders and content owners to facilitate content updates, while reinforcing legal compliance in global digital governance.

• Triage incoming publishing requests with the appropriate stakeholders to streamline digital operations and maintain efficient, organized workflows.

• Conduct global content audits and regular platform health-checks to identify gaps, eliminate redundancies, and keep the ecosystem clean.

• Guide and train key global stakeholders to ensure common knowledge and experience across our digital operating landscape.

Who you are:

• You have a BSc/MSc degree and 3+ years of experience in website management, IT systems, and platforms, with a basic understanding of HTML and CSS.

• You have excellent written and spoken English communication skills, combined with good interpersonal skills to work as part of a team and engage with senior leaders.

• You are detail-oriented, well-organized, and highly efficient with time management, ensuring precision and quality across all digital platforms.

• You are a quick learner passionate about technology and the web, bringing a dynamic, flexible approach to working with different tools.

In exchange, we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additional holidays and bonus payment, Work in a hybrid model (2 days/week from the office)

• A global diverse community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Salary starts from 1900 EUR gross/monthly.

jobs.title: Omnichannel Customer Experience Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As an Omnichannel Customer Experience Partner, you will act as an expert in marketing, digital marketing, and strategy, while providing integrated systems thinking and leadership. Your responsibilities include developing, owning, and jointly implementing team outcomes with pod members, co-defining portfolio strategy, and leading or contributing to related work packages and initiatives.

In terms of Omnichannel capabilities, you are expected to serve as a powerful lever to deliver a seamless customer experience across face-to-face and digital channels, having demonstrated experience in creating and delivering Omnichannel campaigns that blend our “traditional” activities with digital touchpoints in an orchestrated way, with a focus on effective messaging, customer satisfaction, speed, and cost-effectiveness.

Although hired into a country affiliate, this role requires you to be part of an APAC collaboration, working across borders to realize and scale country outcomes by contributing to virtual, cross-border, cross-functional work package teams.

Roche expects all employees to hold high standards of compliance with both external and internal policies and regulations and actively participate in SHE initiatives within the Company.

Key Responsibilities

• Co-own and pursue outcomes alongside assigned, empowered self organized teams (such as pods and work package teams) in an agile work environment with a fluid resourcing model (i.e., assignment to one or more teams that can change over time, contribution to work packages on local and international level).

• Contribute expertise in digital marketing and product strategy development to create a cohesive customer experience across all touchpoints.

• Lead comprehensive marketing efforts, including market analysis and market research that informs both traditional and digital channels.

• Define and implement customer segmentation strategies that operate seamlessly across all channels.

jobs.title: 患者解决方案经理 _乳腺治疗领域

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile soluzioni per i pazienti _Area terapia del seno
titleByLocale.en: 患者解决方案经理 _乳腺治疗领域

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
患者解决方案经理是相应疾病领域 HCP（医疗专业人士）的主要接触点，负责制定患者整体解决方案相关的策略和相关项目的支持和执行工作，包含但不限于患者全程管理、创新支付解决方案、疾病认知（患者教育）、准入及安全运营以及上市前后产品的学术平台搭建等，从而提升标准化诊疗水平，提高患者知晓率和可及性，从而实现患者获益。

A. 患者全程管理

• 梳理并建立生态圈内患者跨院/院内的分级诊疗与双向转诊路径（Patient Flow)，从而更好的推动全程管理在医院内/间的落地.

• 协助生态圈内医院及相关科室推进和打造会诊通道，协助上下层医院间衔接流转，助力绿色转诊通道的建立，最终实现患者获益。

• 管理生态圈内患者全程管理项目的各项落地实施，并确保其合规性。

B. 支付方案

• 与准入团队合作，协助整合罗氏相关支付方案，依法依规传递相关支付解决方案信息。

C. 疾病认知（患者教育）

• 与第三方机构协作，针对相关疾病领域区域现状及整体策略，协助开展患者教育，提升疾病认知，促进患者获益。

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 跨职能、或者相关治疗领域经验优先

• 拥有成长性思维和快速学习能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Power Platform Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

As a Microsoft Power Platform Architect, you will demonstrate proven expertise in the platform’s foundation and component technologies. You will guide the platform team in making the platform available to the broader enterprise, so that citizen developers and federated application teams can create business value by leveraging the platform. You will effectively translate organizational goals into a robust technical roadmap, guiding the strategic direction for a secure, compliant, and scalable low-code ecosystem. You will create governance frameworks and provide best practices to empower developers. In addition, you will design the automated administration of the platform, leveraging AI, so that tasks like monitoring platform capacity and user licensing do not need to be done manually. You will act as a technical leader for the platform team, while at the same time collaborating with the global architect community and the technical experts responsible for other Microsoft components.

Job Responsibilities

• Content Leadership: Treats platform services as internal products with clear documentation, lifecycle management, and stakeholder feedback loops. Designs and documents components of shared technology platforms (e.g., CI/CD, observability, DLP policies) while creating proof of concepts, reference implementations, automation scripts, and platform tooling. Closely follows Microsoft’s Power Platform roadmap and general developments in the low-code, no-code and AI space to identify opportunities and challenges within Roche.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Takes ownership of ambiguous tasks and topics in the "grey zone" and successfully drives small to medium (S/M) initiatives at the platform level. These initiatives may include the implementation of platform level initiatives, such as the deployment of the Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit or other automations to support platform administrations. Challenges the status quo, skillfully navigates group dynamics, and fosters good collaboration, knowledge sharing, coaching, and mentoring.

• Stakeholder Management: Prioritizes and communicates with stakeholders effectively. Leads the platform team to ensure that platform is fit for use, socializes the platform to prospective internal customers, and represents the platform within architect communities. Maintains a bigger picture view informed by Microsoft’s roadmap and general low-code, no-code, and AI trends. Understands how various platform components fit into the overall organizational strategy and goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Acts as a technical mentor and aligns development plans with the global strategy. Gives speeches and shares knowledge in internal events (e.g., DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live) and gets involved in initiatives or tasks reaching outside of the regular project scope.

• Complexity: Operates at the platform level with a direct impact on the platform team’s technical decisions and an indirect impact on the decisions of citizen developers, professional developers, and business use case owners. Records decisions in architecture decision records and other formal documentation.

• Business / Technical ability: Possesses a deep understanding of the broader technical landscape beyond the specific component being worked on. Formulates and implements technical strategies aligned with organizational objectives, investing time and energy in initiatives that boost automation and innovation while maintaining the highest engineer

jobs.title: Medical Affairs Advisor
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
Roche Diagnostics provides integrated solutions for diagnostics testing in commercial and hospital labs, medical centers and laboratory networks. Our products and solutions support healthcare professionals in clinical decision making in a wide field of indications .
Within the Healthcare Transformation and Access Department, we are seeking a Medical Affairs Advisor Advisor to provide medical and scientific support for our solutions with an initial core focus on Oncology diseases. The Medical Affairs Partner is a field-based medical expert in one or more therapeutic areas, responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) in order to create a better understanding of products and increase disease/product awareness, providing clinical and scientific support for HCPs, and providing medical information for our products to patients, caregivers, and the general public.

Role scope:

Key responsibilities

• Drives business-aligned medical strategy by leading annual and ongoing medical planning, including inputs on situational analyses and strategies

• Plan and implement medical tactics and activities for assigned therapeutic areas

• Plan and handle medical budgets

• Communicate, drive, and handle clinical research/study for medical evidence generation that helps practitioners, patients and payers make good health care decisions

• Establish and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) to create a better understanding of the company’s products and increase disease/product awareness

• Provide clinical and scientific support for HCPs, including answering questions about products and other related issues

• Prepare and deliver presentations on the therapeutic areas and company products, and participate in panel discussions

• Keep up to date on scientific and clinical developments in the therapeutic areas, and provide medical information to internal and external customers

• Review of non-, and promotional materials

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

Additional task, duties and responsibilities:

• Responsible for acting in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice (such as Roche Code of Conduct and any other Roche directives and guidelines)

• Work in a cross functional setup applying agile working methodology

• Ensure compliance with HCP interaction guidelines (e.g. iHCP) , and other guidelines from Roche quality and compliance groups

Requirements:
Education and experience

• Master’s degree or higher in science or related fields

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the life sciences industry (diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or biotechnology).

• Hands-on experience in medical affairs, clinical development, scientific communication, or product strategy .

• Prior experience in Oncology diseases is highly preferred.

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

Required skills and qualifications

• Good knowledge of Compliance requirements and clear understanding of high standards of Integrity

• Scientific and commercial understanding of diagnostic products, knowledge of product development and tri
