jobs.title: Production Technician (3rd shift)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Senior Production Technician you will be able to set up and operate equipment and processes in accordance with standard operating procedures and pilot
protocols. Inspect product for quality and adherence to specifications. Completes and ensures accuracy of all process orders and associated required documentation, records
and metrics. Participate in the development and review of documentation changes to ensure accuracy and efficiency. Prepare work centers for appropriate line clearance procedures and conduct regular cleaning in
accordance with standard operating procedures. Trains other employees, as needed. Participates in process improvement teams and helps implement improvements. Acts as a liaison with engineering staff on process improvement and development and communicates to the production team. Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality
objectives through daily actions. Performs semi-routine support duties of a specialized nature within an assigned area.

The opportunity:

• Have key responsibilities supporting manufacturing operations either in the manufacturing, packaging, and/or product labeling areas.

• Set up and operate a variety of automatic or semi-automatic machines used in the production of the company's product.

• Work from process sheets or written/verbal instructions given by supervisor to perform production tasks.

• Check and inspects operations against predetermined tolerances.

• Provide support to an area, person, or program. Interfaces with internal customers.

• Function as a subject matter expert in the area of knowledge.

• Participate in the development and/or delivery of training for other employees on equipment and/or procedures.

Who you are:

• You hold a High school diploma with 2 years of related experience.

• You have specialized training or certification in particular area, system or equipment

• You have experience in team oriented work environment

• You have experience in regulated work environment

• You have thorough understanding of appropriate safety, health, and environmental procedures

• ERP and/or Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) experience

• Ability to engage, lead, and communicate in written and verbal format

• Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing methodology

• Basic computer skills with competency using Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)

• Thorough understanding of the principles and applications of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and ISO 9001

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Pay transparency
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indianapolis is 44,200.00 - 82,200.00 USD Annual . Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

jobs.title: Software Testing Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Purpose of the role

This position aims at offering the opportunity to develop competences in the area of testing, integration and validation of Software solutions in the field of Laboratory connectivity components in Roche Laboratories. Our team is responsible for developing connectivity solutions which are enabling interoperability of all components part of the Diagnostics of our clients (instruments, Network integrators, IT solutions, LIS…). The position will support this ambition by covering activities related to gain understanding of requirements at business and technical level so that they can support on the component, E2E and field validation of functionality, testing activities and integration with other solutions. The role will also provide technical requirements to development teams when appropriate.

How would your day to day look like?

You will be part of a development team based in Sant Cugat and as part of it, you will join their Agile ceremonies (SAFE Framework). You will work in some activities from your team backlog related to your role. You will be in the office an average of 1 to 2 days per week together with the rest of the team for specific testing needs. In addition, you will need to travel 3-4 times per year to Switzerland or other client locations.

Who are you?

You are a recent graduate (max 3 years after graduation) in the fields of Informatics, Telecommunications and Biotech.
You are a person with high curiosity and willingness to learn from other domains. You try to find autonomy in your work and are able to ask for help or advice in order to ensure you are doing valuable work. You are authentic, tell the truth and explain the why, strive for excellence and continuously improve and live our values of Integrity, Courage and Passion.

What do we offer?

We offer a learning environment and opportunities to develop quickly yourself both on our domains and on your personal growth and leadership. 
• We offer you a mature organization with Innovative and passionate people, very customer centric and open to change and continuously improving and delivering value fast. You also will be trained on the basic competencies you need to work with us and will feel safe for failing and learning as the essence to growing with us.

This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Digital Sales Specialist - Central Lab

titleByLocale.it: Specialista di vendita digitale - Laboratorio centrale

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Digital Sales Specialist- Central Lab

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
Come join the Roche Digital Solutions sales organization as a Digital Central Lab Consultant where you will be responsible for selling the Roche navify digital portfolio to IHN, hospital, and reference laboratory customers. This field-based position requires consultative sales experience and expertise in lab workflow, IT infrastructure, data flow, informatics, laboratory medicine, laboratory operations, digital applications (i.e. middleware, business intelligence tools, etc.), and Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) to effectively consult with clinical laboratory stakeholders on customized Roche digital solutions and provide strategic recommendations on digital processes. This position engages early in the sales cycle to understand customer needs, deliver customized demos, and design customized digital solutions in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Roche’s and customers’ teams.

Responsibilities

• Generates new customer demand across the full portfolio of Core Lab and Molecular navify products (middleware, connectivity, informatics, apps, etc).

• Engage in strategic digital discussions with key customer buying influences, from technical end users to executive level decision makers.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across sales and implementation teams to define and align on total solution sales strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.

• Conduct laboratory process analysis, develop solution proposal presentations, and deliver recommendations to customers in close alignment with internal stakeholders.

• Deliver software demos and tailored technical presentations to internal and external audiences.

• Adept at translating customer needs into internal action to meet those needs while balancing key business priorities and goals.

• Strong clinical and financial acumen with a demonstrated ability to understand and translate customer needs to effectively position the value of Roche digital solutions.

• Effectively qualify leads and utilize outcomes from workflow analysis and impact studies to provide competitive differentiation and value to the overall customer solution.

• Provides in-depth technical expertise regarding assigned product lines.

• Work cross functionally with internal stakeholders to share information and best practices while remaining actively informed on industry/customer trends that impact business.

• Follow a standardized end-to-end approach that creates evidence-based, differentiated value for the solution portfolio, both inside and outside the walls of the laboratory.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (i.e. Information Technology, Medical Technology, Life Sciences) or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years relevant or equivalent experience (i.e. healthcare digital solutions sales, laboratory diagnostics sales)

• Must be autonomous and organized with effective communication, negotiation, and problem solving skills

• Familiarity with digital solutions, laboratory middleware solutions and hospital LIS systems

• Experience with presenting technical information to large external and internal audiences

Preferred Qualifications

• Preferred experience

Questa posizione si impegna presto nel ciclo di vendita per comprendere le esigenze dei clienti, fornire demo personalizzati e progettare soluzioni digitali personalizzate in collaborazione con gli stakeholder interfunzionali tra i team di Roche e i clienti. responsabilità
• Genera una nuova domanda del cliente attraverso il portafoglio completo dei prodotti Core Lab e Molecular Navify (middleware, connettività, informatica, applicazioni, ecc).
• Impegnarsi nelle discussioni strategiche digitali con influenze chiave di acquisto dei clienti, dagli utenti finali tecnici ai decisori a livello esecutivo.
• Collabora con gli stakeholder interni tra i team di vendita e implementazione per definire e allineare le strategie di vendita di soluzioni totali per soddisfare e superare costantemente gli obiettivi di vendita.
• Condurre analisi di processo di laboratorio, sviluppare presentazioni di proposte di soluzione e fornire raccomandazioni ai clienti in stretto allineamento con gli stakeholder interni.
• Fornire demo software e presentazioni tecniche su misura per il pubblico interno ed esterno.
• Adept per tradurre le esigenze dei clienti in azioni interne per soddisfare tali esigenze, mentre bilanciare le priorità e gli obiettivi aziendali chiave.
• Forte acume clinico e finanziario con una capacità dimostrata di comprendere e tradurre le esigenze del cliente per posizionare efficacemente il valore delle soluzioni digitali Roche.
• Efficacemente qualificare i cavi e utilizzare i risultati dell'analisi del flusso di lavoro e gli studi di impatto per fornire differenziazione e valore competitivi alla soluzione globale del cliente.

• Il lavoro intercorre in modo funzionale con gli stakeholder interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche, pur rimanendo attivamente informati sulle tendenze del settore/cliente che influiscono sul business.
• Seguire un approccio end-to-end standardizzato che crea valori differenziati e basati su prove per il portafoglio soluzioni, sia all'interno che all'esterno delle pareti del laboratorio. Chi sei
• Corso di laurea in un campo relativo (ossia tecnologia dell'informazione, tecnologia medica, scienze della vita) o esperienza equivalente.
• 5+ anni di esperienza rilevante o equivalente (ad es. vendite di soluzioni digitali sanitarie, vendite di diagnostica di laboratorio)
• Deve essere autonomo e organizzato con efficaci capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e problem solving
• Familiarità con soluzioni digitali, soluzioni di middleware di laboratorio e sistemi LIS ospedalieri

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste de spécialiste des ventes numériques - Central Lab Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. The Opportunity Venez rejoindre l'organisation de vente de Roche Digital Solutions en tant que consultant en Digital Central Lab où vous serez responsable de la vente du portefeuille numérique de Roche navify à des clients IHN, hôpital et laboratoire de référence. Ce poste sur le terrain exige de l'expérience et une expertise en matière de ventes consultatives dans les domaines suivants : flux de travail en laboratoire, infrastructure informatique, flux de données, informatique, médecine de laboratoire, opérations de laboratoire, applications numériques (c.-à-d. intergiciels, outils d'intelligence d'affaires, etc.) et systèmes d'information de laboratoire (SIL) pour consulter efficacement les intervenants des laboratoires cliniques sur les solutions numériques Roche personnalisées et formuler des recommandations stratégiques sur les processus numériques. Cette position s'engage dès le début du cycle de vente pour comprendre les besoins des clients, fournir des démos personnalisées et concevoir des solutions numériques personnalisées en partenariat avec des intervenants interfonctionnels à travers les équipes Roche et les clients. Responsabilités
• Génère la demande de nouveaux clients dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits Core Lab et Molecular navify (milieux, connectivité, informatique, applications, etc.).
• S'engager dans des discussions numériques stratégiques avec des influences clés sur l'achat des clients, des utilisateurs finaux techniques aux décideurs de niveau exécutif.
• Collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes des équipes de vente et de mise en oeuvre afin de définir et d'aligner les stratégies de vente de solutions totales pour atteindre et dépasser systématiquement les objectifs de vente.
• Effectuer des analyses de processus en laboratoire, élaborer des propositions de solutions et présenter des recommandations aux clients en étroite harmonie avec les parties prenantes internes.
• Fournir des démos logicielles et des présentations techniques adaptées aux publics internes et externes.
• S'efforcer de traduire les besoins des clients en actions internes pour répondre à ces besoins tout en conciliant les priorités et les objectifs clés de l'entreprise.
• Forte concentration clinique et financière avec une capacité démontrée de comprendre et de traduire les besoins du client pour positionner efficacement la valeur des solutions numériques Roche.
• Qualifier efficacement les pistes et utiliser les résultats de l'analyse des flux de travail et des études d'impact pour fournir une différenciation concurrentielle et une valeur à la solution globale du client.
• Fournit une expertise technique approfondie concernant les gammes de produits assignées.
• Travailler de concert avec les parties prenantes internes pour partager l'information et les meilleures pratiques tout en restant activement informé des tendances de l'industrie et des clients qui influent sur les entreprises.
• Suivez une approche standard de bout en bout qui crée une valeur factuelle et différenciée pour le portefeuille de solutions, tant à l'intérieur qu'à l'extérieur des murs du laboratoire. Qui vous êtes
• Baccalauréat Diplôme dans un domaine connexe (p. ex. technologie de l'information, technologie médicale, sciences de la vie) ou expérience équivalente.
• 5+ ans d'expérience pertinente ou équivalente (c'est-à-dire vente de solutions numériques de soins de santé, vente de diagnostics de laboratoire)
• Doit être autonome et organisé avec des compétences de communication, de négociation et de résolution de problèmes efficaces
• Familiarité avec les solutions numériques, les solutions intermédiaires de laboratoire et les systèmes LIS hospitaliers
• Expérience de la présentation d'informations techniques à de grands publics externes et internes Qualifications privilégiées

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Instrument Operations Specialist supports the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of instrument operations within the Indianapolis Distribution Center. This role focuses on operational investigations, systems troubleshooting, inventory accuracy, and process optimization to ensure efficient instrument movement and order fulfillment.
This position will serve as a key operational resource for resolving complex issues, improving workflows, and supporting cross-functional initiatives that impact instrument distribution and warehouse execution. The role will work closely with warehouse operations, transportation, supply chain planning, and quality teams to ensure operational stability and continuous improvement.

The Opportunity
Operational Execution & Issue Resolution

• Investigate and resolve operational issues related to order fulfillment, inventory discrepancies, and system transactions.

• Troubleshoot SAP and warehouse management system transactions to identify root causes of operational disruptions.

• Support accurate execution of transfer orders, shipments, and instrument movements.

• Monitor operational workflows and escalate issues as needed to maintain service levels.

Systems & Process Expertise

• Serve as an operational resource for SAP and warehouse management processes related to instrument operations.

• Identify recurring issues or process gaps and recommend improvements to strengthen operational efficiency.

• Support development and maintenance of work instructions, process documentation, and operational standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Supply Chain, Transportation, Quality, and Warehouse teams to resolve operational issues and improve workflow coordination.

• Support communication between operational teams and system stakeholders when troubleshooting issues or implementing process changes.

Continuous Improvement

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on workflow optimization, operational efficiency, and inventory accuracy.

• Support implementation and sustainment of CI tools such as 5S, root cause analysis, and standard work documentation.

• Identify opportunities to improve throughput, reduce operational friction, and strengthen process reliability.

Operational Reporting & Analysis

• Track and review operational performance indicators related to inventory integrity and order execution.

• Support analysis of operational data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities for improvement.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field OR equivalent combination of education and relevant operations experience

• 3+ years of experience in supply chain, warehouse operations, distribution, or logistics

• Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP or warehouse management systems (WMS)

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to investigate operational issues and identify root causes

• Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in supply chain or distribution center operations

• Experience troubleshooting SAP transactions or warehouse management system processes

• Experience supporting operational investigations, inventory management, or order execution workflows

• Experience with continuous improvement tools such as Lean, root cause analysis, or 5S

• Strong organizational, documentat

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be :

• Validate and process (fix & check) Purchase Requisitions to ensure completeness and in compliance with Procurement Policy. Convert Purchase Requisitions to Purchase Orders.

• Purchase Order amendment, close and cancellation. Manage and resolve internal queries. Participate in invoice reconciliation process.

• Work closely with Accounts Payable team to resolve any outstanding invoice reconciliation or mismatch. Execute and produce accurate and timely reports.

• Manage and execute the quote collections and multiple source biddings when applicable.Review and update SOP, DTP & LP timely. Ensure adherence to the Procurement Policy, Directive, Guidelines and Local Procurement policies.

• Actively participate in new project, such as ASPIRE/MyBuy and etc. Attend related meetings, trainings, knowledge transfer and etc.

Key skills and Experience:

• Degree or Diploma in Business Studies, Finance & Accounting/Commerce, Supply Chain or Procurement equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English. Additional Chinese/Mandarin in speaking and writing is required.

• 3-5 years’ experience in a centralized purchasing environment and Supply Chain with production planning background.

• Experience of working in a shared service center across a global / large organization will be an added advantage.

• Good negotiation and analytical skills, resourceful in identifying new sources of items requested and results oriented.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

全面统筹罗氏中国MCE渠道数据的治理与渠道折扣的体系化运作。在确保渠道数据（DDI）、与折扣管理的绝对准确、完整、及时与合规的基础上，以前瞻性的行业视野，引入自动化、智能化（AI）等先进的数据管理工具与系统，驱动业务流程的精益化重塑。引领渠道数据团队进行精益化、数智化的转型，实现团队效能的降本增效。同时通过精准的数据洞察赋能商业决策，打造行业领先的渠道数据管理生态标杆。

您将有机会：
1. 渠道数据治理

• 全面统筹渠道数据（包含但不限于 DDI 直连数据、流向数据、进销存数据、主数据等）的日常直连、收集、清洗、校验等工作。

• 建立并优化数据管理体系，确保数据的准确性、完整性与及时性，满足公司对业务决策与追踪、财务审计及合规风控的要求。

• 协同内外部资源，探索并建立药品追溯码数据管理机制等，作为 DDI 数据以外的前瞻性战略补充。
2. 渠道折扣管理

• 负责渠道折扣管理标准流程与运作机制的设计与维护，确保其严格符合内外部法律法规与合规审计要求。

• 主导折扣名单、协议、计算、核对、发放、对账等全链路流程管理，确保折扣执行结果的严谨准确以及公司资金安全。

• 联合策略、财务与业务部门，定期监控与分析折扣兑付情况，为商业政策与折扣政策的迭代提供数据支撑。
3. 数智化转型与效能跃升

• 敏锐识别现有数据处理与折扣执行流程中的痛点，主导并落地 RPA、AI 工具、管理系统与平台等项目，为团队增优提效。
4. 业务赋能与跨部门协同

• 从海量数据中提炼业务洞察，搭建直观的数据看板与报告，为业务管理与决策提供数据支持。

• 与跨职能团队组成敏捷工作矩阵，协同实现渠道生态体系多元化业务价值的效能支撑。

• 助力渠道运营“集中化”建设，推动运营团队内部跨职能轮岗，实现运营团队跨职能深度融合与打通。
5. 团队领导与人才孵化

• 建立梯队化的人才培养机制，鼓励团队成员多元化发展，激发团队创新思维，打造一支具备“敏捷迭代”能力与自驱基因的复合型高绩效团队。

期待您：
Education/Qualifications 教育程度 / 所获资格证书

• 本科及以上学历，信息/计算机科学、财务、数据分析或商业管理类专业优先。

• 大学英语六级及以上，具备优秀的中英文书面与口头商务沟通能力。

Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力

• 行业经验：具有 8 年以上医药企业工作经验，其中至少 3 年以上渠道数据管理（DDI）、SFE、财务或商业运营管理经验。

• 专业技能：精通医药行业渠道数据管理与折扣管理模式。具备较强的数据敏感度与逻辑分析能力，熟悉 BI 工具（如 Tableau, PowerBI）、ERP 系统及主数据管理逻辑。有主导过 RPA、AI 工具引入或数据自动化系统落地经验者优先。

• 业务敏锐度：具备出色的商业敏锐度与全局观。能够穿透数据表面，深刻理解渠道策略、渠道运营、合规管控之间的内在联系，具备将海量复杂底层数据转化为高价值业务洞察并反哺业务决策与管理的能力。

• 领导力特质：具备“破局”意识，能够积极拥抱环境变化，敢于在不确定性中重塑和精益化现有流程，同时底线思维清晰，确保在变革过程中业务结果的绝对准确可靠。

• 卓越协同： 出色的跨部门沟通与谈判能力，擅长在错综复杂的相关（如策略、业务、财务、合规）之间拉齐共识，探寻复杂挑战的最优解并强力推进项目落地。

• 人才教练： 认可并善于激发团队成员的潜力，能够为下属设定清晰的发展目标、提供建设性反馈，并推行轮岗与技能拓宽，打造高绩效的自驱型敏捷组织。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position 全面统筹罗氏中国MCE渠道数据的治理与渠道折扣的体系化运作。在确保渠道数据（DDI）、与折扣管理的绝对准确、完整、及时与合规的基础上，以前瞻性的行业视野，引入自动化、智能化（AI）等先进的数据管理工具与系统，驱动业务流程的精益化重塑。引领渠道数据团队进行精益化、数智化的转型，实现团队效能的降本增效。同时通过精准的数据洞察赋能商业决策，打造行业领先的渠道数据管理生态标杆。 您将有机会： 1. 渠道数据治理
• 全面统筹渠道数据（包含但不限于 DDI 直连数据、流向数据、进销存数据、主数据等）的日常直连、收集、清洗、校验等工作。
• 建立并优化数据管理体系，确保数据的准确性、完整性与及时性，满足公司对业务决策与追踪、财务审计及合规风控的要求。
• 协同内外部资源，探索并建立药品追溯码数据管理机制等，作为 DDI 数据以外的前瞻性战略补充。 2. 渠道折扣管理
• 负责渠道折扣管理标准流程与运作机制的设计与维护，确保其严格符合内外部法律法规与合规审计要求。
• 主导折扣名单、协议、计算、核对、发放、对账等全链路流程管理，确保折扣执行结果的严谨准确以及公司资金安全。
• 联合策略、财务与业务部门，定期监控与分析折扣兑付情况，为商业政策与折扣政策的迭代提供数据支撑。 3. 数智化转型与效能跃升
• 敏锐识别现有数据处理与折扣执行流程中的痛点，主导并落地 RPA、AI 工具、管理系统与平台等项目，为团队增优提效。 4. 业务赋能与跨部门协同
• 从海量数据中提炼业务洞察，搭建直观的数据看板与报告，为业务管理与决策提供数据支持。
• 与跨职能团队组成敏捷工作矩阵，协同实现渠道生态体系多元化业务价值的效能支撑。
• 助力渠道运营“集中化”建设，推动运营团队内部跨职能轮岗，实现运营团队跨职能深度融合与打通。 5. 团队领导与人才孵化

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。

A. 目标与计划管理

• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性

• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划

B. 客户管理与区域合作

• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。

C. 团队管理

• 参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划

• 吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展

• 打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景

D. 财务和合规管理

• 分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标

• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者

• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质

• 思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维

• 领导力特质：系统思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养

• 业务及资源规划能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

• 具有卓越合规意识，以身作则，带领团队业务在合规基石上稳健发展

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 主要工作目标
• 治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

主要职责
• 规范诊疗
• 1.基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
• 2.基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升
• 学科建设
• 1.访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 2.组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范
• 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

能力与经验
• 岗位所需胜任力
• ● 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识；3年以上医药行业工作经验
• ● 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• ● 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)
• ● 既往有销售/市场/医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
• 教育程度/所获资格证书
• ● 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
• ● 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试；在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Associate Manager - GMP/ GMP副经理
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement GMP-related systems, processes, and workflows for the production department.
● Develop and implement GMP training programs tailored to production staff, aligned with corporate quality policies and regulatory requirements.
● Establish the deviation management and CAPA processes in manufacturing for handling non- conformances effectively and ensuring timely resolutions.
● Implement a robust change control process, ensuring GMP compliance and proper documentation of changes in the production environment.
● Participate in the preparation for facility qualification audits and regulatory inspections, ensuring that all systems and practices meet GMP standards.
● Lead consumable materials/service introduction and track the status to ensure to meet the manufacturing requirement.
● Support the development of GMP documentation including SOPs, validation protocols, and project-specific documentation for compliance.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:
● Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.
● Serve as the primary interface between the production department and QA/Compliance teams for GMP-related matters.
● Manage ongoing GMP training programs, ensuring production personnel are regularly updated on GMP and compliance requirements.
● Oversee the timely identification, investigation, and resolution of deviations, ensuring proper execution of CAPAs to avoid recurrence.
● Evaluate and coordinate changes within the production department, ensuring proper implementation and documentation in line with regulatory requirements.
● Act as the production department’s primary liaison during internal and external audits, ensuring inspection readiness and addressing observations.
● Monitor GMP compliance in daily operations, identifying gaps and implementing corrective actions.
● Proactively identify areas for improvement in GMP operations, driving initiatives to enhance quality and productivity while maintaining compliance.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
● Bachelor’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies
● 5 or more years’ operation experience in GMP compliance roles in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.
● Experienced in strategic projects of facility including design, commissioning & qualification is preferred.
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.
● Hands-on experience in deviation handling, CAPA management, change control, and audit preparation is required.
● Familiarity with compliance tools and systems for managing training, deviations, and CAPAs.
● Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

jobs.title: （Senior) Specialist - Filling/分装(高级)专员
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, smoke study, VHP, Isolator EMPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.
● Support the initial development and optimization of aseptic filling processes.
● Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan.
● Trained and qualified on equipment operation and aseptic techniques.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:
● Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.
● Performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, filling and stoppering, capping.
● Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team.
● Support environmental monitoring activities to ensure that the Isolatore environment meets aseptic standards.
● Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA.
● Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime.
● Execute regular validation activities, such as APS.
● Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area.
● Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
● College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies
● 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.
● Experienced in strategic projects of Aseptic Filling facility including design, commissioning & qualification，Isolator filling line is preferred.
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.
● Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Maintenance Specialist (1st Shift)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Doing now what patients need next. A pioneer in the development of blood glucose monitoring and insulin delivery systems, Roche Diabetes Care is committed to helping people with diabetes live lives that are as normal and active as possible and helping healthcare professionals manage their patients' condition in an optimal way. The ACCU-CHEK® portfolio-from blood glucose monitoring through information management to insulin delivery - offers innovative products, services and comprehensive solutions for convenient, efficient and effective diabetes management.

Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

As a Maintenance Specialist , you will perform electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning electro-mechanical equipment used in the manufacturing process. You will dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches or drawings. You’ll use test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts. You will rebuild manufacturing equipment as required. You will also perform equipment modifications as directed by manufacturing engineers. You may use predictive maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies.

The Maintenance Specialist position will entail specialized knowledge of a particular area, system, or equipment and requires specific training and certification. You will apply some advanced skill to the position or specialization. You may adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Your duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks. You will resolve most questions and problems and refer only the most complex issues to higher levels. You will apply basic skills and may develop advanced skills appropriate for the position. Your duties and tasks are standardized. You will work under direct supervision and follow standard procedures to accomplish tasks.

You will also be responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

The opportunity :

• Performs troubleshooting to determine problems and may be required to do corrective maintenance. Completes preventative maintenance task according to detailed procedures and schedules. May provide emergency call-in support for operations that run during off-hours. Maintain accurate records of all activities.

• Provides technical set-up support for manufacturing areas.

• Performs equipment modifications, including installation, validation support and start-up, of new equipment as well as decommissioning activities.

Who you are:
Minimum Requirements:

• High school diploma or equivalency

• 4 years related operations or manufacturing experience

• In-depth knowledge of company policies a

jobs.title: Safety Data Acquisition & Partnering Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Are you ready to be at the forefront of patient safety and shape how critical data enters a global healthcare leader?

As a Safety Data Acquisition & Partnering Specialist , you will join our Patient Safety Operations team to build and secure the vital "Front-End" pillar of our safety data network. In this role, you will support strategic partnerships and ensure compliance, directly impacting our ability to deliver safe, life-changing innovations to patients worldwide. We strive for operational excellence as we deliver and oversee implementation activities of Safety agreements and monitor compliance.

This position offers you a unique opportunity to grow your expertise across two key operational areas: Data Acquisition implementation or Safety Agreement management. Working within a dynamic, cross-functional matrix environment, you will solve moderately complex operational challenges, collaborate with international stakeholders, and directly contribute to the smooth delivery of our global Patient Safety strategy.

• Manage safety agreements: Support global business process owners in developing, maintaining, and overseeing compliance for safety agreement templates.

• Monitor business performance: Provide expertise to develop and implement metrics, KPIs, and performance measures to track incoming data trends.

• Support mergers & acquisitions: Facilitate the efficient, compliant transfer of safety data and documentation during product and company acquisitions.

• Collaborate with suppliers: Proactively partner with internal and external suppliers, providing pharmacovigilance (PV) guidance to ensure absolute alignment.

• Implement data collection: Support the scoping of new data sources and implement innovative methods to collect safety data within an evolving strategy.

• Ensure audit readiness: Perform quality assurance activities related to safety agreement implementation to support inspections and audits.

• Drive operational excellence: Apply Roche ways of working to daily tasks, collaborate with matrix teams, and support the Quality Management System.

Who You Are

You are an analytical, relationship-oriented professional who thrives in a process-focused environment and loves solving complex puzzles. You are looking for a place where you can expand your expertise, take ownership of meaningful tasks, and collaborate with diverse global teams in an inclusive and supportive environment.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Relevant industry experience: Around 3 years of experience within a pharmacovigilance system, exposure to safety agreements management with degree- level qualification

• Regulatory & PV knowledge: A solid understanding of the drug development process, PV systems, and GVP/GCP regulations, experience in PV Agreements and/or Safety Data Exchange Agreements.

• Strong communication & influencing skills: Well-developed interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence across all levels without direct authority.

• Matrix collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively within global, cross-functional, or virtual team structures.

• Problem-solving mindset: Creative problem-solving abilities combined with excellent conflict resolution skills.

• Flexibility for travel: The ability and willingness to travel internationally (approximately 10%).

Location: This position is based in Budapest . Relocation Assistance is not available.

治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: (Sr.) Analyst, Analytical Lab, Biologics
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roles & Responsibilities

Routine Operation :

Perform the physical and chemical testing on the samples from incoming raw materials and packaging materials, produced bulks and products, environment monitoring, process validation and cleaning validation, etc. Issue the reliable analytical report in reasonable lead time.

Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements

Assist Head of Analytical Testing lab to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance. Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely to, internal investigations and regulatory inspectors.

Accomplish the calibration and maintenance of assigned instruments, to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time.

Report the abnormal status, unexpected results to supervisors with initiative.

By reporting abnormal status and unexpected results during analysis processing by detailed data and information to alert supervisor to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.

Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of bioanalytical materials and cell supplies

Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification

Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness :

Analytical method transfer execution: Support and execute the analytical method transfer for the aseptic product.

Analytical Method Validation and Qualification: Execute the methods comparison, qualification and validation activities.

Equipment Support: Support the Performance Qualification (PQ) of laboratory equipment and ensure routine operation.

Qualification and Experience

Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

Job Required Competencies

• 2 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on bioanalytical and bioassay testing. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred

• Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance and physical and chemical testing.

• Experienced in QC new facility startup readiness and operation ramp up is preferred.

• ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Fluent communications skills in English

• Project management skills is preferred.

jobs.title: P&C Business Partner (Advisory) - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
What we do:
The People Support Solutions (PSS) organization brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions. Join us now and be part of our unique transformational journey: we are building a global People & Culture (P&C/HR) Center of Excellence by bringing in talented HR professionals in order to cover complex and challenging HR functions and areas.

The Opportunity:
As a German speaking People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner (Advisory) you partner flexibly and mostly virtually with leaders across the globe, offering on-demand, ad-hoc support on Business Partnering topics that need more immediate or short-term guidance and value creation. With a good understanding of the business needs and the business context and an excellent ability to apply key P&C concepts, policies and processes, you provide coaching, guidance and support to leaders to help them diagnose and translate their business needs into immediate P&C approaches and ensure effective implementation of solutions in partnership with other chapters. You are a trusted member of the Business Partner Chapter and closely integrated into the PSS organization.
Your day to day responsibilities are:

• Strategic Guidance: Provide on-demand coaching and advisory to global leaders on critical P&C topics, including talent management, succession planning, performance management, and organizational design.

• Transformation Support: Lead and advise on complex organizational changes, transformations, and employee representation topics, ensuring risk-based decision-making and compliance with established policies.

• Global Rollouts: Deliver first-class support and coaching during the implementation of new global processes and projects, such as global grading systems or new system launches.

• Data-Driven Insights: Analyze P&C metrics and business data to recommend innovative solutions and provide insights that support our culture and strategic direction.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global/regional squads and PSS chapters to ensure the seamless execution of P&C initiatives and consistent policy application.

​
Who You Are:

• Experienced HR Professional: You bring 3–7 years of experience in similar roles such as HR Business Partnering, People Relations, or Labor Law.

• Bilingual Expert: You possess an excellent written and spoken command of both English and German, enabling you to support the DACH region and global stakeholders effectively.

• Skilled Coach & Communicator: You have a proven ability to provide difficult feedback, resolve conflicts, and influence leaders at all levels of management.

• Strategic Thinker: You can thoughtfully diagnose business needs, weigh the risks and benefits of various options, and propose fit-for-purpose HR approaches.

• You demonstrate strong knowledge in interpreting employment laws and policies, ensuring all solutions are legally sound and culturally sensitive.

• Agile Mindset: You thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, demonstrating high customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, and a passion for continuous learning.

• Relationship Builder: You are a natural networker who excels at navigating complex, matrixed reporting relationships across multiple cultures.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position What we do: The People Support Solutions (PSS) organization brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions. Join us now and be part of our unique transformational journey: we are building a global People & Culture (P&C/HR) Center of Excellence by bringing in talented HR professionals in order to cover complex and challenging HR functions and areas. The Opportunity: As a German speaking People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner (Advisory) you partner flexibly and mostly virtually with leaders across the globe, offering on-demand, ad-hoc support on Business Partnering topics that need more immediate or short-term guidance and value creation. With a good understanding of the business needs and the business context and an excellent ability to apply key P&C concepts, policies and processes, you provide coaching, guidance and support to leaders to help them diagnose and translate their business needs into immediate P&C approaches and ensure effective implementation of solutions in partnership with other chapters. You are a trusted member of the Business Partner Chapter and closely integrated into the PSS organization. Your day to day responsibilities are:
• Strategic Guidance: Provide on-demand coaching and advisory to global leaders on critical P&C topics, including talent management, succession planning, performance management, and organizational design.
• Transformation Support: Lead and advise on complex organizational changes, transformations, and employee representation topics, ensuring risk-based decision-making and compliance with established policies.
• Global Rollouts: Deliver first-class support and coaching during the implementation of new global processes and projects, such as global grading systems or new system launches.
• Data-Driven Insights: Analyze P&C metrics and business data to recommend innovative solutions and provide insights that support our culture and strategic direction.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global/regional squads and PSS chapters to ensure the seamless execution of P&C initiatives and consistent policy application. ​ Who You Are:
• Experienced HR Professional: You bring 3–7 years of experience in similar roles such as HR Business Partnering, People Relations, or Labor Law.
• Bilingual Expert: You possess an excellent written and spoken command of both English and German, enabling you to support the DACH region and global stakeholders effectively.
• Skilled Coach & Communicator: You have a proven ability to provide difficult feedback, resolve conflicts, and influence leaders at all levels of management.
• Strategic Thinker: You can thoughtfully diagnose business needs, weigh the risks and benefits of various options, and propose fit-for-purpose HR approaches.
• You demonstrate strong knowledge in interpreting employment laws and policies, ensuring all solutions are legally sound and culturally sensitive.
• Agile Mindset: You thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, demonstrating high customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, and a passion for continuous learning.
• Relationship Builder: You are a natural networker who excels at navigating complex, matrixed reporting relationships across multiple cultures. In Exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung

Unsere QC Mikrobiologie, bestehend aus 7 Mitarbeitenden, ist ein wichtiger Pfeiler in der Freigabe unserer diagnostischen Einsatzstoffe. Wir freuen uns auf ein hilfsbereites und flexibles neues Teammitglied, das Spaß an der täglichen Arbeit hat und eine positive Arbeitsatmosphäre unterstützt.
Wir möchten dir als Praktikant:in einen umfassenden Einblick in das „Daily Business“ der Qualitätskontrolle geben und dir zusätzlich die Möglichkeit bieten, dich aktiv in der Optimierung unserer Arbeitsabläufe einzubringen. Du erhältst spannende Einblicke in ein GMP-reguliertes Umfeld und lernst, wie man Qualität und Effizienz vereint.

Deine Aufgaben
Das Praktikum bietet dir eine spannende Mischung aus mikrobiologischer Analytik und der Mitarbeit an zukunftsgerichteten Projekten im Bereich Operational Excellence (OpEx):

1. Qualitätskontrolle & strategische Laborprojekte

• Routine & GMP: Du unterstützt bei der mikrobiologischen Analytik (z. B. Keimzahl- oder Endotoxinbestimmung) für die Freigabe diagnostischer Einsatzstoffe und sammelst wertvolle Praxis-Erfahrung im GMP-regulierten Umfeld.

• Nachhaltigkeit & Portfolio-Pflege: Du begleitest uns bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres Methoden-Portfolios. Dabei unterstützt du beispielsweise bei der Evaluierung nachhaltiger Alternativen oder bei der Vorbereitung auf neue digitale Labor-Systeme.

2. Operational Excellence (OpEx)

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Du hilfst uns dabei, etablierte Laborabläufe weiter zu optimieren und datenbasierte Potenziale für eine noch effizientere Arbeitsweise zu identifizieren.

• Lean-Kultur & Kommunikation: Du unterstützt dabei, Prozessdaten in anschauliche Erfolgsgeschichten zu übersetzen. Durch die kreative Gestaltung von internen News-Formaten (z. B. Interviews, digitale Beiträge) trägst du aktiv zu unserer Lean-Kultur bei.

Dein Profil

• Du bist aktuell in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium immatrikuliert (B.Sc. / M.Sc. Biologie, Mikrobiologie, Biochemie o.ä.) oder befindest dich in deinem Gap-Year.

• Du bringst bereits allgemeine praktische Laborerfahrung mit. Spezifische Grundkenntnisse in der Mikrobiologie sind dabei ein zusätzlicher Vorteil.

• Du bringst eine strukturierte, analytische Denkweise mit und hast Freude daran, Prozesse stetig zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern.

• Eine Affinität zu digitaler Kommunikation und die Kompetenz, Inhalte kreativ und ansprechend aufzubereiten, runden dein Profil ab.

• Erste Berührungspunkte mit Lean Management oder Operational Excellence sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss – am wichtigsten sind uns deine Neugier, Lernbereitschaft und Motivation!

• Du bist fließend in Deutsch (Wort und Schrift) und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit.

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine

• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

• Du lernst Roche Diagnostics Operations (Penzberg) kennen, einen der weltweit größten Hersteller von diagnostischen Einsatzstoffen

Deine Bewerbung

Denke daran, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann , auf welcher Universität/Hochs

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
In Roche’s China Early Development (ED) Center of Excellence (CoE), we play a critical role in accelerating the global early development of transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. We are a strategic partner to global early development teams of Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED), and pharma Product Development (PD) to integrate China into the global early development programs. Together, we bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This position is located in the clinical science function of Roche Product Development China, home of the China ED CoE. This position is dedicated to leading and driving early development programs in oncology and hematology therapeutic areas as a clinical lead.

The Opportunity
This role will have the opportunity to shape global early development strategy and CDP, to drive innovative early development trial design, to make significant impacts to the efficiency and success of our early development programs in oncology/hematology, and contribute to the China drug development innovation ecosystem.
In your role, you will:

• Contribute to and influence global asset strategy and early development CDP as a member of the global asset teams

• Proactively identify opportunities of accelerating and optimizing global ED CDP leveraging expertise, experience, speed, and scale in China

• Lead the China cross-functional team to evaluate opportunities of China joining global ED programs or China-first trials from strategic, scientific, regulatory, and operational perspectives

• Drive innovative trial design and trial conduct in close partnership with global early development functional experts on China-first clinical trials

• Being the Medical Monitor for China ED clinical trials

• Scientifically engage China TAEs, Roche internal and external stakeholders

• Serve as a scientific point of contact to global early development asset teams of oncology/hematology

• Mentor junior medical directors to further build capability and capacity of ED CoE

Who you are

• You hold a MD in oncology/hematology, or a Bachelor/Master of Clinical Medicine with at least 3 years of post-graduation clinical practice in oncology/hematology

• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry and extensive early development experience in oncology/hematology

• You have hands-on experience in developing early development CDP, designing and running early development clinical trials, interacting with Health Authorities, collaborating with investigators and clinical research You have a very good understanding of oncology/hematology global development guidelines and regulations, including CDE, FDA and EMEA

• You are an effective communicator: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts to global cross functional teams, governance committees and key stakeholders in a logical and succinct manner

• You are a great team player; highly collaborative, good interpersonal and influencing skills, can influence without authority

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 b

In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La posizione Nel Centro di Eccellenza (CoE) China Early Development (ED) di Roche, svolgiamo un ruolo fondamentale nell'accelerare lo sviluppo precoce globale di farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti, al fine di affrontare alcune delle esigenze sanitarie insoddisfatte più difficili del mondo. Siamo un partner strategico dei team globali di sviluppo iniziale di Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED) e pharma Product Development (PD) per integrare la Cina nei programmi globali di sviluppo iniziale. Insieme, portiamo avanti in tempi rapidi innovazioni straordinarie che cambiano la vita. Questa posizione si trova nella funzione di scienza clinica di Roche Product Development China, sede del China ED CoE. Questa posizione è dedicata alla guida e alla guida di programmi di sviluppo iniziale nelle aree terapeutiche di oncologia ed ematologia come responsabile clinico. L'opportunità Questo ruolo avrà l'opportunità di definire la strategia globale di sviluppo precoce e il CDP, di guidare la progettazione innovativa di sperimentazioni di sviluppo precoce, di avere un impatto significativo sull'efficienza e il successo dei nostri programmi di sviluppo precoce in oncologia/ematologia e di contribuire all'ecosistema di innovazione dello sviluppo di farmaci in Cina. Nel tuo ruolo:
• Contribuirai e influenzerai la strategia asset globale e il CDP di sviluppo iniziale come membro dei team asset globali
• Identificherai in modo proattivo opportunità di accelerazione e ottimizzazione del CDP globale per ED sfruttando competenza, esperienza, velocità e scala in Cina
• Guidarai il team interfunzionale cinese per valutare le opportunità della Cina di aderire ai programmi globali per ED o ai primi studi clinici in Cina da prospettive strategiche, scientifiche, normative e operative
• Guidare la progettazione di studi innovativi e la conduzione di studi in stretta collaborazione con esperti funzionali globali di sviluppo iniziale sui primi studi clinici in Cina
• Essere il Medical Monitor per gli studi clinici ED in Cina
• Coinvolgere scientificamente i TAE cinesi e le parti interessate interne ed esterne di Roche
• Servire come punto di contatto scientifico per i team globali di sviluppo iniziale di oncologia/ematologia
• Fare da mentore ai direttori medici junior per sviluppare ulteriormente le capacità e le capacità del CoE ED Chi sei
• Possiedi un MD in oncologia/ematologia o una laurea/master in Medicina Clinica con almeno 3 anni di pratica clinica post-laurea in oncologia/ematologia
• Hai almeno 5 anni di esperienza nel settore biofarmaceutico e una vasta esperienza di sviluppo iniziale in oncologia/ematologia
• Hai esperienza pratica nello sviluppo di CDP di sviluppo iniziale, progettazione e conduzione di studi clinici di sviluppo iniziale, interazione con le autorità sanitarie, collaborazione con ricercatori e ricerca clinica Hai un'ottima conoscenza delle linee guida e dei regolamenti di sviluppo globale di oncologia/ematologia, inclusi CDE, FDA ed EMEA
• Sei un comunicatore efficace: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese scritto e verbale, con la capacità di presentare concetti complessi a team interfunzionali globali, comitati di governance e le principali parti interessate in modo logico e conciso
• Sei un grande giocatore di squadra; altamente collaborativo, buone capacità interpersonali e di influenza, può influenzare senza autorità Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. I nostri sforzi si traducono in oltre 26 milioni di persone curate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 b

descriptionByLocale.it:

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. The Position In Roche’s China Early Development (ED) Center of Excellence (CoE), giochiamo un ruolo fondamentale nell’accelerare lo sviluppo precoce globale dei farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie non soddisfatte al mondo. Siamo un partner strategico per i team globali di sviluppo precoce di Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED), e pharma Product Development (PD) per integrare la Cina nei programmi globali di sviluppo precoce. Insieme, portiamo avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Questa posizione si trova nella funzione scientifica clinica di Roche Product Development Cina, sede della Cina ED CoE. Questa posizione è dedicata a guidare e guidare programmi di sviluppo precoce in aree terapeutiche di immunologia, neurologia, CVRM e oftalmologia come un piombo clinico. L'opportunità Questo ruolo avrà l'opportunità di plasmare la strategia globale di sviluppo precoce e il CDP, di guidare il design innovativo di prova di sviluppo precoce, di fare impatti significativi per l'efficienza e il successo dei nostri programmi di sviluppo precoce in aree terapeutiche di immunologia, neurologia, CVRM e oftalmologia, e contribuire all'ecosistema di innovazione di sviluppo della droga Cina.
• Contribuire e influenzare la strategia di asset globale e il CDP di sviluppo precoce come membro dei team di asset globali
• Identificare attivamente le opportunità di accelerare e ottimizzare il CDP globale ED sfruttando le competenze, l'esperienza, la velocità e la scala in Cina
• Guidare il team multifunzionale cinese per valutare le opportunità di unire i programmi globali di EDRM o la Cina-primi studi da prospettive strategiche, scientifiche, regolamentari e operative Chi sei? • Proactively identify opportunities of accelerating and optimizing global ED CDP leveraging expertise, experience, speed, and scale in China

• Scientifically engage China TAEs, Roche internal and external stakeholders
