jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【募集職種】 Clinician Engagement Sales_九州エリア担当
　　　　　　（小・中型医療機器のソリューション営業・保守サポート）

【職務内容】
担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、および開業医・クリニックに対し、中型医療機器（e411）および小型検査機器（Near Patient Care / POCT）の提案から導入後の保守点検まで、一貫した価値提供を担っていただきます。顧客の潜在的な課題を抽出し、現場に最適なオーダーメイド製品の提案を行い、導入から稼働後のアフターフォローまで伴走します。単なる機器の販売にとどまらず、検査の迅速化による院内ワークフローの改善や、救急・急性期医療における診療の質向上など、医療従事者との強固な信頼関係を構築しながら、患者ケアの質を高めるトータルソリューションを提供していただきます。また、定期的な保守点検やトラブルシューティングを通じて、機器が常に最適なパフォーマンスを発揮できるよう現場を支える重要な役割です。

＜具体的な業務内容＞
1. 提案・営業活動（Clinician Engagement）

• 担当エリア（大学病院、総合病院、クリニック、開業医）の医師、看護師、臨床検査技師などへのアプローチ

• 医療現場の課題のヒアリングと課題抽出

• ニーズに合わせた機器（cobas e 411、cobas pulse、cobas liatなど）や試薬のプレゼンテーション、デモンストレーションの実施

• 導入に伴う費用対効果（ROI）のシミュレーション、見積書作成、契約交渉

2. 導入・立ち上げサポート

• 機器納入時のセットアップおよび動作確認

• 医療従事者向けの操作説明会（アプリケーション・トレーニング）の実施

3. 保守点検・アフターフォロー（Technical Support）

• 契定期的な保守点検（メンテナンス）の実施

• 機器の不具合やエラー発生時の一次対応（電話によるリモートサポート、または現場への訪問・修理対応）

• 新しい試薬（検査項目）の追加提案や、最新の学術情報の提供

【応募資格（必須要件）】
医療業界における課題解決型の提案営業経験
（対象顧客：大学病院、総合病院、または開業医・クリニック等）
具体的には、以下のいずれかの経験において高い成果を上げている方：

• 単なるモノ売りではなく、自社のリソースを組み合わせたソリューション観点での提案を行ってきた経験

• 院長・事務長などの経営層や、医師・臨床検査技師などの現場担当者などのキーマンに対するアプローチおよび強固な関係構築経験

普通自動車第一種運転免許（AT限定可）

【歓迎要件（優遇スキル）】
・医療業界において、営業活動と保守サービス両方の業務を一貫して担ったご経験（ハイブリッド型のご経験）をお持ちの方
・エンジニアで、保守サービスなどのプロモーションや提案活動のご経験をお持ちの方
・臨床検査領域における専門知識、または同関連製品の営業経験

【求める人物像】
Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方

Achieving Results（結果志向）: 「顧客の課題解決」と「機器の安定稼働」という高い目標の達成に向け、新規提案からアフターフォローまで、当事者意識を持ち根気強く行動し続けられる方

Teamwork & Collaborations（協働と連携）: お客様に最適なトータルソリューションを届けるため、自身の役割や枠組みにとらわれず、社内のさまざまなステークホルダーを巻き込み、チームワークとコラボレーションを促進できる方

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 【募集職種】 Clinician Engagement Sales_九州エリア担当 （小・中型医療機器のソリューション営業・保守サポート） 【職務内容】 担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、および開業医・クリニックに対し、中型医療機器（e411）および小型検査機器（Near Patient Care / POCT）の提案から導入後の保守点検まで、一貫した価値提供を担っていただきます。顧客の潜在的な課題を抽出し、現場に最適なオーダーメイド製品の提案を行い、導入から稼働後のアフターフォローまで伴走します。単なる機器の販売にとどまらず、検査の迅速化による院内ワークフローの改善や、救急・急性期医療における診療の質向上など、医療従事者との強固な信頼関係を構築しながら、患者ケアの質を高めるトータルソリューションを提供していただきます。また、定期的な保守点検やトラブルシューティングを通じて、機器が常に最適なパフォーマンスを発揮できるよう現場を支える重要な役割です。 ＜具体的な業務内容＞ 1. 提案・営業活動（Clinician Engagement）
• 担当エリア（大学病院、総合病院、クリニック、開業医）の医師、看護師、臨床検査技師などへのアプローチ
• 医療現場の課題のヒアリングと課題抽出
• ニーズに合わせた機器（cobas e 411、cobas pulse、cobas liatなど）や試薬のプレゼンテーション、デモンストレーションの実施
• 導入に伴う費用対効果（ROI）のシミュレーション、見積書作成、契約交渉 2. 導入・立ち上げサポート
• 機器納入時のセットアップおよび動作確認
• 医療従事者向けの操作説明会（アプリケーション・トレーニング）の実施 3. 保守点検・アフターフォロー（Technical Support）
• 契定期的な保守点検（メンテナンス）の実施
• 機器の不具合やエラー発生時の一次対応（電話によるリモートサポート、または現場への訪問・修理対応）
• 新しい試薬（検査項目）の追加提案や、最新の学術情報の提供 【応募資格（必須要件）】 医療業界における課題解決型の提案営業経験 （対象顧客：大学病院、総合病院、または開業医・クリニック等） 具体的には、以下のいずれかの経験において高い成果を上げている方：
• 単なるモノ売りではなく、自社のリソースを組み合わせたソリューション観点での提案を行ってきた経験
• 院長・事務長などの経営層や、医師・臨床検査技師などの現場担当者などのキーマンに対するアプローチおよび強固な関係構築経験 普通自動車第一種運転免許（AT限定可） 【歓迎要件（優遇スキル）】 ・医療業界において、営業活動と保守サービス両方の業務を一貫して担ったご経験（ハイブリッド型のご経験）をお持ちの方 ・エンジニアで、保守サービスなどのプロモーションや提案活動のご経験をお持ちの方 ・臨床検査領域における専門知識、または同関連製品の営業経験 【求める人物像】 Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方 Achieving Results（結果志向）: 「顧客の課題解決」と「機器の安定稼働」という高い目標の達成に向け、新規提案からアフターフォローまで、当事者意識を持ち根気強く行動し続けられる方 Teamwork & Collaborations（協働と連携）: お客様に最適なトータルソリューションを届けるため、自身の役割や枠組みにとらわれず、社内のさまざまなステークホルダーを巻き込み、チームワークとコラボレーションを促進できる方 雇用形態および期間 雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用） 試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり） 業務内容 （雇い入れ直後）：募集職種 Clinician Engagement Sales （変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり 就業場所 （雇い入れ直後）: 福岡オフィス 〒812-0011 福岡県福岡市博多区博多駅前1-4-4東京建物博多ビル 12F （変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする 給与 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～ ※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。 ＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月） 諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など ※各種手当は当社規定により支給 労働時間・休憩時間 所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分 勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用 標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00 （※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。） 時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ） 休日および休暇 休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日 休暇: ・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり） ・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休 暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など） 福利厚生・社会保険 ：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険 受動喫煙防止措置 屋内全面禁煙 募集者名 ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社 (Roche Diagnostics K.K.) jobs.title: Key Account Manager- Sustain
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This unique opportunity joins our dynamic commercial team in Costa Rica, driving strategic partnerships across the Central America and Caribbean region . As the Key Account Manager – Sustain , you will champion a collaborative culture that unites cross-functional internal departments and local distributors to shape the future of healthcare . You will play a vital role in transforming institutional customer relationships into high-value strategic partnerships that expand our business footprint .
Drives the establishment and maintenance of long-term customer relationships by providing outstanding customer service. Proactively leads the coordination of all internal departments as the primary point of contact for key accounts.

The Opportunity:

• Strategic Partnerships: Transform operational customer relationships into high-value, long-term strategic alliances with key institutional stakeholders.

• Commercial Growth: Drive sales growth, market share, and profitability across all product portfolios using creative channel and segment-filling strategies.

• Workflow Optimization: Partner with accounts to analyze workflows and implement integrated Roche solutions that maximize efficiency.

• Contract & Financial Oversight: Monitor contract compliance and manage financial aspects, including sales forecasting, P&L analysis, inventory, and collections.

• "One Roche" Collaboration: Lead cross-departmental alignment across internal teams (Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Pharma, etc.) to ensure seamless service delivery and account retention.

• Distributor Alignment: Coordinate with local distributors to optimize logistics, protect contract retention, and support joint commercial goals.

• Project Management: Act as senior project manager for the end-to-end implementation of complex diagnostics solutions.

• Executive Reporting: Design and present business status updates, account health indicators, and strategic milestones during regional and executive reviews.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Build trust and long-term relationships with stakeholders at all levels, from technical staff to C-suite executives.

• Account Intelligence & CRM: Maintain deep knowledge of accounts' short- and long-term strategies, utilizing CRM tools ( Gold/Blue Sheets and REXIS ).

• Market & Trend Analysis: Gather business intelligence on competitor activities, industry trends, and healthcare shifts to protect and grow accounts.

• Continuous Compliance: Achieve top-tier sales proficiency while strictly adhering to company policies, compliance procedures, and high customer care standards.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor's degree from an accredited university, preferably in healthcare sciences or a related field .

• You possess a minimum of 6–8 years of progressive experience in sales, key account management, or business development (B2B environment) within healthcare diagnostics, medical devices, or pharmaceutical industries .

• You have a proven track record of transforming enterprise-level customer accounts, establishing value-based strategic alliances, and successfully managing large-scale negotiations .

• You demonstrate business acumen with advanced financial skills in analyzing account profitability, profit and loss conditions, and commercial efficiency models .

• You are an elite communicator and resilient matrix leader, capable of establishing trust, authority, and confidence with stakeholders at all levels, while coaching cross-functional teams without direct authority .

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is based in Costa Rica, working with the Central America & The Caribbean region, driving healthcare accessibility by matching customer needs with value-added diagnostics solutions. We operate in a highly collaborative matrix environment, offering a dynamic workplace where you can directly impact local market growth and build long-term relationships with key industry stakeholders. The extensive variety of diagnostic lines and strategic commercial initiatives in this division offers you exceptional learning and professional growth opportunities.

This role drives market share expansion across all product lines within the Roche Diagnostics portfolio by matching customer needs with value-added medical and commercial solutions.

The Opportunity:

• Market Expansion & Acquisition: Drive intense market share growth in the Costa Rican healthcare sector by identifying, prospecting, and converting net-new and competitive accounts.

• Strategic Account Management: Map and penetrate current strategic accounts to uncover and execute high-value cross-selling and up-selling opportunities across all diagnostic product lines.

• Competitive Intelligence: Maintain robust business intelligence on competitor positioning, market disruptions, and tendering timelines to exploit vulnerabilities and secure long-term contracts.

• Stakeholder Engagement (C-Suite): Build long-term, trusted relationships with key stakeholders across public and private sectors, from technical laboratory staff to C-Suite executives.

• Strategic Negotiations: Design and execute creative, data-driven negotiation strategies for complex public and private tenders, leveraging cross-departmental insights to maximize win rates.

• Distributor Alignment: Partner with and lead local distributors to align target positioning, pricing strategies, localized logistics, and customer retention/acquisition initiatives.

• Financial Accountabilities: Deliver on established sales quotas and profitability goals through a deep understanding of each opportunity’s P&L, volume forecasting, and inventory levels.

• Project Management & Implementation: Act as Project Manager for the end-to-end implementation process of Roche Diagnostics’ solutions, ensuring seamless onboarding.

• Strategic Methodology (CRM): Utilize Miller Heiman methodologies (Blue/Gold Sheets) within CRM tools to analyze stakeholder motivators, map account strategies, and maintain pipeline health.

• Cross-Functional Leadership ("One Roche"): Lead alignment and collaboration across internal areas (Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Medical, Pharma) to drive unified business continuity.

• Executive Reporting: Prepare and present strategic account performance, pipeline health, and milestone wins during regional Commercial and Business Review meetings.
​

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor's degree from an accredited university, preferably in healthcare sciences, business management, or related fields.

• You possess a minimum of 4–5 years of progressive experience in sales, business development, or marketing, preferably within a B2B healthcare or diagnostics environment.

• You are characterized by a structured, proactive, and strategic mindset with excellent business acumen, financial understanding, and analytical skills.

• You are a resilient matrix leader with a proven ability to influence and collaborate with cross-functional teams, managing strict timelines in high-pressure environments.

• You have exceptional interpersonal, negotiation,

jobs.title: IT Infrastructure Engineer - RDT ERP
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The ERP Platform Engineer is a seasoned technical expert who focuses on engineering, managing, and optimizing enterprise resource planning (ERP) platforms, such as SAP, to ensure robust performance and scalability. In this role, you will take ownership of complex technical topics, providing platform support through streamlined processes and advanced tools. By proactively challenging the status quo, fostering collaboration, and formulating technical strategies that align seamlessly with organizational objectives, you will mentor team members and improve the overall platform delivery and lifecycle management process.

Description of the area
As an IT Infrastructure Engineer, you'll be part of an exciting journey - designing, installing, running, operating, and decommissioning infrastructure platforms that power critical applications for Roche.

What You'll Do:

• Collaborate with a team of like-minded professionals to achieve squad goals and make a real impact.

• Foster a culture of continuous growth and partnership within the squad, ensuring seamless collaboration with application owners and other infrastructure product teams.

• Play a crucial role in evolving our infrastructure platform, keeping it up-to-date and ready to support the technology roadmap of the applications it hosts.

• Provide 24/7 support for the platform, because we believe in being there for our systems.

• Embrace the opportunity to learn and develop your skills, even if you don't tick all the qualification boxes. Your drive and interest matter to us

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership) & Accountability/Problem Solving: Takes ownership of ambiguous tasks and topics in the "grey zone" (where there is no defined owner) and successfully drives small to medium (S/M) initiatives at the project, squad, or product level. Challenges the status quo, skillfully navigates group dynamics in diversified settings, and fosters good collaboration, knowledge sharing, coaching, and mentoring.

• Stakeholder Management: Prioritizes and communicates with stakeholders effectively. Maintains a "bigger picture" view to thoroughly understand how various technical and platform components fit into the overall product strategy and goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Acts as a technical mentor and aligns development and platform plans with the global strategy. Actively gives speeches and shares knowledge in internal events (e.g., DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live). Engages in the organization of knowledge-sharing events and gets involved in initiatives or tasks reaching outside of the regular project scope.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates at the Product or Site level, making a direct impact on the technical decisions within the product and the ways of working of other chapter members.

• Business / Technical ability: Possesses a deep understanding of the broader technical landscape beyond the specific ERP component being worked on. Formulates and implements technical strategies aligned with organizational objectives. Invests time and energy in initiatives that boost creativity and innovation while creating solutions with the highest engineering quality. Understands and applies agile principles in daily development and platform management tasks.

Qualifications

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent working experience.

• Hands-on experience (3+ years) with infrastructure technologies like Windows Server, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, VMWare vSphere/Nu

The Position Job description The ERP Platform Engineer is a seasoned technical expert who focuses on engineering, managing, and optimizing enterprise resource planning (ERP) platforms, such as SAP, to ensure robust performance and scalability. In this role, you will take ownership of complex technical topics, providing platform support through streamlined processes and advanced tools. By proactively challenging the status quo, fostering collaboration, and formulating technical strategies that align seamlessly with organizational objectives, you will mentor team members and improve the overall platform delivery and lifecycle management process. Description of the area As an IT Infrastructure Engineer, you'll be part of an exciting journey - designing, installing, running, operating, and decommissioning infrastructure platforms that power critical applications for Roche. What You'll Do:
• Collaborate with a team of like-minded professionals to achieve squad goals and make a real impact.
• Foster a culture of continuous growth and partnership within the squad, ensuring seamless collaboration with application owners and other infrastructure product teams.
• Play a crucial role in evolving our infrastructure platform, keeping it up-to-date and ready to support the technology roadmap of the applications it hosts.
• Provide 24/7 support for the platform, because we believe in being there for our systems.
• Embrace the opportunity to learn and develop your skills, even if you don't tick all the qualification boxes. Your drive and interest matter to us Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership) & Accountability/Problem Solving: Takes ownership of ambiguous tasks and topics in the "grey zone" (where there is no defined owner) and successfully drives small to medium (S/M) initiatives at the project, squad, or product level. Challenges the status quo, skillfully navigates group dynamics in diversified settings, and fosters good collaboration, knowledge sharing, coaching, and mentoring.
• Stakeholder Management: Prioritizes and communicates with stakeholders effectively. Maintains a "bigger picture" view to thoroughly understand how various technical and platform components fit into the overall product strategy and goals.
• Impact/Strategy: Acts as a technical mentor and aligns development and platform plans with the global strategy. Actively gives speeches and shares knowledge in internal events (e.g., DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live). Engages in the organization of knowledge-sharing events and gets involved in initiatives or tasks reaching outside of the regular project scope.
• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates at the Product or Site level, making a direct impact on the technical decisions within the product and the ways of working of other chapter members.
• Business / Technical ability: Possesses a deep understanding of the broader technical landscape beyond the specific ERP component being worked on. Formulates and implements technical strategies aligned with organizational objectives. Invests time and energy in initiatives that boost creativity and innovation while creating solutions with the highest engineering quality. Understands and applies agile principles in daily development and platform management tasks. Qualifications
• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent working experience.
• Hands-on experience (3+ years) with infrastructure technologies like Windows Server, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, VMWare vSphere/Nu

jobs.title: Data Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Lead Data Architect – Clinical Imaging and AI Platforms will lead the design, governance, and evolution of enterprise imaging and multi-modal data ecosystems, ensuring alignment with GxP, SaMD, FAIR, and clinical data governance frameworks. This role serves as the strategic bridge between scientific, business, and technology organizations across Research, Product Development, RIS, and RDT, translating business priorities into scalable, secure, and interoperable data architectures.
The role is responsible for defining enterprise data architecture strategy and establishing standards for metadata, interoperability, lineage, and AI-ready data models. It will enable scalable analytics and AI/ML workflows for Research (REDs) and Product Development(PD) while driving modernization of imaging data platforms in partnership with engineering, informatics, and governance teams.

Job Responsibilities

• Define and execute the enterprise data architecture strategy and roadmap for multi-modal imaging and research data within the Global Imaging Platform (GIP ).

• Design scalable and interoperable data architectures supporting Radiology, Digital Pathology, AI/ML, clinical, and translational research workflows.

• Establish and enforce standards for data modeling, metadata management, lineage, interoperability, cataloging, and governance across structured and unstructured datasets in close partnership with the Data managers and Study teams.

• Lead the design and implementation of cloud-native data platforms, data lakes/lakehouses, and distributed analytics ecosystems supporting global R&D and clinical initiatives.

• Partner with scientific, clinical, and technical stakeholders to translate business and research requirements into scalable, compliant, and reusable data solutions.

• Act as the primary architecture lead for imaging and multi-modal data ecosystems, coordinating across gRED, pRED, PD, RDT, RIS, and enterprise IT functions.

• Ensure alignment with GxP, FAIR standards, HIPAA/GDPR, security, privacy, and enterprise governance standards across all data architecture initiatives.

• Drive enterprise-wide adoption of common data models, interoperability standards, APIs, and semantic frameworks to improve data accessibility and reusability.

• Collaborate with engineering and platform teams to design robust data ingestion, transformation, storage, and access patterns optimized for AI/ML and advanced analytics, focussed on biomarker research and analysis of Imaging data.

• Define architecture patterns for high-volume imaging and pathology data, including metadata indexing, streaming, archival, and federated access strategies.

• Lead modernization efforts for legacy data environments towards scalable and efficient hybrid architectures.

• Drive automation and standardization across data lifecycle management, data quality monitoring, observability, and governance workflows.

• Oversee architecture reviews, technical governance, and cross-functional design decisions to ensure consistency, scalability, and operational excellence.

• Identify and implement opportunities to improve scalability, cost optimization, performance, automation, and operational efficiency across enterprise data platforms.

• Monitor emerging technologies and industry trends in data platforms, imaging data formats, AI/ML ecosystems, digital pathology, interoperability, and data standards to guide innovation and future-state architecture.

• Drive the evolution of AI-ready and semantically enriched

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - Manufacturing Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Security Engineer plays a vital role in protecting Roche Manufacturing systems and networks against cybersecurity threats. This role is responsible for local architecture and engineering support, helping system owners and administrators in keeping their manufacturing environment up to date with the latest Roche Manufacturing Cybersecurity standards, baselines and industry best practices. Some of this role’s responsibilities are:

• Taking part in technical design reviews, integration, testing, and documentation activities concerning new OT systems and/or changes to existing manufacturing system or infrastructure

• Supporting development of Manufacturing Cybersecurity standards and baselines OT Cybersecurity Advisor during OT System planning phase and OT System Risk Assessment process

• Advising System Owners in selecting appropriate security measures to mitigate risk

• Coordinating of OT services and activities delivered by Vendors

• Reviewing local technical designs as part of Manufacturing Cybersecurity Requests (in ServiceNow)

• Designing and sustaining OT Security Monitoring (IIDS) at the Manufacturing Site

• Providing technical support during Incident Response process including steps to minimize the impact, conducting a technical and forensic investigation into how the breach happened and the extent of the damage

• Working closely with System Owners, Cybersecurity Site Representative and is a catalyst for cross-site collaboration on topics related to Manufacturing Cybersecurity

The Senior Security Engineer is a member of the Manufacturing Cybersecurity Engineering team led by the Head of Manufacturing Cybersecurity Engineering and part of the Security Platforms subfunction in the Information Security function at Roche.

Job Responsibilities

• Independently manages end-to-end security analysis tasks across various capabilities and contributes to more complex problems

• Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of security best practices

• Stakeholder Management

• Identifies a diverse range of security stakeholders across functional areas and effectively manages relationships to build reliance through deep business and technical understanding, acting as a trusted advisor

• Acts as a strategic influencer, defining and driving stakeholder engagement strategies for complex initiatives, facilitating workshops, resolving conflicts, and proactively shaping stakeholder perspectives to align with project goals

• Impact/Strategy

• Demonstrates strong and consistent performance across diverse products, with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster

• Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans that align with overall business objectives, and takes a proactive role in shaping team processes Complexity

• Manages business analysis activities on more complex projects or across multiple products within a domain

• Capable of handling ambiguous requirements, navigating intricate stakeholder environments, and evaluating solution impacts considering both immediate and longer-term implications within the domain

• Business/Technical ability

• Demonstrates a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies

• Can independently apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis, effectively managing interconnections to improve overall efficiency and effectiveness

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Mission:
En tant que spécialiste commercial d’une/plusieurs gammes de produit (Core Lab), vous êtes responsable du développement et de l’atteinte des objectifs commerciaux et de part de marché de vos gamme de produits en coopération avec les Key Account Managers (KAM) / Customer Success Managers (CSM)
Vous interagissez en tant qu'expert(e) auprès des KAM / CSM en définissant et en présentant au client les solutions techniques envisagées.

Lieu d’habitation : Région de Paris

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous développez et maintenez une connaissance très forte de la gamme de produits/solutions dont vous avez la charge, grâce à une forte interaction avec le marketing et les experts produits du groupe; est en mesure de répondre à toutes les questions des clients sur ces produites, en autonomie et sait promouvoir la Valeur ajoutée différenciante de l’offre Roche vs les compétiteurs.

• Vous partagez les informations et tendance concurrence /marché que vous identifiez aux équipes marketing Roche. A ce titre, vous pouvez Identifier et informer le marketing des solutions de

• Vous soutenez les KAM et CSM d'un point de vue technique, médical ou scientifique sur le sujet dont vous êtes l'expert dans une perspective de développement du compte concerné

• Vous collaborez avec les CSM et le KAM à la construction de la stratégie commerciale des comptes sur ces gammes en identifiant les opportunités de croissance.

• Vous portez avec votre équipe la responsabilité de l’atteinte des objectifs de CA et de profitabilité associés à la/les gammes dont vous avez la charge - channel filling inclus.

• Vous construisez des offres spécifiques basées sur la compréhension des besoins clients en incluant les tierces parties nécessaires et en vous assurant notamment de la bonne adéquation entre l'offre commerciale et l'environnement opérationnel du client (CQ, repasse, volume, interface avec les autres chapters). Pour les dossiers AO publics - vous collaborez à la réponse financière et au pricing de la solution.

• Vous contribuez au sein de son équipe à l’amélioration de la performance de la/les gammes dont vous avez la responsabilité.

• Vous garantissez le respect de la compliance dans les relations avec le client

Qui vous êtes:

• De formation scientifique ou technique, vous maîtrisez l'environnement de la santé et les enjeux de l'industrie du Diagnostic In Vitro (DIV).

• Reconnu pour votre intelligence situationnelle et votre aisance relationnelle, vous maîtrisez l'art de la négociation et de la contractualisation de haut niveau.

• Doté d'une écoute active, vous savez traduire les demandes clients en solutions concrètes, conseiller avec valeur ajoutée et aligner vos interlocuteurs autour d'une vision stratégique commune.

• Vous possédez une forte capacité à inspirer, engager et influencer positivement. Vous excellez dans la collaboration transversale et la coopération hors lien hiérarchique.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: Solution Architect - Identity & Access Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The IAM Solution Architect is a high-impact technical leadership role accountable for the architectural integrity, long-term technical strategy, and evolution of the global Identity & Access Management ecosystem. Reporting directly to the Head of Identity & Access Management, you serve as a strategic technical advisor, bridging the gap between broad security goals and the tangible roadmap for our seven core enterprise IAM pillars.
While this is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, you are a vital member of the IAM Leadership Team (LT). You will orchestrate a broader ecosystem of technical leads and product leaders to ensure that every solution is desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable. Your mission is to define the technical vision that enables a seamless, "Zero Trust" user experience while protecting the company’s most critical digital assets.
Your primary objective is to architect a unified Identity Fabric that balances the Information Security Strategy, ensures harmony across the IAM ecosystem, and guarantees an optimal end-user experience while protecting the company’s most critical digital assets.

Job Responsibilities

Strategy & Roadmap Definition

• Architectural Vision: Provide expert technical knowledge to define the overarching IAM strategy and multi-year technology roadmaps in alignment with the overall Information Security’s vision.

• Roadmap Support: Support the Head of IAM and the Leadership Team in transforming complex scientific and business needs into high-value technology solutions.

• Trend Integration: Proactively monitor market shifts and technology trends, including AI/ML capabilities, to inform product iterations and maintain a competitive advantage.

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership

• Product Leader Support: Provide technical consultancy and architectural oversight to the 7 IAM areas (Enterprise Identity, Access Management, Customer Identity, Data Access Control, Privileged Access Management, External Identity, and Directory Services).

• Zero Trust Catalyst: Champion modern principles such as "Never Trust, Always Verify" and "Policy-as-Code," ensuring these are integrated into CI/CD and DevSecOps workflows.

• Continuous Platform Evolution: Drive ongoing collaboration with RDT Functions and business stakeholders to ensure the continuous evolution of our IAM platforms, delivering services that meet emerging needs.

Technical Excellence & Lifecycle Management

• Lifecycle Oversight: Actively contribute to the lifecycle management of technological components, from initial ideation and strategic planning to decommissioning.

• Operational Integrity: Ensure that solutions integrate seamlessly with existing systems, deliver high performance, and provide an intuitive user experience.

• Compliance & Standards: Guarantee that all technical architectures comply with GxP, CSV, and global data privacy regulations like GDPR.

• Mentorship: Actively coach and provide technical guidance to specialists and engineers across the IAM organization to foster a strong product culture.

Qualifi cations

You are a technical visionary with an "Enterprise Mindset" who can break down silos and bring diverse groups together toward a common purpose. You are someone who wants to influence the development of global security standards and thrives in a complex, multi-national environment.

• 10+ years of successful technical experience supporting Enterprise IAM and IT Security systems in a major globa

• Product Leader Support: Provide technical consultancy and architectural oversight to the 7 IAM areas (Enterprise Identity, Access Management, Customer Identity, Data Access Control, Privileged Access Management, External Identity, and Directory Services).
• Zero Trust Catalyst: Champion modern principles such as "Never Trust, Always Verify" and "Policy-as-Code," ensuring these are integrated into CI/CD and DevSecOps workflows.
• Continuous Platform Evolution: Drive ongoing collaboration with RDT Functions and business stakeholders to ensure the continuous evolution of our IAM platforms, delivering services that meet emerging needs. Technical Excellence & Lifecycle Management
• Lifecycle Oversight: Actively contribute to the lifecycle management of technological components, from initial ideation and strategic planning to decommissioning.
• Operational Integrity: Ensure that solutions integrate seamlessly with existing systems, deliver high performance, and provide an intuitive user experience.
• Compliance & Standards: Guarantee that all technical architectures comply with GxP, CSV, and global data privacy regulations like GDPR.
• Mentorship: Actively coach and provide technical guidance to specialists and engineers across the IAM organization to foster a strong product culture. You are someone who wants to influence the development of global security standards and thrives in a complex, multi-national environment.

jobs.title: Project Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Our Insulin Therapy Solutions division is dedicated to providing world-class products for people with diabetes. We work with a holistic approach, which means that we take care of our product portfolio from the idea, through development and bringing products to the market, to phase-out. This includes in-house developments, strategic partnerships and collaborations. We achieve our goals in a very close and collaborative partnership with all global functions at Roche Diabetes Care and the entire Roche family (Dia and Pharma).

As Project Lead you will act as global business lead in the new Continuous Monitoring Lifecycle Team (LCT) with focus on FDA approval of our CGM Solution. You will be the central point of contact for colleagues from the affiliates for questions regarding the introduction of our CGM Solution into the US market and will lead the corresponding project team. In this exciting and diverse role, you will report directly to the Lifecycle Leader (LCL).

You will take on the strategic task of introducing a new medical device (CGM) in the US. You will be responsible for decision making, leadership, planning and ensuring efficient and effective utilization of resources. You will achieve success by managing executives, professionals and/or support staff. You will set the strategy for your department and have full HR responsibility for your employees.

The Opportunity

• You will be responsible for providing cross-functional leadership and management to ensure product launches are delivered to timelines, budgets and specifications (All projects (incl. PCQT projects).

• You will ensure planning and adherence to budgets, timelines, risk mitigation plans and resources in coordination with stakeholders in Finance, Project Management, Operations and R&D.

• You will develop global product development strategies from project initiation to the market launch decision. In particular, you will develop strategic options based on the principles of time, cost and risk, taking into account technical, regulatory, business and operational requirements.

• You will communicate the risks of solution development and the implementation of risk mitigation plans.

• You lead, motivate and organize the project team (based on Roche leadership principles) to define and implement an innovative and sustainable project strategy in line with LCT objectives and budget.

• You will demonstrate leadership skills among PL colleagues to drive cross LCT and CA/BA project discussions, create a positive environment, encourage creative or unconventional ideas and ensure they are utilized by the team.

Who you are

• Degree in science, engineering or equivalent (MBA or PhD is an advantage).

• +8 years of relevant professional experience in project management and leadership and ideally more than 6 years of relevant professional experience in diagnostics or pharma in development or operations.

• Experience in MDR and IVDR, references regarding product approval projects in the US (510k or equivalent)

• You have leadership skills in managing multidisciplinary teams in a global matrix environment: Here you have experience in developing and building teams and manage change and conflict resolution.

• You have proven experience with (FDA) projects in the range of the portfolio (FDA relevant study planning and execution, FDA approval processes, as well as experience in interacting with the US FDA)

• You communicate clearly, present accurately and stakeholder-oriented in front of large groups

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La divisione Position Our Insulin Therapy Solutions è dedicata a fornire prodotti di livello mondiale per le persone con diabete. Lavoriamo con un approccio olistico, il che significa che ci occupiamo del nostro portafoglio di prodotti dall'idea, attraverso lo sviluppo e portare i prodotti al mercato, alla fase-out. Questo include sviluppi interni, partnership strategiche e collaborazioni. Conseguiamo i nostri obiettivi in una collaborazione molto stretta e collaborativa con tutte le funzioni globali di Roche Diabetes Care e dell'intera famiglia Roche (Dia e Pharma). Come Project Lead si agirà come leader di business globale nel nuovo Continuous Monitoring Lifecycle Team (LCT) con focus sull'approvazione della FDA della nostra soluzione CGM. Sarete il punto centrale di contatto per i colleghi delle affiliate per domande circa l'introduzione della nostra soluzione CGM nel mercato statunitense e guiderà il team di progetto corrispondente. In questo ruolo emozionante e diversificato, si riferirà direttamente al Lifecycle Leader (LCL). Si assumerà il compito strategico di introdurre un nuovo dispositivo medico (CGM) negli Stati Uniti. Sarete responsabili per il processo decisionale, la leadership, la pianificazione e garantire un utilizzo efficiente ed efficace delle risorse. Conseguirai il successo gestendo dirigenti, professionisti e/o personale di supporto. Impostare la strategia per il vostro dipartimento e avere piena responsabilità HR per i vostri dipendenti. Opportunità
• Sarete responsabili di fornire leadership e gestione interfunzionali per garantire che i lanci dei prodotti siano consegnati a tempi, budget e specifiche (tutti i progetti (compresi i progetti PCQT).
• Garantirai la pianificazione e l'adesione a budget, linee temporali, piani di mitigazione del rischio e risorse in coordinamento con gli stakeholder in Finanza, Project Management, Operazioni e R&D.
• Si svilupperà strategie globali di sviluppo del prodotto dall'avvio del progetto alla decisione di lancio del mercato. In particolare, svilupperai opzioni strategiche basate sui principi di tempo, costi e rischi, tenendo conto dei requisiti tecnici, normativi, aziendali e operativi.
• Comunicherà i rischi di sviluppo della soluzione e l'attuazione dei piani di mitigazione del rischio.
• Guida, motiva e organizza il team di progetto (basato sui principi di leadership Roche) per definire e implementare una strategia di progetto innovativa e sostenibile in linea con gli obiettivi e il budget LCT.
• Potrai dimostrare competenze di leadership tra i colleghi PL per guidare le discussioni di progetto LCT e CA/BA, creare un ambiente positivo, incoraggiare idee creative o non convenzionali e garantire che siano utilizzati dal team. Chi sei
• Laurea in scienze, ingegneria o equivalente (MBA o PhD è un vantaggio).
• +8 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante nella gestione e nella leadership del progetto e idealmente più di 6 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante nella diagnostica o nel farmaco nello sviluppo o nelle operazioni.
• Esperienza in MDR e IVDR, riferimenti a progetti di approvazione dei prodotti negli Stati Uniti (510k o equivalente)
• Hai competenze di leadership nella gestione di team multidisciplinari in un ambiente di matrice globale: Qui avete esperienza nello sviluppo e nella costruzione di team e gestire il cambiamento e la risoluzione dei conflitti.
• Hai dimostrato esperienza con i progetti (FDA) nella gamma del portafoglio (FDA relativa pianificazione e esecuzione di studio, processi di approvazione della FDA, così come l'esperienza nell'interazione con la FDA degli Stati Uniti)
• Comunichi chiaramente, presenti con precisione e orientati agli stakeholder di fronte a grandi gruppi

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Unsere Abteilung für Insulintherapielösungen widmet sich der Bereitstellung von Weltklasse-Produkten für Menschen mit Diabetes. Wir arbeiten mit einem ganzheitlichen Ansatz, das heißt, wir kümmern uns um unser Produktportfolio von der Idee über die Entwicklung und Markteinführung bis hin zum Ausstieg. Dazu gehören interne Entwicklungen, strategische Partnerschaften und Kooperationen. Wir erreichen unsere Ziele in einer sehr engen und kooperativen Partnerschaft mit allen globalen Funktionen bei Roche Diabetes Care und der gesamten Roche-Familie (Dia und Pharma). Als Projektleiter fungieren Sie als globaler Business Lead im neuen Continuous Monitoring Lifecycle Team (LCT) mit Schwerpunkt auf der FDA-Zulassung unserer CGM-Lösung. Sie sind die zentrale Anlaufstelle für Kollegen aus den Affiliates bei Fragen zur Einführung unserer CGM-Lösung in den US-Markt und leiten das entsprechende Projektteam. In dieser spannenden und vielfältigen Rolle berichten Sie direkt an den Lifecycle Leader (LCL). Sie übernehmen die strategische Aufgabe, ein neues Medizinprodukt (CGM) in den USA einzuführen. Sie sind für die Entscheidungsfindung, Führung, Planung und Sicherstellung einer effizienten und effektiven Nutzung der Ressourcen verantwortlich. Sie werden Erfolg erzielen, indem Sie Führungskräfte, Fachleute und / oder Support-Mitarbeiter leiten. Sie legen die Strategie für Ihre Abteilung fest und tragen die volle HR-Verantwortung für Ihre Mitarbeiter. Die Chance
• Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, eine funktionsübergreifende Führung und Verwaltung bereitzustellen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Produkteinführungen nach Zeitplänen, Budgets und Spezifikationen erfolgen (Alle Projekte (einschließlich PCQT-Projekte).
• Sie gewährleisten die Planung und Einhaltung von Budgets, Zeitplänen, Risikominderungsplänen und Ressourcen in Abstimmung mit Stakeholdern in den Bereichen Finanzen, Projektmanagement, Betrieb und F & E.
• Sie entwickeln globale Produktentwicklungsstrategien von der Projektinitiierung bis zur Markteinführungsentscheidung. Insbesondere entwickeln Sie strategische Optionen, die auf den Prinzipien Zeit, Kosten und Risiko basieren und technische, regulatorische, geschäftliche und operative Anforderungen berücksichtigen.
• Sie werden die Risiken der Lösungsentwicklung und die Umsetzung von Risikominderungsplänen kommunizieren.
• Sie leiten, motivieren und organisieren das Projektteam (basierend auf den Führungsprinzipien von Roche), um eine innovative und nachhaltige Projektstrategie im Einklang mit den LCT-Zielen und dem Budget zu definieren und umzusetzen.
• Sie werden Führungsqualitäten unter PL-Kollegen demonstrieren, um LCT- und CA / BA-Projektdiskussionen zu führen, ein positives Umfeld zu schaffen, kreative oder unkonventionelle Ideen zu fördern und sicherzustellen, dass sie vom Team genutzt werden. Wer du bist
• Abschluss in Naturwissenschaften, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder gleichwertig (MBA oder PhD ist von Vorteil).
• +8 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Projektmanagement und der Führung und idealerweise mehr als 6 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Diagnostik oder Pharma in Entwicklung oder Betrieb.
• Erfahrung in MDR und IVDR, Referenzen zu Produktzulassungsprojekten in den USA (510k oder gleichwertig)
• Sie haben Führungsqualitäten bei der Verwaltung multidisziplinärer Teams in einer globalen Matrixumgebung: Hier haben Sie Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und dem Aufbau von Teams und verwalten Veränderung und Konfliktlösung.
• Sie haben nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit (FDA) Projekten im Portfoliobereich (FDA relevante Studienplanung und -durchführung, FDA-Zulassungsprozesse sowie Erfahrung in der Interaktion mit der US FDA)
• Sie kommunizieren klar, präsent und Stakeholder-orientiert vor großen Gruppen

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Notre division Insulin Therapy Solutions est dédiée à la fourniture de produits de classe mondiale pour les personnes atteintes de diabète. Nous travaillons avec une approche holistique, ce qui signifie que nous prenons soin de notre portefeuille de produits de l'idée, en passant par le développement et la mise sur le marché, à l'élimination progressive. Cela comprend les développements internes, les partenariats stratégiques et les collaborations. Nous atteignons nos objectifs dans un partenariat très étroit et collaboratif avec toutes les fonctions mondiales de Roche Diabetes Care et toute la famille Roche (Dia et Pharma). En tant que chef de projet, vous jouerez le rôle de chef de file mondial dans la nouvelle équipe de surveillance continue du cycle de vie (LCT) en mettant l'accent sur l'approbation par la FDA de notre solution de MCC. Vous serez le point de contact central pour les collègues des filiales pour les questions concernant l'introduction de notre solution CGM sur le marché américain et dirigera l'équipe de projet correspondante. Dans ce rôle passionnant et diversifié, vous ferez rapport directement au Leader du cycle de vie (LCL). Vous assumerez la tâche stratégique d'introduire un nouvel appareil médical (CGM) aux États-Unis. Vous serez responsable de la prise de décisions, du leadership, de la planification et de l'utilisation efficiente et efficace des ressources. • Vous serez chargé d'assurer un leadership et une gestion interfonctionnels afin de s'assurer que les lancements de produits respectent les délais, les budgets et les spécifications (tous les projets (y compris les projets PCQT).

• Vous développerez des stratégies globales de développement de produits depuis l'initiation du projet jusqu'à la décision de lancement du marché. En particulier, vous élaborerez des options stratégiques fondées sur les principes du temps, des coûts et des risques, en tenant compte des exigences techniques, réglementaires, commerciales et opérationnelles.
• Vous communiquerez les risques liés à l'élaboration de solutions et à la mise en oeuvre de plans d'atténuation des risques.
• Vous dirigez, motivez et organisez l'équipe du projet (fondée sur les principes de leadership de Roche) pour définir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de projet innovante et durable conforme aux objectifs et au budget du LCT.
• Vous démontrerez des compétences de leadership parmi vos collègues PL pour mener des discussions transversales sur les projets LCT et CA/BA, créer un environnement positif, encourager des idées créatives ou non conventionnelles et s'assurer qu'elles sont utilisées par l'équipe. Qui vous êtes
• Diplôme en sciences, génie ou équivalent (MBA ou doctorat est un avantage).
• +8 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente en gestion de projet et en leadership et idéalement plus de 6 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente en diagnostic ou en pharmacologie dans le développement ou les opérations.
• Expérience en MDR et IVDR, références concernant les projets d'approbation de produits aux États-Unis (510k ou équivalent)
• Vous avez des compétences en leadership dans la gestion d'équipes multidisciplinaires dans un environnement matriciel global : Ici, vous avez de l'expérience dans le développement et la constitution d'équipes et gérer le changement et la résolution de conflits.
• Vous avez prouvé votre expérience avec des projets (FDA) dans la gamme du portefeuille (planification et exécution des études pertinentes de la FDA, processus d'approbation de la FDA, ainsi que l'expérience dans l'interaction avec la FDA américaine)
• Vous communiquez clairement, présentez avec précision et orientées vers les parties prenantes devant de grands groupes

jobs.title: Government & External Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position: Government & External Affairs Lead
Team: Health System Shaping Lab
Reports to: General Manager

Roche Slovensko is seeking a Government & External Affairs Lead to join the Local Leadership Team (Purpose Enabling Board - PEB). This senior role is responsible for shaping national policy and creating patient access strategies.

The successful candidate will proactively drive changes in the national policy and legislative environment. You will lead strategies to influence key stakeholders, ensuring patient access to our innovations. This position requires strategic thinking, political knowledge, and an entrepreneurial approach to impact the Slovak healthcare system.

Key Responsibilities:

• Policy Advocacy: Lead targeted efforts to influence public health and pricing legislation to drive systemic improvements for patient access and innovation.

• Stakeholder Management: Develop and maintain strong, strategic relationships with political stakeholders, decision-makers, and payers at the national level.

• External Representation: Serve as the primary representative for OneRoche, building alliances with external organizations to enhance reputation and create value.

• Strategic Alignment: Manage the External Engagement Strategy, ensuring it supports Patient Access goals and integrates across Pharma, Diagnostics, and the wider Roche enterprise.

• Leadership: Participate in the Purpose Enabling Board (Affiliate Leadership Team), connecting the Health System Shaping group's goals to the affiliate strategy, and guiding the team.

Required Qualifications:

• Experience: Minimum 5 years in Government & External Affairs (policy/network development). Minimum 7 years of experience in the Slovak Health Care. Minimum 6 months in leadership roles.

• Expertise:
Deep understanding of healthcare funding and external conditions impacting the system. Proven ability in strategy development, execution, and navigating complex or uncertain situations (Triple Win concept).

• Mindset:

• Systemic & Enabling: Focus on leveraging networks for value creation and scaling.

• Entrepreneurial: Self-managed, comfortable with risk, committed to continuous learning.

• Ethical: High integrity and strong alignment with affiliate values.

• Skills:
Strategic Thinking (Enterprise Mindset), VACC Leadership, Influencing, Effective Decision Making (in ambiguity), Strategic Agility (managing long-term goals amid change).

• Education & Language:
Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Medicine, Law, Health Economics). Fluent in Slovak and proficient in English.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Bratislava Pribinova is 64,900.00 EUR - 120,540.00 EUR. Roche Slovakia provides 13th month Salary. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target of 25% subject to both individual and company performance.

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conduct

• External Representation: Serve as the primary representative for OneRoche, building alliances with external organizations to enhance reputation and create value.

jobs.title: System Shaping Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join the Health System Shaping Lab as a System Shaping Partner . This pivotal role is your opportunity to drive large-scale, long-term national health system reform. Leverage your deep policy expertise and strategic agility to proactively influence legislation, align diverse stakeholders, and ensure sustainable access to cutting-edge healthcare for patients.

As the strategic analyst and implementation expert, you will report to the Government & External Affairs Lead. Your core mission is to shape a resilient market environment by addressing systemic healthcare challenges and championing policy changes that directly support our organization's strategic vision—both current and future.

Key Accountabilities

• Policy and Legislative Foresight: Conduct advanced Legislative Monitoring and Policy Analysis to deliver strategic intelligence, mitigate risks, and uncover opportunities for healthcare innovation.

• National Advocacy: Design and execute high-impact advocacy initiatives, including the development of compelling narratives, position papers, and white papers to advance our National Policy Shaping strategy.

• Stakeholder Ecosystem Collaboration: Build and maintain strategic partnerships with critical external stakeholders—policymakers, thought leaders, payers, and academic institutions—to build evidence and co-create solutions that generate mutual value for patient care and system efficiency.

• Integrated Strategy Execution: Collaborate seamlessly with the Commercialization Community to ensure a unified "OneRoche" approach in all external engagements and communications.

Candidate Profile
Education and Professional Experience

• Education: Master’s degree (required) in Business, Economy, Health Economics, Medicine, Pharmacy, or an equivalent academic background in Life Sciences.

• Experience:

• Minimum 5 years of proven experience in Reimbursement, Market/Patient Access, or Health Policy, demonstrating a comprehensive understanding of healthcare financing, reimbursement systems, and relevant compliance frameworks.

• Minimum 7 years of professional experience within the Health Care sector in Slovakia.

Required Mindset and Competencies

• Strategic Agility: Ability to maintain a clear focus on the long-term vision while effectively navigating ambiguity, complexity, and uncertainty.

• System Thinking: Capacity to think and operate at an enterprise level, looking beyond organizational boundaries to achieve optimal outcomes for the local health environment.

• Impactful Communication: Exceptional skill in articulating complex value propositions and translating external insights into actionable intelligence for internal teams.

• Agile Mindset: Enthusiastic adoption of agile, self-managed working models based on trust, continuous learning, and adaptability.

• VACC Leadership: Embodies the principles of Visionary, Architect, Coach, and Catalyst, driving change both externally and internally.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Bratislava Pribinova is 44,390.00 EUR - 82,450.00 EUR. Roche Slovakia provides 13th month Salary. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target of 25% subject to both individual and company performance.

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Join an experienced and collaborative team of dedicated Global Medical Affairs Leaders in Clinical Development and Medical Affairs (CDMA) at Roche Diagnostics. Work with the Oncology Assays Lifecycle Team on the deployment and commercialization of Cervical Cancer Screening solutions. This is an unparalleled opportunity for career development and job satisfaction as you help improve healthcare around the globe.

The Opportunity:

Essential Functions of the role include the following:

• Provide subject matter expertise in cervical cancer screening as well as leadership in developing and executing global medical strategies for integrated evidence generation, collaborations, medical communications and engagements like advisory boards, scientific symposia and educational events.

• Drive evidence-based screening adoption and advocate for public health initiatives that support cervical cancer elimination strategy including adoption of HPV testing, self sampling and specialised dual stain cytology.

• Build strong partnerships with medical and patient communities including global thought leaders, academic networks and professional societies while ensuring operational excellence and compliance with industry regulations and HCP interaction guidelines.

• Develop and deliver content for timely and effective communication of science and clinical data within or outside the organization in educational programs, publications and congress presentations.

• Partner across functions (including commercial, access and policy), regions, cultures, and time zones to create an environment of belonging and identify mutual value and opportunities for collaborations.

​
Additional responsibilities include:

• Champion patient and customer-centricity in mindset, behaviors and actions by always putting the needs of the patients and customers first.

• Model Roche’s values of integrity, courage, and passion and We@Roche Diagnostics (culture, mindset and behaviors) in everything you do.

• Act in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice including Roche Code of Conduct and other relevant directives and guidelines.

• Work independently and autonomously, act as coach for colleagues with less experience.

Who you are:

You’re someone who wants to advance healthcare globally and influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies, where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

Required experience and skills:

• You have an advanced degree (MD and/or PhD) and 8+ years of relevant industry experience in medical affairs and/or clinical development leading the design and implementation of clinical studies, scientific communication and medical education initiatives.

• You have a deep understanding of cervical cancer screening solutions, practices, guidelines and implementation in complex healthcare ecosystems and various resource settings.

• Vous avez une compréhension approfondie des solutions de dépistage du cancer du col de l'utérus, des pratiques, des lignes directrices et de la mise en oeuvre dans des écosystèmes de soins complexes et divers milieux de ressources.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a seasoned project engineer with a passion for driving innovation in complex infrastructure within a regulated, high-tech environment? At Roche, we are committed to pioneering solutions that advance global health, and we need a dedicated Project Engineer to lead vital capital infrastructure projects that bolster our facilities’ safety, efficiency, and compliance. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence Roche’s operational excellence by managing projects from inception to completion, ensuring they align with our strategic goals and contribute to sustainable growth.

In this dynamic role, you'll collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams—including engineering, operations, quality, and SHE—to deliver projects that meet regulatory standards and organizational needs. Your technical expertise will be essential in troubleshooting facility systems, optimizing utilities, and maintaining comprehensive documentation of infrastructure modifications. Roche’s culture of continuous improvement means your innovative ideas and process enhancements will help shape best practices across our global engineering network.

The Opportunity
Responsibilities

• Lead the end-to-end delivery of capital projects, managing scope, schedule, and budget for initiatives typically ranging from $500K to $2M.

• Develop precise project scopes by identifying core problems, functional requirements, and performing risk and cost-benefit analyses to recommend optimal solutions.

• Oversee design reviews and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to promote space efficiency, asset utilization, and alignment with Roche’s site master plans.

• Manage small to medium projects through all phases from conception to commissioning, qualification, and operational handover, ensuring seamless transitions.

• Maintain comprehensive knowledge of site infrastructure systems—HVAC, electrical, utilities—and provide troubleshooting support for critical facilities.

• Facilitate stakeholder coordination by preparing engineering documentation, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting change control processes.

• Commit to continuous improvement by sharing best practices, supporting cross-site collaborations, and advancing engineering standards within Roche’s network

Who You Are
Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or related discipline) or equivalent professional experience. A Professional Engineer (PE) license or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred.

• 5+ years of combined experience in project management, project engineering, or capital planning within regulated or high-tech manufacturing environments, including biotech, pharmaceutical, or similar industries, preferred.

• Proven experience delivering capital projects from concept to completion, with responsibility for managing budgets and schedules. Experience with capital project governance frameworks such as stage-gate or portfolio management is advantageous.

• Proficiency with MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent project management tools. Experience with SAP, AutoCAD, building management systems, or process control systems is a plus.

• Strong knowledge of facility systems, utilities infrastructure, or building engineering, with familiarity with BIM (Building Information Modeling) tools or digital asset management platforms preferred.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of presenting technical information effectively to divers

A Roche, siamo impegnati a soluzioni pionieristiche che promuovono la salute globale, e abbiamo bisogno di un Project Engineer dedicato per condurre progetti di infrastruttura di capitale vitale che rafforzano la sicurezza, l’efficienza e la conformità delle nostre strutture. Questo ruolo offre un’opportunità unica per influenzare l’eccellenza operativa di Roche gestendo progetti dall’inizio al completamento, garantendo loro di allineare con i nostri obiettivi strategici e contribuire alla crescita sostenibile. In questo ruolo dinamico, collaborerai a stretto contatto con team multidisciplinari, tra cui ingegneria, operazioni, qualità e SHE, per fornire progetti che soddisfino gli standard normativi e le esigenze organizzative. La vostra competenza tecnica sarà essenziale nei sistemi di risoluzione dei problemi, ottimizzare le utenze e mantenere la documentazione completa delle modifiche delle infrastrutture. La cultura di Roche di miglioramento continuo significa che le vostre idee innovative e miglioramenti dei processi aiuteranno a plasmare le migliori pratiche nella nostra rete di ingegneria globale. L'opportunità responsabilità
• Condurre la consegna end-to-end di progetti di capitale, la gestione del campo di applicazione, il programma e il budget per iniziative tipicamente da $ 500K a $2M.
• Sviluppare obiettivi di progetto precisi identificando i problemi fondamentali, i requisiti funzionali, l'esecuzione di analisi di rischio e di costi-benefici per consigliare soluzioni ottimali.
• Superare le recensioni di progettazione e collaborare con team multidisciplinari per promuovere l’efficienza dello spazio, l’utilizzo degli asset e l’allineamento con i piani di master del sito Roche.
• Gestire progetti di piccole e medie dimensioni attraverso tutte le fasi dal concepimento alla messa in servizio, alla qualificazione e alla consegna operativa, garantendo transizioni senza soluzione di continuità.
• Mantenere la conoscenza completa dei sistemi di infrastruttura del sito – HVAC, elettrico, utilità e fornire il supporto per la risoluzione dei problemi per le strutture critiche.
• Facilitare il coordinamento delle parti interessate preparando la documentazione ingegneristica, garantendo la conformità alle normative e supportando i processi di controllo dei cambiamenti.
• Impegnarsi a un miglioramento continuo condividendo le migliori pratiche, supportando collaborazioni cross-site e migliorando gli standard di ingegneria all’interno della rete di Roche Chi sei Qualifiche
• Laurea in Ingegneria (civile, meccanico, elettrico o disciplina correlata) o equivalente esperienza professionale. È preferibile una licenza di ingegnere professionale (PE) o la certificazione di Project Management Professional (PMP).
• 5+ anni di esperienza combinata nella gestione dei progetti, nell'ingegneria dei progetti o nella pianificazione dei capitali all'interno di ambienti di produzione regolamentati o high-tech, tra cui industrie biotecnologiche, farmaceutiche o simili, preferiti.
• Esperienza comprovata che offre progetti di capitale dal concept al completamento, con responsabilità per la gestione di budget e programmi. L'esperienza con i quadri di governance del progetto di capitale, come la fase-gate o la gestione del portafoglio è vantaggiosa.
• Proficienza con MS Project, Smartsheet o strumenti di gestione del progetto equivalenti. L'esperienza con SAP, AutoCAD, sistemi di gestione degli edifici o sistemi di controllo dei processi è un vantaggio.
• Forte conoscenza dei sistemi di impianti, delle infrastrutture di utilizzo o dell'ingegneria degli edifici, con familiarità con gli strumenti BIM (Building Information Modeling) o le piattaforme di gestione degli asset digitali preferite.
• Eccellente capacità comunicative verbali e scritte, in grado di presentare informazioni tecniche efficacemente ai subacquei

Roches Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung bedeutet, dass Ihre innovativen Ideen und Prozessverbesserungen dazu beitragen werden, Best Practices in unserem globalen Engineering-Netzwerk zu gestalten. Die Chance Zuständigkeiten Führen Sie die End-to-End-Bereitstellung von Kapitalprojekten, verwalten Sie Umfang, Zeitplan und Budget für Initiativen, die typischerweise von $ 500.000 bis $ 2 Millionen reichen.
• Entwickeln Sie präzise Projektbereiche, indem Sie Kernprobleme, funktionale Anforderungen identifizieren und Risiko- und Kosten-Nutzen-Analysen durchführen, um optimale Lösungen zu empfehlen.
• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Entwurfsprüfungen und arbeiten Sie mit multidisziplinären Teams zusammen, um die Raumeffizienz, die Anlagenauslastung und die Ausrichtung auf die Masterpläne von Roche zu fördern.
• Verwalten Sie kleine bis mittlere Projekte in allen Phasen von der Konzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme, Qualifizierung und operativen Übergabe, um nahtlose Übergänge zu gewährleisten.
• Behalten Sie umfassende Kenntnisse über Infrastruktursysteme vor Ort – HVAC, Elektrik, Versorgungsunternehmen – und bieten Sie Unterstützung bei der Fehlerbehebung für kritische Einrichtungen.
• Erleichterung der Stakeholder-Koordination durch die Erstellung der technischen Dokumentation, die Gewährleistung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften und die Unterstützung von Änderungskontrollprozessen.
• Verpflichtung zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung durch den Austausch von Best Practices, die Unterstützung der standortübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit und die Weiterentwicklung von Engineering-Standards innerhalb des Roche-Netzwerks Wer du bist Qualifikationen
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften (zivile, mechanische, elektrische oder verwandte Disziplin) oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung. Eine Professional Engineer (PE) Lizenz oder Project Management Professional (PMP) Zertifizierung wird bevorzugt.
• 5+ Jahre kombinierte Erfahrung in Projektmanagement, Projekttechnik oder Kapitalplanung in regulierten oder High-Tech-Fertigungsumgebungen, einschließlich Biotech, Pharma oder ähnlichen Branchen, bevorzugt.
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung bei der Bereitstellung von Kapitalprojekten vom Konzept bis zum Abschluss, mit Verantwortung für die Verwaltung von Budgets und Zeitplänen. Erfahrungen mit Capital Project Governance Frameworks wie Stage-Gate oder Portfolio Management sind von Vorteil.
• Kenntnisse mit MS Project, Smartsheet oder gleichwertigen Projektmanagement-Tools. Erfahrung mit SAP, AutoCAD, Gebäudemanagementsystemen oder Prozessleitsystemen ist ein Plus.
• Starkes Wissen über Anlagensysteme, Versorgungsinfrastruktur oder Gebäudetechnik, mit BIM-Tools (Building Information Modeling) oder Digital Asset Management-Plattformen bevorzugt.
• Ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, in der Lage, technische Informationen effektiv für Taucher zu präsentieren
