jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du willst den digitalen Wandel im Gesundheitsmarkt als Führungspersönlichkeit von morgen aktiv mitgestalten und die Diagnostik durch patientenzentrierte Innovationen revolutionieren? Starte als Leadership StartUp Trainee (m/w/d) bei Roche Diagnostics Deutschland GmbH in eine unbefristete Karriere mit echter Verantwortung. Wir bieten dir Raum für deinen individuellen Führungspfad, agile Projekte und die strategische Prägung der Gesundheitsversorgung. Werde die treibende Innovationskraft!

Wer wir sind
Als Partner für innovative Diagnostik- und datenbasierte Entscheidungsunterstützung tragen wir dazu bei, die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen gemeinsam zu gestalten. Dabei setzen wir auf digitale Vernetzung, intelligente Technologien und enge Zusammenarbeit.

Diese Vision verfolgen wir als Vertrieb Deutschland tagtäglich mit unserem vollen Einsatz - immer im Sinne der Patient:innen.

Willst Du auch Teil davon sein?

Was bieten wir dir
Während Deines 24-monatigen Programms wirst Du vom ersten Tag an:

• Deine Leistungs- und Entwicklungsziele definieren und diesen durch intensives Training on und off the job jeden Tag einen Schritt näher kommen.

• Verantwortung für Projekte (Product Owner, Projektleitung) übernehmen, in klassischen Projekten und agilen Settings (lokal oder international) mitarbeiten und diese den entsprechenden Stakeholdern präsentieren.

• Seminare und Workshops besuchen, sowie eine:n erfahrene:n Senior Manager:in für Deine Progamm- und Karriereplanung an Deiner Seite als Mentor:in haben.

• Dein persönliches internationales Netzwerk mit aktuellen und ehemaligen Trainees sowie mit Kollegen:innen in anderen Funktionen und Bereichen aufbauen und so sehr viele Erfahrungen und Erkenntnisse in einem sich derzeit stark verändernden Umfeld sammeln.

• Die Möglichkeit haben, an einem unserer anderen Standorte im Ausland zu arbeiten und dort ein Projekt zu übernehmen.

Wer du bist
Du bist jemand, der seine eigene Entwicklung beeinflussen will. Du liebst das Experimentieren und Vorangehen in unbekannten Gebieten. Du bist die treibende Kraft, agierst innovativ und hinterfragst Bestehendes. Du willst rasch Verantwortung übernehmen und bist bereit, die Extrameile zu gehen. Darüber hinaus hast Du ein hohes Interesse an unserem Gesundheitsmarkt, denkst unternehmerisch und willst die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen aktiv mitgestalten.

Deine Qualifikationen

• Hervorragend abgeschlossenes Masterstudium (wirtschafts- oder naturwissenschaftlicher Studiengang)

• Relevante Praxiserfahrung durch Praktika oder bis zu 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung

• Mindestens dreimonatige Auslandserfahrung (außerhalb DACH-Region)

• Affinität für Digitalisierung und den medizinischen Wert der Diagnostik

• Verhandlungssicheres Englisch sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, soziale Kompetenz, Zielstrebigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Nachweisbares Engagement über das Studium hinaus (Ehrenamt, Sport etc.)

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser!

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) is a global business organization of more than 3,700 employees dedicated to transforming Roche's operations. Our mission is to provide innovative business services and solutions to our customers/partners, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. We enable Roche to thrive in a competitive and constantly evolving business landscape in areas ranging from Finance and procurement to regulatory affairs to analytics and automation. Roche Services & Solutions operates from various strategic locations across the world, including Costa Rica, Hungary, India, Latvia, Malaysia and Switzerland. Discover the Roche Services & Solutions Center and how we work together as a truly global team!

The Opportunity
As the RSS Enablement Operations Manager, you will work in a dynamic global environment ensuring seamless communication, efficient operations, and alignment of strategic priorities across RSS. This will include the planning of annual key RSS events, as well as the follow up on agreed action items and RSS LT deliverables. You will directly manage projects and initiatives and lead the RSS enabling support team.

Your key responsibilities:

• Act as the main enabling role to the Head of RSS Strategy and Enablement and the RSS leadership team; this includes developing and supporting the creation of management materials, such as presentations, memos, strategy documents, and content as needed.

• Coordinate the strategic calendar of global RSS events, such as (extended) leadership team meetings, site visits, forecasting events, operational and financial check-ins, etc.

• Ensure the definition of the RSS Leadership team agendas for regular meetings, and ensure appropriate documentation of outcomes, as well as follow up for agreed action items

• Utilise your expertise and experience to lead and guide strategic projects

• Support the annual planning cycle for RSS, including strategy and roadmap reviews, as well as the regular / quarterly review of OKRs in RSS

• Lead and develop the RSS enabling support team

Who you are

• You hold a university degree in business or a similar field and have 5-8 years of professional experience, ideally gained in business services organisation or healthcare industry or in strategy consulting.

• You have a proven track record in a role or through consulting engagements supporting a senior leader or leadership team, driving change, harmonization, and alignment.

• You have proven ability to communicate difficult or complex business-related concepts and influence others (including senior stakeholders) to adopt a new or complementary view, approach, or way of working.

• You have advanced skills creating management-level presentations, including effective storyboarding, content creation, and the ability to translate complex ideas and topics into accessible output for various audiences.

• You have strong business acumen, including a solid understanding and comfort with principles of finance, strategic planning, organisational development, and benchmarking.

• You are known for your ability to influence and collaborate effectively across teams, and your agility to adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• You are open-minded and inclusive, generously sharing ideas and knowledge, while being receptive to ideas and feedback from others.

• You are fluent in English to a Business level; knowledge of German is a strong advantage.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Togethe

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La Posizione Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) è un'organizzazione aziendale globale di oltre 3.700 dipendenti dedicata alla trasformazione delle operazioni di Roche. La nostra missione è quella di fornire servizi e soluzioni aziendali innovative ai nostri clienti/partner, consentendo loro di concentrarsi sulle attività incentrate sui pazienti. Permettiamo a Roche di prosperare in un panorama aziendale competitivo e in continua evoluzione in settori che vanno dalla finanza e dall'approvvigionamento alle questioni regolamentari all'analisi e all'automazione. Roche Services & Solutions opera da diverse sedi strategiche in tutto il mondo, tra cui Costa Rica, Ungheria, India, Lettonia, Malesia e Svizzera. Scopri il Roche Services & Solutions Center e come lavoriamo insieme come team veramente globale! L'Opportunità Come RSS Enablement Operations Manager, lavorerai in un ambiente globale dinamico che garantisca una comunicazione senza soluzione di continuità, operazioni efficienti e allineamento delle priorità strategiche attraverso RSS. Questo includerà la pianificazione di eventi chiave annuali RSS, così come il follow up su oggetti d'azione concordati e RSS LT consegnabili. Gestirai direttamente progetti e iniziative e guiderai il team di supporto RSS abilitante. Le tue responsabilità principale: - Atto come il ruolo principale che consente al Capo della Strategia RSS e dell'Abilitazione e al team di leadership RSS; questo include lo sviluppo e il supporto della creazione di materiali di gestione, come presentazioni, memo, documenti di strategia e contenuti secondo le necessità. - Coordinare il calendario strategico degli eventi RSS globali, come (esteso) incontri di team di leadership, visite di siti, eventi di previsione, check-in operativo e finanziario, ecc. - Assicurare la definizione degli ordini del team di RSS Leadership per riunioni regolari, e garantire la documentazione appropriata dei risultati, così come seguire per gli elementi d'azione concordati - Utilizzare la vostra competenza e l'esperienza per condurre e guidare i progetti strategici - Supporta il ciclo di pianificazione annuale per il trimestre RSS, tra cui strategia e roadmap Hai una laurea in economia o in un campo simile e hai 5-8 anni di esperienza professionale, idealmente acquisita nell'organizzazione di servizi aziendali o nell'industria sanitaria o nella consulenza strategica. - No. Hai un record di traccia provata in un ruolo o attraverso la consulenza di impegni che supportano un senior leader o team di leadership, il cambiamento di guida, l'armonizzazione e l'allineamento. - No. Hai dimostrato la capacità di comunicare concetti aziendali difficili o complessi e influenzare gli altri (compresi gli stakeholder senior) per adottare una nuova o complementare visione, approccio o modo di lavorare. - No. Hai competenze avanzate che creano presentazioni a livello di gestione, tra cui storyboard efficace, creazione di contenuti, e la capacità di tradurre idee complesse e argomenti in output accessibile per vari pubblico. - No. Hai un forte acume aziendale, tra cui una solida comprensione e comfort con principi di finanza, pianificazione strategica, sviluppo organizzativo e benchmarking. - No. Siete noti per la vostra capacità di influenzare e collaborare efficacemente tra i team, e la vostra agilità di adattarsi a cambiare le priorità in un ambiente veloce. - No. Sei aperto e inclusivo, generosamente condividere idee e conoscenze, pur essendo ricettivo a idee e feedback da altri. - No. Sei fluente in inglese a livello aziendale; la conoscenza del tedesco è un forte vantaggio. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. A

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was Dich erwartet:

Die Labordiagnostik ist das Herzstück unseres Gesundheitswesens und von entscheidender Bedeutung für jeden einzelnen Patienten. Schätzungsweise 70 % aller klinischen Entscheidungen basieren auf In-vitro-diagnostischen Tests. Die absolute Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme ist daher die Grundvoraussetzung für sichere Diagnosen und medizinische Weichenstellungen.

Für unser Praktikantenprogramm suchen wir motivierte, technologiebegeisterte und wissbegierige Studierende, die unser Service-Team tatkräftig unterstützen und gemeinsam mit uns den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche Karriere bei Roche legen möchten.

Werde Teil unserer dynamischen Serviceorganisation! Mit viel Energie, Leidenschaft und Innovationsgeist bringen wir die Labordiagnostik in Deutschland voran und gestalten die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mit. Bei uns kannst Du tagtäglich Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein theoretisches und praktisches Wissen einbringen, um komplexe technische Fragestellungen im Team zu lösen.

Als Praktikant:in (m/w/d) begleitest Du unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden bei der Planung, Installation, Wartung und Modifikation unserer Analysensysteme cobas® pro und cobas® pure . Darüber hinaus tauchst Du tief in die IT-Vernetzung unserer Systeme ein. Bei den täglichen Einsätzen in verschiedenen Krankenhaus- und Privatlaboren sind Deine Eigeninitiative, Deine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Dein technisches Geschick gefragt.

Dein perfekter Start: Zu Beginn Deines Praktikums erhältst Du eine fundierte Ausbildung auf unseren Immunologie cobas®-Systemen und wirst während Deines gesamten Außendiensteinsatzes von einem festen Mentor oder einer Mentorin intensiv begleitet.

Du wirst im Raum Niedersachsen, Hamburg, Bremen eingesetzt und genießt die Freiheit, Deinen Wohnort innerhalb dieses Gebiets frei zu wählen (idealerweise im Raum Hamburg, Hannover, Bremen ) .

Folgende Schwerpunkte erwarten Dich bei Deinem Praktikum im Service Außendienst:

• Professionelles Training: Du absolvierst im September (28.09. – 02.10.2026) ein spezialisiertes Wartungstraining an zwei Immunologie-Modulen ( cobas® e402 und cobas® e801 ).

• Praktische Technik: Du stellst Dein handwerkliches und technisches Geschick direkt bei Geräteinstallationen und präventiven Wartungen unter Beweis.

• Problem-Solving: Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Analyse sowie Behebung komplexer technischer und applikativer Fragestellungen und unterstützt unser Team aktiv bei der Ursachenforschung.

• Perspektivenwechsel: Du fokussierst Dich auf die Bereiche Klinische Chemie und Immunologie, hast jedoch jederzeit die Möglichkeit, durch Hospitationen auch andere spannende Unternehmensbereiche kennenzulernen.

• Zukunftsthema IT: IT-Netzwerke und IT-Sicherheit wecken Deinen Ehrgeiz – bei der Installation von Firewalls lernst Du direkt von unseren IT-Spezialisten.

• Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Deine organisatorischen Fähigkeiten ein und übernimmst selbstständig definierte Aufgabenpakete (z. B. die professionelle Einweisung unserer Kunden in die Nutzung unserer Online-Plattform Navify ).

• Kommunikationstalent: Du schärfst Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im direkten Dialog mit unseren Kunden sowie bei der kollegialen Abstimmung im Team.

• Flexibilität: Kleinere Projektaufgaben bearbeitest Du ganz flexibel an einzelnen Tagen im Homeoffice. Die meiste Zeit bist Du jedoch dort, wo unsere Geräte stehen: direkt vor Ort bei unseren Kunden.

• Wachstumsumfeld: Wir bieten Dir ein attraktives und wertschätzendes Praktik

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi mostrarti come be, assegnato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuina, dove sei valorizzato, previsto e rispettato per chi essere, permettendo di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è come vogliono prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e assicurare che tutti hanno accesso tutti cura oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Cosa ti aspetta: La diagnostica laboratoristica è il cuore del nostro sistema sanitario e di fondamentale importanza per ogni singolo paziente. Stime approssimative che il 70% di tutte le decisioni cliniche si basano su test di diagnostica in vitro. La assoluta affidabilità dei nostri sistemi è quindi la condizione base per diagnostica sicurezza e scelte mediche. Per il nostro programma di tirocinio stiamo cercando studenti motivati, tecnologicamente care e curiosi, che siano in grado di supportare concretamente il nostro team di servizio e di costruire con noi le basi per una di successo a Roche. Unisciti alla nostra organizzazione di servizio! Con molta energia, passione e spirito innovativo portando avanti la diagnostica laboratoristica in Germania e stiamo attivamente plasmare il futuro del sistema sanitario. A Roche puoi portare ogni giorno le do idee e il tuo sapere teorico e pratico per risolvere questioni complesse nel team. Come tirocinante (m/w/d) seguirai i nostri collaboratori esperti nella pianificazione, installazione, manutenzione e modifica dei nostri sistemi di analisi cobas® pro e cobas® pure. Inoltre, immergerai profondamente la connessione IT dei nostri sistemi. Durante le do missioni quotidiane in diversi ospedali e laboratori privati, la tua iniziativa personale, la tua orientamento al cliente e le do abilità tecniche saranno richieste. Il tuo perfetto inizio: all'inizio del tuo tirocinio riceve un'addestramento fondato sulle nostre immunologia cobas®-systeme e sarai seguito da un mentore fermo o una mentore durante tutto il tuo impiego esterno. Sarai impiegato nella regione di Niedersachsen, Amburgo, Brema e potrai godere della libertà di scegliere il tuo luogo di residenza all'interno di questo territorio (ideale che sia nella regione di Amburgo, Hannover, Brema). I seguenti punti saranno al centro del tuo tirocinio nel servizio esterno:
• Formazione professionale: assolverai un addestramento di manutenzione specializzata a due moduli di immuno (cobas® e402 e cobas® e801) nel mese di settembre (28.09. - 02.10.2026).
• Pratica tecnica: dimostraerai le do abilità manuali e tecniche direttamente durante le installazioni di apparecchiature e le manutenzioni pregiudizi.
• Risoluzione dei problemi: ricevere una profonda comprensione dell'analisi e della risoluzione di complesse questioni tecniche e applicative e supporterai attivamente il nostro team nella ricerca delle cause.
• Cambio di prospettiva: ti concentrerai sui settori di chimica clinica e immunologia, ma avrai sempre la possibilità di conoscere altri settori interessantii dell'azienda attraverso le visite di ospitalità.
• Tema di futuro IT: i reti di rete IT e la sicurezza IT ti eccitano - durante l'installazione di firewall imparerai direttamente dagli esperti IT.
• Autonomia personale: porterai le do abilità organizzative e assumerai compiti di lavoro autonomi definiti (ad esempio, l'addestramento professionale dei nostri clienti nella utilizzazione della nostra piattaforma online Navify).
• Abilità di comunicazione: affinerai le do abilità di comunicazione nel dialogo diretto con i nostri clienti e nella discussione collettiva nel team.
• Flessibilità: compilauterai piccoli progetti autonomiamente a casa, ma la maggior parte del tempo sarai là dove si trovano le nostre apparecchiature: direttamente presso i nostri clienti.
• Campo di crescita: offriamo un ambiente di crescita e rispettoso, dove puoi sviluppare le do abilità e realizzare i tuoi obiettivi. Requisiti - Studente motivato, tecnologicamente esposti e curiosi - Abilità di comunicazione e di lavoro in team - Abilità di risoluzione dei problemi e pensiero di critico - Flessibilità e capacità di adattamento - Buone praticheve e di gestione del tempo - Conoscenza di base di IT e di rete - Disponibilità a lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e in continua evoluzione Cosa? - Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in continua evoluzione - Opportunità di crescita e sviluppo professionale - Formazione professionale e continua - Collaborazione con un team di esperti - Accesso a risorse e strumenti di lavoro avanzato - Opportunità di partecipazione a progetti e iniziative innovative - Un ambiente di lavoro rispettoso e inclusivo Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarti al nostro programma di tirocinio, contattare a [inserisci il tuo indirizzo smalto o il tuo numero di telefono].

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'impressione personale, il dialogueo aperto e le connessioni authentique, colombe sei valorizzato, accettato e rispettato per chi be, permettendo di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è come vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e Assicurare che tutti abbiano accesso all cure oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, colombe ogni voce conta. La Posizione Qu'est-ce que t'aspetta: La diagnostica laboratoristica è il cuore del nostro sistema sanitario e di fondamentale importanza per ogni singolo paziente. Stime approssimative indicano che il 70% di tutte le decisioni cliniche si basano su test di diagnostica in vitro. La assoluta affidabilità dei nostri sistemi è quindi la condizione base per diagnosi sicure e scelte mediche. Per il nostro programma di tirocinio stiamo cercando studenti motivati, tecnologicamente entusiasti e curiosi, che siano in grado di supportare concretamente il nostro team di servizio e di costruire con noi le basi per una carriera di successo a Roche. Unisciti alla nostra dinamica organizzazione di servizio! Con molta energia, passione e spirito innovativo stiamo portando avanti la diagnostica laboratoristica in Germania e stiamo attivamente plasmare il futuro del sistema sanitario. A Roche puoi portare ogni giorno le do idee e il tuo sapere teorico e pratico per risolvere complesse questioni tecniche nel team. Come tirocinante (m/w/d) seguirai i nostri collaboratori esperti nella pianificazione, installazione, manutenzione e modifica dei nostri sistemi di analisi cobas® pro e cobas® pure. Inoltre, immergerai profondamente la connessione IT dei nostri sistemi. Durant le do missioni quotidiane in diversi ospedali e laboratori privati, la tua iniziativa personale, la tua orientalo al cliente e le do abilità tecniche saranno riccieste. Il tuo perfetto inizio: all'inizio del tuo tirocinio riceverai un'addestramento fondato sulle nostre immunologia cobas®-systeme e sarai seguito da un mentore fermo o una mentore durant tutto il tuo impiego esterno. Sarai impiegato nella regione di Niedersachsen, Amburgo, Brema e potrai godere della libertà di scegliere il tuo luogo di residentnza all'interno di questo territorio (idéale che sia nella regione di Amburgo, Hannover, Brema). I seguenti punti saranno al centro del tuo tirocinio nel servizio esterno:
• Professionale formazione: assolverai un addestramento di manutenzione specializzato a due moduli di immunologia (cobas® e402 e cobas® e801) nel mese di settembre (28.09. - 02.10.2026).
• Pratica tecnica: diostrerai le do abilità manuali e tecniche direttamente pendant le installazioni di apparecchiature e le manutenzioni prejudice.
• Risoluzione dei problemi: rizverai una profonda comprensione dell'analisi e della risoluzione di complesse questioni tecniche e applicative e supporterai attivamente il nostro team nella ricerca delle cause.
• Cambio di prospettiva: ti concentrerai sui settori di chimica clinica e immunologia, ma avril sempre la possibilità di conoscere altri settori interesti dell'azienda attraverso le visite di ospitalità.
• Tema di futuro IT: i reti di rete IT e la sicurezza IT ti eccitano - durée l'installation di pare-feu imparerai direttamente dagli esperti IT.
• Autonomia personale: porterai le do abilità organizzative e assumera compiti di lavoro autonomi definiti (ad esempio, l'addestramento professionale dei nostri clienti nella usingzazione della nostra piattaforma online Navify).
• Abilità di comunicazione: affinerai le do abilità di comunicazione nel dialogueo diretto con i nostri clienti e nella discussione collettiva nel team.
• Flessibilità: compiuterai piccoli progetti autonomeamente a casa, ma la maggior parte del tempo sarai là dove si trovano le nostre apparecchiature: direttamente presso i nostri clienti.
• Campo di crescita: offriamo un ambiente di crescita attraente e rispettoso, dove puoi sviluppare le do abilità e realizzare i tuoi obiettivi. jobs.title: Solution Architect, Global Supply Chain
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In alignment with our core corporate purpose—"Doing now what patients need next"—the Solution Architect provides strategic technical leadership and architectural governance to optimize our global supply chain and logistics systems. This critical role acts as the primary conduit between complex operational requirements and enterprise digital ecosystems, ensuring our warehouse management, material tracking, and cold-chain infrastructure remain scalable, resilient, and fully compliant.

The Opportunity
This position champions an integrated, system-wide approach focused on three core imperatives:

• Architectural Blueprinting: Design and govern the end-to-end technical architecture for warehouse operations, integrating ERP, WMS, and automated data monitoring tools.

• Operational Integrity: Ensure all technical platforms satisfy regulatory compliance boundaries while safeguarding the continuity of supply.

• Digital Transformation: Catalyze the modernization of legacy supply chain systems, introducing advanced automation, predictive data models, and unified communication matrices across local and external partner networks.

What You Do

• Formulate and articulate a compelling, long-term technical vision for our supply chain infrastructure, ensuring software systems scale seamlessly with product portfolio growth.

• Actively monitor and anticipate shifts in enterprise cloud capabilities, digital compliance requirements, and IoT tracking frameworks to engineer future-proof architectures.

• Author comprehensive architectural blueprints that seamlessly unify operational warehouse management systems (Exacta, Syncro, SAP) with global material planning frameworks (ERP / SAP), optimizing data synchronization and transaction velocity

• Partner with the Data Insights team to design well structured and real-time metric dashboards, enabling automated reporting.

• Act as an enterprise technical advisor to cross-functional teams, translating complex architectural choices into practical, operational realities for business stakeholders.

• Influence internal development teams and third-party vendors to adhere to rigid architectural standards, prioritizing continuous system refinement and robust cyber-security posture.

• Serve as the core technical connector bridging Warehouse Operations, Quality Assurance, Global Logistics, and Corporate IT networks to eliminate digital friction.

• Lead the technical risk mitigation strategies required during the deployment of automated high-density storage platforms, cloud migrations, or shifting network structures.

• Design and maintain scalable system architectures that integrate core warehouse operations with peripheral data layers, emphasizing system uptime, data redundancy, and robust API frameworks.

• Evaluate, select, and manage relationships with enterprise software vendors and external integrators, ensuring deliverables satisfy rigorous service level agreements (SLAs).

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Supply Chain Systems, or a related technical discipline.

• 5-8+ years of progressive experience in enterprise solution architecture and/or data engineering with documented success designing integrations for ERP (e.g., SAP) and modern Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) within high-density logistics networks.

Preferred Technical Credentials & Skills

• Architectural Frameworks: Certified in TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect Professional, or

jobs.title: Inbound & Storage Senior Supervisor - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
In this role you will be accountable for setting the direction and strategy for assigned team. Continually assesses daily process flows with the goal of implementing improvements to increase efficiency, improve customer experience, and meet the Supply Chain “On Time and In Full” (OTIF) KPIs. Collaborates and aligns with manager on direction and improvement of team processes to ensure objectives, timelines, and all requirements are achieved (including but not limited to local, regional, & global regulations, finance, tax, safety, environmental, transportation, Customs, and internal company standard requirements). Devotes a significant amount of time to leading employees, overseeing both the day-to-day operations and long term goals for assigned team. Provides feedback to the manager on employees' work performance and has input into employment decisions. Responsible for managing to a prescribed budget, training and development of staff, resource management, work assignments, interprets and ensures consistent application of organizational policies. Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions. Demonstrate strong customer focused skills. May have responsibilities that covers multiple shifts, warehouses and/or team leads. Responsible for hiring and onboarding of new employees.

What You Do:

• Lead shift activities across Inbound and Storage operations, driving inventory replenishment efforts for effective global distribution while ensuring the proper handling of sensitive materials.

• Participate in project teams as both a functional subject matter expert and an operational representative to drive site logistics success.

• Maintain hands-on operational agility by mastering the functional responsibilities of the team, ensuring the ability to step in and support daily business continuity when needed.

• Collaborate with management and key stakeholders to align daily execution with broader organizational requirements, milestones, and strategic goals.

• Develop and monitor operational KPIs to ensure optimal team performance, inventory accuracy, and workflow efficiency.

• Schedule: 2nd Shift, Monday through Friday, 13:30 - 22:00

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Science, Technology, Supply Chain, or a related field (or 4 years of related experience while actively pursuing a degree).

• Demonstrated leadership skills in managing key project objectives to achieve high-level organizational benefits and continuous improvement.

• Excellent communication (oral and written), interpersonal, and organizational skills.

• Proficient with Google Workspace/Office Suite and analytical tools.

Preferred Experience:

• 2+ years of supervisory or leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to motivate teams and foster collaboration.

• Experience with SAP, EWM, and other warehouse management systems (WMS).

• Strong cultural awareness and the ability to work effectively across multi-cultural and cross-functional teams.

• Customer service-oriented with the ability to support clients within a complex, global, and regulated environment.

• Proven ability to work in a fast

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Overview
We are seeking a motivated and organized Working Student to join our Marketing department. In this part-time role, you will support our team across various marketing initiatives, from administrative tasks to digital media campaigns and creative coordination. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic diagnostics environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Administrative Support:

• Purchase Order (PO) creation and new vendor setup.

• General administrative support.

• Marketing Coordination:

• Coordinating product-related updates and communications across the Product Management team.

• Coordinating Marketing Team Meetings and corresponding tasks.

• Digital & Social Media:

• Creating content for social media channels and influencer campaigns.

• Facilitating communication with agencies and external partners.

• Marketing Materials Creation:

• Executing simple graphic design tasks.

• Performing translation checks.

Requirements

• Currently enrolled in a university degree program (e.g., Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field).

• Interested in healthcare and diagnostics.

• Fluent in English.

• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to balance administrative tasks with creative projects.

• Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected minimum hourly rate for this position, based on the primary location of Bratislava Pribinova is From 7 EUR gross / hour. Pay for this position will be pro-rated for the contracted working hours. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Sr. Corporate Counsel, US Privacy

titleByLocale.it: Senior Corporate Counsel, Privacy negli Stati Uniti
titleByLocale.fr: Conseil Juridique Principal, Confidentialité aux États-Unis

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

We believe in the potential of science, data and insights to improve the standard of care for humankind. We also believe the right to privacy is a fundamental human right. We process personal data with due care. Team members of the Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy team contribute their talents with a strong focus on collaboration and teamwork to support Roche Diagnostic Customer Areas, North America affiliates and Group colleagues on privacy and digital legal matters.

As Senior Counsel, US Privacy, you would join our North America Digital & Privacy team to play a key role in providing legal advice on a wide range of matters related to data protection, digital initiatives, US privacy laws and regulations, and data governance.

The Opportunity

○ Provide guidance to key stakeholders including, other Legal and Compliance colleagues, the business and the Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy team in order to support the organizations’ compliance with US state and federal privacy laws (e.g., HIPAA, CCPA/CPRA, TCPA), and other applicable data protection and privacy laws and regulations. Such guidance may include:
• ○ Review privacy impact assessments for new projects and technologies and advise on risk mitigation strategies.
• ○ Support the Diagnostics US Privacy Office in developing and maintaining policies, procedure and communications.
• ○ Develop and conduct training programs for our Legal and Compliance colleagues and other workforce members on compliance with data privacy laws and best practices for data governance.
• ○ Review and negotiate contracts with third parties, ensuring that data protection and privacy clauses align with Roche’s policies and positions.
• ○ Advise and support during the response to a suspected Breach or other data privacy incidents, including internal investigations and advising on notification and reporting obligations.
• ○ Stay updated on applicable cybersecurity requirements, new digital technologies like blockchain, AI, and the Internet of Things and advise on their legal implications.
○ Develop and maintain networks by working closely with other Legal and Compliance colleagues, IT security, People & Culture, Finance, Support Services, and other business teams to ensure a cohesive approach to US data protection and digital operations.

Who You Are

You are someone who has:

● A Doctor of Jurisprudence from an ABA-accredited law school, licensed to practice law in one or more of the 50 states in good standing.
● At least eight (8) years’ experience practicing law at a large- to medium-sized law firm or experience within a privacy, compliance, legal or contracting department in a Life Sciences company (i.e., Pharma, Diagnostics, Devices, Biotech).
● Knowledge of, and working experience advising on data privacy and digital matters, federal, state, and international information security and privacy laws, rules, regulations, and industry standards (such as HIPAA, CCPA, GDPR).
● Experience reviewing, drafting, and negotiating; experience with information security and privacy provisions in agreements, Business Associate Agreements and data transfer or processing agreements is preferred.
● A demonstrated ability to establish and maintain open, candid, collaborative, and trusting work relationships.
● An ability to exercise independent judgment and deliver a consistent message in the face of pressure or adversity, and to work with and maintain confid

Descrizione A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Crediamo nel potenziale della scienza, dei dati e delle intuizioni per migliorare lo standard di cura per l'umanità. Crediamo anche che il diritto alla privacy sia un diritto umano fondamentale. Elaboriamo i dati personali con la dovuta cura. I membri del team Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy contribuiscono al loro talento con una forte attenzione alla collaborazione e al lavoro di squadra per supportare le aree clienti diagnostiche Roche, le affiliate del Nord America e i colleghi del Gruppo sulla privacy e questioni legali digitali. In qualità di Senior Counsel, US Privacy, si unirà al nostro team North America Digital & Privacy per svolgere un ruolo chiave nel fornire consulenza legale su una vasta gamma di questioni relative alla protezione dei dati, iniziative digitali, leggi e regolamenti sulla privacy degli Stati Uniti e la governance dei dati. B. HIPAA, CCPA / CPRA, TCPA) und anderer anwendbarer Datenschutz- und Datenschutzgesetze und -vorschriften zu unterstützen. Diese Leitlinien können Folgendes umfassen: - Überprüfung der Datenschutzfolgenabschätzungen für neue Projekte und Technologien und Beratung zu Strategien zur Risikominderung. Unterstützung des Diagnostics US Privacy Office bei der Entwicklung und Pflege von Richtlinien, Verfahren und Kommunikation. - Entwicklung und Durchführung von Schulungsprogrammen für unsere Rechts- und Compliance-Kollegen und andere Mitarbeiter zur Einhaltung der Datenschutzgesetze und Best Practices für Data Governance. - Überprüfung und Verhandlung von Verträgen mit Dritten, um sicherzustellen, dass Datenschutz- und Datenschutzklauseln mit den Richtlinien und Positionen von Roche übereinstimmen. - Beratung und Unterstützung bei der Reaktion auf einen vermuteten Verstoß oder andere Datenschutzvorfälle, einschließlich interner Untersuchungen und Beratung bei Benachrichtigungs- und Berichtspflichten. Bleiben Sie über die geltenden Cybersicherheitsanforderungen, neue digitale Technologien wie Blockchain, KI und das Internet der Dinge auf dem Laufenden und beraten Sie über ihre rechtlichen Auswirkungen. - Aufbau und Pflege von Netzwerken durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Rechts- und Compliance-Kollegen, IT-Sicherheit, People & Culture, Finanzen, Support Services und anderen Geschäftsteams, um einen kohärenten Ansatz für den Datenschutz und den digitalen Betrieb in den USA zu gewährleisten.
• Requisiti - Ein Doktor der Jurisprudenz von einer ABA-akkreditierten juristischen Fakultät, lizenziert, um Recht in einem oder mehreren der 50 Staaten in gutem Ansehen zu üben. - Mindestens acht (8) Jahre Erfahrung in der Rechtspraxis in einer großen bis mittleren Anwaltskanzlei oder Erfahrung in einer Datenschutz-, Compliance-, Rechts- oder Vertragsabteilung in einem Life Sciences-Unternehmen (d. H. Pharma, Diagnostics, Devices, Biotech). - Kenntnis und Berufserfahrung in Bezug auf Datenschutz und digitale Angelegenheiten, Bundes-, Landes- und internationale Informationssicherheits- und Datenschutzgesetze, Regeln, Vorschriften und Industriestandards (wie HIPAA, CCPA, DSGVO). - Erfahrung bei der Überprüfung, Erstellung und Verhandlung; Erfahrung mit Informationssicherheits- und Datenschutzbestimmungen in Vereinbarungen, Geschäftspartnervereinbarungen und Datenübertragungs- oder Verarbeitungsvereinbarungen wird bevorzugt. Eine nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, offene, offene, kooperative und vertrauensvolle Arbeitsbeziehungen aufzubauen und aufrechtzuerhalten. - Die Fähigkeit, ein unabhängiges Urteilsvermögen auszuüben und eine konsistente Botschaft angesichts von Druck oder Widrigkeiten zu vermitteln und mit Vertrauen zu arbeiten und zu pflegen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione Nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Nous croyons au potentiel de la science, des données et des idées pour améliorer le niveau de soins pour l'humanité. Nous croyons également que le droit à la vie privée est un droit fondamental de la personne. Nous traitons les données personnelles avec soin. Les membres de l'équipe de Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy apportent leurs talents en mettant fortement l'accent sur la collaboration et le travail d'équipe pour soutenir Roche Diagnostic Customer Areas, les affiliés nord-américains et les collègues du Groupe sur les questions de confidentialité et de droit numérique. En tant qu'avocat principal, United States Privacy, vous vous joindriez à notre équipe North America Digital & Privacy pour jouer un rôle clé dans la prestation de conseils juridiques sur un large éventail de questions liées à la protection des données, aux initiatives numériques, aux lois et règlements américains sur la protection de la vie privée et à la gouvernance des données. Opportunità - Fournir des conseils aux intervenants clés, y compris aux autres collègues juridiques et de conformité, à l'entreprise et à l'équipe de Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy afin de soutenir les organisations. Ces lignes directrices peuvent comprendre : - Examiner les évaluations des répercussions sur la vie privée des nouveaux projets et des nouvelles technologies et donner des conseils sur les stratégies d'atténuation des risques. - Soutenir le Diagnostics US Privacy Office dans l'élaboration et le maintien de politiques, procédures et communications. - Élaborer et diriger des programmes de formation à l'intention de nos collègues juridiques et de conformité et d'autres membres de l'effectif sur la conformité aux lois sur la protection des données et aux pratiques exemplaires en matière de gouvernance des données. - Examiner et négocier des contrats avec des tiers, en veillant à ce que les clauses de protection des données et de protection de la vie privée soient conformes aux politiques et aux positions de Roches. - Conseiller et appuyer pendant la réponse à une infraction présumée ou à d'autres incidents liés à la confidentialité des données, y compris les enquêtes internes et donner des conseils sur les obligations de notification et de déclaration. - Restez à jour sur les exigences applicables en matière de cybersécurité, les nouvelles technologies numériques comme la blockchain, l'IA et l'Internet des objets et donnez des conseils sur leurs implications juridiques. - Développer et maintenir les réseaux en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec d'autres collègues juridiques et de conformité, la sécurité informatique, People & Culture, Finance, Services de soutien, et d'autres équipes d'affaires pour assurer une approche cohérente de la protection des données américaines et des opérations numériques.
• Requisiti - Docteur en droit d'une école de droit agréée par l'ABA, autorisée à pratiquer le droit dans un ou plusieurs des 50 États en règle. - Oui. Au moins huit (8) ans d'expérience pratique du droit dans un grand ou moyen cabinet d'avocats ou expérience au sein d'un service de protection de la vie privée, de conformité, juridique ou contractuel dans une entreprise des sciences de la vie (p. ex., Pharma, Diagnostics, Appareils, Biotech). - Connaissance des lois, des règles, des règlements et des normes de l'industrie sur la protection des données et les questions numériques, ainsi que sur la sécurité de l'information et la protection de la vie privée à l'échelle fédérale, des États et internationale (comme HIPAA, CCPA, RGPD). - Expérience de l'examen, de la rédaction et de la négociation; l'expérience des dispositions relatives à la sécurité de l'information et à la protection des renseignements personnels dans les accords, les accords commerciaux associés et les accords de transfert ou de traitement de données est privilégiée. - Une capacité démontrée d'établir et de maintenir des relations de travail ouvertes, franches, collaboratives et confiantes. - Oui. Capacité à exercer un jugement indépendant et à transmettre un message cohérent face à la pression ou à l'adversité, et à travailler avec et maintenir la confiance

jobs.title: Practicante - Legal & Compliance
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
xt

En Roche estamos buscando talento dispuesto a tomar retos innovar con proyectos, e interactuar con la diversidad con la que cuenta nuestro equipo multidisciplinar.

Si eres estudiante de últimos semestres de Derecho consideras que tienes un nivel de inglés B2 - C2 y te interesa explorar el área de Legal & Compliance ( Derecho Corporativo); te invitamos a que hagas parte de este equipo.
Donde harás parte de proyectos críticos y de impacto para el negocio, en temas de Compliance, apoyando en elaboración de documentos legales, apoyo en investigaciones legales y monitoreo del cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas, regulaciones locales y Códigos de ética de la industria.

¿Qué harías?

• Elaborar documentos legales atendiendo la operatividad del negocio y regulaciones locales.

• Apoyar al Legal & Compliance Business Partner Pharma en diversas tareas incluidas la realización de investigaciones legales, redacción y revisión de documentos.

• Preparar sesiones de capacitación en asuntos legales, regulatorios y de compliance, cuando sea requeridas.

• Apoyar a los diferentes Legal & Compliance Business Partners Pharma/DIA/DC en la implementación de los mandatos legales y éticos aplicables en Colombia, a través de herramientas innovadoras.

• Realizar y acompañar las labores de monitoreo y seguimiento al cumplimiento de las acciones correctivas y preventivas que correspondan para el cabal cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas, regulaciones locales y código de ética de la industria farmacéutica de AFIDRO y normas vigentes.

• Soportar las labores que tengan impacto legal corporativo y comercial que requiera el negocio tales como elaboración de Actas de Junta directiva, modificaciones estatutarias, otorgamiento de poderes generales y especiales y sus correspondientes trámites ante las Autoridades.

• Apoyar en entrenamiento y consultas relacionadas con la herramienta de contratos ECML y el procedimiento de contratación.

¿Quién eres?

• Eres estudiante de últimos semestres de la carrera de Derecho.

• Tienes manejo de paquete de Microsoft Office.

• Tienes manejo de Inglés Intermedio - avanzado.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, smoke study, VHP, Isolator EMPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.
● Support the initial development and optimization of aseptic filling processes.
● Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan.
● Trained and qualified on equipment operation and aseptic techniques.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:
● Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.
● Performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, filling and stoppering, capping.
● Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team.
● Support environmental monitoring activities to ensure that the Isolatore environment meets aseptic standards.
● Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA.
● Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime.
● Execute regular validation activities, such as APS.
● Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area.
● Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
● College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies
● 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.
● Experienced in strategic projects of Aseptic Filling facility including design, commissioning & qualification，Isolator filling line is preferred.
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.
● Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Technical Product Owner

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity

As a Technical Product Owner for our Source-to-Procure (S2P) ecosystem, you bridge the gap between technical execution and business objectives. Working at an advanced professional level alongside Senior Product Managers, you own the product backlog and drive the execution of our digital procurement roadmap. You join a collaborative, forward-thinking Informatics team focused on delivering enterprise-scale value.
In this role, you will:

• Own and prioritize the S2P product backlog, translating strategic business goals into actionable technical user stories.

• Lead the end-to-end scope and execution of large-scale S2P initiatives, managing dependencies across cross-functional teams.

• Optimize delivery methodologies by tailoring frameworks like Scrum, SAFe, Kanban, or ITSM to maximize efficiency and maintain high quality.

• Act as a trusted advisor to a diverse group of stakeholders, navigating complex matrix environments to align expectations and build consensus.

• Diagnose system bottlenecks and lead root-cause analysis to design and validate technical or workflow enhancement plans.

• Mentor team members , fostering a collaborative spirit, driving mutual accountability, and guiding the team through ambiguity.

Who You Are

You are a versatile, analytical professional who thrives at the intersection of agile delivery and procurement technology. You are a natural facilitator who handles uncertainty with a pragmatic mindset and communicates effortlessly with both technical and business partners.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• 6-8 years of experience working with procurement platforms (Source-to-Pay, Sourcing, Contracting, or Requisition-to-Pay), including at least 2 years supporting the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry.

• A proven track record of leading the delivery of complex features, major product releases, or service transitions within a product ownership or delivery management capacity.

• Versatile framework expertise with hands-on experience navigating environments as a Product Owner, Project Manager, Service Delivery Manager, or Agile Coach.

• Strong strategic acumen with a demonstrated ability to translate high-level business goals into structured implementation roadmaps and technical delivery strategies.

• Advanced problem-solving skills and proficiency with modern delivery tools to analyze dependencies, run root-cause analysis, and optimize workflows.

• Exceptional relationship-building skills , with a coaching mindset

descriptionByLocale.it: Roche Digital Technology (RDT) Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è il luogo in cui l'innovazione incontra uno scopo preciso. Come team globale al cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi con una mentalità imprenditoriale, impegnati ad aiutare a plasmare il futuro digitale dell'assistenza sanitaria di domani. La nostra missione è potenziare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e di innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidati da uno scopo e da una passione, stiamo preparando un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza trainante in tutta Roche, volendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, sperimentando il potenziale umano e guidando le innovazioni che contano davvero per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. Opportunità di lavoro Come Technical Product Owner per il nostro ecosistema Source-to-Procure (S2P), colmi il potenziale tra l'esecuzione tecnica e gli obiettivi aziendali. Un livello professionale avanzato insieme ai Senior Product Manager, possiedi il product backlog e guidi l'esecuzione della nostra roadmap digitale di appalti. Ti unirai a un team informatico collaborativo e lungimirante, concentrato sulla consegna di valore su scala aziendale. In questo ruolo, ti ripudiai di: - Possedere e osare priorità al prodotto backlog S2P, diffusondo gli obiettivi strategici in storie utente implementabili. - Guidare l'ambito e l'esecuzione end-to-end di iniziative S2P su larga scala, gestendo le dipendenze tra team multifunzionali. - Ottimizzare le metodologie di consegna adattando framework come Scrum, SAFe, Kanban o ITSM per massimizzare l'efficienza e mantenere un'alta qualità. - Agire come consulente fidato per un gruppo diversificato di stakeholder, navigando in ambienti complessi a matrice per allineare le aspettative e costruire il consenso. - Diagnosticare i colli di bottiglia del sistema e guidare l'analisi delle cause radice per progettare e convalidare piani di potenziamento tecnici o di flusso di lavoro. - Mentore dei membri del team, promuovendo uno spirito collaborativo, favorndo la responsabilità reciproca e guidando il team attraverso l'ambiguità. Chi sei Sei un professionista versatile e analitico che prospera all'incrocio tra consegna agile e tecnologia di approvvigionamento. Sei un facilitatore naturale che controlla l'errore con un mindset pragmatico e comunica senza sforzo con entrambi i partner tecnici e aziendali. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, porti: - 6-8 anni di esperienza nel lavoro con piattaforme di approvvigionamento (Source-to-Pay, Sourcing, Contracting o Requisition-to-Pay), inclusi almeno 2 anni di supporto al settore delle scienze della vita o dell'industria farmaceutica. - No. Un track record comprovato nella guida della consegna di funzionalità complesse, di importanti rilasci di prodotti o di transizioni di servizi all'interno di una capacità di proprietà del prodotto o di gestione della consegna. - Esperienza versatile con i framework con esperienza pratica nella navigazione di ambienti come Product Owner, Project Manager, Service Delivery Manager o Agile Coach. - Forte acume strategica con capacità dimostrata di tradurre obiettivi aziendali di alto livello in road map di implementazione strutturate e strategie di consegna tecnica. - Abilità avanzata di problem solving e competenza con strumenti di consegna moderni per analisi le dipendenze, eseguire l'analisi delle cause eredita e ottimizza i flussi di lavoro. - Eccellenti capacità di costruzione di relazioni, con un mindset di coaching.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
LEL 区域生态圈负责人
Local Ecosystem Lead

生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。

A. 目标与计划管理

• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性

• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划

B. 客户管理与区域合作

• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。

C. 团队管理

• 参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划

• 吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展

• 打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景

D. 财务和合规管理

• 分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标

• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者

• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质

• 思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维

• 领导力特质：系统思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养

• 业务及资源规划能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

• 具有卓越合规意识，以身作则，带领团队业务在合规基石上稳健发展

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Data Transfer Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Data Transfer Engineer within the Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) team, you will be responsible for owning the high-speed data transfer services that feed our advanced compute environments. With the introduction of our industry-leading AI Factory, the ability to move massive, petabyte-scale datasets rapidly and securely is more critical than ever. You will own the deployment, configuration, and ongoing optimization of specialized Data Transfer Appliances that bridge our traditional HPC clusters with our next-generation AI infrastructure. By ensuring seamless, high-bandwidth data mobility and aggressively eliminating network and I/O bottlenecks, you will play a foundational role in ensuring that our researchers can train complex AI models and execute large-scale computational science workloads without friction.

Description of the area

Hosting and Infrastructure (HI) provides mission-critical on-premise infrastructure, cloud hosting, connectivity, and technology products that enable all functions at every Roche site to develop, innovate, connect, and deliver compliant digital products across the Roche Enterprise.
The Value Streams - Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) Team is focused on driving both customer success and platform success by acting as a center of excellence and delivery for the High Performance Compute and AI Infrastructure supporting AI and HPC use cases across Roche. This team facilitates seamless onboarding and adoption for business vertical customers needing accelerated compute—helping those infrastructure consumers with needs optimized for high availability, seamless data transfer, flexibility, speed, and the rapidly changing needs of AI—helping achieve rapid time-to-value.

Job Responsibilities

Pipeline Architecture & Management

• Own the end-to-end deployment and lifecycle management of specialized Data Transfer Appliances.

• Identify and resolve systemic network and I/O bottlenecks to maximize throughput between storage tiers and compute nodes.

Technical Operations & Optimization

• Manage integration with various storage architectures, including Object Storage, NAS (NFS), and parallel file systems such as GPFS.

• Implement automation for on-site deployment and configuration of our factory-built and tuned Data Transfer appliances using Ansible, Kickstart, or Red Hat Satellite to ensure scalable and reproducible environments.

Performance & Monitoring

• Analyze system logs, kernel messages, and network statistics to proactively monitor the health and performance of the data transfer fabric.

• Define and track success metrics for data mobility, providing insights to leadership on infrastructure utilization and performance trends.

User Enablement & Support Experience .

• Explore innovative approaches to drive more frictionless consumption of our Data Transfer appliances, e.g, Agentic AI and MCP

• Develop user-facing documentation, scripts, and tools that simplify complex data movement tasks for the broader scientific community.

• Provide high-level technical support, isolating complex issues across storage, network, and application layers in a collaborative, cross-functional manner.

Who You Are

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s or an advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a similar technical discipline.

• Proven experience in managing large-scale Linux environments (RHEL/rebuilds) with deep proficiency in CLI tools (grep, awk, sed, etc.).

• Demonstrated experience in high-performance computing (HPC

• Manage integration with various storage architectures, including Object Storage, NAS (NFS), and parallel file systems such as GPFS.

• Analyze system logs, kernel messages, and network statistics to proactively monitor the health and performance of the data transfer fabric.
• Define and track success metrics for data mobility, providing insights to leadership on infrastructure utilization and performance trends. User Enablement & Support Experience .
• Explore innovative approaches to drive more frictionless consumption of our Data Transfer appliances, e.g, Agentic AI and MCP
• Develop user-facing documentation, scripts, and tools that simplify complex data movement tasks for the broader scientific community.
• Provide high-level technical support, isolating complex issues across storage, network, and application layers in a collaborative, cross-functional manner. Who You Are Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s or an advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a similar technical discipline.
• Proven experience in managing large-scale Linux environments (RHEL/rebuilds) with deep proficiency in CLI tools (grep, awk, sed, etc.).
• Demonstrated experience in high-performance computing (HPC

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Expert Permit Management (Building Law, Federal Immission Control Act, Ordinance on Installations for Handling Substances Hazardous to Water) (m/w/d) | Experte Genehmigungsmanagement (Baurecht, BImSchG, AwSV)

Dein neues Team
Im Standort Management Mannheim/Penzberg, sind wir gut 1'300 Spezialisten für verschiedenste Infrastruktur- und Professional-Services, die diese für die Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg zur Verfügung stellen. In einem dynamischen Umfeld fördern wir die nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Geschäftsbereiche und Funktionen hinweg, bieten innovative Lösungen und verbessern die Arbeitsumgebung der Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg.

In dieser Funktion bist du Teil der Roche Diagnostics GmbH "Risk Management & SHE Compliance", explizit des Teams "Implementation Management". In unserem Team übernehmen wir die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Überführung von rechtlichen Anforderungen, globalen SHE-Standards sowie Prozessen und Systemen in praktische und wirtschaftliche Lösungen an unseren Standorten. Wir handeln stets mit dem Bewusstsein für unsere große Verantwortung gegenüber der Umwelt und der Gesellschaft und stellen sicher, dass Rahmenbedingungen nachhaltig implementiert und gelebt werden. Wir sind verantwortlich für zwei Standorte, aber dennoch ein Team: Trotz der räumlichen Distanz verbindet uns ein engmaschiger, standortübergreifender Austausch und ein starker Teamgeist.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In der Rolle übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für die Steuerung und Implementierung von Genehmigungsverfahren. Dein Fokus liegt dabei auf der Einhaltung umweltrechtlicher und baurechtlicher Vorgaben und deren wirtschaftlicher Umsetzung in Projekten. Darüber hinaus übernimmst du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Du unterstützt und koordinierst bei der Vorbereitung von Anzeige und Genehmigungsverfahren nach BImSchG, AwSV und Bauordnungsrecht und stellst die Kommunikation zwischen Projekten (CAPEX&OPEX) und den Behörden sicher und begleitest diese bis zur Umsetzung.

• Du wirkst auf die Vollständigkeit von Genehmigungsanforderungen hin, um die Rechtssicherheit der Verantwortlichen zu gewährleisten.

• In Investitionsprojekten (CAPEX) agierst du als strategische Beratungsinstanz für alle SHE-relevanten Genehmigungsfragen.

• Gemeinsam mit den Business Units entwickelst du nachhaltige Lösungen, die lokale Gegebenheiten und globale Trends harmonisieren.

• Du stellst den nachhaltigen Erfolg deiner Maßnahmen sicher und weist deren ökonomischen sowie sicherheitstechnischen Wert für die Organisation nach.

• Du verantwortest in Abstimmung mit SHE-Legislation sowie den Business Units die gesamte genehmigungsrechtliche Dokumentation.

Qualifikationen | Das bringt Du mit

• Du hast ein Studium (Master oder Bachelor) der Ingenieurwissenschaften, Sicherheitstechnik, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Du bringst fundierte einschlägige Berufserfahrung mit (Bachelor 6-8 Jahre, Master 5-7 Jahre), idealerweise erworben in der chemischen Industrie.

• Du verfügst über tiefgreifende Kenntnisse der relevanten Regelwerke, insbesondere BImSchG und AwSV, sowie.

• Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Englisch und verfügst generell über ausgezeichnete kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Als Teamplayer bist du in der Lage, effektiv mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln.

• Du agierst standortübergreifend als Experte/in, eventuelle Dienstreisen vorr

descriptionByLocale.it: Posizione Expert Gestione delle autorizzazioni (legge edilizia, legge federale sul controllo delle immissioni, ordinanza sugli impianti per il trattamento di sostanze pericolose per l'acqua) (m/f/d) | Gestione delle approvazioni da parte di esperti (diritto edilizio, BImSchG, AwSV) Il nuovo team Nel Site Management Mannheim/Penzberg, è composto da 1.300 specialisti che offrono diverse infrastrutture e servizi professionali da Mannheim e Penzberg. In un'atmosfera dinamica, la collaborazione si basa su una soluzione continua per il business e la funzionalità, offrendo soluzioni innovative e un ambiente migliore per gli studenti di Mannheim e Penzberg. In questo caso, da Roche Diagnostics GmbH “Risk Management & SHE Compliance”, specificamente dal team “Implementation Management”. Il nostro team è responsabile della responsabilità della pratica tradizionale e nei termini più economici della più ricca legalità, dello standard globale di SHE e del processo e del sistema nel nostro paese. Operiamo sempre con la consapevolezza della nostra grande responsabilità nei confronti dell'ambiente e della società, garantendo che le condizioni quadro siano implementate e vissute in modo sostenibile. Siamo responsabili di due siti, ma siamo comunque un team: noostante la distanza fisica, siamo uniti da uno stretto scambio tra siti e da un forte spirito di squadra. Responsabilità | Tenendo presente questo aspetto, ci assumiamo la responsabilità della gestione e dell'implementazione del processo di creazione. L'obiettivo è garantire il rispetto delle norme ambientali e edilizie e la loro attuazione economica nei progetti. Inoltre, ti occuperai delle seguenti entusiasmanti mansioni: - Supportare e coordinare la preparazione per le procedure di notifica e autorizzazione ai sensi del BImSchG, AwSV e del diritto edilizio, garantendo la comunicazione tra progetti (CAPEX&OPEX) e le autorità e accompagnando Il processo si conclude con tutta l'attenzione. - Verificare la completezza dei requisiti di autorizzazione per garantire la certezza giuridica delle responsabilità. - Agire come consult strategico per domande relative a tutti gli autori dei propri piani di investimento (CAPEX). - Sviluppare soluzioni sostenibili con le Business Unit, armonizzando le condizioni locali con le tendenze globali. - Garantire il successo del fallimento e ridurre il valore economico e la sicurezza dell'organizzazione. - Gestire, in accordo con SHE-Legislation e le Business Units, rilascia la documentazione relativa a tutte le autorizzazioni. Oggetti di scena | Cosa devi portare - Hai completato con successo una laurea (Master o Bachelor) in Ingegneria, Sicurezza Tecnica o una qualifica equivalente. - Ha una forte esperienza professionale (6-8 anni con la laurea triennale, 5-7 anni con la laurea magistrale), idealmente acquisita nell'ambito dell'ingegneria industriale. - Possiedi una conoscenza approfondita delle normative rilevanti, in particolare BImSchG e AwSV. - Parli inglese fluentemente e in generale hai ottime capacità comunicative. Entra come membro del team, sii in grado di collaborare efficacemente con le varie parti interessate e spiega i concetti complessi in modo chiaro. - Agisci come esperto a livello di sito, con eventuali viaggi di lavoro.
