jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Expert Safety Assessments [incl. SIL-Graph & K16] | Experte Sicherheitsbetrachtungen [inkl. Sil-Graph & K16] (m/w/d)

Dein neues Team
Im Standort Management Mannheim/Penzberg, sind wir gut 1'300 Spezialisten für verschiedenste Infrastruktur- und Professional-Services, die diese für die Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg zur Verfügung stellen. In einem dynamischen Umfeld fördern wir die nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Geschäftsbereiche und Funktionen hinweg, bieten innovative Lösungen und verbessern die Arbeitsumgebung der Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg.

In dieser Funktion bist du Teil der Roche Diagnostics GmbH "Risk Management & SHE Compliance", explizit des Teams "Implementation Management". In unserem Team übernehmen wir die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Überführung von rechtlichen Anforderungen, globalen SHE-Standards sowie Prozessen und Systemen in praktische und wirtschaftliche Lösungen an unseren Standorten. Wir handeln stets mit dem Bewusstsein für unsere große Verantwortung gegenüber der Umwelt und der Gesellschaft und stellen sicher, dass Rahmenbedingungen nachhaltig implementiert und gelebt werden. Wir sind verantwortlich für zwei Standorte, aber dennoch ein Team: Trotz der räumlichen Distanz verbindet uns ein engmaschiger, standortübergreifender Austausch und ein starker Teamgeist.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In der Rolle übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für die Gewährleistung der technischen Anlagen- und Verfahrenssicherheit sowie der Arbeitssicherheit in der RDG, mit einem klaren Fokus auf die funktionale Sicherheit und die Gestaltung sicherer Arbeitsumgebungen. Darüber hinaus übernimmst du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Du führst fachspezifische Sicherheitsbetrachtungen und Risikoanalysen durch, wobei Du insbesondere Deine Expertise in der Klassifizierung der Funktionalen Sicherheit (SIL-Graphen) und Beurteiltung von Systemen mit erstickend wirkenden Gasen (K16-Standard) einbringst.

• Du stimmst Sicherheitsvorgaben ab und implementierst diese konsequent, um die Rechtssicherheit für alle Verantwortlichen im Fachbereich zu erhöhen.

• Als kompetente Ansprechperson prüfst Du Sicherheitskonzepte und berätst die Organisation bei der Umsetzung komplexer technischer Anforderungen.

• Du untersuchst berufsbezogene Verletzungen oder Medienfreisetzungen, führst fundierte Ursachenanalysen durch und leitest daraus präventive Maßnahmen ab.

• Gemeinsam mit den Business Units entwickelst Du nachhaltige Lösungen und begleitest diese aktiv bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe in den operativen Betrieb.

• Du stellst sicher, dass getroffene Maßnahmen nicht nur sicher, sondern auch wirtschaftlich sind, und weist deren nachhaltigen Erfolg für die Organisation nach.

• Du verantwortest in Abstimmung mit SHE-Legislation sowie den Business Units die gesamte genehmigungsrechtliche Dokumentation zwischen Roche und den Genehmigungsbehörden.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du hast ein Studium (Master oder Bachelor) der Ingenieurwissenschaften, Sicherheitstechnik, des Gesundheitsmanagements oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Du verfügst über fundierte einschlägige Berufserfahrung (bei Bachelor 6-8 Jahre, bei Master 5-7 Jahre), idealerweise im Umfeld der chemischen Industrie.

• Du bringst tiefgreifende Kenntnisse der relevanten Regelwerke mit, insbesondere in Bezug auf BetrSichV, TRBS, TRGS, TRAS, DIN EN 61508, DIN EN 615011 und K16.

• Ein ausgeprägtes wirtschaftliches Denken und Ha

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Le valutazioni sulla sicurezza degli esperti di posizione [incl. Grafico SIL e K16] | Considerazioni sulla sicurezza degli esperti [incl. Sil-Graph & K16] (m/f/d) Il vostro nuovo team Nella sede direzionale di Mannheim/Penzberg siamo ben 1.300 specialisti per un'ampia gamma di infrastrutture e servizi professionali, che li forniamo per le sedi di Mannheim e Penzberg. In un ambiente dinamico, promuoviamo la collaborazione senza soluzione di continuità tra aree e funzioni aziendali, offriamo soluzioni innovative e miglioriamo l'ambiente di lavoro per i dipendenti nelle sedi di Mannheim e Penzberg. In questo ruolo fai parte di Roche Diagnostics GmbH "Risk Management & SHE Compliance", esplicitamente del team "Implementation Management". Nel nostro team ci assumiamo la responsabilità di tradurre con successo i requisiti legali, gli standard SHE globali, nonché i processi e i sistemi in soluzioni pratiche ed economiche presso le nostre sedi. Agiamo sempre con la consapevolezza della nostra grande responsabilità nei confronti dell’ambiente e della società e garantiamo che le condizioni quadro siano attuate e vissute in modo sostenibile. Siamo responsabili di due sedi, ma pur sempre di una squadra: nonostante la distanza fisica, siamo legati da uno scambio affiatato e trasversale e da un forte spirito di squadra. Responsabilità | Questo è ciò che ti aspetta Nel ruolo, ti assumerai la responsabilità di garantire la sicurezza dei sistemi tecnici e dei processi, nonché la sicurezza sul lavoro nell'RDG, con una chiara attenzione alla sicurezza funzionale e alla progettazione di ambienti di lavoro sicuri. Inoltre, ti assumerai i seguenti entusiasmanti compiti:
• Effettuerai considerazioni specialistiche sulla sicurezza e analisi dei rischi, apportando in particolare la tua esperienza nella classificazione della sicurezza funzionale (grafici SIL) e nella valutazione di sistemi con gas asfissianti (norma K16).
• Coordinate i requisiti di sicurezza e li attuate in modo coerente per aumentare la certezza del diritto per tutti i responsabili del dipartimento.
• In qualità di interlocutore competente verificate i concetti di sicurezza e consigliate l'organizzazione sull'implementazione di requisiti tecnici complessi.
• Indagate sugli infortuni sul lavoro o sull'esposizione ai media, effettuate analisi approfondite delle cause e ricavate da esse misure preventive.
• Insieme alle unità aziendali svilupperete soluzioni sostenibili e le sosterrete attivamente finché non saranno trasferite con successo alle operazioni operative.
• Ti assicuri che le misure adottate non siano solo sicure ma anche economiche e dimostrino il loro successo sostenibile per l'organizzazione.
• Siete responsabili di tutta la documentazione di approvazione tra Roche e le autorità di approvazione in coordinamento con la Legislazione SHE e le business unit. Qualifiche | Cosa porti con te
• Hai conseguito con successo una laurea (Master o Bachelor) in ingegneria, tecnologie della sicurezza, gestione della salute o una qualifica equivalente.
• Hai una solida e rilevante esperienza professionale (6-8 anni per una laurea, 5-7 anni per un master), idealmente nel settore chimico.
• Conoscete approfonditamente le normative pertinenti, in particolare quelle relative a BetrSichV, TRBS, TRGS, TRAS, DIN EN 61508, DIN EN 615011 e K16.
• Una forte mentalità economica e Ha
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Expert Safety Assessments [incl. SIL graph & K16] | Expert security considerations [incl. Sil-Graph & K16] (m/f/d) Your new team In the Mannheim/Penzberg management location, we are a good 1,300 specialists for a wide range of infrastructure and professional services, who provide them for the Mannheim and Penzberg locations. In a dynamic environment, we promote seamless collaboration across business areas and functions, offer innovative solutions and improve the working environment for employees at the Mannheim and Penzberg locations. In this role you are part of Roche Diagnostics GmbH "Risk Management & SHE Compliance", explicitly of the "Implementation Management" team. In our team, we take responsibility for the successful translation of legal requirements, global SHE standards as well as processes and systems into practical and economical solutions at our locations. We always act with awareness of our great responsibility towards the environment and society and ensure that framework conditions are implemented and lived sustainably. We are responsible for two locations, but still one team: despite the physical distance, we are connected by a close-knit, cross-location exchange and a strong team spirit. Responsibilities | This is what awaits you In the role, you will take responsibility for ensuring technical system and process safety as well as occupational safety in the RDG, with a clear focus on functional safety and the design of safe working environments. In addition, you will take on the following exciting tasks:
• You will carry out specialist safety considerations and risk analyses, particularly contributing your expertise in the classification of functional safety (SIL graphs) and assessment of systems with asphyxiating gases (K16 standard).
• You coordinate security requirements and implement them consistently in order to increase legal certainty for everyone responsible in the department.
• As a competent contact person, you check security concepts and advise the organization on the implementation of complex technical requirements.
• You investigate work-related injuries or media exposures, carry out in-depth cause analyzes and derive preventive measures from them.
• Together with the business units, you will develop sustainable solutions and actively support them until they are successfully handed over into operational operations.
• You ensure that the measures taken are not only safe but also economical and demonstrate their sustainable success for the organization.
• You are responsible for all approval documentation between Roche and the approval authorities in coordination with SHE Legislation and the business units. Qualifications | What you bring with you
• You have successfully completed a degree (Master or Bachelor) in engineering, safety technology, health management or a comparable qualification.
• You have sound, relevant professional experience (6-8 years for a bachelor's degree, 5-7 years for a master's degree), ideally in the chemical industry.
• You have in-depth knowledge of the relevant regulations, especially with regard to BetrSichV, TRBS, TRGS, TRAS, DIN EN 61508, DIN EN 615011 and K16.
• A strong economic mindset and Ha

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Security Insights and Automation

titleByLocale.it: Data Ingegnere - Security Insights and Automation
titleByLocale.en: Data Engineer - Security Insights and Automation
titleByLocale.de: Data Ingenieur - Security Insights and Automation
titleByLocale.fr: Data Ingénieur - Security Insights and Automation

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Security Insights and Automation Data Engineer is responsible for leading, designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and robust data pipelines and infrastructure within the Roche’s DataOne ecosystem. This role involves independently building ETL/ELT processes, optimizing data storage solutions (such as data warehouses and data lakes), ensuring data quality and reliability, and monitoring data systems. You will collaborate closely with data scientists and analysts to meet their specific data requirements, implementing decentralized Data Products following Data Mesh principles, utilizing strong programming skills in Python, expert SQL knowledge, and proficiency in big data technologies like Snowflake.

Job Responsibilities:

• Data Architecture & Pipeline Engineering : Leads the design, build, and maintenance of scalable end-to-end data pipelines using Talend, dbt, and Python. Ensure all architectures are scalable, secure, and aligned with the Data Mesh standards. .

• Security Intelligence Support: Transform raw security telemetry and vulnerability data into high-quality feature sets for predictive modeling, anomaly detection, and automated risk scoring. .

• Stakeholder Management: Engages directly with broader business units and data scientists to thoroughly understand and meet their data needs. Communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Visualization & Insights: Support the mastery of Tableau and ThoughtSpot by ensuring underlying data structures and schemas are optimized for intuitive executive narratives and self-service analytical apps.

• System Optimization: Solve complex data ingestion problems and perform expert-level Snowflake table optimizations and schema designs. Leads high-impact, large-scale data engineering initiatives by implementing robust strategies and integrating complex, diverse infrastructures to ensure seamless organizational data flow.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience handling big-sized data engineering projects and managing complex, large-scale data systems.

• Proven track record of independently building ETL/ELT processes and optimizing data storage solutions such as data warehouses and data lakes.

• Experience ensuring data quality, reliability, and monitoring data systems

Technical Skills

• Expert SQL & Snowflake : Advanced proficiency in designing Snowflake data structures, schemas, and performance optimizations.

• Advanced Programming: Expert-level Python or Scala for data engineering and Gitlab for version control and orchestration.

• Modern Data Stack: Hands-on experience with dbt for transformation and Talend for integration.

• Data Mesh & AI/ML: Solid understanding of decentralized Data Mesh principles and preparing data for AI/ML initiatives (e.g., feature engineering).

• BI Tooling: Technical capability to support advanced visualizations in Tableau and ThoughtSpot.

• API Integration: Expertise in consuming and exposing APIs to integrate security insights across the enterprise ecosystem

Additional Qualifications
Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the proven ability to engage effectively with both technical audiences (like data scientists) and non-technical business stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result i

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Security Insights and Automation Data Engineer is responsible for leading, designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and robust data pipelines and infrastructure within the Roche’s DataOne ecosystem. This role involves independently building ETL/ELT processes, optimizing data storage solutions (such as data warehouses and data lakes), ensuring data quality and reliability, and monitoring data systems. You will collaborate closely with data scientists and analysts to meet their specific data requirements, implementing decentralized Data Products following Data Mesh principles, utilizing strong programming skills in Python, expert SQL knowledge, and proficiency in big data technologies like Snowflake. Job Responsibilities:
• Data Architecture & Pipeline Engineering : Leads the design, build, and maintenance of scalable end-to-end data pipelines using Talend, dbt, and Python. Ensure all architectures are scalable, secure, and aligned with the Data Mesh standards. .
• Security Intelligence Support: Transform raw security telemetry and vulnerability data into high-quality feature sets for predictive modeling, anomaly detection, and automated risk scoring. .
• Stakeholder Management: Engages directly with broader business units and data scientists to thoroughly understand and meet their data needs. Communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Visualization & Insights: Support the mastery of Tableau and ThoughtSpot by ensuring underlying data structures and schemas are optimized for intuitive executive narratives and self-service analytical apps.
• System Optimization: Solve complex data ingestion problems and perform expert-level Snowflake table optimizations and schema designs. Leads high-impact, large-scale data engineering initiatives by implementing robust strategies and integrating complex, diverse infrastructures to ensure seamless organizational data flow. Qualifications Education / Experience
• Demonstrated experience handling big-sized data engineering projects and managing complex, large-scale data systems.
• Proven track record of independently building ETL/ELT processes and optimizing data storage solutions such as data warehouses and data lakes.
• Experience ensuring data quality, reliability, and monitoring data systems Technical Skills
• Expert SQL & Snowflake : Advanced proficiency in designing Snowflake data structures, schemas, and performance optimizations.
• Advanced Programming: Expert-level Python or Scala for data engineering and Gitlab for version control and orchestration.
• Modern Data Stack: Hands-on experience with dbt for transformation and Talend for integration.
• Data Mesh & AI/ML: Solid understanding of decentralized Data Mesh principles and preparing data for AI/ML initiatives (e.g., feature engineering).
• BI Tooling: Technical capability to support advanced visualizations in Tableau and ThoughtSpot.
• API Integration: Expertise in consuming and exposing APIs to integrate security insights across the enterprise ecosystem Additional Qualifications Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the proven ability to engage effectively with both technical audiences (like data scientists) and non-technical business stakeholders. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. jobs.title: Policy, Access & Communications Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a dynamic and motivated intern to support our Policy, Access, and Communications team initiatives. This role provides hands-on experience in health policy, market access, pricing, and strategic communications, allowing you to contribute to meaningful projects that shape healthcare access and engagement.

You will support internal and external events, projects and strategic communication efforts, while gaining exposure to healthcare policy discussions, pricing frameworks and access-related initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Communications:

• Support internal events (monthly townhalls) and external events to increase awareness of products, disease areas and healthcare access strategies.

• Develop communication materials (presentations, infographics, posters, reports, digital content).

• Videography (concept, shoot, editing) and photography for internal and external initiatives.

• Assist in updating and managing the intranet and social media channels.

• Manage the corporate inbox by responding to emails and routing enquiries to the relevant teams.

Access & Pricing Support:

• Assist the Pricing Lead and Pricing & Tender Partner in tracking, analysing and ensuring compliance with pricing strategies and policies.

• Assist the Pricing & Tender Partner in daily operational tasks.

• Support the Policy & Access Partners by gathering, analysing and compiling key data to inform access strategies and decision-making.

• Conduct market research and monitor pricing and reimbursement trends to support strategic recommendations.

• Help prepare pricing submissions, reports, dossier and stakeholder engagement materials for internal and external use.

External Engagement & Policy Support:

• Assist in organising and coordinating high-impact healthcare events and meetings.

• Provide research and logistical support for policy roundtables, media briefings and advocacy initiatives.

• Track and summarise pricing, access and policy trends relevant to the healthcare landscape.

Skills & Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who:

• Has completed coursework in Public Policy, Health Economics, Communications, Business, or related fields.

• Is passionate about healthcare policy, access, and pricing.

• Has experience with graphic design tools (Adobe Photoshop, InDesign, Canva, Illustrator) and video editing software.

• Is digitally savvy, with strong storytelling, writing, and communication skills.

• Has proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).

• Can manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrates high integrity, professionalism, and a strong sense of accountability.

This role offers an opportunity to gain exposure to real-world policy, access, and pricing strategies while contributing to impactful healthcare initiatives. If you are eager to learn and want to make a difference in the healthcare landscape, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier fu

jobs.title: (Sr) AI Engineering Consultant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:
Serving as the Lead Architect of AI Transformation, this role is the visionary and technical engine behind redefining how the organization builds software. Much like a technical evangelist and researcher, you will bridge the gap between "Research AI" and "Applied AI Engineering." Your mission is to revolutionize the engineering lifecycle through AI, establish world-class methodologies for AI-native product development, and act as a high-impact coach to transition the entire engineering team into an AI-augmented powerhouse. You will ensure we don't just "use AI," but fundamentally change how we engineer for the future.

The Opportunity:

AI-Driven Engineering Transformation

• Methodology Research: Deeply research and define the next generation of software engineering workflows (e.g., Software 2.0, Agentic Workflows, AI-assisted coding architectures).

• Process Redesign: Diagnose existing engineering bottlenecks and deploy AI tools/frameworks to automate and optimize the SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle), achieving radical efficiency gains.

• Evolutionary Catalyst: Serve as a "Strategic Catalyst" to steer the engineering culture toward an AI-Native mindset.

Product Engineering & AI Integration

• AI Engineering Excellence: Design and oversee the implementation of robust, scalable AI engineering patterns (LLMOps, RAG architectures, and fine-tuning pipelines) to bring AI capabilities into the core product portfolio.

• Agile Prototyping: Rapidly translate the latest breakthroughs in AI research (from multi-modal models to reasoning-step optimizations) into production-ready features with an agile, hands-on approach.

• Technical Interpretation: Translate complex algorithmic logic and technical constraints into actionable business roadmaps and product strategies.

Capability Building & Knowledge Hub

• Master Educator: Design and lead high-level AI training programs for senior engineers and architects, focusing on Prompt Engineering, model evaluation, and AI-native architecture.

• AI Knowledge Hub: Build and iterate an enterprise-level repository of AI best practices, reusable code patterns, and internal benchmarks to ensure consistent technical excellence.

• Talent Coaching: Mentor engineering leads on how to leverage AI to scale their own teams’ output and creative capacity.

Who you are:

Education & Qualifications

• Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

• A proven track record of open-source contributions or technical thought leadership in the AI space.

Experience

• 5+ years of senior engineering experience, with at least 3+ years specifically focused on deploying AI/ML systems at scale.

• Experience in Digital Transformation or leading large-scale engineering team transitions is highly preferred.

Professional Capabilities/Skills

• AI Technical Mastery: Deep expertise in LLMs, Generative AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), and modern AI infrastructure (GPU orchestration, vector databases).

• Engineering Methodology: Strong opinions, weakly held, on software architecture, clean code in the age of AI, and "Human-in-the-loop" engineering systems.

• Business Acumen: The ability to match bleeding-edge AI capabilities with specific market pain points and IVD/Tech business scenarios.

• Soft Skills: Exceptional cross-functional communication and "Change Management" capabilities—the ability to inspire a team to unlearn old habits an

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Posting: Product Manager
Company: Roche Diagnostics Turkey
Location: Istanbul
Department: Marketing

About Roche
At Roche, our mission is "Doing now what patients need next" . We lead the transformation in healthcare by providing innovative diagnostic solutions that help healthcare professionals make the right decisions and touch the lives of millions of patients. Join our Marketing team to drive the success of our Core Lab product portfolio, which is critical for healthcare professionals' usage.

The Purpose of the Role

As a Product Manager , you will be responsible for defining and executing the comprehensive business and marketing strategy for a highly professional portfolio used directly by healthcare facilities. You will identify market opportunities, understand the needs of healthcare professionals and laboratories, and ensure our innovative solutions are positioned for maximum value and strategic market penetration. This role requires a strong commercial mindset , exceptional stakeholder/KOL management skills , and a focus on B2B dynamics. You will report to the Marketing Manager.

Key 
• Responsibilities

Strategy and Business Leadership

● Define the overarching business strategy for the current and future product portfolio.
● Develop and execute specific marketing plans and strategies for the assigned product groups.
● Identify market opportunities and customer needs to create value for healthcare professionals and patients.
● Develop business cases for new initiatives and manage resources and budget for all assigned programs and initiatives.
● Utilize a strong commercial mindset to drive demand and maximize sales for the portfolio.

Market Engagement and Collaboration

● Engage with key external stakeholders and KOLs , including Lab Directors, Clinicians and Business Partners (distributors) , for current and future solutions portfolio.
● Represent the marketing group on local and global cross-functional teams, driving innovation and market penetration.
● Foster strong collaboration with diverse internal functions such as Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, and Finance, ensuring a seamless and integrated approach.
● Organize and conduct training programs for the sales team/distributors about product specifications, marketing strategies, and competition.

Product Management and Leadership

● Co-create and implement customized solutions to meet defined outcomes.
● Drive process improvements to deliver higher productivity.
● Demonstrate qualities of Creativity, Collaboration, and Contribution in day-to-day work, reflecting an entrepreneurial approach.
● Involve/contribute forecasting, demand management processes.
● Actively collaborate with Healthcare Consultants for required projects.

Qualifications We Are Looking For

● Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Science or Business in the related field.
● Experience: Previous experience in Marketing within the Healthcare (pharmaceutical or diagnostics) sector is important.
● Mindset: Demonstrated Growth Mindset and a strong commercial mindset .
● Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to build relationships, trust, and influence with internal members and other key stakeholders.
● Project Management: Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects .
● Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills and presentation skills are important.
● Language: At least an upper-intermediate level of English (both written and verbal) to collaborate interna

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung

Als Teil einer globalen Matrix-Organisation, entwickelt und produziert der Bereich „Pharma Operations Penzberg“ mit mehr als 1.000 Mitarbeitenden biotechnologische Wirkstoffe für innovative Medikamente zum Wohle unserer Patienten. Um eine optimale und effiziente Produktion sicherzustellen, versorgen wir als “Facilities & Engineering” die Wirkstoffproduktion mit Reinstmedien (WFI, CIP, Reinstdampf, Gase) und managen die Wartungs- und Instandhaltungs Aktivitäten rund um unsere Produktionsanlagen und Gebäude.
Unser Team ist verantwortlich für die GMP Compliance in diesem Bereich. Wir sind ein Team von 7 Mitarbeitern und bearbeiten die ganze Palette der GMP Themen (Dokumentenmanagement, Abweichungen, Training, Change Control, Quality Risk Management). Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung in die grundlegenden GMP Anforderungen wollen wir Dich in die Themen Dokumentenmanagement und Quality Risk Management miteinbeziehen. Dabei wirst Du mit einem diversen und motivierten Team zusammenarbeiten.

Deine Aufgaben

als Praktikant unterstützt Du die Mitarbeiter des GMP Service Facilities & Engineering und verrichtest zum Teil selbständig nach Anweisung oder nach Vorgabe folgende Tätigkeiten:

• Erstellung von Standard Operating Procedures

• Erstellung von Quality Risk Dokumenten

• weitere Qualitätssicherungstätigkeiten nach Bedarf

Die Tätigkeit ist auf Wunsch auch größtenteils remote möglich. Ein Laptop wird gestellt. Ein Anspruch auf weitere Ausstattung für mobile Arbeiten besteht nicht.

Dein Profil

• Du bist aktuell in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudium im naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich immatrikuliert oder Du befindest Dich in einem Gap-Year

• Du bringst idealerweise erste Kenntnisse im Bereich Clean Utilities und grundlegende theoretische und praktische Kenntnisse in der Analyse und Aufbereitung technischer Fragestellungen mit

• Du arbeitest gern in der Matrix

• Du kannst Dich gut selbst organisieren, arbeitest strukturiert und hast sehr gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung

• You are good in English

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine

• Fitnessstudio auf dem Roche Campus

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle

Deine Bewerbung

Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden.

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Zeitraum : ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von 6 Monaten (bis 37.5 h/Woche) bzw. 12 Monaten (20 h/Woche)

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe

jobs.title: Volontariat in der Unternehmenskommunikation (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wer wir sind

Roche beschäftigt weltweit mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeitende, Pionierarbeit in Diagnostik und Pharma leisten, um eine gesündere Zukunft für alle zu schaffen. Das Unternehmen ist zu einem der größten Biotech-Unternehmen der Welt gewachsen, ebenso zu einem führenden Anbieter von In-vitro-Diagnostika und einem globalen Anbieter von innovativen Lösungen für große Therapiebereiche. In Deutschland arbeiten rund 18.600 Mitarbeitende täglich für das Wohl von Patient:innen.

Unser Erfolg gründet sich auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt – und darauf, dass wir unsere Unterschiede als Vorteil betrachten. Um das Gesundheitswesen durch Innovationen voranzutreiben, wollen wir weiterhin lernen und wachsen. Deshalb suchen wir nach neuen Kolleg:innen, die die gleichen ehrgeizigen Ziele wie wir verfolgen.

Group Communications

Wir sind Teil von Group Communications als zentrale Konzernkommunikation von Roche. Der Bereich verantwortet die Schaffung eines nachhaltig positiven Images von Roche und vertritt die Stimme des Unternehmens auf Konzernebene. Das heißt: Wir kommunizieren die Strategie von Roche und die Umsetzung unseres Ziels “Doing now what patients need next” an Roche-Kolleg:innen und vielfältige externe Zielgruppen. Wir führen integrierte und globale Kampagnen durch und stellen Plattformen zur Verfügung, über die unsere Geschäftspartner und Tochtergesellschaften mit den Zielgruppen kommunizieren können. Wir tragen dazu bei, das Vertrauen wichtiger Anspruchsgruppen in unser Unternehmen aufzubauen, die Marke und den Ruf von Roche zu pflegen und ein günstiges Umfeld für unser Geschäft zu schaffen. Wir streben ebenso danach, innovativ, zukunftsorientiert, kreativ und mutig zu sein und eine starke, integrierte Unternehmensmarke und ein positives Publikumserlebnis zu repräsentieren. Wir arbeiten in einem Umfeld, in dem Menschen sich entfalten, neue Fähigkeiten erlernen, großartige Dinge schaffen und gemeinsam Spaß haben können.

Unsere Kommunikationsvision ist ehrgeizig und einfach: Wir begeistern die Welt für den Beitrag von Roche zur Gesundheit der Menschen.

Sites Network Communications Germany

Das deutsche Kommunikationsteam des Sites Networks ist verantwortlich für die Umsetzung von Kommunikationsstrategien und -maßnahmen, die zur positiven Wahrnehmung von Roche und unserer Standorte beitragen – und das sowohl bei unseren derzeitigen und zukünftigen Mitarbeitenden als auch den Communities, in denen wir tätig sind. Mit unserem lokalen Fachwissen und Netzwerk fördern wir die integrierte Kommunikation innerhalb der Konzernkommunikation und schlagen Brücken zwischen lokalen Bedürfnissen und globalen Prioritäten, um die Wirkung unserer Kommunikationsarbeit zu maximieren.

Die Position

Als Kommunikationsabteilung des Sites Network Germany arbeiten wir gemeinsam daran, aus den vielfältigen Inhalten unseres Unternehmens spannende Geschichten zu entwickeln und diese mit kreativen Ideen und Formaten für unsere Mitarbeitenden, Medienvertreter:innen und unser Umfeld kommunikativ umzusetzen. So unterstützen wir die strategische Ausrichtung des Unternehmens und machen die Identität von Roche erlebbar.

Als Volontär:in erhältst du Einblicke in die inhaltlichen und organisatorischen Abläufe der Unternehmenskommunikation und lernst unser kommunikatives Tagesgeschäft kennen. Du hilfst mit, die Transformation des Geschäfts und die Geschichten unserer Standorte Mannheim, Penzberg und Ludwigsburg verständlich darzustellen und dabei den Menschen in den Mittelpunkt zu stellen. Im

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary) 主要工作目标（岗位简介）

• Lead CE-ON event planning and execution excellence

• Lead strategic initiatives of AI and employee engagement

• Implement and track license-to-operate activities and optimize business process

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
(Major functions of the position)

Lead

• Deliver cycle meeting, annual meeting, BTP -enabling meeting, and regular cross-function meeting to drive CE-ON’s strategic priorities

• Elevate CE-ON employee engagement, motivation and recognition mechanisms through close collaborations with TA and cross-functions

• Spearhead Everyday AI to enhance employee efficiency and to drive strategic customer engagement

• Manage CE-ON budget planning, PO and ad-hoc finance analysis with the support of operational specialist

• Serve as PPoC (primary point of contact) in EBPG (Event Business Process Group) to continuously optimize the policies, processes and systems for operational efficiency

• Serve as PPoC to implement and track enterprise-level license-to-operate (e.g., legal & compliance) initiatives and regular requirements

Support

• Proactively contribute to CE-ON People Strategy initiatives (e.g., leadership, capability building, hi-potential program) in collaborations with TA, RCA, P&C and P&OG

• Provide coaching to the operational specialist for the maintenance of internal communication content and key channels, event and meeting logistics

Our therapeutic focus spans Ophthalmology and Neuroscience (ON). Under the Roche One Pharma Strategy, these two end-to-end disease areas are prioritized both globally and in China across the entire value chain—from R&D and manufacturing through to commercialization. We offer an industry-leading pipeline, a best-in-class inline portfolio, and innovative solutions specifically tailored to address the unmet needs of patients and the clinical community.

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验

Education/Qualifications教育程度/所获资格证书

• Master degree preferred

• Project management and/or operation management certificates preferred

• Event planning or internal communications, event management excellence, HR training experience is a plus

Leadership Competencies领导者胜任力

• Strong organizational and business acumen

• Strong communication skills and cross-functional teamwork

• Influencing skills

• High learning agility

• Accountability and self-motivated

Job Required Competencies岗位所需胜任力

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in operations management, process improvement, or business excellence roles within the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry

• Proven record of excellent project management and organizational skills, with a focus on delivering results

• Fluent in both written and spoken English

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer for Edge Defense (Cloud)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As a Cybersecurity Engineer for Cloud & Edge Defense, you will be the primary architect and engineer responsible for the security of our global digital boundaries and multi-cloud ecosystems. Your mission is to secure our "front door" by designing and implementing high-performance traffic inspection solutions across AWS, GCP, and Azure using Palo Alto VM-Series as the central pillar. This is a technical "implementer" role where you will architect, design, build, and operate cloud network security infrastructure . You will bridge the gap between traditional network security and cloud-native architectures, leveraging Terraform and Python to deploy security as code. Your goal is to ensure that our global cloud expansion remains resilient, compliant, and protected against machine-speed threats.

Responsibilities

1. Architecture & Design

• Multi-Cloud Infrastructure Design: Design and develop robust cloud network infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and Azure, leveraging Palo Alto instances as the central solution for deep traffic inspection.

• Solution Blueprints: Create detailed cloud network diagrams, design documents, and implementation plans for new cloud-native and hybrid security architectures.

• Architectural Collaboration: Partner closely with network and cloud architects to integrate firewall solutions seamlessly into the existing global network fabric.

​
2. Product Lifecycle & Evolution

• Advanced Palo Alto Engineering: Execute advanced configuration and management of Palo Alto solutions (VM-Series, Panorama), including complex upgrades and migrations in production environments.

• Cloud Programming: Leverage a deep understanding of cloud vendor network infrastructures to configure, program, and deploy security solutions via automated pipelines.

• Feature Enforcement: Implement and manage App-ID, User-ID, WildFire, Threat Prevention, SSL Decryption, and GlobalProtect to enforce a Zero Trust posture.

​
3. Operational Excellence & Visibility

• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Troubleshoot complex network and security issues related to cloud-native routing, load balancing, and firewall inspection within multi-cloud environments.

• Automation & Orchestration: Manage security policies as code while continuously improving automation workflows and cross-platform orchestration to eliminate manual friction, reduce operational overhead, and ensure consistent, high-speed security enforcement.

• Continuous Evo

• Architectural Collaboration: Partner closely with network and cloud architects to integrate firewall solutions seamlessly into the existing global network fabric. ​ 2. Product Lifecycle & Evolution
• Advanced Palo Alto Engineering: Execute advanced configuration and management of Palo Alto solutions (VM-Series, Panorama), including complex upgrades and migrations in production environments.
• Cloud Programming: Leverage a deep understanding of cloud vendor network infrastructures to configure, program, and deploy security solutions via automated pipelines.
• Feature Enforcement: Implement and manage App-ID, User-ID, WildFire, Threat Prevention, SSL Decryption, and GlobalProtect to enforce a Zero Trust posture. ​ 3. Operational Excellence & Visibility
• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Troubleshoot complex network and security issues related to cloud-native routing, load balancing, and firewall inspection within multi-cloud environments.
• Automation & Orchestration: Manage security policies as code while continuously improving automation workflows and cross-platform orchestration to eliminate manual friction, reduce operational overhead, and ensure consistent, high-speed security enforcement.
• Continuous Evo

jobs.title: Planning and Logistics Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
As the Planning and Logistics Partner, you will work together with the Supply Chain Lead to manage the availability of supply of goods in the Malaysia market, logistics operation, inventory management and material master maintenance.
You will analyze and challenge their inputs to ensure sufficient inventory in Malaysia market, while balancing write-off levels error-free and ensure smooth process from importation all the way to the custom clearance of goods into our designated warehouse.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

In this role, you will

• Support the Supply Chain lead in various topics to ensure confidence in RDMY Supply Chain function.

• Drive S&OP meetings with Sales and Marketing to understand demand and forecasts of the market.

• Work closely with the sales and marketing for demand forecasting.

• Manage operations for inter-company purchases & order placement.

• Manage and monitor the performance of 4PL and forwarding agent.

• Manage the import and custom clearance operation ensuring all goods arrive at the warehouses without delay.

• Manage instruments and spare parts warehouse operation and deliveries.

• Material master and install base record creation and maintenance.

• Perform monthly inventory reconciliation.

• Monitor EDI process for goods receiving and material movement by 4PL.

• Work together with internal RA/QA team to maintain Global quality standards for operations.

• Identify process gaps and improvements to be implemented to improve the financial health of the company.

• Support and implement Global tools/projects.

Any other tasks or projects assigned from time to time.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Account Executive - Core Lab
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
A professional with wide-ranging experience. Deals with diverse and oftentimes complex issues, where analysis may require in-depth evaluation of many factors. Exercises judgment in evaluating methods and may determine criteria for obtaining solutions. May coordinate the activities of other employees. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in area of expertise as well as some key contacts outside area of expertise.

Responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories. Typically responsible for medium to large accounts or have a medium to large quota/territory. Must develop customer prospects and create and maintain relationships with decision makers. Contacts/visits existing and potential customers. Works to build and maintain network of colleagues, partners, and customers to share information and obtain prospects. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers. Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of product line and have a more in-depth knowledge of other products or services.
Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

This is a field based role - the territory is San Jose, San Francisco and Marin, CA. You must live within 50 miles of the territory with ability to travel throughout the territory for customer meetings.

Job Facts:

• Contacts new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• Generates demand and maximizes product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• Implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• Works with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• Conducts and organizes necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• Communicates competitive market information internally.

• Networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

Who you are:

• You have a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• You have 3 years of relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Minimum of 3 years experience in the Diagnostics industry; 5 years preferred.

• Minimum of 3 years experience selling capital equip

jobs.title: Stagiaire - Relations Sociales (f/h/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
En tant que stagiaire au sein de l'équipe Relations Sociales de la Direction People & Culture de l'entreprise Roche France, votre rôle consistera à contribuer à la réussite des projets RH.

Quel sera ton impact ?
Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les Responsables des Relations Sociales de deux entités (Roche Diagnostics, Roche Pharma) pour notamment:

• Aider à l'organisation des réunions des instances en conformité avec les réglementations légales.

• Mener des etudes spécifiques liées notamment a la Base de Données Économique et Sociale et Environnement (BDESE) et autres rapports sociaux.

• Aider à la gestion des dossiers individuels de rupture de contrat.

• Organiser et animer une veille juridique sociale.

Ton ADN :
En formation de niveau bac+5 dans le domaine du Droit social (Master 2 ou école avocat), vous :

• Souhaitez acquérir une expérience dans un environnement international.

• Êtes une personne rigoureuse, curieuse, autonome dans votre travail.

• Êtes capable de travailler en équipe et de faire preuve de polyvalence.

• Êtes connu(e) pour votre esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, votre capacité rédactionnelle, et votre écoute.

Poste basé à Meylan (Isère, 38)
Stage de 6 mois à compter de Septembre 2026 /

Chez Roche, nous considérons que la diversité est source d'innovation. Nous sommes ouverts à tous les profils et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail agréable et inclusif.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
● Nous considérons les stagiaires / les alternants comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes.
● Tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de personnes en situation de handicap. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésite pas à nous le signaler en amont de l’entretien.
● Tu cherches un sens à ce que tu fais ? Rejoins un groupe qui œuvre pour des projets à fort impact et l’avancée pour la santé de tous.

Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur et à propulser ta carrière avec Roche, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature !

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: SHE (Safety, Health, & Environment) Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Roche Diagnostics' dynamic Carlsbad and San Diego operations as an experienced SHE (Safety, Health, and Environment) leader ready to make a meaningful impact. In this strategic leadership role, you'll direct comprehensive safety, health, and environmental initiatives across our thriving 24/6 manufacturing and R&D facilities, building a culture of proactive protection that safeguards our people, environment, and business continuity. Reporting to the Director of Sites, SHE, & Security, you'll lead a dedicated SHE team and collaborate cross-functionally to embed best practices throughout the organization—transforming strategic vision into operational excellence.

The Opportunity

• Lead day-to-day and long-term strategic SHE operations at a 24/6 manufacturing and Research & Development business, while leading a team of SHE professionals to protect employees, environment, property, and business continuity.

• Develop, implement, and lead a comprehensive SHE management system aligned with Roche corporate directives and all local, regional, state, and federal regulatory requirements.

• Develop and drive business goals that promote a proactive SHE culture tailored to local needs while meeting Roche SHE objectives.

• Drive continual improvement within the SHE team to develop internal capabilities and capacities through individual growth, team development, and process optimization.

• Monitor, document, and report SHE KPIs, trends, and implementation progress while ensuring risk management and assessment guide continual improvement in site performance.

• Lead or participate in investigations into critical incidents affecting the company, including injuries, environmental releases, and security events, and provide site leadership during SHE inspections and audits.

• Manage financial provisions for the SHE department and establish/maintain relationships with local SHE authorities, professional organizations, and regulatory bodies.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's degree in Science and/or Engineering-related field, with professional certifications such as CIH, CSP, CBSP, or REM preferred.

• 8+ years in a similar SHE leadership role with demonstrated technical expertise and people leadership experience.

• Extensive project management, organizational change management, and experience working in matrix and multi-cultural environments.

• Substantial experience working with diverse senior leaders and ability to communicate effectively in spoken and written English.

• Regular travel between local sites required; occasional travel to US and International locations necessary.

This position is not eligible for relocation.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $105,000 - $195,00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
GenMark is now a proud member of the Roche Group, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. As a global leader in healthcare, Roche Diagnostics offers a broad portfolio of products, tools and services that help in the prevention, diagnosis and management of diseases like HPV, HIV, hepatitis and diabetes as well as other medical conditions, such as fertility

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【職務内容】 本ポジションは、検査に関して高度な専門性、学術知識を持つスペシャリストとして、臨床検査技師や医師、コメディカルに対して最前線で向き合い、検査機器の設置時の最適なアプリケーションセットアップや、検査試薬を用いた正確なデータ取得に向けた技術的アプローチを主導します。日進月歩で進化する医療技術や個別化医療のトレンドを捉えながら、医療現場や検査室が抱える潜在的な課題を専門的見地から抽出し、解決へと導くことが求められます。
高い責任感を持って検査室の検査の質や生産性向上にダイレクトに貢献し、ひいては患者様への最適な医療提供や「臨床検査の価値向上」に繋げていただく、非常にやりがいがあるポジションです。

【業務内容】 ご自身の専門領域および担当エリアにおいて、施設担当の営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職からの依頼、および電話一次対応のカスタマーサポートからの依頼に基づき、病院や検査センターに訪問して以下の業務を担っていただきます。

1. 医療従事者との関係構築・学術活動（拡販活動）

• 臨床検査技師、医師、コメディカルとのコミュニケーションを通じた強固な関係構築

• 当社製品の情報提供及び拡販活動（病院内、検査センター内向けの勉強会の企画・実施等を含む）

2.アプリケーション・セットアップおよび高度なデータサポート

• 検査機器の設置時における、専門的なアプリケーションセットアップ業務

• 検査試薬を用いた、正確なデータ取得のための技術的なサポート業務

• Digital Productを用いた検査業務の運用最適化の推進業務

• 機器試薬に関する問い合わせ、苦情対応業務

3. セールス・サポートおよび将来のプロモーション活動

• 専門的知見を用いた、機器・DigitalProduct・試薬販売における営業へのサポート業務および検査室への学術情報の提供

• 将来的にはセールスサイエンティストとして、顧客の課題抽出やソリューション提案、プロモーション活動など、ビジネスを牽引する役割も期待されます

【応募条件（必須要件）】

• 普通自動車運転免許および運転経験を有すること。

• 全国転勤可であること。

• 以下1〜4いずれかのご経験・志向をお持ちの方
臨床検査技師の方: 病院、または検査センターでの検体検査の実務経験があり、個別化医療に関わり、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上への志向をお持ちの方（※遺伝子検査、免疫・生化学検査、病理検査の経験者が好ましいですが、ヘマトロジー検査、尿検査、血液凝固検査など幅広く歓迎します）。
診断薬・医療機器メーカーの経験者 体外診断薬や医療機器メーカーにおいて、アプリケーションスペシャリスト（AS）やアプリケーションサイエンティストとしての実務経験をお持ちの方。これまでの経験を活かし、より専門性を高めながら、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上やビジネスの拡大に深くコミットしたい方。
学術部門のご経験者 製薬メーカー等の学術部門での経験があり、病気の早期発見から治療方針決定、モニタリングまで幅広く貢献する「臨床検査学」に関心をお持ちの方。

【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】

• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方。

• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方。

• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方。

• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　フィールドサイエンティスト
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
就業場所
（雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス　※担当地域は立川または板橋
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※入社にあたり転居が必要と会社が判断した場合は、社宅適用あり
　　 時間外固定手当：月51,936円　（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　　※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
　　＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
（※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
受動喫煙防止措置　屋内全面禁煙

descriptionByLocale.de:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position
• 業務内容
• ・検査機器の設置時のアプリケーションセットアップ業務
• ・検査試薬を用いた正確なデータ取得のためのサポート業務
• ・医師・コメディカルとのコミュニケーションを通じた関係構築と当社製品の情報提供及び拡販活動
• （病院内、検査センター内向けの勉強会の実施等を含む）
• ・機器 / 試薬販売における営業へのサポート業務 特定の施設への定期訪問というよりは、自身の専門領域＆担当エリアにおいて、施設担当の営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職からの依頼。及び電話一次対応のカスタマーサポートからの依頼で、病院や検査センターに訪問となります。ルーチン的な業務に追われるのではなく、営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職よりも検査に関して高度な専門性を持つ役割として、高い責任感を持ち、検査室の検査の質や生産性向上に貢献いただく業務です。 応募条件
• 【必須（MUST）】
• ・普通自動車運転免許および運転経験を有し、以下、1〜4いずれかのご経験者
• ・全国転勤可であること
• 1：臨床検査技師資格を有し、病院、または検査センターでの検体検査の実務経験があり、個別化医療に関わり、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上への志向をお持ちの方
• ※遺伝子検査、免疫・生化学検査、病理検査の経験者が好ましいですが、ヘマトロジー検査、尿検査、血液凝固検査など幅広く歓迎
• 2：臨床検査分野の営業（DMR）や、製薬メーカーやCSO、CROでのMR、MSL、CRA等の経験があり、営業ではなく、サイエンティスト（学術）業務に興味がある方
• 3：製薬メーカーの学術部門の経験があり、近年、技術の向上がめざましく、病気の早期発見、治療方針決定、治療効果や予後のモニタリング等の幅が広い臨床検査学に関心をお持ちの方
• 4: 体外診断薬の研究、または製品開発の経験があり、個別化医療に関わり、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上への志向をお持ちの方 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【職務内容】 本ポジションは、検査に関して高度な専門性、学術知識を持つスペシャリストとして、臨床検査技師や医師、コメディカルに対して最前線で向き合い、検査機器の設置時の最適なアプリケーションセットアップや、検査試薬を用いた正確なデータ取得に向けた技術的アプローチを主導します。日進月歩で進化する医療技術や個別化医療のトレンドを捉えながら、医療現場や検査室が抱える潜在的な課題を専門的見地から抽出し、解決へと導くことが求められます。
高い責任感を持って検査室の検査の質や生産性向上にダイレクトに貢献し、ひいては患者様への最適な医療提供や「臨床検査の価値向上」に繋げていただく、非常にやりがいがあるポジションです。

【業務内容】 ご自身の専門領域および担当エリアにおいて、施設担当の営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職からの依頼、および電話一次対応のカスタマーサポートからの依頼に基づき、病院や検査センターに訪問して以下の業務を担っていただきます。

1. 医療従事者との関係構築・学術活動（拡販活動）

• 臨床検査技師、医師、コメディカルとのコミュニケーションを通じた強固な関係構築

• 当社製品の情報提供及び拡販活動（病院内、検査センター内向けの勉強会の企画・実施等を含む）

2.アプリケーション・セットアップおよび高度なデータサポート

• 検査機器の設置時における、専門的なアプリケーションセットアップ業務

• 検査試薬を用いた、正確なデータ取得のための技術的なサポート業務

• Digital Productを用いた検査業務の運用最適化の推進業務

• 機器試薬に関する問い合わせ、苦情対応業務

3. セールス・サポートおよび将来のプロモーション活動

• 専門的知見を用いた、機器・DigitalProduct・試薬販売における営業へのサポート業務および検査室への学術情報の提供

• 将来的にはセールスサイエンティストとして、顧客の課題抽出やソリューション提案、プロモーション活動など、ビジネスを牽引する役割も期待されます

【応募条件（必須要件）】

• 普通自動車運転免許および運転経験を有すること。

• 全国転勤可であること。

• 以下1〜4いずれかのご経験・志向をお持ちの方
臨床検査技師の方: 病院、または検査センターでの検体検査の実務経験があり、個別化医療に関わり、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上への志向をお持ちの方（※遺伝子検査、免疫・生化学検査、病理検査の経験者が好ましいですが、ヘマトロジー検査、尿検査、血液凝固検査など幅広く歓迎します）。
診断薬・医療機器メーカーの経験者 体外診断薬や医療機器メーカーにおいて、アプリケーションスペシャリスト（AS）やアプリケーションサイエンティストとしての実務経験をお持ちの方。これまでの経験を活かし、より専門性を高めながら、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上やビジネスの拡大に深くコミットしたい方。
学術部門のご経験者 製薬メーカー等の学術部門での経験があり、病気の早期発見から治療方針決定、モニタリングまで幅広く貢献する「臨床検査学」に関心をお持ちの方。

【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】

• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方。

• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方。

• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方。

• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　フィールドサイエンティスト
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
就業場所
（雇い入れ直後）:大宮オフィス　〒330-0854埼玉県さいたま市大宮区桜木町1-10-16　シーノ大宮ノースウイング　10F
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　 時間外固定手当：月51,936円　（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　　※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
　　＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）

The Position 【職務内容】 本ポジションは、検査に関して高度な専門性、学術知識を持つスペシャリストとして、臨床検査技師や医師、コメディカルに対して最前線で向き合い、検査機器の設置時の最適なアプリケーションセットアップや、検査試薬を用いた正確なデータ取得に向けた技術的アプローチを主導します。日進月歩で進化する医療技術や個別化医療のトレンドを捉えながら、医療現場や検査室が抱える潜在的な課題を専門的見地から抽出し、解決へと導くことが求められます。 高い責任感を持って検査室の検査の質や生産性向上にダイレクトに貢献し、ひいては患者様への最適な医療提供や「臨床検査の価値向上」に繋げていただく、非常にやりがいがあるポジションです。 【業務内容】 ご自身の専門領域および担当エリアにおいて、施設担当の営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職からの依頼、および電話一次対応のカスタマーサポートからの依頼に基づき、病院や検査センターに訪問して以下の業務を担っていただきます。 1. 医療従事者との関係構築・学術活動（拡販活動）
• 臨床検査技師、医師、コメディカルとのコミュニケーションを通じた強固な関係構築
• 当社製品の情報提供及び拡販活動（病院内、検査センター内向けの勉強会の企画・実施等を含む） 2.アプリケーション・セットアップおよび高度なデータサポート
• 検査機器の設置時における、専門的なアプリケーションセットアップ業務
• 検査試薬を用いた、正確なデータ取得のための技術的なサポート業務
• Digital Productを用いた検査業務の運用最適化の推進業務
• 機器試薬に関する問い合わせ、苦情対応業務 3. セールス・サポートおよび将来のプロモーション活動
• 専門的知見を用いた、機器・DigitalProduct・試薬販売における営業へのサポート業務および検査室への学術情報の提供
• 将来的にはセールスサイエンティストとして、顧客の課題抽出やソリューション提案、プロモーション活動など、ビジネスを牽引する役割も期待されます 【応募条件（必須要件）】
• 普通自動車運転免許および運転経験を有すること。
• 全国転勤可であること。
• 以下1〜4いずれかのご経験・志向をお持ちの方 臨床検査技師の方: 病院、または検査センターでの検体検査の実務経験があり、個別化医療に関わり、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上への志向をお持ちの方（※遺伝子検査、免疫・生化学検査、病理検査の経験者が好ましいですが、ヘマトロジー検査、尿検査、血液凝固検査など幅広く歓迎します）。 診断薬・医療機器メーカーの経験者 体外診断薬や医療機器メーカーにおいて、アプリケーションスペシャリスト（AS）やアプリケーションサイエンティストとしての実務経験をお持ちの方。これまでの経験を活かし、より専門性を高めながら、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上やビジネスの拡大に深くコミットしたい方。 学術部門のご経験者 製薬メーカー等の学術部門での経験があり、病気の早期発見から治療方針決定、モニタリングまで幅広く貢献する「臨床検査学」に関心をお持ちの方。 【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】
• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方。
• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方。
• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方。
• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。 雇用形態および期間 雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用） 試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり） 業務内容 （雇い入れ直後）：募集職種 フィールドサイエンティスト （変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり 就業場所 （雇い入れ直後）:大宮オフィス 〒330-0854埼玉県さいたま市大宮区桜木町1-10-16 シーノ大宮ノースウイング 10F （変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする 給与 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～ ※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。 時間外固定手当：月51,936円 （時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給） ※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給 ＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月） 諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など ※各種手当は当社規定により支給 労働時間・休憩時間 所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分 勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用 標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00 （※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。） 時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ） 休日および休暇 休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日 休暇: ・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり） ・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休 暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など） 福利厚生・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険 受動喫煙防止措置 屋内全面禁煙 募集者名 ロシュ・ダイアグノ

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Diabetes Care
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Your Key 
• Responsibilities

E-commerce Strategy Planning and Execution
Oversee the day-to-day operations of the e-commerce platform(s) to ensure smooth performance, accuracy, and timely execution of campaigns.
Understand business goals and key priorities to develop an end-to-end e-commerce marketing strategy and campaigns
Monitor inventory, pricing, and product listings to maintain consistency with brand standards and competitive market positioning
Develop strategies to optimize visibility, conversions, and overall performance on owned online platforms
Ensure high-quality customer experience across all digital touchpoints, resolving any operational issues and improving customer satisfaction.
Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Conversion Rate, Average Order Value (AOV), and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), providing regular data-driven reports.

E-shop and Naver Brand Store Management
Plan and manage to develop the whole scope of owned e-shop and Naver Brand Store
Create strategic action plans to attain consumers connected to the brand
Analyze traffic of e-shop and Naver brand store on a regular basis to understand the trend of online consumer's behavior
Closely work with APAC and global team to enhance owned e commerce shop and unified portal

CRM activation
Plan and execute CRM activities based on SFDC & Commercial website analysis
Plan to expand CRM to customers (retail stores/E-commerce/etc,)
Champion the digital customer journey, leveraging CRM strategies and market insights to foster customer loyalty and retention.

Key stakeholder Management
E-commerce distributor management
Other agencies and partners depending on business situations
Collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, including marketing, supply chain, and IT, to ensure seamless digital operations and efficient inventory management.

Who You Are

Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher
Experience: Minimum of 5 years of proven experience in e-commerce, digital merchandising, or online retail operations
Language Skills: Advanced English proficiency (both written and verbal) required for seamless communication with APAC and global team.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret complex data (e.g., sales history, search trends, customer buying patterns) to drive actionable insights and optimize product visibility.
Platform & Tech Expertise: Solid understanding of e-commerce platforms and proficiency in web analytics tools.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 职位职责：
• （1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （3 ） 协助 开展学术会议，协助带教人员向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （4 ） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

职位要求：
• （1 ）在校大学生
• （2 ）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4 ）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （5 ）拥有良好的英语书写能力
• tag #LI-DN

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
