jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer for Secure Access Network

titleByLocale.it: Senior Cybersecurity Ingegnere for Secure Access Network
titleByLocale.en: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer for Secure Access Network
titleByLocale.de: Senior Cybersecurity Ingenieur for Secure Access Network
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Cybersecurity Ingénieur for Secure Access Network

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee ingress and egress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are delivered through leading-edge security platforms, automation, and orchestration .
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection, Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN), Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Network Security), you will act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Secure Access Network Services, leading the evolution of Network Access Control, identity-driven security, segmentation and authentication services across Roche's global enterprise.
Your mission is to ensure that Roche’s network remains resilient and compliant through the continuous evolution of our "Defense in Depth" strategy.

Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Technical Leadership

• Act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Secure Access technologies, providing deep technical expertise in the evaluation and selection of emerging security tools.

• Drive the long-term technical roadmap for network access, ensuring all initiatives are strictly aligned with Roche's Zero Trust security architecture and strategy.

• Partner with business units to translate high-level security requirements into actionable, scalable technical initiatives and functional policies.

• Provide mentorship and technical leadership to junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence within the team.

Identity-Based Access and Authentication

• Design, deploy, and maintain robust authentication solutions utilizing protocols such as 802.1X, EAP-TLS, EAP-TEAP, RADIUS, TACACS+, SAML, and MFA.

• Integrate disparate security platforms with enterprise Identity Providers (IdPs) to ensure a seamless and secure authentication flow across the environment.

• Architect and manage highly available authentication services to support Roche's global workforce and critical business operations.

Network Access Control (NAC) and Segmentation

• Lead the end-to-end lifecycle management of Cisco ISE deployments, including software upgrades, capacity planning, and platform optimization.

• Develop and refine endpoint profiling techniques to accurately identify and secure corporate, medical, and IoT devices.

• Implement advanced access control mechanisms , including Dot1x, MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB), Guest Access, and posture-based authorization.

• Design and oversee the implementation of Cisco TrustSec and Scalable Group Tag (SGT)-based micro-segmentation to reduce the network attack surface.

Operational Excellence and Automation

• Serve as a senior point of escalation for complex technical incidents, performing deep root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence.

• Develop and maintain comprehensive observability, monitoring, and reporting dashboards to track platform health and security compliance.

• Advocate for and implement Infrastruct

• Drive the long-term technical roadmap for network access, ensuring all initiatives are strictly aligned with Roche's Zero Trust security architecture and strategy.
• Partner with business units to translate high-level security requirements into actionable, scalable technical initiatives and functional policies.
• Provide mentorship and technical leadership to junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence within the team. Identity-Based Access and Authentication
• Design, deploy, and maintain robust authentication solutions utilizing protocols such as 802.1X, EAP-TLS, EAP-TEAP, RADIUS, TACACS+, SAML, and MFA.
• Integrate disparate security platforms with enterprise Identity Providers (IdPs) to ensure a seamless and secure authentication flow across the environment.
• Architect and manage highly available authentication services to support Roche's global workforce and critical business operations. Network Access Control (NAC) and Segmentation
• Lead the end-to-end lifecycle management of Cisco ISE deployments, including software upgrades, capacity planning, and platform optimization.
• Develop and refine endpoint profiling techniques to accurately identify and secure corporate, medical, and IoT devices.
• Implement advanced access control mechanisms , including Dot1x, MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB), Guest Access, and posture-based authorization.
• Design and oversee the implementation of Cisco TrustSec and Scalable Group Tag (SGT)-based micro-segmentation to reduce the network attack surface. Operational Excellence and Automation
• Serve as a senior point of escalation for complex technical incidents, performing deep root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence.
• Develop and maintain comprehensive observability, monitoring, and reporting dashboards to track platform health and security compliance.
• Advocate for and implement Infrastruct

jobs.title: Praktikum im Energiemanagement & Nachhaltigkeit (m/w/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Stage en gestion de l'énergie et durabilité (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du willst an Lösungen arbeiten, die wirklich etwas bewegen – für Menschen, Umwelt und Zukunft? Dann werde Teil unseres Energy Supply Teams am Roche-Standort Mannheim und hilf mit, unsere ambitionierten Nachhaltigkeitsziele zu erreichen.
Hier arbeitest du mit an der Umsetzung unserer Dekarbonisierungsstrategie, der Optimierung von Energieverbräuchen und der Weiterentwicklung innovativer Versorgungssysteme – direkt an der Schnittstelle von Technik, Nachhaltigkeit und Industrie. Du unterstützt mit deiner Arbeit das Team, das als zentraler Dienstleister für die Energie- und Medieninfrastruktur des Werks Mannheim verantwortlich ist.

Wer wir sind:
Roche ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Pharma und Diagnostik mit über 100.000 Mitarbeitern weltweit, das durch Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit die Lebensqualität der Menschen verbessert. An unserem Standort Mannheim arbeiten rund 9.000 Mitarbeitende an innovativen Lösungen für eine bessere Gesundheitsversorgung.
In unserer Abteilung Energy Supply arbeiten wir daran, den ökologischen Fußabdruck unseres Produktionsstandortes zu minimieren – durch technische Innovationen, intelligente Energiemonitoringsysteme und konkrete Maßnahmen zur CO₂-Reduktion.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Du entwickelst smarte Energie-KPIs und Dashboards zur Visualisierung von Verbräuchen, um Optimierungspotenziale zu identifizieren.

• Du unterstützt bei der Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung einer mobilen Energiemessungen, um auf Anlagenebene Verbräuche darzustellen.

• Du unterstützt bei der Identifikation von Ineffizienzen (z.B. gleichzeitiges Heizen und Kühlen).

• Du hilfst mit der grafischen Aufbereitung von Verbrauchsdaten zur Überprüfung der Wirksamkeit umgesetzter technischer Maßnahmen.

• Du übernimmst die Erstellung von Entwürfen für die jährlichen Kurzberichte sowie die Abschlussberichte nach Ende der Optimierungsphase gemäß Prozessvorgabe.

• Du übernimmst eigenständig kleine Teilprojekte und setzt deine Ideen direkt um.

Das bringst Du mit:

• Studium: Du studierst im Bereich Energie-, Umwelt-, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Versorgungstechnik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang und bist für die Dauer des Praktikums immatrikuliert.

• Begeisterung: Du bringst Leidenschaft mit für die Themen der Nachhaltigkeit und Technik.

• Sprachen: Du besitzt sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch

Deine Vorteile:

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten (37,5 Stundenwoche) & attraktive Vergütung von 2.268 €/Monat > 3 Monate

• Home-Office Möglichkeit

• Rabatt von -50 % auf Kantinenessen

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Umfassendes Onboarding und Mentoring & Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

Erfahre mehr über unseren Standort Penzberg:
https://www.roche.de/unternehmen/unsere-standorte/mannheim

Deine Bewerbung
Bitte lade Deinen Lebenslauf, ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben und relevante Zeugnisse/Bescheinigungen online hoch.

Denke daran, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation richtet oder alternativ an Personen im Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium).

Start: ab August 2026
Dauer des Praktikums : max. 6 Monate

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future dr

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Key Account Manager (KAM) , serás responsable de liderar la ejecución de la estrategia integral de Roche en las cuentas estratégicas asignadas y dentro de tu squad de trabajo en Paraguay, bajo el modelo operativo ágil ReImagine Latam . Tu propósito será orquestar planes de cuenta estratégicos que integren innovación, gestión de relaciones de alto nivel (C-Suite) y planificación de ventas, actuando como un socio consultor experto que conecte la visión de la organización con las necesidades del cliente para maximizar la rentabilidad y acelerar el acceso de la innovación a los pacientes.

The Opportunity

• Liderar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas, el forecast comercial y la gestión eficiente de los presupuestos en el territorio asignado.

• Diseñar y orquestar los Account Plans integrando objetivos estratégicos, planificación de la base instalada (IP) e innovación para maximizar la cuota de mercado.

• Trabajar proactivamente dentro del modelo operativo de Squad , colaborando de forma transversal con áreas como Finanzas, Servicio Técnico, Supply, Médica y Marketing.

• Liderar con autonomía la renovación de contratos y la gestión integral del ciclo de vida de la cuenta para mitigar riesgos de pérdida de negocio.

• Identificar y desarrollar activamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling para expandir el portafolio de soluciones en cada cuenta.

• Diseñar soluciones de negocio a medida y Business Cases de alto impacto que demuestren el retorno de inversión (ROI) ante perfiles directivos y tomadores de decisión.

• Mantener actualizado de forma impecable el pipeline de ventas, los contactos clave y los planes estratégicos por cuenta dentro de la plataforma CRM.

Who you are

• Profesional graduado con título universitario en áreas de la Salud, Gestión Empresarial, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines.

• Trayectoria comprobable de más de 5 años en la industria de la salud, con una fuerte preferencia dentro del sector de Diagnóstico (IVD).

• Experiencia sólida gestionando cuentas complejas de alto desempeño y mapeando roles de decisión clave a nivel directivo (C-Level).

• Habilidades avanzadas en venta consultiva, competencias de comunicación estratégica, disciplina operativa y fuerte orientación a resultados.

• Capacidad probada para trabajar de manera autónoma, colaborativa (Framework VACC) y con alta resiliencia en entornos de volatilidad y complejidad.

• Disponibilidad y flexibilidad para radicarte en Asunción y realizar viajes de negocio tanto al interior como al exterior del país según las necesidades comerciales.

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Network Engineer - Roche Cloud Platform Azure

titleByLocale.it: Cloud Infrastructure Network Ingegnere - Roche Cloud Platform Azure
titleByLocale.en: Cloud Infrastructure Network Engineer - Roche Cloud Platform Azure
titleByLocale.de: Cloud Infrastructure Network Ingenieur - Roche Cloud Platform Azure
titleByLocale.fr: Cloud Infrastructure Network Ingénieur - Roche Cloud Platform Azure

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Azure Cloud IT Infrastructure Network Engineer is a highly skilled, technology-agnostic expert responsible for solving unusually complex business problems with innovative solutions across the entire infrastructure technology space. In this role, you will leverage your deep knowledge of IT infrastructure's impact on Roche's business to make critical technical decisions with considerable independence. As a leader, you will proactively influence technology strategy, mentor global teams, and ensure that all technical designs and deliveries align with long-term organizational objectives and regulatory standards.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Acts as a multi-disciplinary, technology-agnostic solution architect, designing, building, testing, and implementing integrated and resilient solutions across the entire infrastructure technology space. Demonstrates a broad view of how different solutions work together and adapt to business demands, taking accountability for ultimate decision-making in technical design and delivery with considerable independent judgment.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Utilizes outstanding problem-solving skills to develop innovative technological ideas and guide them into final products. Follows industry advancements closely to evaluate promising technologies via Proofs of Concept (PoCs) across technology domains. Leads the end-to-end design of infrastructure solutions, maintains related component standards, and provides internal escalation support to resolve major incidents proactively.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates complex information and potential solutions across the organization, including to the most senior levels of the business, in non-technical terms. Leads as a consultant to senior managers on technology strategy, policies, and objectives, while managing relationships with line-of-business stakeholders. Influences technology vendors and collaborates extensively with IT partners, such as Enterprise Architects and Solution Owners, to integrate feedback.

• Impact/Strategy: Makes strategic decisions that significantly affect departmental goals and leads large to enterprise-level project teams to ensure successful implementation. Ensures that all solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and adhere to the organization’s Technical Architecture Framework (TAF). Plays a pivotal role in project planning by estimating engineering resources, dependencies, risks, and timelines.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Drives success across multiple product lines within a domain by collaborating effectively with diverse, virtual teams from various locations and cultural backgrounds. Leads geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship, providing specialized guidance to optimize performance and innovation.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies advanced technical principles, theories, and concepts, acting as a recognized expert with proven depth and breadth across many areas. Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of multiple Roche business areas beyond IT infrastructure, understanding exactly how infrastructure impacts business processes.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated hands-on experience architecting and implementing Azure cloud network solutions , in depth knowledge of advanced Azure networking architectures and interconnectivity options

• General network engineering experience

• Infrastructure as code software: Terraform, Ansible, Pyt

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Descrizione del lavoro L'Ingegnere di rete per infrastrutture IT di Azure Cloud è un esperto altamente qualificato e diagnostico della tecnologia responsabile della soluzione di problemi aziendali insolitamente complessi con soluzioni innovative in tutto lo spazio tecnologico delle infrastrutture. In questo ruolo, potrete sfruttare la vostra profonda conoscenza dell'impatto dell'infrastruttura IT sul business di Roche per prendere decisioni tecniche critiche con notevole indipendenza. In qualità di leader, influenzerai proattivamente la strategia tecnologica, tutor team globali, e ti assicurerai che tutti i progetti tecnici e le consegne si allineino agli obiettivi organizzativi a lungo termine e agli standard normativi. Descrizione della zona Responsabilità del lavoro
• Scope / (Content Leadership): agisce come architetto di soluzioni multidisciplinari e diagnostiche, progettando, costruendo, testando e implementando soluzioni integrate e resilienti in tutto lo spazio tecnologico delle infrastrutture. Dimostra un ampio punto di vista sul modo in cui le diverse soluzioni lavorano insieme e si adattano alle esigenze aziendali, tenendo conto della responsabilità del processo decisionale definitivo nella progettazione tecnica e nella consegna con un giudizio indipendente considerevole.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: utilizza eccezionali capacità di problem solving per sviluppare idee tecnologiche innovative e guidarle nei prodotti finali. Segui i progressi del settore per valutare le tecnologie promettenti tramite Proofs of Concept (PoCs) attraverso i domini tecnologici. Conduce la progettazione end-to-end di soluzioni infrastrutturali, mantiene i relativi standard di componenti, e fornisce supporto di escalation interno per risolvere i principali incidenti proattivamente.
• Stakeholder Management: Comunica informazioni complesse e potenziali soluzioni in tutta l'organizzazione, compresi i livelli più anziani del business, in termini non tecnici. Leader come consulente per i senior manager sulla strategia, le politiche e gli obiettivi della tecnologia, mentre la gestione dei rapporti con le parti interessate della linea di business. Influenza fornitori di tecnologia e collabora ampiamente con partner IT, come Enterprise Architects e Solution Owners, per integrare i feedback.
• Impatto/Strategia: Prende decisioni strategiche che influiscono significativamente sugli obiettivi dipartimentali e porta grandi team di progetto a livello aziendale per garantire una corretta implementazione. Assicura che tutte le soluzioni siano conformi agli standard di qualità/regolazione e aderiscano al Framework di Architettura Tecnica dell’organizzazione (TAF). Svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella pianificazione del progetto valutando risorse ingegneristiche, dipendenze, rischi e tempistiche.
• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): consente di ottenere il successo su più linee di prodotto all'interno di un dominio collaborando efficacemente con diverse squadre virtuali provenienti da varie sedi e background culturali. Conduce team geo-distribuiti attraverso l'influenza e la mentorship, fornendo una guida specializzata per ottimizzare le prestazioni e l'innovazione.
• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: si basa su principi tecnici avanzati, teorie e concetti, che agiscono come esperto riconosciuto con profondità e larghezza comprovate in molte aree. Dimostra la conoscenza approfondita di più aree aziendali Roche oltre l'infrastruttura IT, capire esattamente come l'infrastruttura influisce sui processi aziendali. Qualifiche Istruzione / Esperienza
• Dimostrata esperienza nell'architettura e nell'implementazione di soluzioni di rete cloud Azure, conoscenza approfondita delle architetture avanzate di rete Azure e delle opzioni di interconnessione
• Esperienza di ingegneria della rete generale
• Infrastrutture come software di codice: Terraform, Ansible, Pyt

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

As a Cloud DevOps Infrastructure Engineer at the SE7 level, you will be responsible for solving unusually complex business problems with innovative DevOps solutions across the entire infrastructure landscape. Possessing deep knowledge of the impact of DevOps practices on business infrastructure, you will make critical technical decisions across multiple product lines with considerable independence. In this role, you will proactively influence technology strategy, mentor teams, and ensure alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory standards.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Establishes technical direction to the whole lifecycle of platforms and services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and retirement. Applies software engineering principles to build and manage large-scale IT infrastructure products and services, abstracting away the complexity of infrastructure to provide self-service tools and APIs for developers. Designs complex CI/CD pipelines, designs and develops self-healing features, and leads Disaster Recovery design and execution plans.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Strategically applies advanced problem-solving and decision-making skills to address highly complex issues spanning multiple product lines within a domain. Leads the maintenance of live services by designing metrics to measure availability, latency, and system health, and is responsible for identifying critical metrics used to establish SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs. Proactively plans for IT Infrastructure capacity, performance, and scalability, and leads large initiatives aimed at optimizing inter-related platforms. Accountable for availability, tuning, efficiency, change and configuration management, and emergency response.

• Stakeholder Management: Demonstrates exceptional customer and delivery focus by proactively leading partnership and collaboration with developers, Managed Services suppliers, and vendors to continuously improve application development velocity and optimize services reliability. Works closely with development teams to ensure new features are rolled out with a strategic understanding of reliability. Provides direction, guidance, and priority setting, acting as a senior analyst to transform customer and developer needs into specific requirements.

• Impact/Strategy: Ensures implemented solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and is responsible for implementing and updating cost, compliance, and security best practices. Leads complex audit exercises, providing required evidence to audit teams, and leads audit remediation plans. Manages ITSM processes, challenges requirements to scale systems sustainably, and applies innovation to foster business strategy.

• Complexity/ (Product Size): Demonstrates proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse virtual teams globally, driving success across multiple product lines within a domain. Leads geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship, providing specialized guidance to optimize performance and innovation.

• Business/Technical ability: Utilizes wide experience applying Software Engineering principles, automated testing, and CI/CD tools to define technical computing infrastructure entirely under the control of software with no human intervention. Implements and maintains Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and CI/CD pipelines. Applies design thinking, lean, prioritization, and agile methodologies to evo

La posizione Descrizione del lavoro Come Cloud DevOps Infrastructure Engineer a livello SE7, sarai responsabile della soluzione di problemi aziendali insolitamente complessi con soluzioni DevOps innovative in tutto il paesaggio delle infrastrutture. Possedere profonda conoscenza dell'impatto delle pratiche DevOps sull'infrastruttura aziendale, prendere decisioni tecniche critiche in più linee di prodotto con notevole indipendenza. Descrizione della zona Responsabilità del lavoro
• Scope / (Content Leadership): stabilisce la direzione tecnica per l'intero ciclo di vita di piattaforme e servizi, dall'inizio e dal design attraverso la distribuzione, il funzionamento e il pensionamento. Si basa sui principi di ingegneria del software per costruire e gestire prodotti e servizi di infrastruttura IT su larga scala, astrattando la complessità delle infrastrutture per fornire strumenti self-service e API per gli sviluppatori. Disegni complessi CI / CD condutture, progetta e sviluppa caratteristiche auto-guarigione, e conduce Disaster Recovery progettazione e piani di esecuzione.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: applica strategicamente competenze avanzate di problem solving e decision-making per affrontare problemi altamente complessi che spaziano da più linee di prodotto all'interno di un dominio. Conduce la manutenzione dei servizi dal vivo progettando metriche per misurare la disponibilità, la latenza e la salute del sistema, ed è responsabile dell'identificazione delle metriche critiche utilizzate per stabilire SLIs, SLOs e SLAs. Proattivamente piani per la capacità, le prestazioni e la scalabilità delle infrastrutture IT, e conduce grandi iniziative volte a ottimizzare le piattaforme interconnesse. Contabile per la disponibilità, l'ottimizzazione, l'efficienza, la gestione delle modifiche e delle configurazioni e la risposta di emergenza.
• Stakeholder Management: dimostra un'attenzione eccezionale al cliente e alla consegna, guidando attivamente partnership e collaborazione con sviluppatori, fornitori di Managed Services e fornitori per migliorare continuamente la velocità di sviluppo delle applicazioni e ottimizzare l'affidabilità dei servizi. Lavora a stretto contatto con i team di sviluppo per garantire nuove funzionalità vengono implementate con una comprensione strategica dell'affidabilità. Fornisce la direzione, la guida e l'impostazione prioritaria, agendo come analista senior per trasformare le esigenze del cliente e dello sviluppatore in requisiti specifici.
• Impatto/Strategia: assicura le soluzioni implementate conformi agli standard di qualità/regolazione ed è responsabile dell'implementazione e dell'aggiornamento dei costi, della conformità e delle best practice di sicurezza. Conduce esercizi di audit complessi, fornendo prove richieste ai team di audit e conduce i piani di bonifica di audit. Gestisce i processi ITSM, sfida i requisiti per scalare i sistemi in modo sostenibile e applica l'innovazione per promuovere la strategia aziendale.
• Complessità/ (dimensione del prodotto): dimostra la comprovata capacità di collaborare efficacemente con diverse squadre virtuali a livello globale, guidando il successo attraverso più linee di prodotto all'interno di un dominio. Conduce team geo-distribuiti attraverso l'influenza e la mentorship, fornendo una guida specializzata per ottimizzare le prestazioni e l'innovazione.
• Capacità commerciale/tecnica: utilizza un'ampia esperienza nell'applicazione dei principi di Software Engineering, dei test automatizzati e degli strumenti CI/CD per definire l'infrastruttura informatica tecnica interamente sotto il controllo del software senza intervento umano. Implementa e mantiene piattaforme interne di sviluppo (IDP) e tubazioni CI/CD. Applica il pensiero di progettazione, magra, priorità e metodologie agili per evo

Planifier proactivement la capacité, la performance et l'évolutivité de l'infrastructure de TI, et diriger de grandes initiatives visant à optimiser les plateformes interreliées. jobs.title: Senior/Principal Scientist - Pharmacometrician
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Major Responsibilities and Accountabilities :
Accountable for the scientific and technical quality and the timeliness of the pharmacometric (i.e. Modeling and Simulation - M&S) support provided for development projects within one or several Disease Translational Areas (DTA) by integration of scientific knowledge from literature and pre-clinical and clinical studies into mathematical models, in order to support optimal decision making in drug development from exploratory phase to confirmatory phase. Additionally, the position offers professional latitude to allocate dedicated time toward methodological innovation, evaluation of new modeling techniques, and standard process optimization to expand functional modeling excellence. For candidates with strong background or interest in clinical pharmacology, a dual-role framework can be customized.

• Develops and maintains timely, scientifically sound, innovative and business-oriented M&S strategy for the projects within or across DTA in accordance with the overall DTA Clinical Pharmacology strategy defined by the DTA Clinical Pharmacologist and the DTA disease Modeling Leader
• Develops and executes appropriate (population) pharmacokinetic and (population) pharmacodynamic models for the project and applies, if available for the project, empirical and/or mechanistically-based drug disease models
• Conducts simulations to illustrate the impact of development decisions such as dosage regimen selection and other trial design features as well as reporting of the respective outcome for internal decision making or NDA documents or peer reviewed journals
• Interacts on a scientific level with the Clinical Pharmacologist with regards to all aspects of the integration of M&S to ensure efficient and appropriate M&S strategy and activities for the project
• Prepares information and strategy for presentation at pRED and PD project team meetings in order to ensure consistency of M&S activities/objectives with overall project goals and with current Roche standards
• Ensures that members of the project team and management have a sufficient understanding of the M&S methods and results applied to the project
• Ensures that M&S strategy and results are integrated into internal and external project documents (e.g. Clinical Development Plan, Investigator Brochure)
• Manages consultants and outside collaborators that provide M&S expertise for individual tasks or entire projects.
• Ensures that M&S activities performed within the project are executed in a timely manner and to the required high statistical, pharmacological and other reporting standards
• Develops and maintains specific scientific expertise in new and emerging areas of Pharmacometrics. Establishes and manages external contacts and alliances in this field and ensures that knowledge for the assigned areas is shared effectively throughout the department.
• Provides mentorship and scientific and professional leadership to other members of the Clinical Pharmacology department.
• For candidates with strong background or interest in clinical pharmacology for local and global, a dual-role framework can be customized.

Qualifications:
Medical degree or PharmD or PhD in natural science with relevant related experience in the planning and conduct of M&S projects for pre-clinical or clinical study data (preferably in a pharmaceutical industry setting)

Experience and/or Competencies Required :
• Experience in planning and conduct of M&S projects for pre-clinical and clinical study data.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Responsabilità e responsabilità principali: Contabile per la qualità scientifica e tecnica e la tempestività del supporto farmacometrico (cioè Modeling and Simulation - M&S) fornito per progetti di sviluppo all'interno di uno o più Aree Traduzionali Malattie (DTA) mediante l'integrazione delle conoscenze scientifiche dalla letteratura e studi preclinici e clinici in modelli matematici, al fine di sostenere il processo decisionale ottimale nello sviluppo della droga dalla fase esplorativa alla fase di confermatoria. Inoltre, la posizione offre latitudine professionale per assegnare il tempo dedicato all'innovazione metodologica, alla valutazione di nuove tecniche di modellazione e all'ottimizzazione dei processi standard per espandere l'eccellenza della modellazione funzionale. Per i candidati con un forte background o interesse nella farmacologia clinica, un quadro a due rulli può essere personalizzato.
• Sviluppa e mantiene la strategia M&S tempestiva, scientificamente sana, innovativa e orientata al business per i progetti all'interno o attraverso DTA in conformità con la strategia globale di DTA Clinical Pharmacology definita dal DTA Clinical Pharmacologist e dalla DTA Disease Modeling Leader
• Sviluppa ed esegue i modelli farmacocinetici e farmacodinamici appropriati (popolazione) per il progetto e si applica, se disponibili per il progetto, modelli empirici e/o meccanizzati di malattia della droga
• Conduce simulazioni per illustrare l'impatto delle decisioni di sviluppo, come la selezione del regime di dosaggio e altre caratteristiche di progettazione di prova, nonché la segnalazione del rispettivo risultato per il processo decisionale interno o documenti NDA o riviste peer-review
• Interagisce a livello scientifico con il Farmacologo Clinico per quanto riguarda tutti gli aspetti dell'integrazione di M&S per garantire una strategia e attività M&S efficienti e appropriate per il progetto
• Prepara le informazioni e la strategia per la presentazione alle riunioni del team di progetto pRED e PD al fine di garantire la coerenza delle attività/oggettive M&S con obiettivi di progetto globali e con gli attuali standard Roche
• Assicura che i membri del team di progetto e della gestione abbiano una sufficiente comprensione dei metodi e dei risultati M&S applicati al progetto
• Assicura che la strategia e i risultati M&S siano integrati in documenti di progetto interni ed esterni (ad esempio Piano di Sviluppo Clinico, Brochure Investigator)
• Gestisce consulenti e collaboratori esterni che forniscono competenze M&S per singoli compiti o interi progetti.
• Assicura che le attività M&S svolte all'interno del progetto siano eseguite in modo tempestivo e agli elevati standard statistici, farmacologici e di segnalazione richiesti
• Sviluppa e mantiene specifiche competenze scientifiche nelle aree nuove ed emergenti della Farmacometrica. Stabilisce e gestisce contatti e alleanze esterne in questo campo e assicura che la conoscenza delle aree assegnate sia condivisa efficacemente in tutto il dipartimento.
• Fornisce mentorship e leadership scientifica e professionale ad altri membri del dipartimento di Farmacologia Clinica.
• Per i candidati con forte background o interesse nella farmacologia clinica per il locale e globale, è possibile personalizzare un quadro a due rulli. Qualifiche: Grado medico o PharmD o PhD in scienze naturali con relativa esperienza nella pianificazione e nella conduzione di progetti M&S per dati di studio preclinici o clinici (preferibilmente in un ambiente di industria farmaceutica) Esperienza e/o competenze necessarie:
• Esperienza nella pianificazione e nella conduzione di progetti M&S per i dati di studio preclinici e clinici.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wichtige Verantwortlichkeiten und Verantwortlichkeiten: Verantwortlich für die wissenschaftliche und technische Qualität und die Aktualität der pharmakometrischen (dh Modellierung und Simulation - M & S) Unterstützung für Entwicklungsprojekte in einem oder mehreren Disease Translational Areas (DTA) durch die Integration von wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnissen aus der Literatur und vorklinischen und klinischen Studien in mathematische Modelle, um eine optimale Entscheidungsfindung in der Arzneimittelentwicklung von der Erkundungsphase bis zur Bestätigungsphase zu unterstützen. Darüber hinaus bietet die Position professionellen Spielraum, um gewidmete Zeit für methodische Innovationen, die Bewertung neuer Modellierungstechniken und die Standard-Prozessoptimierung zu verwenden, um die Exzellenz der funktionalen Modellierung zu erweitern. Für Kandidaten mit starkem Hintergrund oder Interesse an klinischer Pharmakologie kann ein Dual-Role-Framework angepasst werden.
• Entwicklung und Aufrechterhaltung einer zeitnahen, wissenschaftlich fundierten, innovativen und geschäftsorientierten M&S-Strategie für die Projekte innerhalb oder innerhalb des DTA gemäß der vom DTA Clinical Pharmacology und dem DTA Disease Modeling Leader definierten Gesamtstrategie für klinische Pharmakologie
• Entwickelt und führt geeignete (Populations-) pharmakokinetische und (Populations-) pharmakodynamische Modelle für das Projekt aus und wendet, falls für das Projekt verfügbar, empirische und / oder mechanistisch basierte Drogenkrankheitsmodelle an
• Führt Simulationen durch, um die Auswirkungen von Entwicklungsentscheidungen zu veranschaulichen, wie z. B. die Auswahl des Dosierungsschemas und andere Merkmale des Studiendesigns sowie die Berichterstattung über das jeweilige Ergebnis für interne Entscheidungsfindungen oder NDA-Dokumente oder Peer-Review-Zeitschriften
• Interagiert auf wissenschaftlicher Ebene mit dem klinischen Pharmakologen in Bezug auf alle Aspekte der Integration von M & S, um eine effiziente und angemessene M & S-Strategie und -Aktivitäten für das Projekt zu gewährleisten
• Bereitet Informationen und Strategien für die Präsentation bei pRED- und PD-Projektteamtreffen vor, um die Kohärenz der M&S-Aktivitäten/Ziele mit den Gesamtprojektzielen und den aktuellen Roche-Standards zu gewährleisten
• Stellt sicher, dass die Mitglieder des Projektteams und des Managements ein ausreichendes Verständnis der M&S-Methoden und -Ergebnisse haben, die auf das Projekt angewendet werden
• Sicherstellt, dass M&S-Strategie und -Ergebnisse in interne und externe Projektdokumente integriert werden (z. B. Klinischer Entwicklungsplan, Prüferbroschüre)
• Verwaltet Berater und externe Mitarbeiter, die M&S-Know-how für einzelne Aufgaben oder ganze Projekte bereitstellen.
• Sicherstellt, dass die im Rahmen des Projekts durchgeführten M&S-Aktivitäten rechtzeitig und nach den erforderlichen hohen statistischen, pharmakologischen und anderen Berichtsstandards durchgeführt werden
• Entwickelt und pflegt spezifische wissenschaftliche Expertise in neuen und aufstrebenden Bereichen der Pharmakometrie. Etabliert und verwaltet externe Kontakte und Allianzen in diesem Bereich und stellt sicher, dass das Wissen für die zugewiesenen Bereiche effektiv in der gesamten Abteilung geteilt wird.
• Bietet Mentoring und wissenschaftliche und professionelle Führung für andere Mitglieder der Abteilung für klinische Pharmakologie.
• Für Kandidaten mit starkem Hintergrund oder Interesse an klinischer Pharmakologie für lokale und globale, kann ein Dual-Role-Rahmen angepasst werden. Qualifikationen: Medizinstudium oder PharmD oder PhD in Naturwissenschaften mit einschlägiger Erfahrung in der Planung und Durchführung von M & S-Projekten für präklinische oder klinische Studiendaten (vorzugsweise in einer pharmazeutischen Industrie) Erforderliche Erfahrungen und/oder Kompetenzen:
• Erfahrung in der Planung und Durchführung von M&S-Projekten für vorklinische und klinische Studiendaten.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Principales responsabilités et responsabilités : Responsable de la qualité scientifique et technique et de l'actualité du soutien pharmacométrique (c.-à-d. modélisation et simulation - M et S) fourni pour des projets de développement dans un ou plusieurs domaines translationnels de la maladie (DTA) par l'intégration des connaissances scientifiques issues de la littérature et des études précliniques et cliniques dans des modèles mathématiques, afin d'appuyer la prise de décision optimale en matière de développement de médicaments, de la phase exploratoire à la phase de confirmation. De plus, le poste offre une latitude professionnelle pour consacrer du temps à l'innovation méthodologique, à l'évaluation des nouvelles techniques de modélisation et à l'optimisation standard des processus afin d'accroître l'excellence de la modélisation fonctionnelle. Pour les candidats ayant de solides antécédents ou qui s'intéressent à la pharmacologie clinique, un cadre à double rôle peut être personnalisé.
• Élaborer et maintenir une stratégie de S-S opportune, scientifiquement solide, novatrice et axée sur l'entreprise pour les projets à l'intérieur ou à l'extérieur du DTA, conformément à la stratégie globale de pharmacologie clinique du DTA définie par le DTA Clinical Pharmacologue et le chef de la modélisation de la maladie du DTA
• Concevoir et exécuter des modèles pharmacocinétiques et pharmacodynamiques appropriés (population) pour le projet et appliquer, s'ils sont disponibles pour le projet, des modèles empiriques et/ou des modèles de médicaments à base mécanique
• Effectue des simulations pour illustrer l'impact des décisions de développement telles que la sélection des régimes posologiques et d'autres caractéristiques de conception des essais, ainsi que la présentation des résultats respectifs pour la prise de décision interne ou les documents de l'EDN ou les revues examinées par les pairs
• Interagit au niveau scientifique avec le pharmacologue clinique en ce qui concerne tous les aspects de l'intégration de la M&S pour assurer une stratégie et des activités de M&S efficaces et appropriées pour le projet
• Prépare l'information et la stratégie à présenter lors des réunions de l'équipe de projet PRED et PD afin d'assurer la cohérence des activités/objectifs de M&S avec les objectifs généraux du projet et les normes actuelles de Roche
• S'assure que les membres de l'équipe et de la direction du projet comprennent suffisamment les méthodes et les résultats de M&S appliqués au projet;
• S'assure que la stratégie et les résultats de M&S sont intégrés dans les documents de projet internes et externes (p. ex. plan de développement clinique, brochure du chercheur)
• Gère des consultants et des collaborateurs extérieurs qui fournissent une expertise en M & S pour des tâches individuelles ou des projets entiers.
• Veiller à ce que les activités de S&S menées dans le cadre du projet soient exécutées en temps voulu et conformément aux normes élevées requises en matière de statistiques, de pharmacologie et d'autres rapports;
• Développer et maintenir une expertise scientifique spécifique dans les domaines nouveaux et émergents de la pharmacométrie. Établir et gérer des contacts et des alliances externes dans ce domaine et veiller à ce que les connaissances pour les domaines assignés soient partagées efficacement dans l'ensemble du Ministère.
• Assurer le mentorat et le leadership scientifique et professionnel d'autres membres du département de pharmacologie clinique.
• Pour les candidats qui ont une solide expérience ou qui s'intéressent à la pharmacologie clinique locale et mondiale, un cadre à double rôle peut être personnalisé. Qualifications Diplôme médical ou PharmD ou doctorat en sciences naturelles ayant une expérience pertinente dans la planification et la conduite de projets de M et S pour des données précliniques ou cliniques (de préférence dans un contexte d'industrie pharmaceutique) Expérience et/ou compétences requises :
• Expérience de la planification et de la réalisation de projets de M et S pour les données des études précliniques et cliniques.

jobs.title: Competitive Intelligence Leader
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Our Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) team is the heartbeat of Pharma, setting the rhythm by shaping Roche’s strategic direction and ensuring our portfolio delivers meaningful innovation to patients worldwide. By integrating scientific, commercial, and market insights, GPS drives enterprise-wide strategy, portfolio prioritization, and business model innovation to advance Roche’s leadership in the evolving healthcare landscape. As part of the Portfolio, Strategy, and Insights (PSI) team within GPS, which is composed of Advanced Analytics for Business Insights, Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights, Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, these teams work together to provide unbiased, expertly curated, and technology-enabled intelligence to drive lifecycle management, commercialization excellence, and portfolio strategies. The Global Competitive Intelligence (CI) team delivers high-quality competitive intelligence and actionable recommendations that shape Roche’s decision-making across leadership and end-to-end (E2E) molecule teams.
In this role as a Competitive Intelligence Leader based in Basel, you will lead and implement competitive intelligence strategies for both early- and late-stage pipeline assets, as well as prioritized on-market products by leveraging AI-driven technologies and deep analysis of scientific, clinical, and commercial information. You will serve as a strategic thought partner and trusted advisor in guiding Roche’s product, disease area, pharma, and corporate strategy, focusing your efforts on specific Disease Areas (DA) within a Therapeutic Area (TA) and broader industry trends. As a catalyst for strategic collaboration, you will engage with key functions including Research and Early Development (RED), Product Development (PD), PDMA, GPS, Partnering/Business Development, US Pharma, and Pharma International to drive strategic impact.

The Opportunity

• Strategic Thought Leadership & Competitive Intelligence: Act as a strategic thought partner, providing high-quality insights and recommendations to guide decision-making at the Disease Area (DA), Therapeutic Area (TA), and enterprise levels. Analyze and synthesize data from multiple sources (including primary/secondary research, real-world evidence, and AI-driven analytics) to anticipate market evolution, competitor moves, and emerging trends that impact Roche’s strategy and competitiveness.

• Competitive Pipeline Development: Shape competitive strategies by informing competitive positioning, TPP creation, and launch plans (value proposition, differentiation, messaging), while leading the assessment of standard-of-care evolution by synthesizing insights at pre-clinical and clinical stages, including emerging trends and modalities.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence: Partner with key internal stakeholders (GPS, R&D, Product Development, Medical Affairs, Business Development, and commercial teams) to ensure insights are embedded in strategic planning, while fostering collaboration across the lifecycle, functions, and geographies to maximize impact.

• Project, Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Lead and execute strategic initiatives with clear objectives, ensuring timely, high-quality, and impactful deliverables. Manage relationships with external agencies and internal partners, ensuring complete alignment with business priorities and objectives.

• Innovation & AI-Enabled Insights: Champion the adoption of advanced analytics, AI-driven intelligence

By integrating scientific, commercial, and market insights, GPS drives enterprise-wide strategy, portfolio prioritization, and business model innovation to advance Roche’s leadership in the evolving healthcare landscape. As part of the Portfolio, Strategy, and Insights (PSI) team within GPS, which is composed of Advanced Analytics for Business Insights, Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights, Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, these teams work together to provide unbiased, expertly curated, and technology-enabled intelligence to drive lifecycle management, commercialization excellence, and portfolio strategies. The Global Competitive Intelligence (CI) team delivers high-quality competitive intelligence and actionable recommendations that shape Roche’s decision-making across leadership and end-to-end (E2E) molecule teams. In this role as a Competitive Intelligence Leader based in Basel, you will lead and implement competitive intelligence strategies for both early- and late-stage pipeline assets, as well as prioritized on-market products by leveraging AI-driven technologies and deep analysis of scientific, clinical, and commercial information. You will serve as a strategic thought partner and trusted advisor in guiding Roche’s product, disease area, pharma, and corporate strategy, focusing your efforts on specific Disease Areas (DA) within a Therapeutic Area (TA) and broader industry trends. As a catalyst for strategic collaboration, you will engage with key functions including Research and Early Development (RED), Product Development (PD), PDMA, GPS, Partnering/Business Development, US Pharma, and Pharma International to drive strategic impact. • Strategic Thought Leadership & Competitive Intelligence: Act as a strategic thought partner, providing high-quality insights and recommendations to guide decision-making at the Disease Area (DA), Therapeutic Area (TA), and enterprise levels. Analyze and synthesize data from multiple sources (including primary/secondary research, real-world evidence, and AI-driven analytics) to anticipate market evolution, competitor moves, and emerging trends that impact Roche’s strategy and competitiveness.
• Competitive Pipeline Development: Shape competitive strategies by informing competitive positioning, TPP creation, and launch plans (value proposition, differentiation, messaging), while leading the assessment of standard-of-care evolution by synthesizing insights at pre-clinical and clinical stages, including emerging trends and modalities.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence: Partner with key internal stakeholders (GPS, R&D, Product Development, Medical Affairs, Business Development, and commercial teams) to ensure insights are embedded in strategic planning, while fostering collaboration across the lifecycle, functions, and geographies to maximize impact.
• Project, Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Lead and execute strategic initiatives with clear objectives, ensuring timely, high-quality, and impactful deliverables. Manage relationships with external agencies and internal partners, ensuring complete alignment with business priorities and objectives.
• Innovation & AI-Enabled Insights: Champion the adoption of advanced analytics, AI-driven intelligence

jobs.title: Procurement Specialist - Research & Development
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has defined an exciting 10-year ambition plan, and our Global Procurement (GP) organization is already established as an agile, high-functioning team dedicated to delivering on our mission for patients. We operate with a focus on accelerating Roche’s goal to bring innovative solutions to patients quickly and efficiently through robust business and supplier partnerships.

Are you wondering what is in it for you?

Are you interested in further developing and leveraging your market knowledge, business partnering, and influencing skills? Here is why we think the Procurement Specialist - Research & Development role is a fantastic job to consider!

As a Procurement Specialist, you will work in a dynamic global environment where you bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Thanks to your strong problem-solving and core procurement skills, you will effectively collaborate with internal procurement (customer relationship management, contracting, solutions, etc.) and business stakeholders to translate business needs into sourcing, spend management activities, and content enhancement. Based on your general procurement and commodity expertise, you ensure the effective and efficient delivery of core procurement services and continuous improvement of automation and content availability.

You will work closely with team members to support customer demand, improve the customer buying experience, deliver on day-to-day operational activities, and provide capacity and expertise to provide productivity and other customer-oriented projects/solutions.

The Opportunity:

Your successful performance and contribution depend on the full embodiment and demonstration of core mindsets and behaviors, including an entrepreneurial spirit, enterprise thinking, inclusive collaboration, and desire for continuous learning that underpin our culture and ways of working.

As a Procurement Specialist, you will work within the broader team and GP networks and squads to determine the various roles needed to deliver project and foundational work. You will also play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and the general business/team requirements, such as:

• Sourcing and category subject matter specialist conducting market and internal analysis to develop and implement strategies and tactical plans for Roche to source and negotiate for third-party goods and services that satisfy stakeholder requirements.

• Procurement practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management, and project management skills to achieve objectives and key results.

• Content and automation advocate translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

Who you are :

• You hold a university degree, with a business degree preferable. You also have 3+ years of experience in sourcing, contracting, operational efficiency projects, or relevant commodity experience, preferably in the Pharmaceutical industry.

• You demonstrate knowledge in the C

Ecco perché pensiamo che il Procurement Specialist - Ricerca & Sviluppo ruolo è un lavoro fantastico da considerare! In qualità di Procurement Specialist, lavorerai in un ambiente globale dinamico in cui porterai pensiero analitico, pianificazione, esecuzione e attenzione all'approvvigionamento e alla capacità di consegna. Grazie alle vostre forti capacità di problem solving e di acquisizione di base, collaborerete efficacemente con l'approvvigionamento interno (gestione delle relazioni cliente, contrazione, soluzioni, ecc.) e gli stakeholder aziendali per tradurre le esigenze aziendali in approvvigionamento, attività di gestione spesa e valorizzazione dei contenuti. Sulla base delle vostre competenze generali di approvvigionamento e delle materie prime, assicurate la fornitura efficace ed efficiente dei servizi di approvvigionamento di base e il miglioramento continuo dell'automazione e della disponibilità dei contenuti. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i membri del team per supportare la domanda del cliente, migliorare l'esperienza di acquisto del cliente, fornire le attività operative quotidiane, e fornire capacità e competenze per fornire produttività e altri progetti / soluzioni orientate al cliente. L'opportunità: Le tue prestazioni e il tuo contributo di successo dipendono dalla piena incarnazione e dimostrazione di mentalità e comportamenti fondamentali, tra cui uno spirito imprenditoriale, il pensiero aziendale, la collaborazione inclusiva e il desiderio di apprendimento continuo che sostengono la nostra cultura e i modi di lavorare. In qualità di Procurement Specialist, lavorerai all'interno del team più ampio e delle reti GP e delle squadre per determinare i vari ruoli necessari per fornire lavoro di progetto e di fondazione. Potrai anche svolgere una varietà di ruoli secondo la vostra esperienza, la conoscenza, e le esigenze generali business / team, come:
• Sourcing e soggetto di categoria materia specializzata conduzione del mercato e analisi interna per sviluppare e implementare strategie e piani tattici per Roche a fonte e negoziare per beni e servizi di terze parti che soddisfano i requisiti delle parti interessate.
• Praticanti di appalti che forniscono ed eseguono strategie di approvvigionamento sfruttando le capacità di spesa, know-how di categoria, sourcing robusto, negoziazione, contrazione, gestione dei fornitori e capacità di gestione del progetto per raggiungere obiettivi e risultati chiave.
• Sostenitore di contenuti e automazione che traduce risultati e opportunità di approvvigionamento in contenuti e canali di acquisto automatizzati che migliorano l'adozione, la soddisfazione e l'efficienza complessiva. Chi sei?
• Ha una laurea, con una laurea preferibile. Hai anche 3+ anni di esperienza nell'ambito dei progetti di approvvigionamento, di contrazione, di efficienza operativa o di esperienza delle materie prime rilevanti, preferibilmente nell'industria farmaceutica.
• Voi dimostrate la conoscenza nella C

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are developing the next-generation of sequencing systems. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are also broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing workflows.

Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows. We are seeking a Principal Mechanical Engineer to contribute to the design, development, characterization, and integration of cutting-edge sequencing systems.This is a hands-on role focused on solving the fluidic and consumable challenges at the heart of our next-generation platforms. We are looking for someone who exhibits a high degree of motivation, independence, and resourcefulness to help us develop solutions to our automation challenges in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Core Responsibilities:

• Contribute to architecture, design, research and early development of specialized consumables and mating mechanisms.

• Contribute to the layout, prototyping, and characterization of new fluidic circuits and architectures.

• Design, build, and assemble custom test fixtures to support testing of fluidic subsystems and novel consumables.

• Translate high-level system and assay requirements into fluidic schematics, system architectures and concepts to evaluate, compare, and downselect design paths.

• Create and maintain comprehensive design documentation for your sub-systems, including detailed 3D CAD models, manufacturing drawings, and material specifications with a focus on chemical compatibility and robustness.

• Conduct cross-functional design reviews. Present progress, data, and engineering decisions clearly to stakeholders.

This position is based on-site in Santa Clara, CA. (This is not a hybrid position.)
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

Who You Are
(Required)

• You have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline, with relevant years of industry experience (7+ years for a Bachelor's, 5+ years for a Master's, or 3+ years for a PhD).

• You have demonstrated hands-on experience designing, developing, and testing complex fluidic manifolds, consumable interfaces, or moving mechanisms, preferably for life science or diagnostic instrumentation.

• You have a high level of proficiency with Python for device control, automated test bench execution, and data acquisition/analysis.

• You have a strong background in experimental design for fluidic characterization.

• You have a high level of proficiency with machine shop tools, measurement equipment, and rapid prototyping technologies.

• You have demonstrated expertise in SolidWorks for detailed assembly design and the creation of manufacturing drawings.

• You have demonstrated troubleshooting skills, with a solid understanding of physics, chemistry and engineering fundamentals.

Preferred:

• You have experience with plastic bonding techniques and injection molding principles.

• You have experience utilizing CFD or FEA tools to guide fluidic and thermal design decisions.

• You have experience developing DNA sequencing, DNA synthesizers and other complex fluidic automation instrumentation.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, stiamo sviluppando la prossima generazione di sistemi di sequenziamento. Accelerando la ricerca clinica, razionalizzando i flussi di lavoro e espandendo i menu di analisi, stiamo anche ampliando l'accesso ai dati genomici e abbassando le barriere all'adozione. Dai robusti strumenti di isolamento e preparazione dei campioni alle nuove tecnologie di sequenziamento e alla bioinformatica avanzata, stiamo sviluppando soluzioni end-to-end differenziate e altamente integrate per flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento di nuova generazione. Il nostro System Technology Group, parte di Roche Sequencing Solutions, si concentra sulla creazione e l'avanzamento di tecnologie per migliorare in modo significativo i flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento del DNA. Stiamo cercando un ingegnere meccanico principale per contribuire alla progettazione, sviluppo, caratterizzazione e integrazione di sistemi di sequenziamento all'avanguardia. Questo è un ruolo pratico focalizzato sulla soluzione delle sfide fluidiche e di consumo al centro delle nostre piattaforme di nuova generazione. Stiamo cercando qualcuno che esibisce un alto grado di motivazione, indipendenza e risorse per aiutarci a sviluppare soluzioni alle nostre sfide di automazione in un ambiente veloce e collaborativo. Responsabilità fondamentali:
• Contribuire all'architettura, alla progettazione, alla ricerca e allo sviluppo precoce dei materiali di consumo specializzati e dei meccanismi di accoppiamento.
• Contribuire al layout, alla prototipazione e alla caratterizzazione di nuovi circuiti e architetture fluidiche.
• Progettare, costruire e assemblare dispositivi di prova personalizzati per supportare la sperimentazione di sottosistemi fluidi e nuovi materiali di consumo.
• Tradurre i requisiti di sistema e di analisi di alto livello in schemi fluidi, architetture di sistema e concetti per valutare, confrontare e downselect percorsi di progettazione.
• Creare e mantenere una documentazione di progettazione completa per i sottosistemi, compresi i modelli CAD 3D dettagliati, i disegni di produzione e le specifiche dei materiali con un focus sulla compatibilità chimica e la robustezza.
• Condurre recensioni di design interfunzionali. Presentare i progressi, i dati e le decisioni di ingegneria chiaramente agli stakeholder. Questa posizione si basa sul sito in Santa Clara, CA. (Questa non è una posizione ibrida.) I vantaggi di trasferimento non sono offerti per questo ruolo. Chi sei (richiesto)
• Hai una laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, o una disciplina strettamente correlata, con anni rilevanti di esperienza del settore (7+ anni per un Bachelor, 5+ anni per un Master, o 3+ anni per un dottorato).
• Hai dimostrato la progettazione, lo sviluppo e la sperimentazione di collettori fluidi complessi, interfacce di consumo o meccanismi mobili, preferibilmente per la scienza della vita o la strumentazione diagnostica.
• Hai un alto livello di competenza con Python per il controllo del dispositivo, l'esecuzione automatica del banco di prova e l'acquisizione/analisi dei dati.
• Hai uno sfondo forte nel design sperimentale per la caratterizzazione fluidica.
• Hai un alto livello di competenza con macchine utensili, apparecchiature di misura e tecnologie di prototipazione rapida.
• Hai dimostrato competenze in SolidWorks per la progettazione dettagliata del montaggio e la creazione di disegni di produzione.
• Hai dimostrato le capacità di risoluzione dei problemi, con una solida comprensione della fisica, della chimica e dei fondamenti ingegneristici. Preferito:
• Hai esperienza con tecniche di incollaggio in plastica e principi di stampaggio ad iniezione.
• Hai esperienza utilizzando strumenti CFD o FEA per guidare le decisioni di progettazione fluida e termica.
• Hai esperienza nello sviluppo di sequenziamento del DNA, sintetizzatori del DNA e altre complesse strumentazione di automazione fluidica.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Molecular Account Executive - Clinical MD

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
Are you an experienced sales professional with a talent for solving complex challenges? In this role, you'll use your expertise to navigate diverse issues and make strategic decisions that drive success. You'll manage medium to large accounts, exceeding sales targets while building lasting relationships with key decision-makers.

Your goal will be to expand your network, identify new opportunities, and present compelling value propositions. With a deep understanding of our product line, you'll serve as a trusted advisor, continuously improving our quality system through your daily actions.

As a Molecular Account Executive you will:

• be responsible for promoting Roche’s molecular products and services.

• contacting new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• generate demand and maximize product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• work with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• Conduct and organize necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• communicates competitive market information internally.

• networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

This is a field-based role - the territory is Utah, Northern Arizona. You must live within 50 miles of the territory.

Travel expectation: 50% Overnight

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 3+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience

Preferred Requirements:

• Good oral and written communication skills, including making impactful presentations

• Proven leadership abilities

• Negotiation, contracting, and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work in a regulated environment

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting

The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Utah is $86,700.00 - $169,00.00. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This position is eligible to earn incentive compensation that is calculated and paid in accordance with the applicable Incentive Compensation Plan

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Molecular Account Executive - MD clinico Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per far avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità: sei un professionista delle vendite esperto con un talento nel risolvere sfide complesse? In questo ruolo, utilizzerai la tua esperienza per affrontare diverse questioni e prendere decisioni strategiche che portino al successo. Gestirai account medio-grandi, superando gli obiettivi di vendita e costruendo relazioni durature con i principali decisori. Il tuo obiettivo sarà espandere la tua rete, identificare nuove opportunità e presentare proposte di valore convincenti. Con una profonda conoscenza della nostra linea di prodotti, fungerai da consulente di fiducia, migliorando continuamente il nostro sistema di qualità attraverso le tue azioni quotidiane. In qualità di Molecular Account Executive:
• sarai responsabile della promozione dei prodotti e dei servizi molecolari di Roche.
• contattare clienti nuovi ed esistenti per raggiungere e superare gli obiettivi di vendita in account mirati, sviluppando nuovo business, facendo crescere il business esistente, mantenendo le relazioni con i clienti e risolvendo i problemi dei clienti. Ciò include l'identificazione e lo sviluppo di piani cliente strategici, lo sviluppo e la diffusione del messaggio differenziante e del valore economico quantificabile per prodotti e servizi, la vendita della differenziazione primaria dei prodotti Roche, il superamento e la gestione delle obiezioni e la negoziazione per ottenere vendite.
• generare domanda e massimizzare la consapevolezza del prodotto collaborando e fornendo formazione e informazioni ai clienti.
• implementa iniziative e piani strategici per facilitare il processo di vendita e la produttività.
• collaborare con altri, secondo necessità o necessità, per preparare proposte per i conti assegnati. Presenta tutte le proposte contrattuali ai clienti per massimizzare il business e la redditività complessivi, che potrebbero richiedere alcune negoziazioni.
• Condurre e organizzare la pianificazione e l'instradamento del territorio necessari per l'efficienza. Conduce analisi e pianificazione aziendale.
• comunica internamente le informazioni sul mercato competitivo.
• reti e interfacce con colleghi interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche pur rimanendo attivamente coinvolti nelle organizzazioni del settore/cliente che hanno un impatto sul business. Questo è un ruolo sul campo: il territorio è lo Utah, l'Arizona settentrionale. Devi vivere entro 50 miglia dal territorio. Aspettativa di viaggio: 50% Pernottamento Chi sei:
• Laurea o esperienza equivalente
• 3+ anni di vendite rilevanti o esperienza equivalente
• La partecipazione a un programma approvato di sviluppo accelerato, borse di studio o rotazione può essere presa in considerazione al posto dell'esperienza Requisiti preferiti:
• Buone capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta, inclusa la realizzazione di presentazioni di grande impatto
• Comprovate capacità di leadership
• Capacità di negoziazione, contrattazione e risoluzione dei problemi
• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente regolamentato
• Pianificazione strategica e capacità organizzative I vantaggi di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questo annuncio di lavoro L'intervallo di retribuzione previsto per questa posizione, in base alla sede principale dello Utah, è $ 86.700,00 - $ 169.00,00. La retribuzione effettiva sarà determinata in base all'esperienza, alle qualifiche, alla posizione geografica e ad altri fattori legati al lavoro consentiti dalla legge. Questa posizione ha diritto a guadagnare un compenso di incentivo calcolato e pagato in conformità con il Piano di compensazione degli incentivi applicabile
