descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Molecular Account Executive – Klinischer Arzt Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns zu Innovationen antreibt. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Die Chance: Sie sind ein erfahrener Vertriebsprofi mit Talent für die Lösung komplexer Herausforderungen? In dieser Rolle nutzen Sie Ihr Fachwissen, um verschiedene Probleme zu lösen und strategische Entscheidungen zu treffen, die den Erfolg vorantreiben. Sie verwalten mittlere bis große Kunden, übertreffen Umsatzziele und bauen gleichzeitig dauerhafte Beziehungen zu wichtigen Entscheidungsträgern auf. Ihr Ziel wird es sein, Ihr Netzwerk zu erweitern, neue Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren und überzeugende Wertversprechen zu präsentieren. Mit einem tiefen Verständnis unserer Produktlinie fungieren Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater und verbessern durch Ihr tägliches Handeln kontinuierlich unser Qualitätssystem. Als Molecular Account Executive sind Sie:
• für die Vermarktung der molekularen Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Roche verantwortlich.
• Kontaktaufnahme mit neuen und bestehenden Kunden, um Verkaufsziele in ausgewählten Kunden zu erreichen und zu übertreffen, durch die Entwicklung neuer Geschäfte, den Ausbau bestehender Geschäfte, die Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen und die Behebung von Kundenproblemen. Dazu gehören die Identifizierung und Entwicklung strategischer Account-Pläne, die Entwicklung und Bereitstellung der differenzierenden Botschaft und des quantifizierbaren wirtschaftlichen Werts für Produkte und Dienstleistungen, der Verkauf der Hauptdifferenzierung von Roche-Produkten, die Überwindung und Bewältigung von Einwänden sowie Verhandlungen zur Erzielung von Verkäufen.
• Nachfrage generieren und Produktbekanntheit maximieren, indem wir mit Kunden zusammenarbeiten und ihnen Aufklärung und Informationen bieten.
• implementiert strategische Initiativen und Pläne zur Erleichterung des Verkaufsprozesses und der Produktivität.
• Bei Bedarf oder Bedarf mit anderen zusammenarbeiten, um Vorschläge für zugewiesene Konten auszuarbeiten. Präsentiert den Kunden alle Vertragsvorschläge, um das Gesamtgeschäft und die Rentabilität zu maximieren, was möglicherweise einige Verhandlungen erfordert.
• Führen und organisieren Sie die erforderliche Gebietsplanung und Routenplanung für Effizienz. Führt Geschäftsanalysen und -planungen durch.
• kommuniziert intern Wettbewerbsmarktinformationen.
• Netzwerke und Schnittstellen mit internen Kollegen, um Informationen und Best Practices auszutauschen und gleichzeitig aktiv in Branchen-/Kundenorganisationen eingebunden zu bleiben, die sich auf das Geschäft auswirken. Dies ist eine feldbasierte Rolle – das Gebiet ist Utah, Nord-Arizona. Sie müssen im Umkreis von 50 Meilen um das Territorium wohnen. Reiseerwartung: 50 % Übernachtung Wer Sie sind:
• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige Erfahrung
• 3+ Jahre relevante Vertriebs- oder gleichwertige Erfahrung
• Die Teilnahme an einem genehmigten beschleunigten Entwicklungs-, Stipendien- oder Rotationsprogramm kann anstelle der Erfahrung in Betracht gezogen werden Bevorzugte Anforderungen:
• Gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, einschließlich wirkungsvoller Präsentationen
• Nachgewiesene Führungsqualitäten
• Verhandlungs-, Vertrags- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten
• Fähigkeit, in einem regulierten Umfeld zu arbeiten
• Strategische Planungs- und Organisationsfähigkeiten Umzugsvorteile gibt es nicht Verfügbar für diese Stellenausschreibung. Die erwartete Gehaltsspanne für diese Position, basierend auf dem Hauptstandort Utah, liegt zwischen 86.700,00 $ und 169.000,00 $. Das tatsächliche Gehalt wird auf der Grundlage von Erfahrung, Qualifikationen, geografischem Standort und anderen gesetzlich zulässigen berufsbezogenen Faktoren ermittelt. Diese Position hat Anspruch auf eine Anreizvergütung, die gemäß dem geltenden Anreizvergütungsplan berechnet und ausgezahlt wird
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Directeur de comptes moléculaires - Clinical MD Un avenir plus sain. C’est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé dont il a besoin aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous passons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C’est ce qui fait de nous Roche. L'opportunité : Êtes-vous un professionnel de la vente expérimenté doté d'un talent pour résoudre des défis complexes ? Dans ce rôle, vous utiliserez votre expertise pour résoudre divers problèmes et prendre des décisions stratégiques qui conduisent au succès. Vous gérerez des comptes de taille moyenne à grande, dépassant les objectifs de vente tout en établissant des relations durables avec les décideurs clés. Votre objectif sera d'élargir votre réseau, d'identifier de nouvelles opportunités et de présenter des propositions de valeur convaincantes. Grâce à une compréhension approfondie de notre gamme de produits, vous agirez en tant que conseiller de confiance, améliorant continuellement notre système qualité grâce à vos actions quotidiennes. En tant que chargé de compte moléculaire, vous :
• serez responsable de la promotion des produits et services moléculaires de Roche.
• contacter les clients nouveaux et existants pour atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente dans les comptes ciblés, en développant de nouvelles affaires, en développant les activités existantes, en entretenant les relations avec les clients et en résolvant les problèmes des clients. Cela comprend l'identification et l'élaboration de plans de compte stratégiques, l'élaboration et la diffusion du message différenciateur et de la valeur économique quantifiable des produits et services, la vente de la principale différenciation des produits Roche, le dépassement et la gestion des objections et la négociation pour obtenir des ventes.
• générer de la demande et maximiser la notoriété des produits en travaillant avec les clients et en leur fournissant une éducation et des informations.
• met en œuvre des initiatives et des plans stratégiques pour faciliter le processus de vente et la productivité.
• travailler avec d'autres, selon les besoins, pour préparer des propositions pour les comptes attribués. Présente toutes les propositions de contrat aux clients afin de maximiser l'activité et la rentabilité globales, ce qui peut nécessiter des négociations.
• Conduire et organiser la planification du territoire et le tracé nécessaires pour plus d'efficacité. Effectue l’analyse et la planification commerciales.
• communique en interne des informations sur le marché concurrentiel.
• réseaux et interfaces avec des collègues internes pour partager des informations et des meilleures pratiques tout en restant activement impliqué dans les organisations de l'industrie/clients qui ont un impact sur les affaires. Il s'agit d'un rôle basé sur le terrain : le territoire est l'Utah, dans le nord de l'Arizona. Vous devez habiter à moins de 50 miles du territoire. Attente de voyage : 50 % pour la nuit Qui vous êtes :
• Baccalauréat ou expérience équivalente
• Plus de 3 ans d'expérience pertinente en vente ou équivalente
• La participation à un programme de développement accéléré, de bourse ou de rotation approuvé peut être considérée à la place de l'expérience. L'échelle salariale attendue pour ce poste, en fonction de l'emplacement principal de l'Utah, est de 86 700,00 $ à 169 00,00 $. Le salaire réel sera déterminé en fonction de l'expérience, des qualifications, de la situation géographique et d'autres facteurs liés à l'emploi autorisés par la loi. Ce poste est éligible à une rémunération incitative calculée et versée conformément au plan de rémunération incitative applicable.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Bioinformatics
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is working to improve DNA sequencing data analysis. Roche is innovating new approaches that fundamentally change when and where DNA sequencing gets processed. Our goal is to analyze data as it's generated, where it’s generated.

We are seeking a visionary and deeply technical leader to champion the customer-facing bioinformatics and software strategy for our revolutionary Axelios sequencing platform. As we launch XOOS —our cutting-edge ecosystem of bioinformatics tools—you will be the bridge between our pioneering new customers and our internal development teams.

This is not a traditional role. You will lead an elite team of bioinformatics scientists and software engineers to create bespoke, high-impact solutions, resolve sophisticated technical roadblocks, and even engage in collaborative research with early adopters. Because the Axelios platform operates on a completely different paradigm than traditional Sequencing-by-Synthesis (SBS), you will be instrumental in educating the market, ensuring seamless migration to our tools, and translating complex customer feedback into actionable development pipelines.

The Opportunity

• Customer Advocacy & Technical Enablement: Serve as the primary executive-level technical contact for new customers, driving deep adoption of the XOOS bioinformatics ecosystem across major clinical and research applications.

• Team Leadership: Build, inspire, and manage a high-performing team of customer-facing bioinformatics scientists and solutions architects.

• Bespoke Solution Engineering: Lead the creation of customized workflows, data analysis pipelines, and software integrations to solve unique customer pain points and accelerate Axelios platform adoption.

• Collaborative Research: Partner with strategic early-adopter customers on collaborative research projects, co-authoring whitepapers, and demonstrating the unique capabilities of Axelios non-SBS data.

• Cross-Functional Feedback Loop: Act as a critical strategic partner to internal Bioinformatics and Software R&D teams, synthesizing market requirements, feature requests, and technical friction points into the product roadmap.

• Commercial & Technical Strategy: Collaborate with Sales and Product Management to support high-value customer engagements, technical evaluations, and complex contract closures.

This position is based on-site in Santa Clara, CA or San Diego, CA. (This is a hybrid position.)
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a Ph.D.in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field with 4+ years of industry experience; or a Master’s degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field with 6+ years of industry experience.

• You have 8+ years of progressive experience in next-generation sequencing (NGS) bioinformatics, with a demonstrated track record of leadership in an industry setting.

• You have a significant level of expertise and comprehensive knowledge of the NGS landscape, clinical genomics space, and secondary/tertiary data analysis pipelines.

• You demonstrated leadership experience.

• You have a high level of proficiency with cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP), modern software development practices, pipeline frameworks (e.g., Nextflow, Snakemake), and scripting languages (Python, R).

• You have demonstrated experience in product commercialization, go-to-market execution, or technical c

jobs.title: Subchapter Lead, Head of Pathology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche is the world’s #1 provider of companion diagnostics and offers unrivaled experience in developing and commercializing predictive diagnostics that enable personalized treatment strategies for cancer patients. We offer unique opportunities for pathologists interested in playing a role in the development and implementation of new assays critical to our goal of providing more patient access to innovative new therapies.

The Opportunity
As the Subchapter Lead in Clinical Development, Head of Pathology, you will stand at the intersection of cutting-edge science and people leadership. Based in our Tucson, AZ campus, you will lead a world-class team of pathologists dedicated to shaping the future of diagnostics and targeted cancer therapies.
In this role, you provide strategic and scientific leadership while overseeing pathology operations that support more than 100 new and existing product development initiatives and enhancements annually across Primary Antibodies, Special Stains, Digital Pathology, Companion Diagnostics and Instruments. Your team plays a critical role in enabling innovative diagnostics that support precision medicine and targeted cancer therapies worldwide.

In this role, you aren't just managing—you are mentoring, inspiring, and working hands-on with leading-edge technologies to transform patient care globally.

• People Leadership & Development: Direct, mentor, and foster the professional growth of Instrua highly specialized team of pathologists and 6-7 team leaders. Drive a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Medical oversight for day to day Path Lab activities.

• Scientific & Clinical Strategy: Serve as the pathology subject matter expert within the Companion Diagnostics & Oncology business unit, ensuring scientific rigor and clinical relevance in all assay development programs.

• Advanced Assay Development: Guide the team in the development, validation, and implementation of complex assays utilizing top-tier technologies including:

• Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and in situ hybridization (ISH)

• Immunofluorescence (IF) and Multiplex assays

• Digital Pathology and AI-driven image analysis

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with life science companies, clinical trial teams, regulatory bodies, and internal R&D stakeholders

• Innovation Champion: Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging pathology technologies to maintain Roche’s position as the market leader in companion diagnostics and oncology

Who You Are:

You are a visionary leader who balances deep clinical expertise with a passion for developing people. You thrive in collaborative, fast-paced environments and are motivated by the tangible impact your work has on cancer patients worldwide.

• You are a MD with US Board Certification in Anatomic Pathology

• You have 10+ years of people management and leadership within a pharmaceutical, diagnostics, or major academic or medical center environment.

• You have deep expertise in oncology pathology and hands-on experience with tissue-based biomarkers (IHC, ISH, Multiplex).

• You have strong familiarity with development processes including digital pathology workflows, image analysis tools, Clinical Case and CAP/CLIA

In questo ruolo, si fornisce leadership strategica e scientifica, supervisionando le operazioni di patologia che supportano più di 100 nuove e esistenti iniziative di sviluppo del prodotto e miglioramenti ogni anno attraverso gli anticorpi primari, le macchie speciali, la patologia digitale, la diagnostica e gli strumenti di Companion. • Strategia scientifica e clinica: servire come esperto di materia patologia all'interno dell'unità di business Companion Diagnostics & Oncology, assicurando rigore scientifico e rilevanza clinica in tutti i programmi di sviluppo di saggi.
• Sviluppo del saggio avanzato: Guida il team nello sviluppo, nella convalida e nell'implementazione di saggi complessi che utilizzano tecnologie di alto livello tra cui:
• Immunohistochimica (IHC) e ibridazione in situ (ISH)
• Immunofluorescenza (IF) e saggi Multiplex
• Patologia digitale e analisi dell'immagine guidata dall'IA
• Collaborazione trasversale: collaborare a stretto contatto con le aziende di scienze della vita, i team di sperimentazione clinica, gli organismi normativi e gli stakeholder R&D interni
• Campione dell’Innovazione: Restate davanti alle tendenze del settore e alle tecnologie di patologia emergenti per mantenere la posizione di Roche come leader di mercato nella diagnostica dei compagni e nell’oncologia Chi sei? Sei un leader visionario che bilancia profonda esperienza clinica con la passione per lo sviluppo delle persone. Si prospera in ambienti collaborativi e veloci e sono motivati dall'impatto tangibile che il vostro lavoro ha sui pazienti tumorali in tutto il mondo.
• Sei un MD con certificazione US Board in Patologia Anatomica
• Hai 10 anni di gestione e leadership delle persone all'interno di un ambiente farmaceutico, diagnostico, o principale centro accademico o medico.
• Hai una profonda esperienza nella patologia oncologica e nell'esperienza pratica con biomarcatori basati sui tessuti (IHC, ISH, Multiplex).
• Hai una forte familiarità con i processi di sviluppo, inclusi i flussi di lavoro di patologia digitale, gli strumenti di analisi delle immagini, il caso clinico e CAP/CLIA

Roche est le premier fournisseur mondial de diagnostics complémentaires et offre une expérience inégalée dans le développement et la commercialisation de diagnostics prédictifs qui permettent des stratégies de traitement personnalisées pour les patients cancéreux. Nous offrons des possibilités uniques aux pathologistes intéressés à jouer un rôle dans l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de nouveaux tests essentiels à notre objectif d'offrir plus de patients accès à de nouvelles thérapies innovantes. L'opportunité En tant que sous-chapitre responsable du développement clinique, Chef de la pathologie, vous serez à l'intersection de la science de pointe et du leadership humain. Basé sur notre campus Tucson, AZ, vous dirigerez une équipe de pathologistes de classe mondiale dédiée à façonner l'avenir des diagnostics et des thérapies ciblées contre le cancer. Dans ce rôle, vous fournissez un leadership stratégique et scientifique tout en surveillant les opérations de pathologie qui soutiennent plus de 100 initiatives de développement de produits nouveaux et existants et des améliorations annuelles à travers les anticorps primaires, les stains spéciaux, la pathologie numérique, les diagnostics et les instruments de compagnon. Votre équipe joue un rôle crucial en permettant des diagnostics innovants qui soutiennent la médecine de précision et des thérapies contre le cancer ciblées dans le monde entier. Dans ce rôle, vous ne vous contentez pas de gérer — vous êtes mentor, inspirant et travaillant main-d'oeuvre avec des technologies de pointe pour transformer les soins aux patients à l'échelle mondiale.
• People Leadership & Development: Direct, mentor, et favoriser le développement professionnel d'Instrua équipe hautement spécialisée de pathologistes et 6-7 chefs d'équipe. Favoriser une culture d'innovation, de collaboration et d'apprentissage continu. Surveillance médicale des activités quotidiennes du laboratoire Path.
• Stratégie scientifique et clinique: servir d'expert en pathologie au sein de l'unité de diagnostic et oncologie Companion, assurant la rigueur scientifique et la pertinence clinique dans tous les programmes de développement de tests.
• Développement avancé de l'essai : guidez l'équipe dans le développement, la validation et la mise en oeuvre d'essais complexes utilisant des technologies de pointe, notamment :
• Immunohistochimie (IHC) et hybridation in situ (ISH)
• Essais d'immunofluorescence (IF) et de multiplex
• Pathologie numérique et analyse d'images par l'IA
• Collaboration interfonctionnelle: partenariat étroit avec des entreprises de sciences de la vie, des équipes d'essais cliniques, des organismes de réglementation et des intervenants internes en R-D
• Champion de l'innovation : restez en avance sur les tendances de l'industrie et les nouvelles technologies de pathologie pour maintenir Roches comme leader du marché en diagnostic et oncologie Qui vous êtes : Vous êtes un leader visionnaire qui équilibre une expertise clinique profonde avec une passion pour le développement des gens. Vous prospèrez dans des environnements collaboratifs et rapides et êtes motivé par l'impact tangible que votre travail a sur les patients atteints de cancer dans le monde entier.
• Vous êtes un MD avec la certification US Board en pathologie anatomique
• Vous avez plus de 10 ans de gestion des personnes et de leadership au sein d'un environnement pharmaceutique, de diagnostic ou de centre universitaire ou médical majeur.
• Vous avez une expertise approfondie en pathologie oncologique et une expérience pratique des biomarqueurs à base de tissus (IHC, ISH, Multiplex).
• Vous connaissez bien les processus de développement, y compris les flux de travail de pathologie numérique, les outils d'analyse d'image, le cas clinique et le CAP/CLIA

jobs.title: Legal & Compliance Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Key Responsibilities

• Support compliance communications by creating engaging newsletters and short, bite-sized videos to effectively convey compliance messages

• Assist in the development and ongoing maintenance of the compliance microsite, ensuring content such as policies, standards, communications, and monitoring reports are kept up to date

• Provide administrative and coordination support for compliance monitoring activities, including following up with internal stakeholders to obtain required information and documentation

• Perform other administrative and ad-hoc tasks as assigned by the compliance team

Requirements

• Currently pursuing a degree in Law, Business, Life Sciences, Political Science or a related field

• Strong written communication skills and attention to detail

• Proactive, organized, and comfortable working with multiple stakeholders

• Interest in legal, compliance, and corporate governance matters

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

The Data Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex, multiple solution, or product context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance. Applies frameworks in a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for the product. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded and published for multiple solutions or the product. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including vendor assessments.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates difficult concepts clearly and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view. Drives information sharing across the complete product.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas. Proactively contributes to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context.

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes.

• Proven track record of proactively contributing to architecture practices development and mentoring others.

Technical Skills

• In-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas

• Strong understanding of modern data engineering architectures and patterns, including cloud-based data platforms, batch and streaming data pipelines, and analytics layers

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomie

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Backend (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

Developing software is great, but developing software with a purpose is even better! As a Senior Software Engineer Backend, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and QA experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software development practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users' lives at risk!

We are looking for an experienced, motivated Senior Software Engineer Backend who will work closely with their backend colleagues, and who ideally has built digital products and platforms. As a code-magician, you will support our efforts to improve the digital health ecosystem. You will contribute with your knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, relational databases & REST within our agile and cross-functional teams. As a flexible and open-minded person with a passion for clean code you will be a perfect addition to our team. We are committed to quality, dedicating time to code reviews, test coverage, quality days and CI/CD principles. If this resonates with you, we would love to hear from you!
You will be part of the Platform Engineering chapter working on our navify platform.

Essentials skills for your mission:

• At least 5 years of experience working as a software engineer including 2 years as a backend engineer.

• You are familiar with the following backend technologies: Java 21+ and frameworks like Spring Boot 3+

• SQL and relational databases (e.g.PostgreSQL) are second nature to you

• You have experience with OpenID Connect standard and Keycloak or other open source software product that allows single sign-on with identity and access management

• You have experience building AI/LLM-powered backend services and tools

• You enjoy developing clean, stable, testable, and performant backend code, serving our beautiful applications

• You are passionate about solid technical design, clean code, and future-proof architectures

• You have experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other cloud providers

• You enjoy guiding and sharing your knowledge with other engineers

• Great written and verbal communication in English

Bonus skills:

• Experienced in automated testing with Selenium or Selenide

• Knowledge of Infra as Code, Terraform and Github Actions

• Understanding of medical, security, and privacy regulations

• Knowledge of the diabetes industry or other comparable health industries

Here's what you can expect from us:

• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products for a global audience

• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with really smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams

• Loads of benefits (brand new Apple hardware, fitness, public transport, lunch benefit, language classes, professional training budget, chance to join global conferences...)

• Flexible working hours and home office policy, 5 weeks vacation

• An amazing office with a rooftop terrace, fully stocked kitchen and amazing barista coffee machines in the middle of Vienna… oh, and did we mention the best team in the world!

You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, from native mobile development to infrastructure-as-code in our cloud environment, gaining a rich understanding of the spec

You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here . Here's what we're looking for: Developing software is great, but developing software with a purpose is even better! As a Senior Software Engineer Backend, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and QA experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software development practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users' lives at risk! We are looking for an experienced, motivated Senior Software Engineer Backend who will work closely with their backend colleagues, and who ideally has built digital products and platforms. As a code-magician, you will support our efforts to improve the digital health ecosystem. You will contribute with your knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, relational databases & REST within our agile and cross-functional teams. As a flexible and open-minded person with a passion for clean code you will be a perfect addition to our team. We are committed to quality, dedicating time to code reviews, test coverage, quality days and CI/CD principles. If this resonates with you, we would love to hear from you! You will be part of the Platform Engineering chapter working on our navify platform. Essentials skills for your mission:
• At least 5 years of experience working as a software engineer including 2 years as a backend engineer.
• You are familiar with the following backend technologies: Java 21+ and frameworks like Spring Boot 3+
• SQL and relational databases (e.g.PostgreSQL) are second nature to you
• You have experience with OpenID Connect standard and Keycloak or other open source software product that allows single sign-on with identity and access management
• You have experience building AI/LLM-powered backend services and tools
• You enjoy developing clean, stable, testable, and performant backend code, serving our beautiful applications
• You are passionate about solid technical design, clean code, and future-proof architectures
• You have experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other cloud providers
• You enjoy guiding and sharing your knowledge with other engineers
• Great written and verbal communication in English Bonus skills:
• Experienced in automated testing with Selenium or Selenide
• Knowledge of Infra as Code, Terraform and Github Actions
• Understanding of medical, security, and privacy regulations
• Knowledge of the diabetes industry or other comparable health industries Here's what you can expect from us:
• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products for a global audience
• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with really smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams
• Loads of benefits (brand new Apple hardware, fitness, public transport, lunch benefit, language classes, professional training budget, chance to join global conferences...)
• Flexible working hours and home office policy, 5 weeks vacation
• An amazing office with a rooftop terrace, fully stocked kitchen and amazing barista coffee machines in the middle of Vienna… oh, and did we mention the best team in the world! You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, from native mobile development to infrastructure-as-code in our cloud environment, gaining a rich understanding of the spec

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

This role is based in Global MSAT, Engineering, and Sustainability (PTT), an organization that is responsible for ensuring Pharma Technical Operations (PT) stays at the forefront of technology in our current and future facilities. PTT, composed of global MSAT and Engineering, plays a key role in leading seamless industrialization and thorough technical product management through integrating SHE, proactive maintenance, facility fitness, performance optimization, and scalable manufacturing processes and technologies in support of the manufacturing network. In this role, you have the opportunity to shape the manufacturing network that delivers life saving medicines to patients.
The Engineering Project Feasibility and Product Sourcing Leader within the PTT CapEx Feasibility and Investment Planning (CFIP) group conducts early feasibility and product sourcing assessments for Global Engineering CapEx projects.

The Opportunity
This role ensures that capital investments and investments supporting sourcing decisions align with and enable the Pharma long-range plan. A core responsibility of this role is partnering closely with Network Strategy, Global Product & Supply Chain Management, manufacturing sites, and Finance to develop robust business cases that inform PT governance decisions regarding capital investments and product sourcings.

• Secure buy-in from stakeholders and senior leadership, drive cross-functional alignment, and resolve issues within the engineering community and broader network for Global Engineering CapEx projects

• Build robust scenarios that model best- and worst-case outcomes and provide flexibility for informed decision-making in a dynamic business environment

• Develop comprehensive business cases for capital projects, maintaining fiduciary responsibility for real estate and equipment assets

• Assess requirements for product launches, technology transfers, and capital investments; ensuresassumptions across options are agreed upon and aligned with stakeholders

• Conduct complex early feasibility assessments across sites and functions, collaborating closely with senior leaders, subject matter experts, and site engineering teams

• Partner with the engineering community/network to apply technology standards that enable successful project outcomes and reduce business risk

• Transition completed early feasibility assessments to Project Initiation teams and contribute as an expert reviewer during project reviews

Who You Are
You are an engineering leader with a distinguished track record in complex global CapEx project execution, ideally bringing a strong background in process engineering combined with the proven ability to seamlessly drive results through matrix leadership.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field

• 12+ years of Pharmaceutical or Biotech experience, process engineering experience preferred

• Minimum of 8 years of management leadership experience in a matrix organization

• Experience in a complex global environment with CapEx project execution

• International/global experience is strongly preferred

​ Flexibility for domestic and international travel as required

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity!

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo ruolo ha sede in Global MSAT, Engineering e Sustainability (PTT), un'organizzazione che ha la responsabilità di garantire che Pharma Technical Operations (PT) rimanga all'avanguardia della tecnologia nelle nostre strutture attuali e future. PTT, composto da MSAT globale e Engineering, svolge un ruolo chiave nel guidare un'industrializzazione senza soluzione di continuità e un'accurata gestione tecnica del prodotto attraverso l'integrazione di SHE, manutenzione proattiva, idoneità delle strutture, ottimizzazione delle prestazioni e processi e tecnologie di produzione scalabili a supporto della rete di produzione. In questo ruolo, hai l'opportunità di plasmare la rete di produzione che fornisce farmaci salvavita ai pazienti. Il responsabile della fattibilità dei progetti di ingegneria e dell'approvvigionamento dei prodotti all'interno del gruppo CFIP (CapEx Feasibility and Investment Planning) di PTT conduce valutazioni iniziali di fattibilità e di approvvigionamento dei prodotti per i progetti Global Engineering CapEx. L'opportunità Questo ruolo garantisce che gli investimenti di capitale e gli investimenti a supporto delle decisioni di approvvigionamento siano in linea e consentano il piano a lungo termine del settore farmaceutico. Una delle responsabilità principali di questo ruolo è quella di collaborare strettamente con la strategia di rete, la gestione globale della catena di fornitura e dei prodotti, i siti di produzione e la finanza per sviluppare solidi casi aziendali che informino le decisioni di governance di PT relative agli investimenti di capitale e all'approvvigionamento dei prodotti.
• Garantire il consenso delle parti interessate e della leadership senior, favorire l'allineamento interfunzionale e risolvere i problemi all'interno della comunità ingegneristica e della rete più ampia per progetti CapEx di ingegneria globale.
• Costruire scenari solidi che modellano i risultati dei casi migliori e peggiori e fornire flessibilità per un processo decisionale informato in un ambiente aziendale dinamico.
• Sviluppare casi aziendali completi per progetti di capitale, mantenendo la responsabilità fiduciaria per beni immobili e attrezzature. garantisce che le ipotesi tra le opzioni siano concordate e allineate con le parti interessate
• Condurre complesse valutazioni iniziali di fattibilità tra siti e funzioni, collaborando a stretto contatto con dirigenti senior, esperti in materia e team di ingegneria del sito
• Collaborare con la comunità/rete di ingegneri per applicare standard tecnologici che consentano risultati positivi del progetto e ridurre il rischio aziendale
• Transizione completata delle prime valutazioni di fattibilità ai team di avvio del progetto e contributo come revisore esperto durante le revisioni del progetto Chi sei Sei un leader tecnico con un track record distinto nell'esecuzione di progetti CapEx globali complessi, idealmente portando un forte background nell'ingegneria di processo combinato con la comprovata capacità di ottenere risultati senza soluzione di continuità attraverso la leadership della matrice.
• Laurea in ingegneria o settore correlato
• Oltre 12 anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico o biotecnologico, preferibile esperienza in ingegneria di processo
• Minimo 8 anni di esperienza di leadership gestionale in un'organizzazione a matrice
• Esperienza in un ambiente globale complesso con esecuzione di progetti CapEx
• L'esperienza internazionale/globale è fortemente preferita Flessibilità per viaggi nazionali e internazionali come richiesto Pronto per il passo successivo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentire la tua opinione. Candidati ora per scoprire questa entusiasmante opportunità! Laddove si applica la trasparenza retributiva, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla sede di distacco principale. Per questo ruolo, la sede principale è Basilea. Se sei interessato ad ulteriori località in cui il ruolo potrebbe essere disponibile, ti forniremo le informazioni

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Diese Rolle ist bei Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) angesiedelt, einer Organisation, die dafür verantwortlich ist, sicherzustellen, dass Pharma Technical Operations (PT) in unseren aktuellen und zukünftigen Einrichtungen auf dem neuesten Stand der Technik bleibt. PTT, bestehend aus globalen MSAT- und Engineering-Mitarbeitern, spielt eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Führung einer nahtlosen Industrialisierung und eines gründlichen technischen Produktmanagements durch die Integration von SHE, proaktiver Wartung, Anlagenfitness, Leistungsoptimierung und skalierbaren Herstellungsprozessen und -technologien zur Unterstützung des Fertigungsnetzwerks. In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, das Produktionsnetzwerk zu gestalten, das lebensrettende Medikamente an Patienten liefert. Der Leiter für Machbarkeit und Produktbeschaffung von technischen Projekten innerhalb der PTT CapEx Feasibility and Investment Planning (CFIP)-Gruppe führt frühe Machbarkeits- und Produktbeschaffungsbewertungen für Global Engineering CapEx-Projekte durch. Die Chance Diese Rolle stellt sicher, dass Kapitalinvestitionen und Investitionen zur Unterstützung von Beschaffungsentscheidungen mit dem langfristigen Pharma-Plan übereinstimmen und ihn ermöglichen. Eine der Hauptaufgaben dieser Rolle besteht darin, eng mit der Netzwerkstrategie, dem globalen Produkt- und Lieferkettenmanagement, den Produktionsstandorten und der Finanzabteilung zusammenzuarbeiten, um solide Geschäftsmodelle zu entwickeln, die PT-Governance-Entscheidungen in Bezug auf Kapitalinvestitionen und Produktbeschaffungen beeinflussen.
• Sichern Sie sich die Zustimmung von Stakeholdern und Führungskräften, fördern Sie die funktionsübergreifende Ausrichtung und lösen Sie Probleme innerhalb der Ingenieursgemeinschaft und des breiteren Netzwerks für Global Engineering CapEx-Projekte.
• Erstellen Sie robuste Szenarien, die Best- und Worst-Case-Ergebnisse modellieren und Flexibilität für fundierte Entscheidungen in einem dynamischen Geschäftsumfeld bieten. stellt sicher, dass Annahmen für alle Optionen vereinbart und mit den Stakeholdern abgestimmt werden.
• Führen Sie komplexe frühe Machbarkeitsbewertungen über Standorte und Funktionen hinweg durch und arbeiten Sie dabei eng mit Führungskräften, Fachexperten und Standorttechnikteams zusammen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit der Ingenieurgemeinschaft/dem Ingenieurnetzwerk zusammen, um Technologiestandards anzuwenden, die erfolgreiche Projektergebnisse ermöglichen und das Geschäftsrisiko reduzieren Ein fundierter Hintergrund in der Verfahrenstechnik kombiniert mit der nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, durch Matrixführung nahtlos Ergebnisse voranzutreiben.
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich
• Mehr als 12 Jahre Erfahrung in der Pharma- oder Biotechnologiebranche, Erfahrung in der Verfahrenstechnik bevorzugt
• Mindestens 8 Jahre Management- und Führungserfahrung in einer Matrixorganisation
• Erfahrung in einem komplexen globalen Umfeld mit CapEx-Projektabwicklung
• Internationale/globale Erfahrung wird dringend bevorzugt ​ Flexibilität für Inlands- und Auslandsreisen nach Bedarf Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Kontaktaufnahme. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt, um diese spannende Gelegenheit zu entdecken! Wenn Lohntransparenz gilt, erfolgt die Angabe der Angaben auf Basis des primären Entsendungsorts. Der Hauptstandort für diese Rolle ist Basel. Wenn Sie an weiteren Standorten interessiert sind, an denen die Stelle möglicherweise verfügbar ist, stellen wir Ihnen die entsprechenden Informationen zur Verfügung

Le responsable de la faisabilité des projets d'ingénierie et de l'approvisionnement en produits au sein du groupe de planification de la faisabilité et des investissements (CFIP) de PTT CapEx effectue des évaluations précoces de faisabilité et d'approvisionnement en produits pour les projets mondiaux d'investissement en ingénierie. L'opportunité Ce rôle garantit que les investissements en capital et les investissements soutenant les décisions d'approvisionnement s'alignent et permettent le plan à long terme de l'industrie pharmaceutique. L'une des principales responsabilités de ce rôle consiste à collaborer étroitement avec la stratégie de réseau, la gestion mondiale des produits et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les sites de fabrication et les finances pour élaborer des analyses de rentabilisation solides qui éclairent les décisions de gouvernance des PT concernant les investissements en capital et l'approvisionnement en produits.
• Obtenir l'adhésion des parties prenantes et de la haute direction, favoriser l'alignement interfonctionnel et résoudre les problèmes au sein de la communauté des ingénieurs et du réseau plus large pour les projets Global Engineering CapEx.
• Créer des scénarios robustes qui modélisent les meilleurs et les pires résultats et offrir une flexibilité pour une prise de décision éclairée dans un environnement commercial dynamique. s'assure que les hypothèses relatives aux options sont convenues et alignées avec les parties prenantes
• Mener des évaluations de faisabilité précoces complexes sur tous les sites et fonctions, en collaborant étroitement avec les hauts dirigeants, les experts en la matière et les équipes d'ingénierie de site
• Collaborer avec la communauté/le réseau d'ingénierie pour appliquer des normes technologiques qui permettent des résultats de projet réussis et réduire les risques commerciaux
• Transition terminée les premières évaluations de faisabilité vers les équipes de lancement de projet et contribuer en tant qu'examinateur expert lors des examens de projet. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader en ingénierie avec une expérience distinguée dans l'exécution de projets d'investissement mondiaux complexes, apportant idéalement une solide expérience en l'ingénierie des processus combinée à la capacité éprouvée à générer des résultats de manière transparente grâce à un leadership matriciel.
• Baccalauréat en ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe
• Plus de 12 ans d'expérience en pharmacie ou en biotechnologie, expérience en génie des procédés préférée
• Minimum de 8 ans d'expérience en leadership en gestion dans une organisation matricielle
• Expérience dans un environnement mondial complexe avec l'exécution de projets CapEx
• Une expérience internationale/mondiale est fortement préférée Flexibilité pour les voyages nationaux et internationaux selon les besoins Prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Nous sommes impatients de vous entendre. Postulez dès maintenant pour découvrir cette opportunité passionnante ! Lorsque la transparence salariale s’applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d’affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, le site principal est Bâle. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le poste pourrait être disponible, nous vous fournirons les informations nécessaires.

jobs.title: Account Value Partner (Sales - Upper South)

titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire de la valeur du compte

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Position: Account Value Partner (Sales - Upper South), 1 year contract
Area : Petchaburi, Prachuabkhirikhan, Chumporn, Ranong

Purpose of the Job
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
As an Account Value Partner, you are at the forefront of our mission, driving the sales of Roche's innovative diagnostic products within your assigned territory in Thailand. You will be a trusted partner to healthcare professionals, providing them with the solutions and expertise they need to improve patient outcomes. This is a dynamic field-based role where you will build strong relationships, exceed sales targets, and be a key contributor to our success.

Role-Specific Accountabilities

• Define and own the medical education event and KOL engagement strategy.

• Gather and analyze insights to co-create solutions with hospital management, KOLs, and key customers.

• Take accountability for achieving budgeted sales while keeping costs under control.

• Seek out opportunities in key accounts and lead/organize promotional activities or product/solution presentations to achieve sales growth.

• Develop and implement territory and key account plans that align with the marketing plan, demonstrating effective time management and prioritization.

• Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction post-sale, including coordinating technical support or addressing initial product inquiries to maintain long-term partnerships.

• Manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiation, closing deals, and contract implementation.

QUALIFICATIONS
Experience and Competencies:

• Deep understanding of business drivers, products, the local market, and competition.

• Ability to influence at all levels, position/sell ideas to client groups, and manage expectations in line with the agreed portfolio.

• Builds trustful and effective relationships.

• Capable of finding creative solutions to complex problems, taking responsibility, driving results, and achieving expected outcomes.

Industry Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Medical Technology.

• 3+ years of work experience in a related sales or clinical field.

• Flexibility to be based in various locations across Thailand, including Bangkok, upcountry provinces, or in a hybrid model, depending on the assigned territory.

• Preferred area Petchaburi, Prachuabkhirikhan, Chumporn, Ranong

• Proficient language skills in Thai and a good command of spoken and written English.

• A valid driver's license and willingness to travel frequently are required.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: （高级）治疗领域专员-免疫治疗领域-郑州

titleByLocale.en: （高级）治疗领域专员-免疫治疗领域-郑州
titleByLocale.de: (高级)治疗领域专员-免疫治疗领域-郑州

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要职责/责任
客户管理

• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求

• 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

a)传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
b)传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
c)传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设

• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程

• 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

• 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育

• 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。

• 组织和支持区域专家会议

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈

• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理

• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗

• 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作

• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家

• 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力

• 业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 多产品资源整合能力

• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限

• 1年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书

• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试

• 在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Clinical Data Standards and Master Data Digital Solution Lead

titleByLocale.it: Standard clinici di dati e Master Data Digital Solution Lead
titleByLocale.en: Clinical Data Standards and Master Data Digital Solution Lead
titleByLocale.de: Clinical Data Standards und Master Data Digital Solution Lead
titleByLocale.fr: Normes relatives aux données cliniques et solution numérique de base

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Digital Solution Lead at this level, you lead the strategy, operating model, and delivery governance for Clinical Data Standards, Master Data, and the supporting technology ecosystem, including Roche's in-house standards and reference data platforms (Global Clinical Data Standards Repository (GDSR) and Lynx). You partner with PD Data Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Study Teams, Roche Data Technologies, and Enterprise Informatics to ensure clinical data is defined once, governed consistently, delivered reliably, and reused at scale. This role requires deep expertise in CDISC and semantic modelling, combined with strong delivery leadership, to shape interoperable, metadata-driven foundations and ensure the associated platforms are run with the right quality, compliance, and service levels.

Description of the area

Within PD Data Sciences, this area is responsible for defining, governing, and operationalizing the standards and master data that underpin Roche's clinical data landscape. The team ensures consistent use of clinical data standards, controlled terminology, metadata, and master/reference data across protocol design, data collection, transformation, analysis, submission, and downstream reuse. It also drives the roadmap and business-facing direction for the in-house technologies that manage these assets (GDSR and Lynx), enabling study teams and downstream analytical environments to consume trusted standards and master data through governed, reusable services.
A key focus of the area is advancing semantic interoperability across the clinical ecosystem. This includes developing semantically rich information models, metadata structures, and linked data concepts that improve traceability, reuse, and machine readability across clinical workflows. By combining strong governance with fit-for-purpose technology and disciplined delivery management, the team creates AI-ready foundations that allow analytics and agentic solutions to reason over high-quality, well-defined clinical data assets safely and consistently, while sustaining operational reliability, release quality, and business continuity for downstream consumers.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Leads the domain vision for Clinical Data Standards, Master Data, and supporting technologies, shaping cross-functional strategy, governance, priorities, and delivery models. Acts as a subject matter expert in CDISC, master/reference data management, and semantic modelling, while setting clear expectations for platform health, release quality, and vendor or partner accountability.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads resolution of complex issues spanning data standards adoption, metadata definition, master data stewardship, technology integration, and downstream consumption. Establishes transparent tracking for roadmap delivery, defects, incidents, and service health; anticipates gaps in process, governance, and architecture; conducts root cause analysis across organizational boundaries; and drives sustainable solutions that improve data quality, lineage, platform reliability, and operational efficiency.

• Stakeholder Management: Builds trusted partnerships across PD Data Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Study Teams, Regulatory, Roche Data Technologies, Enterprise Data, Architecture, Informatics, and external delivery partners. Translates between scientific, operational, and technical stakeholders, acts as a trusted liaison between business owners

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, w e offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The role of an Information Architect is to understand business processes and information objects and to work with members of the informatics and business team to identify and design information flows and information standards that meet the business needs . The Information Architect works toward consistency within and across groups and drives for reuse and simplicity of information objects . descriptionByLocale.de:

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und in den kommenden Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Daten-/Informationsarchitekt – Datenplattformen Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation auf Zweck trifft. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft geschäftsorientierter Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien voranzutreiben und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der die Digitalisierung eine zentrale Stärke von Roche darstellt. Wir ermöglichen intelligentere Arbeitsweisen, setzen menschliches Potenzial frei und treiben Durchbrüche voran, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wirklich von Bedeutung sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Derzeit verlangen wir von unseren Mitarbeitern, dass sie durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Townhalls, Teambesprechungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Die Rolle eines Informationsarchitekten besteht darin, Geschäftsprozesse und Informationsobjekte zu verstehen und mit Mitgliedern des Informatik- und Geschäftsteams zusammenzuarbeiten, um Informationsflüsse und Informationsstandards zu identifizieren und zu entwerfen, die den Geschäftsanforderungen entsprechen. Der Informationsarchitekt strebt die Konsistenz innerhalb und zwischen Gruppen an und fördert die Wiederverwendung und Einfachheit von Informationsobjekten. Der Informationsarchitekt wird dies tun, indem er Informationsobjekte identifiziert, klassifiziert, standardisiert und Informationsflüsse erstellt und dabei eng mit Geschäftsinteressenten, Lösungsarchitekten, Softwarearchitekten, IT-Geschäftspartnern und Geschäftsanalysten zusammenarbeitet. Die Chance:
• Entwerfen und pflegen Sie die umfassende Informationslandschaft und optimieren Sie sowohl den eingehenden als auch den ausgehenden Informationsfluss für MRHub.
• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Data Engineering Lead kritische Standards und Governance für Informationsobjekte etablieren und durchsetzen.
• Fördern Sie die Qualitätssicherung durch regelmäßige Überprüfungen der Konformität und Integrität aller Informationsobjekte und Architekturabläufe.
• Bereitstellung strategischer Führung bei der Informationsmodellierung für Projekt- und Betriebsteams und Sicherstellung der Ausrichtung auf globale Informatikziele.
• Identifizieren und organisieren Sie komplexe Informationsanforderungen und -objekte für MRHub, um eine nahtlose Rückverfolgbarkeit und einen einfachen Zugriff sicherzustellen.
• Unterstützen Sie die Behebung suboptimaler Datenflüsse innerhalb von Geschäftsprozessen, um die Effizienz und Leistung des Gesamtsystems zu verbessern.
• Stellen Sie architektonische Genauigkeit sicher, indem Sie aktuelle automatisierte Abläufe in Archimedes beibehalten und konzeptionelle Designs erstellen, die zu IT-/Geschäftsstrategien passen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit agilen Teams und Lösungsarchitekten zusammen, um Governance, Compliance und Stammdatenstandards innerhalb der Lösungsarchitektur zu dokumentieren. Wer Sie sind:
• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Datenwissenschafts- und Informationsarchitekturprojekte von Anfang bis Ende mit dem Streben nach erheblichen geschäftlichen Auswirkungen. Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung, um strategische Geschäftsentscheidungen und Datenrahmen auf hoher Ebene zu informieren und zu beeinflussen.
• Nachgewiesene Fachkenntnisse in der Gestaltung und Implementierung unternehmensweiter Data-Science-Frameworks, Informationslebenszyklen und Best Practices für die Governance.
• Tiefe technische Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie Python und R, gepaart mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Versionskontroll-Workflows mit Git zu entwerfen und zu verwalten.
• Umfassende Expertise im Cloud-nativen Datenbankmanagement

Animés par un objectif et une passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique constitue une force essentielle dans l’ensemble de Roche, permettant des méthodes de travail plus intelligentes, libérant le potentiel humain et conduisant à des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous proposons un modèle de travail hybride qui allie flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l’instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient présents dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise, tels que des ateliers, des conférences, des assemblées publiques, des réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements collaboratifs. Le rôle d'un architecte de l'information est de comprendre les processus métier et les objets d'information et de travailler avec les membres de l'équipe informatique et commerciale pour identifier et concevoir des flux d'informations et des normes d'information qui répondent aux besoins de l'entreprise. L'architecte de l'information travaille à la cohérence au sein et entre les groupes et favorise la réutilisation et la simplicité des objets d'information. Pour ce faire, l'architecte de l'information identifiera, classifiera, standardisera les objets d'information et créera des flux d'informations, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes de l'entreprise, les architectes de solutions, les architectes logiciels, les partenaires commerciaux informatiques et les analystes commerciaux. L'opportunité :
• Concevoir et maintenir un paysage d'informations complet et rationaliser les flux d'informations entrants et sortants pour MRHub.
• Établir et appliquer des normes et une gouvernance critiques pour les objets d'information en étroite collaboration avec le responsable de l'ingénierie des données.
• Piloter l'assurance qualité en effectuant des examens périodiques sur la conformité et l'intégrité de tous les objets d'information et flux architecturaux.
• Fournir un leadership stratégique sur la modélisation de l'information aux équipes de projet et opérationnelles, en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs informatiques mondiaux.
• Identifiez et organisez les exigences et les objets d'informations complexes pour MRHub afin de garantir une traçabilité transparente et un accès facile.
• Prise en charge de la correction des flux de données sous-optimaux au sein des processus métier afin d'améliorer l'efficacité et les performances globales du système.
• Assurer l'exactitude architecturale en maintenant les flux automatisés à jour dans Archimède et en créant des conceptions conceptuelles adaptées aux stratégies informatiques/commerciales.
• Collaborer avec les équipes Agile et les architectes de solutions pour documenter la gouvernance, la conformité et les normes de données de base au sein de l'architecture de la solution. Qui vous êtes :
• Vaste expérience dans la direction de projets complexes de science des données et d'architecture de l'information de bout en bout avec une volonté d'avoir un impact commercial significatif. Expérience avérée de travail en étroite collaboration avec la haute direction pour éclairer et influencer les décisions commerciales stratégiques de haut niveau et les cadres de données.
• Expertise démontrée dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de cadres de science des données à l'échelle de l'entreprise, de cycles de vie de l'information et de meilleures pratiques de gouvernance.
• Maîtrise technique approfondie des langages de programmation tels que Python et R, associée à la capacité d'architecturer et de maintenir des flux de travail de contrôle de version complexes à l'aide de Git.
• Expertise complète dans la gestion de bases de données cloud natives
