Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient présents dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise, tels que des ateliers, des conférences, des assemblées publiques, des réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements collaboratifs. L'ERP Test Manager est l'architecte stratégique et le gardien opérationnel de la méthodologie de test ASPIRE. Vous êtes chargé d'identifier les « espaces blancs » opérationnels et de concevoir de nouveaux processus pour combler ces lacunes. Vous veillerez à ce que l'organisation de test soit conforme aux normes de validation du système informatique (CSV) et de qualité tout en favorisant une évolution continue. En tant que principal défenseur des processus lors des audits et architecte principal des mises à niveau des systèmes, vous équilibrez rigueur réglementaire et efficacité opérationnelle. Portée des responsabilités / (Leadership du contenu) : Fournit un leadership de niveau expert et des conseils stratégiques pour des projets d'assurance qualité à fort impact et/ou complexes. Développe et met en œuvre les meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie qualité dans plusieurs initiatives, garantissant la cohérence, la traçabilité des tests et l'alignement avec les normes de l'entreprise. Dirige les efforts d’analyse de la qualité sur des projets importants, fournit des conseils aux ingénieurs qualité moins expérimentés et contribue aux initiatives stratégiques. Fournit une supervision, des conseils et une assurance qualité pour l’ensemble des initiatives stratégiques, garantissant l’alignement de l’objectif et de la portée des tests, la cohésion des tests, la traçabilité et la valeur finale du produit.
• Dépositaire : Posséder la version principale de la méthodologie de test ASPIRE.
• Alignement réglementaire : assurez-vous que chaque mise à jour de processus est « pré-validée » en vous alignant sur les équipes CSV et Qualité avant le déploiement.
• Création de contenu : rédigez une documentation technique de haute qualité, notamment des SOP, des instructions de travail et des guides d'utilisation. Responsabilité/Résolution de problèmes : dirige l'analyse des problèmes de qualité logiciels complexes et stratégiques, définissant la portée de l'assurance qualité et conduisant une analyse complète des causes profondes des défauts critiques pouvant dépasser les limites de l'organisation. Obtient et analyse les besoins complexes en matière de qualité des parties prenantes avec une expertise, influençant les parties prenantes de l'entreprise à informer et à prendre les bonnes décisions concernant la qualité des produits et la préparation à la sortie. Définit la portée de la solution de test stratégique, gère la complexité et recherche un consensus sur les normes de qualité et les critères de publication grâce à une communication convaincante. Recommande des technologies et des outils d'assurance qualité optimaux pour la transformation de l'entreprise, en fournissant des solutions hautement innovantes à des défis de qualité inhabituellement complexes.
• Gestion des étapes : assumez l'entière responsabilité de garantir que toutes les phases de test (par exemple, SAT, UAT, RT) démarrent à temps, conformément au calendrier de publication mondial.
• Surveillance des progrès : suivez les mesures de test en temps réel et la gravure des défauts.

jobs.title: Expert Software Developer / Architect C#
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a Expert Software Developer / Architect C# for a role in Spain, focused on strategic decision-making and setting the organizational technical strategy. You will drive high-level system design and the technical vision while establishing elite coding standards for the enterprise across C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0.
If you excel at navigating ambiguity, utilizing modern AI-supporting tools, and mentoring engineers to build highly scalable, secure, and high-quality systems, this is the perfect opportunity to make a lasting technical impact.

Key Responsibilities
Engineering & Development (50%)

• Software Development Lifecycle : Participate fully in all phases of software development, including feasibility studies, design, development, testing, bug fixing, and ongoing software maintenance.

• Design & Implementation: Produce unit and subsystem specifications based on software requirements, project architecture, and guidelines. Accurately design and implement code, including the necessary tests to verify functionality against specifications.

• Strategic Tech Roadmapping & Governance: Define the technical roadmap and maintain architectural governance across development teams. Proactively align implementation with long-term business goals and project management strategies.

• Quality Assurance & Review: Conduct thorough reviews and analysis of personal source code and, upon request, the source code of peers. Review application design, functionality, usability, and performance to drive enhancements.

• Ambiguity Management: Possess the ability to navigate ambiguity and maintain forward progress.

• Role Type: Function as a Fullstack Developer.

Architect & Technical Expert (50%)

• Define all aspects of development, selecting appropriate technologies, workflows, and establishing rigorous coding standards.

• Collaborate with other professionals to determine and analyze functional and non-functional requirements for new software or applications.

• Mentorship & Talent Development: Provide high-level guidance and professional coaching to developers, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous learning within the engineering organization.

• Monitor the progress of the development team to ensure consistency with the initial design and technical vision.

• Ensure all software complies strictly with requirements for quality, security, modifiability, and extensibility.

Who You Are
Technical Skills

• Programming & Frameworks

jobs.title: Specialist Inbound (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Specialist Inbound (m/w/d)

Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Abteilung und das Team

Jeden Tag leisten wir Pionierarbeit, um die Grenzen der Medizin zu erweitern und Patient:innen weltweit mehr Zeit mit ihren Liebsten zu schenken. In der Logistik bist Du das Rückgrat dieser Mission: Deine Präzision im Wareneingang stellt sicher, dass lebenswichtige Ressourcen genau dort ankommen, wo sie gebraucht werden. Werde Teil unseres Teams und baue mit uns an einer gesünderen Zukunft.

Wir als Logistics Operations RDG zeichnen uns verantwortlich für die Kommissionierung, Verpackung und Versendung von Diagnostischen Produkten für unsere Endkunden im Rahmen der Direktbelieferung und unserer Filialen rund um den Globus. Mit dem Neubau 391 betreten wir ein neues Zeitalter und heben die Logistik auf das nächste technologische Level. Sei auch du von Anfang an dabei, wenn wir mit der neuen Direktbelieferung durchstarten und schreibe die Erfolgsgeschichte des Standort Mannheims für die kommenden Jahre fort.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen engagierten und erfahrenen Inbound Spezialisten (m/w/d) . Wenn du Lust hast, in einem dynamischen und respektvollen Umfeld zu arbeiten und dich in dem untenstehenden Profil angesprochen fühlst, zögere nicht, und bewirb Dich!

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

In dieser Rolle bist Du Teil unseres Inbound-Teams und treibst die digitale und operative Transformation unserer Logistikprozesse aktiv voran. Dabei übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Du nimmst eigenverantwortlich an fachbezogenen Projekten innerhalb der GSC Operations EMEA mit Fokus auf Prozessoptimierung und Netzwerkausbau.

• Die Analyse und Auswertung von Inbound-Daten liegt in Deiner Hand, um mittels KPIs eine effektive Steuerung und präzise Forecasts zu ermöglichen.

Bei Roche Diagnostics leisten wir Pionierarbeit, um die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens zu gestalten. Unsere Arbeit gibt Menschen mehr Zeit mit denjenigen, die sie lieben – ein Wunsch, den wir alle teilen und der uns zu medizinischen Durchbrüchen antreibt. In Deiner Rolle als Specialist Strategic Order Control sicherst Du die operativen Abläufe in unserem Logistik-Hub EMEA. Durch vorausschauende Steuerung und kluges Engpassmanagement sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Innovationen genau dann dort ankommen, wo sie am dringendsten benötigt werden: bei den Patient:innen. Werde Teil unserer Mission, durch wissenschaftliche Exzellenz und effiziente Logistik ein gesünderes Morgen zu schaffen.

Du wirst Teil des Control Tower Teams, einer dynamischen Einheit, die die verschiedenen Bereiche der operativen Abwicklung durch datengestützte Analysen verbindet und für eine reibungslose, übergeordnete Steuerung sorgt. Wir leben eine Kultur des Vertrauens, der Zusammenarbeit und des gegenseitigen Respekts. In unserem Team schätzen wir unterschiedliche Perspektiven, denn wir wissen, dass die besten Lösungen durch den Austausch vielfältiger Ideen entstehen. Gemeinsam meistern wir komplexe Herausforderungen und sorgen für Prozessstabilität im Hub EMEA.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

In dieser Position bist Du der Dirigent unserer logistischen Prozesse und stellst sicher, dass alle Zahnräder effizient ineinandergreifen. Dabei übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Du übernimmst die strategische Überwachung der Auftragslage und entwickelst eigenständig Maßnahmen zur Lastverteilung und Effizienzsteigerung im Hub EMEA.

• Die Identifikation von Prozessengpässen (Personal, Systeme, Fläche) gehört ebenso zu Deinem Bereich wie das Erarbeiten von Handlungsempfehlungen für die operativen Einheiten.

• Du koordinierst und entwickelst Notfallstrategien weiter und leitest Taskforces zur Wiederherstellung der Prozessstabilität bei komplexen Störungen.

• Mittels komplexer Analysen und Leistungsstatistiken identifizierst Du Potenziale und führst datenbasierte Diskussionen mit Deinen Stakeholdern.

• Du wirkst aktiv an der Ausgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung der Funktion der strategischen Steuerung mit.

• Als Expert:in begleitest Du Projekte (z. B. SAP-Integration, Logsys-Updates) und planst sowie führst komplexe Softwaretests eigenverantwortlich durch.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Logistik und behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick? Dann suchen wir genau Dich:

• Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (idealerweise Schwerpunkt Logistik) mit entsprechender Weiterbildung oder mehrjähriger einschlägiger Berufserfahrung.

• Fundierte Berufserfahrung im Bereich Logistik sowie ein tiefes Verständnis von Intralogistik-Abläufen (Wareneingang bis Warenausgang) sind wünschenswert und von großem Vorteil.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Shape the Future of Secure Engineering with Roche

Are you ready to tackle bold challenges and make a real impact? At Roche, we’re not just building IT infrastructure — we’re engineering secure, scalable, and highly innovative software solutions that protect and empower digital health systems globally. We're looking for passionate and driven individuals to join our Certman PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) team as a Senior DevOps Engineer and help us lead the way in cutting-edge, trust-based technology.

Our Certman team issues and manages the digital certificates that secure Roche's internal systems and services worldwide. We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help us automate, scale, and secure that trust infrastructure end-to-end.

Who We Are: A Better Tomorrow Starts Today

At Roche, everything we do is powered by our passion to transform patients’ lives. We embrace science, ethics, and innovation. We're bold in our decisions and actions because we know a brighter future depends on it. Every day, we show up to build that future — for a better world, for humankind.

Diversity and inclusion aren’t just buzzwords here; they’re essential to who we are. We believe that unique perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we are committed to building teams that reflect the extraordinary range of human potential.

What You'll Do

You'll own the infrastructure that keeps our PKI running . That means designing and maintaining Terraform modules across multi-cloud environments, operating Kubernetes in a genuinely hybrid setup, and running the secrets and PKI plumbing that everything else depends on.

Day-to-day, you'll shape how we ship and observe things : improving CI/CD pipelines in GitLab CI and GitHub Actions, maturing our ArgoCD-based GitOps, managing self-hosted runners, and building observability with Grafana Cloud. When on-prem workloads need it, you'll build VM images.

Beyond the tools, you'll support three product teams in the Certificates organization, balancing their operational needs with the longer-term infrastructure work — and you'll have the autonomy to propose better ways of doing things rather than just executing tickets.

What You Bring

We are looking for thinkers that implement solutions to technical problems (optimisation, reliability). Someone with production Kubernetes experience who's comfortable owning clusters end-to-end, and who has solid hands-on experience with Terraform, AWS, secrets management, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling. Scripting in Python or Bash should feel natural, and your English — written and spoken — needs to be excellent. Your communication skills must be so good that we can see you leading technical conversations at all levels from day one.

But honestly, the mindset matters more than the checklist . In a cohesive DevOps and delivery team, we need someone who takes ownership without being asked, communicates openly when things are unclear, asks for help before getting stuck, and treats teammates and stakeholders with patience and respect. We value people who are curious, pragmatic, and genuinely enjoy improving the things around them.

Your Opportunity to Shine:

This role is about taking ownership and leading the charge toward transformational DevOps best practices, precision engineering, and cutting-edge cloud integration. Show your skills, grow your career, and make a measurable impact on enterprise security — all alongside a team that has your back.

Why Choose This Role?

At Roche, y

Au jour le jour, vous façonnerez la façon dont nous expédions et observons les choses : améliorer les pipelines CI/CD dans GitLab CI et GitHub Actions, affiner nos GitOps basés sur ArgoCD, gérer les coureurs autonomes et construire l'observabilité avec Grafana Cloud. Lorsque les charges de travail sur site en ont besoin, vous créerez des images VM. Au-delà des outils, vous soutiendrez trois équipes de produits dans l'organisation des certificats, en conciliant leurs besoins opérationnels avec les travaux d'infrastructure à plus long terme — et vous aurez l'autonomie de proposer de meilleures façons de faire les choses plutôt que de simplement exécuter des tickets. Ce que vous apportez Nous recherchons des penseurs qui mettent en œuvre des solutions aux problèmes techniques (optimisation, fiabilité). Quelqu'un avec la production Kubernetes expérience qui est confortable propriétaire de grappes bout à bout, et qui a une solide expérience pratique avec Terraform, AWS, gestion de secrets, pipelines CI/CD, et outillage d'observation. L'écriture en Python ou en Bash devrait être naturelle, et votre anglais — écrit et parlé — doit être excellent.

Nous apprécions les gens curieux, pragmatiques, et nous aimons vraiment améliorer les choses qui les entourent. Votre occasion de briller : Ce rôle consiste à s'approprier et à diriger la charge vers les meilleures pratiques de transformation DevOps, l'ingénierie de précision et l'intégration cloud de pointe. Montrez vos compétences, développez votre carrière et faites un impact mesurable sur la sécurité de l'entreprise, à côté d'une équipe qui a votre dos. Pourquoi choisir ce rôle? Chez Roche, y

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
On en Roche

Looking to launch your career in healthcare and make a real impact from day one?
Join a global leader in diagnostics and be part of shaping the future of healthcare operations, finance, and supply chain at scale.

What is it?

• ON en Roche is a 2-year rotational graduate program within Finance & Operations designed for high-potential early-career professionals.

• From day one, you will take ownership of real business challenges that directly impact operations, customer experience, and Roche’s end-to-end value chain.

• You will rotate across different areas within Finance & Operations, gaining hands-on experience and a holistic understanding of how a global healthcare organization operates.

• The program is designed to accelerate your development through structured rotations, cross-functional exposure, and continuous learning.

Why join?

• Real ownership from day one on business-critical challenges

• Exposure to an end-to-end healthcare value chain at global scale

• Rotations across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations

• High-impact projects with international and cross-functional teams

• Structured development, mentoring, and continuous feedback

• Clear fast-track career progression within Roche

The Opportunity

Drive business performance through financial insight, strategic sourcing, and data-driven decision-making.
Rotations may include:

• Customer Finance

• Controlling & Reporting

• Procurement & Strategic Sourcing

The Position

• Analyze financial and operational performance to identify risks and opportunities

• Support pricing, cost, and margin optimization initiatives

• Contribute to procurement and sourcing strategies

• Participate in forecasting, business planning, and performance management

• Monitor customer profitability and performance

• Support cross-functional transformation initiative

Who you are

We are looking for high-potential early-career professionals with a strong analytical mindset and motivation to build a career in healthcare and operations.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, Data Science , or related fields

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Fluent Spanish and English (written and spoken)

• Interest in healthcare, operations, and data-driven environments

• Full availability for a 24-month program

Timelines & further information

• Full-time 24-month graduate contract (not a university internship agreement)

• Based in Sant Cugat (Barcelona)

• Start date: September 2026

• Assessment Center: July 15th

• Applications reviewed on a rolling basis

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Account Executive - Pathology Lab

The Opportunity:
This role supports our Tissue Diagnostics franchise and will be responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories. Typically responsible for medium to large accounts or have a medium to large quota/territory. Must develop customer prospects and create and maintain relationships with decision makers. Contacts/visits existing and potential customers. Works to build and maintain network of colleagues, partners, and customers to share information and obtain prospects. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers. Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of product line and have a more in-depth knowledge of other products or services.

A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career-oriented position. Has a complete knowledge of company products and services. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise. Responsible for selling the company's products or services, developing new accounts and/or expanding existing accounts. Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments.

This is a field based role - the territory includes MA, ME, NH & VT. Relocation benefits are not provided for this role. You must live within 50 miles of the territory.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

• Contacts new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• Generates demand and maximizes product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• Implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• Works with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• Conducts and organizes necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• Communicates competitive market information internally.

• Networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• You hold 3 years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience.

Preferred:

• Proven leadership abilities

• Negotiation, contracting

• Possiedi una laurea o un'esperienza equivalente
• Hai 3 anni di esperienza nelle vendite o equivalente

• Comprovate capacità di leadership
• Negoziazione, contrattazione

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Account Executive - Pathology Lab The Opportunity: This role supports our Tissue Diagnostics franchise and will be responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories. Typically responsible for medium to large accounts or have a medium to large quota/territory. Must develop customer prospects and create and maintain relationships with decision makers. Contacts/visits existing and potential customers. Works to build and maintain network of colleagues, partners, and customers to share information and obtain prospects. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers. Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of product line and have a more in-depth knowledge of other products or services. A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career-oriented position. Has a complete knowledge of company products and services. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise. Responsible for selling the company's products or services, developing new accounts and/or expanding existing accounts. Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments. This is a field based role - the territory includes MA, ME, NH & VT. Relocation benefits are not provided for this role. You must live within 50 miles of the territory. Key Roles & Responsibilities:
• Contacts new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.
• Generates demand and maximizes product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.
• Implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.
• Works with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.
• Conducts and organizes necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.
• Communicates competitive market information internally.
• Networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.
• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions. Who you are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
• You hold 3 years relevant sales or equivalent experience
• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience. Preferred:
• Proven leadership abilities
• Negotiation, contracting

Typischerweise verantwortlich für mittlere bis große Konten oder mit einem mittleren bis großen Kontingent/Gebiet. Muss Kundenperspektiven entwickeln und Beziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern aufbauen und pflegen. Kontakte/Besuche bestehender und potenzieller Kunden. Arbeitet am Aufbau und der Pflege eines Netzwerks von Kollegen, Partnern und Kunden, um Informationen auszutauschen und Interessenten zu gewinnen. Darüber hinaus erfordert die Position Präsentationen zur Wertquantifizierung gegenüber potenziellen Kunden. Muss umfassende Kenntnisse der Produktlinie nachweisen und über umfassendere Kenntnisse anderer Produkte oder Dienstleistungen verfügen. Ein erfahrener Fachmann mit umfassender Kenntnis des Fachgebiets. Löst eine Vielzahl von Problemen auf kreative Weise. • Sie verfügen über einen Bachelor-Abschluss oder eine gleichwertige Erfahrung.

• Verhandlung, Vertragsabschluss

Généralement responsable de comptes moyens à grands ou disposant d'un quota/territoire moyen à grand. Doit développer des prospects clients et créer et entretenir des relations avec les décideurs. Travaille sur des problèmes de portée diverse où l'analyse des données nécessite l'évaluation de facteurs identifiables. Fait preuve d’un bon jugement dans la sélection des méthodes et des techniques permettant d’obtenir des solutions. Réseauter avec du personnel interne et externe de haut niveau dans son propre domaine d'expertise. Responsable de la vente des produits ou services de l'entreprise, du développement de nouveaux comptes et/ou de l'expansion des comptes existants. Reçoit normalement peu d'instructions sur le travail quotidien, des instructions générales sur les nouvelles missions. Il s'agit d'un rôle basé sur le terrain - le territoire comprend MA, ME, NH et VT. Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas fournies pour ce rôle. Vous devez habiter à moins de 50 miles du territoire. Rôles et responsabilités clés :
• Contacter les clients nouveaux et existants pour atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente dans les comptes ciblés, en développant de nouvelles affaires, en développant les activités existantes, en entretenant les relations avec les clients et en résolvant les problèmes des clients. Cela comprend l'identification et l'élaboration de plans de compte stratégiques, l'élaboration et la diffusion du message différenciateur et de la valeur économique quantifiable des produits et services, la vente de la principale différenciation des produits Roche, le dépassement et la gestion des objections et la négociation pour obtenir des ventes.
• Génère la demande et maximise la notoriété des produits en travaillant avec les clients et en leur fournissant une éducation et des informations.
• Met en œuvre des initiatives et des plans stratégiques pour faciliter le processus de vente et la productivité.
• Travaille avec d'autres, selon les besoins, pour préparer des propositions pour les comptes attribués. Présente toutes les propositions de contrat aux clients afin de maximiser l'activité et la rentabilité globales, ce qui peut nécessiter des négociations.
• Conduit et organise la planification du territoire et le tracé nécessaires pour plus d'efficacité. Effectue l’analyse et la planification commerciales.
• Communique en interne des informations sur le marché concurrentiel.
• Réseaux et interfaces avec des collègues internes pour partager des informations et des meilleures pratiques tout en restant activement impliqué dans les organisations de l'industrie/clients qui ont un impact sur les affaires.
• Responsable du maintien et de l'amélioration continue du système qualité et de l'atteinte des objectifs de qualité par des actions quotidiennes. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une expérience équivalente
• Vous possédez 3 ans d'expérience pertinente en vente ou une expérience équivalente
• La participation à un programme de développement accéléré, de bourse ou de rotation approuvé peut être considérée à la place de l'expérience. Préféré :
• Capacités avérées de leadership
• Négociation, passation de marchés

• o Implementieren Sie Best Practices und betriebliche Standards, um Prozesse zu optimieren und die Produktivität zu maximieren. Wer Sie sind:
• Strategische und technische Führung: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung, Betreuung und Skalierung leistungsstarker technischer Support- oder Außendienstteams, idealerweise im IVD-Bereich (In-vitro-Diagnostik).

• Datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung: Starke analytische Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten zu nutzen, klare KPIs festzulegen und Kennzahlen in proaktive, kosteneffiziente Aktionspläne umzusetzen. Funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit: Außergewöhnliche Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Managementfähigkeiten mit nachweislicher Fähigkeit, starke Partnerschaften zwischen Vertrieb, Marketing, Betrieb und globalen/lokalen Teams aufzubauen. Kundenzentrierte Denkweise: Ein leidenschaftlicher Verfechter des End-to-End-Kundenerlebnisses, der über das nötige Einfühlungsvermögen und die Professionalität verfügt, um komplexe Probleme zu lösen

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Customer Marketing
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Manager, Customer Marketing

Mission: Leads the strategy and execution of customer marketing initiatives across the Molecular Diagnostics portfolio, aligning brand, campaign, and commercial objectives to drive engagement, retention, and growth.

Job Facts:
Responsible for defining and overseeing high-impact campaigns, events, and corporate and enterprise account engagement. By shaping brand messaging and value propositions using competitive intelligence and Voice of Customer insights, this individual ensures that all marketing efforts align with broader brand, campaign, and commercial objectives. This position involves a high degree of cross-functional partnership with sales, product marketing, and digital teams to develop cohesive content and campaign roadmaps. A key function of this role is to guide and coach peers in execution, prioritization, and performance optimization to drive customer engagement, retention, and growth.

6 month deliverables:

• Define and document Roche Molecular Lab value proposition, key messaging pillars, and positioning strategy across key customer segments

• Partner with Sales and Marketing leadership to identify and prioritize key enterprise accounts for ABX and tailored customer engagement

• Work with the Marketing Operations Manager to define and align KPIs across the marketing funnel, including awareness, engagement, lead quality, and conversion metrics

• Deliver a standardized toolkit to help Product Marketing and Sales field teams develop and execute campaigns that align with customer strategy

12 month deliverables:

• Lead integrated campaigns tied to critical products within the Molecular portfolio strategy, targeting high-value segments

• Build and launch an account-based marketing (ABX) program in partnership with Customer Marketing, Customer Engagement and Digital teams, with measurable impact on enterprise account engagement and pipeline growth

• Work with the Marketing Operations Manager to design and launch an internal dashboard with campaign, content, and engagement analytics to track performance, ROI, and inform marketing optimization

24-Month Deliverables:

• Build and evolve a maturity model for Enterprise Account Marketing, including personalized campaigns, content strategies, and integrated reporting

• Partner with the Marketing Operations Manager to implement and refine advanced attribution models showing influence on revenue and customer engagement

Ongoing Deliverables:

• Continuously refine and communicate the Molecular Lab value proposition and strategic messaging based on evolving market trends, competitive intelligence, and customer insights

• Provide ongoing coaching and guidance to the marketing team, fostering alignment on strategic priorities, campaign execution, and performance optimization

• Maintain a strategic roadmap for integrated marketing campaigns and Account-Based experience (ABX) initiatives, ensuring alignment with sales leadership and commercial Roche Job Description objectives

• Deliver regular performance reports and insight-driven recommendations to key stakeholders to inform adjustments and business decisions

Key responsibilities:

• Define and oversee customer marketing strategy across high-impact campaigns, events, and enterprise account engagement

• Lead the strategy, prioritization, and execution of marketing initiatives for key customer accounts, including Account-Based Experience (ABX) programs

• Shape brand messaging and value propositions using competitiv

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Senior Manager, Customer Marketing Missione: conduce la strategia e l'esecuzione delle iniziative di marketing del cliente attraverso il portafoglio di Diagnostica Molecolare, allineando il marchio, la campagna e gli obiettivi commerciali per guidare il coinvolgimento, la ritenzione e la crescita. Fatti di lavoro: Responsabile per la definizione e la supervisione di campagne ad alto impatto, eventi e impegno di account aziendali e aziendali. Attraverso la definizione di messaggistica di marca e proposizioni di valore utilizzando intelligenza competitiva e intuizioni Voice of Customer, questo individuo assicura che tutti gli sforzi di marketing si allineano con il marchio più ampio, la campagna e gli obiettivi commerciali. Questa posizione comporta un alto grado di partnership interfunzionale con le vendite, il marketing dei prodotti e i team digitali per sviluppare contenuti coesivi e roadmap di campagna. Una funzione chiave di questo ruolo è quello di guidare e coach pari in esecuzione, priorità e ottimizzazione delle prestazioni per guidare l'impegno del cliente, la ritenzione e la crescita. 6 mesi consegnabili:
• Definire e documentare la proposta di valore di Roche Molecular Lab, i pilastri di messaggistica chiave e la strategia di posizionamento nei segmenti dei clienti chiave
• Partner con la leadership Vendite e Marketing per identificare e privilegiare i principali account aziendali per ABX e il coinvolgimento dei clienti su misura
• Lavorare con il Marketing Operations Manager per definire e allineare i KPI attraverso l'imbuto di marketing, tra cui la consapevolezza, l'impegno, la qualità del piombo e le metriche di conversione
• Fornire un toolkit standardizzato per aiutare i team del settore Marketing e Vendite a sviluppare ed eseguire campagne che si allineano alla strategia del cliente 12 mesi consegnabili:
• Lead campagne integrate legate ai prodotti critici all'interno della strategia del portafoglio molecolare, mirando a segmenti ad alto valore
• Costruire e lanciare un programma di marketing basato su account (ABX) in collaborazione con i team di Customer Marketing, Customer Engagement e Digital, con un impatto misurabile sull'impegno e la crescita di un conto aziendale
• Lavorare con Marketing Operations Manager per progettare e lanciare una dashboard interna con campagne, contenuti e analisi di engagement per monitorare le prestazioni, ROI e informare l'ottimizzazione del marketing Consegnabili 24 mesi:
• Costruire ed evolvere un modello di maturità per Enterprise Account Marketing, incluse campagne personalizzate, strategie di contenuti e report integrati
• Partner con Marketing Operations Manager per implementare e perfezionare modelli di attribuzione avanzata che mostrano l'influenza sul fatturato e sull'impegno del cliente Consegnabili in corso:
• perfezionare e comunicare costantemente la proposta di valore del Laboratorio Molecolare e la messaggistica strategica basata su tendenze di mercato in evoluzione, intelligenza competitiva e intuizioni dei clienti
• Fornire coaching e guida in corso al team di marketing, favorendo l'allineamento sulle priorità strategiche, l'esecuzione della campagna e l'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni
• Mantenere una roadmap strategica per campagne di marketing integrate e iniziative di esperienza basata su Account (ABX), garantendo l'allineamento con la leadership di vendita e obiettivi commerciali Roche Job Description
• Fornire rapporti regolari sulle prestazioni e raccomandazioni orientate agli stakeholder chiave per informare le modifiche e le decisioni aziendali Responsabilità chiave:
• Definire e supervisionare la strategia di marketing del cliente attraverso campagne ad alto impatto, eventi e impegno del conto aziendale
• Guidare la strategia, la priorità e l'esecuzione di iniziative di marketing per i principali account dei clienti, compresi i programmi Account-Based Experience (ABX)
• Forma di messaggistica del marchio e proposizioni di valore utilizzando competitiv

En formulant des messages de marque et des propositions de valeur à l'aide de l'intelligence concurrentielle et de la voix des clients, cette personne s'assure que tous les efforts de marketing s'harmonisent avec des objectifs plus larges de marque, de campagne et de commerce. Cette position implique un degré élevé de partenariat interfonctionnel avec les ventes, la commercialisation de produits et les équipes numériques pour développer un contenu cohérent et des feuilles de route de campagne. Une fonction clé de ce rôle est de guider et d'entraîner les pairs dans l'exécution, la priorisation et l'optimisation des performances pour stimuler l'engagement, la rétention et la croissance des clients. • Collaborer avec le directeur des opérations marketing pour définir et aligner les ICR à travers l'entonnoir marketing, y compris la sensibilisation, l'engagement, la qualité de plomb et les mesures de conversion

• Collaborer avec le directeur des opérations marketing à la conception et au lancement d'un tableau de bord interne avec des analyses de campagne, de contenu et d'engagement pour suivre les performances, le ROI et informer l'optimisation marketing Livraisons 24 mois :
• Construire et développer un modèle de maturité pour le marketing des comptes d'entreprise, comprenant des campagnes personnalisées, des stratégies de contenu et des rapports intégrés
• Partenariat avec le responsable des opérations marketing pour mettre en œuvre et affiner des modèles d'attribution avancés montrant une influence sur les revenus et l'engagement des clients Produits livrables en cours :

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst - RDT EPIE
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Business Analyst

We focus on the long - term, leading investment in research and development, striving to improve lives today and for generations to come. Poland plays the role of Technology Co-creation and Acceleration Hub building capabilities driving digital innovation. In Roche Informatics we are a diverse team of open and friendly people, enthusiastic about technological novelties and optimal IT solutions.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As the strategic engine for RDT Enterprise Platforms, Infrastructure & Engineering (EPIE), our team bridges high-level vision with world-class execution. We are a high-performing collective of experts—from project leaders to business analysts and human centered design experts—dedicated to elevating operational excellence and driving long-term strategy. By harnessing data-driven insights and managing critical shared capabilities, we ensure our division meets its global commitments with precision. Joining us means operating at the intersection of strategy, technology, and operational effectiveness, with the autonomy to streamline complex processes and the influence to shape the digital future of healthcare at Roche.

The opportunity:
As a Business Analyst, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity. You will demonstrate a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes, methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.

• Scope: Independently manages end-to-end business analysis workstreams without guidance, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of needs and problems, performs thorough research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to operational excellence and effectiveness solutions, and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Delivers impact that extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster, contributing to domain goals by ensuring solutions provide demonstrable business value. Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans, influences tactical decisions, and contributes to long-term solution roadmaps.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for an experienced and passionate Legal Counsel to join our Legal team at Roche Diagnostics Turkiye. In this role, you will play a key part in protecting our reputation and supporting strategic decision-making with expert legal guidance.

What will you do?
As a Legal Counsel, you will be a strategic partner for Roche, providing proactive and commercially focused legal services and solutions. You will oversee legal compliance, mitigate risks, support corporate governance, and advise on business operations. Your role includes managing contracts, handling litigation, monitoring regulatory developments, and ensuring company policies align with legal requirements.

Key responsibilities include:

• Drafting, reviewing, and negotiating bilingual legal documents such as contracts and agreements.

• Leading key contract negotiations and maintaining Roche’s contract template pool.

• Keeping company departments updated on changes in laws and recent cases, assessing potential risks, and offering legal solutions.

• Handling litigation to safeguard Roche’s legal rights and interests.

• Managing corporate maintenance topics, including company registration and corporate filings.

• Overseeing external legal counsel on various legal matters.

• Providing legal support for commercial and operational projects.

• Delivering legal training to employees and third parties, such as distributors and suppliers.

• Managing legal department reporting responsibilities and documentation.

Who are you?
As a Legal Counsel, you are a proactive and business-minded legal professional with a strong ability to navigate complex regulatory environments. You thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic setting, and you bring the following qualifications and skills:

• A Bachelor’s Degree in Law (Master’s preferred).

• At least 6-7 years of experience in contract law, commercial law, and tender law.

• Strong expertise in developing business models and customer solutions that drive superior business results.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (additional languages are a plus).

• High adaptability and eagerness for continuous learning and self-development.

• Exceptional analytical, investigative, and organizational skills.

• Experience in the healthcare industry is an advantage.

Why Roche?
At Roche, we believe in fostering a culture of learning, innovation, and collaboration. We offer an environment where you have the freedom to shape your role in a way that aligns with your strengths and ambitions. Diversity and inclusion are at the core of our identity, and we encourage you to bring your authentic self to work every day.
What do we offer?

• A dynamic and market-leading company with national and international career opportunities.

• A chance to make a meaningful impact by improving the lives of patients worldwide.

• An agile and people-focused work environment, where autonomy and decision-making are valued.

• Opportunities for personal and professional growth, with Roche investing in your development.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions h

Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la protection de notre réputation et l'appui à la prise de décisions stratégiques avec des conseils juridiques spécialisés. Qu'allez-vous faire ? En tant que conseiller juridique, vous serez un partenaire stratégique pour Roche, offrant des services et des solutions juridiques proactives et commerciales. Vous surveillerez la conformité juridique, atténuerez les risques, appuierez la gouvernance d'entreprise et conseillerez sur les opérations commerciales. Votre rôle consiste notamment à gérer les contrats, à traiter les litiges, à surveiller l'évolution de la réglementation et à veiller à ce que les politiques de l'entreprise soient conformes aux exigences légales. Les principales responsabilités sont les suivantes :
• Rédaction, examen et négociation de documents juridiques bilingues comme les contrats et les ententes.
• Diriger les négociations clés et maintenir le modèle de contrat Roches.
• tenir les services de l'entreprise au courant de l'évolution de la législation et des affaires récentes, évaluer les risques potentiels et proposer des solutions juridiques.
• Traitement des litiges pour protéger les droits et intérêts légaux de Roche.
• Gérer les sujets de maintenance des entreprises, y compris l'enregistrement des sociétés et les dépôts des sociétés.
• Superviser les services d'un avocat externe chargé de diverses questions juridiques.
• Fournir un appui juridique aux projets commerciaux et opérationnels.
• Offrir une formation juridique aux employés et aux tiers, tels que les distributeurs et les fournisseurs.
• Gestion des responsabilités et de la documentation des services juridiques. Qui êtes-vous ? En tant que conseiller juridique, vous êtes un professionnel du droit proactif et axé sur l'entreprise qui a une forte capacité de naviguer dans des environnements réglementaires complexes. Vous prospèrez dans un cadre dynamique et rapide, et vous apportez les qualifications et les compétences suivantes:
• Baccalauréat en droit (maîtrise préférée).
• Au moins 6-7 ans d'expérience en droit des contrats, en droit commercial et en droit des offres.
• Une solide expertise dans le développement de modèles d'affaires et de solutions client qui conduisent à des résultats commerciaux supérieurs.
• Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite en anglais (les langues supplémentaires sont un plus).
• Haute adaptabilité et empressement à l'apprentissage continu et à l'autodéveloppement.
• Compétences exceptionnelles en matière d'analyse, d'enquête et d'organisation.
• L'expérience dans le secteur de la santé est un avantage. Pourquoi Roche ? Chez Roche, nous croyons en la promotion d'une culture d'apprentissage, d'innovation et de collaboration. Nous offrons un environnement où vous avez la liberté de façonner votre rôle d'une manière qui s'harmonise avec vos forces et ambitions. La diversité et l'inclusion sont au cœur de notre identité, et nous vous encourageons à apporter votre authentique soi au travail chaque jour. Qu'est-ce qu'on offre ?
• Une entreprise dynamique et leader sur le marché avec des opportunités de carrière nationales et internationales.
• Une chance d'avoir un impact significatif en améliorant la vie des patients dans le monde entier.
• Un environnement de travail agile et axé sur les personnes, où l'autonomie et la prise de décisions sont appréciées.
• Possibilités de développement personnel et professionnel, Roche investissant dans votre développement. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions.

jobs.title: Clinical Scientist in neurosciences
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are currently seeking a Clinical Scientist to join our global team based in Basel in the Early Development department in the Neuroscience and Rare Disease DTA. This role will primarily support our latest development priorities.

We are a dedicated, collaborative team focused on meaningful lifecycle innovations that directly impact the neuroscience community. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to established science while addressing unmet needs in the Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s, multiple sclerosis, and rare disease community.

The Opportunity

• Provide support in developing and/or preparing clinical science information for inclusion into the Clinical Development Plan.

• Guided by the Lead/senior Clinical Scientist, contribute to protocol/ICF (writing or amendment), construct appropriate CRFs and coordinate cross-functionally.

• Guided by the Lead/senior Clinical Scientist, contribute to internal/external clinical presentations and communications (e.g. investigator meetings, study site interactions, patient information, study newsletters). Present at appropriate internal meetings, e.g. Study Leadership Team. Contributes to abstracts, posters, content for scientific meetings.

• Work with Lead/senior Clinical Scientists/Medical Directors/Clinical Directors and cross-functional groups to execute the Medical Data Review Plan, data interpretation and contribute to study reporting.

• Work as medical monitor of phase 1 and phase 2 clinical trials in Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s disease

• Work on advanced imaging technique to measure neurodegeneration (e.g. neuromelanin-MRI) in Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s disease

• With guidance, contribute to Clinical Trial Application (CTA)/Ethics Committee (EC) written interactions, briefing packs, written responses to Health Authority (HA) questions, clinical science data/preparations for HA interactions and clinical data input to regulatory submissions.

Who you are

• Degree in Medicine required (e.g. MD, MBBS). An advanced clinical/Science Degree is highly preferred (e.g. PhD, PharmD, MSN, MPH, etc.).

• 1 to 3 years of clinical development experience. While prior experience is a plus, we are primarily looking for someone with high potential, strong motivation, and a willingness to learn

• Familiarity with governing laws, regulations, guidelines on global clinical trial execution is required and some knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonization of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA and other relevant guidelines and regulation.

• Good understanding of the multidisciplinary functions involved in drug development. Some therapeutic area relevant clinical trial experience or clear potential to assimilate with some support.

• Strong collaborative skills with the ability to work effectively within a geographically distributed global team.

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Stiamo attualmente cercando uno scienziato clinico per unire il nostro team globale con sede a Basilea nel dipartimento di sviluppo precoce in Neuroscience e Malattia Rara DTA. Questo ruolo sosterrà principalmente le nostre ultime priorità di sviluppo. Siamo un team dedicato e collaborativo focalizzato sulle innovazioni significative del ciclo di vita che influenzano direttamente la comunità di neuroscienze. Questa posizione offre l'opportunità di contribuire alla scienza consolidata, affrontando le esigenze insoddisfatte nel Parkinson, Alzheimer, sclerosi multipla, e comunità di malattie rare. L'opportunità
• Fornire supporto nello sviluppo e/o nella preparazione di informazioni scientifiche cliniche per l'inclusione nel Piano di Sviluppo Clinico.
• Guidato dallo scienziato clinico Lead/Senior, contribuire al protocollo/ICF (scrittura o modifica), costruire CRF appropriati e coordinare cross-funzionalmente.
• Guidato dallo Scienziato Clinico Lead/Senior, contribuire a presentazioni e comunicazioni cliniche interne/esterne (ad esempio incontri di ricerca, interazioni dei siti di studio, informazioni dei pazienti, newsletter di studio). Presente a riunioni interne appropriate, ad esempio il Team di Leadership di Studio. Contribuisce a astratti, manifesti, contenuti per incontri scientifici.
• Lavorare con Lead/Senior Clinical Scientists/Medical Directors/Clinical Directors e gruppi interfunzionali per eseguire il Medical Data Review Plan, l'interpretazione dei dati e contribuire allo studio di reportistica.
• Lavorare come monitor medico della fase 1 e fase 2 studi clinici nella malattia di Parkinson e Alzheimer
• Lavorare sulla tecnica avanzata di imaging per misurare la neurodegenerazione (ad esempio neuromelanina-MRI) nella malattia di Parkinson e Alzheimer
• Con l'orientamento, contribuire all'applicazione clinica di prova (CTA)/Comitato di etica (CE) interazioni scritte, pacchetti di briefing, risposte scritte alle domande dell'Autorità sanitaria (HA), dati/preparazioni di scienze cliniche per le interazioni HA e l'inserimento dei dati clinici alle presentazioni regolamentari. Chi sei
• Laurea in Medicina necessaria (ad esempio MD, MBBS). Un avanzato grado clinico/Science è altamente preferito (ad esempio PhD, PharmD, MSN, MPH, ecc.).
• da 1 a 3 anni di esperienza di sviluppo clinico. Mentre l'esperienza precedente è un plus, stiamo principalmente cercando qualcuno con alto potenziale, forte motivazione, e una volontà di imparare
• La familiarità con le leggi, i regolamenti, le linee guida sull'esecuzione di prova clinica globale è necessaria e una certa conoscenza degli aspetti medici di GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (Conferenza internazionale sull'armonizzazione dei requisiti tecnici per la registrazione dei farmaci per uso umano), FDA, EMA e altre linee guida e regolazione rilevanti.
• Buona comprensione delle funzioni multidisciplinari coinvolte nello sviluppo della droga. Un'area terapeutica pertinente esperienza di sperimentazione clinica o un chiaro potenziale per assimilare con qualche supporto.
• Forte capacità di collaborazione con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente all'interno di un team globale geograficamente distribuito. Sei pronto a fare la differenza per i nostri pazienti? Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione – unisciti a noi ora e diventi parte del nostro viaggio! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la piega

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wir suchen derzeit einen klinischen Wissenschaftler, der unserem globalen Team mit Sitz in Basel in der Frühentwicklungsabteilung für Neurowissenschaften und seltene Erkrankungen beitritt. Diese Rolle wird in erster Linie unsere jüngsten Entwicklungsprioritäten unterstützen. Wir sind ein engagiertes, kooperatives Team, das sich auf sinnvolle Lifecycle-Innovationen konzentriert, die sich direkt auf die neurowissenschaftliche Gemeinschaft auswirken. Diese Position bietet die Möglichkeit, einen Beitrag zur etablierten Wissenschaft zu leisten und gleichzeitig unerfüllte Bedürfnisse in der Parkinson-, Alzheimer-, Multiple Sklerose- und Seltenen Krankheitsgemeinschaft zu berücksichtigen. Die Chance
• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und / oder Vorbereitung klinischer Wissenschaftsinformationen für die Aufnahme in den klinischen Entwicklungsplan.
• Geführt durch den Lead / Senior Clinical Scientist, tragen Sie zum Protokoll / ICF (Schreiben oder Änderung), konstruieren Sie geeignete CRFs und koordinieren Sie funktionsübergreifend.
• Unter der Leitung des leitenden klinischen Wissenschaftlers tragen Sie zu internen / externen klinischen Präsentationen und Kommunikationen bei (z. B. Prüfertreffen, Interaktionen vor Ort, Patienteninformationen, Studiennewsletter). Teilnahme an geeigneten internen Meetings, z.B. Study Leadership Team. Trägt zu Abstracts, Postern, Inhalten für wissenschaftliche Meetings bei.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Lead/Senior Clinical Scientists/Medical Directors/Clinical Directors und funktionsübergreifenden Gruppen zusammen, um den Medical Data Review Plan durchzuführen, Daten zu interpretieren und zur Studienberichterstattung beizutragen.
• Arbeit als medizinischer Monitor von klinischen Studien der Phase 1 und Phase 2 bei Parkinson und Alzheimer
• Arbeiten an fortschrittlicher Bildgebungstechnik zur Messung der Neurodegeneration (z. B. Neuromelanin-MRT) bei Parkinson und Alzheimer
• Mit Anleitung, tragen Sie zu Clinical Trial Application (CTA) / Ethik-Ausschuss (EC) schriftliche Interaktionen, Briefing-Pakete, schriftliche Antworten auf Fragen der Gesundheitsbehörde (HA), klinische Wissenschaft Daten / Vorbereitungen für HA-Interaktionen und klinische Daten Eingabe zu regulatorischen Einreichungen. Wer du bist
• Abschluss in Medizin erforderlich (z. B. MD, MBBS). Ein fortgeschrittener klinischer / Science Degree ist sehr bevorzugt (z. B. PhD, PharmD, MSN, MPH usw.).
• 1 bis 3 Jahre klinische Entwicklungserfahrung. Während frühere Erfahrungen ein Plus sind, suchen wir in erster Linie jemanden mit hohem Potenzial, starker Motivation und Lernbereitschaft
• Vertrautheit mit den geltenden Gesetzen, Vorschriften, Richtlinien zur Durchführung globaler klinischer Studien ist erforderlich und einige Kenntnisse der medizinischen Aspekte von GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonization of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA und anderen relevanten Richtlinien und Vorschriften.
• Gutes Verständnis der multidisziplinären Funktionen, die an der Medikamentenentwicklung beteiligt sind. Einige therapeutische Bereich relevante klinische Studie Erfahrung oder klares Potenzial zu assimilieren mit einigen Unterstützung.
• Starke kollaborative Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv in einem geografisch verteilten globalen Team zu arbeiten. Sind Sie bereit, einen Unterschied für unsere Patienten zu machen? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung – kommen Sie jetzt mit und werden Sie Teil unserer Reise! Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d'un Clinical Scientist pour rejoindre notre équipe mondiale basée à Bâle dans le département de développement précoce de la DTA des neurosciences et des maladies rares. Ce rôle appuiera principalement nos dernières priorités de développement. Nous sommes une équipe dévouée et collaborative axée sur des innovations significatives du cycle de vie qui ont une incidence directe sur la communauté des neurosciences. Ce poste offre la possibilité de contribuer à la science établie tout en répondant aux besoins non satisfaits dans la communauté des Parkinson, des Alzheimer, de la sclérose en plaques et des maladies rares. L'opportunité
• Fournir un appui pour l'élaboration et/ou la préparation d'information scientifique clinique à inclure dans le Plan de développement clinique.
• Guidé par le chef/chercheur clinique principal, contribuer au protocole/ICF (écriture ou modification), construire des CRF appropriés et coordonner de manière transversale.
• Guidé par le responsable/chercheur clinique principal, contribuer aux présentations et communications cliniques internes/externes (p. ex. réunions des chercheurs, interactions avec les sites d'étude, information des patients, bulletins d'étude). Présenter aux réunions internes appropriées, p. ex. Équipe de leadership d'étude. Contribue aux résumés, aux affiches, au contenu des réunions scientifiques.
• Collaborer avec les scientifiques cliniciens principaux/directeurs médicaux/directeurs cliniques et les groupes interfonctionnels pour exécuter le plan d'examen des données médicales, interpréter les données et contribuer à la production de rapports d'études.
• Travailler comme moniteur médical des essais cliniques de phase 1 et de phase 2 chez Parkinson et la maladie d'Alzheimer
• Travail sur la technique d'imagerie avancée pour mesurer la neurodégénérescence (par exemple neuromélanine-IRM) chez Parkinson et la maladie d'Alzheimer
• Avec des conseils, contribuer à la demande d'essai clinique (DEC)/Comité d'éthique (CE) des interactions écrites, des dossiers d'information, des réponses écrites aux questions de l'Autorité sanitaire (HA), des données/préparations scientifiques cliniques pour les interactions avec les AP et des données cliniques entrées dans les présentations réglementaires. Qui vous êtes
• Diplôme de médecine requis (p. ex. MD, MBBS). Un diplôme clinique/science avancé est très préféré (p. ex. doctorat, PharmD, MSN, MPH, etc.).
• 1 à 3 ans d'expérience clinique. Bien que l'expérience antérieure soit un atout, nous cherchons surtout une personne qui a un potentiel élevé, une forte motivation et une volonté d'apprendre.
• Il est nécessaire de se familiariser avec les lois, les règlements et les directives régissant l'exécution des essais cliniques à l'échelle mondiale et de connaître certains aspects médicaux du GCP (bonnes pratiques cliniques), de l'ICH (Conférence internationale sur l'harmonisation des prescriptions techniques relatives à l'enregistrement des produits pharmaceutiques à usage humain), de la FDA, de l'EMA et d'autres directives et règlements pertinents.
• Bonne compréhension des fonctions multidisciplinaires liées au développement de la drogue. L'expérience d'essais cliniques pertinents dans certains domaines thérapeutiques ou un potentiel évident d'assimilation avec un certain soutien.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
On en Roche

Looking to launch your career in healthcare and make a real impact from day one?
Join a global leader in diagnostics and be part of shaping the future of healthcare operations, finance, and supply chain at scale.

What is it?

• ON en Roche is a 2-year rotational graduate program within Finance & Operations designed for high-potential early-career professionals.

• From day one, you will take ownership of real business challenges that directly impact operations, customer experience, and Roche’s end-to-end value chain.

• You will rotate across different areas within Finance & Operations, gaining hands-on experience and a holistic understanding of how a global healthcare organization operates.

• The program is designed to accelerate your development through structured rotations, cross-functional exposure, and continuous learning.

Why join?

• Real ownership from day one on business-critical challenges

• Exposure to an end-to-end healthcare value chain at global scale

• Rotations across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations

• High-impact projects with international and cross-functional teams

• Structured development, mentoring, and continuous feedback

• Clear fast-track career progression within Roche

The Opportunity

Enhance global supply chain performance through analytics, planning, and service optimization. Get familiar with the entire order fulfillment process and how we support our customers on a daily basis.
Rotations may include:

• Demand & Supply Planning

• Transport & 3PL Network Management

• Order management & customer collaboration

The Position

• Monitor and analyze key supply chain KPIs

• Support demand and supply planning activities

• Manage small scale projects within some of the Supply Chain areas, participate in the daily operations to get to know the activities like e.g. in order management & customer collaboration.

• Contribute to inventory optimization and stock management

• Collaborate with logistics partners to ensure reliable delivery

• Support projects for network optimization and process improvement initiatives

• Prepare insights and reports for decision-making

Who you are

We are looking for high-potential early-career professionals with a strong analytical mindset and motivation to build a career in healthcare and operations.
You should have:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Supply Chain , analytics profiles or related fields

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Fluent Spanish and English (written and spoken)

• Interest in healthcare, operations, and data-driven environments

• Full availability for a 24-month program

Timelines & further information

• Full-time 24-month graduate contract (not a university internship agreement)

• Based in Sant Cugat (Barcelona)

• Start date: September 2026

• Assessment Center: July 15th

• Applications reviewed on a rolling basis

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.
