Applicate subito! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività, e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter offrire la salute che cambia la vita

jobs.title: Senior Quality Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity

At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), we strive for confidence in the integrity of our data and processes, agility, and unrivalled transparency with health authorities, patients, and society. As a Senior Quality Lead within our Quality Assurance Process and Affiliate team, you will bring diverse thinking and technical expertise across various quality disciplines to support the Roche/Genentech organisation.

In this pivotal role, you will design and deliver risk-based Quality Assurance strategies, audits, and conclusions for post-approval products, affiliates, and processes. You will act as a trusted partner to senior business stakeholders, guiding cross-functional collaboration to ensure global quality standards are met while navigating complex regulatory landscapes.

• Design and Implement QA Strategies: Partner with business stakeholders to independently define the QA approach, assessing risks and adapting strategies using the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework across GCP, GVP, and Medical Device areas.

• Define and Lead Audits: Determine required audits, leverage data analytics to develop methodologies, and independently manage the end-to-end audit process from preparation to reporting.

• Manage Quality Issues: Independently manage quality issues, tracking systematic findings for process improvement and escalating significant risks to PDQ management.

• Quality Conclusion and Stakeholder Communication: Independently evaluate quality positions to drive compliance action plans. Lead high-level risk presentations and strategic discussions with business stakeholders, Pharma representatives, Legal, and Regulatory Affairs.

• Lead and support Health Authority Inspections: Lead preparation, staff training, and the management of major regulatory inspections (e.g., FDA, EMA), confidently presenting quality strategies and conclusions.

• Drive PDQ Leadership & Mentorship: Contribute to the long-term strategic direction of PDQ, lead compliance projects, and act as a dedicated mentor to develop Quality Leads within the team.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, strategic thinker who thrives in a collaborative, matrixed environment and is passionate about driving Quality outcomes. You possess strong digital and data literacy, allowing you to turn data into insights, and you are comfortable asking challenging questions to support PDQ outcomes.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Extensive Quality Expertise: A strong background in the drug development process and clinical trials, with robust cross-functional experience in GCP, GVP/PV, or Medical Devices/SaMD.

• Inspection Leadership: A proven track record of leading major Health Authority inspections (such as FDA or EMA), including inspection readiness and post-inspection management.

• Analytical & Critical Thinking: Advanced problem-solving skills with a proactive, risk-based mindset and the ability to utilise data and data visualisation tools to drive decisions.

• Influencing & Communication Skills: Exceptional relationship management skills with a proven ability to negotiate effective solutions and influence senior stakeholders.

• Inclusive Leadership: Experience managing projects in global, multicultural teams, with a passion for coaching and mentoring others.

• Academic Qualifications: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a scientific or quality-related field (an advanced degree is preferred).

In qualità di Senior Quality Lead all'interno del nostro team di Quality Assurance e Affiliazione, avrai diverse competenze tecniche e di pensiero in diverse discipline di qualità per supportare l'organizzazione Roche/Genentech. In questo ruolo fondamentale, progettare e fornire strategie di assicurazione della qualità basate sul rischio, audit e conclusioni per i prodotti post-approvazione, affiliati e processi. Potrai agire come partner affidabile per gli stakeholder aziendali senior, guidando la collaborazione interfunzionale per garantire standard di qualità globali sono soddisfatti durante la navigazione di paesaggi normativi complessi.
• Design e Implement QA Strategie: Partner con gli stakeholder aziendali per definire in modo indipendente l'approccio QA, valutare i rischi e adattare le strategie utilizzando il framework Critical to Quality (CtQ) in aree GCP, GVP e Medical Device.
• Definire e Lead Audits: Determinare gli audit necessari, sfruttare l'analisi dei dati per sviluppare metodologie e gestire in modo indipendente il processo di audit end-to-end dalla preparazione alla reportistica.
• Gestione dei problemi di qualità: gestire in modo indipendente i problemi di qualità, tracciare i risultati sistematici per il miglioramento del processo e aumentare i rischi significativi per la gestione del PDQ.
• Conclusione di qualità e Stakeholder Comunicazione: Valutare in modo indipendente le posizioni di qualità per guidare i piani di azione di conformità. Condurre presentazioni di rischio di alto livello e discussioni strategiche con gli stakeholder aziendali, i rappresentanti di farmaci, gli affari legali e regolamentari.
• Lead and support Health Authority Inspections: preparazione del piombo, formazione del personale, e la gestione di importanti ispezioni normative (ad esempio, FDA, EMA), presentando con fiducia strategie e conclusioni di qualità.
• Guida PDQ Leadership & Mentorship: Contribuisci alla direzione strategica a lungo termine del PDQ, ai progetti di conformità dei lead e funge da mentore dedicato per sviluppare i lead di qualità all'interno del team. Chi sei Sei un proattivo, pensatore strategico che prospera in un ambiente collaborativo, matrice ed è appassionato di guidare i risultati di qualità. Possiedi una forte alfabetizzazione digitale e dei dati, permettendoti di trasformare i dati in insight, e sei a tuo agio a porre domande impegnative per supportare i risultati PDQ. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Esperienza di qualità estesa: uno sfondo forte nel processo di sviluppo del farmaco e studi clinici, con una solida esperienza interfunzionale in GCP, GVP/PV, o dispositivi medici/SaMD.
• Leadership di ispezione: una comprovata traccia di importanti ispezioni dell'Autorità sanitaria (come FDA o EMA), compresa la disponibilità di ispezione e la gestione post-ispezione.
• pensiero analitico e critico: competenze avanzate di problem solving con una mentalità proattiva e basata sul rischio e la capacità di utilizzare strumenti di visualizzazione dati e dati per guidare le decisioni.
• Influencing & Communication Skills: competenze di gestione delle relazioni eccezionali con una comprovata capacità di negoziare soluzioni efficaci e influenzare gli stakeholder senior.
• Leadership Inclusive: esperienza nella gestione di progetti in team globali e multiculturali, con la passione per allenare e sostenere gli altri.
• Qualifiche accademiche: diploma di laurea o equivalente in un campo scientifico o di qualità (è preferito un grado avanzato). Location
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), we strive for confidence in the integrity of our data and processes, agility, and unrivalled transparency with health authorities, patients, and society. As a Senior Quality Lead within our Quality Assurance Process and Affiliate team, you will bring diverse thinking and technical expertise across various quality disciplines to support the Roche/Genentech organisation. In this pivotal role, you will design and deliver risk-based Quality Assurance strategies, audits, and conclusions for post-approval products, affiliates, and processes. You will act as a trusted partner to senior business stakeholders, guiding cross-functional collaboration to ensure global quality standards are met while navigating complex regulatory landscapes.
• Design and Implement QA Strategies: Partner with business stakeholders to independently define the QA approach, assessing risks and adapting strategies using the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework across GCP, GVP, and Medical Device areas.
• Define and Lead Audits: Determine required audits, leverage data analytics to develop methodologies, and independently manage the end-to-end audit process from preparation to reporting.
• Manage Quality Issues: Independently manage quality issues, tracking systematic findings for process improvement and escalating significant risks to PDQ management.
• Quality Conclusion and Stakeholder Communication: Independently evaluate quality positions to drive compliance action plans. Lead high-level risk presentations and strategic discussions with business stakeholders, Pharma representatives, Legal, and Regulatory Affairs.
• Lead and support Health Authority Inspections: Lead preparation, staff training, and the management of major regulatory inspections (e.g., FDA, EMA), confidently presenting quality strategies and conclusions.
• Drive PDQ Leadership & Mentorship: Contribute to the long-term strategic direction of PDQ, lead compliance projects, and act as a dedicated mentor to develop Quality Leads within the team. Who You Are You are a proactive, strategic thinker who thrives in a collaborative, matrixed environment and is passionate about driving Quality outcomes. You possess strong digital and data literacy, allowing you to turn data into insights, and you are comfortable asking challenging questions to support PDQ outcomes. To be successful in this role, you bring:
• Extensive Quality Expertise: A strong background in the drug development process and clinical trials, with robust cross-functional experience in GCP, GVP/PV, or Medical Devices/SaMD.
• Inspection Leadership: A proven track record of leading major Health Authority inspections (such as FDA or EMA), including inspection readiness and post-inspection management.
• Analytical & Critical Thinking: Advanced problem-solving skills with a proactive, risk-based mindset and the ability to utilise data and data visualisation tools to drive decisions.
• Influencing & Communication Skills: Exceptional relationship management skills with a proven ability to negotiate effective solutions and influence senior stakeholders.
• Inclusive Leadership: Experience managing projects in global, multicultural teams, with a passion for coaching and mentoring others.
• Academic Qualifications: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a scientific or quality-related field (an advanced degree is preferred). Location

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Die Chance Bei Roche bringen wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Bei Pharma Development Quality (PDQ) streben wir nach Vertrauen in die Integrität unserer Daten und Prozesse, Agilität und konkurrenzlose Transparenz gegenüber Gesundheitsbehörden, Patienten und der Gesellschaft. Als Senior Quality Lead in unserem Qualitätssicherungsprozess und Affiliate-Team bringen Sie vielfältiges Denken und technisches Know-how in verschiedenen Qualitätsdisziplinen mit, um die Roche / Genentech-Organisation zu unterstützen. In dieser zentralen Rolle entwerfen und liefern Sie risikobasierte Qualitätssicherungsstrategien, Audits und Schlussfolgerungen für Produkte, verbundene Unternehmen und Prozesse nach der Zulassung. Sie werden als vertrauenswürdiger Partner für Senior Business Stakeholder fungieren und die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit leiten, um sicherzustellen, dass globale Qualitätsstandards eingehalten werden, während Sie durch komplexe Regulierungslandschaften navigieren.
• Gestaltung und Umsetzung von QA-Strategien: Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsbeteiligten, um den QA-Ansatz unabhängig zu definieren, Risiken zu bewerten und Strategien unter Verwendung des CtQ-Rahmens (Critical to Quality) in den Bereichen GCP, GVP und Medical Device anzupassen.
• Definieren und Leiten von Audits: Bestimmen Sie erforderliche Audits, nutzen Sie Datenanalysen zur Entwicklung von Methoden und verwalten Sie den End-to-End-Auditprozess von der Vorbereitung bis zum Reporting unabhängig.
• Qualitätsprobleme verwalten: Verwalten Sie Qualitätsprobleme unabhängig, verfolgen Sie systematische Ergebnisse zur Prozessverbesserung und eskalieren Sie erhebliche Risiken für das PDQ-Management.
• Qualitätsschlussfolgerung und Stakeholder-Kommunikation: Unabhängige Bewertung von Qualitätspositionen, um Compliance-Aktionspläne voranzutreiben. Führen Sie hochkarätige Risikopräsentationen und strategische Gespräche mit Geschäftsinteressenten, Pharmavertretern, Rechts- und Regulierungsangelegenheiten.
• Führen und Unterstützen von Inspektionen der Gesundheitsbehörden: Lead-Vorbereitung, Schulung des Personals und Management von wichtigen behördlichen Inspektionen (z. B. FDA, EMA), wobei Qualitätsstrategien und Schlussfolgerungen selbstbewusst präsentiert werden.
• PDQ Leadership & Mentorship fördern: Tragen Sie zur langfristigen strategischen Ausrichtung von PDQ bei, leiten Sie Compliance-Projekte und agieren Sie als engagierter Mentor, um Qualitätsleiter im Team zu entwickeln. Sie verfügen über eine starke Digital- und Datenkompetenz, mit der Sie Daten in Erkenntnisse umwandeln können, und Sie stellen gerne herausfordernde Fragen, um die PDQ-Ergebnisse zu unterstützen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie: Umfangreiche Qualitätsexpertise: Ein starker Hintergrund im Arzneimittelentwicklungsprozess und in klinischen Studien mit robuster funktionsübergreifender Erfahrung in GCP, GVP/PV oder Medical Devices/SaMD.
• Inspektionsleitung: Eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz führender großer Inspektionen der Gesundheitsbehörde (wie FDA oder EMA), einschließlich Inspektionsbereitschaft und Post-Inspektionsmanagement. Analytisches und kritisches Denken: Fortgeschrittene Problemlösungskompetenzen mit einer proaktiven, risikobasierten Denkweise und der Fähigkeit, Daten und Datenvisualisierungswerkzeuge zu nutzen, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
• Einflussnahme und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Außergewöhnliche Fähigkeiten im Beziehungsmanagement mit der nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, effektive Lösungen auszuhandeln und leitende Stakeholder zu beeinflussen.
• Inklusive Führung: Erfahrung im Management von Projekten in globalen, multikulturellen Teams mit einer Leidenschaft für das Coaching und Mentoring anderer.
• Akademische Qualifikationen: Ein Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertig in einem wissenschaftlichen oder qualitätsbezogenen Bereich (ein fortgeschrittener Abschluss wird bevorzugt). Standort

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opportunité Chez Roche, nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Dans Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), nous nous efforçons de faire confiance à l'intégrité de nos données et de nos processus, à l'agilité et à une transparence inégalée avec les autorités sanitaires, les patients et la société. En tant que responsable principal de la qualité au sein de notre équipe de processus d'assurance de la qualité et d'affiliation, vous apporterez une diversité de réflexion et d'expertise technique dans différentes disciplines de qualité pour soutenir l'organisation Roche/Genentech. Dans ce rôle pivot, vous concevrez et fournirez des stratégies, des vérifications et des conclusions d'assurance de la qualité fondées sur les risques pour les produits, les filiales et les processus post-approbation. Vous agirez en tant que partenaire de confiance auprès des principaux intervenants commerciaux, en guidant la collaboration interfonctionnelle pour assurer le respect des normes de qualité mondiales tout en naviguant dans des paysages réglementaires complexes.
• Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies d'AQ : établir des partenariats avec les intervenants commerciaux pour définir de façon indépendante l'AQ, évaluer les risques et adapter les stratégies à l'aide du cadre essentiel à la qualité (CtQ) dans l'ensemble des secteurs du GCP, du GVP et des instruments médicaux.
• Définir et diriger les audits : Déterminer les audits requis, tirer parti de l'analyse des données pour élaborer des méthodologies et gérer de manière indépendante le processus d'audit de bout en bout, de la préparation à l'établissement de rapports.
• Gérer les problèmes de qualité : gérer les problèmes de qualité de façon indépendante, suivre les constatations systématiques pour améliorer les processus et augmenter les risques importants pour la gestion des PDQ.
• Conclusion sur la qualité et communication avec les parties prenantes: évaluer de manière indépendante les positions de qualité afin d'orienter les plans d'action en matière de conformité. Diriger des présentations de risques de haut niveau et des discussions stratégiques avec les intervenants commerciaux, les représentants des pharmaciens, les Affaires juridiques et réglementaires.
• Diriger et appuyer les inspections des autorités sanitaires : préparation des responsables, formation du personnel et gestion des principales inspections réglementaires (par exemple, FDA, EMA), présentation confiante de stratégies et de conclusions de qualité.
• Diriger le leadership et le mentorat du PDQ : contribuer à l'orientation stratégique à long terme du PDQ, diriger des projets de conformité et agir comme un mentor dévoué pour développer des responsables de qualité au sein de l'équipe. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un penseur proactif et stratégique qui prospère dans un environnement collaboratif et matriciel et qui est passionné par les résultats de qualité. Vous possédez une solide connaissance du numérique et des données, vous permettant de transformer les données en idées, et vous êtes à l'aise de poser des questions difficiles pour soutenir les résultats de la PDQ. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• Expertise en qualité étendue : une solide expérience dans le processus de développement des médicaments et les essais cliniques, avec une solide expérience interfonctionnelle en GCP, GVP/PV ou dispositifs médicaux/saMD.
• Leadership en matière d'inspection : une expérience éprouvée des principales inspections des autorités sanitaires (comme la FDA ou l'EMA), y compris la préparation aux inspections et la gestion après inspection.
• Analyse et réflexion critique: compétences avancées en résolution de problèmes avec un état d'esprit proactif et basé sur le risque et la capacité d'utiliser des outils de visualisation de données et de données pour conduire les décisions.
• Influencer et communiquer : compétences exceptionnelles en gestion des relations avec une capacité éprouvée de négocier des solutions efficaces et d'influencer les acteurs seniors.
• Leadership inclusif: Expérience de la gestion de projets dans des équipes mondiales et multiculturelles, avec une passion pour le coaching et le mentorat.
• Qualifications académiques: un baccalauréat ou l'équivalent dans un domaine scientifique ou lié à la qualité (un diplôme avancé est préféré). Lieu

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Shape the Future of Secure Engineering with Roche

Are you ready to tackle bold challenges and make a real impact? At Roche, we’re not just building IT infrastructure — we’re engineering secure, scalable, and highly innovative software solutions that protect and empower digital health systems globally. We're looking for passionate and driven individuals to join our Certman PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) team as a Software Engineer and help us lead the way in cutting-edge, trust-based technology.

Who We Are: A Better Tomorrow Starts Today

At Roche, everything we do is powered by our passion to transform patients’ lives. We embrace science, ethics, and innovation. We're bold in our decisions and actions because we know a brighter future depends on it. Every day, we show up to build that future — for a better world, for humankind.

Diversity and inclusion aren’t just buzzwords here; they’re essential to who we are. We believe that unique perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we are committed to building teams that reflect the extraordinary range of human potential.

Your Role: Redefine Excellence in Secure Software Engineering

As a Software Engineer within Roche's Certman PKI team, you will become a driving force behind the design, development, and evolution of our mission-critical enterprise trust and identity software. Working closely with latest technology trends, you will build the software layer that manages digital certificate lifecycles, cryptographic keys, and secure authentication. Every feature you code, every system you architect, and every application you optimize will contribute directly to safeguarding the technology that enhances people’s lives worldwide.

A Key Element of Your Contribution: As an experience C# engineer, you will design and deliver high-performance, resilient software services that power Roche's global operations. This role demands deep expertise across the full .NET stack — from advanced memory management and asynchronous programming patterns to designing secure, scalable backend systems and orchestrating containerized microservices across AWS and Kubernetes at enterprise scale. You'll apply asynchronous programming practices and design excellence to build high-throughput, low-latency APIs that meet the reliability and compliance requirements of medical devices serving patients worldwide. Your commitment to software engineering excellence, clean code principles, and robust design patterns will be fundamental to delivering seamless and secure experiences that uphold Roche's standards of quality and trust.

What You’ll Do:

As a Software Engineer in the Certman PKI team, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and evolving our certificate issuance API using ASP.NET Core (C#). You will own the end-to-end quality of the service.

You will design and implement well-versioned REST APIs, automate cryptographic and certificate lifecycle workflows, and diagnose and resolve complex performance, concurrency, or architectural bottlenecks using profiling and observability tooling.

You will deploy and operate our services natively on AWS and AliCloud, working hands-on with EKS/Kubernetes, KMS for key operations, EC2, IAM, and other core AWS building blocks. You will own and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines on GitLab and GitHub Actions — building reproducible, secure, and fully automated build, test, scan, and deploy workflows for containerized .NET services.

This role involves writing clean, testa

Questo ruolo richiede competenze profonde in tutto lo stack .NET completo — dalla gestione avanzata della memoria e modelli di programmazione asincrono per la progettazione di sistemi backend sicuri e scalabili e l'orchestrazione di microservizi containerizzati in AWS e Kubernetes a scala aziendale. Si applicano pratiche di programmazione asincrono e l'eccellenza del design per la costruzione di API ad alta produttività, a bassa latenza che soddisfano i requisiti di affidabilità e conformità dei dispositivi medici che servono pazienti in tutto il mondo. Il vostro impegno per l'eccellenza dell'ingegneria software, i principi del codice pulito e i modelli di design robusti saranno fondamentali per offrire esperienze senza soluzione di continuità e sicure che sostengono gli standard di qualità e fiducia di Roche. Cosa farai: Come Ingegnere di software nel team di Certman PKI, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella progettazione, costruzione e evoluzione della nostra API di emissione di certificati utilizzando ASP.NET Core (C#). Avrete la qualità end-to-end del servizio. Potrai progettare e implementare le API REST ben convertite, automatizzare i flussi di lavoro crittografico e certificato del ciclo di vita, e diagnosticare e risolvere le prestazioni complesse, la convalutazione, o strozzature architettoniche utilizzando la profilazione e l'osservabilità tooling. Potrai implementare e gestire i nostri servizi in modo nativo su AWS e AliCloud, lavorando hands-on con EKS/Kubernetes, KMS per le operazioni chiave, EC2, IAM e altri blocchi di costruzione AWS core. Azioni GitLab e GitHub - costruzione riproducibile, sicura e completamente automatizzata costruire, testare, eseguire la scansione e distribuire flussi di lavoro per i servizi containerizzati .NET. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Position
We are building a global Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team to support critical commercial and internal platforms and applications. As an SRE, you will help design, build, and scale reliable distributed systems that power healthcare innovation worldwide.
This role is focused on reliability, scalability, automation and operational excellence. You will influence system design, define reliability standards and reduce operational toil through engineering solutions.
This role includes participation in a structured on-call rotation.

Who We Are
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

Step into the Future of IT with Roche!
As a seasoned Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at Roche, you will leverage your deep software engineering expertise to propel our products to new heights of robustness, scalability and reliability. This isn't just a role—it's an invitation to shape the backbone of technological innovations forward.

Your Mission
Design and maintain cutting-edge tools, scripts and frameworks that automate repetitive tasks, streamline software deployment and manage expansive systems with unparalleled efficiency. Partner closely with forward-thinking development teams to architect and implement high-performance solutions that elevate system efficiency, optimize resource utilization and enhance deployment processes for superior uptime and user satisfaction.

Your Impact
Lead the charge in incident management and response. Detect system anomalies, troubleshoot swiftly and conduct thorough root cause analyses to prevent recurring issues.
Champion continuous improvement by refining monitoring and alerting mechanisms, conducting insightful post-incident reviews and embedding best practices in software lifecycle management. Your strategic foresight and meticulous planning will ensure our systems are not only reliable but also superlatively performant.
By joining our elite team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering seamless experiences to our end-users, exceeding business and customer demands, and solidifying Roche's reputation as a leader in IT innovation.

Your Core Responsibilities
Reliability Engineering & Architecture

• Define and implement SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with product and engineering teams

• Conduct reliability reviews for new and existing services

• Design scalable, fault-tolerant architectures in AWS and Azure environments

• Lead capacity planning, performance and cost optimization initiatives

• Improve system resilience through automation and self-healing patterns

• Drive organizational observability maturity (metrics, logs, traces, alert quality)

Incident Management & Continuous Improvement

• Perform complex root cause analysis and drive rapid mitigation

• Participate in blameless postmortems and follow-through

• Improve MTTR, reduce incident frequency, and elevate production standards

• Collaborate seamlessly with engineering teams to enable timely and effective

Votre mission Concevoir et entretenir des outils, des scripts et des cadres de pointe qui automatisent les tâches répétitives, rationalisent le déploiement des logiciels et gèrent des systèmes étendus avec une efficacité inégalée. Collaborez étroitement avec des équipes de développement avant-gardistes pour concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions de haute performance qui améliorent l'efficacité du système, optimisent l'utilisation des ressources et améliorent les processus de déploiement pour un temps de pointe supérieur et la satisfaction des utilisateurs. Votre impact Diriger l'accusation dans la gestion des incidents et l'intervention. Détecter les anomalies du système, dépanner rapidement et effectuer des analyses profondes des causes profondes afin de prévenir les problèmes récurrents. Promouvoir l'amélioration continue en perfectionnant les mécanismes de surveillance et d'alerte, en effectuant des examens approfondis après les incidents et en intégrant les meilleures pratiques dans la gestion du cycle de vie des logiciels. Votre prospective stratégique et votre planification méticuleuse garantiront que nos systèmes sont non seulement fiables, mais également superlativement performants. En vous joignant à notre équipe d'élite, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la prestation d'expériences sans faille à nos utilisateurs finaux, en dépassant les exigences des entreprises et des clients, et en solidifiant la réputation de Roche en tant que leader de l'innovation informatique. Vos responsabilités fondamentales Ingénierie et architecture de fiabilité
• Définir et mettre en œuvre des budgets d'erreurs, d'IDS et d'OLS avec des équipes de produits et d'ingénierie
• Effectuer des examens de fiabilité pour les services nouveaux et existants
• Concevoir des architectures évolutives et tolérantes aux défauts dans les environnements AWS et Azure
• Initiatives de planification des capacités, de performance et d'optimisation des coûts
• Améliorer la résilience du système par l'automatisation et l'auto-guérison
• Conduire la maturité de l'observation organisationnelle (métrique, logs, traces, qualité d'alerte) Gestion des incidents et amélioration continue
• Effectuer une analyse complexe des causes profondes et provoquer une atténuation rapide
• Participer aux postmortems irréprochables et suivre
• Améliorer le MTTR, réduire la fréquence des incidents et élever les normes de production
• Collaborer en toute transparence avec les équipes d'ingénieurs pour permettre une utilisation rapide et efficace

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Expert Safety Assessments (m/w/d) Explosion Protection | Experte Sicherheitsbetrachtungen (m/w/d) Explosionsschutz / Ex-Schutz

Dein neues Team
Im Standort Management Mannheim/Penzberg, sind wir gut 1'300 Spezialisten für verschiedenste Infrastruktur- und Professional-Services, die diese für die Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg zur Verfügung stellen. In einem dynamischen Umfeld fördern wir die nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Geschäftsbereiche und Funktionen hinweg, bieten innovative Lösungen und verbessern die Arbeitsumgebung der Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg.

In dieser Funktion bist du Teil der Roche Diagnostics GmbH "Risk Management & SHE Compliance", explizit des Teams "Implementation Management". In unserem Team übernehmen wir die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Überführung von rechtlichen Anforderungen, globalen SHE-Standards sowie Prozessen und Systemen in praktische und wirtschaftliche Lösungen an unseren Standorten. Wir handeln stets mit dem Bewusstsein für unsere große Verantwortung gegenüber der Umwelt und der Gesellschaft und stellen sicher, dass Rahmenbedingungen nachhaltig implementiert und gelebt werden. Wir sind verantwortlich für zwei Standorte, aber dennoch ein Team: Trotz der räumlichen Distanz verbindet uns ein engmaschiger, standortübergreifender Austausch und ein starker Teamgeist.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
n der Rolle übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für die technische Anlagen- und Verfahrenssicherheit sowie die Arbeitssicherheit bei Roche Diagnostics durch die Abstimmung und Implementierung von Vorgaben mit dem Schwerpunkt systematische Sicherheitsbetrachtungen und Explosionsschutz. Dazu übernimmst du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Sicherheitsbetrachtungen: Du koordinierst und implementierst technische Sicherheitsanforderungen und führst systematische Sicherheitsbetrachtungen (z. B. PAAG/HAZOP) sowie Bewertungen im Rahmen des Explosionsschutzes durch.

• Beratung & Netzwerken: Du berätst die Business Units proaktiv bei komplexen sicherheitstechnischen Fragestellungen und arbeitest eng mit Global SHE sowie den lokalen Engineering- und Produktionsteams zusammen.

• Konzepterstellung: Du erstellst und überprüfst Sicherheits- sowie Explosionsschutzkonzepte und stellst deren Konformität zu internationalen Standards und internen Richtlinien sicher.

• Wirtschaftlichkeit: Du achtest bei der Umsetzung von Sicherheitsmaßnahmen auf globale Abstimmung und hohe Wirtschaftlichkeit, ohne Kompromisse bei der Compliance einzugehen.

• Bestellte Funktion : Du nimmst fachspezifische Aufgaben als zur Prüfung befähigte Person im Explosionsschutz wahr und trägst so zur Rechtssicherheit der Verantwortlichen bei.

• Prozessbegleitung: Du begleitest technische Lösungen aktiv von der Planungsphase bis zur Übergabe in die Operative und stellst eine nahtlose Integration in den Betrieb sicher.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du hast ein Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Sicherheitstechnik, Elektrotechnik, Gesundheitsmanagement oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Du verfügst über mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung (je nach Abschluss ca. 5-8 Jahre), idealerweise innerhalb der chemischen Industrie oder einem vergleichbar regulierten Umfeld.

• Du bringst tiefgreifende Kenntnisse der relevanten Vorschriften (z.B. ATEX, GefStoffV, BetrSichV, ProdSV) sowie der zugehörigen technischen Regelwerke mit.

• Du hast fundierte Erfahrung im Explosionssc

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Valutazione della sicurezza degli esperti (m/f/d) Protezione contro le esplosioni | Considerazioni di sicurezza degli esperti (m/f/d) Protezione contro le esplosioni / Ex protection La tua nuova squadra Nella posizione Management Mannheim/Penzberg, siamo un buon 1.300 specialisti per una vasta gamma di infrastrutture e servizi professionali, che forniscono per le sedi di Mannheim e Penzberg. In un ambiente dinamico, promuoviamo una collaborazione senza soluzione di continuità tra business unit e funzioni, offriamo soluzioni innovative e migliorare l'ambiente di lavoro dei dipendenti nei siti di Mannheim e Penzberg. In questo ruolo, fai parte della Roche Diagnostics GmbH "Risk Management & SHE Compliance", esplicitamente del team "Implementazione Management". Nel nostro team, ci assumiamo la responsabilità di tradurre con successo i requisiti legali, gli standard e i processi e i sistemi SHE globali in soluzioni pratiche ed economiche nelle nostre sedi. Agiamo sempre con la consapevolezza della nostra grande responsabilità verso l'ambiente e la società e assicuriamo che le condizioni quadro siano attuate e vissute in modo sostenibile. Siamo responsabili di due sedi, ma ancora una squadra: nonostante la distanza spaziale, siamo collegati da uno scambio ravvicinato, trasloco e da un forte spirito di squadra. Responsabilità | Questo è ciò che vi aspetta n prende il controllo della bobina Sarete responsabili per la sicurezza degli impianti e dei processi tecnici, nonché per la sicurezza sul lavoro presso Roche Diagnostics coordinando e implementando le specifiche con un focus su considerazioni di sicurezza sistematiche e protezione contro le esplosioni. Con questo scopo, si prenderanno le seguenti attività eccitanti:
• Considerazioni di sicurezza: coordina e implementa i requisiti di sicurezza tecnica e effettua considerazioni di sicurezza sistematiche (ad esempio PAAG/HAZOP) e valutazioni di protezione contro le esplosioni.
• Consulenza e networking: consigliate proattivamente le business unit su complessi problemi di sicurezza e lavorate a stretto contatto con Global SHE e con i team locali di ingegneria e produzione.
• Creazione di concetti: creare e controllare i concetti di sicurezza e protezione contro le esplosioni e garantire la loro conformità con gli standard internazionali e le linee guida interne.
• Efficienza: quando si implementano misure di sicurezza, si presta attenzione al coordinamento globale e ad alta efficienza senza compromettere la conformità.
• Funzione ordinata: Lei svolge compiti specialistici come persona qualificata per la prova nella protezione contro le esplosioni e contribuisce così alla certezza giuridica dei responsabili.
• Supporto di processo: accompagni attivamente soluzioni tecniche dalla fase di progettazione al trasferimento a livello operativo e garantisci un'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità nell'azienda. Qualificazioni | Questo è ciò che porti con te
• Hai completato con successo una laurea (bachelor o master) in ingegneria, ingegneria della sicurezza, ingegneria elettrica, gestione della salute o una qualifica paragonabile.
• Hai diversi anni di esperienza professionale rilevante (circa 5-8 anni a seconda della tua laurea), idealmente nell'industria chimica o in un ambiente regolamentato paragonabile.
• Avrete una conoscenza approfondita delle relative normative (ad esempio ATEX, GefStoffV, BetrSichV, ProdSV) e delle relative normative tecniche.
• Hai una vasta esperienza in Explosionssc

jobs.title: Pasante de Corporate Affairs & Communications

titleByLocale.it: Pasante de Affari Aziendali e Comunicazione

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Como Pasante de Corporate Affairs & Communications en Roche Chile, tienes la oportunidad única de adquirir experiencia real dentro de una industria altamente regulada. Al integrarte a nuestra área, serás un actor clave para dar vida a nuestra cultura, conectando nuestro propósito y valores institucionales con los medios de comunicación, líderes de la salud y nuestra propia comunidad interna.

La Oportunidad:

• Apoyas en tácticas de relaciones públicas mediante el monitoreo diario de prensa, la actualización de bases de datos de periodistas y la redacción de comunicados para hitos corporativos.

• Colaboras en planes de posicionamiento para promover a líderes internos de Roche como referentes técnicos del debate de salud pública.

• Ejecutas estrategias de comunicación interna usando narrativas transmedia para traducir información en mensajes movilizadores que fortalezcan nuestra cultura corporativa.

• Planificas y redactas contenido para los canales digitales de Roche Chile, adaptando mensajes complejos a formatos multiplataforma para interactuar de forma fluida con la comunidad digital.

• Asistes en el análisis de entorno y en la preparación de documentos de posición dirigidos a autoridades ministeriales y legislativas, apoyando nuestro rol en la modernización del sistema de salud chileno.

• Aseguras el soporte operativo controlando los flujos de trabajo de comunicación y garantizando el cumplimiento riguroso de los estándares normativos de la industria farmacéutica.

Quién eres:

• Eres estudiante activo de 3ero o 4to año de la carrera de Periodismo .

• Cuentas con alta capacidad de autogestión para dedicar al menos 4 horas diarias, las cuales puedes coordinar de manera flexible según tus compromisos universitarios.

• Posees sólidas habilidades de redacción periodística, ortografía, capacidad de entrevista y un excelente criterio editorial.

• Manejas a nivel intermedio herramientas de edición digital, multimedia y creación de imágenes.

• Tienes un nivel de inglés intermedio.

*Los beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta vacante.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Product Engineering Expert (Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz is one of the world's leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for hospitals, laboratories, and physician offices. With over 2,200 employees, Rotkreuz is one of Roche Diagnostics' main sites, making it the largest manufacturer of fully automated in vitro diagnostic systems in Switzerland with more than 2,700 passionate colleagues from over 65 nationalities. At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare, working together as one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups where success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity. We believe in the power of diversity and inclusion, striving to identify and create opportunities that enable all people to bring their unique selves to Roche, while offering extensive development and training opportunities, flexible working options, 18 weeks of maternity leave, 10 weeks of gender independent partnership leave, and multiple on-site services such as child-care facilities, medical services, restaurants, cafeterias, and various employee events.
In this highly specialized permanent, full-time role as Senior Specialist – Tech Transfer & Manufacturing Science (SBX Sequencing) within the DODINL Production Laboratory & QC line organisation led by Eric Wanko, you will be the key technical anchor for the critical technology transfer of advanced genetic sequencing workflows. As part of Roche’s global Dual-Site Strategy, we are expanding our manufacturing footprint to establish parallel production capabilities, where this transfer to Rotkreuz, Switzerland, is designed to complement and work in tandem with our existing operations in Santa Clara, USA, ensuring long-term global supply security and scaling our production capacity across both key sites. In this position, you will act as the ultimate Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical execution, optimization, and scaling of our proprietary sequencing consumable portfolios in Europe, leveraging your deep, pre-existing technical knowledge of our US-developed manufacturing lines to ensure seamless cross-site standardization as a central part of a genius team and shaping role.

The Opportunity

• Technology Transfer & Site Alignment: Drive the technical transfer of RUO (Research Use Only) and regulated genetic sequencing workflows (specifically SBX sequencing chemistry) from Roche Santa Clara (US) to the Rotkreuz site, ensuring absolute process alignment between both operating sites.

• Subject Matter Expert (SME): Serve as the primary technical authority for drafting, reviewing, and auditing site-specific operating procedures (SOPs), batch record templates, and work instructions for critical consumable components.

• Process Optimization & Scaling: Manage and execute complex experiments throughout the product lifecycle, from initial feasibility and stability testing through to official launch and routine manufacturing transfer.

• Advanced Quality Control: Oversee high-priority investigations into complex process failures or manufacturing deviations, applying advanced statistical techniques and data analysis to implement robust Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).

• Cross-Functional Training: Translate development workflows into standardized work procedures, providing deep technical guidance and training local operators on complex reagent handling, raw material formulation, automated dispensing, and data analyzation.

• End-to-End Quality Inspectio

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche Diagnostics International AG di Rotkreuz è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di soluzioni di sistema diagnostico per ospedali, laboratori e uffici medici. Con oltre 2.200 dipendenti, Rotkreuz è uno dei principali siti di Roche Diagnostics, che lo rende il più grande produttore di sistemi diagnostici in vitro completamente automatizzati in Svizzera con oltre 2.700 colleghi appassionati di oltre 65 nazionalità. A Roche, più di 100.000 persone in 100 paesi stanno spingendo indietro le frontiere della sanità, lavorando insieme come uno dei principali gruppi sanitari focalizzati sulla ricerca in cui il successo è costruito su innovazione, curiosità e diversità. Crediamo nel potere della diversità e dell'inclusione, cercando di identificare e creare opportunità che consentano a tutte le persone di portare i loro se stessi unici a Roche, offrendo ampie opportunità di sviluppo e formazione, opzioni di lavoro flessibili, 18 settimane di congedo di maternità, 10 settimane di congedo di partenariato indipendente di genere, e più servizi on-site come strutture per l'infanzia, servizi medici, ristoranti, caffetterie e vari eventi dei dipendenti. In questo ruolo permanente e a tempo pieno altamente specializzato come Senior Specialist – Tech Transfer & Manufacturing Science (SBX Sequencing) all'interno dell'organizzazione della linea DODINL Production Laboratory & QC guidata da Eric Wanko, sarete l'ancora tecnica chiave per il trasferimento di tecnologia critica dei flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento genetico avanzati. Nell’ambito della strategia globale Dual-Site di Roche, stiamo espandendo la nostra impronta produttiva per stabilire capacità di produzione parallele, dove questo trasferimento a Rotkreuz, in Svizzera, è stato progettato per integrare e lavorare in sintonia con le nostre operazioni esistenti a Santa Clara, negli Stati Uniti, garantendo la sicurezza globale a lungo termine e scalando la nostra capacità produttiva in entrambi i siti chiave. In questa posizione, si agirà come ultimo Oggetto Matter Expert (SME) per l'esecuzione tecnica, l'ottimizzazione e lo scaling dei nostri portafogli di materiali di sequenziamento proprietari in Europa, sfruttando la vostra profonda e preesistente conoscenza tecnica delle nostre linee di produzione sviluppate dagli Stati Uniti per garantire la standardizzazione trasversale senza soluzione di continuità come parte centrale di un team di genio e ruolo di modellazione. L'opportunità
• Trasferimento Tecnologico & Site Alignment: Guidare il trasferimento tecnico di RUO (solo ricerca) e i flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento genetico regolamentati (specialmente la chimica di sequenziamento SBX) da Roche Santa Clara (US) al sito Rotkreuz, garantendo l'allineamento assoluto del processo tra entrambi i siti operativi.
• Oggetto Matter Expert (SME): Serve come autorità tecnica primaria per la redazione, la revisione e l'audit delle procedure operative specifiche del sito (SOP), modelli di record batch e istruzioni di lavoro per i componenti di consumo critici.
• Ottimizzazione del processo & Scaling: Gestire ed eseguire esperimenti complessi in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla prima fattibilità e test di stabilità fino al lancio ufficiale e trasferimento di produzione di routine.
• Controllo avanzato della qualità: supervisionare le indagini ad alta priorità in caso di guasti complessi di processo o deviazioni di produzione, applicare tecniche statistiche avanzate e analisi dei dati per implementare robuste Azioni Correttive e Preventive (CAPA).
• Cross-Functional Training: Tradurre i flussi di lavoro di sviluppo in procedure di lavoro standardizzate, fornendo una profonda guida tecnica e formazione degli operatori locali sulla gestione complessa dei reagenti, la formulazione delle materie prime, l'erogazione automatica e l'analisi dei dati.
• Ispezione di qualità end-to-end

Nous croyons au pouvoir de la diversité et de l'inclusion, nous nous efforçons d'identifier et de créer des possibilités qui permettent à tous de s'amener à Roche, tout en offrant des possibilités de perfectionnement et de formation étendues, des possibilités de travail flexibles, 18 semaines de congé de maternité, 10 semaines de congé de partenariat indépendant pour les femmes et de nombreux services sur place tels que les garderies, les services médicaux, les restaurants, les cafétérias et divers événements destinés aux employés. Dans ce rôle permanent hautement spécialisé et à temps plein en tant que spécialiste principal – Tech Transfer & Manufacturing Science (SBX Sequencing) au sein de l'organisation de la ligne DODINL Production Laboratory & QC dirigée par Eric Wanko, vous serez l'ancre technique clé pour le transfert de technologie critique des workflows de séquençage génétique avancés. Dans le cadre de la stratégie mondiale du double site de Roches, nous développons notre empreinte manufacturière pour établir des capacités de production parallèles, où ce transfert à Rotkreuz, en Suisse, est conçu pour compléter et travailler en parallèle avec nos activités existantes à Santa Clara, aux États-Unis, assurant la sécurité d'approvisionnement mondiale à long terme et augmentant notre capacité de production sur les deux sites clés. Dans cette position, vous agirez comme l'expert en matière (SME) ultime pour l'exécution technique, l'optimisation et la mise à l'échelle de nos portefeuilles consommables de séquençage propriétaires en Europe, en tirant parti de vos connaissances techniques profondes et préexistantes de nos lignes de fabrication développées aux États-Unis pour assurer une standardisation trans-site transparente comme partie centrale d'une équipe de génie et un rôle de façonnage. L'opportunité
• Transfert de technologie & Alignement du site: Diriger le transfert technique de RUO (Research Use Only) et les processus de séquençage génétique réglementés (séquençage SBX en particulier) de Roche Santa Clara (US) vers le site Rotkreuz, assurant l'alignement absolu des processus entre les deux sites opérationnels.
• Expert en la matière (SME): servir d'autorité technique principale pour la rédaction, l'examen et l'audit des procédures d'exploitation propres au site, des modèles d'enregistrement par lots et des instructions de travail pour les composants consommables critiques.
• Optimisation et calibrage des processus : gérer et exécuter des expériences complexes tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, depuis les essais initiaux de faisabilité et de stabilité jusqu'au lancement officiel et au transfert de fabrication de routine.
• Contrôle avancé de la qualité: Surveiller les enquêtes hautement prioritaires sur les défaillances complexes des procédés ou les écarts de fabrication, en appliquant des techniques statistiques avancées et des analyses de données pour mettre en œuvre des actions correctives et préventives robustes (CAPA).
• Formation interfonctionnelle : Traduire les flux de travail de développement en procédures de travail normalisées, fournir une orientation technique approfondie et former les opérateurs locaux à la manipulation complexe des réactifs, à la formulation des matières premières, à la distribution automatisée et à l'analyse des données.
• Inspectio de qualité de bout en bout

jobs.title: Estagiário de Pricing e Contratos
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A Roche Diagnóstica está em busca de um Estagiário de Pricing e Contratos para se juntar à nossa equipe de Finanças. Esta posição oferece uma excelente oportunidade para desenvolver as suas habilidades financeiras, monitorização comercial e gestão de projetos numa das maiores empresas do setor farmacêutico do mundo!

A Oportunidade:

• Auxilia na preparação e análise de dados de preços e realiza a monitorização ativa de contratos.

• Colabora diretamente com as equipas de vendas para desenvolver estratégias de gestão de faturação e pagamentos.

• Participa ativamente na preparação de relatórios e apresentações para a gestão sénior.

• Ajuda na implementação de medidas de eficiência e monitoriza a sua execução no dia a dia.

• Dá suporte à manutenção de sistemas de preços e ferramentas analíticas vitais para a equipa.

• Lidera o processo de implementação de reajustes com uma vasta carteira de clientes.

• Contribui com impacto em projetos especiais relacionados com preços, custos e reajustes.

Quem você é:

• Formação Acadêmica: em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas. Com previsão de conclusão de curso para 2028 .

• Disponibilidade: Carga horária de 6 horas diárias .

• Disponibilidade para estagiar de 1 a 2 anos , mantendo vínculo ativo com a instituição de ensino durante todo o período.

• Idiomas: Inglês nível intermediário.

• Ferramentas: Excel do nível intermediário ao avançado .

• Possui forte capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes na execução das suas tarefas.

• Demonstra excelentes competências de comunicação verbal e escrita.

• Tem capacidade para trabalhar de forma independente e em equipa, interagindo com stakeholders de diversas áreas e níveis de senioridade.

• Possui conhecimentos de Excel de nível intermediário a avançado e inglês de nível intermediário.

Preferencial:

• Tem conhecimentos prévios em SAP.

*Benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Network Security Engineer (Cloud) - RDT Information Security

titleByLocale.it: Senior Network Security Ingegnere (Cloud) - RDT Information Security
titleByLocale.en: Senior Network Security Engineer (Cloud) - RDT Information Security
titleByLocale.de: Senior Network Security Ingenieur (Cloud) - RDT Information Security
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Network Security Ingénieur (Cloud) - RDT Information Security

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer for Cloud & Edge Defense, you will be the primary architect and engineer responsible for the security of our global digital boundaries and multi-cloud ecosystems. Your mission is to secure our "front door" by designing and implementing high-performance traffic inspection solutions across AWS, GCP, and Azure using Palo Alto VM-Series as the central pillar. This is a technical "implementer" role where you will architect, design, build, and operate cloud network security infrastructure.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Multi-Cloud Infrastructure Design: Design and develop robust cloud network infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and Azure, leveraging Palo Alto instances for deep traffic inspection.

• Advanced Palo Alto Engineering: Execute advanced configuration and management of Palo Alto solutions (VM-Series, Panorama), including complex upgrades and migrations in production.

• Cloud Programming & Automation: Leverage cloud vendor network infrastructures to configure and deploy security solutions via automated pipelines using Terraform and Python.

• Feature Enforcement: Implement and manage App-ID, User-ID, WildFire, Threat Prevention, SSL Decryption, and GlobalProtect to enforce a Zero Trust posture.

• Operational Excellence: Manage security policies as code and improve automation workflows and cross-platform orchestration to eliminate manual friction.

• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Troubleshoot complex issues related to cloud-native routing, load balancing, and firewall inspection within multi-cloud environments.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, or a related technical field.

• You have a proven track record of implementing network security controls in at least two major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

• You possess 3+ years of experience configuring and maintaining Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), including TLS inspection, WildFire, and GlobalProtect.

• You have proven experience using Ansible, Terraform, or Python to manage network security infrastructure at scale.

• You have a deep understanding of core protocols (BGP, OSPF, DNS, TLS/SSL) and how they intersect with security enforcement.

Preferred:

• Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, AWS Certified Security, or Azure Security Engineer Associate certifications.

• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and GitHub to maintain version-controlled security configurations.

• Strong scripting skills in Python or Go to build custom API integrations between security platforms.

• Experience working in highly regulated environments such as Pharmaceuticals, Healthcare, or Finance.

• A self-starter with the ability to manage technical workstreams from concept to production with minimal supervision.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità: Come Senior Cybersecurity Engineer per Cloud & Edge Defense, sarai l'architetto e ingegnere primario responsabile della sicurezza dei nostri confini digitali globali e degli ecosistemi multi-cloud. La vostra missione è quella di garantire la nostra "porta anteriore" progettando e implementando soluzioni di controllo del traffico ad alte prestazioni in AWS, GCP e Azure utilizzando Palo Alto VM-Series come pilastro centrale. Questo è un ruolo tecnico "implementer" in cui si architetto, progettazione, costruzione e operare infrastrutture di sicurezza della rete cloud. Le tue principali responsabilità includono:
• Multi-Cloud Infrastructure Design: Progettazione e sviluppo di robuste infrastrutture di rete cloud in AWS, GCP e Azure, sfruttando istanze Palo Alto per l'ispezione del traffico profondo.
• Advanced Palo Alto Engineering: Eseguire la configurazione avanzata e la gestione delle soluzioni Palo Alto (VM-Series, Panorama), compresi gli aggiornamenti complessi e le migrazioni in produzione.
• Programmazione e automazione cloud: infrastrutture di rete del fornitore cloud Leverage per configurare e distribuire soluzioni di sicurezza tramite pipeline automatizzate utilizzando Terraform e Python.
• Esecuzione caratteristica: Implementa e gestisci App-ID, User-ID, WildFire, Threat Prevention, SSL Decryption e GlobalProtect per far rispettare una posizione di Zero Trust.
• Eccellenza Operativa: Gestisci le politiche di sicurezza come codice e migliora i flussi di lavoro di automazione e l'orchestrazione cross-platform per eliminare l'attrito manuale.
• Competenza Tecnica: Risoluzione dei problemi complessi relativi al routing, al bilanciamento del carico e all'ispezione del firewall in ambienti multi-cloud. Chi sei:
• Hai una laurea in Informatica, ingegneria del software, sicurezza delle informazioni, o un campo tecnico correlato.
• Hai una comprovata traccia di implementare i controlli di sicurezza di rete in almeno due principali fornitori di cloud (AWS, Azure o GCP).
• Possiedi 3+ anni di esperienza nella configurazione e nel mantenimento di Palo Alto Firewall di prossima generazione (NGFW), tra cui ispezione TLS, WildFire e GlobalProtect.
• Hai dimostrato esperienza utilizzando Ansible, Terraform o Python per gestire l'infrastruttura di sicurezza di rete in scala.
• Hai una profonda comprensione dei protocolli di base (BGP, OSPF, DNS, TLS/SSL) e come si intersecano con l'applicazione della sicurezza. Preferito:
• Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, AWS Certified Security o Azure Security Engineer Associate certificazioni.
• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) utilizzando Terraform e GitHub per mantenere le configurazioni di sicurezza controllate dalla versione.
• Forte capacità di scripting in Python o Vai a costruire integrazioni API personalizzate tra piattaforme di sicurezza.
• Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti altamente regolamentati come Pharmaceuticals, Healthcare o Finance.
• Un self-starter con la capacità di gestire i flussi di lavoro tecnici dal concetto alla produzione con una supervisione minima. I vantaggi di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa pubblicazione Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un fut più sano

Votre mission est de sécuriser notre "porte d'entrée" en concevant et en mettant en œuvre des solutions d'inspection de la circulation haute performance à travers AWS, GCP et Azure en utilisant Palo Alto VM-Series comme pilier central. Il s'agit d'un rôle technique « d'exécution » où vous allez concevoir, concevoir, construire et exploiter l'infrastructure de sécurité du réseau cloud. Vos principales responsabilités comprendront :

• Programmation et automatisation en nuage: Tirez parti des infrastructures de réseau de fournisseurs en nuage pour configurer et déployer des solutions de sécurité via des pipelines automatisés utilisant Terraform et Python.

• Excellence opérationnelle : gérer les politiques de sécurité comme code et améliorer les flux de travail d'automatisation et l'orchestration multiplateforme pour éliminer les frictions manuelles.
• Expertise technique : résoudre des problèmes complexes liés au routage cloud-natif, à l'équilibrage des charges et à l'inspection des pare-feu dans des environnements multi-cloud. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, sécurité de l'information ou un domaine technique connexe.
• Vous avez prouvé que vous avez mis en place des contrôles de sécurité réseau dans au moins deux grands fournisseurs de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
• Vous possédez plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans la configuration et la maintenance des pare-feu Palo Alto Next-Generation (NGFW), y compris l'inspection TLS, WildFire et GlobalProtect.
• Vous avez prouvé votre expérience en utilisant Ansible, Terraform ou Python pour gérer l'infrastructure de sécurité du réseau à l'échelle.
• Vous avez une compréhension approfondie des protocoles de base (BGP, OSPF, DNS, TLS/SSL) et de la façon dont ils se croisent avec l'application de la sécurité. Préféré:
• Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, AWS Certified Security ou Azure Security Engineer Associate certifications.
• Compétence en infrastructure comme code (IaC) en utilisant Terraform et GitHub pour maintenir des configurations de sécurité contrôlées par version.
• Des compétences de script solides en Python ou Go pour construire des intégrations d'API personnalisées entre les plateformes de sécurité.
• Expérience de travail dans des environnements hautement réglementés comme les produits pharmaceutiques, les soins de santé ou les finances.
• Un auto-démarrage avec la capacité de gérer les flux de travail techniques du concept à la production avec une supervision minimale. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche .

At Roche Diagnostics , we are driven by our vision: innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare, and changing lives. We are excited to see this vision come to life.
Roche Diagnostic Solutions is responsible for delivering on our Diagnostics Strategy. Within this, the Core Lab business area plays a key role: we strive to expand global access to innovative diagnostics and empower our customers to improve patient outcomes across the healthcare continuum.
By increasing access and setting new standards in core laboratory diagnostics, we provide efficient, end-to-end testing systems and high medical-value solutions, leveraging the full strength of our One Roche approach.

Our Core Lab Automation Lifecycle Leadership Team is dedicated to transforming patients' lives. We achieve this by pushing scientific boundaries, upholding ethics, and expanding access to innovative diagnostics. We focus on delivering robust software solutions that meet business and customer needs, building scalable infrastructures, and fostering collaboration in a complex multicultural environment. Our work directly supports Roche’s mission to create transformative diagnostics solutions and significantly improve patient outcomes.

As the Project Leader for cobas ultra, you will act as a cross-functional leader and a member of both the Automation Lifecycle Leadership Team and the corresponding Life Cycle Team (LCT). Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für die kommenden Generationen benötigt. Schaffung einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Bei Roche Diagnostics sind wir von unserer Vision angetrieben: Innovieren von Diagnostik, Gestaltung der Gesundheitsversorgung und Veränderung des Lebens. Wir freuen uns, dass diese Vision zum Leben erweckt wird. Roche Diagnostic Solutions ist verantwortlich für die Umsetzung unserer Diagnosestrategie. Dabei spielt der Geschäftsbereich Core Lab eine Schlüsselrolle: Wir sind bestrebt, den globalen Zugang zu innovativen Diagnosen zu erweitern und unsere Kunden in die Lage zu versetzen, die Patientenergebnisse im gesamten Gesundheitskontinuum zu verbessern. Durch den verbesserten Zugang zu und die Festlegung neuer Standards in der Kernlabordiagnostik bieten wir effiziente, durchgängige Testsysteme und Lösungen mit hohem medizinischen Wert, die die volle Stärke unseres One Roche Ansatzes nutzen. Wir erreichen dies durch die Verbreitung wissenschaftlicher Grenzen, die Wahrung von Ethik und den Ausbau des Zugangs zu innovativen Diagnosen. Wir konzentrieren uns auf die Bereitstellung robuster Softwarelösungen, die den Bedürfnissen von Unternehmen und Kunden gerecht werden, den Aufbau skalierbarer Infrastrukturen und die Förderung der Zusammenarbeit in einem komplexen multikulturellen Umfeld. Als Projektleiter für cobas ultra agieren Sie als funktionsübergreifender Leiter und Mitglied sowohl des Automation Lifecycle Leadership Teams als auch des entsprechenden Life Cycle Teams (LCT). In dieser Funktion sind Sie voll verantwortlich für den Aufbau und die Umsetzung von groß angelegten, ultraintegrierten Cobas-Lösungen, die von der Initiation bis zur Startentscheidung klare Weichen für die globale Produktentwicklungsstrategie stellen. Sie arbeiten eng mit dem cobas ultra Programm, den entsprechenden Functional Partners, die mit LCTs verbunden sind, und externen Zulieferpartnern zusammen, um umfassende, erfolgreiche Lösungen termingerecht, kosten- und qualitätsgerecht zu liefern.Die Chance
• Strategische Ausrichtung & Lösungsabrechnung: Stellen Sie von der Einführung bis zur Einführung klare Weichen für die globale Produktentwicklungsstrategie, wobei Sie die volle Rechenschaft über Verfügbarkeit, Qualität, Kosten, Erfolg und die Lieferung vordefinierter Meilensteine für die ultra modularen integrierten Lösungen von cobas übernehmen.
• Cross-Functional & Partner Leadership: Führung, Inspiration und Mentoren multidisziplinärer, multisite Teams und Squads, Förderung der Teamverantwortung, hohe Leistungsfähigkeit, eine kundenorientierte Denkweise und kontinuierliches Lernen.
• Stakeholder Alignment & Integration: Übersetzen Sie Kunden- und Geschäftsbedürfnisse in Prioritäten für das Projektteam (PT), brechen Silos über Netzwerke hinweg auf und lösen eskalierte Engpässe und Abhängigkeiten, um eine abgestimmte Bereitstellung zu gewährleisten.
• Operational & Risk Management: Operative Herausforderungen überwinden, indem sie Risiken proaktiv angehen, Probleme abmildern, alternative Handlungswege vorantreiben und Entwicklungs-, Engineering- und Integrationsaktivitäten zwischen internen Teams und externen Partnern ausrichten.
• Financial & Resource Governance: Budgets, Zeitpläne, Risikominderungspläne und Ressourcen, die notwendig sind, um definierte Projektziele innerhalb von Qualitäts- und Zeitrahmen zu erreichen, zu genehmigen und zu überwachen.
• Thought Leadership & Collaboration: Partner mit anderen Projektleitern, Lifecycle Networks und internationalen Wirtschaftsführern (IBL)/Lifec
