Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassés par les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Pour faire progresser la science et faire en sorte que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait Roche. Chez Roche Diagnostics, nous sommes animés par notre vision : innover le diagnostic, façonner les soins de santé et changer les vies. Dans ce cadre, le secteur d'activité Core Lab joue un rôle clé : nous nous efforçons d'élargir l'accès mondial aux diagnostics innovants et de donner à nos clients les moyens d'améliorer les résultats des patients dans tout le continuum de soins. En augmentant l'accès et en établissant de nouveaux standards dans les diagnostics de laboratoire de base, nous fournissons des systèmes de tests efficaces et de bout en bout et des solutions à haute valeur médicale, en tirant parti de la force de notre approche One Roche. Nous nous concentrons sur la fourniture de solutions logicielles robustes qui répondent aux besoins des entreprises et des clients, la construction d'infrastructures évolutives et la promotion de la collaboration dans un environnement multiculturel complexe. Notre travail soutient directement Roche, sa mission de créer des solutions de diagnostics transformatifs et d'améliorer considérablement les résultats des patients. En tant que chef de projet pour cobas ultra, vous agirez comme chef de file interfonctionnel et membre de l'équipe de leadership du cycle de vie d'Automation et de l'équipe de cycle de vie correspondante (LCT). Dans ce rôle, vous serez pleinement responsable de la construction et de la mise en œuvre de solutions ultra intégrées cobas à grande échelle, en établissant une orientation claire pour la stratégie de développement de produits mondial, du début à la décision de lancement. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec le programme cobas ultra, les partenaires fonctionnels correspondants liés aux ECL et les partenaires externes pour fournir des solutions complètes et efficaces dans les délais, sur les coûts et sur la qualité.L'Opportunité
• Orientation stratégique et responsabilisation en matière de solutions : définir une orientation claire pour la stratégie globale de développement de produits, de l'initiation au lancement, en prenant pleinement en compte la disponibilité, la qualité, le coût, la réussite et la livraison des étapes prédéfinies pour les solutions intégrées ultra modulaires cobas.
• Leadership interfonctionnel et partenaire : Guider, inspirer et mentorer des équipes multidisciplinaires, multisites et des équipes, encourager la responsabilisation de l'équipe, la performance élevée, une mentalité axée sur la clientèle et l'apprentissage continu.
• Alignement et intégration des parties prenantes : traduire les besoins des clients et des entreprises en priorités pour l'équipe de projet (PT), briser les cloisonnements entre les réseaux et résoudre les goulets d'étranglement et les dépendances qui se sont intensifiés pour assurer une livraison harmonisée.
• Gestion des risques et des opérations : Surmonter les défis opérationnels en abordant les risques de façon proactive, en atténuant les problèmes, en orientant d'autres pistes d'action et en alignant les activités de développement, d'ingénierie et d'intégration entre les équipes internes et les partenaires externes.
• Gouvernance financière et financière : Approuver et surveiller les budgets, les calendriers, les plans d'atténuation des risques et les ressources nécessaires pour atteindre les objectifs définis du projet dans les délais et la qualité.
• Leadership de la pensée et collaboration: partenariat avec d'autres chefs de projet, des réseaux de cycle de vie et des dirigeants d'entreprises internationales (IBL)/Lifec

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Main Tasks & Responsibilities :

Responsible for ITOT PI & Interface Layer system (such as File Transfer, SCADA, MQTT and etc.) implementation project, especially in configuration work for project. Make sure all configuration related activities are delivered on time with high quality (eg: minimum deviation, minimum finding, minimum major incident), support PI & Interface Layer system implementation project and the whole site project go live on time. Detail work including:

• System solution and information flow confirmation

• User requirements collection and confirmation

• Tag configuration in the system according to Roche change process and tag configuration process

• Tag verification according to Roche Validation & Qualification process

• Training if any

• All related documentation

• Other work may be needed

Responsible for ITOT PI & Interface Layer system (such as File Transfer, SCADA, MQTT and etc) configuration change and small projects in routine operation for SHA site after project go live. Make sure all configuration related activities are delivered on time with high quality (eg: minimum deviation, minimum finding, minimum major incident), support PI & Interface Layer system configuration change and small projects deliver on time. Detail work including:

• Tag configuration in the system according to Roche change SOP and tag configuration SOP

• Tag verification according to Roche Validation & Qualification SOP

Responsible for the 2nd level support for ITOT PI & Interface Layer system (such as File Transfer, SCADA, MQTT and etc) in routine operation for SHA site after project go live. Track and solve incidents & problems according to ITOT incident & problem management SOP, base on OSP and SLA.

Responsible for ITOT PI & Interface Layer system (such as File Transfer, SCADA, MQTT and etc.) configuration work for future project. Make sure all configuration related activities are delivered on time with high quality (eg: minimum deviation, minimum finding, minimum major incident), support future PI & Interface Layer system implementation project and future site project go live on time.

Join in internal and external audit of ITOT system PI & Interface Layer system (such as File Transfer, SCADA, MQTT and etc.) Prepare for the audits and answer the related questions.

Train junior PI & Interface Layer Configuration Experts, improve overall PI & Interface Layer Configuration Experts’ capability.

Improve SHA site digitalization level, support business opportunities enabled by new technology, meet global ITOT and SHA Site Strategy.

Qualification and Experience

Education/Qualifications
Bachelor degree or above in related subject, computer or automation related subject is preferred

Job Required Competencies

• 7 years’ or above related experience, at least 5 years’ experience of PI engineer

• Have GMP working experience, or have pharmaceutical working experience is preferred.

• Language skills: Good at listening, speaking, reading and written English

• System: OSI Soft PI (familiar with PI AF, EF, PI Vision)，File Transfer, SCADA

• PC skill: Word, Excel, Powerpoint

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 mill

jobs.title: R&D Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
China Innovation Center of Roche (CICoR) functions as a center of excellence for research and early development, and CICoR Oncology group is looking for a motivated and curious intern student majoring in Biotechnology or related fields to join our team. This role offers a unique cross-functional experience, combining dry-lab data analysis, wet-lab experimental support, and creative science communication. You will work closely with senior scientists and bioinformaticians, gaining hands-on industry experience.

• The main responsibilities of the position include:
• Bioinformatics & Data Analysis Support
• Assist in basic bioinformatics workflows.

• Support the team in data visualization, creating charts, and organizing datasets for internal research projects.

• Learn and utilize internal platforms or open-source tools to assist in literature mining and biological database searches.

• Wet-Lab Experimental Assistance
• Support routine laboratory operations, including reagent preparation, sample archiving, and inventory management under strict safety guidelines.

• Assist scientists in executing basic molecular biology or cell culture experiments (training will be provided).

• Science Communication & Video Creation

Brainstorm, script, and produce short promotional or educational videos to showcase team achievements, lab technologies, or internal scientific events.

• Qualifications / Discipline:
Bachelor of Biotechnology degree in relevant fields.

• Skills:
Strong motivation and leadership in pursuing challenging scientific questions.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
This position has overall accountability for completing the manufacturing tasks as scheduled while in full compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices and Roche’s corporate principles, quality policies and standards.

Key Responsibilities:

• Support the Biochemical Manufacturing Department by working effectively within the group to meet department goals and objectives.

• Responsible for completing assigned tasks which may include preparing small equipment, cleaning and sterilizing vessels, preparing solutions, monitoring and operation biochemical processing equipment, raw materials sampling, dispensing and environmental monitoring sampling and maintain housekeeping of the areas while adhering to Safety, cGMP and Biochemical Manufacturing guidelines.

• Assigned tasks must be prioritized and work must be documented per approved manufacturing formulae.

• Troubleshoot equipment and process problems.

• Support process improvement efforts.

• Operate computers for process control and data entry.

Others:

• Participate in staff and shift change meetings and work closely with other shift personnel and external support groups.

• Ensure all assigned tasks are performed as per safety requirement. Report safely incident and near misses on a timely basis and support SHE in incident investigation.

Preferred
Safety, Health & Environment:

• Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.

• Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.

Lean Production System:

• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives.

Who You Are

• Fresh Graduate with degree in Life Sciences or Engineering discipline or Diploma or NITEC or equivalent holders. Diploma holders with at least 3 years of experience. NITEC or equivalent holders with 7 years of experience. Biologics experience is a plus.

• Must possess good problem solving, interpersonal communication and team skills.

• Must be a self-starter with a strong focus on safety, quality, details and results.

• Must be able to work weekends, off-shifts and overtime as required.

• Must be able to carry heavy loads of up to 25kg.

• Mechanical aptitude and a familiarity with computer based systems are highly desirable.

• Background in microbiology, fermentation, or protein purification is desired.

• Must be willing to work at Singapore Tuas Bay Link.

• Assigned tasks must be prioritized and work must be documented per approved manufacturing formulae.

• Support process improvement efforts.

• Operate computers for process control and data entry.

• Participate in staff and shift change meetings and work closely with other shift personnel and external support groups.

• Fresh Graduate with degree in Life Sciences or Engineering discipline or Diploma or NITEC or equivalent holders. Diploma holders with at least 3 years of experience. NITEC or equivalent holders with 7 years of experience. Biologics experience is a plus.

• Must possess good problem solving, interpersonal communication and team skills.

• Must be a self-starter with a strong focus on safety, quality, details and results.

• Must be able to work weekends, off-shifts and overtime as required.

• Must be able to carry heavy loads of up to 25kg.

• Mechanical aptitude and a familiarity with computer based systems are highly desirable.

• Must be willing to work at Singapore Tuas Bay Link. Company Shuttle Bus is provided at the MRT Stations.

• Background in microbiology, fermentation, or protein purification is desired.

• Ensure all assigned tasks are performed as per safety requirement. Report safely incident and near misses on a timely basis and support SHE in incident investigation.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Digital Technology (RDT) for People & Culture (P&C) acts as the "Capability Factory" for Roche. We are a team of business-minded technologists who play "offense"—moving beyond supporting systems to architecting a high-performance digital chassis. We aim to amplify human potential by creating a zero-effort, intelligent ecosystem where technology simplifies complexity and empowers every Roche employee to do their best work.

The Opportunity

The Delivery Service Manager (DSM) for Financial & Mobility technology ensures that the "what" and "why" of the product vision are actually realized through a disciplined "how". While other roles may focus on long-term strategy or technical design, the DSM ensures that the delivery ecosystem works together effectively to provide a stable, supportable, and high-value service.

• Backlog Ownership: Manage and prioritize the product backlog by balancing business value, risks, and technical dependencies.

• Requirement Translation: Convert stakeholder needs into clear, "ready" user stories equipped with specific acceptance criteria for the development team.

• Release Planning: Lead operational readiness and impact assessments to ensure feature deployments are successfully integrated into daily operations.

• Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the bridge between business leaders and developers to manage expectations and refine the product roadmap.

• End-to-End Execution: Oversee daily operations and track progress to ensure the stable and reliable delivery of services.

• Vendor Management: Serve as the primary contact for external partners, ensuring they meet quality, scope, and compliance standards in collaboration with the Transformation Lead.

• Quality & Health Monitoring: Monitor system health and maintain performance dashboards to ensure high service availability.

• Risk & Compliance: Maintain audit readiness and internal controls to ensure all delivery activities align with security and regulatory policies.

Who you are

• Domain & Methodological Expertise: Possesses deep technical knowledge in specified systems alongside a strong understanding of IT Service Management and SCRUM methodologies.

• Stakeholder & Communication Mastery: Demonstrates excellent English communication skills and the ability to represent user groups, influencing and managing expectations across all levels of the organization.

• Strategic Prioritization: Combines analytical thinking with a "good enough instead of perfection" philosophy to manage high input volumes and meet objectives effectively.

• Independent & Virtual Collaboration: Proven ability to work with minimal supervision and plan personal workloads while remaining a highly effective contributor to virtual teams.

• Problem-Solving & Growth Mindset: Driven by a passion for continuous learning and sharing knowledge, utilizing a hands-on, customer-service-oriented approach to resolve issues.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility:

jobs.title: (Senior) Medical Science Manager (Immunology)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader.
● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker.
● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies.
● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.
● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators.
● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area.

Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities (Major functions of the position)
1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related biomarker
● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy.
● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs.
● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events; Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs, preferences and views of new data.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As a Cluster Section Lead in the Global Finance Support organization, you will be responsible for establishing and leading day-to-day Finance Technical support, working with the respective Global Cluster Lead. The role has a strong focus on people management, compliance and operational excellence. In this position you will drive operational excellence to achieve the objectives of the Global Product Line, leading a team of Finance Business and System Analysts.
As a people manager you will inspire and help to shape the future of our organization.
You will actively coach and foster the development of the team members, help remove siloes and support your team to evolve with the organic development of the business.
You will lead the collaboration across clusters, as well as, across Global Product Lines, and Global teams.

• Strategic Talent Management: Lead the full employee lifecycle by managing recruitment with P&C, overseeing onboarding/integration, and ensuring comprehensive training through various learning channels.

• Performance & Development: Motivate and develop team members by setting clear goals, documenting performance, and providing proactive coaching and feedback.

• Operational Excellence: Drive service quality in Finance Business Support by meeting KPI targets, ensuring high end-user satisfaction, and maintaining a deep understanding of end-to-end finance processes.

• Collaboration & Communication: Foster a culture of teamwork and transparency by proactively sharing information, project roadmaps, and business knowledge across global and functional boundaries.

• Continuous Improvement: Partner with enabling functions to implement best practices and identify system/process enhancements that drive automation, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

• Stakeholder & Risk Management: Manage key business relationships and collaborate with leadership to set performance targets, manage team workloads, and mitigate operational risks.

• Values-Driven Leadership: Serve as a role model by embodying Roche values and Leadership Commitments while promoting Agile, LEAN, and ITIL methodologies.

Who you are

• Strategic Leadership & Change Management: Proven ability to lead projects in complex matrix organizations, drive organizational change, and mentor/coach team members to success.

• Operational Excellence & Metrics: Extensive experience in customer support (preferably Finance) with a focus on meeting department KPIs, managing escalations, and utilizing reporting tools for data-driven decisions.

• Stakeholder & Account Management: Expert in demand and relationship management, possessing exceptional negotiation, facilitation, and communication skills to navigate a dynamic international environment.

• Agile & Structured Methodologies: Proficient in implementing support processes through modern ways of working, such as Agile, ITIL, and LEAN, while maintaining a strong sense of urgency.

• Results-Oriented Professionalism: Highly accountable and resourceful problem-solver with a university degree and the ability to manage multiple priorities with composure and integrity.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care
Roche Diagnostics Nederland

We zijn op zoek naar een ervaren Medical Affairs professional om ons team te versterken in de functie van Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care. In deze functie maak je deel uit van het Medical & Access Chapter en werk je samen met collega's aan de uitdagingen en ontwikkelingen in de gezondheidszorg. In een multidisciplinair team en op een agile werkwijze, draag je bij aan de toegankelijkheid van de diagnostische en digitale innovaties voor de patiënt om het zorgpad en daarmee de patiëntuitkomsten te verbeteren.

Als Medical Value Partner ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de medische strategie van Cardiologie en Critical Care. Hiervoor werk je samen met diverse stakeholders, waaronder Key Opinion Leaders binnen cardiologie, interne geneeskunde en anesthesiologie, patiëntenverenigingen, beroepsverenigingen en zorgverzekeraars.
We zoeken iemand met een sterk strategisch en analytisch denkvermogen, creativiteit en een proactieve houding. Je hebt ervaring met evidence generation, het vertalen van bewijslast naar de dagelijkse praktijk, de toepassing van waardegedreven zorg, medische of waardegedreven projecten en het ontwikkelen van gerichte medische educatie. Daarnaast is ervaring met werken in multidisciplinaire teams, stakeholder engagement en kennis van de farmaceutische industrie en/of gezondheidszorg gewenst.

Als persoon ben je een teamspeler, flexibel, resultaatgericht en in staat om prioriteiten te stellen. Je hebt een open mindset en kunt in een dynamische en agile omgeving werken. Daarnaast ben je communicatief sterk en kun je helder en effectief communiceren in zowel Nederlands als Engels.

Je verantwoordelijkheden:

• Het identificeren en creëren van kansen om de patiëntenzorg te verbeteren

• Het bouwen en onderhouden van relevante stakeholder netwerken

• Het genereren van klinische bewijslast in samenwerking met artsen en onderzoekers

• Het organiseren van medische educatie

• Als subject matter expert ben je een (sparring) partner voor interne en externe stakeholders

Je vaardigheden:

• Kennis op het gebied van cardiologie en/of critical care

• Uitstekende communicatie vaardigheden en in staat mensen te verbinden en mobiliseren

• Ervaring met klinische studies, medische educatie en stakeholder engagement

• Relevante medisch wetenschappelijke opleiding (Msc, MD, PharmD, PhD)

• Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in de farmaceutische en/of medical device industrie

Waarom Roche?
Al meer dan 125 jaar werkt Roche aan een gezondere toekomst met één duidelijk doel: “Doing now what patients need next”. Wij geloven dat we de grootste medische uitdagingen alleen kunnen oplossen door intensieve samenwerking met zorgprofessionals en patiënten.
Onze impact gaat echter verder dan de zorg; we nemen ook de volle verantwoordelijkheid voor onze planeet. Zo draaien al onze locaties sinds 2025 op 100% duurzame elektriciteit, een belangrijke mijlpaal in onze ambitie om in 2045 volledig klimaatneutraal (net zero) te zijn. Bij Roche werk je dus niet alleen aan de zorg van morgen, maar ook aan een gezonde, duurzame wereld.

Dit krijg je bij ons:

• Een inspirerende werkomgeving waar plezier en maatschappelijke impact samenkomen.

• Een organisatie waar jouw expertise wordt gewaardeerd en waar je autonoom beslissingen kan nemen binnen je team.

• Werken met een portfolio van innovatieve producten die de cardiologische zorg fundamenteel transformeren.

• Volop ka

jobs.title: Migration & Integration Expert - Roche Cloud Platform AWS

titleByLocale.it: Esperto di migrazione e integrazione - Roche Cloud Platform AWS
titleByLocale.en: Migration & Integration Expert - Roche Cloud Platform AWS
titleByLocale.de: Migration & Integration Experte - Roche Cloud Platform AWS
titleByLocale.fr: Expert en migration et intégration - Roche Cloud Platform AWS

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Migration-integration expert & Technical Product Owner you are responsible for:

• Leading technically Roche’s high-stakes AWS account migrations. Your primary mission is to facilitate the seamless integration of newly acquired entities (M&A) and the consolidation of legacy infrastructure into the Roche Cloud Platform (RCP) AWS .

• Advanced AWS engineering for complex networking, security and IAM environments and stakeholder management at all levels in the organization. When not leading active migrations, you will pivot to the platform team to engineer new features and ensure RCP remains at the cutting edge of enterprise cloud standards.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Establishes technical direction to the whole lifecycle of platforms and services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and retirement. Applies software engineering principles to build and manage large-scale IT infrastructure products and services, abstracting away the complexity of infrastructure to provide self-service tools and APIs for developers. Designs complex CI/CD pipelines, designs and develops self-healing features, and leads Disaster Recovery design and execution plans.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Strategically applies expert problem-solving and decision-making skills to address the most complex issues within a team. Leads the maintenance of live services by designing metrics to measure availability, latency, and system health, and is responsible for identifying critical metrics used to establish SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs. Proactively plans for IT Infrastructure capacity, performance, and scalability, and leads large initiatives aimed at optimizing inter-related platforms. Accountable for availability, tuning, efficiency, change and configuration management, and emergency response.

• Stakeholder Management: Demonstrates exceptional customer and delivery focus by proactively leading partnership and collaboration with developers, Managed Services suppliers, and vendors to continuously improve application development velocity and optimize services reliability. Works closely with development teams to ensure new features are rolled out with a strategic understanding of reliability. Provides direction, guidance, and priority setting, acting as a senior analyst to transform customer and developer needs into specific requirements.

• Impact/Strategy: Ensures implemented solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and is responsible for implementing and updating cost, compliance, and security best practices. Leads complex audit exercises, providing required evidence to audit teams, and leads audit remediation plans. Manages ITSM processes, challenges requirements to scale systems sustainably, and applies innovation to foster business strategy.

• Complexity/ (Product Size): Demonstrates proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse virtual teams globally, driving success across multiple product lines within a domain. Leads geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship, providing specialized guidance to optimize performance and innovation.

• Business/Technical ability: Utilizes wide experience applying Software Engineering principles, automated testing, and CI/CD tools to define technical computing infrastructure entirely under the control of software with no human intervention. Implements and maintains Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and CI/CD pipelines. Applies design thinking, lean, prioritization, and agile meth

jobs.title: Commercial Support Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Commercial Support Specialist

The Opportunity

As our Commercial Application Support Specialist, you will play an essential role in maintaining the integrity and seamless operation of Roche’s commercial contract management ecosystem. You will serve as a vital link between our business operations and IT systems, ensuring data accuracy and resolving critical inquiries that empower our teams to deliver excellence worldwide.

In this role, you will:

• Drive platform stability by operationally maintaining and supporting Contract Management Lifecycle Deal Solutions systems and their integrations.

• Empower global business users by diagnosing and resolving systems inquiries, tool-handling issues, and data consistency challenges with a strong customer-centric focus.

• Collaborate across ecosystems with diverse stakeholders from local, regional, and global Business and IT teams to implement system releases smoothly.

• Champion data excellence by proactively monitoring data quality, performing root-cause analysis, and leading data cleansing initiatives to support strategic business results.

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert in cross-functional stakeholder meetings, advising on technical limitations, platform logic, and process implications.

• Foster continuous improvement by translating complex technical data into concise, actionable solutions that streamline sales and pricing processes.

Who You Are

You are an upbeat, dynamic professional who is passionate about commercial technologies and digital ecosystems. A natural problem-solver, you look at the big picture to design sustainable, scalable solutions while keeping user experience at the center of everything you do.

To thrive in this role, you bring:

• An Academic Foundation: A BSc/MSc degree in Business Administration, Finance, IT, Economics, or a related field.

• Commercial Systems Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in contract management, commercial operations, or project coordination—ideally within a global or cross-functional environment.

• Technical Curiosity: Familiarity with sales, service, or ticketing ecosystems (such as Salesforce, SAP, or ServiceNow) and a passion for mastering new digital tools.

• Analytical Precision: An outstanding analytical mindset with intermediate to advanced Excel skills and the ability to synthesize data sets into straightforward formats.

• Exceptional Communication: Excellent oral and written communication skills in English, enabling you to manage stakeholders smoothly in a fast-paced environment.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. That’s what makes us Roche.

Pl

jobs.title: Disease Area Squad Lead Neurology

titleByLocale.fr: Neurologie de l'escouade de la région de la maladie

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
The Disease Area Squad Lead as an agnostic steward of resources, leverages the expertise across the network to ensure integrated disease area outcomes are achieved through prioritization of business outcomes, optimising resource allocation and seizing opportunities to deliver on evolving DA needs and enable triple win outcomes.

Whilst being hired into a country affiliate, this role will be a member of the PI network, working in cross border collaborations, to realise and scale country outcomes by contributing to virtual, cross border, cross functional work package teams.

Main Responsibilities

• Provides inspirational leadership in setting the vision and strategic ambition for the squad and assuming overall accountability for the execution of this vision/ambition by applying Outcome based planning principles (including budget oversight)

• Creates an environment where diverse technical disciplines can align, develop and execute in order to pursue the affiliate/squad North Star ambition

• Uses agile methodologies in the squad and constantly seeks for continuous improvement through team retrospectives

• Ensures Customer (Internal and external) voice is included in their solutions through co creation and establishes a consistent and best-in-class customer journey experience through omnichannels

• Provides VACC leadership and coaching of squad members, peers and more broadly as required, to ensure individuals and teams are fit-for-purpose and growing in line with their passion and the needs of the Organisation

• In collaboration with other Squad Leads, champions synergies in overall prioritisation of all squad priorities, in line with Organisational resourcing capacity, enabling re-use and reducing duplication in delivering seamless end-to-end patient solutions partnering with Global and Pharma international

• Aligns squad vision and ambition with regional and global outcomes, leverage the networked ways of working to identify synergies cross countries and maximize impact

• End to end accountable for their respective squads, including outcome based plan and defining (and regularly assess) resources and capabilities required to achieve these outcomes

• Responsible to collaborate with other squad leads to prioritize and mane trade off decisions between squads and portfolio prioritization

• Works collaboratively, contributing and sharing expertise across the organisation to remove silos and duplication, ensure efficient use of similar skill-sets, and to ultimately support common pursuit of the organisational North Star.

Who you are:
Functional Capabilities

• Mobilizes teams and fosters partnership

• Mentoring, Coaching and Developing people

• End-to-end management of and accountability for the product backlog and outcomes through VACC leadership

• Know how of the Disease area landscape and life cycle management

• Full command of English and French is required

Other Critical Capabilities :

• Entrepreneurial, able to identify opportunities, to experiment, to take risks and disrupt the status quo

• Borderless Collaboration: working closely with other countries/communities/teams, embracing the loop of “sharing and learning together” to co-create and upscale Ecosystem Solutions

• Budget Management - for oversight and prioritization

• Project Management - Leading projects and solutions in an impactful way

• Influencing and Communication skills

• Deep listening, Empathy and co-creating solutions

• Stakeholder management

• System Think

jobs.title: Senior Data Product Owner

titleByLocale.fr: Propriétaire principal de produits de données

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a passionate and experienced Data Product Owner ready to drive business value through innovative data solutions? Join Roche's PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) organization as a Senior Data Product Owner!

At Roche, our 10-year Pharma vision is centered on delivering new data analytics solutions to scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT). PTE is catalyzing PT's digital transformation, activating data citizenship, and building a FAIR data ecosystem. In this role, you will be pivotal in building, maintaining, and sustaining data products that drive operational excellence and enable impactful decision-making for our patients' benefit.

In this role, you will:

• Define & Communicate Product Vision: Lead the vision and roadmap for data products, aligning with organizational goals and stakeholder needs.

• Lead Data Product Development: Manage the full lifecycle of data products, from ideation to deployment, leveraging Roche’s IT/OT ecosystems for stable, automated solutions.

• Drive Value Delivery & Prioritization: Develop prioritized product backlogs, guiding teams to deliver scalable, reusable data products that achieve measurable business outcomes.

• Ensure Governance & Compliance: Guarantee data products adhere to Roche’s data quality standards, governance policies, and regulatory requirements (e.g., data privacy, GxP).

• Champion Collaboration & Mentorship: Act as a key liaison between business and technical teams, fostering harmonization and mentoring other Data Product Owners.
Who You Are:

• 7+ years of agile experience designing and delivering complex data solutions, including 4+ years as a Product Owner or Data Analyst, preferably in the pharma or healthcare industry.

• Proven track record of data management on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake)

• Strong understanding of data architectures, data modeling, data integration (e.g., data mesh, data warehousing), and SDLC/CSV.

• Excellent ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications and lead teams in an agile setting.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
By concentrating on healthcare’s toughest challenges, we’ve been able to make many major breakthroughs, improving lives around the world. But there’s still work to be done.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a Patient Journey Partner (PJP) to join our team.

The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.
The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.
This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)
It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives

Your Impact
The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey

• The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

• Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.

• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem.

• The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs.

• Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services.

Who you are

• You possess a university degree in a scientific, economic, or business field; an advanced degree in life sciences or an MBA is a plus.

• You have a proven track record in leading cross-functional teams, formulating strategies, and orchestrating execution, with experience partnering with patient advocacy groups (PAGs) being highly desirable.

• You demonstrate strong business expertise, particularly in commercialization, medical affairs, and customer experience excellence, and have experience with agile ways of working.

• You excel in stakeholder engagement, including partnering with therapeutic area experts (TAEs) and organizations, with excellent collaboration and communication skills.

By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster. The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions. • Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.

jobs.title: Digital Campaigns Subchapter Lead

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del Subcapitolo delle Campagne Digitali

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Global Digital Hub has newly been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Digital Campaigns Subchapter Lead at Roche, you'll have the opportunity to develop groundbreaking digital skills while fostering the growth of colleagues across the organization. This role offers an unparalleled chance to advance your leadership and functional expertise.

The Opportunity:

• You will coordinate subchapter operations, onboard and mentor team members, and ensure the team's proficiency in executing high-impact digital campaigns.

• You'll provide strategic vision and direction, optimize processes, manage escalations, and ensure seamless coordination among teams to achieve organizational goals.

• Continuously monitoring and optimizing resource utilization, you will ensure customer satisfaction and the effective delivery of objectives.

• By fostering a culture of continuous improvement, you will encourage team members to grow and develop their digital capabilities.

• You will build strong relationships with other Subchapter Leads to align on strategic priorities, accelerate decision-making, and support each other.

• Additionally, you will gather and share best practices, creating a community of learning and synergy.

• Establishing and maintaining process governance principles, you will ensure proper documentation and adherence to best practices within the scope of responsibility.

Who you are:

• As an experienced professional, you have a minimum of 8 years in digital operations with a proven track record in omnichannel marketing and content delivery.

• You have at least 3 years in coaching, leadership, and people development.

• You are an excellent communicator in English (additional languages are a plus).

• You are skilled in navigating complex, multicultural environments with strong project and change management capabilities.

• As an innovative problem-solver, you are analytical, detail-oriented, and efficient in time management.

• You are able to work under pressure and manage complex issues independently.

• You are also a tech enthusiast, passionate about technology, a quick learner, and proficient with different tools.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

jobs.title: ERP Solution Consultant - SAP Intercompany
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
ERP Solution Consultant - SAP Intercompany

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The ERP Solution Consultant leads independently complex ERP solution delivery, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to architecture. In this role, you will guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product or product line level. By bringing advanced ERP knowledge, in-depth expertise in key areas, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and team development.

Job Responsibilities

• Backlog Management: Defining, ordering, and refining Product Backlog items to align with business goals.

• Product Strategy: Evaluate existing SD processes to identify optimization opportunities, particularly in the areas of automated order processing and real-time analytics.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborating with Supply Chain stakeholders to gather feedback, manage expectations, and communicate product updates.

• Development Collaboration: Working with Scrum teams to define, build, and validate product features during sprints.

• Solution Design & Configuration: Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of new features within S/4HANA .

• Hands-on Core Customizing : Perform independent, hands-on SAP standard configuration and customization within the S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) and Material management (MM) module.

• WRICEF Specification & Design : Translate complex business requirements into detailed functional specifications for custom developments, actively designing and delivering WRICEF items (Workflow, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms) from ideation to hypercare.

• Logistics Integration: Act as the functional lead for SD integration touchpoints with Decentralized EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) and Embedded TM (Transportation Management) to ensure seamless flow from Sales Order to TM Integration

Technical & Professional Qualifications

• S/4HANA SD: Minimum of 3 of experience in SAP SD, ideally with full-cycle S/4HANA implementations.

• Familiarity with Solution Manager (SolMan) or SAP Cloud ALM for documentation and transport management.

• Technical Literacy: Proficiency in monitoring and troubleshooting IDocs/ALE.

Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

• Life Sciences / Pharma Experience: Familiarity with pharmaceutical business models

• Analytical Mindset: Ability to translate comp

Entra a far parte di Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ERP Solution Consultant - SAP Intercompany Roche Digital Technology (STD) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a modellare domani.s futuro digitale della sanità. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale di intelligenza artificiale, dati, e innovazioni tecnologiche di scalable.Svolto da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutta Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano e guidare scoperte che veramente contano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità e collaborazione personale. Per ora, chiediamo ai nostri dipendenti di essere nei nostri uffici in media due giorni a settimana. I giorni di ufficio specifici possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, municipi, riunioni di gruppo, e altri eventi collaborativi. L'ERP Solution Consultant conduce in modo indipendente la fornitura di soluzioni ERP, risolve proattivamente i problemi dei prodotti e contribuisce all'architettura. In questo ruolo, guiderai i team di prodotti, la responsabilità dei campioni e comunicherai efficacemente con le parti interessate. Risolverai problemi complessi, prenderai decisioni indipendenti a livello di prodotto, fornirai una supervisione tecnica e riferirai a livello di prodotto o linea di prodotto. Portando a conoscenza ERP avanzate, competenze approfondite in settori chiave e forti competenze analitiche, contribuirai attivamente al miglioramento continuo e allo sviluppo di team. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Gestione Backlog: Definizione, ordinazione e raffinazione di articoli Backlog prodotto per allinearsi agli obiettivi aziendali.
• Strategia del prodotto: Evaluare i processi SD esistenti per individuare opportunità di ottimizzazione, in particolare nei settori dell'elaborazione automatizzata degli ordini e dell'analisi in tempo reale.
• Gestione delle parti interessate: il trattamento con gli stakeholder di Supply Chain per raccogliere feedback, gestire le aspettative e comunicare gli aggiornamenti dei prodotti.
• Sviluppo: il lavoro con i team Scrum per definire, costruire e convalidare le funzionalità del prodotto durante gli sprint.
• Solution Design & Con 209tion: Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of new features in S/4HANA.
• Personalizzazione manuale del nucleo: eseguire una configurazione e personalizzazione standard SAP, pratiche e indipendenti all'interno del modulo S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) e Material Management (MM).

• Integrazione logistica: agire come il lead funzionale per i touchpoint di integrazione SD con EWM decentralizzato (Extended Warehouse Management) e Embedded TM (Transportation Management) per garantire il flusso senza soluzione di continuità dall'ordine di vendita all'integrazione TM Qualificazioni tecniche e professionali

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position ERP Solution Consultant - SAP Intercompany Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world. At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events. The ERP Solution Consultant leads independently complex ERP solution delivery, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to architecture. In this role, you will guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product or product line level. By bringing advanced ERP knowledge, in-depth expertise in key areas, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and team development. Job Responsibilities
• Backlog Management: Defining, ordering, and refining Product Backlog items to align with business goals.
• Product Strategy: Evaluate existing SD processes to identify optimization opportunities, particularly in the areas of automated order processing and real-time analytics.
• Stakeholder Management: Collaborating with Supply Chain stakeholders to gather feedback, manage expectations, and communicate product updates.
• Development Collaboration: Working with Scrum teams to define, build, and validate product features during sprints.
• Solution Design & Configuration: Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of new features within S/4HANA .
• Hands-on Core Customizing : Perform independent, hands-on SAP standard configuration and customization within the S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) and Material management (MM) module.
• WRICEF Specification & Design : Translate complex business requirements into detailed functional specifications for custom developments, actively designing and delivering WRICEF items (Workflow, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms) from ideation to hypercare.
• Logistics Integration: Act as the functional lead for SD integration touchpoints with Decentralized EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) and Embedded TM (Transportation Management) to ensure seamless flow from Sales Order to TM Integration Technical & Professional Qualifications
• S/4HANA SD: Minimum of 3 of experience in SAP SD, ideally with full-cycle S/4HANA implementations.
• Familiarity with Solution Manager (SolMan) or SAP Cloud ALM for documentation and transport management.
• Technical Literacy: Proficiency in monitoring and troubleshooting IDocs/ALE. Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)
• Life Sciences / Pharma Experience: Familiarity with pharmaceutical business models
• Analytical Mindset: Ability to translate comp

Job Responsibilities
• Backlog Management: Definieren, bestellen und verfeinern Sie Product Backlog items, um sich an die Geschäftsziele anzupassen.

• Stakeholdermanagement: Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern der Supply Chain, um Feedback zu sammeln, Erwartungen zu verwalten und Produktupdates zu kommunizieren.

• WRICEF Spezifikation & Design : Übersetzen komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen in detaillierte funktionale Spezifikationen für kundenspezifische Entwicklungen, aktiv Entwurf und Lieferung von WRICEF-Elemente (Workflow, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements und Formulare) von der Idee zu Hypercare.
• Logistikintegration: Funktionelle Führung für SD-Integrationskontaktpunkte mit dezentralisiertem EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) und Embedded TM (Transportation Management) zur Gewährleistung eines nahtlosen Flows vom Verkaufauftrag bis zur TM-Integration Technische & Professionelle Qualifikationen
• S/4HANA SD: Minimum an Erfahrung in SAP SD, idealerweise mit S/4HANA-Implementierungen im Full-Cycle.
• Vertrautheit mit Solution Manager (SolMan) oder SAP Cloud ALM zur Dokumentation und Transportmanagement.
• Technisches Literat: Kompetenz bei der Überwachung und Fehlerbehebung von IDocs/ALE.
• Life Sciences / Pharma Experience: Vertrautheit mit pharmazeutischen Geschäftsmodellen
• Analytical Mindset: Fähigkeit, comp zu übersetzen

• Intégration logistique : agir comme chef de file fonctionnel pour les points de contact d'intégration SD avec EWM décentralisé (Gérant d'entrepôt étendu) et TM embarqué (Gestion des transports) pour assurer un flux sans faille de l'ordre des ventes aux qualifications techniques et professionnelles d'intégration TM
• S/4HANA SD : minimum de 3 d'expérience en SAP SD, idéalement avec des implémentations S/4HANA à cycle complet.
• Familiarité avec le Gestionnaire de Solution (SolMan) ou SAP Cloud ALM pour la gestion de la documentation et des transports.
• Alphabétisation technique : compétence en surveillance et dépannage IDocs/ALE. Expérience en sciences de la vie / Pharma : connaissance des modèles d'affaires pharmaceutiques

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche/Genentech Pharma Product Development Global Clinical Operations (PDG), we are determined to transform drug development and realize our Pharma Ambition to deliver 20 transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden by 2029.

By joining us, you are joining a team dedicated to transforming the future of healthcare. We model our leadership commitments on transparency, inclusion, and a relentless focus on the patient.

Your missions
As the Clinical Operations Country Head - France (d/f/m) , you will be a strategic architect of clinical excellence. You will lead the Country Leadership Team to bridge the gap between global strategy and local execution, ensuring our life-changing portfolio reaches patients with speed, quality, and integrity.
In this high-visibility role, you will champion operational excellence, manage pivotal CRO partnerships, and cultivate our high-performing culture.

1. Strategic Leadership & Global Alignment

• Drive the Country Leadership Team across our therapeutic areas.

• Partner with Global TA Leaders and Country Medical Director to align local execution with the "One Pharma" strategy.

• Proactively resolve resource conflicts and optimize the country portfolio to maximize patient impact.

2. Operational Excellence & Innovation

• Partner with CROs to implement data-driven strategies that enhance productivity and streamline workflows.

• Maintain gold-standard adherence to local legal, financial, and ethical regulations.

• Manage country resources and budgets with a focus on maximizing value and minimizing waste.

3. External Shape & Partnerships

• Build close relationships with Health Authorities, Ethics Committees, and Industry Groups to advance the clinical research landscape.

• Ensure CRO partnerships are collaborative and accountable.

4. Empowering People

• Lead by example by fostering an inclusive environment.

• Manage and develop a pipeline of future leaders through active coaching, performance management, and career pathing.

Your profile
You are a visionary leader who thrives in a matrixed environment. You balance a high-level strategic mindset with the analytical rigor required to manage complex clinical operations.

• Degree in Life Sciences (MD, PhD, or Master’s preferred).

• Ideally 10+ years experience in the pharmaceutical or related industry.

• Experience in drug development is essential.

• Extensive expertise of end-to-end clinical trial processes and local regulatory landscapes (local/Global trends).

• A proven track record of people leadership, fostering cross-functional collaboration and influencing stakeholders at all levels. Any additional experience in a commercial environment is a strong asset.

• Ability to thrive in an international organisation; including national and international travels as required by the business.

• Very good level of French and English.

jobs.title: Medical Administration & Communication Support Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Medical Administration & Communication Support Intern

W Roche Diagnostics naszym priorytetem jest troska o zdrowie i jakość życia pacjentów na całym świecie. Tworzymy i wdrażamy innowacyjne, kompleksowe rozwiązania w kluczowych obszarach diagnostyki i terapii, koncentrując się na profilaktyce, diagnozowaniu oraz leczeniu chorób.
Jeśli chcesz zdobyć praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy w międzynarodowej firmie diagnostycznej oraz rozwijać swoje umiejętności w obszarze administracji i komunikacji projektów medical value, ta oferta jest dla Ciebie!

Twoje zadania:

• Wsparcie w optymalizacji systemu oceny materiałów medycznych i grantów.

• Współpraca z zespołem komunikacji w zakresie przygotowywania i publikowania treści.

• Wprowadzanie danych i dokumentów do baz danych.

• Ścisła współpraca z expertami Medical, Access i Communication.

• Udział w inicjatywach wspierających integrację networków (medical, sales, marketing).

O Tobie:

• Jesteś studentem lub absolwentem kierunku medycznego, administracyjnego lub związanego z komunikacją.

• Jesteś dokładny, umiesz pracować z danymi, masz umiejętności analityczne.

• Masz wysokie kompetencje interpersonalne, umiesz pracować zarówno indywidualnie, jak i w zespole.

• Swobodnie komunikujesz się zarówno po polsku jak i po angielsku.

• Znajomość zagadnień i doświadczenie w pracy w sektorze medycznym będzie dodatkowym atutem!

Co oferujemy?

• Rodzaj umowy: Umowa zlecenie (do czerwca 2027).

• Wymiar czasu pracy: 30 godzin tygodniowo.

• Wynagrodzenie: 5 120 – 6 080 PLN brutto miesięcznie.

• Możliwość zdobycia cennego doświadczenia w międzynarodowej firmie z branży wyrobów medycznych.

• Szansę na rozwój zawodowy i uczestnictwo w ciekawych projektach.

• Elastyczne godziny pracy dopasowane do Twojego planu zajęć.

Jeśli chcesz rozwijać się w dynamicznym środowisku i zdobyć cenne doświadczenie – aplikuj!

Administratorem danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Domaniewskiej 28 (02-672). Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Osobom, które zaaplikują przysługuje prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-dia-pl .

Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. działa w pełnej zgodności z przepisami prawa i nie toleruje żadnych naruszeń. W Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. obowiązuje Procedura zgłaszania naruszeń prawa. W przypadku chęci zgłoszenia nieprawidłowości związanych z naszą działalnością, wszelkie niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgłaszania naruszeń znajdują się na naszej stronie internetowej: https://www.roche.pl/kontakt/ochrona-sygnalistow-zglaszanie-naruszen .

Compensation & Benefits
Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Warsaw. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Information about the compensation package for this position will be provided ahead of any interview

The Position
Job description

As an Infrastructure Provisioning and Management Engineer within the Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) team, you will be responsible for overseeing and advancing our core infrastructure management and provisioning tech stack. This role has a strong focus on driving configuration-as-code, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), and modern automated provisioning best practices across our high-performance compute (HPC) and industry-leading AI Factory.
You will own the lifecycle, deployment, and optimization of bare-metal and virtualized compute environments that power Roche's advanced computing initiatives. By treating infrastructure strictly as code and eliminating manual configurations, you will ensure our advanced clusters are highly reproducible, securely patched, and rapidly scalable to meet the evolving demands of computational science and large-scale AI workloads.

Description of the area

Hosting and Infrastructure (HI) provides mission-critical on-premise infrastructure, cloud hosting, connectivity, and technology products that enable all functions at every Roche site to develop, innovate, connect, and deliver compliant digital products across the Roche Enterprise.
The Value Streams - Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) Team is focused on driving both customer success and platform success by acting as a center of excellence and delivery for the High Performance Compute and AI Infrastructure supporting AI and HPC use cases across Roche. This team facilitates seamless onboarding and adoption for business vertical customers needing accelerated compute—helping those infrastructure consumers with needs optimized for high availability, seamless data transfer, flexibility, speed, and the rapidly changing needs of AI—helping achieve rapid time-to-value.

Job Responsibilities

Automated Provisioning & Cluster Orchestration

• Design, deploy, and manage large-scale automated provisioning systems for multi-node HPC and AI Factory environments.

• Own and maintain the infrastructure management and provisioning tech stack underpinning the orchestration, monitoring, and provisioning of complex GPU and CPU workloads.

• Streamline bare-metal provisioning and node imaging pipelines to ensure minimal downtime and rapid expansion capabilities.

Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) & Configuration Governance

• Enforce a strict configuration-as-code and infrastructure-as-code mindset, replacing manual interventions with repeatable automation scripts.

• Author, review, and maintain complex Ansible playbooks and roles for configuration management, patch deployment, and compliance drift remediation.

• Establish robust CI/CD pipelines using GitLab to test, validate, and deploy infrastructure changes safely across development, staging, and production clusters.

Operating System Engineering & Lifecycle Management

• In partnership with Enterprise OS teams, standardize and manage operating system builds, with dual proficiency across HPC and AI Factory platforms.

• Utilize solutions such as Red Hat Image Builder and NVIDIA Base Command Manager to create optimized, compliant, and secure custom golden images tailored for AI and high-performance computing workloads.

• Manage OS lifecycles, including kernel tuning, automated package updates, and vulnerability management, ensuring alignment with global security standards.

Platform Reliability & Collaboration

• Implement proactive monitoring and alerting for infrastructure provisioning health, node availability, and configurat
