jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

As a member of the ACE Value Engineering & Outcomes (VEO) team, you will play a key role in ensuring that AI and High Performance Computing (HPC) use cases are successfully translated, deployed, and executed across Roche’s AI Factory and HPC infrastructure.
Operating at the intersection of business domains, RDT AI teams (such as Applied AI), and platform engineering, you will contribute to owning the end-to-end flow from use case intent to real, running workloads. You will ensure that workloads are technically executable, scalable, and aligned with platform capabilities, enabling rapid time-to-value and sustainable adoption, and ensuring alignment between business intent and platform execution.
You will also contribute to defining and continuously improving how use cases move from concept to execution across the AI Factory and HPC ecosystem, helping to establish repeatable and scalable pathways for workload execution.

Description of the area
Hosting and Infrastructure (HI) provides mission-critical on-premise infrastructure, cloud hosting, connectivity, and technology products that enable all functions at every Roche site to develop, innovate, connect, and deliver compliant digital products across the Roche Enterprise.
The Value Streams - Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) Team is focused on driving both customer success and platform success by acting as a center of excellence and delivery for the High Performance Compute and AI Infrastructure supporting AI and HPC use cases across Roche. This team facilitates seamless onboarding and adoption for business vertical customers needing accelerated compute—helping those infrastructure consumers with needs optimized for high availability, seamless data transfer, flexibility, speed, and the rapidly changing needs of AI—helping achieve rapid time-to-value.
Within Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE), the Value Engineering & Outcomes (VEO) team plays a critical role in the AI Factory ecosystem by ensuring that AI and HPC use cases are translated into executable workloads and successfully realized on platform infrastructure. Acting as a bridge between business domain teams, RDT AI teams (such as Applied AI), platform engineering, and infrastructure, the VEO team ensures that demand entering the AI Factory is structured, governed, and aligned with platform capabilities, enabling effective onboarding, execution, and measurable outcomes.

Job Responsibilities

Use Case Structuring, Challenge & Readiness

• Partner with business domain teams and RDT AI teams (such as Applied AI) to clarify, structure, and constructively challenge AI and HPC use cases

• Assess readiness, dependencies, and feasibility across data, infrastructure, and platform constraints

• Ensure use cases are technically viable and aligned with platform capabilities before execution

• Identify gaps early and guide teams toward executable pathways

Workload Translation, Architecture & Platform Routing

• Translate use cases into executable workload designs, including compute, storage, orchestration, and data requirements

• Define how workloads are deployed across AI Factory, HPC, and hybrid environments

• Leverage experience with containerized and distributed systems (e.g., Kubernetes, HPC schedulers) to ensure workloads are production-ready

• Develop reusable patterns to standardize workload deployment and scaling

Platform Onboarding & Execution

This team facilitates seamless onboarding and adoption for business vertical customers needing accelerated compute—helping those infrastructure consumers with needs optimized for high availability, seamless data transfer, flexibility, speed, and the rapidly changing needs of AI—helping achieve rapid time-to-value.

Job Responsibilities

Orchestration Stack Deployment & Governance

• Design, implement, and maintain the SLURM Workload Manager ecosystem across our HPC cluster architectures, ensuring high availability and optimal resource distribution.

• Deploy and manage Run:ai as the core orchestration and virtualization layer for the AI Factory, enabling fractional GPU allocation and dynamic resource allocation.

• Evaluate, architect, and implement SLURM Slinky integrations where required to seamlessly bridge Kubernetes-based AI orchestration with traditional HPC cluster resources.

Containerization & Workload Optimization

• Define best practices and frameworks for containerized scientific execution, utilizing Singularity/Apptainer and/or Enroot to provide secure, reproducible performance environments for HPC.

• Translate user and workload requirements into optimized scheduling parameters (e.g., topology-aware scheduling, multi-node scaling).

• Actively profile and tune scheduling queues, quality-of-service (QoS) parameters, and fair-share policies to maximize multi-tenant efficiency.

Platform Reliability & Telemetry

• Partner with Observability Engineers to implement continuous monitoring, telemetry, and reporting dashboards to track scheduler efficiency, queue wait times, and hardware utilization rates.

• Troubleshoot complex workload failures, including distributed training synchronization issues, MPI communication bottlenecks, and driver incompatibilities.

• Maintain configuration-as-code models for the scheduling tier, leveraging automation to deploy cluster policies uniformly.

Qualifications

jobs.title: Business Analytics Lead (m/f/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de file de l'analyse commerciale (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

As the Business Analytics Lead , you will be the strategic architect of the data roadmap shaping the Patient Insights portfolio and strategy at Roche Information Solutions (RIS). You will serve as the single source of truth for the RIS Patient Insights portfolio metrics and act as the orchestrator of Patient Insights-wide business analytics. You will create effective strategies to collect data, analyze information, conduct research and implement analytics. You will bring a keen strategic focus and ability to translate data into actionable insights, championing data-driven decision making and the journey at RIS Patient Insights to become the leading chronic disease management company.

We are looking for a proven business leader. You demonstrate energy, passion, courage, vision and the drive to be part of an organization at the forefront of the industry, delivering benefits for patients, our people, and our business. Moreover, you bring:

The Business Analytics Lead will report to the Head of Business Analytics & Competitive Intelligence and be a member of the wider Strategy & Growth team. The Position is based in Vienna, Austria. This is a global role and up to 30% travel (largely international) is required.

Your upcoming mission:
Within this role, your responsibilities will fall into these main areas:

Business Analytics & KPI Strategy & Orchestration

• You explore, develop, implement and evaluation innovative business analytic solutions to meet customer needs (internal and external)

• You act as a bridge between traditionally siloed data sets (e.g. Finance, Portfolio, CX, Sales) in order to inform RIS Patient Insights business decisions and promote alignment with RIS Patient Insights Strategy

• You lead key strategic initiatives related to RIS Patient Insights-wide data analytics (e.g. executive dashboard creation; transversal governance data requirement / definition) – developing and coordinating project plans with stakeholders to deliver to expectations

• You collaborate with other business intelligence functions (incl. Finance, Commercial) to harmonize and simply the KPI identification, gathering, collection and visualization processes

• You work with technical colleagues in R&D and IT, identifying business requirements related to data analytics and supporting development of solutions that meet customer requirements (internal and external)

• Customer Solution Business Analytics & KPIs

• You serve as the single source of truth for RIS Patient Insights customer portfolio metrics

• You collaborate with product, service and solution development and pipeline key stakeholders to define key performance metrics for all RIS Patient Insights solutions – tracking product development, commercialization and use

• You serve as the accountable business owner of key reporting solutions (e.g. Tableau), serving as a ‘super user’ able to interrogate data and translate it into actionable insight

• You provide expertise with respect to portfolio analytics and key strategic recommendations that facilitate trade-off discussions

• Leadership & Growth Mindset

• You serve as a coach and mentor, building competencies in business analytics via training, education of methods, tools and frameworks

• You promote insights-backed development and data-driven decision making, developing content and delivering presentations (internal and extern

jobs.title: Contract Records Processor - French speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:
As a Contract Records Processor, you are responsible for establishing governance for contract records management, implementing modern archiving methodology, screening, summarizing, and entering legal contract data to provide complete, accurate profiles of contracts in Contract Lifecycle Management System (CLM) and ensuring adherence to document retention policies across Roche affiliates.

• Utilizing ticketing system for incoming requests and issues

• Support end users and requesters on system related questions, trainings, providing consultancy services on existing functionalities of the system

• Utilizing multiple data sources to confirm and update contract data in contract data migration collection sheet

• Reviewing data in database to check for completeness and accuracy

• Managing multiple data cleanup for different Groups simultaneously

• Work with team members within Global Procurement to achieve project uniformity and provide feedback of project tasks

• Coordinate project duties with other team members

Who you are:

• Have a passion for accuracy and organizational skills, which are applied to database correction and standardization

• Are skilled in writing and interpersonal communications, ample business/functional knowledge to understand complex data and detailed instructions

jobs.title: Government Affairs Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In an Organization with big ambition, there is opportunity to make meaningful change a reality. Our mission is to deliver better outcomes for more patients faster. It is worth our hard work and innovation.
The Government Affairs Partner is a full time role in Algiers. His/Her mission is to focus on shaping public policy to instigate system change in the Algerian healthcare environment.

The role:
Optimize system change through Public Policy

• Develops a Roche Algeria Public Policy strategy to shape and future proof the Algerian Healthcare environment for innovative technologies.

• Navigating political landscape and delivering projects with relevant stakeholders e.g.: Government Industry Associations, Advocacy Groups, Journalists, KOLs, Decision Makers and all stakeholders within the healthcare system

• Identifies opportunities to shape policy in collaboration with Primary Points of Contact (Patient Journey Partners & Healthcare System Partners)

• Identifies opportunities to enhance Roche’s reputation and positioning as a preferred and impactful partner for sustainable healthcare.

• Provides in-depth knowledge and insight on healthcare legalization, keeping relevant internal stakeholders up-to-date with any changes.

• Liaises with Regional counterparts on Public Policy projects to ensure shared learning and efficient delivery of initiatives.

• Collaborates closely with internal Stakeholders to ensure alignment of objectives and coordination of activities.

• Leads the production of high quality internal/external responses to relevant policies and discussion documents as required.

• Works with the GM on key policies shifts.

• Provides support to PPOCs on issues of a political or healthcare policy, to deliver on company mission to get better outcomes, for more patients, faster.

Corporate Communications:

• Contribute to the delivery of Policy inputs into an integrated communications plan aligned to Roche Algeria key goals

• Ensure an understanding of Healthcare environmental influences to direct the development of communications strategies aligned to healthcare policy opportunities.

Compliance / Monitoring:

• Agree KPIs in line with Policy Plan and monitor regularly to ensure appropriate action taken

• Take personal responsibility for maintaining high ethical standards and operating in compliance with local and global policies.

Who you are:

• You have a knowledge of Algeria Healthcare and General Health policy and understanding of how this is shaped.

• You have a strong networking and influencing skills to facilitate stakeholder engagement.

• You have and excellent written and oral communication skills to facilitate communicating complex information clearly internally and Externally (Arabic, French and English)

• You have good Interpersonal Skills

• You are a self-starter with demonstrable ability to plan both strategically and tactically and to effectively prioritize tasks.

• You adept at project management to coordinate project delivery perhaps requiring managing of third party inputs to time and budget.

• You have the ability to successfully navigate regulatory and legislative environment

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics p

jobs.title: Healthcare System Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Local customer facing role driving Healthcare System Innovation

• Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.

• The Healthcare System Partner (HSP) is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche working closely with system-level healthcare stakeholders such as policy makers, regulators, and payers.

• The HSP identifies shared purpose and value, co-creates solutions and co-implements them across ecosystems, indirectly impacting outcomes for thousands of patients

• By doing so the HSP will be directly accountable to challenge and shape the healthcare system in service of better health outcomes for more patients faster in a sustainable way to society

The role :

• The HSP partners with healthcare system stakeholders to drive healthcare system innovation and unlock possibilities to deliver value for the ecosystem and society

• As part of this, the HSP contributes to identifying, mapping, engaging and managing ecosystem stakeholders.

• The HSP acts as a trusted partner and the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche. She or he shares the stakeholder community vision and value internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• The Healthcare System Partner lives the Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst (VACC) model, acts as catalyst and coach externally and internally.

• The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other Healthcare System Partners and Patient Journey Partners.

• HSP works to develop and execute access effective strategies that will ensure fast patient access to our innovative solutions.

• HSP works closely with Global Access, Communities of Practices and other internal stakeholders in building and tailoring value propositions for local context.

• The HSP looks across the individual ecosystem and catalyzes our ability to see broader trends and patterns in healthcare systems. They need to bring outside insights into Roche to influence strategy AND to bring our expertise, science and knowledge out to shape policy and drive ecosystem improvement

Who you are:
The HSP demonstrates personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem, both locally and for Roche more broadly. They think from an Enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, in order to bring the best possible outcomes to both the local health environment, and more broadly, across Roche globally.

• Visionary: defining and embedding the strategy around creating better health outcomes for more patients faster

• Mindset:
• Strong entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand)

• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche

• Self managed and self directed - altruistic in supporting the global network

• Display of integrity in everything (i.e. open, honest, ethical and genuine)

• Enabler mindset leveraging the internal and external networks to create value, sharing back and scaling.

• Boldly acts on key decisions and opportunities and boldly stops any activity that is not add

• The Healthcare System Partner (HSP) is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche working closely with system-level healthcare stakeholders such as policy makers, regulators, and payers.
• The HSP identifies shared purpose and value, co-creates solutions and co-implements them across ecosystems, indirectly impacting outcomes for thousands of patients
• By doing so the HSP will be directly accountable to challenge and shape the healthcare system in service of better health outcomes for more patients faster in a sustainable way to society The role :
• The HSP partners with healthcare system stakeholders to drive healthcare system innovation and unlock possibilities to deliver value for the ecosystem and society
• As part of this, the HSP contributes to identifying, mapping, engaging and managing ecosystem stakeholders.
• The HSP acts as a trusted partner and the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche. She or he shares the stakeholder community vision and value internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.
• The Healthcare System Partner lives the Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst (VACC) model, acts as catalyst and coach externally and internally.
• The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other Healthcare System Partners and Patient Journey Partners.
• HSP works to develop and execute access effective strategies that will ensure fast patient access to our innovative solutions.
• HSP works closely with Global Access, Communities of Practices and other internal stakeholders in building and tailoring value propositions for local context.
• The HSP looks across the individual ecosystem and catalyzes our ability to see broader trends and patterns in healthcare systems. They need to bring outside insights into Roche to influence strategy AND to bring our expertise, science and knowledge out to shape policy and drive ecosystem improvement Who you are: The HSP demonstrates personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem, both locally and for Roche more broadly. They think from an Enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, in order to bring the best possible outcomes to both the local health environment, and more broadly, across Roche globally.
• Visionary: defining and embedding the strategy around creating better health outcomes for more patients faster
• Mindset:
• Strong entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand)
• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche
• Self managed and self directed - altruistic in supporting the global network
• Display of integrity in everything (i.e. open, honest, ethical and genuine)
• Enabler mindset leveraging the internal and external networks to create value, sharing back and scaling.
• Boldly acts on key decisions and opportunities and boldly stops any activity that is not add

jobs.title: Drug Regulatory Affairs Partner

titleByLocale.it: Partner per gli Affari Regolatori dei Farmaci
titleByLocale.fr: Partenaires en matière de réglementation des médicaments

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Drug Regulatory Affairs Partner’s responsibilities are typically for regulatory activities across the product lifecycle, from early development through post-marketing activities. Develops and manages execution of regulatory strategies, regulatory projects, regulatory submissions and associated activities to ensure rapid and optimal registration for new products and indications, as well as line extensions and ensuring the effective and compliant regulatory maintenance of existing products. With teams, have interactions with local health authorities. With teams, develops and cultivates external relationships, such as with health authorities and other stakeholders or influencers. Ensures regulatory activities result in the timely approval and broadest use of products. Ensures regulatory activities are appropriately aligned with regional and global regulatory direction and guidance. Ensures timely, accurate and compliant regulatory documentation, standards, systems and procedures for regulatory activities. Helps ensure affiliate inspection-readiness at all times, as this relates to regulatory documentation and other regulatory activities. May participate in internal and external audits and post-auditing activities to address audit findings. Selects, develops and evaluates employees ensuring the efficient operation of the function.

The role:
Strategy/planning:

• Shape the regulatory environment by taking leadership roles in industry associations on regulatory policy and regulations.

• Contribute to and influence global regulation and business needs.

• Own regulatory intelligence gathering and dissemination across the Affiliate; involving regional and global organizations when appropriate.

• Lead regulatory affairs input into cross functional Affiliate business strategies (e.g. market access, medical affairs, promotional activities, public policy, technical assessments, technical agreements, local manufacturing/packaging activities, legal issues, etc...)

• Lead and develop innovative, risk-based regulatory strategies and work plans for all products across the Affiliate to accelerate access in alignment with global.

Fillings:

• Lead and provide strategic oversight of execution of all regulatory filling activities across product lifecycles, which may involve performing some of the work of DRA staff.

• Lead contact and negotiation with local Has and internal stakeholders to build and cultivate trusted partnerships.

• Ensure regulatory filings are aligned with commercial and supply needs to ensure business continuity significantly influence internal and external stakeholders for successful regulatory outcomes.

Regulatory compliance:

• Develop and maintain current knowledge of international and local regulations and other governing regulatory practices, policies, procedures, systems and standards.

• Ensure regulatory inspection-readiness for the Affiliate, including leading or participating in internal/external regulatory audits.

• Ensure all Affiliate regulatory activities comply with Roche global standards and local regulations.

Other:

• Oversee and guide end-to-end local product packaging and labelling from a regulatory perspective.

• Where applicable, oversee review and approvals of promotional materials to provide regulatory input and guidance across the Affiliate.

• As applicable, provide oversight of shipment clearance/QA release of Affiliate materials/products.

• Support local access market activities from a regulatory perspective.

• Overse

jobs.title: Praktikum bei MSAT Analytics (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung

Unser 14-köpfiges Team, bestehend aus Analytikern, Projektleitern und Gruppenleiter im Bereich der molekularbiologischen Analytik, freut sich auf tatkräftige Unterstützung von einem hilfsbereiten und flexiblen neuen Teammitglied. Du solltest Spaß an neuen Herausforderungen haben und Dich in unsere positive Arbeitsatmosphäre einfügen.

Wir möchten Dir als Praktikant (m/w/d) einen Einblick in das „ daily business “ im Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) Umfeld geben. Dabei wirst Du auch die Möglichkeit haben, Dich selbstständig mit Projektarbeiten zu befassen, um bestehende Prozesse zu optimieren.

Deine Aufgaben

• Unterstützung unserer Projektarbeiten im Bereich Design Transfer & Product Care

• Analytik von molekularbiologischen und biochemischen und Einsatzstoffen im diagnostischen Umfeld

Dein Profil

• Du bist aktuell in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium (Bachelor oder Master in Biochemie / Molekularbiologie / Lebensmittelchemie / Life Science) immatrikuliert oder Du befindest Dich in Deinem Gap-Year zwischen diesen beiden

• Kenntnisse in der molekularbiologische / biochemische Analytik (insbesondere qPCR & Nukleinsäureaufreinigung, wie auch Zellkultur )

• Du bist motiviert, neugierig und möchtest Dich und Deine Ideen einbringen

• solide Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate

• Vernetzungsmöglichkeiten für Deine weitere Karriereplanung

• Vergünstigte Preise in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Zugang zu unserem Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boarding House während des Praktikums

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte beachte, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation richtet oder alternativ an Personen im Gap-Year zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium.

Für Deine Bewerbung benötigen wir ausschließlich Deinen vollständigen Lebenslauf.

Zeitraum: Flexibel im Zeitraum August bis Oktober für die Gesamtdauer des Praktikums von 6 Monaten

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il tuo dipartimento Il nostro team di 14 membri, composto da analisti, project manager e leader di gruppo nel campo dell'analisi della biologia molecolare, è impaziente di sostenere attivamente un nuovo membro del team disponibile e flessibile. Si dovrebbe godere di nuove sfide e adattarsi alla nostra atmosfera di lavoro positiva. In qualità di tirocinante, vorremmo darvi una panoramica dell’ambiente di Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT). jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Roche’s sequencing and pathology product portfolios.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a highly autonomous, deep-dive technical investigator. You masterfully dissect complex, edge-case software failures, bridging the gap between field trouble-shooting and core R&D development teams. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity

• You are accountable for handling complex software complaints for our sequencing and pathology products, like safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as a senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause/causal factor of software malfunctions. You master the Roche internal quality processes and understand their regulatory background to justify decisions.

• You are an interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

• You serve as a trusted technical proxy for the Principal Engineer when required.

Who You Are

• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an IT related field (preferred) with knowledge of bioinformatics or genomics. Advanced degrees (Master’s or Ph.D.) are a plus but not required.

• 5+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Bioinformatics or IT support related functions

• Strong IT skills, especially the ability to read and debug complex source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues

• Good ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty.

• Good ability to present technical work to stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

Locations
This is a primarily onsite position in Tucson, Arizona.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson Arizona is $77,280 and $143,520. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifi

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), sarai in prima linea nel garantire la qualità e le prestazioni delle soluzioni digitali di Roche, trattando reclami relativi ai portafogli dei prodotti di sequenziamento e patologia di Roche. Unire il Capitolo Soluzioni Digitali significa lavorare in un ambiente software altamente trasversale, dandovi l'opportunità di impegnarsi con tecnologie all'avanguardia e linguaggi di programmazione diversi per il software on-premise e cloud-based. La vostra missione principale sarà di agire come un investigatore tecnico altamente autonomo e profondo. Si distinguono i guasti complessi, bordure i guasti del software, colmare il divario tra i team di sviluppo R&D di campo e risoluzione dei problemi di campo. Mentre la vostra attenzione è sull'analisi della causa principale, non sarete responsabili per le correzioni di bug finali. Questo ruolo è ambientato in un ambiente Agile dove le tue idee e le tue proposte innovative sono altamente apprezzate, contribuendo direttamente a un team focalizzato sul miglioramento continuo. L'opportunità
• Sei responsabile per la gestione di reclami software complessi per i nostri prodotti di sequenziamento e patologia, come problemi di sicurezza e richieste di prodotti software (su premessa, cloud, mobile, applicazioni,...).
• Potrai gestire in modo indipendente l'intero ciclo di vita dei casi, dalla creazione iniziale e classificazione alle indagini approfondite, collaborazione con il team di risoluzione dei problemi in loco, documentazione e risoluzione finale. Per i casi che non possono essere risolti direttamente, si prende la proprietà di aumentare al reparto sviluppo.
• Si agisce come esperto tecnico senior per la risoluzione dei casi, utilizzando la capacità di leggere e comprendere il codice sorgente complesso per identificare la causa principale / fattore causale di malfunzionamenti software. Si padroneggia i processi di qualità interna Roche e capire il loro background normativo per giustificare le decisioni.
• Sei un'interfaccia con affiliati e organizzazioni di paese. Sarete responsabili della comunicazione tempestiva delle informazioni essenziali e delle iniziative di supporto alla qualità che migliorano i nostri partenariati regionali.
• Utilizzi le tue capacità di automazione e analisi dei dati per migliorare il processo di gestione dei casi e monitorare proattivamente i dati sulle prestazioni dei prodotti
• Serve come un proxy tecnico affidabile per l'Ingegnere Principale quando necessario. Chi sei
• Una laurea in Informatica o un campo relativo IT (preferito) con conoscenza di bioinformatica o genomica. I gradi avanzati (Master o Ph.D.) sono un plus ma non richiesto.
• 5+ anni di comprovata traccia di lavoro nell'area della Bioinformatica o funzioni correlate supporto IT
• Forti competenze IT, in particolare la capacità di leggere e debug codice sorgente complesso di diversi linguaggi di programmazione per comprendere la causa principale dei problemi segnalati
• Buona capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente anche di fronte all'incertezza.
• Buona capacità di presentare il lavoro tecnico alle parti interessate, influenzare e negoziare per spingere avanti iniziative
• Forte capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato) Località Questa posizione è principalmente in loco a Tucson, Arizona. Le prestazioni di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa posizione. L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione in base alla posizione principale di Tucson Arizona è $77,280 e $143,520. La retribuzione effettiva sarà determinata in base all'esperienza, alle qualifiche, alla posizione geografica e ad altri fattori legati al lavoro consentiti dalla legge. Un bonus annuale discrezionale può essere disponibile in base alle prestazioni individuali e aziendali. Questa posizione anche qualifi

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Als Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ) sind Sie an vorderster Front dabei, die Qualität und Leistung der digitalen Lösungen von Roche zu gewährleisten und Beschwerden im Zusammenhang mit den Sequenzierungs- und Pathologie-Produktportfolios von Roche zu bearbeiten. Der Beitritt zum Digital Solutions Chapter bedeutet, in einer hochgradig transversalen Softwareumgebung zu arbeiten und Ihnen die Möglichkeit zu geben, sich mit innovativen Technologien und verschiedenen Programmiersprachen für On-Premise- und Cloud-basierte Software zu beschäftigen. Ihre Kernaufgabe wird es sein, als hoch autonomer, tiefgehender technischer Ermittler zu agieren. Sie sezieren meisterhaft komplexe, Edge-Case-Softwarefehler und schließen die Lücke zwischen der Fehlersuche im Feld und den Kernteams für F & E-Entwicklung. Während Sie sich auf die Ursachenanalyse konzentrieren, sind Sie nicht für die endgültigen Fehlerbehebungen verantwortlich. Diese Rolle spielt in einer agilen Umgebung, in der Ihre innovativen Ideen und Vorschläge hoch geschätzt werden und direkt zu einem Team beitragen, das sich auf kontinuierliche Verbesserung konzentriert. Die Chance
• Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, komplexe Softwarebeschwerden für unsere Sequenzierungs- und Pathologieprodukte wie Sicherheitsprobleme und Produktanfragen für Softwareprodukte (vor Ort, Cloud, Mobile, Apps, ...) zu bearbeiten.
• Sie werden den gesamten Falllebenszyklus unabhängig verwalten, von der anfänglichen Erstellung und Klassifizierung bis hin zur eingehenden Untersuchung, der Zusammenarbeit mit dem Problembehandlungsteam vor Ort, der Dokumentation und der endgültigen Lösung. In Fällen, die nicht direkt gelöst werden können, übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Eskalation an die Entwicklungsabteilung.
• Sie fungieren als leitender technischer Experte für die Falllösung und nutzen Ihre Fähigkeit, komplexen Quellcode zu lesen und zu verstehen, um die Ursache / den ursächlichen Faktor von Softwarestörungen zu identifizieren. Sie beherrschen die Roche internen Qualitätsprozesse und verstehen deren regulatorischen Hintergrund, um Entscheidungen zu rechtfertigen.
• Sie sind eine Schnittstelle zu Affiliates und Länderorganisationen. Sie sind für die zeitnahe Kommunikation wesentlicher qualitätsbezogener Informationen und die Unterstützung von Initiativen zur Stärkung unserer regionalen Partnerschaften verantwortlich.
• Sie nutzen Ihre Automatisierungs- und Datenanalysefähigkeiten, um den Fallbearbeitungsprozess zu verbessern und die Produktleistungsdaten proaktiv zu überwachen
• Sie dienen bei Bedarf als vertrauenswürdiger technischer Proxy für den Principal Engineer. Wer du bist
• Ein Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik oder einem IT-bezogenen Bereich (bevorzugt) mit Kenntnissen der Bioinformatik oder Genomik. Fortgeschrittene Abschlüsse (Master oder Ph.D.) sind ein Plus, aber nicht erforderlich.
• 5+ Jahre nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz im Bereich Bioinformatik oder IT-Support-Funktionen
• Starke IT-Fähigkeiten, insbesondere die Fähigkeit, komplexen Quellcode verschiedener Programmiersprachen zu lesen und zu debuggen, um die Ursache der gemeldeten Probleme zu verstehen
• Gute Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten, auch wenn sie mit Unsicherheit konfrontiert sind.
• Gute Fähigkeit, technische Arbeit den Stakeholdern zu präsentieren, zu beeinflussen und zu verhandeln, um Initiativen voranzutreiben

jobs.title: R&D Engineer (m/w/w) innerhalb R&D Diagnostics
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Möchtest Du die Zukunft der Diagnostik aktiv mitgestalten? In der Abteilung Enzyme Technologies arbeiten wir mit Leidenschaft daran, maßgeschneiderte Enzyme für alle globalen Roche-Testplattformen zu bewerten, zu entwickeln und zu produzieren. Als R&D Engineer (m/w/d) wirst Du Teil eines dynamischen Teams, das durch biochemische Innovationen direkt zu präziseren Diagnosen und damit zur Gesundheit von Patient:innen weltweit beitragen.

Die Chance

• Du stellst innovative Enzymvarianten mittels Mutagenese, Rekombination, mikrobieller Proteinexpression und modernster Enzymreinigung im Labor her.

• Du verantwortest und optimierst Downstream-Prozesse (DSP) und führst präzise Enzymassays sowie biochemische Charakterisierungen durch.

• Du entwickelst und etablierst neue, zukunftsweisende Methoden zur Enzymherstellung im kleinen wie im großen Maßstab.

• Du bewertest Enzyme für interne und externe Partner.

• Du begleitest den Technologietransfer entwickelter Enzyme und Prozess in die globalen Produktionseinheiten.

• Du hältst Deine Forschungsergebnisse nach modernen Standards in elektronischen Laborbüchern (ELN) fest und präsentierst deine Ergebnisse souverän in interdisziplinären Projektteams.

Wer du bist

• Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes naturwissenschaftliches Studium (z. B. Biologie, Biotechnologie, Chemie, Biochemie, Life Sciences, Bioprozesstechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation).

• Idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrung im Laborumfeld, vorzugsweise in der mikrobiellen Proteinexpression, der biochemischen Assayentwicklung und/oder der Proteinreinigung (DSP).

• Ein breites Verständnis der Biochemie und Enzymkinetik, sowie erste Berührungspunkte mit Proteindesign (Modellierung), Bioinformatik-Tools (z.B. Genious, PyMOL) und Software zur statistischen Versuchsplanung (DoE – Design of Experiments), z.B. JMP.

• Eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Freude an agiler Teamarbeit sowie Offenheit für neue Technologien und digitale Tools.

• Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- (Niveau C1) und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und

• Schrift (Niveau B2), um sich problemlos im globalen Roche-Netzwerk auszutauschen, runden Dein Profil ab.

Diese Position ist auf zwei Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung

Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf und relevante Zeugnisse.

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Vuoi plasmare attivamente il futuro della diagnostica? Nel dipartimento Enzyme Technologies, siamo appassionati di valutazione, sviluppo e produzione di enzimi su misura per tutte le piattaforme di test globali Roche. Come ingegnere R&D (m/f/d), diventerai parte di un team dinamico che contribuisce direttamente a diagnosticare più precise e quindi alla salute dei pazienti in tutto il mondo attraverso innovazioni biochimiche. L'opportunità
• Si producono innovative varianti di enzimi utilizzando la mutagenesi, la ricombinazione, l'espressione di proteine microbiche e la purificazione degli enzimi all'avanguardia in laboratorio.
• Sei responsabile e ottimizza i processi a valle (DSP) ed esegue analisi enzimatiche precise e caratterizzazioni biochimiche.
• Sviluppi e crei nuovi metodi previsionali per la produzione di enzimi su larga scala.
• Valuta gli enzimi per i partner interni ed esterni.
• Potrai accompagnare il trasferimento tecnologico di enzimi sviluppati e processo nelle unità di produzione globali.
• Si registrano i risultati della ricerca secondo gli standard moderni nei libri elettronici di laboratorio (ELN) e presentano i risultati con fiducia in team di progetto interdisciplinari. Chi sei
• Hai completato con successo una laurea scientifica (ad esempio biologia, biotecnologia, chimica, biochimica, scienze della vita, ingegneria del bioprocesso o una qualifica simile).
• Idealmente, prima esperienza pratica in ambiente di laboratorio, preferibilmente in espressione proteica microbica, sviluppo di analisi biochimica e/o purificazione proteica (DSP).
• Una vasta comprensione della biochimica e della cinetica degli enzimi, così come i punti iniziali di contatto con il design delle proteine (modello), gli strumenti di bioinformatica (ad esempio Genious, PyMOL) e il software per la pianificazione statistica degli esperimenti (DoE – Design of Experiments), ad esempio JMP.
• Un modo strutturato di lavorare, il godimento del lavoro di squadra agile e l'apertura a nuove tecnologie e strumenti digitali.
• Eccellente tedesco (livello C1) e ottime competenze in inglese in parola e
• Font (livello B2), al fine di scambiare facilmente idee nella rete globale Roche, completare il tuo profilo. Questo articolo è limitato a due anni. La tua domanda Vi chiediamo i seguenti documenti:
• CV corrente e certificati pertinenti. Attualmente non sono necessari ulteriori documenti. Prima di presentare la domanda, si prega di notare che non è possibile aggiungere ulteriori documenti in seguito. Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione! Il tuo contatto con noi! Con la gente. Per le persone. Hai bisogno di ulteriore supporto? Date un'occhiata alle nostre FAQ, le troverete via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

jobs.title: Especialista en Comercio Exterior
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Experto en Comercio Exterior en el área de Finanzas y Operaciones, tendrás la oportunidad única de liderar y optimizar de extremo a extremo la cadena de suministro internacional para nuestras operaciones. En este rol, trabajarás de forma integral con otros departamentos para garantizar la disponibilidad oportuna de nuestro portafolio de productos, generando un mayor valor para los pacientes. Formarás parte de un entorno colaborativo y dinámico que vive diariamente los comportamientos de We@Roche Diagnostics.

La Oportunidad:

• Supervisas y optimizas el flujo de importaciones y exportaciones de materiales, coordinando el transporte internacional con forwarders para garantizar el cumplimiento de las ventanas de entrega.

• Gestionas y validas la documentación comercial (facturas, certificados de origen, listas de empaque y BL/AWB) para asegurar la correcta internación de mercancías y la óptima aplicación de preferencias arancelarias.

• Evalúas y controlas el desempeño (KPIs) de agentes aduanales, forwarders y operadores logísticos (3PL) mediante comités de revisión operativa orientados a la mejora continua.

• Diseñas e implementas matrices de riesgo y estrategias preventivas en las operaciones de comercio exterior para mitigar incidencias y asegurar la operación aduanera.

• Coordinas sinergias con el área regulatoria para la obtención oportuna de información normativa, incluyendo certificaciones, NOMs mexicanas y trámites ante COFEPRIS.

• Actúas como consultor estratégico en los equipos de lanzamientos de nuevos productos y estudios clínicos, definiendo la viabilidad logística, regulatoria y arancelaria desde etapas tempranas.

• Auditas y autorizas el registro y seguimiento de las cuentas de gastos del agente aduanal, garantizando eficiencias presupuestales y el cumplimiento de condiciones contractuales.

• Aseguras el cumplimiento fiscal en las operaciones aduaneras mediante la generación de reportes de aranceles pagados en estrecha colaboración con el área de impuestos.

Quién eres:

• Cuentas con un título universitario concluido (Cédula Profesional vigente) y conocimientos generales en administración de contratos y cadena de suministro.

• Posees manejo avanzado del idioma inglés.

• Posees un dominio avanzado del marco normativo del comercio exterior en México, incluyendo la Ley Aduanera y las Reglas Generales de Comercio Exterior (RGCE) vigentes.

• Tienes experiencia en la gestión preventiva de auditorías del SAT, interpretación de actualizaciones de la Secretaría de Economía (SE) y la obtención o mantenimiento de certificaciones como IVA/IEPS u OEA.

• Demuestras experiencia sólida en la negociación y manejo de proveedores, contratos de cadena de suministro y gestión con agentes aduanales, forwarders y operadores logísticos (3PL).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As Team Lead Engineering Commercial Pharma International Engagement Lead (CRM, Field, VOC, Events) (Senior Engineering Manager) you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area

This role serves as the engagement lead for end-to-end customer engagement within the Pharma International region, encompassing the strategic oversight of CRM, Voice of Customer (VoC), and field integration. As a specialized ecosystem, the CRM space is designed to streamline relationships with healthcare professionals and patients while ensuring strict regulatory compliance across global markets. The system centralizes stakeholder data to enable personalized, omnichannel engagement across digital and in-person channels, supported by automated processes such as strategic account planning and sample management. By integrating VoC insights directly into these workflows, the platform ensures that field teams can refine their account strategies based on real-time customer feedback and preferences. Beyond execution, the CRM acts as a strategic hub for data-based insights, utilizing dashboards to monitor how effectively the organization is delivering on its customer-centricity goals while maintaining audit-ready documentation for legal requirements. Ultimately, this environment breaks down departmental silos to foster seamless collaboration between sales, marketing, and medical teams through a unified source of truth.

Job responsibilities

• Team Member Capability and Career Development 

• Proactively identifies and develops future-focused engineering team capabilities, aligning with long-term strategic goals.

• Mentors team members on long-term career paths, creating new opportunities and roles within the organization to support their growth.

• Addresses and helps resolve complex, systemic roadblocks that impact multiple development teams, and coaches other managers on effective performance management.

• Oversees the technical and soft skill development, ensuring a balanced and high-performing talent portfolio.

​

• Team Health and Sustainability 

• Establishes and monitors metrics for team health and sustainability across several development teams, implementing strategies to ensure long-term balance.

• Designs and implements initiatives to improve collaboration and psychological safety across multiple related development teams or a whole product area.

• Proactively identifies and resolves systemic impediments that affect multiple development teams, improving the overall work environment.

• Manages the talent composition for own and related teams, planning for future needs and ensuring a healthy pipeline of skills.

• Product and Service Delivery Leadership ⚙️

• Responsible for co-creating the long-term technical vision and strategy for a product portfolio, partnering with Product Managers and Leaders who are overall responsible for the roadmaps.

• Accountable for

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Così ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso alla sanità oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione di team lead engineering Commercial Pharma International Engagement Lead (CRM, Field, VOC, Events) (Senior Engineering Manager) ti concentrerà sullo sviluppo delle capacità dei tuoi membri del team che si allineano alla visione di function.s. Incoraggi il tuo team a definirsi autonomamente il loro percorso di carriera e a cercare modi per consentire opportunità di sviluppo nella direzione del viaggio. Li sosterrai nella rimozione dei blocchi stradali e ponendo l'accento sulla loro gestione delle prestazioni. Supporti il software e/o il servizio come obiettivo di riferimento, eliminando gli ostacoli, gestendo gli stakeholder e creando efficienze in collaborazione ove possibile. Descrizione dell'area Questo ruolo funge da lead di engagement per l'impegno dei clienti end-to-end all'interno della regione Pharma International, che comprende la supervisione strategica di CRM, Voice of Customer (VoC), e l'integrazione sul campo. Come ecosistema specializzato, lo spazio CRM è progettato per semplificare i rapporti con professionisti e pazienti sanitari garantendo nel contempo una rigorosa conformità normativa sui mercati globali. Il sistema centralizza i dati degli stakeholder per consentire l'impegno personalizzato e omnicanale attraverso canali digitali e personalizzati, supportati da processi automatizzati come la pianificazione strategica degli account e la gestione dei campioni. Incorporando le informazioni VoC direttamente in questi flussi di lavoro, la piattaforma assicura che i team di settore possano perfezionare le loro strategie di account in base a feedback e preferenze in tempo reale dei clienti. Oltre all'esecuzione, il CRM funge da hub strategico per le intuizioni basate sui dati, utilizzando dashboard per monitorare l'efficacia dell'organizzazione che sta portando sui suoi obiettivi di customer-centrity mantenendo la documentazione audit-ready per i requisiti legali. In definitiva, questo ambiente rompe i silos dipartimentali per promuovere la collaborazione senza soluzione di continuità tra vendite, marketing e team medici attraverso una fonte unificata di verità. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Capacità dei membri del team e sviluppo della carriera.
• Identifica e sviluppa proattivamente le capacità del team di ingegneria focalizzate sul futuro, allineandosi con obiettivi strategici a lungo termine.
• Membri del team dei Mentors su percorsi di carriera a lungo termine, creando nuove opportunità e ruoli all'interno dell'organizzazione per sostenere la loro crescita.
• Indirizzi e aiuta a risolvere complessi blocchi stradali sistemici che hanno un impatto su più team di sviluppo e allena altri manager su una gestione efficace delle prestazioni.
• Sovraintende lo sviluppo tecnico e delle competenze soft, garantendo un portafoglio di talenti equilibrato e performante.
• Salute e sostenibilità del team.
• Stabilisce e monitora le metriche per la salute e la sostenibilità del team in diversi team di sviluppo, implementando strategie per garantire l'equilibrio a lungo termine.
• Progetta e implementa iniziative per migliorare la collaborazione e la sicurezza psicologica in più team di sviluppo correlati o in un'intera area di prodotto.
• Identifica e risolve proattivamente gli ostacoli sistemici che colpiscono più team di sviluppo, migliorando l'ambiente di lavoro complessivo.
• Gestisce la composizione dei talenti per team propri e correlati, progettando le esigenze future e garantendo una sana pipeline di competenze.
• Leadership di consegna di prodotti e servizi
• Responsabile della creazione di una visione tecnica e strategia a lungo termine per un portafoglio di prodotti, collaborando con i Product Manager e i Leader che sono complessivamente responsabili delle roadmap.
• Accountable for

Le poste de chef d'équipe Ingénieur Commercial Pharma International Engagement Leader (CRM, Field, COV, Events) (Directeur de l'ingénierie) vous concentrerez votre attention sur le développement des capacités des membres de votre équipe qui s'alignent sur la fonction, la vision. Vous encouragerez votre équipe à définir leur parcours professionnel et à chercher des moyens de permettre des opportunités de développement dans la direction du parcours. Vous les accompagnerez dans la suppression des obstacles routiers et en se concentrant sur leur gestion de la performance. Vous soutenez la prestation de logiciels et/ou de services comme un point de repère de choix, en éliminant les obstacles, en gérant les intervenants et en créant des gains d'efficacité en collaboration dans la mesure du possible. Description du domaine Ce rôle sert de chef de file pour l'engagement des clients de bout en bout dans la région de Pharma International, qui englobe la surveillance stratégique de la CRM, de la Voix du Client (VoC) et de l'intégration sur le terrain. • Capacité et perfectionnement professionnel des membres de l'équipe
• Identifier et développer de façon proactive les capacités de l'équipe d'ingénierie axée sur l'avenir, en s'harmonisant avec les objectifs stratégiques à long terme.
• Les membres de l'équipe de mentors sur les cheminements de carrière à long terme, en créant de nouvelles opportunités et de nouveaux rôles au sein de l'organisation pour soutenir leur croissance.
• S'attaquer et aider à résoudre les obstacles complexes et systémiques qui influent sur les équipes de développement multiples et entraîner d'autres gestionnaires sur une gestion efficace du rendement.
• Supervise le développement technique et le soft qualificing, assurant un portefeuille de talents équilibré et performant.
• Team Health and Sustainability,
• Établit et surveille des mesures pour la santé et la durabilité des équipes dans plusieurs équipes de développement, mettant en œuvre des stratégies pour assurer un équilibre à long terme.
• Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des initiatives pour améliorer la collaboration et la sécurité psychologique entre les équipes de développement multiples ou tout un domaine de produits.
• Identifier et résoudre de manière proactive les obstacles systémiques qui affectent les équipes de développement multiples, en améliorant l'environnement de travail global.
• Gérer la composition des talents pour ses équipes et les équipes qui s'y rattachent, planifier les besoins futurs et assurer un bassin de compétences sain.
• Leadership de la prestation des produits et des services - - Responsable de la co-réalisation de la vision et de la stratégie techniques à long terme pour un portefeuille de produits, partenariat avec les gestionnaires de produits et les dirigeants qui sont globalement responsables des feuilles de route.

jobs.title: Digital Campaigns Subchapter Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Position summary: As a Subchapter Lead in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure delivery on long-term outcomes and strategy, embed and role model the new agile operating model, and inspire subchapter members to collaborate globally towards Roche’s Ten-Year Ambitions while shaping the Hub’s future by building cutting-edge digital capabilities (e.g., Social Media, Website Management, Creative Design, Digital Campaigns, Marketing Automation & Digital Operations), supporting colleagues’ development, driving innovation and value creation, and leading a diverse global team.

The Opportunity:

• Coordinate the operation of the subchapter and the Digital Campaign Chapter within the Global Digital Hub: onboard and develop team members through coaching and support, ensure they have the proficiency to execute work packages and deliver objectives, continuously improve ways of working, and professionally represent the subchapter with key stakeholders.

• Drive and role model agile collaboration and the embedding of the new operating model, support and lead cross-functional initiatives with a global perspective, and contribute recommendations to improve service and responsiveness to business partners.

• Oversee resource management by monitoring resource utilization and customer satisfaction within the subchapter, quickly and effectively engaging resources via formal and informal networks, and working closely with Digital Hub Chapter Leads.

• Foster capability development and talent management: find, attract, develop, and retain diverse talent aligned with evolving function and business needs, and support the embedding of the OneRoche mindset within the chapter and across the Global Digital Hub.

• Lead Business Process Management as a center of excellence by establishing process governance principles, maintaining proper documentation, and partnering with other Subchapter Leads and RSS organizations to align on strategic priorities, accelerate decision-making, ease bottlenecks, and maximize business impact.

Who you are :
We are looking for upbeat, dynamic individuals who are highly involved and passionate about digital campaigns and willing to learn more about digital campaign management. As a Subchapter Lead, you are a person who enjoys teamwork and has the ability to work in a fast-paced global environment.
You are a proactive, innovative problem-solver with a focus on sustainable and scalable solutions. You love to stay abreast of the latest digital updates in order to provide partners with cutting-edge digital capabilities, being fully aware of the most current digital trends.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 7+ years of experience in digital operations in large organizations, agencies, or start-ups and 3+ years in people development, coaching, and leadership.

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken; additional languages a plus), with proven ability to navigate complex, multicultural, highly matrixed environments and to engage effectively with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.

• Demonstrated project and change management capabilities and end-to-end accountability, combining big-picture impact understanding with the ability to engage others for successful outcomes.

• Innovative, analytical problem-solver with a growth mindset (experimentation, continuous learning, feedback), quick to learn new technologies, dynamic and flexible with different tools, and focused on sus

• Guida e modello di ruolo agile collaborazione e l'integrazione del nuovo modello operativo, supporto e portare iniziative interfunzionali con una prospettiva globale, e contribuire raccomandazioni per migliorare il servizio e la reattività ai partner commerciali.
• Superare la gestione delle risorse monitorando l'utilizzo delle risorse e la soddisfazione del cliente all'interno del sottocapitolo, coinvolgendo rapidamente ed efficacemente le risorse attraverso reti formali e informali, e lavorando a stretto contatto con i Leads di Digital Hub Chapter.
• Promuovere lo sviluppo delle capacità e la gestione dei talenti: trovare, attrarre, sviluppare e mantenere diversi talenti allineati a funzioni e bisogni aziendali in evoluzione, e sostenere l'integrazione della mentalità OneRoche all'interno del capitolo e attraverso il Global Digital Hub.
• Leader Business Process Management come centro di eccellenza stabilendo principi di governance dei processi, mantenendo la documentazione corretta, e collaborando con altre organizzazioni Subchapter Leads e RSS per allineare sulle priorità strategiche, accelerare il processo decisionale, facilitare strozzature e massimizzare l'impatto aziendale. Chi sei? Siamo alla ricerca di individui ottimi e dinamici che sono altamente coinvolti e appassionati di campagne digitali e disposti a saperne di più sulla gestione delle campagne digitali. Come Subchapter Lead, sei una persona che gode del lavoro di squadra e ha la capacità di lavorare in un ambiente globale veloce. Sei un problem-solver proattivo e innovativo con un focus su soluzioni sostenibili e scalabili. Ti piace rimanere al passo con gli ultimi aggiornamenti digitali al fine di fornire ai partner funzionalità digitali all'avanguardia, essendo pienamente consapevoli delle tendenze digitali più attuali.
• Corso di laurea o Master con 7+ anni di esperienza nelle operazioni digitali in grandi organizzazioni, agenzie, o start-up e 3+ anni di sviluppo, coaching e leadership.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritta e parlata; lingue aggiuntive a plus), con comprovata capacità di navigare in ambienti complessi, multiculturali, altamente matrici e di impegnarsi efficacemente con leader senior e team interfunzionali.
• Dimostrate capacità di gestione del progetto e del cambiamento e responsabilità end-to-end, combinando la comprensione dell'impatto di grande immagine con la capacità di coinvolgere gli altri per risultati di successo.
• Innovativo e analitico problem-solver con una mentalità di crescita (esperimentazione, apprendimento continuo, feedback), rapido per imparare nuove tecnologie, dinamico e flessibile con diversi strumenti, e focalizzato sus
