jobs.title: Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a highly motivated and skilled Principal Scientist to support the development of advanced molecular diagnostics technologies. This role requires expertise in both preparative chromatography and analytical techniques, spanning the entire product development lifecycle—from early-stage research through on-market support.

As part of the Chemistry Team, you will have access to cutting-edge technologies and state-of-the-art instrumentation, enabling you to contribute meaningfully to advancements in molecular diagnostics. Your work will directly impact global health, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the field of diagnostics.

The Opportunity

• Advanced Research & Development:
You will synthesize, purify, characterize complex nucleotides, phosphoramidites, oligonucleotides, their analogs, and related small molecule reagents. You will drive process optimization to enable efficient scale-up and successful product launches.

• Analytical Method Support:
You will support and utilize analytical methods for characterizing reagents, reactions, and assay performance, with applications spanning R&D and Operations.

• Problem Solving:
You will design and execute advanced troubleshooting experiments independently and in collaboration with cross-functional teams. You will develop assays that push the limits of system understanding and error detection to ensure robust designs.

• Data & Documentation Transfer:
You might manage knowledge handoffs of prototype methods and assist in transferring comprehensive documentation from research stages to development and manufacturing teams.

• Expert Collaboration:
You will act as a subject matter expert to provide technical depth across R&D departments and operations.

This position is based on-site in Pleasanton, CA.
Relocation benefits are not offered for this role.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have Ph.D. in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Biology, Medical Chemistry (or a related field) and have at least 2+ years of relevant industry experience, OR you hold a Master’s Degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Biology, Medical Chemistry (or a related field) with 5+ years of industry experience

• You have demonstrated experience and problem-solving skills in UPLC/HPLC, ion pair chromatography, ion exchange, advanced mass spectrometry, absorption spectroscopy, and fluorescence spectroscopy.

• You have a high level of knowledge of synthetic methods for nucleotides, phosphoramidites, oligonucleotides (including post-synthetic modification) and considerable understanding of PCR methodologies.

• You have demonstrated in-depth knowledge of DNA, RNA, modified oligonucleotides (including dye- and non-natural modifications), and small molecule reagents. You also have a strong level of expertise in purifying and characterizing oligonucleotides and small molecules.

• You have proven skills in experimental design, particularly in developing and optimizing sophisticated analytical assays applied to oligonucleotides and PCR..

Preferred:

• Your attention to detail and technical writing skills enable you to prepare clear, detailed documentation, including analytical reports.

• You exhibit a proactive approach to problem-solving, a growth mindset, and a passion for contributing to a collaborative workplace culture.

• You have demonstrated Interpersonal skills: Strong verbal communication and influencing skills; can influence without authority and has proven experience building and cultivating relationsh

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Stiamo cercando uno scienziato principale altamente motivato e qualificato per sostenere lo sviluppo di tecnologie diagnostiche molecolari avanzate. Questo ruolo richiede competenze sia nella cromatografia preparatoria che nelle tecniche analitiche, che coprono l'intero ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del prodotto, dalla ricerca del primo stadio attraverso il supporto sul mercato. Nell'ambito del team di chimica, avrai accesso a tecnologie all'avanguardia e alla strumentazione all'avanguardia, consentendoti di contribuire in modo significativo ai progressi nella diagnostica molecolare. Il vostro lavoro influenzerà direttamente la salute globale, spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile nel campo della diagnostica. L'opportunità
• Ricerca avanzata e sviluppo: Potrai sintetizzare, purificare, caratterizzare nucleotidi complessi, fosforramidite, oligonucleotidi, loro analoghi, e relativi piccoli reagenti molecolari. Aziona l'ottimizzazione del processo per consentire la scalabilità efficiente e lanci di successo del prodotto.
• Supporto metodo analitico: Potrai supportare e utilizzare metodi analitici per la caratterizzazione di reagenti, reazioni e prestazioni di analisi, con applicazioni che spaziano dalla R&D e dalle Operazioni.
• Risoluzione dei problemi: Progettare ed eseguire esperimenti di risoluzione dei problemi avanzati in modo indipendente e in collaborazione con team interfunzionali. Si svilupperà saggi che spingono i limiti della comprensione del sistema e del rilevamento degli errori per garantire disegni robusti.
• Trasferimento dati e documentazione: Potreste gestire la conoscenza dei metodi di prototipo e aiutare a trasferire la documentazione completa dalle fasi di ricerca ai team di sviluppo e produzione.
• Collaborazione degli esperti: Si agirà come esperto di materia tematica per fornire profondità tecnica nei reparti e nelle operazioni R&D. Questa posizione si basa sul sito in Pleasanton, CA. I vantaggi di trasferimento non sono offerti per questo ruolo. Chi sei? (richiesto)
• Hai Ph.D. in Chimica, Biochimica, Biologia chimica, Chimica Chimica (o un campo correlato) e hanno almeno 2+ anni di esperienza nel settore rilevante, O hai un Master in Chimica, Biochimica, Chimica Biologia, Chimica Chimica (o un campo correlato) con 5+ anni di esperienza nel settore
• Hai dimostrato esperienza e capacità di problem solving in UPLC/HPLC, cromatografia a coppia ionica, scambio ionico, spettrometria di massa avanzata, spettroscopia di assorbimento e spettroscopia di fluorescenza.
• Hai un alto livello di conoscenza dei metodi sintetici per nucleotidi, fosforramidite, oligonucleotidi (compresa la modifica post-sintetica) e una notevole comprensione delle metodologie PCR.
• Hai dimostrato una conoscenza approfondita del DNA, del RNA, degli oligonucleotidi modificati (comprese le modifiche coloranti e non naturali) e dei piccoli reagenti molecolari. Hai anche un forte livello di competenza nel purificare e caratterizzare oligonucleotidi e piccole molecole.
• Hai dimostrato competenze nel design sperimentale, in particolare nello sviluppo e nell'ottimizzazione di sofisticate analisi analitiche applicate a oligonucleotidi e PCR. Preferito:
• La vostra attenzione ai dettagli e alle capacità di scrittura tecnica vi permettono di preparare una documentazione chiara e dettagliata, compresi i rapporti analitici.
• Esprimi un approccio proattivo per risolvere i problemi, una mentalità di crescita e una passione per contribuire a una cultura di lavoro collaborativa.
• Hai dimostrato competenze interpersonali: forte comunicazione verbale e capacità di influenzare; può influenzare senza autorità e ha dimostrato esperienza di costruire e coltivare relazioni

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten und qualifizierten Hauptwissenschaftler, der die Entwicklung fortschrittlicher molekularer Diagnostiktechnologien unterstützt. Diese Rolle erfordert Fachwissen sowohl in der präparativen Chromatographie als auch in analytischen Techniken, die den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Produktentwicklung abdecken - von der Frühphase der Forschung bis zur Unterstützung auf dem Markt. Als Teil des Chemie-Teams haben Sie Zugang zu modernsten Technologien und modernsten Instrumenten, die es Ihnen ermöglichen, sinnvoll zu Fortschritten in der molekularen Diagnostik beizutragen. Ihre Arbeit wird sich direkt auf die globale Gesundheit auswirken und die Grenzen dessen überschreiten, was im Bereich der Diagnostik möglich ist. Die Chance
• Fortgeschrittene Forschung & Entwicklung: Sie werden komplexe Nukleotide, Phosphoramidite, Oligonukleotide, ihre Analoga und verwandte niedermolekulare Reagenzien synthetisieren, reinigen und charakterisieren. Sie werden die Prozessoptimierung vorantreiben, um eine effiziente Skalierung und erfolgreiche Produkteinführungen zu ermöglichen.
• Unterstützung analytischer Methoden: Sie unterstützen und verwenden analytische Methoden zur Charakterisierung von Reagenzien, Reaktionen und Assay-Leistung mit Anwendungen, die R & D und Operations umfassen.
• Problemlösung: Sie entwerfen und führen fortschrittliche Experimente zur Fehlerbehebung unabhängig und in Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams durch. Sie werden Assays entwickeln, die die Grenzen des Systemverständnisses und der Fehlererkennung erweitern, um robuste Designs zu gewährleisten.
• Daten- und Dokumentationstransfer: Sie können Wissensübergaben von Prototyp-Methoden verwalten und dabei helfen, umfassende Dokumentation von den Forschungsphasen an Entwicklungs- und Fertigungsteams zu übertragen.
• Experten-Zusammenarbeit: Sie werden als Fachexperte fungieren, um technische Tiefe in allen F & E-Abteilungen und Operationen zu bieten. Diese Position basiert auf dem Standort in Pleasanton, CA. Umzugsvorteile werden für diese Rolle nicht angeboten. Wer Du bist: (erforderlich)
• Sie haben einen Ph.D. in Chemie, Biochemie, Chemische Biologie, Medizinische Chemie (oder ein verwandtes Gebiet) und haben mindestens 2+ Jahre einschlägige Industrieerfahrung, ODER Sie haben einen Master-Abschluss in Chemie, Biochemie, Chemische Biologie, Medizinische Chemie (oder ein verwandtes Gebiet) mit 5+ Jahren Industrieerfahrung
• Sie haben Erfahrungen und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten in UPLC / HPLC, Ionenpaarchromatographie, Ionenaustausch, fortgeschrittener Massenspektrometrie, Absorptionsspektroskopie und Fluoreszenzspektroskopie gezeigt.
• Sie verfügen über ein hohes Maß an Wissen über synthetische Methoden für Nukleotide, Phosphoramidite, Oligonukleotide (einschließlich postsynthetischer Modifikation) und ein beträchtliches Verständnis der PCR-Methoden.
• Sie haben fundierte Kenntnisse über DNA, RNA, modifizierte Oligonukleotide (einschließlich Farbstoff- und nicht-natürliche Modifikationen) und niedermolekulare Reagenzien nachgewiesen. Sie haben auch ein hohes Maß an Fachwissen in der Reinigung und Charakterisierung von Oligonukleotiden und kleinen Molekülen.
• Sie verfügen über nachgewiesene Fähigkeiten im experimentellen Design, insbesondere bei der Entwicklung und Optimierung anspruchsvoller analytischer Assays für Oligonukleotide und PCR. Bevorzugt:
• Ihre Aufmerksamkeit für Details und technische Schreibfähigkeiten ermöglichen es Ihnen, klare, detaillierte Dokumentationen zu erstellen, einschließlich analytischer Berichte.
• Sie zeigen einen proaktiven Ansatz zur Problemlösung, eine Wachstumsmentalität und eine Leidenschaft für einen Beitrag zu einer kollaborativen Arbeitsplatzkultur.
• Sie haben zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten demonstriert: Starke verbale Kommunikation und Einflussfähigkeiten; kann ohne Autorität beeinflussen und hat nachgewiesene Erfahrung beim Aufbau und der Pflege von Beziehungen

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes à la recherche d'un scientifique principal hautement motivé et compétent pour appuyer le développement de technologies de diagnostic moléculaire de pointe. Ce rôle exige une expertise en chromatographie préparative et en techniques d'analyse, couvrant l'ensemble du cycle de développement des produits, depuis la recherche en phase initiale jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Dans le cadre de l'équipe de chimie, vous aurez accès à des technologies de pointe et à des instruments de pointe, ce qui vous permettra de contribuer de façon significative aux progrès du diagnostic moléculaire. Votre travail aura un impact direct sur la santé mondiale, en repoussant les limites de ce qui est possible dans le domaine du diagnostic. L'opportunité
• Recherche et développement avancés : Vous synthétiserez, purifierez, caractériserez les nucléotides complexes, les phosphoramidites, les oligonucléotides, leurs analogues et les réactifs de petites molécules connexes. Vous allez conduire l'optimisation des processus pour permettre une mise à niveau efficace et des lancements de produits réussis.
• Appui aux méthodes d'analyse : Vous soutiendrez et utiliserez des méthodes analytiques pour caractériser les réactifs, les réactions et les performances d'essai, avec des applications couvrant la R-D et les Opérations.
• Résolution des problèmes : Vous concevez et exécutez des expériences de dépannage avancées indépendamment et en collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles. Vous développerez des tests qui repoussent les limites de la compréhension du système et de la détection d'erreurs pour assurer des conceptions robustes.
• Transfert de données et de documentation : Vous pourriez gérer le transfert des connaissances des méthodes prototypes et aider à transférer la documentation complète des étapes de recherche aux équipes de développement et de fabrication.
• Collaboration d'experts : Vous agirez à titre d'expert en la matière pour fournir une profondeur technique à l'ensemble des ministères et des opérations de R-D. Cette position est basée sur le site de Pleasanton, CA. Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas offertes pour ce rôle. Qui vous êtes : (Requis)
• Vous avez un doctorat en chimie, biochimie, biologie chimique, chimie médicale (ou un domaine connexe) et avez au moins 2+ années d'expérience pertinente de l'industrie, OU vous avez un Master en chimie, biochimie, biologie chimique, chimie médicale (ou un domaine connexe) avec 5+ années d'expérience de l'industrie
• Vous avez démontré votre expérience et vos compétences en résolution de problèmes en UPLC/HPLC, en chromatographie par paires d'ions, en échange d'ions, en spectrométrie de masse avancée, en spectroscopie d'absorption et en spectroscopie par fluorescence.
• Vous avez un niveau élevé de connaissance des méthodes synthétiques pour les nucléotides, les phosphoramidites, les oligonucléotides (y compris les modifications post-synthétiques) et une compréhension considérable des méthodologies PCR.
• Vous avez démontré une connaissance approfondie de l'ADN, de l'ARN, des oligonucléotides modifiés (y compris les modifications de colorant et non naturelles) et des réactifs de petites molécules. Vous avez également une forte expertise dans la purification et la caractérisation des oligonucléotides et des petites molécules.
• Vous avez des compétences éprouvées en conception expérimentale, en particulier dans le développement et l'optimisation de tests analytiques sophistiqués appliqués aux oligonucléotides et PCR. Préféré:
• Votre attention aux détails et compétences techniques de rédaction vous permet de préparer une documentation claire et détaillée, y compris des rapports analytiques.

jobs.title: Representante de Promoción Médica (Oncología)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Rol local orientado al cliente responsable de impulsar la innovación en el sistema de salud.

Propósito del Especialista en Experiencia del Paciente (Patient Journey Partner)

El cuidado de la salud está cambiando: hay una innovación radical, mayor apertura al cambio, un creciente empoderamiento del paciente, múltiples fuentes de información médica y presión sobre el gasto público. Como resultado de todo esto, las necesidades de nuestros actores siguen evolucionando.

El Especialista en Experiencia del Paciente (Patient Journey Partner - PJP) está en el centro de la nueva organización de Roche, dando un giro al papel que desempeñamos en la sociedad, pasando de ofrecer medicamentos de calidad mundial principalmente a tener un rol de mayor colaboración, innovación y liderazgo en la disrupción creativa. De este modo, el PJP será directamente responsable de obtener mejores resultados para los pacientes, su comunidad, el ecosistema y la organización, con mayor rapidez.

El PJP es un líder empoderado y la cara local de Roche. Trabaja de cerca con todos los actores que intervienen directamente en la experiencia del paciente (en un área terapéutica o de enfermedad determinada), obteniendo un profundo conocimiento de sus necesidades para conectar las capacidades de Roche en favor de la creación conjunta de soluciones significativas.

Esta función está integrada a nivel local en el ecosistema, es una función integrada, funcionalmente agnóstica, (es decir, no encaja en los conceptos tradicionales de Asuntos Médicos o Comercial/Ventas)

La Oportunidad

• El PJP es un líder empoderado y la cara local de Roche, fungiendo como puente principal entre la organización y el ecosistema de salud. Las responsabilidades clave incluyen:

• Colaboración con Actores Clave : Trabajar estrechamente con todos los actores involucrados directamente en la experiencia del paciente dentro de un área terapéutica o patología específica, desarrollando una comprensión profunda de sus necesidades y conectando las capacidades de Roche para co-crear soluciones significativas.

• Autoridad en Toma de Decisiones : Ejercer autoridad decisoria para asignar recursos —tanto de la afiliada como de la red más amplia de Roche— con el fin de mejorar el impacto en la experiencia del paciente.

• Engagement del Ecosistema : Actuar como socio de confianza y punto de contacto principal (aunque no exclusivo) entre los actores del ecosistema y Roche, compartiendo necesidades de la comunidad de pacientes, priorizando soluciones y asegurando la asignación de recursos.

• Eliminación de Obstáculos y Creación de Valor : Asociarse con actores del ecosistema para eliminar barreras e identificar oportunidades que agreguen valor demostrable a pacientes y comunidades.

• Gestión del Ciclo de Vida de Productos : Gestionar el ciclo de vida de los productos de Roche y asegurar su uso adecuado, incluyendo comunicar beneficios de manera equilibrada y veraz a profesionales de la salud.

• Perspectiva Sistémica : Monitorear la experiencia completa del paciente con un enfoque de pensamiento sistémico, identificando propósitos compartidos y co-creando soluciones entre los diferentes actores del ecosistema.

• Movilización de Conocimiento y Recursos : Atraer experiencia y recursos internos a nivel local y de red según sea necesario, incluyendo colaboración con otros PJPs.

Quién eres

El PJP demuestra un propósito personal en mejorar la experiencia del paciente, así como una fuerte pasión por crear valor e impacto en el ecosistema. Tie

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

As an Accounts Payable Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for Accounts Payable matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

The Opportunity

• Invoice & Payment Processing – Handle receipt, verification, and processing of PO/non-PO invoices, prepayments, and intercompany transactions while ensuring timely and accurate payments.

• Reconciliation & Closing – Perform supplier and balance sheet reconciliations, clear aged items, and execute month-end closing activities including accruals and reporting.

• Query & Issue Resolution – Manage internal and external queries, investigate payment issues, and collaborate with relevant teams to resolve system or process-related problems.

• Compliance & Audit Support – Ensure adherence to company policies, ICFR, and statutory requirements; support internal and external audits as needed.

• Process Improvement & Knowledge Sharing – Drive process improvement initiatives, participate in system testing and integration, and provide training or mentorship to team members.

Who you are

• A degree in Finance & Accounting, Commerce, or equivalent. Professional qualifications (e.g., ACCA, CPA, MIA) are an advantage.

• Good communication skills and proficiency in English & Japanese Languages.

• Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking the specific country language for business communications.

• At least 2 years of experience in transactional accounting teams within a performance-driven environment.

• Knowledge and experience with SAP or other ERP/Accounting systems.

• Experience working in a shared service center across a global or large organization is advantageous.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Customer Support Partner (Engineer)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
As the Customer Support Partner (Engineer), you will be responsible for performing instrument troubleshooting, instrument installation, instrument preventive maintenance, and other instrument after-sales service issues to the satisfaction of the customer base and organization's procedures and policies.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

In this role, you will

• Maintain and perform necessary support at customer site, such as troubleshooting, corrective and preventive maintenance, and installation hardware and software modification.

• Provide service training to the customer and peers.

• Conduct workshop activities as required.

• Handles trouble shooting for customers and carry out root cause analysis, and liaises with GCS to manage technical issues when required.

• Well documented all customers’ touchpoints in the CRM system correctly in a timely manner.

• Monitor spare part movement in individual storage location and ensure part used is written off via the CRM system in a timely manner.

• Responsible to ensure (together with Regulatory and Product team) that customer is informed of safety / quality issues and technical updates via Customer Notification timely.

• Cooperate with the cross-functional support team to help customers solve the problem effectively.

• Collaborate closely with stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of their needs and identifying shared purpose in order to create fruitful partnerships.

• Represent Roche in engagement opportunities, collect and compiling insights, positions and feedback to inform our access and policies strategies.

• Regularly check the intranet/emails and all available channels to keep up-to-date service information including instrument operation and application related information.

• Meet customer service KPI and participate in continuous improvements.

• Actively promote and provide digital service, proactive and remote support through Remote CareGiver.

• May act as a coach for colleagues with less experience and provide guidance. Proactively identify opportunities to improve and enhance the target audience experience. Work autonomously; complete work with minimal supervision or guidance but maintain communication with supervisor regarding progress.

Any other tasks or projects as assigned from time to time.

Who you are
You are someone who are/have:

• Strong troubleshooting and multi-tasking skills.

• Efficient, organized, details oriented and result driven.

• Customer-oriented individual and an outstanding problem-solver.

• Able to efficiently prioritise tasks in a fast-changing environment.

• Team players demonstrated by the ability to receive and provide feedback professionally thrive and collaborate in a cross-functional environment.

• Detail oriented, meticulous, responsive to deadlines.

• Ongoing interest in digital services, industry trends, best practices and emerging technologies.

Qualification and Experience

• Minimum Diploma in Biomedical, Electronic, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent from a reputable University

• Preferably, at least 1 year of related experience in a similar industry

• IT experience will be an added advantage

• Marketing and busines

jobs.title: Warehouse Operator Despatch
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Warehouse Operator Despatch plays a vital role in our supply chain operations. This role is responsible for the physical and administrative tasks involved in the shipping, receiving, storing and distributing of materials, parts, supplies and equipment.

• Permanent Full-Time position with overtime

• Pemulwuy Warehouse based role, onsite parking available

• Collaborative and supportive team environment

As a Warehouse Operator Despatch, you will be responsible for:

• Picking orders in temperature-controlled environments (Ambient and Cold Storage) using RF gun

• Operating counterbalance and high-reach forklifts

• Handling Post Goods Issue operations using SAP

• Handling and shipping Dangerous Goods

• Booking shipments via contracted carriers.

• Always ensure compliance of safety guidelines

Who You Are

You have:

• Forklift license (LF)

• Dangerous goods license (Desirable, training provided)

• Sound knowledge of WH&S principles

• Attention to detail & ability to work independently, within a team environment and meet key performance indicators

• Ability for Heavy lifting (up to 20 Kg)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
Join a highly collaborative team within our global shared services hub, where your dedication directly impacts our operational efficiency. As a Procurement Customer Support Specialist, you will be the first line of professional contact for system users, resolving inquiries, managing platform access, and ensuring a seamless end-to-end procurement experience that supports our broader mission in global healthcare.

In this engaging role, you will:

• Deliver Exceptional Support: Provide first-level operational and system-related support via phone and ticketing tools for global indirect procurement end-users.

• Manage Ticket Lifecycles: Create, maintain, and track support cases efficiently, striving for first-contact resolution within 24 hours to achieve optimal response targets.

• Bridge Knowledge Gaps: Act as a vital connector between system users and advanced technical resolver groups, translating complex technical feedback into clear, actionable instructions for the business.

• Optimize Platform Roles: Manage system access and platform role ownership requests accurately, ensuring security and compliance protocols are met.

• Build Hub Intelligence: Contribute to the creation and maintenance of standard operating documentation, knowledge base articles, and reference materials to support team performance.

• Champion Safety and Compliance: Perform daily duties in strict alignment with environmental, health, technical safety guidelines, and corporate compliance standards.

Who You Are
You are a customer-oriented, analytical problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You possess excellent organizational skills, take extreme accountability for your work, and communicate effortlessly with diverse technical and non-technical audiences.

Your Qualifications:

• Educational Background: You hold a University or College Degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Economics, or a related field.

• Professional Experience: You bring 1 to 3 years of experience in procurement operations, customer service centers, or shared services support functions.

• System Familiarity: You possess a solid foundational understanding of procurement systems and enterprise planning tools (such as SAP), alongside familiarity with modern digital ticketing platforms.

• Language Excellence: You are completely fluent in both written and spoken English and Mandarin to effectively support our regional business clusters.

• Operational Agility: You possess sharp troubleshooting skills, manage your time effectively, and are comfortable working an afternoon schedule (until 6:00 PM).

Let’s grow together by accessing opportunities that set you up for success.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Esperienza professionale: Lei porta da 1 a 3 anni di esperienza nelle operazioni di approvvigionamento, nei centri di assistenza clienti o nelle funzioni di supporto dei servizi condivisi.
• Familiarità di sistema: Possiedi una solida comprensione fondamentale dei sistemi di approvvigionamento e degli strumenti di pianificazione aziendale (come SAP), insieme alla familiarità con le moderne piattaforme di ticketing digitali.
• Eccellenza linguistica: Lei è completamente fluente in inglese scritto e parlato e mandarino per sostenere efficacemente i nostri cluster aziendali regionali.
• Agility Operativa: Possiedi abilità di risoluzione dei problemi taglienti, gestisci il tuo tempo in modo efficace e sei comodo a lavorare un programma pomeridiano (fino alle 6:00 PM). I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

• Champion de la sécurité et de la conformité : Effectuez des tâches quotidiennes en stricte conformité avec les lignes directrices en matière d'environnement, de santé, de sécurité technique et les normes de conformité de l'entreprise. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un résolveur de problèmes analytique orienté client qui prospère dans un environnement rapide. Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences organisationnelles, prenez une responsabilité extrême pour votre travail et communiquez sans effort avec divers publics techniques et non techniques. Vos qualifications :
• Contexte éducatif : Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire ou collégial en finance, administration des affaires, informatique, économie ou un domaine connexe.
• Expérience professionnelle: Vous apportez 1 à 3 ans d'expérience dans les opérations d'approvisionnement, les centres de service à la clientèle, ou les fonctions de soutien de services partagés.
• Familiarité du système: Vous possédez une solide compréhension fondamentale des systèmes d'approvisionnement et des outils de planification d'entreprise (comme SAP), ainsi que la connaissance des plateformes de billetterie numériques modernes.
• Excellence linguistique : Vous maîtrisez parfaitement l'anglais écrit et parlé et le mandarin pour soutenir efficacement nos grappes d'affaires régionales.
• Agilité opérationnelle: Vous possédez des compétences de dépannage précises, gérez votre temps efficacement et êtes à l'aise de travailler un horaire de l'après-midi (jusqu'à 18 h). Laissez grandir ensemble en accédant aux opportunités qui vous mettent en place pour le succès. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Solution Architect (Quality & Compliance)

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

Join a team at the forefront of the "Quality Unites Us" program, where you will design the digital backbone of our global pharma quality and compliance systems. This role is a unique chance to lead the shift toward a paperless, predictive quality ecosystem, ensuring our life-saving medicines reach patients faster. You will work in a high-impact environment, balancing cutting-edge lab technologies with robust enterprise standards.

The opportunity:

• Scope/(Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance. Applies frameworks in a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for the product. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded and published for multiple solutions or the product. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including vendor assessments.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates difficult concepts clearly and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view. Drives information sharing across the complete product.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Business /Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas. Proactively contributes to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Who you are:

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Senior Solution Architect (Quality & Compliance) Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Unisciti a un team all'avanguardia del programma "Quality Unites Us", dove potrai progettare la spina dorsale digitale dei nostri sistemi di qualità e conformità di farmaci globali. Questo ruolo è un'occasione unica per portare lo spostamento verso un ecosistema di qualità senza carta, predittivo, assicurando che i nostri farmaci salvavita raggiungano i pazienti più velocemente. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente ad alto impatto, bilanciando tecnologie di laboratorio all'avanguardia con standard aziendali robusti. L'opportunità:
• Scope/(Content Leadership): progetta soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti del prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali. Gestisce i requisiti non funzionali (NFR) e le funzioni di fitness. Documenti ed evolve l'architettura in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto e si allinea con la comunità di architettura per la governance. Riguarda i quadri in una soluzione complessa o multipla o nel contesto del prodotto.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: porta altri a risolvere problemi complessi; utilizza un sofisticato pensiero analitico per esercitare giudizio e identificare soluzioni innovative. Mantiene la visione, la roadmap e il paesaggio attuale per soluzioni multiple. Assesse e consultazioni sugli impatti e le dipendenze delle iniziative sulle capacità, sui rischi e sul paesaggio delle applicazioni. Crea modelli di dati concettuali e logici, tassonomie, ontologie e percorsi di integrazione per il prodotto. Definisce e guida architetture di riferimento, modelli, NFR e funzioni di fitness, assicurando che l'Architettura Decision Records (ADRs) siano registrate e pubblicate per più soluzioni o il prodotto. Guida le tendenze della tecnologia esterna e valuta la fattibilità, comprese le valutazioni dei fornitori.
• Gestione degli Stakeholder: Comunica chiaramente concetti difficili e negozia con altri per adottare un punto di vista diverso. Guida la condivisione delle informazioni attraverso il prodotto completo.
• Impatto/Strategia: sviluppa e mantiene la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto. Fornisce la supervisione tecnica, la guida e la consultazione su tecnologie specifiche per i team di prodotti. Migliora le soluzioni esistenti, gestisce il debito tecnico, e le ricerche, valuta, pilota e guida l'adozione di nuove tecnologie. Identifica le opportunità per migliorare il valore e i processi aziendali all'interno di un Contesto Complesso o Soluzione Multiple o Prodotto.
• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): funziona all'interno di una soluzione complessa o multipla o Contesto del prodotto.
• Capacità aziendale /tecnica: si basa su una conoscenza approfondita ed esperta in più aree tecnologiche. Proattivamente contribuisce alle pratiche di architettura

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Senior Solution Architect (Qualität und Compliance) Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation den Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Community von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die dazu beitragen, die digitale Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen zu gestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien zu treiben und das Potenzial künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren Tech-Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zweck und Leidenschaft, bauen wir eine Zukunft, in der digital eine Kernkraft für alle Roche ist, die intelligentere Möglichkeiten der Arbeit ermöglicht, das menschliche Potenzial zu entsperren und Durchbrüche zu treiben, die wirklich für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wichtig sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Wir verlangen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter in unseren Büros durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Bedarf variieren, z.B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathause, Teamtreffen und andere kollaborative Veranstaltungen. Nehmen Sie an der Spitze des Programms "Quality Unites Us" teil, wo Sie das digitale Rückgrat unserer globalen Pharma-Qualitäts- und Compliance-Systeme entwerfen werden. Diese Rolle ist eine einzigartige Chance, die Verschiebung zu einem papierlosen, prädiktiven Qualitäts-Ökosystem zu führen, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere lebenssparenden Medikamente schneller Patienten erreichen. Sie werden in einer hocheffizienten Umgebung arbeiten und modernste Labortechnologien mit robusten Unternehmensstandards ausgleichen. Die Gelegenheit:
• Scope/(Content Leadership): Entwerfen Sie Lösungen, die Produktanforderungen, Unternehmensprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards erfüllen. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) und Fitness-Funktionen. Dokumente und entwickelt die Architektur während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus und richtet sich an die Architekturgemeinschaft für Governance. Gilt für Frameworks in einem komplexen oder mehreren Lösungs- oder Produktkontext.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Führen Sie andere, um komplexe Probleme zu lösen; nutzt ausgeklügelten analytischen Gedanken, um Urteil zu üben und innovative Lösungen zu identifizieren. Bewahrt die Vision, Roadmap und aktuelle Landschaft für mehrere Lösungen. Unterstützung und Beratung zu den Auswirkungen und Abhängigkeiten von Initiativen auf Fähigkeiten, Risiken und die Anwendungslandschaft. Erzeugt Konzept- & Logische Datenmodelle, Taxonomien, Ontologien und Integration Pfade für das Produkt. Definiert und treibt Referenzarchitekturen, Muster, NFRs und Fitness-Funktionen, die sicherstellen, dass Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) aufgezeichnet und für mehrere Lösungen oder das Produkt veröffentlicht werden. treibt Trends der externen Technologie voran und bewertet Machbarkeit, einschließlich Herstellerbewertungen.
• Stakeholder Management: Kommuniziert schwierige Konzepte klar und verhandelt mit anderen, um einen anderen Standpunkt zu vertreten. Fahren Sie den Informationsaustausch über das gesamte Produkt.
• Impact/Strategy: Entwickelt und pflegt die Technologiekarte des Produkts. Bietet technische Aufsicht, Beratung und Beratung zu spezifischen Technologien für Produktteams. Verbessert bestehende Lösungen, verwaltet technische Schulden und forscht, bewertet, pilotiert und treibt die Einführung neuer Technologien voran. Erkennt Möglichkeiten, Wert- und Geschäftsprozesse innerhalb eines komplexen oder mehrerer Lösungs- oder Produktkontexts zu verbessern.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Architecte principal des solutions (qualité et conformité) Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. Rejoignez une équipe à l'avant-garde du programme « Qualité Unites Us », où vous concevrez l'épine dorsale numérique de nos systèmes mondiaux de qualité et de conformité des produits pharmaceutiques. Ce rôle est une chance unique de conduire le changement vers un écosystème de qualité sans papier et prédictive, assurant que nos médicaments qui sauvent la vie atteignent les patients plus rapidement. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement à impact élevé, en conciliant les technologies de laboratoire de pointe avec des normes d'entreprise robustes. L'occasion :
• Portée/(Le leadership du contenu): Concevoir des solutions qui répondent aux exigences du produit, aux priorités opérationnelles et aux normes d'entreprise. Gérer les exigences non fonctionnelles (NFR) et les fonctions de conditionnement physique. Documente et évolue l'architecture tout au long du cycle de vie du produit et s'harmonise avec la communauté de l'architecture pour la gouvernance. Applique les cadres dans un contexte complexe ou multiple de solution ou de produit.
• Responsabilisation/Résoudre des problèmes: mène les autres à résoudre des problèmes complexes; utilise la pensée analytique sophistiquée pour faire preuve de jugement et identifier des solutions innovantes. Maintenir la vision, la feuille de route et le paysage actuel pour de multiples solutions. Évaluer et consulter les répercussions et les dépendances des initiatives sur les capacités, les risques et le contexte d'application. Crée des modèles de données conceptuelles et logiques, des taxonomies, des ontologies et des voies d'intégration pour le produit. Définir et piloter les architectures de référence, les modèles, les NFR et les fonctions de fitness, en veillant à ce que les documents de décision d'architecture (ADR) soient enregistrés et publiés pour plusieurs solutions ou le produit. Incite les tendances technologiques externes et évalue la faisabilité, y compris les évaluations des fournisseurs.
• Gestion des parties prenantes: Communique clairement les concepts difficiles et négocie avec d'autres pour adopter un point de vue différent. Permet le partage de l'information dans le produit complet.
• Impact/Stratégie: développe et maintient la feuille de route technologique du produit. Fournit une supervision technique, des conseils et des consultations sur des technologies spécifiques aux équipes de produits. Améliore les solutions existantes, gère la dette technique et recherche, évalue, pilote et stimule l'adoption de nouvelles technologies. Indique les possibilités d'améliorer la valeur et les processus opérationnels dans un contexte complexe ou de solutions multiples ou de produits.
• Complexité / (Taille du produit): fonctionne dans une solution complexe ou multiple ou dans un contexte de produit.
• Capacités professionnelles/techniques: Applique des connaissances approfondies et spécialisées dans plusieurs domaines technologiques. Contribution proactive aux pratiques d'architecture

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Pharma-Vision
Medikamente schnell zu den Patienten zu bringen und das beste Ergebnis für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. Das ist es, was uns in Sterile Drug Product Manufacturing (SDPM) in Mannheim antreibt. So tragen wir auch dazu bei, bis 2029 unser Ziel zu erreichen: 20 bahnbrechende Medikamente zur Behandlung der Krankheiten mit der größten gesellschaftlichen Belastung bereitzustellen. Unsere Arbeit, unser täglicher Einsatz und unser Engagement bedeuten für sehr viele große Hoffnung und Zuversicht und deswegen müssen wir anders denken und arbeiten. Mit dem Patient im Fokus setzen wir auf eine neue Organisation und zwar #WIRGEMEINSAM in SDPM! ​

Was Dich erwartet:

Als Leiter der Herstellung / Pharmazeutischer Assistent (m/w/d) unterstützt Du den Asset Lead in Operations im Rahmen der folgenden Aufgaben:

• Als Leiter der Herstellung gemäß AMWHV bist du verantwortlich für die Sicherstellung und Einhaltung der GMP-konforme Herstellpraxis und die GMP-gerechte Dokumentation im Betrieb. Für den Chargenreview (papierbasiert und elektronisch)sowie konzeptionelle Erstellung der GMP-Dokumente in deutscher und englischer Sprache bist Du verantwortlich

• Zu deinem Aufgabengebiet gehört die Erstellung, Aktualisierung und Implementierung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen im Betrieb

• Du bist kompetente Ansprechperson für interne und externe Reklamationen

• Changes, Abweichungen und CAPAs werden von Dir erstellt und bearbeitet

• Für die Erstellung, Aktualisierung, Schulung und Kontrolle der ordnungsgemäßen Durchführung von Arbeitsanweisungen (SOPs) und Herstellanweisungen (HEAs) bist Du verantwortlich

• Du nimmst eigenverantwortlich an behördlichen Inspektionen teil und setzt die Maßnahmen um

• Du bist für das interne Risikomanagement verantwortlich

• Ein weiterer Bestandteil deiner Arbeit ist die Bearbeitung von Projekten zur Effizienzsteigerung, Prozessoptimierung, Produkt Transfers sowie die Einführung neuer/ innovativer Technologien und Prozesse

Wer Du bist:

• Du hast idealerweise Pharmazie studiert oder ein vergleichbares naturwissenschaftliches Studium erfolgreich abgeschlossen und verfügst über mehrjährige (mindestens 5 Jahre) Berufserfahrung in der Pharmaindustrie (z.B. Verpackung, aseptische Produktion, Qualitätskontrolle, Qualitätssicherung)

• Du hast ein sehr gutes GMP Verständnis und sehr gute Kenntnisse der gesetzlichen Vorschriften (AMG, AMWHV)

• Gute Dokumentationspraxis (GDP) und der Umgang mit den gängigen DV-Anwendungen (MS-Office, MES, SAP und Veeva) ist für Dich selbstverständlich

• Du besitzt ein hohes Maß an Teamfähigkeit, Verantwortungsbereitschaft, Flexibilität und nimmst eine Vorbildfunktion wahr

• Die Fähigkeit zu interdisziplinärem Denken, Konfliktbewältigung sowie Integrations- und Überzeugungsfähigkeit runden dein Profil ab

• Du hast bereits Erfahrung in Audits und Inspektionen

• Du bringst vertiefte Kenntnisse zu Lean Methoden mit

• Du überzeugst mit deinen Sprachkenntnissen und einem sehr guten Ausdrucksvermögen in Deutsch und Englisch (in Wort und Schrift)

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus:

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join the small-molecule team within AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), formerly Prescient Design, at Roche and Genentech’s Computational Sciences Center of Excellence as a Machine Learning Scientist / Senior Machine Learning Scientist in Small Molecule Drug Design. You will develop and apply ML methods and models to accelerate small-molecule drug design with a focus on structure-driven approaches, working hand in hand with world-class computational and medicinal chemists and structural biologists.

The Opportunity

• Design, build, and apply cutting-edge ML models for small-molecule drug design, focused on protein–ligand interactions, binding affinity and key molecular properties.

• Train and fine-tune foundation models for structure prediction, using internally developed and open-source models on internal datasets.

• Validate and refine ML-generated hypotheses alongside world-class computational and medicinal chemists and structural biologists.

• Drive scientific impact through publications, open-source releases, and conference talks.

• Collaborate widely with computational and experimental researchers at Roche and with academic partners.

Who you are

• You bring deep machine-learning expertise with a strong foundation in linear algebra, probability and optimization, and hands-on experience designing & implementing machine learning approaches such as graph neural networks, sequence models, and reinforcement learning.

• You have structure-driven modelling experience with co-folding methods, binding-affinity prediction, and structural-biology datasets.

• You are fluent in Python and cheminformatics with toolkits such as RDKit and OpenEye, and modern ML frameworks like PyTorchor JAX.

• You hold a PhD or equivalent research depth in machine learning, computational chemistry, chemical engineering or a related quantitative field such as physics or statistics.

• You have a record of scientific excellence evidenced by journal and conference publications or a public portfolio of relevant projects (e.g. hosted on GitHub/GitLab)..

Preferred:

• Hands-on experience building structure-prediction foundation models.

• Experience collaborating directly with medicinal chemists and structural biologists.

Location & Travel Requirements

This position must be based in either Basel, Switzerland (preferred) or Welwyn Garden City in the United Kingdom. Although this can be a hybrid role, there is an expectation of ongoing and sustained site presence, in compliance with local company site requirements.

If using AI to design the medicines patients need next inspires you, apply now and help accelerate small-molecule discovery at Roche.

La posizione Unisciti al team di piccole-molecole all'interno di AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), precedentemente Prescient Design, presso il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Roche e Genentech come Scienziato per l'Apprendimento della Macchina / Senior Machine Learning Scientist in Small Molecule Drug Design. Svilupperai e applicherai metodi e modelli ML per accelerare la progettazione di farmaci di piccola molecola con un focus sugli approcci struttura-driven, lavorando mano in mano con chimici computazionali e medicinali di livello mondiale e biologi strutturali. L'opportunità:
• Progettare, costruire e applicare modelli ML all'avanguardia per la progettazione di farmaci di piccola molecola, focalizzati sulle interazioni proteina-ligand, l'affinità vincolante e le proprietà molecolari chiave.
• Modelli di fondazione per la predizione della struttura, con modelli interni sviluppati e open source su dataset interni.
• convalidare e affinare le ipotesi generate da ML insieme a chimici computazionali e medicinali di livello mondiale e biologi strutturali.
• Guidare l'impatto scientifico attraverso pubblicazioni, comunicati open source e conferenze.
• Collaborare ampiamente con ricercatori computazionali e sperimentali a Roche e con partner accademici. Chi sei:
• Porti una profonda esperienza di machine-learning con una forte base in algebra lineare, probabilità e ottimizzazione, e l'esperienza hands-on progettazione e applicazione di approcci di machine learning come reti neurali grafici, modelli di sequenza e apprendimento di rinforzo.
• Hai esperienza di modellazione struttura-driven con metodi di co-folding, predizione di binding-affinity e dataset di biologia strutturale.
• Sei fluente in Python e cheminformatics con strumenti come RDKit e OpenEye, e moderni framework ML come PyTorchor JAX.
• Ha una profondità di ricerca di dottorato o equivalente nell'apprendimento automatico, nella chimica computazionale, nell'ingegneria chimica o in un campo quantitativo correlato come la fisica o le statistiche.
• Hai un record di eccellenza scientifica evidenziato da pubblicazioni di riviste e conferenze o un portafoglio pubblico di progetti rilevanti (ad esempio ospitato su GitHub/GitLab). Preferito:
• Hands-on esperienza costruzione modelli di fondazione struttura-predizione.
• Esperienza di collaborazione direttamente con chimici medicinali e biologi strutturali. Se si utilizza l'IA per progettare i farmaci che i pazienti bisogno dopo ti ispira, applicare ora e aiutare ad accelerare la scoperta di piccole molecole a Roche. #ComputationCoE #tech4lifeComputationalScienza #tech4lifeAI Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Basilea. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

titleByLocale.it: Scienziato di apprendimento della macchina - Chimica quantistica
titleByLocale.fr: Scientifique en apprentissage automatique - Chimie quantique

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join the small-molecule team within AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), formerly Prescient Design, at Roche and Genentech’s Computational Sciences Center of Excellence as a Machine Learning Scientist / Senior Machine Learning Scientist in Quantum Chemistry. You will combine machine learning methods and quantum chemistry to build fast, accurate models that power small-molecule drug discovery. You will work with world-class computational and experimental scientists and leverage proprietary datasets and state-of-the-art compute.

The Opportunity

• Create cutting-edge solutions that combine quantum chemistry and machine learning algorithm development to model small-molecule energetics and protein–ligand interactions, from conformation and reactivity to binding affinity and free energy.

• Build synthetic datasets using quantum mechanics and related methods to shape novel research directions in ML.

• Develop deployable pipelines that are robust, scalable and reproducible, and feed directly into molecular-design tools used across Roche.

• Drive scientific impact through publications, open-source releases, and talks at internal and external conferences.

• Collaborate widely with world-class computational and experimental researchers at Roche and with academic partners.

Who you are

• You bring deep machine-learning expertise with a strong theoretical foundation in linear algebra, probability and optimization, and you build models from first principles.

• You have hands-on quantum chemistry experience and fluency in toolkits such as Psi4, PySCF and ORCA, as well as semi-empirical methods like xTB.

• You are fluent in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.

• You hold a PhD or equivalent research depth in machine learning, computational chemistry, chemical engineering or a related quantitative field such as physics or statistics.

• You have a record of scientific excellence evidenced by journal and conference publications or a public portfolio of relevant projects (e.g. hosted on GitHub/GitLab).

Preferred

• Experience in scientific software development, scaling ML training, and applying models to drug discovery.

• Experience generating large-scale synthetic datasets.

Location & Travel Requirements

This position must be based in either Welwyn Garden City in the United Kingdom (preferred) or Basel, Switzerland. Although this can be a hybrid role, there is an expectation of ongoing and sustained site presence, in compliance with local company site requirements.

If building physics-grounded machine learning models that bring better medicines to patients faster is your calling, apply now and help shape the future of small-molecule drug discovery.

#ComputationCoE
#tech4lifeComputationalScience
#tech4lifeAI

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Welwyn. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions

• Sviluppare oleodotti dispiegabili robusti, scalabili e riproducibili, e alimentarsi direttamente in strumenti di progettazione molecolare utilizzati in Roche.
• Guidare l'impatto scientifico attraverso pubblicazioni, comunicati open source e colloqui a conferenze interne ed esterne.
• Collaborare ampiamente con ricercatori computazionali e sperimentali di livello mondiale a Roche e con partner accademici. Chi sei:
• Porti una profonda esperienza di machine-learning con una forte base teorica in algebra lineare, probabilità e ottimizzazione, e costruisci modelli dai primi principi.
• Hai esperienza di chimica quantistica pratica e fluidità in strumenti come Psi4, PySCF e ORCA, così come metodi semi-empirici come xTB.
• Sei fluente in Python e moderni framework ML come PyTorch o JAX.
• Ha una profondità di ricerca di dottorato o equivalente nell'apprendimento automatico, nella chimica computazionale, nell'ingegneria chimica o in un campo quantitativo correlato come la fisica o le statistiche.
• Hai un record di eccellenza scientifica evidenziato da pubblicazioni di riviste e conferenze o un portafoglio pubblico di progetti rilevanti (ad esempio ospitato su GitHub/GitLab). Preferito:
• Esperienza nello sviluppo del software scientifico, scalare la formazione ML e applicare modelli alla scoperta della droga.
• Esperienza generando set di dati sintetici su larga scala. Se la costruzione di modelli di machine learning basati sulla fisica che portano farmaci migliori ai pazienti più velocemente è la vostra chiamata, applicare ora e contribuire a modellare il futuro della scoperta di droga di piccola molecola. #ComputationCoE #tech4lifeComputationalScienza #tech4lifeAI Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Welwyn. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Technical Product Owner - Digital Health Platform, Secure Cloud

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Roche’s expanding digital product portfolio demonstrates its commitment to provide healthcare professionals, laboratories, and patients with digital and digitally-enabled solutions that transform patient care. The existing product portfolio includes decision support systems, data management solutions, and workflow solutions. At the center of these diverse types of solutions is always patient data security and privacy as the highest priority for Roche.

In this context, Roche has built a global team that builds, secures, and operates infrastructure platforms (cloud and on-prem) for its digital products. This team is working with a high freedom to operate in a self-organized setup and is responsible for tackling the cybersecurity, compliance, and infrastructure challenges of the healthcare industry while enabling high-velocity product development.

The opportunity:
The Technical Product Owner will join the Secure Account Management (SAM) team - responsible for cloud infrastructure, account provisioning, security, and governance across Roche's digital product portfolio. The team manages 650+ AWS accounts and enables application teams to build and operate healthcare solutions by providing secure, standardized infrastructure while maintaining development and deployment autonomy.
This role sits at the intersection of product thinking and cloud engineering. You will own the product roadmap and backlog for SAM's cloud and services portfolio, translating the needs of digital health product teams into a platform that is secure, self-service, and well-documented. The platform delivers compliant AWS landing zones integrated with a modern cybersecurity backbone, providing guardrails for hosted applications across AWS regions worldwide - and is evolving toward supporting external partners and third-party consumers.

What you will do:

• Own, prioritise, and communicate the product roadmap for SAM's cloud landing zone and associated services - balancing security, compliance, developer experience, and self-service.

• Act as the voice of platform customers (internal product teams and, increasingly, external partners): gather feedback, represent the platform in PI planning sessions, and maintain transparency on request lifecycle and prioritisation decisions.

• Drive platform evolution toward self-service and automation - reducing manual ticket-based workflows in favour of programmatic access, Infrastructure-as-Code, and API-first interfaces.

• Ow
