jobs.title: Sales Manager (Diabetes Care)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Sales Manager executes the commercial strategy within their assigned geographical region. This role involves actively promoting products to current and potential prescribers and influencers to achieve sales targets. The Sales Manager co-creates commercial strategies, shares best practices locally and globally, and collaborates with Marketing on KOL management, product promotion, and competitive analysis.

Your Impact:

Business Development:

• Cultivate new and existing customer relationships to achieve sales KPIs, including a minimum of 12 daily visits, timely plan updates, and meeting all sales targets. Ensure all interactions and time allocations are accurately documented in the CRM system.

• Identify commercial process limitations and propose solutions to relevant stakeholders; co-lead the implementation of these improvements.

• Prioritize new opportunities across the entire portfolio and continue the activation of blood glucose meters and related services.

• Maintain existing and develop potential customer base

• Analyze customer needs, competition, and regulatory shifts to identify market opportunities and threats. Recommend and implement measures to achieve objectives in collaboration with commercial teams.

Controlling and Reporting:

• Report activities, sales plan progress, and target achievements in Salesforce/REXIS to commercial management.

• Provide regular feedback on product quality, customer satisfaction, and profitability through benchmarking and analysis.

• Document all interactions with HCPs and HCOs in compliance with DIA Symphony, Roche Code of Conduct, internal policies, and local regulations.

Adherence to Compliance Policies and Company Operating Standards:

• Complete administrative tasks, including call reports and expenses, within standard deadlines.

• Ensure that financial responsibilities are correctly managed, including expense compliance, sponsorship budget and FOC meter budget.

• Ensure that all relevant Company policies and procedures are understood and adhered to.

• Maintain confidence in the confidential information, management of document accuracy.

Dia Symphony adherence:

• Adhere to Roche Directives regarding the differentiation of Medical and Commercial functions (Standard 61) and maintain effective cross-functional collaboration.

• Any off-label promotion of Roche products is strictly prohibited, above mentioned products always refer to on-label products

• Ensure compliance with Roche Group Code of Conduct and all other local laws, company policies and regulations

• Pass mandatory trainings related to behavior in business, compliance, quality, regulatory.

External and Internal collaboration:

• Foster a positive organizational culture and collaborate with stakeholders across all levels to share best practices and knowledge.

• Increase knowledge and best practice sharing through networking and connecting experts and talents

• Focus on efficiency, performance

• Ensure effective information flow and cooperate with other departments to optimize procedures and enhance customer satisfaction.

Personal Development and growth:

• Engage in continuous professional upskilling to deepen understanding of Roche products and operating standards.

• Commit to a personal development plan focused on enhancing soft skills and competencies to maintain high performance.

Who you are

• You hold University master's degree in Natural/Life Sciences, Engineering, Business & Economics Project Management. Preferably relation

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Sales Manager esegue la strategia commerciale all'interno della loro regione geografica assegnata. Questo ruolo coinvolge attivamente la promozione dei prodotti ai prescritti e agli influencer attuali e potenziali per raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita. Il Sales Manager co-crea strategie commerciali, condivide le migliori pratiche a livello locale e globale, e collabora con Marketing sulla gestione KOL, la promozione dei prodotti e l'analisi competitiva. Il tuo impatto: Sviluppo aziendale:
• Coltivare nuove e esistenti relazioni con i clienti per raggiungere i KPI di vendita, tra cui un minimo di 12 visite giornaliere, aggiornamenti tempestivi del piano e soddisfare tutti gli obiettivi di vendita. Assicurarsi che tutte le interazioni e le allocazioni di tempo siano documentate con precisione nel sistema CRM.
• Identificare le limitazioni dei processi commerciali e proporre soluzioni alle parti interessate pertinenti; co-perare l'attuazione di tali miglioramenti.
• Priorizzare nuove opportunità in tutto il portafoglio e continuare l'attivazione di contatori di glucosio nel sangue e servizi correlati.
• Mantenere la base clienti esistente e sviluppare potenziali
• Analizzare le esigenze dei clienti, la concorrenza e i cambiamenti normativi per identificare le opportunità di mercato e le minacce. Raccomandare e attuare misure per raggiungere obiettivi in collaborazione con team commerciali. Controllo e reporting:
• Rapporti le attività, i progressi del piano di vendita e i risultati raggiunti in Salesforce/REXIS alla gestione commerciale.
• Fornisci un feedback regolare sulla qualità del prodotto, sulla soddisfazione del cliente e sulla redditività attraverso il benchmarking e l'analisi.
• Documenta tutte le interazioni con HCP e HCO in conformità con DIA Symphony, Roche Code of Conduct, politiche interne e normative locali. Aderenza alle politiche di conformità e agli standard operativi aziendali:
• Completi compiti amministrativi, inclusi i rapporti di chiamata e le spese, entro scadenze standard.
• Assicurarsi che le responsabilità finanziarie siano correttamente gestite, tra cui la conformità delle spese, il bilancio di sponsorizzazione e il bilancio del misuratore FOC.
• Assicurarsi che tutte le politiche e le procedure aziendali pertinenti sono comprese e aderite.
• Mantenere la fiducia nelle informazioni riservate, la gestione della precisione dei documenti. Aderenza Sinfonica di Dia:
• Direttive Roche per quanto riguarda la differenziazione delle funzioni mediche e commerciali (Standard 61) e mantenere un'efficace collaborazione interfunzionale.
• Qualsiasi promozione off-label dei prodotti Roche è severamente vietata, i prodotti sopra menzionati si riferiscono sempre ai prodotti on-label
• Assicurarsi il rispetto del Codice di condotta del Gruppo Roche e di tutte le altre leggi locali, politiche aziendali e regolamenti
• Passare formazioni obbligatorie relative al comportamento in affari, conformità, qualità, regolazione. Collaborazione esterna e interna:
• Promuovere una cultura organizzativa positiva e collaborare con gli stakeholder di tutti i livelli per condividere le migliori pratiche e conoscenze.
• Aumentare la conoscenza e la migliore condivisione delle pratiche attraverso il networking e la connessione di esperti e talenti
• Focus su efficienza, prestazioni
• Assicurare un flusso di informazioni efficace e collaborare con altri dipartimenti per ottimizzare le procedure e migliorare la soddisfazione del cliente. Sviluppo personale e crescita:
• Impegnarsi in continuo aggiornamento professionale per approfondire la comprensione dei prodotti Roche e degli standard operativi.
• Impegnarsi a un piano di sviluppo personale mirato a migliorare le competenze e le competenze morbide per mantenere alte prestazioni. Chi sei
• Hai conseguito la laurea in Scienze naturali/vita, Ingegneria, Business & Economics Project Management. Preferito rapporto

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Der Verkaufsleiter führt die Geschäftsstrategie innerhalb der ihm zugewiesenen geografischen Region aus. Diese Rolle beinhaltet die aktive Förderung von Produkten bei aktuellen und potenziellen Verschreibern und Influencern, um Verkaufsziele zu erreichen. Der Sales Manager erstellt gemeinsam Geschäftsstrategien, teilt Best Practices lokal und global und arbeitet mit dem Marketing in den Bereichen KOL-Management, Produktwerbung und Wettbewerbsanalyse zusammen. Ihre Wirkung: Geschäftsentwicklung:
• Pflegen Sie neue und bestehende Kundenbeziehungen, um Verkaufs-KPIs zu erzielen, einschließlich mindestens 12 täglicher Besuche, rechtzeitiger Planaktualisierungen und Erreichung aller Verkaufsziele. Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Interaktionen und Zeitzuweisungen im CRM-System genau dokumentiert sind.
• Identifizieren Sie kommerzielle Prozessbeschränkungen und schlagen Sie Lösungen für relevante Interessengruppen vor; führen Sie die Umsetzung dieser Verbesserungen mit.
• Priorisieren Sie neue Möglichkeiten im gesamten Portfolio und setzen Sie die Aktivierung von Blutzuckermessgeräten und damit verbundenen Dienstleistungen fort.
• Pflegen Sie bestehende und potenzielle Kundenbasis
• Analysieren Sie Kundenbedürfnisse, Wettbewerb und regulatorische Veränderungen, um Marktchancen und -bedrohungen zu identifizieren. Empfehlen und implementieren Sie Maßnahmen, um Ziele in Zusammenarbeit mit kommerziellen Teams zu erreichen. Controlling und Reporting:
• Melden Sie Aktivitäten, Verkaufsplanfortschritte und Zielerreichungen in Salesforce/REXIS an das kaufmännische Management.
• Regelmäßiges Feedback zu Produktqualität, Kundenzufriedenheit und Rentabilität durch Benchmarking und Analyse.
• Dokumentation aller Interaktionen mit HCPs und HCOs in Übereinstimmung mit DIA Symphony, Roche Code of Conduct, internen Richtlinien und lokalen Vorschriften. Einhaltung von Compliance-Richtlinien und Betriebsnormen des Unternehmens:
• Erledigen Sie Verwaltungsaufgaben, einschließlich Anrufmeldungen und Ausgaben, innerhalb der üblichen Fristen.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die finanziellen Verantwortlichkeiten korrekt verwaltet werden, einschließlich Kosteneinhaltung, Sponsoring-Budget und FOC-Meter-Budget.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle relevanten Richtlinien und Verfahren des Unternehmens verstanden und eingehalten werden.
• Halten Sie das Vertrauen in die vertraulichen Informationen, Verwaltung der Dokumentgenauigkeit. Einhaltung von Dia Symphony:
• Befolgen Sie die Roche-Richtlinien zur Differenzierung von medizinischen und kommerziellen Funktionen (Standard 61) und pflegen Sie eine effektive funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit.
• Jede Off-Label-Werbung für Roche-Produkte ist strengstens untersagt, die oben genannten Produkte beziehen sich immer auf On-Label-Produkte.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung des Verhaltenskodex der Roche Group und aller anderen lokalen Gesetze, Richtlinien und Vorschriften
• Bestehen Sie obligatorische Schulungen in Bezug auf Verhalten in der Wirtschaft, Compliance, Qualität, Regulierung. Externe und interne Zusammenarbeit:
• Fördern Sie eine positive Organisationskultur und arbeiten Sie mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen zusammen, um Best Practices und Wissen auszutauschen.
• Steigerung des Wissens- und Best-Practice-Austauschs durch Vernetzung und Vernetzung von Experten und Talenten
• Fokus auf Effizienz, Performance
• Gewährleistung eines effektiven Informationsflusses und Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen, um die Abläufe zu optimieren und die Kundenzufriedenheit zu verbessern. Persönliche Entwicklung und Wachstum:
• Engagieren Sie sich in einer kontinuierlichen beruflichen Weiterbildung, um das Verständnis der Roche-Produkte und Betriebsnormen zu vertiefen.
• Verpflichten Sie sich zu einem persönlichen Entwicklungsplan, der sich auf die Verbesserung von Soft Skills und Kompetenzen konzentriert, um eine hohe Leistung zu gewährleisten. Wer du bist
• Sie haben einen Master-Abschluss in Natural / Life Sciences, Engineering, Business & Economics Project Management. Vorzugsweise Beziehung

• Suivi et rétroaction concernant la qualité des produits et la qualité du service, ce qui permet de maintenir et d'améliorer la satisfaction des clients
• Mener des négociations et des discussions contractuelles avec les principaux clients (C-Suite)
• Assurer le respect du code de conduite de Roche Group et de toutes les autres lois, politiques et règlements locaux. Contrôle et rapports :
• Rapporter les activités, les progrès du plan de vente et les réalisations cibles de Salesforce/REXIS aux gestionnaires commerciaux

jobs.title: Central Operations Specialist (PV, Pharmacovigilance)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Are you ready to play a pivotal role in transforming how patient safety data is delivered globally?

As our Central Operations Specialist within Patient Safety Operations , you will be at the heart of our mission to ensure the efficient, high-quality, and compliant delivery of safety data outputs. You will process and report Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs) and device safety reports, via the utilisation of current/future safety systems, and use of vendor services, and co-develop innovative approaches for the transformation and reporting of wider types of safety-relevant data, beyond ICSRs.

In this dynamic role, you will collaborate closely with global vendors, business process owners, and cross-functional teams to maintain our inspection readiness and drive continuous improvements. You will have the unique opportunity to support change initiatives, explore cutting-edge technologies like artificial intelligence in pharmacovigilance, and guide our operations to meet both current and future regulatory requirements.

• Oversee Safety Data Quality: Monitor workload, compliance, and quality across the global ICSR footprint to ensure internal and external performance standards are consistently met.

• Manage Vendor & Process Collaboration: Support the oversight, coordination, and inspection readiness of ICSR and medical device safety activities in collaboration with external vendors and internal alliance managers.

• Drive Continuous Improvement: Develop, maintain, and review metrics and KPIs to identify and execute process enhancements within safety reporting sub-processes.

• Lead AI & Innovation Initiatives: Support the implementation of AI-augmented activities and human-in-the-loop interventions to optimize operational safety report delivery.

• Provide Governance & Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a key point of contact for queries and issue escalations, supporting Case Processing Governance across Patient Safety Operations sites.

• Support Regulatory Reporting Projects: Execute and coordinate regulatory reporting projects for Roche products by preparing documentation and ensuring adherence to established quality standards.

Who You Are

• Industry Experience: A minimum of 2 years of relevant experience within the pharmaceutical industry, preferably with an emphasis on pharmacovigilance.

• PV Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of global Pharmacovigilance regulatory obligations and compliance standards.

• Project & Conflict Management: Proven ability to support or lead projects to a successful conclusion while demonstrating strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.

• Agile Mindset: Comfort working in a matrix environment, actively participating in or leading agile squads and sprints to deliver on business strategies.

• Educational Background: A minimum of a degree-level qualification in a scientific or relevant field.

This position is based in Budapest, Hungary. Relocation Assistance is not available.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make

jobs.title: Senior Statistician
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Statistician

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
This role is within Biostatistics, a core function within Product Development Data Science and Analytics (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across Development at Roche. Biostatistics identifies opportunities to apply the full breadth of data, digital, and design capabilities to deploy innovative methods across PDD, PD and the broader Roche Pharma organization.
As trusted analytical partners in end-to-end drug development, Biostatistics leverages data to drive scientifically rigorous programmatic decisions across Roche’s Development portfolio; Biostatistics designs robust trials and analysis plans that increase the probability of technical success, accelerating timelines to advance Roche’s clinical pipeline and promote regulatory success — ultimately bringing medicines to our patients faster.

The Opportunity:

The Statistician is a key member of the cross-functional study or molecule team, responsible for applying statistical expertise to the design, conduct, analysis, and interpretation of individual clinical trials. This role ensures the scientific rigor and regulatory compliance of the study by contributing to protocol development, authoring statistical analysis plans, performing or overseeing data analyses, and supporting the interpretation and communication of results. The Statistician plays a critical role in ensuring that each study generates robust, meaningful data to support decision-making and regulatory submissions.

• You independently lead statistical input into clinical trial design, aligning with scientific objectives

• You own the development and quality review of statistical study documents

• You design and execute complex analyses, proactively resolving challenges

• You represent Biostatistics and PDD at the Study Team level, ensuring statistical and scientific rigor of study deliverables

• You collaborate proactively with cross-functional teams to align deliverables and timelines

• You interpret and communicate results in context, influencing study-level decisions

• You lead statistical contributions to CSRs and selected regulatory documents

• You provide functional guidance and informal mentoring to less experienced statisticians

• You may lead or influence study-level projects or contribute significantly to large project teams or initiatives

Who You Are:

• You hold an MSc or PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a closely related quantitative field

• You have a confirmed experience in clinical trial statistics within a pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO setting

• You have demonstrated experience contributing to the design, analysis, and interpretation of clinical studies across different phases

• You have a solid understanding of regulatory expectations and statistical methodologies for clinical development

• You are proficient in SAS and/or R and familiar with CDISC standards

• You are able to work autonomously while collaborating effectively in cross-functional teams

• You demonstrate capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles

• You bring excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond the te

Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Questo ruolo è all'interno di Biostatistics, una funzione fondamentale all'interno di Product Development Data Science and Analytics (PDD) che fornisce leadership strategica e rigore scientifico attraverso lo sviluppo a Roche. La biostatistica identifica le opportunità di applicare la larghezza completa delle capacità di dati, digitali e di progettazione per implementare metodi innovativi attraverso PDD, PD e l'organizzazione Roche Pharma più ampia. Come partner analitici di fiducia nello sviluppo di droga end-to-end, Biostatistics sfrutta i dati per guidare le decisioni programmatiche scientificamente rigorose in tutto il portafoglio di sviluppo di Roche; Biostatistics progetta studi e piani di analisi robusti che aumentano la probabilità di successo tecnico, accelerando le linee temporali per avanzare la pipeline clinica di Roche e promuovere il successo normativo - alla fine portando i farmaci ai nostri pazienti più velocemente. L'opportunità: Lo statististico è un membro chiave del team di studio o molecola multifunzione, responsabile dell'applicazione di competenze statistiche alla progettazione, alla conduzione, all'analisi e all'interpretazione di singoli studi clinici. Questo ruolo garantisce il rigore scientifico e la conformità normativa dello studio contribuendo allo sviluppo del protocollo, autorizzando piani di analisi statistica, eseguendo o supervisionando analisi dei dati, e sostenendo l'interpretazione e la comunicazione dei risultati. Lo statististico svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire che ogni studio genera dati robusti e significativi per supportare il processo decisionale e le sottomissioni normative.
• Condurre in modo indipendente l'ingresso statistico nella progettazione clinica di prova, allineando con gli obiettivi scientifici
• Lei possiede lo sviluppo e la revisione di qualità dei documenti di studio statistico
• Progettare ed eseguire analisi complesse, risolvendo proattivamente le sfide
• Tu rappresenti Biostatistica e PDD a livello del Team di Studio, garantendo rigore statistico e scientifico dei risultati di studio
• Collabori in modo proattivo con i team interfunzionali per allineare le consegne e le tempistiche
• Interpreti e comunichi i risultati nel contesto, influenzando le decisioni a livello di studio
• Conduci contributi statistici alla RSI e ai documenti regolamentari selezionati
• Fornisci una guida funzionale e un mentore informale agli statistici meno esperti
• È possibile condurre o influenzare progetti a livello di studio o contribuire in modo significativo a grandi team di progetto o iniziative Chi sei?
• Hai un MSc o un dottorato in Statistica, Biostatistica, o un campo quantitativo strettamente correlato
• Hai un'esperienza confermata nelle statistiche di sperimentazione clinica all'interno di un'impostazione farmaceutica, biotecnologia o CRO
• Hai dimostrato esperienza contribuendo alla progettazione, analisi e interpretazione di studi clinici in diverse fasi
• Hai una solida comprensione delle aspettative normative e delle metodologie statistiche per lo sviluppo clinico
• Sei esperto in SAS e/o R e conosci gli standard CDISC
• Siete in grado di lavorare autonomamente mentre collaborate efficacemente in team interfunzionali
• Lei dimostra capacità di pensiero indipendente e capacità di prendere decisioni basate su principi sani
• Porti un'eccellente agilità strategica tra cui capacità di problem solving e di pensiero critico, e agilità che si estende oltre il te

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Senior Statistiker Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Diese Rolle ist Teil von Biostatistics, einer Kernfunktion von Product Development Data Science and Analytics (PDD), die strategische Führung und wissenschaftliche Strenge in der Entwicklung bei Roche bietet. Biostatistik identifiziert Möglichkeiten, die gesamte Bandbreite der Daten-, Digital- und Designfähigkeiten anzuwenden, um innovative Methoden für PDD, PD und die breitere Roche Pharma-Organisation einzusetzen. Als vertrauenswürdiger analytischer Partner in der End-to-End-Arzneimittelentwicklung nutzt Biostatistics Daten, um wissenschaftlich strenge programmatische Entscheidungen im gesamten Entwicklungsportfolio von Roche zu treffen; Biostatistics entwickelt robuste Studien- und Analysepläne, die die Wahrscheinlichkeit des technischen Erfolgs erhöhen, die Zeitpläne beschleunigen, um die klinische Pipeline von Roche voranzutreiben und den regulatorischen Erfolg zu fördern – und letztlich Medikamente schneller zu unseren Patienten bringen. Die Gelegenheit: Der Statistiker ist ein wichtiges Mitglied der funktionsübergreifenden Studie oder des Molekülteams und verantwortlich für die Anwendung von statistischem Fachwissen für die Gestaltung, Durchführung, Analyse und Interpretation einzelner klinischer Studien. Diese Rolle stellt die wissenschaftliche Strenge und die Einhaltung der Vorschriften durch die Studie sicher, indem sie zur Protokollentwicklung beiträgt, statistische Analysepläne erstellt, Datenanalysen durchführt oder überwacht und die Interpretation und Kommunikation der Ergebnisse unterstützt. Der Statistiker spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Sicherstellung, dass jede Studie robuste, aussagekräftige Daten generiert, um Entscheidungsfindung und regulatorische Einreichungen zu unterstützen.
• Sie führen unabhängig voneinander den statistischen Input in die klinische Studiengestaltung und richten sich an wissenschaftlichen Zielen aus
• Sie besitzen die Entwicklung und Qualitätsüberprüfung von statistischen Studiendokumenten
• Sie entwerfen und führen komplexe Analysen durch und lösen proaktiv Herausforderungen
• Sie vertreten Biostatistik und PDD auf der Ebene des Studienteams und gewährleisten die statistische und wissenschaftliche Genauigkeit der Studienergebnisse
• Sie arbeiten proaktiv mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um Ergebnisse und Zeitpläne aufeinander abzustimmen
• Sie interpretieren und kommunizieren Ergebnisse im Kontext und beeinflussen Entscheidungen auf Studienebene
• Sie führen statistische Beiträge zu CSRs und ausgewählten regulatorischen Dokumenten
• Sie bieten funktionale Anleitung und informelles Mentoring für weniger erfahrene Statistiker
• Sie können Projekte auf Studienebene leiten oder beeinflussen oder wesentlich zu großen Projektteams oder Initiativen beitragen. Wer Du bist:
• Sie haben einen MSc oder PhD in Statistik, Biostatistik oder einem eng verwandten quantitativen Bereich
• Sie haben eine bestätigte Erfahrung in der klinischen Studienstatistik in einer Pharma-, Biotech- oder CRO-Einstellung
• Sie haben Erfahrung gezeigt, die zur Gestaltung, Analyse und Interpretation klinischer Studien in verschiedenen Phasen beiträgt
• Sie haben ein solides Verständnis der regulatorischen Erwartungen und statistischen Methoden für die klinische Entwicklung
• Sie beherrschen SAS und / oder R und sind mit CDISC-Standards vertraut
• Sie können autonom arbeiten und gleichzeitig effektiv in funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenarbeiten
• Sie zeigen die Fähigkeit zu unabhängigem Denken und die Fähigkeit, Entscheidungen auf der Grundlage solider Prinzipien zu treffen
• Sie bringen ausgezeichnete strategische Agilität mit, einschließlich Problemlösungs- und kritischen Denkfähigkeiten, und Agilität, die über den gesamten Zeitraum hinausgeht.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
The Position

At Roche, we are building a scalable and compliant omnichannel engagement ecosystem that enables personalized, data-driven interactions across channels.
As an IT Business Analyst within Omnichannel Orchestration, you will act as the bridge between business stakeholders, affiliate teams, and technology delivery teams. You will play a key role in translating business needs into clear requirements, supporting onboarding and adoption of omnichannel capabilities, and ensuring successful delivery of customer engagement use cases across markets.
A major focus of this role will be supporting the rollout, adoption, and continuous improvement of omnichannel engagement capabilities across Pharma International affiliates.
This role will work closely with Product Owners, Solution Architects, Engineers, Data Teams, and Business Stakeholders, you will help shape requirements, improve processes, and ensure solutions deliver measurable business value.

The Opportunity
Business Analysis & Requirements Management

• Gather, analyze, and document business requirements for omnichannel engagement, customer journeys, audience segmentation, and activation use cases.

• Translate business needs into user stories, process flows, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria.

• Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and requirement gathering activities with global and affiliate stakeholders.

• Support backlog refinement and prioritization activities with Product Owners and delivery teams.

Affiliate Engagement & Omnichannel Adoption

• Act as a key point of contact for affiliate teams adopting omnichannel capabilities.

• Understand affiliate business processes, pain points, and market-specific requirements.

• Support onboarding activities, capability demonstrations, training sessions, and business readiness efforts.

• Identify opportunities to improve adoption, operational efficiency, and user experience.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Product Owners, Solution Architects, Engineers, Data Teams, and Vendors to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and implemented.

• Support testing, validation, and user acceptance activities.

• Help manage dependencies across business, process, data, and technology workstreams.

Continuous Improvement

• Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for optimization and standardization.

• Contribute to documentation, governance practices, templates, and best practices.

• Support reporting, insights, and measurement activities to evaluate business outcomes and adoption.

Who You Are
You are a delivery-oriented and collaborative leader who is comfortable operating across business and technology domains within large-scale enterprise transformation programs.

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Consulting, Product Delivery, CRM, Marketing Technology, Omnichannel Engagement, or Digital Transformation domains.

• Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements and translating them into scalable technology solutions.

• Strong stakeholder management skills with experience working in large-scale enterprise transformation or digital engagement programs.

• Experience operating within Agile delivery environments and collaborating across product, engineering, and business teams.

• Strong understanding of omnichannel engagement, campaign execution, customer journeys, audience segmentation, and activation workflows.

• Identificare le opportunità per migliorare l'adozione, l'efficienza operativa e l'esperienza degli utenti. Collaborazione trasversale
• Partner con Product Owners, Solution Architects, Engineers, Data Teams e Vendors per garantire che i requisiti aziendali siano chiaramente compresi e implementati.

• Aiuta a gestire le dipendenze attraverso business, processi, dati e flussi di lavoro di tecnologia. Miglioramento continuo
• Analizzare i processi aziendali e identificare le opportunità di ottimizzazione e standardizzazione.

• Prova a raccogliere, analizzare e documentare i requisiti aziendali e traducerli in soluzioni tecnologiche scalabili.
• Forte capacità di gestione degli stakeholder con esperienza di lavoro nella trasformazione aziendale su larga scala o programmi di coinvolgimento digitale.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Service Delivery Manager, RDT Onsite Europe West (Engineering Manager) you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area

Workforce Enablement (WE) is the home for employee facing products, services, and experiences within RDT. We deliver digital tools, drive adoption, and provide the support necessary to enable the entire workforce, wherever they are, every single day.
The Onsite Enablement organization is the heartbeat of our physical presence. We are the bridge between digital strategy and local execution, ensuring that every site—from R&D labs to corporate hubs—operates with seamless, cutting-edge technology services. As part of this team, you will oversee a team of individual contributors who are the primary points of accountability for onsite service excellence, infrastructure stability, and user experience within their respective sites. Our mission is to provide a "frictionless" workplace where technology empowers our people to focus on what matters most: improving patient lives.
This RDT leader is accountable for the people, budget, and services required to deliver a high quality offering for employees.

Job responsibilities

• Team Member Capability and Career Development 

• Focuses on developing engineering team capabilities that align with the immediate project needs and goals and function's overall vision.

• Encourages team members to self-define their career journey and actively enables development opportunities that align with it.

• Removes roadblocks and sets clear, achievable performance goals.

• Ensures the team develops the right skills and healthy internal dynamics to meet current and future challenges.

• Team Health and Sustainability 

• Maintains a sustainable pace of work for the team, balancing delivery goals with team well-being.

• Cultivates healthy team dynamics and collaboration, ensuring psychological safety and open communication.

• Removes impediments that hinder flow or morale, acting as an escalation point for the team.

• Ensures team members are equipped with the necessary, relevant skills and that roles are clearly defined.

• Product and Service Delivery Leadership ⚙️

• Responsible for co-creating the Product / Service Roadmap from a technical perspective, partnering with the Product Manager who is overall responsible.

• Accountable for the team's end-to-end delivery of features as part of the product development, ensuring alignment with the product roadmap and quality standards.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Als Service Delivery Manager, RDT Onsite Europe West (Engineering Manager) konzentrieren Sie sich auf die Entwicklung der Fähigkeiten Ihrer Teammitglieder, die mit der Vision der Funktion übereinstimmen. Sie werden Ihr Team ermutigen, seine Karrierereise selbst zu definieren und nach Möglichkeiten zu suchen, Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in Richtung der Reise zu ermöglichen. Sie werden sie dabei unterstützen, Hindernisse zu beseitigen und sich auf ihr Leistungsmanagement zu konzentrieren. Sie stellen sicher, dass Sie Ihr Team mit den richtigen Fähigkeiten, einer gesunden Dynamik und einem nachhaltigen Tempo entwickeln. Sie unterstützen die Software- und/oder Servicebereitstellung als Führungskraft, indem Sie Hindernisse beseitigen, Stakeholder verwalten und wo immer möglich Effizienz in der Zusammenarbeit schaffen. Beschreibung des Gebiets Workforce Enablement (WE) ist das Zuhause für Mitarbeiter, die mit Produkten, Dienstleistungen und Erfahrungen innerhalb von RDT konfrontiert sind. Wir liefern digitale Tools, fördern die Akzeptanz und bieten die notwendige Unterstützung, um die gesamte Belegschaft, wo auch immer sie sind, jeden Tag zu ermöglichen. Die Onsite Enablement Organisation ist der Herzschlag unserer physischen Präsenz. Wir sind die Brücke zwischen digitaler Strategie und lokaler Umsetzung und stellen sicher, dass jeder Standort - von F & E-Labors bis hin zu Unternehmenszentren - mit nahtlosen, innovativen Technologiediensten arbeitet. Als Teil dieses Teams betreuen Sie ein Team von einzelnen Mitwirkenden, die die Hauptverantwortungspunkte für Vor-Ort-Service-Exzellenz, Infrastrukturstabilität und Benutzererfahrung in ihren jeweiligen Standorten sind. Unsere Mission ist es, einen "friktionslosen" Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, an dem Technologie unsere Mitarbeiter befähigt, sich auf das zu konzentrieren, was am wichtigsten ist: das Leben der Patienten zu verbessern. Dieser RDT-Leiter ist für die Mitarbeiter, das Budget und die Dienstleistungen verantwortlich, die erforderlich sind, um ein qualitativ hochwertiges Angebot für die Mitarbeiter zu liefern. • Team Gesundheit und Nachhaltigkeit
• Behält ein nachhaltiges Arbeitstempo für das Team bei und balanciert Lieferziele mit dem Wohlbefinden des Teams.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que gestionnaire de la prestation des services, RDT Onsite Europe West (gestionnaire d'ingénierie), vous vous concentrerez sur le développement des capacités des membres de votre équipe qui s'alignent sur la vision de la fonction. Vous encouragerez votre équipe à définir elle-même leur parcours de carrière et à chercher des moyens de permettre des opportunités de développement dans la direction du parcours. Vous les aiderez à supprimer les barrages routiers et en mettant l'accent sur leur gestion du rendement. Vous assurez-vous de développer votre équipe avec les bonnes compétences, dynamique saine et un rythme durable. Vous soutenez le logiciel et/ou la prestation de services en tant que chef de file, en éliminant les obstacles, en gérant les intervenants et en créant des gains d'efficacité en collaboration dans la mesure du possible. Description de la zone Activement de la main-d'oeuvre (WE) est la maison pour les employés faisant face aux produits, services et expériences au sein du RDT. Nous livrons des outils numériques, conduisons l'adoption et fournissons le soutien nécessaire pour permettre à l'ensemble de la main-d'oeuvre, où qu'elle soit, chaque jour. L'organisation d'activation sur place est le battement de cœur de notre présence physique. Nous sommes le pont entre la stratégie numérique et l'exécution locale, en veillant à ce que chaque site — des laboratoires de R-D aux centres d'entreprises — fonctionne avec des services technologiques de pointe sans faille. Dans le cadre de cette équipe, vous superviserez une équipe de contributeurs individuels qui sont les principaux responsables de l'excellence des services sur place, de la stabilité de l'infrastructure et de l'expérience utilisateur dans leurs sites respectifs. Notre mission est de fournir un lieu de travail « sans friction » où la technologie permet à nos employés de se concentrer sur ce qui compte le plus : améliorer la vie des patients. Ce chef de file est responsable des personnes, du budget et des services nécessaires pour offrir une offre de haute qualité aux employés. Responsabilités professionnelles
• Capacité des membres de l'équipe et perfectionnement professionnel
• Se concentre sur le développement des capacités de l'équipe d'ingénierie qui correspondent aux besoins et aux objectifs immédiats du projet et à la vision globale de la fonction.
• Encourage les membres de l'équipe à définir eux-mêmes leur parcours de carrière et permet activement des possibilités de développement qui s'harmonisent avec elle.
• Enlever les barrages routiers et fixer des objectifs de rendement clairs et réalisables.
• S'assure que l'équipe développe les bonnes compétences et une dynamique interne saine pour relever les défis actuels et futurs.
• Équipe Santé et durabilité
• Maintenir un rythme de travail durable pour l'équipe, en conciliant les objectifs de prestation et le bien-être de l'équipe.
• Cultiver une saine dynamique d'équipe et la collaboration, en assurant la sécurité psychologique et la communication ouverte.
• Supprime les obstacles qui entravent l'écoulement ou le moral, agissant comme un point d'escalade pour l'équipe.
• S'assure que les membres de l'équipe sont dotés des compétences nécessaires et pertinentes et que les rôles sont clairement définis.
• Leadership de la prestation des produits et des services
• Responsable de la co-création de la feuille de route produit / service d'un point de vue technique, en partenariat avec le gestionnaire de produit qui est globalement responsable.
• Responsable de la livraison de bout en bout des caractéristiques de l'équipe dans le cadre du développement du produit, assurant l'alignement sur la feuille de route du produit et les normes de qualité.
• Établir des priorités et des priorités claires pour le travail d'exécution de l'équipe, en assurant l'alignement sur les feuilles de route des produits.
• Supprime activement les obstacles et les obstacles au progrès, et augmente au besoin pour protéger l'orientation de l'équipe.
• Gérer et harmoniser les attentes et les besoins des intervenants, en fournissant des mises à jour régulières sur les progrès et les risques.
• Créer des gains d'efficacité en collaboration lorsque cela est possible entre les équipes et les fonctions. •

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

We are looking for the Delivery Lead who will be accountable for leading the design, implementation, and operationalization of Master Data Management capabilities across RDT Diagnostics Commercial, with a strong focus on Customer Master Data Management, Patient Master Data Management, and global MDM implementation programs.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is based in the Digital Endpoints and Patient-Centered Solutions (DEPCS) team, the innovative digital, AI, and tech function within Roche Product Development Data Sciences (PDD). Operating across the Science of Medicines and Operations, DEPCS is responsible for embedding patient-centered and AI-enabled digital solutions into the fabric of clinical research. By integrating data science, measurement science, and digital product thinking, DEPCS delivers scalable and regulatory-ready innovations that enhance trial design, evidence generation, and clinical value of Roche medicines.

The Opportunity:

The Senior AI/ML Data Scientist within the Digital Endpoints and Patient-Centered Solutions (DEPCS) function is responsible for designing, building, and deploying AI-based solutions to enhance clinical trials and accelerate data-driven decision-making in drug development. Collaborating across clinical, data science, and engineering teams, the role contributes to the development of multimodal AI solutions, anchored primarily in sensor time-series and causal inference, with the agility to expand into other modalities like medical imaging. You will act as a key technical and operational anchor, driving sensor data analytics activities to maximize the portfolio impact of measures derived from digital health technologies (DHT).

• You analyze sensor time-series, biological, and clinical data to generate insights supporting decision-making in clinical development.

• You transform raw sensor data from varied wearable platforms into interpretable digital measures through robust signal processing, feature engineering, and algorithm development.

• You design and implement advanced machine learning algorithms tailored to clinical trial data, ensuring adherence to best software engineering practices, comprehensive documentation, and validation protocols to safeguard scientific rigor.

• You design and apply advanced Causal ML methodologies to clinical trial and observational data to support robust evidence generation and decision-making.

• You collaborate cross-functionally with teams including, but not limited to, clinical scientists, digital business leads, biostatisticians, and biomarker leaders, to integrate machine learning models into Roche platforms and clinical workflows.

• You present technical insights to both scientific and non-technical audiences and contribute to the publication of findings and to internal knowledge development efforts and also maintain awareness of trends in ML, digital biomarkers, and clinical AI

Who you are:

• You hold an MSc or PhD (preferred) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field and have 6+ years of experience in machine learning, signal processing or AI in biomedical, pharma, or healthcare innovation settings.

• You bring excellent communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills, with a track record of delivering innovative machine learning solutions aligned with business needs, and the ability to work independently as well as in a cross-functional team.

• You have expertise in sensor data analysis and signal processing, causal inference, machine learning, foundation models, statistics, and probabilistic modeling, with exposure to image analysis and computer vision.

• You have experience in bridging advanced sensor analytics with rigorous statistical frameworks, including the evaluation of psychometric properties to ensure valid evidence ge

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo ruolo si basa sul team Digital Endpoints e soluzioni paziente-Centered (DEPCS), l'innovativa funzione digitale, AI e tech all'interno di Roche Product Development Data Sciences (PDD). Operando attraverso la Scienza dei Medicinali e delle Operazioni, DEPCS è responsabile dell'integrazione di soluzioni digitali orientate al paziente e basate sull'intelligenza artificiale nel tessuto della ricerca clinica. Integrando la scienza dei dati, la scienza delle misurazioni e il pensiero dei prodotti digitali, DEPCS offre innovazioni scalabili e leggibili che migliorano la progettazione di prove, la generazione delle prove e il valore clinico dei medicinali Roche. L'opportunità: Lo scienziato di dati AI/ML senior all'interno della funzione Digital Endpoints e soluzioni pazienti-Centered (DEPCS) è responsabile della progettazione, costruzione e distribuzione di soluzioni basate su AI per migliorare gli studi clinici e accelerare il processo decisionale basato sui dati nello sviluppo della droga. Collaborando tra team clinici, di data science e di ingegneria, il ruolo contribuisce allo sviluppo di soluzioni AI multimodali, ancorate principalmente in serie di sensori e inferenza causale, con l'agilità di espandersi in altre modalità come l'imaging medico. Agirai come un importante ancoraggio tecnico e operativo, guidando le attività di analisi dei dati dei sensori per massimizzare l'impatto del portafoglio delle misure derivate dalle tecnologie sanitarie digitali (DHT).
• Analizzi i dati del tempo del sensore, biologici e clinici per generare informazioni che supportano il processo decisionale nello sviluppo clinico.
• Trasformate i dati del sensore grezzo da varie piattaforme indossabili in misure digitali interpretabili attraverso un'elaborazione robusta del segnale, l'ingegneria delle caratteristiche e lo sviluppo dell'algoritmo.
• Progetta e implementa algoritmi avanzati di machine learning su misura per i dati di prova clinica, assicurando l'adesione alle migliori pratiche di ingegneria del software, documentazione completa e protocolli di validazione per salvaguardare il rigore scientifico.
• Progetta e applica metodologie ML causali avanzate ai dati clinici di prova e di osservazione per supportare una solida generazione di prove e processi decisionali.
• Collabori in modo interfunzionale con team tra cui, ma non solo, scienziati clinici, business lead digitali, biostatisti e leader di biomarcatori, per integrare modelli di apprendimento automatico nelle piattaforme Roche e nei flussi di lavoro clinici.
• Vi presentiamo approfondimenti tecnici sia per il pubblico scientifico che non tecnico e contribuiscono alla pubblicazione dei risultati e agli sforzi di sviluppo della conoscenza interna e anche mantenere la consapevolezza delle tendenze in ML, biomarcatori digitali e AI clinica Chi sei:
• Hai un MSc o un PhD (preferito) in Informatica, Machine Learning, Statistica, Ingegneria Elettrica, Ingegneria Biomedicale, o un campo correlato e hanno 6+ anni di esperienza nell'apprendimento delle macchine, nell'elaborazione dei segnali o nell'intelligenza artificiale nelle impostazioni di innovazione biomedica, farmaceutica o sanitaria.
• Porti eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, problem solving e di lavoro di squadra, con un track record di fornire soluzioni innovative di machine learning allineate alle esigenze aziendali, e la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e in un team interfunzionale.
• Hai esperienza nell'analisi dei dati dei sensori e nell'elaborazione dei segnali, nell'inferenza causale, nell'apprendimento automatico, nei modelli di fondazione, nelle statistiche e nella modellazione probabilistica, con l'esposizione all'analisi delle immagini e alla visione del computer.
• Hai esperienza nell'analizzare i sensori avanzati con rigorosi framework statistici, compresa la valutazione delle proprietà psicometriche per garantire una prova valida ge

• Vous concevez et implémentez des algorithmes avancés d'apprentissage automatique adaptés aux données des essais cliniques, assurant le respect des meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie logicielle, une documentation complète et des protocoles de validation pour protéger la rigueur scientifique.
• Vous concevez et appliquez des méthodologies avancées de LM de Causal aux essais cliniques et aux données d'observation pour appuyer la production de preuves solides et la prise de décisions.
• Vous collaborez de façon interfonctionnelle avec des équipes comprenant, sans s'y limiter, des cliniciens-chercheurs, des chefs d'entreprise numériques, des biostatisticiens et des leaders de biomarqueurs, pour intégrer des modèles d'apprentissage automatique dans les plateformes Roche et les workflows cliniques.
• Vous présentez des idées techniques à des auditoires scientifiques et non techniques et contribuez à la publication des résultats et aux efforts de développement des connaissances internes. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'une maîtrise ou d'un doctorat (préféré) en informatique, en apprentissage automatique, en statistique, en génie électrique, en génie biomédical ou dans un domaine connexe et avez 6 ans ou plus d'expérience en apprentissage automatique, en traitement de signaux ou en IA dans des contextes d'innovation biomédicale, pharmaceutique ou en soins de santé.
• Vous apportez d'excellentes compétences en communication, résolution de problèmes et travail d'équipe, avec une expérience de la fourniture de solutions d'apprentissage automatique innovantes alignées sur les besoins de l'entreprise, et la capacité de travailler de manière indépendante ainsi que dans une équipe interfonctionnelle.
• Vous avez une expertise dans l'analyse de données de capteur et le traitement des signaux, l'inférence causale, l'apprentissage automatique, les modèles de base, les statistiques et la modélisation probabiliste, avec l'exposition à l'analyse d'image et la vision informatique.
• Vous avez de l'expérience dans l'analyse avancée des capteurs avec des cadres statistiques rigoureux, y compris l'évaluation des propriétés psychométriques pour assurer une preuve valide

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

岗位职责：
A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
（高级）治疗领域专员负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Biotechnologist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

The Opportunity

This position has overall accountability for completing the manufacturing tasks as scheduled while in full compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices and Roche’s corporate principles, quality policies and standards.

Key Responsibilities/Tasks:

• Support the Biochemical Manufacturing Department by working effectively within the group to meet department goals and objectives.

• Responsible for completing assigned tasks which may include preparing small equipment, cleaning and sterilizing vessels, preparing solutions, monitoring and operation biochemical processing equipment, raw materials sampling, dispensing and environmental monitoring sampling and maintain housekeeping of the areas while adhering to Safety, cGMP and Biochemical Manufacturing guidelines.

• Assigned tasks must be prioritized and work must be documented per approved manufacturing formulae.

• Troubleshoot equipment and process problems.

• Support process improvement efforts.

• Operate computers for process control and data entry.

• Participate in staff and shift change meetings and work closely with other shift personnel and external support groups.

• Ensure all assigned tasks are performed as per safety requirement. Report safely incident and near misses on a timely basis and support SHE in incident investigation.

Safety, Health & Environment:

• Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.

• Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.

Lean Production System:

• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives.

Who Are You

• Diploma in Life Sciences or Engineering discipline or equivalent holders. Minimum 3 years of related working experience for diploma equivalent holders with combination of education and relative work experience.

• Related working experience in a biotech or pharmaceutical operating environment is preferred.

• Must possess good problem solving, interpersonal communication and team skills.

• Must be a self-starter with a strong focus on safety, quality, details and results.

• Mechanical aptitude and a familiarity with computer based systems are highly desirable.

• Background in microbiology, fermentation, or protein purification is desired.

Preferred

• Must be willing to work at Singapore Tuas Bay Link . Company Shuttle Bus is provided at the MRT Stations.

• Must be able to work weekends, off-shifts and overtime as required.

• Must be able to carry heavy loads of up to 25kg.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier futu

jobs.title: Administrative & Finance Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That is what makes us Roche.

The Administrative & Finance Specialist provides critical operational support across multiple departments. This role is responsible for streamlining travel logistics, managing expense compliance, coordinating large-scale corporate events, and supporting the integrity of the company’s financial cycle through diligent Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP) management.

Key Duties and Responsibilities;

1. General Administrative Support

• Travel & Entertainment (T&E): Coordination of business travels. This includes booking airfare, hotel accommodations and ground transfers, ensuring arrangements align with company travel policies.

• Expense Management (Concur): Ensure all claims include valid supporting documents (Official Receipts, invoices) and comply with internal audit standards.

• Corporate Credit Card Management: Oversee card issuance, limit monitoring and support usage compliance.

• Operational Monitoring: Track and maintain "Events Forms" and other administrative logs to ensure departmental requests are processed and filed systematically.

• Corporate Events Management: Support the logistics of companywide events such as National Conventions, Mid-Year Conferences and Holiday Celebrations to name a few. Manage relationships with external vendors (catering, audiovisual, venues) and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution.

2. Grants, Sponsorships & Donations (GSD) Support

• Compliance & Documentation: Facilitate the administrative processing of GSD requests, ensuring all contributions are documented, approved, and tracked.

3. Finance Operations
A. Accounts Receivable (AR) Management

• Customer Reconciliation: Perform regular audits of customer accounts to identify discrepancies and support resolution of payment issues.

• Credit & Collection Support: Assist the finance team in monitoring aging reports and following up on overdue accounts to maintain healthy cash flow.

• KPI Achievement: Actively contribute to meeting departmental AR goals, such as reducing Days Sales Outstanding (DSO).
B. Accounts Payable (AP) Management

• Stakeholder & Vendor Relations: Act as a bridge between internal departments and external vendors to reconcile outstanding invoices and resolve billing disputes.

• Procurement Cleanup: Regularly audit Purchase Orders (PO) and Purchase Requisitions (PR) to close out aged items and ensure the accuracy of the general ledger.

Who you are;

• Experience: 3+ years in a dual Admin/Finance role or as an Operations Coordinator.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP/Concur and advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables).

• Competencies: High attention to detail, strong negotiation skills for vendor management, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Technical Proficiencies & Software Skills

• ERP & Expense Management:
• Proficiency in SAP for auditing and reporting.

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems specifically for AR/AP modules and PO management.

• Data Analysis & Reporting:
• Advanced MS Excel Skills: Must be comfortable with VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, and Data Validation to reconcile large financial datasets.

This role is only open to candidates that have full eligibility to live and work in Ph

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That is what makes us Roche. The Administrative & Finance Specialist provides critical operational support across multiple departments. This role is responsible for streamlining travel logistics, managing expense compliance, coordinating large-scale corporate events, and supporting the integrity of the company’s financial cycle through diligent Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP) management. Key Duties and Responsibilities; 1. General Administrative Support
• Travel & Entertainment (T&E): Coordination of business travels. This includes booking airfare, hotel accommodations and ground transfers, ensuring arrangements align with company travel policies.
• Expense Management (Concur): Ensure all claims include valid supporting documents (Official Receipts, invoices) and comply with internal audit standards.
• Corporate Credit Card Management: Oversee card issuance, limit monitoring and support usage compliance.
• Operational Monitoring: Track and maintain "Events Forms" and other administrative logs to ensure departmental requests are processed and filed systematically.
• Corporate Events Management: Support the logistics of companywide events such as National Conventions, Mid-Year Conferences and Holiday Celebrations to name a few. Manage relationships with external vendors (catering, audiovisual, venues) and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution. 2. Grants, Sponsorships & Donations (GSD) Support
• Compliance & Documentation: Facilitate the administrative processing of GSD requests, ensuring all contributions are documented, approved, and tracked. 3. Finance Operations A. Accounts Receivable (AR) Management
• Customer Reconciliation: Perform regular audits of customer accounts to identify discrepancies and support resolution of payment issues.
• Credit & Collection Support: Assist the finance team in monitoring aging reports and following up on overdue accounts to maintain healthy cash flow.
• KPI Achievement: Actively contribute to meeting departmental AR goals, such as reducing Days Sales Outstanding (DSO). B. Accounts Payable (AP) Management
• Stakeholder & Vendor Relations: Act as a bridge between internal departments and external vendors to reconcile outstanding invoices and resolve billing disputes.
• Procurement Cleanup: Regularly audit Purchase Orders (PO) and Purchase Requisitions (PR) to close out aged items and ensure the accuracy of the general ledger. Who you are;
• Experience: 3+ years in a dual Admin/Finance role or as an Operations Coordinator.
• Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP/Concur and advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables).
• Competencies: High attention to detail, strong negotiation skills for vendor management, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. Technical Proficiencies & Software Skills
• ERP & Expense Management:
• Proficiency in SAP for auditing and reporting.
• Hands-on experience with ERP systems specifically for AR/AP modules and PO management.
• Data Analysis & Reporting:
• Advanced MS Excel Skills: Must be comfortable with VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, and Data Validation to reconcile large financial datasets. This role is only open to candidates that have full eligibility to live and work in Ph

• ERP & Expense Management:
• Kenntnisse in SAP für Auditing und Reporting.
• Praxiserfahrung mit ERP Systemen speziell für AR/AP Module und PO Management.

• Erweiterte MS Excel-Fähigkeiten: Sie müssen mit VLOOKUPs, Pivot-Tabellen und Datenvalidierung vertraut sein, um große Finanzdatensätze in Einklang zu bringen. Diese Rolle steht nur Kandidaten offen, die die volle Berechtigung haben, in Ph zu leben und zu arbeiten.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Le spécialiste de l'administration et des finances fournit un soutien opérationnel essentiel à plusieurs ministères. Ce rôle est chargé de rationaliser la logistique des voyages, de gérer la conformité des dépenses, de coordonner les grands événements organisationnels et de soutenir l'intégrité du cycle financier de l'entreprise par une gestion diligente des comptes débiteurs et des comptes créditeurs. Fonctions et responsabilités clés; 1. Appui administratif général
• Voyages et divertissements (T&E): Coordination des voyages d'affaires. Cela comprend la réservation de billets d'avion, d'hébergements d'hôtel et de transferts terrestres, en veillant à ce que les arrangements soient conformes aux politiques de voyage de l'entreprise.
• Gestion des dépenses (Concur): S'assurer que toutes les demandes comprennent des documents justificatifs valides (réceptions officielles, factures) et qu'elles sont conformes aux normes de vérification interne.
• Gestion de la carte de crédit : Surveiller l'émission de la carte, limiter la surveillance et appuyer la conformité à l'utilisation.
• Surveillance opérationnelle : Suivre et tenir à jour les « formulaires d'événements » et les autres registres administratifs pour s'assurer que les demandes ministérielles sont traitées et déposées systématiquement.
• Gestion des événements d'entreprise : Soutenir la logistique d'événements à l'échelle de l'entreprise tels que les congrès nationaux, les conférences de mi-année et les célébrations des fêtes. Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs externes (quartier, audiovisuel, lieux) et les intervenants internes pour assurer une exécution transparente. 2. Soutien aux subventions, aux commandites et aux dons
• Conformité et documentation : Faciliter le traitement administratif des demandes de DSG, en veillant à ce que toutes les contributions soient documentées, approuvées et suivies. 3. Opérations financières A. Gestion des comptes débiteurs
• Rapprochement des clients : Effectuer des vérifications régulières des comptes clients afin de déceler les écarts et de faciliter la résolution des problèmes de paiement.
• Soutien au crédit et à la perception : Aider l'équipe financière à surveiller les rapports sur le vieillissement et à suivre les comptes en souffrance afin de maintenir des flux de trésorerie sains.
• Réalisation de l'ICP : Contribuer activement à la réalisation des objectifs ministériels en matière d'EI, comme la réduction des ventes de jours en circulation. B. Gestion des comptes créditeurs (AP)
• Relations avec les intervenants et les fournisseurs : Agir comme un pont entre les ministères internes et les fournisseurs externes afin de concilier les factures en souffrance et de régler les différends en matière de facturation.
• Nettoyage de l'approvisionnement : Vérification régulière des bons de commande et des demandes d'achat afin de fermer les articles vieillis et d'assurer l'exactitude du grand livre. Qui vous êtes;
• Expérience : 3 ans et plus dans un double rôle d'admin/Finance ou en tant que coordonnateur des opérations.
• Compétences techniques : maîtrise des compétences SAP/Concur et Excel avancées (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables).
• Compétences : Une grande attention aux détails, de solides compétences en négociation pour la gestion des fournisseurs et la capacité de multitâche dans un environnement accéléré. Compétences techniques et compétences logicielles
• ERP & Gestion des frais :
• Compétence en SAP pour la vérification et l'établissement de rapports.
• Expérience pratique des systèmes ERP spécifiquement pour les modules AR/AP et la gestion PO.
• Analyse des données et rapports :
• Compétences avancées MS Excel : doit être à l'aise avec VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, et la validation des données pour concilier les grands ensembles de données financières. Ce rôle n'est ouvert qu'aux candidats qui ont la pleine admissibilité à vivre et à travailler à Ph
