The Opportunity
We are seeking a Manufacturing Specialist – Cyber Security to join our PTE organization. In this role, you will serve as the key liaison between the global TechOps cyber security function and our local manufacturing sites across the globe.
Your mission will be to ensure compliance, secure operations, elevate Operational Technology (OT) security awareness, and achieve seamless integration of enterprise-level initiatives with site-specific needs. This position requires a strong blend of manufacturing knowledge, cyber security awareness, and exceptional stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities:

• PT Representation at Site: Act as the primary liaison and strategic bridge between manufacturing site operations and the PTE cyber security / digital teams.

• Site Compliance: Ensure site-level compliance with corporate cyber security standards, policies, and regulatory requirements.

• Security Integration: Drive the seamless roll-out of global enterprise security initiatives, adapting them effectively to local manufacturing needs without disrupting operations.

• Awareness & Culture: Elevate OT (Operational Technology) security awareness among site staff, fostering a culture of cyber-vigilance.

Who You Are
You are someone who shares our passion for science, technology, and people. You bring structure, collaboration, and a secure-by-design mindset to manufacturing environments.
To be successful in this role, you should bring:

• A proven track record or strong background in manufacturing operations combined with a solid awareness of Cyber Security/OT Security.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between global strategies and local site execution.

• A proactive approach to compliance, risk management, and continuous improvement.

• Fluency in English (global team collaboration).

• Awareness & Culture: Elevate la consapevolezza della sicurezza di OT (Tecnologia Operativa) tra il personale del sito, promuovendo una cultura della cyber-vigilanza. • Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di colmare il divario tra strategie globali e l'esecuzione del sito locale.

jobs.title: Solution Architect - RDT Group Functions
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every employee can make a mark.
As a Senior Solution Architect, you will join our Legal, Compliance and Group Communication (LCG) team to lead the architectural evolution of our Product Data, Analytics, and AI portfolio. Reporting to the Head of Product Data, Analytics and AI, you will act as a visionary change agent, challenging business requirements and proposing AI-driven efficiencies to design complex, global compliance solutions.
The Opportunity
In this role, you will have the chance to influence the strategic direction of our data landscape through the following priorities:

• Lead the strategic migration of legacy SAP BW systems to SAP Datasphere, ensuring high performance and data integrity.

• Drive the Roche corporate Data strategy by aligning architectural transitions with global enterprise standards.

• Act as a high-level consultant to senior business stakeholders, proactively challenging requirements to ensure genuine business value.

• Define the architectural roadmap for data modeling, analytics, and integration patterns (APIs, ETL) within the LCG domain.

• Implement cutting-edge AI efficiencies using Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI frameworks to automate compliance.

• Ensure robust information architecture and provide expert guidance across the broader Data & AI product suite.

• Govern architecture standards to maintain a scalable and secure data fabric/mesh environment for global operations.

• Collaborate with geographically dispersed teams to lead virtual architecture organizations and foster a culture of technical excellence.

Who you are
We are looking for a proactive negotiator and technical expert who meets the following qualifications:

• You possess 15+ years of professional experience, with at least 10 years specifically in Architecture leading complex migrations.

• You hold a Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.

• You are an expert in the SAP Ecosystem, specifically with deep, hands-on knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA and SAP Datasphere.

• You demonstrate AI/ML mastery through a proven track record of implementing GenAI and Agentic AI within an enterprise context.

• You have extensive Data Engineering experience with Big Data systems, modern data fabric, and cloud stacks like Snowflake and SAP BTP.

• You bring a proactive mindset, with the ability to anticipate business needs and "look around corners" before requirements are articulated.

• You are a preferred expert in compliance reporting, such as the Sunshine Act or similar global regulatory data standards.

Call to Action
Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.
#RDT2026

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we believe every employee can make a mark. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will join our Legal, Compliance and Group Communication (LCG) team to lead the architectural evolution of our Product Data, Analytics, and AI portfolio. Reporting to the Head of Product Data, Analytics and AI, you will act as a visionary change agent, challenging business requirements and proposing AI-driven efficiencies to design complex, global compliance solutions. The Opportunity In this role, you will have the chance to influence the strategic direction of our data landscape through the following priorities:
• Lead the strategic migration of legacy SAP BW systems to SAP Datasphere, ensuring high performance and data integrity.
• Drive the Roche corporate Data strategy by aligning architectural transitions with global enterprise standards.
• Act as a high-level consultant to senior business stakeholders, proactively challenging requirements to ensure genuine business value.
• Define the architectural roadmap for data modeling, analytics, and integration patterns (APIs, ETL) within the LCG domain.
• Implement cutting-edge AI efficiencies using Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI frameworks to automate compliance.
• Ensure robust information architecture and provide expert guidance across the broader Data & AI product suite.
• Govern architecture standards to maintain a scalable and secure data fabric/mesh environment for global operations.
• Collaborate with geographically dispersed teams to lead virtual architecture organizations and foster a culture of technical excellence. Who you are We are looking for a proactive negotiator and technical expert who meets the following qualifications:
• You possess 15+ years of professional experience, with at least 10 years specifically in Architecture leading complex migrations.
• You hold a Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
• You are an expert in the SAP Ecosystem, specifically with deep, hands-on knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA and SAP Datasphere.
• You demonstrate AI/ML mastery through a proven track record of implementing GenAI and Agentic AI within an enterprise context.
• You have extensive Data Engineering experience with Big Data systems, modern data fabric, and cloud stacks like Snowflake and SAP BTP.
• You bring a proactive mindset, with the ability to anticipate business needs and "look around corners" before requirements are articulated.
• You are a preferred expert in compliance reporting, such as the Sunshine Act or similar global regulatory data standards. Call to Action Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare. #RDT2026 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous croyons que chaque employé peut faire une marque. En tant qu'architecte principal de solutions, vous rejoindrez notre équipe juridique, de conformité et de communication de groupe (LCG) pour diriger l'évolution architecturale de notre portefeuille de données de produits, d'analyses et d'IA. Relevant du responsable des données sur les produits, de l'analyse et de l'IA, vous agirez comme un agent de changement visionnaire, défiant les exigences opérationnelles et proposant des gains d'efficacité liés à l'IA pour concevoir des solutions de conformité complexes et globales. L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la chance d'influencer l'orientation stratégique de notre paysage de données par les priorités suivantes:
• Diriger la migration stratégique des anciens systèmes SAP BW vers SAP Datasphere, assurant une performance élevée et l'intégrité des données.
• Dirigez la stratégie de données d'entreprise Roche en alignant les transitions architecturales sur les standards d'entreprise mondiaux.
• Agir en tant que consultant de haut niveau auprès des principaux intervenants du monde des affaires, exigeant des exigences proactives pour assurer une véritable valeur commerciale.
• Définir la feuille de route architecturale pour la modélisation des données, l'analyse et les modèles d'intégration (API, ETL) dans le domaine LCG.
• Mettre en oeuvre des économies d'IA de pointe en utilisant des cadres d'IA, d'apprentissage automatique et d'IA Agent pour automatiser la conformité.
• Assurer une architecture d'information robuste et fournir des conseils d'experts dans l'ensemble des produits Data & AI.
• Normes d'architecture gouvernementale pour maintenir un environnement de tissu de données/mesh évolutif et sécurisé pour les opérations mondiales.
• Collaborer avec des équipes dispersées géographiquement pour diriger des organismes d'architecture virtuelle et favoriser une culture d'excellence technique. Qui vous êtes Nous cherchons un négociateur proactif et un expert technique qui possède les qualifications suivantes :
• Vous possédez plus de 15 ans d'expérience professionnelle, avec au moins 10 ans spécifiquement en Architecture menant des migrations complexes.
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un master ou d'un baccalauréat en informatique, en technologie de l'information ou dans un domaine technique connexe.
• Vous êtes un expert dans l'écosystème SAP, en particulier avec une connaissance approfondie et pratique de SAP BW/4HANA et de SAP Datasphère.
• Vous démontrez la maîtrise de l'IA/ML grâce à une expérience éprouvée de la mise en œuvre de l'IA GenAI et de l'IA Agentique dans un contexte d'entreprise.
• Vous avez une vaste expérience de l'ingénierie des données avec les systèmes Big Data, le tissu de données moderne et les piles cloud comme Snowflake et SAP BTP.
• Vous apportez un état d'esprit proactif, avec la capacité d'anticiper les besoins des entreprises et de « regarder autour des coins » avant que les exigences soient articulées.
• Vous êtes un expert privilégié dans la déclaration de conformité, comme la Sunshine Act ou des normes similaires de la réglementation mondiale des données. Appel à l'action Prêt à apporter vos qualités uniques à Roche et faire un impact? Postulez maintenant et rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de façonner l'avenir des soins de santé. #RDT2026 Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Device Development department within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support.

The Device Engineering section combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities.

The opportunity:

In this role, you will engage in extensive cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Quality Assurance (QA), Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Commercial teams. Additionally, you will take on strategic responsibilities and contribute to efforts led by the Device Engineering leadership team.
This role reports to the Section Head of Device Engineering and is integrated into the Roche Device Development function.

• Act as project leader / team leader / technical expert to successfully bring combination products and medical devices to the market

• Evaluation of new and breakthrough technologies. Application of theoretical engineering knowledge, to establish robust technical product requirements, and develop engineering design solutions to assure devices maintain the required level of performance throughout the life of the product

• Author design control documentation (Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, Design Verification Plans and DHF creation/maintenance DHF), conformity assessments and risk management documentation.

• Forecast and plan resource demands for device development projects. Execute projects within the agreed time, quality and cost constraints, resulting in state-of–the-art drug delivery devices

• Apply knowledge of the regulatory landscape to ensure standard compliant designs (e.g. ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 and 21 CFR 820.30)

Who you are:

• You have university level education (engineering degree or related discipline).

• You have a minimum 10-year proven track record in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development with experience in pharma or other closely-regulated environments, under current Good Practice (cGxP), Quality System Regulation (QSR), or similar working practices.

• You have hands-on Pen injector / Auto injector development expertise.

• You have sound knowledge of legislation, regulation, industry standards, and guidance within the area of combination products and medical devices.

• You have experience with Health Authority interactions.

• You have demonstrable knowledge of drug delivery devices, parenteral drug delivery, risk assessment, tolerance analysis, statistical techniques, process capability, manufacturing processes, and reliability engineering.

• You possess excellent documentation, presentation, interpersonal communication skills and strategic thinking.

• You have an excellent command of the English language; proficiency in German is preferable.

Unsere Aktivitäten erstrecken sich über eine Reihe von Engineering-Disziplinen von der Phase der Anforderungsdefinition bis hin zur Kommerzialisierung und vermarkteten Produktunterstützung. Der Bereich Device Engineering kombiniert Design, Engineering, Testen und Fertigung, um zuverlässige und sichere Arzneimittelabgabegeräte zu entwickeln, die den Bedürfnissen von Patienten, Gesundheitsdienstleistern und Gesundheitsbehörden entsprechen. Die Gelegenheit: In dieser Rolle werden Sie sich in einer umfassenden funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit engagieren, insbesondere mit Qualitätssicherungsteams (QA), Regulatory Affairs, Clinical und Commercial. Diese Rolle berichtet an den Sektionsleiter Device Engineering und ist in die Funktion Roche Device Development integriert.
• Handeln Sie als Projektleiter / Teamleiter / technischer Experte, um Kombinationsprodukte und Medizinprodukte erfolgreich auf den Markt zu bringen
• Bewertung neuer und bahnbrechender Technologien. Anwendung von theoretischem Ingenieurwissen, um robuste technische Produktanforderungen zu etablieren und Engineering-Design-Lösungen zu entwickeln, um sicherzustellen, dass Geräte das erforderliche Leistungsniveau während der gesamten Lebensdauer des Produkts beibehalten
• Dokumentation zur Autor-Design-Kontrolle (Designentwicklungspläne, Benutzeranforderungen, Design-Inputs, Design-Outputs, Design-Verifizierungspläne und DHF-Erstellung/-Wartung), Konformitätsbewertungen und Dokumentation zum Risikomanagement.

• Kenntnisse der Regulierungslandschaft anwenden, um standardkonforme Designs sicherzustellen (z. B. ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 und 21 CFR 820.30) Wer du bist:

jobs.title: Medical Network Expert/Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary职位概述:
The Medical Network Expert/Lead is a key role that brings the Medical Scientific Affairs (MSA) strategy to life for a given disease area by serving as the interface between China Medical Affairs teams, China cross-functional strategy teams, Regional, and Global teams to deliver an integrated medical strategy plan that incorporates short-, mid- and long-term perspectives. The Medical Strategy Partner works hand in hand with the Medical Affairs team members to understand and address customer needs, leverages external stakeholder generated insights, and collaborate with the Global teams to provide China-specific insights into products in development.

医疗网络专家/经理是一个关键角色，通过作为中国医疗事务团队、中国跨职能战略团队、区域和全球团队之间的桥梁，为特定疾病领域带来医学科学事务（MSA）战略，以提供包含短期、中期和长期视角的综合医学战略计划。医学网络专家/经理与医学事务团队成员携手合作，了解并满足客户需求，利用外部利益相关者提出的见解，并与全球团队合作，为正在开发的产品提供中国市场特有的洞见

Main Tasks & Responsibilities主要工作职责 :
1. Bring clinical insights to all disease area medical squad conversations
在所有疾病领域医学相关讨论中提供临床见解
2. Works within the cross functional core team, in close collaboration with the MSA stakeholders to develop the medical components of the overall China integrated strategy for a given disease area (and related assets/services) leveraging external stakeholder generated insights/needs
在跨职能核心团队中工作，与MSA团队伙伴密切合作利用外部利益相关者提出的见解/需求，针对特定疾病领域制定中国整体综合战略
3. Coordinate medical strategy plan development for a particular disease area to include: INSIGHTS, INNOVATIONS, EVIDENCE, GUIDELINES and EDUCATION & SCIENTIFIC EXCHANGES
协调特定疾病领域的医学战略计划制定，包括：见解、创新、证据、指南以及教育和科学交流
4. Develop a robust KOL network outside of the company that can be strategically tapped for medical insights and advocacy work
在公司外部建立强大的 KOL 网络并战略性地利用该网络进行医学见解宣传
5. Review outputs of internal partners for medical accuracy and patient centricity
审查内部合作伙伴的交付成果以确保医学准确性以及以患者为中心的宗旨被充分贯彻
6. Supports the creation of an inspiring team environment with agile, open, and inclusive culture
支持创建具有敏捷、开放和包容文化的鼓舞人心的团队环境
7. May support Medical Affairs work in the specific disease area as needed and respond to unsolicited requests for information about unapproved products or uses, or off-label information.
按需支持特定疾病领域的医学事务工作，对有关未经批准的产品/用途的信息/标签外信息的需求做出回应。
8. Identifies opportunities for cross-functional cooperation to maximize utilization of resources
识别跨职能合作的机会以最大限度地利用资源

Basic Requirements of the Job基本任职资格:
Education & Qualifications教育背景与专业资格:
MD, PhD or PharmD and working experience in relevant disease areas
医学、科学或药学博士及相关疾病领域的工作经验
Experience工作经验:
1. 4+ years of experience in developing and implementing medical strategies for various diseases in the medical or pharmaceutical industry
4年以上在医学或制药行业，具备针对各种疾病制定和实施医疗策略的经验
2. Clinical research and trial management experience, and the ability to interact with KOLs with sufficient knowledge, expertise and confidence.
临床研究试验管理经验，及拥有丰富的知识，专长及自信与KOL 进行互动的能力
3. Must maintain knowledge of applicable research and literature
对适用的研究文献有知识储备
4. Fluent English skills and excellent presentation and teaching skills and the ability to represent the company in a professional manner at medical, scientific and public events.
流利的英语语言能力，优秀的报告展示能力及教学技巧，有代表公司参加医学科学及公共活动并表现专业的能力
Values & Core Competencies 价值观与核心能力：
• Demonstrate Roche values of Integrity, Courage, Passion
体现罗氏的价值观：真诚,勇气,激情
• Follow Roche Operating Principles
遵循罗氏运营准则
• Equip with the core skill sets as required by this role

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a User Enablement Engineer within the Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) team, you will be responsible for overseeing the deployment, optimization, and day-to-day operation of user-facing software, application frameworks, and research environments across our High-Performance Computing (HPC) and AI Factory platforms. Your mission is to maximize the productivity of Roche’s scientific community by providing frictionless access to cutting-edge computational tools.
With the introduction of our industry-leading NVIDIA AI Factory infrastructure, you will play a pivotal role in productizing and supporting advanced software suites like NVIDIA AI Enterprise. By ensuring that complex AI/ML frameworks, large language model (LLM) tools, and specialized simulation environments are perfectly tuned for our clusters, you will directly accelerate the time-to-value for researchers training complex AI models and executing large-scale computational science workloads.

Description of the area

Hosting and Infrastructure (HI) provides mission-critical on-premise infrastructure, cloud hosting, connectivity, and technology products that enable all functions at every Roche site to develop, innovate, connect, and deliver compliant digital products across the Roche Enterprise.
The Value Streams - Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) Team is focused on driving both customer success and platform success by acting as a center of excellence and delivery for the High Performance Compute and AI Infrastructure supporting AI and HPC use cases across Roche. This team facilitates seamless onboarding and adoption for business vertical customers needing accelerated compute—helping those infrastructure consumers with needs optimized for high availability, seamless data transfer, flexibility, speed, and the rapidly changing needs of AI—helping achieve rapid time-to-value.

Job Responsibilities

User-Facing Platform & Environment Management

• Deploy, support, and optimize user-facing environment portals and platforms, including Roche ROCs and SCOOP environments for HPC.

• Own the lifecycle and availability of standard software stacks, modules, and containerized application environments.

• Collaborate closely with infrastructure engineers to ensure user-facing portals interface seamlessly with core scheduling and data transfer layers.

AI Factory & Software Stack Productization

• Architect and manage the deployment of the NVIDIA AI Enterprise software suite, ensuring proper integration and license optimization.

• Provide and support cutting-edge AI pipelines and development platforms, including NVIDIA NeMo for generative AI/LLMs and NVIDIA Omniverse for advanced industrial simulations and digital twins.

• Build, benchmark, and maintain highly optimized container builds for standard AI/ML Frameworks (such as PyTorch and TensorFlow), incorporating deep learning inference servers like Dynamo-Triton to maximize GPU utilization.

Scientific Consultation & Technical Enablement

• In partnership with the Value Engineering and Outcomes team, act as the technical entry point and consultant for research teams, assisting them in porting their code, algorithms, and models onto the ACE platforms.

• Develop, curate, and maintain developer documentation, example code repositories, and user guides to enable self-service onboarding.

• Diagnose and resolve complex software-layer bottlenecks, dependency conflicts, and compilation issues spanning scientific software packages, Python virtual environments, and

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Analytics & Intelligence – Lead Analyst (Pharma CRM Measurement & Analytics)
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Chennai or Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics and technology‑driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates and global teams across the globe.

As a Lead Analyst (Pharma CRM Measurement & Analytics), you will play a critical role in supporting the Pharma CRM Platform / Product team in building and optimizing CRM measurement frameworks. You will lead the development of strategic performance scorecards, engagement velocity metrics, and activity‑based KPIs, and generate analytics that inform CRM platform simplification, user experience improvements, and commercial impact.

Your Opportunity

• Design and build CRM performance scorecards and dashboards for home office and field teams

• Develop and track activity‑based metrics (e.g., engagement velocity, objective‑based calls, high‑value interactions, call planning adherence)

• Measure engagement timeliness and call quality indicators to understand execution quality and improvement areas

• Establish a standard CRM measurement framework and KPI dictionary, enabling consistent reporting across markets and brands

• Quantify value of high‑ vs low‑impact engagements and identify patterns in customer coverage and segmentation

• Evaluate CRM workflows and engagement models (e.g., call planning, suggestions/NBA, remote engagement) and recommend simplification and optimization

• Translate business strategy and CRM product vision into measurable KPIs and reporting requirements

• Support leadership reviews and roadmap prioritization with clear, executive‑ready insights and recommendations

• Partner with CRM Product, CRM Operations & Commercial Excellence to deliver robust analytics solutions

• Provide guidance and oversight to junior analysts and contribute to best practices and standards for CRM measurement

• Collaborate with global stakeholders and be flexible to work in IST/PST overlapping hours

Who You Are

• You hold a bachelor's degree in Technology, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Business Analytics and 6 to 12 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, commercial analytics, or sales operations

• Strong experience in CRM / Engagement analytics and performance measurement, exposure to pharma or healthcare commercial models is strongly preferred

Domain & Technical Skills

• Veeva CRM or Salesforce CRM knowledge is mandatory, with strong understanding of CRM data structures (accounts, contacts, calls, activities, suggestions, events, NBAs, etc.)

• Hands‑on experience working with CRM systems and data from an analytics/reporting perspective

• Proficiency in SQL, Excel, and BI/visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau

• Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS – Redshift, S3, Athena) or similar

• Ability to work with structured, semi‑structured, and unstructured data, experience with Python or R is an advantage

Behavioral & Communication Skills

• Strong analytical thinking and hypothesis‑driven problem solving, with a clear focus on business impact

• Proven ability to translate busines

• Misurare la tempistica di fidanzamento e chiamare indicatori di qualità per comprendere le aree di esecuzione e di miglioramento

• Tradurre strategia aziendale e CRM prodotto visione in KPI misurabili e requisiti di reporting
• Sostenere le recensioni di leadership e la priorità roadmap con chiare, approfondimenti e raccomandazioni
• Partner con CRM Product, CRM Operations & Commercial Excellence per fornire soluzioni di analisi robuste

• Hai una laurea in Tecnologia, Ingegneria, Statistica, Matematica, Scienza dei dati, Business Analytics e 6-12 anni di esperienza in analisi, business intelligence, analisi commerciali o operazioni di vendita
• Una forte esperienza nell'analisi e nella misurazione delle prestazioni di CRM / Engagement, l'esposizione a modelli commerciali farmaceutici o sanitari è fortemente preferita Dominio e competenze tecniche

• Esperienza pratica che funziona con sistemi CRM e dati da una prospettiva di analisi/reporting
• Proficienza in strumenti SQL, Excel e BI/visualizzazione come Power BI o Tableau
• Esperienza con piattaforme di dati cloud (ad esempio, AWS – Redshift, S3, Athena) o simili

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior DevOps Automation Engineer

The Patient Software Insights group within Roche Information Solutions (RIS) is responsible for a portfolio of software solutions that support healthcare providers and patients across various applications and disease areas.

For a quick look at what we do, check out Roche tech4life .

The Opportunity:
Developing software is great, but developing software with a purpose is even better! As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and QA experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software development practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users' lives at risk!

You will oversee application releases and manage the automation process to support building our applications. Tasks may include scripting, testing, troubleshooting problems, and communicating issues to software engineers.

Who you are:
We seek an experienced, motivated Senior DevOps Software Engineer who will work closely with engineers and our product teams. Required skills to accomplish your mission:

• At least 7 years of hands-on experience automating CI/CD pipelines (for example, Backend, Web, API, Lambdas, and Desktop (Windows, MacOS)).

• Proven ability to establish code branching and review processes.

• Proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language.

• Deep experience in:

• Setting up and maintaining CI systems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).

• Building containers (Containerd, Docker).

• Managing artifact repositories (Nexus, Artifactory).

• Integrating SAST and DAST security tools (SonarQube, Mayhem, Trivy).

• A real enthusiasm for teamwork and helping others across different teams.

• A desire to mentor colleagues and share your knowledge.

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

The following skills significantly strengthen your application:

• Familiarity with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other cloud platforms.

• Experience in building and testing applications (e.g., JMeter, Appium, xCUITest, JUnit, Selenium),

• Background in developing digital products such as SaaS, marketplaces, and e-commerce platforms.

• Knowledge of the diabetes or similar healthcare industries.

Here's what you can expect from us:

• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products

• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams

• We welcome technical evangelists, so if you are interested in any thought leadership contributions (blogs, conferences) within the realm of the organization, we are happy to support you.

• Loads of benefits (brand new Apple hardware, fitness, public transport, lunch benefit, language classes, professional training budget,...)

You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, from native mobile development to infrastructure-as-code in our cloud environment, gaining a rich understanding of the specific requirements of medical software, be it security, medical risk management, safe and resilient programming, or certifications and audits.

You will have direct contact with our users, learning about their daily struggles living with diabetes, as well as customers and partners, understanding the unique needs and mechanics of healthcare systems worldwide.

Interested? Great. We’d like to hear from you!

jobs.title: Procurement Manager, Commercial
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

About the job

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

This role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

As a Procurement Manager in Commercial, you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Using your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise in a specific category or spend areas and procurement overall, you will proactively identify and drive strategies and approaches for managing and sourcing third party spend requirements. You can also play the role of Category strategy owner in charge of driving, coordinating and signing the category strategy.

As a Procurement Manager in Commercial, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter specialist in Marketing & Sales (Creative and Digital, Medical and Scientific Activities, Market Access and Sales) conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies and tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements.

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and frameworks and project management skills.

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree, preferably in business or a related discipline.

• You have solid procurement experience in strategic sourcing, category strategy building and strategic project execution with general contracting understanding and proficiency or relevant commodity experience.

• Proficiency in procurement systems, processes, and general contracting.

• You possess knowledge and experience in the Strategic Procurement , while specific expertise in Marketing & Sales commodity area.

• You are a proactive, curious, and motivate

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Riguardo al lavoro Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Global Procurement gestisce proattivamente l'intero ecosistema dei fornitori, fornendo un contributo vitale per migliorare i risultati della salute, riducendo i costi per i pazienti e i sistemi sanitari globali, e assicurando che Roche continui a fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Questo ruolo si trova all'interno del gruppo Indirect Procurement Delivery, che copre le attività principali di approvvigionamento da gestione di categoria, approvvigionamento strategico e operativo, gestione dei fornitori, contratto, definizione di strategia di contenuto e l'esecuzione. Il gruppo Indirect Procurement Delivery comprende molte comunità che raggruppano le categorie della stessa catena del valore o che hanno una comunitÃ, tra cui ricerca e sviluppo, servizi commerciali e aziendali, tecnologia digitale e servizi. Le comunità sono i principali abilitatori di una forte competenza di categoria, consentendo la flessibilità nella risposta di consegna degli appalti alle esigenze in evoluzione dei nostri clienti. Come Procurement Manager in Commercial, si porterà il pensiero analitico, la pianificazione, l'esecuzione, e concentrarsi sull'area di approvvigionamento di approvvigionamento e capacità di consegna. Utilizzando le vostre conoscenze specialistiche e competenze approfondite in una specifica categoria o aree di spesa e approvvigionamento generale, si proattivamente identificare e guidare le strategie e gli approcci per la gestione e l'assistenza dei requisiti di spesa di terze parti. È inoltre possibile svolgere il ruolo del proprietario di strategia di categoria incaricato di guidare, coordinare e firmare la strategia di categoria. Come Procurement Manager in Commercial, si giocherà una varietà di ruoli in base alla vostra esperienza, conoscenza e requisiti aziendali generali, tra cui ma non limitati a:
• Sei uno specialista di materia tematica di categoria e sourcing in Marketing & Sales (creativo e digitale, attività mediche e scientifiche, accesso al mercato e vendite) che conduce il mercato e l'analisi interna per sviluppare strategie e piani tattici per come Roche dovrebbe fonte e negoziare per beni e servizi di terze parti al fine di soddisfare i requisiti delle parti interessate.
• Sei un professionista della consegna degli appalti che fornisce ed esegue le strategie di approvvigionamento sfruttando il know-how di spesa, il know-how di categoria, il sourcing robusto, la negoziazione, la contrazione, le metodologie di gestione dei fornitori e i quadri e le competenze di gestione del progetto.
• Si sviluppano contenuti e automazione, traducendo risultati e opportunità di approvvigionamento in contenuti e canali di acquisto automatizzati che migliorano l'adozione aziendale, la soddisfazione e l'efficienza complessiva. Chi sei:
• Lei ha una laurea, preferibilmente in affari o una disciplina relativa.
• Hai una solida esperienza di approvvigionamento nell'approvvigionamento strategico, nella costruzione di strategie di categoria e nell'esecuzione di progetti strategici con la comprensione e la competenza contrattuale generale o l'esperienza delle materie prime rilevanti.
• Competenza nei sistemi di approvvigionamento, nei processi e nei contratti generali.
• Possiedi conoscenza ed esperienza nel Procurement Strategico , mentre competenze specifiche nell'area Marketing & Sales commodity.
• Sei un proattivo, curioso e motivato

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Über den Job Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Das Gesundheitswesen entwickelt sich weiter, und Global Procurement reagiert darauf, indem es kontinuierlich nach höchstmöglicher Leistung strebt und innovative und strategische Ansätze für Geschäfts- und Lieferantenpartnerschaften verfolgt. Global Procurement verwaltet proaktiv das gesamte Lieferanten-Ökosystem und leistet einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Verbesserung der Gesundheitsergebnisse, zur Senkung der Kosten für Patienten und globale Gesundheitssysteme und stellt sicher, dass Roche weiterhin das tut, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Die Chance Diese Rolle ist Teil der Gruppe Indirect Procurement Delivery, die die wichtigsten Beschaffungsaktivitäten von Category Management, strategischem und operativem Sourcing, Lieferantenmanagement, Contracting, Content Strategy Definition und Ausführung abdeckt. Die Gruppe Indirekte Beschaffung umfasst viele Gemeinschaften, die Kategorien derselben Wertschöpfungskette oder Gemeinsamkeiten gruppieren, darunter Forschung und Entwicklung, kommerzielle und Unternehmensdienstleistungen, Digital & Technology und Einrichtungen. Die Communitys sind Schlüsselfaktoren für eine starke Kategoriekompetenz und ermöglichen gleichzeitig Flexibilität bei der Bereitstellung von Beschaffungen, um auf die sich ändernden Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden zu reagieren. Als Procurement Manager in Commercial bringen Sie analytisches Denken, Planung, Ausführung und Fokus auf den Beschaffungs- und Lieferbereich. Mit Ihrem Fachwissen und Ihrer fundierten Expertise in einer bestimmten Kategorie oder Ausgabenbereichen und der gesamten Beschaffung werden Sie proaktiv Strategien und Ansätze für die Verwaltung und Beschaffung von Ausgabenanforderungen Dritter identifizieren und vorantreiben. Sie können auch die Rolle des Kategoriestrategiebesitzers übernehmen, der für das Fahren, Koordinieren und Unterzeichnen der Kategoriestrategie verantwortlich ist. Als Procurement Manager in Commercial, werden Sie eine Vielzahl von Rollen nach Ihrer Erfahrung, Wissen und allgemeine Geschäftsanforderungen spielen, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf:
• Sie sind ein Spezialist für Kategorie- und Beschaffungsthemen in Marketing & Sales (Kreative und digitale, medizinische und wissenschaftliche Aktivitäten, Marktzugang und Vertrieb), der Markt- und interne Analysen durchführt, um Strategien und taktische Pläne zu entwickeln, wie Roche Waren und Dienstleistungen von Drittanbietern beziehen und verhandeln sollte, um die Anforderungen der Stakeholder zu erfüllen.
• Sie sind ein Procurement Delivery Practitioner, der Sourcing-Strategien liefert und ausführt, indem Sie Ausgaben, Kategorie-Know-how, robustes Sourcing, Verhandlungen, Verträge, Lieferantenmanagement-Methoden und -Frameworks sowie Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten nutzen.
• Sie entwickeln Inhalte und Automatisierung und übersetzen Sourcing-Ergebnisse und -Möglichkeiten in Inhalte und automatisierte Einkaufskanäle, die die Akzeptanz, Zufriedenheit und Gesamteffizienz des Unternehmens verbessern. Wer du bist:
• Sie haben einen Hochschulabschluss, vorzugsweise in der Wirtschaft oder einer verwandten Disziplin.
• Sie verfügen über solide Beschaffungserfahrung in den Bereichen strategische Beschaffung, Kategoriestrategieaufbau und strategische Projektdurchführung mit allgemeinem Vertragsverständnis und Kenntnissen oder relevanter Rohstofferfahrung.
• Kenntnisse in Beschaffungssystemen, -prozessen und allgemeinen Aufträgen.
• Sie besitzen Wissen und Erfahrung in der strategischen Beschaffung, während spezifische Expertise in Marketing & Sales Rohstoffbereich.
• Sie sind proaktiv, neugierig und motivierend
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Sur le travail Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les soins de santé évoluent, et Global Approvisionnement répond en s'efforçant constamment d'obtenir les meilleurs résultats possibles, en adoptant des approches novatrices et stratégiques pour les partenariats avec les entreprises et les fournisseurs. Global Approvisionnement gère de manière proactive l'ensemble de l'écosystème fournisseur, contribuant de façon essentielle à améliorer les résultats en matière de santé, réduisant les coûts pour les patients et les systèmes de santé mondiaux, et faisant en sorte que Roche continue de faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Ce rôle fait partie du groupe chargé de la prestation des achats indirects, qui couvre les principales activités d'approvisionnement liées à la gestion des catégories, à l'approvisionnement stratégique et opérationnel, à la gestion des fournisseurs, à la passation de marchés, à la définition de la stratégie de contenu et à l'exécution. Le groupe de la prestation d'approvisionnements indirects comprend de nombreuses collectivités regroupant des catégories de la même chaîne de valeur ou ayant des points communs, y compris la recherche et le développement, les services commerciaux et ministériels, le numérique et la technologie et les installations. Les collectivités sont des catalyseurs clés d'une solide expertise de catégorie tout en permettant de répondre avec souplesse aux besoins changeants de nos clients. En tant que gestionnaire des approvisionnements dans le secteur commercial, vous apporterez une réflexion analytique, la planification, l'exécution et la concentration sur le domaine de la capacité d'approvisionnement et de livraison. À l'aide de vos connaissances spécialisées et de votre expertise approfondie dans une catégorie particulière ou dans des domaines de dépense et d'approvisionnement en général, vous définirez et dirigerez de façon proactive des stratégies et des approches pour gérer et acheminer les dépenses de tiers. Vous pouvez également jouer le rôle de propriétaire de la stratégie de catégorie en charge de la conduite, la coordination et la signature de la stratégie de catégorie. En tant que gestionnaire de l'approvisionnement dans le secteur commercial, vous jouerez divers rôles en fonction de votre expérience, de vos connaissances et de vos besoins opérationnels généraux, notamment :
• Vous êtes un spécialiste de la catégorie et de l'approvisionnement en marketing et ventes (activités créatives et numériques, médicales et scientifiques, accès au marché et ventes) qui effectue des analyses de marché et internes afin d'élaborer des stratégies et des plans tactiques sur la façon dont Roche devrait se procurer et négocier des biens et services tiers afin de satisfaire aux exigences des intervenants.
• Vous êtes un praticien de l'approvisionnement fournissant et exécutant des stratégies d'approvisionnement en tirant parti des dépenses, de la catégorie savoir-faire, de l'approvisionnement robuste, de la négociation, de la passation de marchés, des méthodes et des cadres de gestion des fournisseurs et des compétences en gestion de projet.
• Vous développez du contenu et de l'automatisation, traduisant les résultats et les possibilités d'approvisionnement en contenu et en canaux d'achat automatisés qui améliorent l'adoption, la satisfaction et l'efficacité globale des entreprises. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire, de préférence en affaires ou dans une discipline connexe.
• Vous disposez d'une solide expérience en matière d'approvisionnement stratégique, d'élaboration de catégories de stratégies et d'exécution de projets stratégiques avec une compréhension et une compétence générales en matière de passation de marchés ou une expérience pertinente en matière de produits.
• Compétence dans les systèmes d'approvisionnement, les processus et les marchés généraux.
• Vous possédez des connaissances et de l'expérience dans le domaine de l'approvisionnement stratégique, tout en possédant une expertise spécifique dans le domaine du marketing et des ventes.
• Vous êtes un proactif, curieux et motivé

jobs.title: Senior Medical Writer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub is a growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Medical Writer, you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners. You will be part of formulating and identifying current and future content needs and support different content creation initiatives.

In addition, you will work with Senior Medical Writers and stakeholders to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that writing activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs.

The Opportunity:

• Writing and editing medical content for different formats / digital channels and platforms, including: information for patients, educational materials for HCPs (slides, posters, speaker briefs and presentations for conferences), newsletters, medical reports/study summaries, materials for use in public relations teams

• Researching, writing and editing pre-clinical and/or clinical reports, summarizing data from pre-clinical and/or clinical studies

• Assisting in the development of formats and guidelines for clinical documentation and may prepare scientific manuscripts, abstracts and posters while controlling quality and proofreading for scientific accuracy

• Managing multiple concurrent projects across a range of therapeutic areas, delivering on agreed timelines and ensuring that the content, format and structure comply with regulatory and other guidelines, as well as with Roche best practices

• Partnering with the Creative Artworker to develop content and partnering with other internal teams, clients, business partners, healthcare professionals and other key stakeholders to understand their business needs and how content creation will contribute to their success.

Who you are:

• You have a degree in Medical Sciences and 2-4 years experience in a similar role.

• You have a native-level written and spoken English , and additional languages (Spanish, Italian, German, French) are a big advantage.

• You have effective time management and excellent communication skills both written and verbal, so you can work effectively across our diverse resources and business stakeholders with a customer-service mentality.

• You have excellent attention to detail, consistency, clarity and scientific rigor, you are able to interpret data and you are accountable and focused.

• You have the ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment and the ability to prioritize tasks.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free la

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist - Spanish speaking in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a crucial role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion.

The Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist may collaborate closely with affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines.

The Opportunity:

• Manage the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.

• Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Instructs stakeholders on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area

• Supports Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators in client communications in the area of service offering, change management or communication

• Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility

Who you are :

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; you are highly creative, innovative, forward thinking marketer with the ability to demonstrate awareness of digital trends.

• You have a solid understanding of digital marketing principles, content creation, and campaign management and 3+ years of experience in content production, project management, or digital campaign management, with a focus on coordinating digital marketing initiatives across multiple channels.

• You own excellent communication skills in English and in Spanish , and you have experience in stakeholder management and incorporating feedback into content strategies.

• You have a customer-focused behavior in everything you do and ability to create and maintain well-functioning relationships with internal stakeholders and other 3rd party providers.

• You have proficiency in project management tools and software, with a readiness to learn new systems as needed.

• You possess strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with a proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support fle

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Global Digital Hub è stato fondato all'interno del Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest. Il nostro scopo principale è quello di rafforzare le capacità digitali di Roche a livello globale, supportando iniziative centrali con Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting e Creative Design. In qualità di Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist - Spagnolo che parla nel Global Digital Hub, si garantisce la consegna di successo dei progetti di creazione di contenuti di campagne digitali all'interno del Digital Campaigns Chapter. Il ruolo riveste un ruolo cruciale nel garantire il coordinamento e il completamento della creazione di contenuti di campagne digitali tempestive e di alta qualità. Il Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist può collaborare a stretto contatto con i team aziendali affiliati o i team di marca, i vendori di terze parti, i coordinatori della campagna e della campagna globale nell'organizzazione, relativi ai requisiti di progetto, obiettivi e tempi. L'opportunità:
• Gestire la creazione e il processo di consegna dei contenuti delle campagne digitali affiliate o globali, assicurando il completamento tempestivo e di successo di tutti i progetti dall'iniziazione all'implementazione finale, garantendo al contempo gli standard di consegna.
• Incorporare feedback da parte degli stakeholder e rivedere le richieste di contenuti delle campagne digitali per garantire l'allineamento con le loro aspettative.
• Istruisce le parti interessate a nuovi processi o requisiti che aumenterebbero l'efficienza nei modi di lavorare nell'area tematica
• Supporta i Coordinatori della Campagna e i Coordinatori della Campagna Globale nelle comunicazioni dei clienti nell'ambito dell'offerta di servizi, della gestione dei cambiamenti o della comunicazione
• Adozione e Centro di Eccellenza: seguire i processi esistenti, stabilire i principi di governance dei processi e mantenere una corretta documentazione e attuazione nell'ambito della responsabilità Chi sei?
• Hai una laurea in Marketing, Comunicazione, Business o un campo correlato; sei altamente creativo, innovativo, avanzato marketing di pensiero con la capacità di dimostrare la consapevolezza delle tendenze digitali.
• Hai una solida comprensione dei principi di marketing digitale, la creazione di contenuti e la gestione delle campagne e 3+ anni di esperienza nella produzione dei contenuti, nella gestione dei progetti o nella gestione delle campagne digitali, con l'obiettivo di coordinare le iniziative di marketing digitale su più canali.
• Possiedi eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese e spagnolo, e hai esperienza nella gestione degli stakeholder e incorporando feedback nelle strategie di contenuto.
• Hai un comportamento focalizzato sul cliente in tutto ciò che fai e la capacità di creare e mantenere relazioni ben funzionanti con gli stakeholder interni e altri fornitori di terze parti.
• Hai competenza negli strumenti di gestione del progetto e nel software, con una disponibilità ad imparare nuovi sistemi come necessario.
• Possiedi forti capacità organizzative e multitasking, con una comprovata esperienza di gestione simultanea di più progetti. In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche fle

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Der Global Digital Hub wurde im Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest eingerichtet. Unser Hauptzweck ist es, die digitalen Fähigkeiten von Roche weltweit zu stärken, indem wir zentrale Initiativen wie Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting und Creative Design unterstützen. Als Spezialist für digitale Kampagnenbereitstellung - Spanisch sprechend im Global Digital Hub, stellen Sie die erfolgreiche Bereitstellung von Projekten zur Erstellung von Inhalten für digitale Kampagnen innerhalb des Kapitels "Digitale Kampagnen" sicher. Diese Rolle spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Sicherstellung einer zeitnahen und qualitativ hochwertigen Koordination und Fertigstellung von Inhalten für digitale Kampagnen. Der Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist kann eng mit Affiliate-Business-Teams oder Markenteams, Drittanbietern, Kampagnen- und globalen Kampagnenkoordinatoren in der Organisation zusammenarbeiten, die sich auf Projektanforderungen, Ziele und Zeitpläne beziehen. Die Gelegenheit:
• Verwalten Sie den Affiliate- oder globalen Prozess zur Erstellung und Bereitstellung von Inhalten für digitale Kampagnen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Projekte von der Einleitung bis zur endgültigen Implementierung rechtzeitig und erfolgreich abgeschlossen werden und gleichzeitig die Lieferstandards eingehalten werden.
• Integrieren Sie Feedback von Stakeholdern und überarbeiten Sie die Inhaltsanfragen für digitale Kampagnen entsprechend, um die Übereinstimmung mit ihren Erwartungen sicherzustellen.
• Belehrt die Stakeholder über neue Prozesse oder Anforderungen, die die Effizienz der Arbeitsweise im Fachbereich erhöhen würden
• Unterstützt Campaign Coordinators und Global Campaign Coordinators bei der Kundenkommunikation im Bereich Serviceangebot, Change Management oder Kommunikation
• Adoption und Center of Excellence: Befolgen Sie bestehende Prozesse, legen Sie Prozess-Governance-Prinzipien fest und pflegen Sie im Verantwortungsbereich eine ordnungsgemäße Dokumentation und Umsetzung Wer du bist :
• Sie haben einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Marketing, Kommunikation, Business oder einem verwandten Bereich; Sie sind ein sehr kreativer, innovativer, zukunftsorientierter Marketer mit der Fähigkeit, das Bewusstsein für digitale Trends zu demonstrieren.
• Sie verfügen über ein solides Verständnis der Prinzipien des digitalen Marketings, der Erstellung von Inhalten und des Kampagnenmanagements sowie über mehr als 3 Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Content-Produktion, Projektmanagement oder digitales Kampagnenmanagement mit Schwerpunkt auf der Koordinierung digitaler Marketinginitiativen über mehrere Kanäle hinweg.
• Sie besitzen ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Spanisch und haben Erfahrung im Stakeholder-Management und in der Integration von Feedback in Content-Strategien.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Das Site Management stellt Rahmenbedingungen und Infrastruktur für unsere rund 16.000 Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Mannheim & Penzberg in Deutschland zur Verfügung, um mit diagnostischen und medizinischen Lösungen wertschöpfend für Patienten tätig sein zu können.
Das Chapter Engineering ist mit 160 Mitarbeitenden für die strategische Entwicklung und die erfolgreiche Planung sowie Umsetzung aller großen Investitionsprojekte in Bezug auf Gebäude & Anlagenbau in Mannheim und Penzberg verantwortlich. Aktuell setzen wir ca. 100 Projekte mit einem Volumen von wenigen Millionen Euro bis hin zu einigen hundert Millionen Euro um. Durch unsere Arbeit sichern wir die Versorgung unserer Patienten mit innovativen Produkten. Wir sind eine Einheit mit flachen Hierarchien und legen viel Wert auf Eigenverantwortlichkeit, eine offene Unternehmenskultur und Spaß an der Arbeit. Teamarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und Freiheitsgrade bei der Projektbearbeitung sind bei uns selbstverständlich.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Als Senior Projekt Manager Capex (m/w/d) führst du Investitionsprojekte größer 100 mEUR, sowohl im Green- als auch Brownfield. Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für hochgradig komplexe Projekte im Umfeld Pharma, Health Care und Diagnostica. Im Detail beinhaltet dies folgende spannende Tätigkeiten:

• Du bist für das Abwicklungsmodell und alle Ressourcen und Verträge während der strategischen Projektphase, der Planung, der Umsetzung sowie der Inbetriebnahme und Qualifizierung verantwortlich.

• Durch Deine technologische und prozessuale Expertise, Deine Fähigkeit Business Strategien in Lösungsoptionen zu übersetzen, präzises Anforderungsmanagement und die Sicherstellung eines stabilen Designs, sicherst Du unsere ambitionierten Projektziele ab.

• Du hast sehr ausgeprägte Präsentationsfähigkeiten und kannst andere begeistern, identifizierst relevante Stakeholder und bindest diese zum richtigen Zeitpunkt ein. Steering Committees und Gremien für finanzielle Genehmigungen überzeugst Du durch das richtige Detaillevel und gleichzeitig hohe Transparenz. Auf dem “politischen Parkett” fühlst Du Dich zu Hause.

• Als Vordenker treibst Du Innovationen voran, indem du neue Technologien und Prozesse identifizierst, entwickelst und erfolgreich implementierst.

• Du führst Dein Team mit Empathie und Klarheit, verteilst Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten gemäß den individuellen Stärken und Fähigkeiten Deiner Teammitglieder und sorgst Du für eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit und einen optimalen Informationsfluss – auch über externe Dienstleister hinweg.

• Dein Wissen und deine Expertise gibst du gerne in Form von Mentoring und Ausbildung an Kolleg:innen weiter.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Tiefe Expertise und Berufserfahrung (10+ Jahre, vorzugsweise in den Branchen Pharma, Health Care, Anlagenbau)

• Führungskompetenz und erfolgreicher Abschluss von großen und komplexen Investitionsprojekten

• Ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium (Uni, FH, oder gleichwertig)

• Anerkannte Zertifizierung im Projektmanagement

• Generalisten Fähigkeiten mit tiefgreifender Expertise in Projektmanagement (agile, klassische und hybride Ansätze), Sinn für ein erfolgreiches Stakeholdermanagement sowie Expertise in und Offenheit für verschiedene Abwicklungs- und Vertragsmodelle

• Kenntnis von Qualifizierungsprozessen und Anforderungen im GMP-Umfeld

• Analytisches und kritisches Denken, Selbstreflektion, hohe Problemlösungskompetenz

• Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Wiss

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Site Management fornisce condizioni quadro e infrastrutture per i nostri circa 16.000 dipendenti nei siti di Mannheim & Penzberg in Germania per poter lavorare con soluzioni diagnostiche e mediche che aggiungono valore ai pazienti. Con 160 dipendenti, Chapter Engineering è responsabile dello sviluppo strategico e della riuscita pianificazione e realizzazione di tutti i principali progetti di investimento relativi agli edifici e alla costruzione di impianti a Mannheim e Penzberg. Al momento mettiamo ca. 100 progetti con un volume di pochi milioni di euro fino a poche centinaia di milioni di euro. Attraverso il nostro lavoro, garantiamo la fornitura dei nostri pazienti con prodotti innovativi. Siamo un'unità con gerarchie piatte e attribuiamo grande importanza alla responsabilità personale, una cultura aziendale aperta e divertimento sul lavoro. Il lavoro di squadra, il sostegno reciproco e i gradi di libertà nello sviluppo del progetto sono una questione naturalmente per noi. Responsabilità | Questo è ciò che vi aspetta Come Senior Project Manager Capex (m/f/d) si guidano progetti di investimento di oltre 100 mEUR, sia a Greenfield che a Brownfield. Si assume la responsabilità generale per progetti altamente complessi nei settori farmaceutico, sanitario e diagnostico. In dettaglio, questo include le seguenti attività interessanti:
• Sei responsabile del modello di esecuzione e di tutte le risorse e i contratti durante la fase strategica del progetto, la pianificazione, l'implementazione, la messa in servizio e la qualificazione.
• Attraverso la vostra esperienza tecnologica e di processo, la vostra capacità di tradurre le strategie aziendali in opzioni di soluzione, la gestione precisa dei requisiti e garantire un design stabile, garantite i nostri obiettivi di progetto ambiziosi.
• Hai competenze di presentazione molto forti e puoi ispirare gli altri, identificare gli stakeholder rilevanti e coinvolgerli al momento giusto. Commissioni e organi direttivi per l'approvazione finanziaria Si attraversa il giusto livello di dettaglio e allo stesso tempo elevata trasparenza. Sul “piano politico” ci si sente a casa.
• Come leader di pensiero, si guida l'innovazione identificando, sviluppando e implementando con successo nuove tecnologie e processi.
• Guida il tuo team con empatia e chiarezza, distribuisci compiti e responsabilità in base ai punti di forza e alle capacità individuali dei membri del tuo team e garantisci una cooperazione fluida e un flusso ottimale di informazioni, anche attraverso i fornitori di servizi esterni.
• Sei felice di trasmettere le tue conoscenze e competenze ai colleghi sotto forma di mentoring e formazione. Qualificazioni | Questo è ciò che porti
• Profonda competenza e esperienza professionale (10+ anni, preferibilmente nei settori farmaceutico, sanitario, ingegneria vegetale)
• Competenze di leadership e completamento di grandi e complessi progetti di investimento
• Laurea in ingegneria (uni, FH, o equivalente)
• Certificazione riconosciuta nella gestione del progetto
• Competenze generalistiche con competenze approfondite nella gestione del progetto (approccio agile, classico e ibrido), senso di gestione degli stakeholder di successo e competenza e apertura a vari modelli di regolamento e contratto
• Conoscenza dei processi e dei requisiti di qualificazione nell'ambiente GMP
• pensiero analitico e critico, autoriflessione, elevata competenza di problem solving
• Forte comprensione di Wiss
