At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Site Management provides framework conditions and infrastructure for our approximately 16,000 employees at the Mannheim & Penzberg sites in Germany in order to be able to work with diagnostic and medical solutions that add value to patients. With 160 employees, Chapter Engineering is responsible for the strategic development and the successful planning and implementation of all major investment projects relating to buildings and plant construction in Mannheim and Penzberg. At the moment we put approx. 100 projects with a volume of a few million euros up to a few hundred million euros. Through our work, we ensure the supply of our patients with innovative products. We are a unit with flat hierarchies and attach great importance to personal responsibility, an open corporate culture and fun at work. Teamwork, mutual support and degrees of freedom in project development are a matter of course for us. Responsibility | This is what awaits you As Senior Project Manager Capex (m/f/d) you lead investment projects of more than 100 mEUR, both in Greenfield and Brownfield. You assume overall responsibility for highly complex projects in the pharmaceutical, health care and diagnostics sectors. In detail, this includes the following exciting activities:
• You are responsible for the execution model and all resources and contracts during the strategic project phase, planning, implementation, commissioning and qualification.
• Through your technological and process expertise, your ability to translate business strategies into solution options, precise requirements management and ensuring a stable design, you secure our ambitious project goals.
• You have very strong presentation skills and can inspire others, identify relevant stakeholders and engage them at the right time. Steering committees and bodies for financial approval You through the right level of detail and at the same time high transparency. On the “political floor” you feel at home.
• As a thought leader, you drive innovation by identifying, developing and successfully implementing new technologies and processes.
• You lead your team with empathy and clarity, distribute tasks and responsibilities according to the individual strengths and abilities of your team members and ensure smooth cooperation and an optimal flow of information – also across external service providers.
• You are happy to pass on your knowledge and expertise to colleagues in the form of mentoring and training. Qualifications | This is what you bring
• Deep expertise and professional experience (10+ years, preferably in the pharmaceutical, health care, plant engineering sectors)
• Leadership skills and successful completion of large and complex investment projects
• Engineering degree (uni, FH, or equivalent)
• Recognized certification in project management
• Generalist skills with in-depth expertise in project management (agile, classical and hybrid approaches), sense of successful stakeholder management, and expertise in and openness to various settlement and contract models
• Knowledge of qualification processes and requirements in the GMP environment
• Analytical and critical thinking, self-reflection, high problem-solving competence
• Strong understanding of Wiss

The Position
Dein neues Team
Als Mitglied des PDG Country Study Start-Up Teams liegt dein Hauptaugenmerk darauf, einen reibungslosen und hocheffizienten Studienstart sicherzustellen, um so die Bereitstellung klinischer Studien für Patient:innen zu unterstützen. In dieser Schlüsselrolle vernetzt du dich intensiv mit lokalen und globalen Teams sowie unseren CRO Partnern (Auftragsforschungsinstituten).

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle konzentrierst du dich auf die effiziente und rechtskonforme Initiierung von Roche-gesponserten klinischen Studien. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Your new team As a member of the PDG Country Study Start-Up Team, your main focus is to ensure a smooth and highly efficient trial start to support the delivery of clinical trials to patients. You innovate clinical trials: You meet the specific needs in the start-up phase across different therapeutic areas and guarantee a smooth process for patients: inside and testing centers. In this key role, you will network intensively with local and global teams as well as our CRO partners (contract research institutes). Responsibility | This is what awaits you In this role, you will focus on the efficient and legally compliant initiation of Roche-sponsored clinical trials. You develop effective start-up strategies, control operational processes and drive process improvements at country and center level – always in compliance with all regulatory requirements. Your main tasks include:
• Strategic management: You lead teams in the strategic planning of the operational implementation of the start of the study, with responsibility for risk management, regulatory compliance and partnership with external stakeholders.
• Operational excellence: You manage the start-up activities and ensure timely activation of the test centres and regulatory compliance. You are responsible for and control the entire budget and contract process – from budget creation to contract negotiation and insurance documents to system-side data maintenance to ensure financial and legal compliance and precise planning.
• Global Alignment: You work with the global study team to ensure that schedules are met and manage changes throughout the study cycle.
• Innovation & Standardization: Identify opportunities for process optimization and automation and work with regional and global partners to harmonize systems and optimize schedules.
• Authority communications: You interact with authorities and institutions (e.g. ethics committees and health authorities) to coordinate policies and practices in clinical trials. Qualifications | This is what you bring For the role as Study Start Up Lead (m/f/d) you bring a successfully completed study (MD, PhD, Master or Bachelor) in the Life Sciences or a comparable qualification. A further university degree (Postgraduate/Master) is very desirable. The following points round off your profile:
• Professional experience: You have profound experience in the start-up of clinical trials, in regulatory submission processes and in cross-functional cooperation.
• Expertise: You have an in-depth understanding of the ICH-GCP guidelines, the EU-CTR and the local regulatory framework and have already gained experience in managing service providers and CROs.
• Methods & IT: You are confident in handling clinical systems (e.g. Veeva Vault, CTIS, RIM) and have strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Mindset: You bring a collaborative and adaptive mindset. You also manage to keep track of complex, matrix-organized and global teams

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Votre nouvelle équipe En tant que membre de l'équipe de démarrage de l'étude par pays de la DGP, votre objectif principal est d'assurer un début d'essai fluide et très efficace pour soutenir la livraison d'essais cliniques aux patients. Vous innovez les essais cliniques : Vous répondez aux besoins spécifiques de la phase de démarrage dans différents domaines thérapeutiques et vous garantissez un processus en douceur pour les patients : à l'intérieur et centres de test. Dans ce rôle clé, vous travaillerez en réseau intensif avec des équipes locales et mondiales ainsi que nos partenaires CRO (instituts de recherche contractuels). Responsabilité C'est ce qui vous attend Dans ce rôle, vous vous concentrerez sur le lancement efficace et conforme aux lois des essais cliniques parrainés par Roche. Vous développez des stratégies de démarrage efficaces, contrôlez les processus opérationnels et conduisez les améliorations de processus au niveau du pays et du centre – toujours en conformité avec toutes les exigences réglementaires. Vos principales tâches comprennent:
• Gestion stratégique : Vous dirigez des équipes dans la planification stratégique de la mise en oeuvre opérationnelle du début de l'étude, avec la responsabilité de la gestion des risques, de la conformité réglementaire et du partenariat avec les intervenants externes.
• Excellence opérationnelle : Vous gérez les activités de démarrage et assurez l'activation en temps opportun des centres d'essais et la conformité réglementaire. Vous êtes responsable et contrôlez l'ensemble du processus budgétaire et contractuel – de la création du budget à la négociation de contrats et documents d'assurance à la maintenance des données côté système pour assurer la conformité financière et juridique et la planification précise.
• Alignement global : Vous travaillez avec l'équipe d'étude mondiale pour vous assurer que les calendriers sont respectés et gérer les changements tout au long du cycle d'étude.
• Innovation et normalisation: Identifier les possibilités d'optimisation des processus et d'automatisation et travailler avec les partenaires régionaux et mondiaux pour harmoniser les systèmes et optimiser les horaires.
• Communications avec les autorités : Vous interagissez avec les autorités et les institutions (p. ex. les comités d'éthique et les autorités sanitaires) pour coordonner les politiques et les pratiques en matière d'essais cliniques. Qualités C'est ce que vous apportez Pour le rôle en tant que chef de démarrage d'étude (m/f/d) vous apportez une étude réussie (MD, doctorat, maîtrise ou baccalauréat) dans les sciences de la vie ou une qualification comparable. Un autre diplôme universitaire (postgraduate/Master) est très souhaitable. Les points suivants complètent votre profil :
• Expérience professionnelle : Vous avez une expérience profonde dans le démarrage d'essais cliniques, dans les processus de présentation réglementaires et dans la coopération interfonctionnelle.
• Expertise: Vous avez une compréhension approfondie des lignes directrices de l'ICH-GPC, de l'EU-CTR et du cadre réglementaire local et avez déjà acquis de l'expérience dans la gestion des fournisseurs de services et des ORC.
• Méthodes et TI : Vous êtes confiant dans la gestion des systèmes cliniques (p. ex. Veeva Vault, CTIS, RIM) et avez de solides compétences organisationnelles, analytiques et de résolution de problèmes.
• Mindset: Vous apportez un esprit collaboratif et adaptatif. Vous réussissez aussi à suivre les équipes complexes, organisées par matrice et globales

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As part of our dynamic Product Development Regulatory (PDR) function, the Regulatory Intelligence team serves as a flexible, bold, and forward-thinking organization. We thrive on innovation, continuous learning, and adapting swiftly to an ever-evolving global landscape.
Regulatory Intelligence is at the forefront of delivering high-impact regulatory insights and is accountable for providing the framework to understand, assess, and influence the rapidly changing regulatory environment, while serving as a strategic voice to both internal and external stakeholders

The Role

In this dynamic role, you manage regulatory intelligence for our fast-paced pharma and medical device portfolio, focusing on the EU landscape. You will provide strategic, data-driven regulatory recommendations, master advanced intelligence tools, and collaborate across development teams. This role drives innovation by developing advanced AI tools and scalable systems to maximize efficiency and elevate regulatory intelligence.

As a Regulatory Science Professional - Intelligence , you will have the chance to shape the future of our impact focussing on the following key responsibilities:

• Maintain Oversight: Maintain a proactive regulatory intelligence overview of the fast-paced pharmaceutical and medical device environment in the European Union to inform the organization and enable smart, agile decision-making.

• Insight Generation : Gather comprehensive regulatory data and translate it into high-value, actionable insights for the business.

• Knowledge Sharing : Disseminate regulatory intelligence efficiently across the entire organization using a variety of dedicated communication channels.

• Strategic Recommendations: Provide sound regulatory advice and policy recommendations grounded in deep scientific and regulatory expertise.

• Systems Proficiency : Utilize and master a dedicated suite of internal and external intelligence tools, platforms, and search engines.

• Tool & Vendor Management: Develop, optimize, and maintain critical infrastructure—including databases, third-party engines, and vendor relationships—to effectively track global health authority updates (e.g. from the EMA and other European regulatory bodies).

• Cross-Functional Networking: Build and nurture dedicated networks across Roche to leverage collective expertise and maximize the knowledge of the broader organization.

• Impactful Collaboration: Act as an agile contributor who embraces change, fosters cross-functional teamwork, and boldly drives innovative outcomes that deliver tangible value to patients, stakeholders, and the company.

• Regulatory Intelligence 3.0: This role goes beyond providing regulatory intelligence information. You will focus on building and enhancing the next level of Regulatory Intelligence leveraging advanced AI tools and setting up systems that are scalable and increase efficiency.

Who You Are

We are looking for a strategic thinker who blends technical expertise with the ability to influence and collaborate across a global organisation.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The healthcare landscape is evolving, and Global Procurement responds by continuously striving for peak performance, pursuing innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement Management proactively nurtures the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving healthcare outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring Roche continues to deliver what patients need next.

This role is part of the Materials, Manufacturing, and CAPEX Delivery group, which covers core procurement activities ranging from category management to strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy, and execution. The Materials, Manufacturing, and CAPEX Delivery group comprises multiple communities that group categories from the same value chain or shared commonalities, including raw materials, external manufacturing services, logistics, research and lab supplies, as well as engineering (CAPEX). These communities are crucial enablers for building strong category expertise while providing the flexibility required to adapt our procurement responses to the evolving needs of our customers.

The Opportunity
As a Procurement Manager in Direct Operations , you will leverage your strong analytical, planning, and execution skills to strengthen our direct procurement capabilities. Drawing on both your broad procurement knowledge and specialized expertise in a specific raw material category used in active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) or drug product manufacturing, you will deliver effective and efficient procurement services while continuously driving automation, data quality, and content accessibility— including the exploration and deployment of AI-driven tools .

You will work closely with business stakeholders, particularly within Pharma Technical Operations , to translate their needs into sound procurement decisions and effective ways of working with global and local suppliers. At the same time, you will leverage synergies with internal procurement teams, including chapters and capability areas such as Customer Excellence, Contracting, Solutions, and Analytics. Together with our team members, you will support direct materials requests, enhance the end-to-end procurement experience, manage daily operational activities, and apply your expertise to deliver productivity improvements and customer-centric procurement solutions.

Depending on your experience, knowledge, and general business needs, you will play a variety of roles as a Procurement Manager in Direct Operations, including, but not limited to:

• Category & Sourcing Specialist: Conduct market and internal analyses to develop strategies and tactical plans on how Roche should source and negotiate third-party goods and services to meet stakeholder requirements.

• Procurement Delivery Practitioner: Implement and execute procurement strategies by leveraging spend, category knowledge, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, and supplier management methodologies, alongside project management skills.

• Content & Automation Developer: Translate procurement outcomes and opportunities into content and automated purchasing channels that enhance business adoption, user satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

• Process Optimizer: Support or lead the development of procurement-related processes to improve our overall service level, helping the team and stakeholders reduce operational and systemic risks.

Who you are:

Questo ruolo fa parte del gruppo Materials, Manufacturing e CAPEX Delivery, che copre le attività di approvvigionamento core che vanno dalla gestione della categoria all'approvvigionamento strategico e operativo, la gestione dei fornitori, la contrazione, la strategia dei contenuti e l'esecuzione. Il gruppo Materials, Manufacturing e CAPEX Delivery comprende più comunità che raggruppano categorie dalla stessa catena del valore o comunitÃ condivise, tra cui materie prime, servizi di produzione esterna, logistica, ricerca e forniture di laboratorio, nonché ingegneria (CAPEX). Queste comunità sono fattori determinanti per la costruzione di competenze di categoria forti, fornendo la flessibilità necessaria per adattare le nostre risposte di approvvigionamento alle esigenze in evoluzione dei nostri clienti. Attingendo sia alla vostra vasta conoscenza di approvvigionamento che all'esperienza specializzata in una specifica categoria di materie prime utilizzata nella produzione di componenti farmaceutici attivi (API) o di prodotti farmaceutici, offrirete servizi di approvvigionamento efficaci ed efficienti mentre guidate continuamente l'automazione, la qualità dei dati e l'accessibilità dei contenuti, tra cui l'esplorazione e l'implementazione di strumenti basati su AI. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder aziendali, in particolare all'interno di Pharma Technical Operations , per tradurre le loro esigenze in decisioni di approvvigionamento sano e modi efficaci di lavorare con fornitori globali e locali. Allo stesso tempo, potrai sfruttare le sinergie con i team di approvvigionamento interno, compresi i capitoli e le aree di funzionalità come Customer Excellence, Contracting, Solutions e Analytics. Insieme ai nostri membri del team, supporterete le richieste di materiali diretti, migliorare l'esperienza di approvvigionamento end-to-end, gestire le attività operative quotidiane e applicare le vostre competenze per fornire miglioramenti di produttività e soluzioni di approvvigionamento customer-centric. A seconda della vostra esperienza, conoscenza e delle esigenze aziendali generali, si giocherà una varietà di ruoli come Procurement Manager nelle operazioni dirette, tra cui, ma non limitato a:
• Specialista Categoria & Sourcing: Condurre il mercato e le analisi interne per sviluppare strategie e piani tattici su come Roche dovrebbe fonte e negoziare beni e servizi di terze parti per soddisfare i requisiti delle parti interessate.
• Practitioner di consegna degli appalti: implementare ed eseguire strategie di approvvigionamento sfruttando la spesa, la conoscenza della categoria, la sourcing robusto, la negoziazione, la contrazione e le metodologie di gestione dei fornitori, insieme alle competenze di gestione del progetto.
• Sviluppatore: Traduci i risultati e le opportunità di approvvigionamento in contenuti e canali di acquisto automatizzati che migliorano l'adozione aziendale, la soddisfazione degli utenti e l'efficienza complessiva.
• Ottimizzatore di processo: Supporto o condurre lo sviluppo di processi correlati agli appalti per migliorare il nostro livello di servizio globale, aiutando il team e gli stakeholder a ridurre i rischi operativi e sistemici. Chi sei:

En collaboration avec les membres de notre équipe, vous soutiendrez les demandes de matériaux directs, améliorerez l'expérience d'approvisionnement de bout en bout, gérerez les activités opérationnelles quotidiennes et appliquerez votre expertise pour améliorer la productivité et offrir des solutions d'approvisionnement axées sur le client. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Technical Manager – Regional Customer Support Centre (Tissue Diagnostics)

Location: Burgess Hill, Sussex (Hybrid: Minimum 2 days per week in office)
Position Type: Full-time, Permanent

The Opportunity
Are you ready to lead a specialist team where the work you do directly impacts patient care across Northern Europe?
Roche Diagnostics has an exciting opportunity for a Technical Manager to lead our Tissue Diagnostics remote support team. Based within our state-of-the-art Regional Customer Support Centre (RCSC) in Burgess Hill, you will head a core support group dedicated to providing high-value technical and application services.
By leading this vital team, you ensure that healthcare providers across the UK, Ireland, Nordics, and the wider EMEA-LATAM region can seamlessly deliver the diagnostic results that patients rely on every day.

Who You Are
You are an inspiring, resilient, and collaborative leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment. Driven by a desire to exceed customer expectations, you bring a "questioning" mindset that challenges the status quo and drives continuous innovation. You take immense pride in coaching others, removing operational bottlenecks and acting as a champion for the Roche brand.
What You’ll Do
As our Technical Manager, you will lead a team of 12 dedicated specialists providing remote technical and system support for the Roche Tissue Diagnostics portfolio, alongside customer and staff training.
Your core responsibilities will include:

• Leadership & Coaching: Empower, mentor and foster high performance within your team, taking full accountability for line management, recruitment, and professional development.

• Operational Excellence: Oversee the daily delivery of high-value remote support, ensuring full alignment with Roche Global quality and performance standards.

• Strategic Collaboration: Partner cross-functionally with Regional Service Managers, Sales and Marketing to ensure our service offering directly supports broader business goals.

• Matrix Influence: Act as a key stakeholder within the RCSC leadership network, shaping how we deliver a "best-in-class" customer experience across international borders.

What You Bring
Essential Requirements:

• Education: A Degree in a Life Science subject, or an equivalent professional engineering/clinical qualification.

• Leadership Experience: Proven track record in line management, or a clear ability to demonstrate the leadership competencies required to coach, develop, and upskill a high-performing technical team.

• Industry Background: At least 3 years of experience in systems support and implementation, or a proven track record working within a Pathology or Blood Sciences laboratory environment.

• Technical Skills: Strong digital literacy, including proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Suite, and enterprise CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce).

• Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a natural ability to influence stakeholders within a complex matrix organization.

Desirable Attributes:

• A specialized background or technical familiarity with Histology/Tissue Diagnostics workflows is highly advantageous.

Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests

jobs.title: IT Business Analyst - Pharma R&D
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Senior IT Business Analyst - Pharma R&D

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

As a Senior Business Analyst , you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams and drive key initiatives, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity. Bringing a strong strategic mindset, you will actively partner with stakeholders to co-create and support the overall Product Strategy. You will demonstrate a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes, methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity

• Lead Workstreams Independently: Manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams without guidance, proactively driving strategic initiatives through complex environments with emerging ambiguity.

• Solve Complex Problems: Lead the deep analysis of business challenges, perform thorough domain research, execute root-cause analysis, and deliver comprehensive, high-quality requirements.

• Act as a Trusted Advisor: I dentify a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders, building reliance through deep domain expertise while facilitating workshops and resolving conflicts to align project goals.

• Shape Product Strategy: Co-create and support long-term Product Strategy, translating business requirements into actionable implementation plans and influencing tactical roadmap decisions.

• Manage Product Complexity: Navigate multiple solutions across a broad product ecosystem, systematically evaluating immediate and long-term business impacts.

• Apply Technical & Business Expertise: Leverage tools, principles, and techniques across data, usability, and process analysis to manage technical interdependencies and optimize efficiency.

• Empower and Mentor Others: Guide junior and intermediate Business Analysts, helping them organize activities while shaping team ways of working and best practices.

• Drive Organizational Development: Champion continuous process improvement and actively contribute to the growth of our internal global Community of Practice (CoP).

Who you are

• Experienced Professional: You bring 5+ years of Business Analys

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Senior IT Business Analyst - Pharma R&D Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. Come Senior Business Analyst , gestirai in modo indipendente flussi di lavoro di analisi aziendali end-to-end e guiderai iniziative chiave, affrontando complessi problemi di business con l'ambiguità emergente. Portando una forte mentalità strategica, partnerrai attivamente con gli stakeholder per co-creare e sostenere la strategia globale del prodotto. Dimostrerai una forte comprensione del dominio aziendale, delle tecnologie correlate e delle loro interdipendenze, applicando strumenti e tecniche avanzate per tradurre i requisiti in piani di implementazione strategici. In questo ruolo, si agirà come consulente affidabile per i team interfunzionali, modellando le prospettive degli stakeholder, gestire le interdipendenze di processo, e contribuire in modo significativo alla progettazione e validazione di soluzioni efficaci. Potrai anche mentore analisti junior e modellare attivamente i processi del team, le metodologie e le migliori pratiche all'interno della più ampia Comunità di Pratica. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. L'opportunità
• Flussi di lavoro di piombo Indipendentemente: gestire flussi di lavoro di analisi aziendali end-to-end senza guida, guidando attivamente iniziative strategiche attraverso ambienti complessi con ambiguità emergenti.
• Risolvere i problemi complessi: condurre l'analisi profonda delle sfide aziendali, eseguire una ricerca approfondita di dominio, eseguire analisi root-cause e fornire requisiti completi e di alta qualità.
• Atto come Consulente Fiducioso: Dentifico una gamma diversificata di stakeholder interfunzionali, costruisco affidamento attraverso competenze di dominio profondo, facilitando workshop e risolvendo conflitti per allineare gli obiettivi del progetto.
• Strategia del prodotto di forma: Co-creare e sostenere la strategia del prodotto a lungo termine, traducendo i requisiti aziendali in piani di implementazione attuabili e influenzando le decisioni di roadmap tattiche.
• Gestisci la complessità del prodotto: Navigare soluzioni multiple in un ampio ecosistema di prodotti, valutando sistematicamente gli impatti aziendali immediati e a lungo termine.
• Applicare Technical & Business Expertise: strumenti di levaggio, principi e tecniche tra dati, usabilità e analisi di processo per gestire interdipendenze tecniche e ottimizzare l'efficienza.
• Empower and Mentor Others: Guide junior e intermedi Business Analysts, aiutandoli a organizzare attività mentre modellano i modi di lavoro e le migliori pratiche.
• Sviluppo organizzativo: il miglioramento continuo del processo campione e contribuire attivamente alla crescita della nostra comunità internazionale di pratica (CoP). Chi sei
• Professionista esperto: porti 5+ anni di Business Analys

jobs.title: Field Application Specialist - Alicante/ Murcia
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Estamos comprometidos, no sólo con el avance de soluciones diagnósticas que puedan ayudar a los profesionales sanitarios a tomar decisiones críticas para la salud de sus pacientes, sino también con la mejora de la forma en que estas herramientas esenciales se integran en los sistemas sanitarios de todo el mundo a un coste menor y sin dejar de obtener los mejores resultados posibles.

En más de 100 países ofrecemos la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector combinada con apoyo a la toma de decisiones clínicas, consultoría, diagnóstico digital, gestión de enfermedades, automatización de laboratorios y soluciones de software para proporcionar soluciones integradas a laboratorios, clínicos y sistemas sanitarios.

La misión de esta posición que abrimos es la de prestar un servicio científico / técnico a los sistemas y soluciones instalados en cliente garantizando la mayor eficiencia y eficacia en cada una de las actividades asignadas: configuración del sistema, formación a cliente, mantenimiento de usuario, resolución de dudas, actualizaciones y modificaciones. Además, la misión es asegurar que el servicio prestado genera una ventaja competitiva convirtiéndose en el elemento diferencial de la propuesta de valor de Roche consiguiendo así niveles óptimos de satisfacción del cliente.

Principales responsabilidades:

• Responsable de la instalación y de la configuración de los analizadores en el laboratorio del cliente acordados conforme a los requisitos y los estándares de la compañía.

• Responsable de la formación a cliente/usuario, de los analizadores instalados conforme a los requisitos y los estándares de la compañía.

• Atiende a los clientes de acuerdo con responsabilidades previamente atribuidas (predominantemente jefe de laboratorio, jefe de sección, adjunto, técnico de laboratorio).

• Establecer y mantener un excelente nivel de comunicación, seguimiento y colaboración proactiva con el cliente, informando de las actualizaciones de los reactivos y controles de calidad e implementando si es necesario nuevos protocolos.

• Proporciona información científica y técnica a los clientes.

• Coordinación con los técnicos de mantenimiento para garantizar que la instalación se ejecute en el plazo establecido.

• Garantiza un uso óptimo de los instrumentos en el laboratorio del cliente y de las soluciones instaladas.

• Gestionar el cumplimiento de los estándares corporativos y divisionales para instalaciones, formación y entrenamiento a clientes, calidad, desarrollo de aplicaciones y seguimiento a productos de Roche.

• Implementación de los planes de acción anuales definidos por la dirección de Roche Diagnostics y de Customer Support dentro de la actividad de instalación.

• Planificar y coordinar con la red de ventas las instalaciones, presentaciones y pruebas de productos a clientes.

• Soporte al equipo de Ventas y Marketing para optimizar las operaciones comerciales participando en las fases de preventa, venta y postventa de las oportunidades comerciales manteniendo el ciclo de vida del cliente.

• Optimizar y mejorar el proceso de instalación, configuración y formación al usuario garantizando la sostenibilidad y la satisfacción del cliente utilizando las herramientas digitales que provee la compañía.

Perfil requerido
● Grado en las siguientes disciplinas de Ciencias de la Salud:
○ Biología Sanitaria
○ Biomedicina
○ Biotecnología
● Valorable especialización en biología molecular y/o anatomía patológica
● Valorable experiencia en el trat

jobs.title: Content Editor
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Position Summary: As a content editor in the growing medical writing team within Roche, you will play a crucial role in reviewing and editing various forms of content, such as articles, blog posts, social media posts, website content, and promotional materials related to medical and healthcare topics. With your strong editorial experience, you will guide the team in developing consistent, clear, and impactful digital content for our business partners. In addition, you will work with relevant stakeholders to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that writing activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs. The medical copy and content team within the Global Digital Hub operates under the Content Creation Chapter. This specialized team focuses on generating commercial content intended for various digital formats (emails, videos, banners, infographics, websites, etc.). Their work plays a crucial role in supporting the communication strategies developed by Roche's global and local business teams.

The Opportunity:

• Review, edit, and fact-check high-quality medical content for multiple formats, digital channels, and platforms (e.g., patient information; HCP education materials such as slides/posters/speaker briefs/presentations; newsletters; medical reports/study summaries; and PR materials), ensuring accuracy, appropriate tone, clarity, conciseness, and engagement for the target audience.

• Ensure all deliverables comply with Roche best practices, brand guidelines, regulatory requirements, applicable industry guidelines, and SOPs and are optimized for search engines and digital marketing best practices, while staying up-to-date with trends in medical writing and digital marketing.

• Collaborate closely with writers, subject matter experts, marketing teams, and business partners to understand content objectives, provide constructive feedback and guidance, and support writers’ professional development to consistently improve content quality.

• Manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines across various therapeutic areas, monitoring assigned tasks and workload, maintaining meticulous attention to detail, taking ownership, and proactively anticipating capacity issues and proposing solutions.

• Quickly and effectively engage resources via formal and informal networks to meet goals, work closely with business partners, and make recommendations to improve service levels and responsiveness to business needs.

Who you are:

• Upbeat, dynamic editor with 2–4 years’ experience in a similar role, full (native-level) English proficiency, excellent attention to detail, consistency and clarity, and a strong passion for writing, language, and (ideally) pharmaceutical/healthcare/life sciences topics.

• Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, English, life sciences, or a related discipline (Master's is a plus), with proven experience editing and proofreading for accuracy, consistency, brand adherence, and familiarity with medical terminology, scientific research, and healthcare/pharma regulatory guidelines (advantageous).

• Strong understanding of digital marketing strategies and tactics (content creation, SEO, social media, and email marketing), with proficiency or interest in CMS and digital marketing tools, standard IT applications (preferably Google Workspace), and a quick-learning, technology-friendly mindset

Inoltre, lavorerai con le parti interessate pertinenti per garantire l'efficace distribuzione di risorse e strumenti per supportare e garantire che le attività di scrittura siano condotte in modo efficiente, economico e in conformità alle esigenze aziendali. Il team di copia e contenuti medici all'interno del Global Digital Hub opera sotto il Content Creation Chapter. Questo team specializzato si concentra sulla generazione di contenuti commerciali destinati a vari formati digitali (email, video, banner, infografica, siti web, ecc.). Il loro lavoro svolge un ruolo cruciale nel sostenere le strategie di comunicazione sviluppate dai team aziendali globali e locali di Roche. L'opportunità:
• Recensione, modifica e verifica di fatto contenuti medici di alta qualità per formati multipli, canali digitali e piattaforme (ad esempio, informazioni sul paziente; materiali di istruzione HCP come diapositive/poster/speaker brevi/presentazioni; newsletter; report/study summaries; e materiali PR), assicurando accuratezza, tono appropriato, chiarezza, conciseità e impegno per il pubblico di destinazione.
• Assicurarsi che tutti i prodotti conformi a Roche migliori pratiche, linee guida del marchio, requisiti normativi, linee guida del settore applicabili e SOP e sono ottimizzati per i motori di ricerca e le best practice di marketing digitale, pur rimanendo aggiornati con le tendenze nella scrittura medica e nel marketing digitale.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con scrittori, esperti di materia tematica, team di marketing e partner commerciali per comprendere gli obiettivi dei contenuti, fornire feedback costruttivi e guida, e sostenere lo sviluppo professionale degli scrittori per migliorare costantemente la qualità dei contenuti.
• Gestire più progetti e scadenze concorrenziali in varie aree terapeutiche, monitorare i compiti assegnati e il carico di lavoro, mantenendo meticolosa attenzione ai dettagli, prendendo la proprietà e anticipando proattivamente i problemi di capacità e proponendo soluzioni.
• Affrontare rapidamente ed efficacemente le risorse attraverso reti formali e informali per soddisfare gli obiettivi, lavorare a stretto contatto con i partner commerciali, e fare raccomandazioni per migliorare i livelli di servizio e la reattività alle esigenze aziendali. Chi sei:
• Upbeat, editor dinamico con esperienza di 2–4 anni in un ruolo simile, piena (livello nativo) competenza inglese, ottima attenzione ai dettagli, consistenza e chiarezza, e una forte passione per la scrittura, la lingua, e (idealmente) farmaceutica / sanità / scienze della vita.
• Corso di laurea in giornalismo, comunicazioni, inglese, scienze della vita, o una disciplina relativa (Master's è un plus), con comprovata esperienza di editing e correzione di prova per l'accuratezza, la consistenza, l'adesione del marchio, e la familiarità con terminologia medica, la ricerca scientifica, e le linee guida sanitarie / farmacologiche (vantaggiose).
• Forte comprensione delle strategie di marketing digitale e tattiche (creazione dei contenuti, SEO, social media e email marketing), con competenza o interesse in CMS e strumenti di marketing digitale, applicazioni IT standard (preferibilmente Google Workspace), e una rapida apprendimento, mentalità tecnologica
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. Position Summary: As a content editor in the growing medical writing team within Roche, you will play a crucial role in reviewing and editing various forms of content, such as articles, blog posts, social media posts, website content, and promotional materials related to medical and healthcare topics. With your strong editorial experience, you will guide the team in developing consistent, clear, and impactful digital content for our business partners. In addition, you will work with relevant stakeholders to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that writing activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs. The medical copy and content team within the Global Digital Hub operates under the Content Creation Chapter. This specialized team focuses on generating commercial content intended for various digital formats (emails, videos, banners, infographics, websites, etc.). Their work plays a crucial role in supporting the communication strategies developed by Roche's global and local business teams. The Opportunity:
• Review, edit, and fact-check high-quality medical content for multiple formats, digital channels, and platforms (e.g., patient information; HCP education materials such as slides/posters/speaker briefs/presentations; newsletters; medical reports/study summaries; and PR materials), ensuring accuracy, appropriate tone, clarity, conciseness, and engagement for the target audience.
• Ensure all deliverables comply with Roche best practices, brand guidelines, regulatory requirements, applicable industry guidelines, and SOPs and are optimized for search engines and digital marketing best practices, while staying up-to-date with trends in medical writing and digital marketing.
• Collaborate closely with writers, subject matter experts, marketing teams, and business partners to understand content objectives, provide constructive feedback and guidance, and support writers’ professional development to consistently improve content quality.
• Manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines across various therapeutic areas, monitoring assigned tasks and workload, maintaining meticulous attention to detail, taking ownership, and proactively anticipating capacity issues and proposing solutions.
• Quickly and effectively engage resources via formal and informal networks to meet goals, work closely with business partners, and make recommendations to improve service levels and responsiveness to business needs. Who you are:
• Upbeat, dynamic editor with 2–4 years’ experience in a similar role, full (native-level) English proficiency, excellent attention to detail, consistency and clarity, and a strong passion for writing, language, and (ideally) pharmaceutical/healthcare/life sciences topics.
• Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, English, life sciences, or a related discipline (Master's is a plus), with proven experience editing and proofreading for accuracy, consistency, brand adherence, and familiarity with medical terminology, scientific research, and healthcare/pharma regulatory guidelines (advantageous).
• Strong understanding of digital marketing strategies and tactics (content creation, SEO, social media, and email marketing), with proficiency or interest in CMS and digital marketing tools, standard IT applications (preferably Google Workspace), and a quick-learning, technology-friendly mindset

jobs.title: System Architect / System Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Within the Near Patient Care R&D Development Network, our team of system architects supports the development of diagnostic and medical devices. We ensure that the system of hardware, software, and sensors works together seamlessly to form a robust solution. We are looking for a technically focused team player who can think holistically, understand complex systems, and act proactively to bring experts together to develop state-of-the-art diagnostic and disease management solutions.

Your Opportunity

• You will hold technical responsibility in key systems engineering disciplines for the development of systems or complex system components.

• You will be accountable for systems engineering deliverables, such as requirements, architecture, risks, concepts,, and configuration management.

• You will contribute to product development projects, including system integration.

• You will create development documentation and design artifacts according to good design practices and regulatory-relevant requirements.

• You will drive the alignment between instrument and assay development and their integration.

• You will work closely with other functions such as HW and SW Engineering, Operations, or Customer Support in cross-functional activities.

Who You Are

• You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree (BSc/MSc) in Mechatronics, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Physics, Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, natural sciences, or an equivalent qualification.

• You have experience in medical device development (a focus on hardware is a plus) and have ideally worked in a regulated environment (e.g., IVDR).

• With your clear, structured, and proactive working style, you promote collaboration in interdisciplinary teams.

• You think analytically and are capable of seeing the big picture as well as the details.

• You have practical experience in system integration, working with various technology domains.

• You navigate confidently within complex systems and distributed organizations, proactively identifying system-level issues and driving them to resolution.

• You are fluent in English, with additional knowledge of German considered a plus.

What We Offer

• A meaningful role at the intersection of hardware and software development in a highly relevant field of medical technology.

• The opportunity to work on innovative and complex systems within an interdisciplinary team of experts.

• A collaborative environment that encourages proactive engagement and continuous learning.

• Individual development opportunities and the chance to apply your expertise in a global setting.

Your Application

Please upload your current CV, a motivation letter and the certificate of your highest qualification.
We look forward to receiving your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione All'interno del Near Patient Care R&D Development Network, il nostro team di architetti di sistema supporta lo sviluppo di dispositivi diagnostici e medici. Garantiamo che il sistema di hardware, software e sensori funzionino senza soluzione di continuità per formare una soluzione robusta. Stiamo cercando un giocatore di squadra tecnicamente focalizzato che può pensare olistico, comprendere sistemi complessi, e agire proattivamente per riunire gli esperti per sviluppare soluzioni diagnostiche e di gestione delle malattie all'avanguardia. La tua opportunità
• Avrete la responsabilità tecnica nelle discipline di ingegneria dei sistemi chiave per lo sviluppo di sistemi o componenti di sistema complessi.
• Sarete responsabili per i materiali di ingegneria dei sistemi, come requisiti, architettura, rischi, concetti e gestione della configurazione.
• Contribuirai a progetti di sviluppo del prodotto, inclusa l'integrazione del sistema.
• Si creerà documentazione di sviluppo e artefatti di progettazione secondo buone pratiche di progettazione e requisiti di regolazione-rilevanti.
• Potrai guidare l'allineamento tra lo sviluppo dello strumento e del saggio e la loro integrazione.
• Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con altre funzioni come HW e SW Engineering, Operations o Customer Support in attività multifunzionali. Chi sei
• Hai una laurea o master (BSc/MSc) in Meccatronica, Ingegneria Meccanica/Elettrica, Fisica, Ingegneria Biomedica, Biotecnologia, Scienze naturali, o una qualifica equivalente.
• Hai esperienza nello sviluppo di dispositivi medici (un focus sull'hardware è un plus) e hai lavorato idealmente in un ambiente regolamentato (ad esempio, IVDR).
• Con il vostro stile di lavoro chiaro, strutturato e proattivo, promuovete la collaborazione in team interdisciplinari.
• Pensi analiticamente e sono in grado di vedere il grande quadro così come i dettagli.
• Hai esperienza pratica nell'integrazione del sistema, lavorando con vari domini tecnologici.
• Si naviga con fiducia all'interno di sistemi complessi e organizzazioni distribuite, identificare proattivamente i problemi di livello di sistema e guidarli alla risoluzione.
• Sei fluente in inglese, con conoscenza aggiuntiva del tedesco considerato un plus. Cosa offriamo
• Un ruolo significativo nell'intersezione dello sviluppo hardware e software in un campo altamente rilevante della tecnologia medica.
• L'opportunità di lavorare su sistemi innovativi e complessi all'interno di un team interdisciplinare di esperti.
• Un ambiente collaborativo che incoraggia l'impegno proattivo e l'apprendimento continuo.
• Opportunità di sviluppo individuali e la possibilità di applicare le tue competenze in un ambiente globale. La tua domanda Si prega di caricare il CV corrente, una lettera di motivazione e il certificato della vostra più alta qualifica. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

This role offers the opportunity to support our Donor Screening business, which plays a critical role in detecting antibodies and antigens to aid in diagnosing infections, ensuring blood safety, and monitoring immune responses.

The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist you will:

• Showcase your expertise in technical repair for Roche assigned product lines.

• Offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• Provide routine technical support, on-site service and repair of Roche products.

• Serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• Document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This field-based role requires up to 25% travel. This person will support Providence, RI.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Rhode Island is 71,100.00 - 132,000.00 USD Annual. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to pioneer the sourcing strategies that deliver critical, near-patient diagnostic technologies to the world? As our Sourcing Lead in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will drive operations for our Active Diagnostic Ingredients (ADI), Reagents, and Instruments portfolios. Balancing strategic alignment with tactical excellence, you will lead a highly capable team, drive digital procurement transformation, and collaborate directly with executive leadership to shape the future of our supply network.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Head of Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You are accountable for leading, coaching, and developing a local team of up to 16 Sourcing Managers and one Business Capability Lead. In addition, you will be part of the CoE Leadership Team (LT) and manage critical relationships with executive leadership, including the Direct Procurement LT.

• Role Type: A leadership position combining an even balance of strategic category alignment and tactical sourcing execution.

• Impact: Your impact is defined by driving measurable financial value, robust governance, and process optimization across the ADI, Reagents and Instruments Networks globally. Specifically, you are accountable for

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics (PPV, preferred supplier share, cycle times) while managing your team’s OPEX budget.

• Sourcing & Contracts: Executing compliant global sourcing, market research, and NPI benchmarking. In addition, you will oversee a critical portfolio of low-to-high complexity contracts (e.g., CDAs, SOWs or MSAs).

• Digital Leadership: Governing and improving Roche`s iCollab platform to advance supplier integration alongside Planning, Global Supply Chain, and the Roche Shared Services (RSS).

• SLA Governance: Defining KPIs to guarantee on-time and in-full (OTIF) service delivery across your assigned portfolio.

• Conflict & Exposure: Resolving high-stakes matrix priority conflicts, representing Roche to external providers, and delivering high-frequency monthly/quarterly updates to executive leadership (CoE, Category, Delivery, and DPLT).

• Process & Technology: Together with our Digital & Process experts, you foster and role model the development, deployment, and usage of novel AI / Digital solutions and continuously identify and implement process improvements.

Who you are

We strive to keep our standards high and look for candidates who can lead high-performance cultures, embrace collaboration, and remove operational friction.

• Education: A University degree (Business or Life Sciences) is required; a Master's (MBA) and CIPS certification are highly preferred.

• Experience: 7 to 10 years in Direct Procurement (Medtech, Automotive, Electronics, Pharmaceuticals, or Chemicals industries) with 3 to 5 years specifically in a Shared Service or CoE environment.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Siete pronti a pionieri le strategie di approvvigionamento che forniscono tecnologie diagnostiche critiche e quasi pazienti al mondo? Come il nostro Sourcing Lead a Sant Cugat, Spagna, guiderà le operazioni per i nostri Active Diagnostic Ingredients (ADI), Reagenti e portafogli strumenti. Bilanciando l'allineamento strategico con l'eccellenza tattica, guiderai un team altamente capace, guiderai la trasformazione degli appalti digitali e collaborerai direttamente con la leadership esecutiva per plasmare il futuro della nostra rete di approvvigionamento.
• Linea di segnalazione: La posizione riporta direttamente al Capo del Centro di Eccellenza (CoE).
• Squadra Wider e stakeholder: Sei responsabile per la guida, l'allenatore e lo sviluppo di un team locale di fino a 16 Sourcing Manager e un Leader di Capability Business. Inoltre, sarete parte del CoE Leadership Team (LT) e gestire relazioni critiche con la leadership esecutiva, tra cui il Direct Procurement LT.
• Role Type: Una posizione di leadership che combina un equilibrio anche di allineamento di categoria strategica e esecuzione di sourcing tattico.
• Impatto: Il tuo impatto è definito guidando il valore finanziario misurabile, la governance robusta e l'ottimizzazione dei processi attraverso le reti ADI, Reagenti e Strumenti a livello globale. In particolare, sei responsabile per
• Performance & Savings: Guidare metriche chiave (PPV, quota di fornitore preferita, tempi di ciclo) mentre gestisci il budget OPEX del tuo team.
• Sourcing & Contracts: Esecuzione di sourcing globale conforme, ricerca di mercato e benchmarking NPI. Inoltre, si supervisionerà un portafoglio critico di contratti di scarsa complessità (ad esempio, CDAs, SOWs o MSAs).
• Leadership digitale: Governare e migliorare la piattaforma iCollab di Roche per far avanzare l'integrazione dei fornitori insieme a Planning, Global Supply Chain, e Roche Shared Services (RSS).
• SLA Governance: Definire i KPI per garantire la consegna dei servizi on-time e in-full (OTIF) nel vostro portafoglio assegnato.
• Conflict & Exposure: Risolvere conflitti prioritari di matrice ad alto livello, in rappresentanza di Roche a fornitori esterni, e fornire aggiornamenti mensili / trimestrali ad alta frequenza alla leadership esecutiva (CoE, Categoria, Consegna e DPLT).
• Process & Technology: Insieme ai nostri esperti di Digital & Process, si promuove e modella lo sviluppo, la distribuzione e l'utilizzo di nuove soluzioni AI / Digital e identificare continuamente e implementare i miglioramenti del processo. Chi sei Ci sforziamo di mantenere i nostri standard elevati e cercare candidati che possono condurre culture ad alte prestazioni, abbracciare la collaborazione e rimuovere l'attrito operativo.
• Istruzione: Una laurea universitaria (Business o Scienze della vita) è necessaria; una certificazione Master (MBA) e CIPS sono molto preferiti.
• Esperienza: da 7 a 10 anni in Procurement Diretto (Medtech, Automotive, Electronics, Pharmaceuticals, or Chemicals industry) con 3 a 5 anni in particolare in un Servizio Condiviso o CoE ambiente.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Über unser Team Wir bei Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) sind ein Team von rund 200 begeisterten Fachleuten, die sich dafür einsetzen, mit unseren Lieferanten weltweit Wert zu schaffen. Von Standorten auf der ganzen Welt und mit einem vielfältigen und multikulturellen Team beziehen, verwalten wir unsere Lieferantenbasis, entwickeln und führen Kategoriestrategien aus und entwickeln und digitalisieren ständig Prozesse, die es uns ermöglichen, unser Geschäft bestmöglich zu unterstützen, um nachhaltig zu wachsen. Wenn Sie etwas bewirken möchten und Teil eines leistungsstarken und erstklassigen Beschaffungsteams sein möchten, ist dies das Richtige für Sie. Wir sind DOP. Bei Roche tun wir jetzt, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, die Sourcing-Strategien voranzutreiben, die der Welt wichtige, patientennahe Diagnosetechnologien liefern? Als unser Sourcing Lead in Sant Cugat, Spanien, werden Sie den Betrieb für unsere Portfolios Active Diagnostic Ingredients (ADI), Reagents und Instruments steuern. Durch die Balance zwischen strategischer Ausrichtung und taktischer Exzellenz führen Sie ein hochqualifiziertes Team, treiben die Transformation des digitalen Beschaffungswesens voran und arbeiten direkt mit der Geschäftsleitung zusammen, um die Zukunft unseres Liefernetzwerks zu gestalten.
• Reporting Line: Die Position berichtet direkt an den Head of Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
• Breiteres Team und Stakeholder: Sie sind verantwortlich für die Leitung, das Coaching und die Entwicklung eines lokalen Teams von bis zu 16 Sourcing Managern und einem Business Capability Lead. Darüber hinaus sind Sie Teil des CoE Leadership Teams (LT) und verwalten kritische Beziehungen zur Führungskraft, einschließlich der Direct Procurement LT.
• Rollentyp: Eine Führungsposition, die eine ausgeglichene Balance zwischen strategischer Kategorieausrichtung und taktischer Beschaffungsausführung kombiniert.
• Auswirkungen: Ihre Auswirkungen werden durch messbaren finanziellen Wert, robuste Governance und Prozessoptimierung in den ADI-, Reagenzien- und Instrumentennetzwerken weltweit definiert. Insbesondere sind Sie verantwortlich für
• Performance & Einsparungen: Führen Sie wichtige Metriken (PPV, bevorzugter Lieferantenanteil, Zykluszeiten) und verwalten Sie das OPEX-Budget Ihres Teams.
• Sourcing & Contracts: Durchführung konformer globaler Beschaffung, Marktforschung und NPI-Benchmarking. Darüber hinaus beaufsichtigen Sie ein kritisches Portfolio von Verträgen mit geringer bis hoher Komplexität (z. B. CDAs, SOWs oder MSAs).
• Digital Leadership: Steuerung und Verbesserung der iCollab-Plattform von Roche zur Förderung der Lieferantenintegration neben Planung, globaler Lieferkette und Roche Shared Services (RSS).
• SLA Governance: Definieren von KPIs, um die termingerechte und vollständige (OTIF) Servicebereitstellung in Ihrem zugewiesenen Portfolio zu gewährleisten.
• Conflict & Exposure: Lösung von Matrix-Prioritätskonflikten mit hohen Einsätzen, Vertretung von Roche gegenüber externen Anbietern und Bereitstellung von monatlichen und vierteljährlichen Hochfrequenz-Updates für Führungskräfte (CoE, Category, Delivery und DPLT).
• Process & Technology: Gemeinsam mit unseren Digital & Process Experten fördern und modellieren Sie die Entwicklung, den Einsatz und die Nutzung neuartiger KI/Digitaler Lösungen und identifizieren und implementieren kontinuierlich Prozessverbesserungen. Wer du bist Wir bemühen uns, unsere Standards hoch zu halten und suchen nach Kandidaten, die Hochleistungskulturen führen, die Zusammenarbeit fördern und Reibungen beseitigen können.
• Ausbildung: Ein Universitätsabschluss (Business oder Life Sciences) ist erforderlich; ein Master (MBA) und CIPS-Zertifizierung sind sehr bevorzugt.
• Erfahrung: 7 bis 10 Jahre in der Direktbeschaffung (Medtech-, Automobil-, Elektronik-, Pharma- oder Chemieindustrie) mit 3 bis 5 Jahren speziell in einer Shared Service- oder CoE-Umgebung.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à être le pionnier des stratégies d'approvisionnement qui fournissent des technologies diagnostiques critiques et proches des patients au monde? En tant que leader d'approvisionnement à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous piloterez les opérations de nos portefeuilles d'ingrédients diagnostiques actifs (ADI), réactifs et instruments. Équilibrant l'alignement stratégique avec l'excellence tactique, vous dirigerez une équipe hautement compétente, piloterez la transformation des achats numériques et collaborerez directement avec les dirigeants pour façonner l'avenir de notre réseau d'approvisionnement.
• Ligne hiérarchique : Le poste relève directement du chef du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement (CdE).
• Équipe élargie et parties prenantes : Vous êtes responsable de la direction, du coaching et du développement d'une équipe locale pouvant compter jusqu'à 16 gestionnaires d'approvisionnement et d'un responsable de la capacité opérationnelle. De plus, vous ferez partie de l'équipe de leadership du Conseil de l'Europe (EL) et gérerez des relations critiques avec les cadres supérieurs, y compris le LT d'approvisionnement direct.
• Type de rôle : Un poste de leadership combinant un équilibre uniforme entre l'alignement de catégorie stratégique et l'exécution tactique de l'approvisionnement.
• Impact : Votre impact est défini par une valeur financière mesurable, une gouvernance robuste et l'optimisation des processus à travers les réseaux ADI, Réactifs et Instruments à l'échelle mondiale. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable de
• Performance et économies : Diriger les paramètres clés (PPV, part de fournisseur préférée, temps de cycle) tout en gérant votre budget OPEX équipe.
• Sourcing & Contracts: Exécuter un approvisionnement mondial conforme, des études de marché et des analyses comparatives NPI. De plus, vous superviserez un portefeuille essentiel de contrats de faible à grande complexité (p. ex., ACD, ASU ou ASM).
• Leadership numérique : diriger et améliorer la plateforme iCollab de Roche pour faire progresser l'intégration des fournisseurs aux côtés de la planification, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale et des services partagés de Roche (RSS).
• Gouvernance de l'ALS : Définir les ICR pour garantir la prestation de services à temps et en entier (OTIF) dans l'ensemble de votre portefeuille.
• Conflit et exposition : Résoudre les conflits de priorité de la matrice des prises élevées, représenter Roche auprès des fournisseurs externes, et fournir des mises à jour mensuelles et trimestrielles à la direction (CoE, Catégorie, Exécution et DPLT).
• Processus et technologie: Avec nos experts en processus numériques, vous encouragez et modélisez le développement, le déploiement et l'utilisation de nouvelles solutions d'IA / numérique et identifiez et implémentez en permanence les améliorations de processus. Qui vous êtes Nous nous efforçons de maintenir nos normes élevées et de chercher des candidats qui peuvent diriger des cultures de haute performance, embrasser la collaboration et éliminer les frictions opérationnelles.
• Études : Un diplôme universitaire (affaires ou sciences de la vie) est requis; une maîtrise (MBA) et une certification CIPS sont hautement préférées.
• Expérience : de 7 à 10 ans dans l'approvisionnement en direct (industries Medtech, Automobile, Électronique, Pharmaceutique ou Chimie) avec 3 à 5 ans spécifiquement dans un environnement de service partagé ou de CdE.
