At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This internship is a hands-on opportunity to join the ASPIRE project, a major digital transformation. You'll become a vital part of the ASPIRE project, a global IT and business transformation program that's shaping the future of Roche. Our mission is to create a unified, efficient, and user-friendly digital solution using SAP S/4HANA.
As an intern you will support the organizational readiness lead and the Project lead to establish and strengthen the connection between the project and the various business units to ensure a smooth transition for everyone involved.

The Opportunity

• Strategic Change Management Support: You will work closely with the Organizational Readiness team to help shape and implement our change strategy. This includes conducting stakeholder analyses, drafting and distributing project communications, and developing measures that promote the acceptance and success of new processes.

• Administrative and Operational Responsibilities: You will take on a range of administrative tasks essential for smooth project operations. This involves preparing reports and presentations, coordinating and booking meetings, maintaining distribution lists, and managing our shared inbox as well as Trello access permissions.

• Provide robust PMO support to ensure the smooth execution of transformation initiatives.

• Maintain project documentation, track action items, milestones, and deliverables across multiple timelines.

• Support resource management, capacity planning, and status reporting workflows.

• Utilize project management tools (such as Jira, Monday, or smart tracking sheets) to optimize team productivity and visibility.

• Event and Logistics Coordination: You will actively assist in the planning and execution of project-related events. Your tasks will include booking venues, arranging catering and logistics, and preparing all necessary materials for All Hands meetings, go-live celebrations, and team-building activities.

• Creative and Visual Contributions: You will contribute to the visual consistency of the project by ensuring that project branding is maintained (e.g., in the formatting of presentations and newsletters). Furthermore, you will support creative initiatives such as video production (e.g., with Camtasia), handling project merchandise, and running internal engagement campaigns.

Who You are

• Currently enrolled in or recently graduated with a degree in Business, Information Systems, Communications, Business Psychology, General Management or Project Management or a related field

• A strong interest in project management and organizational change

• Creative and detail-oriented, with an eye for visual design

• Highly motivated with a proactive and structured approach to work

• Excellent English communication skills; German is a plus.

• Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace; basic design/video editing skills (e.g., Camtasia, Canva) are a plus

Additional Information

• Duration: 3-9 months

• Fully Remote Work is not possible: We are convinced that we can best drive change by working directly with our teams. Therefore, the core of our work takes place on-site. While flexibility is available, working with people is our main focus.

jobs.title: Digital Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to bring structured thinking, execution, and focus to digitalization in procurement, unlocking new levels of automation and self-service for global operations? As our Digital Enablement Manager, located in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will proactively identify and drive digital opportunities that support our needs and positively impact process efficiency. Acting as a true ambassador for procurement digitization, you will provide strategic thought leadership in a dynamic global environment to ensure digital tools are seamlessly aligned with our overall business objectives.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Digital & Process Management Lead and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will manage cross-functional relationships across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Category, DOP Delivery, IT, external providers, and internal stakeholders (e.g., process managers and owners).

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on digital enablement, stakeholder advisory, and transformation governance.

• Impact: You drive global operational efficiency, process compliance, and large-scale digital adoption. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Digital Strategy & Roadmap: Developing and governing the digital enablement strategy, setting clear objectives, timelines, and Performance Indicators to monitor the impact of digital tools on procurement outcomes.

• Technology Assessment: Researching and evaluating emerging technologies (AI, Machine Learning, RPA) to enhance procurement processes. Conducting pilot programs to test feasibility and aligning initiatives across functions.

• Stakeholder Advisory & Management: Acting as a trusted advisor to business units and IT, understanding their unique priorities, and fostering an inclusive, collaborative approach to digital transformation.

• AI Pipeline: Spearheading our AI transformation by coordinating and/or building cutting-edge AI solutions in close collaboration with RSS Demand to Pay and Roche Digital Technology (RDT).

• Value Communication: Highlighting the ROI and impact of digital initiatives by developing and delivering data-driven presentations, success stories, and progress reports to senior stakeholders.

• Process Improvement: Conducting thorough analyses of current procurement activities to pinpoint inefficiencies or bottlenecks, using data to prioritize areas for digital intervention and automation.

• Implementation & Adoption: Guiding digitalization projects and solution deployments by creating clear roadmaps. Acting as a liaison with external partners to ensure accurate requirements and promoting seamless adoption by making digitalization "easy to understand for everyone" through targeted training and communication.

Who you are

We look for curious, inclusive, and innovative change agents with a pro

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Siete pronti a portare il pensiero strutturato, l'esecuzione e la messa a fuoco per la digitalizzazione negli appalti, sbloccando nuovi livelli di automazione e self-service per le operazioni globali? Come il nostro Digital Enablement Manager, situato a Sant Cugat, Spagna, si proattivamente identificare e guidare opportunità digitali che supportano le nostre esigenze e l'efficienza del processo di impatto positivo. Essendo un vero ambasciatore per la digitalizzazione degli appalti, fornirete una leadership di pensiero strategica in un ambiente dinamico globale per garantire che gli strumenti digitali siano allineati perfettamente con i nostri obiettivi aziendali globali.
• Reporting Line: Report direttamente al Digital & Process Management Lead e fa parte del Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
• Il team e gli stakeholder dei Wider: gestirete le relazioni interfunzionali attraverso il DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Categoria, DOP Delivery, IT, fornitori esterni e stakeholder interni (ad esempio, responsabili dei processi e proprietari).
• Tipo di ruolo: un ruolo di Contributor individuale focalizzato su abilitazione digitale, consulenza degli stakeholder e governance di trasformazione.
• Impatto: Guida l'efficienza operativa globale, la conformità dei processi e l'adozione digitale su larga scala. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Strategia digitale & Roadmap: Sviluppare e governare la strategia di abilitazione digitale, stabilire obiettivi chiari, linee temporali e Indicatori di performance per monitorare l'impatto degli strumenti digitali sui risultati degli appalti.
• Valutazione della tecnologia: Ricerca e valutazione delle tecnologie emergenti (AI, Machine Learning, RPA) per migliorare i processi di approvvigionamento. Condurre programmi pilota per testare la fattibilità e allineare le iniziative attraverso le funzioni.
• Stakeholder Advisory & Management: Agire come consulente affidabile per le business unit e l'IT, comprendere le loro priorità uniche, e promuovere un approccio inclusivo e collaborativo alla trasformazione digitale.
• AI Pipeline: Guidare la nostra trasformazione AI coordinando e/o costruendo soluzioni AI all'avanguardia in stretta collaborazione con RSS Demand to Pay e Roche Digital Technology (RDT).
• Comunicazione di valore: Evidenziare il ROI e l'impatto delle iniziative digitali sviluppando e fornendo presentazioni, storie di successo e report sui progressi verso gli stakeholder senior.
• Miglioramento del processo: Condurre analisi approfondite delle attuali attività di approvvigionamento per individuare inefficienze o strozzature, utilizzando i dati per priorità aree di intervento e automazione digitale.
• Attuazione & Adozione: Guidare progetti di digitalizzazione e implementazioni di soluzioni creando chiare roadmap. Agire come un collegamento con i partner esterni per garantire requisiti accurati e promuovere l'adozione senza soluzione di continuità, rendendo la digitalizzazione "facile da capire per tutti" attraverso la formazione mirata e la comunicazione. Chi sei Cerchiamo agenti di cambiamento curiosi, inclusi e innovativi con un pro

jobs.title: Business Process Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to optimize the global Demand-to-Pay landscape and drive the tactical execution of digital procurement innovations? As our Business Process Expert (BPE) located in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will take tactical and strategic ownership over complex business processes in the Demand-to-Pay space for DOP. In this role, you will analyze, design, and implement innovative solutions - including adjoining IT ecosystems like SAP and myBuy - to increase stability, reduce errors, and drive seamless process adoption across the global network.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Digital & Process Management Lead and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will manage cross-functional relationships across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Category, DOP Delivery, DOP Sourcing Teams, RSS Demand to Pay, Global Procurement, and external service providers.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role blending tactical process execution with strategic design elements.

• Impact: You drive departmental efficiency, process compliance, and effective change management. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Process Optimization & System Integration: Managing and further developing complex business processes within the Demand-to-Pay landscape and designing efficient interfaces to other business processes.

• Innovation & Automation: Proactively identifying opportunities for process improvements, automation, and digitalization in close collaboration with Delivery, Category, Digital & Process Management, and RSS Demand to Pay.

• Project Leadership: Leading partial and overall projects independently, contributing to large local and global cross-functional teams, and independently designing workshops and training courses.

• Innovative Solution Design: Developing and analyzing innovative approaches to complex problems and system optimizations, verifying them at a global level, and guiding their local implementation.

• Process Optimization: Analyzing and implementing area-specific solutions to reduce critical errors, increase stability and productivity, and integrate Best Practices for optimal usage.

• Strategic Process Development & Knowledge Transfer: Driving continuous improvement through simple, fast, and agile business processes while acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to ensure robust know-how transfer across the organization.

• Conflict & Exposure: Resolving matrix conflicts regarding competing project priorities or process expectations, while delivering high-frequency (monthly/quarterly) KPI updates - such as cycle times and compliance - to the CoE LT and DPLT.

Who you are

We look for positive, self-reflecting professionals with a solution-oriented "Can-Do" attitude and a clear focus on end-to-end perspectives.

• Education: A University degree with a business or life scie

In questo ruolo, si analizza, progetta e implementa soluzioni innovative - tra cui gli ecosistemi IT come SAP e myBuy - per aumentare la stabilità, ridurre gli errori, e guidare l'adozione di processo senza soluzione di continuità in tutta la rete globale.
• Reporting Line: Report direttamente al Digital & Process Management Lead e fa parte del Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
• Team Wider e stakeholder: gestirai relazioni interfunzionali attraverso il DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Category, DOP Delivery, DOP Sourcing Teams, RSS Demand to Pay, Global Procurement e fornitori di servizi esterni.
• Tipo di ruolo: Un ruolo di Contributor individuale fondendo l'esecuzione tattica del processo con elementi di progettazione strategici.
• Impatto: Lei guida l'efficienza dipartimentale, la conformità del processo e la gestione efficace del cambiamento. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Ottimizzazione del processo & Integrazione del sistema: Gestione e sviluppo di processi aziendali complessi all'interno del paesaggio di Demand-to-Pay e progettazione di interfacce efficienti ad altri processi aziendali.
• Innovazione & Automazione: individuare attivamente le opportunità di miglioramento del processo, automazione e digitalizzazione in stretta collaborazione con Delivery, Categoria, Digital & Process Management e RSS Demand to Pay.
• Leadership del progetto: Leader di progetti parziali e globali in modo indipendente, contribuendo a grandi team interfunzionali locali e globali, e progettazione indipendente di workshop e corsi di formazione.
• Innovative Solution Design: sviluppo e analisi di approcci innovativi a problemi complessi e ottimizzazione del sistema, verificandoli a livello globale e guidando la loro implementazione locale.
• Ottimizzazione del processo: analizzare e implementare soluzioni specifiche per l'area per ridurre gli errori critici, aumentare la stabilità e la produttività e integrare le Best Practices per un utilizzo ottimale.
• Trasferimento strategico di processo e conoscenza: Guidare il miglioramento continuo attraverso processi aziendali semplici, veloci e agili, agendo come esperto di materia (SME) soggetto per garantire un trasferimento di know-how robusto in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Conflict & Exposure: Risolvere i conflitti di matrice per quanto riguarda le priorità del progetto in competizione o le aspettative di processo, offrendo al contempo aggiornamenti KPI ad alta frequenza (mese / trimestrale) - come tempi di ciclo e conformità - al CoE LT e DPLT. Chi sei Cerchiamo professionisti positivi e auto-riflettenti con un atteggiamento "Can-Do" orientato alla soluzione e un chiaro focus sulle prospettive end-to-end.
• Istruzione: Una laurea universitaria con una scienza aziendale o di vita

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à concevoir le paysage des processus numériques mondiaux et à diriger l'optimisation stratégique des systèmes qui pilotent nos opérations d'approvisionnement mondial de bout en bout? En tant que responsable des capacités d'affaires (BCL) pour la collaboration avec les fournisseurs, situé à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous prendrez en charge stratégique et opérationnelle des segments critiques du paysage mondial des processus de demande à paiement. Dans ce rôle à impact élevé, vous définirez la gouvernance des processus, intégrerez des interfaces complexes entre les écosystèmes d'entreprise et servirez d'agent de changement essentiel pour accélérer nos solutions techniques de collaboration des fournisseurs, principalement notre solution iCollab, afin de favoriser l'adoption dans toute l'entreprise. iCollab est la nouvelle plateforme de collaboration de Roche pour la chaîne d'approvisionnement, offrant des mises à jour en temps réel, la transparence et l'automatisation avec nos fournisseurs.
• Ligne hiérarchique : relève directement de notre responsable d'approvisionnement et fait partie du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement (CdE).
• Équipe élargie et parties prenantes : dirige une communauté mondiale des capacités d'affaires formée par les PME. Vous gérerez les relations interfonctionnelles entre l'équipe de leadership du DOP (DPLT), la CoE LT, la livraison, les équipes d'approvisionnement, la demande de RSS à payer, l'approvisionnement mondial et les fournisseurs de technologie externes.
• Type de rôle: En tant que BCL, vous représentez les intérêts commerciaux de DOP dans le monde entier dans les forums pertinents et vous êtes responsable du développement et de l'amélioration continue de la stratégie de collaboration des fournisseurs.
• Impact: Vous dirigez l'efficacité opérationnelle mondiale, la conformité des processus et l'adoption numérique à grande échelle. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Conception et stratégie des processus : Élaboration et déploiement de la feuille de route DOP pour iCollab et d'autres solutions adjacentes, en adéquation avec des partenaires fonctionnels comme DIA Global Supply Chain et RSS Demand to Pay.
• Automatisation et innovation: identifier proactivement les possibilités d'automatisation des processus et de numérisation en étroite collaboration avec la livraison, la catégorie, la gestion numérique et des processus, et la demande de RSS à payer.
• Analyse et gouvernance des PME : agir à titre d'expert en la matière pour analyser, élaborer des options et concevoir des solutions qui résolvent les problèmes de processus, de système, d'indicateur de rendement ou de données, tout en appuyant les définitions des données et des règles.
• Délégation de projet de transformation : Être un délégué responsable des grandes initiatives ministérielles (comme le programme ASPIRE; notre processus global et la transformation numérique) pour appuyer l'adoption de modèles mondiaux et évaluer les impacts du changement localisé.
• Amélioration continue : Diriger des initiatives d'amélioration continue, gérer l'alignement des besoins à l'échelle mondiale et établir des partenariats avec d'autres BCL et propriétaires de capacités d'affaires (BCO) pour optimiser les performances interfonctionnelles de bout en bout.
• Représentation de la communauté et des ARTS : Diriger la communauté des capacités d'affaires des PME et représenter le DOP dans les collectivités et les trains de libération Agile.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à concevoir le paysage des processus numériques mondiaux et à diriger l'optimisation stratégique des systèmes qui pilotent nos opérations d'approvisionnement mondial de bout en bout? En tant que chef de file en matière de capacités d'affaires (BCL) situé à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous assumerez la responsabilité stratégique et opérationnelle de segments critiques du paysage mondial des processus de demande à paiement. Dans ce rôle à fort impact, vous définirez la gouvernance des processus, intégrerez des interfaces complexes entre les écosystèmes d'entreprise et servirez d'agent de changement vital pour accélérer l'adoption de la solution myBuy dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise. myBuy est la plateforme d'approvisionnement numérique de Roche, conçue pour améliorer le processus d'approvisionnement à la paye en fournissant la transparence, les transactions en temps opportun et l'automatisation pour nos opérations d'achat.
• Ligne hiérarchique : relève directement de notre responsable d'approvisionnement et fait partie du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement (CdE).
• Équipe élargie et parties prenantes : dirige une communauté mondiale des capacités d'affaires formée par les PME. Vous gérerez les relations interfonctionnelles entre l'équipe de leadership du DOP (DPLT), le COE LT, la livraison du DOP, les équipes d'approvisionnement du DOP, la demande de paiement du RSS, les fournisseurs de technologie mondiaux et externes.
• Type de rôle: En tant que BCL, vous représentez les intérêts commerciaux de DOP à l'échelle mondiale dans les forums pertinents, et vous êtes responsable du développement et de l'amélioration continue de la stratégie d'achat à paiement de DOP.
• Impact: Vous dirigez l'efficacité opérationnelle mondiale, la conformité des processus et l'adoption numérique à grande échelle. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Conception et stratégie des processus : Élaborer et déployer la feuille de route DOP pour myBuy, en accord avec des partenaires fonctionnels comme DIA Global Supply Chain et RSS Demand to Pay.
• Automatisation et innovation: identifier proactivement les possibilités d'automatisation des processus et de numérisation en étroite collaboration avec la livraison, la catégorie, la gestion numérique et des processus, et la demande de RSS à payer.
• Analyse et gouvernance des PME : agir en tant qu'expert en matière profonde pour analyser, élaborer des options et concevoir des solutions qui résolvent les problèmes de processus, de système, d'indicateur de rendement ou de données, tout en appuyant les définitions des données et des règles.
• Délégation de projet de transformation : Être un délégué responsable des grandes initiatives ministérielles (comme le programme ASPIRE; notre processus global et la transformation numérique) pour appuyer l'adoption de modèles mondiaux et évaluer les impacts du changement localisé.
• Amélioration continue : Diriger des initiatives d'amélioration continue, gérer l'alignement des besoins à l'échelle mondiale et établir des partenariats avec d'autres BCL et propriétaires de capacités d'affaires (BCO) pour optimiser les performances interfonctionnelles de bout en bout.
• Représentation de la communauté et des ARTS : Diriger la communauté des capacités d'affaires des PME et représenter le DOP dans les collectivités et les trains de libération Agile.
• Gestion des connaissances: encadrement du développement, de l'entretien structurel et de la mise en œuvre des processus du système mondial

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the long-term supplier strategies and project pipelines that deliver medical innovation to patients worldwide? As our Associate Category Manager (ACM) in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will support the development, validation, and execution of global category strategies and annual strategic initiatives. In this role, you will leverage rigorous procurement analytics to transform market intelligence into actionable category guidance, ensuring global supply resilience and portfolio value.
We are looking to fulfill one Associate Category Manager position per team. Successful candidates will be aligned to support one of the following dedicated procurement categories: Biologicals & Chemicals, Plastics & Packaging, Electronics & Systems, Mechanicals, Logistics.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the respective Category Lead within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Collaborates closely with Category Managers, Sourcing Managers, Delivery Managers, Finance, Legal, and external market intelligence providers. Participates in a global ACM Community of Practice (CoP) coordinated by the Category Integration & Excellence Lead to ensure consistency of methodologies, reporting standards, strategic planning processes, and cross-category collaboration.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role in support of the allocated Category, focused on strategic enablement, market data intelligence, and stakeholder management.

• Impact: You drive category compliance, data integrity, and strategic execution across the global operations network. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Pipeline Support: Collation of supplier, market, and internal business data to help formulate the long-term Category Strategy and build a proactive pipeline of future initiatives.

• Strategic Initiative Deployment: Supporting Category Managers, Project Delivery, Delivery, and Sourcing Managers in executing and deploying complex projects in strict compliance with global standards and procedures.

• Negotiation & Contracting Preparation: Supporting contract drafting and vendor negotiations for strategic, key, or bottleneck suppliers by delivering comprehensive analytics, fact-bases, and market benchmarks.

• Strategic Sourcing: Support selected high-value strategic sourcing initiatives and complex RFx activities to convert pipeline targets into realized business value.

• Reporting & Analytics: Collaborating with data analytics experts to generate Category-specific insights, generating monthly spend/savings metrics, and conducting data validation to safeguard governance.

• Implementation Support: Converting strategic outcomes into clear category guidance documents and support materials to ensure category strategies can be effectively implemented across the organization.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Siete pronti a modellare le strategie di lungo termine dei fornitori e le condotte di progetto che forniscono innovazione medica ai pazienti in tutto il mondo? Come nostro Associate Categoria Manager (ACM) a Sant Cugat, Spagna, supporterai lo sviluppo, la convalida e l'esecuzione delle strategie di categoria globali e delle iniziative strategiche annuali. In questo ruolo, si leverà rigorosa analisi degli appalti per trasformare l'intelligenza di mercato in una guida di categoria attuabile, garantendo la resilienza globale dell'offerta e il valore del portafoglio. Stiamo cercando di soddisfare una posizione Associate Categoria Manager per team. I candidati di successo saranno allineati per sostenere una delle seguenti categorie di appalti dedicati: Biologicals & Chemicals, Plastics & Packaging, Electronics & Systems, Meccanica, Logistica.
• Reporting Line: Referisce direttamente alla rispettiva categoria Lead all'interno dell'organizzazione Categoria.
• Wider Team e Stakeholders: Collabora a stretto contatto con i responsabili della categoria, Sourcing Managers, Delivery Managers, Finance, Legal e fornitori di intelligence di mercato esterni. • Tipo di ruolo: Un ruolo di Contributor individuale a sostegno della Categoria assegnata, focalizzato su abilitazione strategica, intelligenza dei dati di mercato e gestione degli stakeholder.
• Impatto: Guida la conformità della categoria, l'integrità dei dati e l'esecuzione strategica nella rete operativa globale. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Supporto Strategy & Pipeline: Collazione dei dati di fornitori, di mercato e di business interni per contribuire a formulare la strategia di categoria a lungo termine e costruire una pipeline proattiva di future iniziative.
• Strategic Initiative Deployment: Supporting Category Managers, Project Delivery, Delivery e Sourcing Managers nell'esecuzione e distribuzione di progetti complessi in stretta conformità con gli standard e le procedure globali.
• Negotiation & Contracting Preparation: Sostenere la redazione dei contratti e i negoziati dei fornitori per i fornitori strategici, chiave o strozzature offrendo analisi complete, basi di fatto e benchmark di mercato.
• Sourcing Strategico: Supporto selezionato iniziative strategiche ad alto valore e complesse attività RFx per convertire obiettivi pipeline in valore aziendale realizzato.
• Reporting & Analytics: Collaborare con esperti di analisi dei dati per generare informazioni specifiche sulla categoria, generare metriche mensili di spesa/risparmio e condurre la convalida dei dati per salvaguardare la governance.
• Supporto per l'attuazione: convertire i risultati strategici in documenti di guida di categoria chiari e materiali di supporto per garantire strategie di categoria possono essere efficacemente implementati in tutta l'organizzazione. Chi sei Cerchiamo problem-solvers analitici con eccellente in

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you highly organized, digitally savvy, and ready to provide top-tier administrative support to a global leadership team? As our Administrative Assistant based in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will provide critical support to the Head of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE) and the CoE Leadership Team. In the context of the Diagnostics Global Operations transformation (“FOM”), this role is critically based in Sant Cugat to support our evolving, globally distributed organization.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Head of Procurement Center of Excellence and is part of the wider Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Interacts closely with the CoE Leadership Team, Category, Delivery, the broader DOP team in Sant Cugat, and the Executive Assistant to the Head of DOP.

• Role Type: An operational and tactical support role with a global scope.

• Impact: You will be the organizational backbone of the CoE, ensuring seamless operational continuity, optimized digital workflows, and a strong departmental culture. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Executive & Administrative Support: Providing high-level support by proactively managing complex calendars and mailboxes, coordinating end-to-end business travel logistics and expenses, and acting as an active deputy within the administrative support team.

• Meeting & Event Coordination: Independently coordinating CoE Leadership Team meetings, workshops, and global CoE Huddles. You will facilitate meeting flows, manage timelines, and organize large internal and external events or team-building activities.

• Digital Workplace & Tools Master: Acting as a "Super User" for collaboration tools like Monday.com to design optimized boards, track action items, and automate workflows. You will also own the department's internal G-Site, ensuring templates and SOPs are organized and up to date.

• Onboarding & HR Administration: Managing the full onboarding lifecycle for new Direct Procurement employees, including hardware/software provisioning and training matrix implementation. You will also handle time management support for the Sant Cugat team and HR administration for external consultants.

• Communication & Community Building: Drafting and coordinating leadership announcements and organizational success stories, while facilitating cross-site cultural exchanges and networking events to connect the Sant Cugat team with global hubs.

Who you are

We look for a proactive, culturally intelligent professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and excels at supporting a globally distributed team and a manager who is not co-located.

• Experience: 1 to 3 years of experience in a similar administrative or executive support role.

Potrai anche gestire il supporto di gestione del tempo per il team di Sant Cugat e l'amministrazione HR per consulenti esterni.

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Von Standorten auf der ganzen Welt und mit einem vielfältigen und multikulturellen Team beziehen, verwalten wir unsere Lieferantenbasis, entwickeln und führen Kategoriestrategien aus und entwickeln und digitalisieren ständig Prozesse, die es uns ermöglichen, unser Geschäft bestmöglich zu unterstützen, um nachhaltig zu wachsen. Wenn Sie etwas bewirken möchten und Teil eines leistungsstarken und erstklassigen Beschaffungsteams sein möchten, ist dies das Richtige für Sie. Wir sind DOP. Bei Roche tun wir jetzt, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Die Chance Sind Sie hoch organisiert, digital versiert und bereit, einem globalen Führungsteam erstklassige administrative Unterstützung zu bieten? Als unser Verwaltungsassistent mit Sitz in Sant Cugat, Spanien, unterstützen Sie den Leiter des Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE) und das CoE Leadership Team entscheidend. Im Kontext der Transformation von Diagnostics Global Operations („FOM) ist diese Rolle von entscheidender Bedeutung in Sant Cugat, um unsere sich entwickelnde, global verteilte Organisation zu unterstützen.
• Reporting Line: Berichtet direkt an den Leiter des Procurement Center of Excellence und ist Teil des erweiterten Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
• Breiteres Team und Stakeholder: Interagiert eng mit dem CoE Leadership Team, der Kategorie, der Lieferung, dem breiteren DOP Team in Sant Cugat und dem Executive Assistant des Head of DOP.
• Rollentyp: Eine operative und taktische Unterstützungsrolle mit globaler Reichweite.
• Impact: Sie werden das organisatorische Rückgrat des CoE sein und eine nahtlose operative Kontinuität, optimierte digitale Workflows und eine starke Abteilungskultur gewährleisten. Insbesondere sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Executive & Administrative Support: Bereitstellung von High-Level-Support durch die proaktive Verwaltung komplexer Kalender und Postfächer, die Koordination von End-to-End-Geschäftsreiselogistik und -kosten und als aktiver Stellvertreter im administrativen Support-Team.
• Meeting & Event Koordination: Unabhängige Koordination von CoE Leadership Team Meetings, Workshops und globalen CoE Huddles. Sie erleichtern Meeting-Flows, verwalten Zeitpläne und organisieren große interne und externe Veranstaltungen oder Teambuilding-Aktivitäten.
• Digital Workplace & Tools Master: Als "Super User" für Collaboration-Tools wie Monday.com fungieren, um optimierte Boards zu entwerfen, Action-Elemente zu verfolgen und Workflows zu automatisieren. Sie werden auch die interne G-Site der Abteilung besitzen, um sicherzustellen, dass Vorlagen und SOPs organisiert und auf dem neuesten Stand sind.
• Onboarding & HR Administration: Verwaltung des gesamten Onboarding-Lebenszyklus für neue Direct Procurement-Mitarbeiter, einschließlich Hardware- / Softwarebereitstellung und Schulungsmatriximplementierung. Sie übernehmen auch die Zeitmanagement-Unterstützung für das Sant Cugat-Team und die Personalverwaltung für externe Berater.
• Kommunikation & Community Building: Erstellung und Koordination von Ankündigungen von Führungskräften und organisatorischen Erfolgsgeschichten, während der standortübergreifende kulturelle Austausch und Networking-Events erleichtert werden, um das Sant Cugat-Team mit globalen Hubs zu verbinden. Wer du bist Wir suchen einen proaktiven, kulturell intelligenten Fachmann, der in einem dynamischen Umfeld gedeiht und sich durch die Unterstützung eines global verteilten Teams und eines Managers auszeichnet, der nicht zusammenlebt.

Are you ready to lead digital innovation and process excellence for DOP? As our Digital & Process Management Lead based in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will have an instrumental global impact on the deployment and continuous improvement of our processes, systems, and underlying data. This newly created role combines elements of previous teams to significantly increase organizational scale and impact within the Diagnostics Global Operations transformation (“FOM”).

• Impact: You will drive a high-performance culture, transform challenges into opportunities, and unlock the potential of your team. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Digitalization & Innovation: Identifying, planning, and executing digitalization initiatives (e.g., process automation, tool deployment). You will orchestrate relevant stakeholders, develop business cases, drive user adoption, and benchmark digital procurement capabilities.

• Global Initiatives (ASPIRE & iCollab): Representing DOP in the Roche-wide ASPIRE transformation program (D2P stream). You are accountable for delivering project milestones, leading end-to-end process design, and transitioning successfully into the sustain organization.

• Business Process Management: Managing the D2P process landscape within DOP. You will collaborate with the Global Business Process Owner to develop specificities, ensure compliant execution, and collect feedback for continuous improvement.

• Financial Scope: Maintaining oversight and working within the GRP budgets provided for various multi-year initiatives (ASPIRE, iCollab, FOM Integration).

• Talent Leadership: Coaching and developing a global team, ensuring cultural awareness, and fostering an environment of psychological safety to achieve ambitious divisional goals.

Who you are

We look for an authentic, courageous, and transformational leader who is a true "systems thinker"—someone who can navigate complexity, manage competing priorities, and craft integrated solutions that drive efficiency.

L'opportunità Sei pronto a guidare l'innovazione digitale e l'eccellenza di processo per DOP? Con sede a Sant Cugat, in Spagna, il nostro Digital & Process Management Lead avrà un impatto globale strumentale sull'implementazione e il miglioramento continuo dei nostri processi, sistemi e dati sottostanti. Questo ruolo appena creato combina elementi di precedenti team per aumentare significativamente la scala organizzativa e l'impatto all'interno della trasformazione Diagnostics Global Operations (“FOM”).
• Linea di segnalazione: Rapporti direttamente al Capo del Centro di Eccellenza e fa parte del più ampio Centro di Eccellenza (CoE).
• Il team e le parti interessate del Wider: Interagisce frequentemente con ASPIRE Program Leadership, il team di Leadership dei contratti diagnostici (DPLT), la gestione della categoria, la consegna e la domanda di RSS da pagare. Lei rappresenterà anche il DOP come “proprietario di affari” nella strategica D2P Business Owner Community.
• Tipo di ruolo: un ruolo di leadership senior, bilanciando le responsabilità strategiche e tattiche, dirigendo un team globale di fino a 15 professionisti (tra cui Digital Enablement Managers, Business Process Experts, e ASPIRE Deployment Risorse).
• Impatto: Potrai guidare una cultura ad alte prestazioni, trasformare le sfide in opportunità e sbloccare il potenziale del tuo team. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Digitalizzazione & Innovazione: Identificare, pianificare ed eseguire iniziative di digitalizzazione (ad esempio, automazione dei processi, distribuzione degli strumenti). Potrai orchestrare le parti interessate rilevanti, sviluppare i casi aziendali, guidare l'adozione degli utenti e le capacità di approvvigionamento digitale di riferimento.
• Global Initiatives (ASPIRE & iCollab): Rappresentare il DOP nel programma di trasformazione ASPIRE (D2P stream). Sei responsabile per la fornitura di pietre miliari di progetto, progettazione di processo end-to-end leader, e transizione con successo nell'organizzazione di supporto.
• Business Process Management: Gestione del paesaggio di processo D2P all'interno del DOP. Collaborerai con il Global Business Process Owner per sviluppare specificità, garantire l'esecuzione conforme e raccogliere feedback per il miglioramento continuo.
• Ambito finanziario: Mantenere la supervisione e il lavoro all'interno dei bilanci GRP previsti per varie iniziative pluriennali (ASPIRE, iCollab, FOM Integration).
• Talent Leadership: coaching e sviluppo di un team globale, garantire la consapevolezza culturale e promuovere un ambiente di sicurezza psicologica per raggiungere obiettivi di divisione ambiziosi. Chi sei Cerchiamo un leader autentico, coraggioso e trasformazionale, che è un vero "sistemi pensatore"—qualcuno che può navigare nella complessità, gestire le priorità concorrenti e creare soluzioni integrate che favoriscano l'efficienza.
• Istruzione: Una laurea universitaria è richiesto, con un focus sulle scienze aziendali o vita altamente preferibile. Le certificazioni di acquisto professionali (MBA o equivalente) e di master (ad esempio, CIPS) sono preferibili

• Education: A University degree is required, with a focus on business or life sciences highly preferable. A Master's degree (MBA or equivalent) and professional purchasing certifications (e.g., CIPS) are prefer

jobs.title: Project Engineer (m/w/d) Filling & Packaging
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben. Roche hat sich ein inspirierendes Ziel bis 2030 gesetzt: Mehr medizinische und hochwertige diagnostische Lösungen zu geringeren Kosten für die Gesellschaft bereitzustellen. Das Site Management für die Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg stellt Infrastruktur und Rahmenbedingungen für unsere rund 15.000 Mitarbeitenden in Deutschland zur Verfügung, um mit diagnostischen und medizinischen Lösungen wertschöpfend für Patienten tätig sein zu können.

Das sind wir
Das Chapter Engineering der RDG ist mit 170 Mitarbeitenden für die erfolgreiche Planung und Umsetzung aller großen Investitionsprojekte an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg verantwortlich. Durch unsere Arbeit sichern wir die Versorgung unserer Patienten mit innovativen Produkten. Wir sind eine Einheit mit flachen Hierarchien und legen viel Wert auf Eigenverantwortlichkeit, eine offene Unternehmenskultur und Spaß an der Arbeit. Teamarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und Freiheitsgrade bei der Projektbearbeitung sind bei uns selbstverständlich.

Die Gruppe Filling & Packaging ist für die eigenverantwortliche Planung und Realisierung von maschinen- und verfahrenstechnischen Projekten zuständig. Wir unterstützen unsere Business-Partner kompetent in Fragen der Pharma-, Dia- und Prozesstechnik und stellen die Einhaltung aller GMP-Richtlinien sicher.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Du übernimmst die eigenverantwortliche Planung, Projektierung und Realisierung von maschinen- und verfahrenstechnischen Projekten im Bereich Filling & Packaging unter Einhaltung aller internen SOPs sowie gesetzlichen Vorgaben.

• Dein Fokus liegt auf der Leitung und dem Management kleiner bis mittelgroßer Projekte im pharmazeutischen und diagnostischen Umfeld inklusive Planung, Steuerung und Monitoring der Projektaktivitäten.

• Du verantwortest das Fremdfirmenmanagement : Von der Leistungsbeschreibung über die Auswahl und Steuerung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Abnahme von externen Dienstleistern und Fachfirmen.

• Du agierst als kompetente:r Berater:in für interne Business-Partner in Fragen der Pharma-, Dia- und Prozesstechnik und engagierst Dich aktiv in der Engineering Community zum Austausch von Best Practices.

• Du identifizierst Innovationen sowie neue Technologien und trägst zu deren wirtschaftlich bedeutsamen Entwicklung und dem Einsatz vor Ort bei.

• Die Tätigkeit wird primär am Hauptstandort Mannheim durchgeführt, beinhaltet jedoch auch Projektarbeit an weiteren Standorten sowie im Rahmen internationaler Projekte.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du hast ein Studium des Ingenieurwesens mit Fachrichtung Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Biotechnologie oder einen ähnlichen Studiengang erfolgreich abgeschlossen und bringst idealerweise mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position in der Industrie mit.

• Du verfügst über einschlägige Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement sowie in der Projektierung von diagnostischem und pharmazeutischem Equipment, idealerweise im Produktions- oder Verpackungsumfeld.

• Du besitzt tiefgreifendes Wissen in deinem Spezialgebiet (z. B. Abfülltechnik, Verpackungstechnik oder optische Inspektion) und hast Grundwissen in Bereichen wie Automation oder Serialisierung.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in GMP und in der konzeptionellen Planung zeichnen dich aus.

• Du bist sicher im Umgang mit relevanten DV-Anwendungen und verfügst über ein sehr gutes Ausdrucksvermögen.

descriptionByLocale.it:

Roche si è imposta un obiettivo ispiratore entro il 2030: fornire soluzioni diagnostiche più mediche e di alta qualità per la società a un costo più basso. La gestione del sito per i siti di Mannheim e Penzberg fornisce l'infrastruttura e il framework per i nostri circa 15.000 dipendenti in Germania per poter lavorare con soluzioni diagnostiche e mediche che aggiungono valore ai pazienti. Noi siamo Con 170 dipendenti, RDG’s Chapter Engineering è responsabile della pianificazione e dell’implementazione di tutti i principali progetti di investimento nei siti di Mannheim e Penzberg. Attraverso il nostro lavoro, garantiamo la fornitura dei nostri pazienti con prodotti innovativi. Siamo un'unità con gerarchie piatte e attribuiamo grande importanza alla responsabilità personale, una cultura aziendale aperta e divertimento sul lavoro. Il lavoro di squadra, il sostegno reciproco e i gradi di libertà nello sviluppo del progetto sono una questione naturalmente per noi. Il Gruppo Filling & Packaging è responsabile per la pianificazione e l'implementazione auto-responsabili di progetti di ingegneria meccanica e di processo. Sosteniamo i nostri partner commerciali competenti in materia di tecnologia farmaceutica, dia e di processo e garantiamo il rispetto di tutte le linee guida GMP. Responsabilità | Questo è ciò che vi aspetta
• Si prende il controllo della pianificazione responsabile, la pianificazione del progetto e la realizzazione di progetti di ingegneria meccanica e di processo nel campo di Filling & Packaging in conformità a tutti i SOP interni e requisiti legali.
• L'attenzione è rivolta alla gestione e alla gestione di progetti di piccole e medie dimensioni nell'ambiente farmaceutico e diagnostico, tra cui la pianificazione, il controllo e il monitoraggio delle attività di progetto.
• L'utente è responsabile della gestione esterna dell'azienda: dalla specifica dei servizi alla selezione e al controllo fino alla riuscita accettazione di fornitori di servizi esterni e aziende specializzate.
• Lei agisce come consulente competente per i partner commerciali interni in materia di tecnologia farmaceutica, dia e di processo e sono attivamente coinvolti nella comunità di ingegneria per scambiare le migliori pratiche.
• Identificare innovazioni e nuove tecnologie e contribuire al loro sviluppo e distribuzione economicamente significativo sul posto.
• L'attività si svolge principalmente presso la sede centrale di Mannheim, ma comprende anche lavori di progetto in altre sedi e nel quadro di progetti internazionali. Qualificazioni | Questo è ciò che porti
• Hai completato con successo una laurea in ingegneria con una specializzazione in ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria industriale, biotecnologia o un corso di laurea simile e idealmente portare diversi anni di esperienza professionale in una posizione paragonabile nell'industria.
• Hai una conoscenza rilevante nella gestione del progetto e nella pianificazione del progetto di apparecchiature diagnostiche e farmaceutiche, idealmente nell'ambiente di produzione o di imballaggio.
• Hai una conoscenza approfondita della tua specialità (ad esempio tecnologia di riempimento, tecnologia di imballaggio o ispezione ottica) e conoscenze di base in settori come l'automazione o la serializzazione.
• La conoscenza approfondita di GMP e la pianificazione concettuale vi distingue.
• Sei fiducioso nel trattare con applicazioni DV pertinenti e avere una buona espressività.

Roche has set itself an inspiring goal by 2030: to provide more medical and high-quality diagnostic solutions for society at a lower cost. Teamwork, mutual support and degrees of freedom in project development are a matter of course for us. The Filling & Packaging Group is responsible for the self-responsible planning and implementation of machine and process engineering projects. We support our business partners competently in matters of pharmaceutical, dia and process technology and ensure compliance with all GMP guidelines. Responsibility | This is what awaits you
• You take over the responsible planning, project planning and realization of machine and process engineering projects in the field of Filling & Packaging in compliance with all internal SOPs as well as legal requirements.

• You are responsible for external company management: from the specification of services to the selection and control up to the successful acceptance of external service providers and specialist companies.
• You act as a competent consultant for internal business partners in matters of pharmaceutical, dia and process technology and are actively involved in the engineering community to exchange best practices.
• You identify innovations and new technologies and contribute to their economically significant development and deployment on site.
• The activity is primarily carried out at the headquarters in Mannheim, but also includes project work at other locations and within the framework of international projects. Qualifications | This is what you bring
• You have successfully completed a degree in engineering with a specialization in mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, biotechnology or a similar degree program and ideally bring several years of professional experience in a comparable position in industry.
• You have relevant knowledge in project management as well as in the project planning of diagnostic and pharmaceutical equipment, ideally in the production or packaging environment.
• You have in-depth knowledge in your specialty (e.g. filling technology, packaging technology or optical inspection) and basic knowledge in areas such as automation or serialization.
• In-depth knowledge of GMP and conceptual planning sets you apart.
• You are confident in dealing with relevant DV applications and have a very good expressiveness.

Das Site Management für die Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg stellt Infrastruktur und Rahmenbedingungen für unsere rund 15.000 Mitarbeitenden in Deutschland zur Verfügung, um mit diagnostischen und medizinischen Lösungen wertschöpfend für Patienten tätig sein zu können. Das sind wir Das Chapter Engineering der RDG ist mit 170 Mitarbeitenden für die erfolgreiche Planung und Umsetzung aller großen Investitionsprojekte an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg verantwortlich. Durch unsere Arbeit sichern wir die Versorgung unserer Patienten mit innovativen Produkten. Wir sind eine Einheit mit flachen Hierarchien und legen viel Wert auf Eigenverantwortlichkeit, eine offene Unternehmenskultur und Spaß an der Arbeit. Teamarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und Freiheitsgrade bei der Projektbearbeitung sind bei uns selbstverständlich. Die Gruppe Filling & Packaging ist für die eigenverantwortliche Planung und Realisierung von maschinen- und verfahrenstechnischen Projekten zuständig. Wir unterstützen unsere Business-Partner kompetent in Fragen der Pharma-, Dia- und Prozesstechnik und stellen die Einhaltung aller GMP-Richtlinien sicher. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
• Du übernimmst die eigenverantwortliche Planung, Projektierung und Realisierung von maschinen- und verfahrenstechnischen Projekten im Bereich Filling & Packaging unter Einhaltung aller internen SOPs sowie gesetzlichen Vorgaben.
• Dein Fokus liegt auf der Leitung und dem Management kleiner bis mittelgroßer Projekte im pharmazeutischen und diagnostischen Umfeld inklusive Planung, Steuerung und Monitoring der Projektaktivitäten.
• Du verantwortest das Fremdfirmenmanagement : Von der Leistungsbeschreibung über die Auswahl und Steuerung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Abnahme von externen Dienstleistern und Fachfirmen.
• Du agierst als kompetente:r Berater:in für interne Business-Partner in Fragen der Pharma-, Dia- und Prozesstechnik und engagierst Dich aktiv in der Engineering Community zum Austausch von Best Practices.
• Du identifizierst Innovationen sowie neue Technologien und trägst zu deren wirtschaftlich bedeutsamen Entwicklung und dem Einsatz vor Ort bei.
• Die Tätigkeit wird primär am Hauptstandort Mannheim durchgeführt, beinhaltet jedoch auch Projektarbeit an weiteren Standorten sowie im Rahmen internationaler Projekte. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Du hast ein Studium des Ingenieurwesens mit Fachrichtung Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Biotechnologie oder einen ähnlichen Studiengang erfolgreich abgeschlossen und bringst idealerweise mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position in der Industrie mit.
• Du verfügst über einschlägige Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement sowie in der Projektierung von diagnostischem und pharmazeutischem Equipment, idealerweise im Produktions- oder Verpackungsumfeld.
• Du besitzt tiefgreifendes Wissen in deinem Spezialgebiet (z. B. Abfülltechnik, Verpackungstechnik oder optische Inspektion) und hast Grundwissen in Bereichen wie Automation oder Serialisierung.
• Fundierte Kenntnisse in GMP und in der konzeptionellen Planung zeichnen dich aus.
• Du bist sicher im Umgang mit relevanten DV-Anwendungen und verfügst über ein sehr gutes Ausdrucksvermögen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous faisons avancer la science pour pouvoir passer plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Roche s'est fixé un objectif inspirant d'ici 2030 : fournir à la société des solutions diagnostiques plus médicales et de haute qualité à moindre coût. La gestion des sites de Mannheim et Penzberg fournit l'infrastructure et le cadre à nos quelque 15 000 employés en Allemagne pour pouvoir travailler avec des solutions diagnostiques et médicales qui ajoutent de la valeur aux patients. Nous sommes Avec 170 employés, le RDG est responsable de la planification et de la mise en oeuvre de tous les grands projets d'investissement sur les sites de Mannheim et Penzberg. Grâce à notre travail, nous assurons l'approvisionnement de nos patients en produits innovants. Nous sommes une unité avec des hiérarchies plates et attachons une grande importance à la responsabilité personnelle, une culture d'entreprise ouverte et amusante au travail. Le travail d'équipe, le soutien mutuel et les degrés de liberté dans l'élaboration de projets sont bien sûr une question pour nous. Le groupe Filling & Packaging est responsable de la planification et de la mise en œuvre des projets d'ingénierie des machines et des procédés. Nous soutenons nos partenaires commerciaux avec compétence dans les domaines de la technologie pharmaceutique, des dia et des procédés et nous assurons le respect de toutes les lignes directrices sur les BPF. Responsabilité C'est ce qui vous attend
• Vous prenez en charge la planification responsable, la planification de projet et la réalisation de projets d'ingénierie de machine et de processus dans le domaine du remplissage et emballage en conformité avec toutes les SOP internes ainsi que les exigences légales.
• L'accent est mis sur la gestion et la gestion des projets de petite à moyenne taille dans le milieu pharmaceutique et diagnostique, y compris la planification, le contrôle et le suivi des activités du projet.
• Vous êtes responsable de la gestion externe de l'entreprise : de la spécification des services à la sélection et au contrôle jusqu'à l'acceptation réussie des prestataires de services externes et des entreprises spécialisées.
• Vous agissez en tant que consultant compétent pour les partenaires commerciaux internes en matière de technologie pharmaceutique, de dia et de processus et vous participez activement au sein de la communauté de l'ingénierie pour échanger les meilleures pratiques.
• Vous identifiez les innovations et les nouvelles technologies et contribuez à leur développement et à leur déploiement sur place.
• L'activité est principalement menée au siège de Mannheim, mais comprend également des travaux de projet dans d'autres sites et dans le cadre de projets internationaux. Qualités C'est ce que vous apportez
• Vous avez obtenu avec succès un diplôme en génie avec une spécialisation en génie mécanique, en génie industriel, en biotechnologie ou un programme de diplôme similaire et apportez idéalement plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans un poste comparable dans l'industrie.
• Vous avez des connaissances pertinentes en gestion de projet ainsi que dans la planification de projet d'équipement diagnostique et pharmaceutique, idéalement dans l'environnement de production ou d'emballage.
• Vous avez des connaissances approfondies dans votre spécialité (p. ex. technologie de remplissage, technologie d'emballage ou inspection optique) et des connaissances de base dans des domaines comme l'automatisation ou la sérialisation.
• Une connaissance approfondie des BPF et de la planification conceptuelle vous distingue.
• Vous êtes confiant dans le traitement des applications DV pertinentes et avez une très bonne expressivité.

jobs.title: 实习医药信息顾问
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
岗位名称：实习医药信息顾问

职位职责：
• （1） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （2） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （3） 协助 开展学术会议，协助带教人员向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （4） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

职位要求：
• （1）在校大学生
• （2）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （3）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （5）拥有良好的英语书写能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
TAM 治疗领域经理
Therapeutic Area Manager

治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Finance & Accounting Intern (Supply Chain) based in Sunway Pinnacle , you will support manufacturing and commercial sites by ensuring financial compliance, executing month-end close activities, and delivering standard cost and inventory-related activities. You will play a vital role in our finance operations, collaborating globally to continuously improve processes, systems, and standards across the network.

The Opportunity

• Execute month-end close activities, including the preparation of Manual Journal Entries as requested by the global team.

• Manage standard costing execution, ensuring the timely delivery of results while maintaining strict data quality.

• Investigate relevant accounts (such as inventory, variances, and allowances) and recommend actionable solutions to management.

• Ensure system and procedure compliance with company policies, acceptable accounting practices, and applicable financial regulations.

• Collaborate globally across the Roche network to improve financial operations and standardize processes

Who You Are

• You are currently pursuing a Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline at a Malaysian university or professional body (e.g., ACCA, CPA).

• You possess a solid foundation in finance and accounting principles and are eager to apply them practically.

• You have strong proficiency in computerized applications, especially MS Excel, PowerPoint, and G-Suite (experience with financial databases is a distinct advantage).

• You demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills in English to effectively collaborate with international stakeholders.

• Pinnacle Management InsightsYou are available for a full-time internship and are comfortable working in an agile, structured corporate environment.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. À faire progresser continuellement la science et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Vous êtes une personne efficace pour résoudre les problèmes, passionnée par le milieu de la santé, et vous comprenez l'importance de nos solutions sur l'expérience client et les soins aux patients. Votre passion pour la résolution de problèmes et la satisfaction de la clientèle s'appuie sur vos connaissances techniques pour offrir une expérience client hors pair. Vous fournirez un soutien rapide, précis et constant à nos clients afin de minimiser l'interruption de leur prestation de services de diagnostic.

• Maintenance et soutien technique : Effectuer les maintenances préventives, résoudre les bulletins techniques et appuyer les équipes régionales pour minimiser l'interruption des services de diagnostic.

• Intégration des systèmes IT : Travailler avec les spécialistes locaux (RIS et équipes techniques) pour installer, configurer et soutenir l'infrastructure logicielle et informatique.

• Collaboration et administration : Participer aux réunions (service, ventes, clients) et assurer la gestion administrative quotidienne, incluant la clôture des dossiers après chaque visite de site.

Qui vous êtes

• Formation et expertise technique : Détenir un diplôme d'études collégiales (DEC) en technologie de l'électronique (ou formation connexe) et posséder des connaissances solides en systèmes informatiques et infrastructures réseau.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to drive the strategic architecture and tactical enablement of our Demand-to-Pay processes, unlocking continuous improvement and seamless digital adoption? As our Business Capability Lead for SAP based in Mumbai/Pune , India, you will play a critical role in designing, managing, and governing our system processes. Operating at the intersection of strategic design and tactical execution, you will champion continuous improvement and drive the strategy for our key SAP solution.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to Procurement Operations Lead and is part of the wider Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Works closely with the DOP Leadership Team, DOP Delivery, Category teams, RSS Demand-to-Pay, Global Procurement, and external providers. You will also lead the Business Capability Community formed by SMEs and represent DOP in Agile Release Trains (ARTs).

• Role Type: A senior strategic and tactical individual contributor role focused on global process ownership, governance, and change management.

• Impact: You have a key, measurable impact on departmental efficiency and compliance (e.g., cycle times). Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Process Management: Acting as a deep Subject Matter Expert (SME) for business processes and systems, elaborating design options to resolve system, perfo mance, and data concerns while shaping the overall vision and strategy.

• System Strategy & Projects: Developing and deploying the DOP strategy for assigned solutions SAP and acting as a responsible delegate on global projects (e.g., Aspire), ensuring successful template adoption and managing change impacts.

• Continuous Improvement & Change Management: Proactively identifying and driving automation and digitalization opportunities. Acting as a change agent to escalate improvement areas, driving global requirements alignment, and partnering across functions to implement optimized End-to-End solutions.

• Governance & Analytics: Supporting delegated data and rules definition for global data. Serving as the primary enterprise reporting SME to advise senior leadership on maximizing ERP and SAP S/4HANA analytics to solve complex problems.

• Knowledge Management: Developing and maintaining global system process documentation and comprehensive training materials.

Who you are

We look for a positive, self-reflecting change agent with an entrepreneurial "Can-Do" attitude, a clear focus on End-to-End perspectives, and the ability to work in a self-organized manner.
