jobs.title: Master Data Manager (Pune)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to architect the data foundation that drives digital excellence and unlocks actionable insights for our global procurement operations? As our Master Data Manager based in Pune/Mumbai, India , you will be a core member of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE). In this critical role, you will define, govern, and optimize the data assets that power the digital evolution of DOP.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Procurement Operations Lead and is part of the wider Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Works closely with the colleagues in Analytics and Performance Insights, data consumers, and multifunctional teams globally to ensure data is fit for purpose.

• Role Type: A senior individual contributor role focused on data architecture, governance, and master data management. May involve project-based direct or indirect supervision.

• Impact: You assure quality and trust in our data, establishing the governance framework for the organization. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Data Strategy & Governance: Defining data assets within the DOP domain, creating standard guidelines, and establishing internal policies and data controls to monitor adherence.

• Quality Assurance: Maintaining data quality using customer feedback, developing reporting metrics, evaluating issues, and coordinating regular corrections.

• Continuous Improvement: Optimizing workflows and continuously driving the quality and availability of data in alignment with other business units and functions.

• Alignment & Projects: Supporting organizational and system alignment, data standardization, and Master Data ERP projects.

• Knowledge Management & Training: Developing and executing data trainings, capturing relevant documentation, and ensuring process-specific training content is accessible to DOP communities.

Who you are

We look for a self-directed professional with a sense of urgency who can drive data excellence in a complex, matrixed environment.

• Education: A relevant Bachelor’s degree is required; a Master’s degree is highly desirable.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience leading a data architecture or engineering

jobs.title: Senior Procurement Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to drive operational excellence and lead end-to-end purchasing efficiencies that support our global diagnostic innovations? As our Senior Procurement Specialist in Mumbai/Pune, India , you will be responsible for the execution of critical purchasing support activities. In this role, you will bring functional leadership to the operational and tactical procurement space, owning outcomes, delivering high stakeholder satisfaction, and ensuring seamless purchase-to-pay (P2P) operations.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to Procurement Operations Lead and is part of the wider Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Works closely with business partners and internal stakeholders in DOP across a multicultural, virtual setting, while guiding and mentoring junior Procurement Specialists.

• Role Type: A tactical position focused on executing critical operational activities, mitigating issues, and driving process optimization.

• Impact: You ensure stakeholder expectations are satisfied by efficiently supporting the end-to-end procurement process. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Operational Execution: Leading the operational and tactical activities for the effective and timely procurement of products and services in a compliant manner.

• Data & System Management: Maintaining material master data and supplier master data, executing workflows effectively, and ensuring accurate documentation within SAP.

• Mentorship & Issue Resolution: Guiding junior procurement specialists and business partners to mitigate procurement issues and achieve agreed business goals.

• Policy & Compliance: Executing activities in line with a responsible Procurement approach, utilizing tools, policy settings, and enforcement aligned with DOP business processes.

• Performance Metrics: Owning the achievement of established customer service metrics and performance targets.

• Continuous Improvement: Identifying new opportunities and supporting the optimization of processes to increase overall quality and efficiency standards.

• Internal Consulting: Working closely with the broader organization to act as a consultant on operational procurement and related system topics.

Who you are

We look for self-driven professionals with a continuous improvement mindset who can navigate complex enterprise systems and foster collaborative networks.

• Education: A relevant university business degree is required; SAP MM certifications are good to have.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in operational/tactical Procurement processes. Experience working in a multicultural, virtual setting is required, and prior experience with planning and buying activities is required. Direct procurement experience is highly desirable.

• Leadership: Demonstrated ability or potential to lead, even informally, small to mid-size teams. Prior

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à exécuter des activités d'achat critiques et à offrir l'excellence opérationnelle qui soutient nos innovations diagnostiques mondiales? En tant que notre spécialiste des achats à Pune/Mumbai, en Inde, vous serez responsable de l'exécution des activités de soutien à l'achat. Dans ce rôle, vous naviguerez dans les outils d'entreprise et le processus d'achat à paiement pour atteindre les objectifs d'entreprise et de projet d'une manière entièrement conforme.
• Ligne hiérarchique : Le poste relève directement du responsable des opérations d'approvisionnement et fait partie du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement (CdE).
• Élargir l'équipe et les intervenants : Collabore étroitement avec les partenaires commerciaux et les intervenants internes du DOP dans un contexte multiculturel et virtuel.
• Type de rôle : Un rôle opérationnel axé sur l'exécution des activités d'achat de bout en bout et l'appui à l'amélioration continue.
• Impact : En appuyant efficacement le processus d'approvisionnement et en offrant des niveaux élevés de service à la clientèle interne, vous assurez que les attentes des intervenants sont satisfaites. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Exécution opérationnelle : Appuyer l'acquisition efficace de produits et de services essentiels en temps opportun et de manière efficiente.
• Données et documentation : tenir à jour les données de base pour les matériaux et les fournisseurs, exécuter les flux de travail et s'assurer que toute la documentation pertinente (p. ex., la diligence raisonnable des fournisseurs, les listes de prix) est complète et disponible dans le SAP ou les systèmes respectifs.
• Résolution des problèmes : Travailler avec les membres de l'équipe et les partenaires commerciaux pour atténuer les problèmes d'approvisionnement ou d'affaires et aider à atteindre les objectifs commerciaux convenus.
• Politique et conformité : Exécuter des activités d'approvisionnement opérationnel conformément à une approche responsable en matière d'approvisionnement, en utilisant des outils, des processus et des cadres stratégiques alignés sur les processus opérationnels du DOP.
• Mesure du rendement : Contribuer à la prestation des cibles et des mesures établies en matière de service à la clientèle, suivre et surveiller ces mesures au besoin et accroître les problèmes au fur et à mesure qu'ils se posent.
• Amélioration continue : Soutenir l'optimisation des processus pour augmenter constamment les normes de qualité et d'efficacité. Qui vous êtes Nous recherchons des professionnels autonomes avec un état d'esprit d'amélioration continue qui peuvent développer des idées innovantes et favoriser des réseaux collaboratifs.
• Éducation : Un diplôme universitaire en affaires est requis.
• Expérience : de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience dans les processus d'approvisionnement opérationnel et tactique. Une expérience de travail dans un cadre multiculturel et virtuel est nécessaire. L'expérience en matière d'approvisionnement direct est hautement souhaitable.
• Expertise en systèmes : Expérience solide de navigation des systèmes d'entreprise SAP et des outils d'acquisition à paiement.
• Connaissances de l'industrie : L'expérience de l'industrie des sciences de la vie est hautement souhaitable.
• AI & Digitalisation: Vous avez une forte affinité pour explorer les solutions basées sur l'IA en général, en particulier en ce qui concerne la transformation numérique des opérations (Digital 2.0 / Indus

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to optimize the supply networks that make life-saving diagnostics possible? As our Sourcing Manager in Mumbai/Pune, India, you will be a vital part of our APAC sourcing operations. In this high-impact role, you will execute end-to-end, medium- to high-complexity sourcing projects while acting as a key mechanism for the Asia Sourcing Office - identifying regional suppliers, performing initial due diligence, and translating transactional requests into strategic, value-add solutions.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Sourcing Lead APAC and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Partners with DOP Category, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, regional operations stakeholders, and external suppliers to resolve administrative bottlenecks and inform future strategies.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on end-to-end sourcing execution, master data management, and value creation.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing excellence, financial value, and compliance across the APAC footprint. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Asia Supplier Discovery: Identifying potential suppliers across Asia, executing initial due diligence, and conducting targeted regional benchmarking.

• Sourcing Execution: Compliantly executing regional sourcing projects, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and eSourcing tools for on-market products and New Product Introductions (NPI).

• Demand Aggregation: Analyzing site user requirements, aggregating regional demand to maximize leverage, and escalating non-standard requests to Category Management.

• Project & Risk Management: Developing comprehensive project plans (timelines, milestones, resources) and proactively identifying and mitigating risks to objectives.

• Contract Lifecycle: Setting up template-based contracts (such as CDAs and SOWs) and accurately managing their lifecycle repository, renewals, and potential contractual improvements.

• Operational Excellence: Utilizing enterprise tools (SAP, myBuy) and master data management to simplify workflows and ensure strict compliance with global procurement policies.

• Metrics & CSR: Tracking operational targets and customer service metrics (such as cycle times and compliance) while championing supplier diversity, sustainability, and ethical practices.

• Collaboration & Exposure: Partnering with support functions (like Accounts Payable) to clear administrative bottlenecks and presenting regular KPI and project updates to the Sourcing Lead and regional stakeholders.

Who you are

We strive to keep our standards high and look for analytical problem-solvers with a strong customer-service focus.

• Education: University degree (Business/Life Sciences preferred) is required; an MBA or CIPS certification is highly desirable.

• Experience: 3–5+ years in procurement or sourcing, specializing

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à optimiser les réseaux d'approvisionnement qui rendent le diagnostic de sauvetage possible? En tant que notre gestionnaire d'approvisionnement à Mumbai/Pune, en Inde, vous serez un élément essentiel de nos opérations d'approvisionnement APAC. Dans ce rôle à impact élevé, vous exécuterez des projets d'approvisionnement de bout en bout, de moyenne à haute complexité tout en agissant comme un mécanisme clé pour le Asia Sourcing Office - identifier les fournisseurs régionaux, effectuer une diligence raisonnable initiale, et traduire les demandes transactionnelles en solutions stratégiques et à valeur ajoutée.
• Ligne hiérarchique : relève directement du responsable de l'approvisionnement APAC et fait partie du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement (CdE).
• Équipe élargie et intervenants : Partenaires de la catégorie DOP, de la livraison DOP, de la demande de paiement RSS, des intervenants régionaux et des fournisseurs externes pour résoudre les goulets d'étranglement administratifs et éclairer les stratégies futures.
• Type de rôle : Un rôle de contributeur individuel axé sur l'exécution de l'approvisionnement de bout en bout, la gestion des données et la création de valeur.
• Impact : Vous dirigez l'excellence de l'approvisionnement à l'échelle mondiale, la valeur financière et la conformité à l'échelle de l'APAC. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Découverte des fournisseurs en Asie : Identifier les fournisseurs potentiels dans toute l'Asie, exécuter la diligence raisonnable initiale et effectuer des comparaisons régionales ciblées.
• Exécution de l'approvisionnement : Exécution des projets d'approvisionnement régionaux, des processus standard (RfI, RfQ, RfPs) et des outils eSourcing pour les produits sur le marché et les nouvelles introductions de produits (NPI).
• Agrégation de la demande : Analyse des besoins des utilisateurs du site, regroupement de la demande régionale pour maximiser l'effet de levier et augmentation des demandes non standard à la gestion de catégorie.
• Gestion des projets et des risques : Élaborer des plans de projets détaillés (échéanciers, jalons, ressources) et déterminer de façon proactive et atténuer les risques pour les objectifs.
• Cycle de vie des contrats : Établissement de contrats fondés sur des modèles (tels que les CDA et les SOW) et gestion précise de leur dépôt, renouvellements et améliorations contractuelles potentielles.
• Excellence opérationnelle : Utiliser les outils d'entreprise (SAP, myBuy) et la gestion des données de base pour simplifier les flux de travail et assurer le strict respect des politiques mondiales d'approvisionnement.
• Mesures et RSE : Suivi des cibles opérationnelles et des mesures du service à la clientèle (telles que les cycles et la conformité) tout en défendant la diversité des fournisseurs, la durabilité et les pratiques éthiques.
• Collaboration et exposition : Partenariat avec les fonctions de soutien (comme les comptes à payer) pour éliminer les goulets d'étranglement administratifs et présenter régulièrement des mises à jour de l'ICP et du projet au responsable de l'approvisionnement et aux intervenants régionaux. Qui vous êtes Nous nous efforçons de maintenir nos normes élevées et de rechercher des solutions analytiques aux problèmes avec une forte orientation client-service.
• Études : Un diplôme universitaire (de préférence en sciences des affaires et de la vie) est requis; une certification MBA ou CIPS est hautement souhaitable.
• Expérience: 3-5 ans et plus en achats ou en approvisionnement, spécialisation

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.

Are you ready to orchestrate the supply networks that make life-saving diagnostics possible? You will lead end-to-end sourcing projects, mentor a rising team of Sourcing Managers, and serve as a key advisor to executive leadership. If you thrive on complexity and want to feel a direct impact on the delivery of life-saving diagnostics to patients worldwide, this is where you belong.

• Sourcing & Analysis: Executing global sourcing activities, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and NPI benchmarking in close collaboration with Category and NPI managers.

• Contract & Document Management: Setting up and reviewing high-complexity contracts (e.g., MSAs) and purchasing documentation, while accurately managing their lifecycle repository and renewals.

• Operational Excellence & SME Leadership: Acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to simplify workflows, analyze site user requirements for best-value methods, and ensure strict compliance with global policies.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à orchestrer les réseaux d'approvisionnement qui rendent possible des diagnostics vitaux? En tant que Senior Sourcing Manager à Pune/Mumbai, en Inde, vous serez un élément clé de nos opérations d'approvisionnement APAC. Vous dirigerez des projets d'approvisionnement de bout en bout, mentorerez une équipe montante de gestionnaires d'approvisionnement et servirez de conseiller clé au leadership de la direction. Si vous développez sur la complexité et voulez sentir un impact direct sur la livraison de diagnostics de sauvetage aux patients dans le monde entier, c'est là que vous appartenez.

• Type de rôle : Un cotisant individuel ayant des responsabilités de mentorer les membres de l'équipe junior.
• Impact : Vous dirigez l'excellence de l'approvisionnement à l'échelle mondiale, la valeur financière et la conformité à l'échelle de l'APAC. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Performances et économies : Les mesures clés – y compris les économies de VCP, la part de fournisseur préférée et les temps de cycle raccourcis – doivent permettre d'obtenir une valeur de base tout en assurant le suivi de la satisfaction des intervenants.
• Sourcing & Analysis: Exécuter des activités d'approvisionnement à l'échelle mondiale, des processus standard (RfI, RfQ, RfP) et des analyses comparatives NPI en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de catégorie et NPI.
• Gestion des contrats et des documents : Établissement et examen des contrats à haute complexité (p. ex., ESM) et de la documentation d'achat, tout en gérant avec précision leur dépôt et leur renouvellement du cycle de vie.
• Excellence opérationnelle et leadership des PME : agir à titre d'expert en la matière (EMS) pour simplifier les flux de travail, analyser les exigences des utilisateurs du site pour les méthodes les plus avantageuses et assurer le strict respect des politiques mondiales.
• Résolution des goulets d'étranglement & RSE: partenariat avec des fonctions de soutien comme Comptes à payer (AP) pour éliminer les goulets d'étranglement administratifs liés aux fournisseurs, tout en défendant les initiatives RSE de base de l'offre (diversité, durabilité, pratiques éthiques).
• Conflits et exposition : gérer les conflits à fort débit concernant les priorités concurrentes du projet ou la sélection des fournisseurs, et fournir des mises à jour mensuelles et trimestrielles à haute fréquence au CdE LT et au DPLT. The Position
Who We Are
At Roche, we deliver life-saving medicines to patients worldwide. Behind every breakthrough is a highly trained team of IT professionals ensuring our technical infrastructure runs safely and flawlessly. In a regulatory environment, adequate training isn't just a corporate objective—it is a critical necessity to ensure patient safety and product quality .
We are seeking an expert TechOps Training Management Lead to join us as a Delivery Management Professional (SE7) . In this highly visible role, you will navigate organizational complexity to shape, optimize, and manage the end-to-end training ecosystem for all IT associates supporting Pharma Technical Operations . Your work will ensure our global workforce remains highly compliant and fully prepared for Health Authority inspections .

The Role: What You Will Do

• Training Capability Delivery: Lead the strategic delivery, implementation, and tracking of training frameworks designed specifically for IT associates supporting TechOps .

• GxP Compliance & Inspection Readiness: Oversee the comprehensive assignment, tracking, and reporting of personnel training . You will ensure that robust, audit-ready evidence is seamlessly provided to Health Authorities inspectors .

• Content & Scope Leadership: Develop, implement, and champion scope management strategies and best practices for large-scale training initiatives, managing changes with minimal disruption .

• Strategic Problem Solving: Lead the analysis of complex, cross-boundary delivery problems, define strategic solution options, and drive consensus across global teams .

• Stakeholder Engagement: Act as a trusted partner to senior management and diverse stakeholder networks . You will develop communication plans, influence delivery decisions, and masterfully navigate conflicts to achieve alignment .

• Agile Coaching & Mentorship: Embed Agile best practices, foster a culture of continuous innovation, and mentor less experienced professionals to support team growth .

What You Will Bring to the Team
Experience & Archetype

• Proven Track Record: Extensive experience operating within a Delivery Management archetype (e.g., Program Manager, Service Delivery Manager, Agile Coach, Project Manager, or Scrum Master) managing large-scale, complex programs .

• Change Leadership: Demonstrated success embedding Agile methodologies and leading impactful organizational change initiatives across product lines or domains .

Technical & Compliance Expertise

• Critical GxP Knowledge: Deep, foundational knowledge of operating within a GxP-regulated environment is absolutely critical . You must understand compliance training requirements from initial assignment to tracking and reporting .

• Framework Implementation: Mastery in implementing various delivery frameworks, innovating methodologies, and driving continuous business process improvements .

Leadership & Professional Strengths

• Communication Mastery: Exceptional communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills, with an innate ability to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes .

• Analytical Polish: Advanced analytical skills to evaluate strategic solution options and shape delivery roadmaps based on modern market trends .

• Mentorship Mindset: A strong passion for coaching, providing constructive feedback, and guiding others through complex problem-solving .

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
At Roche, we deliver life-changing medicines to patients worldwide. Behind this mission is a highly interconnected digital ecosystem that keeps our production, manufacturing, and supply chain moving seamlessly.
We are seeking a visionary TechOps Risk & Business Continuity Management (BCM) Specialist to join us as a Senior Principal Business Analyst . In this high-impact, enterprise-level role, you will not just analyze processes—you will shape the resilience strategy for our Technical Operations applications and ecosystem . If you are a recognized thought leader who thrives on navigating extreme complexity and driving strategic, long-term organizational change, your next chapter starts here .

The Role: What You Will Do

• Strategic Content Leadership: Shape and steer cross-organizational outcomes at the highest strategic levels . You will focus heavily on managing the end-to-end business continuity lifecycle and risk management frameworks for our critical TechOps applications .

• Resilience & Problem Solving: Hold ultimate responsibility for the success of critical, highly uncertain initiatives . You will apply advanced systems thinking to analyze complex business challenges, advocate for innovative solutions, and guide enterprise-wide change adaptation .

• Methodology Innovation: Develop entirely new, groundbreaking business analysis frameworks and methodologies, while mentoring senior practitioners to elevate our global business analysis practice .

• Executive Stakeholder Management: Engage directly with executive leaders, strategy heads, and governance bodies . You will navigate politically sensitive landscapes as a master negotiator, securing alignment on transformative initiatives and long-range planning .

• Future-State Roadmapping: Anticipate disruptive industry trends and emerging business needs to design long-term solution roadmaps and lead massive corporate reengineering efforts .

What You Will Bring to the Team
Experience & Education

• 10+ years of Business Analysis or Consultancy experience .

• 7+ years of dedicated experience within the life sciences / pharmaceutical sector or supporting relevant manufacturing and technical operations functions .

• A proven track record of owning and successfully delivering large-scale, high-uncertainty organizational initiatives .

Technical & Domain Expertise

• Core BCM & Risk Expertise: Practical, hands-on experience covering the end-to-end lifecycle of application business continuity management and IT risk management .

• Regulatory Compliance: Deep compliance skills, specifically with extensive experience operating within a strict GxP environment .

• Systems Thinking Mastery: Exceptional ability to map interconnected architectures, look at the big picture, and provide holistic consulting advice .

Leadership & Soft Skills

• Exceptional negotiation, facilitation, and executive-level stakeholder management skills .

• Natural mentorship capability with a history of evolving the business analysis discipline .

• An established professional reputation for strategic agility and thought leadership .

Why Join Roche TechOps?
You will step into an environment where your expertise has a direct, lasting impact on global patient health . We give you the platform to challenge the status quo, transform existing methodologies, and define the future-state of pharma manufacturing resilience .
Apply today to build a more resilient future with Roche!

#RDT2026

Who we are
A healthier future drives

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Typically studying in a field related to the assigned function. May be assigned a variety of tasks relevant to the assigned function and/or special projects for the assigned function. The objective of assignments is for the intern to practically apply academic or vocational studies/learning in a Roche setting, as well as learn more about the Roche organisation, as future employment with Roche may be a possibility subject to job availability, candidate qualification and past performance. Assignments vary but are typically to support the activities of regular employees, such as entry-level research and reporting, analyses and modelling, preparing materials for others, coordinating small events or meetings, improving basic departmental operations such as filing or archiving systems, departmental libraries, etc. Length of internship will vary according to business needs and legal requirements in the market where the internship is occurring.

Academic requirement

• Undergraduate students from reputable universities in relevant fields of study (Prefer business, law or finance related major).

Key Competencies required

• Good command of spoken and written English and Chinese

• Proactive at work and able to manage multiple tasks efficiently

• Strong analytical skills and great attention to details

• Able to challenge the status quo with skepticism and is passionate about process validation/ improvement

• Possess strong communication skills and a good record of extra-curricular activities.

• Good interpersonal skills, able to work in a team effectively, deliver on commitment.

Key Responsibilities

• Responsible for assessing compliance of employee reimbursement activities as well as associated healthcare compliance reviews in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Clearly documents all compliance assessment (i.e assessment results) activities in concur

• during claim processing

• Performs other relevant support activities as and when required (e.g. support in validating/ performing data analysis/testing which contributes to the reporting to affiliates/ Compliance Projects )

• Escalates issues to superior/RSS Line Manager (where required)

• Engages in networking with colleagues from other business functions when required to

• Supports the team in performing operational activities and involved in identifying/ implementing improvement opportunities within the current operational process

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Accountant - Polish speaking (Fixed-term)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Please note this is a fixed-term role for 2 years.

The Opportunity:
As an Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English and Polish

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Sarete responsabili della prenotazione di fatture complesse in conformità con Roche e gli standard locali in modo che il fornitore riceve i fondi in tempo per le merci fornite e i servizi resi. Avrete la possibilità di avere piena responsabilità per il processo AP end-to-end e la gestione di domande interne e di fornitori ricevute per telefono o per posta in lingua locale.

• Responsabilità end-to-end, capacità di problem solving, crescita e mentalità agile in situazioni ambigue
• accettazione multiculturale, capacità di lavorare in un ambiente veloce e mutevole

• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.

Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Bitte beachten Sie, dass dies eine befristete Rolle für 2 Jahre ist. Die Gelegenheit: Als Accounts Payable Accountant sind Sie für hochwertige Dienstleistungen für Roche Lieferanten und interne Partner verantwortlich. Sie sind für die Buchung komplexer Rechnungen nach Roche und lokalen Standards verantwortlich, so dass der Lieferant das Geld rechtzeitig für die gelieferten Waren und die erbrachten Dienstleistungen erhält. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, die volle Verantwortung für den End-to-End-AP-Prozess zu übernehmen und sowohl interne als auch Lieferantenanfragen per Telefon oder Post in lokaler Sprache zu bearbeiten.
• Verarbeitung und Validierung von PO-basierten und direkten Rechnungen und Zahlungsanfragen, Verwaltung und Ausführung von Zahlungen
• Verwalten von Vendor Accounts
• Audit, Report und Support AP Rechnungsauflösung
• Interne Rechnungsanfragen des Affiliates bearbeiten
• Handeln Sie als Ansprechpartner und fördern Sie starke Kooperationsbeziehungen zwischen den Finanzteams des Affiliates und allen anderen internen SSC-Teams
• Teilnahme an Prozessverbesserungen und laufenden Projekten, Möglichkeit, am Wissenstransfer teilzunehmen Wer du bist:
• Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen oder einschlägige Berufserfahrung
• Allgemeines Verständnis von Finanzprozessen und Standards. Breite Erfahrung in Zahlungsprozessen (oder verwandten Bereichen) und der Verwendung von SAP ist von Vorteil
• Starke Kommunikations- und Beratungsfähigkeiten und Sie sind in der Lage, mit komplexen Themen umzugehen
• Customer Centricity durch Ihre täglichen Interaktionen
• End-to-End-Rechenschaftspflicht, Problemlösungskompetenzen, Wachstum und agile Denkweise in mehrdeutigen Situationen
• Multikulturelle Akzeptanz, Fähigkeit, in einer schnelllebigen und sich verändernden Umgebung zu arbeiten
• Kenntnisse in Englisch und Polnisch Im Gegenzug bieten wir Ihnen:
• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Roche ist reich an Lernressourcen. Wir bieten ständige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, kostenlose Sprachkurse & Trainings, die Möglichkeit internationaler Einsätze, interne Positionswechsel und die Möglichkeit, die eigene Karriere zu gestalten.
• Ausgezeichnete Vorteile: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Cafeteria-Paket, Jahresbonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, Coaching / Mentoring-Möglichkeit, Buddy-Programm, Teamgebäude, Feiertagsparty.
• Flexibilität: Wir unterstützen auch Flexibilität, um Ihnen zu helfen, Ihr Gleichgewicht zu finden. Home Office ist allgemein verfügbar (in der Regel 2 Bürotage / Woche im Durchschnitt). Wir schaffen die Möglichkeit zur Arbeitsfreiheit, in der Ihr Firmen- und Privatleben in Harmonie koexistieren.
• Eine globale inklusive Gemeinschaft, in der wir voneinander lernen. Bei Roche kooperieren, diskutieren, treffen Entscheidungen, feiern Erfolge und haben Spaß als Team. Unsere Führung ist sehr auf Menschen ausgerichtet und schafft eine starke, integrative Kultur, so dass Sie immer die Möglichkeit haben, Ihre Meinung zu teilen. Bitte lesen Sie die Datenschutzerklärung für weitere Informationen darüber, wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten im Zusammenhang mit dem Einstellungsprozess umgehen. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. titleByLocale.en: Internship in Quality Assurance – QA Compliance, Systems and Training (Basel, 8-12 months, 100%)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Am Standort Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing der F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG bekommst du einen einzigartigen Einblick in die Produktion von chemischen und biologischen aktiven pharmazeutischen Wirkstoffen für die kommerzielle und klinische Versorgung.

Der Standort Basel Drug Substance ist ein wichtiger Teil der Versorgung von Patient:innen weltweit. Er besteht aus zwei Haupt-Produktionseinheiten (sogenannten Manufacturing Units): der MU MAB und der MU SUT/ADC. Zusammen mit fünf unterstützenden Einheiten (Units) fokussieren sich rund 600 Mitarbeitende darauf, Patient:innen mit lebenswichtigen Medikamenten zu versorgen. Die Produktionseinheiten werden von der Qualitätssicherung (QA) sowie den weiteren Units umfassend unterstützt.

Innerhalb der Qualitätssicherung spielt das Chapter Compliance, Systems & Training eine zentrale Rolle. Es besteht aus drei Teams, deren gemeinsames Ziel es ist, die Einhaltung höchster Standards in den Bereichen Compliance, Systemmanagement und Schulung am gesamten Standort zu gewährleisten.

Für das QA Systems Team und das QA Training Team suchen wir für beide Teams ab sofort motivierte Praktikant:innen. Wir bieten euch spannende und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem dynamischen Produktionsumfeld.

Die Möglichkeit

Während deines Praktikums übernimmst du vielfältige und praxisnahe Tätigkeiten, unter anderem:

• Mitarbeit in den Team-internen Fachbereichen wie z. B. Event Management (Deviation Management), Records Management, Change Management oder Quality Risk Management – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den jeweiligen Fachbereichs Teams

• Abstimmung und Zusammenarbeit mit den anderen Chapter-internen Praktikant:innen, um sich gegenseitig zu unterstützen und gemeinsam teamübergreifende Aufgaben zu bearbeiten

• Planung und Durchführung eigener kleiner Projekte im Bereich Systems und / oder Training

• Erstellung und Überarbeitung von Standardarbeitsanweisungen (SOPs)

• Archivierung und Verwaltung von qualitätsrelevanten Dokumenten

• Kommunikation und enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen

• Unterstützung bei der Organisation und Durchführung von Schulungen

• Mitwirkung bei der Vorbereitung, Begleitung und Nachbereitung von Behördeninspektionen und Audits

Wer du bist

• Du absolvierst gerade dein Masterstudium im naturwissenschaftlichen oder technischen Bereich oder hast es vor maximal 12 Monaten vor dem Startdatum erfolgreich abgeschlossen (z. B. in Pharmazie, Biotechnologie, Chemie, Molekularbiologie oder Pädagogik).

• Du kommunizierst absolut sicher und fließend in Wort und Schrift – sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch.

• Hohe Lernbereitschaft, Eigeninitiative und proaktive Haltung.

• Sehr gute Arbeitsplanung und Priorisierung – Überblick über vielfältige Aufgaben behalten.

• Strukturierte und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise nach Vorgaben ​

• Du bist flexibel, offen und hast echte Freude an der engen und dynamischen Zusammenarbeit mit anderen.

• Der Umgang mit MS Office und den gängigen Google-Anwendungen geht dir leicht von der Hand.

Zusätzliche Informationen

• Wir bieten dir Einblick in ein internationales Pharmaumfeld und die Herstellung von Wirkstoffen, eigenverantwortliche Aufgaben im Bereich QA Systems mit direkter Praxisrelevanz. Zudem erhältst du Mitarbeit in einem engagierten, interdisziplinären Team, das Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitige Unterstützung lebt, sowie vielfältige Einblicke in die unterschiedlichen Fachbereiche des Teams, wodurch du die Qualitätssysteme und Prozesse umfassend kennenlernst

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Presso il sito di Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing di F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, avrai una visione unica della produzione di ingredienti farmaceutici attivi chimici e biologici per la cura commerciale e clinica. Il sito di Basel Drug Substance è una parte importante della cura dei pazienti in tutto il mondo. Si compone di due unità di produzione principali: la MU MAB e la MU SUT/ADC. Insieme a cinque unità di supporto, circa 600 dipendenti si concentrano sulla fornitura di pazienti con farmaci vitali. Le unità di produzione sono ampiamente supportate dalla garanzia della qualità (QA) e dalle altre unità. Nell'ambito della garanzia della qualità, il capitolo Compliance, Systems & Training svolge un ruolo centrale. Si compone di tre squadre il cui obiettivo comune è quello di garantire i più elevati standard di conformità, gestione dei sistemi e formazione in tutto il sito. Per il QA Systems Team e il QA Training Team, siamo alla ricerca di stagisti motivati per entrambe le squadre da ora in poi. Vi offriamo attività emozionanti e varie in un ambiente di produzione dinamico. La possibilità Durante il vostro tirocinio, avrete una varietà di attività pratiche, tra cui:
• Collaborazione nei dipartimenti di team interni come Event Management (Deviation Management), Gestione record, Gestione dei cambiamenti o Gestione dei rischi di qualità – in stretta collaborazione con i rispettivi dipartimenti di team
• Coordinamento e cooperazione con gli altri tirocinanti del capitolo interno: sostenere l'un l'altro e lavorare insieme sui compiti del team
• Pianificazione e realizzazione di propri piccoli progetti nel settore dei sistemi e/o della formazione
• Preparazione e revisione delle procedure operative standard (SOP)
• Archiviazione e gestione di documenti rilevanti per la qualità
• Comunicazione e stretta collaborazione con le interfacce interne
• Sostegno all'organizzazione e all'attuazione della formazione
• Partecipazione alla preparazione, al monitoraggio e al follow-up delle ispezioni e degli audit ufficiali Chi sei
• Attualmente stai completando il tuo master in scienza o tecnologia o hai completato con successo un massimo di 12 mesi prima della data di inizio (ad esempio in farmacia, biotecnologia, chimica, biologia molecolare o pedagogia).
• Si comunica assolutamente in modo sicuro e fluente nella parola e nella scrittura – sia in tedesco che in inglese.
• Elevata disponibilità a imparare, iniziativa e attitudine proattiva.
• Pianificazione e priorità di lavoro molto buone – mantenere una panoramica di una vasta gamma di compiti.
• Metodo di lavoro strutturato e di qualità consapevole secondo le specifiche
• Sei flessibile, aperto e divertiti a lavorare da vicino e dinamicamente con gli altri.
• Fare affari con MS Office e le applicazioni comuni di Google è facile per voi. Ulteriori informazioni
• Vi offriamo informazioni su un ambiente farmaceutico internazionale e la produzione di principi attivi, attività auto-responsabili nel campo dei sistemi QA con rilevanza pratica diretta. Inoltre, sarete parte di un team interdisciplinare dedicato che lavora insieme e si supporta l'un l'altro, così come una vasta gamma di approfondimenti nei diversi dipartimenti del team, consentendo di conoscere i sistemi di qualità e processi in modo completo.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At the Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing site of F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, you will get a unique insight into the production of chemical and biological active pharmaceutical ingredients for commercial and clinical care. The Basel Drug Substance site is an important part of the care of patients worldwide. It consists of two main production units: the MU MAB and the MU SUT/ADC. Together with five support units, around 600 employees focus on providing patients with vital medicines. The production units are comprehensively supported by quality assurance (QA) and the other units. Within quality assurance, the chapter Compliance, Systems & Training plays a central role. It consists of three teams whose common goal is to ensure the highest standards of compliance, systems management and training throughout the site. For the QA Systems Team and the QA Training Team, we are looking for motivated interns for both teams from now on. We offer you exciting and varied tasks in a dynamic production environment. The possibility During your internship, you will take on a variety of practical activities, including:
• Collaboration in the internal team departments such as Event Management (Deviation Management), Records Management, Change Management or Quality Risk Management – in close cooperation with the respective team departments
• Coordination and cooperation with the other internal chapter trainees: to support each other and work together on cross-team tasks
• Planning and implementation of own small projects in the area of systems and / or training
• Preparation and revision of standard operating procedures (SOPs)
• Archiving and management of quality-relevant documents
• Communication and close cooperation with internal interfaces
• Support for the organisation and implementation of training
• Participation in the preparation, monitoring and follow-up of official inspections and audits Who you are
• You are currently completing your master’s degree in science or technology or have successfully completed it a maximum of 12 months before the start date (e.g. in pharmacy, biotechnology, chemistry, molecular biology or pedagogy).
• You communicate absolutely safely and fluently in word and writing – both in German and English.
• High willingness to learn, initiative and proactive attitude.
• Very good work planning and prioritization – keep an overview of a wide range of tasks.
• Structured and quality-conscious working method according to specifications
• You are flexible, open and enjoy working closely and dynamically with others.
• Dealing with MS Office and the common Google applications is easy for you. Additional information
• We offer you insight into an international pharmaceutical environment and the production of active ingredients, self-responsible tasks in the field of QA systems with direct practical relevance. In addition, you will be part of a dedicated, interdisciplinary team that works together and supports each other, as well as a wide range of insights into the different departments of the team, enabling you to get to know the quality systems and processes comprehensively.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Infrastructure Engineer - Digital Presence Platform Reliability Engineer (d/f/m)
Introduction Digital Presence Platform & Solutions (DPPS) is a part of Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and provides the foundational capabilities for Roche’s global internet ecosystem - encompassing web content publication, social media integration, external content repositories and web domains management . While the development and operations of individual, use case specific solutions remains decentralized, DPPS team provides a common layer that is being leveraged by business facing IT teams, in order to drive consistency and avoid duplication . As a Digital Presence Platform Reliability Engineer, you will lead the evolution of our Platform Toolchain . You will be responsible for engineering tools supporting maintenance of our platforms as well as applications hosted upon them . Ensuring they are robust, scalable, and secure . Your mission is to deliver a world-class Developer Experience and platform stability through advanced automation, AI, deep observability and baked-in compliance .
The Opportunity:

• Lead Toolchain Evolution: Autonomously lead the evolution of the Digital Presence Platforms toolchain by applying state-of-the-art practices and defining the roadmap and implementation strategy .

• Drive DevSecOps Principles: Abstract complexity across domains by applying DevSecOps principles and providing robust self-service tools for platform and application teams .

• Architect Reliability Solutions: Lead the end-to-end design, build, and implementation of reliability, observability, self-service, and advanced automation solutions .

• Partner for Velocity: Partner closely with platform and application teams to optimize service reliability and accelerate application development velocity .

• Deploy AI-Powered Operations: Design and implement robust monitoring and AIOps solutions to proactively detect anomalies, predict capacity constraints, and enable self-healing capabilities .

• Manage Key Initiatives: Lead small-to-medium technical teams on key initiatives, solving complex, interdisciplinary problems across the whole Digital Presence Platforms area .

• Ensure Framework Compliance: Align all technical designs and solutions with internal Quality, Security, and Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) policies .

• Coordinate Global Dependencies: Manage complex issues and variable factors across different organizational boundaries while coordinating multiple teams and moving parts .

Who you are:

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
​Der Produktionsstandort Kaiseraugst ist ein Eckpfeiler im weltweiten Produktions- und Logistiknetzwerk von Roche. Ca. 2000 Personen sind hier beschäftigt und der Standort beherbergt den weltweit grössten und innovativsten Verpackungsbetrieb von Roche.

Als PraktikantIn innerhalb der Training Academy für die Manufacturing Unit Assembly & Packaging bist Du am Puls des Geschehens: Du unterstützt uns dabei, neue Mitarbeitende optimal auf ihre Aufgaben vorzubereiten, Trainings weiterzuentwickeln und die hohen Qualitätsstandards zu sichern.

Die Möglichkeit
In diesem Praktikum bist Du nicht nur administrative Unterstützung, sondern ein aktiver Teil des gesamten Programms.

Deine Aufgabenschwerpunkte:

• Du bist die treibende Kraft bei der Organisation, Koordination und Weiterentwicklung unseres produktionsspezifischen Onboarding-Programms. Du sorgst dafür, dass neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen einen reibungslosen und motivierenden Start hinlegen.

• Du begleitest die Teilnehmenden durch ihre ersten Tage, bist Ansprechperson für Fragen und baust die Brücke zwischen der Academy und der Produktion.

• Du unterstützt uns aktiv bei der Konzeption und dem Design von modernen Trainings Modulen und erstellst zielgruppengerechte, anschauliche Trainingsmaterialien.

• Du übernimmst das eigenständige Handling von administrativen Prozessen (z. B. smarte Kalenderverwaltung, Ressourcenplanung und Materialbeschaffung für Schulungszwecke) und stimmst Dich dazu eng mit den verschiedenen Produktionslinien ab.

Wer Du Bist
Du bist immatrikuliert oder hast Dein Studium an einer Universität oder Fachhochschule, vorzugsweise im Bereich Erwachsenenbildung, Pharmazie, Medien- /Kommunikationswissenschaften oder Wirtschaft, innerhalb der letzten 12 Monate abgeschlossen und hast Interesse, Deine Kenntnisse im Rahmen eines 12-monatigen Praktikums bei einem Arbeitspensum von mindestens 80% in einer modernen Arbeitsumgebung einzusetzen, sowie die pharmazeutische Industrie kennenzulernen.

Überdies rundest Du Dein Profil mit folgenden Kompetenzen ab:

• Schnelle Auffassungsgabe

• Ein hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative sowie selbstständiger, genauer und nachvollziehbarer Arbeitsweise

• Kreativität, Ideenreichtum und Innovation

• Hohe Teamfähigkeit und Lösungsorientierung sowie kollaborative Arbeitsweise

• Eine teamorientierte Denkweise mit Blick auf stete Verbesserung der Prozesse

• Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen

Zusätzliche Information

• Der bevorzugte Start des Praktikums ist ab September 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung.

• Bitte gib Dein präferiertes Startdatum, das Pensum und die gewünschte Praktikumsdauer in Deiner Bewerbung an.

• Nicht-EU / EFTA-Bürger müssen eine Bestätigung der Universität, dass ein Pflichtpraktikum Teil der Ausbildung ist, den Bewerbungsunterlagen beilegen.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, tog

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Project Management Partner based in Lucknow and working to serve the UP Cluster and Punjab Cluster (remotely) regions, you will play a crucial role in driving cluster initiatives, streamlining operations, and championing digital transformation. You will ensure our teams execute their strategies effectively through agile processes, robust compliance, and seamless operational support, helping us deliver exceptional impact to the healthcare ecosystem.

The Opportunity

• Drive project execution and agility: You track the status of key cluster projects, coordinate execution, and maintain project documentation and business planning. You implement agile ways of working and leverage PMP tools to improve processes and bring system efficiencies.

• Lead strategic planning: You assess plan execution through key metrics and lead Outcome-Based Planning within the cluster, driving implementation conceptually and through digital means.

• Manage local operations and vendors: You support marketing campaign rollouts, patient awareness programs, and event logistics. You are responsible for local vendor management, purchasing, administrative support to the Cluster Head, and general office administration matters.

• Act as the Local Compliance Champion: You ensure the state office is SHE compliant and champion audit preparedness, COREMAP, and other critical compliance practices, carrying out due diligence for medico-marketing and access sponsorships.

• Digital Champion: You own cluster responsibilities for digital tools (including CRM and G Suite), driving user adoption and resolving queries. You also serve as the primary Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for SAP.

• Collaborate cross-functionally: You work closely with PJP (Patient Journey Partners) and other internal and external stakeholders to deliver solutions, manage brand collateral, and ensure commercial success.

Who You Are

• You hold a strong academic background with a university degree in Business, Commerce, Engineering, or Life Sciences. An MBA (or equivalent) is highly preferred.

• You have proven experience in client handling and external stakeholder engagement, preferably in service industries. An understanding of the pharma environment and terminologies is highly desirable.

• You possess a strong grasp of technology and digital tools from both a user and admin standpoint. You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and have a high grasp of new tech applications.

• You have excellent oral and written communication skills, enabling you to build relationships and present information clearly to leadership and cross-functional teams.

• You exhibit strong logical reasoning and a positive, "can-do" attitude that thrives in dynamic environments.

• You act with a deep sense of ownership, responsibility, and empathy, ensuring you always keep patient and customer impact in mind.

• You are comfortable and capable of working effectively, managing and serving the UP and Punjab (remote) clusters.

Who we are

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Come Partner di Project Management con sede a Lucknow e lavorando per servire le regioni di UP Cluster e Punjab Cluster (remotely), si svolgerà un ruolo cruciale nella guida di iniziative di cluster, operazioni di razionalizzazione e la promozione della trasformazione digitale. Potrai garantire ai nostri team di eseguire le loro strategie in modo efficace attraverso processi agili, conformità robusta e supporto operativo senza interruzioni, aiutandoci a fornire un impatto eccezionale all'ecosistema sanitario. L'opportunità
• Guidare l'esecuzione del progetto e l'agilità: Si traccia lo stato dei progetti di cluster chiave, coordinare l'esecuzione e mantenere la documentazione del progetto e la pianificazione aziendale. Si implementano modi agili di lavorare e sfruttare gli strumenti PMP per migliorare i processi e portare efficienza di sistema.
• Pianificazione strategica di piombo: Si valuta l'esecuzione del piano attraverso metriche chiave e piombo Outcome-Based Planning all'interno del cluster, guidando l'implementazione concettualmente e attraverso mezzi digitali.
• Gestisci operazioni e fornitori locali: Supporti i rollout della campagna di marketing, i programmi di consapevolezza dei pazienti e la logistica degli eventi. Lei è responsabile per la gestione locale dei fornitori, l'acquisto, il supporto amministrativo al Cluster Head, e le questioni generali di amministrazione dell'ufficio.
• Atto come Campione di Compliance Locale: Assicurarsi che l'ufficio di stato è conforme SHE e la preparazione di audit campione, COREMAP, e altre pratiche di conformità critiche, effettuando la dovuta diligenza per il medico-marketing e l'accesso sponsorizzazioni.
• Campione digitale: Lei possiede responsabilità di cluster per strumenti digitali (tra cui CRM e G Suite), guidando l'adozione degli utenti e risolvendo le domande. Lei è anche il primo singolo punto di contatto (SPOC) per SAP.
• Collaborare in modo interfunzionale: si lavora a stretto contatto con PJP (Patient Journey Partners) e altri stakeholder interni ed esterni per fornire soluzioni, gestire garanzie di marca e garantire il successo commerciale. Chi sei
• Hai un forte background accademico con una laurea in Business, Commercio, Ingegneria, o Scienze della Vita. Un MBA (o equivalente) è altamente preferito.
• Hai dimostrato esperienza nella gestione dei clienti e nell'impegno degli stakeholder esterni, preferibilmente nei settori dei servizi. Una comprensione dell'ambiente e delle terminologie farmaceutiche è altamente auspicabile.
• Possiedi una forte presa di tecnologia e strumenti digitali sia da un punto di vista utente che da admin. Sei abile in Microsoft Excel e hai una grande conoscenza delle nuove applicazioni tecnologiche.
• Hai eccellenti capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta, che ti permettono di costruire relazioni e presentare informazioni chiaramente alla leadership e team interfunzionali.
• Si esibisce forte ragionamento logico e un atteggiamento positivo, "can-do" che prospera in ambienti dinamici.
• Agisci con un profondo senso di proprietà, responsabilità e empatia, assicurandoti sempre di tenere a mente il paziente e l'impatto del cliente.
• Siete comodi e in grado di lavorare efficacemente, gestire e servire i cluster UP e Punjab (remote). Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi si traducono in più

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We at Diagnostics Direct Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to pioneer the sourcing strategies that deliver critical, near-patient diagnostic technologies to the world? As our Sourcing Lead in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will spearhead global sourcing operations for our Near Patient Care (NPC), Sensors & Cartridges, and External Manufacturing (EM) portfolios. Balancing strategic alignment with tactical excellence, you will lead a highly capable team, drive digital procurement transformation, and collaborate directly with executive leadership to shape the future of our supply network.

- Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Head of Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
- Wider team and stakeholders: You are accountable for leading, coaching, and developing a local team of up to 16 Sourcing Managers and one Business Capability Lead. In addition, you will be part of the CoE Leadership Team (LT) and manage critical relationships with executive leadership, including the Direct Procurement LT.
- Role Type: A leadership position combining an even balance of strategic category alignment and tactical sourcing execution.
- Impact: Your impact is defined by driving measurable financial value, robust governance, and process optimization across the NPC, Sensors & Cartridges and EM globally. Specifically, you are accountable for: ​

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics (PPV, preferred supplier share, cycle times) while managing your team’s OPEX budget.

• Sourcing & Contracts: Executing compliant global sourcing, market research, and NPI benchmarking. In addition, you will oversee a critical portfolio of low-to-high complexity contracts (e.g., CDAs, SOWs or MSAs).

• Digital Leadership: Governing and improving Roche`s iCollab platform to advance supplier integration alongside Planning, Global Supply Chain, and the Roche Shared Services (RSS).

• SLA Governance: Defining KPIs to guarantee on-time and in-full (OTIF) service delivery across your assigned portfolio.

• Conflict & Exposure: Resolving high-stakes matrix priority conflicts, representing Roche to external providers, and delivering high-frequency monthly/quarterly updates to executive leadership (CoE, Category, Delivery, and DPLT).

• Process & Technology: Together with our Digital & Process experts, you foster and role model the development, deployment, and usage of novel AI / Digital solutions and continuously identify and implement process improvements.

Who you are

We strive to keep our standards high and look for candidates who can lead high-performance cultures, embrace collaboration, and remove operational friction.

• Education: A University degree (Business or Life Sciences) is required; a Master's (MBA) and CIPS certification are highly preferred.

• Experience: 7 to 10 years in Direct Procurement (Medtech, Automotive, Electronics, Pharmaceuticals, or Chemicals industries) with 3 to 5 years specifically in a Shared Service or Co
