Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Nous, chez Diagnostics Direct Approvisionnement (DOP), sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à être le pionnier des stratégies d'approvisionnement qui fournissent des technologies diagnostiques critiques et proches des patients au monde? En tant que leader d'approvisionnement à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous dirigerez les opérations d'approvisionnement à l'échelle mondiale pour nos portefeuilles Near Patient Care (NPC), Sensors & Cartridges et External Manufacturing (EM). Équilibrant l'alignement stratégique avec l'excellence tactique, vous dirigerez une équipe hautement compétente, piloterez la transformation des achats numériques et collaborerez directement avec les dirigeants pour façonner l'avenir de notre réseau d'approvisionnement. ● Ligne hiérarchique : Le poste relève directement du chef du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement. ● Équipe élargie et parties prenantes: Vous êtes responsable de la direction, de l'encadrement et du développement d'une équipe locale pouvant compter jusqu'à 16 gestionnaires d'approvisionnement et un responsable des capacités d'affaires. De plus, vous ferez partie de l'équipe de leadership du Conseil de l'Europe (EL) et gérerez des relations critiques avec les cadres supérieurs, y compris le LT d'approvisionnement direct. ● Type de rôle : Un poste de leadership combinant un équilibre uniforme entre l'alignement stratégique et l'exécution tactique de l'approvisionnement. ● Impact: Votre impact est défini par une valeur financière mesurable, une gouvernance robuste et l'optimisation des processus à travers le NPC, Sensors & Cartridges et EM à l'échelle mondiale. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable : Performances et économies : Diriger les mesures clés (PPV, part de fournisseur préférée, temps de cycle) tout en gérant le budget OPEX de votre équipe.
• Sourcing & Contracts: Exécuter un approvisionnement mondial conforme, des études de marché et des analyses comparatives NPI. De plus, vous superviserez un portefeuille essentiel de contrats de faible à grande complexité (p. ex., ACD, ASU ou ASM). Leadership numérique : diriger et améliorer la plateforme iCollab de Roche pour favoriser l'intégration des fournisseurs aux côtés de la planification, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale et des services partagés de Roche (RSS). Gouvernance de l'ALS : Définir les ICR pour garantir la prestation des services à temps et en totalité (OTIF) dans l'ensemble de votre portefeuille. Conflit et exposition : résoudre les conflits prioritaires de la matrice des prises élevées, représentant Roche auprès des fournisseurs externes, et fournir des mises à jour mensuelles et trimestrielles à la direction (CoE, Catégorie, Exécution et DPLT). Processus et technologie : avec nos experts en processus numériques, vous encouragez et modélisez le développement, le déploiement et l'utilisation de solutions numériques et d'IA nouvelles et identifiez et implémentez en permanence les améliorations de processus. Qui vous êtes Nous nous efforçons de maintenir nos normes élevées et de chercher des candidats qui peuvent diriger des cultures de haute performance, embrasser la collaboration et éliminer les frictions opérationnelles. ● Éducation: Un diplôme universitaire (affaires ou sciences de la vie) est requis; une maîtrise (MBA) et une certification CIPS sont hautement préférés. ● Expérience : de 7 à 10 ans dans l'approvisionnement direct (industries de la métallurgie, de l'automobile, de l'électronique, des produits pharmaceutiques ou des produits chimiques) et de 3 à 5 ans dans un service partagé

Potrai colmare il divario tra strategia aziendale e implementazione tecnica, assicurando che la nostra soluzione middleware cloud-to-edge rimanga scalabile, sicura e performante. La conoscenza del dominio di Care and Healthcare diventa un bene critico per poter prosperare in un ambiente così complesso. Le tue responsabilità
• Agire come punto di contatto tecnico principale per gli stakeholder aziendali, i proprietari di prodotti e i partner clinici esterni. E allineare tra le discipline incrociate in un ambiente altamente complesso e cross-teams altamente dipendente, assicurandosi che Solution Architecture sia in linea con Enterprise Architecture e overarching E2E Solution Design.
• Guidare la creazione di architetture coerente con roadmap di progetto, strategie di piattaforma, politiche di governance e standard. Inoltre, assicurarsi l'implementazione appropriata degli articoli sopra menzionati.
• Applicare la gestione degli stakeholder e le competenze morbide; in particolare la capacità di influenzare senza autorità formale, allineare le roadmap di architettura e le dipendenze attraverso più programmi e capacità di costruire reti efficaci al di là di pura competenza tecnica.
• Master AI-accelerated SDLCs per trasmettere rapidamente progetti architettonici e core team iterations. Esperienza comprovata che incorpora le capacità AI native in prodotti cloud e edge. E costruire una profonda comprensione dei vincoli legali e normativi dell'IA nel settore sanitario (ad esempio, linee guida della FDA, EU AI Act). Garantisce che tutti i modelli e le caratteristiche AI aderiscano strettamente agli standard di privacy, sicurezza e integrità dei dati del paziente.
• Traduci il debito tecnico complesso, i trade-off roadmap e le opportunità innovative nel linguaggio focalizzato sul valore aziendale per gli stakeholder non tecnici.
• Rimuovere i bloccanti all'interfaccia di organizzazione-team. Mediate tra le dipendenze del team e priorità compiti tecnici in linea con la roadmap architettonica.
• Definire ed evolvere un'architettura modulare ad alta disponibilità su AWS. Guidare l'adozione di moderni framework Java che supportano lo scaling elastico e l'elaborazione di dati ad alto rendimento.
• Standardizzare le nostre soluzioni di bordo basate su DotNet. Scopri come ci interfacciamo con diverse flotte di strumenti (Accu-Chek Pulse, Inform II, Liat, ecc.), assicurando resistenza durante la volatilità della rete.
• Master complesse topologie di messaggistica. Definire modelli per architetture basate su eventi, sincronizzazione di stato distribuita e distribuzione affidabile dei dati in ambienti in cui la connettività è intermittente.
• Impostare il punto di riferimento per i requisiti non operativi. Guidare la modellazione di minacce proattive, integrare la sicurezza per-design, e garantire che il nostro middleware incontra un med rigoroso

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is a high-impact, hybrid role where 75% of your accountability is dedicated to Solution Architecture and Technical Oversight for the navify® Point of Care (PoC) Program, and 25% is dedicated to engineering management and people development. As People Leader, you will be responsible for leading a team of Senior Software Engineers, advising on individual career paths for engineers, mentor Senior/Staff-level contributors, conducting regular performance appraisals, and manage professional growth through personalized development plans. You will be responsible for the architectural health and delivery outcomes of our Point of Care Operations; a world wide scale solution deployed in more than 50 countries in all world wide regions, connected with more that 250.000 Point of Care instruments in the field. You will bridge the gap between business strategy and technical implementation, ensuring our cloud-to-edge middleware solution remains scalable, secure, and performant. Point of Care and Healthcare domain knowledge becomes a critical asset to be able to thrive in such a complex environment. Your Responsibilities
• Act as the primary technical point of contact for business stakeholders, product owners, and external clinical partners. And align between cross disciplines in a highly complex and cross-teams highly dependent environment, making sure Solution Architecture is in line with Enterprise Architecture and overarching E2E Solution design.
• Drive the creation of architectures consistent with project roadmaps, platform strategies, governance policies, and standards. Also, ensure the appropriate implementation of the above-mentioned items.
• Apply stakeholder management and soft skills; especially the ability to influence without formal authority, align architecture roadmaps and dependencies across multiple programs and capacity to build effective networks beyond purely technical expertise.
• Master AI-accelerated SDLCs to rapidly stream architectural designs and core team iterations. Proven experience embedding native AI capabilities into cloud and edge products. And build a deep understanding of the legal and regulatory constraints of AI in healthcare (e.g., FDA guidelines, EU AI Act). Ensures all AI models and features strictly adhere to patient privacy, security, and data integrity standards.
• Translate complex technical debt, roadmap trade-offs, and innovative opportunities into business-value-focused language for non-technical stakeholders.
• Remove blockers at the organization-team interface. Mediate between team dependencies and prioritize technical tasks in line with the architectural roadmap.
• Define and evolve a modular, high-availability architecture on AWS. Drive the adoption of modern Java frameworks that support elastic scaling and high-throughput data processing.
• Standardize our DotNet-based edge solutions. Oversee how we interface with diverse instrument fleets (Accu-Chek Pulse, Inform II, Liat, etc.), ensuring resilience during network volatility.
• Master complex messaging topologies. Define patterns for event-driven architectures, distributed state synchronization, and reliable data delivery in environments where connectivity is intermittent.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Der Senior Engineering Manager & Solution Architect bietet sowohl visionäre technische Steuerung als auch einfühlsame Menschenführung. Dies ist eine einflussreiche, hybride Rolle, bei der 75% Ihrer Verantwortung der Lösungsarchitektur und der technischen Aufsicht für navify® gewidmet sind. Das Point of Care (PoC) -Programm und 25% sind dem Engineering-Management und der Entwicklung von Menschen gewidmet. Als People Leader sind Sie verantwortlich für die Leitung eines Teams von Senior Software Engineers, die Beratung über individuelle Karrierewege für Ingenieure, Mentor Senior / Mitarbeiter, die Durchführung regelmäßiger Leistungsbewertungen und die Verwaltung des beruflichen Wachstums durch personalisierte Entwicklungspläne. Sie sind verantwortlich für den architektonischen Zustand und die Lieferergebnisse unserer Point of Care-Operationen; eine weltweite Lösung, die in mehr als 50 Ländern in allen Regionen der Welt eingesetzt wird, verbunden mit mehr als 250.000 Point of Care-Instrumenten vor Ort. Sie schließen die Lücke zwischen Geschäftsstrategie und technischer Implementierung und stellen sicher, dass unsere Cloud-to-Edge-Middleware-Lösung skalierbar, sicher und performant bleibt. Point of Care- und Healthcare-Domänenwissen wird zu einem kritischen Asset, um in einer so komplexen Umgebung gedeihen zu können. Ihre Aufgaben
• Handeln Sie als primärer technischer Ansprechpartner für Geschäftsbeteiligte, Produktinhaber und externe klinische Partner. Und richten Sie sich zwischen disziplinübergreifenden in einer hochkomplexen und teamübergreifenden Umgebung aus, um sicherzustellen, dass die Lösungsarchitektur mit der Unternehmensarchitektur und dem übergreifenden E2E-Lösungsdesign übereinstimmt.
• Förderung der Schaffung von Architekturen, die mit Projekt-Roadmaps, Plattformstrategien, Governance-Richtlinien und Standards übereinstimmen. Stellen Sie auch die angemessene Umsetzung der oben genannten Punkte sicher.
• Anwendung von Stakeholder-Management und Soft Skills; insbesondere die Fähigkeit, ohne formale Autorität Einfluss zu nehmen, Architektur-Roadmaps und Abhängigkeiten über mehrere Programme hinweg auszurichten und effektive Netzwerke über rein technisches Fachwissen hinaus aufzubauen.
• Master AI-beschleunigte SDLCs, um Architekturdesigns und Kernteam-Iterationen schnell zu streamen. Bewährte Erfahrung darin, native KI-Funktionen in Cloud- und Edge-Produkte einzubetten. Und bauen Sie ein tiefes Verständnis der rechtlichen und regulatorischen Zwänge der KI im Gesundheitswesen (z. B. FDA-Richtlinien, EU AI Act). Stellt sicher, dass alle KI-Modelle und Funktionen strikt den Datenschutz-, Sicherheits- und Datenintegritätsstandards der Patienten entsprechen.
• Übersetzen Sie komplexe technische Schulden, Roadmap-Abwägungen und innovative Möglichkeiten in eine Business-Value-orientierte Sprache für nicht-technische Stakeholder.
• Entfernen Sie Blocker an der Oberfläche des Organisationsteams. Mediieren Sie zwischen Teamabhängigkeiten und priorisieren Sie technische Aufgaben gemäß der architektonischen Roadmap.
• Definieren und Entwickeln einer modularen, hochverfügbaren Architektur auf AWS. Führen Sie die Einführung moderner Java-Frameworks voran, die elastische Skalierung und Datenverarbeitung mit hohem Durchsatz unterstützen.
• Standardisieren Sie unsere DotNet-basierten Edge-Lösungen. Überwachen Sie, wie wir mit verschiedenen Instrumentenflotten (Accu-Chek Pulse, Inform II, Liat usw.) interagieren, um die Widerstandsfähigkeit während der Netzwerkvolatilität zu gewährleisten.
• Master komplexe Messaging-Topologien. Definieren Sie Muster für ereignisgesteuerte Architekturen, verteilte Zustandssynchronisation und zuverlässige Datenbereitstellung in Umgebungen, in denen die Konnektivität intermittierend ist.
• Setzen Sie den Benchmark für nichtfunktionale Anforderungen. Führen Sie proaktive Bedrohungsmodellierung, integrieren Sie Security-by-Design und stellen Sie sicher, dass unsere Middleware den strengen Anforderungen entspricht.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le gestionnaire d'ingénierie principal et architecte de solutions assure à la fois la direction technique visionnaire et le leadership des personnes empathiques. C'est un rôle hybride à fort impact où 75% de votre responsabilité est dédié à l'architecture de solutions et à la surveillance technique pour le navify® Programme Point of Care (PoC) et 25 % est consacré à la gestion de l'ingénierie et au perfectionnement des personnes. En tant que chef du personnel, vous serez chargé de diriger une équipe d'ingénieurs principaux en logiciels, de donner des conseils sur les cheminements de carrière individuels pour les ingénieurs, de mentorer des contributeurs seniors ou de niveau du personnel, de mener régulièrement des évaluations du rendement et de gérer la croissance professionnelle au moyen de plans de perfectionnement personnalisés. Vous serez responsable des résultats en matière de santé architecturale et de prestation de nos opérations Point of Care; une solution à l'échelle mondiale déployée dans plus de 50 pays dans toutes les régions du monde, liée à plus de 250.000 instruments Point of Care dans le domaine. Vous comblerez l'écart entre la stratégie d'affaires et la mise en œuvre technique, assurant que notre solution d'intergiciel Cloud-to-edge reste évolutive, sécurisée et performante. Point de soins et de santé connaissances du domaine devient un atout essentiel pour être en mesure de prospérer dans un environnement aussi complexe. Vos responsabilités
• Agir comme principal point de contact technique pour les intervenants commerciaux, les propriétaires de produits et les partenaires cliniques externes. Et s'aligner entre disciplines dans un environnement hautement complexe et cross-teams très dépendant, en s'assurant que Solution Architecture est en ligne avec l'architecture d'entreprise et la conception globale de la solution E2E.
• Conduire la création d'architectures compatibles avec les feuilles de route du projet, les stratégies de plateforme, les politiques de gouvernance et les normes. De même, veiller à la bonne application des points susmentionnés.
• Appliquer la gestion des intervenants et les compétences souples; particulièrement la capacité d'influencer sans autorité officielle, d'aligner les feuilles de route et les dépendances en architecture sur plusieurs programmes et la capacité de créer des réseaux efficaces au-delà de l'expertise purement technique.
• Maîtrisez les SDLC accélérés pour diffuser rapidement les conceptions architecturales et les itérations de l'équipe centrale. Expérience éprouvée intégrant des capacités d'IA natives dans les produits cloud et bord. Et de mieux comprendre les contraintes juridiques et réglementaires de l'IA dans le domaine des soins de santé (p. ex. lignes directrices de la FDA, loi de l'UE sur l'IA). S'assure que tous les modèles et caractéristiques d'IA respectent strictement les normes de confidentialité, de sécurité et d'intégrité des données du patient.
• Traduire la dette technique complexe, les compromis sur la feuille de route et les possibilités d'innovation en langage axé sur la valeur des entreprises pour les intervenants non techniques.
• Supprimer les bloqueurs à l'interface organisation-équipe. Méditer entre les dépendances de l'équipe et prioriser les tâches techniques conformément à la feuille de route architecturale.
• Définir et développer une architecture modulaire à haute disponibilité sur AWS. Conduire l'adoption de cadres Java modernes qui prennent en charge l'échelle élastique et le traitement de données à haut débit.
• Standardisez nos solutions de bord basées sur DotNet. Surveiller l'interface avec diverses flottes d'instruments (Accu-Chek Pulse, Inform II, Liat, etc.), en assurant la résilience pendant la volatilité du réseau.
• Maîtriser les topologies de messagerie complexes. Définir des modèles pour les architectures axées sur les événements, la synchronisation des états distribués et la livraison fiable de données dans des environnements où la connectivité est intermittente.
• Définir la référence pour les exigences non fonctionnelles. Diriger la modélisation proactive de la menace, intégrer la sécurité par conception, et s'assurer que notre intergiciel répond aux critères stricts

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Patient Journey Partner - Okulistyka

Dołącz do Roche jako Patient Journey Partner!

Chcesz pracować tam, gdzie Twoje działania naprawdę zmieniają sposób leczenia pacjentów ? Gdzie współtworzysz rozwiązania, zamiast realizować schematy? Jeśli tak - mamy coś dla Ciebie.

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy 2 osób . Zapraszamy kandydatki i kandydatów z następujących lokalizacji:

• Szczecin (praca na terenie woj. zachodniopomorskiego i lubuskiego)

• Łódź - (praca na terenie woj. łódzkiego)

Jako Patient Journey Partner stajesz się kluczowym partnerem dla ośrodków medycznych i środowiska okulistycznego. Wspólnie projektujecie lepszy dostęp do nowoczesnych terapii, a Twoje działania przekładają się na to, jak szybko i skutecznie pacjent trafia do właściwej opieki.

To wyjątkowa rola, w której:

• łączysz perspektywę lekarzy, pacjentów i systemu ochrony zdrowia,

• budujesz partnerstwa zamiast relacji transakcyjnych,

• tworzysz realne usprawnienia na ścieżce pacjenta w okulistyce.

Twoje zadania:

• Budowanie i rozwijanie relacji z lekarzami i ośrodkami medycznymi,

• Identyfikowanie realnych wyzwań pacjentów i przekuwanie ich w konkretne rozwiązania,

• Dzielenie się ekspercką wiedzą o terapiach Roche,

• Organizacja spotkań, szkoleń i wydarzeń edukacyjnych,

• Współpraca z lokalnymi i globalnymi zespołami Roche.

Szukamy osoby, która:

• Ma doświadczenie w pracy terenowej i kontaktach z lekarzami (okulistyka będzie dużym atutem),

• Ma doświadczenie w programach lekowych

• Działa samodzielnie, proaktywnie i z naturalną otwartością,

• Świetnie komunikuje się z różnymi partnerami - zarówno w środowisku medycznym, jak i wewnątrz organizacji,

• Potrafi współpracować cross-funkcyjnie, angażując zespoły medyczne, marketingowe, market access i operacyjne,

• Lubi pracować zespołowo i czuje się dobrze w dynamicznym środowisku, gdzie wspólne rozwiązywanie wyzwań jest codziennością,

• Kieruje się empatią i misją realnej poprawy doświadczenia pacjentów,

• Zna język angielski na poziomie umożliwiającym swobodną komunikację.

Mile widziane:

• Wykształcenie medyczne/biologiczne,

• Znajomość środowiska okulistycznego.

Co oferujemy?

• Umowę o pracę, atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie i premię roczną,

• Prywatną opiekę medyczną, ubezpieczenie na życie, karta Multisport,

• Szkolenia, rozwój i lekcje językowe,

• Dwa dodatkowe wolne piątki kwartalnie („Recharge Fridays”),

• Dofinansowanie wakacji, program akcji pracowniczych i emerytalnych,

• Realny wpływ, zaufanie i przestrzeń do działania.

W Roche czekamy na ludzi, którzy chcą działać z misją.

Brzmi jak rola dla Ciebie? Aplikuj!

Jeżeli znasz kogoś, kto idealnie tu pasuje - przekaż dalej.

Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Polska Sp. z o.o., ul. Domaniewska 28, 02-672 Warszawa. Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Przysługuje Ci prawo dostępu do treści swoich danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. jobs.title: Solution Integration & Testing Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Us: A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Within Core Lab Development (CLD) , a division of Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , we focus on developing cutting-edge test solutions spanning clinical and immunochemistry, coagulation, mass spectrometry, and advanced laboratory automation. As part of our Solution Automation Integration and Testing group, you will operate within the cobas ultra omni Solution Layer . Here, a "Solution" represents a massive, complex System of Systems (SoS) where physical medical devices, robotic transport automation, and digital edge-to-cloud workflow software interact seamlessly, combining hardware and software products.

Important Context for Applicants: This is a Product R&D engineering role focused on physical product orchestration and embedded/cloud systems, not an enterprise IT infrastructure position.

Your Role
As a Solution Integration & Testing Architect, you will lead the technical orchestration of our R&D validation campaigns, interfacing across multiple Product Development System Teams and strategic external partners.
You will work in close, hand-in-hand partnership with the Solution Integration Manager. You own the architectural definition of the Solution Integration & Testing Strategy and design the physical, hybrid, and virtual lab topologies needed for complex testing. Your primary challenge is ensuring that hardware products (with long, physical development lifecycles) and software products (with rapid, continuous release lifecycles) are designed and architected to work seamlessly together to enable End-to-End (E2E) clinical workflows. Partnering closely with Solution Definition and Systems Test Architects, as well as your managerial counterpart, you ensure that both functional and non-functional requirements (performance, reliability, scale) are verifiably testable at the E2E solution level.

Key Responsibilities:

• Overarching Integration Strategy: Architect the master Solution Integration Strategy. Define the integration levels, quality gates between those levels, and the Continuous Integration (CI) roadmap. Establish governance for global implementation environments and automated verification pipelines across the divergent development teams of system products.

• Lab & Emulator Topology Strategy: Define the virtual, hybrid, and physical lab setup strategy. Lead the conceptual design and architecture of the digital twin landscapes, and hardware/software emulator topologies required to accurately mirror different systems that compose the solution.

• Design for Testability: Act as the final technical gatekeeper by reviewing system use cases, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and high-level requirements to guarantee verifiable testability at the solution level. Identify and prioritize critical architectural risks for E2E solution workflows.

• Cross-Functional Product Boundaries: Establish and enforce clear cross-functional test and technical responsibilities across the product delivery nodes (e.g., hardware instruments, embedded control units, navify workflow software edge & cloud).

• Technical Guidance & Automation Vision: Provide dedicated technical leadership, automation strategy, and coaching to embedded integration engineers, test automation developers, and analysts across the Solution Train. Facilitate bidirectional feedback with delivery streams to ensu

jobs.title: Digital Campaign Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub team has been established within the Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Group Communications by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management and Digital Publishing Services.

As a Digital Campaign Specialist in the Digital Campaigns Chapter in the Global Digital Hub, you play a crucial role in driving the end-to-end orchestration of campaign content delivery across all channels and request types. You ensure seamless coordination between global and local teams, and achieve consistent messaging throughout the organization. You contribute to global and local content delivery, promote the adoption of global content and templatization.

In this role, you act as a content production coordinator, as well as an advisor to support affiliates in achieving their content goals while aligning with Roche’s digital vision. You build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders in the affiliate network, serving as the first point of contact for questions, ideas, and challenges.

The Opportunity:

• Content production management: Drive the end-to-end orchestration of campaign and content delivery, across all channels and request types. Ensure delivery standards are met, and capture relevant feedback from stakeholders.

• Content network facilitator: Initiate conversations between global and local teams to reflect needs, insights and learnings and achieve consistent messaging across the organization. Collaborate with the global brand engagement team on global/local content plans and reuse.

• Stakeholder Communication: Incorporate feedback from stakeholders, revise digital campaign content requests accordingly, and ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Build and maintain effective working relationships with the relevant stakeholders in the affiliate network by staying up-to-date with digital trends, industry innovations, and sharing best practices across affiliates.

• Empower affiliates to achieve their content goals while aligning with Roche’s digital vision.

• Support affiliates with content demand planning topics and integrate local demand forecast inputs into Roche's global demand planning methodology to ensure strategic alignment and readiness.

• Report and advise: Collect insights on localisation progress. Engage with the global brand team to communicate key insights and recommendations.

Who you are:

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field and 3 + years of experience in content production, project management, or digital campaign management, with a focus on coordinating digital marketing initiatives across multiple channels.

• You have a solid understanding of digital marketing principles, content creation, and campaign management.

• You possess strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with a proven track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously.

• You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills in English with experience in facilitating collaboration between global and local teams.

• You own experience in stakeholder management and incorporating feedback into content strategies.

• Proficiency in project management tools and software, with a readiness to learn new systems are needed.

• Familiarity with the Life Science industry, including key local compliance and regulatory concepts is an advantage.

​
In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportu

• Hai una solida comprensione dei principi di marketing digitale, la creazione di contenuti e la gestione della campagna.
• Possiedi forti capacità organizzative e multitasking, con una comprovata traccia di gestione simultanea di più progetti.

• La familiarità con il settore Life Science, tra cui la conformità locale chiave e i concetti normativi è un vantaggio. ​ In cambio vi forniamo:

jobs.title: Medical Lead (Neurology)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Lead is the key Medical Affairs role that develops broad medical & scientific expertise within given Disease/Therapeutic Areas. As a Medical Lead, you support development and execution of patient-focused medical strategies, primarily drive scientific exchange and evidence generation activities.

Key Responsibilities

• You are a strategic partner who provides medical insights and expertise to the organisation and executes all planned medical activities.

• You will be the medical responsible of the team and will be more in the field.

• You manage the integrity and accuracy of scientific and medical data communicated internally and externally for promotional and non-promotional purposes.

• You collaborate with stakeholders in identifying and prioritising relevant research ideas and developing them into research projects.

• You collaborate closely with Clinical Operations across different phases of interventional clinical trials: Gaining clarity and communicating/spreading the knowledge to communities of interest, helping to define and maintain country participation strategy, supporting development of sites selection strategy through a disease area lens by different means including participation in site feasibility activities, pre-activation site visits and other F2F and remote interactions with the sites as needed, patient recruitment & retention, protocol & patient-related issues, scientific communication of study results, clinical study report and scientific publications.

• You detect the medical gap/need for RWD/E generation activities by reviewing Integrated Evidence Plans, communicate, agree and document, plan & execute and/or participate in respective work in non-interventional studies and RWD/E generation activities: Definition of the research questions and study objectives, study design and protocol, study budget, feasibility, site selection, pre-activation and ad-hoc visits, patient recruitment, protocol & patient issues, scientific communication of study results, clinical study report and scientific publications.

Who You Are

• You have Medicine, pharmacy or dentistry degree

• Your experience in Neurology is preferred

• You have previous experience in Pharma Industry

• You are fluent in Turkish and English

• You have strategic thinking and growth mindset

• You are collaborative and experienced in stakeholder management

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Medical Lead is the key Medical Affairs role that develops broad medical & scientific expertise within given Disease/Therapeutic Areas. As a Medical Lead, you support development and execution of patient-focused medical strategies, primarily drive scientific exchange and evidence generation activities. Key Responsibilities
• You are a strategic partner who provides medical insights and expertise to the organisation and executes all planned medical activities.
• You will be the medical responsible of the team and will be more in the field.
• You manage the integrity and accuracy of scientific and medical data communicated internally and externally for promotional and non-promotional purposes.
• You collaborate with stakeholders in identifying and prioritising relevant research ideas and developing them into research projects.
• You collaborate closely with Clinical Operations across different phases of interventional clinical trials: Gaining clarity and communicating/spreading the knowledge to communities of interest, helping to define and maintain country participation strategy, supporting development of sites selection strategy through a disease area lens by different means including participation in site feasibility activities, pre-activation site visits and other F2F and remote interactions with the sites as needed, patient recruitment & retention, protocol & patient-related issues, scientific communication of study results, clinical study report and scientific publications.
• You detect the medical gap/need for RWD/E generation activities by reviewing Integrated Evidence Plans, communicate, agree and document, plan & execute and/or participate in respective work in non-interventional studies and RWD/E generation activities: Definition of the research questions and study objectives, study design and protocol, study budget, feasibility, site selection, pre-activation and ad-hoc visits, patient recruitment, protocol & patient issues, scientific communication of study results, clinical study report and scientific publications. Who You Are
• You have Medicine, pharmacy or dentistry degree
• Your experience in Neurology is preferred
• You have previous experience in Pharma Industry
• You are fluent in Turkish and English
• You have strategic thinking and growth mindset
• You are collaborative and experienced in stakeholder management Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Vous avez un diplôme en médecine, en pharmacie ou en dentisterie
• Votre expérience en neurologie est préférée
• Vous avez une expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique
• Vous parlez couramment le turc et l'anglais
• Vous avez une pensée stratégique et une mentalité de croissance
• Vous êtes collaborative et expérimenté dans la gestion des intervenants Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist in the Digital Campaigns Chapter in the Global Digital Hub, you play a crucial role in driving the end-to-end orchestration of campaign content delivery across all channels and request types. You ensure seamless coordination between global and local teams, and achieve consistent messaging throughout the organization. You contribute to global and local content delivery, promote the adoption of global content and templatization.

In this role, you act as a content production coordinator, as well as an advisor to support affiliates in achieving their content goals while aligning with Roche’s digital vision. You build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders in the affiliate network, serving as the first point of contact for questions, ideas, and challenges.

The Opportunity:

• Content production management: Drive the end-to-end orchestration of campaign and content delivery, across all channels and request types. Ensure delivery standards are met, and capture relevant feedback from stakeholders.

• Content network facilitator: Initiate conversations between global and local teams to reflect needs, insights and learnings and achieve consistent messaging across the organization. Collaborate with the global brand engagement team on global/local content plans and reuse.

• Stakeholder Communication: Incorporate feedback from stakeholders, revise digital campaign content requests accordingly, and ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Build and maintain effective working relationships with the relevant stakeholders in the affiliate network by staying up-to-date with digital trends, industry innovations, and sharing best practices across affiliates.

• Empower affiliates to achieve their content goals while aligning with Roche’s digital vision.

• Support affiliates with content demand planning topics and integrate local demand forecast inputs into Roche's global demand planning methodology to ensure strategic alignment and readiness.

• Report and advise: Collect insights on localisation progress. Engage with the global brand team to communicate key insights and recommendations.

Who you are:

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; you are highly creative, innovative, forward thinking marketer with the ability to demonstrate awareness of digital trends.

• You have a solid understanding of digital marketing principles, content creation, and campaign management and 1-3 years of experience in content production, project management, or digital campaign management, with a focus on coordinating digital marketing initiatives across multiple channels.

• You own excellent communication and interpersonal skills in English language, and you have experience in stakeholder management and incorporating feedback into content strategies.

• You have a customer-focused behavior in everything you do and ability to create and maintain well-functioning relationships with internal stakeholders and other 3rd party providers.

• You have proficiency in project management tools and software, with a readiness to learn new systems as needed.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Global Digital Hub è stato fondato all'interno del Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest. Il nostro scopo principale è quello di rafforzare le capacità digitali di Roche a livello globale, supportando iniziative centrali con Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting e Creative Design. In qualità di Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist nel Digital Campaigns Chapter nel Global Digital Hub, si gioca un ruolo cruciale nel guidare l'orchestrazione end-to-end della distribuzione dei contenuti della campagna in tutti i canali e tipi di richiesta. Garantisci un coordinamento senza interruzioni tra team globali e locali e ottieni messaggi costanti in tutta l'organizzazione. Contribuisci alla fornitura di contenuti globali e locali, promuovi l'adozione di contenuti globali e la templatizzazione. In questo ruolo, si agisce come coordinatore della produzione di contenuti, così come un consulente per sostenere gli affiliati nel raggiungimento dei loro obiettivi di contenuto, allineando con la visione digitale di Roche. Costruisci e mantieni forti relazioni con gli stakeholder della rete di affiliazione, servendo come primo punto di contatto per domande, idee e sfide. L'opportunità:
• Gestione della produzione dei contenuti: guidare l'orchestrazione end-to-end della campagna e la distribuzione dei contenuti, attraverso tutti i canali e tipi di richiesta. Assicurare gli standard di consegna sono soddisfatti e catturare feedback rilevanti da parte degli stakeholder.
• Contenuti facilitatore di rete: avviare conversazioni tra team globali e locali per riflettere le esigenze, le intuizioni e gli insegnamenti e ottenere messaggi costanti in tutta l'organizzazione. Collabora con il team di brand engagement globale sui piani e il riutilizzo dei contenuti globali/locali.
• Stakeholder Communication: incorporare feedback da parte degli stakeholder, rivedere le richieste di contenuti della campagna digitale e garantire l'allineamento con le loro aspettative.
• Costruire e mantenere relazioni di lavoro efficaci con le parti interessate rilevanti nella rete di affiliazione, rimanendo aggiornati con le tendenze digitali, le innovazioni del settore e la condivisione delle migliori pratiche tra le affiliate.
• Incoraggiare gli affiliati a raggiungere i loro obiettivi di contenuto, allineando con la visione digitale di Roche.
• Sostenere gli affiliati con argomenti di pianificazione della domanda di contenuti e integrare gli input di previsione della domanda locale nella metodologia di pianificazione globale della domanda di Roche per garantire l'allineamento strategico e la disponibilità.
• Segnala e consiglia: Raccogli informazioni sui progressi della localizzazione. Impegnarsi con il team di brand globale per comunicare idee e raccomandazioni chiave. Chi sei:
• Hai una laurea in Marketing, Comunicazione, Business o un campo correlato; sei altamente creativo, innovativo, avanzato marketing di pensiero con la capacità di dimostrare la consapevolezza delle tendenze digitali.
• Hai una solida comprensione dei principi di marketing digitale, la creazione di contenuti e la gestione delle campagne e 1-3 anni di esperienza nella produzione dei contenuti, nella gestione dei progetti o nella gestione delle campagne digitali, con l'obiettivo di coordinare le iniziative di marketing digitale su più canali.
• Possiedi una comunicazione eccellente e competenze interpersonali in lingua inglese, e hai esperienza nella gestione degli stakeholder e incorporando feedback nelle strategie di contenuto.
• Hai un comportamento focalizzato sul cliente in tutto ciò che fai e la capacità di creare e mantenere relazioni ben funzionanti con gli stakeholder interni e altri fornitori di terze parti.
• Hai competenza negli strumenti di gestione del progetto e nel software, con una disponibilità ad imparare nuovi sistemi come necessario.

• Animateur de réseau de contenu : Entreprendre des conversations entre les équipes mondiales et locales afin de refléter les besoins, les idées et les apprentissages et d'obtenir des messages cohérents dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Collaborer avec l'équipe d'engagement de la marque mondiale sur les plans de contenu mondial/local et la réutilisation.
• Communication avec les parties intéressées : Intégrer les commentaires des parties intéressées, réviser les demandes de contenu de campagne numérique en conséquence et assurer l'alignement sur leurs attentes.

• Autoriser les affiliés à atteindre leurs objectifs de contenu tout en s'aligneant sur la vision numérique de Roche.
• Soutenir les affiliés avec des sujets de planification de la demande de contenu et intégrer les données de prévision de la demande locale dans la méthodologie de planification de la demande mondiale de Roche pour assurer l'alignement stratégique et la préparation.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing produziert mit seinen 650 Mitarbeitern Large und Small Molecule APIs (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients) für die kommerzielle und klinische Versorgung.
Zur Produktion von Antikörpern haben wir am Standort Basel moderne, hochautomatisierte Produktionsanlagen. Die Herstellung und Durchführung dieser Prozesse finden unter Einhaltung von cGMP statt.

Die Möglichkeit:

• Bedienung, Überwachung und Störungsbehebung von Produktionsanlagen inklusive Alarmmanagement

• Durchführung der täglichen Produktionsabläufe gemäss Produktionsplan unter Einhaltung der GMP-Richtlinien

• Sicherstellung der GMP-konformen Dokumentation in MES, EBR und Batch Records

• Verarbeitung, Bereitstellung und Lagerung von Verbrauchsmaterialien, Single-Use-Materialien, Chemikalien, Medien und Hilfsstoffen

• Durchführung von Probenzügen (Prozess-, Validierungs- und Final-Rinse-Proben) sowie Sample Management

• Unterstützung bei Qualifizierungen, Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten sowie Sicherstellung des qualifizierten Anlagenstatus

• Mitarbeit bei Abweichungsmanagement, Risikoanalysen, Prozessoptimierungen und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmassnahmen

• Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Hygienestandards sowie Förderung von Ordnung, Sauberkeit und Operational Excellence (5S/OAC)

Wer du bist?

• Abgeschlossen Berufsausbildung, vorzugsweise Chemikant oder Pharmatechnologe

• Gutes GMP Verständnis

• Erfahrungen mit automatisierten Anlagen im Produktionsmassstab

• Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein

• Selbstständiges Arbeiten und Spass an der Arbeit im Team

jobs.title: Head of Automation and Digital Engineering

titleByLocale.en: Head of Automation and Digital Engineering

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Head of Automation and Digital Engineering reports to the Head of Global Engineering and is a member of the Engineering Leadership Team. This leadership position leads a global team of specialists responsible for providing technical expertise, managing automation parts of capital projects (CAPEX), and ensuring integrated automation solutions throughout the asset lifecycle. The function closely partners with Technology Strategy, Standards, and ALCM, as well as gMSAT functions, to support the standardization of equipment and the implementation of smart manufacturing across the network.

The Opportunity

• Provide leadership and oversight to the Automation and Digital Engineering function, including creating a vision and multi-year strategies for a globally aligned function.

• Oversee and develop a technical workforce of 10+ employees globally, alongside strategic service providers delivering a multi-billion CHF CAPEX portfolio.

• Develop capabilities and expertise in automation and digital engineering while ensuring engineering processes are efficient and effective.

• Partner with key stakeholders to evolve global engineering standards and technology advances in automation engineering strategies.

• Leverage innovative technologies to prepare the organization for future automation engineering challenges in manufacturing and process development.

• Ensure innovative, sustainable, and cost-effective design and implementation strategies by keeping pace with global industry trends.

• Develop excellent partnerships with external automation engineering firms in alignment with Global Procurement to optimally deliver capital projects.

• Foster and drive network collaboration by establishing and leading global communities of practice for automation engineers.

• Partner with Pharma Digital and IT/OT to develop a comprehensive strategy for aligning information and operational technologies.

Who you are
You are a visionary leader with strong organizational skills, executive presence, and exceptional business acumen. You possess the ability to lead transformation in a global, networked organization and are passionate about developing talent and a culture of innovation. You are a strategic thinker who navigates complex organizational dynamics with agility and resilience, effectively influencing senior-level partners and stakeholders across a highly regulated GMP environment.
Further, you possess the following qualifications and experience:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or a related discipline; an MS or MBA is desirable.

• At least 12 to 15 years of experience in engineering, automation, and digital technologies, preferably in the biopharmaceutical or life sciences industry.

• Minimum of 10 years of professional experience leading and coaching multi-disciplinary teams within a corporate business environment.

• Proven success in leading regional or global engineering organizations and managing large-scale CAPEX portfolios.

• Deep expertise in automation engineering, including knowledge of governance, sustainability, and energy efficiency.

• Experience in navigating and influencing global cultures and a track record of driving change while balancing risks.

• Willingness to travel (40 - 50%)

Relocation benefits are not offered for this position.

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more

jobs.title: Workforce Optimization / Strategies Intern (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Workforce Optimization Intern (Strategic Workforce Planning)

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is part of the Integrated Workforce Strategies Chapter within the People & Culture organization. Our purpose is to enable the business to achieve its ambitious goals while anticipating and adapting to a rapidly changing environment. We elevate the way leaders shape our future workforce by providing data-driven, skills-based workforce planning solutions to the business, such as Strategic Workforce Planning. Through close partnership with the business, we work on co-creating workforce strategies to close skills gaps. Additionally, as part of our transformation towards a skills-based organization, we drive embedding skills into our people practices, guiding our people & leaders to become future ready.
Shaping new approaches in this field, working with new technologies and cross-functional partners offers you great learning opportunities.

The Opportunity:
As an intern in the Workforce Optimization team for a 6-month period, your main focus will be learning about Workforce Strategies and Strategic Workforce Planning at a global level. You will support the design of our products, enablement materials an contributing to the the delivery of SWP in the business.

Your contribution will be to:

• Support the design of various products and projects in the field of workforce strategies and planning

• Contribute to learning solutions that inspire and educate our partners

• Collaborate with the experts in the field in an agile working environment characterized by empowerment, open communication and willingness to test new ideas

Who you are:

• You are in your Bachelor or Master studies in the field of business administration, Human Resources, Organizational Psychology or similar

• Ideally, you have had a first experience (previous internship) in HR, Learning and/or communication field

• You can address complex problems and develop effective solutions

• You think creatively, and you enjoy the creation of effective presentations, learning material and experiences

• You are motivated to work independently in a collaborative and dynamic environment and can adapt to different needs

• You have a can-do attitude and growth mindset

• You are characterized by a high level of social competence and are able to efficiently communicate in English

General information:

• Work location: Basel, Rotkreuz, Mannheim, Penzberg

• Workload: 40 hours/week or 37.5 hours/week based on the location requirements

Skills Needed:

• PowerPoint or Google Slide (required)

• Excel or Google Sheets

• AI tools

• Communication

• Simplification of concepts

• Creating processes, frameworks

• Agile

• Creative Thinking

• English language

Your application
Simply upload your resume.
Please remember, that this internship is aimed at students (m/f/d) who are currently enrolled for the entire period of the internship or, alternatively, at people in a GAP-year of a maximum of one year (between Bachelor's and Master's studies ) , where it can be proven in writing at which university/college and exactly when (month/year) within a year the studies will be continued.

Period: from August 2026 for a period of 6 months.

We are looking forward to your applicati

• Contribuisci a soluzioni di apprendimento che ispirano ed educano i nostri partner
• Collabora con gli esperti del settore in un ambiente di lavoro agile caratterizzato da potenziamento, comunicazione aperta e disponibilità a testare nuove idee Chi sei:
• Sei nel tuo Bachelor o Master studi nel campo dell'amministrazione aziendale, Risorse umane, Psicologia organizzativa o simili
• Idealmente, hai avuto una prima esperienza (internship precedente) in campo HR, apprendimento e/o comunicazione
• È possibile affrontare problemi complessi e sviluppare soluzioni efficaci
• Pensi creativamente, e ti piace la creazione di presentazioni efficaci, materiale di apprendimento ed esperienze
• Siete motivati a lavorare in modo indipendente in un ambiente collaborativo e dinamico e in grado di adattarsi alle diverse esigenze
• Hai un atteggiamento can-do e mentalità crescita
• Siete caratterizzati da un alto livello di competenza sociale e sono in grado di comunicare in modo efficiente in inglese Informazioni generali:
• Luogo di lavoro: Basilea, Rotkreuz, Mannheim, Penzberg
• Carico di lavoro: 40 ore/settimana o 37,5 ore/settimana in base ai requisiti di posizione Competenze necessarie:
• PowerPoint o Google Slide (richiesto)
• Fogli Excel o Google
• Strumenti di intelligenza
• Comunicazione
• Semplificazione dei concetti
• Creazione di processi, quadri
• Agile
• Creativo pensiero
• Lingua inglese La tua domanda Carica il tuo curriculum. Ricordiamo che questo tirocinio è rivolto a studenti (m/f/d) che sono attualmente iscritti per l'intero periodo dello stage o, in alternativa, a persone in un GAP-anno di un massimo di un anno (tra Bachelor e Master's studies) , dove può essere provato per iscritto a quale università / college e esattamente quando (mese/anno) entro un anno gli studi saranno proseguiti. Periodo: da agosto 2026 per un periodo di 6 mesi. Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join our innovative and purpose-driven team within PTDS Global Clinical Supply Chain Management, where we work to ensure life-changing medicines reach patients who need them the most. As a Global Clinical Materials Manager (GCMM) in our Production Enablement function, you will play a pivotal role in leading procurement and supply planning for clinical trials, driving operational excellence, and collaborating with global partners in a dynamic, inclusive environment. Together, we make a difference while optimizing quality, cost, and timely delivery of vital clinical supplies.

The Opportunity
In this role, you will have the chance to make a meaningful impact by taking on the following key responsibilities:

• Ensure seamless availability of drug products and packaging materials to meet clinical manufacturing requirements, guaranteeing timely production of investigational medical products.

• Maintain accurate master data for drug products in SAP systems, including defining, compiling, and continuously updating product-specific data and documents.

• Manage purchase orders for development, partner, and commercial drug products from both internal and external suppliers using the appropriate procurement systems.

• Lead supplier relationship management by monitoring supplier performance through KPIs, driving continuous improvements, and fostering transparent collaborations.

• Ensure batch availability and readiness of drug products and packaging materials for downstream manufacturing processes.

• Proactively identify, address, and resolve supply chain and procurement issues to ensure smooth global clinical supply operations.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an inclusive, innovative, and international environment to drive excellence in clinical supply chain management.

• Contribute to a high-performing team culture where teamwork, professional growth, and delivering impact for patients are prioritized.

Who You Are
These qualities and experiences make you an ideal candidate for this role:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences or Supply Chain Management, with experience in SAP systems and the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry as a valuable asset.

• You are a clear and professional communicator, both in writing and verbally, with excellent English skills (basic knowledge of German is a plus).

• You excel in building trustful relationships with diverse business partners, demonstrating high cultural awareness and social competence in international and cross-functional settings.

• You are a problem solver with keen attention to detail, strong decision-making abilities, and an understanding of technical systems, allowing you to quickly learn and adapt to new challenges.

• You thrive in collaborative environments and bring well-developed teamwork, negotiation, and organizational skills to complex situations.

Additional information

• The position is scheduled to start as soon as possible in Kaiseraugst with a duration of 12 months.

• This is a full-time opportunity; part-time arrangements are not possible.

Application process

• Applications need to include a CV and a motivation letter.

• To be eligible, you must provide proof of current university enrollment for the full duration of the internship or confirm that you have recently graduated (maximum 12 months prior to the start date).

• Due to regulations non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is a mandatory p

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Unisciti al nostro team innovativo e mirato all'interno di PTDS Global Clinical Supply Chain Management, dove lavoriamo per garantire che i farmaci che cambiano la vita raggiungano i pazienti che ne hanno più bisogno. In qualità di Global Clinical Materials Manager (GCMM) nella nostra funzione di Production Enablement, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nella pianificazione di approvvigionamento e fornitura leader per gli studi clinici, nella guida dell'eccellenza operativa e nella collaborazione con partner globali in un ambiente dinamico e inclusivo. Insieme, facciamo la differenza ottimizzando la qualità, il costo e la consegna tempestiva di forniture cliniche vitali. L'opportunità In questo ruolo, avrete la possibilità di avere un impatto significativo assumendo le seguenti responsabilità chiave:
• Assicurare la disponibilità senza soluzione di continuità di prodotti farmaceutici e materiali di imballaggio per soddisfare i requisiti di produzione clinica, garantendo la produzione tempestiva di prodotti medici investigativi.
• Mantenere dati master accurati per i prodotti farmaceutici nei sistemi SAP, tra cui la definizione, la compilazione e l'aggiornamento continuo dei dati e dei documenti specifici del prodotto.
• Gestire gli ordini di acquisto per lo sviluppo, partner e prodotti di droga commerciali da fornitori sia interni che esterni utilizzando i sistemi di approvvigionamento appropriati.
• Gestione dei rapporti dei fornitori leader monitorando le prestazioni dei fornitori attraverso KPI, guidando miglioramenti continui e promuovendo collaborazioni trasparenti.
• Assicurare la disponibilità di lotti e la disponibilità di prodotti farmaceutici e materiali di imballaggio per i processi produttivi a valle.
• Identificare, affrontare e risolvere i problemi della supply chain e degli appalti per garantire operazioni di approvvigionamento clinico a livello globale.
• Collabora con team interfunzionali in un ambiente inclusivo, innovativo e internazionale per guidare l'eccellenza nella gestione della supply chain clinica.
• Contribuire a una cultura di squadra altamente performante in cui il lavoro di squadra, la crescita professionale e la fornitura di impatto per i pazienti sono prioritari. Chi sei Queste qualità ed esperienze ti rendono un candidato ideale per questo ruolo:
• Hai una laurea o un master in Scienze della vita o Gestione della supply chain, con esperienza nei sistemi SAP e l'industria farmaceutica o biofarmaceutica come un bene prezioso.
• Sei un comunicatore chiaro e professionale, sia per iscritto che verbalmente, con eccellenti competenze inglesi (la conoscenza base del tedesco è un plus).
• Si eccelle nella costruzione di relazioni fiduciose con diversi partner commerciali, dimostrando alta consapevolezza culturale e competenza sociale in contesti internazionali e interfunzionali.
• Sei un risolutore di problemi con la massima attenzione ai dettagli, forti capacità decisionali e una comprensione dei sistemi tecnici, che ti permettono di imparare e adattarsi rapidamente alle nuove sfide.
• Si prospera in ambienti collaborativi e portare ben sviluppato lavoro di squadra, negoziazione e competenze organizzative a situazioni complesse. Ulteriori informazioni
• La posizione è prevista per iniziare il prima possibile a Kaiseraugst con una durata di 12 mesi.
• Si tratta di un'opportunità a tempo pieno; non sono possibili accordi a tempo parziale. Processo di applicazione
• Le domande devono includere un CV e una lettera di motivazione.
• Per essere idoneo, è necessario fornire la prova dell'iscrizione universitaria corrente per tutta la durata dello stage o confermare che si è recentemente laureato (massimo 12 mesi prima della data di inizio).
• A causa di regolamenti non UE/EFTA i cittadini devono fornire un certificato dall'università affermando che uno stage è obbligatorio p

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Treten Sie unserem innovativen und zielgerichteten Team bei PTDS Global Clinical Supply Chain Management bei, wo wir daran arbeiten, dass lebensverändernde Medikamente Patienten erreichen, die sie am dringendsten benötigen. Als Global Clinical Materials Manager (GCMM) in unserer Funktion Production Enablement spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Leitung der Beschaffungs- und Versorgungsplanung für klinische Studien, der Förderung operativer Exzellenz und der Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Partnern in einem dynamischen, integrativen Umfeld. Gemeinsam machen wir einen Unterschied bei der Optimierung von Qualität, Kosten und rechtzeitiger Lieferung von lebenswichtigen klinischen Lieferungen. Die Chance In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, einen sinnvollen Einfluss zu erzielen, indem Sie die folgenden Schlüsselverantwortungen übernehmen:
• Gewährleistung einer nahtlosen Verfügbarkeit von Arzneimitteln und Verpackungsmaterialien, um die klinischen Herstellungsanforderungen zu erfüllen, und Gewährleistung einer rechtzeitigen Herstellung von Prüfpräparaten.
• Pflegen Sie genaue Stammdaten für Arzneimittel in SAP-Systemen, einschließlich der Definition, Zusammenstellung und kontinuierlichen Aktualisierung produktspezifischer Daten und Dokumente.
• Verwalten Sie Bestellungen für Entwicklungs-, Partner- und kommerzielle Arzneimittelprodukte von internen und externen Lieferanten mit den entsprechenden Beschaffungssystemen.
• Führen Sie das Lieferantenbeziehungsmanagement, indem Sie die Lieferantenleistung durch KPIs überwachen, kontinuierliche Verbesserungen vorantreiben und transparente Kooperationen fördern.
• Gewährleistung der Chargenverfügbarkeit und -bereitschaft von Arzneimitteln und Verpackungsmaterialien für nachgelagerte Herstellungsprozesse.
• Proaktive Identifizierung, Adressierung und Lösung von Lieferketten- und Beschaffungsproblemen, um einen reibungslosen globalen klinischen Versorgungsbetrieb sicherzustellen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams in einem integrativen, innovativen und internationalen Umfeld zusammen, um Exzellenz im klinischen Lieferkettenmanagement zu fördern.
• Tragen Sie zu einer leistungsstarken Teamkultur bei, in der Teamarbeit, berufliches Wachstum und die Bereitstellung von Auswirkungen für Patienten Priorität haben. Wer du bist Diese Qualitäten und Erfahrungen machen Sie zu einem idealen Kandidaten für diese Rolle:
• Sie haben einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Life Sciences oder Supply Chain Management mit Erfahrung in SAP-Systemen und der pharmazeutischen oder biopharmazeutischen Industrie als wertvolles Gut.
• Sie sind ein klarer und professioneller Kommunikator, sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich, mit hervorragenden Englischkenntnissen (Grundkenntnisse in Deutsch sind ein Plus).
• Sie zeichnen sich durch den Aufbau vertrauensvoller Beziehungen zu verschiedenen Geschäftspartnern aus und zeigen ein hohes kulturelles Bewusstsein und soziale Kompetenz in internationalen und funktionsübergreifenden Umgebungen.
• Sie sind ein Problemlöser mit viel Liebe zum Detail, starken Entscheidungsfähigkeiten und einem Verständnis für technische Systeme, so dass Sie schnell lernen und sich an neue Herausforderungen anpassen können.
• Sie gedeihen in kollaborativen Umgebungen und bringen gut entwickelte Teamarbeit, Verhandlungs- und Organisationsfähigkeiten in komplexe Situationen ein. Zusätzliche Angaben
• Die Position soll so bald wie möglich in Kaiseraugst mit einer Laufzeit von 12 Monaten beginnen.
• Dies ist eine Vollzeitmöglichkeit; Teilzeitregelungen sind nicht möglich. Anwendungsprozess
• Bewerbungen müssen einen Lebenslauf und ein Motivationsschreiben enthalten.
• Um berechtigt zu sein, müssen Sie für die gesamte Dauer des Praktikums einen Nachweis über die aktuelle Hochschuleinschreibung vorlegen oder bestätigen, dass Sie kürzlich einen Abschluss gemacht haben (maximal 12 Monate vor dem Startdatum).
• Aufgrund von Vorschriften müssen Nicht-EU-/EFTA-Bürger ein Zertifikat der Universität vorlegen, aus dem hervorgeht, dass ein Praktikum obligatorisch ist.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Rejoignez notre équipe innovante et axée sur l'objectif au sein de PTDS Global Clinical Supply Chain Management, où nous travaillons pour garantir que les médicaments qui changent la vie atteignent les patients qui en ont le plus besoin. En tant que gestionnaire mondial des matériaux cliniques (GCMM) dans notre fonction d'activation de la production, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la planification des achats et des approvisionnements pour les essais cliniques, la conduite de l'excellence opérationnelle et la collaboration avec des partenaires mondiaux dans un environnement dynamique et inclusif. Ensemble, nous faisons une différence tout en optimisant la qualité, le coût et la livraison en temps opportun des fournitures cliniques vitales. L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la chance d'avoir un impact significatif en assumant les responsabilités clés suivantes :
• Assurer une disponibilité transparente des produits pharmaceutiques et des matériaux d'emballage pour répondre aux exigences de fabrication clinique, en garantissant la production en temps opportun de produits médicaux expérimentaux.
• Tenir à jour des données de référence précises sur les produits pharmaceutiques dans les systèmes SAP, y compris la définition, la compilation et la mise à jour continue des données et des documents propres aux produits.
• Gérer les bons de commande pour le développement, les produits pharmaceutiques partenaires et commerciaux de fournisseurs internes et externes en utilisant les systèmes d'approvisionnement appropriés.
• Diriger la gestion des relations avec les fournisseurs en surveillant la performance des fournisseurs grâce aux ICR, en favorisant des améliorations continues et en favorisant des collaborations transparentes.
• Assurer la disponibilité et la disponibilité des lots de produits pharmaceutiques et de matériaux d'emballage pour les procédés de fabrication en aval.
• Identifier, traiter et résoudre de façon proactive les problèmes liés à la chaîne d'approvisionnement et à l'approvisionnement afin d'assurer la fluidité des opérations d'approvisionnement clinique à l'échelle mondiale.
• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles dans un environnement inclusif, innovateur et international pour stimuler l'excellence dans la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement clinique.
• Contribuer à une culture d'équipe performante où le travail d'équipe, la croissance professionnelle et l'impact pour les patients sont prioritaires. Qui vous êtes Ces qualités et expériences font de vous un candidat idéal pour ce rôle :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en sciences de la vie ou gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, avec une expérience dans les systèmes SAP et l'industrie pharmaceutique ou biopharmaceutique comme un atout précieux.
• Vous êtes un communicateur clair et professionnel, à la fois par écrit et verbalement, avec d'excellentes compétences en anglais (la connaissance de base de l'allemand est un plus).
• Vous excellez dans l'établissement de relations de confiance avec divers partenaires commerciaux, démontrant une grande sensibilisation culturelle et une compétence sociale dans des contextes internationaux et interfonctionnels.
• Vous êtes un résolveur de problèmes avec une attention particulière au détail, de fortes capacités de décision, et une compréhension des systèmes techniques, vous permettant d'apprendre rapidement et de s'adapter aux nouveaux défis.
• Vous prospèrez dans des environnements de collaboration et apportez des compétences bien développées en travail d'équipe, en négociation et en organisation à des situations complexes. Informations complémentaires
• Le poste devrait commencer dès que possible à Kaiseraugst avec une durée de 12 mois.
• Il s'agit d'une occasion à plein temps; les arrangements à temps partiel ne sont pas possibles. Processus de demande
• Les demandes doivent comprendre un CV et une lettre de motivation.
• Pour être admissible, vous devez fournir la preuve de l'inscription actuelle à l'université pour toute la durée du stage ou confirmer que vous avez récemment obtenu votre diplôme (maximum 12 mois avant la date de début).
• En raison de la réglementation non-UE/AELE les citoyens doivent fournir un certificat de l'université indiquant qu'un stage est obligatoire p
