Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Die Position Das Physical Compute-Team liefert eine intelligente, passgenaue Bare-Metal-Infrastruktur, die nahtlos in das Roche-Ökosystem integriert ist. Das Produkt zentralisiert und vereinfacht die Bereitstellung der physischen Recheninfrastruktur in unseren globalen Rechenzentren, Computerräumen und kleinen Standorten. Wir bieten ein End-to-End-Lifecycle-Management – von der Bereitstellung und Hardwarevorbereitung bis hin zur Wartung und automatisierten Stilllegung – und gewährleisten Zuverlässigkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Compliance für Workloads, die höchste Standards erfordern. Wir verwalten Tausende von Servern in globalen Rechenzentren sowohl für Unternehmens- als auch für wissenschaftliche Workloads. Wir suchen eine hoch motivierte Person für die Position des Physical Compute Engineers. In dieser Rolle leiten Sie technisch anspruchsvolle Aktivitäten, treffen kritische technische Entscheidungen und erstellen belastbare Lösungen in verschiedenen Bereichen. Hauptzuständigkeiten:
• Überwachen Sie den gesamten Compute-Hardware-Lebenszyklus - einschließlich Dimensionierungsberatung, Angebotserstellung, Einkauf, Backlog-Tracking und physische Installation bis hin zur Systemkonnektivität, um sicherzustellen, dass Prozesse effizient und optimiert sind.
• Führen Sie physische Computer-Engineering-Standards und Automatisierung voran, um manuelle Eingriffe in alle physischen Computer-Assets zu minimieren. Führen Sie das End-to-End-Design, den Build und die Implementierung integrierter, belastbarer physikalischer Compute-Lösungen in verschiedenen Compute-Aromen.
• Funktionale Koordination mit Value-Streams, Netzwerk-, Betriebssystem- und Automatisierungsteams sowie Datacenter-Mitarbeitern und -Anbietern in Bezug auf Lieferung und strategische Planung
• Stakeholder-Management: Handeln Sie als wichtiger technischer Berater und übersetzen Sie komplexe Kundenbedürfnisse in Standardlösungen. Kommuniziert und präsentiert regelmäßig komplexe Informationen, Probleme und mögliche Lösungen zu Projekten, funktionsübergreifenden Teams und dem Unternehmen in nicht-technischer Hinsicht. Bietet Anleitungen für hochrangige interne/externe Stakeholder zu relevanten technischen Fragen.
• Demonstrierte Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und Tiefe des Wissens, um die Produktbewertungen von IT-Infrastrukturanbietern und Empfehlungen für Verbesserungen beeinflussen zu können. Führen Sie die Vendor-Governance mit wichtigen Hardware-Partnern (wie HPE und Lenovo), verwalten Sie operative Reviews, SLAs, KPIs und den Lebenszyklus von physischen Computerwartungsverträgen (Erneuerungen, Support-Stufen und Compliance).
• Bewerten Sie neue Technologien im physischen Rechenbereich über PoCs und stellen Sie sicher, dass die gesamte Infrastruktur mit dem Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) von Roche und den Qualitäts- / Regulierungsstandards übereinstimmt.
• Schätzen Sie Engineering-Ressourcen, -Risiken und -Zeitpläne für komplexe Initiativen ab und bieten Sie gleichzeitig Unterstützung bei der Eskalation auf hoher Ebene, um wichtige operative Vorfälle zu lösen. Qualifikationen: Bildung:
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Systemanalyse oder einer verwandten Studie oder gleichwertige Erfahrung. Erfahrung:
• 7-10 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in Hardware Engineering & Operations, Rechenzentrumsinfrastruktur oder Systemadministration.
• Praxiserfahrung in folgenden Bereichen/Technologien:
• Physische Infrastruktur Management & Integration Erfahrung mit dem physischen Angebot von großen Enterprise Data Center Compute Anbieter wie HPE, Lenovo, NVIDIA..
• Erfahrung mit Enterprise HW Management Tools, speziell HPE OneView und Lenovo XClarity.
• Wissen und Erfahrung mit dem Compute-Angebot für Hyperconverge, High Performance Computing (HPC), AICompute HW (NVIDIA-Lösungen). HPE Synergy Frame Management, HPE ProLiant Compute, GB 300
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position La position L'équipe Physical Compute fournit une infrastructure de métaux nus intelligente et adaptée à l'usage intégré de façon transparente dans l'écosystème de Roche. Le produit centralise et simplifie la livraison de l'infrastructure de calcul physique dans nos centres de données mondiaux, salles d'ordinateurs et petits sites. Nous offrons une gestion du cycle de vie de bout en bout – de la fourniture et de la préparation du matériel à la maintenance et au déclassement automatisé – afin d'assurer la fiabilité, l'évolutivité et la conformité des charges de travail qui exigent les normes les plus élevées. Nous gérons des milliers de serveurs à travers les centres de données mondiaux pour les charges de travail tant d'entreprise que scientifique. Nous recherchons une personne très motivée pour le poste d'ingénieur en calcul physique. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez techniquement des activités difficiles, prendrez des décisions techniques critiques et créerez des solutions résilientes dans plusieurs domaines. Principales responsabilités :
• Surveiller l'ensemble du cycle de vie du matériel informatique, y compris les services de conseil en taille, la création de devis, les achats, le suivi des retards et l'installation physique jusqu'à la connectivité du système, en veillant à ce que les processus soient efficaces et optimisés.
• Conduire les normes de calcul physique et l'automatisation pour minimiser l'intervention manuelle sur tous les actifs de calcul physique. Dirigez la conception, la construction et la mise en œuvre de solutions de calcul physique intégrées et résilientes dans différentes saveurs de calcul.
• Coordination interfonctionnelle avec les flux de valeur, les équipes Réseau, OS et Automation, ainsi que le personnel de Datacenter et les fournisseurs sur la livraison et la planification stratégique
• Gestion des intervenants : agir comme conseiller technique clé, traduire les besoins complexes des clients en solutions standard. Communiquer et présenter régulièrement des informations complexes, des questions et des solutions potentielles sur les projets, aux équipes interfonctionnelles et à l'entreprise en termes non techniques. Fournir des conseils aux principaux intervenants internes et externes sur les questions techniques pertinentes.
• Compétences démontrées, expérience et profondeur des connaissances pour pouvoir influencer les évaluations des produits des fournisseurs d'infrastructure de TI et les recommandations d'amélioration. Diriger la gouvernance des fournisseurs avec les principaux partenaires du matériel (comme HPE et Lenovo), gérer les examens opérationnels, les SLA, les KPI et le cycle de vie des contrats de maintenance de calcul physique (renouvellements, niveaux de soutien et conformité).
• Évaluer les technologies émergentes dans le domaine du calcul physique par l'intermédiaire des PdC, tout en veillant à ce que toutes les infrastructures s'harmonisent avec le cadre d'architecture technique de Roche et les normes de qualité/réglementation.
• Estimer les ressources techniques, les risques et les délais pour les initiatives complexes, tout en fournissant un appui d'escalade de haut niveau pour résoudre les principaux incidents opérationnels. Qualifications Éducation:
• Baccalauréat en informatique, analyse de systèmes ou une étude connexe, ou expérience équivalente. Expérience :
• 7-10 ans d'expérience pertinente dans le domaine de l'ingénierie matérielle et des opérations, de l'infrastructure des centres de données ou de l'administration des systèmes.
• Expérience pratique dans les domaines/technologies suivants:
• Infrastructure physique Gestion et intégration expérience de travail avec l'offre physique de grands fournisseurs de données d'entreprise Compute tels que HPE, Lenovo, NVIDIA..
• Expérience avec les outils de gestion d'entreprise HW, en particulier HPE OneView et Lenovo XClarity.
• Connaissance et expérience avec l'offre de calcul pour hyperconverge, calcul haute performance (HPC), AICompute HW (solutions NVIDIA). Par exemple: HPE Synergy Frame management, HPE ProLiant Compute, GB 300

jobs.title: IT Infrastructure Engineer - Physical Compute
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The position

The Physical Compute team delivers intelligent, fit-for-purpose bare-metal infrastructure integrated seamlessly into the Roche ecosystem. The product centralizes and simplifies the delivery of Physical compute infrastructure across our global data centers, computer rooms, and small sites. We provide end-to-end lifecycle management—from provisioning and hardware preparation to maintenance and automated decommissioning—ensuring reliability, scalability, and compliance for workloads that demand the highest standards. We manage thousands of servers across global data centers for both, enterprise and scientific workloads.

We are looking for a highly motivated individual for the position of Physical Compute Engineer. In this role, you will technically lead challenging activities, make critical technical decisions, and architect resilient solutions across multiple domains.

Key responsibilities:

• Oversee the entire compute hardware lifecycle—including sizing consultancy, quotation creation, purchasing, backlog tracking, and physical installation up to system connectivity ensuring processes are efficient and optimized.

• Drive physical compute engineering standards and automation to minimize manual intervention across all physical compute assets. Lead the end-to-end design, build, and implementation of integrated, resilient physical compute solutions across various compute flavors.

• Cross-Functional Coordination with Value streams, Network, OS, and Automation teams, as well as Datacenter staff and vendors on delivery and strategic planning

• Stakeholder management: act as a key technical advisor, translating complex customer needs into standard solutions. Communicates and presents complex information, issues and potential solutions on a regular basis on projects, to cross-functional teams and the business in non-technical terms. Provides guidance to senior internal/external stakeholders on relevant technical matters.

• Demonstrated skills, experience and depth of knowledge to be able to influence IT Infrastructure vendor product evaluations and recommendations for improvements. Lead vendor governance with key hardware partners (such as HPE and Lenovo), managing operational reviews, SLAs, KPIs, and the lifecycle of physical compute maintenance contracts (renewals, support tiers, and compliance).

• Evaluate emerging technologies in the physical compute scope via PoCs, while ensuring all infrastructure aligns with Roche's Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) and Quality/Regulatory standards.

• Estimate engineering resources, risks, and timelines for complex initiatives, while providing high-level escalation support to resolve major operational incidents.

Qualifications:
Education:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, systems analysis or a related study, or equivalent experience.

Experience:

• 7-10 years of relevant experience in hardware Engineering&Operations, data center infrastructure, or systems administration.

• Hands-on experience in the following areas/technologies:

• Physical infrastructure management&integration experience working with the physical offering from major Enterprise Data Center Compute vendors such as HPE, Lenovo, NVIDIA..

• Experience with Enterprise HW management tools, specifically HPE OneView and Lenovo XClarity.

• Knowledge and experience with Compute offering for hyperconverge, High performance computing (HPC), AICompute HW (NVIDIA solutions). E.g.: HPE Synergy Frame management, HPE ProLiant Compute, GB 300

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La posizione Il team Physical Compute offre un'infrastruttura intelligente e fit-for-purpose bare-metal integrata perfettamente nell'ecosistema Roche. Il prodotto centralizza e semplifica la consegna dell'infrastruttura di elaborazione fisica attraverso i nostri data center globali, sale computer e piccoli siti. Forniamo la gestione end-to-end del ciclo di vita, dal provisioning e dalla preparazione hardware alla manutenzione e al decommissioning automatizzato, garantendo affidabilità, scalabilità e conformità ai carichi di lavoro che richiedono i più elevati standard. Gestiamo migliaia di server in centri di dati globali sia per i carichi di lavoro aziendali che scientifici. Stiamo cercando un individuo altamente motivato per la posizione di Physical Compute Engineer. In questo ruolo, sarete tecnicamente condurre attività impegnative, prendere decisioni tecniche critiche, e architetto soluzioni resilient in più domini. Responsabilità chiave:
• Superare l'intero ciclo di vita dell'hardware di elaborazione, tra cui consulenza di dimensionamento, creazione di quote, acquisto, monitoraggio del backlog e installazione fisica fino alla connettività del sistema assicurando processi efficienti e ottimizzati.
• Guidare gli standard di ingegneria della computazione fisica e l'automazione per minimizzare l'intervento manuale in tutti i beni di calcolo fisico. Condurre il design end-to-end, la costruzione e l'implementazione di soluzioni di elaborazione fisica integrata e resiliente attraverso vari gusti di calcolo.
• Cross-Functional Coordination con flussi di valore, team di rete, OS e Automation, nonché personale e fornitori Datacenter sulla consegna e pianificazione strategica
• Gestione degli stakeholder: fungere da consulente tecnico chiave, traducendo complesse esigenze dei clienti in soluzioni standard. Comunica e presenta informazioni complesse, questioni e soluzioni potenziali su base regolare su progetti, a team interfunzionali e il business in termini non tecnici. Fornisce una guida agli stakeholder interni/esterni senior su questioni tecniche rilevanti.
• Competenze dimostrate, esperienza e profondità di conoscenza per poter influenzare le valutazioni dei prodotti e le raccomandazioni dei fornitori di infrastrutture IT per i miglioramenti. Lead vendor governance con i principali partner hardware (come HPE e Lenovo), gestione delle recensioni operative, SLA, KPI, e il ciclo di vita dei contratti di manutenzione della computazione fisica (renewals, supporto e conformità).
• Valutare le tecnologie emergenti nel campo della computazione fisica tramite PoCs, assicurando al contempo tutte le infrastrutture si allineano con Roche's Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) e Quality/Regulatory standards.
• Valutare le risorse ingegneristiche, i rischi e le tempistiche per le iniziative complesse, fornendo al tempo stesso un supporto di escalation di alto livello per risolvere importanti incidenti operativi. Qualifiche: Istruzione:
• Laurea in informatica, analisi dei sistemi o uno studio relativo, o esperienza equivalente. Esperienza:
• 7-10 anni di esperienza rilevante in ingegneria dell'hardware e operazioni, infrastruttura del data center o amministrazione dei sistemi.
• Esperienza pratica nelle seguenti aree/tecnologie:
• Esperienza di gestione e integrazione delle infrastrutture fisiche che lavorano con l'offerta fisica dei principali fornitori Enterprise Data Center Compute come HPE, Lenovo, NVIDIA.
• Esperienza con gli strumenti di gestione HW Enterprise, in particolare HPE OneView e Lenovo XClarity.
• Conoscenza ed esperienza con l'offerta Compute per iperconverge, High Performance computing (HPC), AICompute HW (soluzioni VIDIA). Ad esempio: HPE Synergy Frame management, HPE ProLiant Compute, GB 300

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Um futuro mais saudável. Isso é o que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso aos cuidados de saúde de que precisam hoje e para as gerações futuras. Criar um mundo onde todos temos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. Isso é o que nos faz ser a Roche.

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar na liderança e condução operacional de estudos de Medical Affairs (Geração de Evidências), servindo como o ponto focal para a garantia de qualidade, conformidade regulatória e eficiência orçamentária dos projetos. Este profissional será a peça-chave para coordenar equipes interfuncionais e gerenciar o relacionamento e entregas de fornecedores e centros de pesquisa (sites). O/A candidato(a) ideal deve unir uma forte capacidade de gestão de projetos e controle financeiro a um rigoroso entendimento das regulamentações de pesquisa, buscando constantemente a mitigação de riscos e a prontidão para auditorias.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Atuar como ponto focal no mapeamento de gaps de evidências junto ao time de estratégia médica, facilitando a discussão e a construção de business cases para novas soluções de acesso inovadoras.

• Liderar as atividades dos estudos de Medical Affairs desde a ativação até o encerramento clínico, incluindo viabilidade, seleção de sites, recrutamento/retenção de pacientes e manutenção de suprimentos de medicamentos.

• Supervisionar o desempenho de terceiros, garantindo o cumprimento de cronogramas, orçamentos, procedimentos operacionais e treinamentos aplicáveis, além de coordenar ações preventivas e corretivas.

• Elaborar, monitorar e manter os orçamentos dos estudos, assegurando a acurácia entre o planejado e o executado, além de revisar e negociar ordens de serviço e contratos com centros e parceiros.

• Assegurar a estrita adesão dos projetos às diretrizes locais e globais (ICH GCP/GVP/GPP) e documentações processuais da Roche, garantindo a prontidão para inspeções a qualquer momento.

• Formar e guiar equipes de estudo eficientes, garantindo o alinhamento de responsabilidades entre os membros das afiliadas e participando ativamente de fóruns e comitês globais/regionais.

• Comentar planos, sistemas e métricas dos estudos rigorosamente atualizados, garantindo o arquivamento correto da documentação e contribuindo para o pilar de Data Generation.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa na área da Saúde (Farmácia, Biologia, Biomedicina, Enfermagem) ou áreas correlatas.

• Sólido conhecimento e experiência prática em Geração de Evidências como competência principal (incluindo gestão de Programas de Acesso e implementação de estudos de Medical Affairs).

• Vivência próxima à área de Estratégia Médica e proximidade na atuação com gerentes médicos, com foco na avaliação de gaps de evidências.

• Experiência robusta na condução operacional e gerenciamento de processos de estudos de Medical Affairs, bem como na gestão de terceiros (vendors/CROs) envolvidos.

• Inglês avançado (mandatório), com excelente fluência e segurança para participar ativamente de discussões, alinhamentos e tomadas de decisão junto ao time Global.

• Domínio de Excel voltado para orçamentos (budgets) de projetos.

• Capacidade demonstrada de navegar com independência, autonomia e forte habilidade de comunicação interfuncional com múltiplos stakeholders.

• Conhecimento das regulamentações que regem as atividades de pesquisa e documentações locais/globais (ICH GCP, GVP e GPP).

• Modelo de Trabalho: Contrato híbrido (3x por semana no escrit

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions :
L'ingénieur(e) Service & Maintenance réalise les installations (& désinstallation) , les maintenances préventives, curatives et correctives chez les clients sur l’ensemble du portfolio de Roche .

Localisation idéale: Paris - Ile de France

Responsabilités principales :

• Piloter l'installation, la pré-installation, la validation technique et le transfert des équipements.

• Garantir la continuité de service des systèmes via des interventions de maintenance préventives et curatives efficaces.

• Réaliser les mises à niveau logicielles et matérielles (retrofits) ainsi que les désinstallations.

• Assurer un reporting précis de l'activité dans le strict respect des standards QSE.

• Piloter la mise à niveau continue de vos connaissances techniques.

Qui vous êtes:

• Compétences multi techniques : électricité, hydraulique, mécanique, robotique et électronique.

• Fort sens de la relation client, adaptabilité et sens aigu du service.

• Maîtrise éprouvée des outils et techniques de résolution de problèmes.

• Anglais technique opérationnel

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Account Executive - Core Lab

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
This is a Capital Equipment Sales Role. Responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories. Typically responsible for medium to large accounts or have a medium to large quota/territory. Must develop customer prospects and create and maintain relationships with decision makers. Contacts/visits existing and potential customers. Minimum of 10 to 15 in person sales calls per week required in assigned territory, both existing and prospects. Able to do overnights as needed. Works to build and maintain a network of colleagues, partners, and customers to share information and obtain prospects. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers. Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of product line and have a more in-depth knowledge of other products or services. A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of the area of the clinical laboratory. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is a fully qualified, career-oriented position. Has a complete knowledge of company products and services. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in their own area of expertise. Responsible for selling the company's products or services, developing new accounts and/or expanding existing accounts. Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments. Responsible for maintaining existing business and work in ways that will ensure sales goals, achievements and growth.

This is a field-based role covering Philadelphia, southern New Jersey and Delaware. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the territory.

Job Facts

• Contacts new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted (hospital and reference laboratory) accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche (chemistry, immunoassay and automation) products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• Conducts and organizes necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency.

Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità Questo è un ruolo di vendita attrezzature capitale. Reti con personale interno ed esterno senior nella propria area di competenza. Responsabile della vendita dei prodotti o servizi dell'azienda, dello sviluppo di nuovi conti e/o dell'espansione dei conti esistenti. Normalmente riceve piccole istruzioni sul lavoro quotidiano, istruzioni generali su nuovi incarichi. Responsabile per il mantenimento di business e lavoro esistenti in modi che garantiranno obiettivi di vendita, risultati e crescita. Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo che copre Philadelphia, New Jersey meridionale e Delaware. I candidati devono risiedere entro 50 miglia del territorio. Fatti di lavoro
• Contatti nuovi e già esistenti clienti per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati (ospedale e laboratorio di riferimento), sviluppando nuove attività, crescendo business esistente, mantenendo le relazioni con i clienti e la risoluzione dei problemi dei clienti. Ciò include l'individuazione e lo sviluppo di piani di conto strategici, lo sviluppo e la fornitura del messaggio differenziante e del valore economico quantificabile per prodotti e servizi, la vendita della differenziazione primaria dei prodotti Roche (chimica, immunoassay e automazione), il superamento e la gestione delle obiezioni e la negoziazione per ottenere vendite.

• Genera la domanda e massimizza la consapevolezza del prodotto lavorando con e fornendo istruzione e informazioni ai clienti (diagnosi di laboratorio).

Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. This is the reason why we are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office day/week on average).
We are conducting web-based interviews.

What we do:
The Record to Report Department, often abbreviated as R2R department provides financial services for more than 130 affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Finance and Accounting (General Ledger Accounting, Management Accounting) and Supply Chain Finance. The department is constantly expanding since our main goal is to perform end-to-end accounting activities in the near future.

Your day to day responsibilities are:
As an Accounting Intern you will execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level.
As a qualified expert, you:

• Process General Ledger bookings (and any other local request)

• Clear customer and GL accounts

• Contribute to month-end closing tasks

• Provide help of other team members in need of assistance due to workload

• Assist in investigating account discrepancies involving inventory, variances, and allowances

• Gain practical, real-world exposure to enterprise-level financial systems within a shared services environment

What can you bring to our team:
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Ongoing university studies in the field of Economics - specialized in Accounting

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Available for 25-30 hours per week

• Customer focused mindset

• Proactive mindset

• Proficiency in English

• A solid academic foundation in accounting and finance principles (GAAP or IFRS)

• Proficient with spreadsheet applications and standard office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, G-Suite)

• Bonus Points: Prior exposure to ERP systems (such as SAP modules like FI, CO/PA, MM, PP) or financial close software

In exchange we provide you with:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Young and dynamic environment

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role after graduation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Act as the IT Expert and Consultant for the SAP S/4HANA & MDG – Material Master Data Global Template team, leading the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Global Template. In this role, you will be accountable for defining and governing Material Master data standards, ensuring data quality, lineage, and metadata accuracy across the organization. You will drive and enforce data governance policies, support data stewardship programs, and collaborate closely with business and technical stakeholders to align data definitions, resolve data issues, and ensure compliance with internal and external requirements. By combining deep SAP S/4HANA & MDG expertise with strong data management and governance capabilities, you will play a key role in building a trusted, scalable, and well-managed Material Master data environment that enables high-quality decision-making and operational excellence.

Description of the area

• Act as the IT Expert and Consultant for the SAP S/4HANA & MDG – Material Master Data Global Template team, leading the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Global Template.

• Leads, develops, and enforces data governance policies. Works independently on specific governance projects to ensure organizational alignment and data integrity.

• Responsible for process design, configuration, testing assistance, requirements gathering, and establishing a fully functional MDG environment.

• Execute hands-on functional responsibilities, including requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, solution design, system configuration, and testing.

• Partner closely with Business Product, Process, and Content owners to plan and execute strategic enhancements to the Global Template solution.

• Collaborate with Enterprise Architects, Solution Architects, and Product Owners to create detailed technical architecture patterns for master data initiatives.

• Distribute and coordinate deliverables across cross-functional IT teams (such as Build and Test factories), ensuring on-time delivery and adherence to quality standards.

• Conduct feasibility studies and process design reviews specifically for the SAP S/4HANA / MDG – Material Master Data solution.

• Coordinate all SAP S/4HANA / MDG – Material Master Data dependencies—including data migration, harmonization, and IT integration—while ensuring strict alignment with global template principles.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Addresses big data governance issues. Implements and maintains robust governance standards and practices to proactively resolve compliance challenges.

• Stakeholder Management:

• Partner with business stakeholders to develop innovative solutions addressing business challenges and opportunities.

• Collaborates extensively with various departments to ensure compliance.

• Communicates effectively and clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to build trust and alignment.

• Impact/Strategy: Handles big-sized data governance projects. Develops and executes strategies that significantly improve data quality and overall organizational compliance.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Oversees more complex data governance systems. Ensures critical data integrity and security across multiple business units.

Description de la zone Responsabilités professionnelles
• Portée / ( Leadership du contenu) :
• Agissez en tant qu'expert en TI et consultant pour l'équipe SAP S/4HANA & OMD – Material Master Data Global Template, dirigeant la conception, la mise en œuvre et l'amélioration continue du modèle global.
• Diriger, élaborer et appliquer des politiques de gouvernance des données. Travaille de façon indépendante sur des projets de gouvernance spécifiques pour assurer l'alignement organisationnel et l'intégrité des données.
• Responsable de la conception des processus, de la configuration, de la mise à l'essai de l'aide, de la collecte des besoins et de la mise en place d'un environnement pleinement fonctionnel pour les OMD.
• Exécuter des responsabilités fonctionnelles pratiques, y compris la collecte des exigences, l'analyse de l'ajustement, la conception de la solution, la configuration du système et les essais.
• S'associer étroitement avec les propriétaires de produits, de procédés et de contenus pour planifier et exécuter des améliorations stratégiques à la solution Global Template.
• Collaborez avec Enterprise Architects, Solutions Architects et Product Owners pour créer des modèles d'architecture technique détaillés pour les initiatives de master data.
• Distribuer et coordonner les produits livrables entre les équipes de TI interfonctionnelles (comme les usines de construction et d'essai), assurer la livraison en temps voulu et le respect des normes de qualité.
• Effectuer des études de faisabilité et des examens de la conception des processus spécifiquement pour la solution SAP S/4HANA / OMD – Master Data.
• Coordonner toutes les dépendances SAP S/4HANA / OMD – Matériel Master Data – y compris la migration des données, l'harmonisation et l'intégration des technologies de l'information – tout en assurant un alignement strict sur les principes du modèle mondial.

• Collabore étroitement avec divers ministères pour assurer la conformité.
• Communiquer efficacement et clairement avec les intervenants techniques et non techniques afin d'instaurer la confiance et l'alignement.
• Impact/Stratégie : gère des projets de grande envergure en matière de gouvernance des données. Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies qui améliorent considérablement la qualité des données et la conformité organisationnelle globale.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Account Executive - Core Lab

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity

This is a Capital Equipment Sales Role. Responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories. Typically responsible for medium to large accounts or have a medium to large quota/territory. Must develop customer prospects and create and maintain relationships with decision makers. Contacts/visits existing and potential customers. Minimum of 10 to 15 in person sales calls per week required in assigned territory, both existing and prospects. Able to do overnights as needed. Works to build and maintain a network of colleagues, partners, and customers to share information and obtain prospects. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers. Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of product line and have a more in-depth knowledge of other products or services. A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of the area of the clinical laboratory. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is a fully qualified, career-oriented position. Has a complete knowledge of company products and services. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in their own area of expertise. Responsible for selling the company's products or services, developing new accounts and/or expanding existing accounts. Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments. Responsible for maintaining existing business and work in ways that will ensure sales goals, achievements and growth.

This is a field-based role covering the Greater Boston area. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the territory.

Job Facts

• Contacts new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted (hospital and reference laboratory) accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche (chemistry, immunoassay and automation) products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• Minimum of 10 to 15 in person sales calls per week

• Generates demand and maximizes product awareness by working with and providing education and information to (laboratory diagnostics) customers.

• Implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate (capital equipment) sales process and productivity.

• Works with others, as needed or required, to prepare (reagent and capital equipment) proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• Conducts and organizes necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Account Executive - Core Lab Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità Questo è un ruolo di vendita attrezzature capitale. Responsabile per la riunione e il superamento degli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati su territori specificati. Tipicamente responsabile per i conti medio-grandi o hanno un contingente medio-grande/territorio. Deve sviluppare le prospettive del cliente e creare e mantenere le relazioni con i decisori. Contatti/visita clienti esistenti e potenziali. Minimo di 10 a 15 in persona chiamate di vendita a settimana richiesto in territorio assegnato, sia esistente e prospettive. In grado di fare notti come necessario. Lavora per costruire e mantenere una rete di colleghi, partner e clienti per condividere informazioni e ottenere prospettive. Inoltre, la posizione richiede presentazioni di quantificazione del valore ai potenziali clienti. Deve dimostrare una conoscenza approfondita della linea di prodotto e avere una conoscenza più approfondita di altri prodotti o servizi. Un professionista esperto e esperto con una piena comprensione della zona del laboratorio clinico. Risolve una vasta gamma di problemi in modi creativi. Questo lavoro è una posizione completamente qualificata, orientata alla carriera. Ha una conoscenza completa dei prodotti e servizi aziendali. Funziona su problemi di varia portata in cui l'analisi dei dati richiede la valutazione di fattori identificabili. Dimostra buon giudizio nella scelta di metodi e tecniche per ottenere soluzioni. Reti con personale interno ed esterno senior nella propria area di competenza. Responsabile della vendita dei prodotti o servizi dell'azienda, dello sviluppo di nuovi conti e/o dell'espansione dei conti esistenti. Normalmente riceve piccole istruzioni sul lavoro quotidiano, istruzioni generali su nuovi incarichi. Responsabile per il mantenimento di business e lavoro esistenti in modi che garantiranno obiettivi di vendita, risultati e crescita. Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo che copre la zona di Greater Boston. I candidati devono risiedere entro 50 miglia del territorio. Fatti di lavoro
• Contatti nuovi e già esistenti clienti per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati (ospedale e laboratorio di riferimento), sviluppando nuove attività, crescendo business esistente, mantenendo le relazioni con i clienti e la risoluzione dei problemi dei clienti. Ciò include l'individuazione e lo sviluppo di piani di conto strategici, lo sviluppo e la fornitura del messaggio differenziante e del valore economico quantificabile per prodotti e servizi, la vendita della differenziazione primaria dei prodotti Roche (chimica, immunoassay e automazione), il superamento e la gestione delle obiezioni e la negoziazione per ottenere vendite.
• Minimo di 10 a 15 persone chiamate di vendita a settimana
• Genera la domanda e massimizza la consapevolezza del prodotto lavorando con e fornendo istruzione e informazioni ai clienti (diagnosi di laboratorio).
• Implementa iniziative strategiche e piani per facilitare (attrezzatura di capitale) il processo di vendita e la produttività.
• Lavora con altri, come necessario o richiesto, per preparare (attrezzatura di credito e capitale) proposte per i conti assegnati. Presenta tutte le proposte di contratto ai clienti per massimizzare il business complessivo e la redditività, che possono richiedere alcune trattative.
• Conduce e organizza la pianificazione e il routing del territorio necessari per l'efficienza.
• Comunica competitivo (chimica, immunoassay, middleware e laboratorio automatio

Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. L'opportunité C'est un rôle de vente d'équipement. Responsable de l'atteinte et du dépassement des objectifs de vente dans des comptes ciblés dans des territoires déterminés. Généralement responsable des comptes moyens à grands ou ayant un quota/territoire moyen à grand. Il faut développer les perspectives client et créer et maintenir des relations avec les décideurs. Contacts/visites les clients existants et potentiels. Minimum de 10 à 15 appels de vente par semaine requis sur le territoire assigné, à la fois existants et potentiels. Capable de faire la nuit au besoin. Travaille à bâtir et à maintenir un réseau de collègues, de partenaires et de clients pour partager l'information et obtenir des perspectives. En outre, la position nécessite des présentations de quantification de valeur aux clients potentiels. Doit démontrer une connaissance approfondie de la gamme de produits et avoir une connaissance plus approfondie d'autres produits ou services. Un professionnel expérimenté et expérimenté qui comprend parfaitement le domaine du laboratoire clinique. Résoudre un large éventail de questions de manière créative. Travaille sur des problèmes de portée diverse où l'analyse des données nécessite une évaluation de facteurs identifiables. Démontrer un bon jugement dans le choix des méthodes et des techniques pour obtenir des solutions. Réseaux avec des cadres supérieurs internes et externes dans leur propre domaine d'expertise. Responsable de la vente des produits ou services de l'entreprise, du développement de nouveaux comptes et/ou de l'expansion des comptes existants. Normalement peu d'instructions sur le travail quotidien, des instructions générales sur les nouvelles affectations. Responsable du maintien des activités existantes et du travail de manière à assurer les objectifs de vente, les réalisations et la croissance. Il s'agit d'un rôle sur le terrain qui couvre la région du Grand Boston. Les candidats doivent résider à moins de 50 milles du territoire. Faits sur l'emploi
• Contacts clients nouveaux et existants pour atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente dans les comptes ciblés (hôpital et laboratoire de référence), en développant de nouvelles affaires, en développant les affaires existantes, en maintenant des relations avec les clients et en dépannant les problèmes des clients. • Minimum de 10 à 15 appels de vente par semaine

• Mettre en oeuvre des initiatives et des plans stratégiques pour faciliter le processus de vente et la productivité du matériel (immobilisations).
• Travaille avec d'autres personnes, selon les besoins ou les besoins, pour préparer des propositions (réactifs et matériel d'équipement) pour les comptes attribués. Présente toutes les propositions de contrats aux clients afin de maximiser l'ensemble des activités et de la rentabilité, ce qui peut nécessiter des négociations.

• Communication compétitive (chimie, immunoessais, intergiciel et automate de laboratoire)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The People Support Solutions (PSS) department brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions.

The team supports the following countries: Italy, Israel, Greece, Croatia, Slovenia, Norway, Finland, Denmark, and Sweden.

The Opportunity:
As a People Support Team Lead, you will lead a high-performing HR operations team, ensuring efficient, customer-focused service delivery. Your role involves team leadership, workload management, coaching, and performance optimization , while continuously driving process improvements, compliance, and operational excellence.
As a qualified Leader, you are:

• Building, leading and managing a strong and collaborative team

• Building a culture of customer service within the team

• Creating a safe and positive team environment and ensuring that the team demonstrates the right mindset and attitude

• Being a role model, and facilitating people processes

• Building an engaging culture to both attract and retain top talent, coaching team members regarding their individual development and career plan

• Through frequent check-ins, ensuring that ongoing dialog occurs on the topics of Career, Capabilities, Connections and Contributions; and developing the team members’ knowledge, skills, competency, etc. in order to retain and develop talented staff

• Ensuring maintenance, ongoing development and improvements to Tier 2 platforms, ways of working, process flow, driving employee’s self-service efficiency and enabling end user behavior change

• ​ Developing and managing strong partnerships with key internal organizations and stakeholders and partnering across the business to ensure an ongoing evolution of trust, co-creation and fulfillment of their needs

• Driving continuous improvements to increase productivity, quality and service locally and globally.

​
Who you are:
We’re looking for someone who is passionate about leading with impact, driving innovation, and creating exceptional employee experiences .

• Fluency in English is essential.

• Proven Leadership – 5+ years of experience within a multinational environment, including 2+ years managing a team.

• Broad experience in a shared service center, with a proven track record of leading regional or global service delivery teams, preferably in an HR services environment (2-7 years)

• HR & Tech Savvy – Strong knowledge of Workday HR processes and CRM/Request Management Software is a plus.

• Process & Performance Mindset – Experience in streamlining operations, eliminating inefficiencies, and implementing data-driven decision-making.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in wo

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il dipartimento People Support Solutions (PSS) ha lo scopo di dare vita ai nostri colleghi in tutto il mondo con soluzioni HR integrate su misura per le loro esigenze. Siamo un team che lavora molto attentamente insieme per garantire buone relazioni con i dipendenti, anticipare le esigenze future dei nostri clienti e sviluppare proattivamente soluzioni. Il team sostiene i seguenti paesi: Italia, Israele, Grecia, Croazia, Slovenia, Norvegia, Finlandia, Danimarca e Svezia. L'opportunità: In qualità di People Support Team Lead, guiderai un team di operazioni HR altamente performante, garantendo una consegna efficiente e orientata al cliente. Il vostro ruolo coinvolge la leadership del team, la gestione del carico di lavoro, l'allenatore e l'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni, mentre guida continuamente miglioramenti del processo, la conformità e l'eccellenza operativa. Come Leader qualificato, siete:
• Costruire, guidare e gestire un team forte e collaborativo
• Costruire una cultura del servizio clienti all'interno del team
• Creare un ambiente di team sicuro e positivo e garantire che il team dimostri la giusta mentalità e atteggiamento
• Essere un modello di ruolo e facilitare i processi delle persone
• Costruire una cultura coinvolgente per attrarre e mantenere il talento superiore, allenare i membri del team per quanto riguarda il loro sviluppo individuale e il piano di carriera
• Attraverso controlli frequenti, assicurando che il dialogo continuo si verifichi sui temi di Carriera, Capacità, Connessioni e Contributi; e sviluppando le conoscenze, competenze, competenze dei membri del team, ecc al fine di mantenere e sviluppare personale di talento
• Garantire la manutenzione, lo sviluppo continuo e miglioramenti alle piattaforme Tier 2, i modi di lavorare, il flusso di processo, la guida dell'efficienza self-service del dipendente e l'attivazione del cambiamento di comportamento dell'utente finale
• Sviluppare e gestire partnership forti con le principali organizzazioni interne e stakeholder e collaborare in tutto il business per garantire una continua evoluzione della fiducia, co-creazione e soddisfazione delle loro esigenze
• Miglioramento continuo per aumentare la produttività, la qualità e il servizio a livello locale e globale. ​ Chi sei: Stiamo cercando qualcuno che è appassionato di leader con impatto, guida innovazione, e la creazione di esperienze di dipendenti eccezionali.
• La fluidità in inglese è essenziale.
• Leadership provata – 5+ anni di esperienza in un ambiente multinazionale, tra cui 2+ anni di gestione di un team.
• Ampia esperienza in un centro di assistenza condiviso, con un comprovato record di importanti team regionali o globali di assistenza, preferibilmente in un ambiente di servizi HR (2-7 anni)
• HR & Tech Savvy – Forte conoscenza dei processi HR di Workday e CRM/Request Management Software è un plus.
• Process & Performance Mindset – Esperienza nella semplificazione delle operazioni, eliminando inefficienze e implementando processi decisionali basati sui dati. In Exchange vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Noi creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà nel wo

• Aufbau einer Kultur des Kundenservice innerhalb des Teams
• Schaffung einer sicheren und positiven Teamumgebung und Sicherstellung, dass das Team die richtige Einstellung und Einstellung zeigt
• Vorbild sein und Menschenprozesse erleichtern

• Laufende Verbesserungen zur Steigerung von Produktivität, Qualität und Service auf lokaler und globaler Ebene. ​ Wer du bist: Wir suchen jemanden, der leidenschaftlich daran interessiert ist, mit Wirkung zu führen, Innovationen voranzutreiben und außergewöhnliche Mitarbeitererfahrungen zu schaffen.

• Breite Erfahrung in einem Shared Service Center mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz führender regionaler oder globaler Servicebereitstellungsteams, vorzugsweise in einer HR-Serviceumgebung (2-7 Jahre)

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Join us and make a difference for patients.

The Strategic Operating Model Partner will serve as a seasoned expert, blending deep industry knowledge with advanced consulting skills to deliver measurable business outcomes and accelerate progress in delivering medical solutions to patients worldwide.

• Expertise de l'industrie : Appliquez une compréhension experte de l'industrie pharmaceutique, y compris les moteurs de croissance, les actifs prioritaires, les paysages réglementaires et la dynamique concurrentielle.

• Innovation pragmatique : Favoriser un environnement d'apprentissage continu et d'innovation en élargissant les tactiques commerciales éprouvées, en facilitant l'apprentissage transfrontalier et en accélérant les capacités omnicanales futures à travers l'écosystème. Modèle d'exploitation Mastery & Systemic Design
• Exécution du changement stratégique : Stratégies d'architecture pour optimiser l'efficacité du modèle opérationnel et effectuer des changements organisationnels complexes, en conciliant la vision à long terme et les besoins opérationnels immédiats.
• Connectivité systémique : agir en tant que penseur systémique pour identifier les modèles et les interdépendances entre les équipes, les marchés et les régions à l'échelle mondiale, en veillant à ce que les initiatives stratégiques atteignent des résultats mesurables et agiles.
• Pont mondial-local : servir de pont pragmatique entre la stratégie mondiale et la mise en œuvre de la ligne de front, en veillant à ce que les ajustements des modèles opérationnels réduisent les frictions opérationnelles locales et tirent parti des succès régionaux existants. Influence des cadres et engagement en matière de leadership
• Partenariat de réflexion stratégique : Servir de partenaire de réflexion respecté et d'entraîneur auprès des dirigeants supérieurs, ce qui apporte de la rigueur aux discussions stratégiques et remet en question de façon constructive les décisions avec des recommandations fondées sur des données probantes.
• Facilitation des prises de vues élevées: Faciliter les discussions critiques avec précision et impact, en naviguant sans heurt sur diverses perspectives pour favoriser l'alignement et améliorer l'efficacité commerciale. Consultation Excellence et gouvernance des intervenants
• Résolution et exécution des problèmes : Appliquer des méthodes de consultation avancées et des capacités de gestion de projet pour structurer et résoudre des problèmes complexes et multifaces avec rigueur et précision.
• Conception du cadre et de l'alignement : Concevoir des cadres décisionnels solides et établir des relations de confiance entre divers intervenants afin de rationaliser la gouvernance et de maintenir l'élan du changement.
• Communication percutante : Concevoir des récits convaincants et offrir des cadres de communication à impact élevé conçus pour influencer les décideurs supérieurs.
• Intendance du rythme opérationnel : établir, gérer et maintenir des rythmes opérationnels critiques et des protocoles de rencontre pour les forums de leadership, en veillant à ce que les équipes restent concentrées sur l'extérieur

The Position
Healthcare Solutions Lead - South (based in Lisbon district)
Roche Diagnostics, Portugal

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
As an Healthcare Solutions Lead (HSL) you will be integrated into the Commercial Chapter, developing your activity in close collaboration with other chapters. With the main purpose to develop the business and position Roche as a strategic partner of choice, co-creating and contributing actively to market development, you will act as a first point of contact of the C-suite (decision makers, budget holders), service directors, procurement and laboratory management of public hospitals and private groups and other strategic stakeholders. Your main responsibilities are, but not limited to:

• Drive innovative projects by building a strong network with a broad set of stakeholders, maintaining deep knowledge of our portfolio, deep understanding of customer needs, vision and positioning, and of the market dynamics and trends.

• Actively contribute to strengthening Roche´s position in established strategic accounts, collaborating with other commercial team members and with other relevant internal stakeholders to pursue the full potential of the accounts, new business opportunities and transforming them into strategic initiatives.

• Partner with DSEs (Diagnostic Solutions Experts) to create the strategic account plans and be accountable for results achievements (P&L) in the assigned accounts, and to keep information updated in CRM and other management tools.

• Develop and lead complex negotiation processes in the assigned strategic accounts ensuring sustainable profitability

To be successful as a Healthcare Solutions Lead, the following qualifications and capabilities are required:

• You have a Master’s degree in Management, Marketing, Economics, Life Sciences or Engineering. An additional business management degree will be considered a plus.

• You are experienced in the healthcare business or related sectors, with business development and/or other commercial responsibilities.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Product Manager is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape.
Your primary objective is to lead engineering and service teams building desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards.

Description of the area

The Travel & Expense Management Product consists of a complex, integrated landscape encompassing SAP Concur (Travel, Expense, and Intelligence), SAP ECC and S/4HANA, and Snowflake for analytics and compliance reporting. You will ensure total business continuity by managing and monitoring the critical middleware and integration layers that connect these components. Beyond technical stability, the role focuses on driving value through strategic SaaS vendor management and continuous service optimization.
This position serves as a key technical enabler for the Roche OneT&E vision, understanding and supporting business strategy of standardisation, optimization of travel policies, compliance, and corporate credit card initiatives. By aligning with Business Stakeholders (RSS and Global Procurement), you will ensure the seamless delivery of T&E technology for One T&E Strategy as well as major enterprise programs, including ASPIRE and Mergers and Acquisitions. This area involves translating business efficiency programs into technical reality, ensuring all solutions are delivered with the quality and timing necessary to support global organizational goals.

Job Responsibilities

• Strategy & Vision
Accountable for setting the direction for a product and ensuring that it achieves defined outcomes and financial objectives. Defines product strategy, roadmap, and features aligned with business goals, user needs and organisational policies. Proactively integrate relevant AI capabilities into the product roadmap. Define, track, and communicate relevant KPIs for the product to measure its performance and contribution to business goals and strategy.

• Customer-Centricity
Actively collect, understand, and prioritize the needs of internal users. Act as the primary owner of the “customer's” problem and be responsible for defining and delivering a solution that provides tangible value. Define and track key metrics related to user satisfaction, engagement, and value delivery, and use this data to inform product iterations.

• Product Lifecycle Mgmt.
Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, guide its development, and manage its growth and eventual decline based on market research, customer feedback, and business goals. Manage the product in compliance with emerging regulations.

• Stakeholder Collaboration
Expand collaboration to a broader set of cross-functional teams and be responsible for aligning these teams around the product roadmap. Clearly communicate the product roadmap, timelines, and potential trade-offs to various stakeholders to manag

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Product Manager è responsabile per l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ideazione iniziale e dalla pianificazione strategica fino al lancio, alla scaling e all'eventuale pensionamento. Questo ruolo è fondamentale per trasformare le esigenze scientifiche e aziendali in soluzioni tecnologiche tangibili e ad alto valore. Sarete responsabili di definire la visione del prodotto, la strategia e la roadmap, assicurando che si allinea con gli obiettivi di overarching della nostra organizzazione e, infine, accelera la consegna di diagnostica e medicine che cambiano la vita ai pazienti. Questo ruolo richiede una combinazione distintiva di inquisitività scientifica, competenza tecnica e business insight per navigare con successo nel paesaggio. Il vostro obiettivo primario è quello di guidare team di ingegneria e servizi che costruiscono prodotti desiderabili, fattibili, fattibili e sostenibili che soddisfano le esigenze in evoluzione dei nostri utenti interni pur mantenendo una stretta conformità con gli standard del settore. Descrizione della zona Il prodotto Travel & Expense Management è costituito da un paesaggio complesso e integrato che comprende SAP Concur (Travel, Expense e Intelligence), SAP ECC e S/4HANA, e Snowflake per la reportistica di analisi e conformità. Garantirai una totale continuità aziendale gestendo e monitorando gli strati critici di middleware e integrazione che collegano questi componenti. Oltre alla stabilità tecnica, il ruolo si concentra sul valore di guida attraverso la gestione strategica dei fornitori SaaS e l'ottimizzazione continua dei servizi. Questa posizione funge da principale abilitatore tecnico per la visione Roche OneT&E, la comprensione e il supporto della strategia aziendale di standardizzazione, ottimizzazione delle politiche di viaggio, conformità e iniziative della carta di credito aziendale. Allineando con Business Stakeholders (RSS e Global Procurement), si assicurerà la fornitura senza soluzione di continuità della tecnologia T&E per One T&E Strategy così come i principali programmi aziendali, tra cui ASPIRE e Mergers e Acquisizioni. Questo settore prevede la traduzione di programmi di efficienza aziendale in realtà tecnica, assicurando che tutte le soluzioni vengano consegnate con la qualità e i tempi necessari per sostenere gli obiettivi organizzativi globali. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Strategia e visione Contabile per impostare la direzione di un prodotto e garantire che raggiunga i risultati definiti e gli obiettivi finanziari. Definisce strategia di prodotto, roadmap e caratteristiche allineate agli obiettivi aziendali, alle esigenze degli utenti e alle politiche organizzative. Integrare attivamente le capacità AI rilevanti nella roadmap del prodotto. Definire, tracciare e comunicare i KPI rilevanti per il prodotto per misurarne le prestazioni e il contributo agli obiettivi e alla strategia aziendali.
• Customer-Centricity Raccogliere, comprendere e dare priorità alle esigenze degli utenti interni. Agire come titolare principale del problema del “cliente” ed essere responsabile della definizione e della fornitura di una soluzione che fornisce valore tangibile. Definire e monitorare le metriche chiave relative alla soddisfazione dell'utente, all'impegno e alla consegna del valore, e utilizzare questi dati per informare le iterazioni del prodotto.
• ciclo di vita del prodotto Mgmt. Proprio il ciclo di vita del prodotto end-to-end, guidare il suo sviluppo, e gestire la sua crescita e l'eventuale declino basato su ricerca di mercato, feedback dei clienti e obiettivi aziendali. Gestire il prodotto nel rispetto delle normative emergenti.
• Collaborazione di Stakeholder Espandi la collaborazione a una serie più ampia di team interfunzionali e sia responsabile dell'allineamento di queste squadre intorno alla roadmap del prodotto. Comunicare chiaramente la roadmap del prodotto, le linee temporali e potenziali trade-off a vari stakeholders a manag

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Der Produktmanager ist für den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus verantwortlich, von der ersten Idee und strategischen Planung bis hin zur Einführung, Skalierung und eventuellen Pensionierung. Diese Rolle ist entscheidend für die Umwandlung wissenschaftlicher und geschäftlicher Anforderungen in greifbare, hochwertige Technologielösungen. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, die Produktvision, Strategie und Roadmap zu definieren und sicherzustellen, dass sie mit den übergreifenden Zielen unserer Organisation übereinstimmt und letztendlich die Bereitstellung lebensverändernder Diagnostika und Medikamente für Patienten beschleunigt. Diese Rolle erfordert eine unverwechselbare Kombination aus wissenschaftlicher Neugier, technischen Kenntnissen und Geschäftskenntnissen, um erfolgreich durch die Landschaft zu navigieren. Ihr primäres Ziel ist es, Engineering- und Serviceteams bei der Entwicklung wünschenswerter, machbarer, tragfähiger und nachhaltiger Produkte zu unterstützen, die den sich entwickelnden Bedürfnissen unserer internen Benutzer gerecht werden und gleichzeitig die strikte Einhaltung der relevanten Industriestandards gewährleisten. Beschreibung des Gebiets Das Travel & Expense Management Produkt besteht aus einer komplexen, integrierten Landschaft, die SAP Concur (Travel, Expense, and Intelligence), SAP ECC und S/4HANA sowie Snowflake für Analysen und Compliance-Reporting umfasst. Sie gewährleisten die vollständige Geschäftskontinuität durch die Verwaltung und Überwachung der kritischen Middleware- und Integrationsebenen, die diese Komponenten verbinden. Über die technische Stabilität hinaus konzentriert sich die Rolle auf die Wertschöpfung durch strategisches SaaS-Anbietermanagement und kontinuierliche Serviceoptimierung. Diese Position ist ein wichtiger technischer Wegbereiter für die Vision von Roche OneT & E, das Verständnis und die Unterstützung der Geschäftsstrategie der Standardisierung, Optimierung von Reiserichtlinien, Compliance und Kreditkarteninitiativen von Unternehmen. Durch die Abstimmung mit Business Stakeholders (RSS und Global Procurement) stellen Sie die nahtlose Bereitstellung der T & E-Technologie für One T & E Strategy sowie wichtige Unternehmensprogramme, einschließlich ASPIRE und Mergers and Acquisitions, sicher. Dieser Bereich beinhaltet die Übersetzung von Geschäftseffizienzprogrammen in die technische Realität, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Lösungen mit der Qualität und dem Timing geliefert werden, die erforderlich sind, um globale Organisationsziele zu unterstützen. Aufgabenbereich
• Strategie & Vision Verantwortlich dafür, die Richtung für ein Produkt festzulegen und sicherzustellen, dass es definierte Ergebnisse und finanzielle Ziele erreicht. Definiert Produktstrategie, Roadmap und Funktionen, die auf Geschäftsziele, Benutzeranforderungen und Organisationsrichtlinien ausgerichtet sind. Proaktive Integration relevanter KI-Fähigkeiten in die Produkt-Roadmap. Definieren, verfolgen und kommunizieren Sie relevante KPIs für das Produkt, um seine Leistung und seinen Beitrag zu Geschäftszielen und -strategien zu messen.
• Kundenzentrierung Aktiv sammeln, verstehen und priorisieren Sie die Bedürfnisse interner Benutzer. Handeln Sie als Haupteigentümer des „Kundenproblems und sind Sie verantwortlich für die Definition und Bereitstellung einer Lösung, die einen greifbaren Wert bietet. Definieren und verfolgen Sie wichtige Metriken in Bezug auf Benutzerzufriedenheit, Engagement und Wertlieferung und verwenden Sie diese Daten, um Produkt-Iterationen zu informieren.
• Product Lifecycle Mgmt. Besitzen Sie den End-to-End-Produktlebenszyklus, leiten Sie seine Entwicklung und verwalten Sie sein Wachstum und seinen möglichen Rückgang basierend auf Marktforschung, Kundenfeedback und Geschäftszielen. Verwalten Sie das Produkt in Übereinstimmung mit neuen Vorschriften.
• Stakeholder-Zusammenarbeit Erweitern Sie die Zusammenarbeit auf eine breitere Reihe von funktionsübergreifenden Teams und sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, diese Teams auf die Produkt-Roadmap auszurichten. Kommunizieren Sie die Produkt-Roadmap, Zeitpläne und mögliche Kompromisse an verschiedene Interessengruppen, um sie zu verwalten

La position Le gestionnaire des produits est responsable de l'ensemble du cycle de vie des produits, depuis l'idée initiale et la planification stratégique jusqu'au lancement, à l'échelle et à la retraite. Ce rôle est essentiel pour transformer les besoins scientifiques et commerciaux en solutions technologiques tangibles et de grande valeur. Vous serez responsable de la définition de la vision, de la stratégie et de la feuille de route du produit, en s'assurant qu'elle s'harmonise avec les objectifs généraux de notre organisation et, en fin de compte, accélère la prestation de diagnostics et de médicaments qui changent la vie aux patients. Ce rôle exige une combinaison distinctive d'enquête scientifique, de compétence technique et de perspicacité commerciale pour naviguer avec succès dans le paysage. Votre objectif principal est de diriger les équipes d'ingénierie et de service en construisant des produits souhaitables, réalisables, viables et durables qui répondent aux besoins changeants de nos utilisateurs internes tout en maintenant le strict respect des normes pertinentes de l'industrie. Description de la zone Le produit de gestion des voyages et des dépenses comprend un paysage complexe et intégré comprenant SAP Concur (voyage, dépense et renseignement), SAP ECC et S/4HANA, et Snowflake pour l'analyse et les rapports de conformité. Vous assurerez une continuité totale en gérant et en surveillant les couches d'intergiciel et d'intégration critiques qui relient ces composants. Au-delà de la stabilité technique, le rôle est de stimuler la valeur grâce à la gestion stratégique des fournisseurs SaaS et à l'optimisation continue du service. Ce poste sert de catalyseur technique clé pour la vision Roche OneT&E, la compréhension et le soutien de la stratégie d'affaires de normalisation, l'optimisation des politiques de voyage, la conformité et les initiatives de carte de crédit d'entreprise. En vous alignant avec les intervenants commerciaux (RSS et Approvisionnement mondial), vous assurerez la prestation transparente de la technologie de T-E pour une stratégie de T-E ainsi que des grands programmes d'entreprise, y compris ASPIRE et Fusions et Acquisitions. Il s'agit de traduire les programmes d'efficacité opérationnelle en réalité technique, en veillant à ce que toutes les solutions soient fournies avec la qualité et le calendrier nécessaires pour appuyer les objectifs organisationnels mondiaux. Responsabilités professionnelles
• Stratégie et vision Il est responsable d'établir l'orientation d'un produit et de s'assurer qu'il atteint des résultats et des objectifs financiers définis. Définit la stratégie, la feuille de route et les caractéristiques des produits en fonction des objectifs opérationnels, des besoins des utilisateurs et des politiques organisationnelles. Intégrer de manière proactive les capacités d'IA pertinentes dans la feuille de route des produits. Définir, suivre et communiquer les ICR pertinents pour le produit afin de mesurer son rendement et sa contribution aux objectifs et à la stratégie de l'entreprise.
• Client-Centricité Recueillir, comprendre et prioriser activement les besoins des utilisateurs internes. Agir en tant que propriétaire principal du problème du client et être responsable de définir et de fournir une solution qui fournit une valeur tangible.
