jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Criar um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche.

Como um Especialista de Negócios - Anatomia Patológica você será o ponto focal da Roche no desenvolvimento estratégico e tático de novas oportunidades de mercado, atuando como um elo essencial entre a estratégia de produtos e o time comercial para a geração de valor junto aos clientes.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Atuar como um catalisador no desdobramento da estratégia em campo, desenvolvendo oportunidades de venda junto ao time comercial e realizando visitas focadas na criação de valor.

• Identificar tendências e necessidades dos clientes, fornecendo feedbacks valiosos para a equipe de desenvolvimento de negócios e participando da elaboração de planos estratégicos e táticos.

• Capturar novos leads de negócio, desenvolvendo novas oportunidades e colaborando ativamente com a equipe de vendas nas etapas de negociação e fechamento.

• Apoiar o treinamento do time comercial trazendo inputs de diferenciação técnica do portfólio, fornecer informações específicas para o time de licitações e monitorar de perto o avanço do funil de vendas.

• Ser responsável pela entrega dos resultados mensais de vendas, acompanhamento de KPIs da linha de produtos e controle de OPEX.

• Construir relacionamentos sólidos e de confiança com os clientes para garantir uma experiência pré-venda eficaz, utilizando o CRM para registro e construção sólida de dados.

• Participar ativamente de projetos específicos da linha, oferecendo conhecimento técnico especializado para o atingimento das metas estabelecidas.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa preferencialmente na área da Saúde ou Marketing, Administração e Engenharia.

• Inglês intermediário a avançado (escrita, leitura e conversação).

• Experiência em funções relacionadas ao desenvolvimento de negócios, vendas, marketing e/ou consultoria no mercado de saúde e diagnóstico.

• Experiência prévia na Indústria de equipamentos médicos, com foco principal em testes de Imuno-histoquímica, H&E e colorações especiais.

• Profundo conhecimento em Patologia Digital e algoritmos.

• Vivência sólida com vendas consultivas e gestão de contas de alta performance.

• Domínio na utilização de ferramentas de CRM para gestão de relacionamento e análise de dados.

• Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes e atuação direta em Campo.

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Production Technician has key responsibilities supporting manufacturing operations either in the manufacturing, packaging, and/or product labeling areas. You will set up and operate a variety of automatic or semi-automatic machines used to produce the company's product. You will work from process sheets or written/verbal instructions are given by the supervisor to perform production tasks. You will check and inspect operations against predetermined tolerances. You will provide support to an area, person, or program. You will interface with internal customers and perform semi-routine support duties of a specialized nature within an assigned area.

You will be responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

The opportunity:

• Set up and operate equipment and processes by standard operating procedures and pilot protocols.

• Inspect product for quality and adherence to specifications.

• Completes and ensures accuracy of all process orders and associated required documentation, records and metrics.

• Prepare work centers for appropriate line clearance procedures and conduct regular cleaning by standard operating procedures.

• May train others in the department as needed.

Who you are:

Minimum Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalency

• Thorough understanding of the principles and applications of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and ISO 9001

• Basic computer skills

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team environment

• Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations

• Detail-oriented

Preferred Qualifications:

• Specialized training or certification in a particular area, system or equipment

• 1 year of related experience in operations or manufacturing

• Experience in the team-oriented work environment

• Experience in a regulated work environment

• Thorough understanding of appropriate safety, health, and environmental procedures

• ERP and/or Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) experience

• Experience working in a Lean Manufacturing environment

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indianapolis is 36,300.00 - 67,500.00 USD. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This position is based in the Enterprise Operations division within the Commercialization Operating Model (COM) team.

The Operating Model Enabler position is accountable for enabling the organizational operating model tools, processes, learning operations, continuous improvement, AI/automation, and organizational rhythms that support effective planning, coordination, and execution across the business to accelerate commercialization excellence.

The Opportunity:

Operating Model Enablement

• Lead administration, deployment, training, and user support for operating model tools and platforms

• Lead AI/Automation, and Knowledge Management initiatives in partnership with Roche Digital Technology and other local/global functions.

• Lead the EverydayAI Champion network and coordinate associated AI adoption, enablement, and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.

• Monitor adoption and utilization of operating model tools and identify opportunities to improve user experience, efficiency, and effectiveness.

• Support reporting, KPI monitoring and continuous improvement of operating model processes, standards, and ways of working.

Planning & Execution Excellence

• Provide project management, coordination, and logistical support for Affiliate Outcome Planning, enterprise Work Packages (WPs), Commercialization Capability Learning Programs and other key COM initiatives.

• Maintain and enable adoption of key tools for planning, prioritization, visibility, and execution across the organization.

• Design and facilitate enterprise process improvement and workflow optimization workshops to strengthen operating model effectiveness, align ways of working and remove barriers to execution.

• Support the development and maintenance of dashboards, reports, and organizational updates connected to operating model priorities.

Learning & Capability Operations

• Assign mandatory Legal/Compliance, SHE and Functional training to Canada Pharma commercial functions and other relevant training to the Mississauga site.

• Partner with Global Learning Services (GLS) Learning Experts to manage requests to re-version learning objects, and upload or remove outdated learning assets from the Learning Management System (LMS).

• Main point of contact for technical issues and troubleshooting questions.

• Leverage e-learning authoring tools to create interactive online class modules and Product Monograph Assessments.

• Proactively identify and implement opportunities to streamline processes, automate routine activities, and leverage GLS to improve local operational efficiency and optimize resource utilization.

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, Learning & Development, or a related field.

• You bring a minimum of 5 years of experience in business operations, operating model enablement, project management, or learning operations initiatives.

• You possess strong planning, analytical, continuous improvement, stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across cross-functional teams.

• You have experience administering and deploying enterprise tools, platforms, collaboration tools, and reportin

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
This is a Capital Equipment Sales Role. Responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories. Typically responsible for medium to large accounts or have a medium to large quota/territory. Must develop customer prospects and create and maintain relationships with decision makers. Contacts/visits existing and potential customers. Minimum of 10 to 15 in person sales calls per week required in assigned territory, both existing and prospects. Able to do overnights as needed. Works to build and maintain a network of colleagues, partners, and customers to share information and obtain prospects. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers. Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of product line and have a more in-depth knowledge of other products or services. A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of the area of the clinical laboratory. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is a fully qualified, career-oriented position. Has a complete knowledge of company products and services. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in their own area of expertise. Responsible for selling the company's products or services, developing new accounts and/or expanding existing accounts. Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments. Responsible for maintaining existing business and work in ways that will ensure sales goals, achievements and growth.

This is a field-based role, our ideal candidate would reside in the New York City Metro area, specifically in Nassau and Suffolk area. You must live within 50 miles of the territory with ability to travel throughout the territory for customer meetings.

Relocation benefits are not offered for this position.

Job Facts

• Contacts new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted (hospital and reference laboratory) accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche (chemistry, immunoassay and automation) products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• Minimum of 10 to 15 in person sales calls per week

• Generates demand and maximizes product awareness by working with and providing education and information to (laboratory diagnostics) customers.

• Implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate (capital equipment) sales process and productivity.

• Works with others, as needed or required, to prepare (reagent and capital equipment) proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• Co

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità Questo è un ruolo di vendita attrezzature capitale. Responsabile per la riunione e il superamento degli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati su territori specificati. Tipicamente responsabile per i conti medio-grandi o hanno un contingente medio-grande/territorio. Deve sviluppare le prospettive del cliente e creare e mantenere le relazioni con i decisori. Contatti/visita clienti esistenti e potenziali. Minimo di 10 a 15 in persona chiamate di vendita a settimana richiesto in territorio assegnato, sia esistente e prospettive. In grado di fare notti come necessario. Lavora per costruire e mantenere una rete di colleghi, partner e clienti per condividere informazioni e ottenere prospettive. Inoltre, la posizione richiede presentazioni di quantificazione del valore ai potenziali clienti. Deve dimostrare una conoscenza approfondita della linea di prodotto e avere una conoscenza più approfondita di altri prodotti o servizi. Un professionista esperto e esperto con una piena comprensione della zona del laboratorio clinico. Risolve una vasta gamma di problemi in modi creativi. Questo lavoro è una posizione completamente qualificata, orientata alla carriera. Ha una conoscenza completa dei prodotti e servizi aziendali. Funziona su problemi di varia portata in cui l'analisi dei dati richiede la valutazione di fattori identificabili. Dimostra buon giudizio nella scelta di metodi e tecniche per ottenere soluzioni. Reti con personale interno ed esterno senior nella propria area di competenza. Responsabile della vendita dei prodotti o servizi dell'azienda, dello sviluppo di nuovi conti e/o dell'espansione dei conti esistenti. Normalmente riceve piccole istruzioni sul lavoro quotidiano, istruzioni generali su nuovi incarichi. Responsabile per il mantenimento di business e lavoro esistenti in modi che garantiranno obiettivi di vendita, risultati e crescita. Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo, il nostro candidato ideale risiederebbe nella zona della metropolitana di New York, in particolare nella zona di Nassau e Suffolk. È necessario vivere entro 50 miglia del territorio con la capacità di viaggiare in tutto il territorio per le riunioni dei clienti. I vantaggi di trasferimento non sono offerti per questa posizione. Fatti di lavoro
• Contatti nuovi e già esistenti clienti per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati (ospedale e laboratorio di riferimento), sviluppando nuove attività, crescendo business esistente, mantenendo le relazioni con i clienti e la risoluzione dei problemi dei clienti. Ciò include l'individuazione e lo sviluppo di piani di conto strategici, lo sviluppo e la fornitura del messaggio differenziante e del valore economico quantificabile per prodotti e servizi, la vendita della differenziazione primaria dei prodotti Roche (chimica, immunoassay e automazione), il superamento e la gestione delle obiezioni e la negoziazione per ottenere vendite.
• Minimo di 10 a 15 persone chiamate di vendita a settimana
• Genera la domanda e massimizza la consapevolezza del prodotto lavorando con e fornendo istruzione e informazioni ai clienti (diagnosi di laboratorio).
• Implementa iniziative strategiche e piani per facilitare (attrezzatura di capitale) il processo di vendita e la produttività.
• Lavora con altri, come necessario o richiesto, per preparare (attrezzatura di credito e capitale) proposte per i conti assegnati. Presenta tutte le proposte di contratto ai clienti per massimizzare il business complessivo e la redditività, che possono richiedere alcune trattative.
• Co

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Die Chance Dies ist eine Capital Equipment Sales Role. Verantwortlich für die Erfüllung und Überschreitung der Verkaufsziele in Zielkonten in bestimmten Gebieten. In der Regel verantwortlich für mittlere bis große Konten oder haben eine mittlere bis große Quote / Gebiet. Muss Kundenperspektiven entwickeln und Beziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern aufbauen und pflegen. Kontakte / Besuche bestehende und potenzielle Kunden. Mindestens 10 bis 15 persönliche Verkaufsgespräche pro Woche in zugewiesenem Gebiet erforderlich, sowohl bestehende als auch potenzielle. Kann Übernachtungen nach Bedarf machen. Aufbau und Pflege eines Netzwerks von Kollegen, Partnern und Kunden, um Informationen auszutauschen und Interessenten zu gewinnen. Darüber hinaus erfordert die Position Wertquantifizierungspräsentationen für potenzielle Kunden. Sie müssen fundierte Kenntnisse der Produktlinie nachweisen und über fundierte Kenntnisse anderer Produkte oder Dienstleistungen verfügen. Ein erfahrener, erfahrener Fachmann mit einem vollständigen Verständnis des Bereichs des klinischen Labors. Löst eine breite Palette von Problemen auf kreative Weise. Dieser Job ist eine voll qualifizierte, karriereorientierte Position. Hat eine vollständige Kenntnis der Produkte und Dienstleistungen des Unternehmens. Arbeitet an Problemen unterschiedlichen Umfangs, bei denen die Analyse von Daten eine Bewertung identifizierbarer Faktoren erfordert. Zeigt gutes Urteilsvermögen bei der Auswahl von Methoden und Techniken, um Lösungen zu erhalten. Netzwerke mit leitenden internen und externen Mitarbeitern in ihrem eigenen Fachgebiet. Verantwortlich für den Verkauf der Produkte oder Dienstleistungen des Unternehmens, die Entwicklung neuer Konten und / oder die Erweiterung bestehender Konten. Normalerweise erhält er wenig Anweisungen zur täglichen Arbeit, allgemeine Anweisungen zu neuen Aufgaben. Verantwortlich für die Aufrechterhaltung des bestehenden Geschäfts und die Arbeit auf eine Weise, die Verkaufsziele, Erfolge und Wachstum sicherstellt. Dies ist eine feldbasierte Rolle, unser idealer Kandidat würde im New Yorker U-Bahn-Gebiet wohnen, speziell in Nassau und Suffolk. Sie müssen innerhalb von 50 Meilen von dem Gebiet mit der Fähigkeit leben, durch das Gebiet für Kundentreffen zu reisen. Umzugsvorteile werden für diese Position nicht angeboten. Job Fakten
• Kontaktieren Sie neue und bestehende Kunden, um die Verkaufsziele in gezielten (Krankenhaus- und Referenzlabor) Konten zu erreichen und zu übertreffen, indem Sie neues Geschäft entwickeln, bestehendes Geschäft ausbauen, Kundenbeziehungen pflegen und Kundenprobleme beheben. Dies umfasst die Identifizierung und Entwicklung strategischer Account-Pläne, die Entwicklung und Bereitstellung der differenzierenden Botschaft und des quantifizierbaren wirtschaftlichen Werts für Produkte und Dienstleistungen, den Verkauf der primären Differenzierung von Roche-Produkten (Chemie, Immunoassay und Automatisierung), die Überwindung und Verwaltung von Einwänden und Verhandlungen über den Verkauf.
• Mindestens 10 bis 15 persönliche Verkaufsgespräche pro Woche
• Generiert Nachfrage und maximiert das Produktbewusstsein durch die Zusammenarbeit und Bereitstellung von Schulungen und Informationen für (Labordiagnostik-) Kunden.
• Implementiert strategische Initiativen und Pläne, um den Verkaufsprozess und die Produktivität zu erleichtern.
• Arbeitet mit anderen zusammen, wenn nötig oder erforderlich, um Vorschläge für zugewiesene Konten vorzubereiten (Reagens und Investitionsausrüstung). Präsentiert alle Vertragsvorschläge an Kunden, um das Gesamtgeschäft und die Rentabilität zu maximieren, was einige Verhandlungen erfordern kann.
• Coco

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
By combining our unique strengths, we’re redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. Discover what it’s like to work at Roche.

The Opportunity
The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a Security Engineer on the Vulnerability and Exposure Management Team, you will help protect sensitive data and defend computer systems and web applications from existing and emerging threats. You will not just be managing scanner output. You will help manage and reduce existing risks, assess and evaluate the weaponization of emerging risks, and act as a core builder of our future capabilities.

Responsibilities

• Triage, investigate, and respond to critical vulnerabilities affecting Roche

• Evaluate and prioritize vulnerabilities found through our tools, including our bug-bounty program

• Research emerging vulnerabilities and develop methods to confirm exploitability against our attack surface

• Communicate risk and work with system owners and other stakeholders to mitigate security vulnerabilities

• Assess company systems and web applications using both automated and manual tools

• Maintain, improve, and engineer our scanning, detection, and automation solutions

• Participating in security monitoring for a global environment

Who you are

• Associate degree in relevant field or 5+ years in information security and fluent English.

• Programming experience (Python, Node.js, JavaScript) and ability to write custom detection logic, scripts, and templates

• Demonstrated ability to triage, analyze, and escalate vulnerabilities; experience validating vulnerabilities and basic exploit development in large global environments

• Focus on web application, network, and computer security; cloud security experience; familiarity with attack surface management and AI-assisted development tools

• Strong communication skills explaining complex risks to non-technical audiences; comfort balancing operational tasks with research; passion for security

• Industry certifications in offensive security (OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE); open-source security project contributions

Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. • Maintenir, améliorer et concevoir nos solutions de numérisation, de détection et d'automatisation
• Participation à la surveillance de la sécurité pour un environnement mondial Qui vous êtes
• Diplôme associé dans le domaine pertinent ou 5+ ans en sécurité de l'information et l'anglais couramment.
• Expérience de programmation (Python, Node.js, JavaScript) et capacité à écrire une logique de détection personnalisée, des scripts et des modèles
• Capacité démontrée de trier, d'analyser et d'exacerber les vulnérabilités; expérience de la validation des vulnérabilités et de l'exploitation de base dans les grands environnements mondiaux
• Se concentrer sur les applications Web, le réseau et la sécurité informatique; l'expérience en matière de sécurité dans le cloud; la connaissance des outils de gestion de surface d'attaque et de développement assisté par l'IA
• Fortes compétences en communication expliquant les risques complexes pour les publics non techniques; équilibrer les tâches opérationnelles avec la recherche; passion pour la sécurité

jobs.title: Field Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity

• Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This is a field-based role that requires daily travel and up to 50% overnight travel.
Our ideal candidate would reside in Omaha, Nebraska or Des Moines, Iowa.
Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who You Are

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering

• Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required

Preferred Requirements

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Nebraska is $71,100- $132,000 annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Strategic Account Executive

The Opportunity:
This role supports our Tissue Diagnostics franchise and will be responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories.

Responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives (capital instruments & reagents) in targeted Anatomic Pathology labs within the assigned geography. This role is focused on the region’s largest customers, large strategic scenarios, reference labs and competitive opportunities. Must maintain & grow existing accounts & develop new accounts in the assigned geography. Develop partnerships with all levels of Buying Influences to include: C-Suite, Lab Directors, Lab Managers, Histotechnologist, Safety Officers, Materials Management, etc. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers.

This is a field based role: the territory includes California. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the territory border. Relocation benefits are not provided for this role.

Job Facts:
• Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of the full portfolio of products offered by Roche Diagnostics, Tissue Division.
• Actively promote and sell Roche products and software solutions to customers through daily engagement with Pathologists, Medical Directors, Lab Administration and Lab technicians.
• Proven ability to manage and prioritize multiple account management projects at a time, while maintaining sharp attention to detail
• Meet with customers to discuss their evolving needs and to assess the quality of our company’s relationship with them
• Coordinate the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, and management resources (specialists), in order to meet account performance objectives and customers’ expectations.
• Proactively lead a joint company-strategic account planning process that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones for a one and three-year period.
• Clearly communicate the progress of monthly/quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders
• Proactively assesses, clarifies, and validates customer needs on an ongoing basis.
• Achieves assigned sales quota in designated strategic accounts.
• Closely coordinates company executive involvement and Customer Service Representatives to ensure customer satisfaction and problem resolution.
• Customer focused selling skills are a must to drive consistent results & partnerships.

Who you are (minimum qualifications):
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
• You hold 5+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications:
• Capital sales experience
• Pathology/Digital Pathology sales experience
• Strategic planning and organizational skills
• Experience working with multiple call points (lab managers, directors, clinicians, c-suite)
• Proven leadership abilities
• Understanding of performance metrics
• Ability to work in a regulated environment
• Excellent oral and written communication skills including making impactful presentations
• Hands on experience with CRM software and MS Office (particularly MS Excel)
• Strong negotiation skills with a problem-solving attitude

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $105,100 - $195,300. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This position is eligible to earn incentive compensatio

• Requisiti“, „## Cosa ofriamo“, „## Contatto“) – Verwenden Sie „-“ für Aufzählungspunkte. – Jeder Aufzählungspunkt sollte ein sein einzelnes, vollständiges Element – Behalten Sie den gesamten ursprünglichen Inhalt wörtlich bei – fügen Sie KEINEN Text hinzu, entfernen Sie ihn nicht oder formulieren Sie ihn um – Fügen Sie nur eine Markdown-Struktur hinzu (Überschriften, Aufzählungszeichen, Zeilenumbrüche) – Wenn keine klare Abschnittsstruktur vorhanden ist, verwenden Sie „## Descrizione“ als Überschrift – Geben Sie NUR den formatierten Markdown aus, keine Erklärungen, Präambel oder Code-Zäune – Eingabetext: Eine Stellenbeschreibung auf Englisch für einen „Strategic Account Executive“ bei Roche. Es enthält Abschnitte wie Unternehmensvorstellung, Positionstitel, Stellenbeschreibung, Jobfakten, Mindestqualifikationen, bevorzugte Qualifikationen und Gehaltsinformationen. • Requisiti“ für Qualifikationen, „##

B.“, also verwende ich nur was passt). - Lassen Sie uns sorgfältig abbilden: - Vorstellung + Position + Gelegenheit -> „## Descrizione“ – Job-Fakten (Verantwortlichkeiten) -> „## Mansioni“ – Wer Sie sind (Minimum) + Bevorzugte Qualifikationen -> „##

B.“ und ist daher flexibel. - Wörtliche Regel: Ich darf den Fließtext NICHT übersetzen. Lediglich die Überschriften sollten wie gewünscht auf Italienisch verfasst sein. jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow – Next-Gen Sequencing Systems, Research & Early Development

titleByLocale.it: Postdoctoral Fellow – Next-Gen Sequencing Systems, Ricerca & Early Development
titleByLocale.en: Postdoctoral Fellow – Next-Gen Sequencing Systems, Research & Early Development
titleByLocale.de: Postdoctoral Fellow – Next-Gen Sequencing Systems, Forschung & Early Development
titleByLocale.fr: Postdoctoral Fellow – Next-Gen Sequencing Systems, Recherche & Early Development

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are developing the next-generation of sequencing systems. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are also broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing workflows.

We are seeking a talented and highly motivated Postdoctoral Fellow with a proven track record of excellence in developing novel technology for biological applications. Joining our Systems Technology Group, you will play a major role in the Research and Early Development of new technology, devices, and instruments associated with our next-generation DNA sequencing and molecular diagnostic platforms.

At the heart of these instruments are highly integrated microfluidic systems capable of automating intricate workflows and handling complex biochemistry. To gear up for these ambitious goals, your near-term focus will involve deep, hands-on training with our foundational efforts. You will assist with current projects to master our chemistry, materials, and methods, gaining critical expertise in how we design, fabricate, bond, simulate, operate, characterize, and troubleshoot complex systems and processes.

This is a hands-on, interdisciplinary role designed to bridge the gap between biochemical applications and cutting-edge instrumentation. Collaborating closely with a small, agile team and the broader organization, you will solve challenging problems, invent new technology, and ultimately advance the state-of-the-art in DNA sequencing systems.

The Opportuniity:

• You will design, fabricate, and assemble custom devices, fixtures, and breadboards using various rapid prototyping tools, including custom equipment.

• You will develop and implement microfabrication processes, including photolithography, etching, drilling, bonding, and dicing—and utilize precision metrology instruments to characterize components and evaluate manufacturing methodologies.

• You will create and characterize new materials and bonding methodologies.

• You will test, characterize, and troubleshoot complex fluidic systems and devices. Develop and optimize workflows on these systems while collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to drive technical progress.

• You will generate comprehensive test plans, protocols, technical reports and invention disclosures to document findings and methodology.

• You will select, procure, install, validate, operate, repair, and maintain lab/fab equipment and custom instrumentation.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a Ph.D. in Bioengineering or a closely related discipline with a thesis focused on solving a molecular biology problem with clever engineering.

• You have a solid understanding of physics, engineering, chemistry, molecular biology and sequencing fundamentals.

• You have demonstrated experience with advanced microfabrication techniques (lithography, thin-film deposition, wet/dry etching, and thermal fusion bonding processes).

• You have demonstrated success porting complex biochemical assays or workflows onto novel fluidic systems and optimizing performance using a systematic approach.

• You have a solid publication record, including at least one first-authored and peer-reviewed publication in a top-tier journal.

• You have demonstrated experience with Python scripting for instru

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, stiamo sviluppando la prossima generazione di sistemi di sequenziamento. Accelerando la ricerca clinica, razionalizzando i flussi di lavoro e espandendo i menu di analisi, stiamo anche ampliando l'accesso ai dati genomici e abbassando le barriere all'adozione. Dai robusti strumenti di isolamento e preparazione dei campioni alle nuove tecnologie di sequenziamento e alla bioinformatica avanzata, stiamo sviluppando soluzioni end-to-end differenziate e altamente integrate per flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento di nuova generazione. Stiamo cercando un talentuoso e altamente motivato Fellow Postdoctoral con un comprovato record di eccellenza nello sviluppo di nuove tecnologie per applicazioni biologiche. Partecipando al nostro Systems Technology Group, si svolgerà un ruolo importante nella ricerca e sviluppo precoce di nuove tecnologie, dispositivi e strumenti associati alle nostre piattaforme di sequenziamento del DNA di nuova generazione e diagnostica molecolare. Al centro di questi strumenti sono sistemi microfluidici altamente integrati in grado di automatizzare i flussi di lavoro intricati e gestire la biochimica complessa. Per prepararsi a questi obiettivi ambiziosi, il vostro focus a breve termine coinvolgerà una formazione profonda e pratica con i nostri sforzi fondamentali. Aiuterai con i progetti attuali a padroneggiare la nostra chimica, materiali e metodi, acquisendo competenze critiche nel modo in cui progettiamo, fabbricare, legare, simulare, operare, caratterizzare e risolvere i sistemi e processi complessi. Si tratta di un ruolo pratico e interdisciplinare progettato per colmare il divario tra applicazioni biochimiche e strumentazione all'avanguardia. Collaborando a stretto contatto con un team piccolo e agile e l'organizzazione più ampia, risolverete problemi impegnativi, inventare nuove tecnologie, e alla fine avanzare lo stato dell'arte nei sistemi di sequenziamento del DNA. L'Opportunità:
• Progettare, fabbricare e assemblare dispositivi personalizzati, apparecchi e pannelli di pane utilizzando vari strumenti di prototipazione rapida, comprese le attrezzature personalizzate.
• Svilupperai e implementerai processi di microfabbricazione, tra cui fotolitografia, etching, perforazione, incollaggio e dicing, e userai strumenti di metrologia di precisione per caratterizzare i componenti e valutare le metodologie di produzione.
• Creare e caratterizzare nuovi materiali e metodologie di incollaggio.
• Testare, caratterizzare e risolvere problemi complessi sistemi e dispositivi fluidi. Sviluppare e ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro su questi sistemi, raccogliendo, analizzando e interpretando i dati per guidare il progresso tecnico.
• Potrai generare piani di prova completi, protocolli, relazioni tecniche e rivelazioni di invenzione per documentare i risultati e la metodologia.
• Selezioni, procure, installare, validare, operare, riparare e mantenere attrezzature laboratorio/fabbricate e strumentazione personalizzata. Chi sei? (richiesto)
• Hai un dottorato in Bioingegneria o una disciplina strettamente correlata con una tesi focalizzata sulla risoluzione di un problema di biologia molecolare con l'ingegneria intelligente.
• Hai una solida comprensione della fisica, dell'ingegneria, della chimica, della biologia molecolare e dei fondamenti di sequenziamento.
• Hai dimostrato esperienza con tecniche di microfabbricazione avanzate (litografia, deposizione di film sottile, incisione a secco e processi di incollaggio a fusione termica).
• Hai dimostrato successo portando saggi biochimici complessi o flussi di lavoro su nuovi sistemi fluidi e ottimizzando le prestazioni utilizzando un approccio sistematico.
• Hai un solido record di pubblicazione, tra cui almeno una prima pubblicazione autorizzata e peer-reviewed in una rivista top-tier.
• Hai dimostrato esperienza con lo scripting Python per instru

Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Bei Roche entwickeln wir die nächste Generation von Sequenziersystemen. Durch die Beschleunigung der klinischen Forschung, die Rationalisierung von Workflows und die Erweiterung der Assay-Menüs erweitern wir auch den Zugang zu genomischen Daten und senken die Hindernisse für die Annahme. Von robusten Werkzeugen zur Probenisolierung und -vorbereitung bis hin zu neuartigen Sequenzierungstechnologien und fortschrittlicher Bioinformatik entwickeln wir differenzierte, hochintegrierte End-to-End-Lösungen für Sequenzierungs-Workflows der nächsten Generation. Wir suchen einen talentierten und hochmotivierten Postdoktoranden mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung neuartiger Technologien für biologische Anwendungen. Bei unserer Systems Technology Group werden Sie eine wichtige Rolle in der Forschung und frühen Entwicklung neuer Technologien, Geräte und Instrumente spielen, die mit unseren DNA-Sequenzierungs- und Molekulardiagnostikplattformen der nächsten Generation verbunden sind. Herzstück dieser Instrumente sind hochintegrierte mikrofluidische Systeme, die komplizierte Arbeitsabläufe automatisieren und komplexe Biochemie handhaben können. Um sich auf diese ehrgeizigen Ziele vorzubereiten, wird Ihr kurzfristiger Fokus eine tiefe, praktische Schulung mit unseren grundlegenden Bemühungen beinhalten. Sie unterstützen bei aktuellen Projekten, um unsere Chemie, Materialien und Methoden zu beherrschen, indem Sie kritisches Fachwissen darüber erwerben, wie wir komplexe Systeme und Prozesse entwerfen, herstellen, verbinden, simulieren, betreiben, charakterisieren und beheben. Dies ist eine praktische, interdisziplinäre Rolle, die die Lücke zwischen biochemischen Anwendungen und modernster Instrumentierung schließen soll. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem kleinen, agilen Team und der breiteren Organisation lösen Sie anspruchsvolle Probleme, erfinden neue Technologien und bringen letztendlich den neuesten Stand der Technik in DNA-Sequenzierungssystemen voran. Die Gelegenheit:
• Sie entwerfen, fertigen und montieren benutzerdefinierte Geräte, Armaturen und Brotbretter mit verschiedenen Rapid Prototyping-Tools, einschließlich benutzerdefinierter Geräte.
• Sie entwickeln und implementieren Mikrofabrikationsprozesse, einschließlich Photolithographie, Ätzen, Bohren, Kleben und Würfeln - und verwenden Präzisionsmessgeräte, um Komponenten zu charakterisieren und Fertigungsmethoden zu bewerten.
• Sie erstellen und charakterisieren neue Materialien und Klebemethoden.
• Sie testen, charakterisieren und beheben komplexe fluidische Systeme und Geräte. Entwickeln und optimieren Sie Workflows auf diesen Systemen, während Sie Daten sammeln, analysieren und interpretieren, um den technischen Fortschritt voranzutreiben.
• Sie erstellen umfassende Testpläne, Protokolle, technische Berichte und Erfindungsangaben, um Ergebnisse und Methodik zu dokumentieren.
• Sie wählen, beschaffen, installieren, validieren, betreiben, reparieren und warten Labor- / Fabrikausrüstung und benutzerdefinierte Instrumente. Wer Du bist: (erforderlich)
• Sie haben einen Ph.D. in Bioengineering oder eine eng verwandte Disziplin mit einer Dissertation, die sich auf die Lösung eines molekularbiologischen Problems mit cleverem Engineering konzentriert.
• Sie haben ein solides Verständnis von Physik, Technik, Chemie, Molekularbiologie und Sequenzierung Grundlagen.
• Sie haben Erfahrungen mit fortschrittlichen Mikrofabrikationstechniken (Lithographie, Dünnfilmabscheidung, Nass-/Trockenätzung und thermische Fusionsbonding-Prozesse) nachgewiesen.
• Sie haben den Erfolg gezeigt, komplexe biochemische Assays oder Workflows auf neuartige fluidische Systeme zu übertragen und die Leistung mit einem systematischen Ansatz zu optimieren.
• Sie haben eine solide Publikationsbilanz, einschließlich mindestens einer Erstautoren- und Peer-Review-Publikation in einem Top-Tier-Journal.
• Sie haben Erfahrungen mit Python-Scripting für instru gezeigt

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous développons la prochaine génération de systèmes de séquençage. En accélérant la recherche clinique, en rationalisant les flux de travail et en élargissant les menus d'essais, nous élargissons également l'accès aux données génomiques et abaissons les obstacles à l'adoption. Des outils d'isolement et de préparation d'échantillons robustes aux nouvelles technologies de séquençage et à la bioinformatique avancée, nous développons des solutions de bout en bout différenciées et hautement intégrées pour le séquençage de prochaine génération. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un boursier postdoctoral talentueux et très motivé qui a fait preuve d'excellence dans le développement de nouvelles technologies pour les applications biologiques. En vous joignant à notre Groupe de la technologie des systèmes, vous jouerez un rôle majeur dans la recherche et le développement de nouvelles technologies, de nouveaux appareils et d'instruments associés à nos plateformes de séquençage et de diagnostic moléculaire de prochaine génération. Au cœur de ces instruments se trouvent des systèmes microfluidiques hautement intégrés capables d'automatiser les flux de travail complexes et de manipuler la biochimie complexe. Pour vous préparer à atteindre ces objectifs ambitieux, votre objectif à court terme consistera à vous entraîner de près avec nos efforts fondamentaux. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sei pronto a guidare complesse strategie di consegna e modellare soluzioni organizzative ad alto impatto? Come Senior Delivery Management Lead a Roche, fornire una guida esperta su iniziative su larga scala, navigare complessitÃ strategiche e team di mentore per raggiungere l'eccellenza. A seconda delle esigenze organizzative, avrete l'opportunità unica di appoggiarsi a vari archetipi, tra cui Program Manager, Agile Coach, Service Delivery Manager, o Release Train Engineer (RTE). Le tue responsabilità
• Lead Strategy & Scope: Fornire una direzione esperta per definire e gestire lo scopo di iniziative ad alto impatto, implementando framework e strategie di consegna migliori in classe.
• Risolvere i problemi complessi: condurre l'analisi delle sfide di consegna transfrontaliere, guidare il consenso e definire soluzioni strategiche attraverso la comunicazione persuasiva.
• Gestisci gli stakeholder senior: Identificare e collaborare con gli stakeholder senior a livello globale, eseguendo piani di impegno e allineamento completi attraverso i confini organizzativi.
• Drive Agile Impact: Embed Agile migliori pratiche e iniziative di cambiamento campione attraverso linee di prodotto o domini per promuovere una vivace cultura dell'innovazione.
• Oversee Large-Scale Governance: Gestisci programmi complessi con dipendenze multiple, eseguendo metriche di consegna mentre gestisci i rischi in ambienti ambigui.
• Empower & Mentor Teams: Agite come allenatore dedicato ai colleghi, fornendo feedback costruttivi e alimentando la crescita attraverso le discipline di consegna. Chi sei Sei un leader dinamico e collaborativo che prospera nella navigazione della complessità e nel riunire diversi team per raggiungere obiettivi strategici. Sei un comunicatore esperto in grado di guidare il cambiamento organizzativo e costruire relazioni professionali durature. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Esperienza di gestione della consegna estesa: un record di traccia comprovata operante come Program Manager, Release Train Engineer (RTE), Agile Coach, o simile archetipo di consegna che gestisce i programmi su larga scala e complessi.
• Agile Framework Expertise: Hands-on experience incorporando le migliori pratiche Agile e conducendo con successo iniziative di gestione dei cambiamenti organizzativi.
• Strategic Stakeholder Collaboration: Demonstrated successo costruendo forti relazioni e coltivando la collaborazione con principali stakeholder senior attraverso diversi confini.
• Competenze Analitiche & Problem-Solving avanzate: Forte capacità di analizzare i problemi di consegna transfrontalieri, valutare le opzioni strategiche e implementare soluzioni innovative.
• Comunicazione eccezionale & Coaching: eccezionale facilitazione e competenze di negoziazione, combinato con una passione per i colleghi di mentoring e capacità di team building. Facciamo prosperare insieme in una cultura costruita sulla fiducia, la collaborazione, il rispetto e le alte prestazioni. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche Pharma is seeking a Technical Product Owner to help shape and deliver our global and regional web experience ecosystem. In this role, you will drive scalable, compliant, and customer-centric digital experiences across websites, portals, and connected engagement platforms for healthcare professionals, researchers, patients, and consumers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, engineering teams, UX/UI specialists, regional teams, and external partners to translate business needs into technical solutions and lead day-to-day delivery execution. This role focuses on advancing capabilities across content management, personalization, search, integrations, localization, analytics, and digital experience optimization while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards. Your Responsibilities Product Ownership & Delivery
• Own and prioritize the backlog for web experience and analytics platforms.
• Translate business requirements into user stories, technical requirements, and acceptance criteria.
• Lead sprint planning, refinement, testing, and release activities with development teams.
• Ensure solutions meet functional and non-functional requirements, including Definition of Ready and Definition of Done.
• Coordinate day-to-day delivery across engineering teams, vendors, and partners. Web Platform & Experience Management
• Support the delivery and continuous improvement of:
• Global, regional, and local websites and portals
• Content publishing and localization workflows
• Search and discoverability capabilities
• Personalization and customer journey experiences
• Analytics and digital experience optimization
• Consent and identity-enabled experiences
• Ensure web capabilities are scalable, reusable, and aligned across regions and channels.
• Balance business priorities, technical feasibility, and platform standards. Integration & Technical Coordination
• Coordinate integrations across platforms such as:
• Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and other CMS platforms
• Adobe Assets and other DAM repositories
• Personalization engines like Adobe Target
• IAM/SSO and consent management solutions
• CDP, CRM, and marketing automation platforms
• Analytics, reporting, and insight-generation tools
• Collaborate with architects and engineers on APIs, data flows, metadata, and connected services.
• Support cross-functional coordination across teams and vendors. Quality, Compliance & Operations
• Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, accessible, and compliant with Roche standards and regulations (e.g., GDPR, accessibility, security).
• Support testing, defect management, release readiness, and production validation.
• Identify delivery risks, technical dependencies, and operational impacts.
• Partner with support and operations teams to drive platform stability and continuous improvement. Stakeholder & Vendor Management
• Serve as the primary interface between business stakeholders, engineering teams, and vendors.
• Collaborate with UX/UI, content, SEO, analytics, and regional teams to ensure alignment and usability.
• Facilitate communication across global and regional stakeholders to support consistent delivery and adoption.
• Contribute to governance, roadmap planning, and prioritization activities. Who You Are
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience as a Technical Product Owner, Digital Product Manager,
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Sind Sie bereit, komplexe Lieferstrategien voranzutreiben und wirkungsvolle organisatorische Lösungen zu gestalten? Als Senior Delivery Management Lead bei Roche unterstützen Sie Sie fachkundig bei großen Initiativen, steuern strategische Komplexitäten und beraten Teams, um Exzellenz zu erreichen. Je nach organisatorischen Anforderungen haben Sie die einzigartige Möglichkeit, sich auf verschiedene Archetypen zu konzentrieren, darunter Program Manager, Agile Coach, Service Delivery Manager oder Release Train Engineer (RTE). Ihre Aufgaben
• Lead Strategy & Scope: Bieten Sie eine fachkundige Anleitung zur Definition und Verwaltung von Spielräumen für einflussreiche Initiativen und zur Implementierung von Best-in-Class-Delivery-Frameworks und -Strategien.
• Lösen Sie komplexe Probleme: Führen Sie die Analyse grenzüberschreitender Lieferherausforderungen, fördern Sie den Konsens und definieren Sie strategische Lösungen durch überzeugende Kommunikation.
• Manage Senior Stakeholders: Identifizieren und partnern Sie mit Senior Stakeholdern weltweit und führen Sie umfassende Engagement- und Ausrichtungspläne über organisatorische Grenzen hinweg durch.
• Drive Agile Impact: Betten Sie Agile Best Practices ein und setzen Sie sich für Veränderungsinitiativen über Produktlinien oder Domänen hinweg ein, um eine lebendige Innovationskultur zu fördern.
• Beaufsichtigen Sie Large-Scale Governance: Verwalten Sie komplexe Programme mit mehreren Abhängigkeiten, führen Sie Liefermetriken aus und verwalten Sie Risiken in mehrdeutigen Umgebungen.
• Empower & Mentor Teams: Handeln Sie als engagierter Coach für Kollegen, geben Sie konstruktives Feedback und fördern Sie Wachstum in allen Lieferdisziplinen. Wer du bist Sie sind eine dynamische, kollaborative Führungskraft, die sich darauf konzentriert, Komplexität zu navigieren und verschiedene Teams zusammenzubringen, um strategische Ziele zu erreichen. Sie sind ein erfahrener Kommunikator, der in der Lage ist, organisatorische Veränderungen zu steuern und dauerhafte berufliche Beziehungen aufzubauen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie:
• Umfangreiche Liefermanagement-Erfahrung: Eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz als Programmmanager, Release Train Engineer (RTE), Agile Coach oder ähnlicher Lieferarchetyp, der große, komplexe Programme verwaltet.
• Agile Framework Expertise: Praktische Erfahrung bei der Einbettung agiler Best Practices und der erfolgreichen Leitung organisatorischer Change Management-Initiativen.
• Strategische Stakeholder-Zusammenarbeit: Nachgewiesener Erfolg beim Aufbau starker Beziehungen und der Förderung der Zusammenarbeit mit wichtigen hochrangigen Stakeholdern über verschiedene Grenzen hinweg.
• Advanced Analytical & Problemlösungskompetenzen: Starke Fähigkeit, grenzüberschreitende Lieferprobleme zu analysieren, strategische Optionen zu bewerten und innovative Lösungen zu implementieren.
• Außergewöhnliche Kommunikation & Coaching: Herausragende Erleichterung und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten, kombiniert mit einer Leidenschaft für das Mentoring von Kollegen und den Aufbau von Teamfähigkeiten. Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam in einer Kultur gedeihen, die auf Vertrauen, Zusammenarbeit, Respekt und hoher Leistung basiert. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Êtes-vous prêt à piloter des stratégies de prestation complexes et à façonner des solutions organisationnelles à impact élevé? En tant que responsable principal de la gestion de la prestation à Roche, vous fournirez des conseils d'experts sur les initiatives à grande échelle, naviguerez dans les complexités stratégiques et mentorez des équipes pour atteindre l'excellence. En fonction des besoins organisationnels, vous aurez l'occasion unique de vous pencher sur divers archétypes, y compris le gestionnaire de programme, l'entraîneur agile, le gestionnaire de la prestation des services ou l'ingénieur de la formation à la libération. Vos responsabilités
• Stratégie et portée du chef de file : Fournir une orientation experte sur la définition et la gestion de la portée des initiatives à impact élevé, la mise en oeuvre de cadres et de stratégies d'exécution de qualité.
• Résoudre les problèmes complexes : Diriger l'analyse des défis liés à la prestation transfrontalière, susciter le consensus et définir des solutions stratégiques par la communication persuasive.
• Gérer les intervenants supérieurs : Identifier et collaborer avec les intervenants supérieurs à l'échelle mondiale, en exécutant des plans d'engagement et d'alignement globaux au-delà des limites de l'organisation.
• Conduire l'impact Agile : Intégrer les meilleures pratiques Agile et promouvoir les initiatives de changement dans les gammes de produits ou les domaines afin de favoriser une culture dynamique de l'innovation.
• Superviser la gouvernance à grande échelle : gérer des programmes complexes avec des dépendances multiples, exécuter des mesures de prestation tout en gérant les risques dans des environnements ambigus.
• Empower & Mentor Teams: Agissez en tant qu'entraîneur dévoué pour les collègues, fournissant des commentaires constructifs et favorisant la croissance dans toutes les disciplines de prestation. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un chef de file dynamique et collaboratif qui prospère dans la complexité de navigation et rassembler diverses équipes pour atteindre des objectifs stratégiques. Vous êtes un communicateur expert capable de guider le changement organisationnel et d'établir des relations professionnelles durables. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• Expérience approfondie de la gestion de la prestation : Une expérience éprouvée en tant que gestionnaire de programme, ingénieur de formation à la libération, entraîneur agile ou archétype de prestation semblable gérant des programmes complexes à grande échelle.
• Expertise en cadre agile : Expérience pratique intégrant les meilleures pratiques agiles et menant avec succès des initiatives de gestion du changement organisationnel.
• Collaboration stratégique avec les intervenants : Succès démontré établissant de solides relations et cultivant la collaboration avec les principaux intervenants de haut niveau au-delà de diverses frontières.
• Compétences avancées en matière d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes : Capacité solide d'analyser les problèmes de prestation transfrontalière, d'évaluer les options stratégiques et de mettre en oeuvre des solutions novatrices.
• Communication et coaching exceptionnels : Compétences exceptionnelles en facilitation et en négociation, combinées à une passion pour le mentorat de collègues et le renforcement des capacités de l'équipe. Laissez-les prospérer ensemble dans une culture fondée sur la confiance, la collaboration, le respect et la haute performance. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Territory Manager | Individual Contributor - Madurai
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Territory Manager (Individual Contributor) based in Madurai , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals.

The Opportunity

• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.

• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.

• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.

• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.

• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.

• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.

• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.

• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.

• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.

• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.

• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.

• You are comfortable with field travel within the Madurai territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. W

L'opportunità

• Si preparano ed eseguono piani di promozione delle vendite mensili, tra cui attività di attivazione e merchandising del campo, e meticolosamente registrare le spese e le vendite generate per valutare l'efficacia del programma.

• Gestisci la rete di distribuzione monitorando le prestazioni dei distributori, proponendo la nomina di nuovi distributori, o raccomandando la cessazione di quelli non performanti.
• Si motiva distributori e rivenditori attraverso visite regolari, chiamate e corrispondenza, contribuendo a risolvere le loro preoccupazioni per quanto riguarda conti, prezzi, concorrenza e schemi.
• Si organizzano riunioni di distributori e rivenditori in allineamento con le strategie di marketing, e garantire le collezioni mensili di successo attraverso continui follow-up.
• L'utente agisce come gli occhi e le orecchie del mercato monitorando le attività dei concorrenti, affrontando le lamentele dei clienti o dei rivenditori inoltrandole all'assistenza clienti e assicurando la segnalazione quotidiana delle visite dei clienti. Chi sei
• Hai una laurea in Business, Marketing, Scienze della Vita, o un campo correlato.
• Hai dimostrato esperienza pratica nelle vendite sul campo, nella gestione della distribuzione o in un ruolo di gestione del territorio.
• Hai un forte interesse nel guidare la crescita del mercato, con un focus sulla costruzione di relazioni, la generazione della domanda e l'esecuzione di strategie di marketing.
• Hai eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e di negoziazione e sono fiduciosi nel gestire Medici, interazioni tra Chemist e concessionari, risolvere problemi e condurre incontri promozionali.
• Sei altamente organizzato e diligente con compiti amministrativi, tra cui report giornaliero/Weekly/Monthly, spese di monitoraggio e gestione delle collezioni.
• Sei a tuo agio con i viaggi sul campo all'interno del territorio Madurai e prosperi in un ambiente strutturato dove collabori a stretto contatto con l'Area Sales Manager. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Sie werden unsere Produktdurchdringung im zugewiesenen Markt effektiv sicherstellen, indem Sie Distributoren unterstützen, Marktinformationen sammeln und mit dem Area Sales Manager (ASM) zusammenarbeiten, um unsere Geschäftsziele zu erreichen. Die Chance
• Fördern Sie pharmazeutische Produkte für Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) durch wissenschaftliche Kommunikation, Beziehungsaufbau, Produktdetails und ethisches Marketing, um das Produktbewusstsein und die Rezepte zu erhöhen.
• Sie unterstützen den ASM bei der Planung des Territoriums, indem Sie Marktumfeldinformationen zur Schätzung der jährlichen Nachfrage, zur Vorlage von Bestandsanforderungen auf Händlerebene und zur Überwachung der Lagerverfügbarkeit von Werbematerialien bereitstellen.
• Sie erstellen und führen monatliche Verkaufsförderungspläne aus - einschließlich Aktivierungs- und Merchandising-Aktivitäten - und erfassen akribisch die Ausgaben und Verkäufe, um die Wirksamkeit des Programms zu bewerten.
• Sie stellen die monatliche Erreichung Ihrer Ziele sicher und führen monatliche SKU-Verkaufspläne durch, indem Sie aktiv Sekundärverkäufe auf dem Markt generieren.
• Sie verwalten das Vertriebsnetz, indem Sie die Leistung des Vertriebspartners überwachen, die Ernennung neuer Vertriebspartner vorschlagen oder die Kündigung von leistungsschwachen Vertriebspartnern empfehlen.
• Sie motivieren Händler und Händler durch regelmäßige Besuche, Anrufe und Korrespondenz und helfen, ihre Bedenken in Bezug auf Konten, Preise, Wettbewerb und Systeme zu lösen.
• Sie organisieren Vertriebs- und Händlertreffen in Übereinstimmung mit Marketingstrategien und sorgen für erfolgreiche monatliche Kollektionen durch kontinuierliche Follow-ups.
• Sie fungieren als Augen und Ohren des Marktes, indem Sie die Aktivitäten der Wettbewerber überwachen, Kunden- oder Händlerbeschwerden ansprechen, indem Sie sie an die Kundenbetreuung weiterleiten und die tägliche Berichterstattung über Ihre Kundenbesuche sicherstellen. Wer du bist
• Sie haben einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• Sie haben nachgewiesene praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Vertrieb, Vertriebsmanagement oder einer Gebietsmanagementrolle.
• Sie haben ein starkes Interesse daran, das Marktwachstum zu fördern, wobei der Schwerpunkt auf dem Aufbau von Beziehungen, der Nachfrageerzeugung und der Durchführung von Marketingstrategien liegt.
• Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten und sind zuversichtlich, mit Ärzten, Chemikern und Händlerinteraktionen umzugehen, Probleme zu lösen und Werbetreffen durchzuführen.
• Sie sind hoch organisiert und fleißig mit administrativen Aufgaben, einschließlich täglicher / wöchentlicher / monatlicher Berichterstattung, Nachverfolgung von Ausgaben und Verwaltung von Sammlungen.
• Sie sind zufrieden mit Exkursionen innerhalb des Madurai-Gebiets und gedeihen in einer strukturierten Umgebung, in der Sie eng mit dem Area Sales Manager zusammenarbeiten. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. W
