Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. En tant que Territorial Manager (Individual Contributor) basé à Madurai , vous jouerez un rôle crucial dans la conduite des ventes, Doctor Promotion, la promotion au détail, la gestion des réseaux de distribution, et l'exécution des plans de promotion des ventes pour votre territoire. Vous assurerez la pénétration de nos produits sur le marché assigné efficacement en soutenant les distributeurs, en recueillant des informations sur le marché et en s'associant au Gestionnaire des ventes de secteur (ASM) pour atteindre nos objectifs commerciaux. L'opportunité
• Promouvoir les produits pharmaceutiques auprès des professionnels de la santé (PSC) par la communication scientifique, l'établissement de relations, le détail des produits et le marketing éthique afin d'accroître la sensibilisation aux produits et les prescriptions.
• Vous aidez l'ASM à planifier le territoire en fournissant des renseignements sur l'environnement du marché pour estimer la demande annuelle, en soumettant les exigences d'inventaire au niveau des distributeurs et en surveillant la disponibilité des stocks de matériel promotionnel.
• Vous préparez et exécutez des plans mensuels de promotion des ventes, y compris des activités d'activation sur le terrain et de merchandising, et enregistrez méticuleusement les dépenses et les ventes générées pour évaluer l'efficacité du programme.
• Vous veillez à la réalisation mensuelle de vos objectifs et exécutez des plans de vente mensuels par SKU en générant activement des ventes secondaires sur le marché.
• Vous gérez le réseau de distribution en surveillant les performances des distributeurs, en proposant la nomination de nouveaux distributeurs ou en recommandant la cessation de ceux qui ne sont pas performants.
• Vous motivez les distributeurs et les concessionnaires par des visites régulières, des appels et de la correspondance, aidant à résoudre leurs préoccupations concernant les comptes, les prix, la concurrence et les régimes.
• Vous organisez des réunions de distributeurs et de concessionnaires en accord avec les stratégies de marketing, et vous assurez le succès des collections mensuelles grâce à des suivis continus.
• Vous agissez comme les yeux et les oreilles du marché en surveillant les activités des concurrents, en traitant les plaintes des clients ou des concessionnaires en les transmettant aux soins des clients, et en assurant un rapport quotidien de vos visites des clients. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en affaires, marketing, sciences de la vie ou un domaine connexe.
• Vous avez prouvé votre expérience pratique dans les ventes sur le terrain, la gestion de la distribution ou un rôle de gestion du territoire.
• Vous avez un vif intérêt à stimuler la croissance du marché, en mettant l'accent sur l'établissement de relations, la génération de la demande et l'exécution de stratégies marketing.
• Vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication et en négociation et êtes confiant dans la gestion des interactions médecins, chimistes et concessionnaires, la résolution des problèmes et la tenue de réunions promotionnelles.
• Vous êtes très organisé et diligent avec des tâches administratives, y compris des rapports quotidiens, hebdomadaires et mensuels, le suivi des dépenses et la gestion des collections.
• Vous êtes à l'aise avec les voyages sur le terrain dans le territoire de Madurai et prospèrez dans un environnement structuré où vous collaborez étroitement avec le responsable des ventes Area. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. W

jobs.title: 生产实习生（灌装/filling）
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
工程项目支持和运行准备阶段 :

• 在直线经理的指导下，参与新厂房的设计和建设，包括但不限于工厂验收测试 (FAT)、现场验收测试 (SAT)、安装运行性能确认 (IOPQ) 等，为项目交付做出贡献。

• 参与生产工艺的初步开发和优化。

• 参与运行准备工作的实施。

• 接受生产设备操作，无菌灌装，灯检， CCS 实施等方面的培训并获得相关资质。

日常运营阶段 :

• 确保日常操作符合罗氏的GMP/SHE及相关法规要求。

• 执行日常生产操作并填写GMP记录，确保所有生产活动的数据准确性、完整性和可追溯性。

• 在生产过程中实施冷链管理。

• 熟悉掌握相关IT系统操作，例如SAP、MES。

• 执行其他分配的任务。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Solution Architect - Dia Commercial Operations
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Solution Architect - Dia Commercial Operations

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

This role is based in the Commercial Operations division, which is dedicated to evolving digital technology solutions that enhance healthcare experiences worldwide. We operate within a mature environment built on deep business partnership and trust, which means that you will collaborate directly with cross-functional stakeholders to understand complex needs and propose optimal integration pathways. The critical importance of managing a highly interconnected system combined with the unique opportunity to drive future-ready architecture using MuleSoft offers you an exceptionally engaging space to influence strategic digital transformation.

The opportunity:

• Your main focus will be designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions that handle complex interdependencies and seamlessly connect a wide variety of global commercial systems.

• You are defining and driving integration pathways, reference architectures, and patterns, with a primary emphasis on maximizing the capabilities of MuleSoft as our core integration platform.

• You are establishing and maintaining the long-term technology roadmap and architecture vision, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards while actively managing technical debt and non-functional requirements.

• You are partnering directly with business teams and stakeholders to translate their operational needs into optimal technical concepts, acting as a trusted advisor who can clearly explain complex architectures.

• You are leading and mentoring product teams, providing technical oversight, evaluating external technology trends, and conducting vendor feasibility assessments to continuously enhance business value.

Who you are:

To ensure a seamless fit for this highly interconnected environment, candidates will be evaluated against the following criteria:

• Required Experience: Demonstrated track record designing complex, multi-solution architectures, managing long-term technical roadmaps, and creating logical data models.

• Required Technical Mastery: Advanced, expert-level proficiency in integration frameworks, with a strict requirement for hands-on mastery of MuleSoft across highly interdependent landscapes.

• Required Communication: Exceptional negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to challenge assumptions, influence perspectives, and clearly articulate difficult technical concepts to non-technical business partners.

• Preferred: Prior experience proactively cont

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Soluzione Architetto - Dia Commercial Operations Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Questo ruolo è basato nella divisione Operazioni Commerciali, che è dedicata a soluzioni tecnologiche digitali in evoluzione che migliorano le esperienze sanitarie in tutto il mondo. Operiamo all'interno di un ambiente maturo costruito sulla profonda partnership aziendale e la fiducia, il che significa che collaborerete direttamente con gli stakeholder interfunzionali per comprendere le esigenze complesse e proporre percorsi di integrazione ottimali. L'importanza critica della gestione di un sistema altamente interconnesso combinato con l'opportunità unica di guidare l'architettura pronta per il futuro utilizzando MuleSoft vi offre uno spazio estremamente coinvolgente per influenzare la trasformazione digitale strategica. L'opportunità:
• Il vostro focus principale sarà la progettazione di soluzioni business-driven, basate su standard e future-ready che gestiscono interdipendenze complesse e collegare senza soluzione di continuità una vasta gamma di sistemi commerciali globali.
• Stai definendo e guidando percorsi di integrazione, architetture di riferimento e modelli, con un'enfasi primaria sulla massimizzazione delle capacità di MuleSoft come la nostra piattaforma di integrazione di base.
• Stai stabilendo e mantenendo la roadmap tecnologica a lungo termine e la visione dell'architettura, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard aziendali, mentre gestisci attivamente il debito tecnico e i requisiti non funzionali.
• Stai collaborando direttamente con i team aziendali e gli stakeholder per tradurre le loro esigenze operative in concetti tecnici ottimali, agendo come consulente di fiducia che può chiaramente spiegare architetture complesse.
• Siete leader e team di prodotti di mentoring, fornendo la supervisione tecnica, valutando le tendenze della tecnologia esterna, e conducendo le valutazioni di fattibilità del fornitore per migliorare continuamente il valore aziendale. Chi sei: Per garantire una soluzione perfetta per questo ambiente altamente interconnesso, i candidati saranno valutati rispetto ai seguenti criteri:
• Esperienza richiesta: Dimostrato track record di progettazione di architetture complesse e multi-soluzione, gestione di roadmap tecniche a lungo termine, e la creazione di modelli di dati logici.
• Mastery Tecnico richiesto: Avanzata, competenza a livello di esperti nei quadri di integrazione, con un requisito rigoroso per la padronanza pratica di MuleSoft attraverso paesaggi altamente interdipendenti.
• Comunicazione richiesta: Eccezionale negoziazione e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder, con una comprovata capacità di sfidare i presupposti, influenzare le prospettive e chiaramente articolare concetti tecnici difficili ai partner commerciali non tecnici.
• Preferito: Esperienza precedente proattivamente

• Maîtrise technique requise : Compétence avancée et experte en cadres d'intégration, avec une exigence stricte de maîtrise pratique de MuleSoft sur des paysages fortement interdépendants.

The Position
负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Quality Manager - RDT Diagnostics Commercial

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. The Position
Operations Lead - RDT Diagnostics Commercial

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Located within the Commercial Operations division, this position is central to developing digital technology solutions that improve global healthcare experiences. You will work in a sophisticated setting defined by end-to-end accountability, requiring tight integration with numerous internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to maintain seamless business operations. This role offers a unique and highly engaging platform for innovation, particularly through the deployment of cutting-edge automation and AI frameworks..

The opportunity:

• Your main focus will be holding end-to-end accountability for the operational health, infrastructure lifecycle, and business continuity of our critical global Quote Management ecosystem.

• You are leading and governing our outsourced managed services partner, defining strategic operational KPIs, maintaining strict SLA compliance, and providing crucial business-domain mentorship to external team members.

• You are driving deep cross-functional coordination across integration platforms (including SAP, Salesforce, and MuleSoft) and enterprise infrastructure teams, acting as a strategic liaison to break down technical silos.

• You are managing long-term infrastructure planning, overseeing capacity management and budgeting, while actively identifying opportunities to implement innovative AI and automation solutions

• You are fostering an ecosystem of extreme accountability and proactiveness, mentoring internal technical talent, and championing a "fix once" approach to eliminate recurring operational risks.

Who you are:

• Experience: 5+ years in IT operations, infrastructure, or business analysis with proven end-to-end support ownership; including 3+ years in the MedTech or Healthcare Life Sciences sector.

• Vendor Management: A proven track record of managing and driving accountability with outsourced/managed services delivery partners.

• Domain Expertise: Strong, demonstrable understanding of the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C), CPQ, and Commercial business domains.

• Methodologies: Active ITIL, Agile (Scrum, SAFe)

What you get:

• Salary range 19.000-35.000PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy avail

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:
This role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

As an Intern , you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Applying general procurement knowledge or expertise in a specific commodity or spend area, you will ensure effective and efficient delivery of core procurement services and continuous improvement of automation and content availability.

You will collaborate closely with internal procurement (i.e. Chapters and capability areas such as customer relationship management, contracting, solutions, analytics, etc.) and business stakeholders to translate business needs into sourcing and spend management activities and content enhancement.

You will work closely with other team members to support customer demand, improve the customer buying experience, deliver on day-to day operational activities, and provide capacity and expertise to deliver productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions.

You will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

• Applying your fast-learning skills to assist the team with ad-hoc business projects, continuous improvement initiatives, and new process implementations.

• Acting as a key point of contact to coordinate with external suppliers, track project progress, and help resolve day-to-day operational queries.

• Executing daily system operations, maintaining data accuracy, and ensuring smooth transactional flows within the SAP system.

Who you are:

• You are enrolled at university (preferably in business or a related discipline; preferably as a graduate)

• You demonstrate strong learning agility and a proactive willingness to quickly grasp new concepts, processes, and systems in a dynamic environment.

• You are capable of quickly getting hands-on with SAP systems, and ideally have some basic knowledge or practical exp

• Applicando le tue capacità di apprendimento rapido per aiutare il team con progetti di business ad-hoc, iniziative di miglioramento continuo e nuove implementazioni di processo.
• Agire come punto di contatto chiave per coordinare con fornitori esterni, monitorare i progressi del progetto e aiutare a risolvere le domande operative quotidiane.
• Eseguire operazioni di sistema quotidiane, mantenere l'accuratezza dei dati e garantire flussi transazionali lisci all'interno del sistema SAP. Chi sei:
• Sei iscritto all'università (preferibilmente in affari o una disciplina relativa; preferibilmente come laureato)
• Si dimostra una forte agilità di apprendimento e una proattiva disponibilità a cogliere rapidamente nuovi concetti, processi e sistemi in un ambiente dinamico.
• Siete in grado di ottenere rapidamente hands-on con i sistemi SAP, e idealmente avere alcune conoscenze di base o pratico exp

Les collectivités sont des catalyseurs clés d'une solide expertise de catégorie tout en permettant une souplesse dans la prestation des approvisionnements répondant aux besoins changeants de nos clients. En appliquant les connaissances générales ou l'expertise en matière d'approvisionnement dans un secteur particulier, vous assurerez une prestation efficace et efficiente des services d'approvisionnement de base et une amélioration continue de l'automatisation et de la disponibilité du contenu. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec l'approvisionnement interne (c.-à-d. les chapitres et les domaines de capacité tels que la gestion de la relation client, la passation de marchés, les solutions, l'analyse, etc.) et les intervenants commerciaux pour traduire les besoins opérationnels en activités d'approvisionnement et de gestion des dépenses et en amélioration du contenu. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec d'autres membres de l'équipe afin de soutenir la demande des clients, d'améliorer l'expérience d'achat des clients, de mener des activités opérationnelles quotidiennes et de fournir une capacité et une expertise pour fournir la productivité et d'autres projets/solutions axés sur les clients. Vous jouerez une variété de rôles en fonction de votre expérience, de vos connaissances et des exigences générales de votre entreprise, notamment :
• Vous développez du contenu et de l'automatisation, transformant les résultats et les possibilités d'approvisionnement en contenu et en canaux d'achat automatisés qui améliorent l'adoption, la satisfaction et l'efficacité globale des entreprises.

• Vous démontrez une forte agilité d'apprentissage et une volonté proactive de saisir rapidement de nouveaux concepts, processus et systèmes dans un environnement dynamique.

jobs.title: Sourcing Lead - APAC
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
Are you ready to lead the strategic gateway that bridges APAC innovation with global healthcare demand? As our Asia Sourcing Office Lead in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will drive global sourcing and operational excellence for DOP. In this role, you will lead a dedicated regional team across APAC, champion digital procurement transformation, and navigate complex global markets to ensure our supply networks remain highly competitive and resilient.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Head of Procurement Centre of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You are accountable for leading, coaching, and developing a global, cross-cultural matrix team of up to 15 Sourcing Managers and one Business Capability Lead. You manage key interfaces across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), DOP Category, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, and external suppliers.

• Role Type: A leadership position evenly split between strategic category alignment and tactical sourcing execution, focusing on regional sourcing expertise and talent empowerment.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing excellence, financial value, and digital governance across APAC. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics (PPV, preferred supplier share, cycle times), tracking stakeholder/supplier satisfaction, and managing your team's OPEX budget.

• Asia Sourcing Office Mandate: Finding potential suppliers across Asia, executing initial due diligence, and conducting targeted regional benchmarking.

• Sourcing & Analysis: Overseeing compliant global and regional sourcing, benchmarking (RfX), and detailed procurement analyses alongside NPI and Delivery managers.

• Contracts & SLAs: Ensuring template-based contract execution (CDAs, SOWs), repository health, and defining KPIs to guarantee on-time, in-full (OTIF) portfolio delivery.

• myBuy Governance: Serving as Business Capability Lead (BCL) to drive platform governance, policy, continuous improvement, and knowledge management alongside RSS.

• Conflict & Exposure: Resolving matrix priority and supplier selection conflicts, representing DOP at external events, and delivering monthly/quarterly updates to executive leadership (CoE, Category, Delivery, and DPLT).

Who you are
We look for leaders who can drive high-performance cultures, break down silos, and eliminate operational friction.

• Education: University degree (Business/Life Sciences required); MBA and CIPS certification highly preferred.

• Experience: 5-7+ years in Direct Procurement (Medtech, Automotive, etc.), including 3-5 years within a Shared Service or CoE environment.

• Market Expertise: Strong regional sourcing and NPI experience across complex direct categories (EMS/e-components, Plastics/Packaging, or Biologics/Chemicals).

• AI & Digitalization: You have a strong affinity to explore AI-driven solutions broadly, particularly regard

• Impatto: Guidate l'eccellenza globale, il valore finanziario e la governance digitale attraverso APAC. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Performance & Savings: Guidare metriche chiave (PPV, quota di fornitore preferita, tempi di ciclo), tracciare la soddisfazione degli stakeholder/fornitori e gestire il budget OPEX del vostro team.
• Asia Sourcing Office Mandate: Trovare potenziali fornitori in tutta l'Asia, eseguire due diligence iniziali e condurre benchmark mirati regionali.
• Sourcing & Analysis: supervisionare l'approvvigionamento globale e regionale, il benchmarking (RfX) e le analisi dettagliate di approvvigionamento insieme a NPI e Delivery Manager.
• Contratti & SLA: Garantire l'esecuzione contrattuale basata su modelli (CDA, SOWs), la salute del repository e la definizione di KPI per garantire la consegna del portafoglio on-time, in-full (OTIF).
• myBuy Governance: Serving as Business Capability Lead (BCL) per guidare la governance della piattaforma, la politica, il miglioramento continuo e la gestione della conoscenza accanto a RSS.
• Conflict & Exposure: Risolvere la priorità della matrice e i conflitti di selezione dei fornitori, in rappresentanza del DOP a eventi esterni, e fornire aggiornamenti mensili / trimestrali alla leadership esecutiva (CoE, Categoria, Consegna e DPLT). Chi sei Cerchiamo leader in grado di guidare culture ad alte prestazioni, abbattere silos, ed eliminare attrito operativo.
• Istruzione: laurea universitaria (Business / Life Sciences richiesto); certificazione MBA e CIPS altamente preferito.
• Esperienza: 5-7 anni in Direct Procurement (Medtech, Automotive, ecc.), compresi 3-5 anni all'interno di un servizio condiviso o ambiente CoE.
• Esperienza di mercato: Forte sourcing regionale e esperienza NPI in categorie dirette complesse (EMS/e-components, Plastics/Packaging, o Biologics/Chemicals).
• AI & Digitalization: Hai una forte affinità per esplorare soluzioni basate sull'intelligenza artificiale in generale, in particolare riguardo

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di sostenere al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Siete pronti per orchestrare le reti di approvvigionamento che rendono possibile la diagnostica salvavita? Come nostro Senior Sourcing Manager a Kuala Lumpur, Malesia, sarete una parte fondamentale delle nostre operazioni di sourcing APAC. Potrai condurre progetti sourcing end-to-end, mentore un team crescente di Sourcing Managers, e servire come consulente chiave per la leadership executive. Se si prospera sulla complessità e vuole sentire un impatto diretto sulla consegna di diagnostica salvavita ai pazienti in tutto il mondo, questo è dove si appartiene.
• Linea di segnalazione: La posizione riporta direttamente alla Sourcing Lead APAC e fa parte della il Centro di Eccellenza (CoE).
• Team Wider e stakeholders: farai parte di un team regionale di Senior Sourcing Managers e Sourcing Managers, gestire le relazioni con altri stakeholder DOP (Categoria, Consegna) e fornitori esterni.
• Role Type: Un singolo contributor con responsabilità per i membri della squadra junior.
• Impatto: Guidate l'eccellenza globale, il valore finanziario e la conformità attraverso l'impronta APAC. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Performance & Savings: Guidare metriche chiave - tra cui il risparmio PPV, la quota di fornitore preferita e i tempi di ciclo accorciati - per fornire valore di linea inferiore durante il monitoraggio della soddisfazione degli stakeholder.
• Sourcing & Analysis: Esecuzione di attività di approvvigionamento globale, processi standard (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), e benchmarking NPI in stretta collaborazione con i manager di Categoria e NPI.
• Contract & Document Management: Impostazione e revisione dei contratti di alta complessità (ad esempio, MSAs) e documentazione di acquisto, mentre gestiscono con precisione i loro repository e rinnovi del ciclo di vita.
• Eccellenza Operativa e Leadership delle PMI: Agire come esperto di materia (SME) per semplificare i flussi di lavoro, analizzare i requisiti degli utenti del sito per i metodi di migliore valore e garantire una rigorosa conformità alle politiche globali.
• Risoluzione & CSR del collo di bottiglia: Partner con funzioni di supporto come Accounts Payable (AP) per sgomberare i colli di bottiglia amministrativi relativi ai fornitori, pur sostenendo le iniziative di base di fornitura CSR (diversità, sostenibilità, pratiche etiche).
• Conflict & Exposure: Gestire conflitti di alto livello per quanto riguarda le priorità del progetto o le selezioni dei fornitori concorrenti, e fornire aggiornamenti mensili / trimestrali ad alta frequenza al CoE LT e al DPLT. Chi sei Ci sforziamo di mantenere i nostri standard elevati e cercare candidati che possono abbracciare la collaborazione, fornire direzione e colleghi mentore in diverse posizioni.
• Istruzione: Una laurea universitaria (Business o Scienze della Vita preferita) è necessaria; un MBA o certificazioni equivalenti e professionali (ad esempio, CIPS, ISM) sono desiderabili.
• Esperienza: 5-7 anni di esperienza nella gestione del contratto di sourcing e end-to-end. Hai una comprovata traccia di progetti di appalto di guida (ad esempio, iniziative di riduzione dei costi e programmi di miglioramento del valore).
• Esperienza di mercato:
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position About Our Team We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you. We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next. The Opportunity Are you ready to orchestrate the supply networks that make life-saving diagnostics possible? As our Senior Sourcing Manager in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will be a key part of our APAC sourcing operations. You will lead end-to-end sourcing projects, mentor a rising team of Sourcing Managers, and serve as a key advisor to executive leadership. If you thrive on complexity and want to feel a direct impact on the delivery of life-saving diagnostics to patients worldwide, this is where you belong.
• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Sourcing Lead APAC and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
• Wider team and stakeholders: You will be part of a regional team of Senior Sourcing Managers and Sourcing Managers, managing relationships with other DOP stakeholders (Category, Delivery) as well as external suppliers.
• Role Type: An Individual Contributor with responsibilities to mentor junior team members.
• Impact: You drive global sourcing excellence, financial value, and compliance across the APAC footprint. Specifically, you are accountable for:
• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics - including PPV savings, preferred supplier share, and shortened cycle times - to deliver bottom-line value while tracking stakeholder satisfaction.
• Sourcing & Analysis: Executing global sourcing activities, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and NPI benchmarking in close collaboration with Category and NPI managers.
• Contract & Document Management: Setting up and reviewing high-complexity contracts (e.g., MSAs) and purchasing documentation, while accurately managing their lifecycle repository and renewals.
• Operational Excellence & SME Leadership: Acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to simplify workflows, analyze site user requirements for best-value methods, and ensure strict compliance with global policies.
• Bottleneck Resolution & CSR: Partnering with support functions like Accounts Payable (AP) to clear supplier-related administrative bottlenecks, while championing supply base CSR initiatives (diversity, sustainability, ethical practices).
• Conflict & Exposure: Managing high-stakes conflicts regarding competing project priorities or supplier selections, and delivering high-frequency monthly/quarterly updates to the CoE LT and DPLT. Who you are We strive to keep our standards high and look for candidates who can embrace collaboration, provide direction and mentor colleagues across different locations.
• Education: A University degree (Business or Life Sciences preferred) is required; an MBA or equivalent and professional certifications (e.g., CIPS, ISM) are desirable.
• Experience: 5-7+ years of experience in sourcing and end-to-end contract management. You have a proven track record of driving procurement projects (e.g., cost-reduction initiatives and value-improvement programs).
• Market Expertise:
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Über unser Team Wir bei Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) sind ein Team von rund 200 begeisterten Fachleuten, die sich dafür einsetzen, mit unseren Lieferanten weltweit Wert zu schaffen. Von Standorten auf der ganzen Welt und mit einem vielfältigen und multikulturellen Team beziehen, verwalten wir unsere Lieferantenbasis, entwickeln und führen Kategoriestrategien aus und entwickeln und digitalisieren ständig Prozesse, die es uns ermöglichen, unser Geschäft bestmöglich zu unterstützen, um nachhaltig zu wachsen. Wenn Sie etwas bewirken möchten und Teil eines leistungsstarken und erstklassigen Beschaffungsteams sein möchten, ist dies das Richtige für Sie. Wir sind DOP. Bei Roche tun wir jetzt, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, die Versorgungsnetze zu orchestrieren, die eine lebensrettende Diagnose ermöglichen? Als Senior Sourcing Manager in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, werden Sie ein wichtiger Teil unserer APAC-Sourcing-Aktivitäten sein. Sie werden End-to-End-Sourcing-Projekte leiten, ein wachsendes Team von Sourcing-Managern betreuen und als wichtiger Berater für die Führungskräfte fungieren. Wenn Sie von Komplexität leben und einen direkten Einfluss auf die Bereitstellung lebensrettender Diagnostik für Patienten weltweit spüren möchten, gehören Sie dorthin.
• Reporting Line: Die Position berichtet direkt an den Sourcing Lead APAC und ist Teil von Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
• Breiteres Team und Stakeholder: Sie werden Teil eines regionalen Teams von Senior Sourcing Managern und Sourcing Managern, die Beziehungen zu anderen DOP-Stakeholdern (Kategorie, Lieferung) sowie zu externen Lieferanten verwalten.
• Rollentyp: Ein einzelner Mitwirkender mit Verantwortlichkeiten für Mentor-Junior-Teammitglieder.
• Auswirkungen: Sie fördern globale Sourcing-Exzellenz, finanziellen Wert und Compliance über den gesamten APAC-Fußabdruck hinweg. Insbesondere sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Performance & Einsparungen: Driving Key Metriken - einschließlich PPV Einsparungen, bevorzugte Lieferantenanteile und verkürzte Zykluszeiten - um unterm Strich Wert zu liefern und gleichzeitig die Zufriedenheit der Stakeholder zu verfolgen.
• Sourcing & Analysis: Durchführung von globalen Sourcing-Aktivitäten, Standardprozessen (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs) und NPI-Benchmarking in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Category- und NPI-Managern.
• Contract & Document Management: Einrichtung und Überprüfung von hochkomplexen Verträgen (z. B. MSAs) und Einkaufsdokumentation, während das Lifecycle-Repository und die Verlängerungen genau verwaltet werden.
• Operational Excellence & SME Leadership: Als Subject Matter Expert (KMU) fungieren, um Workflows zu vereinfachen, die Anforderungen der Website-Benutzer nach Methoden mit dem besten Wert zu analysieren und die strikte Einhaltung globaler Richtlinien sicherzustellen.
• Bottleneck Resolution & CSR: Partnerschaft mit Supportfunktionen wie Accounts Payable (AP), um lieferantenbezogene administrative Engpässe zu beseitigen und gleichzeitig CSR-Initiativen (Vielfalt, Nachhaltigkeit, ethische Praktiken) zu fördern.
• Konflikt & Exposure: Bewältigung von Konflikten mit hohen Einsätzen in Bezug auf konkurrierende Projektprioritäten oder Lieferantenauswahlen und Bereitstellung von hochfrequenten monatlichen / vierteljährlichen Updates für die CoE LT und DPLT. Wer du bist Wir bemühen uns, unsere Standards hoch zu halten und suchen nach Kandidaten, die die Zusammenarbeit unterstützen, Orientierungs- und Mentorkollegen an verschiedenen Standorten anbieten können.
• Ausbildung: Ein Universitätsabschluss (Business oder Life Sciences bevorzugt) ist erforderlich; ein MBA oder gleichwertige und professionelle Zertifizierungen (z. B. CIPS, ISM) sind wünschenswert.
• Erfahrung: 5-7+ Jahre Erfahrung im Sourcing und End-to-End-Vertragsmanagement. Sie haben eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Förderung von Beschaffungsprojekten (z. B. Kostensenkungsinitiativen und Wertsteigerungsprogramme).

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à orchestrer les réseaux d'approvisionnement qui rendent possible le diagnostic de sauvetage? En tant que Senior Sourcing Manager à Kuala Lumpur en Malaisie, vous serez un élément clé de nos opérations d'approvisionnement APAC. Vous dirigerez des projets d'approvisionnement de bout en bout, mentorerez une équipe montante de gestionnaires d'approvisionnement et agirez comme conseiller clé du leadership de la haute direction. Si vous vous développez sur la complexité et voulez sentir un impact direct sur la livraison de diagnostics de sauvetage aux patients du monde entier, c'est là que vous appartenez.
• Ligne de rapport : Le poste relève directement du PAAC responsable de l'approvisionnement. le Centre d'excellence pour les achats (CdE).
• Équipe élargie et intervenants : Vous ferez partie d'une équipe régionale de gestionnaires principaux d'approvisionnement et de gestionnaires d'approvisionnement, gérerez les relations avec d'autres intervenants du PAD (catégorie, prestation) ainsi qu'avec des fournisseurs externes.
• Type de rôle : Collaborateur individuel ayant des responsabilités de mentorer les membres de l'équipe junior.
• Impact : Vous dirigez l'excellence globale de l'approvisionnement, la valeur financière et la conformité à l'échelle de l'APAC. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Performances et économies : Ce sont les indicateurs clés - y compris les économies de VCP, la part de fournisseur préférée et les délais de cycle raccourcis - qui permettent d'obtenir une valeur de base tout en suivant la satisfaction des intervenants.
• Sourcing & Analysis: Exécuter des activités d'approvisionnement à l'échelle mondiale, des processus standard (RfI, RfQ, RfP) et des analyses comparatives NPI en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de catégorie et NPI.
• Gestion des contrats et des documents : Établissement et examen des contrats à haute complexité (p. ex., ESM) et de la documentation d'achat, tout en gérant avec précision leur dépôt et leur renouvellement du cycle de vie.
• Excellence opérationnelle et leadership des PME : agir à titre d'expert en matière d'activités (EMS) afin de simplifier les flux de travail, d'analyser les exigences des utilisateurs du site pour les méthodes les plus avantageuses et d'assurer le strict respect des politiques mondiales.
• Résolution des goulets d'étranglement & RSE : partenariat avec des fonctions de soutien comme Comptes créditeurs (AP) pour éliminer les goulets d'étranglement administratifs liés aux fournisseurs, tout en défendant les initiatives RSE de base de l'offre (diversité, durabilité, pratiques éthiques).
• Conflict & Exposure: Gestion des conflits à fort débit concernant les priorités concurrentes du projet ou les sélections de fournisseurs, et livraison de mises à jour mensuelles/trimestriels à haute fréquence au COE LT et au DPLT. Qui vous êtes Nous nous efforçons de maintenir nos normes élevées et de rechercher des candidats qui peuvent embrasser la collaboration, fournir une orientation et des collègues mentors dans différents endroits.
• Études : Un diplôme universitaire (de préférence pour les affaires ou les sciences de la vie) est requis; un MBA ou un certificat équivalent et professionnel (p. ex. CIPS, ISM) sont souhaitables.
• Expérience : 5-7 ans et plus d'expérience en approvisionnement et gestion des contrats de bout en bout. Vous avez fait la preuve de vos antécédents en matière de projets d'approvisionnement (p. ex. initiatives de réduction des coûts et programmes d'amélioration de la valeur).

jobs.title: Category Manager - eComponents
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team
We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
Are you ready to architect the overarching global procurement strategy and command the end-to-end supplier networks for the electronic components that power our next-generation diagnostic devices? As our Global Category Manager for e-Components in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will take ultimate accountability for developing strategies and leading strategic initiatives for this critical spend category. In this role, you will manage top-tier electronic component suppliers, navigate global supply chain complexities, and translate category goals into bottom-line value creation.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the Senior Global Category Lead Electronics & Systems within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Engages directly with cross-functional teams composed of representatives from Category, Delivery, Procurement Center of Excellence, and global business partners. Serves as a key business partner contact point for senior functional and business stakeholders.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role with global category leadership position focused on strategic vision, category development, pipeline building, and relationship ecosystem management

• Impact: You deliver commercial impact by anchoring cost and developing a resilience pipeline of projects, in addition to securing our sustainability priorities. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, supplier data, and business requirements to formulate a formalized, global Category Strategy and initiative pipeline, to be aligned with leaders across the organization.

• Commercial Negotiations: Leading high-value commercial and contractual negotiations for strategic suppliers within the category.

• Supplier Ecosystems: Managing key global suppliers, establishing development and innovation programs, monitoring value targets, and managing supplier risks.

• Guidance & Content: Developing and maintaining category guidance documents to translate strategy into clear, executable content for procurement colleagues and business users.

• Business Partnering: Building deep relationships with senior stakeholders, challenging demand/specifications to maximize value, and managing risk/CSR reviews.

• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching procurement colleagues, providing professional development, managing a shared Associate Category Manager within the team, and tracking budget spend.

Who you are
We look for strategic procurement champions with extensive knowledge of global electronics supply markets and the matrix leadership skills needed to drive complex organizational change.

• Education: University degree required (Business or Life Sciences focus preferred); a post-graduate business-related qualification is preferred.

• Experience: 5+ years of in-depth strategic and operational procurement experience with extensive knowled

L'opportunità Siete pronti ad architettare la strategia di approvvigionamento globale e a comandare le reti di fornitori end-to-end per i componenti elettronici che alimentano i nostri dispositivi diagnostici di nuova generazione? Come nostro Global Categoria Manager per e-Componenti a Kuala Lumpur, Malesia, si terrà la massima responsabilità per lo sviluppo di strategie e le principali iniziative strategiche per questa categoria di spesa critica. In questo ruolo, gestirai fornitori di componenti elettronici di alto livello, navigherai complessitÃ globali della supply chain e traduci gli obiettivi di categoria nella creazione di valore di linea inferiore.
• Reporting Line: Referisce direttamente alla Senior Global Categoria Lead Electronics & Systems all'interno dell'organizzazione Categoria.
• Wider Team e Stakeholders: Engages direttamente con team cross-funzionali composti da rappresentanti di Categoria, Consegna, Centro di Eccellenza e partner commerciali globali. Serve come punto di contatto chiave del partner commerciale per gli stakeholder senior funzionali e aziendali.
• Role Type: Un ruolo di Contributor individuale con la posizione di leadership di categoria globale focalizzata sulla visione strategica, lo sviluppo di categoria, la costruzione di pipeline e la gestione degli ecosistemi di relazione
• Impatto: Consegne l'impatto commerciale ancorando i costi e sviluppando una pipeline di resilienza di progetti, oltre a garantire le nostre priorità di sostenibilità. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Strategia & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, dati dei fornitori e requisiti di business per formulare un pipeline di strategia e iniziativa di categoria formalizzato e globale, da allineare con i leader di tutta l'organizzazione.
• Negoziati commerciali: trattative commerciali e contrattuali di alto valore per i fornitori strategici all'interno della categoria.
• Ecosistemi del fornitore: Gestire fornitori globali chiave, stabilire programmi di sviluppo e innovazione, monitorare obiettivi di valore e gestire i rischi dei fornitori.
• Orientamento e contenuto: Sviluppare e mantenere i documenti di orientamento della categoria per tradurre la strategia in contenuti chiari ed eseguibili per l'approvvigionamento di colleghi e utenti aziendali.
• Business Partnering: Costruire relazioni profonde con gli stakeholder senior, sfidare la domanda / specifiche per massimizzare il valore, e gestire le recensioni di rischio / CSR.
• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching colleghi di approvvigionamento, fornendo lo sviluppo professionale, la gestione di un Associate Categoria Manager condiviso all'interno del team, e il monitoraggio della spesa di bilancio. Chi sei Cerchiamo campioni strategici di approvvigionamento con una vasta conoscenza dei mercati di approvvigionamento dell'elettronica globale e delle competenze di leadership matrice necessarie per guidare il cambiamento organizzativo complesso.
• Istruzione: diploma universitario richiesto (Business o Scienze della vita si concentrano preferito); una qualifica post-laurea legata al business è preferito.
• Esperienza: 5+ anni di esperienza di approvvigionamento strategico e operativo approfondita con ampio knowled

En tant que Global Category Manager pour e-Components à Kuala Lumpur, en Malaisie, vous serez responsable de l'élaboration de stratégies et des initiatives stratégiques pour cette catégorie de dépenses critiques. Dans ce rôle, vous gérerez des fournisseurs de composants électroniques de premier ordre, naviguerez dans les complexités de la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale et traduireez les objectifs de catégorie en création de valeur de base.
• Ligne hiérarchique : relève directement de l'organisation principale de la catégorie Global Lead Electronics & Systems au sein de la catégorie.
• Équipe élargie et parties prenantes : S'engage directement auprès d'équipes interfonctionnelles composées de représentants de la catégorie, de la livraison, du centre d'excellence en achats et de partenaires commerciaux mondiaux. Il sert de point de contact principal des partenaires commerciaux pour les principaux intervenants fonctionnels et commerciaux.
• Type de rôle : Un participant individuel occupant un poste de dirigeant de catégorie mondiale axé sur la vision stratégique, l'élaboration de catégories, la construction de pipelines et la gestion des rapports écosystémiques
• Impact: Vous produisez un impact commercial en ancrage des coûts et en développant un pipeline de résilience de projets, en plus de garantir nos priorités de durabilité. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Stratégie et pipeline annuel : Rassembler les renseignements sur le marché, les données sur les fournisseurs et les exigences opérationnelles pour formuler un pipeline officiel de la catégorie mondiale et de l'initiative, qui sera aligné sur les dirigeants de l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Négociations commerciales : Mener des négociations commerciales et contractuelles de grande valeur pour les fournisseurs stratégiques de la catégorie.
• Écosystèmes fournisseurs : Gestion des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux, établissement de programmes de développement et d'innovation, surveillance des objectifs de valeur et gestion des risques pour les fournisseurs.
• Orientation et contenu : Élaborer et tenir à jour des documents d'orientation de catégorie afin de traduire la stratégie en contenu clair et exécutable pour les collègues en approvisionnement et les utilisateurs commerciaux.
• Partenariat d'affaires : Établir des relations étroites avec les intervenants de haut niveau, mettre en doute la demande et les particularités afin de maximiser la valeur et gérer les examens des risques et des RCS.
• Surveillance de l'équipe et du budget : Encadrer les collègues en approvisionnement, assurer le perfectionnement professionnel, gérer un gestionnaire de catégorie associé partagé au sein de l'équipe et suivre les dépenses budgétaires. Qui vous êtes Nous recherchons des champions stratégiques en matière d'approvisionnement qui possèdent une vaste connaissance des marchés mondiaux de l'approvisionnement en électronique et des compétences de leadership matricielle nécessaires pour favoriser un changement organisationnel complexe.
• Études : Diplôme universitaire requis (priorité de l'accent sur les affaires ou les sciences de la vie); une qualification liée aux affaires de troisième cycle est préférée.
• Expérience: 5 ans et plus d'expérience approfondie en matière d'approvisionnement stratégique et opérationnel avec une connaissance approfondie

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager - Asia Sourcing Office (Malaysia)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.

We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to optimize the supply networks that make life-saving diagnostics possible? As our Sourcing Manager in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will be a vital part of our APAC sourcing operations. In this high-impact role, you will execute end-to-end, medium- to high-complexity sourcing projects while acting as a key mechanism for the Asia Sourcing Office - identifying regional suppliers, performing initial due diligence, and translating transactional requests into strategic, value-add solutions.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Asia Sourcing Office Lead, and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Partners with DOP Category, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, regional operations stakeholders, and external suppliers to resolve administrative bottlenecks and inform future strategies.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on end-to-end sourcing execution, master data management, and value creation.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing excellence, financial value, and compliance across the APAC footprint. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Asia Supplier Discovery: Identifying potential suppliers across Asia, executing initial due diligence, and conducting targeted regional benchmarking.

• Sourcing Execution: Compliantly executing regional sourcing projects, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and eSourcing tools for on-market products and New Product Introductions (NPI).

• Demand Aggregation: Analyzing site user requirements, aggregating regional demand to maximize leverage, and escalating non-standard requests to Category Management.

• Project & Risk Management: Developing comprehensive project plans (timelines, milestones, resources) and proactively identifying and mitigating risks to objectives.

• Contract Lifecycle: Setting up template-based contracts (such as CDAs and SOWs) and accurately managing their lifecycle repository, renewals, and potential contractual improvements.

• Operational Excellence: Utilizing enterprise tools (SAP, myBuy) and master data management to simplify workflows and ensure strict compliance with global procurement policies.

• Metrics & CSR: Tracking operational targets and customer service metrics (such as cycle times and compliance) while championing supplier diversity, sustainability, and ethical practices.

• Collaboration & Exposure: Partnering with support functions (like Accounts Payable) to clear administrative bottlenecks and presenting regular KPI and project updates to the Sourcing Lead and regional stakeholders.

Who you are

We strive to keep our standards high and look for analytical problem-solvers with a strong customer-service focus.

• Education: University degree (Business/Life Sciences preferred) is required; an MBA or CIPS certification is highly desirable.

• Experience: 3–5+ years in procurement or sourcing,

• Metrics & CSR: Monitorare gli obiettivi operativi e le metriche del servizio clienti (come i tempi di ciclo e la conformità) e sostenere la diversità dei fornitori, la sostenibilità e le pratiche etiche.

jobs.title: Performance & Insights Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to be a key driver in transforming our procurement function into a data-driven organization? As our Performance & Insight Manager, based in Mumbai/Pune you will leverage complex data to generate actionable insights that optimize strategies, improve supplier performance, mitigate risks, and enhance overall procurement efficiency.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports the Head of Procurement Center of Excellence (DOP).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Works closely and cross-culturally with procurement team members, category managers, finance, IT, and other global stakeholders.

• Role Type: A highly analytical and strategic role focused on data integration, insights generation, and the continuous enhancement of procurement intelligence solutions.

• Impact: You will translate complex data into clear, impactful recommendations. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Insights Generation & Analysis: Proactively identifying areas where data can optimize decision-making. Conducting in-depth analysis to spot trends and opportunities, and performing scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for different procurement strategies.

• Reporting & Visualization: Designing and developing insightful dashboards, reports, and visualizations to track key procurement metrics (e.g., spend analysis, savings, supplier performance, risk, and compliance).

• Data Integration: Identifying, collecting, cleansing, and integrating relevant data from various internal and external sources, including ERP systems and market intelligence platforms.

• Program & Rollout Support: Supporting the deployment of procurement tools and processes by defining reporting requirements, developing tracking mechanisms, and ensuring data integrity during implementation.

• Technology Evaluation: Evaluating, recommending, and driving the implementation of appropriate data analytics tools and platforms in close collaboration with IT.

• Stakeholder Communication: Preparing and presenting findings effectively, translating complex data insights into clear, understandable formats for both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.

Who you are

We look for professionals with a strong analytical mindset, a can-do mentality, and a high willingness to take personal responsibility to drive our data evolution.

• Education: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline is required.

• Experience: 5+ years of proven experience in data analysis and insights generation, specifically focused on procurement or supply chain. Experience working cross-culturally in a global position is essential.

• Procurement Knowledge: A deep understanding of procurement processes, methodologies, and best practices.

• Technical Skills: Strong proficiency

Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Come nostro Performance & Insight Manager, potrete sfruttare i dati complessi per generare intuizioni attuabili che ottimizzano le strategie, migliorano le prestazioni dei fornitori, mitigano i rischi e migliorano l'efficienza complessiva degli approvvigionamenti.

• Tipo di ruolo: Un ruolo altamente analitico e strategico focalizzato sull'integrazione dei dati, sulla generazione di insight e sul continuo miglioramento delle soluzioni di intelligence di approvvigionamento.
• Impatto: Tradurrete i dati complessi in raccomandazioni chiare e impattanti. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Generazione & Analisi: individuare attivamente aree in cui i dati possono ottimizzare il processo decisionale. Condurre analisi approfondite per individuare tendenze e opportunità, e l'esecuzione della pianificazione dello scenario e analisi della sensibilità per diverse strategie di approvvigionamento.
• Reporting & Visualization: Progettazione e sviluppo di dashboard, report e visualizzazioni per monitorare le metriche di appalto chiave (ad esempio, passare analisi, risparmio, prestazioni dei fornitori, rischio e conformità).
• Integrazione dei dati: Identificare, raccogliere, pulire e integrare i dati pertinenti da varie fonti interne ed esterne, compresi i sistemi ERP e le piattaforme di intelligence di mercato.
• Supporto Program & Rollout: Sostenere l'implementazione di strumenti e processi di approvvigionamento definendo i requisiti di reportistica, sviluppando meccanismi di monitoraggio e garantendo l'integrità dei dati durante l'implementazione.
• Valutazione tecnologica: Valutazione, consulenza e guida dell'implementazione di strumenti e piattaforme di analisi dei dati appropriati in stretta collaborazione con IT.
• Stakeholder Communication: Preparazione e presentazione dei risultati in modo efficace, traducendo intuizioni di dati complesse in formati chiari e comprensibili sia per il pubblico tecnico che non tecnico, compresa la leadership. Chi sei Cerchiamo professionisti con una forte mentalità analitica, una mentalità can-do, e un'elevata disponibilità a prendere la responsabilità personale per guidare la nostra evoluzione dei dati.
• Istruzione: laurea o Master in un campo quantitativo come Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistica, Economia, Gestione della Supply Chain, o una disciplina relativa è necessaria.
• Esperienza: 5+ anni di comprovata esperienza nell'analisi dei dati e nella generazione di approfondimenti, specificamente focalizzati sull'approvvigionamento o sulla supply chain. L'esperienza di lavoro interculturale in una posizione globale è essenziale.
• Conoscenza degli appalti: una profonda comprensione dei processi di approvvigionamento, delle metodologie e delle migliori pratiche.
• Competenze tecniche: Forte competenza in SQL, database mana

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Über unser Team Wir bei Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) sind ein Team von rund 200 begeisterten Fachleuten, die sich dafür einsetzen, mit unseren Lieferanten weltweit Wert zu schaffen. Von Standorten auf der ganzen Welt und mit einem vielfältigen und multikulturellen Team beziehen, verwalten wir unsere Lieferantenbasis, entwickeln und führen Kategoriestrategien aus und entwickeln und digitalisieren ständig Prozesse, die es uns ermöglichen, unser Geschäft bestmöglich zu unterstützen, um nachhaltig zu wachsen. Wenn Sie etwas bewirken möchten und Teil eines leistungsstarken und erstklassigen Beschaffungsteams sein möchten, ist dies das Richtige für Sie. Wir sind DOP. Bei Roche tun wir jetzt, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, ein wichtiger Treiber bei der Umwandlung unserer Beschaffungsfunktion in eine datengesteuerte Organisation zu sein? Als Performance & Insight Manager nutzen Sie komplexe Daten, um umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu generieren, die Strategien optimieren, die Lieferantenleistung verbessern, Risiken mindern und die Gesamteffizienz der Beschaffung verbessern.
• Reporting Line: Die Position meldet direkt den Leiter des Procurement Center of Excellence (DOP).
• Breiteres Team und Stakeholder: Arbeitet eng und interkulturell mit Mitgliedern des Beschaffungsteams, Category Managern, Finanzen, IT und anderen globalen Stakeholdern zusammen.
• Rollentyp: Eine hoch analytische und strategische Rolle, die sich auf Datenintegration, Insights-Generierung und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Beschaffungsintelligenzlösungen konzentriert.
• Auswirkung: Sie übersetzen komplexe Daten in klare, wirkungsvolle Empfehlungen. Insbesondere sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Insights Generation & Analysis: Proaktive Identifizierung von Bereichen, in denen Daten die Entscheidungsfindung optimieren können. Durchführung einer eingehenden Analyse, um Trends und Chancen zu erkennen, und Durchführung einer Szenarioplanung und Sensitivitätsanalyse für verschiedene Beschaffungsstrategien.
• Reporting & Visualisierung: Entwerfen und Entwickeln von aufschlussreichen Dashboards, Berichten und Visualisierungen zur Nachverfolgung wichtiger Beschaffungsmetriken (z. B. Ausgabenanalyse, Einsparungen, Lieferantenleistung, Risiko und Compliance).
• Datenintegration: Identifizierung, Sammlung, Bereinigung und Integration relevanter Daten aus verschiedenen internen und externen Quellen, einschließlich ERP-Systemen und Market Intelligence-Plattformen.
• Programm- und Rollout-Unterstützung: Unterstützung der Bereitstellung von Beschaffungstools und -prozessen durch Definition von Berichtsanforderungen, Entwicklung von Tracking-Mechanismen und Sicherstellung der Datenintegrität während der Implementierung.
• Technologiebewertung: Bewertung, Empfehlung und Umsetzung geeigneter Datenanalyse-Tools und -Plattformen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der IT.
• Stakeholder-Kommunikation: Vorbereiten und Präsentieren von Erkenntnissen effektiv, Umsetzung komplexer Daten Erkenntnisse in klare, verständliche Formate für technische und nicht-technische Zielgruppen, einschließlich Führung. Wer du bist Wir suchen Fachleute mit einer starken analytischen Denkweise, einer Can-Do-Mentalität und einer hohen Bereitschaft, persönliche Verantwortung zu übernehmen, um unsere Datenentwicklung voranzutreiben.
• Ausbildung: Ein Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in einem quantitativen Bereich wie Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistik, Wirtschaft, Supply Chain Management oder einer verwandten Disziplin ist erforderlich.
• Erfahrung: 5+ Jahre nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse und Insights-Generierung, speziell im Bereich Beschaffung oder Lieferkette. Erfahrung in der interkulturellen Arbeit in einer globalen Position ist unerlässlich.
• Beschaffungswissen: Ein tiefes Verständnis von Beschaffungsprozessen, Methoden und Best Practices.
• Technische Fähigkeiten: Starke Kenntnisse in SQL, Datenbank-Mana
