C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à jouer un rôle clé dans la transformation de notre fonction d'approvisionnement en une organisation axée sur les données? En tant que gestionnaire de la performance et de l'information, vous tirerez parti de données complexes pour générer des idées pratiques qui optimisent les stratégies, améliorent la performance des fournisseurs, atténuent les risques et améliorent l'efficacité globale de l'approvisionnement.
• Ligne hiérarchique : Le poste relève directement du Chef du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement (DOP).
• Équipe élargie et parties prenantes : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les membres de l'équipe d'approvisionnement, les gestionnaires de catégorie, les finances, les TI et d'autres parties prenantes mondiales.
• Type de rôle : Un rôle hautement analytique et stratégique axé sur l'intégration des données, la production de renseignements et l'amélioration continue des solutions de renseignement en matière d'approvisionnement.
• Impact: Vous allez traduire des données complexes en recommandations claires et pertinentes. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Insights Génération et analyse : identifier de façon proactive les domaines où les données peuvent optimiser la prise de décisions. Effectuer une analyse approfondie pour repérer les tendances et les possibilités, et effectuer une planification des scénarios et une analyse de sensibilité pour différentes stratégies d'approvisionnement.
• Rapports et visualisation : Conception et élaboration de tableaux de bord, de rapports et de visualisations perspicaces pour suivre les principales mesures d'approvisionnement (p. ex. analyse des dépenses, économies, rendement des fournisseurs, risques et conformité).
• Intégration des données : Identification, collecte, nettoyage et intégration des données pertinentes provenant de diverses sources internes et externes, y compris les systèmes ERP et les plateformes de veille du marché.
• Appui aux programmes et au déploiement : Appuyer le déploiement d'outils et de processus d'approvisionnement en définissant les exigences en matière de rapports, en élaborant des mécanismes de suivi et en assurant l'intégrité des données pendant la mise en oeuvre.
• Évaluation de la technologie : Évaluer, recommander et diriger la mise en oeuvre d'outils et de plates-formes d'analyse de données appropriés en étroite collaboration avec les TI.
• Communication avec les intervenants : Préparer et présenter efficacement les résultats, en traduisant des données complexes dans des formats clairs et compréhensibles pour les publics techniques et non techniques, y compris le leadership. Qui vous êtes Nous recherchons des professionnels avec une solide mentalité analytique, une mentalité de « can-do », et une grande volonté de prendre la responsabilité personnelle de conduire notre évolution de données.
• Éducation : Un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise dans un domaine quantitatif comme la science des données, l'analyse des affaires, la statistique, l'économie, la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou une discipline connexe est nécessaire.
• Expérience : 5 ans et plus d'expérience prouvée dans l'analyse des données et la production de renseignements, en particulier sur les achats ou la chaîne d'approvisionnement. L'expérience du travail interculturel dans une position globale est essentielle.
• Connaissance de l'approvisionnement : Connaissance approfondie des processus, des méthodes et des pratiques exemplaires en matière d'approvisionnement.
• Compétences techniques: Forte compétence en SQL, base de données mana

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position

We are building a global Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team to support critical commercial and internal platforms and applications. As an SRE , you will help design, build, and scale reliable distributed systems that power healthcare innovation worldwide.
This role is focused on reliability, scalability, automation and operational excellence. You will influence system design, define reliability standards and reduce operational toil through engineering solutions.
This role includes participation in a structured on-call rotation.

Who We Are
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

Step into the Future of IT with Roche!
As a seasoned Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at Roche, you will leverage your deep software engineering expertise to propel our products to new heights of robustness, scalability and reliability. This isn't just a role—it's an invitation to shape the backbone of technological innovations forward.

Your Mission
Design and maintain cutting-edge tools, scripts and frameworks that automate repetitive tasks, streamline software deployment and manage expansive systems with unparalleled efficiency.

Partner closely with forward-thinking development teams to architect and implement high-performance solutions that elevate system efficiency, optimize resource utilization and enhance deployment processes for superior uptime and user satisfaction.

Your Impact
Lead the charge in incident management and response. Detect system anomalies, troubleshoot swiftly and conduct thorough root cause analyses to prevent recurring issues.

Champion continuous improvement by refining monitoring and alerting mechanisms, conducting insightful post-incident reviews and embedding best practices in software lifecycle management. Your strategic foresight and meticulous planning will ensure our systems are not only reliable but also superlatively performant.

By joining our elite team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering seamless experiences to our end-users, exceeding business and customer demands, and solidifying Roche's reputation as a leader in IT innovation.

Your Core Responsibilities
Reliability Engineering & Architecture

• Define and implement SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with product and engineering teams

• Conduct reliability reviews for new and existing services

• Design scalable, fault-tolerant architectures in AWS and Azure environments

• Lead capacity planning, performance and cost optimization initiatives

• Improve system resilience through automation and self-healing patterns

• Drive organizational observability maturity (metrics, logs, traces, alert quality)

Incident Management & Continuous Improvement

• Perform complex root cause analysis and drive rapid mitigation

• Participate in blameless postmortems and follow-through

• Improve MTTR, reduce incident frequency, and elevate production standards

• Collaborate seamlessly with engineering teams to enable timely and effe

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La posizione Stiamo costruendo un team globale di Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) per supportare piattaforme e applicazioni commerciali e interne critiche. Come SRE , vi aiuterà a progettare, costruire e scalare sistemi distribuiti affidabili che alimentano l'innovazione sanitaria in tutto il mondo. Questo ruolo è focalizzato su affidabilità, scalabilità, automazione e eccellenza operativa. Influenzi la progettazione del sistema, definisce gli standard di affidabilità e riduce il rendimento operativo attraverso soluzioni ingegneristiche. Ecco perché andiamo al lavoro ogni giorno. Ci impegniamo al rigore scientifico, all'etica insopportabile e all'accesso alle innovazioni mediche per tutti. Lo facciamo oggi per costruire un domani migliore. Roche è fortemente impegnata in un luogo di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo. Ci sforziamo di costruire squadre che rappresentano una gamma di sfondi, prospettive e competenze. Abbracciare la diversità ci permette di creare un ottimo posto di lavoro e di innovare per i pazienti. Entra nel futuro dell'IT con Roche! In qualità di esperto Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) a Roche, potrai sfruttare la tua profonda esperienza di ingegneria del software per spingere i nostri prodotti a nuove altezze di robustezza, scalabilità e affidabilità. Questo non è solo un ruolo: è un invito a modellare la spina dorsale delle innovazioni tecnologiche in avanti. La tua missione Progettare e mantenere strumenti all'avanguardia, script e framework che automatizzano i compiti ripetitivi, semplificano l'implementazione del software e gestiscono sistemi espansivi con efficienza senza pari. Collabora con team di sviluppo avanzati per l'architettura e l'implementazione di soluzioni ad alte prestazioni che elevano l'efficienza del sistema, ottimizzano l'utilizzo delle risorse e migliorano i processi di implementazione per una maggiore soddisfazione degli utenti. Il tuo impatto Guidare l'accusa nella gestione e risposta degli incidenti. Rilevare le anomalie del sistema, risolvere rapidamente i problemi e condurre analisi approfondite causa radice per evitare problemi ricorrenti. Campione continuo miglioramento raffinando i meccanismi di monitoraggio e di avviso, conducendo approfondite recensioni post-incidenti e incorporando le migliori pratiche nella gestione del ciclo di vita del software. La vostra visione strategica e la pianificazione meticolosa garantiranno che i nostri sistemi non siano solo affidabili ma anche superlativamente performanti. Unendo il nostro team di élite, si giocherà un ruolo fondamentale nel fornire esperienze senza soluzione di continuità ai nostri utenti finali, superando le esigenze aziendali e dei clienti, e consolidando la reputazione di Roche come leader nell'innovazione IT. Le tue responsabilità fondamentali Affidabilità Ingegneria e architettura
• Definire e implementare SLIs, SLOs e budget di errore con team di prodotto e ingegneria
• Condurre recensioni di affidabilità per i servizi nuovi e esistenti
• Architetture scalabili e resistenti ai guasti in ambienti AWS e Azure
• Iniziative di pianificazione, performance e ottimizzazione dei costi
• Migliorare la resilienza del sistema attraverso l'automazione e i modelli di autoguarigione
• Matura dell'osservanza organizzativa dell'azionamento (metri, registri, tracce, qualità dell'avviso) Gestione degli incidenti e miglioramento continuo
• Eseguire l'analisi complessa causa e guidare la mitigazione rapida
• Partecipa a postmortems e follow-through senza colpa
• Migliorare MTTR, ridurre la frequenza degli incidenti e elevati standard di produzione
• Collaborare senza soluzione di continuità con i team di ingegneria per consentire tempestive ed effe

jobs.title: Sales Specialist Core Lab - Cataluña
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
¿Te apasiona conectar la innovación científica con la eficiencia hospitalaria? Buscamos un/a Sales Specialist Core para liderar y expandir nuestra presencia en el territorio de Cataluña. En este rol, serás el socio estratégico de los laboratorios y centros sanitarios de la región, estableciendo relaciones de confianza profunda y comprendiendo los retos del ecosistema de salud local.
Tu misión será impulsar el éxito del negocio basándote en la innovación de nuestro porfolio de especialidades diagnósticas y en la optimización de los flujos de trabajo de nuestros clientes. Si tienes una mentalidad estratégica, te apasiona el desarrollo de negocio y quieres transformar la atención al paciente a través de diagnósticos de vanguardia, ¡este es tu lugar!

Your Main Responsibilities

• Ejecución y Estrategia Comercial: Implementar los planes de acción y estrategias definidas en tu zona para alcanzar y superar los objetivos anuales, ganando cuota de mercado y cumpliendo con los KPI del negocio.

• Identificación de Retos y Co-creación: Detectar las necesidades tanto de los profesionales del laboratorio como de las direcciones económicas y gerenciales de los centros, proponiendo soluciones diferenciadoras que aporten un valor real.

• Gestión de Stakeholders (360°): Construir y mantener relaciones estrechas con el personal técnico del laboratorio y con áreas clave del hospital (adquisiciones, finanzas y gestión hospitalaria), garantizando la satisfacción del cliente en todo su ciclo de vida.

• Enlace y Colaboración Interna: Tras la firma de los acuerdos, asegurarás que los equipos y reactivos se implementen a la perfección en los laboratorios, colaborando estrechamente con nuestros equipos de soporte técnico y aplicaciones.

• Expertise y Demostraciones Técnicas: Desarrollar un conocimiento profundo del porfolio de Core Lab , realizando presentaciones y demostraciones de producto de alto impacto que resuelvan las dudas de los clientes y destaquen nuestro valor diferencial.

Who You Are (The skills you need)

Buscamos un perfil dinámico, con un fuerte background técnico o comercial en el sector salud y una alta capacidad de influencia.

• Formación: Licenciatura o Grado en Ciencias de la Salud y/o experiencia demostrada en el sector sanitario. Se valorará positivamente la experiencia previa como técnico/a de laboratorio o en el ámbito de la docencia/formación técnica.

• Apertura al Talento Diverso: En Roche creemos en el valor de las perspectivas únicas; por ello, también valoraremos aquellos perfiles que, aun no cumpliendo estrictamente con la formación o experiencia técnica tradicional, aporten un trasfondo comercial relevante y diferencial para la organización.

• Competencias Clave:

• Alta capacidad estratégica y habilidad técnica y de negocio para navegar en entornos hospitalarios complejos.

• Orientación a la consecución de resultados , con autonomía y toma de decisiones ágiles.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación , con capacidad de inspiración e influencia .

• Mentalidad colaborativa, fuerte orientación al trabajo en equipo y apertura para dar y recibir feedback y coaching .

• Un perfil promotor de la innovación y con competencias sólidas en gestión del cambio para acompañar al cliente en su transformación digital y organizativa.

• Idiomas: Dominio del español y catalán; se valorarán conocimientos de inglés .

• Ubicación : Barcelona y alrededores.

What is here for You?

• Propósito Elevado: Trabajar en una compañía líder donde tu actividad diaria impa

jobs.title: Finance Enterprise Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
Serves as strategic thought partner and leader in driving value creation through entrepreneurial mindset and in-depth business understanding, bringing finance expertise. Enables transparency and insights to make good business decisions highly complex in nature. Builds networks across the organization to support the oneRoche enterprise mindset. May coach colleagues and help others develop expertise/skills. Understands and lives the Finance Framework, mindset and behaviours.

As the Finance Enterprise Partner, you are responsible for:

Business Partnering

• Serve as a finance enterprise partner, providing insights through financial analysis, and advice to meet business objectives or solve business problems.

• Serve as thought partner and leader in driving value creation in our portfolio, drive transparency to make smart business decisions in support of our ambition.

• Seek opportunities to self-align interests with business needs and impact, while committing to action

• Use analysis techniques to build and maintain shared understanding between team and stakeholders

• Advice and counsel the different stakeholders on financial implications of strategies, actions and decisions; looking for innovative solutions with the team

• Work with relevant stakeholders in business planning (sales and resources)

• Review of monthly financial result and analysis with key stakeholders to derive insights that value adds in meeting business needs and supports decisions making.

• Ensure compliance to internal controls, policies & procedures on management reporting

• Collaborate with other key Finance players in Roche, including Roche Global RSS (Shared Services), ERP Analytics and Centers of Expertise (e.g. CoFI, Champions and Global Networks), to ensure requirements for new solutions and enhancements are managed and delivered effectively.

• Seek and build opportunities to partner and collaborate with local and global networks

• May coach colleagues and help others develop expertise/skills. Understands and lives the Finance Framework, mindset and behaviors.

Who You Are:

• Minimum 4+ years of relevant experience in financial planning, budgeting and analysis; as a proven business partner is preferred.

• Knowledge around ERP systems/SAP preferred

• Experience in pharmaceutical preferred

• Knowledge/ exposure to agile principles or working methodology will be of advantage

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skill

• Experience in delivering innovative solutions (example: process simplifications in RPA & etc would be of advantage)

Competencies, mindset and behaviors expected

• Models Integrity

• Entrepreneurial spirit & enterprise thinking

• Adaptable to changes in a dynamic environment

• Outcomes oriented

• Fast Learner, with a growth mindset

• Fosters leadership principles

• Business acumen with end-to-end thinking

• Focus on value and customer-centricity

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity Serves as strategic thought partner and leader in driving value creation through entrepreneurial mindset and in-depth business understanding, bringing finance expertise. Enables transparency and insights to make good business decisions highly complex in nature. Builds networks across the organization to support the oneRoche enterprise mindset. May coach colleagues and help others develop expertise/skills. Understands and lives the Finance Framework, mindset and behaviours. As the Finance Enterprise Partner, you are responsible for: Business Partnering
• Serve as a finance enterprise partner, providing insights through financial analysis, and advice to meet business objectives or solve business problems.
• Serve as thought partner and leader in driving value creation in our portfolio, drive transparency to make smart business decisions in support of our ambition.
• Seek opportunities to self-align interests with business needs and impact, while committing to action
• Use analysis techniques to build and maintain shared understanding between team and stakeholders
• Advice and counsel the different stakeholders on financial implications of strategies, actions and decisions; looking for innovative solutions with the team
• Work with relevant stakeholders in business planning (sales and resources)
• Review of monthly financial result and analysis with key stakeholders to derive insights that value adds in meeting business needs and supports decisions making.
• Ensure compliance to internal controls, policies & procedures on management reporting
• Collaborate with other key Finance players in Roche, including Roche Global RSS (Shared Services), ERP Analytics and Centers of Expertise (e.g. CoFI, Champions and Global Networks), to ensure requirements for new solutions and enhancements are managed and delivered effectively.
• Seek and build opportunities to partner and collaborate with local and global networks
• May coach colleagues and help others develop expertise/skills. Understands and lives the Finance Framework, mindset and behaviors. Who You Are:
• Minimum 4+ years of relevant experience in financial planning, budgeting and analysis; as a proven business partner is preferred.
• Knowledge around ERP systems/SAP preferred
• Experience in pharmaceutical preferred
• Knowledge/ exposure to agile principles or working methodology will be of advantage
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skill
• Experience in delivering innovative solutions (example: process simplifications in RPA & etc would be of advantage) Competencies, mindset and behaviors expected
• Models Integrity
• Entrepreneurial spirit & enterprise thinking
• Adaptable to changes in a dynamic environment
• Outcomes oriented
• Fast Learner, with a growth mindset
• Fosters leadership principles
• Business acumen with end-to-end thinking
• Focus on value and customer-centricity Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Let’s build a healthier future, together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Die Chance Dient als strategischer Denkpartner und führend bei der Förderung der Wertschöpfung durch unternehmerische Denkweise und fundiertes Geschäftsverständnis und bringt Finanzexpertise ein. Ermöglicht Transparenz und Einblicke, um gute Geschäftsentscheidungen zu treffen, die in ihrer Natur sehr komplex sind. Baut Netzwerke im gesamten Unternehmen auf, um die OneRoche-Unternehmensmentalität zu unterstützen. Kann Kollegen coachen und anderen helfen, Fachwissen / Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln. Versteht und lebt den Finanzrahmen, die Denkweise und das Verhalten. Als Finance Enterprise Partner sind Sie verantwortlich für: Geschäftspartner
• Dienen Sie als Finanzunternehmenspartner und bieten Sie Einblicke durch Finanzanalyse und Ratschläge, um Geschäftsziele zu erreichen oder Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen.
• Dienen Sie als Vordenker und führend bei der Wertschöpfung in unserem Portfolio und fördern Sie Transparenz, um intelligente Geschäftsentscheidungen zu treffen, die unsere Ambitionen unterstützen.
• Suchen Sie nach Möglichkeiten, um Interessen an den Geschäftsanforderungen und -auswirkungen auszurichten, während Sie sich zum Handeln verpflichten
• Verwenden Sie Analysetechniken, um ein gemeinsames Verständnis zwischen Team und Stakeholdern aufzubauen und aufrechtzuerhalten
• Beratung und Beratung der verschiedenen Stakeholder zu finanziellen Auswirkungen von Strategien, Maßnahmen und Entscheidungen; Suche nach innovativen Lösungen mit dem Team
• Arbeiten mit relevanten Stakeholdern in der Geschäftsplanung (Verkauf und Ressourcen)
• Überprüfung des monatlichen Finanzergebnisses und der Analyse mit den wichtigsten Stakeholdern, um Erkenntnisse zu erhalten, die zur Erfüllung der Geschäftsanforderungen beitragen und die Entscheidungsfindung unterstützen.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung interner Kontrollen, Richtlinien und Verfahren für die Managementberichterstattung
• Arbeiten Sie mit anderen wichtigen Finanzakteuren von Roche zusammen, darunter Roche Global RSS (Shared Services), ERP Analytics und Kompetenzzentren (z. B. CoFI, Champions und Global Networks), um sicherzustellen, dass die Anforderungen an neue Lösungen und Verbesserungen effektiv verwaltet und bereitgestellt werden.
• Suchen und bauen Sie Möglichkeiten zur Partnerschaft und Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen und globalen Netzwerken auf
• Kann Kollegen coachen und anderen helfen, Fachwissen / Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln. Versteht und lebt den Finanzrahmen, die Denkweise und das Verhalten. Wer Du bist:
• Mindestens 4+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung in der Finanzplanung, Budgetierung und Analyse; als bewährter Geschäftspartner wird bevorzugt.
• Wissen rund um ERP-Systeme/SAP bevorzugt
• Erfahrung in pharmazeutisch bevorzugt
• Wissen / Exposition gegenüber agilen Prinzipien oder Arbeitsmethodik wird von Vorteil sein
• Hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten
• Erfahrung in der Bereitstellung innovativer Lösungen (Beispiel: Prozessvereinfachungen in RPA & etc. wären von Vorteil) Erwartete Kompetenzen, Denkweisen und Verhaltensweisen
• Integrität der Modelle
• Unternehmergeist & Unternehmensdenken
• Anpassbar an Veränderungen in einer dynamischen Umgebung
• Ergebnisorientiert
• Schneller Lernender, mit einer Wachstumsmentalität
• Fördert Führungsgrundsätze
• Geschäftssinn mit End-to-End-Denken
• Fokus auf Value und Customer Centricity Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opportunité Il sert de partenaire de réflexion stratégique et de chef de file pour stimuler la création de valeur grâce à l'esprit d'entreprise et à une compréhension approfondie des affaires, en apportant une expertise financière. Permet la transparence et les idées pour prendre de bonnes décisions d'affaires très complexes dans la nature. Construire des réseaux dans l'ensemble de l'organisation pour soutenir l'esprit d'entreprise OneRoche. Peut entraîner des collègues et aider d'autres personnes à acquérir une expertise ou des compétences. Comprendre et vivre le cadre financier, la mentalité et les comportements. En tant que partenaire Finance Enterprise, vous êtes responsable : Partenaires commerciaux
• Servir de partenaire d'une entreprise financière, en fournissant des renseignements au moyen d'analyses financières et de conseils pour atteindre des objectifs commerciaux ou résoudre des problèmes commerciaux.
• Servir de partenaire de réflexion et de leader dans la création de valeur dans notre portefeuille, stimuler la transparence pour prendre des décisions commerciales intelligentes à l'appui de notre ambition.
• Chercher des occasions d'auto-aligner les intérêts avec les besoins et l'impact des entreprises, tout en s'engageant à agir
• Utiliser des techniques d'analyse pour établir et maintenir une compréhension partagée entre l'équipe et les intervenants
• Conseils et conseils aux différents intervenants sur les incidences financières des stratégies, des actions et des décisions; recherche de solutions novatrices avec l'équipe
• Collaborer avec les parties intéressées à la planification des activités (ventes et ressources)
• Examen des résultats financiers mensuels et analyse avec les principaux intervenants afin d'obtenir des renseignements qui contribuent à répondre aux besoins opérationnels et à appuyer la prise de décisions.
• Assurer la conformité aux contrôles, politiques et procédures internes en matière de rapports de gestion
• Collaborer avec d'autres acteurs financiers clés de Roche, notamment Roche Global RSS (Shared Services), ERP Analytics et Centers of Expertise (par exemple CoFI, Champions et Global Networks), pour s'assurer que les exigences de nouvelles solutions et améliorations sont gérées et mises en œuvre efficacement.
• Rechercher et créer des possibilités de partenariat et de collaboration avec les réseaux locaux et mondiaux
• Peut entraîner des collègues et aider d'autres personnes à acquérir une expertise ou des compétences. Comprendre et vivre le cadre financier, l'état d'esprit et les comportements. Qui vous êtes :
• Au moins 4 ans d'expérience pertinente dans la planification financière, la budgétisation et l'analyse; en tant que partenaire commercial éprouvé est préféré.
• Connaissances concernant les systèmes de PGI/PAS privilégiés
• Expérience dans le domaine pharmaceutique préféré
• La connaissance/l'exposition aux principes agiles ou à la méthodologie de travail sera avantageuse
• Excellente compétence en relations interpersonnelles et en communication
• L'expérience dans la fourniture de solutions innovantes (exemple: simplifications de processus dans l'APR & etc serait d'un avantage) Compétences, mentalités et comportements attendus
• Intégrité des modèles
• Esprit entrepreneurial & pensée d'entreprise
• Adaptable aux changements dans un environnement dynamique
• Résultats orientés
• Apprentis rapide, avec un état d'esprit de croissance
• Favoriser les principes de leadership
• L'esprit d'entreprise et la pensée de bout en bout
• Mettre l'accent sur la valeur et la concentration client Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun un accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

计划管理

• 1. 组织和支持区域专家会议
• 2．了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
• 3. 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

工作年限
• •1年以上医药行业工作经验
• •既往有销售/市场/医学经验
• •跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书
• •医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
• •在试用期内通过RDPAC考试
• •在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Join Us in Transforming Healthcare
Are you passionate about advancing sustainable healthcare solutions and improving patient outcomes? We are seeking a driven Account Value Partner to join our Near Patient Care team, specializing in diagnostics, medical devices, scientific instruments, and digital health solutions.

As an Account Value Partner for Roche Diagnostics Thailand, you’ll play a vital role in managing your own territory by promoting Roche’s Diabetes and Cardio-Metabolic Disease diagnostics, along with other monitoring solutions, to healthcare providers across the continuum of care—from decentralized clinics and medical technology settings to hospital networks and home-based patient care. You will report directly to the Account Value Lead.

Your Opportunity
• ● Establish sales for Diabetes, Cardio-Metabolic Disease diagnostics, and other monitoring solutions in alignment with national direction to drive sales performance within your territory
• ● Gain insights into your territory to plan relevant activities, set priorities, and manage time effectively
• ● Initiate projects to optimize outcomes for both customers and the company
• ● Be responsible for DMS tools and explore new opportunities through innovative business models
• ● Ensure efficient implementation of active HDS tools in hospitals and other healthcare facilities

Who you are
• ● You hold a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Medical Technology, Science, Pharmacy, or another related healthcare field
• ● You have 2–5 years of sales experience in the medical instrument or healthcare industry
• ● You possess strong selling skills, with expertise in both product knowledge and identifying business opportunities
• ● You have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
• ● You are dependable, a team player, flexible, solution-driven, and have a growth mindset
• ● You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Scientist, Clinical Pharmacology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Clinical Pharmacology (CP) Scientist is responsible for developing and implementing quantitative Clinical Pharmacology strategies across early to late phases of clinical drug development to ensure that the right drug is administered to the right patient at the right dosing regimen and to deliver an optimal therapeutic benefit/risk profile for the patients. The CP Scientist uses state of the art modeling and simulation tools and is able to implement model-informed drug development strategies to address critical questions that are aligned with project needs. The CP Scientist is an active member of cross-functional drug development teams, and works in close partnership with Pharmacometricians, Biostatisticians, Clinicians, Biomarker Scientists, Toxicologists, Preclinical Pharmacologists, and other function) to support drug development decisions through registration and post-marketing commitments. The Senior/Principal CP Scientist represents CP function on filing teams and fosters effective collaboration and communications with regulatory agencies to support efficient drug development of drug candidates.

Key responsibilities include:

• Leading the design and review of clinical study protocols for the development of novel therapeutic agents with particular focus on China development (all drug and delivery modalities);

• Leading the planning and conduct of PK/PD data analyses and setting strategy to foster the appropriate use of modeling and simulations to inform clinical drug development decisions;

• CP functional representation and leadership at functional and cross-functional China development focused meetings internally and externally (eg. cross-functional teams, department meetings, governance review meetings, scientific conferences, etc.);

• Implementing strategic agility and effective project management to align critical CP deliverables according to the rapidly evolving regulatory and project needs in China;

• Authorship of regulatory documents and meeting background packages to support key clinical development milestones in China;

• Lead CP representation at health-authority meetings in China, and contribute to the planning, implementation and organization of regulatory filings (e.g. IND, BLA, NDA, sNDA);

• Support the global development strategies for clinical pharmacology and M&S as needed.

Technical Skills:
Required:

• The ability to plan, organize, interpret, and/or perform PK/PD data analyses.

• Familiarity with clinical drug development and clinical study design options for development of different drug and delivery modalities.

• Familiarity with quantitative modeling approaches in drug development and working knowledge of relevant modeling software (e.g. NONMEM, WinNonlin, R, SimCYP, GastroPlus, PKSim, Matlab, etc).

• Familiarity with agentic approaches for work streamlining and integrating agent-based workflows to improve efficiency throughout the drug development lifecycle.

• Working knowledge of statistical approaches as they apply to clinical study design and analysis.

Desired:

• Experience in leading regulatory filing strategy as a CP lead to support the totality of CP filing package, dose/regimen justification, and drug labeling is highly desired.

Communication Skills:

• Excellent written communication skills, in order to deliver high quality protocols, publications, and regulatory documents for team and management review.

• Excellent oral communications to make clear presentations and foster effective stakeholder engagemen

The Position
The Opportunity:
This role is responsible for supporting Regional Center activities in accordance with internal processes and local and international regulatory requirements, and consistently delivering high-quality and compliant outcomes. The role also contributes to oversight of external vendors, and contributes to a high-quality,
inspection-ready PV system across the assigned scope.

• ● Maintains robust oversight and performs safety risk management activities, including those executed by external vendors.
• ● Proactively manages workload and priorities to ensure regulatory timelines and quality standards are consistently met.
• ● Drives continuous improvement and simplification of processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
• ● Collaborate closely with PSO colleagues, Subject Matter Experts (SME),Country Champions, Affiliate Patient Safety and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure seamless execution and compliance
• ● Identify and escalate risks, gaps, or deviations related to Regional Center activities, and ensure appropriate follow-up actions
• ● Ensure accurate and compliant documentation and record management in line with Coremap requirements

Key activities
• All of the key responsibilities outlined below are applied in context with global Roche and local legal requirements.
• I. Maintain a local PV system in context with and as defined in the wider global Roche PV system
• ● Ensure appropriate documentation of operational related information and activities.
• ● Ensure business continuity of critical PV systems, processes, and activities.
• ● Ensure inspection readiness at all times.
• II. Pharmacovigilance System Master File (PSMF)
● Where Regional Center is required to provide information and data relevant to the global Roche PSMF, or for other global PV oversight or management purposes, ensure the data is current, accurate, complete, and provided in a timely manner. Where a separate local PSMF is required, ensure consistency with global Roche processes for local PSMF or PSSF. (where applicable).
III. Case Management
• ● Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant management of safety reports from all sources, including case intake, follow-up, assessment, reporting, and documentation
• ● Maintain high standards of quality and efficiency in safety data handling, in line with Roche processes, regulatory requirements, and internal scientific standards
• ● Provide oversight of activities performed by external vendors, ensuring adherence to defined requirements and timelines.
• IV. Management of aggregate reports
• ● Provide accurate and timely input to global functions for the preparation of aggregate safety reports, as required.
• ● Serve as Lead Author for safety-related documents, including Local Aggregate Report (LAR) and Domestic Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report (PBRER) for medicinal products and medical devices.
• ● Contribute to development of Addendum of Clinical Overview (aCO) with key Partners.
• ● Perform analysis of local/regional safety data in accordance with regulatory requirements to support benefit-risk evaluation and reporting
• V. Risk management and safety communication
• ● Contribute to the development of local Risk Management Plans (RMP) and ensure oversight of RMP implementation and safety communicat

Il ruolo contribuisce anche alla supervisione di fornitori esterni, e contribuisce ad una qualità elevata, sistema fotovoltaico pronto per l'ispezione attraverso l'ambito assegnato.
• Come partner del Centro Regionale (PV, Pharmacovigilance), Lei è responsabile per:
• ● Garantisce la raccolta, la segnalazione e la gestione di informazioni di sicurezza in conformità con Roche e requisiti normativi locali all'interno delle aree di copertura del Centro Regionale assegnate.
• ● Mantiene robusta supervisione e svolge attività di gestione dei rischi di sicurezza, compresi quelli eseguiti da fornitori esterni.
• ● gestisce attivamente il carico di lavoro e le priorità per garantire tempi e standard di qualità normativi sono costantemente soddisfatti.
• ● Miglioramento continuo e semplificazione dei processi per migliorare l'efficienza e l'efficacia
• ● Collaborare a stretto contatto con i colleghi di PSO, gli esperti di materia (SME), i campioni di contea, la sicurezza dei pazienti affiliati e gli stakeholder interfunzionali per garantire l'esecuzione e la conformità senza soluzione di continuità
• ● Identificare e intensificare i rischi, le lacune o le deviazioni relative alle attività del Centro Regionale, e garantire le opportune azioni di follow-up
• ● Assicurare la documentazione accurata e conforme e la gestione dei record in linea con i requisiti Coremap Attività chiave
• Tutte le principali responsabilità descritte di seguito sono applicate nel contesto di Roche globale e requisiti legali locali.
• I. Mantenere un sistema fotovoltaico locale nel contesto e come definito nel sistema globale Roche PV
• ● Assicurare la documentazione appropriata di informazioni e attività connesse operative.
• ● Assicurare continuità aziendale di sistemi, processi e attività fotovoltaiche critiche.
• ● Assicurare la disponibilità di ispezione in ogni momento.
• II. Pharmacovigilance System Master File (PSMF) ● Dove il Centro Regionale è tenuto a fornire informazioni e dati rilevanti per il Global Roche PSMF, o per altri scopi di supervisione o gestione del fotovoltaico globale, assicurarsi che i dati siano attuali, precisi, completi e forniti in modo tempestivo. Se è richiesto un PSMF locale separato, assicura la coerenza con i processi Roche globali per PSMF locale o PSSF. (dove applicabile). III. Gestione dei casi
• ● Assicurare la gestione tempestiva, accurata e conforme dei rapporti di sicurezza da tutte le fonti, incluso l'assunzione di casi, il follow-up, la valutazione, la segnalazione e la documentazione
• ● Mantenere elevati standard di qualità ed efficienza nella gestione dei dati di sicurezza, in linea con i processi Roche, requisiti normativi e standard scientifici interni
• ● Fornire la supervisione delle attività svolte da fornitori esterni, assicurando l'adesione a requisiti e tempi definiti.
• IV. Gestione dei rapporti aggregati
• ● Fornire un input preciso e tempestivo alle funzioni globali per la preparazione di rapporti di sicurezza aggregati, come richiesto.
• ● Servire come Lead Author per documenti relativi alla sicurezza, tra cui Local Aggregate Report (LAR) e National Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report (PBRER) per medicinali e dispositivi medici.
• ● Contribuire allo sviluppo di Addendum di Panoramica Clinica (aCO) con partner chiave.
• ● Eseguire l'analisi dei dati di sicurezza locale/regionale in conformità ai requisiti normativi per sostenere la valutazione e la segnalazione dei rischi di beneficio
• V. Gestione del rischio e comunicazione di sicurezza
• ● Contribuire allo sviluppo di piani di gestione dei rischi locali (RMP) e garantire la supervisione dell'implementazione RMP e del comunicato di sicurezza

jobs.title: EMDM Operations Business Analyst (Fixed term)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Enterprise Master Data Management (EMDM) is a Roche cross-functional and cross-divisional network of master data specialists and subject-matter experts developing governance frameworks and maintenance processes to ensure high-quality and trusted master data as the backbone for seamless business operations, data analytics and digitalization.

The Opportunity
In the Enterprise Master Data Management Operations Business Analyst role, you are responsible for the dedication towards undisturbed business activities by committing to Service Level Agreement.
In this role, you will ensure that technological architecture meets user requirements, and will support the whole data maintenance related queries - including data quality, lifecycle management and monitoring. Execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level and in compliance with the SOPs of the respective business sub-process. Follow the instructions of the Cluster Lead - Enterprise Master Data Management Operations Business Partner domain regarding the daily work coordination, and propose process and system improvements across multiple divisions. Contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of the Finance, Procurement, Sales and Supply Chain
organizations by:
• ● Handling incoming incidents, supporting both Roche Affiliates and multiple regional and global IT departments
• ● 2nd level evaluation of user requests based on ITIL methodology and prioritization towards IT accordingly
• ● Collaborate with IT teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
• ● Perform and participate in the analysis, (re)design and implementation of business and systems processes and procedures following appropriate standards
• ● Management of continuous data cleansing and Data lifecycle management
• ● Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for automation and optimization
• ● Develop business cases and proposals for process improvements and system upgrades
• ● Maintenance of SOPs, Knowledge Base and User Guidance
• ● Audit control management (ICFR)
• ● Training material preparation and delivery (including delta training) – using Train the Trainer and end user concepts
• ● Project management (lead, coordinate, facilitate, participate within RSS projects and participate in global projects)

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development.
• ● Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential.
• ● Strong customer centricity and stakeholder management skills
• ● Experienced in SAP (FI, MM, CO, SD)
• ● Ability to work independently and in team as well
• ● Focus on details and innovation
• ● Skilled in multitasking and prioritization
• ● Has analytical thinking
• ● 3-5 years Master Data management experience is desirable
• ● Project experience (desirable)

In exchange we provide you with
Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the fir

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are excited to be hiring a Senior Counsel, Patent Litigation, Global Legal Pharma . The position is based at Roche’s Headquarters in Basel, Switzerland. This role reports directly to the Senior Director of Global Patent Litigation. It is a high-impact role with significant visibility across the business, leading and supporting patent litigation matters globally, with an emphasis on ex-US matters.

The Opportunity

• Manage and coordinate an active and varied caseload of court proceedings relating to patent infringement, validity and revocation proceedings globally, with an emphasis on ex-US jurisdictions.

• Partner as a team together with highly experienced patent attorneys in the management of such proceedings, leveraging their subject matter and other local expertise.

• Serve as a thought leader for the litigation practice group and patent group on issues including global patent litigation strategy.

• Partner closely with senior business clients and legal/patent department colleagues to advise on a range of strategic issues while using a practical and business-minded approach.

• Develop strategies to mitigate or resolve regional, national and international patent disputes, including negotiating license agreements and settlements.

• Advise on patent strategy across multiple jurisdictions, contributing to an aligned global patent litigation strategy.

• Partner with Group Patents to work closely with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, Finance and other business units.

• Manage outside counsel across Europe and in other jurisdictions outside the United States.

• This is a global role, and legal colleagues, business stakeholders and partners are based in both Basel and South San Francisco; working across cultures and time zones is essential to success

• Travel worldwide as needed in conjunction with managing and resolving disputes.

• Gérer des conseils extérieurs à l'Europe et dans d'autres juridictions à l'extérieur des États-Unis.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.
The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organization, faster.
The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She/he partners closely with all stakeholders touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.
This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives.

Main Responsibilities
- Defining the strategy of the disease area for the Lebanese healthcare system.
- Focusing on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. PJP also brings the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
- Acting as trusted partner and primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and
secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.
- Partnering with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.
- Stewarding Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supporting their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.
- The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs.

Who you are?
Required experience and qualifications
- University degree in Pharmacy. An advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus.
- 4-6 years of experience in Pharmaceutical Company.
- Fluent in Arabic and English.
- Well rounded experience in product/medical/access/account management is a must.
- Strong business acumen with broad experience (e.g. sales, marketing, medical affairs, customer experience excellence)
- Experience in Oncology / Hematology is a plus

Skills and Competencies
- Visionary: defining and embedding the strategy around creating improved patient journeys
- Strong entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand)
- Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche
- Display of integrity in everything (i.e. open, honest, ethical and genuine)
- Boldly acts on key decisions and opportunities and boldly stops any activity that is not adding value. Ability to say “No” to stakeholders when the value is not predictable/foreseen.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us

• Responsibilities - Defining the strategy of the disease area for the Lebanese healthcare system. - Focusing on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. PJP also brings the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem. - Acting as trusted partner and primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster. - Partnering with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community. - Stewarding Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supporting their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner. - The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs. Who you are? Required experience and qualifications - University degree in Pharmacy. An advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus. - 4-6 years of experience in Pharmaceutical Company. - Fluent in Arabic and English. - Well rounded experience in product/medical/access/account management is a must. - Strong business acumen with broad experience (e.g. sales, marketing, medical affairs, customer experience excellence) - Experience in Oncology / Hematology is a plus Skills and Competencies - Visionary: defining and embedding the strategy around creating improved patient journeys - Strong entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand) - Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche - Display of integrity in everything (i.e. open, honest, ethical and genuine) - Boldly acts on key decisions and opportunities and boldly stops any activity that is not adding value. Ability to say “No” to stakeholders when the value is not predictable/foreseen. Who we are A healthier future drives us

descriptionByLocale.fr: Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opportunité Les soins de santé changent : innovation radicale, ouverture accrue au changement, autonomisation accrue des patients, sources multiples d'information médicale et pression sur les dépenses publiques. Par conséquent, les besoins de nos intervenants continuent d'évoluer. Le Patient Journey Partner (PJP) est au centre de la nouvelle organisation Roche, tournant à l'envers le rôle que nous jouons dans la société - de l'offre principalement de médicaments de classe mondiale à beaucoup plus de partenariat, d'innovation et de rupture de génération. Ce faisant, le PJP sera directement responsable d'obtenir de meilleurs résultats pour les patients, leur collectivité, l'écosystème et l'organisation, plus rapidement. Le PJP est un leader habilité et le visage local de Roche. Elle s'associe étroitement avec toutes les parties prenantes touchant le parcours du patient (dans un domaine thérapeutique ou de maladie donné), en acquérant une compréhension profonde de leurs besoins afin de relier les capacités de Roches pour co-créer des solutions significatives. Ce rôle est intégré localement dans l'écosystème, c'est un rôle intégré, fonctionnellement agnostique (c'est-à-dire qu'il ne s'inscrit pas dans les concepts traditionnels de commerce/ventes ou affaires médicales). Il n'a ni objectifs de rentabilité, ni incitations en matière de ventes. Principales responsabilités - Définir la stratégie de la zone de maladie pour le système de santé libanais. - Se concentrant sur l'importance d'amener l'extérieur, en travaillant avec des partenaires pour découvrir toutes les possibilités potentielles de transformer les résultats pour les patients, plus rapidement. PJP apporte également l'intérieur, pour apporter l'expertise Roche, la science et les connaissances à l'écosystème. - En tant que partenaire de confiance et principal point de contact (mais non exclusif) entre les intervenants et Roche; le PJP partage les besoins de la communauté des patients et des intervenants à l'interne, Sécurise les ressources et stimule les solutions qui produisent des résultats plus rapidement. - Établir des partenariats avec les intervenants du cheminement des patients afin de supprimer les barrages routiers et de débloquer les possibilités d'offrir de la valeur aux patients et à la collectivité. - La conservation des produits Roches tout au long de leur cycle de vie et le soutien de leur utilisation appropriée, ce qui inclut le partage de leurs mérites avec les HCP de manière honnête et équilibrée. - Ce rôle est habilité à mobiliser, au besoin, des compétences et des ressources locales et du réseau, y compris en collaboration avec d'autres PJP. Qui êtes-vous ? Expérience et qualifications requises - Diplôme universitaire en pharmacie. Un diplôme avancé en sciences de la vie et/ou MBA est un plus. - 4-6 ans d'expérience dans Pharmaceutical Company. - Fluent en arabe et en anglais. - Une expérience bien arrondie en gestion des produits, des soins médicaux, de l'accès et des comptes est indispensable. - Forte capacité d'affaires avec une vaste expérience (par exemple ventes, marketing, affaires médicales, excellence de l'expérience client) - Expérience en oncologie / hématologie est un plus Compétences et compétences - Visionnaire : définir et intégrer la stratégie autour de l'amélioration des parcours des patients - Une solide mentalité entrepreneuriale avec des capacités de partenariat exceptionnelles (coaching, consultation, capacité à écouter, questionner et comprendre profondément) - L'état d'esprit de croissance, capable d'apprendre et de désapprendre rapidement, de prendre des risques et d'expérimenter, et de contribuer au cycle d'apprentissage en partageant les connaissances avec d'autres à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de Roche - Affichage de l'intégrité dans tout (c.-à-d. ouvert, honnête, éthique et authentique) - Agir avec audace sur les principales décisions et opportunités et mettre fin avec audace à toute activité qui n'apporte pas de valeur ajoutée. Capacité de dire « Non » aux intervenants lorsque la valeur n'est pas prévisible/prévue. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Cybersecurity Analyst investigates security incidents, performs vulnerability assessments, and contributes to improving security operations
You will be capable of independent work on defined tasks, independently handling less complex tasks and contributing to various stages of the analysis lifecycle
By taking ownership of delivering well-defined requirements and supporting the design of feasible security solutions, you will proactively identify solution-level issues and maintain a mindset of continuous improvement within the security domain

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities / Scope

• Independently handles less complex tasks and provides input to solution design by defining and managing requirements for small-scale problem areas

• Focuses on understanding the problem domain, recommending solution options, and proactively identifying solution-level issues, gaps, or inefficiencies to improve products or processes

Accountability/Problem Solving

• Takes ownership of delivering well-defined requirements and supporting the design of feasible solutions for specific features or components

• Independently analyzes less complex security technical problems, defines problem scope, contributes to identifying root causes, and provides solutions to a broad range of difficult problems

• Evaluates change and technology impacts with increasing accuracy, diagnoses gaps, and applies analytical and logical reasoning independently to identify discrepancies and challenge assumptions

Stakeholder Management

• Identifies key business, technical, and security stakeholders for assigned tasks, analyzing their needs and interests regarding security posture and risk

• Primarily interacts within security product teams/squads and across Security Operations functions, while establishing rapport and managing realistic security expectations

• Develops and delivers tailored communication for security tasks and incident updates, facilitates meetings, and proactively engages with stakeholders to elicit, clarify, and validate security requirements

Impact/Strategy

• Contributes to projects or workgroups by providing well-analyzed requirements and supporting the design of solutions that align with business objectives within their specified area

• Demonstrates growing autonomy and expertise within their specific domain by translating requirements into a strategic plan with supervision, and may identify opportunities for minor process improvements within their immediate scope

Complexity

• Works on a product or larger contexts, handling requirements and analysis for specific features or components

• Can navigate moderate levels of complexity in requirements and stakeholder landscapes

• Begins to understand sources of influence and analyze business problems/opportunities within this product context, starting to map basic interconnections

Business/Technical ability

• Possesses a working knowledge of the relevant business domain and supporting technologies

• Understands sources of influence, comprehending internal and external factors affecting the problem space, and is capable of identifying and analyzing basic business problems or opportunities holistically

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Working knowledge of relevant business domains and supporting cybersecurity technologies

• Experience in conducting stakeholder interviews, synthesizing requirements, and mapping/analyzing current processes

• Demonstrated ability to independently handle less c

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose

• As the chapter lead for the Marketing Chapter, you will be responsible for leading, monitoring and developing in-depth marketing strategies to add continuous improvement and value to patients, establish commercial partnership with the external stakeholders and accelerate broader patient access as a result.

• As a chapter lead, you will act as an agile leader ( Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst ) and ensure all chapter members live Roche Taiwan’s desired state culture. You are passionate about our focus on people & culture, our external customers, patient access and long-term healthcare sustainability in Taiwan.

• You will be the catalyst and role model to lead the team, raise the standard of marketing capability in the era of AI to foster commercialization excellence.

• You will be the catalyst to contribute to the network within and beyond Taiwan. You always put patients at the center of our operations and ensure everything we do will sustainably benefit patients and bring value to our society and the company.

Role Scope

• Act as a VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leader who enable individuals and teams are developing and growing in line with their passion and the needs of the organization

• Develop framework to ensure chapter members are marketing experts and are competent to :

• Creates and fosters a strong team spirit and takes on the role of ‘strategic product champion’.

• Leads the development of the local (or above affiliate) marketing strategy.

• Drives and coordinates branding development/evolution process.

• Maintains up to date knowledge of the global market for the therapy area.

• Monitors competitor activity and recommends action.

• Cultivates and develops Key Opinion Leaders, product advocates and speakers.

• Reviews, approves and monitors budget.

• Provides input into public relations and access strategy.

• Assures forecast submission, inventory level and cost seasonality

• Ensure t he development of the marketing strategies and their execution with a strong focus of patient value and connected with all the strategies and solutions generated by different functions and teams

• Lead the t eam t o support commercial ac ti vities for dedicat e d disease areas

• Catalyze the network way of working: l eads the t eam to w ork as partners wi th other chapters/ clusters w ithi n and beyond the a ffi liate

• Ensure resource and talent fluidity to achieve affiliate outcomes

• Support APAC team for the people development of APAC marketers in Taiwan

Requirements

Qualifications: Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

Education:Minimum: A bachelor degree in scientific, economic, or business related fields. An advanced degree in Life Science and/or MBA is a plus.

Working Experience:

• More than 5 years’ experience of pharmaceutical product management or equivalent experience, and more than 8 years’ experience in commercial related function

• Demonstrate the capability achieving or exceeding sales and marketing goals

• Excellent proficiency in planning and managing resources deployment

• Experience in leading cross-functional teams or marketing teams achieving ambitious goals

• Experience in working in an organization that has adopted agile methodologies and ways of working would be a significant advantage

Skills & Knowledge:

• Good knowledge of Compliance requirements and clear understanding of high standards of Integrity
