jobs.title: Pasante de Comunicación Interna
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Sobre Roche:
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Oportunidad:
Estamos en la búsqueda de un talento joven, estudiantes apasionados por la comunicación y la creatividad, para sumarse a nuestro equipo como Pasante/Practicante de Comunicación Interna. En esta posición, tendrás la oportunidad de transformar la comunicación corporativa tradicional en experiencias dinámicas, ágiles y visualmente atractivas, contribuyendo directamente a mantener informados, conectados y motivados a todos los colaboradores de la organización.

Responsabilidades:

• Como pasante, debes de diseñar, proponer y ejecutar nuevos formatos de contenido (desde la conceptualización hasta la edición), asegurando que la información sea clara y atractiva para diversas audiencias internas.

• Redactar contenidos de alto impacto para los diferentes canales internos (boletines, reportes, presentaciones ejecutivas).

• Transformar la información tradicional en mensajes ágiles y digeribles, adecuados para todos los niveles de la organización.

• Brindar soporte activo y coordinación en la realización de eventos internos.

• Apoyar en el monitoreo de los canales de comunicación interna para evaluar su desempeño y proponer mejoras continuas.

Quién eres:

• No puedes ser egresado y debes de graduarte en 2028 para poder realizar 2 años de pasantía.

• Estudiante activo en Comunicación, Marketing, Publicidad, Diseño, Periodismo o carreras afines.

• Profesional en formación con excelente redacción, ortografía y habilidades de comunicación.

• Usuario con dominio de herramientas de diseño y edición como Canva y Adobe Express, con capacidad y gusto por generar contenidos en audio, video y fotografía.

• Persona con nociones básicas para interpretar analíticas de plataformas internas (tasas de apertura, clics, interacción).

• Apasionado por las tendencias actuales de consumo de contenido digital y redes sociales, con visión para aplicarlas en un entorno corporativo.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio (capaz de comprender textos corporativos, buscar referencias y mantener una comunicación básica/intermedia).

• Perfil proactivo, curioso, responsable y con excelente organización para la administración efectiva de sus proyectos y el cumplimiento de los tiempos de trabajo.

Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Becario de Marketing
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Sobre Roche:
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Oportunidad:
Brindar soporte estratégico y operativo al equipo de marketing en la estructuración, análisis y comunicación de iniciativas relacionadas con el desarrollo y futura comercialización de nuevas moléculas del portafolio. Será un enlace clave en la integración de inputs de diversas áreas, incluyendo Customer Operations , para robustecer propuestas de valor. Desarrollará habilidades de análisis, storytelling estratégico y negociación colaborativa.
Responsabilidades:

• Apoyo Estratégico: Colaborar en la elaboración de perfiles estratégicos de molécula y narrativas de posicionamiento.

• Análisis y Reportes: Contribuir a presentaciones ejecutivas, reportes de avance y visualizaciones de datos clave.

• Colaboración Interfuncional: Trabajar estrechamente con áreas médicas, acceso, regulatorias, finanzas y Clinical Operations .

• Alineación de Stakeholders: Desarrollar habilidades de negociación interna para facilitar el alineamiento entre equipos y gestionar conversaciones con diferentes áreas.

• Gestión de Proyectos: Participar en sesiones interfuncionales, dar seguimiento a entregables y cronogramas, además de actualizar bases de datos y sistemas de gestión del portafolio.

Quién eres:

• Formación: Estudiante activo(a) de últimos semestres de Mercadotecnia, Administración, Ciencias de la Salud, Ingeniería Biomédica o carreras afines.

• Intereses: Pasión por la industria farmacéutica y la intersección entre ciencia, estrategia y negocio.

• Herramientas: Manejo intermedio-avanzado de Excel y PowerPoint (Deseable: Power BI ).

• Idiomas: Inglés intermedio (capacidad de lectura, escritura y comprensión de materiales técnicos).

• Disponibilidad: Medio tiempo por la mañana (mínimo 25 horas por semana ).

Competencias Clave:

• Alta capacidad de análisis, síntesis de información y pensamiento crítico.

• Proactividad, responsabilidad y orientación al detalle.

• Comunicación asertiva, habilidades interpersonales y apertura al aprendizaje constante.

• Capacidad para trabajar en entornos colaborativos y multifuncionales.

Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The opportunity
As a Technical Support Partner for Lab-IT, you are responsible for carrying out field service functions for Roche Diagnostics Digital Products. Your primary duties include digital product troubleshooting, installation, commissioning, and performing preventive maintenance procedures. Reporting to the Technical Support Lead for Lab-IT, you will respond promptly to all service calls and handle various after-sales service issues to ensure customer satisfaction and optimal instrument performance.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, proactive, service-minded with strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across functions.
You will be responsible for

• Perform digital product installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting for all Roche Diagnostics digital Products.

• Respond promptly and effectively to all service calls from customers.

• Conduct preventive maintenance according to the established schedule to ensure instrument & digital product reliability.

• Manage and resolve other issues related to digital solution after-sales service to maintain high levels of customer support.

Who you are
Experience and Competencies:

• Strong in analytical and troubleshooting skills.

• Able to drive and travel in upcountry areas and be flexible to work outside of normal working hours.

• Independent, a team player, flexible, and solution-driven with an agile mindset.

• Good command of spoken and written English.

• Good communication skills.

• Demonstrates a desire to influence your own development and pursue interests across functions.

• Industry Experience:

• Bachelors or Masters in IT or related fields.

• Minimum of 1 year of work experience as a IT Specialist in the healthcare business is preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Scientific Strategy Director (Cardiometabolism & Neurology)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Scientific Strategy Director (Cardiometabolism & Neurology)
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

The Opportunity:
The Scientific Strategy Director holds a critical leadership position within US Medical & Scientific Affairs, driving the scientific strategy for designated disease area(s) across multiple franchise portfolios*. This role is instrumental in guiding a team of Senior Scientific Managers, transforming complex scientific information into actionable medical strategies, and ensuring the successful adoption of Roche's innovative diagnostic solutions.

This Director will be responsible for articulating a clear strategic vision, cultivating robust people leadership, and placing a high priority on external engagement and partnership management. The position demands extensive cross-functional collaboration, both with US and global stakeholders, and plays a pivotal role in the integration and delivery of Roche's comprehensive health solutions to patients. The Scientific Strategy Director will also be key in identifying emerging scientific trends, assessing competitive landscapes, and translating these insights to inform Roche's current and future diagnostic portfolios. The work of the Scientific Strategy Director is done in close collaboration with the global research and development, regulatory affairs and US commercial and access teams to ensure alignment and maximize the impact of Roche's diagnostic offerings. Furthermore, the Director will champion a culture of scientific excellence and continuous learning within their team and across the broader organization, fostering an environment where innovation and patient-centric solutions thrive.

*Assigned portfolio may contain multiple technical and disease areas and may change over time based on needs and priorities of the organization

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

• Coaching & Development: Provide continuous coaching, mentorship, and feedback to direct reports, driving performance, growth, and succession planning across key scientific and leadership roles.

• Resource & Capability Planning: Strategically allocate MSA scientific resources and lead targeted training initiatives to strengthen strategic, scientific, and leadership capabilities across the organization.

• Culture Leadership: Foster a culture of high performance, accountability, inclusion, and innovation within MSA and the broader Roche community.

• Strategic Prioritization: Partner with the VP of Medical & Scientific Affairs to define and align U.S. scientific priorities with global and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Strategic & Tactical Execution: Lead development and execution of integrated scientific strategies, including evidence generation, education, and external engagement initiatives.

• Field Alignment: Collaborate with field leadership to ensure alignment between field medical activities and scientific strategy, incorporating field insights into planning and execution.

• External Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with key opinion leaders, professional societies, and pharma/alliance partners to inform and advance scientific strategy.

• Financial Stewardship: Manage discretionary and operational budgets responsibly, ensuring efficient resource use and strong return on scientific investment.

Who You Ar

jobs.title: Marketing Partner- IVD
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Marketing Partner

Role Purpose
As the Marketing Partner, you will be required to have deep understanding and
experience with In-Vitro Diagnostics Solutions and technology trends in the Healthcare industry. Heavily focused on strategic products marketing and identifying qualified opportunities for Roche Diagnostics product lines. Work closely with sales, healthcare consultants and technical product specialists to identify market opportunities, drive sales, and maintain relationships in key accounts.
You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.
In this role, you will
Laboratory Marketing

• Analyses the evolving market environment, develops the strategy such as customer segmentations, positioning, branding, messaging, PR/communications, pricing strategy and ensures effective rollout of strategy to the marketplace.

• Assist in the development of a yearly Marketing Plan which outlines marketing

• strategies and initiatives for the products responsible.

• Laboratory KOL management and development.

• Strategic partnership with 3rd party vendors and medical associations.

Product Management

• Portfolio Management including inventory and product lifecycle management of instrument and reagents.

• Support in product quality issues and implementation.

• Support in the planning and execution of marketing activities

- Product campaigns/promotions
- Exhibition booth
- Digital marketing initiatives

• Product Training and development of selling aids and value stories.

• Provide 2nd line technical/application support e.g. evaluations, projects, troubleshooting.

• Support field force with Customer presentation/CMEs, Market intelligence, Formulation of sales arguments, Product information updates

Market Access

• Assist in the development and implementation of business strategies to achieve profitable relationships and identify potential opportunities with major accounts across the Business Area.

• Cross BA selling as One Roche approach.

Market Intelligence and Trends

• Continuously collect and analyse relevant market and competitor information and trends to assess market position and long term opportunities, translate into actionable information and shape the market.

• Feedback market trends and needs to the relevant internal stakeholders.

Any other tasks or projects as assigned from time to time.
Who you are
You are someone who are/have:

• Strong organizational, communication and interpersonal skills

• Good analytical, problem solving, creative thinking and time management skills.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and strong business acumen together with the ability to manage ambiguity and drive for results

• Ability to perform under pressure while juggling multiple tasks

• An independent and a team player, has positive attitude and a willingness to learn

• Ability to adhere to deadlines and work in a team

• Resourceful, detail-oriented, proven ability to meet deadlines in a fast paced environment

Qualification and Experience

• More than 4 years of experience designing and delivering healthcare solutions

• Passion for the healthcare industry –good understanding of how the healthcare industry operates and the unique characteristics of the industry ecosyst

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. • 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域相关科学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案。

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。 能力要求
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力和业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 多产品资源整合能力
• ​3年以上医药行业工作经验，医学或药学相关本科及以上学历 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Study Start Up Lead (SSUL)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Pharma Korea
Cluster: Product Development Global Clinical Operations (PDG)
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Study Start Up Lead (SSUL)
We are looking for a Study Start Up Lead (SSUL) who will specialize in IND (Investigational New Drug) applications and overall regulatory strategy to lead our clinical trials into action.

The Role
As an SSUL specializing in IND and Regulatory submission, you will be the architect of our country-level start-up strategy. You won't just follow processes—you will optimize them. Your primary focus will be ensuring the efficient and compliant start up of Roche-sponsored trials by mastering the bridge between global strategy and local regulatory requirements.

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of the Korean regulatory landscape. You excel in a cross-functional environment and are passionate about driving innovation in clinical trials.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Proven experience(5-10 years) in IND/Regulatory submissions within the pharmaceutical industry or a leading CRO.

• In-depth knowledge of local regulatory requirements (MFDS, GCP, etc.) and experience interacting with HA or Ethics Committees.

• A "Solution-Oriented" mindset: Ability to identify bottlenecks and proactively drive process improvements.

• Strong communication skills in both Korean and English to effectively collaborate with global stakeholders.

• Leadership through influence: Ability to lead cross-functional teams without formal authority.

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: MD Clinical Fellow
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Clinical Fellowship in Product Development Oncology/Haematology (PDOH)
Summary

This Roche Clinical Fellowship is aimed at medically qualified individuals with a specific interest in haematology or oncology, either before or immediately post specialist training.
Established in 2013, the program was designed to diversify and broaden clinical training through exposure to clinical research methodology from the pharmaceutical medicine perspective. The fellowship will be 1 year in duration, primarily based at Roche Products Ltd in Welwyn Garden City, UK. The position is within the Clinical Development Group, which is responsible for the strategy, design and execution of late phase clinical trials in oncology, haemato-oncology and non-malignant haematology disease areas. Every attempt will be made to accommodate your specific areas of interest and expertise, but available projects will likely need to be determined by the development timelines of each disease area programme There will be the opportunity for direct interaction across Roche/Genentech. There may be opportunities to attend scientific conferences, depending on the project and programme. Your supervisor will be an experienced member of the Clinical Development Group working in Welwyn. In addition, you will be assigned a mentor who is a UK accredited Physician. If successful, you need to be available to start the role before the end of this year.

There is 1 MD Fellow position in:-

• Oncology/Haematology (PDOH), which incorporates the following areas of specialty:
• Oncology

• Haemato-oncology (lymphoid and myeloid)

• Non-malignant haematology (haemophilia and allied bleeding disorders, gene therapy, thrombosis)

As a Fellow in the Global Clinical Development Group you may:

• Be involved in the design, execution, data review, analysis and interpretation of data from clinical studies for molecules in development as well as marketed compounds.

• Interact with globally recognised academic experts and clinical investigators

• Participate in key clinical strategy, implementation and molecule management meetings in order to gain a deeper understanding of the complexities and challenges of the development of medicines

• Provide clinical expertise in the disease area for cross functional pharmaceutical development teams

• Contribute to the generation of abstracts and oral presentations for key external conferences and other specialty meetings as well as publication opportunities.

• Be involved in discussions and initiatives around Personalised Health Care (PHC) and patient selection for different therapeutic interventions

Who is the Roche Clinical Research Fellowship suitable for?
Essential Criteria:

• GMC Registration: Must hold active registration with the General Medical Council (GMC) at the time of application.

• Clinical Experience: A minimum of 3+ years of direct clinical experience post-qualification.

• Specialty Experience: Proven experience working within haematology or oncology settings.

• An individual looking to diversify their training. While some previous clinical research experience is preferred, it is not essential.

• An individual interested in further understanding and influencing the development and approval of medicines for patients within the specific disease area. Note: this is not intended to be a basic science fellowship leading to a post graduate degree, although the clinical research could supplement or inform existing basic research if appropriate.

La posizione Fellowship clinica in Oncologia dello sviluppo del prodotto/Haematology (PDOH) Sintesi Questo Roche Clinical Fellowship è rivolto a persone medicalmente qualificate con un interesse specifico per l'ematologia o l'oncologia, prima o immediatamente post formazione specialistica. Fondato nel 2013, il programma è stato progettato per diversificare e ampliare la formazione clinica attraverso l'esposizione alla metodologia di ricerca clinica dalla prospettiva della medicina farmaceutica. La borsa sarà di 1 anno di durata, principalmente con sede a Roche Products Ltd a Welwyn Garden City, Regno Unito. La posizione è all'interno del Gruppo di Sviluppo Clinico, che è responsabile della strategia, progettazione ed esecuzione di studi clinici di fase avanzata in oncologia, emato-oncologia e aree non maligne di ematologia. Ogni tentativo sarà fatto per soddisfare le vostre specifiche aree di interesse e di competenza, ma i progetti disponibili probabilmente dovranno essere determinati dai tempi di sviluppo di ogni programma di area malattia Ci sarà l'opportunità di interazione diretta tra Roche/Genentech. Ci possono essere opportunità di partecipare a conferenze scientifiche, a seconda del progetto e del programma. Il vostro supervisore sarà un membro esperto del gruppo di sviluppo clinico che lavora a Welwyn. Inoltre, vi verrà assegnato un mentore che è un medico accreditato nel Regno Unito. In caso di successo, è necessario essere disponibili per iniziare il ruolo prima della fine di quest'anno. C'è 1 MD Fellow posizione in:-
• Oncologia/Haematologia (PDOH), che incorpora le seguenti aree di specialità:
• Oncologia
• Emato-oncologia (limphoide e mieloide)
• Ematologia non maligna (emofilia e disturbi sanguinanti alleati, terapia genica, trombosi) Come Fellow nel Global Clinical Development Group puoi:
• Essere coinvolti nella progettazione, esecuzione, recensione dei dati, analisi e interpretazione dei dati da studi clinici per molecole in sviluppo e composti commercializzati.
• Interagire con esperti accademici riconosciuti a livello globale e ricercatori clinici
• Partecipa a importanti incontri di strategia clinica, implementazione e gestione delle molecole al fine di ottenere una comprensione più approfondita delle complessità e delle sfide dello sviluppo dei farmaci
• Fornire competenze cliniche nell'area della malattia per i team di sviluppo farmaceutico funzionale
• Contribuire alla generazione di astratti e presentazioni orali per conferenze esterne chiave e altre riunioni di specialità e opportunità di pubblicazione.
• Essere coinvolti in discussioni e iniziative inerenti la Personalised Health Care (PHC) e la selezione dei pazienti per diversi interventi terapeutici Chi è il Roche Clinical Research Fellowship adatto per? Criteri essenziali:
• GMC Registrazione: deve tenere la registrazione attiva con il Consiglio medico generale (GMC) al momento della domanda.
• Esperienza clinica: un minimo di 3+ anni di esperienza clinica diretta post-qualifica.
• Esperienza di specializzazione: Esperienza comprovata che lavora all'interno delle impostazioni di ematologia o oncologia.
• Un individuo che cerca di diversificare la propria formazione. Mentre alcune precedenti esperienze di ricerca clinica è preferito, non è essenziale.
• Un individuo interessato a comprendere e influenzare ulteriormente lo sviluppo e l'approvazione dei farmaci per i pazienti all'interno dell'area malattia specifica. Nota: questo non è destinato ad essere una borsa di studio di base che porta a un diploma post-laurea, anche se la ricerca clinica potrebbe integrare o informare la ricerca di base esistente se necessario.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Clinical Fellowship in Produktentwicklung Onkologie / Hämatologie (PDOH) Zusammenfassung Dieses Roche Clinical Fellowship richtet sich an medizinisch qualifizierte Personen mit einem spezifischen Interesse an Hämatologie oder Onkologie, entweder vor oder unmittelbar nach der Fachausbildung. Das 2013 gegründete Programm wurde entwickelt, um die klinische Ausbildung durch klinische Forschungsmethodik aus pharmazeutischer Perspektive zu diversifizieren und zu erweitern. Das Stipendium wird 1 Jahr dauern und hauptsächlich bei Roche Products Ltd in Welwyn Garden City, Großbritannien, ansässig sein. Die Position ist innerhalb der Clinical Development Group, die für die Strategie, das Design und die Durchführung von klinischen Spätphasenstudien in den Bereichen Onkologie, Hämatoonkologie und nicht-maligne Hämatologie verantwortlich ist. Jeder Versuch wird unternommen, um Ihre spezifischen Interessensgebiete und Fachkenntnisse unterzubringen, aber verfügbare Projekte müssen wahrscheinlich durch die Entwicklungszeitpläne jedes Krankheitsgebietsprogramms bestimmt werden. Es wird die Möglichkeit für eine direkte Interaktion zwischen Roche/Genentech geben. Es kann Möglichkeiten geben, an wissenschaftlichen Konferenzen teilzunehmen, abhängig vom Projekt und Programm. Ihr Vorgesetzter wird ein erfahrenes Mitglied der Clinical Development Group sein, die in Welwyn arbeitet. Darüber hinaus erhalten Sie einen Mentor, der ein in Großbritannien akkreditierter Arzt ist. Wenn Sie erfolgreich sind, müssen Sie verfügbar sein, um die Rolle vor Ende dieses Jahres zu beginnen. Es gibt 1 MD Fellow Position in:-
• Onkologie / Hämatologie (PDOH), die die folgenden Spezialgebiete umfasst:
• Onkologie
• Hämatoonkologie (Lymphoid und Myeloid)
• Nichtmaligne Hämatologie (Hämophilie und verwandte Blutungsstörungen, Gentherapie, Thrombose) Als Fellow in der Global Clinical Development Group können Sie:
• Beteiligt an Design, Ausführung, Datenüberprüfung, Analyse und Interpretation von Daten aus klinischen Studien für Moleküle in der Entwicklung sowie für vermarktete Verbindungen.
• Interaktion mit weltweit anerkannten akademischen Experten und klinischen Forschern
• Beteiligen Sie sich an wichtigen klinischen Strategie-, Implementierungs- und Molekülmanagement-Meetings, um ein tieferes Verständnis der Komplexität und Herausforderungen der Arzneimittelentwicklung zu erlangen
• Bereitstellung klinischer Expertise im Krankheitsbereich für funktionsübergreifende pharmazeutische Entwicklungsteams
• Beitrag zur Generierung von Abstracts und mündlichen Präsentationen für wichtige externe Konferenzen und andere Fachtagungen sowie Publikationsmöglichkeiten.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an Diskussionen und Initiativen rund um Personalized Health Care (PHC) und Patientenauswahl für verschiedene therapeutische Interventionen Für wen ist das Roche Clinical Research Fellowship geeignet? Wesentliche Kriterien:
• GMC-Registrierung: Muss zum Zeitpunkt der Antragstellung eine aktive Registrierung beim General Medical Council (GMC) durchführen.
• Klinische Erfahrung: Mindestens 3+ Jahre direkte klinische Erfahrung nach der Qualifikation.
• Spezialerfahrung: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Hämatologie oder Onkologie.
• Eine Person, die ihr Training diversifizieren möchte. Während einige frühere klinische Forschungserfahrung bevorzugt wird, ist es nicht wesentlich.
• Eine Person, die daran interessiert ist, die Entwicklung und Zulassung von Medikamenten für Patienten innerhalb des spezifischen Krankheitsbereichs weiter zu verstehen und zu beeinflussen. Hinweis: Dies ist nicht als ein Grundlagenstipendium gedacht, das zu einem postgradualen Abschluss führt, obwohl die klinische Forschung die bestehende Grundlagenforschung gegebenenfalls ergänzen oder informieren könnte.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Bourse de recherche clinique en oncologie/hématologie (PDOH) Résumé Cette bourse clinique Roche s'adresse aux personnes médicalement qualifiées qui s'intéressent particulièrement à l'hématologie ou à l'oncologie, avant ou immédiatement après une formation spécialisée. Créé en 2013, le programme a été conçu pour diversifier et élargir la formation clinique par l'exposition aux méthodes de recherche clinique du point de vue de la médecine pharmaceutique. La bourse durera un an, principalement chez Roche Products Ltd, à Welwyn Garden City, au Royaume-Uni. Le poste fait partie du Groupe de développement clinique, qui est responsable de la stratégie, de la conception et de l'exécution des essais cliniques en phase tardive en oncologie, en hémato-oncologie et dans les zones de maladies hématologiques non malignes. Tout sera fait pour répondre à vos besoins et à vos compétences, mais les projets disponibles devront probablement être déterminés en fonction des délais d'élaboration de chaque programme. Il y aura la possibilité d'une interaction directe entre Roche et Genentech. Il peut y avoir des occasions d'assister à des conférences scientifiques, selon le projet et le programme. Votre superviseur sera un membre expérimenté du Groupe de développement clinique travaillant à Welwyn. De plus, un mentor accrédité au Royaume-Uni vous sera assigné. Si vous réussissez, vous devez être disponible pour commencer le rôle avant la fin de cette année. Il y a 1 MD Fellow en :-
• Oncologie/hématologie (PDOH), qui comprend les domaines de spécialité suivants:
• Oncologie
• Hémato-oncologie (lymphoïde et myéloïde)
• Hématologie non maligne (hémophilie et troubles hémorragiques connexes, thérapie génique, thrombose) En tant que Fellow du Groupe mondial de développement clinique, vous pouvez :
• Participer à la conception, à l'exécution, à l'examen, à l'analyse et à l'interprétation des données issues des études cliniques sur les molécules en développement et les composés commercialisés.
• Interagir avec des experts universitaires et des chercheurs cliniques mondialement reconnus
• Participer à des réunions clés sur la stratégie clinique, la mise en oeuvre et la gestion des molécules afin de mieux comprendre la complexité et les défis du développement des médicaments
• Fournir une expertise clinique dans le domaine de la maladie aux équipes de développement pharmaceutique interfonctionnel
• Contribuer à la production de résumés et de présentations orales pour des conférences externes clés et d'autres réunions spécialisées ainsi que des occasions de publication.
• Participer aux discussions et aux initiatives concernant les soins de santé personnalisés (SSP) et la sélection des patients pour différentes interventions thérapeutiques Pour qui la bourse de recherche clinique Roche convient-elle? Critères essentiels :
• Enregistrement GMC : Doit être inscrit activement auprès du Conseil médical général (CGM) au moment de la demande.
• Expérience clinique : Un minimum de 3 ans et plus d'expérience clinique directe après la qualification.
• Expérience de spécialité: Expérience éprouvée de travail dans des contextes d'hématologie ou d'oncologie.
• Une personne cherchant à diversifier sa formation. Bien que certaines expériences cliniques antérieures soient préférées, elles ne sont pas essentielles.
• Une personne intéressée à mieux comprendre et influencer le développement et l'approbation de médicaments pour les patients dans la zone de maladie spécifique. Remarque : il ne s'agit pas d'une bourse de sciences fondamentales menant à un diplôme d'études supérieures, bien que la recherche clinique puisse compléter ou informer la recherche fondamentale existante, le cas échéant.
• Les candidats doivent présenter une demande d'admission.

jobs.title: Investor Relations Officer (Pharma, ESG)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Welcome to a highly dedicated team where you will have the unique opportunity to gain deep insight into all aspects of investor relations at a world-leading, science-driven pharmaceutical company. Our team focuses on maintaining strong relations with the capital market while offering a dynamic and fast-paced environment with ample opportunities for professional development.

As Investor Relations Officer, your basic responsibilities are to ensure the correct flow of relevant information and company messages, analyze financial community expectations and sentiments, develop the financial community’s understanding and appreciation of Roche’s pharmaceutical business with focus on the development pipeline. You will gain experience related to internal and external communication to senior management and the financial community.

The Opportunity :

• Liaise with franchise heads, product teams, business units, competitive intelligence teams, business development, communication and finance to keep up to date with the Pharma pipeline and ongoing business developments

• Contribute to quarterly results presentations for the management team with focus on the preparation and review of slides decks and Q&A

• Organize IR events, develop story lines and contribute to external presentations delivered by senior management at medical conferences and IR company days (e.g. Pharma Day, Diagnostics Day, ESG Day, Digitalization Day)

• Review and provide feedback to achieve alignment between IR and communication teams for Media & IR releases in assigned areas

• Prepare supporting materials and draft Q&A documents for senior management prior to investor conferences/visits

• Compile analyst notes to summarize financial community sentiment, expectations and projections

• You will be acting as a key point of contact for analysts and investors to process all sustainability (ESG: Environmental, Social, Governance) related requests

• You will liaise with Sustainability, Access, Safety Health & Environment, Legal, and Communications on sustainability and governance topics

• Manage all ESG content on the IR homepage

Who you are:

You have a strong life science/medical background with working experience either in the pharmaceutical industry, pharma consulting or insights businesses, or financial industry (Pharma/Biotech financial analyst). You enjoy working in a highly dedicated team with the opportunity to gain deep insights in all aspects of investor relations at a world-leading, science-driven pharmaceutical company with great opportunities for professional development.

• Minimum 5 years of working experience in the pharmaceutical industry (e.g. business development, scientific/medical communication, competitive intelligence, M&D, R&D etc.) or in an associated field (e.g. Pharma consultancy, insights business, financial analyst in investment banking)

• Strong interest in the trends shaping the pharmaceutical and biotech industry and in capital markets (e.g. understanding company valuations)

• Ability to network and liaise with a wide variety of groups within the company (e.g. R&D, product teams, communication, finance) to obtain and share relevant information

• Excellent narrative development skills with an ability to explain scientific and business concepts alike

• You have developed presentations on scientific, industry or business related topics and have excellent proficiency in Excel, Power Point / Google slides

• Excellent English language skills (written and spoken), German

• Eccellente capacità di sviluppo narrativo con la capacità di spiegare concetti scientifici e aziendali allo stesso modo

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Welcome to a highly dedicated team where you will have the unique opportunity to gain deep insight into all aspects of investor relations at a world-leading, science-driven pharmaceutical company. Our team focuses on maintaining strong relations with the capital market while offering a dynamic and fast-paced environment with ample opportunities for professional development. As Investor Relations Officer, your basic responsibilities are to ensure the correct flow of relevant information and company messages, analyze financial community expectations and sentiments, develop the financial community’s understanding and appreciation of Roche’s pharmaceutical business with focus on the development pipeline. You will gain experience related to internal and external communication to senior management and the financial community. The Opportunity :
• Liaise with franchise heads, product teams, business units, competitive intelligence teams, business development, communication and finance to keep up to date with the Pharma pipeline and ongoing business developments
• Contribute to quarterly results presentations for the management team with focus on the preparation and review of slides decks and Q&A
• Organize IR events, develop story lines and contribute to external presentations delivered by senior management at medical conferences and IR company days (e.g. Pharma Day, Diagnostics Day, ESG Day, Digitalization Day)
• Review and provide feedback to achieve alignment between IR and communication teams for Media & IR releases in assigned areas
• Prepare supporting materials and draft Q&A documents for senior management prior to investor conferences/visits
• Compile analyst notes to summarize financial community sentiment, expectations and projections
• You will be acting as a key point of contact for analysts and investors to process all sustainability (ESG: Environmental, Social, Governance) related requests
• You will liaise with Sustainability, Access, Safety Health & Environment, Legal, and Communications on sustainability and governance topics
• Manage all ESG content on the IR homepage Who you are: You have a strong life science/medical background with working experience either in the pharmaceutical industry, pharma consulting or insights businesses, or financial industry (Pharma/Biotech financial analyst). You enjoy working in a highly dedicated team with the opportunity to gain deep insights in all aspects of investor relations at a world-leading, science-driven pharmaceutical company with great opportunities for professional development.
• Minimum 5 years of working experience in the pharmaceutical industry (e.g. business development, scientific/medical communication, competitive intelligence, M&D, R&D etc.) or in an associated field (e.g. Pharma consultancy, insights business, financial analyst in investment banking)
• Strong interest in the trends shaping the pharmaceutical and biotech industry and in capital markets (e.g. understanding company valuations)
• Ability to network and liaise with a wide variety of groups within the company (e.g. R&D, product teams, communication, finance) to obtain and share relevant information
• Excellent narrative development skills with an ability to explain scientific and business concepts alike
• You have developed presentations on scientific, industry or business related topics and have excellent proficiency in Excel, Power Point / Google slides
• Excellent English language skills (written and spoken), German

• Starkes Interesse an den Trends der Pharma- und Biotech-Industrie und an den Kapitalmärkten (z.B. Verständnis von Unternehmensbewertungen)
• Fähigkeit zur Vernetzung und Verbindung mit einer Vielzahl von Gruppen innerhalb des Unternehmens (z. B. F & E, Produktteams, Kommunikation, Finanzen), um relevante Informationen zu erhalten und auszutauschen
• Hervorragende narrative Entwicklungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, wissenschaftliche und geschäftliche Konzepte gleichermaßen zu erklären
• Sie haben Präsentationen zu wissenschaftlichen, branchen- oder geschäftsbezogenen Themen entwickelt und verfügen über ausgezeichnete Kenntnisse in Excel, Power Point / Google Folien
• Hervorragende Englischkenntnisse (geschrieben und gesprochen), Deutsch

Notre équipe se concentre sur le maintien de relations solides avec le marché des capitaux tout en offrant un environnement dynamique et rapide avec de nombreuses possibilités de développement professionnel. Journée des pharmaciens, Journée du diagnostic, Journée de l'ESG, Journée de la numérisation)

• Préparer des documents d'appui et des ébauches de documents de questions et réponses à l'intention de la haute direction avant les conférences et visites des investisseurs
• Compiler les notes de l'analyste pour résumer le sentiment, les attentes et les projections de la communauté financière
• Vous agirez comme point de contact clé pour les analystes et les investisseurs afin de traiter toutes les demandes liées à la durabilité (ESG : environnement, social, gouvernance)
• Vous serez en contact avec Durabilité, Accès, Sécurité Santé et Environnement, Droit et Communications sur les sujets de durabilité et de gouvernance
• Gérer tous les contenus ESG sur la page d'accueil IR Qui vous êtes : Vous avez une solide expérience en sciences de la vie/médicale avec une expérience de travail soit dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, les entreprises de consultation ou d'information pharmaceutique, ou l'industrie financière (Pharma/Biotech analyste financier). Vous aimez travailler dans une équipe très dévouée avec l'occasion d'acquérir des connaissances approfondies sur tous les aspects des relations avec les investisseurs dans une société pharmaceutique mondialement leader, axée sur la science, avec de grandes opportunités de développement professionnel.
• Au moins 5 années d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique (p. ex. développement des affaires, communication scientifique/médicale, intelligence concurrentielle, M-D, R-D, etc.) ou dans un domaine connexe (p. ex. conseil en pharmacie, information commerciale, analyste financier en banque d'investissement)
• Intérêt marqué pour les tendances qui façonnent l'industrie pharmaceutique et biotechnologique et les marchés financiers (p. ex. compréhension des évaluations des entreprises)
• Capacité d'établir des réseaux et d'assurer la liaison avec une grande variété de groupes au sein de l'entreprise (p. ex. R-D, équipes de produits, communication, finances) pour obtenir et partager des renseignements pertinents
• Excellentes compétences en développement narratif avec une capacité à expliquer les concepts scientifiques et commerciaux
• Vous avez développé des présentations sur des sujets scientifiques, industriels ou commerciaux et avez une excellente compétence dans Excel, Power Point / Google diapositives
• Excellentes compétences en anglais (écrit et parlé), allemand

As an Intern in Roche Pharma Malaysia, you may be assigned to a variety of tasks and/or projects relevant for the assigned team/function.

The objective of assignments is for the intern to practically apply academic or vocational studies/learning in a Roche setting, as well as learn more about the Roche organization, as future employment with Roche may be a possibility subject to job availability, candidate qualification and past performance.

• Collaborating closely with field-facing and office-based colleagues to understand customer/patient/healthcare ecosystem needs as well as Roche strategies and products in the assigned disease area

• Adapting materials/assets/content from global or other countries to local context and needs

• Creating new materials/assets/content

• Support planning, project management and implementation for (digital) marketing campaigns,

• Support development of content/channel strategies and tactics​

Education & Qualifications:

• Currently pursuing a degree in a Medical, Scientific, or Biotechnology-related field (e.g., Science, Medical, Biotechnology).

• Familiar with Canva and demonstrates the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new digital tools.

The Position
Werden auch Du Teil von Roche Diagnostik, dem Weltmarktführer im Bereich der Labordiagnostik Systeme! Wir suchen einen Service Engineer (w/m/d) für Aufbau, Wartung und Störungsbehebung unserer Geräte. Das Gebiet umfasst Ostösterreich.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten :

• Als Aussendienstmitarbeiter:in bist Du für den Aufbau, Wartung und Entstörung von medizinisch diagnostischen Geräten verantwortlich

• Du planst Einsätze in enger Abstimmung mit Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen und führst diese eigenverantwortlich zur vollen Zufriedenheit mit größtmöglicher Sorgfalt durch

• Durchführung von Kund:innenschulungen und Trainings an unseren Geräten

• Du erkennst Kund:innenbedürfnisse und unterstützen unser Sales Team beim Verkauf weiterer Produkte bzw. Serviceleistungen

• Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Einwandbehandlung und kommunizierst lösungsorientiert mit Kund:innen und im Team

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Customer Care Kolleg:innen

• Du bist bereit, Störungsbehebungen im Zuge einer geplanten Bereitschaftstätigkeit auch am Wochenende/Feiertagen durchzuführen

Wer Du bist:

• Freude an der Arbeit mit Menschen und im Aufbau von langfristigen Kund:innenbeziehungen

• Idealerweise Erfahrung im Aufbau, Update und Entstörung von Medizinprodukten im Bereich der Blutanalysesysteme sowie Prä-, und Postanalytik

• FH/HTL in Fachrichtung Mechatronik, Telekommunikation, Medizintechnik, Elektrotechnik oder gleichwertiges Studium bzw. abgeschlossene Lehre mit Praxiserfahrung

• Führerschein Gruppe B & Reisebereitschaft

• Installation und Update von Firewalls, Routern (Troubleshooting Skills auf Netzwerkebene) sind kein Problem für Dich

• Sehr gute Deutsch-und Englischkenntnisse

• Dein Wohnort ist idealerweise im Süden von Wien

In dieser spannenden Position erwartet Dich ein Jahresgehalt ab € 46.000 brutto. Wir bieten zahlreiche attraktive Benefits wie Pensionskasse, betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung bzw. Sportförderung, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, nationale und internationale Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und noch viel mehr. Ein Dienstwagen steht Dir auch zur privaten Nutzung zur Verfügung. Abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung besteht die Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: Junior Supply Chain Intern (Kuwait)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Roche Kuwait early in career Program is a 12 months rotational development program at Roche. The program is tailored for high potential individuals at an early stage of their career, and NO work experience is required. The program accelerates their professional development and enables them to be key contributors to Roche's purpose and what patients need next.

Roche Kuwait offers Supply Chain Intern position for a period of 11 months and 1 month rotation with the below main responsibilities:

Your Responsibilities

• Reviewing customers’ orders details such as materials, prices, quantities, etc., to ensure accuracy

• Coordinating with the warehouse to ensure that orders are processed correctly

• Contact customers directly to resolve any issues related to their orders and deliveries

• Processing orders by updating inventory levels and pricing to ensure that they are accurate

• Monitoring order status to ensure that it is progressing as expected

• Updating customer records with order details such as shipping details and tracking numbers

• Resolve customer concerns regarding shipping delays or damaged goods

• Processing returns or exchanges based on customer requests or company policies

• Communicating with customers regarding order status updates using email, phone, or text message

• Evaluating and managing stock replenishment procedures

• Placing inventory restock orders

• Communicating the products’ update to the internal and external stakeholders

Your Opportunity

• Participants build an extensive network within Roche and upskill themselves

• Best possible work environment is designed to foster participants' learning experience

• Participants will have access to senior leaders and will be assigned to a mentor to support their career journey

• Contributing to purpose driven projects and taking responsibilities from day 1

Who You Are (requirements)

• You hold a BSc and/or MSc degree in Life Sciences, Economy, Business, Public Affairs or any related area

• You are at an early stage in your career. Fresh graduates will be preferred

• You have basic understanding of healthcare system is preferred

• Good knowledge in IT Security

• You understand security and data protection (including Wi-Fi and firewall rules)

• You acquired basic knowledge of laboratory IT solutions: (LIS, HIS, Middleware Solution)

• You are eager to work with diverse cultures

• You are curious and have passion for learning new things, and have high degree of integrity and courage

• You have excellent communication and innovative skills

• You are proficient in English

Our mission

Roche is a global pioneer and leader in Personalized Healthcare. We provide breakthrough differentiated medicines and diagnostic tests using expertise in Science, Technology and Data so that people can live better lives. We believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all.

We are living in truly historic times. The rapid digitalization of healthcare fuels an accelerated transformation in our industry. This change requires leaders who are entrepreneurial, who trust and encourage teams to take risks, learn and progress quickly.

Program Characteristics/Scope

• A rotational talent development program

• 12 months in different disciplines

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees acro

Roche Kuwait offre un poste de stagiaire de la chaîne d'approvisionnement pour une période de 11 mois et 1 mois de rotation avec les principales responsabilités ci-dessous: Vos responsabilités
• Examiner les clients - commande des détails tels que les matériaux, les prix, les quantités, etc., pour assurer l'exactitude

• Résoudre les préoccupations des clients concernant les retards d'expédition ou les marchandises endommagées
• Traitement des retours ou des échanges en fonction des demandes des clients ou des politiques de l'entreprise

• Évaluation et gestion des procédures de reconstitution des stocks
• Commandes de réapprovisionnement des stocks

• Vous avez acquis des connaissances de base sur les solutions informatiques de laboratoire (LIS, HIS, Middleware Solution)
• Vous êtes impatient de travailler avec des cultures diverses

• Vous avez une excellente communication et des compétences innovantes

jobs.title: Senior Financial Accountant - Talent Pool
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This posting is for Talent Pool purposes and may not correspond to a current vacancy with an active recruitment process. However, it reflects a role for which we regularly recruit or anticipate having openings in the near future for permanent or fixed term opportunities.

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Financial Accountant you will perform day-to-day and closing activities in cooperation with cross-functional departments, according to predefined deadlines with full ownership of their tasks and in compliance with the Process Documentations of the respective business sub-process. In this position in close collaboration with the Country Chief Accountant, you will focus on:

• Leased assets, fixed asset and CAPEX accounting activities

• Taxes, GL journals and accruals/ provisions, reconciling BS accounts

• Clearing customer accounts and bank suspense accounts, collecting direct debit, daily bank posting, posting and reconciling treasury transactions

• Calculating and issuing AR manual invoices

• Defining and calculating cost and revenue allocation in controlling

• Conducting product closing in the Material Management module of SAP

• Performing Month-end Closing and Reporting for Consolidation and for Divisions

• Preparing audit documentation and participating in internal and external audits

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:
University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• 2-4 years of experience in a relevant position

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Outstanding customer orientation and service focus

• Strong interpersonal skills and team player attitude

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questa pubblicazione è per scopi Talent Pool e non può corrispondere a una vacanza corrente con un processo di reclutamento attivo. Tuttavia, riflette un ruolo per il quale regolarmente reclutare o anticipare di avere aperture nel prossimo futuro per opportunità a termine permanenti o fissi. Il Dipartimento Record to Report (R2R) è un'organizzazione globale di oltre 650 professionisti esperti di finanza che lavorano insieme per fornire servizi finanziari e soluzioni per Roche in tutta la regione EMEA. I nostri servizi riguardano la gestione finanziaria, la chiusura di fine periodo, la contabilità di capitale e di locazione, il credito e i crediti, la finanza di produzione e la rendicontazione divisionale, assicurando la conformità per 263 entità di reporting in 96 paesi con gli standard contabili (IFRS, GAAP) e fornendo garanzia di integrità finanziaria. L'opportunità In qualità di Senior Financial Accountant effettuerai attività quotidiane e di chiusura in collaborazione con dipartimenti interfunzionali, secondo scadenze predefinite con piena proprietà dei loro compiti e nel rispetto delle Documentazioni di Processo del rispettivo sottoprocesso aziendale. In questa posizione in stretta collaborazione con il Capo Contabile del Paese, ti concentrerai su:
• Attività bancarie, assetto fisso e CAPEX
• Tasse, riviste GL e accruals/ disposizioni, riconciliando conti BS
• Cancellazione account clienti e conti di suspense bancari, raccolta di addebito diretto, postazione giornaliera, postazione e riconciliazione transazioni tesoreria
• Calcolo e emissione di fatture manuali AR
• Definizione e calcolo dei costi e delle entrate nel controllo
• Condurre la chiusura del prodotto nel modulo Gestione dei Materiali di SAP
• Esecuzione di chiusura e reporting mensile per il consolidamento e per le divisioni
• Preparazione della documentazione di audit e partecipazione a audit interni ed esterni Chi sei Stiamo cercando qualcuno che è auto motivato, davvero appassionato del suo lavoro e capisce che fornire un servizio di alta qualità è fondamentale per l'organizzazione. Come membro del team ideale siete open-minded, dedicato a fare la differenza e aperto allo sviluppo costante. Inoltre, avete: Laurea universitaria, preferibilmente in Finanza / Contabilità disciplina relativa
• 2-4 anni di esperienza in una posizione rilevante
• Ottima comunicazione e capacità analitiche
• Ottimi orientamenti e messa a fuoco dei servizi
• Forte abilità interpersonali e atteggiamento del giocatore di squadra
• Proficienza in inglese In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto si può spostare Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.
• Una comunità globale inclusiva, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto concentrata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità

Roche Diagnostics in South Africa is seeking a Field Service Engineer to join our dynamic team in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal. As a Field Service Engineer you will provide the diagnostic instrumentation post-sales technical support in accordance with the manufacturers specifications and Roche Diagnostics standards.

Key Challenges

Installation/De-installations

Technical / Application Support

• Support all modifications and support role out plan to meet Global modification KPI’s.

• To support technical field support for cases by receiving cases, contacting clients, providing telephonic support (if possible) and coordinating resolution of cases within SLA/deadline .

• To support and resolve escalated technical cases and co-share findings with the technical support team. • Pro-actively follow up with customers after complicated/escalated cases are closed by contacting clients via telephone/onsite visits verifying case is fully resolved, reopen/open cases if the issue is reoccurring and resolve within deadline to manage modification projects by engaging with internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance and support for specific products

Customer Service

• To maintain a customer centric approach with all customer engagements by aligning with the Roche values, maintaining professionalism, providing quality technical and application support and advice and delivering according to their expectations and SLA at all times

• To proactively resolve customer issues by conducting courtesy visits, identifying potential issues and resolving and taking preventative action at all times

• Actively contribute in direct sales to customers by fully understanding customer requirements and Roche product solutions

• Actively share and promote product information of new product launches and solutions to the market.

• Provide market intelligence of what is happening in the field to the sales and marketing teams.
