jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Diagnostics Direct Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to steer the long-term category roadmap and command the high-value supplier ecosystems that drive our global Instrument development projects? As our Global Category Manager for Engineering Services based out of Sant Cugat, Spain, you will take ultimate accountability for developing strategies and leading strategic initiatives for this complex, high-value category. In this role, you will manage major engineering consultancies, technical suppliers, and service networks to ensure maximum value delivery across global business sites.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the Global Category Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Engages directly with cross-functional teams composed of representatives from Category,, Procurement Center of Excellence, R&D and other global business partners. Serves as a key business partner contact point for senior functional and business stakeholders in R&D.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role with global category leadership position focused on strategic vision, category development, pipeline building, and relationship ecosystem management

• Impact: You deliver commercial impact by anchoring cost and developing a resilience pipeline of projects, in addition to securing our sustainability priorities. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, supplier data, and business requirements to formulate a formalized, global Category Strategy and initiative pipeline, to be aligned with leaders across the organization.

• Commercial Negotiations: Leading high-value commercial and contractual negotiations for strategic suppliers within the category.

• Supplier Ecosystems: Managing key global suppliers, establishing development and innovation programs, monitoring value targets, and managing supplier risks.

• Guidance & Content: Developing and maintaining category guidance documents to translate strategy into clear, executable content for procurement colleagues and business users.

• Business Partnering: Building deep relationships with senior stakeholders, particularly in R&D, challenging demand/specifications to maximize value, and managing risk/CSR reviews.

• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching procurement colleagues, providing professional development, managing a shared Associate Category Manager within the team, and tracking budget spend.

Who you are

We look for strategic procurement champions with extensive knowledge of the global instruments development (SW development and HW engineering) markets and the matrix leadership skills needed to drive complex organizational change.

• Education: University degree required (Business or Life Sciences focus preferred); a post-graduate business-related qualification is preferred.

• Experience: 5+ years of in-depth strategic and operat

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Diagnostics Direct Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Siete pronti a guidare la roadmap di categoria a lungo termine e a comandare gli ecosistemi fornitori ad alto valore che guidano i nostri progetti globali di sviluppo degli strumenti? Come nostro Global Categoria Manager per i Servizi di Ingegneria con sede a Sant Cugat, in Spagna, si terrà la massima responsabilità per lo sviluppo di strategie e principali iniziative strategiche per questa categoria complessa e di alto valore. In questo ruolo, gestirete importanti consulenze ingegneristiche, fornitori tecnici e reti di servizi per garantire il massimo valore di consegna nei siti aziendali globali.
• Reporting Line: Referisce direttamente al Global Categoria Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT all'interno dell'organizzazione Categoria.
• Wider Team e Stakeholders: Engages direttamente con team interfunzionali composti da rappresentanti di Categoria,, Centro di Eccellenza, R&D e altri partner commerciali globali. Serve come punto di contatto chiave del partner commerciale per gli stakeholder senior funzionali e aziendali in R&D.
• Tipo di ruolo: Un ruolo di Contributor individuale con la posizione di leadership di categoria globale focalizzata sulla visione strategica, lo sviluppo di categoria, la costruzione di pipeline e la gestione dell'ecosistema di relazione
• Impatto: si ottiene un impatto commerciale ancorando i costi e sviluppando una pipeline di resilienza di progetti, oltre a garantire le nostre priorità di sostenibilità. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Strategia & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, dati dei fornitori e requisiti aziendali per formulare un pipeline di strategia e iniziativa di categoria formalizzata e globale, da allineare con i leader di tutta l'organizzazione.
• Negoziati commerciali: negoziati commerciali e contrattuali di alto valore per i fornitori strategici all'interno della categoria.
• Ecosistemi del fornitore: Gestire fornitori globali chiave, stabilire programmi di sviluppo e innovazione, monitorare obiettivi di valore e gestire i rischi dei fornitori.
• Orientamento e contenuto: Sviluppare e mantenere i documenti di orientamento della categoria per tradurre la strategia in contenuti chiari ed eseguibili per l'approvvigionamento di colleghi e utenti aziendali.
• Business Partnering: Costruire relazioni profonde con gli stakeholder senior, in particolare in R&D, sfidando la domanda/specificazioni per massimizzare il valore e gestire le recensioni di rischio/CSR.
• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching colleghi di approvvigionamento, fornendo lo sviluppo professionale, la gestione di un Associate Categoria Manager condiviso all'interno del team, e il monitoraggio della spesa di bilancio. Chi sei Cerchiamo campioni strategici di approvvigionamento con una vasta conoscenza dei mercati globali di sviluppo degli strumenti (SW development and HW engineering) e delle competenze di leadership matrice necessarie per guidare il cambiamento organizzativo complesso.
• Istruzione: diploma universitario richiesto (Business o Scienze della vita si concentrano preferito); una qualifica post-laurea legata al business è preferito.
• Esperienza: 5+ anni di approfondimento strategico e operativo

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Nous, chez Diagnostics Direct Approvisionnement (DOP), sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à piloter la feuille de route de la catégorie à long terme et à commander les écosystèmes fournisseurs de haute valeur qui animent nos projets mondiaux de développement d'instruments? En tant que Global Category Manager pour les services d'ingénierie basés à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous aurez la responsabilité ultime de développer des stratégies et de diriger des initiatives stratégiques pour cette catégorie complexe et de grande valeur. Dans ce rôle, vous gérerez les principaux cabinets de conseil en ingénierie, fournisseurs techniques et réseaux de services afin d'assurer une prestation de valeur maximale sur les sites d'affaires mondiaux.
• Ligne hiérarchique : relève directement de la catégorie mondiale Capex/Services d'ingénierie/TI au sein de l'organisation de la catégorie.
• Équipe élargie et parties prenantes : S'engage directement auprès d'équipes interfonctionnelles composées de représentants de la catégorie, du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement, de R-D et d'autres partenaires commerciaux mondiaux. Il sert de point de contact principal des partenaires commerciaux pour les principaux intervenants fonctionnels et commerciaux en R-D.
• Type de rôle : Un intervenant individuel avec un poste de leadership de catégorie mondiale axé sur la vision stratégique, le développement de catégories, la construction de pipelines et la gestion des rapports écosystémiques
• Impact: Vous produisez un impact commercial en ancrage des coûts et en développant un pipeline de résilience de projets, en plus de garantir nos priorités de durabilité. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Stratégie et pipeline annuel : Rassembler les renseignements sur les marchés, les données sur les fournisseurs et les exigences opérationnelles afin de formuler un pipeline officiel de la Stratégie et de l'initiative de catégorie mondiale, qui sera aligné sur les dirigeants de l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Négociations commerciales : Mener des négociations commerciales et contractuelles de grande valeur pour les fournisseurs stratégiques de la catégorie.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to spearhead the long-term category roadmap and command our high-value IT supplier landscape that drives the functioning of our Diagnostics Instruments? As our Global Category Manager for IT Software & Hardware in Sant Cugat, Spain (or in Indianapolis, U.S.), you will take ultimate accountability for developing strategies and leading strategic initiatives for this rapidly evolving spend category. In this role, you will manage tier-one global technology providers, negotiate complex commercial frameworks, and translate category goals into bottom-line value creation.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the Global Category Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Engages directly with cross-functional teams composed of representatives from Category, Delivery, Procurement Center of Excellence, and global business partners. Serves as a key business partner contact point for senior functional and business stakeholders.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role with global category leadership position focused on strategic vision, category development, pipeline building, and relationship ecosystem management

• Impact: You deliver commercial impact by anchoring cost and developing a resilience pipeline of projects, in addition to securing our sustainability priorities. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, supplier data, and business requirements to formulate a formalized, global Category Strategy and initiative pipeline, to be aligned with leaders across the organization.

• Commercial Negotiations: Leading high-value commercial and contractual negotiations for strategic suppliers within the category.

• Supplier Ecosystems: Managing key global suppliers, establishing development and innovation programs, monitoring value targets, and managing supplier risks.

• Guidance & Content: Developing and maintaining category guidance documents to translate strategy into clear, executable content for procurement colleagues and business users.

• Business Partnering: Building deep relationships with senior stakeholders, challenging demand/specifications to maximize value, and managing risk/CSR reviews.

• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching procurement colleagues, providing professional development, managing a shared Associate Category Manager within the team, and tracking budget spend.

Who you are

We look for strategic procurement champions with extensive knowledge of global IT Hardware and off-the-shelf software supply markets and the matrix leadership skills needed to drive complex organizational change.

• Education: University degree required (Business or Life Sciences focus preferred); a post-graduate business-related qualification is preferred.

• Experience: 5+ years of in-depth strategic and operational procu

• Impatto: si ottiene un impatto commerciale ancorando i costi e sviluppando una pipeline di resilienza di progetti, oltre a garantire le nostre priorità di sostenibilità. In particolare, sei responsabile per:

Chi sei Cerchiamo campioni strategici di approvvigionamento con una vasta conoscenza dei mercati globali dell'hardware IT e dell'offerta software off-the-shelf e delle competenze di leadership matrice necessarie per guidare il cambiamento organizzativo complesso.
• Istruzione: diploma universitario richiesto (Business o Scienze della vita si concentrano preferito); una qualifica post-laurea legata al business è preferito.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted, and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop, and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Are you passionate about influencing policy, building partnerships, and driving meaningful access improvements in healthcare? Come and join our growing Public Affairs team, where we continuously analyse and influence how legislation, regulation, and the political environment impact communities and the pharmaceutical industry. Together, we aim to ensure UK patients have the best access to medicines in Europe.

At Roche UK, we focus our energy and investment in developing tests and treatments that change lives and give us more quality time with the people we love. And, together with others, we’re solving healthcare’s greatest challenges; helping to achieve better results by connecting early diagnosis to targeted treatment and ongoing support.

A key component to our success is our continual focus on the individuals who are affected by the conditions that Roche focuses on, now and in the future. The Public Affairs team is responsible for how Roche shows up with communities of people with lived experience, and the government bodies, policies and systems that shape our environment.

Your Opportunity to Make a Difference

2026/27 will be a year of unprecedented importance for the Roche UK Public Affairs function. With a rapidly evolving political and operational environment, shaped by evolving transatlantic and domestic policy agendas, Corporate Public Affairs will play a decisive and business-critical role in influencing and shaping the external environment to meet Roche UK’s goal of reaching twice as many patients by 2030.

In this role, you will utilise your profound understanding of the UK political system and healthcare policy landscape to identify, shape and execute Roche UK’s Corporate Public Affairs strategy with priority stakeholders. This is a senior, highly visible role that will require a proactive approach to corporate engagement, as well as the ability to manage agency and partner activity.

What You’ll Do:

• Proactively contribute to our enterprise Corporate Public Affairs strategy, synergising therapy area challenges and opportunities into portfolio-wide goals that accelerate business outcomes.

• Monitor and analyse the impact of national and, where required, international policy developments on Roche’s in-line portfolio and future pipeline, including, but not limited to, MFN, VPAG and NICE processes.

• Utilise your network of senior external stakeholders to proactively identify Corporate Public Affairs opportunities to articulate Roche’s value proposition clearly and persuasively.

• Support the Head of Public Affairs in co-ordinating briefing requests and meetings for Roche UK’s senior leadership team, including country visits from Global colleagues, ensuring deployment of a consistent and impactful corporate narrative.

• Lead trade body interactions, including deputising for the Head of Public Affairs in supporting the UK General Manager with briefings and strategic advice as required ahead of senior political forum meetings.

• Regularly lead strategic interactions with pol

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Head of IFU Management US Core Lab , you will lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing team of approximately 10 Technical Writers at the Indianapolis site. Our Product Information teams ensure that customers worldwide receive precise, timely, and compliant documentation. Your mission is to guarantee that the Instructions for Use (IFU) for our US portfolio are delivered with top-notch quality, on time, and within budget—optimally supporting both business-critical product launches and key product lifecycle changes. You will actively help shape the next generation of product information by driving digital innovations (such as AI) and process optimizations.

Responsibilities | What to Expect

• Shaping the Future of Content: As a key member of the Product Information Leadership Team, you align operational processes in Indianapolis with our global strategic goals and digital transformation roadmap.

• Driving Global Collaboration: You establish a cross-site culture, break down silos, and actively leverage synergies between our international locations to boost innovation and operational efficiency.

• Leading Through Innovation: You are a driving force for continuous improvement, establishing data-driven decision-making and integrating cutting-edge technologies into local workflows.

• Team Empowerment: You create an inclusive environment where exceptional results are the standard. You take full disciplinary and functional leadership of your team (including performance management and development) and foster a culture of psychological safety.

• Excellence and Compliance: You ensure that all product documentation strictly complies with legal guidelines and regulations while meeting the evolving needs of our US customers. Additionally, you are responsible for the budget planning and compliance of your unit.

Qualifications | What You Bring

• Education: A successfully completed degree in Technical Communication, Business Administration, Life Sciences, or a comparable field.

• Leadership Experience: 5+ years of experience leading and developing high-performing teams (preferably 10+ people). You have a proven track record of fostering a culture of psychological safety, accountability, and continuous growth.

• Industry Expertise: Sound experience in technical writing, content management, or IFU management, ideally within the medical device, diagnostics, or pharmaceutical industry.

• Pioneer Mindset: A "pioneer" mindset with experience leading teams through digital transformations. You comfortably navigate ambiguity and actively drive new ways of working.

• Project Management: Strong project management skills with a focus on data-driven decision-making to balance "quality on time" with long-term process optimization.

• Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to operate successfully across cultures and time zones. Fluency in English is a given for this role.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indiana Base Pay Range $103,100 - $191,500 Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance, as well as participation in a long-term incentive program. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

Benefits
Location: This position is based in Indianapoli

jobs.title: Head of Health Economics and Outcomes

titleByLocale.en: Head of Health Economics and Outcomes

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is in our Market Access group within the UK and leads the Health Economics team to ensure we can gain reimbursement for our medicines.

As the Head of Health Economics and Outcomes , you are a visionary leader dedicated to ensuring UK patients have the best access to medicines in Europe. You will challenge and shape the UK reimbursement system, ensuring our value is demonstrated through innovative, high-standard health economics. You will demonstrate exceptional leadership and strategic thinking - be passionate about gaining access for all patients, but also plays a significant role in the UK and Globally to ensure healthcare systems are fit for purpose.

Your Impact

• You act as a Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, and Coach to inspire chapter members and foster a culture of growth and accountability.

• Collaborative Excellence: You remove silos and duplication across the organization to support our common "North Star".

• Strategic Leadership: You sign off on reimbursement dossiers and lead strategies that engage key stakeholders and pan-industry relationships.

• System Transformation: You play a significant role both in the UK and globally to ensure healthcare systems are fit for purpose.

• Resource Advocacy: You lead strategic planning to ensure your chapter is fully resourced and capable of meeting both current and future demands.

Who you are

• You have a strong track record in HE&OR is essential, as well as significant knowledge of the UK health system, and the ability to collaborate both locally and globally

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Health Economics

• Inspiring Coach who provides leadership of the Chapter Members within their Chapter, with a Creative Leadership mindset and the VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) roles, and more broadly as required, to ensure individuals and teams are developing and growing in line with their passion and the needs of the Organisation

• Fostering collaboration and expertise-sharing across the organisation to remove silos and duplication, ensure efficient use of similar skill-sets, and to ultimately support common pursuit of the North Star

• Accountable for fostering a culture where every individual is able to bring their whole self & passion to work.

• Acting as a guardian for high standards of compliance, ethics and safety; putting patients at the centre of all actions by consistent business behaviour that complies with applicable laws, industry codes and Roche’s Code of Conduct.

• Lead strategic resource planning to ensure the chapter is fully resourced to meet demands of the organisation, and any resource constraints are constructively flagged, with a collaborative approach to find solutions

• Develop the long term strategy to ensure Chapter capabilities are fit for purpose now and in the future to meet internal and external demands

• Where applicable, ensuring "Foundational work" is completed, with continual review of HOW it's done to drive efficiency and minimise resource required to do it (without compromising on necessary standards)

• Ensuring ruthless prioritisation to avoid Chapter "work-creep" outside of Foundational work, Squad-prioritised work and Personal Develop

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Questo ruolo è nel nostro gruppo Market Access nel Regno Unito e guida il team Health Economics per garantire che possiamo ottenere il rimborso per i nostri farmaci. In qualità di capo dell'economia della salute e dei risultati, sei un leader visionario dedicato a garantire ai pazienti britannici il miglior accesso ai farmaci in Europa. Sfiderai e formerai il sistema di rimborso del Regno Unito, assicurando che il nostro valore sia dimostrato attraverso l'economia sanitaria innovativa e standard. Dimostrerete una leadership eccezionale e un pensiero strategico - essere appassionati di ottenere l'accesso per tutti i pazienti, ma svolge anche un ruolo significativo nel Regno Unito e Globally per garantire i sistemi sanitari sono adatti per lo scopo. Il tuo impatto
• Lei agisce come Visionario, Architetto, Catalista e Coach per ispirare i membri del capitolo e promuovere una cultura di crescita e responsabilità.
• Eccellenza collaborativa: rimuovere silos e duplicazione in tutta l'organizzazione per supportare la nostra comune "North Star".
• Leadership strategica: ti iscrivi ai fascicoli di rimborso e alle strategie di lead che coinvolgono le principali parti interessate e le relazioni di pan-industria.
• Trasformazione di sistema: Lei gioca un ruolo significativo sia nel Regno Unito che a livello globale per garantire i sistemi sanitari sono adatti per lo scopo.
• Advocacy delle risorse: Lei guida la pianificazione strategica per garantire che il suo capitolo sia pienamente informato e capace di soddisfare le richieste attuali e future. Chi sei
• Hai un forte track record in HE&OR è essenziale, così come la conoscenza significativa del sistema sanitario britannico, e la capacità di collaborare sia localmente che globalmente
• Hai una laurea o un master in economia della salute
• Inspirante Coach che fornisce la leadership dei membri del capitolo all'interno del loro Capitolo, con una mentalità di Leadership creativa e il VACC (Visionary, Architetto, Catalizzatore, Coach) ruoli, e più ampiamente come richiesto, per garantire individui e team stanno sviluppando e crescendo in linea con la loro passione e le esigenze dell'Organizzazione
• Promuovere la collaborazione e la condivisione di competenze in tutta l'organizzazione per rimuovere silos e duplicazione, garantire un uso efficiente di simili set di abilità, e per sostenere in ultima analisi la ricerca comune della North Star
• Contabile per promuovere una cultura in cui ogni individuo è in grado di portare tutta la propria auto e passione a lavorare.
• Agire come tutore per elevati standard di conformità, etica e sicurezza; mettere i pazienti al centro di tutte le azioni da un comportamento aziendale coerente che rispetta le leggi applicabili, i codici del settore e il Codice di condotta di Roche.
• Guidare la pianificazione strategica delle risorse per garantire che il capitolo sia pienamente risorse per soddisfare le esigenze dell'organizzazione, e tutti i vincoli delle risorse sono improntati costruttivamente, con un approccio collaborativo per trovare soluzioni
• Sviluppare la strategia a lungo termine per garantire che le capacità del capitolo siano adatte a fini ora e in futuro per soddisfare le esigenze interne ed esterne
• Se applicabile, garantire il "lavoro fruttuoso" è completato, con la revisione continua di HOW è fatto per guidare l'efficienza e ridurre al minimo le risorse necessarie per farlo (senza compromettere le norme necessarie)
• Garantire priorità arrugginite per evitare il capitolo "lavoro-creep" al di fuori del lavoro della Fondazione, il lavoro-prioritizzato e lo sviluppo personale

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Diese Rolle ist in unserer Marktzugangsgruppe in Großbritannien und leitet das Health Economics-Team, um sicherzustellen, dass wir eine Erstattung für unsere Medikamente erhalten können. Als Head of Health Economics and Outcomes sind Sie ein visionärer Führer, der sich dafür einsetzt, dass britische Patienten den besten Zugang zu Medikamenten in Europa haben. Sie werden das britische Erstattungssystem herausfordern und gestalten, um sicherzustellen, dass unser Wert durch innovative, hochwertige Gesundheitsökonomie demonstriert wird. Sie werden außergewöhnliche Führung und strategisches Denken zeigen - seien Sie leidenschaftlich daran, Zugang für alle Patienten zu erhalten, spielen aber auch eine wichtige Rolle in Großbritannien und weltweit, um sicherzustellen, dass die Gesundheitssysteme für den Zweck geeignet sind. Ihre Wirkung
• Sie fungieren als Visionär, Architekt, Katalysator und Coach, um Kapitelmitglieder zu inspirieren und eine Kultur des Wachstums und der Rechenschaftspflicht zu fördern.
• Collaborative Excellence: Sie entfernen Silos und Duplizierungen im gesamten Unternehmen, um unseren gemeinsamen "Nordstern" zu unterstützen.
• Strategische Führung: Sie unterzeichnen Erstattungsdossiers und führen Strategien, die wichtige Stakeholder und branchenübergreifende Beziehungen einbeziehen.
• Systemtransformation: Sie spielen eine wichtige Rolle sowohl in Großbritannien als auch weltweit, um sicherzustellen, dass die Gesundheitssysteme für den Zweck geeignet sind.
• Resource Advocacy: Sie leiten die strategische Planung, um sicherzustellen, dass Ihr Kapitel vollständig ausgestattet ist und sowohl aktuelle als auch zukünftige Anforderungen erfüllen kann. Wer du bist
• Sie haben eine starke Erfolgsbilanz in HE & OR ist wichtig, sowie bedeutende Kenntnisse des britischen Gesundheitssystems und die Fähigkeit, sowohl lokal als auch global zusammenzuarbeiten
• Sie haben einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Gesundheitsökonomie
• Inspirierender Coach, der die Führung der Chapter-Mitglieder innerhalb seines Chapters übernimmt, mit einer Creative Leadership-Mentalität und den VACC-Rollen (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) und allgemeiner, wenn erforderlich, um sicherzustellen, dass sich Einzelpersonen und Teams im Einklang mit ihrer Leidenschaft und den Bedürfnissen der Organisation entwickeln und wachsen
• Förderung der Zusammenarbeit und des Know-how-Sharing in der gesamten Organisation, um Silos und Duplizierungen zu beseitigen, eine effiziente Nutzung ähnlicher Fähigkeiten zu gewährleisten und letztendlich die gemeinsame Verfolgung des Nordsterns zu unterstützen
• Verantwortlich für die Förderung einer Kultur, in der jeder Einzelne in der Lage ist, sein ganzes Selbst und seine Leidenschaft zur Arbeit zu bringen.
• Als Hüterin für hohe Standards in Bezug auf Compliance, Ethik und Sicherheit; Patienten in den Mittelpunkt aller Maßnahmen durch konsequentes Geschäftsverhalten stellen, das den geltenden Gesetzen, Branchenkodizes und dem Verhaltenskodex von Roche entspricht.
• Führen Sie die strategische Ressourcenplanung, um sicherzustellen, dass das Kapitel vollständig mit Ressourcen ausgestattet ist, um die Anforderungen der Organisation zu erfüllen, und alle Ressourcenbeschränkungen konstruktiv markiert werden, mit einem kollaborativen Ansatz, um Lösungen zu finden
• Entwicklung einer langfristigen Strategie, um sicherzustellen, dass die Fähigkeiten von Chapter jetzt und in Zukunft für interne und externe Anforderungen geeignet sind
• Gegebenenfalls wird sichergestellt, dass "Grundlagenarbeiten" abgeschlossen sind, wobei ständig überprüft wird, WIE sie durchgeführt werden, um die Effizienz zu steigern und die dafür erforderlichen Ressourcen zu minimieren (ohne Kompromisse bei den erforderlichen Standards einzugehen).
• Gewährleistung rücksichtsloser Priorisierung, um Chapter "Work-Creep" außerhalb der Grundlagenarbeit, Squad-priorisierter Arbeit und Personal Develop zu vermeiden

Forma zatrudnienia: umowa zlecenie na rok
Miejsce pracy: 2-3 dni w tygodniu praca z biura na Domaniewskiej 28 w Warszawie

W Roche naszym priorytetem jest troska o zdrowie i jakość życia pacjentów na całym świecie. Tworzymy i wdrażamy innowacyjne, kompleksowe rozwiązania w kluczowych obszarach diagnostyki i terapii, koncentrując się na profilaktyce, diagnozowaniu oraz leczeniu chorób.

Jeśli chcesz zdobyć praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy w Dziale Sprzedaży w międzynarodowej firmie farmaceutycznej oraz rozwijać swoje umiejętności w obszarze CRM, ta oferta jest dla Ciebie!

Twoje zadania:

• Skanowanie i archiwizacja dokumentów handlowych.

• Walidacja i weryfikacja poprawności zawieranych umów.

• Wprowadzanie faktur oraz rachunków do systemu wewnętrznego.

• Bieżące wsparcie administracyjne zespołu sprzedaży.

• Współpraca z innymi działami firmy w zakresie obiegu dokumentów.

Nasze oczekiwania:

• Status studenta lub absolwenta (preferowane kierunki: administracja, ekonomia, zarządzanie, pokrewne).

• Dobra znajomość pakietu MS Office, w szczególności Excel i Word.

• Umiejętność pracy z dokumentacją oraz dbałość o szczegóły.

• Komunikatywność, zaangażowanie i chęć zdobywania wiedzy.

• Mile widziane doświadczenie w pracy biurowej lub administracyjnej (również w formie praktyk).

Co oferujemy?

• Możliwość zdobycia doświadczenia w strukturach działu sprzedaży, w dużej organizacji.

• Szkolenie wprowadzające i wsparcie opiekuna stażu.

• Przyjazną atmosferę pracy w zaangażowanym zespole.

• Elastyczne godziny pracy (możliwość pogodzenia ze studiami), min. 30 h tygodniowo.

• Jeśli chcesz rozwijać się w dynamicznym środowisku i zdobyć cenne doświadczenie w pracy z systemami CRM – aplikuj!

Administratorem danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Domaniewskiej 28 (02-672). Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Osobom, które zaaplikują przysługuje prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-dia-pl .

jobs.title: Internship Robotics - 12 months
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In a global, cross-functional environment the System Development (SD) department is responsible for workflow optimization and the successful integration of hardware, software, consumables and reagents to finally perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments.

The Opportunity

As our Intern you will work as a part of a cross-functional team on automating and tooling in the context of development and product care of complex diagnostics systems, consisting of fluidics, robotics software, thermal, electrical, mechanical and biochemistry elements.

In this position, you will be responsible for the following areas:

• Elaboration of (Cobots-) Robotics concepts within a laboratory environment, to support our vision of a dark lab by fully automating laboratory operation and workflows.

• Programming, testing and maintaining of newly created and existing automated solutions within our laboratories.

• Supporting our Integration Teams with the installation of Robotics Solutions within our laboratory environment.

• Plan, coordinate and execute small work packages within your area of responsibility including reporting and escalation of topics or issues to the management.

• Be able to work as an individual as well as part of a team.

Who You Are

You are excited to start your professional career in the medical diagnostics industry and bring the following qualifications:

• You are currently enrolled as a Bachelor- / Master student or have recently graduated (within the last 12 months), preferably in computer science with specific knowledge in e.g. robotics and/or vision, electrical engineering or systems engineering or equivalent.

• Excellent spoken and written command of English (German is an advantage).

• You are able to communicate appropriately with different target groups.

• Knowledge of one or more programming languages (e.g. Python, C#/NET, LabVIEW etc.)

• You are motivated to build, manage and foster relationships and networks within the department and the related projects.

• Quick grasp and understanding of complex issues, conceptual and creative thinking.

• Due to regulations non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university as part of the application documents, stating that an internship is mandatory.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In un ambiente globale e interfunzionale, il dipartimento System Development (SD) è responsabile dell'ottimizzazione del flusso di lavoro e dell'integrazione riuscita di hardware, software, materiali di consumo e reagenti per eseguire infine la verifica del sistema degli strumenti diagnostici. L'opportunità Come nostro Intern lavorerai come parte di un team interfunzionale per automatizzare e attrezzare nel contesto dello sviluppo e della cura del prodotto di sistemi diagnostici complessi, costituiti da fluidi, software robotico, elementi termici, elettrici, meccanici e biochimica. In questa posizione, sarete responsabili delle seguenti aree:
• Elaborazione di (Cobots-) Concetti robotici all'interno di un ambiente di laboratorio, per supportare la nostra visione di un laboratorio scuro automatizzando completamente il funzionamento del laboratorio e i flussi di lavoro.
• Programmazione, collaudo e mantenimento di soluzioni automatizzate di nuova creazione e esistenti all'interno dei nostri laboratori.
• Supportare i nostri team di integrazione con l'installazione di Robotics Solutions all'interno del nostro ambiente di laboratorio.
• Pianificare, coordinare ed eseguire piccoli pacchetti di lavoro all'interno della vostra area di responsabilità, tra cui la segnalazione e l'escalation di argomenti o problemi alla gestione.
• Essere in grado di lavorare come individuo e parte di una squadra. Chi sei Sei entusiasta di iniziare la tua carriera professionale nel settore della diagnostica medica e portare le seguenti qualifiche:
• Sei attualmente iscritto come studente di laurea / Master o si è recentemente laureato (nel corso degli ultimi 12 mesi), preferibilmente in informatica con conoscenze specifiche in robotica e/o visione, ingegneria elettrica o ingegneria dei sistemi o equivalente.
• Ottimo comando parlato e scritto di inglese (il tedesco è un vantaggio).
• Siete in grado di comunicare in modo appropriato con diversi gruppi target.
• Conoscenza di uno o più linguaggi di programmazione (ad esempio Python, C#/NET, LabVIEW ecc.)
• Siete motivati a costruire, gestire e promuovere relazioni e reti all'interno del dipartimento e dei progetti correlati.
• Rapida comprensione e comprensione di problemi complessi, pensiero concettuale e creativo.
• A causa di regolamenti non UE/EFTA i cittadini devono fornire un certificato dall'università come parte dei documenti di richiesta, affermando che uno stage è obbligatorio. Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position In einer globalen, funktionsübergreifenden Umgebung ist die Abteilung Systementwicklung (SD) für die Workflow-Optimierung und die erfolgreiche Integration von Hardware, Software, Verbrauchsmaterialien und Reagenzien verantwortlich, um schließlich die Systemüberprüfung von Diagnoseinstrumenten durchzuführen. Die Chance Als unser Praktikant arbeiten Sie als Teil eines funktionsübergreifenden Teams an der Automatisierung und dem Tooling im Rahmen der Entwicklung und Produktpflege komplexer Diagnosesysteme, bestehend aus Fluidik, Robotik-Software, thermischen, elektrischen, mechanischen und biochemischen Elementen. In dieser Position sind Sie für folgende Bereiche verantwortlich:
• Ausarbeitung von (Cobots-) Robotikkonzepte in einer Laborumgebung, um unsere Vision eines dunklen Labors durch die vollständige Automatisierung von Laborbetrieb und Workflows zu unterstützen.
• Programmierung, Test und Wartung von neu erstellten und bestehenden automatisierten Lösungen in unseren Labors.
• Unterstützung unserer Integrationsteams bei der Installation von Robotiklösungen in unserer Laborumgebung.
• Planen, koordinieren und führen Sie kleine Arbeitspakete in Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich durch, einschließlich der Berichterstattung und Eskalation von Themen oder Themen an das Management.
• Sie können sowohl als Einzelperson als auch als Teil eines Teams arbeiten. Wer du bist Sie freuen sich, Ihre berufliche Karriere in der medizinischen Diagnostikbranche zu beginnen und folgende Qualifikationen mitzubringen:
• Sie sind derzeit als Bachelor- / Masterstudent eingeschrieben oder haben kürzlich (innerhalb der letzten 12 Monate) einen Abschluss gemacht, vorzugsweise in Informatik mit spezifischen Kenntnissen in z.B. Robotik und / oder Vision, Elektrotechnik oder Systemtechnik oder gleichwertig.
• Hervorragende gesprochene und schriftliche Englischkenntnisse (Deutsch ist ein Vorteil).
• Sie können mit verschiedenen Zielgruppen angemessen kommunizieren.
• Kenntnisse einer oder mehrerer Programmiersprachen (z. B. Python, C#/NET, LabVIEW usw.)
• Sie sind motiviert, Beziehungen und Netzwerke innerhalb der Abteilung und der damit verbundenen Projekte aufzubauen, zu verwalten und zu pflegen.
• Schnelles Erfassen und Verstehen komplexer Themen, konzeptionelles und kreatives Denken.
• Aufgrund von Vorschriften müssen Nicht-EU-/EFTA-Bürger als Teil der Bewerbungsunterlagen ein Zertifikat der Universität vorlegen, aus dem hervorgeht, dass ein Praktikum obligatorisch ist. Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir würden gerne von Ihnen hören. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt, um diese aufregende Gelegenheit zu erkunden! Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans un environnement global et interfonctionnel, le département Développement du Système (SD) est responsable de l'optimisation des flux de travail et de l'intégration réussie du matériel, des logiciels, des consommables et des réactifs pour enfin effectuer la vérification du système des instruments de diagnostic. L'opportunité En tant que stagiaire, vous travaillerez dans le cadre d'une équipe interfonctionnelle sur l'automatisation et l'outillage dans le cadre du développement et du soin des produits de systèmes de diagnostic complexes, comprenant des éléments fluidiques, robotiques, thermiques, électriques, mécaniques et biochimiques. Dans ce poste, vous serez responsable des domaines suivants :
• Élaboration de (Cobots-) Concepts de robotique dans un environnement de laboratoire, pour soutenir notre vision d'un laboratoire sombre en automatisant entièrement le fonctionnement et les workflows de laboratoire.
• Programmation, mise à l'essai et entretien de solutions automatisées nouvelles et existantes dans nos laboratoires.
• Soutenir nos équipes d'intégration avec l'installation de Robotics Solutions dans notre environnement de laboratoire.
• Planifiez, coordonnez et exécutez de petits ensembles de travail dans votre domaine de responsabilité, y compris la présentation de rapports et l'escalade de sujets ou de questions à la direction.
• Être capable de travailler en tant qu'individu et en tant qu'équipe. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes heureux de commencer votre carrière professionnelle dans l'industrie du diagnostic médical et apporter les qualifications suivantes:
• Vous êtes actuellement inscrit en tant que Bachelor- / Master étudiant ou avez récemment obtenu votre diplôme (dans les 12 derniers mois), de préférence en informatique avec des connaissances spécifiques en p. ex. robotique et/ou vision, génie électrique ou génie de systèmes ou équivalent.
• Excellente maîtrise orale et écrite de l'anglais (l'allemand est un avantage).
• Vous pouvez communiquer adéquatement avec différents groupes cibles.
• Connaissance d'un ou de plusieurs langages de programmation (p. ex. Python, C#/NET, LabVIEW, etc.)
• Vous êtes motivé à établir, gérer et favoriser des relations et des réseaux au sein du Ministère et des projets connexes.
• Une compréhension et une compréhension rapides des questions complexes, de la pensée conceptuelle et créative.
• En raison de la réglementation non-UE/AELE, les citoyens doivent fournir un certificat de l'université dans le cadre des documents de demande, indiquant qu'un stage est obligatoire. Prêt à faire l'étape suivante ? Nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles. Postulez maintenant pour explorer cette opportunité passionnante! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Customer Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
La persona en esta posición lidera la gestión de cuentas clave con un enfoque integral y estratégico. Este rol es clave para garantizar una ejecución contractual eficiente, manteniendo una comunicación transparente, una atención constante y una respuesta ágil ante las necesidades operativas de los clientes. Como parte de este desafío, la posición busca fortalecer la confianza y la lealtad, fomentando relaciones a largo plazo mientras identifica oportunidades para el desarrollo comercial y el crecimiento sostenible.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de objetivos de ventas, contratos vigentes y coordinar instalación y funcionamiento adecuado de equipos, movilizando recursos internos (Service, Supply Chain, Logística, Soporte Técnico) y siendo el primer contacto operativo para resolver incidencias.

• Detectar y coordinar iniciativas de crecimiento estratégico en las cuentas, retroalimentar al equipo comercial sobre nuevas oportunidades y colaborar con el Commercial Business Developer.

• Supervisar niveles de inventario y consumo en cuentas, gestionar documentación contractual para pagos, actualizar información de clientes y monitorear indicadores de servicio (SLA, satisfacción, tiempos de respuesta) para proponer mejoras.

• Fomentar la empatía, inteligencia emocional y comunicación efectiva, promoviendo la satisfacción y gestión adecuada de quejas y reclamos.

• Garantizar el respeto al Código de Conducta Roche y políticas corporativas, considerando mejora continua, pensamiento estratégico y disciplina en la planificación y ejecución.

Tu perfil:

• Título universitario en administración, ingeniería, ciencias de la salud o áreas afines

• Experiencia en posiciones similares que incluyan responsabilidades de atención a clientes corporativos (incluyendo gestión de incidencias y fidelización), gestión de contratos, operaciones o atención posventa, en áreas de diagnóstico, dispositivos médicos o industrias relacionadas

• Experiencia en la coordinación de proyectos operativos o soporte contractual, incluyendo instalaciones, procesos logísticos, y soporte técnico para equipos de diagnóstico o laboratorio.

• Manejo de CRM como Salesforce, herramientas de gestión documental, buen dominio de Excel, Office/Google Suite y conocimientos básicos de gestión de proyectos (por ejemplo, uso de Gantt).

• Familiaridad con políticas de salud, dinámica del mercado de IVD, y gestión de reclamos o "potential risk incidents" (PRI).

• Conocimiento intermedio del idioma Inglés.

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Commercial Business Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
La persona en esta posición lidera el crecimiento sostenible de Roche Diagnóstica y maximizar el valor que ofrecemos a nuestros clientes estratégicos, tanto actuales como futuros.
Desarrolla y ejecuta estrategias comerciales innovadoras, centradas en la expansión de nuestras cuentas clave y la identificación de nuevas oportunidades de negocio y modelos comerciales disruptivos. El objetivo es consolidar la fidelización de clientes, asegurar el crecimiento del "share of wallet" y expandir la presencia de Roche en el mercado diagnóstico, reforzando nuestra posición de liderazgo. Esto implica un profundo entendimiento del ecosistema diagnóstico, las necesidades no cubiertas de los clientes y el panorama competitivo, para desarrollar propuestas de valor diferenciadoras que generen un impacto significativo en el negocio y la salud.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas asignados en cuentas estratégicas, contribuyendo de manera directa a las metas comerciales de la organización.

• Participar en el estudio y análisis de la estrategia y planes de marketing regional de nuestros portafolios.

• Definir y/o customizar estrategias para la generación de nuevos negocios con nuestros clientes estratégicos; así como para posibles negocios con clientes no Roche en coordinación con los squads de desarrollo de negocio.

• Liderar la ejecución de la estrategia para el desarrollo y la generación de nuevos negocios y modelos de negocio innovadores mediante la elaboración de la propuesta de valor que integre todas nuestras soluciones (consultoría, soluciones digitales, disease management, etc.).

• Ejecutar la estrategia de desarrollo de negocio, generar y conseguir nuevas oportunidades de negocio incremental, crecer el market share, el alcance e impacto de nuestras soluciones/portafolios.

• Colaborar en la implementación de nuevas soluciones de valor y de nuevos modelos de negocio, atendiendo las necesidades del cliente.

• Visita en campo y cobertura nacional para la prospección de nuevas oportunidades de negocio.

• Actuar como conector interno entre equipos y asegurar la colaboración entre diferentes chapters a través del liderazgo de los diferentes SQUADs de la organización (Strategy, Medical, Acceso, Servicio, etc), asegurando que la organización en su conjunto capitalice las oportunidades con los clientes estratégicos.

• Garantizar la diferenciación de Roche en el mercado mediante una propuesta de valor robusta que refuerce nuestro posicionamiento como líder en diagnóstico innovador y socio estratégico confiable y sostenible.

• Monitorear la satisfacción de clientes estratégicos, promoviendo relaciones de largo plazo basadas en confianza y resultados medibles, asegurando que se consideran los insights estratégicos del mercado y de performance de negocio.

Tu perfil:

• Título universitario en ciencias de la salud, ventas, negocios, marketing o similares.

• Experiencia en funciones comerciales similares para la industria de diagnóstico, dispositivos médicos o similares.

• Conocimiento de la dinámica y los participantes del mercado de salud, su sistema y las políticas de salud, también sobre la problemática y soluciones para el laboratorio.

• Amplio conocimiento de la tecnología y marcas de los competidores.

• Conocimiento intermedio del idioma Inglés.

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

jobs.title: Field Engineering Specialist - Austin, TX
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

This is a field-based role. The territory is Austin, TX. Ideal candidate must reside in the territory. This role requires daily travel and up to 30% overnight travel.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Texas is $71,000 and $132,000 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law . A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity

As a Scientist II – Panel Production / Molecular Biology within the Biospecimen Acquisition and Management (BAM) team, you will play a key role in generating and characterizing the biological resources that enable Roche’s research and development efforts . You will apply your molecular biology and cell culture expertise to produce custom clinical panels and characterized biological materials for research, clinical, regulatory, and product development activities .

• Plan and execute project activities independently, applying established scientific principles to support panel production and molecular characterization .

• Design, develop, and produce custom biological panels that enable critical research, assay development, and clinical study objectives .

• Generate and qualify bulk biological materials, ensuring adherence to established quality standards .

• Apply a broad range of molecular biology techniques, including nucleic acid extraction, PCR, qPCR, RT-PCR, and mammalian cell culture .

• Lead small to moderate complexity projects by developing timelines, coordinating deliverables, and troubleshooting technical challenges .

• Analyze experimental data , interpret results, and maintain accurate records within LIMS and electronic laboratory notebooks (eLN) .

• Partner with multidisciplinary teams to transfer products, technologies, and scientific knowledge to internal stakeholders .

• Identify opportunities to improve laboratory processes, enhance operational efficiency, and support the implementation of automation .

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline .

• You have 4+ years of relevant industry experience applying broad knowledge in molecular biology or clinical studies, alongside an understanding of medical device and IVD assay development .

• You enjoy hands-on laboratory work and are passionate about molecular biology techniques and cell culture management .

• You are comfortable working in a BSL-2 laboratory environment, maintaining strong aseptic technique and accurate data documentation (LIMS/eLN) .

• You are a self-motivated collaborator who can independently plan experiments, manage competing priorities, and communicate effectively across cross-functional teams .

Preferred

• An advanced degree in a scientific discipline .

• Experience navigating complex, matrixed organizations and aligning cross-functional stakeholders .

• Experience working with high-throughput molecular biology platforms and automated laboratory systems .

• Experience coordinating project timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communications .

• Customer-facing or client support experience, with the ability to build strong relationships .

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position is based on the primary location of Pleasanton, CA $67,500 - $103,100. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

jobs.title: Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist , you will be responsible for acting as the strategic bridge between regulatory science and technology, driving digital transformation within the PDR organization. In this role, you will design, develop, and implement intelligent automation and generative AI solutions, eliminating repetitive tasks and optimizing operational processes to bring efficiency and agility to a global community of over 500 regulatory professionals.

The Opportunity

• Design, develop, and deploy scalable automation solutions (such as RPA, Python scripts, UiPath workflows, or No-Code/Low-Code tools) to optimize global regulatory processes.

• Research, experiment with, and implement applications based on Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning, and natural language processing (NLP) tailored to regulatory document management.

• Partner closely with business analysts, regulatory subject matter experts, and global leaders to map current operational processes and identify critical automation opportunities.

• Provide ongoing technical support, preventive maintenance, and troubleshooting for automation and AI solutions already deployed in production.

• Author and maintain rigorous technical documentation, including solution architecture, source code, user guides, and testing methodologies.

• Design and deliver internal training programs to empower regulatory teams in the adoption and effective use of AI and automation technologies.

• Present performance metrics, project updates, and strategic recommendations to business stakeholders and organizational leadership (with a scope of influence aligned to the experience level).

Who you are

• University degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Health Sciences with a strong technological focus, or a related field.

• Proven experience in designing and developing process automation (RPA) solutions, workflows, and implementing AI tools (minimum 2–3 years for a Junior profile; 4+ years for a Senior profile).

• Solid technical and programming skills in languages such as Python, SQL, and automation environments (UiPath, Power Automate, or Cloud platforms), along with familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Agile).

• Understanding of pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks and industry registration procedures is highly valued.

• Fluent and advanced English language skills (both written and spoken) to effectively interact, influence, and present findings to global teams across multiple time zones.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, a system-thinking mindset, resilience, and a strong passion for innovation focused on radically simplifying business processes.

No relocation benefits are offered for this position.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Specialista di Regolamentazione AI & Automation, sarai responsabile di agire come ponte strategico tra scienza e tecnologia regolamentare, guidando la trasformazione digitale all'interno dell'organizzazione PDR. In questo ruolo, si progetta, sviluppa e implementa soluzioni intelligenti di automazione e generazione AI, eliminando i compiti ripetitivi e ottimizzando i processi operativi per portare efficienza e agilità a una comunità globale di oltre 500 professionisti normativi. L'opportunità
• Progettazione, sviluppo e distribuzione di soluzioni di automazione scalabili (come RPA, Python script, UiPath workflow, o No-Code/Low-Code strumenti) per ottimizzare i processi normativi globali.
• Ricerca, sperimentazione e realizzazione di applicazioni basate su Artificial Intelligence (AI), apprendimento automatico e elaborazione del linguaggio naturale (NLP) su misura per la gestione dei documenti normativi.
• Collabora a stretto contatto con gli analisti aziendali, gli esperti di materia regolamentare e i leader globali per mappare i processi operativi attuali e identificare le opportunità di automazione critica.
• Fornire supporto tecnico continuo, manutenzione preventiva e risoluzione dei problemi per l'automazione e soluzioni AI già implementate nella produzione.
• Autore e mantenere una rigorosa documentazione tecnica, tra cui l'architettura delle soluzioni, il codice sorgente, le guide degli utenti e le metodologie di test.
• Progettare e fornire programmi di formazione interna per potenziare i team di regolamentazione nell'adozione e nell'utilizzo efficace delle tecnologie AI e di automazione.
• metriche di performance attuali, aggiornamenti del progetto e raccomandazioni strategiche per gli stakeholder aziendali e la leadership organizzativa (con una portata di influenza allineata al livello di esperienza). Chi sei
• Laurea in Informatica, Scienza dei dati, Ingegneria del software, Scienze della salute con un forte focus tecnologico, o un campo correlato.
• Esperienza comprovata nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di soluzioni di automazione dei processi (RPA), flussi di lavoro e nell'implementazione di strumenti AI (minimo 2-3 anni per un profilo Junior; 4+ anni per un profilo Senior).
• Competenze tecniche e di programmazione solide in linguaggi come Python, SQL e ambienti di automazione (piattaforme UiPath, Power Automate o Cloud), insieme alla familiarità con metodologie Agile (Scrum/Agile).
• La comprensione dei quadri normativi farmaceutici e delle procedure di registrazione dell'industria è altamente apprezzata.
• Competenze linguistiche fluenti e avanzate (sia scritte che parlate) per interagire efficacemente, influenzare e presentare risultati a team globali in più fusi orari.
• Competenze interpersonali eccellenti, una mentalità sistematica, resilienza e una forte passione per l'innovazione focalizzata sulla semplificazione radicale dei processi aziendali. Non sono offerti benefici di trasferimento per questa posizione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.
