C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que spécialiste de la réglementation de l'IA et de l'automatisation, vous serez responsable d'agir comme le pont stratégique entre la science réglementaire et la technologie, en conduisant la transformation numérique au sein de l'organisation de RDP. Dans ce rôle, vous concevez, développez et implémentez des solutions d'automatisation intelligente et d'IA générative, éliminant les tâches répétitives et optimisant les processus opérationnels pour apporter efficacité et agilité à une communauté mondiale de plus de 500 professionnels de la réglementation. L'opportunité
• Concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions d'automatisation évolutives (telles que RPA, scripts Python, flux de travail UiPath, ou outils No-Code/Low-Code) pour optimiser les processus réglementaires mondiaux.
• Recherche, expérimentation et mise en œuvre d'applications basées sur l'intelligence artificielle (IA), l'apprentissage automatique et le traitement des langues naturelles (NLP) adaptés à la gestion réglementaire des documents.
• S'associer étroitement avec les analystes commerciaux, les experts en réglementation et les dirigeants mondiaux pour cartographier les processus opérationnels actuels et identifier les possibilités d'automatisation critiques.
• Fournir un soutien technique continu, une maintenance préventive et un dépannage pour les solutions d'automatisation et d'IA déjà déployées dans la production.
• Élaborer et tenir à jour une documentation technique rigoureuse, y compris l'architecture de la solution, le code source, les guides d'utilisation et les méthodes d'essai.
• Concevoir et offrir des programmes de formation internes pour permettre aux équipes de réglementation d'adopter et d'utiliser efficacement les technologies d'IA et d'automatisation.
• Présenter les mesures du rendement, les mises à jour des projets et les recommandations stratégiques aux intervenants opérationnels et au leadership organisationnel (avec une portée d'influence alignée sur le niveau d'expérience). Qui vous êtes
• Diplôme universitaire en informatique, sciences des données, génie logiciel, sciences de la santé avec une forte concentration technologique, ou un domaine connexe.
• Expérience éprouvée dans la conception et le développement de solutions d'automatisation de processus (RPA), de workflows et la mise en œuvre d'outils d'IA (minimum 2–3 ans pour un profil junior; 4+ ans pour un profil senior).
• Des compétences techniques et de programmation solides dans des langages tels que Python, SQL et des environnements d'automatisation (UiPath, Power Automate ou plateformes Cloud), ainsi que la connaissance des méthodologies Agile (Scrum/Agile).
• La compréhension des cadres réglementaires et des procédures d'enregistrement de l'industrie pharmaceutique est très appréciée.
• Compétences en langue anglaise (écrites et parlées) variées et avancées pour interagir efficacement, influencer et présenter les résultats aux équipes mondiales sur plusieurs fuseaux horaires.
• Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, un état d'esprit conceptuel, une résilience et une forte passion pour l'innovation axée sur la simplification radicale des processus d'affaires. Aucune indemnité de réinstallation n'est offerte pour ce poste. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

Impacto Sostenible
Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones.

• Definir factores críticos de éxito, monitorear resultados, incorporar aprendizajes y ajustar estrategias para garantizar el éxito de los planes estratégicos regionales.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
Are you an experienced sales professional with a talent for solving complex challenges? In this role, you'll use your expertise to navigate diverse issues and make strategic decisions that drive success. You'll manage medium to large accounts, exceeding sales targets while building lasting relationships with key decision-makers.

Your goal will be to expand your network, identify new opportunities, and present compelling value propositions. With a deep understanding of our product line, you'll serve as a trusted advisor, continuously improving our quality system through your daily actions.

As an Account Executive - GenMark, you will:

• be responsible for promoting GenMark’s products and services.

• contact new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• generate demand and maximize product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• work with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• Conduct and organize necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• communicates competitive market information internally.

• networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

This is a field-based role - the territory includes New Jersey, Philadelphia, and Baltimore.

Travel expectation: Up to 25% Overnight travel expected

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 3+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience

Preferred Requirements:

• Good oral and written communication skills, including making impactful presentations

• Proven leadership abilities

• Negotiation, contracting, and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work in a regulated environment

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting

The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Pennsylvania is $86,700.00 - $169,00.00. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità: Sei un professionista esperto di vendite con un talento per risolvere sfide complesse? In questo ruolo, userai la tua esperienza per navigare diversi problemi e prendere decisioni strategiche che spingono il successo. Potrai gestire conti di medie e grandi dimensioni, superando gli obiettivi di vendita durante la costruzione di relazioni durature con i decisori chiave. Il vostro obiettivo sarà quello di espandere la vostra rete, identificare nuove opportunità e presentare proposte di valore convincenti. Con una profonda comprensione della nostra linea di prodotti, servirai come consulente affidabile, migliorando continuamente il nostro sistema di qualità attraverso le tue azioni quotidiane. In qualità di amministratore del conto - GenMark, Lei:
• essere responsabile della promozione dei prodotti e dei servizi di GenMark.
• contattare i clienti nuovi e esistenti per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati, sviluppando nuovi business, crescendo business esistente, mantenendo le relazioni con i clienti e risolvere i problemi dei clienti. Ciò include l'individuazione e lo sviluppo di piani di conto strategici, lo sviluppo e la fornitura del messaggio differenziante e del valore economico quantificabile per prodotti e servizi, la vendita della differenziazione primaria dei prodotti Roche, il superamento e la gestione delle obiezioni e la negoziazione per ottenere le vendite.
• generare la domanda e massimizzare la consapevolezza del prodotto lavorando e fornendo istruzione e informazioni ai clienti.
• implementa iniziative strategiche e piani per facilitare il processo di vendita e la produttività.
• lavorare con altri, come necessario o richiesto, per preparare proposte per account assegnati. Presenta tutte le proposte di contratto ai clienti per massimizzare il business complessivo e la redditività, che possono richiedere alcune trattative.
• Condurre e organizzare la pianificazione e il routing del territorio necessario per l'efficienza. Conduce l'analisi aziendale e la pianificazione.
• comunica le informazioni sul mercato competitivo internamente.
• reti e interfacce con colleghi interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche, pur rimanendo attivamente coinvolti in organizzazioni di settore / clienti che impatto business. • Führen und organisieren Sie notwendige Gebietsplanung und Routing für Effizienz. Führt Business-Analyse und Planung durch.
• Wettbewerbsmarktinformationen intern kommuniziert.
• Netzwerke und Schnittstellen mit internen Kollegen, um Informationen und Best Practices auszutauschen und gleichzeitig aktiv in Branchen- / Kundenorganisationen mit Auswirkungen auf das Geschäft involviert zu bleiben. jobs.title: Outcomes & Capability Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Outcomes & Capability Lead, you will work with the affiliate’s Enabling Team to provide strategic guidance. Your primary role consists of driving business effectiveness and catalyzing innovation to deliver our Pharma Vision by embedding new skills and innovation frameworks to support team effectiveness and performance, as well as developing the overarching operations framework and fostering collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. Secondly, you will be responsible for defining and implementing the strategy for capability development (mindset, knowledge, and skills) across the organization based on customer needs.

Your Opportunity

The responsibilities for this role include:

• Vision Realization: Drive the realization of our organization’s vision and defined outcomes of the Colombia Enabling Team (CET) while ensuring operational effectiveness of the leadership team.

• Strategic Partnering: Partner closely with the General Manager and Chapter Leads to enable the achievement of Colombia Outcomes.

• Ambition Management: Plan, track, and provide project management support to monitor progress and delivery of short-term and long-term ambitions, priorities, and outcomes of the affiliate.

• International Connectivity: Partner with other Pharma International Functions to foster agility and augment end-to-end value delivery to the business.

• Coaching & Ways of Working: Coach, train, and educate teams for high performance, guiding them in finding their own journey to self-organization, self-sufficiency, and adopting new ways of working and business principles.

• Mindset Transformation: Leverage a range of tools and practices to enable sustainable change of mindsets and behaviors as required on best practice and be a champion of connecting dots and activating the learning loop across the organization.

• Team Empowerment: Work in a self-managed, fully empowered team to shape what and how you deliver for the organization and your internal customers, collaborating with other chapters to shape the organizational culture.

• Commercialization Capability Plan: Design the Integrated Capability Development Plan for commercialization roles, ensuring the integration of technical capabilities and skills through self-management, according to customer needs and filial outcomes.

• Learning Ecosystem: Catalyze the development and reuse of models, materials, and tools from the global network to support ecosystem teams and individual colleagues in learning and development activities.

• Training Effectiveness: Facilitate, coordinate, and track training activities according to regional and filial priorities, ensuring continuous improvement and effectiveness of tools through evaluation methods and data analytics.

Who you are

The person in this role is a Lean-Agile Leader with a Lean-Agile Mindset, driving innovation, adaptation to change, and encouraging teams to be curious and question the status quo. Possess s trong expert knowledge about and experience with working by outcomes, with a clear goal orientation and commitment to create value in line with corporate objectives.
Thrives on collaboration, with the ability to bring people together and mobilize teams by building effective relationships to work towards the same purpose across organizational boundaries, promoting diversity. Is a ble to motivate, challenge, and coach senior leaders in the organization while fostering an environment of feedback, along with the ability to negotiate agreements and persuade

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come il risultato & Capability Lead, lavorerai con il team di abilitazione della filiale per fornire una guida strategica. Il vostro ruolo principale consiste nel guidare l'efficacia del business e catalizzare l'innovazione per fornire la nostra visione di Pharma incorporando nuove competenze e nuovi framework di innovazione per supportare l'efficacia e le prestazioni del team, oltre a sviluppare il quadro operativo di overarching e promuovere la collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. In secondo luogo, sarete responsabili per la definizione e l'attuazione della strategia per lo sviluppo delle capacità (mindset, conoscenze e competenze) in tutta l'organizzazione basata sulle esigenze del cliente. La tua opportunità Le responsabilità di questo ruolo includono:
• Realizzazione Visione: Guidare la realizzazione della visione della nostra organizzazione e dei risultati definiti del Team Colombia Eattiva (CET) garantendo al contempo l’efficacia operativa del team di leadership.
• Partner Strategico: Partner a stretto contatto con il Direttore Generale e il Capitolo porta a consentire il raggiungimento dei risultati della Colombia.
• Gestione dell'ambizione: Piano, traccia e fornire supporto alla gestione del progetto per monitorare il progresso e la consegna di ambizioni, priorità e risultati a breve termine e a lungo termine della filiale.
• Connettività internazionale: Partner con altre Funzioni internazionali di Pharma per promuovere l'agilità e aumentare la distribuzione end-to-end del valore al business.
• Coaching & Ways of Working: Coach, treno e educare i team per alte prestazioni, guidandoli a trovare il proprio viaggio per l'auto-organizzazione, l'autosufficienza, e l'adozione di nuovi modi di lavoro e principi aziendali.
• Mindset Transformation: Leva una gamma di strumenti e pratiche per consentire un cambiamento sostenibile di mentalità e comportamenti come richiesto nella migliore pratica e essere un campione di punti di connessione e di attivazione del loop di apprendimento attraverso l'organizzazione.
• Team Empowerment: Lavorare in un team autogestito e pienamente abilitato per modellare cosa e come consegnare per l'organizzazione e i vostri clienti interni, collaborando con altri capitoli per modellare la cultura organizzativa.
• Piano di Capacità di Commercializzazione: Progettare il Piano di Sviluppo Capability Integrato per ruoli di commercializzazione, garantendo l'integrazione di capacità tecniche e competenze attraverso l'autogestione, in base alle esigenze del cliente e risultati filiale.
• Ecosistema di apprendimento: catalizzare lo sviluppo e il riutilizzo di modelli, materiali e strumenti della rete globale per supportare team di ecosistemi e singoli colleghi nelle attività di apprendimento e sviluppo.
• Efficacia della formazione: Facilitare, coordinare e monitorare le attività di formazione secondo le priorità regionali e filiali, garantendo un miglioramento continuo e un'efficacia degli strumenti attraverso metodi di valutazione e analisi dei dati. Chi sei La persona in questo ruolo è un Leader Lean-Agile con un Mindset Lean-Agile, guidando l'innovazione, l'adattamento al cambiamento, e incoraggiando i team a essere curiosi e mettere in discussione lo status quo. Possess s trong know-how esperto e l'esperienza con il lavoro da risultati, con un orientamento obiettivo chiaro e l'impegno a creare valore in linea con gli obiettivi aziendali. Thrives sulla collaborazione, con la capacità di riunire le persone e mobilitare i team costruendo relazioni efficaci per lavorare verso lo stesso scopo attraverso i confini organizzativi, promuovendo la diversità. È in grado di motivare, sfidare e coach senior leader nell'organizzazione, mentre promuovere un ambiente di feedback, insieme alla capacità di negoziare accordi e convincere

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Als Outcomes & Capability Lead arbeiten Sie mit dem Enabling Team des Affiliates zusammen, um strategische Beratung zu bieten. Ihre Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, die Geschäftseffektivität zu steigern und Innovationen zu katalysieren, um unsere Pharma Vision zu erfüllen, indem Sie neue Fähigkeiten und Innovationsrahmen zur Unterstützung der Teameffektivität und -leistung einbinden sowie den übergreifenden Betriebsrahmen entwickeln und die Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern fördern. Zweitens sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, die Strategie für die Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten (Mindset, Wissen und Fähigkeiten) im gesamten Unternehmen basierend auf den Kundenbedürfnissen zu definieren und umzusetzen. Ihre Chance Die Verantwortlichkeiten für diese Rolle umfassen:
• Vision Realisation: Die Verwirklichung der Vision unserer Organisation und der definierten Ergebnisse des Colombia Enabling Teams (CET) vorantreiben und gleichzeitig die operative Effektivität des Führungsteams sicherstellen.
• Strategische Partnerschaft: Enge Partnerschaft mit dem General Manager und den Chapter Leads, um die Erreichung der Ergebnisse von Kolumbien zu ermöglichen.
• Ambition Management: Planen, verfolgen und unterstützen Sie das Projektmanagement, um den Fortschritt und die Umsetzung der kurz- und langfristigen Ambitionen, Prioritäten und Ergebnisse des Affiliates zu überwachen.
• International Connectivity: Partnerschaft mit anderen internationalen Pharma-Funktionen, um die Agilität zu fördern und die Wertschöpfung für das Unternehmen zu erhöhen.
• Coaching & Ways of Working: Coachen, trainieren und bilden Teams für hohe Leistung, führen sie bei der Suche nach ihrer eigenen Reise zur Selbstorganisation, Selbstversorgung und Annahme neuer Arbeitsweisen und Geschäftsprinzipien.
• Mindset Transformation: Nutzen Sie eine Reihe von Tools und Praktiken, um eine nachhaltige Veränderung von Denkweisen und Verhaltensweisen zu ermöglichen, wie es für Best Practices erforderlich ist, und seien Sie ein Champion der Verknüpfung von Punkten und der Aktivierung der Lernschleife in der gesamten Organisation.
• Team Empowerment: Arbeiten Sie in einem selbstverwalteten, voll ausgestatteten Team, um zu gestalten, was und wie Sie für das Unternehmen und Ihre internen Kunden liefern, und arbeiten Sie mit anderen Kapiteln zusammen, um die Organisationskultur zu gestalten.
• Kommerzialisierungsfähigkeitsplan: Entwerfen Sie den integrierten Fähigkeitsentwicklungsplan für Kommerzialisierungsrollen und stellen Sie die Integration technischer Fähigkeiten und Fähigkeiten durch Selbstmanagement sicher, entsprechend den Kundenbedürfnissen und den kindlichen Ergebnissen.
• Lernendes Ökosystem: Katalysieren Sie die Entwicklung und Wiederverwendung von Modellen, Materialien und Werkzeugen aus dem globalen Netzwerk, um Ökosystemteams und einzelne Kollegen bei Lern- und Entwicklungsaktivitäten zu unterstützen.
• Trainingseffektivität: Erleichterung, Koordination und Verfolgung von Schulungsaktivitäten nach regionalen und kindlichen Prioritäten, um eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Wirksamkeit der Tools durch Bewertungsmethoden und Datenanalysen zu gewährleisten. Wer du bist Die Person in dieser Rolle ist eine Lean-Agile-Führungskraft mit einer Lean-Agile-Mentalität, die Innovation, Anpassung an Veränderungen vorantreibt und Teams ermutigt, neugierig zu sein und den Status quo in Frage zu stellen. Besitzen Sie Ihr Fachwissen und Ihre Erfahrung mit der Arbeit nach Ergebnissen, mit einer klaren Zielorientierung und der Verpflichtung, Werte im Einklang mit den Unternehmenszielen zu schaffen. Gedeiht von der Zusammenarbeit, mit der Fähigkeit, Menschen zusammenzubringen und Teams zu mobilisieren, indem effektive Beziehungen aufgebaut werden, um über organisatorische Grenzen hinweg auf den gleichen Zweck hinzuarbeiten und Vielfalt zu fördern. Ist eine Fähigkeit, leitende Führungskräfte in der Organisation zu motivieren, herauszufordern und zu coachen, während ein Umfeld von Feedback gefördert wird, zusammen mit der Fähigkeit, Vereinbarungen auszuhandeln und zu überzeugen

jobs.title: Business Capability Specialist - Quality
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
***24 month contract position**

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. As a global healthcare leader operating in over 100 countries, we combine the strengths of our Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics divisions to drive the future of personalized healthcare. We thrive on innovation, scientific excellence, and a shared commitment to delivering sustainable, high-quality medical solutions.

As part of our ambitious 10-year Pharma vision, we are dedicated to delivering more benefits to patients by integrating innovative technology and systems into our lifecycle management processes. By joining Roche, you will be part of a dynamic, diverse, and inspiring environment where your work has a direct, meaningful impact on patients worldwide.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a proactive and pragmatic Business Capability Specialist to join our Pharma Technical Quality (PTQ) ASPIRE Sustainment team. In this role, you will serve as the primary tactical driver owning the lifecycle of Deviations, CAPAs, and Planned Events, bridging the gap between intricate quality challenges and compliant technical solutions within our ERP and Quality Systems (SAP S/4HANA, BRH).

Your core responsibilities will include:

• Serving as the Technical Subject Matter Expert: Act as the hands-on expert for SAP S/4HANA and BRH systems, serving as the primary author for system-related deviations, leading technical investigations, and performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

• Managing System Lifecycle and CAPAs: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs), tracking milestone completion and verifying the effectiveness of implemented solutions to prevent recurrence.

• Coordinating Planned Events: Lead the documentation and coordination of planned system enhancements, maintenance, and upgrades, ensuring all quality impact assessments are robust and pre-approved.

• Executing Tactical Change Management: Support the Strategy Lead by executing the tactical steps of IT Change Requests while ensuring all Computer Systems Validation (CSV) documentation is audit-ready and compliant with GMP Annex 11.

• Ensuring System Health and Sustained Operations: Monitor daily system health in SAP and BRH to proactively identify process pain points and resolve technical bottleneck red flags before they escalate into critical incidents.

• Driving Data Integrity and Governance: Harvest high-quality data from QMS and ERP systems to populate strategic KPIs and dashboards, acting as a steward for record data integrity.

descriptionByLocale.de:

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position ***24-Monats-Kontraktposition** Bei Roche arbeiten wir leidenschaftlich daran, das Leben der Patienten zu verändern. Als globaler Marktführer im Gesundheitswesen, der in über 100 Ländern tätig ist, vereinen wir die Stärken unserer Pharma- und Diagnostik-Divisionen, um die Zukunft der personalisierten Gesundheitsversorgung voranzutreiben. Wir leben von Innovation, wissenschaftlicher Exzellenz und einem gemeinsamen Engagement für nachhaltige, qualitativ hochwertige medizinische Lösungen. Als Teil unserer ehrgeizigen 10-jährigen Pharma-Vision haben wir uns dazu verpflichtet, Patienten mehr Vorteile zu bieten, indem wir innovative Technologien und Systeme in unsere Lebenszyklusmanagementprozesse integrieren. Durch Ihren Eintritt bei Roche werden Sie Teil eines dynamischen, vielfältigen und inspirierenden Umfelds, in dem Ihre Arbeit einen direkten, bedeutsamen Einfluss auf Patienten weltweit hat. Die Chance Wir suchen einen proaktiven und pragmatischen Business Capability Specialist, um unserem Pharma Technical Quality (PTQ) ASPIRE Sustainment-Team beizutreten. In dieser Rolle sind Sie der wichtigste taktische Fahrer, der den Lebenszyklus von Abweichungen, CAPAs und geplanten Ereignissen besitzt und die Lücke zwischen komplexen Qualitätsherausforderungen und konformen technischen Lösungen in unseren ERP- und Qualitätssystemen (SAP S/4HANA, BRH) schließt. Ihre Hauptaufgaben umfassen:
• Als Technical Subject Matter Expert fungieren: Als Hands-on-Experte für SAP S/4HANA- und BRH-Systeme fungieren Sie als Hauptautor für systembezogene Abweichungen, leiten technische Untersuchungen und führen Root Cause Analysis (RCA) durch.
• Verwalten von Systemlebenszyklus und CAPAs: Besitzen Sie den End-to-End-Lebenszyklus von Korrektur- und Präventivmaßnahmen (CAPAs), verfolgen Sie den Meilensteinabschluss und überprüfen Sie die Wirksamkeit implementierter Lösungen, um ein Wiederauftreten zu verhindern.
• Koordinieren von geplanten Veranstaltungen: Führen Sie die Dokumentation und Koordination der geplanten Systemverbesserungen, Wartung und Upgrades, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Qualitätsfolgenabschätzungen robust und vorab genehmigt sind.
• Ausführung von Tactical Change Management: Unterstützen Sie den Strategy Lead, indem Sie die taktischen Schritte von IT Change Requests ausführen und gleichzeitig sicherstellen, dass alle CSV-Dokumentationen (Computer Systems Validation) auditfähig und konform mit GMP Annex 11 sind.

• Förderung von Datenintegrität und Governance: Sammeln Sie hochwertige Daten aus QMS- und ERP-Systemen, um strategische KPIs und Dashboards zu erfassen und als Steward für die Integrität von Daten zu fungieren.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie folgende Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten mit:
• Sie haben einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Life Sciences, Engineering, Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich oder eine gleichwertige technische / berufliche Qualifikation.
• Sie bringen über 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in einer stark regulierten GxP-Umgebung (Pharma, Biotech oder MedTech) mit.
• Sie verfügen über fundierte Navigationserfahrung auf Expertenebene in SAP (vorzugsweise S/4HANA) und Qualitätssystemen (wie Veeva Vault Quality / B)

• Diriger l'intégrité et la gouvernance des données : Récolter des données de haute qualité provenant des systèmes QMS et ERP pour peupler les KPI stratégiques et les tableaux de bord, agissant comme gardien de l'intégrité des données.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Molecular Point of Care (mPOC) Development Chapter is focused on developing, deploying, and maintaining diagnostic tests and systems for the global marketplace. Our chapter is based in Pleasanton, California, and we collaborate with others across RDS R&D to deliver technical solutions aligned with business priorities set by the mPOC Life Cycle Team within the Near Patient Care Customer Area.2

The Opportunity

We are looking for a versatile and organized professional with experience blending executive administrative support with advanced technical assistance. You, as an ideal candidate, should comfortably navigate traditional administrative responsibilities—such as travel booking, procurement, and onboarding—while confidently managing IT environments, data repositories, and agile project planning tools like Jira. Resourceful, proactive, and service oriented, you must possess exceptional communication skills to support cross-functional R&D teams both locally and remotely effectively.

• May provide part-time administrative support to other local R&D chapters, as needed

• Handle general executive administrative tasks such as:

• Travel coordination & bookings for leaders and teams

• Complete expense reports for mPOC Development Leadership team

• Organize meeting logistics, set-up, catering options for team meetings

• Manage staff distribution lists and communication tasks

• Support with recruiting, hiring, and onboarding new staff

• Support chapter with procurement tasks such as purchase order management, CAPEX process, laboratory asset management, tracking, and reporting

• Support group as primary interface to local Bay Area site services and IT

• Support team with advanced IT related tools, especially related to internal agile project planning using enterprise Jira tool, Lucid Board, etc.

• ​ Advanced support and coordination Chapter activities may include:

• Interface with R&D DSI Lab Supervisors for lab management & documentation

• Support coordination of staff training (per Chapter training matrix including interface with TMA and Cornerstone training tools)

• Support with monthly staff time entry tasks (e.g., Myco system)

• Support for local customized Chapter IT and computerized systems (e.g., Discovery server)

• Support of online data/content repositories (S-Drive data warehouse, Google drive maintenance, internal webpages)

• Provide tool and data support for Cube, VB, Python, HTML, AI tools, etc.

Who You Are

• 10 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Technical Support Specialist, or similar role. Experience within the Roche organization is highly desired.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience preferred.

Behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal applicant.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides).

• Experience with calendar management tools, video conferencing platforms (Meet, Zoom, Teams), and project management software.

• Experience with IT enterprise environment and tools, including AI applications is a plus.

• Discretion & Integrity: Absolute trustworthiness with confidential information.

• A resourceful "can-do" attitude with the ability to think critically and pivot quickly. Ability to juggle multiple shifting priorities without losing attention to detail.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a professional demeanor.

Relocation benefits are not availab

jobs.title: Technology Product Owner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. We serve our patients through external partnerships because access to quality products is every patient’s right. We leverage external partners in order to offer flexibility to our internal capacity at the right cost and quality. We enable our external partners to reliably deliver compliant, quality products to our supply chain customers, so that we can deliver to patients worldwide. We do this through cross-functional collaborations ensuring quality process excellence and continuous improvement.

The Technology Product Owner Specialist (PO) or Sub-Product Owner in Roche PT's Network Quality QA/QC Operational Systems team plays a pivotal role in standardizing and optimizing the systems and technology that power Quality operations and data insights. The PO is responsible for defining and implementing the overall Technology strategy for PT Quality, acting as the Global Product Owner for applicable PT technologies. A core function of the role is translating complex business use cases and requirements into standardized, compliant technology solutions, requiring a blend of technical expertise and business acumen. The PO collaborates with cross-functional teams, including Business, IT, and Validation, to ensure that high-quality, innovative solutions are defined, developed, and implemented. The role also involves managing the global master data entity and assisting the organization with expertise during regulatory inspections and the resolution of deviations.

This position requires a collaborative and open-minded individual who is capable of maintaining and transforming integral technologies while valuing continuous learning. The successful candidate must be someone who thoughtfully challenges ideas, prioritizes impactful work, and can be relied upon to operate in the best interest of the team, thriving in a dynamic work environment.

The Opportunity:

• Drive System Strategy: Serve as a global Technology PT Product Owner for QMS technologies (specifically Quality Vault QMS but can include Veeva Quality Docs ), effectively translating complex business requirements into standardized technical solutions.

• Manage Lifecycle & Governance: Direct the entire system lifecycle—including upgrades, system replacements, and retirements—while strictly adhering to established change management processes.

• Shape Product Roadmaps: Partner closely with key Business Stakeholders and IT to define the product vision, align roadmaps, manage feature backlogs, and prioritize system enhancements.

• Ensure Compliance & Data Stewardship: Act as the dedicated Business Data Steward, ensuring unwavering GxP compliance, strict data governance, and adherence to global quality policies.

• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Mobilize and lead high-performing, cross-functional teams spanning global Learning departments, business stakeholders, IT partners, and validation functions.

• Optimize Processes & Systems: Drive continuous improvement initiatives, manage deviations and CAPAs, and oversee master data validation within validated quality systems.

• Govern the Veeva QMS System : Manage the integration and structural nuances of the Veeva QMS and or Quality Docs ecosystem, ensuring seamless data flow, reporting, and interface connectivity across global manufacturing and commercial sites.

​
Who You are:

• You possess deep technical expertise: You bring 7+ years of experience in Veeva Quality Vault

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, prosperiamo per fornire più benefici ai nostri pazienti come parte della nostra visione Pharma di 10 anni. Serviamo i nostri pazienti attraverso partnership esterne perché l’accesso ai prodotti di qualità è diritto di ogni paziente. Ci avvaliamo di partner esterni per offrire flessibilità alla nostra capacità interna al giusto costo e qualità. Permettiamo ai nostri partner esterni di fornire in modo affidabile prodotti conformi e di qualità ai nostri clienti della supply chain, in modo che possiamo consegnare ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. Lo facciamo attraverso collaborazioni interfunzionali che garantiscono eccellenza del processo di qualità e miglioramento continuo. Il team di sistemi operativi QA/QC di qualità di rete di Roche PT svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella standardizzazione e nell'ottimizzazione dei sistemi e della tecnologia che alimentano operazioni di qualità e informazioni sui dati. Il PO è responsabile per la definizione e l'attuazione della strategia tecnologica globale per la qualità PT, che funge da Global Product Owner per le tecnologie PT applicabili. Una funzione fondamentale del ruolo sta traducendo complessi casi di uso aziendale e requisiti in soluzioni tecnologiche standardizzate e conformi, che richiedono una miscela di competenze tecniche e di business acum. Il PO collabora con team interfunzionali, tra cui Business, IT e Validation, per garantire che le soluzioni innovative di alta qualità siano definite, sviluppate e implementate. Il ruolo è anche quello di gestire l'entità globale dei dati master e assistere l'organizzazione con competenza durante le ispezioni normative e la risoluzione delle deviazioni. Questa posizione richiede un individuo collaborativo e aperto che è in grado di mantenere e trasformare le tecnologie integrali, valutando l'apprendimento continuo. Il candidato di successo deve essere qualcuno che presumibilmente sfida idee, privilegia il lavoro d'impatto, e può essere invocata per operare nel miglior interesse del team, prosperando in un ambiente di lavoro dinamico. L'opportunità:
• Strategia del sistema di trasmissione: Servire come un Global Technology PT Product Owner per le tecnologie QMS (in particolare Quality Vault QMS, ma può includere Veeva Quality Docs ), traducendo efficacemente i requisiti aziendali complessi in soluzioni tecniche standardizzate.
• Gestisci Lifecycle & Governance: Dirigere l'intero ciclo di vita del sistema, compresi gli aggiornamenti, i sostituti del sistema e i pensionati, mentre aderiscono rigorosamente ai processi di gestione dei cambiamenti stabiliti.
• Roadmap del prodotto: Partner a stretto contatto con i principali stakeholder aziendali e IT per definire la visione del prodotto, allineare le roadmap, gestire backlog delle funzionalità e priorità miglioramenti del sistema.
• Assicurare Compliance & Data Stewardship: agire come il Business Data Steward dedicato, assicurando la conformità GxP in continuo, la governance dei dati rigorosa e l'adesione alle politiche di qualità globali.
• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Mobilitare e condurre team altamente performanti e interfunzionali che spaziano dai dipartimenti di apprendimento globali, dagli stakeholder aziendali, dai partner IT e dalle funzioni di validazione.
• Ottimizzare Processi e Sistemi: Guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo, gestire deviazioni e CAPAs, e supervisionare la convalida dei dati master all'interno di sistemi di qualità convalidati.
• Governare il sistema QMS di Veeva: gestire l'integrazione e le sfumature strutturali dell'ecosistema Veeva QMS e o Quality Docs, assicurando flussi di dati senza soluzione di continuità, reportistica e connettività di interfaccia tra i siti produttivi e commerciali globali. ​ Chi sei:
• Possiedi una profonda competenza tecnica: porti 7+ anni di esperienza in Veeva Quality Vault

Le rôle consiste également à gérer l'entité mondiale de données maîtresses et à aider l'organisation à posséder des compétences lors des inspections réglementaires et de la résolution des écarts. Cette position exige une personne collaborative et ouverte d'esprit qui est capable de maintenir et de transformer des technologies intégrales tout en valorisant l'apprentissage continu. Le candidat retenu doit être quelqu'un qui remet en question les idées de façon réfléchie, accorde la priorité au travail qui a un impact, et on peut compter sur lui pour fonctionner dans le meilleur intérêt de l'équipe, dans un milieu de travail dynamique. La possibilité :
• Drive System Strategy: Servez-vous d'une technologie mondiale PT Product Owner pour les technologies QMS (en particulier Quality Vault QMS mais peut inclure Veeva Quality Docs ), traduisant efficacement les exigences opérationnelles complexes en solutions techniques normalisées.
• Gérer le cycle de vie et la gouvernance : Diriger l'ensemble du cycle de vie du système, y compris les mises à niveau, les remplacements et les retraites, tout en respectant strictement les processus de gestion du changement établis.
• Former des feuilles de route pour les produits : S'associer étroitement avec les principaux intervenants commerciaux et les TI pour définir la vision du produit, aligner les feuilles de route, gérer les arriérés de fonctionnalités et prioriser les améliorations du système.
• Assurer la conformité et la gérance des données : agir en tant que délégué aux données commerciales, assurer la conformité sans faille à la GxP, la stricte gouvernance des données et le respect des politiques de qualité mondiales.
• Équipes interfonctionnelles de premier plan : Mobilisez et dirigez des équipes interfonctionnelles hautement performantes couvrant les départements de l'apprentissage mondial, les partenaires commerciaux, les partenaires informatiques et les fonctions de validation.
• Optimiser les processus et les systèmes : Mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue, gérer les écarts et les APC, et superviser la validation des données de base dans les systèmes de qualité validés.
• Gouvernance du système QMS de Veeva : Gérer l'intégration et les nuances structurelles de l'écosystème QMS de Veeva et ou Quality Docs, en assurant un flux de données sans faille, des rapports et une connectivité d'interface entre les sites mondiaux de fabrication et commerciaux. ​ Qui vous êtes :
• Vous possédez une expertise technique approfondie : vous apportez 7 ans d'expérience dans Veeva Quality Vault

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It's what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That's what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing, resulting in a sample in, result out workflow.

Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows. We are seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to contribute to the mechanical design, development, characterization, and integration of cutting-edge sequencing systems.

This is a hands-on role focused on solving the mechanical challenges at the heart of our next-generation platforms. You will be responsible for concepting, designing, building, and testing novel electro-mechanical, pneumatic, thermal, and fluidic solutions that ensure the ultimate performance, reliability, and longevity of our systems.

The Senior Mechanical Engineer will play a vital role in driving innovation for our next-generation instrumentation. We are looking for someone that exhibits a high degree of motivation, independence, and resourcefulness to help us develop solutions to novel DNA Sequencing and automation challenges in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

The Opportunity

• You will design and develop sub-systems, including electro-mechanical, pneumatic, fluidic, thermal, and consumable components.

• You will collaborate with cross-functional teams (including electrical, consumables, and materials engineers) to define and manage critical technical interfaces for your module.

• You will have ownership of your sub-systems during verification, integration, and troubleshooting, working closely with Systems Integration engineers.

• You will conduct cross-functional design reviews to drive alignment and resolve technical trade-offs between mechanical design, materials, and assay requirements.

• You will drive technical execution for sub-systems, manage design deliverable timelines, and contribute to the overall project plan.

• You will create and maintain comprehensive design documentation for your sub-systems, including detailed CAD models, drawings, and specifications.

• You will present technical progress, data, and design trade-offs to the project team and stakeholders, clearly articulating the impact of engineering decisions.

Who You Are:
(Required )

• You have a Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering (or a closely related discipline), with 4+ years of relevant industry experience; or a Master's in Mechanical Engineering (or a closely related discipline), with 2+ years of relevant industry experience; or a PhD in in Mechanical Engineering (or a closely related discipline), with 1+ years of relevant industry experience.

Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. E' questo che ci rende Roche. A Roche, stiamo lavorando per rendere il sequenziamento di prossima generazione abbastanza semplice e accessibile per uso di routine. Accelerando la ricerca clinica, razionalizzando i flussi di lavoro e espandendo i menu di analisi, stiamo ampliando l'accesso ai dati genomici e abbassando le barriere all'adozione. Dai robusti strumenti di isolamento e preparazione dei campioni alle nuove tecnologie di sequenziamento e alla bioinformatica avanzata, stiamo sviluppando soluzioni end-to-end differenziate e altamente integrate per la sequenziamento di nuova generazione, con un risultato di campionamento, risultato fuori flusso di lavoro. Il nostro System Technology Group, parte di Roche Sequencing Solutions, si concentra sulla creazione e l'avanzamento di tecnologie per migliorare in modo significativo i flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento del DNA. Stiamo cercando un ingegnere meccanico senior per contribuire alla progettazione meccanica, sviluppo, caratterizzazione e integrazione di sistemi di sequenziamento all'avanguardia. Questo è un ruolo pratico focalizzato sulla soluzione delle sfide meccaniche al centro delle nostre piattaforme di prossima generazione. Sarete responsabili di concettualizzare, progettare, costruire e testare nuove soluzioni elettromeccaniche, pneumatiche, termiche e fluidiche che garantiscono la massima performance, affidabilità e longevità dei nostri sistemi. L'Ingegnere Meccanico Senior svolgerà un ruolo vitale nella guida dell'innovazione per la nostra strumentazione di nuova generazione. Stiamo cercando qualcuno che esibisce un alto grado di motivazione, indipendenza e risorse per aiutarci a sviluppare soluzioni per nuove sfide di DNA Sequencing e automazione in un ambiente veloce e collaborativo. Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows. We are seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to contribute to the mechanical design, development, characterization, and integration of cutting-edge sequencing systems. This is a hands-on role focused on solving the mechanical challenges at the heart of our next-generation platforms. You will be responsible for concepting, designing, building, and testing novel electro-mechanical, pneumatic, thermal, and fluidic solutions that ensure the ultimate performance, reliability, and longevity of our systems. The Senior Mechanical Engineer will play a vital role in driving innovation for our next-generation instrumentation. We are looking for someone that exhibits a high degree of motivation, independence, and resourcefulness to help us develop solutions to novel DNA Sequencing and automation challenges in a fast-paced and collaborative environment. The Opportunity
• You will design and develop sub-systems, including electro-mechanical, pneumatic, fluidic, thermal, and consumable components.
• You will collaborate with cross-functional teams (including electrical, consumables, and materials engineers) to define and manage critical technical interfaces for your module.
• You will have ownership of your sub-systems during verification, integration, and troubleshooting, working closely with Systems Integration engineers.
• You will conduct cross-functional design reviews to drive alignment and resolve technical trade-offs between mechanical design, materials, and assay requirements.
• You will drive technical execution for sub-systems, manage design deliverable timelines, and contribute to the overall project plan.
• You will create and maintain comprehensive design documentation for your sub-systems, including detailed CAD models, drawings, and specifications.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns zu Innovationen antreibt. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Bei Roche arbeiten wir daran, die Sequenzierung der nächsten Generation einfach und für den routinemäßigen Einsatz zugänglich zu machen. Durch die Beschleunigung der klinischen Forschung, die Rationalisierung von Workflows und die Erweiterung der Assay-Menüs erweitern wir den Zugang zu genomischen Daten und senken die Akzeptanzbarrieren. Von robusten Werkzeugen für die Probenisolierung und -vorbereitung bis hin zu neuartigen Sequenzierungstechnologien und fortschrittlicher Bioinformatik entwickeln wir differenzierte, hochintegrierte End-to-End-Lösungen für die Sequenzierung der nächsten Generation, die zu einem Workflow für die Probeneingabe führen. Unsere Systems Technology Group, ein Teil von Roche Sequencing Solutions, konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Technologien, um DNA-Sequenzierungs-Workflows deutlich zu verbessern. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Chez Roche, nous travaillons à rendre le séquençage de la prochaine génération assez simple et accessible pour une utilisation courante. En accélérant la recherche clinique, en rationalisant les workflows et en élargissant les menus d'essais, nous élargissons l'accès aux données génomiques et abaissons les obstacles à l'adoption. Des outils d'isolement et de préparation d'échantillons robustes aux nouvelles technologies de séquençage et à la bioinformatique avancée, nous développons des solutions de bout en bout différenciées et hautement intégrées pour le séquençage de prochaine génération, ce qui donne lieu à un échantillon dans le flux de travail. Notre Groupe de technologie des systèmes, qui fait partie de Roche Sequencing Solutions, est axé sur la création et l'avancement de technologies visant à améliorer considérablement les processus de séquençage de l'ADN. Nous recherchons un ingénieur mécanique principal pour contribuer à la conception, au développement, à la caractérisation et à l'intégration de systèmes de séquençage de pointe. Il s'agit d'un rôle pratique axé sur la résolution des défis mécaniques au cœur de nos plateformes de prochaine génération. Vous serez responsable de la conception, de la construction et de la mise à l'essai de nouvelles solutions électromécaniques, pneumatiques, thermiques et fluides qui assurent la performance, la fiabilité et la longévité ultimes de nos systèmes. L'ingénieur mécanique principal jouera un rôle essentiel dans l'innovation de notre instrumentation de prochaine génération. Nous recherchons une personne qui fait preuve d'un haut degré de motivation, d'indépendance et d'ingéniosité pour nous aider à développer des solutions aux nouveaux défis de séquençage et d'automatisation de l'ADN dans un environnement rapide et collaboratif. L'opportunité
• Vous concevrez et développerez des sous-systèmes, y compris des composants électromécaniques, pneumatiques, fluidiques, thermiques et consommables.
• Vous collaborerez avec des équipes interfonctionnelles (y compris des ingénieurs en électricité, en consommables et en matériaux) pour définir et gérer des interfaces techniques critiques pour votre module.
• Vous serez propriétaire de vos sous-systèmes pendant la vérification, l'intégration et le dépannage, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs de l'intégration des systèmes.
• Vous effectuerez des examens de conception interfonctionnels afin de conduire l'alignement et de résoudre les compromis techniques entre la conception mécanique, les matériaux et les exigences d'essai.
• Vous dirigerez l'exécution technique pour les sous-systèmes, gérerez les délais livrables de conception et contribuerez au plan global du projet.
• Vous créerez et conserverez une documentation de conception complète pour vos sous-systèmes, y compris des modèles CAO détaillés, des dessins et des spécifications.
• Vous présenterez les progrès techniques, les données et les compromis de conception à l'équipe du projet et aux intervenants, en articulant clairement l'impact des décisions d'ingénierie. Qui vous êtes : (Requis)
• Vous avez un baccalauréat en génie mécanique (ou une discipline étroitement liée), avec 4+ années d'expérience pertinente de l'industrie; ou une maîtrise en génie mécanique (ou une discipline étroitement liée), avec 2+ années d'expérience pertinente de l'industrie; ou un doctorat en génie mécanique (ou une discipline étroitement liée), avec 1+ années d'expérience pertinente de l'industrie.
• Vous avez démontré une expérience pratique de conception, de développement et d'essai d'assemblages électromécaniques, pneumatiques, thermiques ou fluidiques complexes, de préférence pour les sciences de la vie.

• ※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
한국로슈가 7월 14일까지 2026년 체험형 인턴을 모집합니다.

“Doing now what patients need next”라는 미션 아래, 환자와 사회를 위한 혁신을 이끌어가는 글로벌 헬스케어 기업 한국로슈에서 우리와 함께 성장할 인재를 찾고 있습니다.

➤공고 기간: 7월 1일~ 7월 14일까지
• ➤모집 부문: 법무 및 컴플라이언스 (Legal & Compliance)
• ➤담당 업무:
• -컴플라이언스 정책 고도화 프로젝트: 사내 주요 규정 및 가이드라인의 Gap 리서치 및 최신화 작업 참여 (AI 활용)
• -사내 계약 및 SOP 관리 혁신: 계약서 및 SOP프로세스 효율화 (AI 활용)
• -전사 준법 의식 제고 캠페인: 임직원 대상 컴플라이언스 가이드북 제작 및 교육 프로그램 기획 지원
• -글로벌 규제 동향 리서치: 최신 법률/규제(데이터 프라이버시, ESG, 공정거래 등) 동향 분석 및 사내 리스크 리포트 작성 지원

➤자격 요건:
• 공통: 대학교/대학원 졸업예정자, 졸업자 가능 (6개월 근무 가능자)
• 전공: 법학, 경영학, 행정학, 정치외교학, 회계학 등 관련 전공자 (또는 이에 준하는 지식을 보유하신 분)
• 기타 우대 사항 -빠르게 변화하는 규제 환경과 비즈니스 요구에 유연하고 민첩하게 대처할 수 있는 분
• -생소한 법률 용어나 새로운 규제 도메인을 스스로 탐구하고 빠르게 흡수할 수 있는 분
• -다양한 유관 부서의 요구사항을 경청하고, 명확하고 논리적인 언어로 조율할 수 있는 분
• -AI Tools 활용 능력이 우수하신 분

➤제출 서류
자유 형식의 이력서와 자기소개서를 국문/영문으로 1개의 Word 파일로 제출해 주세요.

➤프로세스
• 서류 전형 ▶ 온라인 평가 (7월) ▶ 면접 전형 (7월) ▶ 종합 심사 (8월 초) ▶ 최종 합격 통지 (8월 초) ▶ 입사 (2025년 9월 초)

➤제공되는 교육
• -지원 부문과 관련된 기초 지식
• -제약 산업에 대한 이해
• -프로젝트 참여 기회
• -멘토링 및 피드백 제공 기회

➤근무 조건
• 고용형태: 직계약직 (체험형 인턴) , 4대보험 가입
• 인턴기간: 채용일로부터 6개월

➤기타 사항 ​
• ※ 타 인턴 직무와 중복 지원은 불가합니다.
• ※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.

• ※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

• ※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
한국로슈가 7월 14일까지 2026년 체험형 인턴을 모집합니다.

“Doing now what patients need next”라는 미션 아래, 환자와 사회를 위한 혁신을 이끌어가는 글로벌 헬스케어 기업 한국로슈에서 우리와 함께 성장할 인재를 찾고 있습니다.

➤공고 기간: 7월 1일~ 7월 14일까지
• ➤모집 부문: 연구 운영 및 실사용 증거 (Study Operation & Real-World Evidence)
• ➤담당 업무:
• -로컬 연구 및 Medical Program관련 운영 지원
• -연구 관련 문서 및 계약서 아카이브 정리 지원
• -업무관리 시스템 데이터 마이그레이션 지원
• -Evidence Generation Planning을 위한 자료 조사 및 정리
• -Disease Area 및 RWE Landscape 리뷰 지원
• -팀 내 업무 개선 과제 및 프로젝트 참여

➤자격 요건:
• 공통: 대학교/대학원 졸업예정자, 졸업자 가능 (6개월 근무 가능자)
• 전공: 약학/생명과학/보건학/간호학/통계학 등 관련 전공
• 기타 우대 사항
• -체계적인 정보 정리 및 문서화 역량 보유하신 분
• -실무 중심의 프로젝트나 업무에 적극적으로 참여할 수 있는 분
• -팀 내에서 원활하게 소통하고 협업할 수 있는 태도를 가진 분
• -책임감과 꼼꼼함을 가진 분
• -영어 활용 능력 우대

jobs.title: Intern-Pharmacovigilance
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
한국로슈가 7월 14일까지 2026년 체험형 인턴을 모집합니다.

“Doing now what patients need next”라는 미션 아래, 환자와 사회를 위한 혁신을 이끌어가는 글로벌 헬스케어 기업 한국로슈에서 우리와 함께 성장할 인재를 찾고 있습니다.

➤공고 기간: 7월 1일~ 7월 14일까지
• ➤모집 부문: 약물감시 (Pharmacovigilance)
• ➤담당 업무:
• -개별 증례 안전성 보고(ICSR)의 수집, 제출 및 보고 시스템 관리 지원
• -안전성 관련 규제 업무 지원 (RMP, DSUR, PBRER, 품목 갱신, 실마리 정보 탐지 활동 등)
• -사내 연구(임상시험, 비중재연구 등), 시장조사/환자 지원 프로그램 등의 안전 관리 업무 지원
• -국내외 약물 감시 프로젝트 참여 및 지원

➤자격 요건:
• 공통: 대학교/대학원 졸업예정자, 졸업자 가능 (6개월 근무 가능자)
• 전공: 제약산업/ 보건의료/생명과학 관련 전공자
• 기타 우대 사항
• -국내외 바이오/제약업 관련 규제(특히, 약물감시 분야)에 대한 지식/이해 있는 분
• -실무 중심의 프로젝트나 업무에 적극적으로 참여할 수 있는 분
• -팀 내에서 원활하게 소통하고 협업할 수 있는 태도를 가진 분
• -책임감과 꼼꼼함을 가진 분
• -영어 활용 능력 우대
• -MS 활용 능력 우대

➤제출 서류
자유 형식의 이력서와 자기소개서를 국문/영문으로 1개의 Word 파일로 제출해 주세요.

➤프로세스
• 서류 전형 ▶ 온라인 평가(7월)▶ 면접 전형 (7월) ▶ 종합 심사 (8월 초) ▶ 최종 합격 통지 (8월 초) ▶ 입사 (2025년 9월 초)
• ※채용 전형 및 일정은 회사 사정에 의해 변경될 수 있으며, 변경될 경우 별도 안내될 예정입니다.

➤제공되는 교육
• -지원 부문과 관련된 기초 지식
• -제약 산업에 대한 이해
• -프로젝트 참여 기회
• -멘토링 및 피드백 제공 기회

➤근무 조건
• 고용형태: 직계약직 (체험형 인턴) , 4대보험 가입
• 인턴기간: 채용일로부터 6개월

➤기타 사항 ​
• ※ 타 인턴 직무와 중복 지원은 불가합니다.
• ※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
• ※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
• ※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
• ※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• ※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
• ※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Intern-Quality & Medical Compliance
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
한국로슈가 7월 14일까지 2026년 체험형 인턴을 모집합니다.

“Doing now what patients need next”라는 미션 아래, 환자와 사회를 위한 혁신을 이끌어가는 글로벌 헬스케어 기업 한국로슈에서 우리와 함께 성장할 인재를 찾고 있습니다.

➤공고 기간: 7월 1일~ 7월 14일까지
• ➤모집 부문: 품질 및 의료 컴플라이언스 (Quality & Medical Compliance)
• ➤담당 업무:
• -품질 관리 시스템(QMS) 운영 지원
• -의료 컴플라이언스 및 품질 모니터링 관련 업무 지원
• -문서 및 데이타 관리 업무 지원 (품질/컴플라이언스 관련)

➤자격 요건:
• 공통: 대학교/대학원 졸업예정자, 졸업자 가능 (6개월 근무 가능자)
• 전공: 전공불문 (약학, 간호학, 생명과학, 화학 유관 전공 우대)
• 기타 우대 사항
• -실무 중심의 프로젝트나 업무에 적극적으로 참여할 수 있는 분
• -팀 내에서 원활하게 소통하고 협업할 수 있는 태도를 가진 분
• -책임감과 꼼꼼함을 가진 분
• -생성형 인공지능 활용 능력 우대
• -영어 활용 능력 우대
• -MS 활용 능력 우대

➤제출 서류
자유 형식의 이력서와 자기소개서를 국문/영문으로 1개의 Word 파일로 제출해 주세요.

➤프로세스
• 서류 전형 ▶ 온라인 평가 (7월) ▶ 면접 전형 (7월) ▶ 종합 심사 (8월 초) ▶ 최종 합격 통지 (8월 초) ▶ 입사 (2025년 9월 초)
• ※채용 전형 및 일정은 회사 사정에 의해 변경될 수 있으며, 변경될 경우 별도 안내될 예정입니다.

➤제공되는 교육
• -지원 부문과 관련된 기초 지식
• -제약 산업에 대한 이해
• -프로젝트 참여 기회
• -멘토링 및 피드백 제공 기회

➤근무 조건
• 고용형태: 직계약직 (체험형 인턴) , 4대보험 가입
• 인턴기간: 채용일로부터 6개월

➤기타 사항 ​
• ※ 타 인턴 직무와 중복 지원은 불가합니다.
• ※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
• ※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
• ※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
• ※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• ※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
• ※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Intern-Medical
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
한국로슈가 7월 14일까지 2026년 체험형 인턴을 모집합니다.

“Doing now what patients need next”라는 미션 아래, 환자와 사회를 위한 혁신을 이끌어가는 글로벌 헬스케어 기업 한국로슈에서 우리와 함께 성장할 인재를 찾고 있습니다.

➤공고 기간: 7월 1일~ 7월 14일까지
• ➤모집 부문: 의학 (Medical)
• ➤담당 업무:
• -의학 정보 자료 조사 및 분석 지원
• -학술 자료 및 발표 자료 준비 지원
• -의학 자문 회의 및 심포지엄 준비 및 지원
• -Medical Information 문의 응대 및 자료 제공 지원
• -의학부 내 프로젝트 지원 (데이터 정리, 문서 작성 등)
• -내부 교육 및 트레이닝 참여

➤자격 요건:
• 공통: 대학교/대학원 졸업예정자, 졸업자 가능 (6개월 근무 가능자)
• 전공: 약학 또는 간호학/생물학 관련자
• 기타 우대 사항
• -데이터 분석 능력을 가진 분
• -실무 중심의 프로젝트나 업무에 적극적으로 참여할 수 있는 분
• -팀 내에서 원활하게 소통하고 협업할 수 있는 태도를 가진 분
• -책임감과 꼼꼼함을 가진 분
• -영어 활용 능력 우대
• -MS 활용 능력 우대

➤제출 서류
자유 형식의 이력서와 자기소개서를 국문/영문으로 1개의 Word 파일로 제출해 주세요.

➤프로세스
• 서류 전형 ▶ 온라인 평가(7월)▶ 면접 전형 (7월) ▶ 종합 심사 (8월 초) ▶ 최종 합격 통지 (8월 초) ▶ 입사 (2025년 9월 초)
• ※채용 전형 및 일정은 회사 사정에 의해 변경될 수 있으며, 변경될 경우 별도 안내될 예정입니다.

➤제공되는 교육
• -지원 부문과 관련된 기초 지식
• -제약 산업에 대한 이해
• -프로젝트 참여 기회
• -멘토링 및 피드백 제공 기회

➤근무 조건
• 고용형태: 직계약직 (체험형 인턴) , 4대보험 가입
• 인턴기간: 채용일로부터 6개월

➤기타 사항 ​
• ※ 타 인턴 직무와 중복 지원은 불가합니다.
• ※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
• ※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
• ※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
• ※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• ※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
• ※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner - Neurology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Patient Journey Partner – Neurology
Job Location: Hyderabad

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche's capabilities and resources to co-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

Your Opportunity

• You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators

• You will be a one point of contact for top accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public & private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations

• You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations

• You will be leading collaboration in field through co-creation of solutions for key accounts

Who you are

• You are someone who has a relevant graduate/ post graduate degree in Science. From a experience standpoint having more than 8 years’ experience with 4+ years in Patient Services or similar preferred

• You must exhibit strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

La posizione Partner del Viaggio Paziente – Neurologia Luogo di lavoro: Hyderabad La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Siamo alla ricerca di candidati per unirsi al nostro team come Partner del Viaggio Paziente In questo ruolo, avrete l'opportunità di avere un impatto significativo sulla cura del paziente collegando le capacità e le risorse di Roche per co-creare soluzioni con i principali stakeholder coinvolti nel viaggio del paziente. Il vostro ruolo è multiforme, affrontando diverse esigenze di viaggio paziente come l'accelerazione dell'accesso ai trattamenti, la semplificazione del processo decisionale. Questo ruolo è localmente incorporato nell'ecosistema, è un ruolo integrato, funzionalemente agnostico, (cioè non si inserisce nei concetti tradizionali di Commercial/Sales o Affari Medici). Il PJP si concentra sull'importanza di portare l'esterno dentro, lavorando con i partner per scoprire tutte le potenziali opportunità di trasformare i risultati per i pazienti, più velocemente. • Sarete responsabili della gestione finale di Top Therapy Area Relazioni di esperti e bisogni legittimi attraverso la giusta identificazione di sfide, credenze, motivatori
• Sarete un punto di contatto per i conti principali dello stato. Stai creando ed eseguendo strategie per i migliori account pubblici e privati, allineando e supportando le squadre statali per un'efficace esecuzione delle strategie statali, in modo da servire e massimizzare i pazienti con Roche Innovations
• Si sarà la costruzione di relazione con i decisori chiave nel conto Identificare e risolvere i problemi di business in top account e strategie di implementazione e guidare i risultati per migliorare l'accesso alle innovazioni Roche

• È necessario esporre forti capacità di collaborazione e networking, orientamento del processo e gestione delle alleanze Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.
