jobs.title: Insights Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

We are seeking candidates to join our team as Insights Partner. You will act as a Custodian of the overall insighting domain for his/her state cluster – overall accountable for gathering & upkeep of cluster-specific insights, working in tandem with cluster team members, as well as sharing them as needed within the insights chapter

Your Opportunity

•  You will be the single point of contact for all research & insight generation efforts within the state cluster, including
• o Primary / secondary research specific to brands, disease areas
• o Competitive intelligence
• o Patient journey mapping (if cluster-specific) and related research
• o Customer (prescribers & non-prescribers) insights
• o SoF-specific information pertinent to the respective cluster
• The above activities will require the Insights partner to be on field (upto 50%).
•  Lead insight generation & collation activities from own cluster as required, given the chapter needs
•  Distill key insights from own cluster from time to time, and share as relevant – fostering sharing of
• learnings across clusters
•  Design & maintain up-to-date cluster-specific collateral for effective, data-driven decision-making. For example:
• o Customer and patient personas to enable better messaging, call planning, engagement
• strategies, promotional initiatives, etc.
• o Influence maps in the cluster for different ecosystems and accounts
• o Customer belief-mapping estimates for various Roche products
• o Lead local market research needs for the state, including any for new launches
• o Support design of innovative solutions based on customer / account / patient level insights

Who you are

•  You are someone with 3+ years of work experience in strategy consulting, or in a corporate strategy
• function
•  Strong analytical capability, strategic thinking and strong problem solving skills
•  Prior experience of handling consulting / complex research projects, preferably in healthcare / pharma and must have Knowledge of productivity tools

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Co-creating partnership agreements and strengthen strategic alliance with partners along with other functions

• Leveraging access solutions from the Access centre of excellence to increase funding and healthcare capacity for access to innovation

jobs.title: Market Development Leader
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Market Development Leader
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients' lives and are bold in both decision and action. We believe that good business means a better world. This is why we come to work each day, committed to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and ensuring access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

The Opportunity
As the Market Development Leader, you will play a pivotal role in driving cutting-edge scientific collaborations and defining the global market expansion strategy for our sequencing ecosystem. Instead of traditional, reductive portfolio management, this role utilizes divergent strategic thinking to "bake a bigger pie"—pumping air into the funnel to explore how large a market opportunity can become. You will act as an upstream pipeline builder, a facilitator, and an integrator across the scientific community, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and internal stakeholders to cultivate a thriving, research and translational ecosystem.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

Ecosystem Mapping & Expansion

• Utilize creative thinking to expand the market horizon, identifying emergent research areas where SBX technology is a good match.

• Map out, foster, and capitalize on opportunities in the translational and basic research space.

• Execute high-level technological mapping to match sequencer capabilities with emerging research niches, identifying the "greatest fit" for market expansion.

Pipeline Fueling & Lifecycle Integration

• Interview and collaborate with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) to forecast where the genomic and sequencing fields are moving.

• Gathers, refines, analyzes, and prioritizes unique product requirements from the scientific community to build robust requirements for innovative or revolutionary new products.

• Contribute to and update the relevant chapters of Design Control, including the Product Requirements Document (PRD) to bridge research needs back to the organization.

• Perform ROI analysis on "placed bets" within the research community to determine long-term returns for the broader organization.

Cross-Functional Team Leadership

• Provide cross-functional leadership to project teams responsible for executing market cultivation activities.

• Motivate and inspire the team to achieve ambitious goals, fostering a positive environment of trust, transparent communication, and unconventional ideas.

• Highly effective at communicating requirements, capabilities, and deliverables internally and externally across a complex global matrix environment.

Who You Are
You are a visionary, growth-oriented leader with a deep scientific background who acts as a true "Product Champion." You are passionate about leveraging innovative technology to transform patient lives, operating comfortably in highly ambiguous environments to drive high-impact, high-value deliverables.

Qualifications:

• Education: Master’s or PhD preferred in Molecular Biology or a highly relevant technical topic.

• Experience: 6+ years of total leadership experience, with a strong background in biotech, pharma, and Next Generation Sequencing (NGS).

• Mindset: Possesses a distinct "Researcher Mindset" with a peer-level understanding of how the scientific community uses sequencing technology.

• Commercial & Strategic Acumen: Demonstrated experience in life science and tools market development, product positioning, and translating complex science into compelling market narra

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Leader del mercato A Roche, siamo appassionati di trasformare la vita dei pazienti e siamo coraggiosi sia nella decisione che nell'azione. Crediamo che il buon business significhi un mondo migliore. Questo è il motivo per cui andiamo a lavorare ogni giorno, impegnati a rigore scientifico, etica insopportabile, e garantire l'accesso alle innovazioni mediche per tutti. Lo facciamo oggi per costruire un domani migliore. L'opportunità In qualità di Leader per lo Sviluppo del mercato, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nella guida di collaborazioni scientifiche all'avanguardia e nella definizione della strategia di espansione del mercato globale per il nostro ecosistema di sequenziamento. Invece della gestione tradizionale e riduttiva del portafoglio, questo ruolo utilizza il pensiero strategico divergente per "battere una torta più grande"—pumping air in ilmbuto per esplorare quanto grande un'opportunità di mercato può diventare. Potrai agire come costruttore di pipeline a monte, un facilitatore e un integratore in tutta la comunità scientifica, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), e stakeholder interni per coltivare un ecosistema fiorente, di ricerca e di traduzione. Ruoli e responsabilità chiave: Ecosystem Mapping & Expansion
• Utilizzare il pensiero creativo per espandere l'orizzonte del mercato, identificare aree di ricerca emergenti in cui la tecnologia SBX è una buona corrispondenza.
• Mappare, promuovere e capitalizzare sulle opportunità nello spazio di ricerca traduttivo e di base.
• Eseguire la mappatura tecnologica di alto livello per abbinare le capacità di sequencer con le nicchie di ricerca emergenti, identificando il "più grande fit" per l'espansione del mercato. Pipeline Fueling & Lifecycle Integrazione
• Intervista e collabora con Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) per prevedere dove si muovono i campi genomici e sequenzianti.
• Raccogliere, affinare, analizzare e privilegia i requisiti di prodotto unici dalla comunità scientifica per costruire requisiti robusti per prodotti innovativi o rivoluzionari.
• Contribuisci e aggiorna i capitoli pertinenti di Design Control, incluso il Documento dei requisiti di prodotto (PRD) per collegare le esigenze di ricerca all'organizzazione.
• Eseguire l'analisi ROI su "scommessa in posizione" all'interno della comunità di ricerca per determinare i ritorni a lungo termine per l'organizzazione più ampia. Leadership del team
• Fornire leadership interfunzionale ai team di progetto responsabili dell'esecuzione delle attività di coltivazione di mercato.
• Motivare e ispirare il team a raggiungere obiettivi ambiziosi, promuovendo un ambiente positivo di fiducia, comunicazione trasparente e idee non convenzionali.
• Altamente efficace nella comunicazione di requisiti, capacità e consegnabili internamente ed esternamente in un complesso ambiente di matrice globale. Chi sei Sei un leader visionario e orientato alla crescita con un profondo background scientifico che funge da vero "Product Champion". Sei appassionato di sfruttare la tecnologia innovativa per trasformare la vita dei pazienti, operando comodamente in ambienti altamente ambigui per guidare materiali di alto impatto e ad alto valore. Qualifiche:
• Istruzione: Master o PhD hanno preferito in Biologia Molecolare o un argomento tecnico molto rilevante.
• Esperienza: 6+ anni di esperienza di leadership totale, con un forte background in biotecnologia, farmacia e Next Generation Sequencing (NGS).
• Mindset: Possede una distintiva "Researcher Mindset" con una comprensione a livello peer di come la comunità scientifica utilizza la tecnologia di sequenziamento.
• Acume Commerciale & Strategico: Esperienza dimostrata nello sviluppo del mercato della scienza della vita e degli strumenti, posizionamento dei prodotti e traduzione della scienza complessa nella narrazione del mercato

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst - Privileged Access Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In a world where every application, pipeline, and cloud workload depends on secure access, the people who build and manage that trust layer are critical. At Roche, our Enterprise Privileged Access Management team is responsible for exactly that — ensuring the right systems and people have the right access, at the right time, with the right controls in place. If you enjoy working on platforms that matter, thrive in a complex global environment, and want to deepen your expertise in one of the most in-demand areas of enterprise security — this is the role for you.

Your Opportunity

As a Cybersecurity Analyst specialising in PAM, HashiCorp Vault, and PKI, you will be a core member of a global security team working at the intersection of platform engineering and cybersecurity. You will own meaningful workstreams, partner with product owners and application teams, and serve as the Tier 3 expert when complex PAM and Vault issues need to be resolved. This is not a monitoring-and-ticket role — you will be expected to design, build, and continuously improve.

In this role, you will:

• Drive HashiCorp Vault platform delivery in partnership with the product owner — leading initiatives to upgrade and automate privileged access controls across the enterprise

• Design and deploy automation scripts and integrations (PowerShell, Python, Ansible) to streamline Vault operations and reduce manual effort

• Build self-service portals and APIs that make secret usage effortless for application teams, embedding DevSecOps principles into access processes

• Integrate secrets management into CI/CD pipelines and IaC toolchains across major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)

• Monitor, maintain, and evolve PKI infrastructure including certificate lifecycle management via platforms such as Keyfactor and RedHat IDM

• Implement certificate automation standards such as ACME for internal issuance and integrate PKI workflows into deployment pipelines

• Secure containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes) through mutual TLS implementation

• Act as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex PAM and HashiCorp Vault issues — providing advanced troubleshooting, guidance, and architectural direction

Who you are

You hold a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline — or bring equivalent experience that demonstrates the same depth of knowledge.

You have 3–5 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity or identity and access management, ideally within a large, global, or regulated organisation. You work well independently, take ownership of your deliverables, and have a track record of not just maintaining security systems — but actively improving them.
Your technical background includes:

• HashiCorp Vault — you have configured and administered Vault in a team environment, with practical experience across secrets engines (KV, PKI, Database, cloud), auth methods (AppRole, Kubernetes, LDAP, JWT/OIDC), and policy management; experience with Vault Agent or Kubernetes sidecar injection is a plus

• PKI and certificate lifecycle management — you understand CA hierarchy, certificate issuance and renewal, and have worked with platforms such as Keyfactor, RedHat IDM, or Microsoft ADCS; familiarity with ACME-based automation for internal certificate issuance is advantageous

• Secrets management automation — you have written scripts and integrations using Python, PowerShell, or Ansible to streamline security operations and reduce manual effort

• CI/CD and Infrastructure

• Norme di automazione del certificato di implementazione come ACME per l'emissione interna e integrare i flussi di lavoro PKI in pipeline di distribuzione
• Ambienti containerizzati sicuri (Docker, Kubernetes) attraverso l'implementazione reciproca di TLS
• Agire come punto di escalation Tier 3 per problemi complessi di PAM e HashiCorp Vault — fornendo risoluzione avanzata dei problemi, guida e direzione architettonica Chi sei Hai una laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, o una disciplina relativa — o portare esperienza equivalente che dimostra la stessa profondità di conoscenza. Hai 3-5 anni di esperienza pratica nella sicurezza informatica o nella gestione dell'identità e dell'accesso, idealmente all'interno di un'organizzazione ampia, globale o regolamentata. Il tuo background tecnico comprende:
• HashiCorp Vault — hai configurato e amministrato Vault in un ambiente di squadra, con esperienza pratica tra i motori segreti (KV, PKI, Database, cloud), metodi auth (AppRole, Kubernetes, LDAP, JWT/OIDC), e gestione delle politiche; l'esperienza con Vault Agent o Kubernetes sidecar iniezione è un plus
• PKI e la gestione del ciclo di vita certificato — si comprende la gerarchia CA, l'emissione del certificato e il rinnovo, e hanno lavorato con piattaforme come Keyfactor, RedHat IDM, o Microsoft ADCS; la familiarità con l'automazione basata su ACME per l'emissione di certificati interni è vantaggiosa
• Segreti gestione automazione — hai scritto script e integrazioni utilizzando Python, PowerShell, o Ansible per semplificare le operazioni di sicurezza e ridurre lo sforzo manuale
• CI/CD e infrastrutture

Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Der Patient Journey Partner (PJP) steht im Zentrum der Roche-Organisation und ist direkt dafür verantwortlich, Patienten, ihrer Gemeinschaft, dem Ökosystem und der Organisation schneller bessere Ergebnisse zu liefern. Die PJP ist eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit und das lokale Gesicht von Roche. Sie arbeitet eng mit allen Interessengruppen zusammen, die die Patientenreise (in einem bestimmten Therapie- oder Krankheitsbereich) direkt berühren, um ein tiefes Verständnis ihrer Bedürfnisse zu erlangen, um die Fähigkeiten von Roche zu verbinden und sinnvolle Lösungen zu entwickeln. jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - Quote Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Business Analyst , you will independently manage end-to-end workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity to drive Quote Management initiatives and Diagnostics commercial launches . You will act as a trusted advisor to leadership and Diagnostics affiliate commercial teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives and translating requirements into strategic implementation plans . Join us to lead the design of effective solutions and shape best practices within our global digital landscape .

Description of the area
The Quote Management team is part of DIA Commercial Operations, a strategic global function within Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and is at the heart of our Diagnostics digital landscape. We are responsible for developing, globally rolling out, and continuously evolving technology solutions that enhance the experience of healthcare providers and patients. Serving as a link between global business units - such as Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), Roche Information Solutions (RIS), and Commercial Enablement - and their operational goals, we design the digital architecture that enables Roche to scale its impact across APAC, EMEA/LATAM, and NAM.

The Opportunity:

• Drive Strategic Delivery : Act as the RDT delivery lead for Quote Management initiatives and enable high-impact commercial product launches across global markets .

• Orchestrate End-to-End Workstreams : Autonomously manage complex BA workstreams from discovery to implementation while navigating high-ambiguity environments .

• Translate Business Needs : Gather complex requirements and translate them into clear, actionable user stories and robust technical solution designs in partnership with Architects .

• Execute System Rollouts : Take ownership of system functional definitions and execute complex configurations to drive successful regional rollouts .

• Serve as a Trusted Advisor : Facilitate high-level workshops to shape strategy and resolve complex stakeholder conflicts, aligning regional expectations with global roadmaps .

• Optimize Solution Value : Contribute to long-term solution roadmaps and ensure every initiative delivers demonstrable business value and technical scalability .

• Bridge Technical Gaps : Act as the direct technical liaison between affiliate business stakeholders and offshore managed services to ensure seamless execution .

• Ensure Quality Excellence : Define clear acceptance criteria and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that solutions meet rigorous business standards .

Who you are:

• Experienced Professional : Proven track record of managing complex BA workstreams independently, driving regional rollouts in the APAC region, and making localization system configurations. You bring 7+ years of Business Analysis experience managing end-to-end IT workstreams, including 4+ years in MedTech or Healthcare Life Sciences .

• Domain Expert : You possess deep functional and technical knowledge of the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) and Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) commercial sales domains .

• Technically Proficient : You have hands-on experience with Conga CPQ and Salesforce (SFDC) , with familiarity in Jira and SAP S/4HANA (ASPIRE) .

• Academic Background : You hold a Bachelor’s or Advanced Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field .

• Agile Practitioner : You have practical knowledge of Agile frameworks (Scrum/SAFe); professional certifications like CBAP or IIBA AAC are highly preferre

jobs.title: In Vitro Bioanalysis Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organization enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive End to End asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimize dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

The Opportunity

Serving as a technical expert within the ADME chapter of Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS). The primary objective is to drive the discovery portfolio forward by providing high-quality, actionable in vitro bioanalytical data that informs drug candidate selection.

• Mass Spectrometry & HPLC Operation: Independently develop and validate robust bioanalytical methods using HPLC and triple quad (Sciex) or high-resolution (e.g. Orbitrap/Thermo) mass spectrometry.

• Multi-Modality Quantification: Lead the quantification and rigorous data analysis for a diverse portfolio including small molecules, peptides, and oligonucleotides.

• Digital Transformation: Design and implement workflow automation and digitalization initiatives to streamline laboratory data flow and experimental execution.

• Strategic Throughput Optimization: Continuously evaluate and optimize the BA strategy to specifically increase sample throughput and reduce manual data analysis time.

• Large Molecule Support: Provide technical expertise for the quantification of large molecules as required by the pRED discovery pipeline.

• Optimize BA strategy to increase throughput and automation of data analysis

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the ADME team to interpret bioanalytical results and influence project progression.

• Roche Leadership Framework: Demonstrate a Creative Mindset and VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) principles in all interactions, even as an individual contributor.

Who You Are

• An MSc or PhD degree in bioanalysis, biochemistry or a related relevant discipline, paired with proven practical experience, ideally within an industrial setting.

• Take full ownership of the quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of in vitro bioanalytical data supporting discovery projects.

• Exercise authority to permanently optimize laboratory processes, ensuring they meet evolving quality and efficiency standards.

• Act as a primary technical point of contact for internal stakeholders, utilizing high-level communication and collaboration skills to align on project needs.

• Apply economic and entrepreneurial thinking to prioritize tasks and manage laboratory resources effectively within the ADME department

• Permanently optimizes

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organizzazione (pRED), facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme, creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo degli asset End to End in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione del target al supporto sul mercato. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. L'opportunità Servire come esperto tecnico nel capitolo ADME delle scienze farmaceutiche (PS). L'obiettivo primario è quello di spingere il portafoglio di scoperta in avanti fornendo dati bioanalitici in vitro di alta qualità e utilizzabili che informano la selezione dei candidati alla droga.
• Mass Spectrometry & HPLC Operazione: Sviluppare e convalidare in modo indipendente metodi bioanalitici robusti utilizzando HPLC e triplo quad (Sciex) o spettrometria di massa ad alta risoluzione (ad esempio Orbitrap/Thermo).
• Quantificazione multi-modulazione: portare la quantificazione e analisi dei dati rigorose per un portafoglio diversificato tra cui piccole molecole, peptidi e oligonucleotidi.
• Digital Transformation: Progettazione e realizzazione di iniziative di automazione del flusso di lavoro e digitalizzazione per ottimizzare il flusso di dati di laboratorio e l'esecuzione sperimentale.
• Ottimizzazione del throughput strategico: Valutare e ottimizzare costantemente la strategia BA per aumentare specificamente la produttività del campione e ridurre il tempo di analisi manuale dei dati.
• Grande supporto Molecule: fornire competenze tecniche per la quantificazione di grandi molecole come richiesto dalla pipeline di scoperta pRED.
• Ottimizzare la strategia BA per aumentare il throughput e l'automazione dell'analisi dei dati
• Collaborazione interattiva: Partner con il team ADME per interpretare i risultati bioanalitici e influenzare la progressione del progetto.
• Roche Leadership Framework: Dimostrare un Creative Mindset e VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) principi in tutte le interazioni, anche come singolo collaboratore. Chi sei
• Una laurea MSc o PhD in bioanalisi, biochimica o una disciplina relativa, abbinata a comprovata esperienza pratica, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente industriale.
• Assumere la piena proprietà della qualità, accuratezza e consegna tempestiva dei dati bioanalitici in vitro che supportano i progetti di scoperta.
• Esercizio dell'autorità per ottimizzare in modo permanente i processi di laboratorio, garantendo loro di soddisfare gli standard di qualità e efficienza in evoluzione.
• Agire come punto di contatto tecnico primario per gli stakeholder interni, utilizzando competenze di comunicazione e collaborazione di alto livello per allinearsi alle esigenze del progetto.
• Applicare il pensiero economico e imprenditoriale per privilegiare i compiti e gestire le risorse di laboratorio in modo efficace all'interno del dipartimento ADME
• Ottimizzazione permanente

• Spectrométrie de masse et fonctionnement de la CLHP : Développer et valider des méthodes bioanalytiques robustes en utilisant la CLHP et la spectrométrie de masse triple quad (Sciex) ou haute résolution (par exemple Orbitrap/Thermo).
• Quantification multimodalité : Dirigez la quantification et l'analyse rigoureuse des données pour un portefeuille diversifié comprenant de petites molécules, des peptides et des oligonucléotides.
• Transformation numérique: Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des initiatives d'automatisation et de numérisation des flux de travail pour rationaliser le flux de données en laboratoire et l'exécution expérimentale.
• Optimisation du débit stratégique : Évaluer et optimiser en permanence la stratégie de BA pour augmenter spécifiquement le débit d'échantillons et réduire le temps d'analyse manuelle des données.
• Soutien aux grandes molécules : Fournir une expertise technique pour la quantification des grandes molécules, comme l'exige le pipeline de découverte pRED.
• Optimiser la stratégie de BA pour accroître le débit et l'automatisation de l'analyse des données
• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Partenaire avec l'équipe du SMAE pour interpréter les résultats bioanalytiques et influencer la progression du projet.
• Roche Leadership Framework: Démontrer un esprit créatif et des principes VACC (Visionnaire, Architecte, Catalyst, Coach) dans toutes les interactions, même en tant que contributeur individuel. Qui vous êtes
• Maîtrise ou doctorat en bioanalyse, biochimie ou discipline connexe, jumelée à une expérience pratique éprouvée, idéalement dans un contexte industriel.
• S'approprier pleinement la qualité, l'exactitude et la livraison en temps opportun des données bioanalytiques in vitro à l'appui des projets de découverte.
• Exercer le pouvoir d'optimiser en permanence les processus de laboratoire, en s'assurant qu'ils répondent aux normes de qualité et d'efficacité en évolution.
• Agir comme principal point de contact technique pour les intervenants internes, en utilisant des compétences de communication et de collaboration de haut niveau pour s'aligner sur les besoins du projet.

jobs.title: Scientific Outsourcing Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organization enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive End to End asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimize dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

Purpose of the Position
The Scientific Outsourcing Manager orchestrates the end-to-end external workflows that fuel our Pharmaceutical Sciences engine. Moving beyond traditional vendor management, this role treats external scientific expertise as a seamless, integrated extension of our team. By connecting internal capabilities with a global ecosystem of external partners in the laboratory space to assess safety and efficacy in the preclinical and clinical area, this role ensures that complex, multi-disciplinary workflows are executed with maximum velocity, data integrity, and compliance. As a champion of modern R&D, the position spearheads pRED- and cross-Roche collaborative network approaches to ensure the end-to-end implementation of R&D Excellence (RDE) solutions. Your main responsibilities will be:
Scientific Outsourcing Operations:

• Portfolio & Data Integration: Transition fragmented outsourcing into unified, portfolio-level external workflows and automated "sample-to-data" pipelines, ensuring secure, seamless, and frictionless access to advanced scientific capabilities.

• Performance Oversight & Risk Management: Utilize modern tracking tools to provide holistic visibility into external pipelines, actively monitoring vendor performance, optimizing data exchange, and proactively eliminating operational and scientific bottlenecks.

Supplier Management

• Ecosystem & Partnerships: Leads a curated network of premier Contract Research Organisations (CROs) and tech partners, shifting relationships from tactical vendors to strategic, co-innovative allies.

• Performance & Problem Solving: Tracks partners via dynamic metrics (engagement, delivery, quality, cycle times) and champions rapid, proactive resolution of scientific and operational hurdles.

Demand Coordination

• Predictive AI Models: Transitions to AI-supported forecasting to anticipate workflow volumes, capacity constraints, and intelligently match demands to optimal partners.

• Financial & Strategic Alignment: Integrates real-time financial tracking to maximize cost-efficiencies while dynamically aligning with shifting portfolio priorities and business-critical milestones.

Governance & Compliance

• Quality & Data Integrity: Ensures all external workflows r

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organizzazione (pRED), facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme, creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo degli asset End to End in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione del target al supporto sul mercato. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. Finalità della Posizione Il responsabile dell'outsourcing scientifico orchestra i flussi di lavoro esterni end-to-end che alimentano il nostro motore di Scienze Farmaceutiche. Passando oltre la tradizionale gestione dei fornitori, questo ruolo tratta l'esperienza scientifica esterna come un'estensione senza soluzione di continuità e integrata del nostro team. Collegando le capacità interne ad un ecosistema globale di partner esterni nello spazio di laboratorio per valutare la sicurezza e l'efficacia nell'area preclinica e clinica, questo ruolo assicura che i flussi di lavoro complessi e multidisciplinari siano eseguiti con velocità massima, integrità dei dati e conformità. Come campione della R&D moderna, la posizione lancia pRED- e cross-Roche si avvicina alla rete collaborativa per garantire l'implementazione end-to-end delle soluzioni R&D Excellence (RDE). Le vostre principali responsabilità saranno: Operazioni di Outsourcing Scientifico:
• Portfolio & Data Integration: Transition frammentato outsourcing in flussi di lavoro esterni unificati a livello di portafoglio e condotte automatizzate "sample-to-data", garantendo un accesso sicuro, senza interruzioni e senza attrito a capacità scientifiche avanzate.
• Performance Oversight & Risk Management: Utilizzare strumenti di monitoraggio moderni per fornire visibilità olistica in tubazioni esterne, monitorare attivamente le prestazioni del fornitore, ottimizzare lo scambio di dati, e proattivamente eliminare strozzature operative e scientifiche. Gestione dei fornitori
• Ecosystem & Partnerships: conduce una rete curata di premier Contract Research Organisations (CROs) e partner tecnologici, spostando le relazioni da venditori tattici a alleati strategici e co-innovazione.
• Performance & Problem Solving: Traccia i partner attraverso metriche dinamiche (impegno, consegna, qualità, tempi di ciclo) e campioni risoluzione rapida e proattiva degli ostacoli scientifici e operativi. Coordinamento della domanda
• Modelli AI predittivi: le transizioni alle previsioni supportate dall'IA per anticipare i volumi del flusso di lavoro, i vincoli di capacità, e in modo intelligente corrispondono alle esigenze dei partner ottimali.
• Allineamento finanziario e strategico: Integra il tracciamento finanziario in tempo reale per massimizzare l'efficienza dei costi, allineando dinamicamente con le priorità del portafoglio mobile e le pietre miliari business-critical. Governance & Compliance
• Qualità & Data Integrity: Assicura tutti i flussi di lavoro esterni r

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position In Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organisation (pRED) stellen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten her, um einige der weltweit härtesten unerfüllten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED verbindet uns unsere Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen. An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft und Innovation ermöglicht die pRED-Organisation Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) die Entdeckung und Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Therapeutika in optimalen Dosen in relevanten Populationen mit einer Vision für die Energieübersetzung, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Genauigkeit unserer Vorhersagen und die Beschleunigung der Entwicklung von Medikamenten von morgen. Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Unsere Mission ist es, die prädiktive Genauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, Dosierungsstrategien für die richtigen Patientengruppen zu optimieren und die Entwicklung der sicheren und wirksamen Therapeutika von morgen zu beschleunigen. Zweck der Position Der Scientific Outsourcing Manager orchestriert die durchgängigen externen Workflows, die unsere Pharmaceutical Sciences Engine antreiben. Über das traditionelle Anbietermanagement hinaus betrachtet diese Rolle externe wissenschaftliche Expertise als nahtlose, integrierte Erweiterung unseres Teams. Durch die Verbindung interner Fähigkeiten mit einem globalen Ökosystem externer Partner im Laborbereich zur Bewertung von Sicherheit und Wirksamkeit im präklinischen und klinischen Bereich stellt diese Rolle sicher, dass komplexe, multidisziplinäre Workflows mit maximaler Geschwindigkeit, Datenintegrität und Compliance ausgeführt werden. Als Verfechter moderner F&E führt die Position pRED- und Cross-Roche kollaborative Netzwerkansätze an, um die End-to-End-Implementierung von R&D Excellence (RDE)-Lösungen sicherzustellen. Ihre Hauptaufgaben werden sein: Wissenschaftliches Outsourcing:
• Portfolio- und Datenintegration: Übergang fragmentiertes Outsourcing in einheitliche externe Workflows auf Portfolioebene und automatisierte "Sample-to-Data"-Pipelines, die einen sicheren, nahtlosen und reibungslosen Zugriff auf fortschrittliche wissenschaftliche Fähigkeiten gewährleisten.
• Performance Oversight & Risk Management: Verwenden Sie moderne Tracking-Tools, um einen ganzheitlichen Einblick in externe Pipelines zu bieten, die Leistung der Anbieter aktiv zu überwachen, den Datenaustausch zu optimieren und proaktiv betriebliche und wissenschaftliche Engpässe zu beseitigen. Lieferantenmanagement
• Ecosystem & Partnerships: Leitet ein kuratiertes Netzwerk von führenden Vertragsforschungsorganisationen (Contract Research Organisations, CROs) und Technologiepartnern, die Beziehungen von taktischen Anbietern zu strategischen, co-innovativen Verbündeten verlagern.
• Performance & Problemlösung: Verfolgt Partner über dynamische Metriken (Engagement, Lieferung, Qualität, Zykluszeiten) und setzt sich für eine schnelle, proaktive Lösung wissenschaftlicher und operativer Hürden ein. Koordination der Nachfrage
• Prädiktive KI-Modelle: Übergänge zu KI-gestützter Prognose, um Workflow-Volumen und Kapazitätsbeschränkungen zu antizipieren und die Anforderungen intelligent an optimale Partner anzupassen.
• Financial & Strategic Alignment: Integriert das Echtzeit-Finanz-Tracking, um die Kosteneffizienz zu maximieren und gleichzeitig dynamisch auf sich verändernde Portfolioprioritäten und geschäftskritische Meilensteine abzustimmen. Governance & Compliance
• Qualität & Datenintegrität: Sicherstellt alle externen Workflows

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformateurs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires qui changent la vie. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet la découverte et le développement de traitements sûrs et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision pour la traduction de puissance, améliore continuellement l'exactitude de nos prédictions et accélère le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, Pharmacologie de la traduction et Biomarqueurs — nous amenons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, de l'évaluation des cibles au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement l'exactitude prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des traitements sûrs et efficaces de demain. Objet du poste Le responsable de l'externalisation scientifique orchestre les workflows externes de bout en bout qui alimentent notre moteur des sciences pharmaceutiques. Au-delà de la gestion traditionnelle des fournisseurs, ce rôle traite l'expertise scientifique externe comme une extension transparente et intégrée de notre équipe. En connectant les capacités internes à un écosystème mondial de partenaires externes dans l'espace de laboratoire pour évaluer la sécurité et l'efficacité dans le domaine préclinique et clinique, ce rôle garantit que les workflows multidisciplinaires complexes sont exécutés avec une vitesse maximale, l'intégrité des données et la conformité. En tant que champion de la R-D moderne, le poste est le fer de lance des approches de réseau collaboratif pRED et cross-Roche pour assurer la mise en oeuvre de bout en bout des solutions d'excellence en R-D (RDE). Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes : Opérations d'externalisation scientifique :
• Portfolio & Data Integration: Transition fragmentée de l'impartition en flux de travail externes unifiés au niveau du portefeuille et en pipelines automatisés « d'échantillons à données », assurant un accès sécurisé, sans faille et sans friction aux capacités scientifiques avancées.
• Surveillance du rendement et gestion des risques : Utiliser des outils modernes de suivi pour assurer une visibilité globale sur les pipelines externes, surveiller activement la performance des fournisseurs, optimiser l'échange de données et éliminer de façon proactive les goulets d'étranglement opérationnels et scientifiques. Gestion des fournisseurs
• Ecosystem & Partnerships: Dirige un réseau d'organisations de recherche sur les contrats (ORC) et de partenaires technologiques, passant des fournisseurs tactiques aux alliés stratégiques et co-innovateurs.
• Performance et résolution des problèmes : suit les partenaires via des mesures dynamiques (engagement, livraison, qualité, temps de cycle) et défend une résolution rapide et proactive des obstacles scientifiques et opérationnels. Coordination de la demande
• Modèles d'IA prédictifs : Transitions vers des prévisions appuyées par l'IA pour anticiper les volumes de workflow, les contraintes de capacité et la correspondance intelligente des demandes aux partenaires optimaux.
• Alignement financier et stratégique : Intégre le suivi financier en temps réel pour maximiser l'efficacité des coûts tout en s'harmonisant dynamiquement avec les priorités changeantes du portefeuille et les jalons stratégiques. Gouvernance et conformité
• Qualité & Intégrité des données: assure tous les workflows externes r

The Position
Global Product Planner

The Global HARP planner (Holistic Aligned Replenishment Planning) is part of the Global Planning team and is accountable for ensuring affiliate product availability supplied in the most efficient way. This includes generating robust replenishment plans and aligning requirements with GPP’s to ensure timely hub availability.

Key responsibilities include actively driving replenishment strategies, managing affiliate master data, and governing the process to ensure automated, demand-driven replenishment and optimized stock levels across our global and local network. Furthermore, the GPP serves as the central orchestration link in the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) processes to guarantee seamless supply continuity across all regional and central warehouse locations. Through proactive and close collaboration with affiliates and GPP’s, the HARP planner optimizes the replenishment process, monitors affiliate orders and shipments (focus on achieving high ocean shipment ratio).

Hub to affiliate replenishment planning (50%)

• Supply & inventory optimization: Accountable for creating accurate, robust affiliate supply plans based on demand inputs with efficient MOT processing. Defines product-based inventory strategies (including safety stock parameters) to balance customer service levels, business continuity, and cost efficiency.

Prepares for and hosts affiliate planning alignment meetings which are an integrated part of our S&OP process. Continues communication with all stakeholders and regular updates to affiliates.

• Proactive conflict management: Daily/weekly review of affiliate inventory projections, open orders at the hub, in transit shipments and forecast performance to proactively avoid service or cost issues.

• Lifecycle & launch management: Oversee the affiliate product lifecycle process to avoid service impact, hub financial impact and costly air shipments

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Planificateur mondial de produits Le planificateur mondial HARP (Holistic Aligned Repleinment Planning) fait partie de l'équipe de planification mondiale et est responsable d'assurer la disponibilité des produits affiliés de la manière la plus efficace. Cela comprend l'élaboration de plans de reconstitution robustes et l'harmonisation des exigences avec les GPP pour assurer la disponibilité en temps opportun des centres. Les principales responsabilités comprennent la conduite active des stratégies de reconstitution, la gestion des données maîtresses des filiales et la gestion du processus pour assurer une reconstitution automatisée, axée sur la demande et des niveaux de stocks optimisés dans notre réseau mondial et local. De plus, le GPP sert de lien central d'orchestration dans les processus de planification des ventes et des opérations (S&OP) afin de garantir une continuité d'approvisionnement transparente dans tous les entrepôts régionaux et centraux. Grâce à une collaboration proactive et étroite avec les sociétés affiliées et les GPP, le planificateur HARP optimise le processus de reconstitution, surveille les commandes et les expéditions des sociétés affiliées (en mettant l'accent sur l'atteinte d'un taux élevé d'expédition en mer). L'opportunité Hub à filiale planification de reconstitution (50%)
• Optimisation de l'approvisionnement et de l'inventaire : Responsable de la création de plans d'approvisionnement d'affiliation précis et robustes basés sur les entrées de demande avec un traitement MOT efficace. Définir des stratégies d'inventaire axées sur les produits (y compris les paramètres de sécurité des stocks) pour équilibrer les niveaux de service à la clientèle, la continuité des activités et l'efficacité des coûts.
• Gouvernance et surveillance du rendement en matière de S&OP : Suivre le respect du plan et entreprendre les mesures correctives et les clarifications nécessaires dans le cadre de l'examen des approvisionnements du processus de planification des ventes et des opérations. Préparer et accueillir les réunions d'harmonisation de la planification des filiales qui font partie intégrante de notre processus de S-OP. Continuer la communication avec tous les intervenants et les mises à jour régulières des affiliés.
• Gestion proactive des conflits : Examen quotidien/hebdomadaire des projections d'inventaire des filiales, des commandes ouvertes au centre, des expéditions en transit et des prévisions de rendement pour éviter les problèmes de service ou de coût.
• Gestion du cycle de vie et du lancement : Surveiller le processus de cycle de vie du produit affilié pour éviter l'impact du service, l'impact financier du centre et les expéditions aériennes coûteuses Gouvernance harmonisée de la planification de la reconstitution des ressources des pays alignés (20 %)
• Stratégie HARP & exécution de la reconstitution: Dirige et gère le processus d'inventaire géré à l'échelle mondiale pour les portefeuilles de produits et les pays, assurant une reconstitution automatisée, axée sur la demande et des niveaux de stock optimisés dans les centres de distribution et les filiales mondiaux.
• Collaboration et assurance du niveau de service : agit comme interface principale entre les réseaux mondiaux d'approvisionnement et les partenaires affiliés, surveille en permanence la santé des stocks afin de maximiser la disponibilité des produits tout en prévenant les situations de surstock.
• Optimisation et analyse du système : Supervise les paramètres du système et les paramètres de performance requis, identifie les tendances de façon proactive, suit les écarts et met en œuvre des mesures correctives pour rationaliser le cycle mondial de reconstitution. Données de base (20 %)
• Optimisation et précision des paramètres : Responsable de l'optimisation continue et de l'exactitude des données des paramètres de planification au sein des systèmes mondiaux et locaux, en stricte adéquation avec les directives de gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale (GSC) (couvrant à la fois les processus d'approvisionnement direct et de reconstitution).
• Examens périodiques : Effectue des examens systématiques et périodiques des paramètres de planification établis afin d'assurer l'alignement continu sur les besoins opérationnels.
• Résolution disparate: identifie proactivement les écarts de données et exécute l'adju nécessaire

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are
passionate about transforming patients’ lives and we are brave in both decision and action. And we believe that good business
means a better world.

Join Our Team: Make a Difference in International Regulatory Affairs!

Roche is seeking a dynamic and highly motivated individual to join our team as an International Regulatory Affairs
Professional. We are looking for candidates who bring an innovative and creative mindset to the table, along with a proven
track record in the Regulatory Affairs field. If you are passionate about making a positive impact on global healthcare through
regulatory excellence, we invite you to be part of our dedicated team.

Key Responsibilities

As an International Regulatory Affairs Professional at Roche, you will be responsible for:

• Leading and supporting regulatory strategies for global IVD/MD instruments and software submissions

• Ensuring compliance with international regulatory requirements and standards

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including R&D, Quality, and Clinical, to drive regulatory initiatives

• Providing regulatory guidance to support product development and lifecycle management

• Staying abreast of evolving regulatory trends and up‐ dates, and implementing best practices

Requirements

• Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, or a related field

• 5 to 7 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs ( Regulatory, R&D, Quality and/or Clinical), with some experience in healthcare regulatory affairs

• In-depth knowledge of global regulatory requirements, guidelines, and procedures especially for IVD instruments & software

• Strong organizational and communication skills

• Ability to multitask and effectively manage multiple projects simultaneously

• Self-motivated and capable of working independently in a self-management environment

• Experience in IVD instrument and/or software development

Why Roche

• Collaborative and innovative work environment

• Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patients' lives globally

• Competitive compensation and benefits package

• Professional development and growth opportunities within a leading global healthcare organization

If you are a dedicated professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about contributing to the
International Regulatory Affairs landscape, we want to hear from you! Submit your resume and cover letter detailing your
relevant experience and qualifications.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

La position Chez Roche, nous pensons qu'il est urgent de fournir des solutions médicales dès maintenant – même lorsque nous développons des innovations pour l'avenir. Nous sommes passionnés de transformer les vies des patients et nous sommes courageux dans la décision et l'action. Et nous croyons que les bonnes affaires signifie un monde meilleur. Rejoignez notre équipe : faites une différence en matière de réglementation internationale! Roche cherche une personne dynamique et très motivée pour rejoindre notre équipe en tant qu'Affaires réglementaires internationales Professionnel. Nous recherchons des candidats qui apportent un état d'esprit novateur et créatif à la table, ainsi qu'un des antécédents dans le domaine des affaires réglementaires. Si vous êtes passionné par un impact positif sur les soins de santé mondiaux excellence réglementaire, nous vous invitons à faire partie de notre équipe dédiée. Principales responsabilités En tant que professionnel de la réglementation internationale chez Roche, vous serez responsable :
• Diriger et appuyer les stratégies réglementaires pour les instruments et les logiciels mondiaux de DIV/MD
• Assurer le respect des exigences et normes réglementaires internationales
• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, y compris la R-D, la qualité et la clinique, pour mener des initiatives réglementaires
• Fournir des conseils réglementaires pour appuyer le développement de produits et la gestion du cycle de vie
• Se tenir au courant de l'évolution des tendances et des mises à jour de la réglementation et mettre en oeuvre les pratiques exemplaires Exigences

• De 5 à 7 ans d'expérience en affaires réglementaires (réglementation, R-D, qualité et/ou clinique), avec une certaine expérience en affaires réglementaires en soins de santé
• Connaissance approfondie des exigences réglementaires, des lignes directrices et des procédures mondiales, en particulier pour les instruments et logiciels de DIV
• Compétences solides en matière d ' organisation et de communication
• Capacité à multitâcher et gérer efficacement plusieurs projets simultanément
• Automotivé et capable de travailler indépendamment dans un environnement d'autogestion
• Expérience dans le développement d'instruments et/ou de logiciels de DIV Pourquoi Roche
• Un environnement de travail collaboratif et innovant
• Possibilité d'avoir un impact significatif sur la vie des patients dans le monde
• Compensation et avantages concurrentiels
• Développement professionnel et possibilités de croissance au sein d'une organisation mondiale de soins de santé de premier plan Si vous êtes un professionnel dévoué qui prospère dans un environnement rapide et est passionné de contribuer à la Réglementation internationale Affaires paysage, nous voulons avoir des nouvelles de vous! jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose
Assume full responsibility in managing Retail customers including field promotion and
business partnership to ensure sales and KPI achievement in Retail Chapter in a cost
effective manner. Develop and implement annual HCP plan and promotions to solidify CS-
NPC leading position in the target market.
負責零售通路客戶群、現場推廣及事業夥伴的全部責任，確保以有效成本達成銷售和KPI績效
。 制定並實施年度Retail Chapter計劃和推廣活動，以確保CS-NPC在目標市場領先地位

Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in
Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security,
Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of
compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.
在進行所有業務活動時，應完全遵守羅氏安全政策、羅氏商業行為準則、羅氏競爭法互動對
話準則以及羅氏安全、安保、健康和環境保護政策，同時展現對合規要求的深刻理解，並堅
持高標準的誠信。

主要工作職責 Main Tasks & Responsibilities :

• Contribute to the formulation of the Annual Sales Plan and develop specific account plans and profiles to maximize coverage, sales and distribution objectives
協助制定年度銷售計劃並製定特定的客戶計劃和資料，以最大程度地覆蓋範圍，銷售和銷售目標

• Develop and implement annual plan and contract for retail customers timely and with quality.
及時並高品質地制定和實施零售通路客戶群年度營銷計劃和合約

• Disease area-based position responsible for developing and enhancing professionalrelationships with healthcare professionals across various specialty networks including endocrinology and so on.
負責疾病領域相關工作，與包括內分泌學等在內的各個專科網絡的醫療保健專業人員建立和加強專業關係。

• Collaborate with the Key Account Team to identify and capitalize on new market opportunities, driving business growth.與關鍵客戶團隊合作，識別並掌握新的市場機遇，推動業務成長。

• Support Portfolio Management / Supports for assigned products
支援產品組合管理/為指定產品提供支援

• Manage retail customers and business partners sales and develop promotions to achieve sales target and KPIs.
管理零售通路客戶群和事業夥伴的銷售並開展促銷活動以實現銷售目標和KPI

• Develop new channels, innovate new sales models, and create cooperation between Roche and other external companies
開發新銷售通路，創新銷售模式，並與其他外部公司之間建立合作

• Visit channels at the required frequency and build strong engagement and partnership with them.
按要求的頻率訪問各通路，並與他們建立牢固的夥伴關係

• Track the results of promotion and effectiveness of field promotion regularly.
定期追蹤區域推廣銷售活動的成果與效能

• Accelerate product off-take in trade and optimize inventory level.
加快商品迴轉，優化庫存水平

• Provide Account sales forecast for order placement and sales tracking.
提供重要客戶銷售預測，以進行訂單投放和銷售追踪

• Well manage M&D budget on Account and business partners.
有效管理客戶和事業夥伴的 M&D預算

• Maintain awareness of market trends, understanding forthcoming customer initiatives and monitor what competitors are doing.
保持對市場趨勢的了解，了解即將到來的客戶計劃並監控競爭對手的行為

• Raise applications of FOC and demo goods from the team, and monitor if applications are written off monthly
提出FOC和展示商品申請，並監視是否每月核銷申請

• Conduct business in full compliance to Behavior in Business and Behavior in Competition.
完全遵守業務行為和競爭行為來開展業務

• Other tasks assigned by Head of CS-NPC
負責人分配的其他任務

Requirements:
Qualifications:

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

• Experience in retail/OTC business management/development is preferred

Education:
University graduate

Working Experience:
At least 3 years retail customers business management experience in medical related field
or consumer healthcare
Skills & Knowledge: Good knowledge of Compliance requirements and clear understanding of high
standards

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

Therapeutic Modalities (TMo) organization, accountable for translating disease biology into high-quality drug candidates across small molecules, large molecules, oligonucleotides, and genomic medicines. By integrating deep modality expertise with cross-disciplinary collaboration, TMo drives innovation within and across platforms to enable differentiated, sustainable therapeutic impact.

We are CMC experts and build our strength on a broad diversity of technical expertise in chemistry, formulation design, material science, and analytical chemistry, delivering and innovating in the space of small molecules, peptides, and nucleic acid based medicines.

As Subject Matter Expert (SME) you will lead the identification of the optimal solid-state form, ensuring that early-stage candidates possess the necessary solubility and stability to succeed in the clinic. You will serve as the central hub, coordinating complex screening and characterization activities across internal labs and global external partners. You will lead cross-functional efforts to de-risk drug candidates and define the "Golden Form" that carries our therapies from the lab to the patient.

The opportunity

• Scientific Leadership: Act as the single point of accountability for the solid-state strategy of assigned projects, ensuring the selection of optimal salt, polymorph, and particle forms to support both stability and bioavailability.

• End-to-End Ownership: Assume full responsibility for the lifecycle management of materials, from the initial integration of biopharmaceutical assessments to the final definition of robust crystallization processes.

• Cross-Functional Integration: Orchestrate the interface between Chemistry, Analytics, and Formulation teams to harmonize the material science narrative throughout the drug development lifecycle.

• Strategic Oversight: Spearhead the evaluation, technical vetting, and selection of global external CRO/CMO partners. You will orchestrate these collaborations, governing the seamless exchange of scientific methodologies while ensuring data generation meets our rigorous standards for quality and project milestones. You will manage the balance between internal technical services and external outsourcing partners, ensuring high-quality data generation and proactive risk mitigation.

• Innovation Driver: Champion the adoption of digitalization and automated screening tools to enhance data analysis throughput and accelerate project cycle times.

Who you are

• Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Material Science, or a related field, with a strong focus on solid-state characterization and crystallization.

• Deep understanding of solid-state analytical techniques (e.g., XRD, DSC, TGA, DVS, Microscopy) and their application in a pharmaceutical development context.

• Proven ability to lead complex projects in a matrix environment, with the communication skills necessary to translate technical data into strategic decisions for non-expert stakeholders.

• Experience managing external CRO/

L'organizzazione di Modalities terapeutici (TMo), responsabile per la traduzione della biologia delle malattie in candidati di droga di alta qualità attraverso piccole molecole, molecole di grandi dimensioni, oligonucleotidi e medicine genomiche. Integrando una profonda esperienza di modalità con la collaborazione interdisciplinare, TMo guida l'innovazione all'interno e attraverso piattaforme per consentire un impatto terapeutico differenziato e sostenibile. Siamo esperti CMC e costruiamo la nostra forza su una vasta gamma di competenze tecniche in chimica, progettazione della formulazione, scienza materiale e chimica analitica, fornendo e innovando nello spazio di piccole molecole, peptidi e farmaci a base di acido nucleico. Come Soggetto Matter Expert (SME) si porterà l'identificazione della forma di stato solido ottimale, assicurando che i candidati all'inizio del palco possiedono la solubilità e la stabilità necessarie per avere successo nella clinica. Potrai fungere da hub centrale, coordinando complesse attività di screening e caratterizzazione in laboratori interni e partner esterni globali. Condurrai gli sforzi interfunzionali per de-rischiare i candidati alla droga e definire la "forma d'oro" che trasporta le nostre terapie dal laboratorio al paziente. L'opportunità
• Leadership scientifica: agire come unico punto di responsabilità per la strategia a stato solido di progetti assegnati, garantendo la selezione di forme ottimali di sale, polimorfo e particella per supportare sia la stabilità che la biodisponibilità.
• ProprietÃ end-to-End: Assume la piena responsabilitÃ per la gestione del ciclo di vita dei materiali, dall'integrazione iniziale delle valutazioni biofarmaceutiche alla definizione finale di robusti processi di cristallizzazione.
• Integrazione Cross-Functional: Orchestra l'interfaccia tra i team di Chimica, Analytics e Formulazione per armonizzare la narrazione della scienza materiale durante il ciclo di vita dello sviluppo della droga.
• Supervisione strategica: testa la valutazione, il controllo tecnico e la selezione dei partner CRO/CMO esterni globali. Potrai orchestrare queste collaborazioni, regolando lo scambio senza soluzione di problemi di metodologie scientifiche, garantendo al tempo stesso la generazione dei dati soddisfa i nostri rigorosi standard per le pietre miliari di qualità e progetto. Potrai gestire l'equilibrio tra servizi tecnici interni e partner esterni di outsourcing, garantendo una generazione di dati di alta qualità e una mitigazione del rischio proattivo.
• Driver per l'innovazione: Campione l'adozione di strumenti di digitalizzazione e screening automatizzati per migliorare l'analisi dei dati attraverso la produzione e accelerare i tempi del ciclo di progetto. Chi sei
• Ph.D. in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Chimica, Scienza dei Materiali, o un campo correlato, con un forte focus sulla caratterizzazione e cristallizzazione dello stato solido.
• Profonda comprensione delle tecniche analitiche a stato solido (ad esempio, XRD, DSC, TGA, DVS, Microscopia) e la loro applicazione in un contesto di sviluppo farmaceutico.
• Prove capacità di condurre progetti complessi in un ambiente matrice, con le competenze di comunicazione necessarie per tradurre i dati tecnici in decisioni strategiche per gli stakeholder non esperti.
