descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position In Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organisation (pRED) stellen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten her, um einige der weltweit härtesten unerfüllten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED verbindet uns unsere Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen. Therapeutische Modalitäten (TMo) Organisation, verantwortlich für die Übersetzung der Krankheitsbiologie in qualitativ hochwertige Arzneimittelkandidaten über kleine Moleküle, große Moleküle, Oligonukleotide und genomische Medikamente. Durch die Integration von fundiertem Modalitäts-Know-how mit interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit fördert TMo Innovationen innerhalb und zwischen Plattformen, um eine differenzierte, nachhaltige therapeutische Wirkung zu ermöglichen. Wir sind CMC-Experten und bauen unsere Stärke auf einer breiten Vielfalt an technischer Expertise in Chemie, Formulierungsdesign, Materialwissenschaft und analytischer Chemie auf und liefern und innovieren im Bereich kleiner Moleküle, Peptide und Nukleinsäure-basierter Medikamente. Als Subject Matter Expert (SME) leiten Sie die Identifizierung der optimalen Festkörperform und stellen sicher, dass Nachwuchskandidaten die notwendige Löslichkeit und Stabilität besitzen, um in der Klinik erfolgreich zu sein. Sie dienen als zentraler Knotenpunkt und koordinieren komplexe Screening- und Charakterisierungsaktivitäten in internen Labors und globalen externen Partnern. Sie werden funktionsübergreifende Bemühungen führen, um Drogenkandidaten zu entrisikoen und die "Goldene Form" zu definieren, die unsere Therapien vom Labor zum Patienten führt. Die Chance
• Wissenschaftliche Führung: Handeln Sie als einziger Verantwortlichkeitspunkt für die Solid-State-Strategie der zugewiesenen Projekte und stellen Sie die Auswahl optimaler Salz-, Polymorph- und Partikelformen sicher, um sowohl Stabilität als auch Bioverfügbarkeit zu unterstützen.
• End-to-End Ownership: Übernahme der vollen Verantwortung für das Lebenszyklusmanagement von Materialien, von der anfänglichen Integration biopharmazeutischer Bewertungen bis zur endgültigen Definition robuster Kristallisationsprozesse.
• Funktionale Integration: Orchestrieren Sie die Schnittstelle zwischen Chemie-, Analyse- und Formulierungsteams, um die materialwissenschaftliche Erzählung während des gesamten Lebenszyklus der Arzneimittelentwicklung zu harmonisieren.
• Strategische Aufsicht: Speerspitze bei der Bewertung, technischen Überprüfung und Auswahl globaler externer CRO/CMO-Partner. Sie orchestrieren diese Kooperationen, regeln den nahtlosen Austausch wissenschaftlicher Methoden und stellen sicher, dass die Datenerzeugung unseren strengen Standards für Qualität und Projektmeilensteine entspricht. Sie verwalten die Balance zwischen internen technischen Services und externen Outsourcing-Partnern und gewährleisten eine qualitativ hochwertige Datengenerierung und proaktive Risikominderung.
• Innovationstreiber: Verfechten Sie die Einführung von Digitalisierungs- und automatisierten Screening-Tools, um den Datenanalysedurchsatz zu verbessern und die Projektzykluszeiten zu beschleunigen. Wer du bist
• Ph.D. in Pharmazeutischen Wissenschaften, Chemie, Materialwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Gebiet, mit einem starken Fokus auf Festkörpercharakterisierung und Kristallisation.
• Tiefes Verständnis der analytischen Festkörpertechniken (z. B. XRD, DSC, TGA, DVS, Mikroskopie) und ihrer Anwendung in einem pharmazeutischen Entwicklungskontext.
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, komplexe Projekte in einer Matrixumgebung zu leiten, mit den Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die erforderlich sind, um technische Daten in strategische Entscheidungen für nicht-fachkundige Interessengruppen zu übersetzen.
• Erfahrung im Management externer CRO/

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformateurs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires qui changent la vie. Organisation des Modalités Thérapeutiques (TMo), responsable de la traduction de la biologie des maladies en candidats médicamenteux de haute qualité à travers les petites molécules, les grandes molécules, les oligonucléotides et les médicaments génomiques. En intégrant une grande expertise en modalité avec une collaboration interdisciplinaire, TMo stimule l'innovation au sein des plateformes et entre elles pour permettre un impact thérapeutique différencié et durable. Nous sommes des experts du CMC et nous bâtissons notre force sur une vaste gamme d'expertises techniques dans les domaines de la chimie, de la conception de formulation, de la science des matériaux et de la chimie analytique. En tant qu'expert en matière de matière, vous dirigerez l'identification de la forme optimale à l'état solide, en veillant à ce que les candidats en début de carrière possèdent la solubilité et la stabilité nécessaires pour réussir dans la clinique. Vous serez le centre central, en coordonnant des activités complexes de dépistage et de caractérisation entre laboratoires internes et partenaires externes mondiaux. Vous dirigerez les efforts interfonctionnels pour dérisquer les candidats aux médicaments et définirez la « forme d'or » qui transporte nos thérapies du laboratoire au patient. L'opportunité
• Leadership scientifique : agir comme le seul point de responsabilisation pour la stratégie à l'état solide des projets assignés, en assurant le choix des formes optimales de sel, de polymorphe et de particules pour soutenir la stabilité et la biodisponibilité.
• Propriété de bout en bout : Assumer l'entière responsabilité de la gestion du cycle de vie des matériaux, de l'intégration initiale des évaluations biopharmaceutiques à la définition finale de processus de cristallisation robustes.
• Intégration interfonctionnelle : orchestrer l'interface entre les équipes de chimie, d'analyse et de formulation afin d'harmoniser le récit des sciences matérielles tout au long du cycle de développement des médicaments.
• Surveillance stratégique : Diriger l'évaluation, le contrôle technique et la sélection de partenaires externes du CRO/CMO. Vous orchestrerez ces collaborations, qui régissent l'échange continu de méthodologies scientifiques tout en veillant à ce que la production de données respecte nos normes rigoureuses de qualité et les jalons du projet. Vous gérerez l'équilibre entre les services techniques internes et les partenaires externes d'externalisation, assurant une production de données de haute qualité et une atténuation proactive des risques.
• Pilote de l'innovation : championne de l'adoption d'outils de numérisation et de dépistage automatisés pour améliorer le débit d'analyse des données et accélérer le cycle du projet. Qui vous êtes
• Ph.D. en sciences pharmaceutiques, chimie, science des matériaux, ou un domaine connexe, avec un accent marqué sur la caractérisation et la cristallisation à l'état solide.
• Connaissance approfondie des techniques d'analyse à l'état solide (p. ex. XRD, DSC, TGA, DVS, Microscopie) et de leur application dans un contexte de développement pharmaceutique.
• Capacité éprouvée de diriger des projets complexes dans un environnement matriciel, avec les compétences en communication nécessaires pour traduire les données techniques en décisions stratégiques pour les intervenants non experts.
• Expérience dans la gestion des ORC externes/

By integrating deep modality expertise with cross-disciplinary collaboration, TMo drives innovation within and across platforms to enable differentiated, sustainable therapeutic impact. As the siRNA Design Principal Scientist, you will play a key role in designing and optimizing therapeutic siRNA against various disease targets working from Target Assessment through Lead Optimization across different disease areas. You will integrate deep scientific expertise with high quality execution of discovery programs. The Opportunity
• Therapeutic Design Strategy: Lead the drug design strategy of oligonucleotides with a strong focus on siRNAs, leveraging computational and empirical approaches, for both initial Proof of Concept on novel targets and full-scale lead optimization for clinical development.
• Guide projects holistically ensuring early design decisions align with late-stage clinical and manufacturing requirements.
• Utilize and invent new advanced chemical modification patterns and sequence selection strategies to optimize relevant pharmacological properties of siRNAs
• AI Collaboration: Work in close partnership with our AI Experts to develop, validate, and apply the suit of AI design solutions. You understand AI needs and will provide the "ground truth" biological data and domain expertise to sharpen our machine-learning approaches.
• Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the RNAi subject matter expert in collaboration with project teams and disease experts. Who You Are
• Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Bioinformatics, Biochemistry, or a related field with 5+ years of industry experience specifically in siRNA/RNAi therapeutic design.
• Deep understanding of the RNAi mechanism and profiling of siRNA therapeutics.
• Proven track record in applying chemical modification patterns of siRNA to enhance therapeutic profile.
• Familiarity with the interface of biology and data science; comfortable discussing parameters and data features with AI engineers; hands-on experience with command-line utilities and scripting languages for biological sequence analysis and data management.
• The "Team Player" Mindset: Ability to communicate complex nucleic acid chemistry to non-experts and integrate feedback from diverse stakeholders.
• Strategic Thinking: Ability to balance aggressive development timelines with meticulous attention to detail.
• Excellent communication skills, capable of translating complex scientific concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences. • Ph.D. en biologie moléculaire, en bioinformatique, en biochimie ou dans un domaine connexe avec plus de 5 ans d'expérience de l'industrie en conception thérapeutique siRNA/RNAi.
• Connaissance approfondie du mécanisme de l'ARNi et profilage des thérapies de l'ARNi.
• Expérience éprouvée dans l'application de modèles de modification chimique de l'ARN si pour améliorer le profil thérapeutique.
• Connaissance de l'interface de la biologie et de la science des données; discussions à l'aise sur les paramètres et les caractéristiques des données avec les ingénieurs de l'IA; expérience pratique des utilitaires de ligne de commande et des langages de script pour l'analyse des séquences biologiques et la gestion des données.
• L'esprit d'équipe : Capacité de communiquer la chimie complexe de l'acide nucléique aux non-experts et d'intégrer la rétroaction de divers intervenants.
• Pensée stratégique : Capacité d'équilibrer les délais de développement agressifs avec une attention minutieuse aux détails.
• Excellentes compétences en communication, capables de traduire des concepts scientifiques complexes en idées claires et réalisables pour divers publics. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

Therapeutic Modalities (TMo) organization, accountable for translating disease biology into high-quality drug candidates across small molecules, large molecules, oligonucleotides, and genomic medicines. By integrating deep modality expertise with cross-disciplinary collaboration, TMo drives innovation within and across platforms to enable differentiated, sustainable therapeutic impact.

We are CMC experts and build our strength on a broad diversity of technical expertise in chemistry, formulation design, material science, and analytical chemistry, delivering and innovating in the space of small molecules, peptides, and nucleic acid based medicines.

As Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Oral Enabling Formulation Technologies . This is a high-impact, technical leadership role focused on overcoming the challenges of poorly soluble or poorly permeable drug candidates. You will lead the strategy, design, and execution of advanced formulation platforms to drive our pipeline from discovery through clinical proof-of-concep

The Opportunity

Enabling Formulation Mastery:

• Establish a high-impact technical network to maintain state-of-the-art oral enabling formulation technologies for delivery of complex synthetic modalities.

• Design and execute specialized formulations (e.g., lipid based-delivery systems such as SMEDDS/SNEDDS, amorphous solid dispersion spray-dried, hot-melt extrusion) to maximize exposure in PK, PD, and safety studies.

• Drive the advancement of global formulation strategies by integrating novel delivery technologies to enhance absorption and therapeutic efficacy

• Lead the technical profiling of NCEs and conduct rigorous Developability Assessments to identify and mitigate risks in molecular properties early in the pipeline

Internal Advisory Collaboration:

• You act as subject matter expert (SME) for internal pRED scientists, advising on formulation strategies for complex synthetic molecules and foster collaborative innovation across the organization.

Portfolio Execution & Excellence:

• Act as pCMC Drug Product lead within research project teams, guiding the end to end CMC scientific strategy until transfer to the Technical Development Department.

• Plan, coordinate and effectively communicate with research teams, function, stakeholders and governance boards.

• Master Modeling & Simulation and AI/ML tools to predict drug performance, optimize formulation selection, and bridge in vitro data to in vivo outcomes.

• Ensure scientific excellence and operational efficiency while meeting dynamic portfolio needs through effective internal and external supply strategies.

Who You Are

You possess a very strong background in Pharmaceutical Research and Development, Chemistry or related field. Ideally you have obtained a PhD in Pharmaceutical Technology and got at least 8 years of industry experience in Drug Discovery/Development, with at least 3-5 years specifically focused on Enabling Formulation Technologies for Oral Drug Delivery.

• A strong knowledge and experience in Enabling Formul

• Progettare ed eseguire formulazioni specializzate (ad es. sistemi a base di lipidi come SMEDDS/SNEDDS, estrusione a spruzzo a dispersione solida amorfa, a caldo) per massimizzare l'esposizione in PK, PD e studi di sicurezza.
• Guidare l'avanzamento delle strategie di formulazione globale integrando nuove tecnologie di consegna per migliorare l'assorbimento e l'efficacia terapeutica
• Guidare la profilazione tecnica delle NCE e condurre rigorose valutazioni di sviluppo per identificare e mitigare i rischi nelle proprietà molecolari all'inizio della pipeline Collaborazione consultiva interna:
• Agisci come esperto di materia soggettiva (SME) per gli scienziati pRED interni, consigliando strategie di formulazione per molecole sintetiche complesse e favorendo l'innovazione collaborativa in tutta l'organizzazione. Portfolio Execution & Excellence:
• Agire come pCMC Drug Product lead all'interno di team di progetto di ricerca, guidando la fine alla fine della strategia scientifica CMC fino al trasferimento al dipartimento di sviluppo tecnico.
• Pianificare, coordinare e comunicare efficacemente con i team di ricerca, la funzione, gli stakeholder e i consigli di governance.
• Gli strumenti Master Modeling & Simulation e AI/ML per prevedere le prestazioni della droga, ottimizzare la selezione della formulazione e collegare i dati in vitro ai risultati in vivo.
• Assicurare l'eccellenza scientifica e l'efficienza operativa, soddisfando le esigenze del portafoglio dinamico attraverso efficaci strategie interne ed esterne di fornitura. Chi sei Possiedi uno sfondo molto forte in Ricerca e Sviluppo Farmaceutico, Chimica o campo relativo. Idealmente hai ottenuto un dottorato in tecnologia farmaceutica e hai avuto almeno 8 anni di esperienza nel settore della ricerca/sviluppo della droga, con almeno 3-5 anni specificamente focalizzati su Eable Formulation Technologies for Oral Drug Delivery.
• Una forte conoscenza ed esperienza nell'abilitare Formul

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Patient Insights Software Chapter, within the Architecture and Software Engineering global function, aims to leverage software engineering as a competitive advantage for Roche, empowering patients and healthcare professionals to deliver better care.
We are looking for a Delivery Manager to play the Release Train Engineer (RTE) role for Accu-Chek Care to lead and improve software delivery management across its teams. Accu-Chek Care is the integrated digital ecosystem that empowers Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) — moving from standalone tools to a unified platform that enhances clinical decision-making and operational efficiency.

As RTE you lead and take ownership of Product Delivery within Engineering. This is an operationally hands-on role focused on engineering best practices, tooling standards, regulatory compliance, project management and scaled agile leadership. You are the orchestrator with a single goal: ensure effective and efficient product delivery — on time, within budget, and with the expected level of product quality — while actively leveraging AI-enabled tools and analytics to enhance predictability, performance and operating model effectiveness at scale.

If you are passionate about agile software delivery, a strong people leader, an empathic communicator, a team player, and excited to help build an AI-augmented delivery ecosystem, this role is for you.

Your Responsibilities
1. Delivery Leadership & Coordination

• ART Leadership: As a member of the ART leadership team, drive alignment, support decision-making, and ensure the train delivers value effectively, on time, within budget and with the expected level of product quality.

• Agile Governance: Facilitate key ceremonies (PI Plannings, Demos, Inspect & Adapt, refinements, syncs, and retrospectives) ensuring the ART maintains alignment, coordination and focus on clear priorities.

• Risk & Dependency Management: Proactively map cross-team dependencies, monitor technical/delivery risks, and make impediments visible to resolve them early, leveraging AI-powered forecasting.

• Value Optimization: Oversee the release process, backlog prioritization, integration needs (within the product and as part of the larger solution) and end-to-end flow of value across the platform to enable predictable, sustainable and high-performing delivery..

• Financial & Capacity Tracking: Oversee the allocated budget to define and adapt team structures to context changes, identifying opportunities to optimize engineering delivery.

• Operational Readiness: Support overall audit readiness and cross-functional coordination, ensuring that train delivery milestones naturally align with organizational standards and release guardrails.
2. Ways of Working & Continuous Improvement

• Process Evolution: Support the evolution of roles, ceremonies, processes, and tools to reduce complexity, eliminate waste and make daily work easier for teams.

• AI & Analytics: Drive continuous improvement by identifying systemic inefficiencies through data-driven insights and automated analytics, including AI-enabled process optimization.

• Engineering Standards: Promote robust engineering practices that naturally embed quality guardrails, cybersecurity awareness and technical documentation (such as SBOM) directly into continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.

• Community Engagement: Collaborate with other RTEs across the organization to share and leverage learnings, strengthening capabilities as an active member of the AS

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Customer Insights Software Chapter, all'interno della funzione globale di Architettura e Software Engineering, mira a sfruttare l'ingegneria del software come vantaggio competitivo per Roche, consentendo ai pazienti e ai professionisti sanitari di fornire una migliore assistenza. Stiamo cercando un Delivery Manager per svolgere il ruolo di Release Train Engineer (RTE) per Accu-Chek Care di guidare e migliorare la gestione della consegna del software attraverso i suoi team. Accu-Chek Care è l'ecosistema digitale integrato che consente ai professionisti del settore sanitario (HCP) - passando dagli strumenti standalone a una piattaforma unificata che migliora il processo decisionale clinico e l'efficienza operativa. Come RTE si guida e prendere la proprietà della consegna del prodotto all'interno di Ingegneria. Si tratta di un ruolo operativamente pratico focalizzato sulle migliori pratiche ingegneristiche, standard di utensili, conformità normativa, gestione del progetto e leadership agile scalata. Lei è l'orchestratore con un unico obiettivo: garantire la consegna efficace ed efficiente del prodotto - in tempo, all'interno del budget, e con il livello atteso di qualità del prodotto - mentre sfrutta attivamente gli strumenti e le analisi di AI per migliorare la prevedibilità, le prestazioni e l'efficacia del modello operativo in scala. Se siete appassionati di fornitura di software agile, un leader di persone forti, un comunicatore empatico, un giocatore di squadra, e entusiasta di contribuire a costruire un ecosistema di consegna aumentata dall'IA, questo ruolo è per voi. Le tue responsabilità 1. Leadership di consegna e coordinamento
• ART Leadership: Come membro del team di leadership ART, allineare l'unità, sostenere il processo decisionale, e garantire che il treno offre valore in modo efficace, nel tempo, all'interno del budget e con il livello atteso di qualità del prodotto.
• Governance Agile: Facilitate cerimonie chiave (PPI Pianificazione, Demo, Ispezione e Adapt, perfezionamenti, sincronizzazioni e retrospettive) assicurando che l'ART mantiene l'allineamento, il coordinamento e l'attenzione su priorità chiare.
• Risk & Dependency Management: mappare in modo attivo le dipendenze trasversali, monitorare i rischi tecnici / di consegna e rendere visibili gli impedimenti per risolverli in anticipo, sfruttando le previsioni AI-powered.
• Ottimizzazione del valore: supervisionare il processo di rilascio, priorità backlog, esigenze di integrazione (nel prodotto e come parte della soluzione più ampia) e flusso end-to-end di valore in tutta la piattaforma per consentire la consegna prevedibile, sostenibile e ad alta prestazione.
• Financial & Capacity Tracking: supervisionare il budget assegnato per definire e adattare le strutture del team ai cambiamenti di contesto, identificare le opportunità per ottimizzare la consegna ingegneristica.
• Prontezza Operativa: Sostenere la prontezza dell'audit complessivo e il coordinamento interfunzionale, assicurando che le pietre miliari di consegna del treno si allineano naturalmente con gli standard organizzativi e le protezioni di rilascio. 2. Modi di lavoro e miglioramento continuo
• Evoluzione del processo: Sostenere l'evoluzione di ruoli, cerimonie, processi e strumenti per ridurre la complessità, eliminare i rifiuti e rendere il lavoro quotidiano più facile per i team.
• AI & Analytics: Promuovere un miglioramento continuo identificando inefficienze sistemiche attraverso approfondimenti basati sui dati e analisi automatizzate, tra cui l'ottimizzazione dei processi abilitata all'intelligenza artificiale.
• Engineering Standards: Promuovere pratiche ingegneristiche robuste che naturalmente incorporano guardrails di qualità, consapevolezza della sicurezza informatica e documentazione tecnica (come SBOM) direttamente in continuo integrazione e distribuzione (CI/CD).
• Community Engagement: Collabora con altri RTE in tutta l'organizzazione per condividere e sfruttare gli insegnamenti, rafforzare le capacità di membro attivo dell'AS

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to optimize the sourcing channels for the cutting-edge hardware, sensor technologies, and core chemical components that drive our next generation of diagnostic innovations? As a Sourcing Manager in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will execute end-to-end tactical procurement within our diagnostic portfolios. In this role, you will elevate routine transactional requests into strategic, value-add solutions, driving bottom-line cost savings and ensuring global supply reliability.
To support our rapid growth, we are hiring a cohort of Sourcing Managers who will be aligned to one of two specialized technology teams: Near Patient Care (NPC), Sensors & Cartridges, and External Manufacturing (EM) or Active Diagnostic Ingredients (ADI), Reagents, and Instruments.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Sourcing Lead, and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will partner seamlessly with critical global cross-functional teams, including Category, Delivery, Accounts Payable (AP) and RSS Demand to Pay, to clear supply bottlenecks and inform future procurement strategies. You will also manage operational relationships with a diverse base of external suppliers.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on end-to-end sourcing execution, process optimization, master data management, and value creation.

• Impact: You drive global procurement efficiency, value execution, and compliance across your portfolios. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Sourcing Execution: Executing global sourcing activities, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and market benchmarking for on-market products and New Product Introductions (NPI).

• Demand Aggregation: Analyzing user requirements to identify value-driving methods, aggregating global demand to maximize leverage, and escalating non-standard requests to Category Management.

• Project & Risk Management: Developing comprehensive project plans (timelines, milestones, resources), participating in project teams, and proactively identifying and mitigating risks to objectives.

• Contract Lifecycle: Setting up template-based contracts (such as CDAs and SOWs) and managing their full lifecycle, repository tracking, and potential renewals or improvements.

• Operational Excellence: Utilizing enterprise tools (SAP, myBuy) to simplify new and existing workflows, managing purchasing documentation, and ensuring strict compliance with global procurement policies.

• Metrics & CSR: Tracking and delivering on key operational targets and customer service metrics (such as cycle times) while championing supplier diversity, sustainability, and ethical practices.

• Conflict & Exposure: Managing process expectations and competing activity priorities, while presenting regular KPI and project updates to the Sourcing Lead and global stakeholders.

Who you are

Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Siete pronti ad ottimizzare le operazioni di approvvigionamento per le tecnologie avanzate dei sensori e le reti di produzione esterne che rendono possibile il test a breve termine? Come nostro Sourcing Manager a Sant Cugat, in Spagna, eseguirai gli appalti tattici end-to-end all'interno dei nostri portafogli Near Patient Care (NPC), Sensors & Cartridges e External Manufacturing (EM). In questo ruolo, eleverai richieste transazionali standard in opportunità strategiche, a valore aggiunto, guiderai il risparmio di costi di linea inferiore e garantirai l'affidabilità globale dell'offerta.
• Linea di segnalazione: La posizione riporta direttamente al Piombo Sourcing – NPC, Sensori e Cartucce, ed EM, ed è parte del Centro di Eccellenza Procurement (CoE).
• Team Wider e stakeholder: Partner con Categoria DOP, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, stakeholder di operazioni globali e fornitori esterni/fornitori esterni per risolvere strozzature amministrative e informare le strategie future.
• Tipo di ruolo: Un ruolo di Contributor individuale focalizzato sull'esecuzione di sourcing end-to-end, la gestione dei dati master e la creazione di valore.
• Impatto: si guida l'efficienza degli appalti globali, l'esecuzione del valore e la conformità attraverso i vostri portafogli. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Esecuzione Sourcing: Esecuzione di attività di approvvigionamento globale, processi standard (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), e benchmarking di mercato per i prodotti on-market e Nuove Introduzioni di prodotto (NPI).
• Aggregazione della domanda: Analizzando i requisiti degli utenti per identificare i metodi di gestione del valore, aggregando la domanda globale per massimizzare la leva e intensificando le richieste non standard alla gestione della categoria.
• Project & Risk Management: Sviluppo di piani di progetto completi (linee temporali, pietre miliari, risorse), partecipazione a team di progetto e identificazione proattiva e mitigazione dei rischi per gli obiettivi.
• Contratto Lifecycle: Impostazione dei contratti basati sui modelli (come CDAs e SOWs) e gestione del loro ciclo di vita completo, monitoraggio dei repository e potenziali rinnovi o miglioramenti.
• Eccellenza Operativa: Utilizzando gli strumenti aziendali (SAP, myBuy) per semplificare i flussi di lavoro nuovi e esistenti, gestire la documentazione di acquisto e garantire una rigorosa conformità alle politiche di approvvigionamento globale.
• Metrics & CSR: tracciare e fornire obiettivi operativi chiave e metriche di servizio al cliente (come i tempi di ciclo) mentre il campione della diversità dei fornitori, della sostenibilità e delle pratiche etiche.
• Conflict & Exposure: Gestione delle aspettative dei processi e delle priorità delle attività concorrenti, presentando regolarmente KPI e aggiornamenti dei progetti al Sourcing Lead e agli stakeholder globali. Chi sei Ci sforziamo di mantenere i nostri standard elevati e cercare i problem-solvers analitici con una forte attenzione al servizio clienti.
• Istruzione: Una laurea universitaria (Business o Scienze della Vita preferita) è richiesto; una certificazione MBA o CIPS è altamente desiderabile.
• Esperienza: 3–5+ anni di sourcing, specializzandosi in modo tattico

• Mesures et RSE : Suivi et réalisation des objectifs opérationnels clés et des mesures du service à la clientèle (telles que les cycles) tout en défendant la diversité des fournisseurs, la durabilité et les pratiques éthiques.
• Conflit et exposition : gérer les attentes du processus et les priorités d'activités concurrentes, tout en présentant régulièrement des mises à jour de l'ICP et du projet au responsable de l'approvisionnement et aux intervenants mondiaux. titleByLocale.it: Senior Associate - Genetics & Genomics Lab Expert

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Associate - Genetics & Genomics Lab Expert, you play a pivotal role in accelerating early drug development within our Pharmaceutical Sciences team. This role serves as a vital bridge between high-throughput advanced wet-lab molecular biology and data-driven laboratory operations. You will spend your days executing hands-on laboratory work and leveraging modern digital tools to maximize scientific insights and advance our global therapeutic pipeline.
In this role, you will:

• Develop, validate, and implement advanced genetics and genomics-based biomarker assays (including epigenetics, gene expression signatures, and circulating DNA/RNA) to characterize disease mechanisms.

• Evaluate and apply cutting-edge genomics technologies , such as single-cell sequencing, spatial-omics, and digital droplet PCR (ddPCR), to maximize biological insights from precious, low-volume samples.

• Drive digital integration by utilizing advanced digital lab infrastructure, automation tools, and electronic lab notebooks (ELNs) to ensure high-fidelity data tracking.

• Collaborate within an agile ecosystem , partnering seamlessly across matrixed project teams with project leads, pathologists, and computational scientists to turn samples into actionable insights.

• Facilitate technology transfer by leading the robust technical delivery of validated methodologies to external collaboration partners and Contract Research Organizations (CROs).

• Inspire and mentor other scientists, associates, and interns, fostering a laboratory culture of continuous improvement, curiosity, and learning agility.

Who You Are

We are looking for an engaged scientific professional who thrives at the intersection of laboratory science and digital innovation.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Education & Experience: A Master’s degree in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Genomics, or a related life-sciences field, alongside solid hands-on experience in biomarker assay development and a minimum of 3 years of working experience.

• Technical Expertise: Deep proficiency in molecular biology techniques (qPCR, ddPCR) and next-generation sequencing (NGS) platforms, with a strong interest in executing high-quality experimental workflows.

Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. Questo ruolo funge da ponte vitale tra la biologia molecolare avanzata a lastra umida ad alto rendimento e le operazioni di laboratorio basate sui dati. Trascorrerete le vostre giornate di esecuzione del lavoro pratico di laboratorio e sfruttando moderni strumenti digitali per massimizzare le intuizioni scientifiche e avanzare la nostra pipeline terapeutica globale. In questo ruolo, voi:
• Sviluppare, convalidare e implementare saggi di biomarcatori basati sulla genetica avanzata e sulla genomica (tra cui epigenetica, firme di espressione genica e DNA/RNA circolante) per caratterizzare i meccanismi della malattia.
• Valutare e applicare tecnologie genomiche all'avanguardia, come il sequenziamento monocellulare, l'omica spaziale e il PCR a goccia digitale (ddPCR), per massimizzare le intuizioni biologiche da campioni preziosi e a basso volume.
• Guida l'integrazione digitale utilizzando infrastrutture di laboratorio digitali avanzate, strumenti di automazione e notebook elettronici di laboratorio (ELNs) per garantire il monitoraggio dei dati ad alta fedeltà.
• Collaborare all'interno di un ecosistema agile, collaborando senza soluzione di continuità tra team di progetto matrici con lead di progetto, patologi e scienziati computazionali per trasformare i campioni in insight attuabili.
• Facilitare il trasferimento tecnologico con la guida della robusta consegna tecnica di metodologie convalidate a partner di collaborazione esterni e organizzazioni di ricerca contrattuali (CRO).
• Ispirare e mentore altri scienziati, associati e tirocinanti, promuovendo una cultura di laboratorio di miglioramento continuo, curiosità e agilità di apprendimento. Chi sei Stiamo cercando un professionista scientifico impegnato che prospera all'incrocio tra scienza di laboratorio e innovazione digitale. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Istruzione & Esperienza: Laurea Magistrale in Biologia Molecolare, Biochimica, Biotecnologia, Genomics, o un campo legato alla vita-scienze, oltre a una solida esperienza pratica nello sviluppo del saggio biomarcatore e un minimo di 3 anni di esperienza lavorativa.
• Competenza tecnica: Profonda competenza nelle tecniche di biologia molecolare (qPCR, ddPCR) e nelle piattaforme di sequenziamento di nuova generazione (NGS), con un forte interesse nell'esecuzione di flussi di lavoro sperimentali di alta qualità.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed. At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics. The Opportunity As a Senior Associate - Genetics & Genomics Lab Expert, you play a pivotal role in accelerating early drug development within our Pharmaceutical Sciences team. This role serves as a vital bridge between high-throughput advanced wet-lab molecular biology and data-driven laboratory operations. You will spend your days executing hands-on laboratory work and leveraging modern digital tools to maximize scientific insights and advance our global therapeutic pipeline. In this role, you will:
• Develop, validate, and implement advanced genetics and genomics-based biomarker assays (including epigenetics, gene expression signatures, and circulating DNA/RNA) to characterize disease mechanisms.
• Evaluate and apply cutting-edge genomics technologies , such as single-cell sequencing, spatial-omics, and digital droplet PCR (ddPCR), to maximize biological insights from precious, low-volume samples.
• Drive digital integration by utilizing advanced digital lab infrastructure, automation tools, and electronic lab notebooks (ELNs) to ensure high-fidelity data tracking.
• Collaborate within an agile ecosystem , partnering seamlessly across matrixed project teams with project leads, pathologists, and computational scientists to turn samples into actionable insights.
• Facilitate technology transfer by leading the robust technical delivery of validated methodologies to external collaboration partners and Contract Research Organizations (CROs).
• Inspire and mentor other scientists, associates, and interns, fostering a laboratory culture of continuous improvement, curiosity, and learning agility. Who You Are We are looking for an engaged scientific professional who thrives at the intersection of laboratory science and digital innovation. To be successful in this role, you bring:
• Education & Experience: A Master’s degree in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Genomics, or a related life-sciences field, alongside solid hands-on experience in biomarker assay development and a minimum of 3 years of working experience.
• Technical Expertise: Deep proficiency in molecular biology techniques (qPCR, ddPCR) and next-generation sequencing (NGS) platforms, with a strong interest in executing high-quality experimental workflows.

En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, pharmacologie de la traduction et biomarqueurs —, nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain. L'opportunité En tant que Senior Associate - Genetics & Genomics Lab Expert, vous jouez un rôle central dans l'accélération du développement précoce des médicaments au sein de notre équipe des sciences pharmaceutiques. Ce rôle sert de pont vital entre la biologie moléculaire avancée de laboratoire humide à haut débit et les opérations de laboratoire axées sur les données. Vous passerez vos journées à exécuter des travaux pratiques en laboratoire et à utiliser des outils numériques modernes pour maximiser les connaissances scientifiques et faire progresser notre pipeline thérapeutique mondial. Dans ce rôle, vous :
• Élaborer, valider et mettre en oeuvre des tests de biomarqueurs de génétique et de génomique avancés (y compris l'épigénétique, les signatures d'expression génétique et l'ADN/ARN circulant) pour caractériser les mécanismes de la maladie.
• Évaluer et appliquer des technologies génomiques de pointe, telles que le séquençage à une seule cellule, l'espace-omique et les gouttelettes numériques PCR (ddPCR), afin de maximiser les connaissances biologiques provenant de précieux échantillons à faible volume.
• Conduire l'intégration numérique en utilisant une infrastructure de laboratoire numérique avancée, des outils d'automatisation et des ordinateurs portables de laboratoire électroniques (ELN) pour assurer le suivi des données de haute fidélité.
• Collaborer au sein d'un écosystème agile, en s'associant harmonieusement entre les équipes de projet matricielles avec les chefs de projet, les pathologistes et les chercheurs en calcul pour transformer les échantillons en idées exploitables.
• Faciliter le transfert de technologie en dirigeant la fourniture technique robuste de méthodes validées aux partenaires de collaboration externes et aux organismes de recherche sous contrat (ORC).
• Inspirez et mentorez d'autres scientifiques, associés et stagiaires, favorisant une culture de laboratoire d'amélioration continue, de curiosité et d'agilité d'apprentissage. Qui vous êtes Nous recherchons un professionnel scientifique engagé qui prospère à l'intersection des sciences de laboratoire et de l'innovation numérique. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• Éducation et expérience : Maîtrise en biologie moléculaire, biochimie, biotechnologie, génomique ou domaine connexe des sciences de la vie, ainsi qu'une solide expérience pratique dans le développement de tests de biomarqueurs et un minimum de 3 ans d'expérience de travail.
• Expertise technique : Connaissance approfondie des techniques de biologie moléculaire (qPCR, ddPCR) et des plates-formes de séquençage de prochaine génération (NGS), avec un vif intérêt pour l'exécution de workflows expérimentaux de haute qualité.

The Opportunity

As an engaged Pathology and Applied Safety Science Hematology & Safety Biomarker Expert, you will play a pivotal role in the development, validation, and implementation of assays for translational safety assessment. Your primary responsibility will be to propose, conduct and report relevant assays to understand mechanisms of toxicity, leveraging modern tools to maximise scientific insights, drive innovation, and advance our therapeutic pipeline in a highly collaborative environment.

• Strategic Biomarker Integration & Translational Safety: Collaborate with experts to develop and execute integrated in vitro and in vivo hematology and safety biomarker strategies, provide subject matter expertise for clinical candidate selection, and deliver comprehensive safety risk assessments for regulatory documentation (e.g., IND/CTA).

• Multi-Disciplinary Laboratory Expertise: Allocate approximately 50% of working time to wet-lab work, focusing on the development and implementation of tailored in vitro and ex vivo hematology and fluid-based safety biomarker assays, as well as generating and compiling clinical pathology data (hematology, coagulation, clinical chemistry, urinalysis) for the responsible pathologist.

• Digitisation, Image Analysis, and Automation: Partner with Digital Pathology and modelling experts to develop screening assays, utilise digital and data curation platforms (e.g., LIMS, SLIMS, Arvados) to ensure streamlined data transfer and harmonised datasets, and optimise workflow integration to maximise operational efficiency.

An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft und Innovation ermöglicht die pRED-Organisation Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) die Entdeckung und Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Therapeutika in optimalen Dosen in relevanten Populationen mit einer Vision für die Energieübersetzung, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Genauigkeit unserer Vorhersagen und die Beschleunigung der Entwicklung von Medikamenten von morgen. Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Unsere Mission ist es, die prädiktive Genauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, Dosierungsstrategien für die richtigen Patientengruppen zu optimieren und die Entwicklung der sicheren und wirksamen Therapeutika von morgen zu beschleunigen. Diese Position befindet sich in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, einer Abteilung innerhalb der Pharmaceutical Sciences Funktion. Wir fördern die nichtklinische Sicherheitsbewertung von Wirkstoffkandidaten von kleinen Molekülen bis hin zu komplexen biologischen Produkten während der Entdeckungs- und Entwicklungsphase bei Roche. Die Chance Als engagierter Experte für Pathologie und angewandte Sicherheitswissenschaft Hämatologie & Sicherheits-Biomarker spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Entwicklung, Validierung und Implementierung von Assays für die translationale Sicherheitsbewertung. Ihre Hauptaufgabe wird es sein, relevante Assays vorzuschlagen, durchzuführen und zu berichten, um die Mechanismen der Toxizität zu verstehen, moderne Werkzeuge zu nutzen, um wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse zu maximieren, Innovationen voranzutreiben und unsere therapeutische Pipeline in einem hochgradig kooperativen Umfeld voranzutreiben.
• Strategische Biomarker-Integration & Translationale Sicherheit: Arbeiten Sie mit Experten zusammen, um integrierte In-vitro- und In-vivo-Hämatologie- und Sicherheits-Biomarker-Strategien zu entwickeln und durchzuführen, Fachwissen für die klinische Kandidatenauswahl bereitzustellen und umfassende Sicherheitsrisikobewertungen für die regulatorische Dokumentation (z. B. IND / CTA) durchzuführen.
• Multidisziplinäre Laborexpertise: Geben Sie etwa 50% der Arbeitszeit für Nasslaborarbeiten zu und konzentrieren sich auf die Entwicklung und Umsetzung maßgeschneiderter In-vitro- und Ex-vivo-Hämatologie- und fluidbasierter Sicherheits-Biomarker-Assays sowie die Erstellung und Zusammenstellung klinischer Pathologiedaten (Hämatologie, Gerinnung, klinische Chemie, Urinanalyse) für den verantwortlichen Pathologen.
• Digitalisierung, Bildanalyse und Automatisierung: Partnerschaft mit Experten für digitale Pathologie und Modellierung, um Screening-Assays zu entwickeln, digitale und Datenkurationsplattformen (z. B. LIMS, SLIMS, Arvados) zu nutzen, um eine optimierte Datenübertragung und harmonisierte Datensätze zu gewährleisten und die Workflow-Integration zu optimieren, um die betriebliche Effizienz zu maximieren.
• Vendor Management, Quality & Compliance Outsourcing & CRO Coordination: Verwalten Sie externe Partnerschaften und treiben Sie die Auslagerung relevanter Assays an Auftragsforschungslaboratorien (CROs) voran, um die strikte Einhaltung von Zeitplänen und Datenqualitätsstandards sicherzustellen.
• Sicherheitsstandards: Einhaltung der Vorschriften für Sicherheit, Gesundheit und Umwelt (SHE) und aktive Förderung einer Kultur der Sicherheit

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires et changeantes. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. jobs.title: Head, PV Regional Center EMEA

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur, Centre régional de PV EMEA

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

We are seeking a high-caliber strategist to lead, scale, and transform our PV Regional Center. As the regional head, you will oversee all PV and Device Vigilance operations across the EEMEA region. This pivotal role puts you at the intersection of global strategy and regional execution, tasks you with driving absolute compliance, operational agility, and clinical safety integration.
As a strategic peer to Affiliate Patient Safety and Global Leadership, you will directly influence the overarching Patient Safety Operations (PSO) roadmap. We look to you to leverage automation, data analytics, and digital tools to elevate our safety framework to a world-class level.

• Strategic Leadership: Direct and motivate a multi-site regional team, fostering a culture centered on quality, accountability, and customer focus.

• Regulatory Oversight: Ensure regional operations seamlessly align with global standards and diverse local legal frameworks.

• Digital Evolution: Act as a catalyst for modernization by integrating AI, machine learning, and advanced digital insights into safety operations.

• Audit Mastery: Guarantee continuous audit and inspection readiness while maintaining a bulletproof business continuity strategy.

• Matrix Integration: Work hand-in-hand with cross-functional internal partners to unify regional clinical safety efforts with global business objectives.

• Talent Development: Embody the VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) philosophy to mentor talent and build robust succession plans.

• Industry Representation: Serve as the primary regional interface for regulators and external partners, reinforcing our market-leading reputation.

Who You Are
You are an analytical thinker and people-first leader who thrives when managing complexity. You understand the nuances of the global pharma landscape and want a role where your decisions directly impact corporate strategy and patient lives.

• Qualifications: Health Care Professional Degree (MD, Pharmacist, or equivalent senior-level industry experience).

• Track Record: Minimum of 10 years in the pharmaceutical sector, with 5+ years specifically dedicated to leading substantial PV operations.

• Geographic Scope: Demonstrated success managing multi-country, cross-border operations within a matrixed multinational environment.

• People Leadership: Mastery of VACC leadership principles, with a history of building high-trust, diverse, and high-performing teams.

• Domain Knowledge: Subject matter expertise in GVP, ICH-GCP, and international regulatory standards (FDA/EMA).

• Influence: Elite communication skills in English, capable of navigating complex stakeholder landscapes and driving consensus.

• Innovation Mindset: A proactive champion of change, eager to pilot digital tools and methodologies to optimize efficiency.

Location
Budapest-based. (Relocation assistance is not provided).

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal O

jobs.title: Investigative Toxicology Junior Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position is located in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, a department within the Pharmaceutical Sciences function. We drive the non-clinical safety assessment of drug candidates from small molecules to complex biological products during the discovery and development phases at Roche.

The Opportunity

As an engaged Junior Investigative Toxicology Scientist within our Pathology and Applied Safety Science department, you will play a pivotal role in the development, validation, and implementation of nonclinical assays for translational safety assessment. Your primary responsibility will be to propose, conduct, and report investigative toxicology experiments to understand mechanisms of toxicity and predict toxicity liabilities of early drug series. Leveraging modern tools to maximise scientific insights and drive innovation, you will support the development of in vitro predictive safety models and remain accountable for the scientific delivery of modern toxicology assays to inform risk assessment across projects ranging from small molecules to complex biological products. The Junior Investigative Toxicology Scientist is primarily a wet lab-focused position with the majority of time dedicated to hands-on experimental work in the lab.

• Scientific Strategy & In Vitro Model Development: Design, develop, optimise, and perform in vitro toxicology assays, including advanced 2D and 3D human cell models, to support translational safety assessment and predict toxicity liabilities of early drug candidates.

• Advanced Analytical Workflows & High-Content Imaging: Drive proficiency in state-of-the-art analytical methods (including high-content screening, confocal imaging platforms, and next-generation sequencing) while building, deploying, and maintaining custom image analysis tools and automated pipelines to extract metrics from complex cellular setups, collaborating closely with digital engineering, bioinformatics, and digital pathology teams to scale cell data into accessible project arrays.

• Data Curation, Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), & Reporting: Conduct rigorous data analysis, critical procedure evaluations, and proper internal reporting of study phase data within the LIMS, acting as a lead presenter to deliver conc

Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti innovazione straordinaria e mutevole a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. Questa posizione si trova in Patologia e Scienze della Sicurezza Applicata, un dipartimento all'interno della funzione Scienze Farmaceutiche. Noi guidiamo la valutazione di sicurezza non ciclica dei candidati alla droga da piccole molecole a prodotti biologici complessi durante le fasi di scoperta e sviluppo a Roche. L'opportunità In qualità di scienziato tossicologico investigativo junior impegnato all'interno del nostro dipartimento di Patologia e Scienze della Sicurezza Applicata, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nello sviluppo, nella convalida e nell'implementazione di saggi non clinici per la valutazione della sicurezza traduttiva. La vostra responsabilità primaria sarà quella di proporre, condurre e segnalare esperimenti di tossicologia investigativa per comprendere meccanismi di tossicità e prevedere passività di tossicità delle prime serie di droga. Sfruttando strumenti moderni per massimizzare le intuizioni scientifiche e guidare l'innovazione, supporterai lo sviluppo di modelli di sicurezza predittivi in vitro e resterai responsabile per la consegna scientifica di test tossicologici moderni per informare la valutazione del rischio su progetti che vanno da piccole molecole a prodotti biologici complessi. Il Junior Investigative Toxicology Scientist è principalmente una posizione focalizzata sul laboratorio umido con la maggior parte del tempo dedicata al lavoro sperimentale pratico in laboratorio.
• Strategia scientifica e sviluppo del modello in Vitro: progettazione, sviluppo, ottimizzazione ed eseguire analisi tossicologiche in vitro, compresi i modelli avanzati di cellule umane 2D e 3D, per sostenere la valutazione di sicurezza traduttiva e prevedere passività di tossicità dei candidati di droga primi.
• Advanced Analytical Workflows & High-Content Imaging: Proficienza dell'azionamento nei metodi analitici all'avanguardia (tra cui screening ad alto contenuto, piattaforme di imaging confocale e sequenziamento di prossima generazione) mentre la costruzione, la distribuzione e il mantenimento di strumenti di analisi dell'immagine personalizzati e condotte automatizzate per estrarre metriche da complesse configurazioni cellulari, collaborando strettamente con l'ingegneria digitale, la bioinformatica e i team di patologia digitale accessibili per scalare i dati.
• Curazione dei dati, Sistema di gestione delle informazioni di laboratorio (LIMS), & Reporting: Condurre analisi rigorose dei dati, valutazioni delle procedure critiche e una corretta segnalazione interna dei dati di fase di studio all'interno del LIMS, agendo come presentatore principale per fornire conc

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen. Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Unsere Mission ist es, die prädiktive Genauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, Dosierungsstrategien für die richtigen Patientengruppen zu optimieren und die Entwicklung der sicheren und wirksamen Therapeutika von morgen zu beschleunigen. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires et changeantes. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, pharmacologie de la traduction et biomarqueurs —, nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain. Ce poste est situé à Pathology and Applied Safety Science, un département de la fonction Sciences pharmaceutiques. Nous conduisons l'évaluation non clinique de l'innocuité des médicaments candidats à partir de petites molécules à des produits biologiques complexes pendant les phases de découverte et de développement à Roche. L'opportunité En tant que chercheur en toxicologie junior engagé au sein de notre département des sciences de la pathologie et de la sécurité appliquée, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'élaboration, la validation et la mise en oeuvre d'essais non cliniques pour l'évaluation de l'innocuité translationnelle. Votre principale responsabilité sera de proposer, de mener et de rapporter des expériences toxicologiques d'investigation afin de comprendre les mécanismes de toxicité et de prédire les responsabilités toxicologiques des premières séries de médicaments. En tirant parti des outils modernes pour maximiser les connaissances scientifiques et stimuler l'innovation, vous soutiendrez le développement de modèles de sécurité prédictive in vitro et demeurez responsable de la livraison scientifique de tests toxicologiques modernes pour éclairer l'évaluation des risques dans tous les projets allant de petites molécules à des produits biologiques complexes. Le Junior Investigative Toxicology Scientist est principalement un poste axé sur le laboratoire humide avec la majorité du temps consacré aux travaux expérimentaux pratiques au laboratoire.
• Stratégie scientifique et développement de modèles in vitro : Concevoir, développer, optimiser et effectuer des essais de toxicologie in vitro, y compris des modèles de cellules humaines 2D et 3D avancés, pour appuyer l'évaluation de l'innocuité translationnelle et prédire les responsabilités de toxicité des premiers candidats au médicament.
• Flux de travail analytiques avancés et imagerie à haut contenu : Conduire les compétences dans les méthodes d'analyse de pointe (y compris le dépistage à haute teneur, les plates-formes d'imagerie confocale et le séquençage de la prochaine génération) tout en construisant, en déployant et en maintenant des outils d'analyse d'images personnalisés et des pipelines automatisés pour extraire des mesures de configuration cellulaire complexe, en collaborant étroitement avec des équipes d'ingénierie numérique, de bioinformatique et de pathologie numérique pour faire évoluer les données cellulaires dans des réseaux de projets accessibles.
• Couverture des données, système de gestion de l'information de laboratoire (SIGI) et établissement de rapports : Effectuer une analyse rigoureuse des données, des évaluations des procédures critiques et des rapports internes appropriés sur les données de la phase d'étude au sein du SIGI, en agissant à titre de diffuseur principal pour fournir des résultats.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed. At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics. This position is located in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, a department within the Pharmaceutical Sciences function. We drive the non-clinical safety assessment of drug candidates from small molecules to complex biological products during the discovery and development phases at Roche. The Opportunity As an engaged Digital Pathologist, you will play a pivotal role in the development, validation, and implementation of pathology investigations and the application of computational pathology approaches for translational safety assessment. Your primary responsibility will be to propose, conduct, and report computational toxicologic pathology approaches to understand mechanisms of toxicity, leveraging modern tools to maximise scientific insights, drive innovation, and advance our therapeutic pipeline. You will support the automation of pathology algorithms, workflows, and platforms, remaining accountable for the scientific delivery of pathology data to inform risk assessment across projects ranging from small molecules to complex biological products.
• Core Portfolio Toxicologic Pathology : Provide expert pathology support in preclinical development, aligning toxicity study designs with current science and regulatory guidelines. Conduct qualitative and quantitative (histo)pathologic evaluations for discovery and development toxicology studies, including GLP-compliant studies. Peer-review histopathologic data and interpretations from internal or CRO pathologists per established SOPs. Integrate clinical pathology data (haematology, clinical chemistry) with histopathology findings for a holistic, mechanistic interpretation of toxicity. Deliver clear, concise test result interpretations and author pathology sections for Research Reports, regulatory filings (e.g., IND/CTA), and governance presentations.
• Algorithm Architecture & Image Analysis Deployment : Propose, build, test, and implement custom image analysis solutions and algorithms to automate cell and biomarker quantification on scanned tissue. Oversee the integration of ML and non-ML software to detect, segment, and score complex tissue morphologies. Extract high-dimensional spatial features and quantitative metrics from multiplexed or standard IHC and ISH slides. Transform comp

IND / CTA) und Governance-Präsentationen.

Intégrer les données de pathologie clinique (hématologie, chimie clinique) avec les résultats de l'histopathologie pour une interprétation globale et mécaniste de la toxicité. Superviser l'intégration des logiciels ML et non-ML pour détecter, segmenter et marquer des morphologies tissulaires complexes. Extraire des caractéristiques spatiales haute dimension et des mesures quantitatives des diapositives IHC et ISH standard ou multiplexées. Transformer comp
