jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to orchestrate the supply networks that make life-saving diagnostics possible? As our Senior Sourcing Manager in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will be a key part of our global sourcing operations. You will lead end-to-end sourcing projects within our diagnostic portfolios, mentor a rising team of Sourcing Managers, and serve as a key advisor to executive leadership. If you thrive on complexity and want to feel a direct impact on the delivery of life-saving diagnostics to patients worldwide, this is where you belong.
To support our rapid growth, we are hiring a cohort of Senior Sourcing Managers who will be aligned to one of two specialized technology teams: Near Patient Care (NPC), Sensors & Cartridges, and External Manufacturing (EM) or Active Diagnostic Ingredients (ADI), Reagents, and Instruments.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Sourcing Lead, and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will be part of a regional team of Senior Sourcing Managers and Sourcing Managers, managing relationships with other DOP stakeholders (Category, Delivery) as well as external suppliers and contract manufacturers.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor with responsibilities to mentor junior team members.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing & contracting excellence, financial value, and compliance across the network footprint. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics—including PPV savings, preferred supplier share, and shortened cycle times—to deliver bottom-line value while tracking stakeholder satisfaction.

• Sourcing & Analysis: Executing global sourcing activities, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and NPI benchmarking in close collaboration with Category and New Product Introductions (NPI) managers.

• Contract & Document Management: Setting up and reviewing high-complexity contracts (e.g., MSAs) and purchasing documentation, while accurately managing their lifecycle repository and renewals.

• Operational Excellence & SME Leadership: Acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to simplify workflows, analyze site user requirements for best-value methods, and ensure strict compliance with global policies.

• Bottleneck Resolution & CSR: Partnering with support functions like Accounts Payable (AP) to clear supplier-related administrative bottlenecks, while championing supply base CSR initiatives (diversity, sustainability, ethical practices).

• Conflict & Exposure: Managing high-stakes conflicts regarding competing project priorities or supplier selections, and delivering high-frequency monthly/quarterly updates to the CoE LT and DPLT.

Who you are

We strive to keep our standards high and look for candidates who can provide direction and mentor colleagues across different locations.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Sei pronto per orchestrare le reti di approvvigionamento che rendono possibile la diagnostica salvavita? Come nostro Senior Sourcing Manager a Sant Cugat, Spagna, sarete una parte fondamentale delle nostre operazioni di approvvigionamento globale. Potrai condurre progetti di sourcing end-to-end all'interno dei nostri portafogli di assistenza ai pazienti vicini (NPC), sensori e cartucce, e di fabbricazione esterna (EM), mentore un team crescente di Sourcing Managers, e servire come consulente chiave per la leadership esecutiva. Se si prospera sulla complessità e si desidera sentire un impatto diretto sulla consegna di diagnostica salvavita ai pazienti in tutto il mondo, questo è dove si appartiene.
• Linea di segnalazione: La posizione riporta direttamente al Piombo Sourcing – NPC, sensori e cartucce, e la fabbricazione esterna (EM) e fa parte del Centro di Eccellenza di Procurement (CoE).
• Team Wider e stakeholders: Faremo parte di un team regionale di Senior Sourcing Managers e Sourcing Managers, gestire i rapporti con altri stakeholder DOP (Category, Delivery) e fornitori esterni e produttori di contratti.
• Tipo di ruolo: Un singolo contributor con responsabilità per i membri della squadra junior.
• Impatto: Lei guida il sourcing globale e contrae l'eccellenza, il valore finanziario e la conformità attraverso l'impronta della rete. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Prestazioni & Risparmio: Guidare metriche chiave - tra cui il risparmio PPV, la quota di fornitore preferita e i tempi di ciclo ridotti - per fornire valore di linea inferiore durante il monitoraggio della soddisfazione degli stakeholder.
• Sourcing & Analysis: Esecuzione di attività di approvvigionamento globale, processi standard (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), e benchmarking NPI in stretta collaborazione con i manager di Categoria e Nuove Introduzioni prodotto (NPI).
• Gestione dei contratti e dei documenti: Impostazione e revisione dei contratti di alta complessità (ad esempio, MSAs) e documentazione di acquisto, mentre gestiscono con precisione i loro repository e rinnovi del ciclo di vita.
• Eccellenza Operativa & PMI Leadership: Agire come Soggetto esperto di materia (SME) per semplificare i flussi di lavoro, analizzare i requisiti degli utenti del sito per i metodi di migliore valore e garantire una rigorosa conformità alle politiche globali.
• Risoluzione & CSR del collo di bottiglia: Partner con funzioni di supporto come Accounts Payable (AP) per sgomberare i colli di bottiglia amministrativi relativi ai fornitori, pur sostenendo le iniziative di base di fornitura CSR (diversità, sostenibilità, pratiche etiche).
• Conflict & Exposure: Gestione di conflitti di alto livello per quanto riguarda le priorità dei progetti concorrenti o le selezioni dei fornitori, e fornire aggiornamenti mensili / trimestrali ad alta frequenza al CoE LT e al DPLT. Chi sei Ci sforziamo di mantenere i nostri standard elevati e cercare candidati che possono fornire direzione e colleghi mentore in diverse posizioni.
• Istruzione: Una laurea universitaria (Business o Scienze della Vita preferita) è necessaria; un MBA o certificazioni equivalenti e professionali (ad esempio, CIPS, ISM) sono desiderabili.
• Esperienza: 5-7 anni di esperienza

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de la prestation des services – rédaction médicale

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
At Roche, we combine science and digital innovation to deliver life-changing medicines and diagnostics globally. Behind our success is the global Roche content and digital services Lab, a cutting-edge unit driving scalable, high-quality content production across the enterprise.

We are seeking a structured, visionary Service Delivery Lead (SDL) to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will be accountable for ensuring effective, scalable, and high-quality operational service delivery within our global Medical Writing and core content ecosystem. You will oversee operational governance across both internal teams and external vendors, ensuring our communications remain scientifically accurate, regulatory-compliant, and impactful.

The Role: What You Will Do
As an SDL, you will be the operational engine and accountable owner for day-to-day service delivery performance within your scope. You will bridge the gap between creative storytelling, medical writing expertise, and rigorous operational governance.
Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Lead Medical Writing Services: Oversee Medical Writing services, ensuring that content production perfectly aligns with therapeutic guidelines, business needs, and strict regulatory standards.

• Harmonize Workflows: Manage and streamline cross-pillar content processes and workflows between medical writing and other core digital content functions.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate closely with Compliance and Medical Affairs to maintain a perfect balance between creative brand storytelling and regulatory requirements.

• Operational Governance: Implement, monitor, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), delivery frameworks, KPIs, and SLAs to guarantee consistent and measurable service execution.

• Stakeholder & Vendor Orchestration: Serve as the central coordination point between internal Business Leads, GDH Leads, and external delivery partners to ensure structured, transparent operations.

• Drive Continuous Improvement: Analyze service performance data, monitor metrics, identify inefficiencies, and execute structured improvement initiatives using defined governance frameworks.

• Future-Ready Innovation: Ensure cost-conscious, scalable delivery models while actively driving the adoption of modern technologies—including GenAI where applicable—to maximize efficiency.

• Capacity & Incident Management: Coordinate operational capacity planning for workload balance, and manage service incidents or escalations with rigorous root-cause follow-up.

• Collaboration with business partners in Switzerland, this position is based in Malaysia will need to work flexible hours . Occasionally—though not regularly—need to work during Malaysian evening hours.

Who You Are
You thrive within structured governance environments and are highly comfortable balancing operational oversight with executive stakeholder alignment. You are an expert at anticipating risks, addressing delivery challenges proactively, and championing a culture of continuous service improvement. Process integrity, performance transparency, and service consistency are at the core of how you operate.

Your Experience & Background

• 7–10 years of relevant experience in service delivery management, operational governance, or structured digital/content operations environments (corporate or agency setting).

• A strong, demonstrated background in the delivery of medical writing services , with personal experience as a medical writer consider

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen. An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft und Innovation ermöglicht die pRED-Organisation Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) die Entdeckung und Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Therapeutika in optimalen Dosen in relevanten Populationen mit einer Vision für die Energieübersetzung, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Genauigkeit unserer Vorhersagen und die Beschleunigung der Entwicklung von Medikamenten von morgen. Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires et changeantes. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, pharmacologie de la traduction et biomarqueurs —, nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain. L'opportunité En tant qu'associé en toxicologie d'investigation, vous jouez un rôle central dans l'élaboration, la validation, la mise en oeuvre et l'exécution d'essais non cliniques de culture cellulaire in vitro pour l'évaluation de l'innocuité translationnelle. Dans ce rôle pratique de laboratoire, vous exploitez des outils scientifiques modernes pour maximiser les connaissances, stimuler l'innovation et faire progresser notre pipeline thérapeutique dans un environnement hautement collaboratif. Principales responsabilités :
• Fournir des données scientifiques de haute qualité pour les essais de toxicologie in vitro réglementés et non réglementés modernes afin d'éclairer l'évaluation des risques dans l'ensemble des projets de découverte et de développement.
• Appuyer l'élaboration, la mise en oeuvre et l'analyse de données de nouveaux modèles prédictifs de sécurité in vitro.
• Effectuer une analyse précise des données, gérer les rapports internes au sein du Système de gestion de l'information de laboratoire (SGGI) et présenter les principales constatations aux intervenants internes.
• Optimiser les processus de laboratoire en continu pour améliorer la qualité, l'efficacité et les normes de sécurité.
• S'engager de façon proactive auprès d'équipes de matrices interfonctionnelles des sciences pharmaceutiques afin de s'aligner sur les jalons du projet et de hiérarchiser les calendriers des laboratoires.
• Établir et entretenir des relations professionnelles avec des fournisseurs externes et des fournisseurs de technologie pour évaluer et intégrer les technologies de laboratoire de prochaine génération. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel de laboratoire curieux, collaboratif et axé sur les détails passionné par l'avancement des soins de santé par la science de pointe. Vous apportez une solide connaissance fondamentale de la biologie cellulaire et vous prospèrez dans des environnements dynamiques et organisés en matrice. Qualifications et compétences :
• Un apprentissage comme technicien de laboratoire de biologie, ou un baccalauréat en biologie cellulaire, en biotechnologie, en génie biomédical, en pharmacologie, en toxicologie ou dans une discipline scientifique connexe.
• Un minimum de 3 ans d'expérience pratique dans un laboratoire de culture cellulaire de niveau de biosécurité 2 (BSL2) avec manipulation de cellules primaires et/ou iPSC.
• Expertise démontrée dans les techniques de culture cellulaire des mammifères, y compris l'expérience de modèles in vitro complexes, d'organoïdes ou de systèmes d'organes sur puce.
• Connaissance des technologies d'imagerie de pointe, telles que l'imagerie à haut contenu ou l'imagerie confocale, ainsi que de la familiarité avec l'imagerie

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

Within the Clinical Pharmacology Section in the Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology Department, this position operates globally, is deeply embedded within cross-functional matrix project teams and can support multiple of Roche's focus disease areas (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology).

The Opportunity

In this role, you will lead the scientific advancement of clinical programs by serving as the core quantitative and clinical pharmacology lead within cross-functional project teams. You will drive all aspects of Clinical Pharmacology (CP) across all development phases and strategically apply Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) approaches to optimise trial designs, justify dose selections, inform development decisions and mitigate risks across both early and late-stage development. Your scope will be modality-agnostic, giving you oversight that spans small molecules, large molecules, and novel platforms.

• Strategic & Quantitative Plan Execution: Actively contribute to the development of clinical development strategies, including the design of clinical trials and lead the development, implementation, and execution of the Clinical Pharmacology and MIDD strategies for assigned assets across all development phases. Translate Clinical Pharmacology principles into predictive models that guide dose/regimen selection, drug-drug interactions (DDI), special population strategies, pediatric extrapolations and geographic/ethnic bridging.

• Modelling & Simulation Mastery: Apply pharmacometric methodologies (such as population PK/PD, PBPK, or QSP) to perform clinical trial simulations, characterise exposure-response relationships, and define quantitative criteria for early, data-driven go/no-go decisions. You bring proficiency in pharmacometric software (e.g., NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB).

• Regulatory & Asset Maximisation: Lead the CP sections of major regulatory documents (including IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Ensure high-quality, fit-for-purpose submission documents using Roche initiatives like lean development authoring and digital submission excellence. Represent the company as a subject matter expert in health authority interactions.

• Business Development: Provide clinical and quantitative pharmacology exp

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation Recherche Pharmaceutique et Développement Débutal (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformateurs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires et changeantes. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, pharmacologie de la traduction et biomarqueurs —, nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain. Au sein de la Section de pharmacologie clinique du Département de pharmacologie clinique quantitative, ce poste fonctionne à l'échelle mondiale, est profondément ancré dans les équipes de projets de matrices interfonctionnelles et peut soutenir plusieurs des domaines d'intervention de Roche (CVRM, immunologie, neuroscience, oncologie et ophtalmologie). L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez l'avancement scientifique des programmes cliniques en servant de chef de file en pharmacologie quantitative et clinique au sein des équipes de projets interfonctionnelles. Vous dirigerez tous les aspects de la pharmacologie clinique (PC) dans toutes les phases de développement et appliquerez stratégiquement des approches de développement de médicaments en connaissance de cause (PDIM) pour optimiser les conceptions d'essais, justifier la sélection des doses, éclairer les décisions de développement et atténuer les risques au début et à la fin du développement. jobs.title: Alternant - Marketing Accès Régional (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Présentation de l'équipe :
Rattaché(e) au directeur de l’Unité Accès Regional au sein de la Direction Accès, Affaires Publiques et Communication, ta mission sera de garantir l'accès à notre portefeuille produits Roche auprès des établissements de soins et des officines, dans les meilleures conditions et dans le respect du bon usage, au bénéfice des patients.

Quel sera ton impact ?

En étroite collaboration avec les autres équipes de la direction Accès, Affaires Publiques et Communication (accès national, médicoéconomie…), les autres unités de l’entreprise (médical, marketing produit, omnicanalité…) et les squad parcours, tu contribueras :
● Lancement de produits innovants : Coordonner les référencements hospitaliers ou mise en place grossiste-répartiteur, en partenariat avec les équipes produits et les équipes terrain
● Lien ville-hôpital : Développer des solutions d'accompagnement pour les produits prescrits à l’hôpital et dispensés en ville, afin d’assurer une bonne coordination entre la ville et l'hôpital (pharmaciens, URPS, DAC, OMEDIT…).
● Nouvelles initiatives : Contribuer à faire évoluer notre offre et nos services par des propositions différenciantes (événements, site internet, dispositifs d’accompagnement), et à leur communication interne et externe en capitalisant sur les différents canaux de communication (omnicanalité).
● Gestion de projets marketing : Soutenir la création de Newsletters, d'événements et d'outils pour l'équipe terrain (slidedecks, brochures).
● Veille active : Surveiller l'environnement de l'accès aux soins en ville et à l'hôpital et anticiper les changements impactant notre écosystème.
● Analyse d'impact : Mesurer les résultats des actions menées à l'aide d'indicateurs pertinents.

Ton ADN

• Tu es de formation supérieure scientifique et tu recherches une alternance pour ton master en marketing ou école de commerce

• Tu aimes travailler sur des sujets diverses, tu as la capacité à travailler en transverse, à convaincre et fédérer, tu es force de proposition, autonome, ouvert d'esprit, rigoureux et organisé

• Pour toi, un intitulé de poste n’est pas une définition figée de ce que tu es, mais le point de départ d’une carrière.

• Tu as des connaissances sur le système de santé français, tu es à l’aise la gestion de projets et les outils bureautiques (Google suite et les autres)

• Tu veux maîtriser ton développement professionnel.

• Tu recherches l’entreprise qui te donnera l’opportunité d’approfondir tes connaissances, et ce, quelle que soit ta fonction, ton lieu de travail.

Alternance de 12 mois à compter de Septembre 2026
Poste basé à Paris

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

• Tu es intéressé(e) par le marketing au travers l’organisation d’événements, de congrès et de supports pour les équipes terrains mais tu cherches à t’ouvrir à d’autres univers comme l’accès au marché ? Ce poste est une belle opportunité de découvrir ces deux facettes.

• Cette alternance va te permettre de comprendre et maîtriser par des cas d’usage au quotidien, les différents aspects de l’accès régional via notamment la mise à disposition de nos innovations thérapeutiques auprès d’un large panel de clients (hôpitaux, grossistes, institutionnels en régions…) et la définition /mise en place / suivi / analyse d’impact de la stratégie marketing permettant d’atteindre ce but

• Notre laboratoire dispose d'un environnement collaboratif et stimulant, où tu pourras travailler aux côtés de professionnels expérimentés et passionnés, ce qui facilitera ton apprentissage

En étroite collaboration avec les autres équipes de la direction Accès, Affaires Publiques et Communication (accès national, médicoéconomie…), les autres unités de l’entreprise (médical, marketing produit, omnicanalité…) et les squad parcours, tu contribueras : ● Lancement de produits innovants : Coordonner les référencements hospitaliers ou mise en place grossiste-répartiteur, en partenariat avec les équipes produits et les équipes terrain ● Lien ville-hôpital : Développer des solutions d'accompagnement pour les produits prescrits à l’hôpital et dispensés en ville, afin d’assurer une bonne coordination entre la ville et l'hôpital (pharmaciens, URPS, DAC, OMEDIT…). ● Nouvelles initiatives : Contribuer à faire évoluer notre offre et nos services par des propositions différenciantes (événements, site internet, dispositifs d’accompagnement), et à leur communication interne et externe en capitalisant sur les différents canaux de communication (omnicanalité). ● Gestion de projets marketing : Soutenir la création de Newsletters, d'événements et d'outils pour l'équipe terrain (slidedecks, brochures). ● Veille active : Surveiller l'environnement de l'accès aux soins en ville et à l'hôpital et anticiper les changements impactant notre écosystème. ● Analyse d'impact : Mesurer les résultats des actions menées à l'aide d'indicateurs pertinents. Ton ADN
• Tu es de formation supérieure scientifique et tu recherches une alternance pour ton master en marketing ou école de commerce
• Tu aimes travailler sur des sujets diverses, tu as la capacité à travailler en transverse, à convaincre et fédérer, tu es force de proposition, autonome, ouvert d'esprit, rigoureux et organisé
• Pour toi, un intitulé de poste n’est pas une définition figée de ce que tu es, mais le point de départ d’une carrière.
• Tu as des connaissances sur le système de santé français, tu es à l’aise la gestion de projets et les outils bureautiques (Google suite et les autres)
• Tu veux maîtriser ton développement professionnel.
• Tu recherches l’entreprise qui te donnera l’opportunité d’approfondir tes connaissances, et ce, quelle que soit ta fonction, ton lieu de travail. Alternance de 12 mois à compter de Septembre 2026 Poste basé à Paris Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
• Tu es intéressé(e) par le marketing au travers l’organisation d’événements, de congrès et de supports pour les équipes terrains mais tu cherches à t’ouvrir à d’autres univers comme l’accès au marché ? Ce poste est une belle opportunité de découvrir ces deux facettes.
• Cette alternance va te permettre de comprendre et maîtriser par des cas d’usage au quotidien, les différents aspects de l’accès régional via notamment la mise à disposition de nos innovations thérapeutiques auprès d’un large panel de clients (hôpitaux, grossistes, institutionnels en régions…) et la définition /mise en place / suivi / analyse d’impact de la stratégie marketing permettant d’atteindre ce but
• Notre laboratoire dispose d'un environnement collaboratif et stimulant, où tu pourras travailler aux côtés de professionnels expérimentés et passionnés, ce qui facilitera ton apprentissage

jobs.title: Clinical Pharmacology Lead - Principal Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

Within the Clinical Pharmacology Section in the Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology Department, this position operates globally, is deeply embedded within cross-functional matrix project teams and can support multiple of Roche's focus disease areas (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology).

The Opportunity

In this role, you will lead the scientific advancement of clinical programs by serving as the core quantitative and clinical pharmacology lead within cross-functional project teams. You will drive all aspects of Clinical Pharmacology (CP) across all development phases and strategically apply Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) approaches to optimise trial designs, justify dose selections, inform development decisions and mitigate risks across both early and late-stage development. Your scope will be modality-agnostic, giving you oversight that spans small molecules, large molecules, and novel platforms.

• Strategic & Quantitative Plan Execution: Actively contribute to the development of clinical development strategies, including the design of clinical trials and lead the development, implementation, and execution of the Clinical Pharmacology and MIDD strategies for assigned assets across all development phases. Translate Clinical Pharmacology principles into predictive models that guide dose/regimen selection, drug-drug interactions (DDI), special population strategies, pediatric extrapolations and geographic/ethnic bridging.

• Modelling & Simulation Mastery: Apply pharmacometric methodologies (such as population PK/PD, PBPK, or QSP) to perform clinical trial simulations, characterise exposure-response relationships, and define quantitative criteria for early, data-driven go/no-go decisions. You bring proficiency in pharmacometric software (e.g., NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB).

• Regulatory & Asset Maximisation: Lead the CP sections of major regulatory documents (including IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Ensure high-quality, fit-for-purpose submission documents using Roche initiatives like lean development authoring and digital submission excellence. Represent the company as a subject matter expert in health authority interactions.

• Business Development: Provide clinical and quantitative pharmacology exp

Unsere Mission ist es, die Vorhersagegenauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, die Dosierungsstrategien für die richtige Patientenpopulation zu optimieren und die Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Therapien von morgen zu beschleunigen. Innerhalb der Sektion Klinische Pharmakologie in der Abteilung Quantitative Klinische Pharmakologie ist diese Position global tätig, ist tief in funktionsübergreifende Matrix-Projektteams eingebettet und kann mehrere der Roche-Schwerpunkte (CVRM, Immunologie, Neurowissenschaften, Onkologie und Ophthalmologie) unterstützen. Die Chance In dieser Rolle führen Sie die wissenschaftliche Weiterentwicklung klinischer Programme durch die zentrale quantitative und klinische Pharmakologie-Führung in funktionsübergreifenden Projektteams. Sie treiben alle Aspekte der Klinischen Pharmakologie (CP) über alle Entwicklungsphasen hinweg und wenden strategisch modellinformierte Arzneimittelentwicklungsansätze (MIDD) an, um die Versuchsplanung zu optimieren, Dosisauswahl zu rechtfertigen, Entwicklungsentscheidungen zu informieren und Risiken sowohl in der frühen als auch in der späten Entwicklung zu mindern. Ihr Umfang wird modalitäts-agnostisch sein, was Ihnen Aufsicht über kleine Moleküle, große Moleküle und neuartige Plattformen gibt. - Strategische und Quantitative Planausführung: Aktiv zur Entwicklung klinischer Entwicklungsstrategien beitragen, einschließlich der Gestaltung klinischer Studien und führen die Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Durchführung der klinischen Pharmakologie und MIDD-Strategien für zugewiesene Vermögenswerte über alle Entwicklungsphasen hinweg. Übersetzen Sie die Prinzipien der klinischen Pharmakologie in prädiktive Modelle, die Dosis/Regimen-Auswahl, Arzneimittel-Wirkungsbeziehungen (DDI), spezielle Populationsstrategien, pädiatrische Extrapolationen und geografische/ethnische Überbrückung leiten. - Modellierung & Simulation Mastery: Apply pharmacometrische Methodologien (wie Population PK/PD, PBPK oder QSP) um klinische Testsimulationen durchzuführen, Expositions-Response-Beziehungen zu charakterisieren und quantitative Kriterien für frühe, datengetriebene Go/No-Go-Entscheidungen zu definieren. descriptionByLocale.fr: La position Dans Roche, l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins du monde, les plus difficiles et non satisfaits en matière de santé. Chez PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont habilités et inspirés pour faire avancer une innovation extraordinaire et changeante à la vitesse. Au carrefour de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation pRED,s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des traitements sûrs et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision pour la traduction de puissance, améliore continuellement l'exactitude de nos prévisions et accélère le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant sans heurt nos trois piliers fondamentaux – Sécurité traductionnelle, Pharmacologie Translationnelle et Biomarqueurs – nous conduisons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, de l'évaluation des cibles au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les populations de patients appropriées et d'accélérer le développement des traitements sûrs et efficaces de demain. Au sein de la Section de pharmacologie clinique du Département de pharmacologie clinique quantitative, ce poste fonctionne à l'échelle mondiale, est profondément intégré dans les équipes de projets multi-fonctionnels et peut soutenir plusieurs domaines de maladies de Roche (CVRM, immunologie, neurosciences, oncologie et ophtalmologie). o Vous dirigerez tous les aspects de la pharmacologie clinique (PC) dans toutes les phases de développement et appliquerez stratégiquement des approches de développement de médicaments en connaissance de cause (MDDM) pour optimiser les modèles d'essai, justifier la sélection des doses, éclairer les décisions de développement et atténuer les risques au début et à la fin du développement. Votre champ d'application sera agnostique-de modalité, vous donnant une surveillance qui couvre les petites molécules, les grandes molécules et les nouvelles plateformes. - Exécution du plan stratégique et quantitatif : Contribuer activement au développement de stratégies de développement clinique, y compris la conception d'essais cliniques et diriger le développement, la mise en oeuvre et l'exécution des stratégies de pharmacologie clinique et de MIDD pour les actifs assignés à toutes les phases de développement. Traduire les principes de pharmacologie clinique en modèles prédictifs qui guident la sélection des doses/régimes, les interactions médicament-médicament (DDI), les stratégies de population spéciales, les extrapolations pédiatriques et les transitions géographiques/ethniques. - Maîtrise de la modélisation et de la simulation : Appliquer des méthodologies pharmacométriques (comme la population PK/PD, PBPK ou QSP) pour effectuer des simulations d'essais cliniques, caractériser les relations exposition-réponse et définir des critères quantitatifs pour les décisions précoces, fondées sur des données, aller/pas de go. Vous apportez la compétence dans les logiciels pharmacométriques (p. ex., NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB). - Maximisation de la réglementation et des actifs : Diriger les sections PC des principaux documents réglementaires (dont IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Assurer la qualité des documents de soumission adaptés aux besoins, en utilisant des initiatives Roche comme l'auteur de développement maigre et l'excellence numérique de la soumission.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is in Analytical Data Science, a core function within Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across Development at Roche. PDD Analytical Data Science teams are mobilized across the portfolio to generate data-driven insights, identify opportunities for scale, and implement impactful solutions.

PDD Analytical Data Science is recognized as a leading hub for top industry talent, operating as an agile workforce to deliver regulatory commitments across the portfolio. We identify, influence, and adopt industry-leading digital and automation solutions, develop analytical approaches to support exploratory analyses, and align statistical programming practices across both early- and late-stage clinical development.

The Opportunity:

The Analytical Data Science Programmer is a key contributor to the clinical study team, responsible for transforming statistical analysis plans into high-quality, traceable programming deliverables. This includes both static and dynamic outputs, such as tables, listings, figures, and interactive data visualizations or dashboards. The role involves creating and validating datasets in accordance with Study Data Tabulation Model and Analysis Data Model standards, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and Roche standards. In addition to supporting regulatory submissions, the ADS Programmer plays a critical role in generating data insights through platforms such as the Insight Engine, enabling real-time exploration and interpretation of diverse clinical and exploratory data. This role contributes to a modern, insight-driven development environment by facilitating robust, timely, and decision-enabling analytics across clinical programs.

• You independently develop, validate, and maintain datasets and statistical outputs for clinical trials, including Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) datasets, Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets, and tables, listings, and figures (TLFs), ensuring programming accuracy, traceability, and compliance with internal processes and regulatory expectations

• You develop and support programming outputs across a wide range of data types, including exploratory biomarker data and real-world data, to support both regulatory and scientific objectives

• You collaborate on exploratory analyses that span disease areas and therapeutic areas, enabling insight generation to inform drug development strategies

• You support the creation and refinement of interactive tools and analytical applications (e.g., dashboards or visual data platforms) that enable dynamic exploration of integrated datasets by scientific and clinical teams

• You provide programming leadership for assigned studies, coordinating deliverables across internal and external programming partners to meet study timelines and requirements

• You interpret statistical analysis plans and translate them into executable programming specifications to ensure scientific rigor in outputs

• You troubleshoot and resolve technical programming challenges with limited supervision, proactively identifying risks and implementing effective solutions while meeting timelines

• You contribute to the design and maintenance of standard

Il ruolo riguarda la creazione e la convalida di set di dati in conformità con gli standard del Modello di Scheda di Studio e del Modello di Dati di Analisi, garantendo il rispetto dei requisiti normativi e degli standard Roche. • L'utente sviluppa, convalida e mantiene in modo indipendente set di dati e output statistici per gli studi clinici, inclusi i dataset del Modello di Tabulazione dei Dati di Studio (SDTM), i dataset del Modello di analisi (ADaM) e le tabelle, gli elenchi e le cifre (TLF), garantendo precisione di programmazione, tracciabilità e conformità ai processi interni e alle aspettative normative
• Sviluppi e supporti gli output di programmazione in una vasta gamma di tipi di dati, compresi i dati di biomarcatori esplorativi e i dati del mondo reale, per supportare obiettivi sia normativi che scientifici
• Collabori su analisi esplorative che abbracciano aree di malattia e aree terapeutiche, consentendo una generazione di informazioni per informare le strategie di sviluppo della droga
• Supporti la creazione e la raffinatezza di strumenti interattivi e applicazioni analitiche (ad esempio, dashboard o piattaforme di dati visivi) che consentono l'esplorazione dinamica di dataset integrati da parte di team scientifici e clinici
• Fornite la leadership di programmazione per gli studi assegnati, coordinando i deliverable tra i partner di programmazione interni ed esterni per soddisfare le tempistiche e i requisiti di studio
• Lei interpreta i piani di analisi statistica e li traduce in specifiche di programmazione eseguibili per garantire rigore scientifico nelle uscite
• La risoluzione dei problemi e la risoluzione delle sfide di programmazione tecnica con una supervisione limitata, l'identificazione proattiva dei rischi e l'implementazione di soluzioni efficaci durante la riunione dei termini
• Contribuisci alla progettazione e manutenzione di standard

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position sits within the Clinical Pharmacology Section in the Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology Department in pRED / Pharmaceutical Sciences, but maintains a company-wide footprint. The scope of influence transcends individual teams, regularly partnering across major organisational boundaries and cross-entities (e.g., pRED, gRED, PDR) to shape institutional knowledge.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will serve as a senior enterprise leader and expert in Clinical Pharmacology, including Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) and Quantitative Medicine, solving high-risk development challenges and embedding advanced computational capabilities to accelerate the R&D pipeline. Operating on a senior strategic and scientific track, you will hold high accountability for shaping long-term scientific and development strategies and capital allocation for entire disease areas or global functions. Additionally, you will drive high-stakes corporate due diligence for licensing opportunities, lead complex global health authority negotiations, and act as a strategic mentor across the wider organisation.

• High-Impact Strategic and Scientific Leadership : Formulate and evolve overarching Clinical Pharmacology and MIDD strategies for high-profile molecules or portfolio segments (e.g. Antibody-Drug-Conjugates) of Roche's focus disease areas (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology), ensuring alignment with end-to-end development goals.

• Pioneering Technical Innovation : Identify, develop, and integrate state-of-the-art computational methodologies into workflows, stimulating the broader scientific community to experiment and challenge development paradigms.

• Complex Submissions & Regulatory Defence : Provide authoritative guidance on highly complex or unprecedented submission strategies (e.g., pediatric extrapolations, novel modalities) and serve as a primary counter-partner to health authorities and KOLs.

• Strategic Business Development : Lead Clinical Pharmacology and modelling evaluations and actively contribute to the development of Clinical Development Plans for high-stakes due diligence, in-licensing, and out-licensing opportunities to assess the path to value as well as the technical viability and risks of external

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti innovazione straordinaria e mutevole a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. Questa posizione si trova all'interno della Sezione Farmacologia Clinica nel Dipartimento di Farmacologia Clinica Quantitativa in Scienze pRED / Farmaceutiche, ma mantiene un'impronta aziendale. La portata dell'influenza trascende i singoli team, collaborando regolarmente tra i principali confini organizzativi e le intersezioni (ad esempio, pRED, gRED, PDR) per plasmare le conoscenze istituzionali. L'opportunità In questo ruolo, si servirà come leader di impresa senior e esperto in Farmacologia Clinica, tra cui Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) e Quantitative Medicine, risolvendo sfide di sviluppo ad alto rischio e incorporando capacità computazionali avanzate per accelerare la pipeline R&D. Operando su una traccia strategica e scientifica senior, si terrà alta responsabilitÃ per la definizione di strategie scientifiche e di sviluppo a lungo termine e allocazione di capitale per intere aree di malattia o funzioni globali. Inoltre, guiderai le due diligence aziendali ad alto livello per le opportunità di licenza, guiderai negoziazioni di autorità sanitarie globali complesse e agirai come mentore strategico in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Leadership strategica e scientifica di alto impatto: formulare ed evolvere le strategie cliniche di farmacologia e MIDD per le molecole di alto profilo o segmenti di portafoglio (ad esempio Antibody-Drug-Conjugates) delle aree di malattia di punta di Roche (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology e Ophthalmology), garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi di sviluppo end-to-end.
• Identificare, sviluppare e integrare metodologie computazionali all'avanguardia nei flussi di lavoro, stimolando la più ampia comunità scientifica a sperimentare e sfidare i paradigmi dello sviluppo.
• Submissions & Regulatory Defence: Fornire una guida autorevole su strategie di presentazione altamente complesse o senza precedenti (ad esempio, estrapolazioni pediatriche, nuove modalità) e servire come contro-partner primario alle autorità sanitarie e KOL.
• Sviluppo Strategico delle Imprese: Lead Clinical Pharmacology and modelling assessments e contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo di Piani di Sviluppo Clinico per un elevato fabbisogno di diligenza, in-licenziamento e opportunità per la valutazione del percorso di valore, nonché la fattibilità tecnica e i rischi di esterna

• Strategische und wissenschaftliche Führungsrolle mit hohem Einfluss: Formulierung und Entwicklung übergreifender klinischer Pharmakologie- und MIDD-Strategien für hochkarätige Moleküle oder Portfoliosegmente (z. B. Antikörper-Wirkstoff-Konjugate) der Roche-Fokus-Krankheitsbereiche (CVRM, Immunologie, Neurowissenschaften, Onkologie und Ophthalmologie), um die Ausrichtung auf die End-to-End-Entwicklungsziele sicherzustellen.
• Pionierhafte technische Innovation: Identifizieren, entwickeln und integrieren Sie modernste Computermethoden in Workflows, um die breitere wissenschaftliche Gemeinschaft zu ermutigen, Entwicklungsparadigmen zu experimentieren und herauszufordern.
• Komplexe Einreichungen und regulatorische Verteidigung: Geben Sie maßgebliche Leitlinien für hochkomplexe oder beispiellose Einreichungsstrategien (z. B. pädiatrische Extrapolationen, neuartige Modalitäten) und dienen Sie als primärer Gegenpartner für Gesundheitsbehörden und KOLs.
• Strategische Geschäftsentwicklung: Führen Sie klinische Pharmakologie- und Modellbewertungen und tragen Sie aktiv zur Entwicklung klinischer Entwicklungspläne für High-Stakes-Due-Diligence-, In-Licensing- und Out-Licensing-Möglichkeiten bei, um den Weg zum Wert sowie die technische Lebensfähigkeit und die Risiken externer Unternehmen zu bewerten

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires et changeantes. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, pharmacologie de la traduction et biomarqueurs —, nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain. Ce poste fait partie de la Section de pharmacologie clinique du Département de pharmacologie clinique quantitative en sciences pRED / Pharmaceutiques, mais conserve une empreinte à l'échelle de l'entreprise. L'étendue de l'influence transcende les équipes individuelles, s'associant régulièrement entre les grandes frontières organisationnelles et les entités (p. ex., pRED, gRED, PDR) pour façonner les connaissances institutionnelles. L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez le rôle de chef d'entreprise principal et d'expert en pharmacologie clinique, y compris le développement de médicaments en connaissance de cause (PDIM) et la médecine quantitative, en résolvant les défis de développement à risque élevé et en intégrant des capacités informatiques avancées pour accélérer le pipeline de R-D. Dans le cadre d'une démarche stratégique et scientifique de haut niveau, vous serez fortement responsable de l'élaboration de stratégies scientifiques et de développement à long terme et de l'affectation des capitaux pour l'ensemble des domaines de maladie ou des fonctions mondiales. De plus, vous dirigerez une diligence raisonnable de l'entreprise pour les possibilités d'octroi de licences, dirigerez des négociations complexes sur les autorités sanitaires mondiales et agirez comme un mentor stratégique dans toute l'organisation.
• Leadership stratégique et scientifique à haut impact : Formuler et développer des stratégies globales de pharmacologie clinique et de MIDD pour les molécules ou les segments de portefeuille à haut rayonnement (p. ex. anticorps-drogue-conjugués) des domaines d'intervention de Roche (CVRM, immunologie, neuroscience, oncologie et ophtalmologie), en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs de développement de bout en bout.
• Innovation technique pionnière : Identifier, développer et intégrer des méthodologies informatiques de pointe dans les flux de travail, en stimulant la communauté scientifique à expérimenter et à défier les paradigmes de développement.
• Soumissions complexes et défense réglementaire : Fournir des lignes directrices faisant autorité sur les stratégies de présentation très complexes ou sans précédent (p. ex. extrapolations pédiatriques, nouvelles modalités) et servir de principal contre-partenaire aux autorités de la santé et aux KOL.
• Développement stratégique des affaires : Diriger les évaluations de la pharmacologie clinique et de la modélisation et contribuer activement à l'élaboration de plans de développement clinique pour la diligence raisonnable élevée, l'octroi de licences et les possibilités de sous-licence pour évaluer la voie de la valeur ainsi que la viabilité technique et les risques de l'extérieur

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Within Pharma Research & Early Development (pRED), our Ophthalmology teams are redefining how precision medicine can transform the detection and treatment of complex retinal diseases. This is a rare opportunity to build a new function from the ground up — establishing an Ophthalmology Precision Medicine group at our Welwyn site that brings together biomarker science, advanced imaging, clinical expertise, and artificial intelligence. You will have the platform, pipeline, and resources to shape something truly new in one of the most dynamic areas of ophthalmic research.
The Opportunity

• Build a new Ophthalmology Precision Medicine function from the ground up — defining the vision, structure, and scientific direction for a group that integrates biomarkers, advanced imaging, clinical science, and AI across the pRED Ophthalmology portfolio.

• Lead a cross-functional expert team spanning translational medicine, imaging, clinical development, data science, and biomarker disciplines — ensuring precision medicine is at the heart of our Ophthalmology strategy.

• Bridge laboratory science and clinical practice by steering the generation of robust fluid- and imaging biomarker strategies that enable project and disease area decisions.

• Advance innovation in imaging science by directing cutting-edge ophthalmic imaging approaches including OCT, OCT-A, and FA to inform future clinical practice and therapeutic development.

• Enable translational insights through AI and data by integrating preclinical and clinical datasets using classical and next-generation analytical approaches.

• Influence portfolio strategy across multiple retinal diseases including neovascular AMD, diabetic macular edema, geographic atrophy, and intermediate AMD — driving the direction and future of clinical development and research.

• Represent Roche externally through strong partnerships with scientific experts, investigators, and the broader ophthalmology community — remaining at the forefront of innovation.

Who you are

• You are a board-certified ophthalmologist (MD or MD/PhD) with deep expertise in ophthalmology, translational medicine, or biomedical sciences.

• You are a recognised expert in the retina space, with a strong scientific publication record and standing as a key opinion leader in your field.

• You have deep knowledge of ophthalmic imaging technologies (OCT, OCT-A, FA) and experience with imaging analysis or Reading Centre environments.

• You are experienced in integrating preclinical and clinical data to support proof of biology, efficacy, and safety strategies, with some exposure to clinical trials.

• You are a collaborative scientific leader who thrives in matrix environments, energised by innovation and the opportunity to build something new.

Preferred

• Experience applying AI or machine learning to ophthalmic imaging analysis or clinical data interpretation.

• Prior experience in pharmaceutical drug development programmes for retinal diseases.

• Flexible working arrangements may be available for exceptional candidates who wish to maintain some clinical activity alongside this role.

If building a world-class precision medicine function and shaping the future of ophthalmic therapy development is the kind of challenge that excites you — apply now and help us bring transformative medicines to patients faster.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione All'interno di Pharma Research & Early Development (pRED), i nostri team di oftalmologia stanno ridefinindo come la medicina di precisione può trasformare il rilevamento e il trattamento di malattie renali complesse. Questa è una rara opportunità di costruire una nuova funzione da zero — che stabilisce un gruppo di Medicina di Precisione di Oftalmologia nel nostro sito di Welwyn che riunisce la scienza del biomarcatore, l'imaging avanzato, la competenza clinica e l'intelligenza artificiale. Avrete la piattaforma, la pipeline e le risorse per modellare qualcosa di veramente nuovo in una delle aree più dinamiche della ricerca oftalmica. L'opportunità
• Costruire una nuova funzione di medicina di precisione di Oftalmologia da zero — definendo la visione, la struttura e la direzione scientifica per un gruppo che integra biomarcatori, imaging avanzato, scienza clinica e AI attraverso il portafoglio di oftalmologia pRED.
• Guidare un team esperto interfunzionale che comprende la medicina traduttiva, l'imaging, lo sviluppo clinico, la scienza dei dati e le discipline del biomarcatore — garantire la medicina di precisione è al centro della nostra strategia di oftalmologia.
• La scienza di laboratorio di bridge e la pratica clinica guidando la generazione di robuste strategie di biomarcatore fluido- e imaging che consentono decisioni di area di progetto e malattia.
• Avanzare l'innovazione nella scienza dell'imaging dirigendo approcci di imaging oftalmico all'avanguardia tra cui OCT, OCT-A e FA per informare la pratica clinica futura e lo sviluppo terapeutico.
• Abilitare le intuizioni traduttive attraverso l'intelligenza artificiale e i dati integrando set di dati preclinici e clinici utilizzando approcci analitici classici e di nuova generazione.
• La strategia del portafoglio di influenza su più malattie renali, tra cui AMD neovascolare, edema maculare diabetico, atrofia geografica e AMD intermedio, guida la direzione e il futuro dello sviluppo clinico e della ricerca.
• Rappresentare Roche esternamente attraverso forti partnership con esperti scientifici, ricercatori e la più ampia comunità oftalmologica — rimanendo all'avanguardia dell'innovazione. Chi sei
• Sei un oftalmologo certificato dal consiglio di amministrazione (MD o MD/PhD) con profonda esperienza in oftalmologia, medicina traduttiva, o scienze biomediche.
• Sei un esperto riconosciuto nello spazio retina, con un forte record di pubblicazione scientifica e in piedi come leader di opinione chiave nel tuo campo.
• Hai una profonda conoscenza delle tecnologie dell'imaging oftalmico (OCT, OCT-A, FA) e dell'esperienza con l'analisi delle immagini o gli ambienti del Centro di lettura.
• Siete esperti nell'integrazione di dati preclinici e clinici per sostenere la prova di biologia, efficacia e strategie di sicurezza, con qualche esposizione a studi clinici.
• Sei un leader scientifico collaborativo che prospera in ambienti matrici, stimolato dall'innovazione e dall'opportunità di costruire qualcosa di nuovo. Preferito
• Esperienza nell'applicazione dell'intelligenza artificiale o dell'apprendimento automatico all'analisi oculistica o all'interpretazione dei dati clinici.
• Esperienza prioritaria nei programmi di sviluppo di farmaci farmaceutici per le malattie retiniche.
• Le modalità di lavoro flessibili possono essere disponibili per i candidati eccezionali che desiderano mantenere una certa attività clinica a fianco di questo ruolo. Se costruire una funzione di medicina di precisione di livello mondiale e modellare il futuro dello sviluppo di terapia oftalmica è il tipo di sfida che ti eccita — applicare ora e aiutarci a portare i farmaci trasformativi ai pazienti più velocemente. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect (Demand to Pay, Travel & Expense Management) focuses on designing, implementing, and optimizing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex enterprise context. In this role, you will play a critical role in translating complex business requirements into technical designs for the T&E solutions which includes the Concur platform and other systems, ensuring seamless integration with other enterprise systems and driving continuous improvement. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for the T&E landscape, and serve as a key leader and point of escalation for Concur-related issues within the organization.

Your Responsibilities

• Design T&E solutions that meet product requirements and enterprise standards across a multiple-solution context, managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions while ensuring configurations adhere to data privacy (GDPR/CCPA) and audit requirements.

• Define and drive reference architectures, ensuring that Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), taxonomies, ontologies, and integration pathways are documented and published for the T&E product.

• Develop comprehensive architecture documentation and manage data flows between Concur and other enterprise systems, including Workday, SAP ERP, ServiceNow (EPP), IQVIA, and Oversight.

• Lead the design and management of non-standard integrations utilizing RESTful APIs, WebServices, and secure SFTP, leveraging middleware platforms such as Mulesoft and Denodo.

• Optimize system performance and business objectives by utilizing reporting systems and data platforms, including Concur Intelligence, Snowflake, and standard reporting configurations.

• Proactively contribute to the development of global Architecture Practices and provide technical oversight and mentoring to product teams.

• Maintain the roadmap for T&E solutions, evaluating external technology trends—such as AI-driven expense categorization and RPA— to enhance value and manage technical debt.

Who You Are

• You have a minimum of 10 years of experience in designing and implementing solutions within the Concur platform, with at least 5 years focused on integration enhancements to and from Concur Intelligence, Travel, and Expense.

• You possess expert-level knowledge of the Concur modules and a proven track record of integrating them with SAP ERP, HR systems (Workday), and other enterprise applications.

• You are experienced in RESTful API consumption, data transformation via middleware (Mulesoft/Denodo), and creating conceptual and logical data models.

• You are capable of maintaining a vision for multiple solutions and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape.

• You bring exceptional negotiation skills and the ability to communicate difficult concepts, influencing stakeholders to adopt different points of view or innovative solutions.

• You have a strong understanding of database concepts, SQL, web services, and XML/JSON data formats.

• You understand financial accounting principles and industry-specific T&E best practices; experience with pharmaceutical industry regulations is a significant plus.

• You hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field; a "Certified Professional - Expense Configuration" credential is preferred.

​
#RDT2026

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Warsaw G

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Solution Architect (Demand to Pay, Travel & Expense Management) si concentra sulla progettazione, l'implementazione e l'ottimizzazione di soluzioni business-driven, basate su standard e future-ready all'interno di un contesto aziendale complesso. In questo ruolo, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella traduzione di complessi requisiti aziendali in progetti tecnici per le soluzioni T&E che includono la piattaforma Concur e altri sistemi, garantendo un'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità con altri sistemi aziendali e la guida di miglioramento continuo. Condurrai gli altri a risolvere problemi complessi, mantenere la visione e la roadmap per il paesaggio T&E, e servire come leader chiave e punto di escalation per le questioni relative al Concur all'interno dell'organizzazione. Le tue responsabilità
• Soluzioni di progettazione T&E che soddisfano i requisiti dei prodotti e gli standard aziendali in un contesto a più soluzioni, gestione dei requisiti non funzionali (NFRs) e funzioni di fitness, assicurando le configurazioni attenersi alla privacy dei dati (GDPR/CCPA) e ai requisiti di audit.
• Definire e guidare architetture di riferimento, assicurando che l'Architettura Decision Records (ADR), tassonomie, onlogie e percorsi di integrazione sono documentati e pubblicati per il prodotto T&E.
• Sviluppare la documentazione completa dell'architettura e gestire i flussi di dati tra Concur e altri sistemi aziendali, tra cui Workday, SAP ERP, ServiceNow (EPP), IQVIA e Oversight.
• Guidare la progettazione e la gestione di integrazioni non standard utilizzando API RESTful, WebServices e SFTP sicuro, sfruttando piattaforme middleware come Mulesoft e Denodo.
• Ottimizzare le prestazioni del sistema e gli obiettivi aziendali utilizzando sistemi di reporting e piattaforme di dati, tra cui Concur Intelligence, Snowflake e configurazioni di report standard.
• Proattivamente contribuire allo sviluppo di pratiche di architettura globali e fornire supervisione tecnica e mentoring ai team di prodotto.
• Mantenere la roadmap per le soluzioni T&E, valutando le tendenze della tecnologia esterna, come la categorizzazione delle spese AI e RPA, per migliorare il valore e gestire il debito tecnico. Chi sei
• Hai un minimo di 10 anni di esperienza nella progettazione e nell'implementazione di soluzioni all'interno della piattaforma Concur, con almeno 5 anni focalizzati sui miglioramenti di integrazione da e verso Concur Intelligence, Travel e Expense.
• Possiedi una conoscenza di livello esperto dei moduli Concur e una comprovata traccia di integrarli con sistemi SAP ERP, HR (Workday) e altre applicazioni aziendali.
• Sei esperto nel consumo RESTful API, nella trasformazione dei dati tramite middleware (Mulesoft/Denodo), e nella creazione di modelli di dati concettuali e logici.
• Siete in grado di mantenere una visione per soluzioni multiple e valutare gli impatti delle iniziative sulle capacità, sui rischi e sul paesaggio delle applicazioni.
• Porti eccezionali competenze di negoziazione e la capacità di comunicare concetti difficili, influenzando gli stakeholder ad adottare diversi punti di vista o soluzioni innovative.
• Hai una forte comprensione dei concetti di database, SQL, servizi web e formati di dati XML/JSON.
• Capisci i principi contabili finanziari e le best practice T&E specifiche per il settore; l'esperienza con le normative del settore farmaceutico è un vantaggio significativo.
• Hai una laurea in Informatica o un campo correlato; è preferibile una credenziali "Certified Professional - Expense Configuration". ​ #RDT2026 Compensazioni e vantaggi L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione, in base alla posizione principale di Varsavia G
