jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every patient deserves a personalized healthcare solution. As the IT Strategic Risk & Audit Manager , you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that our digital evolution—from AI-driven drug discovery to personalized healthcare apps—is built on a foundation of trust and resilience. You will act as a strategic partner to Digital Technology leaders, ensuring that risks are managed proactively rather than reactively.
This role moves beyond tactical "checkbox" auditing to focus on strategic foresight —anticipating shifts in the threat landscape, regulatory environment, and emerging technologies (like AI and Cloud architecture)

Job Responsibilities

Scope / (Content Leadership): Defines the strategic vision for IT risk, audit, and compliance, and drives strategic initiatives for long-term risk management success. Initiates and leads large, complex projects with a significant impact on the organization. Leads the development of enterprise-wide risk and compliance policies and advises on emerging trends and best practices.

• Strategic Risk Architecture & Vision: Define and architect the global IT Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), aligning long-term digital strategy with Roche’s risk appetite to ensure "Compliance by Design" across complex, interconnected global portfolios.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of highly complex business and risk challenges with significant organizational impact, proactively identifying potential strategic issues within your sphere of influence. Develops comprehensive risk management and compliance policies, implements proactive measures to avoid repeated issues, and leads initiatives to anticipate and mitigate future risks. Contributes to framing strategic questions and facilitates strategic decision-making at the executive level.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies and engages key stakeholders at the executive level and external partners, analyzing enterprise-wide stakeholder landscapes. Leads enterprise-wide risk, audit, and compliance initiatives, presenting them to executive leadership to secure support and strategic alignment for risk-related investments. Navigates highly complex and politically sensitive landscapes, acting as an organizational trust builder and providing expert counsel on critical strategic decisions.

• E2E Audit & Compliance Leadership: Lead the full lifecycle of complex IT audits and continuous monitoring programs across infrastructure and applications, ensuring the organization meets global regulatory requirements while proactively identifying systemic issues to prevent recurrence.

• Inspection Command & Control: Serve as the primary IT liaison during complex Health Authority inspections (FDA, EMA, etc.), leading "Front-Room/Back-Room" operations, coaching SMEs in regulatory interview techniques, and ensuring the rapid delivery of high-quality, validated evidence.

• Data Integrity & ALCOA+ Systematically audit and enforce the "Digital Thread" to ensure all health-regulated data remains Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, and Accurate, maintaining the integrity of life-saving digital health solutions.

• Global Stakeholder & Transformation Management: Navigate sensitive landscapes to lead enterprise-wide risk initiatives, partnering with IT owners to develop robust remediation CAPAs and innovating risk management approaches to drive lasting, transformative impact across the global org

Questo ruolo va oltre l'auditing tattico "checkbox" per concentrarsi sulla previsione strategica —anticipando i cambiamenti nel panorama delle minacce, ambiente normativo e tecnologie emergenti (come l'architettura AI e Cloud) Responsabilità del lavoro Scope / (Content Leadership): Definisce la visione strategica per il rischio IT, l'audit e la conformità, e guida iniziative strategiche per il successo della gestione del rischio a lungo termine. Inizia e conduce progetti grandi e complessi con un impatto significativo sull'organizzazione. Conduce lo sviluppo di politiche di rischio e conformità a livello aziendale e consiglia tendenze e best practice emergenti.
• Strategic Risk Architecture & Vision: Definire e progettare il quadro globale IT Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), allineare la strategia digitale a lungo termine con l’appetito di rischio di Roche per garantire la "Compliance by Design" attraverso complessi e interconnessi portafogli globali.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: conduce l'analisi di sfide di business e di rischio altamente complesse con un impatto organizzativo significativo, identificando attivamente potenziali problemi strategici all'interno della vostra sfera di influenza. Sviluppa politiche complete di gestione dei rischi e di conformità, implementa misure proattive per evitare ripetute questioni, e porta iniziative per anticipare e mitigare i rischi futuri. Contribuisce a inquadrare questioni strategiche e facilita il processo decisionale strategico a livello esecutivo.
• Stakeholder Management: Identificare e coinvolgere i principali stakeholder a livello esecutivo e partner esterni, analizzando i paesaggi delle parti interessate a livello aziendale. Conduce iniziative di rischio, audit e conformità a livello aziendale, presentandole alla leadership esecutiva per garantire il supporto e l'allineamento strategico per gli investimenti legati al rischio. Naviga paesaggi molto complessi e politicamente sensibili, agendo come costruttore di fiducia organizzativo e fornendo consulenza esperta sulle decisioni strategiche critiche.
• E2E Audit & Compliance Leadership: guidare il ciclo di vita completo di audit IT complessi e programmi di monitoraggio continuo in infrastrutture e applicazioni, assicurando che l'organizzazione soddisfi i requisiti normativi globali, identificando in modo proattivo i problemi sistemici per prevenire la ricorrenza.
• Comando di ispezione e controllo: Servire come collegamento IT primario durante le ispezioni complesse dell'Autorità sanitaria (FDA, EMA, ecc.), principali operazioni "Front-Room/Back-Room", coaching PMI nelle tecniche di intervista di regolamentazione, e garantire la consegna rapida di prove di alta qualità, convalidate.
• Integrità dei dati & ALCOA+ Controllare sistematicamente e far rispettare il "Filo digitale" per garantire che tutti i dati regolati dalla salute restino Attribuibili, leggibili, contemporanei, originali e precisi, mantenendo l'integrità delle soluzioni di salute digitale salvavita.
• Global Stakeholder & Transformation Management: Navigare paesaggi sensibili per condurre iniziative di rischio a livello aziendale, collaborando con i proprietari IT per sviluppare una robusta bonifica CAPAs e innovare approcci di gestione del rischio per guidare un impatto duraturo e trasformativo attraverso l'org globale

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Dein Team
Als Nurse Liaison Manager:in (NLM) wirst Du Teil unserer Disease Area Neuroimmunologie. In Deiner Rolle als Expert:in im Außendienst gestaltest Du die Zusammenarbeit mit der Nurses-Community sowie unseren Teams in Vertrieb, Medical und Marketing aktiv mit. Wir verstehen uns als verlässliche Partner für Behandelnde, um gemeinsam die bestmögliche Versorgung von Patient:innen mit Multipler Sklerose zu fördern.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Beratung & Schulung: Du informierst und schulst Nurses und Ärzte zur Anwendung von B-Zell- und IL6-Therapien, inkl. Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Komplikationsmanagement.

• Organisationsberatung: Du berätst Praxen und Kliniken bei der Optimierung von Ablauforganisationen rund um unsere Neuroimmunologie-Produkte.

• Digitale Lösungen: Du begleitest die Implementierung unserer CE-zertifizierten Medizinprodukte (z.B. Brisa) zur Therapieunterstützung.

• Eventmanagement: Du planst und gestaltest aktiv lokale Anwendertreffen, Best-Practice-Sharing-Konzepte und moderierst Workshops.

• Netzwerkarbeit: Du identifizierst Kundenbedürfnisse vor Ort und bringst Deine Erkenntnisse aktiv in das Disease Area Squad ein.

• Crossfunktionale Kooperation: Du arbeitest eng mit allen Vertretern der Customer Pacing Functions, Medical, Marketing und Patient Partnership Bereichen zusammen und unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Account Plänen.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger:in, Medizinische Fachangestellte oder vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 4 Jahre), idealerweise in der Neurologie.

• Erfahrung in der Therapie der Multiplen Sklerose (MS),insbesondere im Umgang mit MS-Patienten und Erfahrung im Management von Praxisabläufen und der Anleitung von Pflegekräften (Praxisanleiter:in)

• Medizinische Praxis: Sicherer Umgang mit Venenverweilkanülen, Durchführung von Infusionstherapien und Komplikationsmanagement.

• Zusatzqualifikation: Kenntnisse im Qualitätsmanagement (QSM) und Ausbildung zum Medizinprodukteberater sind von Vorteil.

• Hohe Sozialkompetenz, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative und Teamgeist.

• Sicherer Umgang mit Google Workspace/MS Office sowie gute Englischkenntnisse und eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente: Aktueller Lebenslauf. Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

• Beratung & Schulung: Du informierst und schulst Nurses und Ärzte zur Anwendung von B-Zell- und IL6-Therapien, inkl. Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Komplikationsmanagement.
• Organisationsberatung: Du berätst Praxen und Kliniken bei der Optimierung von Ablauforganisationen rund um unsere Neuroimmunologie-Produkte.

• Netzwerkarbeit: Du identifizierst Kundenbedürfnisse vor Ort und bringst Deine Erkenntnisse aktiv in das Disease Area Squad ein.

• Erfahrung in der Therapie der Multiplen Sklerose (MS),insbesondere im Umgang mit MS-Patienten und Erfahrung im Management von Praxisabläufen und der Anleitung von Pflegekräften (Praxisanleiter:in)

• Réseautage : Vous identifiez les besoins des clients locaux et contribuez activement à l'équipe de lutte contre la maladie.

• Pratique médicale : manipulation sécuritaire des canules d'habitation veineuse, traitement des perfusions et gestion des complications.

• Haute compétence sociale, méthodes de travail axées sur la solution, esprit d'initiative et esprit d'équipe.

jobs.title: Compliance Specialist (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Als Compliance Specialist (w/m/d) sind Sie im Compliance Office Basel & Kaiseraugst tätig, das direkt an die Standortleitung Basel & Kaiseraugst berichtet. Zusätzlich sind Sie 30-40% am Standort Rotkreuz im Einsatz. Das Compliance Office setzt sich für die konsequente Umsetzung und Einhaltung des Roche Verhaltenskodex ein.

In der Rolle als Compliance Specialist unterstützen und leiten Sie die Untersuchung von Non-Compliance Fällen. Dies beinhaltet die Voruntersuchung inklusive der Datenanalyse, die rechtliche Abklärung, das Führen von Interviews, sowie die Dokumentation der Fallführung.

Ihre Möglichkeit

• Umsetzung von Compliance Aufgaben im lokalen Compliance Team unter der Leitung des lokalen Compliance Officers

• Konzeptionierung und Durchführung von Classroom Schulungen für spezifische Ansprechgruppen zum Zweck der Prävention rund um den Roche Verhaltenskodex

Sie bringen mit

• Ein Hochschulabschluss im Bereich Recht mit mindestens 3 Jahren Erfahrung im Bereich Legal Compliance oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Legal Compliance.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse zu Compliance-Richtlinien und der Schweizer Gesetzgebung.

• Kompetenz in der Durchführung interner Untersuchungen.

• Erfahrung in der interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit in Projekten sowie mit Stakeholdern.

• Verhandlungsfähigkeit und hervorragende Fähigkeiten in der Kommunikation.

• Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Pharmabranche.

• Äusserst selbständige, initiative und integre Persönlichkeit mit hoher Sozialkompetenz

• Fähigkeit, komplexe Situationen durch schnelles Verständnis und Analyse von Fakten zu bewältigen.

• Sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift in Deutsch und Englisch.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie bitte unsere FAQs und Videos auf careers.roche.ch/faq.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Competenza nel condurre indagini interne.

• Capacità di negoziazione e eccellenti capacità di comunicazione.
• Idealmente, esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica.
• Estremamente indipendente, iniziativa e integrità con un alto livello di competenza sociale

Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Intern (Mandarin Speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Job Ad Text

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
As an Intern – Accounts Payable supporting the China region , you will play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of our financial operations. You will ensure our accounting processes deliver exceptional impact through meticulous document handling, timely invoice processing, and effective communication in Mandarin — helping our global business units maintain the financial health required to deliver care to patients.
The Opportunity

• You manage the full cycle of AP documentation , from receiving and sorting to barcoding and pre-archiving, ensuring all records are ready for further processing.

• You validate and process PO and contract-based invoices, Non-PO invoices, and prepayments with high attention to detail.

• You support financial accuracy by reviewing supplier open items, investigating non-successful payments, and performing balance sheet account reconciliations.

• You contribute to month-end excellence by participating in closing activities and preparing operational KPI reports based on affiliate requirements.

• You act as a bridge for our China stakeholders , handling internal and external queries in Mandarin and building effective partnerships with vendors.

• You engage in continuous improvement by supporting system integration testing, participating in team projects, and initiating process enhancements.

Who You Are

• You are currently pursuing or hold a Degree or Diploma in Finance, Accountancy, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

• You are fluent in Mandarin (Mandatory) , as this role specifically supports our affiliates and vendors in China ; you are also proficient in English.

• You have a strong interest in corporate finance and accounting , with a desire to learn best practices in a global shared services environment.

• You have a working knowledge of MS Office tools ; familiarity with SAP or other ERP systems is a significant advantage.

• You are a proactive communicator who enjoys resolving queries and working collaboratively within a "Buddy System" framework.

• You are available for a minimum internship duration of six (6) months .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a pro-active, passionate and talented Strategic Talent Acquisition Intern colleague for our Corporate People & Culture Team. As a Talent Acquisition Intern you will be responsible for supporting the daily work of the Talent Acquisition Partner and the People & Culture Business Partners in the recruitment process for open roles.
Throughout the course of your internship here at Roche Services and Solutions (RSS), you will be able to gain suitable experience and skills in order to lead the recruitment process of certain positions end-to-end. In this position you will focus on:

• Using social media platforms (such as Linkedin Recruiter), professional networking sites/platforms/databases (like Profession.hu, Phenom People) to source and identify potential candidates

• Conducting phone screenings , checking the candidates' professional background, motivation and language knowledge via telephone interview

• Organizing and partaking in online and face-to-face interviews

• Supporting the candidates' hiring journey comprehensively from start to finish

• Ensuring accurate administration of the whole recruitment process

• Creating compelling and accurate job advertisements that will play a pivotal role in attracting top talent

Who you are ​

• You have ongoing studies at any Hungarian University/college

• ​You are available at least 25- 30 hour s per week

• ​​You have a good command of English, Hungarian and you have outstanding communication skills, German is a plus

• ​You have a customer oriented mind-set and you are creative, enthusiastic, proactive and​ open to taking over new tasks

• You have the passion to find people careers rather than simply jobs

In exchange we provide you with:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training, mentoring and development opportunities

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Home-office opportunity (4-days/week)

• Young and dynamic environment

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role within the Roche organization after graduation

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Tax Accounting & Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
All’interno della direzione Finance, siamo alla ricerca di un Tax Accounting Specialist da inserire nel nostro ufficio fiscale con spiccate competenze tecnico-contabili. La risorsa sarà responsabile della gestione autonoma del ciclo di compliance fiscale e della reportistica per le società italiane del Gruppo Roche. Il ruolo richiede una solida capacità di coniugare gli adempimenti tributari con le registrazioni contabili.

Principali Responsabilità

• Tax Compliance & Operations: Gestione integrale degli adempimenti periodici relativi a IVA (LIPE, dichiarazione annuale), imposte dirette (IRES/IRAP) e ritenute d’acconto, garantendo il rispetto rigoroso delle scadenze di legge.
• Accounting & Tax Reporting: Calcolo accurato delle imposte correnti, differite e anticipate per le fasi di actual e forecast.
• Predisposizione Bilancio: Supporto tecnico nella redazione delle poste fiscali del bilancio civilistico e consolidato, assicurando la corretta applicazione dei principi contabili.
• Reporting di Gruppo: Preparazione della reportistica fiscale periodica in conformità alle linee guida della casa madre e ai requisiti locali.
• Monitoraggio Normativo: Analisi degli impatti delle novità fiscali sui processi contabili aziendali e implementazione delle procedure necessarie per garantire la conformità.

Requisiti Richiesti

• Laurea magistrale in Economia (preferibilmente con diploma di Ragioneria) ; l'abilitazione alla professione di Commercialista è considerata un requisito preferenziale.
• Almeno 2-3 anni di esperienza professionale maturata presso società di consulenza (Big4), studi specializzati o all'interno di dipartimenti fiscali di contesti multinazionali strutturati.
• Profonda conoscenza della normativa fiscale italiana e padronanza dei principi contabili nazionali (OIC) e internazionali (IFRS).
• Utilizzo avanzato del sistema ERP SAP e di Excel.
• Madrelingua italiano e buona padronanza della lingua inglese (scritta e parlata).
• Completano il profilo: eccellenti capacità analitiche, attitudine al problem solving, precisione e orientamento al lavoro di squadra in un ambiente dinamico.

Sede di lavoro: Monza
Tipologia contrattuale: Tempo determinato
Data di inizio: 1° settembre 2026

La fascia salariale prevista per questa posizione è di euro 38.290–71.096 euro. Roche Italia offre una retribuzione su 14 mensilità. La retribuzione finale sarà determinata da una serie di fattori, tra cui le competenze, l'esperienza e le qualifiche.

Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position Within the Finance management, we are looking for a Tax Accounting Specialist to be included in our tax office with strong technical-accounting skills. The resource will be responsible for autonomous management of the fiscal compliance cycle and reporting for Italian companies of the Roche Group. The role requires a solid capacity to combine tax compliance with accounting records. Main Responsibility
• Tax Compliance & Operations: Full management of periodic VAT obligations (LIPE, annual declaration), direct taxes (IRES/IRAP) and deemed to be in agreement, ensuring strict compliance with statutory deadlines.
• Accounting & Tax Reporting: Accurate calculation of current taxes, deferred and anticipated for actual and forecast phases.
• Budget preparation: Technical support in drafting the tax posts of the civil and consolidated financial statements, ensuring the correct application of accounting principles.
• Group Reporting: Preparation of the periodic tax reporting in accordance with the parent company guidelines and local requirements.
• Regulation Monitoring: Analysis of the impacts of tax innovations on business accounting processes and implementation of the procedures necessary to ensure compliance. Requirements Requested
• Master's degree in Economics (preferably with diploma of Reason) ; the qualification to the profession of Commercialist is considered a preferential requirement.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner - Oncology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Patient Journey Partner- Oncology
Location: Mumbai

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche’s capabilities and resources to co-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

Your Opportunity

• You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators

• You will be a one point of contact for top accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public & private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations

• You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations

• You will be leading collaboration in field through co-creation of solutions for key accounts

Who you are

• You are someone who has a relevant graduate/ post graduate degree in Science. From an experience standpoint having more than 8 years’ experience with 4+ years in Patient Services or similar preferred

• You must exhibit strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management

• Min 4 years of Oncology sales and Key account management experience within MH/Mumbai

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is leading the industry with respect to the investment in R&D. We drive one of the largest and most promising pipelines.
Pharma Technical Development (PTD) engages with all R&D engines within the Roche group and supports more than 100 development projects with CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls) activities.
Pharma Technical Development (PTD) brings game-changing therapies from clinical phase I into the market to serve every patient, every day. Our core business is to develop safe, innovative and effective drugs using cutting edge technologies for manufacturing processes (Drug Substance and Drug Product), clinical supply, formulation, device, packaging, and analytical development. Our daily work also includes compiling of regulatory documents and the transfer of development projects to commercial manufacturing.
We are striving for a caring and sensing network organization, which lives a culture of trust and collaboration. Our smart people drive innovation through their expertise, passion and "getting it done" mentality. The benefit for the patient is in the center of our thoughts and efforts. To achieve this goal we have embraced new ways of working and thinking.
The department of Pharmaceutical Development is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products from Phase 1 up to Launch. Activities encompass formulation and manufacturing process development for parenteral drug products for all clinical stages and the market, the transfer of product and process to commercial manufacturing sites, commercial product support, line extension development, and drug product supplies for pre-clinical studies.

As an Associate Scientist within Pharmaceutical Development, you are responsible for laboratory studies related to drug product formulation and process development for parenteral dosage forms, including large biological molecules, small synthetic molecules, and gene therapy.

The Opportunity

• Plan and coordinate lab work packages with support from the Pharmaceutical Project Leader (PPL) and peers

• Write study protocols and reports

• Execute hands-on laboratory studies related to parenteral drug product formulation and process development (Ph0 to Ph3), identify support needs, prioritize tasks, and consider flexibility in execution

• Independently analyze, interpret and present results

• Plan timing, instrument use, analytical methods, materials, and sample logistics for studies, ensuring robust and timely sample flow and storage.

• High quality standard from study planning, execution and data handling, ensuring proper documentation, data integrity, and adherence to ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate +) and FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable) data principles.

• The position is limited to 1 year. Extension might be possible.

Who You Are

• Completed apprenticeship as a chemical/biological laboratory technician; Chemical-Technical Assistant (CTA), or Biological-Technical Assistant (BTA) or related fields

• Proven knowledge and hands-on experience in laboratory

• A high degree of self-motivation, curiosity and high aspiration in terms of quality is required

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a deep commitment to working in a delivery oriented environment

• Strong team player attitude

• Strong interest to embrace new ways of working and to act as change agent

• Fluent in English (written and spoken) is a must. German language skills are a plus.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche è leader del settore rispetto all'investimento in R&D. Noi guidiamo una delle tubazioni più grandi e più promettenti. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) si impegna con tutti i motori R&D all'interno del gruppo Roche e supporta oltre 100 progetti di sviluppo con attività CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls). Pharma Technical Development (PTD) porta terapie che cambiano gioco dalla fase clinica I nel mercato per servire ogni paziente, ogni giorno. Il nostro core business è quello di sviluppare farmaci sicuri, innovativi ed efficaci utilizzando tecnologie all'avanguardia per i processi produttivi (Drug Substance and Drug Product), fornitura clinica, formulazione, dispositivo, imballaggio e sviluppo analitico. Il nostro lavoro quotidiano comprende anche la compilazione di documenti normativi e il trasferimento di progetti di sviluppo alla produzione commerciale. Ci sforziamo di un'organizzazione di rete attenta e sensibile, che vive una cultura di fiducia e collaborazione. Le nostre persone intelligenti guidano l'innovazione attraverso la loro competenza, passione e mentalità "getting it done". Il beneficio per il paziente è al centro dei nostri pensieri e sforzi. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo abbiamo abbracciato nuovi modi di lavorare e di pensare. Il dipartimento di sviluppo farmaceutico è responsabile per lo sviluppo di prodotti farmaceutici parenterali dalla fase 1 fino al lancio. Le attività comprendono la formulazione e lo sviluppo del processo di produzione per i prodotti farmaceutici parenterali per tutte le fasi cliniche e il mercato, il trasferimento del prodotto e del processo a siti di produzione commerciale, il supporto del prodotto commerciale, lo sviluppo dell'estensione della linea e l'approvvigionamento di prodotti farmaceutici per studi preclinici. Come scienziato associato all'interno dello sviluppo farmaceutico, siete responsabili di studi di laboratorio relativi alla formulazione del prodotto di droga e allo sviluppo di processo per le forme di dosaggio parenterale, tra cui grandi molecole biologiche, piccole molecole sintetiche e terapia genica. L'opportunità
• Pianificare e coordinare i pacchetti di lavoro di laboratorio con il supporto del Leader del Progetto Farmaceutico (PPL) e dei coetanei
• Scrivere protocolli e report di studio
• Esegui gli studi pratici di laboratorio relativi alla formulazione e allo sviluppo dei processi dei prodotti farmaceutici (Ph0 a Ph3), identifica le esigenze di supporto, privilegia le attività e considera la flessibilità nell'esecuzione
• Analisi indipendente, interpretazione e risultati attuali
• Pianificare la tempistica, l'uso degli strumenti, i metodi analitici, i materiali e la logistica dei campioni per gli studi, garantendo un flusso e un deposito robusti e tempestivi.

Pharma Technical Development (PTD) engages with all R&D engines within the Roche group and supports more than 100 development projects with CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls) activities. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) brings game-changing therapies from clinical phase I into the market to serve every patient, every day. Our core business is to develop safe, innovative and effective drugs using cutting edge technologies for manufacturing processes (Drug Substance and Drug Product), clinical supply, formulation, device, packaging, and analytical development. Our daily work also includes compiling of regulatory documents and the transfer of development projects to commercial manufacturing. We are striving for a caring and sensing network organization, which lives a culture of trust and collaboration. Activities encompass formulation and manufacturing process development for parenteral drug products for all clinical stages and the market, the transfer of product and process to commercial manufacturing sites, commercial product support, line extension development, and drug product supplies for pre-clinical studies. As an Associate Scientist within Pharmaceutical Development, you are responsible for laboratory studies related to drug product formulation and process development for parenteral dosage forms, including large biological molecules, small synthetic molecules, and gene therapy. The Opportunity
• Plan and coordinate lab work packages with support from the Pharmaceutical Project Leader (PPL) and peers
• Write study protocols and reports
• Execute hands-on laboratory studies related to parenteral drug product formulation and process development (Ph0 to Ph3), identify support needs, prioritize tasks, and consider flexibility in execution
• Independently analyze, interpret and present results
• Plan timing, instrument use, analytical methods, materials, and sample logistics for studies, ensuring robust and timely sample flow and storage.
• High quality standard from study planning, execution and data handling, ensuring proper documentation, data integrity, and adherence to ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate +) and FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable) data principles.
• The position is limited to 1 year. Extension might be possible. Who You Are
• Completed apprenticeship as a chemical/biological laboratory technician; Chemical-Technical Assistant (CTA), or Biological-Technical Assistant (BTA) or related fields
• Proven knowledge and hands-on experience in laboratory
• A high degree of self-motivation, curiosity and high aspiration in terms of quality is required
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a deep commitment to working in a delivery oriented environment
• Strong team player attitude
• Strong interest to embrace new ways of working and to act as change agent
• Fluent in English (written and spoken) is a must. German language skills are a plus.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers - we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires et changeantes. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité, pharmacologie translationnelle et biomarqueurs — nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, de l'évaluation des cibles au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain. Ce poste est situé à Pathology and Applied Safety Science, un département de la fonction Sciences pharmaceutiques. Nous conduisons l'évaluation non clinique de l'innocuité des médicaments candidats à partir de petites molécules à des produits biologiques complexes pendant les phases de découverte et de développement à Roche. • In Vivo - in vitro Immunosafety Integration & Mechanistic Strategy: Formuler, mettre en œuvre et défendre des stratégies intégrées d'immunosafety pour les projets de portefeuille, en assurant la validation scientifique et l'exécution des biomarqueurs immunologiques prédictifs. Interroger et décoder les résultats de l'immunosécurité in vivo (p. ex., changements dans l'architecture lymphoïde, lecture de l'immunogénicité, profils de cytokine ou hypersensibilités systémiques) et les relier au contexte mécaniste à l'aide d'outils d'investigation in vitro. Traduire les résultats immunologiques complexes en documents de position de sécurité unifiés, en présentant des résumés d'impact définitifs pour la validation des cibles, le profilage des composés et les paquets d'activation IND/CTA.
• Faire progresser les modèles cellulaires in vitro par l'intermédiaire d'éléments immunologiques : Appliquer de façon proactive des éléments immunologiques humains (p. ex. cellules immunitaires primaires, cocultures immuno-épithéliales, circuits de stimulation inflammatoires) pour améliorer la précision physiologique des modèles cellulaires prédictifs in vitro. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Sobre Roche:
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Oportunidad:
Serás parte del equipo de Marketing, brindando soporte tanto estratégico como operativo en iniciativas que generen valor y vayan acorde con la estrategia de cada área terapéutica. Tendrás la oportunidad de colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios, participar en proyectos de alto impacto y contribuir a la generación de análisis, materiales y seguimiento de iniciativas para el negocio. Será un enlace clave en la integración de diversas áreas, incluyendo equipo comercial, medical, eventos, finanzas, compliance, control interno y compras. Desarrollarás habilidades de análisis, storytelling estratégico y negociación colaborativa.

Buscamos a una persona analítica, proactiva, organizada y con interés por la industria farmacéutica, capaz de combinar pensamiento estratégico con una ejecución impecable en las actividades del día a día en entornos multifuncionales.

Responsabilidades :

• Socio Estratégico del Negocio: Interactuar directamente con gerentes y coordinadores de marketing para identificar y evaluar nuevas oportunidades consistentes con los objetivos estratégicos.

• Gestión Operativa y Presupuesto: Coordinar actividades logísticas clave y control de procesos administrativos internos hasta su finalización. Dar seguimiento a proyectos, monitoreando cronogramas, entregables y acuerdos con las distintas áreas involucradas.

• Campañas de marketing: Apoyo en la creación y adaptación de materiales para comunicación interna y externa correspondientes con la estrategia del negocio y enfocado en distintas audiencias.

• Colaboración Multidisciplinaria: Actuar como enlace clave con el equipo de ventas, medical y diversas áreas de soporte incluyendo, eventos, finanzas, compliance, control interno y compras para consolidar información y asegurar la alineación entre stakeholders.

Quién eres:

• Formación: Estudiante activo(a) de los últimos semestres de Administración, Economía, Finanzas, Mercadotecnia, Negocios Internacionales, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería Química, Ingeniería Biomédica u otras carreras afines relacionadas con negocios, ingeniería o ciencias.

• Herramientas: Manejo intermedio o avanzado de Microsoft Excel y PowerPoint. Deseable: Manejo de Google Workspace (Google Sheets, Docs, Slides, Drive y G-Site).

• Idiomas: Inglés intermedio-avanzado, con capacidad para comprender documentación técnica. Deseable: Participar en conversaciones de trabajo.

• Disponibilidad: Disponibilidad para laborar medio tiempo (mínimo 25 horas por semana) en horario matutino. Deseable poder asistir a la oficina tres días por semana, favoreciendo el trabajo colaborativo con el equipo (siendo indispensables los martes y miércoles para coincidir con todo el squad presencialmente en las oficinas de CDMX).

Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist - French speaking in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a crucial role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion.

The Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist may collaborate closely with affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines.

The Opportunity:

• Manage the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.

• Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.

Le spécialiste de l'exécution des campagnes numériques peut collaborer étroitement avec des équipes d'affaires affiliées ou des équipes de marque, des tiers vendors, des coordonnateurs de campagnes et des coordonnateurs de campagnes mondiales dans l'organisation, en ce qui concerne les exigences, les objectifs et les délais du projet. • Vous avez une solide compréhension des principes du marketing numérique, de la création de contenu et de la gestion de campagne et 3 ans d'expérience dans la production de contenu, la gestion de projet ou la gestion de campagne numérique, avec un accent sur la coordination des initiatives de marketing numérique sur plusieurs canaux.
• Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et en italien, et vous avez de l'expérience dans la gestion des intervenants et l'intégration de la rétroaction dans les stratégies de contenu.
• Vous avez un comportement axé sur le client dans tout ce que vous faites et la capacité de créer et de maintenir des relations efficaces avec les intervenants internes et d'autres fournisseurs de tiers.
• Vous maîtrisez les outils et les logiciels de gestion de projet, et vous êtes prêt à apprendre de nouveaux systèmes au besoin.
• Vous possédez de solides capacités organisationnelles et multitâches, avec une expérience éprouvée de gestion simultanée de plusieurs projets. En échange, nous vous fournissons:

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Business Developer - Banco de Sangre
¿Te apasiona generar un impacto directo en la salud de las personas a través de la innovación comercial? Como Business Developer - Banco de Sangre , te unirás a un equipo dinámico enfocado en expandir el negocio de diagnóstico y construir relaciones sólidas con nuestros clientes . Esta es una oportunidad única para liderar estrategias comerciales que maximicen la rentabilidad y aseguren los más altos niveles de satisfacción en el sector sanitario .

La Oportunidad

Implementarás las acciones de los planes estratégicos en las cuentas, siendo un experto comercial en la línea de negocio asignada, con el objetivo de promocionar técnicamente los productos, así como expandir el negocio de diagnóstico logrando así la más alta satisfacción del cliente construyendo relaciones efectivas, maximizar la participación de mercado y la rentabilidad en los productos a cargo.

• Conocerás y verificarás las necesidades de las cuentas asignadas.

• Contribuirás a la construcción, mantenimiento y ejecución de un “Plan Estratégico por Cuenta”.

• Serás el experto interlocutor interno de las necesidades de sus stakeholder a cargo.

• Asegurarás el nivel de visitas de asesoramiento y seguimiento con la adecuada actualización de la información técnica y de negocio en clientes y prospectos.

• Serás responsable de realizar ofertas y propuestas comerciales de acuerdo a las necesidades relevadas en sus clientes.

Quién eres

• Posees formación universitaria concluida en las carreras de Administración, Ingeniería o áreas afines, y cuentas con tu cédula profesional vigente .

• Cuentas con experiencia en desarrollo de negocios, ventas consultivas o roles comerciales dentro del sector de la salud o diagnóstico médico .

• Tienes una mentalidad estratégica y la habilidad de ejecutar planes comerciales orientados a resultados y a la satisfacción del cliente .

• Destacas por tus excelentes habilidades interpersonales, comunicando con fluidez y construyendo relaciones efectivas con diversos perfiles de clientes .

• Te caracteriza tu proactividad, autonomía y un estilo de trabajo altamente colaborativo .

Esta posición no incluye beneficios de relocación.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist - Italian & Spanish speaking in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a crucial role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion.

The Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist may collaborate closely with affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines.

The Opportunity:

• Manage the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.

• Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Instructs stakeholders on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area

• Supports Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators in client communications in the area of service offering, change management or communication

• Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility

Who you are :

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; you are highly creative, innovative, forward thinking marketer with the ability to demonstrate awareness of digital trends.

• You have a solid understanding of digital marketing principles, content creation, and campaign management and 3+ years of experience in content production, project management, or digital campaign management, with a focus on coordinating digital marketing initiatives across multiple channels.

• You own excellent communication skills in English, plus Italian and Spanish , and you have experience in stakeholder management and incorporating feedback into content strategies.

• You have a customer-focused behavior in everything you do and ability to create and maintain well-functioning relationships with internal stakeholders and other 3rd party providers.

• You have proficiency in project management tools and software, with a readiness to learn new systems as needed.

• You possess strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with a proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Global Digital Hub è stato fondato all'interno del Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest. Il nostro scopo principale è quello di rafforzare le capacità digitali di Roche a livello globale, supportando iniziative centrali con Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting e Creative Design. In qualità di Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist - Italian & Spanish che parla nel Global Digital Hub, garantisci la consegna di progetti di creazione di contenuti di campagne digitali all'interno del Digital Campaigns Chapter. Il ruolo riveste un ruolo cruciale nel garantire il coordinamento e il completamento della creazione di contenuti di campagne digitali tempestive e di alta qualità. Il Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist può collaborare a stretto contatto con i team aziendali affiliati o i team di marca, i vendori di terze parti, i coordinatori della campagna e della campagna globale nell'organizzazione, relativi ai requisiti di progetto, obiettivi e tempi. L'opportunità:
• Gestire la creazione e il processo di consegna dei contenuti delle campagne digitali affiliate o globali, assicurando il completamento tempestivo e di successo di tutti i progetti dall'iniziazione all'implementazione finale, garantendo al contempo gli standard di consegna.
• Incorporare feedback da parte degli stakeholder e rivedere le richieste di contenuti delle campagne digitali per garantire l'allineamento con le loro aspettative.
• Istruisce le parti interessate a nuovi processi o requisiti che aumenterebbero l'efficienza nei modi di lavorare nell'area tematica
• Supporta i Coordinatori della Campagna e i Coordinatori della Campagna Globale nelle comunicazioni dei clienti nell'ambito dell'offerta di servizi, della gestione dei cambiamenti o della comunicazione
• Adozione e Centro di Eccellenza: seguire i processi esistenti, stabilire i principi di governance dei processi e mantenere una corretta documentazione e attuazione nell'ambito della responsabilità Chi sei?
• Hai una laurea in Marketing, Comunicazione, Business o un campo correlato; sei altamente creativo, innovativo, avanzato marketing di pensiero con la capacità di dimostrare la consapevolezza delle tendenze digitali.
• Hai una solida comprensione dei principi di marketing digitale, la creazione di contenuti e la gestione delle campagne e 3+ anni di esperienza nella produzione dei contenuti, nella gestione dei progetti o nella gestione delle campagne digitali, con l'obiettivo di coordinare le iniziative di marketing digitale su più canali.
• Possiedi eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese e italiano e/o spagnolo, e hai esperienza nella gestione degli stakeholder e incorporando feedback nelle strategie di contenuto.
• Hai un comportamento focalizzato sul cliente in tutto ciò che fai e la capacità di creare e mantenere relazioni ben funzionanti con gli stakeholder interni e altri fornitori di terze parti.
• Hai competenza negli strumenti di gestione del progetto e nel software, con una disponibilità ad imparare nuovi sistemi come necessario.
• Possiedi forti capacità organizzative e multitasking, con una comprovata esperienza di gestione simultanea di più progetti. In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.
• Flessibilità

jobs.title: DMPK-PD Project Leader
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

The Opportunity

As an experienced DMPK-PD Project Leader within the Translational DMPK-PD Group, you will be pivotal in ensuring the right drug is delivered at the right dose, safely and efficaciously, to patients. You will lead nonclinical and translational strategies, collaborating across therapeutic areas to transform scientific hypotheses into groundbreaking clinical candidates.

Your Impact & Responsibilities:

• Strategy & Design: Define and lead drug design and optimisation strategies and compound profiling integrating cutting-edge Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) principles, with a strong focus on target biology validation and translational PK/Pharmacodynamics (PD) concepts.

• Translational Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert, guiding early discovery teams in developing sophisticated translational strategies for clinical evaluation of target modulation, leveraging deep biochemical and pharmacological knowledge.

• Modelling & Simulation (M&S): Execute fundamental M&S activities, including PKPD, Physiologically-Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), and human dose/regimen prediction, to provide essential support for projects spanning from Lead Optimisation (LO) through early and late-stage clinical development (EIH, Ph 2/3).

• Regulatory Mastery: Author and present definitive, high-quality scientific assessments of non-clinical DMPK data for critical internal program reviews and all major external regulatory submissions (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), ensuring global compliance and accelerated timelines.

• Implementation: Implement biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close collaboration with key partners to ensure both patient safety and the achievement of meaningful therapeutic benefit.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion transparent, data-driven decision-making, acting as a trusted advisor and cultivating high-trust professional relationships across global project teams, governance bodies, and external partnerships.

Who You Are

• You hold a PharmD or PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, Bioengineering or similar, coupled with over 5-10 years of industry experience in a pharmacokinetic-related role

• You possess deep, comprehensive expertise across the entire discovery

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme, creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. L'opportunità Come leader di progetto DMPK-PD esperto all'interno del gruppo DMPK-PD Traduzionale, sarete fondamentali per garantire che il farmaco giusto sia consegnato alla dose giusta, in modo sicuro ed efficace, ai pazienti. Condurrai strategie non cliniche e traduttive, collaborando in aree terapeutiche per trasformare le ipotesi scientifiche in candidati clinici innovativi. I vostri impatti e responsabilità:
• Strategia & Design: Definire e condurre strategie di progettazione e ottimizzazione della droga e profilazione dei composti che integrano i principi di Metabolismo e Farmacokinetics (DMPK) all'avanguardia, con un forte focus sui concetti di convalida della biologia e di traduzione PK/Pharmacodinamica (PD).
• Esperienza traduttiva: Servire come esperto di materia tematica, guidare i team di scoperta precoce nello sviluppo di sofisticate strategie di traduzione per la valutazione clinica della modulazione target, sfruttando la conoscenza biochimica e farmacologica profonda.
• Modelling & Simulation (M&S): Eseguire attività M&S fondamentali, tra cui PKPD, Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), e predizione dose/regimen umano, per fornire un supporto essenziale per i progetti che spaziano dall'Optimizzazione di piombo (LO) attraverso lo sviluppo clinico precoce e di fine stadio (EIH, Ph 2/3).
• Mastery di regolamentazione: Autore e presente valutazioni scientifiche definitive e di alta qualità dei dati DMPK non clinici per le recensioni critiche dei programmi interni e tutte le principali sottomissioni normative esterne (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), assicurando la conformità globale e tempi accelerati.
• Attuazione: Implement biomarker e strategie bioanalitiche in stretta collaborazione con partner chiave per garantire sia la sicurezza del paziente che il raggiungimento di un significativo beneficio terapeutico.
• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion trasparente, data-driven decision-making, agendo come consulente affidabile e coltivando relazioni professionali di alta fiducia in team di progetto globali, enti di governance e partnership esterne. Chi sei
• Hai un PharmD o un PhD in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Farmacologia, Bioingegneria o simili, accoppiato con oltre 5-10 anni di esperienza nel settore in un ruolo legato alla farmacocinetica
• Possiedi competenze profonde e complete in tutta la scoperta
