Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position SW Technical Lead - Datenplattformen Als Custom Software Developer fungieren Sie als strategischer Führer und Innovator. Sie werden Aufgaben für andere definieren, Großinitiativen und Mentorkollegen zur Förderung des Wachstums antreiben. Diese Rolle beinhaltet die Bereitstellung globaler Unterstützung für technische Initiativen, das Teilen von Wissen international und die Gestaltung der technischen Richtung der Organisation. Sie verfügen über fundiertes Know-how in mehreren Technologiebereichen, setzen hohe Standards für die Codequalität und Sicherheit, und entfernen Hindernisse für Teams, kontinuierlich die Produktivität der Entwickler und den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Softwareentwicklung. Die Gelegenheit:
• Anwendungsbereich: Strategische technische Beratung bereitstellen und die Richtung für die digitale Produktentwicklung in Abstimmung mit Geschäftszielen und Prioritäten festlegen.
• Architektonische Evolution: Führen Sie den strategischen Übergang von einem modularen Monolith zu Mikroservices, um sicherzustellen, dass Domaingrenzen eingehalten werden und die Leistung bleibt hoch. Nehmen Sie das Eigentum an der Entwicklung neuer Komponenten und Ideen, während Sie mit einem multidisziplinären Team zusammenarbeiten, um End-to-End-Erfahrungen an die Endbenutzer zu liefern.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Aufgaben für andere definieren und auf der Ebene der Produkt- oder Produktlinie erfolgreiche Initiativen mit mittlerer bis großer (M/L) vorantreiben. Fordern Sie andere auf wachstumssteigernde Weise heraus, hebeln Sie Teamstärken effektiv und fungieren als Trainer und/oder führen Sie für andere.
• Stakeholder Management: Besteht ein starkes Verständnis der Stakeholder-Ökosysteme und deren Bedürfnisse, die sich in Verhandlungen und Partnerschaften für gegenseitige Vorteile auszeichnen. Richten Sie Richtung für mittel- bis langfristige Ziele und Ziele.
• Impact/Strategy: Globale Unterstützung für innovative und technologische Initiativen. Sprechen Sie an lokalen/internationalen Veranstaltungen und Wissensaustauschinitiativen und beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an RDT Data Domain/Site-bezogenen Aktivitäten.
• Komplexität/ (Produktgröße): Betrieb auf der Produkt-/Domain-/Site-Ebene.
• Business/Technische Fähigkeit: Aktiver Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung des technischen Wissens im Feld durch Veröffentlichungen, Präsentationen und Mentorship (z.B. als Leistungsinhaber). Inspirieren Sie Innovation, treiben Sie innovative Lösungen im Einklang mit Technologietrends und setzen Sie auf die Entwicklung neuer Ansätze für bestehende Probleme. Wer du bist:
• 10+ Jahre bewährte Erfahrung, die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit vorantreibt, um organisatorische technische Probleme zu lösen und unterschiedliche technische Anstrengungen zu gemeinsamen Zielen auszurichten.
• Ein tiefes Verständnis der Datenverarbeitungsprinzipien und des Bedarfs an AI-Readiness-Daten. Erfahrung in Gebäudelösungen für Datenexperten halten (z.B. Data Owners, Data Consumers, Data Product Owners und Digital Asset Management).
• Erwarten Sie tiefes Know-how in mehreren Technologiebereichen und die Fähigkeit, geeignete Technologien zur Lösung komplexer Probleme auszuwählen und anzuwenden.
• Erhalten Sie Kenntnisse in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, Event-getriebene Architektur oder ähnliche Technologien.
• Demonstrieren Sie ein starkes Verständnis von Software-Entwicklungs-Lebenszyklus-Praktiken, einschließlich Leistungsabstimmung und Skalierbarkeit.
• Vermitteln Sie hervorragende Kenntnisse über marktübliche Software-Entwicklungstools, um die Einführung in den aktuellen Roche-Toolset vorzuschlagen, die Entwicklerproduktivität und Erfahrung Roche-weit kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
• Kompetenz in der Cybersicherheit Best Practices anwenden, um sicherzustellen, dass Softwarelösungen Sicherheitsstandards in Abstimmung mit einem geeigneten Roche-Experten erfüllen

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Lead technique SW - Plateformes de données En tant que développeur de logiciel personnalisé, vous agirez comme leader stratégique et innovateur. Vous définirez des tâches pour les autres, stimulerez des initiatives à grande échelle et mentorez vos collègues pour favoriser la croissance. Ce rôle consiste à fournir un appui mondial aux initiatives techniques, à partager les connaissances à l'échelle internationale et à façonner l'orientation technique de l'organisation. Vous posséderez une expertise approfondie dans plusieurs domaines technologiques, établirez des normes élevées pour la qualité et la sécurité des codes, et supprimerez les obstacles pour les équipes, améliorant continuellement la productivité des développeurs et le cycle de vie global du développement logiciel. La possibilité :
• Portée: Fournir des orientations techniques stratégiques et définir l'orientation pour le développement de produits numériques en conformité avec les objectifs et les priorités des entreprises.
• Evolution architecturale: Diriger la transition stratégique d'un monolithe modulaire à un microservices, en assurant le respect des limites du domaine et le maintien des performances. Prenez en charge le développement de nouveaux composants et idées alors que vous coopérez avec une équipe multidisciplinaire pour fournir des expériences de bout en bout aux utilisateurs finaux.
• Responsabilisation/Résoudre les problèmes : Définir les tâches pour les autres et mener à bien les initiatives moyennes à grandes (M/L) au niveau du produit ou de la gamme de produits. Définer les autres de façon à favoriser la croissance, tirer parti des forces de l'équipe et agir comme entraîneur et/ou chef de file pour les autres.
• Gestion des parties prenantes: posséder une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes des parties prenantes et de leurs besoins, excellant dans les négociations et les partenariats pour des avantages mutuels. Fournir une orientation pour les buts et objectifs à moyen et à long terme.
• Impact/Stratégie: fournir un appui au niveau mondial pour les initiatives innovantes et technologiques. Donner des discours et partager des connaissances sur les événements locaux et internationaux et les initiatives de partage des connaissances, et participer activement aux activités liées au domaine de données et au site de RDT.
• Complexité/ (Taille du produit): Fonctionnez au niveau du produit/domaine/site.
• Capacités commerciales/techniques: contribuer activement à l'avancement des connaissances techniques sur le terrain au moyen de publications, de présentations et de mentorat (par exemple, en servant de propriétaire de capacités). Inspirer l'innovation, proposer des solutions innovantes en fonction des tendances technologiques et se concentrer sur la conception de nouvelles approches des problèmes existants. Qui vous êtes :
• Plus de 10 ans d'expérience prouvée conduisant à une collaboration interfonctionnelle pour résoudre des problèmes techniques à l'échelle de l'organisation et aligner les efforts d'ingénierie disparates sur des objectifs communs.
• Posséder une compréhension approfondie des principes de traitement des données et des besoins en données de préparation à l'IA. Avoir de l'expérience dans la construction de solutions pour les experts en données (p. ex., les propriétaires de données, les consommateurs de données, les propriétaires de produits de données et la gestion numérique d'actifs).
• Exposer une expertise approfondie dans plusieurs domaines technologiques et la capacité de sélectionner et d'appliquer des technologies appropriées pour résoudre des problèmes complexes.
• Maintenir la compétence en Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, l'architecture d'événements ou des technologies similaires.
• Démontrer une bonne compréhension des pratiques de développement du cycle de vie des logiciels, y compris le réglage des performances et l'évolutivité.
• Tirer parti d'une excellente connaissance des outils de développement de logiciels disponibles sur le marché pour suggérer l'adoption dans l'outil Roche actuel, améliorant en permanence la productivité du développeur et l'expérience à l'échelle de Roche.
• Appliquer l'expertise dans les meilleures pratiques de cybersécurité, en veillant à ce que les solutions logicielles respectent les normes de sécurité en coordination avec l'expert Roche approprié

Technical Product Owner - Service AI

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to helping shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche with cutting-edge digital technologies by harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter to millions of patients worldwide.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the North America Functional Lead for Quote Management, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams for the region, tackling complex commercial problems with emerging ambiguity. You will drive and deliver Q2C initiatives and Diagnostics commercial launches, demonstrating a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans.

You will act as a trusted advisor to Diagnostics commercial affiliate teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling regional requests, and leading the design and validation of effective solutions. You will serve as the local delivery lead for Quote Management systems and initiatives.

The Opportunity:
The Quote Management team is part of DIA Commercial Operations, a strategic global function within Roche Digital Technology (RDT), and is at the heart of our Diagnostics digital landscape. We are responsible for developing, globally rolling out, and continuously evolving technology solutions that enhance the experience of healthcare providers and patients. Serving as a link between global business units - such as Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), Roche Information Solutions (RIS), and Commercial Enablement - and their operational goals, we design the digital architecture that enables Roche to scale its impact across APAC, EMEA/LATAM, and NAM.

Job Responsibilities

• Acts as the primary Quote Management IT representative and trusted consultant for commercial leadership.

• Gathers complex commercial requirements across quoting, contracting, and adjacent processes, translating them into clear, actionable user stories.

• Performs functional architecting, proposing solutions within the boundaries of existing systems.

• Executes hands-on configuration and adaptation, and drives regional rollouts for business priorities.

• Owns scope definition and change control, managing significant scope changes to ensure strategic alignment and minimal delivery disruption.

• Leads QM regional IT initiatives, partnering with global teams for technical delivery.

• Defines acceptance criteria, designs test scenarios, and coordinates User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

• Provides hands-on support for data and configuration adjustments, and guides business stakeholders on master data.

• Acts as the direct technical liaison, bridging affiliate business needs and our global/offshore managed services.

• Proactively identifies business needs and proposes high-impact technical solutions.

• Aligns regional Q2C processes with system-supported global standards, constructively challenging local deviations while advocating for legitimate regional needs.

• Partners closely with IT leads and business leads on strategic prioritization and orienting demand towards delivering the highest value.

• Supports change management by providing training content, user documentation, and ongoing technical guidance to enable smooth business adoption.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's or Advanced Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 5+ years as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, or similar role in enterprise IT, preferably in commercial operations, CPQ, or Q2C domains.

• Deep functional and technical knowledge of the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C), Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ), and Commercial Sales domains.

• Proven track record of managing complex BA workstreams independently, driving

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Power Platform Administrator, you will ensure the security, scalability, and health of our program and be the key technical expert on its technical setup and configuration. You will manage environments, implement Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies and other detailed configuration, and oversee governance frameworks to empower citizen developers and application teams across Roche. You will monitor platform capacity and other platform health metrics, manage user licensing, and perform other administration tasks. As appropriate, you will implement automations for administration and provide technical leadership and supervision to others who may also be acting as administrators. By bridging the gap between IT governance and developers, you will ensure our organization leverages the full potential of the Power Platform in a secure, high-performing, and efficient manner.

Your Responsibilities

• Scope: Demonstrates deep proficiency in the Power Platform’s general configuration, primary components and governance frameworks. Oversees the creation, configuration, and decommissioning of environments—while ensuring alignment with organizational security standards. Influences tech choices regarding access control, data residency, encryption and DLP (Data Loss Prevention) policies.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Contributes to the platform roadmap and technical vision. Defines, executes, or oversees administrative tasks which support the roadmap. Successfully drives initiatives, such as deploying the Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit. Monitors performance metrics and usage data to ensure peek performance and to optimize resource allocation

• Stakeholder Management: Possesses a strong grasp of stakeholder ecosystems and their needs. Stakeholders include peers responsible for other aspects of the Microsoft technology stack or specific capabilities. Excels in negotiations and partnerships for mutual benefits. Provides clear direction toward mid- to long-term goals and objectives.

• Impact/Strategy: Supports innovative initiatives and continuous improvement across the platform, including knowledge-sharing initiatives. Regularly reviews and refines configuration and governance practices to adapt to evolving organizational needs.

• Complexity: Operates expansively at the platform level, which will be used globally by all areas of the enterprise.

• Business/Technical ability: Capable of driving innovative platform administration by analyzing trends in low-code, no-code, and AI. Actively contributes to the platform roadmap by suggesting and implementing configuration and implementation that makes the platform compelling to our internal customers.

• Compliance: Authors and reviews documentation to show that the Power Platform program complies with enterprise process directives, security requirements, and regulations such as GxP and GDPR.

• Proven experience as a Power Platform administrator in a large, regulated organization.

• Ideally, experience with application development on the Power Platform or other Microsoft technologies.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

• In-depth knowledge of the full Microsoft Power Platform, demonstrated through Microsoft certifications

• Hands-on experience with the Power Platform Center of Excellence (CoE), including installation, configuration, and customization of the CoE Starter Kit.

• Ambito: Dimostra profonda competenza nella configurazione generale della Piattaforma di Potere, componenti primari e quadri di governance. Supera la creazione, la configurazione e la decommissione di ambienti, assicurando al contempo l'allineamento con gli standard di sicurezza organizzativi. Influenza scelte tecnologiche in materia di controllo degli accessi, residenza dei dati, crittografia e DLP (Data Loss Prevention) politiche.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Contribuisce alla roadmap della piattaforma e alla visione tecnica. Definisce, esegue o supervisiona i compiti amministrativi che sostengono la roadmap. Guida con successo iniziative, come la distribuzione del Kit Starter Center of Excellence (CoE). Monitora le metriche delle prestazioni e i dati di utilizzo per garantire prestazioni e ottimizzare l'allocazione delle risorse
• Stakeholder Management: Possede una forte comprensione degli ecosistemi delle parti interessate e delle loro esigenze. Stakeholders includono peers responsabili per altri aspetti dello stack di tecnologia Microsoft o specifiche funzionalità. Eccellenza nei negoziati e nelle partnership per i benefici reciproci. Fornisce una chiara direzione verso obiettivi e obiettivi a medio-lungo termine.
• Impact/Strategy: Supporta iniziative innovative e miglioramento continuo della piattaforma, comprese le iniziative di condivisione delle conoscenze. Recensioni e perfeziona regolarmente le pratiche di configurazione e governance per adattarsi alle esigenze organizzative in evoluzione.
• Complessità: Opera espansivamente a livello di piattaforma, che sarà utilizzato a livello globale da tutte le aree dell'impresa.
• Capacità commerciale/tecnica: Capacità di guidare l'amministrazione di piattaforma innovativa analizzando le tendenze in basso codice, no-code e AI. Contribuisce attivamente alla roadmap della piattaforma suggerendo e implementando la configurazione e l'implementazione che rende la piattaforma competitiva ai nostri clienti interni.
• Compliance: Autori e revisioni documentazione per dimostrare che il programma Power Platform è conforme alle direttive di processo enterprise, requisiti di sicurezza e normative come GxP e GDPR. Chi sei
• Provata esperienza come amministratore di Power Platform in un'organizzazione ampia e regolamentata.
• Idealmente, esperienza con lo sviluppo delle applicazioni sulla Power Platform o altre tecnologie Microsoft.
• Laurea in Ingegneria, Informatica, o esperienza equivalente.
• Conoscenza approfondita della piattaforma Microsoft Power completa, dimostrata attraverso le certificazioni Microsoft
• Esperienza pratica con il Power Platform Center of Excellence (CoE), tra cui installazione, configurazione e personalizzazione del CoE Starter Kit.
• Capacità di analizzare le metriche delle prestazioni e i dati di utilizzo per identificare le tendenze e opti

Sie verwalten Umgebungen, implementieren DLP-Richtlinien (Data Loss Prevention) und andere detaillierte Konfigurationen und überwachen Governance-Frameworks, um Bürgerentwickler und Anwendungsteams in ganz Roche zu stärken. Indem Sie die Lücke zwischen IT-Governance und Entwicklern schließen, stellen Sie sicher, dass unsere Organisation das volle Potenzial der Power-Plattform auf sichere, leistungsstarke und effiziente Weise nutzt. Ihre Aufgaben
• Umfang: Zeigt fundierte Kenntnisse in der allgemeinen Konfiguration, den Primärkomponenten und den Governance-Frameworks der Power Platform. Überwacht die Erstellung, Konfiguration und Stilllegung von Umgebungen – und stellt gleichzeitig die Ausrichtung auf die organisatorischen Sicherheitsstandards sicher. Beeinflusst technische Entscheidungen in Bezug auf Zugriffskontrolle, Datenresidenz, Verschlüsselung und DLP-Richtlinien (Data Loss Prevention).
• Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Trägt zur Plattform-Roadmap und zur technischen Vision bei. Definiert, führt oder beaufsichtigt administrative Aufgaben, die die Roadmap unterstützen. Fördert erfolgreich Initiativen wie den Einsatz des Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit. Überwacht Performance-Metriken und Nutzungsdaten, um die Peek-Performance sicherzustellen und die Ressourcenzuweisung zu optimieren
• Stakeholder Management: Verfügt über ein starkes Verständnis der Stakeholder-Ökosysteme und ihrer Bedürfnisse. Zu den Stakeholdern gehören Peers, die für andere Aspekte des Microsoft-Technologiestacks oder spezifische Funktionen verantwortlich sind. Excels in Verhandlungen und Partnerschaften für gegenseitige Vorteile. Bietet eine klare Richtung für mittel- bis langfristige Ziele.
• Wirkung/Strategie: Unterstützt innovative Initiativen und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen auf der gesamten Plattform, einschließlich Initiativen zum Wissensaustausch. Überprüfen und verfeinern Sie regelmäßig die Konfigurations- und Governance-Praktiken, um sich an die sich ändernden organisatorischen Anforderungen anzupassen.
• Komplexität: Funktioniert expansiv auf Plattformebene, die global von allen Unternehmensbereichen genutzt wird.
• Business/Technical Fahigkeit: Fähig zur Förderung innovativer Plattformverwaltung durch Analyse von Trends in Low-Code, No-Code und AI. Trägt aktiv zur Plattform-Roadmap bei, indem es Konfiguration und Implementierung vorschlägt und implementiert, die die Plattform für unsere internen Kunden attraktiv macht.
• Compliance: Dokumentation von Autoren und Reviews, um nachzuweisen, dass das Power Platform-Programm den Richtlinien für Unternehmensprozesse, Sicherheitsanforderungen und Vorschriften wie GxP und DSGVO entspricht. Wer du bist
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung als Power Platform Administrator in einer großen, regulierten Organisation.
• Idealerweise Erfahrung mit der Anwendungsentwicklung auf der Power Platform oder anderen Microsoft-Technologien.
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Informatik oder gleichwertige Erfahrung.
• Tiefe Kenntnisse der vollständigen Microsoft Power Platform, demonstriert durch Microsoft-Zertifizierungen
• Praktische Erfahrung mit dem Power Platform Center of Excellence (CoE), einschließlich Installation, Konfiguration und Anpassung des CoE Starter Kits.

jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Sequencing Solutions is expanding with a Principal Data Scientist to lead and help drive forward R&D activity by providing a deep level of insight into experimental data, its interpretation and implications for project development efforts. This role seeks a highly advanced and versatile individual who combines deep statistical expertise with proficiency in advanced data analysis tools and a focus on applying these skills to complex biological problems. (Applicants whose primary experience is narrowly defined within established bioinformatics analysis workflows might not align for the scope of this Principal Data Scientist role.)

Principal data scientists combine a number of skills from different domains to organize, process, and learn from data, often through the lens of domain-expert informed models that help to abstract concepts from the data, test their validity and make predictions.

The Opportunity:

• You will analyze large datasets, identify patterns, correlations, and anomalies that might be hidden within the data. Use statistical methods and machine learning algorithms to extract meaningful insights.

• You will have experience with DOE for biological and assay development experiments, where we need to draw meaningful conclusions on small sample sizes.

• You will provide statistical analysis of experimental results and communicate it to internal customers in a way that is both approachable and informative.

• You will work cross functionally using various pilot studies to then integrate the necessary analytical or inferential routines into a pipeline through a collaborative software engineering effort; the overall goal resulting in a validated internal software product that may be used regularly by experimentalists to track their research progress.

• You will utilize AI based tools for data analysis and create AI based support tools for internal customers.

• You have the ability to create clear and informative visualizations of the data and analysis results, making it easier for the technical (and non technical) team(s) to understand the situation and make informed decisions.

• You are able to identify technical challenges as they pertain to your team as well as collaborating teams, definite requirements and architecture for next-generation machine learning and statistical analysis products.

This position is based on-site in Santa Clara, CA.
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a PhD in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or other related areas of study and 5 years (or more) of experience handling various data sets/modules.

• You are able to define and lead analysis projects interfacing with multiple stakeholders.

• You have demonstrated experience handling large datasets, with demonstrated ability of transferring the data into meaningful and actionable reports.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Les soins de santé évoluent, et Global Approvisionnement répond en s'efforçant constamment d'obtenir les meilleurs résultats possibles, en adoptant des approches novatrices et stratégiques pour les partenariats avec les entreprises et les fournisseurs. Global Approvisionnement gère de manière proactive l'ensemble de l'écosystème fournisseur, contribuant de façon essentielle à améliorer les résultats en matière de santé, réduisant les coûts pour les patients et les systèmes de santé mondiaux, et faisant en sorte que Roche continue de faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. Ce rôle de chef de file en matière de programmes et de solutions - Chaîne d'approvisionnement et génie (achats) fait partie du chapitre Stratégie et solutions, où notre mission est d'orchestrer les priorités stratégiques, de catalyser la prestation de valeur pour l'entreprise et d'amplifier l'excellence en matière d'approvisionnement. Nous ne nous contentons pas de gérer les processus; nous conduisons une amélioration continue pour renforcer l'impact des achats mondiaux sur toute l'organisation Roche. En tant que responsable des programmes et des solutions, vous guiderez une équipe agile et performante axée sur la chaîne d'approvisionnement et l'ingénierie. Votre mandat est de diriger la responsabilité de mettre en œuvre des solutions innovantes et d'accélérer l'impact des achats. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez l'équipe à livrer contre un portefeuille à impact élevé comprenant:
• Innovation axée sur le marché et les fournisseurs : Co-création de solutions de premier marché pour résoudre des défis complexes. On s'attend à ce que vous mettiez en doute le statu quo et redéfinissiez les méthodes de travail, en regardant au-delà de la chaîne de valeur traditionnelle pour obtenir un impact au-delà des mesures d'approvisionnement standard.
• Programmes et projets stratégiques complexes : Accélération et amplification des résultats pour les initiatives d'approvisionnement à fort rendement, comme les programmes à grande échelle (p. ex. transformation des coûts) et les projets essentiels (p. ex. négociations et approvisionnement complexes). Ces initiatives sont choisies pour leur poids stratégique, leur impact et leur faisabilité. Vous dirigerez une équipe qui s'attend à établir la norme d'or pour la qualité et le rythme, exigeant un « développement continu » pour rester en avance sur les tendances du marché. C'est une chance d'obtenir un impact mesurable tout en façonnant une culture d'équipe qui reflète l'engagement de Roche pour les personnes et les patients. Au-delà de l'exécution du projet, vous serez un bâtisseur communautaire, favorisant une culture de curiosité, de sécurité psychologique et de collaboration radicale où les gens se sentent capables d'expérimenter et de grandir. Vous entraînerez une équipe moyenne à grande, guiderez l'affectation des ressources au travail d'impact le plus élevé et la planification pour transformer les objectifs de haut niveau en réalité. La possibilité :
• Leadership de portefeuille et de programme : Dirigez votre équipe dans un environnement mondial rapide pour gérer un portefeuille diversifié de solutions et de programmes (y compris les transformations des coûts et les négociations essentielles) qui offrent une valeur considérable aux intervenants de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et du génie.
• Culture et développement communautaire : Culturer un environnement de confiance et d'inclusion. Vous serez un moteur clé dans la construction d'une communauté où les membres de l'équipe se sentent en sécurité pour partager les échecs comme apprentissages, célébrer les succès ensemble et collaborer au-delà des frontières pour susciter de nouvelles idées.
• Resource Orchestration: équilibre dynamiquement les ressources pour maximiser l'impact; vous travaillerez à travers les réseaux et les équipes pour s'assurer que le bon talent est au bon endroit au bon moment.
• Innovation stratégique et résolution des problèmes : Diagnostiquer les besoins complexes des entreprises dans l'espace de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et de l'ingénierie, choisir la bonne approche (p. ex. solution par rapport au programme) en cherchant des pistes pour accélérer la réalisation de la valeur
• Excellence du cadre : Diriger la conception et le perfectionnement des outils du projet

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

This Programs and Solutions Lead - Digital and Tech (Procurement) role sits within the Strategy and Solutions Chapter, where our mission is to orchestrate strategic priorities, catalyse value delivery for the business, and amplify Procurement Excellence. We don’t just manage processes; we drive continuous improvement to strengthen Global Procurement’s impact on the entire Roche organisation.

As a Programs and Solutions Lead , you will guide a high-performing, agile team focused on Digital and Tech . Your mandate is to lead the charge in bringing innovative solutions to life and accelerating procurement impact. In this role, you will lead the team to deliver against a high-impact portfolio encompassing:

• Market and Supplier-Driven Innovation: Co-creation of market-first solutions to solve complex business challenges. You will be expected to challenge the status quo and redefine ways of working, looking beyond the traditional value chain to deliver impact beyond standard procurement metrics.

• Complex Strategic Programs and projects: Acceleration and amplification of outcomes for high-stakes procurement initiatives, such as large-scale programs (e.g. cost transformations ) and critical projects (e.g. complex negotiations and sourcing ).

These initiatives are selected for their strategic weight, impact, and feasibility. You will lead a team expected to set the gold standard for quality and pace, requiring a "continuous development" mindset to stay ahead of market trends. This is a chance to deliver measurable impact while shaping a team culture that reflects Roche’s commitment to people and patients.
Beyond project delivery, you will be a community-builder, fostering a culture of curiosity, psychological safety, and radical collaboration where people feel empowered to experiment and grow.
You will coach a medium-to-large team, guiding resource allocation to the highest impact work and planning to turn high-level objectives into reality.

The Opportunity:

• Portfolio & Program Leadership: Lead your team in a fast-paced global environment to manage a diverse portfolio of solutions and programs (including cost transformations and critical negotiations) that deliver massive value for Digital and Tech stakeholders.

• Culture & Community Building: Cultivate a high-trust, inclusive environment. You will be a key driver in building a community where team members feel safe to share failures as learnings, celebrate successes together, and collaborate across boundaries to spark new ideas.

• Resource Orchestration: Dynamically balance resources to maximize impact; you will work across networks and squads to ensure the right talent is in the right place at the right time.

• Strategic Innovation & Problem Solving: Diagnose complex business needs within the Digital and Tech space, selecting the right approach (e.g. Solution versus program) seeking avenues to accelerate value realisation

• Framework Excellence: Lead the design and refinement of project tools and frameworks for both "beyond-procurement&#3

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'assistenza sanitaria si sta evolvendo e Global Procurement risponde continuando ad impegnarsi per le più alte prestazioni possibili, adottando approcci innovativi e strategici per le partnership tra imprese e fornitori. Global Procurement gestisce proattivamente l'intero ecosistema dei fornitori, fornendo un contributo vitale per migliorare i risultati della salute, riducendo i costi per i pazienti e i sistemi sanitari globali, e assicurando che Roche continui a fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. Questo ruolo di Leader di Programmi e Soluzioni - Digital e Tech (Procurement) si trova all'interno del Capitolo Strategia e Soluzioni, dove la nostra missione è di orchestrare le priorità strategiche, catalizzare la consegna del valore per l'azienda, e amplificare l'eccellenza degli appalti. Non gestiamo solo i processi; guidiamo un miglioramento continuo per rafforzare l’impatto del Global Procurement sull’intera organizzazione Roche. Come Leader di programmi e soluzioni, guiderai un team agile e performante focalizzato su Digital e Tech . Il vostro mandato è quello di guidare l'accusa di portare soluzioni innovative alla vita e accelerare l'impatto degli appalti. In questo ruolo, si porterà il team a fornire contro un portafoglio ad alto impatto che comprende:
• Mercato e Fornitore-Driven Innovation: Co-creazione di soluzioni prima di mercato per risolvere complesse sfide aziendali. Sarete tenuti a sfidare lo status quo e ridefinire i modi di lavorare, guardando oltre la catena del valore tradizionale per fornire impatto oltre metriche standard di approvvigionamento.
• Programmi e progetti strategici complessi: accelerazione e amplificazione dei risultati per iniziative di approvvigionamento ad alto livello, come programmi su larga scala (ad esempio trasformazioni dei costi) e progetti critici (ad esempio trattative complesse e sourcing). Queste iniziative sono selezionate per il loro peso strategico, impatto e fattibilità. Condurrai un team che si aspetta di fissare lo standard oro per la qualità e il ritmo, richiedendo una mentalità di "sviluppo continuo" per rimanere al passo con le tendenze del mercato. Questa è l’occasione per dare un impatto misurabile durante la formazione di una cultura di squadra che riflette l’impegno di Roche verso persone e pazienti. Oltre alla consegna del progetto, sarai un costruttore di comunità, che promuove una cultura della curiosità, della sicurezza psicologica e della collaborazione radicale in cui le persone si sentono in grado di sperimentare e crescere. Potrai allenare un team medio-grande, guidando l'allocazione delle risorse al lavoro di impatto più alto e la pianificazione per trasformare gli obiettivi di alto livello in realtà. L'opportunità:
• Portfolio & Program Leadership: Guida il tuo team in un ambiente globale veloce per gestire un portafoglio diversificato di soluzioni e programmi (tra cui le trasformazioni dei costi e i negoziati critici) che offrono un valore enorme per gli stakeholder digitali e tecnologici.
• Cultura & Community Building: Coltivare un ambiente inclusivo ad alta fiducia. Sarete un driver chiave nella costruzione di una comunità in cui i membri del team si sentono al sicuro per condividere i fallimenti come apprendimento, celebrare i successi insieme e collaborare attraverso i confini per scintillare nuove idee.
• Orchestrazione delle risorse: bilanciare dinamicamente le risorse per massimizzare l'impatto; si lavorerà attraverso reti e squadre per garantire che il talento giusto sia nel posto giusto al momento giusto.
• Strategic Innovation & Problem Solving: Diagnosi delle complesse esigenze di business all'interno dello spazio digitale e tecnologico, selezionando l'approccio giusto (ad esempio Soluzione rispetto al programma) alla ricerca di viali per accelerare la realizzazione del valore
• Eccellenza Framework: Guidare la progettazione e la raffinatezza di strumenti e quadri di progetto sia per "oltre-procurement&#3

C'est une chance d'obtenir un impact mesurable tout en façonnant une culture d'équipe qui reflète l'engagement de Roche pour les personnes et les patients. jobs.title: Principal Software/Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is based in the Innovation Accelerator (IA) team, the innovation engine and connective tissue for Design, Data and Data Science innovation strategy within Product Development Data Sciences (PDD). We translate our long-term PDD vision into actionable strategy, shaping and prioritizing innovative cross-functional use cases that span PDD, PD, and Pharma. As both integrators and incubators, we explore, prototype, and help productize solutions to deliver impact in close partnership with internal Roche teams and external collaborators. With a mindset rooted in openness, value creation, and adaptability, we navigate the innovation ecosystem to drive transformative impact and future readiness across the organization.

The Opportunity

• You design and implement robust, secure, and scalable software architectures that support data- and ML-driven products

• You build front-end interfaces using modern frameworks (e.g., React, Vue) to enable intuitive user interactions with complex data outputs

• You develop and maintain back-end APIs and data pipelines that integrate models and data into production-grade environments

• You write simple, elegant, well-structured, and well-tested applications, software, and/or code that drive new features and improvements across all our products and services in adherence with regulatory compliance

• You collaborate with UX designers, data scientists, and product managers to align on user needs and translate them into technical solutions

• You monitor and optimize the performance, reliability, and maintainability of deployed software systems

• You enable reproducibility and development efficiency by implementing standardized logging, version control, and configuration management, while contributing to internal knowledge sharing and reusable code libraries

• You partner with IT teams to manage CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and security protocols

• You participate in agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) and contribute to backlog refinement and prioritization

• You apply a product-thinking mindset to balance technical trade-offs with user impact and business value

• You develop tools and dashboards for monitoring data flows, system health, and model performance

• You keep up to date with emerging technologies in software, cloud, and data engineering to continuously improve practices

• You support early pilots, MVPs, and scaled implementations across therapeutic areas by ensuring smooth deployment of experiments and applications in cloud and custom PaaS environments

• You embrace a collaborative culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and feedback

Who you are:

• You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field

• You have a minimum of 8 years of experience in software engineering, including leading architecture or infrastructure efforts for data-centric or ML-powered applications; or an advanced degree with 6 years of equivalent work experience

• You have 4+ years of experience with relational and non-relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, Redshift, MongoDB, S3)

• You have 4+ years of experience building and optimizing data pipelines using tools such as DVC, Pandas, Airflow

• You have strong proficiency in front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular) and back-end API development

• Collaborate con i team IT per gestire i protocolli CI/CD, infrastruttura cloud e sicurezza
• Partecipate a cerimonie agili (ad esempio, pianificazione sprint, recensioni, retrospettive) e contribuiscono alla raffinatezza e alla priorità del backlog

Die Chance
• Sie entwerfen und implementieren robuste, sichere und skalierbare Softwarearchitekturen, die daten- und ML-gesteuerte Produkte unterstützen
• Sie erstellen Front-End-Schnittstellen mit modernen Frameworks (z. B. React, Vue), um intuitive Benutzerinteraktionen mit komplexen Datenausgaben zu ermöglichen
• Sie entwickeln und pflegen Backend-APIs und Datenpipelines, die Modelle und Daten in Produktionsumgebungen integrieren

• Sie ermöglichen Reproduzierbarkeit und Entwicklungseffizienz, indem Sie standardisiertes Protokollierungs-, Versionskontrolle- und Konfigurationsmanagement implementieren und gleichzeitig zum internen Wissensaustausch und wiederverwendbaren Codebibliotheken beitragen
• Sie arbeiten mit IT-Teams zusammen, um CI/CD-Pipelines, Cloud-Infrastruktur und Sicherheitsprotokolle zu verwalten
• Sie nehmen an agilen Zeremonien teil (z.B. Sprintplanung, Reviews, Retrospektiven) und tragen zur Verfeinerung und Priorisierung des Backlogs bei
• Sie wenden eine produktorientierte Denkweise an, um technische Kompromisse mit Benutzerwirkung und Geschäftswert auszugleichen
• Sie entwickeln Tools und Dashboards zur Überwachung von Datenflüssen, Systemzustand und Modellleistung
• Sie halten sich mit neuen Technologien in den Bereichen Software, Cloud und Data Engineering auf dem Laufenden, um die Praktiken kontinuierlich zu verbessern
• Sie unterstützen frühe Piloten, MVPs und skalierte Implementierungen in therapeutischen Bereichen, indem Sie einen reibungslosen Einsatz von Experimenten und Anwendungen in Cloud- und benutzerdefinierten PaaS-Umgebungen sicherstellen
• Sie umarmen eine kollaborative Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens, Experimentierens und Feedbacks Wer du bist:
• Sie haben einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Data Science oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich
• Sie haben mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, einschließlich führender Architektur- oder Infrastrukturbemühungen für datenzentrierte oder ML-basierte Anwendungen; oder einen höheren Abschluss mit 6 Jahren gleichwertiger Berufserfahrung
• Sie haben über 4 Jahre Erfahrung mit relationalen und nicht-relationalen Datenbanksystemen (z.B. PostgreSQL, Redshift, MongoDB, S3)
• Sie haben mehr als 4 Jahre Erfahrung beim Erstellen und Optimieren von Datenpipelines mit Tools wie DVC, Pandas, Airflow
• Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse in Front-End-Frameworks (z. B. React, Angular) und Back-End-API-Entwicklung
• Sie haben praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Services (AWS, GCP oder Azure) und Infrastruktur als Code (z.B. Terra)

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Ce rôle repose sur l'équipe de l'Accélérateur d'innovation (IA), le moteur d'innovation et le tissu conjonctif pour la stratégie d'innovation en conception, en données et en science des données au sein du développement de produits Data Sciences (PDD). Nous transformons notre vision à long terme de la DDP en stratégie concrète, en concevant et en priorisant des cas d'utilisation transfonctionnels innovateurs qui couvrent la DDP, la DPP et la pharmacie. En tant qu'intégrateurs et incubateurs, nous explorons, prototypes et aidons à produire des solutions pour produire de l'impact en partenariat étroit avec des équipes internes Roche et des collaborateurs externes. Avec une mentalité ancrée dans l'ouverture, la création de valeur et l'adaptabilité, nous naviguons dans l'écosystème de l'innovation pour stimuler l'impact transformateur et la préparation future dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. L'opportunité
• Vous concevez et implémentez des architectures logicielles robustes, sécurisées et évolutives qui prennent en charge les produits pilotés par les données et les ML

• Vous développez et maintenez des API back-end et des pipelines de données qui intègrent des modèles et des données dans des environnements de production

• Vous appliquez un concept de produit pour équilibrer les compromis techniques avec l'impact utilisateur et la valeur commerciale
• Vous développez des outils et des tableaux de bord pour surveiller les flux de données, la santé du système et les performances des modèles
• Vous vous tenez au courant des nouvelles technologies dans le domaine des logiciels, du cloud et de l'ingénierie des données pour améliorer continuellement les pratiques
• Vous aidez les premiers pilotes, les MVP et les implémentations à grande échelle dans les zones thérapeutiques en assurant le déploiement en douceur des expériences et des applications dans les environnements cloud et PaaS personnalisés
• Vous adoptez une culture collaborative d'apprentissage continu, d'expérimentation et de rétroaction Qui vous êtes :

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) was established to drive analytics and technology-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

Your Opportunity:
As an Analyst (MDM Data Steward) , you will join the GATE organization in a pivotal role partnering with the US-based Master Data Management (MDM) team.
Your mission is to drive data stewardship, improve data quality, and support critical business decisions. You will act as a bridge between technical data operations and business strategy, ensuring our data assets are accurate, compliant, and actionable.

Key Responsibilities
Master Data Management (MDM) Operations

• Data Change Requests: Lead the ongoing processing of Data Change Requests (DCRs) related to Health Care Master Data.

• Record Maintenance: Perform rigorous matching, merging, and maintenance of Master records (HCPs, HCOs, and Affiliations) to ensure a "single source of truth".

Data Stewardship & Quality Assurance

• Stewardship: Act as the Data Steward for HCP (Health Care Professional), HCO (Health Care Organization) profile data, and Affiliations.

• Discrepancy Resolution: Proactively investigate data discrepancies from internal and external sources.

• Data Integrity: Ensure all newly onboarded datasets are accurate, complete, and strictly adhere to defined data standards.

Process Optimization & Governance

• Governance Methodologies: Develop and document adaptable governance methodologies to enhance efficiency in MDM, data integration, taxonomy, and reporting.

• Automation: Identify opportunities to automate or improve data management workflows.

• Workflow Enhancement: Build data products to enhance workflow optimization.

Strategic Analysis

• Analytical Support: Provide analytical support to develop insights and strategies that optimize data-related processes.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with stakeholders across business functions to translate data into informed decision-making.

Who You Are:

Education & Experience

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.

• Experience : Hands-on experience in Data Stewardship or Data Analytics operations.

• Industry Focus: Prior experience in the Pharma, Life Sciences, or Biotech industry is strongly preferred.

Technical Skills

• Core Data Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel and SQL is required .

• Scripting: Practical knowledge of programming languages such as Python or PySpark.

• Domain Tools: Experience with MDM solutions (e.g., Reltio, Informatica MDM) and Pharma CRM solutions (e.g., Salesforce, OCE, Veeva CRM).

• Cloud Platforms: Working experience in AWS services (S3, Athena, Glue, Sagemaker Studio, EC2, API Gateway, Bedrock) Or other cloud platforms like GCP, Azure is a strong plus.

Key Competencies

• Analytical Mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with an unwavering focus on quality, accuracy, and detail.

• Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders and translate technical data issues for business audiences.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

jobs.title: Strategic Quality Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to an inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing inclusion and belonging enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

We are seeking a highly motivated Strategic Quality Partner (SQP) to join our Product Development Quality organization, reporting to the Subchapter lead Product Development Quality. As the Strategic Quality Partner, you will be responsible for ensuring effective partnerships with Development Project Teams in the Molecular Lab - Sequencing Solutions portfolio, thriving for project acceleration and ensuring no delay in milestones and project execution. You drive consistent interpretation & implementation of global requirements across Customer Areas (CAs). You ensure the deployment and implementation of the Design & Development Process and drive awareness and adoption of Risk based decision making across all functions. You are an example of living collective success by working, trusting and empowering each other.

The Opportunity

• Ensure consistent interpretation & implementation of global requirements across Customer Areas (CAs)

• Incorporate lessons learned from all areas of quality across Customer Areas (CA) into project support and ensure PostMarket Quality feedback is built into the requirements

• Ensure development project plans contain the right deliverables according to the Design & Development module to deliver safe and compliant solutions

• Support internal and external audits

• Lead and facilitate constructive discussions e.g. at project team meetings

• Drive awareness and adoption of the Risk Enabler inside and outside of Global Quality & Regulatory decision making; prepare and enable risk-based decisions

• Partner to ensure effective resolution of issues (e.g. CAPA, NC)

• Ensure effective feedback loops and information flow for milestone review.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's degree in science, engineering, business administration or a related field. MBA or advanced degree is considered an advantage.

• 8+ years of experience in the diagnostics industry or a related field in business related Functions

• Strong scientific and technical background preferable in Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) with sound product knowledge, ideally with assay/reagents/system/hardware/software development experience for IVD Products.

• Strong business and financial acumen with an enterprise mindset

• Knowledge of Regulations pertaining to the environment (i.e. ISO 13485, ISO 14971, GDP, GMP, others)

• Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

• Strong agile knowledge and capabilities demonstrating new ways of working

• Pragmatic decision making and ability to move forward without a perfect solution

• Demonstrated thorough E2E understanding for lifecycle management

• Strong leadership capabilities, with experience in leading cross-functional teams (Squad Lead, Matrix Lead) and driving change.

Locations
You are located in Santa Clara, California. This is a primarily onsite role.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

• Assicurarsi che i progetti di sviluppo contengano i prodotti giusti in base al modulo Design & Development per fornire soluzioni sicure e conformi

• Guidare e facilitare discussioni costruttive per esempio nelle riunioni del team di progetto

• Partner per garantire una risoluzione efficace dei problemi (ad esempio CAPA, NC)
• Assicurare loop di feedback efficaci e flusso di informazioni per la recensione milestone. Chi sei
• Laurea in scienze, ingegneria, amministrazione aziendale o un campo correlato. MBA o grado avanzato è considerato un vantaggio.
• 8+ anni di esperienza nell'industria della diagnostica o in un campo correlato in funzioni correlate al business
• Forte background scientifico e tecnico preferibile in Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) con conoscenza del prodotto sonoro, idealmente con test/reagenti/system/hardware/software di sviluppo esperienza per i prodotti IVD.
• Forte business e acume finanziario con una mentalità aziendale
• Conoscenza dei Regolamenti relativi all'ambiente (ossia ISO 13485, ISO 14971, PIL, GMP, altri)
• Ottima capacità di comunicazione, presentazione e negoziazione.
• Forte conoscenza e capacità agili che dimostrano nuovi modi di lavorare
• Decisioni pratiche e capacità di andare avanti senza una soluzione perfetta
• Dimostrata comprensione E2E approfondita per la gestione del ciclo di vita
• Forte capacità di leadership, con esperienza nei principali team interfunzionali (Squad Lead, Matrix Lead) e cambiamento di guida. Località Ti trovi a Santa Clara, California. Questo è un ruolo principalmente in loco. Le prestazioni di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa posizione.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Schedule: This position is within a 24/7 call center. It is expected for this individual to have flexibility working 2nd or 3rd shifts and/or weekends, including some holidays. Your schedule will be determined on a quarterly basis.

This is an exciting time to join Roche Support Network. If you have passion for problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

The Opportunity
This position provides technical support to customers, answering questions on function and usage of products via the Technical Support Center. This individual may also provide technical assistance to sales, marketing and other Roche departments.

• You will analyze basic problems with non functioning electro/mechanical equipment, software applications or reagents to identify problem area(s) and recommend corrective action.

• You will also serve as the primary support liaison between Roche and the customer.

• This individual will recommend solutions to customer’s application questions and maintain a database of problems so that recurring problems can be analyzed and reported.

• You will know and apply the fundamental concepts, practices and procedures of the particular field of specialization.

• You will have significant on-the-job training or formalized education in a specific area. Requires some evaluation, originality or ingenuity.

• This individual will contribute independently or with a team towards a program or department goal or service.

• You will interface with internal customers and departments.

• This individual is responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

This is a remote based role.

Who You Are

• Associate’s degree or equivalent military training in medical technology, electronics or related field.

Preferred Requirements

• Bachelor's degree preferred, or Associates degree in medical or STEM, or equivalent field service or CSC experience.

• Phone customer service experience

• Clinical chemistry applications background

• Applications training in cobas 6000, cobas 8000, or cobas pro, cobas pure, mass spec.

• Interest/ability in working 2nd or 3rd shift.

• Interest/ability in working a Saturday or Sunday in schedule.

The expected salary range for this position based on Indianapolis, IN is $47,600.00 - $88,400.00/year. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Are you ready to apply?

Relocation benefits are not eligible for this job posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Schedule: This position is within a 24/7 call center. It is expected for this individual to have flexibility working 2nd or 3rd shifts and/or weekends, including some holidays. Your schedule will be determined on a quarterly basis.

This is an exciting time to join Roche Support Network. If you have passion for problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

The Opportunity
This position provides technical support to customers, answering questions on function and usage of products via the Technical Support Center. This individual may also provide technical assistance to sales, marketing and other Roche departments.

• You will analyze basic problems with non functioning electro/mechanical equipment, software applications or reagents to identify problem area(s) and recommend corrective action.

• You will also serve as the primary support liaison between Roche and the customer.

• This individual will recommend solutions to customer’s application questions and maintain a database of problems so that recurring problems can be analyzed and reported.

• You will know and apply the fundamental concepts, practices and procedures of the particular field of specialization.

• You will have significant on-the-job training or formalized education in a specific area. Requires some evaluation, originality or ingenuity.

• This individual will contribute independently or with a team towards a program or department goal or service.

• You will interface with internal customers and departments.

• This individual is responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

This is a remote based role.

Who You Are

• Associate’s degree or equivalent military training in medical technology, electronics or related field.

Preferred Requirements

• Bachelor's degree preferred, or Associates degree in medical or STEM, or equivalent field service or CSC experience.

• Phone customer service experience

• Clinical chemistry applications background

• Applications training in cobas 6000, cobas 8000, or cobas pro, cobas pure, mass spec.

• Interest/ability in working 2nd or 3rd shift.

• Interest/ability in working a Saturday or Sunday in schedule.

The expected salary range for this position based on Indianapolis, IN is $47,600.00 - $88,400.00/year. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Are you ready to apply?

Relocation benefits are not eligible for this job posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

This is a field-based role. The position manages a key account in Berkeley, CA. Candidates should live within 50 miles of Berkeley, CA.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Ready to start Your Career in Roche Services Americas Finance? Join Our Team!
Are you a detail-oriented professional looking to grow within a dynamic, multicultural environment? We are looking for an Accounts Payable Analyst who is eager to learn, enthusiastic about financial processes, and ready to make an impact. If you have a passion for finance, love problem-solving, and want to be part of a collaborative Shared Service Center, this is the perfect place for you to build your career!
Overall Purpose of Job
The Accounts Payable Analyst will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operations of our Accounts Payable department. In this role, you will ensure the accuracy and timeliness of invoice processing and vendor disbursements while maintaining proper internal controls.
You will work closely with our AP Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and local affiliates, providing exceptional service to vendors and internal customers. This is an excellent opportunity to master end-to-end AP processes and contribute to the efficiency of our Shared Service Center.
Job Accountabilities

• Invoice Management: Receive, scan, and accurately process vendor invoices in compliance with internal policies and local tax regulations.

• Account Analysis: Perform routine reconciliation and follow-up on vendor statements of account to ensure no outstanding balances or discrepancies.

• Customer & Vendor Support: Provide timely and effective responses to inquiries from local vendors and internal stakeholders regarding payment status and receipts.

• Transactional Execution: Execute daily processing work within the assigned business area, ensuring high service quality and compliance.

• Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for efficiency improvements in daily tasks and systems, collaborating with the team to implement best practices.

• Documentation: Assist in keeping Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) updated.

Requirements & Qualifications

• Education: University student or recent graduate in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields.

• Experience: Previous experience in administrative or basic accounting roles is a plus, but a strong willingness to learn is highly valued.

• Languages: * Intermediate English (written and spoken) is required.
• Portuguese language skills are a strong plus (desirable).

• Skills: * High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
• Good communication and customer service skills.

• A dedicated team player with a proactive attitude.

• Basic to intermediate Excel skills.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Istruzione: Studente universitario o recente laureato in Finanza, Contabilità, Business Administration, o campi correlati.

• Team Development: Sostenere la crescita del team attraverso la formazione, la revisione del lavoro, e contribuire a iniziative interfunzionali e progetti globali.
• Miglioramento continuo: Miglioramento del processo di guida e supporto iniziative di automazione per aumentare l'efficienza del flusso Record-to-Report. • Istruzione: laurea in Contabilità, Finanza, o un campo correlato. È preferibile una certificazione professionale (CPA, ACCA o equivalente).

• Competenze di base: * Forte capacità di gestione e collaborazione degli stakeholder.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As the R2R Period-End Close Senior Analyst based in San José, Costa Rica, you will be an integral part of our Global Shared Services organization. This role serves as a subject matter expert, delivering advanced accounting support and complex financial analysis while driving process improvements and automation initiatives. You will act as a key point of contact for accounting and reporting matters, serving as a trusted advisor for our supported affiliates. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Accounting Expertise & Audit Leadership: Lead complex accounting analyses and audit activities for assigned areas. You will serve as a subject matter expert for affiliates and internal stakeholders, ensuring technical accounting excellence.
• Financial Reporting & Close Activities: Prepare and review complex financial statements and reports. You will manage month-end close activities, including journal entries, cost allocations, and reconciliations, while maintaining a proper audit trail and compliance with standards.
• Analysis, Commentary & Advisory: Analyze financial results to investigate variances and provide clear, actionable insights to management. You will interpret and communicate financial data effectively to both internal and external stakeholders.
• Compliance & Governance: Ensure strict compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Team Development: Support the growth of the team through coaching, reviewing work, and contributing to cross-functional initiatives and global projects.
• Continuous Improvement: Drive process improvements and support automation initiatives to increase the efficiency of the Record-to-Report flow. Who you are: You are a highly analytical finance professional with a strong attention to detail, capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment to meet tight deadlines. Requirements and Qualifications:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance , or a related field. A professional certification ( CPA, ACCA , or equivalent) is preferred.
• Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of experience in accounting or finance. Prior experience in a Finance Shared Services environment is preferred. Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry is a plus.
• Technical Skills: * Strong knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS .
• Experience with ERP systems, specifically SAP (FI, CO/PA, MM, FA, FCC) and BlackLine is highly desirable.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Workspace.
• Languages: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluent in English and Spanish .
• Core Competencies: * Strong stakeholder management and collaboration abilities.
• Problem-solving mindset with a focus on process automation and continuous improvement.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, toget

Diese Rolle dient als Fachexperte und bietet fortschrittliche Buchhaltungsunterstützung und komplexe Finanzanalysen, während Prozessverbesserungen und Automatisierungsinitiativen vorangetrieben werden. • Accounting Expertise & Audit Leadership: Führen Sie komplexe Buchhaltungsanalysen und Auditaktivitäten für zugewiesene Bereiche. Sie werden als Fachexperte für Affiliates und interne Stakeholder dienen, um technische Buchhaltung Exzellenz zu gewährleisten.

Sie verwalten Aktivitäten zum Monatsende, einschließlich Zeitschrifteneinträge, Kostenzuweisungen und Abstimmungen, während Sie einen ordnungsgemäßen Audit-Trail und die Einhaltung von Standards beibehalten.
