• Teamentwicklung: Unterstützung des Wachstums des Teams durch Coaching, Überprüfung der Arbeit und Beitrag zu funktionsübergreifenden Initiativen und globalen Projekten.
• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Prozessverbesserungen vorantreiben und Automatisierungsinitiativen unterstützen, um die Effizienz des Record-to-Report-Flows zu erhöhen. Wer du bist: Sie sind ein hoch analytischer Finanzprofi mit einer starken Liebe zum Detail, der in der Lage ist, unabhängig in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu arbeiten, um enge Fristen einzuhalten. Anforderungen und Qualifikationen:
• Ausbildung: Bachelor-Abschluss in Rechnungswesen, Finanzen oder einem verwandten Bereich. Eine professionelle Zertifizierung (CPA, ACCA oder gleichwertig) wird bevorzugt.
• Erfahrung: Mindestens 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in Buchhaltung oder Finanzen. Vorkenntnisse in einer Finance Shared Services-Umgebung werden bevorzugt. Erfahrung in der Pharma- oder Gesundheitsbranche ist ein Plus.
• Technische Fähigkeiten: * Starke Kenntnisse der US GAAP und / oder IFRS .
• Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen, insbesondere SAP (FI, CO/PA, MM, FA, FCC) und BlackLine, ist sehr wünschenswert.
• Erweiterte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Excel und Google Workspace.
• Sprachen: Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten; fließend Englisch und Spanisch.
• Kernkompetenzen: * Starke Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management und in der Zusammenarbeit.
• Problemlösungsdenken mit Fokus auf Prozessautomatisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung.
• Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten mit minimaler Aufsicht zu verwalten. Umzugsvorteile sind für dieses Posting nicht verfügbar. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen, toget

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position La possibilité : En tant qu'analyste principal basé à San José, Costa Rica, vous ferez partie intégrante de notre organisation de services partagés mondiaux. Ce rôle sert d'expert en la matière, fournissant un soutien comptable avancé et une analyse financière complexe tout en menant des initiatives d'amélioration des processus et d'automatisation. Vous agirez comme un point de contact clé pour les questions de comptabilité et de rapport, servant de conseiller de confiance pour nos affiliés soutenus. Vos principales responsabilités comprendront :
• Expertise en comptabilité et leadership en matière de vérification : Diriger des analyses comptables complexes et des activités de vérification dans les domaines assignés. Vous serez un expert en la matière pour les affiliés et les intervenants internes, assurant l'excellence technique en comptabilité.
• Rapports financiers et activités de clôture : Préparer et examiner des états financiers et des rapports complexes. Vous gérerez les activités de clôture en fin de mois, y compris les entrées de journaux, les allocations de coûts et les rapprochements, tout en conservant une piste de vérification appropriée et en respectant les normes.
• Analyse, commentaires et avis : Analyser les résultats financiers afin d'étudier les écarts et de fournir des renseignements clairs et concrets à la direction. Vous interpréterez et communiquerez efficacement les données financières aux intervenants internes et externes.
• Conformité et gouvernance : Veiller au strict respect des politiques, des normes comptables et des exigences réglementaires de l'entreprise.
• Développement de l'équipe : Appuyer la croissance de l'équipe par l'encadrement, l'examen du travail et la contribution aux initiatives interfonctionnelles et aux projets mondiaux.
• Amélioration continue : Diriger les améliorations des processus et appuyer les initiatives d'automatisation afin d'accroître l'efficacité du flux d'enregistrement à rapport. Qui vous êtes : Vous êtes un professionnel de la finance hautement analytique avec une grande attention au détail, capable de travailler de façon indépendante dans un environnement accéléré pour respecter des délais serrés. Exigences et qualifications :
• Études: Baccalauréat en comptabilité, finance, ou un domaine connexe. Une certification professionnelle ( CPA, ACCA, ou l'équivalent) est préférable.
• Expérience : minimum de 4 ans d'expérience en comptabilité ou en finance. Une expérience antérieure dans un environnement de services partagés financiers est privilégiée. L'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique ou de la santé est un plus.
• Compétences techniques : * Bonne connaissance des GAAP et/ou IFRS américains .
• L'expérience des systèmes ERP, en particulier SAP (FI, CO/PA, MM, FA, FCC) et BlackLine est hautement souhaitable.
• Compétences avancées dans Microsoft Excel et Google Workspace.
• Langues: Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale; maîtrise de l'anglais et de l'espagnol.
• Compétences de base : * Fortes capacités de gestion et de collaboration des intervenants.
• Résolution de problèmes avec un accent sur l'automatisation des processus et l'amélioration continue.
• Capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités avec une supervision minimale. Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour cette affectation. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Laissez-les construire un avenir plus sain,

jobs.title: Estagiário de Engenharia
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Como Estagiário de Engenharia - Customer Experience, você integrará a equipe de atendimento ao cliente, oferecendo suporte vital às operações diárias. Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para aplicar seus conhecimentos técnicos e causar um impacto positivo na experiência dos nossos clientes.

A Oportunidade:

• Você realiza o cadastro de peças e a consolidação de informações em planilhas de Excel.

• Você fornece suporte essencial ao time de especialistas de campo e interage constantemente com a equipe.

• Você controla e afere instrumentos e ferramentas utilizadas nas operações.

• Você atua no controle de modificações e gerencia as manutenções preventivas.

• Você monitora os casos de preparação do local ( site preparation ), bem como os processos de instalação e desinstalação.

• Você oferece suporte na utilização das ferramentas ASA, Online Support e cobas link.

• Você presta suporte presencial ( on site ) de forma proativa aos clientes da sua base.

Quem você é:

• Você tem previsão de conclusão de curso acadêmico a partir de 2028 e manterá vínculo ativo com a instituição de ensino durante todo o período.

• Você tem disponibilidade para estagiar de 1 a 2 anos, com uma carga horária de 6 horas diárias.

• Você possui conhecimento técnico/científico na área e demonstra um raciocínio analítico, lógico e focado.

• Você tem conhecimento, no mínimo intermediário, do pacote Windows Office.

• Você é proativo, demonstra grande interesse em aprender e mantém uma postura atenta e cuidadosa em suas atividades.

• Você constrói um bom relacionamento com todas as áreas e valoriza fortemente o trabalho em equipe.

• Você não se importa em lidar com demandas de rotina operacional e se adapta bem a elas.

Desejável:

• Você possui conhecimento de inglês em nível intermediário.

*Benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about people, communication, and making a real difference in a global organization? If you excel at coaching, building relationships, and solving complex problems, we want you! Join our People Support Solutions team as a Talent Acquisition Partner and leverage your expertise in human interaction to launch a career in global talent acquisition.

The Opportunity:

• Launch your career in Talent Acquisition by learning to manage the full recruiting lifecycle within a supportive global team.

• Act as a key communication partner for hiring managers and senior leaders, applying your coaching and interpersonal skills to guide them through the hiring process.

• Learn to conduct in-depth candidate assessments , focusing on evaluating core competencies and fit.

• Manage and optimize the candidate experience , ensuring clear, consistent communication from application to offer.

• Utilize advanced HR technology (Workday) to streamline recruiting activities and support crucial data management.

• Collaborate closely on internal talent management efforts, including succession planning and internal mobility, applying a strategic lens to organizational needs.

• Contribute to process innovation , helping us challenge the status quo and continuously improve our talent search strategies.

Who You Are:

• Advanced language skills in German and English (both written and spoken) are mandatory.

• 2-3 years of experience in end-to-end recruitment

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Life Science or equivalent work experience is required

• You possess a strong customer-centric, growth, and agile mindset , thriving in ambiguous and multicultural environments.

• You demonstrate proven stakeholder management and influencing skills , with the ability to manage expectations and build trust with diverse partners.

• You are capable of working independently , effectively managing multiple, competing priorities, and driving toward results with a positive attitude.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/dpn4candidates

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 mil

• Contribuire a elaborare l'innovazione, aiutandoci a sfidare lo status quo e migliorare continuamente le nostre strategie di ricerca del talento. Chi sei?
• Le competenze linguistiche avanzate in tedesco e inglese (sia scritte che parlate) sono obbligatorie.

• Lei dimostra la gestione comprovata delle parti interessate e le capacità di influenzare, con la capacità di gestire le aspettative e costruire fiducia con partner diversi.
• Siete in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente, gestire in modo efficace più, priorità concorrenti, e guidare verso i risultati con un atteggiamento positivo. In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.
• Una comunità globale inclusiva, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto focalizzata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità di condividere la tua opinione. Si prega di leggere la Informativa sulla privacy dei dati per ulteriori informazioni su come gestiamo i vostri dati personali relativi al processo di reclutamento: https://go.roche.com/dpn4candidates Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni

jobs.title: Manufacturing Operator
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Manufacturing Operator contributes to producing reliable products and supplies with effective operations in an empowered organization. As part of a dynamic team, the Manufacturing Operator is responsible for collaborating with their team to operate automated equipment and systems to perform a wide variety of complex tasks related to assembly, printing, fill and kitpack manufacturing operations.

The opportunity:

• Executes the process of assembly, filling, labeling & packaging equipment of varying complexity and in accordance with production manufacturing records, operating procedure requirements to produce finished intermediates and final kits while meeting production targets.

• Performs basic transactions within highly complex systems and controls in a regulated manufacturing environment (e.g. receive, process, build product/materials, facilitate material availability, SAP transactions/confirmations).

• Runs automated systems/equipment and sequences of operation, including: equipment setup, operation, and cleaning; monitoring and performing basic troubleshooting.

• Participates in the execution of protocol/validations.

• Maintains ability to be a subject matter expert (SME) in one or more areas of production. Contributes to daily end of shift reports and pass downs.

Who you are?

• You hold a High School Diploma or GED (Associate's Degree preferred)

• 2+ years of relevant work experience.

• 2+ years of working experience with: Automated manufacturing equipment in a regulated environment. Experience with validated software systems used to maintain quality, Inventory, and Processes. Familiarity with sensors, motors, cylinders, etc., and with use of hand tools and test equipment.

• Relevant work experience in GMP environment (preferred)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every person deserves a healthy future — and that starts with ensuring the right medicines reach the right patients. We're looking for a strategic leader to shape how Indonesia's healthcare system values and accesses innovative therapies, working at the intersection of public policy, communications, and patient impact.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences who share our commitment to improving lives through science.

Your Opportunity
As Chapter Lead, you will sit on Indonesia's Leadership Team and play a central role in shaping the country's medicines access strategy — ensuring eligible patients can reach Roche's innovative therapies. You'll build and lead a high-performing team while driving relationships across government, health authorities, and patient organizations.
In this role, you will:

• Build productive relationships with government bodies, the Ministry of Health, and patient groups to strengthen treatment access and delivery nationally

• Lead the development of public policy strategies that create a favorable environment for healthcare investment and innovative treatment access

• Oversee the process for securing formulary listings and drive proposals that expand or extend access to Roche therapies

• Shape communications strategy and campaigns that reflect the business's long-term vision and key brand priorities

• Represent Roche in industry trade groups and collaborate with regional and global teams to share learnings across markets

• Lead early strategic analysis of local market potential for new therapies entering the pipeline

• Coach, mentor, and develop your team, embedding a culture of collaboration, integrity, and continuous growth

Who you are

• You hold a university degree in a relevant field such as life sciences, political science, health economics, public health, or business; an MBA is a plus

• You bring at least 10 years of experience in specialty therapeutic areas, ideally within pharmaceuticals, health economics, or private payer industries

• You have a track record of engaging senior stakeholders across complex, matrixed organizations

• You're a strong communicator with excellent analytical and business presentation skills

• You bring proven people leadership experience, with a genuine passion for developing others

• You act with integrity, courage, and a strategic mindset, and you're energized by driving impact at a national level

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst - Monitoring & Incident Response
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats.

As a CyberSecurity Analyst -Monitoring & Incident Response , you will help protect proprietary information, patient data, keep computer systems clean, and provide a safe information environment for our users. Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems.

Note: As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents.

Responsibilities:

• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment

• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information

• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts

• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents

• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations

• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team

• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group

• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management

• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes

• Mentor newer team members

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment

• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices

• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience

• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents

• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts

• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)

• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)

• Excellent organization and communication skills.

• Fluent spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications:

• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment

• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring

• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)

• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)

• A passion for the field of computer and network security

• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets

• Public speaking or mentoring experience

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare sol

• Capacità di comunicare concetti e situazioni legati alla sicurezza delle informazioni a un pubblico non tecnico

• Conoscenza dell'ingegneria di rilevamento e dei concetti di minaccia
• Capacità di scrittura e programmazione (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, ...)
• Conoscenza dimostrata dei sistemi operativi (Windows, Linux, macOs)
• Eccellente capacità di organizzazione e comunicazione.
• Fluente parlato e scritto inglese Preferiti:
• Esperienza di monitoraggio della sicurezza di rete e Endpoint in un ambiente complesso
• Prima esposizione ai framework di privacy nel contesto del monitoraggio della sicurezza IT

• Familiarità con vari strumenti di sicurezza difensivi e offensivi

Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività, e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter offrire il sol sanitario in continua evoluzione

jobs.title: Customer Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Customer Partner, you will be responsible for growing the market share and achieving sales goals for the assigned territory. You will be responsible for executing the sales process, ensure operation effectiveness and efficiency, with proficient interpersonal and communication skills, and providing effective solutions to establish and maintain relationships that result in customer satisfaction, retention and acquisition.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

Territory coverage: Central + Negeri Sembilan
Primary work location: Central - based

In this role, you will

• Lead the complete sales process including prospecting, qualification, closing, contracting, implementation, and ensuring high-standard after-sales support through solution/consultative selling.

• Build long-term, value-based customer relationships by continuously uncovering changing needs, improving customer experience, and adding value through creative solutions.

• Establish credibility with stakeholders by demonstrating business acumen, professional expertise, and adapting one's communication style to align with customers' working styles.

• Drive business development by identifying, developing, retaining, extending, and acquiring accounts, and collaborating across teams to attain objectives.

• Strategize for growth by developing and implementing annual territorial plans to achieve sales goals and future growth, and profiling accounts to position RDMY strongly to win tenders.

• Maintain data integrity in REXIS Salesforce by regularly updating accounts/contacts, and ensuring weekly entry and monitoring of activities and business opportunities.

• Support sales execution with technical proficiency, including conducting basic troubleshooting and using the Global Deal Calculator (GDC) to prepare sales proposals, along with participation in relevant marketing events.

Any other tasks or projects as assigned from time to time.

Who you are

• Strong client-facing skills including communication, negotiation, and influencing.

• Highly efficient and results-driven, demonstrating strong critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.

• Commercial awareness and product knowledge, plus the ability to be a team player who thrives and collaborates in a cross-functional, fast-changing environment.

• Required education is a Bachelor or Master Degree in Health/Science/Medical disciplines (Tertiary qualification in Science and Business focus is desired), preferably with at least one year of related industry experience.

• High technical ability and computer literacy are required, along with a valid Malaysian driver’s license and the ability to travel interstate; IT, people management, marketing, and business development experience are beneficial.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster

• Führen Sie den gesamten Verkaufsprozess, einschließlich Prospektion, Qualifizierung, Abschluss, Kontraktion, Implementierung und Sicherstellung eines hochwertigen After-Sales-Supports durch Lösungs- / Beratungsverkauf.
• Bauen Sie langfristige, wertorientierte Kundenbeziehungen auf, indem Sie ständig wechselnde Bedürfnisse aufdecken, die Kundenerfahrung verbessern und durch kreative Lösungen Mehrwert schaffen.
• Etablieren Sie Glaubwürdigkeit bei den Stakeholdern, indem Sie Geschäftssinn, professionelles Fachwissen und die Anpassung des eigenen Kommunikationsstils an die Arbeitsstile der Kunden demonstrieren.

• Unterstützung der Vertriebsausführung mit technischen Kenntnissen, einschließlich der Durchführung grundlegender Fehlersuche und der Verwendung des Global Deal Calculator (GDC) zur Vorbereitung von Verkaufsvorschlägen sowie der Teilnahme an relevanten Marketingveranstaltungen. • Starke kundenorientierte Fähigkeiten, einschließlich Kommunikation, Verhandlung und Einflussnahme.

• Erforderliche Ausbildung ist ein Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Gesundheits- / Wissenschafts- / Medizinischen Disziplinen (Tertiäre Qualifikation in Wissenschaft und Wirtschaft Schwerpunkt ist erwünscht), vorzugsweise mit mindestens einem Jahr einschlägiger Branchenerfahrung.
• Hohe technische Fähigkeiten und Computerkenntnisse sind erforderlich, zusammen mit einem gültigen malaysischen Führerschein und der Fähigkeit, zwischenstaatliche Reisen zu unternehmen; IT, Personalmanagement, Marketing und Geschäftsentwicklung sind von Vorteil. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
As the AI Product Manager, you will lead the strategic development and implementation guidance of AI & Digital empowered solutions, ensuring strict alignment with business objectives. You will drive the delivery of key initiatives including DPMM (Digital Patient Monitoring and Management), PLM (Patient-Like-Me), Content Generation, and Research Solutions. Success in this position requires partnering closely with Medical Affairs, Customer Engagement (CE), and Access teams to foster strategic synergy and ensure the seamless execution of these digital innovations.

Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Strategic Planning & Lifecycle Management Develop and execute a long-term strategic plan for the assigned AI & Digital empowered solutions (e.g., DPMM, PLM, Content Generation, or Research Solutions) that aligns with the organization’s overall business goals.
a) Market Intelligence: Conduct regular analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and threats within the data-driven product management and marketing landscape.
b) Roadmap & Implementation: Provide strategic guidance to cross-functional teams on the deployment of digital solutions; develop and maintain a phased roadmap to ensure structured execution and scalability.
c) Partnership Management: Establish and nurture relationships with external partners—including data providers, technology vendors, and industry experts—to leverage external capabilities and accelerate innovation.
d) Continuous Improvement: Create a systematic mechanism for the ongoing review and optimization of strategies, processes, and product performance across the solution lifecycle.

2. Scientific Leadership & Ecosystem Engagement Reinforce Roche’s position as a scientific leader in the increasingly competitive and evolving Innovative Healthcare Solution landscape.
a) Ecosystem Collaboration: Leverage internal expertise while fostering collaborations with key players in the external AI & Digital Innovation ecosystem to demonstrate scientific value and address stakeholder needs.
b) Value Communication: Ensure the medical and scientific value of the digital solutions is effectively communicated and recognized by the healthcare system, leveraging existing medical team expertise and stakeholder networks.

3. Governance, Compliance & Risk Management Ensure strict adherence to corporate policies, SOPs, and local regulations across all initiatives.
a) Medical Governance: Uphold high standards of scientific and medical compliance, ensuring a balanced framework for risk/benefit management specifically tailored to digital health innovations.
b) Regulatory Adherence: Guarantee that all initiatives strictly comply with Roche’s SOPs, codes of conduct, and local regulatory requirements throughout the product lifecycle.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
1. Bachelor’s degree or above in life sciences, medicine, or data science, i.e. an MBA, or equivalent combination of scientific and business education/experience is helpful, such as strategy consulting experience
2. >2 years’ experience in medical affairs, marketing, business development, digital innovation in multinational company
Leadership Competencies
1. Strategic agility
2. Technical and business expertise
3. Inspiring and influencing
4. Teamwork and collaboration
5. Experienced strategic thinking and planning skills.
6. Demonstrated ability in cross-functional leadership, cross-industry and ecosystem leadership

Job Required

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

We are looking for an IT senior engineer to join one of our teams in Roche Digital Technology.
In Roche Digital Technology we focus on delivering technology that evolves the practice of medicine and helps patients live longer, better lives.
You will be responsible for the Design and Implementation of Directory Services (mainly Microsoft Active Directory) solutions and tier 2-3 operational support, performance, lifecycle management and continuous improvement of the underlying technologies. You will be part of multiple initiatives or projects with multiple specialists across multiple time zones in order to achieve the organizational objectives.

Description of the area
As a Manufacturing Specialist Directory Services you would be part of a multicultural and global team protecting our information and assets from unauthorized access, security risks and cyber attacks.
Job Responsibilities

• Collaborate in small to medium sized technical teams and contribute to the end to end design of infrastructure solutions producing and maintaining sufficient documentation.

• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters and contribute to determining success criteria and evaluation of promising solutions/technologies via Proofs of Concepts (PoC’s) and feasibility studies.

• Providing 2nd and 3rd level support. Operationally manage and support and implement the Directory Services Infrastructure on premises for manufacturing environments and its associated compliments and applications.

• Proactively monitor systems and platforms for performance, availability and capacity management and ensure that the solution and component escalations are minimized.

• Promptly responding to customer requests, resolve incidents and implement changes, ensuring a high level of customer engagement and satisfaction

• Understanding, implementing and following relevant concepts of ITIL, GxP and Project Management. These include Request Management, Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, Document Management, Qualification and Validation and Project Management

• Actively focusing on own self-development and creating actionable plans to improve

• Provide 24x7 on-call support. Flexibility regarding working hours

• Occasional international travel is required

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline; or recognition of prior working experience which is equivalent.

• 4+ years experience administering and advance troubleshooting in Active Directory

• Robust experience working in a major global organization, preferably in a regulated industry

Technical Skills

• Strong design and hands-on technical background. Solid experience on Microsoft Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Services (LDAP) and desirable in Entra ID.

• Powershell Scripting skills will be required

• Ability to apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis in practical scenarios

• Skill in evaluating change and technology impacts with increasing accuracy, and breaking down complex technical concepts with minimal guidance

Additional Qualifications

• Proven interpersonal skills to interact effectively with individuals in multiple countries and in varying cultures

• Willingness to continually evolve, acquire and maintain the technical and soft skills appropriate to the requirements of this position

• Committing to operational ex

titleByLocale.it: Business Development Lead: Nuovi modelli di business
titleByLocale.en: Business Development Lead: New Business Models
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable du développement des entreprises : nouveaux modèles d'affaires

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Location: Morocco, Côte d'Ivoire, Kenya, Egypt, Nigeria, or South Africa.

Travel Requirement: The initial pilots for this initiative will be conducted in various African countries. Candidates must be prepared for extensive travel, particularly during the project's go-live and hypercare periods . Estimated travel: 50%

The Opportunity: Commercial Execution and Scale a High-Impact
Healthcare Model

At Roche, we are driven to do "Now What Patients Need Next". This is a unique opportunity to lead the on-the-ground execution of a transformative healthcare solution in Africa. We are seeking an entrepreneurial leader to spearhead the first-ever implementation of a new IVD- Access enabling business model.

The innovative model employs a Hub-and-Spoke approach to connect small and medium-sized IVD laboratories to a state-of-the-art central reference laboratory, dedicated to improving access to high-quality In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) in Africa and other low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). The model seeks to catalyze the development of Lab Medicine practices in the selected countries by driving increased investment in capacity and capability development.

As the Business Development Lead, you will own the end-to-end success (strategic, operational, and commercial) of the initial pilot and the development of related models in Africa. Your primary mission is to drive the successful launch of the defined and validated business model, ensuring the business is commercially sustainable and scalable. This is an execution-focused role, responsible for bringing this innovative business model’s vision to life.

Your Mission: A Phased Approach to Impact
Your role will evolve through three distinct phases:
1. Execute the Blueprint: Lead the inaugural pilot implementation to establish a successful, sustainable operational foundation. This includes commercial accountability for the pilot and its expansion.
2. Codify & Deploy the Playbook: Ensure the systematic capture of insights and learnings from the first pilot to create a replicable, scalable playbook for future deployments.
3. Drive Replication: Leverage your practical expertise to support the scaling of other new business models across Subregion Africa, ensuring lessons from the pilot are integrated into future launches. This includes commercial accountability for future deployments.

Key 
• Responsibilities
Phase 1: Pilot Leadership
● Lead the on-the-ground implementation and operational scaling of the innovative model in the first pilot market.
● Drive all commercial and contracting processes with laboratory network leaders to ensure sustainable deployment and financial viability.
● Engage Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and lab stakeholders to co-build the network, shape governance frameworks, and refine business models.
● Collaborate with internal experts (e.g., legal, finance, procurement) and external partners to ensure a compliant and sustainable deployment of the model.

Phase 2 & 3: Playbook Development & Replication Support
● Systematically translate pilot execution into a practical, replicable success model for other regions.
● Develop and empower regional and local teams through on-field coaching and guidance, building implementation expertise across the organization.
● Serve as the subject matter expert on the Model’s implementation, supporting the rollout of similar business models across public and private sectors in the sub-region.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Posizione: Marocco, Costa d'Avorio, Kenya, Egitto, Nigeria o Sudafrica. Richiesta di viaggio: Il primo pilota per questa iniziativa sarà condotto in Marocco. I candidati con sede al di fuori del Marocco devono essere preparati per lunghi viaggi in Marocco, in particolare durante i periodi di go-live e ipercare del progetto. Poiché i modelli si espandono, sarà richiesto un ulteriore viaggio all'interno della regione. L'opportunità: esecuzione commerciale e scalare un alto impatto Modello sanitario A Roche, siamo spinti a fare "Ora che i pazienti hanno bisogno di Next". Questa è un'occasione unica per condurre l'esecuzione on-the-ground di una soluzione sanitaria trasformativa in Africa. Stiamo cercando un leader imprenditoriale per testare la prima implementazione di un nuovo IVD- Accesso a modello aziendale. L'innovativo modello impiega un approccio Hub-and-Spoke per collegare piccoli e medi laboratori IVD ad un laboratorio di riferimento centrale all'avanguardia, dedicato a migliorare l'accesso a sistemi diagnostici in vitro di alta qualità in Africa e in altri paesi a basso e medio reddito (LMIC). Il modello mira a catalizzare lo sviluppo delle pratiche di Lab Medicine nei paesi selezionati, promuovendo un aumento degli investimenti in capacità e sviluppo delle capacità. Come il Business Development Lead, possiederai il successo finale (strategico, operativo e commerciale) del pilota in Marocco e lo sviluppo di modelli correlati in Africa. La vostra missione primaria è quella di guidare il lancio di successo del modello aziendale definito e convalidato, garantendo che l'azienda sia commercialmente sostenibile e scalabile. Si tratta di un ruolo focalizzato sull’esecuzione, responsabile di portare a vita la visione di questo innovativo modello di business. La vostra missione: un approccio graduale all'impatto Il vostro ruolo si evolverà attraverso tre fasi distinte: 1. Eseguire la Blueprint: guidare l'implementazione pilota inaugurale in Marocco per stabilire una fondazione operativa di successo e sostenibile. Ciò include la responsabilità commerciale per il pilota e la sua espansione. 2. Codify & Deploy the Playbook: Assicurare la cattura sistematica di intuizioni e apprendimento dal pilota del Marocco per creare un playbook replicabile e scalabile per future distribuzioni in Marocco e nuovi mercati. 3. Drive Replication: Leva la tua esperienza pratica per supportare la scalatura di altri nuovi modelli di business in Subregion Africa, assicurando lezioni dal pilota sono integrati in future lanci. Ciò include la responsabilità commerciale per le future distribuzioni. Principali responsabilità Fase 1: Leadership pilota (Marocco)
• Guidare l'implementazione on-the-ground e lo scaling operativo del modello innovativo in Marocco.
• Guidare tutti i processi commerciali e contrattuali con i leader di rete di laboratorio per garantire la distribuzione sostenibile e la redditività finanziaria.
• I leader del parere chiave di Engage (KOLs) e gli stakeholder di laboratorio per co-costruire la rete, i quadri di governance della forma e perfezionare i modelli di business.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a business product owner, you will work within an agile team, contributing to the creation and delivery of desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products and solutions that fulfill customer needs. This role requires close collaboration with various stakeholders to ensure alignment with business goals and user requirements throughout the product development lifecycle.

What You Bring to the Table
You aren’t just a backlog manager; you are the strategic bridge between digital learning innovation and business value. You understand that a great learning experience isn't just about pushing content—it’s about engagement, seamless architecture, and driving a clear return on investment.
To thrive in this role, you should bring a mix of the following skills, mindsets, and experiences:

The Digital Learning Acumen

• EdTech Ecosystem Savvy: Solid grasp of modern learning ecosystems (LMS/LXP, content authoring, resource management) and how to integrate them.

• Vendor Fluency

• B2B / External Mindset: Understands the high level of polish, security, and value required when building platforms for external customers vs. internal training.

Business & Product Strategy

• ROI & Value-Driven: Translates feature requests into hard metrics and business cases, ruthlessly prioritizing the backlog based on data and clear ROI.

• Data & Architecture Thinking: Partners with IT architects to ensure seamless, scalable, and simple end-to-end learning data flows.

Collaboration & Agile Leadership

• Agile Execution: Collaborates closely with Dev, UX, and QA teams to translate a broad business vision into crisp, actionable user stories.

• Stakeholder Diplomacy: A master communicator who aligns senior leadership, business process owners, and diverse teams with clarity and empathy.

• Continuous Improvement: Monitors support data, user feedback, and SLAs to ensure the platform constantly evolves post-launch.

Additional Tasks:

• Demonstrate the We@RD dimensions and help evolve the function's cultural beliefs and bring We@Roche Diagnostics to life as part of the TransformD journey. The dimensions are:
• We are passionate about our customers and patients

• We radically simplify

• We trust, collaborate & have fun

• We ALL lead

• We experiment & learn

Who are you?

• Experience: 3-5+ years as an Agile Product Owner or Product Manager.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, or a related field; Agile certifications (CSPO/PSPO) preferred.

• Ecosystems: Strong grasp of learning ecosystems (LMS/LXP).

• B2B / External Focus: Proven track record managing digital platforms for
external clients or commercial customers (not just internal HR training).

• Business Acumen: Ability to build data-driven business cases, define KPIs, and ruthlessly prioritize backlogs based on ROI.

• Technical Literacy: Comfortable partnering with IT architects on data flows, platform integrations, and system scalability.

• Roche Culture Fit (We@RD): Demonstrates a mindset for radical simplification, data-driven experimentation, and leading without direct authority.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Sant Cugat del Vallès. jobs.title: Clinical Research Engagement Lead (CREL)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about strengthening healthcare partnerships to accelerate clinical innovation? As the Clinical Research Engagement Lead (CREL), you will play a pivotal role in driving strategic site engagement, optimizing clinical trial operations, and delivering an exceptional, streamlined experience for clinical trial sites.
In this role, you will champion a "One Roche" approach, acting as the primary point of contact for strategic sites and bringing together internal medical and operational teams to anticipate and support site needs. By establishing a collaborative local community and managing key relationships with Contract Research Organizations (CROs), you will ensure the successful, high-quality delivery of our portfolio from early to late-stage clinical development.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive Strategic Site Engagement: Develop and execute tailored country-level site engagement strategies across disease areas, fostering trust, operational excellence, and accelerated trial progression.

• Optimize Early Landscaping & Feasibility: Engage strategically with investigators during early trial setup, landscaping, and protocol review phases to identify the most suitable sites and optimize recruitment speed.

• Lead Relationship Management & Collaboration: Act as the primary point of contact for strategic clinical sites, building deep connections with investigators, pharmacists, and clinic administrations to align cross-study priorities and capture feedback trends.

• Coordinate Internal Communities: Convene and lead a local site engagement community (integrating Local Medical Affairs, field medical teams, and clinical operations) to streamline communications and enhance the site experience.

• Provide Global & Local Study Oversight: Oversee the planning, risk mitigation, and compliance of assigned clinical studies, tracking monitoring performance, risk-based monitoring plans, and trial master file completeness.

• Manage Partner Relationships: Collaborate closely with CRO partners throughout the clinical trial lifecycle to ensure unified delivery goals, high site satisfaction, and swift resolution of operational challenges.

• Ensure Inspection Readiness: Lead local quality reviews, internal audits, and regulatory inspections for allocated studies, ensuring absolute compliance with global quality standards and regulatory guidelines.

Who You Are
You are a strategic, relationship-driven clinical operations professional who excels in dynamic environments, leads cross-functional alignment through ambiguity, and holds a strong commitment to customer-centric delivery.
Qualifications & Skills:

• Education: Degree (MD, PhD, Master’s, or Bachelor’s) in life sciences or an equivalent discipline.

• Experience: Significant experience in the pharmaceutical or clinical research industry, with essential expertise in end-to-end product development and clinical trial processes.

• Relationship Management: A proven track record of managing site relationships, overseeing complex clinical trials, and effectively collaborating with CROs.

• Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Demonstrated ability to handle multiple priorities, proactively identify operational challenges, and develop effective, data-backed compliance and mitigation strategies.

• Communication & Influencing: Exceptional presentation, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with the ability to bridge communication gaps between global teams and local external stakeholders.

• Languages: Mandatory fluency

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sei appassionato di rafforzare le partnership sanitarie per accelerare l'innovazione clinica? Come il Piombo di Engagement di Ricerca Clinica (CREL), si svolgerà un ruolo cardine nella guida dell'impegno strategico del sito, ottimizzando le operazioni di prova clinica e offrendo un'esperienza eccezionale e snella per i siti di prova clinica. In questo ruolo, si sarà campione di un approccio "One Roche", che funge da punto di contatto primario per i siti strategici e riunisce team medici e operativi interni per anticipare e sostenere le esigenze del sito. Con la creazione di una comunità locale collaborativa e la gestione di relazioni chiave con le Organizzazioni di Ricerca Contrattuali (CRO), si assicurerà la consegna di successo e di alta qualità del nostro portafoglio dal primo al tardo stadio sviluppo clinico. Responsabilità chiave:
• Drive Strategic Site Engagement: Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di coinvolgimento del sito su misura a livello di paese in aree di malattia, promuovere la fiducia, l'eccellenza operativa e accelerare la progressione di prova.
• Ottimizzare Early Landscaping & Feasibility: Coinvolgere strategicamente con gli investigatori durante le fasi di configurazione di prova, paesaggistica e revisione del protocollo per identificare i siti più adatti e ottimizzare la velocità di assunzione.
• Lead Relationship Management & Collaboration: Agire come punto primario di contatto per siti clinici strategici, costruire connessioni profonde con investigatori, farmacisti e amministrazioni cliniche per allineare le priorità di studio e catturare le tendenze di feedback.
• Coordinate Comunità Interne: Convene e guida una comunità locale di coinvolgimento del sito (integrando gli Affari Locali, le squadre mediche di campo e le operazioni cliniche) per semplificare le comunicazioni e migliorare l'esperienza del sito.
• Fornire la supervisione di studi globali e locali: supervisionare la pianificazione, la mitigazione del rischio e la conformità di studi clinici assegnati, monitorare le prestazioni, i piani di monitoraggio basati sui rischi e la completezza dei file master di prova.
• Gestisci i Rapporti Partner: Collabora a stretto contatto con i partner CRO in tutto il ciclo di vita di prova clinica per garantire obiettivi di consegna unificati, alta soddisfazione del sito e rapida risoluzione delle sfide operative.
• Assicurare la prontezza di ispezione: condurre recensioni di qualità locale, audit interni e controlli normativi per gli studi assegnati, assicurando l'assoluta conformità con gli standard di qualità globali e le linee guida regolamentari. Chi sei Sei un professionista di operazioni cliniche strategiche e relazionali che eccelle in ambienti dinamici, conduce l'allineamento interfunzionale attraverso l'ambiguità, e detiene un forte impegno per la consegna concentrica del cliente. Qualifiche e competenze:
• Istruzione: Laurea (MD, PhD, Master o Bachelor) in scienze della vita o una disciplina equivalente.
• Esperienza: Esperienza significativa nel settore della ricerca farmaceutica o clinica, con competenze essenziali nello sviluppo del prodotto end-to-end e nei processi di sperimentazione clinica.
• Relationship Management: una comprovata traccia di gestione delle relazioni del sito, supervisione di studi clinici complessi e collaborazione efficace con CRO.
• Mindset strategico e analitico: capacità dimostrata di gestire più priorità, identificare proattivamente le sfide operative e sviluppare strategie di compliance e mitigazione efficaci e supportate dai dati.
• Comunicazione & Influencing: presentazione eccezionale, competenze interpersonali e di negoziazione, con la capacità di colmare le lacune di comunicazione tra team globali e stakeholder esterni locali.
• Lingue: Fluenza obbligatoria

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, Gesundheitspartnerschaften zu stärken, um klinische Innovationen zu beschleunigen? Als Clinical Research Engagement Lead (CREL) spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Förderung des strategischen Engagements vor Ort, der Optimierung des klinischen Studienbetriebs und der Bereitstellung einer außergewöhnlichen, optimierten Erfahrung für klinische Studienstandorte. In dieser Rolle werden Sie sich für einen "One Roche" -Ansatz einsetzen, der als primärer Ansprechpartner für strategische Standorte fungiert und interne medizinische und operative Teams zusammenführt, um den Bedarf vor Ort zu antizipieren und zu unterstützen. Durch den Aufbau einer kollaborativen lokalen Gemeinschaft und die Verwaltung wichtiger Beziehungen zu Contract Research Organizations (CROs) stellen Sie die erfolgreiche, qualitativ hochwertige Lieferung unseres Portfolios von der frühen bis späten klinischen Entwicklung sicher. Wichtigste Aufgaben:
• Strategisches Standortengagement vorantreiben: Entwicklung und Umsetzung maßgeschneiderter Strategien für das Engagement auf Länderebene in Krankheitsgebieten, Förderung von Vertrauen, operativer Exzellenz und beschleunigter Studienfortschritt.
• Optimieren Sie Early Landscaping & Machbarkeit: Engagieren Sie sich strategisch mit den Ermittlern während der frühen Testphase, der Landschaftsgestaltung und der Protokollüberprüfung, um die am besten geeigneten Standorte zu identifizieren und die Rekrutierungsgeschwindigkeit zu optimieren.
• Lead Relationship Management & Collaboration: Handeln Sie als primärer Ansprechpartner für strategische klinische Standorte und bauen Sie tiefe Verbindungen zu Ermittlern, Apothekern und Klinikverwaltungen auf, um studienübergreifende Prioritäten auszurichten und Feedback-Trends zu erfassen.
• Koordinieren Sie interne Gemeinschaften: Vereinbaren und leiten Sie eine lokale Site-Engagement-Community (integrieren Sie lokale medizinische Angelegenheiten, medizinische Außendienstteams und klinische Operationen), um die Kommunikation zu optimieren und die Erfahrung vor Ort zu verbessern.
• Global & Local Study Oversight: Überwachen Sie die Planung, Risikominderung und Compliance der zugewiesenen klinischen Studien, die Verfolgung der Überwachungsleistung, risikobasierte Überwachungspläne und die Vollständigkeit der Studienstammdatei.
• Partnerbeziehungen verwalten: Arbeiten Sie während des gesamten Lebenszyklus der klinischen Studie eng mit CRO-Partnern zusammen, um einheitliche Lieferziele, eine hohe Zufriedenheit vor Ort und eine schnelle Lösung operativer Herausforderungen zu gewährleisten.
• Sicherstellung der Inspektionsbereitschaft: Führen Sie lokale Qualitätsüberprüfungen, interne Audits und behördliche Inspektionen für zugewiesene Studien durch, um die absolute Einhaltung globaler Qualitätsstandards und regulatorischer Richtlinien sicherzustellen. Wer du bist Sie sind ein strategischer, beziehungsorientierter Experte für klinische Operationen, der sich in dynamischen Umgebungen auszeichnet, eine funktionsübergreifende Ausrichtung durch Mehrdeutigkeit führt und sich stark für eine kundenorientierte Lieferung einsetzt. Qualifikationen & Fähigkeiten:
• Ausbildung: Abschluss (MD, PhD, Master oder Bachelor) in Life Sciences oder einer gleichwertigen Disziplin.
• Erfahrung: Bedeutende Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen oder klinischen Forschungsbranche mit wesentlicher Expertise in der End-to-End-Produktentwicklung und klinischen Versuchsprozessen.
• Relationship Management: Eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Verwaltung von Standortbeziehungen, der Überwachung komplexer klinischer Studien und der effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit CROs.
• Strategisches & analytisches Mindset: Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten zu bewältigen, proaktiv operative Herausforderungen zu identifizieren und effektive, datengestützte Compliance- und Minderungsstrategien zu entwickeln.
• Kommunikation & Einflussnahme: Außergewöhnliches Präsentations-, zwischenmenschliches und Verhandlungsgeschick mit der Fähigkeit, Kommunikationslücken zwischen globalen Teams und lokalen externen Stakeholdern zu schließen.
• Sprachen: Obligatorisch fließend

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Êtes-vous passionné par le renforcement des partenariats en santé pour accélérer l'innovation clinique? En tant que responsable de la participation à la recherche clinique (CREL), vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'engagement stratégique du site, l'optimisation des opérations d'essais cliniques et la prestation d'une expérience exceptionnelle et simplifiée pour les sites d'essais cliniques. Dans ce rôle, vous défendrez une approche « One Roche », agissant comme point de contact principal pour les sites stratégiques et réunissant des équipes médicales et opérationnelles internes pour anticiper et soutenir les besoins des sites. En établissant une communauté locale collaborative et en gérant des relations clés avec des organismes de recherche contractuels (ORC), vous assurerez la prestation réussie et de haute qualité de notre portefeuille, du début à la fin du développement clinique. Principales responsabilités :
• Diriger l'engagement stratégique sur le site : Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies d'engagement sur mesure à l'échelle du pays dans les domaines de la maladie, en favorisant la confiance, l'excellence opérationnelle et la progression accélérée des essais.
• Optimiser l'aménagement paysager et la faisabilité : S'engager stratégiquement auprès des chercheurs pendant les phases de mise en place, d'aménagement paysager et d'examen des protocoles pour identifier les sites les plus appropriés et optimiser la vitesse de recrutement.
• Gestion et collaboration des relations avec les responsables : agir comme principal point de contact pour les sites cliniques stratégiques, établir des liens étroits avec les chercheurs, les pharmaciens et les administrations des cliniques pour harmoniser les priorités des études croisées et saisir les tendances en matière de rétroaction.
• Coordonner les communautés internes : Convoquer et diriger une communauté d'engagement locale (intégration des affaires médicales locales, des équipes médicales de terrain et des opérations cliniques) pour rationaliser les communications et améliorer l'expérience du site.
• Superviser la planification, l'atténuation des risques et la conformité des études cliniques, le suivi du rendement de la surveillance, les plans de surveillance axés sur les risques et l'exhaustivité du dossier principal d'essai.
• Gérer les relations avec les partenaires : Collaborer étroitement avec les partenaires du CRO tout au long du cycle de vie des essais cliniques afin d'assurer l'uniformisation des objectifs d'exécution, la satisfaction élevée du site et la résolution rapide des défis opérationnels.
• Assurer la préparation à l'inspection : Diriger les examens locaux de la qualité, les vérifications internes et les inspections réglementaires pour les études attribuées, en assurant la conformité absolue aux normes de qualité mondiales et aux lignes directrices réglementaires. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel des opérations cliniques stratégique et axé sur les relations qui excelle dans des environnements dynamiques, mène l'alignement interfonctionnel par l'ambiguïté et tient un engagement ferme à la livraison centrée sur le client. Qualifications et compétences :
• Études : Diplôme (MD, doctorat, maîtrise ou baccalauréat) en sciences de la vie ou dans une discipline équivalente.
• Expérience : Expérience importante dans l'industrie de la recherche pharmaceutique ou clinique, avec une expertise essentielle dans le développement de produits de bout en bout et les processus d'essais cliniques.
• Gestion des relations : Une expérience éprouvée de la gestion des relations sur place, de la supervision des essais cliniques complexes et de la collaboration efficace avec les ORC.
• Mindset stratégique et analytique : Capacité démontrée de gérer plusieurs priorités, d'identifier de façon proactive les défis opérationnels et d'élaborer des stratégies efficaces de conformité et d'atténuation appuyées par des données.
• Communication et influence : Compétences exceptionnelles en présentation, en relations interpersonnelles et en négociation, avec la capacité de combler les écarts de communication entre les équipes mondiales et les parties prenantes externes locales.
• Langues: maîtrise obligatoire

The Position
Als Pharmafacharbeiter Ansatz / Abfüllung (m/w/d) bist Du für die Vorbereitung, Überwachung, Reinigung und Desinfizierung der Abfüllmaschine, der Gefriertrocknungsanlage und den optischen Kontrollmaschinen verantwortlich.

• Vous êtes de routine dans le traitement des travaux de documentation et des applications informatiques communes (en particulier MS Office, MES, Unilab).

• 客户管理
• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

计划管理
• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
• 1. 组织和支持区域专家会议
• 2．了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
• 3. 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

工作年限
• •1年以上医药行业工作经验
• •既往有销售/市场/医学经验
• •跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书
• •医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
• •在试用期内通过RDPAC考试
• •在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) serves as the central engine that sets the rhythm for collective success across the Roche Pharma Division. Positioned at the unique intersection of R&D, Commercial, and Manufacturing, GPS acts as the steward for Pharma, Portfolio, and Product strategies. Our mission is to catalyze the Roche ecosystem by leading end-to-end lifecycle management, commercialization excellence, and competitive fitness.

We are a future-focused organization committed to delivering on Roche’s Pharma Ambition — to launch 20 transformative medicines by 2030. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies, data insights, and an "outside-in" market perspective, GPS ensures that groundbreaking scientific discoveries are transformed into impactful healthcare solutions that reach patients swiftly and sustainably. In GPS, we work with a clear purpose and sense of urgency, knowing that the strategic choices we make today fundamentally transform the lives of people tomorrow.

As we strive toward our 2030 Pharma Ambition, the newly created Business Process & Operations (BPO) Unit is designed to ensure our internal operational backbone is efficient, compliant, and scalable. In the complex ecosystem we operate in, we drive consistency, transparency, and quality across all initiatives, ensuring that strategic goals are translated into measurable business impact.

The Opportunity
The Global Program Manager is a critical leadership role within the newly established GPS Business Process & Operations (BPO) Unit . While the Head of BPO sets the vision and the Business Manager enables the operations, you are the architect of coherence and driver of effective delivery .
Your mission is to bring structure to complexity while also proactively removing roadblocks and navigating through ambiguity. You will lead high-priority enterprise initiatives, ensuring they are designed with a customer-centric lens , ensuring that our "customers" (internal stakeholders across Therapeutic Areas, Functions and Organisational Units) experience clarity, not noise. You will be responsible for creating the frameworks that ensure GPS initiatives are not just launched, but successfully pulled through the organization with strategic alignment and operational excellence.

jobs.title: Finance Enterprise Partner (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are currently seeking a Finance Enterprise Partner to join our team at Roche Diagnostics Austria.

As an FEP (Finance Enterprise Partner) you leverage your in-depth business understanding combined with financial expertise in driving initiatives forward that are critical to delivering our commercial strategy. The FEP builds networks across the organisation to share best practices and co-create solutions that generate value for the affiliate, the enterprise and the customer. As an FEP, you are a trusted thought partner to business stakeholders and have close contact with customers, where you will ensure efficient resource allocation and maximum impact along the customer journey.

Main Responsibilities

• Strategic Partnership: Serve as a key business partner, co-leading customer journey touchpoints with an enterprise-wide mindset.

• Financial Advisory: Balance resource allocation across competing priorities and advise on the financial impact of business initiatives.

• Commercial Strategy: Collaborate on developing affiliate strategies, business planning, and creative revenue-generation models.

• Knowledge Sharing: Engage with FEP communities to adopt and implement global best practices locally.

• P&L Optimization: Drive profitability by identifying upsell opportunities, reducing risks, and improving operational efficiency.

• Executive Communication: Translate complex financial data into compelling "storyboard" presentations for executive decision-making.

• Culture & Collaboration: Lead and facilitate cross-functional workshops and events to strengthen team engagement.

• Process Innovation: Apply end-to-end thinking to radically simplify workflows, from deal calculation to contract monitoring.

Competencies

• Commercial and customer centric mindset with an ability to put all available financial and operational information into a holistic picture.

• Understanding of Corporate Finance, Financial Modelling, Insights Collection & Trend Prognosis.

• Understanding of data modeling to guide decision-making, solve problems, provide analytical insight and business judgment to support strategic and tactical initiatives across the affiliate.

• Strategic thinking and ability to translate business goals into financial plans.

• High level of social competence and ability to accurately record and efficiently communicate in English. (German is a plus but not a must)

• You have 2-5 years of experience in finance (ideally in a sales-focused or commercial role) and are familiar with SAP or equivalent ERP systems

We offer a gross salary starting at € 56.000 per year and attractive benefits. Flexible working hours, workplace health promotion and various sports programs, just to name a few. Depending on your qualifications and experience, overpayment is possible.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
