La FEP costruisce reti in tutta l'organizzazione per condividere le migliori pratiche e creare soluzioni che generano valore per la filiale, l'impresa e il cliente. Come FEP, sei un partner di fiducia per gli stakeholder aziendali e hai stretto contatto con i clienti, dove ti garantirai un'efficiente allocazione delle risorse e un impatto massimo lungo il percorso del cliente. Principali responsabilità
• Partenariato Strategico: Servire come partner di business chiave, co-leader touchpoint di viaggio del cliente con una mentalità a livello aziendale.
• Consulente finanziario: allocazione delle risorse di bilancio sulle priorità concorrenti e consulenza sull'impatto finanziario delle iniziative aziendali.
• Strategia commerciale: collaborare allo sviluppo di strategie di affiliazione, pianificazione aziendale e modelli di generazione di ricavi creativi.
• Condivisione della conoscenza: Impegnarsi con le comunità FEP per adottare e implementare le migliori pratiche globali localmente.
• Ottimizzazione P&L: Aumentare la redditività individuando opportunità di upsell, ridurre i rischi e migliorare l'efficienza operativa.
• Comunicazione Esecutivo: Traduci dati finanziari complessi in convincenti presentazioni "storyboard" per il processo decisionale esecutivo.
• Cultura & collaborazione: portare e facilitare workshop e eventi interfunzionali per rafforzare il coinvolgimento del team.
• Process Innovation: Applica il pensiero end-to-end per semplificare radicalmente i flussi di lavoro, dal calcolo degli accordi al monitoraggio dei contratti. Competenze
• Mindset centrico commerciale e cliente con la capacità di mettere tutte le informazioni finanziarie e operative disponibili in un quadro olistico.
• Comprensione di Corporate Finance, Financial Modelling, Insights Collection & Trend Prognosis.
• Comprensione della modellazione dei dati per guidare il processo decisionale, risolvere i problemi, fornire analisi e giudizio aziendale per sostenere iniziative strategiche e tattiche in tutta la filiale.
• Il pensiero strategico e la capacità di tradurre gli obiettivi aziendali in piani finanziari.
• Alto livello di competenza sociale e capacità di registrare con precisione e comunicare in modo efficiente in inglese. (Il tedesco è un plus ma non un must)
• Hai 2-5 anni di esperienza nel settore finanziario (probabilmente in un ruolo commerciale o commerciale) e conosci i sistemi SAP o ERP equivalenti Offriamo uno stipendio lordo a partire da € 56.000 all'anno e benefici interessanti. Ore lavorative flessibili, promozione della salute sul posto di lavoro e vari programmi sportivi, solo per citarne alcuni. A seconda delle vostre qualifiche e esperienza, il pagamento eccessivo è possibile. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Gesundheitsförderung am Arbeitsplatz und verschiedene Sportprogramme, um nur einige zu nennen. Abhängig von Ihren Qualifikationen und Ihrer Erfahrung ist eine Überzahlung möglich. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.

Principales responsabilités

• La réflexion stratégique et la capacité de traduire les objectifs opérationnels en plans financiers.
• Haute compétence sociale et capacité à enregistrer avec précision et à communiquer efficacement en anglais. (L'allemand est un plus mais pas un must)
• Vous avez 2-5 ans d'expérience en finance (idéalement dans un rôle commercial ou axé sur les ventes) et vous connaissez SAP ou des systèmes ERP équivalents Nous offrons un salaire brut à partir de € 56.000 par an et des avantages attrayants. Des horaires de travail flexibles, la promotion de la santé au travail et divers programmes sportifs, pour n'en nommer que quelques-uns. Selon vos qualifications et votre expérience, un trop-payé est possible. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Portfolio Management Lead – Foundational Products Squad

The Foundational Products Squad (FPS) is a location-agnostic squad composed of members from affiliates across multiple regions. FPS is accountable for the management and performance of a dynamic late-life-cycle portfolio, ensuring sustainable patient access, operational excellence, and long-term enterprise value creation.

As the Portfolio Management Lead, you are accountable for the end-to-end stewardship of the FPS portfolio and the deliberate expansion of FPS scope across markets, products, and portfolio clusters.

You operate with a strong enterprise mindset, shaping portfolio strategy, orchestrating product and affiliate transitions, and identifying internal business development opportunities that allow FPS to scale impact in a planned, value-driven, and system-ready manner.

Your role is not simply to manage what is already in FPS, but to anticipate what should come next — ensuring the right products enter FPS at the right time, under the right conditions, and with a clear value case for the enterprise.

Your accountability spans:

• Portfolio analysis, prioritisation, and performance management

• Product and affiliate readiness and transition orchestration

• Internal development to expand FPS scope across markets and products

Your day may involve analysing portfolio trade-offs, shaping transition strategies with affiliates, facilitating decision forums on FPS expansion, or engaging regional and global stakeholders to align on future onboarding opportunities.

The Opportunity

• You spearhead the end-to-end stewardship and strategic expansion of our mature-lifecycle product portfolio across diverse global markets, products, and portfolio clusters.

• You drive a strong enterprise mindset, shaping long-term portfolio strategy, managing complex product transitions, and unlocking internal business development opportunities to scale organizational impact.

• You proactively anticipate future portfolio needs, evaluating market dynamics and building robust value cases to ensure the right products transition into the squad at the optimal time.

• You co-create and continually refine product and market readiness criteria, shifting the organization from a reactive model to a deliberate, planned, and predictable portfolio integration process.

• You collaborate with cross-functional experts across local affiliates and global teams, defining short- and mid-term outcomes while nurturing a high-performance, self-managed agile culture.

• You act as a key driving force behind our operating model's expansion, identifying operational synergies and championing the portfolio's value proposition to executive stakeholders worldwide.

• You lead governance and decision-making forums with transparency, balancing performance, risk, and scalability to drive long-term value and sustainable patient access.

Who You Are

• You bring a minimum of 5+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry, ideally with exposure to multiple geographic markets or cross-border commercial environments.

• You possess solid experience in commercial, strategic, or financial roles (such as product marketing, finance, business operations, or portfolio management).

• You display strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a proven ability to synthesize complex, high-volume, and ambiguous inputs into clear strategic choices.

• You are a natural relationship builder with outstanding interpersonal and Eng

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Portfolio Management Lead – Foundational Products Squad La Foundational Products Squad (FPS) è una squadra di localizzazione-agnostica composta da membri di affiliati in più regioni. FPS è responsabile per la gestione e le prestazioni di un portafoglio dinamico di ciclo di latenza, garantendo un accesso sostenibile ai pazienti, l'eccellenza operativa e la creazione di valore aziendale a lungo termine. Come Lead Portfolio Management, sei responsabile della gestione end-to-end del portafoglio FPS e dell'espansione deliberata della portata FPS su mercati, prodotti e cluster di portafoglio. È possibile operare con una forte mentalità aziendale, modellare la strategia di portafoglio, orchestrare le transizioni di prodotto e di affiliazione, e identificare le opportunità di sviluppo aziendale interno che permettono a FPS di scalare l'impatto in modo pianificato, orientato al valore e sistema-ready. Il vostro ruolo non è semplicemente quello di gestire ciò che è già in FPS, ma di anticipare che cosa dovrebbe venire dopo — assicurando i prodotti giusti entrano in FPS al momento giusto, alle condizioni giuste, e con un caso di valore chiaro per l'impresa. La tua responsabilità si estende:
• Analisi del portafoglio, priorità e gestione delle prestazioni
• Prontezza e orchestrazione di transizione del prodotto e della filiale
• Sviluppo interno per espandere la portata FPS su mercati e prodotti La tua giornata potrebbe coinvolgere l'analisi dei trade-off di portafoglio, la definizione di strategie di transizione con gli affiliati, facilitando forum decisionali sull'espansione FPS, o coinvolgendo gli stakeholder regionali e globali per allinearsi alle future opportunità di bordo. L'opportunità
• Si guida la gestione end-to-end e l'espansione strategica del nostro portafoglio di prodotti a ciclo maturo in diversi mercati globali, prodotti e cluster di portafoglio.
• Guidare una forte mentalità aziendale, modellare strategia di portafoglio a lungo termine, gestire transizioni di prodotti complessi e sbloccare opportunità di sviluppo aziendale interno per scalare l'impatto organizzativo.
• Proattivamente si anticipano le future esigenze del portafoglio, valutando le dinamiche di mercato e costruendo robusti casi di valore per garantire la giusta transizione dei prodotti nella squadra al momento ottimale.
• Co-crea e perfeziona continuamente i criteri di prontezza del prodotto e del mercato, spostando l'organizzazione da un modello reattivo ad un processo di integrazione del portafoglio deliberato, pianificato e prevedibile.
• Collabori con esperti interfunzionali tra affiliati locali e team globali, definendo risultati a breve e medio termine, fornendo al contempo una cultura agile ad alte prestazioni e autogestita.
• Lei agisce come una forza trainante fondamentale dietro l'espansione del nostro modello operativo, identificando sinergie operative e sostenendo la proposta di valore del portafoglio a stakeholders executive in tutto il mondo.
• Si guida forum di governance e decision-making con trasparenza, bilanciamento delle prestazioni, rischio e scalabilità per guidare il valore a lungo termine e l'accesso sostenibile dei pazienti. Chi sei
• Porti un minimo di 5+ anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico o sanitario, idealmente con esposizione a più mercati geografici o ambienti commerciali transfrontalieri.
• Possiedi una solida esperienza in ruoli commerciali, strategici o finanziari (come marketing del prodotto, finanza, operazioni aziendali o gestione del portafoglio).
• Si visualizzano forti capacità analitiche e problem solving, con una comprovata capacità di sintetizzare ingressi complessi, high-volume e ambigui in scelte strategiche chiare.
• Sei un costruttore di relazioni naturali con eccezionale interpersonale e Eng

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Responsable de la gestion de portefeuille – Équipe des produits de base L'équipe des produits de base (FPS) est une équipe d'analyse de localisation composée de membres de filiales de plusieurs régions. Le SPF est responsable de la gestion et de la performance d'un portefeuille dynamique à cycle de vie avancé, assurant un accès durable aux patients, l'excellence opérationnelle et la création de valeur à long terme de l'entreprise. En tant que responsable de la gestion du portefeuille, vous êtes responsable de la gérance de bout en bout du portefeuille de la FPF et de l'expansion délibérée de la portée de la FPF dans les marchés, les produits et les grappes de portefeuille. Vous opérez avec un fort état d'esprit d'entreprise, façonnant la stratégie de portefeuille, orchestrant des transitions de produits et d'affiliation, et identifiant des possibilités de développement interne d'affaires qui permettent à FPS d'évaluer l'impact d'une manière planifiée, axée sur la valeur et adaptée au système. Votre rôle n'est pas simplement de gérer ce qui se trouve déjà dans le SFP, mais d'anticiper ce qui devrait se passer, c'est-à-dire de s'assurer que les bons produits entrent dans le SFP au bon moment, dans les bonnes conditions et avec un argument de valeur clair pour l'entreprise. Votre responsabilité s'étend à :
• Analyse de portefeuille, hiérarchisation et gestion des performances
• Préparation des produits et des filiales et orchestration de transition
• Développement interne en vue d'élargir la portée des SFP à tous les marchés et produits Votre journée peut comprendre l'analyse des compromis de portefeuille, l'élaboration de stratégies de transition avec les affiliés, la facilitation des forums de décision sur l'expansion du SPF, ou la participation des parties prenantes régionales et mondiales à l'alignement sur les futures possibilités d'embarquement. L'opportunité
• Vous êtes le chef de file de l'intendance de bout en bout et de l'expansion stratégique de notre portefeuille de produits à cycle de vie mature sur divers marchés, produits et grappes de portefeuille mondiaux.
• Vous dirigez une solide mentalité d'entreprise, façonnez une stratégie de portefeuille à long terme, gérez des transitions complexes de produits et débloquez des occasions de développement interne d'affaires pour accroître l'impact organisationnel.
• Vous anticipez de manière proactive les besoins futurs du portefeuille, en évaluant la dynamique du marché et en construisant des cas de valeur robustes pour assurer la transition des bons produits dans l'équipe au moment optimal.
• Vous cocréez et perfectionnez continuellement les critères de préparation aux produits et au marché, passant d'un modèle réactif à un processus d'intégration de portefeuille délibéré, planifié et prévisible.
• Vous collaborez avec des experts interfonctionnels à travers des filiales locales et des équipes mondiales, définissant les résultats à court et à moyen terme tout en favorisant une culture agile autogérée et performante.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Marketing Manager

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science & ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today & for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Your Opportunity

• You are a Multi-Channel Marketer who is a versatile leader responsible for driving the brand across the entire patient journey. Your role integrates scientific promotion to HCPs, trade marketing excellence in retail, & digital/e-commerce innovation into a seamless brand experience who can pivot between clinical data interpretation for doctors & shopper-behavior strategies for retail pharmacists.

• As a part of global organization, we regularly work with local, neighboring, regional & global teams to drive marketing initiatives, including new product launches & campaigns collaborating with relevant stakeholders on ongoing & future developments. You will proactively & independently; build, execute & own brand growth strategy for the company’s product portfolio assigned to you that is in line with global organizational strategy & overall priorities.

• Leverage Generative AI tools to accelerate the creation of scientific content for HCPs and creative assets for DTC/Retail channels, ensuring brand consistency and speed-to-market.

• You will work under the leadership of Marketing Head and closely collaborate with Marketing Managers to create & execute a multi-channel marketing plan leading to a seamless user journey delivering a delightful user experience.

• You will actively manage cross-functional stakeholders such as but not limited to, i.e. Sales, Procurement, Logistics, Finance, Taxation, Legal, Quality, & Regulatory etc. to deliver projects from brief through to delivery & manage external stakeholder & agency management i.e. creative agency, media agencies, vendors, distributors, etc. to meet business requirements thereby ensuring service level agreements & quality of services to deliver monthly sales.

• You will also co-ordinate with Strategy, ComEx & Field Teams to understand sales trends & business developments. You will conduct regular market visits to learn competition activity & consumer behavior to generate market feedback by engaging with HCPs, Retail Pharmacies and Patients generating first-hand understanding to refine marketing campaigns.

• You will implement & execute market research projects with multiple research agencies & as per identified needs. Convert insights into real opportunities & campaigns that drive the brand & business. You are comfortable working with big data, market research, customer surveys & web analytics tools to understand customer needs that help discover competitive & functional gaps to identify served & underserved needs & opportunities.

• You can conceptualize & execute patient support programs (PSPs) to enable high-value product selling & brand loyalty. Determine town & outlet penetration strategies to meet growth plans, ensuring the right GTM model for retail pharmacies & distributors. Maximize sales through superior trade visibility, distribution expansion, & customer engagement initiatives. Ensure trade marketing efforts are synchronized with mainline marketing & scientific initiatives. Develop & support in executing marketing plans for health & digital solutions to enhance engagement & usage in the digital arena.

• Define & manage marketing budgets while ensuring 100% compliance with legal requirements

• Sei un Multi-Channel Marketer che è un leader versatile responsabile della guida del marchio attraverso l'intero viaggio del paziente. Il tuo ruolo integra la promozione scientifica a HCP, l'eccellenza commerciale nel retail, e l'innovazione digitale/e-commerce in un'esperienza di marca senza soluzione di continuità che può ruotare tra l'interpretazione dei dati clinici per i medici e le strategie di shopper-behavior per i farmacisti al dettaglio.
• Nell'ambito dell'organizzazione globale, lavoriamo regolarmente con i team locali, vicini, regionali e globali per promuovere iniziative di marketing, tra cui nuovi lancio di prodotti e campagne collaborando con gli stakeholder rilevanti per gli sviluppi in corso e futuri. Proattivamente & indipendentemente; costruire, eseguire & propria strategia di crescita del marchio per il portafoglio prodotti dell'azienda assegnato a voi che è in linea con la strategia organizzativa globale & priorità generali.
• Strumenti Generativi AI per accelerare la creazione di contenuti scientifici per HCP e risorse creative per i canali DTC/Retail, garantendo la coerenza del marchio e la velocità di mercato.
• Potrai lavorare sotto la guida di Marketing Head e collaborare strettamente con Marketing Manager per creare ed eseguire un piano di marketing multicanale che porta a un viaggio utente senza soluzione di continuità che offre una deliziosa esperienza utente.
• Potrai gestire attivamente le parti interessate interfunzionali come, ma non solo, ad esempio, vendite, appalti, logistica, finanza, fiscalità, legale, qualità, e regolamentazione ecc. per fornire progetti da breve a consegna & gestire stakeholder esterni & gestione agenzia, vale a dire agenzia creativa, agenzie media, venditori, distributori, ecc per soddisfare i requisiti aziendali, garantendo così accordi di livello di servizio e qualità dei servizi per fornire vendite mensili.
• Potrai inoltre coordinare con Strategy, ComEx & Field Teams per comprendere le tendenze di vendita e gli sviluppi aziendali. Condurrai regolarmente visite di mercato per imparare l'attività di concorrenza e il comportamento dei consumatori per generare feedback di mercato coinvolgendo HCP, Farmacie al dettaglio e Pazienti che generano la comprensione di prima mano per perfezionare le campagne di marketing.
• Realizzerai ed eseguirai progetti di ricerca di mercato con più agenzie di ricerca & secondo le esigenze identificate. Converti intuizioni in opportunità reali e campagne che guidano il marchio & business. Sei a tuo agio a lavorare con grandi dati, ricerche di mercato, sondaggi dei clienti e strumenti di analisi web per comprendere le esigenze dei clienti che aiutano a scoprire lacune competitive e funzionali per identificare le esigenze e le opportunità servite e sottoserve.
• È possibile concettualizzare ed eseguire programmi di supporto dei pazienti (PSPs) per consentire la vendita di prodotti di alto valore e la fedeltà del marchio. Determinare le strategie di penetrazione di città e outlet per soddisfare i piani di crescita, garantendo il modello GTM giusto per le farmacie e distributori al dettaglio. Ottimizzare le vendite attraverso una visibilità commerciale superiore, l'espansione della distribuzione e le iniziative di coinvolgimento dei clienti. Assicurare gli sforzi di marketing commerciale sono sincronizzati con le principali iniziative di marketing e scientifiche. Sviluppare e sostenere nell'esecuzione di piani di marketing per la salute e le soluzioni digitali per migliorare il coinvolgimento e l'utilizzo nell'arena digitale.
• Definire e gestire i budget di marketing garantendo al 100% la conformità ai requisiti legali

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche, we combine diagnostics, medicines, and digital technology to tackle the toughest health challenges . As a Senior Software Test Engineer at Roche, you will be a key driver in ensuring the quality and reliability of our medical software systems. You will work independently on the test design and verification of complex software functions and features, ensuring they meet rigorous regulatory and safety standards. In this role, you will define the software test environment, lead verification activities, and mentor other team members to foster technical excellence within the software testing chapter.

Key Responsibilities

• Software V&V Planning & Strategy: Conduct independent reviews of software requirements and user stories to ensure clarity and testability. You will define software acceptance criteria in collaboration with stakeholders to establish a solid base for verification results.

• Advanced Software Test Design : Independently create, maintain, and review complex test cases for software components across all lifecycle phases—from early feasibility to product care. This includes collaborating closely with software developers on test case elaboration and issue resolution.

• Test Automation & Environment: Take responsibility for identifying and specifying the required software test equipment and environments. You will independently implement testing tools and automation frameworks in accordance with the test strategy and regulatory requirements.

• Execution & Defect Management: Execute complex software test sets, analyze results, and independently track issues through to verification of the fix. You will report findings directly to project teams and propose strategic further actions.

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance to less experienced team members in software testing methodologies. You will also drive the implementation of new software testing technologies and tools within the organization.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a software verification representative in project meetings and committees, collaborating with disciplines such as Systems Engineering, HW Development, and Operations.

Who you are

• Education: Successfully completed studies (M.Sc. level or higher) in Informatics, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (e.g., Mechatronics, Electronics).

• Experience: At least 5 years of professional experience in software verification or a similar position.

• Certification : ISTQB Certified Tester - Advanced Level (Test Analyst or Technical Test Analyst) or equivalent qualification.

• Technical Expertise :

• Profound knowledge of V&V processes and methods specifically for complex software systems.

• Advanced Programming Skills: Expert knowledge in test automation using languages such as Python, C/C++, Bash Script, or Gherkin .

• Tools: Advanced proficiency with test management tools like JAMA or codebeamer .

• Specialized Testing : Experience in load testing, reliability testing, and usability testing is highly desirable.

• Soft Skills :

• Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems and navigate conflicting situations under pressure.

• Strong communication skills to articulate complex software concepts and provide constructive feedback.

• Innovative mindset with the ability to foresee potential technical risks and proactively address them.

• Languages : Expert English language skills (B2/C1 level or better). ​

This position is based at Maxim Motherwell. We operate in a

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, combiniamo diagnostica, medicine e tecnologia digitale per affrontare le sfide più difficili per la salute. In qualità di Senior Software Test Engineer di Roche, sarete un driver chiave per garantire la qualità e l'affidabilità dei nostri sistemi software medici. Potrai lavorare in modo indipendente sulla progettazione di test e la verifica di funzioni e caratteristiche software complesse, assicurando che soddisfino rigorosi standard normativi e di sicurezza. In questo ruolo, definirete l'ambiente di test del software, le attività di verifica del piombo e il mentore altri membri del team per promuovere l'eccellenza tecnica all'interno del capitolo test del software. Principali responsabilità
• Software V&V Planning & Strategy: Condurre recensioni indipendenti di requisiti software e storie utente per garantire chiarezza e testabilità. Definirai i criteri di accettazione del software in collaborazione con gli stakeholder per stabilire una solida base per i risultati di verifica.
• Progettazione avanzata di test software: creare, mantenere e rivedere in modo indipendente casi di test complessi per i componenti del software in tutte le fasi del ciclo di vita - dalla fattibilità precoce alla cura del prodotto. Questo include collaborare strettamente con gli sviluppatori di software per l'elaborazione dei casi di test e la risoluzione dei problemi.
• Test Automation & Environment: assumersi la responsabilità di identificare e specificare le attrezzature e gli ambienti di prova del software richiesti. Potrai implementare in modo indipendente strumenti di prova e framework di automazione in conformità con la strategia di test e requisiti normativi.
• Execution & Defect Management: Eseguire set di test software complessi, analizzare i risultati e monitorare in modo indipendente i problemi attraverso la verifica della correzione. Potrai segnalare i risultati direttamente ai team di progetto e proporre ulteriori azioni strategiche.
• Leadership tecnica: fornire assistenza tecnica ai membri del team meno esperti nelle metodologie di test software. Potrai anche guidare l'implementazione di nuove tecnologie e strumenti di test software all'interno dell'organizzazione.
• Collaborazione interdisciplinare: agire come rappresentante di verifica del software in riunioni di progetto e comitati, collaborando con discipline come Ingegneria dei sistemi, Sviluppo HW e Operazioni. Chi sei
• Istruzione: Studi completati con successo (livello M.Sc. o superiore) in Informatica, Ingegneria del Software, o un campo tecnico correlato (ad esempio, Meccatronica, Elettronica).
• Esperienza: Almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale nella verifica del software o in una posizione simile.
• Certificazione: Tester certificato ISTQB - livello avanzato (analista di test di prova o analista tecnico) o qualifica equivalente.
• Competenza tecnica :
• Conoscenza comprovata dei processi e dei metodi V&V specificatamente per sistemi software complessi.
• Competenze di programmazione avanzate: Conoscenza degli esperti nell'automazione dei test utilizzando linguaggi come Python, C/C++, Bash Script, o Gherkin .
• Strumenti: Proficienza avanzata con strumenti di gestione dei test come JAMA o codebeamer .
• Testing specializzato: L'esperienza nel test di carico, test di affidabilità e test di usabilità è altamente auspicabile.
• Abilità morbide:
• Capacità dimostrata di risolvere problemi tecnici complessi e di navigare in situazioni di conflitto sotto pressione.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione per articolare concetti software complessi e fornire feedback costruttivi.
• Mindset innovativo con la capacità di prevedere potenziali rischi tecnici e affrontarli proattivamente.
• Lingue: competenze di lingua inglese esperto (livello B2/C1 o meglio). Questa posizione si basa su Maxim Motherwell. Operiamo in un

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Bei Roche kombinieren wir Diagnostik, Medikamente und digitale Technologie, um die größten gesundheitlichen Herausforderungen zu bewältigen. Als Senior Software Test Engineer bei Roche sind Sie ein wichtiger Treiber für die Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit unserer medizinischen Softwaresysteme. Sie arbeiten unabhängig am Testdesign und der Verifizierung komplexer Softwarefunktionen und -funktionen und stellen sicher, dass diese strengen Regulierungs- und Sicherheitsstandards entsprechen. In dieser Rolle definieren Sie die Software-Testumgebung, leiten Verifizierungsaktivitäten und betreuen andere Teammitglieder, um technische Exzellenz innerhalb des Software-Testkapitels zu fördern. Hauptzuständigkeiten
• Software V&V Planung & Strategie: Führen Sie unabhängige Überprüfungen der Softwareanforderungen und User Stories durch, um Klarheit und Testbarkeit zu gewährleisten. Sie definieren Software-Akzeptanzkriterien in Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern, um eine solide Basis für Verifizierungsergebnisse zu schaffen.
• Advanced Software Test Design: Erstellen, pflegen und überprüfen Sie selbstständig komplexe Testfälle für Softwarekomponenten in allen Lebenszyklusphasen - von der frühen Machbarkeit bis zur Produktpflege. Dazu gehört die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Softwareentwicklern bei der Ausarbeitung von Testfällen und der Problemlösung.
• Test Automation & Environment: Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Identifizierung und Spezifikation der erforderlichen Software-Testgeräte und -Umgebungen. Sie implementieren unabhängig Test-Tools und Automatisierungs-Frameworks gemäß Teststrategie und regulatorischen Anforderungen.
• Execution & Defect Management: Führen Sie komplexe Software-Testsets aus, analysieren Sie Ergebnisse und verfolgen Sie unabhängig Probleme bis hin zur Überprüfung des Fixes. Sie berichten die Erkenntnisse direkt an Projektteams und schlagen strategische weitere Maßnahmen vor.
• Technische Führung: Bieten Sie weniger erfahrenen Teammitgliedern technische Unterstützung bei Softwaretestmethoden. Sie werden auch die Implementierung neuer Software-Testtechnologien und -Tools innerhalb der Organisation vorantreiben.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Als Software-Verifizierungsvertreter in Projektbesprechungen und Ausschüssen tätig und arbeitet mit Disziplinen wie Systems Engineering, HW Development und Operations zusammen. Wer du bist
• Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (M.Sc.-Niveau oder höher) in Informatik, Software Engineering oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich (z. B. Mechatronik, Elektronik).
• Erfahrung: Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Verifizierung von Software oder einer ähnlichen Position.
• Zertifizierung: ISTQB Certified Tester - Advanced Level (Test Analyst oder Technical Test Analyst) oder gleichwertige Qualifikation.
• Technische Expertise:
• Tiefes Wissen über V&V-Prozesse und -Methoden speziell für komplexe Softwaresysteme.
• Erweiterte Programmierkenntnisse: Expertenwissen in der Testautomatisierung mit Sprachen wie Python, C/C++, Bash Script oder Gherkin.
• Werkzeuge: Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse mit Testmanagement-Tools wie JAMA oder Codebeamer.
• Spezialisiertes Testen: Erfahrung in Lasttests, Zuverlässigkeitstests und Usability-Tests ist sehr wünschenswert.
• Soft Skills:
• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Probleme zu lösen und in Konfliktsituationen unter Druck zu navigieren.
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Softwarekonzepte zu artikulieren und konstruktives Feedback zu geben.
• Innovative Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, potenzielle technische Risiken vorauszusehen und proaktiv darauf einzugehen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous combinons le diagnostic, les médicaments et la technologie numérique pour relever les défis de santé les plus difficiles. En tant qu'ingénieur principal des tests logiciels chez Roche, vous serez un moteur clé pour assurer la qualité et la fiabilité de nos systèmes logiciels médicaux. Vous travaillerez de manière indépendante sur la conception et la vérification de fonctions et de fonctionnalités logicielles complexes, en s'assurant qu'elles répondent à des normes réglementaires et de sécurité rigoureuses. Dans ce rôle, vous définirez l'environnement de test du logiciel, dirigerez les activités de vérification et mentorerez d'autres membres de l'équipe pour favoriser l'excellence technique dans le chapitre de test du logiciel. Principales responsabilités
• Planification et stratégie du logiciel V&V : Effectuer des examens indépendants des exigences du logiciel et des histoires d'utilisateurs pour assurer la clarté et la testabilité. Vous définirez les critères d'acceptation des logiciels en collaboration avec les intervenants afin d'établir une base solide pour les résultats de vérification.
• Conception de test logiciel avancé : Créez, maintenez et examinez indépendamment des cas de test complexes pour les composants logiciels dans toutes les phases du cycle de vie, de la faisabilité précoce à l'entretien des produits. Cela comprend une collaboration étroite avec les développeurs de logiciels sur l'élaboration de cas de test et la résolution des problèmes.
• Automatisation des essais et environnement: Prendre la responsabilité d'identifier et de spécifier l'équipement et les environnements de test logiciel requis. Vous mettrez en œuvre de manière indépendante des outils de test et des cadres d'automatisation conformément à la stratégie de test et aux exigences réglementaires.
• Exécution et gestion des défauts : Exécuter des ensembles de tests logiciels complexes, analyser les résultats et suivre les problèmes de manière indépendante jusqu'à la vérification de la correction. Vous ferez rapport directement aux équipes de projet et proposerez d'autres actions stratégiques.
• Leadership technique : Fournir des conseils techniques aux membres moins expérimentés de l'équipe en matière de méthodes d'essai logiciel. Vous dirigerez également la mise en oeuvre de nouvelles technologies et outils d'essai de logiciels au sein de l'organisation.
• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Agir en tant que représentant de la vérification des logiciels dans les réunions et les comités de projet, en collaboration avec des disciplines comme le génie des systèmes, le développement des systèmes et les opérations. Qui vous êtes
• Études : Études réussies (niveau de maîtrise ou plus) en informatique, génie logiciel ou dans un domaine technique connexe (p. ex. Mécatronique, électronique).
• Expérience : Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle en vérification de logiciels ou dans un poste similaire.
• Certification : Testeur certifié ISTQB - Niveau avancé (analyste de test ou analyste de test technique) ou qualification équivalente.
• Expertise technique :
• Connaissance approfondie des processus et des méthodes V&V spécifiques aux systèmes logiciels complexes.
• Compétences avancées en programmation : Connaissances d'experts en automatisation des tests en utilisant des langages tels que Python, C/C++, Bach Script ou Gherkin.
• Outils : Compétences avancées avec des outils de gestion de test comme JAMA ou codebeamer.
• Essais spécialisés : L'expérience en essais de charge, de fiabilité et d'utilisation est hautement souhaitable.
• Compétences souples :
• Capacité démontrée de résoudre des problèmes techniques complexes et de naviguer dans des situations conflictuelles sous pression.
• Fortes compétences en communication pour articuler des concepts logiciels complexes et fournir une rétroaction constructive.
• Un état d'esprit novateur capable de prévoir les risques techniques potentiels et de s'y attaquer de manière proactive.

jobs.title: EEMEA Regulatory Policy Associate

titleByLocale.fr: Associé de la politique réglementaire de l'AEEM

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Regulatory Policy Associate. In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in enhancing our regulatory intelligence and policy advocacy across the EEMEA region.

Main Responsibilities
- Conducting comprehensive intelligence digests and analyses to create insightful dashboards, slides, and summaries, capturing key regulatory updates within the EEMEA region internally and externally.
- Assisting in the empowerment program ( capability building program) by converting global strategies into effective training materials for local affiliates, and developing cross-country comparison insights that leverage your understanding of diverse local landscapes.
- Facilitating the operation of the EEMEA Regulatory Policy Community of Practice, including organizing meetings, agenda creation, documenting minutes, coordinating with members, and managing project-based teams ("topic-based squads").
- Enhancing the communication of regulatory policy value through the creation of supportive visual materials for the leadership team, maintaining the EEMEA regulatory policy Community of Practice web page, crafting success story visuals and summaries, and assisting with various external and internal events.
- Contributing to research efforts and connecting with internal stakeholders for the development of regional and local position papers on a variety of topics, ensuring that our regulatory stances are well-informed and robust.
- Supporting the Regradar regulatory monitoring tool by ensuring that regulatory cases are thoroughly evaluated and assessed within specified timelines, maintaining high standards of compliance and awareness.

Who you are
Required experience and competencies
- A minimum of 3 years of experience in regulatory - within medtech industry is a plus
- Experience in project management and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Familiarity with regulatory policy frameworks and a keen interest in staying updated with global regulatory trends is a plus
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex regulatory information.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with proficiency in creating clear and compelling presentations.

NOTE: This role is a contractor, the employment agreement will be signed through a third party agency

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

NOTA: Questo ruolo è un imprenditore, l'accordo di lavoro sarà firmato attraverso un'agenzia di terze parti Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• Position: Intern
• Location: Hyderabad

Job Description:
Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) at Chennai and Hyderabad to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

As an intern, you will work closely with Project leads to execute projects for stakeholders in the business teams across Roche’s global affiliates. The projects can be in the domains of Business Research, Analytics, Data Science, and Technology to deliver solutions to real-world business problems. You will be required to understand healthcare industry, business and mathematical logic and execute solutions using analytical thinking/technical skills.

In this role, you will:
● Turn Science into Business Insights: Use your biotech background to understand competitor pipelines, how new drugs work, and clinical trial updates, helping the team see the big picture & business impact.
• ● Track Competitors & Market Trends: Help monitor the global healthcare market by tracking new drug launches, pricing, and clinical trial progress using public and industry databases.
• ● Experiment with GenAI: Work with AI tools (like ChatGPT/LLMs) to summarize long clinical trial reports, read through company earnings calls, and speed up our research process.
• ● Follow Major Medical Conferences: Help the team prepare for massive global healthcare events (like ASCO and JP Morgan) by tracking what competitor data they are about to release.
• ● Spot Industry & Trigger Events & Keep an eye out for major industry news like new FDA approvals, breakthrough designations, or company mergers that could change the market.
● Learn Premium Industry level Tools & Databases: Get hands-on experience and training with top-tier professional research platforms (like Clarivate, AlphaSense, and EvaluatePharma) that experts use everyday.
• ● Present the findings from the analyses to the stakeholders in an effective and structured fashion
• ● Develop knowledge of the rapidly changing healthcare marketplace
• ● Contribute to the internal initiatives and help grow the GATE team

Education:
● UG: B.Tech/B.E. – (Biotechnology, Pharma sciences and related specializations)

Qualifications:
• ● Overall experience of 0-1 years in the analytics / consulting /technology space
• ● Strong quantitative aptitude and logical thinking ability is required

Your Department

Your internship will take place in the "Antibody Development" subchapter, which is part of our organization "Reagent Research and Design”. This subchapter focuses on the development of antibodies for various Roche Diagnostics platforms. During your internship, you will work in the "Recombinant Antibody Formats" group, responsible for cloning and expressing antibodies.
From the very beginning, you will be warmly welcomed into the team and gain exciting insights into various areas. The focus is to ensure a constant learning effect, to support and challenge you, and to offer you the opportunity to contribute your own ideas.

Your Tasks

• You will work on cloning and expressing antibodies in different cells

• You will support our team in optimizing transient transfection protocols through cell line engineering

• You will be responsible for sequencing of hybridoma cell lines.

• You will be involved in expression analyses of cells using various methods

• You will independently perform quality controls of expressed antibodies

• You will have the opportunity to plan and present your experiments independently

Your Profile

• You are enrolled in a master's degree program in biology, immunology, biotechnology, or a comparable field

• You have knowledge of fundamental immunological and molecular biological techniques (cloning, cell culture)

• You enjoy working in a team

• You are proficient in English and not afraid of talking to international clients

• Flexible working hours

• €2268 gross monthly compensation for a full-time internship > 3 months

• Discounted meal prices (-50%) in our employee cafeteria

• Fitness center on campus

• Networking with other students

• Possibility of accommodation in the Roche Boarding House or convenient transport links to Munich with the Roche Shuttle

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Your Department Your internship will take place in the "Antibody Development" subchapter, which is part of our organization "Reagent Research and Design”. This subchapter focuses on the development of antibodies for various Roche Diagnostics platforms. During your internship, you will work in the "Recombinant Antibody Formats" group, responsible for cloning and expressing antibodies. From the very beginning, you will be warmly welcomed into the team and gain exciting insights into various areas. The focus is to ensure a constant learning effect, to support and challenge you, and to offer you the opportunity to contribute your own ideas. Your Tasks
• You will work on cloning and expressing antibodies in different cells
• You will support our team in optimizing transient transfection protocols through cell line engineering
• You will be responsible for sequencing of hybridoma cell lines.
• You will be involved in expression analyses of cells using various methods
• You will independently perform quality controls of expressed antibodies
• You will have the opportunity to plan and present your experiments independently Your Profile
• You are enrolled in a master's degree program in biology, immunology, biotechnology, or a comparable field
• You have knowledge of fundamental immunological and molecular biological techniques (cloning, cell culture)
• You enjoy working in a team
• You are proficient in English and not afraid of talking to international clients Your Benefits
• Flexible working hours
• €2268 gross monthly compensation for a full-time internship > 3 months
• Discounted meal prices (-50%) in our employee cafeteria
• Fitness center on campus
• Networking with other students
• Possibility of accommodation in the Roche Boarding House or convenient transport links to Munich with the Roche Shuttle Your Application Please upload only your resume. Please remember that this internship is aimed at students (m/f/d) who are currently enrolled for the entire period of the internship or, alternatively, at people in a gap year of a maximum of one year (between Bachelor's and Master's studies), where it can be proven in writing at which university/college and exactly when (month/year) within a year the studies will be continued. Duration : Starting October 1st, 2026 for 6 months. We do not offer the opportunity to write a Master's Thesis. Please note that recommendations for all student activities (e.g. internships, theses, etc.) are excluded. We look forward to your application! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Ihre Abteilung Ihr Praktikum findet im Unterkapitel "Antikörperentwicklung" statt, das Teil unserer Organisation "Reagent Research and Design" ist. Dieses Unterkapitel konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung von Antikörpern für verschiedene Roche Diagnostics Plattformen. Während Ihres Praktikums arbeiten Sie in der Gruppe "Rekombinante Antikörperformate", die für das Klonen und Exprimieren von Antikörpern verantwortlich ist. Von Anfang an werden Sie herzlich in das Team aufgenommen und erhalten spannende Einblicke in verschiedene Bereiche. Der Fokus liegt darauf, einen konstanten Lerneffekt zu gewährleisten, Sie zu unterstützen und herauszufordern und Ihnen die Möglichkeit zu bieten, eigene Ideen einzubringen. Ihre Aufgaben
• Sie arbeiten am Klonen und Exprimieren von Antikörpern in verschiedenen Zellen
• Sie unterstützen unser Team bei der Optimierung transienter Transfektionsprotokolle durch Cell Line Engineering
• Sie sind für die Sequenzierung von Hybridom-Zelllinien verantwortlich.
• Sie werden an Expressionsanalysen von Zellen mit verschiedenen Methoden beteiligt sein
• Sie werden unabhängig Qualitätskontrollen von exprimierten Antikörpern durchführen
• Sie haben die Möglichkeit, Ihre Experimente unabhängig zu planen und zu präsentieren Ihr Profil
• Sie sind in einem Master-Studiengang in Biologie, Immunologie, Biotechnologie oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich eingeschrieben
• Sie haben Kenntnisse über grundlegende immunologische und molekularbiologische Techniken (Klonen, Zellkultur)
• Du arbeitest gerne im Team
• Sie beherrschen Englisch und haben keine Angst, mit internationalen Kunden zu sprechen Ihre Vorteile
• Flexible Arbeitszeit
• €2268 monatliche Bruttovergütung für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate
• Ermäßigte Mahlzeitenpreise (-50%) in unserer Mitarbeitercafeteria
• Fitnesscenter auf dem Campus
• Networking mit anderen Studierenden
• Unterkunft im Roche Boarding House oder bequeme Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit dem Roche Shuttle Ihre Bewerbung Bitte laden Sie nur Ihren Lebenslauf hoch. Bitte beachten Sie, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) richtet, die derzeit für die gesamte Dauer des Praktikums immatrikuliert sind oder alternativ an Personen in einem Lückenjahr von maximal einem Jahr (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium), wo schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, an welcher Universität/Hochschule und wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres das Studium fortgesetzt wird. Dauer: Ab dem 1. Oktober 2026 für 6 Monate. Wir bieten nicht die Möglichkeit, eine Masterarbeit zu schreiben. Bitte beachten Sie, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Aktivitäten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten etc.) ausgeschlossen sind. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Ihr Kontakt zu uns! Mit Menschen. Für Menschen. Benötigen Sie weitere Unterstützung? Bitte werfen Sie einen Blick auf unsere FAQs, Sie finden sie unter https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Votre département Votre stage aura lieu dans le sous-chapitre « Développement Anticorps », qui fait partie de notre organisation « Recherche et design réactifs ». Ce sous-chapitre se concentre sur le développement d'anticorps pour différentes plateformes de diagnostic Roche. Pendant votre stage, vous travaillerez dans le groupe "Recombinant Antibody Formats", responsable du clonage et de l'expression des anticorps. Dès le début, vous serez chaleureusement accueilli dans l'équipe et gagnerez des points de vue passionnants sur différents domaines. L'objectif est d'assurer un effet d'apprentissage constant, de vous soutenir et de vous défier, et de vous offrir la possibilité de contribuer à vos propres idées. Vos tâches
• Vous travaillerez sur le clonage et l'expression des anticorps dans différentes cellules
• Vous soutenirz notre équipe dans l'optimisation des protocoles de transfection transitoire grâce à l'ingénierie des lignes cellulaires
• Vous serez responsable du séquençage des lignées cellulaires d'hybridome.
• Vous serez impliqué dans les analyses d'expression des cellules en utilisant différentes méthodes
• Vous effectuerez indépendamment des contrôles de qualité des anticorps exprimés
• Vous aurez l'occasion de planifier et de présenter vos expériences indépendamment Votre profil
• Vous êtes inscrit à un programme de maîtrise en biologie, immunologie, biotechnologie ou un domaine comparable
• Vous connaissez les techniques biologiques immunologiques et moléculaires fondamentales (fermeture, culture cellulaire)
• Vous aimez travailler en équipe
• Vous maîtrisez l'anglais et n'avez pas peur de parler à des clients internationaux Vos avantages
• Durée du travail flexible
• 2268 € rémunération mensuelle brute pour un stage à temps plein > 3 mois
• Prix réduits des repas (-50%) dans notre cafétéria pour employés
• Centre de fitness sur le campus
• Réseautage avec d'autres étudiants
• Possibilité d'hébergement dans la Maison d'embarquement Roche ou des liaisons de transport pratiques vers Munich avec la navette Roche Votre demande Veuillez télécharger uniquement votre CV. Rappelez-vous que ce stage est destiné aux étudiants (m/f/d) qui sont actuellement inscrits pour toute la période du stage ou, alternativement, aux personnes dans une année d'écart d'un maximum d'un an (entre les études de baccalauréat et de maîtrise), où il peut être prouvé par écrit à quelle université/collège et exactement quand (mois/année) dans un an les études seront poursuivies. Durée : À partir du 1er octobre 2026 pendant 6 mois. Nous n'offrons pas la possibilité d'écrire une thèse de maîtrise. Veuillez noter que les recommandations pour toutes les activités des étudiants (par exemple les stages, les thèses, etc.) sont exclues. Nous nous réjouissons de votre candidature! Votre contact avec nous ! Avec des gens. Pour les gens. Avez-vous besoin d'un soutien supplémentaire? Consultez nos FAQ, vous les trouverez via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position

The Opportunity

• Liderar la clasificación, evaluación y gestión del desempeño de proveedores bajo Acuerdos de Nivel de Servicio (SLAs) e indicadores clave (KPIs) bien definidos.

• Enfoque analítico y ágil con orientación a resultados (ahorros, capital de trabajo, eficiencia operativa) y excelente capacidad de negociación persuasiva.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Asset Administration Shell (AAS) is a fundamental concept in the digitalization of industrial systems, aligning with the vision of Industry 4.0. It represents a standardized digital twin for physical assets, allowing a seamless interface between physical systems and the digital world. The AAS encapsulates all relevant information about an asset, including its state, behavior, and lifecycle data, creating an interoperable and machine-readable profile of the asset. Implementing the AAS concept in a synthetic molecules production facility enables improved data integration, analytics, and automation across processes. This digital twin-like structure enhances operational transparency, supports predictive maintenance, and improves production efficiency by ensuring real-time access to asset information across various systems and stakeholders. The AAS also fosters interoperability, ensuring that different components, equipment, and IT systems can easily exchange and process asset-related data.
Are you passionate about leveraging cutting-edge digital technologies to revolutionise the pharmaceutical industry? Do you have a keen interest in digitalization, Industry 4.0, and the optimization of production processes? If so, we invite you to join our Digital Value Delivery Team at our location in Basel/Kaiseraugst! As a working student, you will have the unique opportunity to collaborate with our dynamic team to develop and implement digital solutions in the space of Asset Administration Shell (AAS) that enhance production processes and drive digital transformation. Our team is dedicated to advancing digitization across all areas of our organisation, with a particular focus on the pharmaceutical sector. We are committed to exploring and creating new opportunities for digital twin models based on the AAS concept.

The Opportunity:

• You play an integral role in the ongoing development of our digital AAS initiative and the expansion of our digital and engineering capabilities.

• Close collaboration with internal stakeholders like engineers and operators, as well as external partners such as universities, enables you to develop innovative AAS solutions that streamline our production processes.

• Your participation allows you to gain in-depth knowledge of digitalization and Industry 4.0 topics like the AAS, specifically within the pharmaceutical industry.

• You actively engage in building a technical community around AAS within the global network and with relevant stakeholders.

• Through this role you strengthen your technical skills while enhancing your ability to build lasting relationships and professional networks.

• Organizing and participating in workshops and events gives you the opportunity to apply practical AAS methods and tools in a hands-on environment.

Who you are:

• You are currently enrolled in a Master's degree program, preferably in study areas connected to digitalization, engineering, or related fields.

• As an ambassador for our ethos of "innovation and excellence," you are a proactive, self-motivated individual with strong engineering and digital skills.

• Thriving in a dynamic environment enables you to provide both professional and personal support while fostering trust within the team through transparency and an open culture.

• You excel in networking and organizational skills, showing a keen interest in people along with familiarity with agile methods and tools.

• Your background allows you to structure and deliver conceptual work

L'implementazione del concetto AAS in un impianto di produzione di molecole sintetiche consente una migliore integrazione dei dati, analisi e automazione nei processi. Questa struttura digitale a due gemelli migliora la trasparenza operativa, supporta la manutenzione predittiva e migliora l'efficienza produttiva garantendo l'accesso in tempo reale alle informazioni sugli asset in diversi sistemi e stakeholder. L'AS promuove anche l'interoperabilità, assicurando che diversi componenti, attrezzature e sistemi IT possano facilmente scambiare e elaborare dati relativi alle attività. Sei appassionato di sfruttare tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia per rivoluzionare l'industria farmaceutica? Hai un forte interesse per la digitalizzazione, l'Industria 4.0 e l'ottimizzazione dei processi produttivi? Se è così, vi invitiamo a partecipare al nostro team di consegna del valore digitale nella nostra posizione a Basilea/Kaiseraugst! Come studente di lavoro, avrete l'opportunità unica di collaborare con il nostro team dinamico per sviluppare e implementare soluzioni digitali nello spazio di Asset Administration Shell (AAS) che migliorano i processi produttivi e spingono la trasformazione digitale. Il nostro team è dedicato a promuovere la digitalizzazione in tutte le aree della nostra organizzazione, con particolare attenzione al settore farmaceutico. Ci impegniamo a esplorare e creare nuove opportunità per i modelli gemelli digitali basati sul concetto AAS. L'opportunità:
• Si gioca un ruolo fondamentale nello sviluppo continuo della nostra iniziativa AAS digitale e nell'espansione delle nostre capacità digitali e ingegneristiche.
• Una stretta collaborazione con le parti interessate interne come ingegneri e operatori, nonché con partner esterni come le università, consente di sviluppare soluzioni AAS innovative che razionalizzano i nostri processi produttivi.
• La tua partecipazione ti consente di acquisire una conoscenza approfondita di argomenti di digitalizzazione e Industria 4.0 come l'AS, in particolare nell'industria farmaceutica.
• Si impegna attivamente nella costruzione di una comunità tecnica intorno AAS all'interno della rete globale e con le parti interessate rilevanti.
• Attraverso questo ruolo rafforzate le vostre competenze tecniche, migliorando la vostra capacità di costruire relazioni durature e reti professionali.
• Organizzare e partecipare a workshop ed eventi ti dà l'opportunità di applicare metodi e strumenti pratici AAS in un ambiente pratico. Chi sei:
• Sei attualmente iscritto a un corso di laurea magistrale, preferibilmente in aree di studio collegate a digitalizzazione, ingegneria o campi correlati.
• Come ambasciatore per la nostra ethos di "innovazione e eccellenza", sei un individuo proattivo e auto-motivato con forti competenze ingegneristiche e digitali.
• La crescita in un ambiente dinamico consente di fornire supporto sia professionale che personale, promuovendo la fiducia all'interno del team attraverso la trasparenza e una cultura aperta.
• Si eccelle in rete e capacità organizzative, mostrando un interesse acuto per le persone insieme con familiarità con metodi e strumenti agili.
• Il tuo background ti permette di strutturare e di fornire un lavoro concettuale
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Asset Administration Shell (AAS) is a fundamental concept in the digitalization of industrial systems, aligning with the vision of Industry 4.0. It represents a standardized digital twin for physical assets, allowing a seamless interface between physical systems and the digital world. The AAS encapsulates all relevant information about an asset, including its state, behavior, and lifecycle data, creating an interoperable and machine-readable profile of the asset. Implementing the AAS concept in a synthetic molecules production facility enables improved data integration, analytics, and automation across processes. This digital twin-like structure enhances operational transparency, supports predictive maintenance, and improves production efficiency by ensuring real-time access to asset information across various systems and stakeholders. The AAS also fosters interoperability, ensuring that different components, equipment, and IT systems can easily exchange and process asset-related data. Are you passionate about leveraging cutting-edge digital technologies to revolutionise the pharmaceutical industry? Do you have a keen interest in digitalization, Industry 4.0, and the optimization of production processes? If so, we invite you to join our Digital Value Delivery Team at our location in Basel/Kaiseraugst! As a working student, you will have the unique opportunity to collaborate with our dynamic team to develop and implement digital solutions in the space of Asset Administration Shell (AAS) that enhance production processes and drive digital transformation. Our team is dedicated to advancing digitization across all areas of our organisation, with a particular focus on the pharmaceutical sector. We are committed to exploring and creating new opportunities for digital twin models based on the AAS concept. The Opportunity:
• You play an integral role in the ongoing development of our digital AAS initiative and the expansion of our digital and engineering capabilities.
• Close collaboration with internal stakeholders like engineers and operators, as well as external partners such as universities, enables you to develop innovative AAS solutions that streamline our production processes.
• Your participation allows you to gain in-depth knowledge of digitalization and Industry 4.0 topics like the AAS, specifically within the pharmaceutical industry.
• You actively engage in building a technical community around AAS within the global network and with relevant stakeholders.
• Through this role you strengthen your technical skills while enhancing your ability to build lasting relationships and professional networks.
• Organizing and participating in workshops and events gives you the opportunity to apply practical AAS methods and tools in a hands-on environment. Who you are:
• You are currently enrolled in a Master's degree program, preferably in study areas connected to digitalization, engineering, or related fields.
• As an ambassador for our ethos of "innovation and excellence," you are a proactive, self-motivated individual with strong engineering and digital skills.
• Thriving in a dynamic environment enables you to provide both professional and personal support while fostering trust within the team through transparency and an open culture.
• You excel in networking and organizational skills, showing a keen interest in people along with familiarity with agile methods and tools.
• Your background allows you to structure and deliver conceptual work

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Die Asset Administration Shell (AAS) ist ein grundlegendes Konzept in der Digitalisierung industrieller Systeme, ausgerichtet auf die Vision von Industrie 4.0. Es stellt einen standardisierten digitalen Zwilling für physische Assets dar, der eine nahtlose Schnittstelle zwischen physischen Systemen und der digitalen Welt ermöglicht. Die AAS kapselt alle relevanten Informationen über einen Vermögenswert, einschließlich seines Zustands, Verhaltens und Lebenszyklusdaten, und erstellt ein interoperables und maschinenlesbares Profil des Vermögenswerts. Die Implementierung des AAS-Konzepts in einer Produktionsanlage für synthetische Moleküle ermöglicht eine verbesserte Datenintegration, Analyse und Automatisierung über Prozesse hinweg. Diese digitale Zwillingsstruktur erhöht die betriebliche Transparenz, unterstützt die vorausschauende Wartung und verbessert die Produktionseffizienz, indem sie Echtzeit-Zugriff auf Asset-Informationen über verschiedene Systeme und Interessengruppen hinweg gewährleistet. Die AAS fördert auch die Interoperabilität und stellt sicher, dass verschiedene Komponenten, Geräte und IT-Systeme anlagenbezogene Daten problemlos austauschen und verarbeiten können. Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, innovative digitale Technologien zu nutzen, um die Pharmaindustrie zu revolutionieren? Haben Sie ein großes Interesse an Digitalisierung, Industrie 4.0 und der Optimierung von Produktionsprozessen? Unser Team setzt sich dafür ein, die Digitalisierung in allen Bereichen unserer Organisation voranzutreiben, mit besonderem Fokus auf den Pharmasektor. Wir sind bestrebt, neue Möglichkeiten für digitale Zwillingsmodelle basierend auf dem AAS-Konzept zu erkunden und zu schaffen. Die Gelegenheit:
• Sie spielen eine wichtige Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer digitalen AAS-Initiative und dem Ausbau unserer digitalen und technischen Fähigkeiten.
• Die enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern wie Ingenieuren und Betreibern sowie externen Partnern wie Universitäten ermöglicht es Ihnen, innovative AAS-Lösungen zu entwickeln, die unsere Produktionsprozesse rationalisieren.
• Ihre Teilnahme ermöglicht es Ihnen, fundierte Kenntnisse über Digitalisierung und Industrie 4.0-Themen wie die AAS zu erwerben, insbesondere in der Pharmaindustrie.
