A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Platform Engineer - Piattaforma dati ERP Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Come SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) Datasphere Platform Engineer/Architetto, guiderai la strategia tecnica e il quadro operativo per il nostro ecosistema B DC, guidando l'ammodernamento degli ambienti SAP BW/4HANA legacy a SAP Datasphere . In questo ruolo, si agirà come un ponte vitale tra l'ingegneria della piattaforma di base, la conformità normativa e la produzione di dati a dominio aziendale. Ti unirai a un team avanzato dedicato alla costruzione di soluzioni dati scalabili, inclusive e all'avanguardia che consentano la scoperta globale della salute. L'opportunità
• Guida e definisce l'Architettura della Soluzione Business Data Cloud (BDC) garantendo un allineamento tecnico senza interruzioni con le strategie globali di "Cloud First" e di data mesh.
• Progettare e implementare critici "Architetture Guardrails" insieme a valutazioni approfondite della prontezza di backend S/4HANA, focalizzandosi sulla compatibilità di vista Core Data Services (CDS), per mantenere un ambiente altamente conforme, scalabile e pronto all'audit.
• Superare il ciclo di vita tecnico di Datasphere Spaces, governando tutto dal provisioning automatizzato e allocazione delle risorse agli standard di decommissione.
• Mantenere la continua integrazione e la continua distribuzione (CI/CD) del ciclo di vita del modello di dati, facilitando la promozione automatizzata attraverso il nostro paesaggio a 4 livelli (Sandbox, Development, Test/Quality, Production) ottimizzando al contempo il modello di unità di capacità flessibile (CU).
• La condivisione di dati bidirezionali (Zero-Copy) tra SAP Datasphere e ecosistemi esterni come Snowflake, assicura un'integrazione ad alte prestazioni con SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) e l'architettura DataOne esistente.
• Integrare la conformità essenziale e la governance direttamente nella configurazione della piattaforma, integrando Good Practice (GxP) e il controllo interno sulle prove di qualificazione del reporting finanziario (ICFR), gestendo la patch di vulnerabilità della piattaforma automatizzata.
• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di dati per far rispettare la gestione dei metadati e le strategie di tagging necessarie per la pubblicazione sul mercato e la sincronizzazione senza soluzione di continuità Collibra.
• Architetto robusti progetti di accesso alla sicurezza, comprese le strategie Identity and Access Management (IAM), i livelli di privacy/mascheramento dei dati (conformità GDPR/CCPA) e gli standard globali di progettazione della modellazione dei dati. Chi sei
• Istruzione: Lei ha una laurea o Master in Informatica, Tecnologia dell'informazione, Ingegneria dei dati, o un campo tecnico correlato.
• Anni di Esperienza: porti 5+ anni di

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Data Teams zusammen, um Metadatenmanagement- und Tagging-Strategien für die Veröffentlichung von Marktplätzen und die nahtlose Collibra-Synchronisierung durchzusetzen.
• Erstellen Sie robuste Sicherheitszugriffsdesigns, einschließlich Identitäts- und Zugriffsmanagement (IAM)-Strategien, Datenschutz-/Masking-Schichten (Gewährleistung der DSGVO/CCPA-Compliance) und globalen Standards für die Gestaltung von Datenmodellen. Wer du bist

En tant qu'ingénieur/architecte de plate-forme de données SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC), vous dirigerez la stratégie technique et le cadre opérationnel de notre écosystème B DC, menant à la modernisation des anciens environnements SAP BW/4HANA vers SAP Datasphère . Dans ce rôle, vous agirez comme un pont vital entre l'ingénierie de plate-forme fondamentale, la conformité réglementaire, et la production de données axée sur le domaine des affaires. Vous rejoindrez une équipe d'avant-garde dédiée à la construction de solutions de données évolutives, inclusives et de pointe qui permettent la découverte de soins de santé mondiaux. L'opportunité
• Dirigez et définissez l'architecture de solution Business Data Cloud (BDC), assurant un alignement technique sans faille avec les stratégies globales de «Cloud First» et de maillage de données.
• Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des « garde-corps architecturaux » critiques en plus d'évaluer en profondeur l'état de préparation du moteur S/4HANA – mettant l'accent sur la compatibilité des services de données de base (CDS) – afin de maintenir un environnement hautement conforme, évolutif et prêt à l'audit.
• Surveiller le cycle de vie technique des espaces de données, qui régit tout, depuis la fourniture automatisée et l'allocation des ressources jusqu'aux normes de déclassement.
• Maintenir le plan d'intégration et de déploiement continu (IC/CD) pour le cycle de vie du modèle de données, en facilitant la promotion automatisée dans notre paysage à quatre niveaux (boîte à sable, développement, test/qualité, production) tout en optimisant le modèle d'unité de capacité flexible (UC).
• Architecte un partage de données bidirectionnel complexe (Zero-Copy) entre SAP Datasphere et des écosystèmes externes comme Snowflake, assurant une intégration à haute performance avec SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) et l'architecture DataOne existante.
• Intégrer directement la conformité et la gouvernance essentielles à la configuration de la plateforme, en intégrant les preuves de qualification de Bonnes Pratiques (GxP) et de Contrôle Interne sur les Rapports Financiers (ICFR) tout en gérant le patchage automatisé de vulnérabilité de la plateforme.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de données afin d'appliquer les stratégies de gestion des métadonnées et d'étiquetage requises pour la publication sur le marché et la synchronisation transparente de Collibra.
• Architecter des conceptions robustes d'accès à la sécurité, y compris des stratégies de gestion de l'identité et de l'accès (IAM), des couches de confidentialité et de masquage des données (assurer la conformité au RGPD/CCPA) et des normes mondiales de modélisation des données. Qui vous êtes

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Security and Compliance Expert, ERP Data Platform

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.
Are you passionate about Information Security and Compliance, specifically in ERP environments with a focus on data integrity and governance? Join a global team where you'll lead the change as a Security and Compliance expert in optimizing processes through experience and automation.

The Mission
Your primary mission is to ensure that the organization's technology landscape, data practices, and security measures do not expose the business to legal penalties, financial loss, or reputational damage. As a recognized expert, you will implement and maintain security, authorization, and compliance standards for SAP ERP platform systems and data products, providing leadership across both on-premise and cloud SAP Data platform ecosystems.

The Opportunity

• Platform Security: Implement and maintain security, authorization, and compliance standards for SAP platforms (SAP BW 7.5 HANA, SAP BW4HANA, and SAP Datasphere). Develop and mature capabilities in cloud compliance and security, particularly within SAP Datasphere.

• Regulatory Alignment & Framework Management: Continuously monitor relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX) and industry standards (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST) to ensure the platform remains ahead of global compliance requirements.

• Policy Development & Data Governance: Drive the creation and refinement of internal policies and data governance frameworks to maintain high standards of integrity, security, and structured data handling.

• ICFR & Control Ownership: Act as the System Owner Deputy and Control Owner , taking accountability for the end-to-end ICFR (Internal Control over Financial Reporting) lifecycle, GxP controls, and other relevant regulations.

• Monitoring & Remediation: Lead weekly and monthly monitoring of SoD (Segregation of Duties) conflicts via GRC dashboards, work with SoD Champions to mitigate risks, and address non-compliant items flagged in the SAP Security Standards Roche documentation.

• System Integrity: Oversee application error reviews (e.g., failed jobs) and sign off on monitoring results in tools like ICAt to provide evidence for control checks.

• Access Governance: Perform quarterly reviews of Critical access , GRC FireFighter roles (Controllers, Owners, Admins), and HANA DB users, initiating timely removals to maintain a "least privilege" environment.

• Audit Leadership: Lead ICFR IT audit support by defining control activities, approving auditor documentation, and acting as the primary

La missione La vostra missione primaria è garantire che il paesaggio tecnologico dell'organizzazione, le pratiche di dati e le misure di sicurezza non espongono l'azienda a sanzioni legali, perdita finanziaria, o danni reputazionali. In qualità di esperto riconosciuto, implementerai e manterrai standard di sicurezza, autorizzazione e conformità per i sistemi e i prodotti di dati della piattaforma SAP ERP, fornendo leadership sia sugli ecosistemi della piattaforma SAP Data on-premise che sul cloud. L'opportunità
• Sicurezza della piattaforma: implementare e mantenere standard di sicurezza, autorizzazione e conformità per le piattaforme SAP (SAP BW 7.5 HANA, SAP BW4HANA e SAP Datasphere). Sviluppare e maturare funzionalità nella conformità e nella sicurezza del cloud, in particolare all'interno di SAP Datasphere.
• Allineamento normativo e gestione quadro: monitorare costantemente le normative pertinenti (ad esempio, GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX) e gli standard del settore (ad esempio, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST) per garantire che la piattaforma resti davanti ai requisiti di conformità globali.
• Politica di sviluppo e governance dei dati: guidare la creazione e la raffinatezza delle politiche interne e dei quadri di governance dei dati per mantenere elevati standard di integrità, sicurezza e gestione dei dati strutturati.
• ICFR & Control Ownership: Act as the System Owner Vice and Control Owner , tenendo conto della responsabilità del ciclo di vita ICFR (Internal Control over Financial Reporting), dei controlli GxP e di altre normative pertinenti.
• Monitoraggio e riparazione: Condurre il monitoraggio settimanale e mensile dei conflitti SoD (Segregation of Duties) tramite cruscotti GRC, lavorare con SoD Champions per mitigare i rischi e affrontare gli elementi non conformi contrassegnati nella documentazione di SAP Security Standards Roche.
• Integrità di sistema: supervisionare le recensioni degli errori delle applicazioni (ad esempio, lavori falliti) e firmare il monitoraggio dei risultati in strumenti come ICAt per fornire prove per i controlli di controllo.
• Access Governance: Eseguire recensioni trimestrali di accesso critico , GRC FireFighter ruoli (Controllers, Owners, Admins), e HANA DB utenti, avviando rimozioni tempestive per mantenere un ambiente "meno privilegio".
• Audit Leadership: Lead ICFR Il supporto dell'audit IT definendo le attività di controllo, approvando la documentazione dell'auditor e fungendo da punto di contatto primario per gli auditor durante i cicli di picco (Sep/Oct).
• Direzione strategica: Impostare le direzioni di sviluppo tecnologico analizzando e implementando nuove soluzioni, strumenti e standard IT, con un focus sulla governance dei dati, la convalida e l'automazione.
• Valutazione del rischio: rivedere e aggiornare annualmente la valutazione del rischio di sistema (SRA) e la classificazione dei dati per garantire l'allineamento con la Baseline di sicurezza minima.
• Ottimizzazione dei processi: condurre attivamente progetti di innovazione per ottimizzare i processi, introdurre nuove soluzioni e aumentare l'efficienza attraverso l'automazione dei prodotti Data.
• Collaborazione: Partner con i team di sistema e le parti interessate per garantire la proprietà delle attività, colmare le lacune di consapevolezza della privacy e formare nuovi membri del team sulle attività di controllo ICFR. Chi sei
• Istruzione e esperienza: Laurea in Informatica, IT o Ingegneria con un minimo di 5 anni di esperienza post-secondaria in SAP Security e una profonda comprensione della conformità.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Sicherheits- und Compliance-Experte, ERP-Datenplattform Sind Sie leidenschaftlich über Informationssicherheit und Compliance, speziell in ERP-Umgebungen mit dem Fokus auf Datenintegrität und Governance? Begleiten Sie ein globales Team, in dem Sie den Wandel als Sicherheits- und Compliance-Experte bei der Optimierung von Prozessen durch Erfahrung und Automatisierung vorantreiben. Die Mission Ihre Hauptaufgabe ist es, sicherzustellen, dass die Technologielandschaft der Organisation, Datenpraktiken und Sicherheitsmaßnahmen das Geschäft nicht auf rechtliche Strafen, finanziellen Verlust oder Rufschäden aussetzen. Als anerkannter Experte implementieren und pflegen Sie Sicherheits-, Berechtigungs- und Compliance-Standards für SAP ERP-Plattformsysteme und Datenprodukte, die sowohl über On-Premise- als auch Cloud-Systeme der SAP Data-Plattform führen. Die Chance
• Plattformsicherheit: Umsetzung und Aufrechterhaltung von Sicherheits-, Berechtigungs- und Compliance-Standards für SAP-Plattformen (SAP BW 7.5 HANA, SAP BW4HANA und SAP Datasphere). Entwickeln und reifen Fähigkeiten in der Cloud-Compliance und -Sicherheit, insbesondere in SAP Datasphere.
• Regulatorische Ausrichtung & Rahmenmanagement: Kontinuierlich relevante Regelungen (z.B. DSGVO, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX) und Industriestandards (z.B. ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST) überwachen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Plattform weiterhin den globalen Compliance-Anforderungen entspricht.
• Policy Development & Data Governance: Die Schaffung und Verfeinerung interner Politiken und Data Governance-Frameworks, um hohe Standards an Integrität, Sicherheit und strukturiertem Datenhandling zu erhalten.
• ICFR & Control Ownership: Act as the System Owner Deputy and Control Owner , unter Berücksichtigung der Verantwortung für den end-to-end ICFR (Internal Control over Financial Reporting) Lebenszyklus, GxP-Kontrollen und andere relevante Vorschriften.
• Monitoring & Sanierung: Führen Sie wöchentliche und monatliche Überwachung von SoD-Konflikten (Segregation of Duties) über GRC-Dashboards, arbeiten mit SoD-Champs zusammen, um Risiken zu mindern und nicht-konforme Objekte, die in der SAP-Sicherheitsstandards Roche-Dokumentation markiert sind, anzusprechen.
• Systemintegrity: Übersehen Sie die Fehlerbeurteilungen der Anwendung (z.B. gescheiterte Arbeitsplätze) und melden Sie sich bei der Überwachung der Ergebnisse in Werkzeugen wie ICAt an, um Nachweise für Kontrollkontrollen zu liefern.
• Access Governance: Führen Sie vierteljährliche Bewertungen von Critical Access, GRC FireFighter Rollen (Controller, Eigentümer, Admins) und HANA DB-Nutzer aus, die rechtzeitige Entfernungen zur Aufrechterhaltung einer "Least Privileg"-Umgebung einleiten.
• Audit Leadership: Lead ICFR IT-Audit-Unterstützung durch Definition von Kontrolltätigkeiten, Genehmigung der Auditor-Dokumentation und als primärer Ansprechpartner für Auditoren während der Spitzenzyklen (Sep/Oct).
• Strategische Richtung: Setzen Sie technologische Entwicklungsrichtungen durch Analyse und Implementierung neuer Lösungen, Tools und IT-Standards, mit einem Fokus auf Daten-Governance, Validierung und Automatisierung.
• Risikobewertung: Jährliche Überprüfung und Aktualisierung der System-Risikobewertung (SRA) und der Datenklassifizierung, um die Anpassung an die Mindestsicherheit Baseline sicherzustellen.
• Prozessoptimierung: Aktive Durchführung von Innovationsprojekten zur Optimierung von Prozessen, Einführung neuer Lösungen und Steigerung der Effizienz durch Automatisierung in Datenprodukten.
• Zusammenarbeit: Partner mit Systemteams und Stakeholdern, um Aufgabeneigentum zu gewährleisten, Datensicherheitslücken zu überbrücken und neue Teammitglieder auf ICFR-Kontrolltätigkeiten zu trainieren. Wer bist du?
• Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, IT oder Engineering mit mindestens 5 Jahren postsekundärer Erfahrung in SAP Security und einem tiefen Verständnis der Compliance.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Expert en sécurité et conformité, ERP Data Platform Êtes-vous passionné par la sécurité et la conformité de l'information, en particulier dans les environnements ERP, en mettant l'accent sur l'intégrité et la gouvernance des données? Rejoignez une équipe mondiale où vous dirigerez le changement en tant qu'expert en sécurité et conformité dans l'optimisation des processus par l'expérience et l'automatisation. La Mission Votre mission principale est de s'assurer que le paysage technologique, les pratiques en matière de données et les mesures de sécurité de l'organisation n'exposent pas l'entreprise à des pénalités légales, à des pertes financières ou à des dommages à sa réputation. En tant qu'expert reconnu, vous appliquerez et maintiendrez des normes de sécurité, d'autorisation et de conformité pour les systèmes et les produits de données SAP ERP, assurant ainsi un leadership à la fois sur site et dans les écosystèmes de la plateforme SAP Data Cloud. L'opportunité
• Sécurité des plateformes: Mettre en œuvre et maintenir des normes de sécurité, d'autorisation et de conformité pour les plateformes SAP (SAP BW 7.5 HANA, SAP BW4HANA et SAP Datasphere). Développer et développer des capacités en matière de conformité et de sécurité cloud, en particulier dans SAP Datasphère.
• Alignement de la réglementation et gestion du cadre: surveiller en permanence les réglementations pertinentes (par exemple, RGPD, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX) et les normes de l'industrie (par exemple, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST) afin de s'assurer que la plateforme reste en avance sur les exigences mondiales de conformité.
• Développement des politiques et gouvernance des données: Favoriser la création et le perfectionnement de politiques internes et de cadres de gouvernance des données pour maintenir des normes élevées d'intégrité, de sécurité et de traitement structuré des données.
• ICFR & Control Ownership: Agir en tant que propriétaire de système adjoint et propriétaire de contrôle, en prenant la responsabilité du cycle de vie de bout en bout ICFR (contrôle interne des rapports financiers), des contrôles GxP et d'autres règlements pertinents.
• Surveillance et réparation: Diriger la surveillance hebdomadaire et mensuelle des conflits de SoD (ségrégation des fonctions) via les tableaux de bord du GRC, travailler avec les champions de SoD pour atténuer les risques et traiter les éléments non conformes signalés dans la documentation SAP Security Standards Roche.
• Intégrité du système: Surveiller les examens d'erreurs d'application (par exemple, les emplois échoués) et signer le suivi des résultats dans des outils comme ICAt pour fournir des preuves pour les contrôles.
• Gouvernance de l'accès : Effectuer des examens trimestriels de l'accès critique, des rôles de FireFighter du GRC (Contrôleurs, Propriétaires, Administrateurs) et des utilisateurs de HANA DB, en initiant des suppressions en temps opportun pour maintenir un environnement « le moins privilégié ».
• Leadership de l'audit : chef de file du CIRF Soutien à la vérification de la TI en définissant les activités de contrôle, en approuvant la documentation de l'auditeur et en agissant comme principal point de contact pour les vérificateurs pendant les cycles de pointe (sept/oct).
• Orientation stratégique: Définir des orientations de développement technologique en analysant et en mettant en œuvre de nouvelles solutions, outils et normes informatiques, en mettant l'accent sur la gouvernance des données, la validation et l'automatisation.
• Évaluation des risques : Revoir et mettre à jour chaque année l'évaluation des risques du système et la classification des données afin d'assurer l'alignement sur la base minimale de sécurité.
• Optimisation des processus : Mener activement des projets d'innovation pour optimiser les processus, introduire de nouvelles solutions et accroître l'efficacité grâce à l'automatisation des produits Data.
• Collaboration: partenariat avec les équipes du système et les parties prenantes pour assurer l'appropriation des tâches, combler les lacunes en matière de sensibilisation à la protection des données et former de nouveaux membres d'équipes aux activités de contrôle du CIRF. Qui vous êtes
• Éducation et expérience: Baccalauréat en informatique, en informatique ou en génie avec un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience postsecondaire en sécurité SAP et une compréhension profonde de la conformité.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Maintenance Specialist, you will be able to contribute to shape the future of the Roche Diagnostics Operations by maintaining the best performance of our electro-mechanical equipment used in the Facilities/Utilities organization.

The Opportunity:

• You're performing electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning electromechanical equipment, HVAC, electrical, refrigeration, and chilled water systems used in Facilities/Utilities. Dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches, or drawings.

• You're using test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts & rebuild facilities/utilities equipment as required and perform equipment modifications including installation, validation support and start-up of new equipment, as well as decommissioning activities as directed by manufacturing engineers

• You're using maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies and apply advanced knowledge and skills to complete assignments requiring judgment and initiative. You will understand the implications of work and make recommendations for solutions. You will receive little instruction on daily assignments and may determine methods and procedures on new assignments.

• You're responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

• You're completing preventative maintenance tasks according to detailed procedures and schedules. You will provide emergency call-in support for operations that run during off- hours and weekends. Maintains accurate records of all activities

Who you are:

Minimum Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalency

• 2+ years related operations or manufacturing experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Associates Degree or equivalent military training or documented 3 years’ experience troubleshooting and repairing the following types of systems: HVAC, Ammonia refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic in an operations or manufacturing setting

• Proficient in Google Office Suite: Docs, Sheets, Slides, Email, Calendar

• Knowledge of screw and reciprocal compressors, electrical and controls troubleshooting

• Experience with Precision Maintenance practices; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and GDP (Good Documentation Practices)

• Experience with HVAC systems (rooftop units, air handling units, VAVs, fan coil units, electric and gas heaters); chilled water systems (ammonia screw chillers, ammonia and pumps); boilers and hot water systems (gas and electric boilers); refrigeration (stand-alone refrigerator/freezers, walk in coolers and freezers, CO2 refrigeration, and ammonia refrigeration)

• Experience with Building Automation systems

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The Position
Sobre Roche:
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.
Oportunidad:

Business & Squads Support Analyst
Como Business & Squads Support Analyst, jugarás un rol fundamental en la articulación y éxito de nuestras estrategias médicas y comerciales. T endrás la oportunidad de trabajar de manera ágil y transversal, brindando soporte directo al Squad Lead y a los Enablers Médicos y de Marketing. Serás el motor logístico, administrativo y organizativo que garantizará la correcta ejecución de nuestros eventos, lanzamientos y presupuestos, asegurando siempre el cumplimiento de nuestras normativas de compliance.

Responsabilidades:

• Gestión de Eventos y Congresos: Coordinar la participación en Congresos Médicos Nacionales e Internacionales, RIMEs, realización de Simposios, reuniones de Advisory Board, workshops, eventos propios locales y regionales.

• Logística Integral: Coordinar, dentro de las normas regulatorias y de compliance vigentes, la logística relacionada con los participantes y el evento (stands, materiales promocionales y no promocionales, contacto con disertantes, Profesionales Médicos, traslados, alojamiento, contratos y pago de honorarios).

• Lanzamientos: Organizar lanzamientos de productos, gestionando toda la logística de participantes y del evento.

• Gestión Presupuestaria: Dar soporte en la planificación de la alocación de inversiones. Realizar el seguimiento de presupuestos médicos y promocionales junto con el Partner de Finanzas, actualizando mensualmente al Squad Lead y Enablers, y monitoreando desvíos en el acumulado trimestral/anual.

• Control Administrativo y SAP: Realizar el control y análisis de gastos en SAP (o herramienta vigente). Enviar provisiones mensuales a Finanzas y controlar el WBS (seguimiento de gastos imputados a cada producto). Cargar requerimientos, controlar su cumplimiento, ingresar facturas/recibos y realizar el seguimiento del circuito de pago para evitar demoras.

• Materiales y Omnicanalidad: Planificar materiales promocionales/no promocionales y su distribución omnichannel a los PPoC’s.

• Soporte de Marca: Apoyar en la adaptación del branding internacional a los requisitos nacionales, slogans y frases promocionales acorde a las regulaciones locales.

• Entrenamientos: Organizar y coordinar el entrenamiento de PJPs junto con el Squad y el PJP Lead.

• Gestión de Grants & Donations (G&D): Recibir solicitudes de becas y donaciones, seguir su aprobación, evaluar presupuestos, confeccionar cartas de aceptación, cargar en el sistema GSD y controlar la ejecución del pedido.

• Contratos y Proveedores: Participar en el armado y validación de contratos junto al Depto. de Legales bajo lineamientos de compliance. Evaluar y tramitar el alta de proveedores según los procedimientos de compras de la compañía.

Buscamos a un profesional dinámico, con un fuerte sentido de la organización y habilidades interpersonales sobresalientes para integrarse a un entorno de trabajo ágil. Para tener éxito en este rol, debes cumplir con los siguientes requisitos:

• Experiencia: Cuentas con 2 a 3 años de experiencia comprobable en puestos similares, preferentemente dentro de la industria.

• Formación: Tienes nivel Terciario o Universitario completo o en curso (prefe

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Sobre Roche:

Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

La oportunidad
Estamos buscando un Becario de Administración y Marketing Médico para unirse a nuestro capítulo de Medical Affairs. Esta es una excelente oportunidad para estudiantes universitarios proactivos que deseen involucrarse en la gestión estratégica del sector farmacéutico. El candidato seleccionado brindará soporte operativo clave en la administración de contratos de profesionales de la salud (HCP), control de bases de datos, gestión de plataformas de compras internas y coordinación de actividades médico-científicas

Requisitos del Perfil

• Educación: Estudiante activo de 5to o 6to semestre de carreras universitarias en Ciencias Biomédicas, Química, Administración, Mercadotecnia o afines.

• Idiomas: Inglés básico.

• Herramientas Informáticas: Manejo básico de Paquetería Office y dominio operativo de Google Suite (Google Sheets automatizados, Drive, Forms).

Funciones y Responsabilidades Principales

• Gestión de Contratos y Cumplimiento Legal (SAC)

• Gestión de Proveedores y Plataformas Internas

• Control Administrativo, Compliance y Soporte al Capítulo Médico

• Gestión de eventos y actividades médico científicas &actividades digitales

Quien eres:
Competencias Deseadas

• Atención al detalle y rigurosidad en el manejo de documentos oficiales.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y servicio interno para interactuar con gerentes médicos, el equipo legal y proveedores externos .

• Autonomía y proactividad para dar seguimiento a procesos que dependen de múltiples áreas de aprobación .

Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Field Support Technician - Knoxville, TN
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring.
Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

The Opportunity:
This position serves as a resource for the technical maintenance and installation of Roche products for assigned product lines. Performs on-site preventative maintenance, installation, and technical updates (TSB’s) on company product(s). Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures as necessary when performing preventative maintenance, installation, and technical updates (TSB’s) activities. Documents all
activity in a manner compliant with the company's quality procedures. Requires specific training and certification. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Duties are generally routine but may include non-routine tasks. You will be responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

This field-based role requires up to 50% travel. This person will support Knoxville, TN.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience.

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy.

• Knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, and information technology.

• Knowledge of basic chemistry.

• Good written/verbal communication, organization and prioritization skills.

• Effective customer service skills, which includes a positive attitude and helpful customer interaction.

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Basic knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• Ability to develop in-depth, technically related troubleshooting skills.

• Strong written/verbal communication, organization, and prioritization skills.

• Effective customer service skills, highlighted by a positive attitude, helpful interactions, and the ability to maintain ongoing customer relationships.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tennessee is 48,600.00 - 90,200.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

• Wissen über Elektronik, elektromechanische Systeme und Informationstechnologie.
• Kenntnisse der grundlegenden Chemie.

En tant qu'entreprise de soins de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche découvre, développe et fournit des produits et des services diagnostiques et thérapeutiques innovants qui procurent des avantages importants aux patients et aux professionnels de la santé, depuis la détection précoce et la prévention des maladies jusqu'au diagnostic, au traitement et au suivi du traitement. Roche est une entreprise prospère qui peut offrir des opportunités de carrière passionnantes. Nous encourageons et soutenons votre développement dans les domaines qui vous intéressent et qui vous prépareront au prochain niveau de votre parcours professionnel. La possibilité : Ce poste sert de ressource pour l'entretien technique et l'installation des produits Roche pour les gammes de produits assignées. Effectue l'entretien préventif sur place, l'installation et les mises à jour techniques (TSB) sur les produits de l'entreprise. Diagnostique la défaillance de la mécanique, du matériel, des logiciels et du système, en utilisant les procédures établies, au besoin, pour effectuer des activités de maintenance préventive, d'installation et de mise à jour technique (TSB). Les tâches sont généralement courantes, mais peuvent comprendre des tâches non courantes. Vous serez responsable du maintien et de l'amélioration continue du système de qualité et de la réalisation des objectifs de qualité par des actions quotidiennes. Ce rôle sur le terrain nécessite jusqu'à 50 % de déplacements. Cette personne soutiendra Knoxville, TN. Qui vous êtes :
• Diplôme d'études secondaires et 2 années d'études techniques ou d'instruction militaire équivalente ou expérience de travail équivalente.
• Formation ou certification réussies selon la définition de leadership et de politique des services de RD.
• Connaissance de l'électronique, des systèmes électromécaniques et des technologies de l'information.
• Connaissance de la chimie de base.
• Bonnes compétences en communication écrite/verbale, organisation et priorisation.
• Des compétences efficaces en matière de service à la clientèle, qui comprennent une attitude positive et une interaction utile avec les clients.
• La capacité de voyager, y compris certains voyages de nuit, est requise. Qualifications préférées :
• Connaissance de base de l'électronique, des systèmes électromécaniques, des technologies de l'information et de la chimie de base.
• Aptitude à développer des compétences techniques approfondies en matière de dépannage.
• Compétences solides en communication écrite/verbale, organisation et priorisation.
• Compétences efficaces en matière de service à la clientèle, mises en évidence par une attitude positive, des interactions utiles et la capacité de maintenir des relations continues avec la clientèle. The Position
CZ verze:
Hledáme Customer Service Representative
Do našeho logistického týmu hledáme nového kolegu/kolegyni na pozici Customer Service Representative , který/á nám pomůže s administrativou a podporou při zpracování objednávek a komunikaci s klienty.
Co bude Vaší náplní práce?

• Zpracování objednávek našich klientů v systému SAP

• Vytváření prodejních objednávek, faktur a dobropisů (Credit Notes)

• Řešení operativních požadavků a dotazů od klientů

• Komunikace s kolegy z logistiky, financí, salesu a kvality (reklamační proces)

• Předávání informací klientům a spolupráce na hladkém průběhu objednávek

• Postupné zapojení do dalších oblastí logistiky

Koho hledáme?

• Máte rád/a administrativu, jste pečlivý/á, zodpovědný/á a umíte si zorganizovat práci

• Máte příjemné a profesionální vystupování při komunikaci se zákazníky

• Ovládáte angličtinu na komunikativní úrovni (psanou i mluvenou), čeština/slovenština na úrovni rodilého mluvčího

• Zkušenost se SAP (objednávkový systém) je velkou výhodou

• Zvládáte práci s e-mailem a platformami Google

• Vzdělání v oblasti Business Administration, Logistiky nebo Ekonomie výhodou

• Máte zkušenosti v zákaznické podpoře, sales support nebo jiné customer-focused roli

• Jste samostatný/á, proaktivní a dokážete zvládat více priorit současně

Co nabízíme?

• Práci v menším přátelském týmu, kde se všichni podporují a pomáhají si

• Možnost pracovat částečně z domova (home office)

• Zaučení do procesů a další rozvoj v oblasti logistiky

• Stabilní pracovní prostředí s možností dlouhodobé spolupráce

EN verze:
We are looking for Customer Service Representative
We are seeking a new colleague to join our logistics team as a Customer Service Representative , to provide administrative and operational support for order processing and customer communication.
Your responsibilities will include:

• Processing customer orders in SAP system

• Creating sales orders, invoices and credit notes

• Communication with customers to resolve operational requests or questions

• Cooperation with colleagues from logistics, finance, sales and quality (complaint handling)

• Providing timely information to clients and ensuring smooth order flow

• Gradually learning and supporting other logistics-related tasks

Who we are looking for:

• You enjoy administrative tasks, are detail-oriented, responsible and well-organized

• You have professional and customer-friendly communication skills

• Fluent in local language (Czech/Slovak native level) and good command of English (spoken and written)

• Experience with SAP (order management) is a strong advantage

• Comfortable using email and Google platforms

• University degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Economics or related field is an advantage

• Proven experience in a customer-focused role (sales support, application support, customer service, training)

• Self-starter, proactive, with ability to handle conflicting priorities independently

• Motivated to develop long-term relationships with clients

What we offer:

• Work in a smaller, friendly team where colleagues support each other

• Possibility to work partly from home (home office)

• Full training and opportunities to grow within logistics

• Stable role with long-term career prospects

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you ready to ensure that life-saving medicines successfully make it from the lab to patients worldwide? As a Legal Counsel - Global Pharma Technical Operations & Facilities, you will join a highly collaborative, global team of experts providing proactive legal support to our manufacturing and supply backbone. In this role, you will be trusted to advise on high-stakes, strategic matters that directly support our company’s global ambition to prevent, stop, and cure diseases.

The Opportunity
In this role, you will serve as an individual contributor providing business-focused legal support and strategic counseling. You can expect to:

• Provide strategic legal advice and business-focused counseling to the Pharma Technical Operations (PT) and Direct Procurement organizations.

• Draft and negotiate complex agreements , including manufacturing, supply, and development contracts key to our global operations.

• Act as the primary legal point of contact for technical operations and facility matters during large, high-stakes transactions.

• Develop and implement legal strategies for the global business by collaborating closely with other lawyers, cross-functional teams, and senior leadership.

• Advise on regulatory and compliance matters under Swiss and EU legislation, with a focus on current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) and quality systems.

• Manage outside counsel retained to support specific global legal matters.

• Thrive in a dynamic, cross-cultural team environment where your agility, influence, and solution-oriented mindset drive meaningful global impact

Who you are
You are a proactive, confident professional who views change as an opportunity and is committed to driving continuous improvement. To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Legal Excellence: A passed Bar Exam and a minimum of 3 years of professional experience within an international law firm or the legal department of a multinational group.

• Industry Expertise: Prior legal experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech sectors, with a strong understanding of drug manufacturing processes, cGMP regulations, and technical compliance.

• Strong Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, a high level of cross-cultural sensitivity, and a dedicated team-player attitude.

• Business & Negotiation Acumen: Excellent analytical and negotiation skills, paired with a results-oriented approach to resolving complex technical and legal issues.

• Language Skills: Fluency in business-level English is required; knowledge of German or other languages is considered a distinct asset.

We look forward to your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you ready to ensure that life-saving medicines successfully make it from the lab to patients worldwide by navigating the evolving digital landscape? As a Legal Counsel - Global Pharma Technical Operations & Facilities (Data & Digital) , you will join a highly collaborative, global team providing proactive legal support to our manufacturing and supply backbone. In this role, you will be trusted to advise on high-stakes, data-driven matters that directly support our company’s global ambition to prevent, stop, and cure diseases.

The Opportunity
In this individual contributor role, you will focus on business-focused legal support, contract negotiation, and strategic data counseling. You can expect to:

• Provide strategic legal advice and business-focused counseling to the Pharma Technical Operations and Direct Procurement organizations.

• Draft and negotiate complex agreements , including manufacturing, supply, and development contracts key to our global operations.

• Act as the primary legal point of contact for technical operations and facility matters during large, high-stakes transactions.

• Develop and implement legal strategies for the global business by collaborating closely with other lawyers, cross-functional teams, and senior leadership.

• Advise on complex data and digital matters arising under Swiss and EU legislation, guiding any legal questions in the field of technical operations.

• Manage outside counsel retained to support specific global legal or digital matters.

• Thrive in a dynamic, cross-cultural team environment where your agility, influence, and solution-oriented mindset drive meaningful global impact.

Who you are
You are a proactive, confident professional who views change as an opportunity and is committed to driving continuous improvement. To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Qualified Legal Professional: You hold a passed Bar Exam and bring at least 3 years of professional experience within an international law firm or the legal department of a multinational group.

• Digital & Pharma Expertise: You have prior experience providing legal support in the pharmaceutical or biotech industries, with a strong focus on data and digital-related matters alongside manufacturing agreements.

• Technical Savvy: You possess a strong affinity for healthcare and biotechnology, allowing you to understand highly complex technical and digital issues relating to pharmaceutical drug manufacturing.

• Strategic Communicator & Collaborator: You combine excellent analytical and negotiation skills with high cross-cultural sensitivity and a dedicated team-player attitude.

• Language Skills: You are fluent in business-level English (written and verbal); knowledge of German or other languages is an asset.

We look forward to your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Servir de contact client pour les questions techniques et de service et effectuer l'entretien préventif.
• Diagnostiquer et résoudre les défaillances mécaniques, matérielles, logicielles et système.
• Documenter toutes les activités, contribuer à l'amélioration de la qualité et se concentrer sur la satisfaction maximale des clients. • Diplôme d'études secondaires et 2 années d'études techniques ou d'instruction militaire équivalente ou expérience de travail équivalente
• 5 ans d'expérience progressive de réparation ou d'entretien du matériel et des logiciels mécaniques/systèmes, ou de réseautage/réseau sans fil OU un baccalauréat en génie biomédical, génie mécanique, génie électrique, chimie ou domaine connexe plus 1-2 ans d'expérience progressive de réparation ou d'entretien du matériel et des logiciels mécaniques/systèmes complexes, ou de réseautage/réseau sans fil
• Formation ou certification réussies selon la définition de leadership et de politique des services de RD
• La capacité de voyager, y compris certains voyages de nuit, est requise Qualifications préférées :
• 8+ années d'expérience progressive ou un baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent plus 4+ années d'expérience progressive sont nécessaires.
• Connaissance avancée de l'électronique, des systèmes électromécaniques, des technologies de l'information et de la chimie de base.
• La capacité de servir de ressource technique interne, de fournir un soutien après les heures de travail et les week-ends et les vacances, et de maintenir de solides relations avec la clientèle est essentielle. Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour cette affectation. L'échelle salariale prévue pour ce poste basé sur l'emplacement principal de la Floride est 71 100,00 - 132 000,00 USD Chaque année. La rémunération réelle sera déterminée en fonction de l'expérience, des qualifications, de l'emplacement géographique et d'autres facteurs liés à l'emploi permis par la loi. jobs.title: Product Manager CoreLab (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Product Manager Core Lab (d/f/m)
Roche Diagnostics, Lisbon, Portugal

Are you a highly competitive, commercially savvy individual ready to be the expert advisor for our Core Lab automation, Core assays and tender strategy? Join our Business Strategy Chapter in Lisbon. You will be instrumental in leveraging our Core Lab solutions portfolio to significantly strengthen our market position and drive substantial business impact within the Portuguese healthcare system.

The Opportunity

As the Product Manager for Core Lab Automation and Core Reagents, you will be a key expert in this area as well as a consultant for our strategic Core Lab solutions. Your main focus will be to apply your strategic and product management expertise to support our strategy, commercial activities and our tender wins within the Core Lab area.

Your key responsibilities and priorities will include:

• Automation Expertise: Serve as the solid technical expert for the Core Lab automation portfolio, leveraging both healthcare consulting and product management experience.

• Commercial Strategy Support: Apply strong commercial acumen to shape the positioning of our automation solutions in a market striving for Healthcare efficiency. Transfer your know-how into valuable customer interactions.

• Tender Consultancy: Act as the expert advisor to proactively guide and support the Core Lab Tender process with tender experience to strengthen all commercial activity and proactively support the sales team with technical expertise to win opportunities in the Core Lab customer area.

• Market Insight & Engagement: Maintain close contact with local and global relevant stakeholders to gather crucial market insights, shape our future solutions and support strategic projects.

• Product Management: Take over the active product management of a wider part of our broad CoreLab portfolio.

Who You Are

We seek a highly motivated individual contributor with a winning, competitive mindset and a strong, positive attitude who is ready to take ownership of the Core Lab Automation and Core reagents business in Portugal while embracing the beauty of strong collaboration between sales, marketing and global teams:

• Education & Experience: University degree in Life Sciences or Healthcare in a relevant field, with product management and/or sales experience, preferably within the In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) or Medical Device industry.

• Mindset & Behaviour: A winning, competitive mindset, a positive challenger with excellent composure, and a strong, positive attitude.

• Expertise: Deep expertise in the IVD business and a solid technical understanding of Core Lab Automation as well as a proven commercial acumen with strong tender experience within the IVD or healthcare sector.

• Collaboration & Communication: A strong collaborator with excellent communication skills, capable of establishing trusting, long-term relationships. Able to work effectively both autonomously and collaboratively with local and international stakeholders across the internal local and global Roche network.

• Language Fluency: Fluent in both Portuguese and English for effective formal presentation and face-to-face interactions.

• Location: While we embrace a hybrid work model, proximity to the Roche office in Lisbon, Amadora, is required to ensure you can comfortably commute.

Ready to make a significant impact? Don't miss this unique opportunity to shape the future of Core Lab in Portugal and apply by July 17, 2026 .

Who we are
A healthier futur

• Istruzione e esperienza: laurea in Scienze della vita o Assistenza sanitaria in un campo rilevante, con la gestione del prodotto e/o l'esperienza di vendita, preferibilmente all'interno del settore In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) o Medical Devices.
• Mindset & Behaviour: Una mentalità vincente e competitiva, un sfidante positivo con un'eccellente compostezza, e un atteggiamento forte e positivo.
• Competenza: Profonda competenza nel business IVD e una solida comprensione tecnica di Core Lab Automation e un comprovato acume commerciale con una forte esperienza di tenerezza all'interno del settore IVD o della sanità.
• Collaborazione & Comunicazione: Un forte collaboratore con eccellenti capacità comunicative, in grado di stabilire relazioni fiduciose e a lungo termine. In grado di lavorare efficacemente sia in modo autonomo che collaborativo con gli stakeholder locali e internazionali in tutta la rete Roche interna locale e globale.
• Fluenza linguistica: Fluente sia in portoghese che in inglese per una presentazione formale efficace e interazioni faccia a faccia.
• Posizione: Mentre abbracciamo un modello di lavoro ibrido, la vicinanza all'ufficio Roche di Lisbona, Amadora, è necessaria per garantire che si può comodamente commutare. Pronto a fare un impatto significativo? Non perdere questa occasione unica per modellare il futuro del Core Lab in Portogallo e applicare entro il 17 luglio 2026 . Chi siamo Un futur più sano

jobs.title: Engenheiro de Serviços | Brasília
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Criar um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche.
Como um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Serviços , você será responsável por realizar visitas de Site Preparation para orientar os clientes na adequação do local onde serão instalados os equipamentos Roche. Você conduzirá manutenções preventivas e corretivas, garantindo o cumprimento do planejamento anual e assegurando o menor impacto possível na rotina laboratorial do cliente. Sua atuação será fundamental para manter a excelência técnica e a disponibilidade das soluções Roche no campo.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

• Realizar visitas de Site Preparation para orientar clientes na adequação técnica de infraestrutura para instalação de equipamentos.

• Conduzir manutenções preventivas técnicas, desde o agendamento e conferência de kits até o registro detalhado em sistema CRM.

• Executar manutenções corretivas de forma eficaz e eficiente para minimizar o downtime e manter a rotina operacional do cliente.

• Efetuar upgrades de hardware e software nos equipamentos instalados conforme orientações dos Especialistas Técnicos.

• Identificar situações críticas em clientes e reportá-las ao Coordenador Regional de Serviços, propondo respostas rápidas e resolutivas.

• Apoiar as equipes de Assessoria Científica na resolução de problemas de operação e aplicações, sempre que necessário.

• Colaborar com o Repair Shop nas revisões de equipamentos seguindo rigorosamente os procedimentos técnicos existentes.

• Garantir o fluxo de informações estratégicas do campo para a equipe de Vendas e dar suporte ao desenvolvimento técnico do time.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa.

• Experiência comprovada em assistência técnica, manutenções e serviços relacionados a equipamentos de análises clínicas ou informática.

• Conhecimento intermediário de Inglês (leitura técnica e comunicação básica).

• Habilidade em organização e autogestão para cumprimento de cronogramas de manutenção e chamados técnicos.

• Facilidade em estabelecer bom relacionamento interpessoal e atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares.

• Perfil proativo com foco na resolução de problemas e excelência no atendimento ao cliente.

• Capacidade de comunicação clara para orientar clientes, reportar situações críticas internamente, bem como apresentar habilidades de liderança e suporte técnico para auxiliar no desenvolvimento de colegas e parceiros.

• Ter base de residência em Brasília.

• Disponibilidade de trabalho em turnos deslocados e escala de plantão.

• Disponibilidade para viagens em território nacional.

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:

• This role is heavily focused on strategic products marketing and identifying qualified opportunities for Roche Pathology Lab product lines.

• The primary resource for technical information regarding products and applications in the areas of expertise.

• Work closely with sales, technical product specialists and marketing staff throughout the region to identify market opportunities, drive sales, and maintain relationships in key accounts

The Opportunity:

• Understand internal and external market situation and deliver short term and long term product strategy and annual bonus policy etc.

• Frequently work closely with global marketing and product management to develop relevant materials used in China market like promotion material, training material, FAQs for internal and external use.

• Timely deliver product sales forecast and work closely with sales team to drive successful implementation of opportunity

• Develop and maintain relationships with key accounts as well as market influencers.

• Develop new product launch plan and lead the product registration, market access, product position, price and strategy through cooperation with relative departments.

• Create market promotion plan and work closely with sales, regional market team etc. to hold market promotion events to deliver medical value efficiently and drive market potential

• Timely provide product training to sales team, distributor partner etc.

Who you are:

• A Bachelor degree or above in the medical area. Completion of an advanced degree in business (MBA) or related science is strongly desired.

• Proficiency in both spoken and written English

• Good command of MS office software application

• Product & marketing expertise

• Good track record for working in a MNC company for eight or more years, with related supervisory work experience in sales, application support, customer service or training

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Riepilogo del lavoro:
• Questo ruolo è fortemente focalizzato sul marketing dei prodotti strategici e l'individuazione di opportunità qualificate per le linee di prodotto Roche Pathology Lab.
• La risorsa primaria per le informazioni tecniche riguardanti i prodotti e le applicazioni nelle aree di competenza.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con le vendite, gli specialisti del prodotto tecnico e il personale di marketing in tutta la regione per identificare le opportunità di mercato, guidare le vendite e mantenere le relazioni in contabilità chiave L'opportunità:
• Comprendere la situazione del mercato interno ed esterno e fornire la strategia a breve termine e a lungo termine del prodotto e la politica di bonus annuale ecc.
• Spesso lavorare a stretto contatto con il marketing globale e la gestione dei prodotti per sviluppare materiali rilevanti utilizzati nel mercato cinese come materiale di promozione, materiale di formazione, FAQ per uso interno ed esterno.
• Consegna puntuale delle previsioni di vendita del prodotto e lavorare a stretto contatto con il team di vendita per guidare l'implementazione di successo delle opportunità
• Sviluppare e mantenere le relazioni con i conti chiave e gli influencer di mercato.
• Sviluppare un nuovo piano di lancio del prodotto e condurre la registrazione del prodotto, l'accesso al mercato, la posizione del prodotto, il prezzo e la strategia attraverso la cooperazione con i reparti relativi.
• Creare un piano di promozione del mercato e lavorare a stretto contatto con le vendite, il team di mercato regionale ecc. per tenere eventi di promozione del mercato per fornire il valore medico in modo efficiente e guidare il potenziale del mercato
• Fornire puntuale formazione del prodotto al team di vendita, partner di distributore ecc. Chi sei:
• Una laurea o superiore nella zona medica. Il completamento di un grado avanzato nel business (MBA) o la scienza relativa è fortemente desiderato.
• Proficienza in inglese parlato e scritto
• Buon comando dell'applicazione software per ufficio MS
• Competenze di prodotto e marketing
• Buon record per lavorare in un'azienda MNC per otto o più anni, con relativa esperienza di lavoro di supervisione in vendite, supporto applicazioni, servizio clienti o formazione Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Custom Software Developer - Salesforce Center of Excellence
Description of the Area The Customer Engagement Platforms and Services function acts as Salesforce Center of Excellence (CoE) within Roche Digital Technology . These platforms and services are consumed by others to create business facing platforms, products and services . The goal is to empower product teams to develop business capabilities efficiently and compliantly, while reducing their cognitive load and allowing them to focus on value generation . Although development and operations remain decentralized, the Salesforce CoE can offer additional services, especially to smaller organizations that may lack certain specialized skills . The team is mandated to significantly reduce unintended customization and technical diversity by partnering with the business functions using the systems and driving re-use, simplification and standardization .
The Opportunity:

• Support Salesforce Engineering: Support the design, crafting, configuration, deployment, and sustaining of Salesforce software solutions (including LWC, Apex, and Flow) tailored to business requirements and objectives .

• Contribute to Global Projects: Serve as an active project contributor within global product teams, operating primarily at the project level within an internationally distributed team .

• Implement Delivery Processes: Implement the entire software delivery process, managing transitions from sandbox development to production deployment using CI/CD tools and SFDX .

• Optimize Software Quality: Improve existing software quality management and metrics through robust execution of Apex Unit Testing and detailed code reviews .

• Manage Stakeholder Communications: Identify and communicate with stakeholders in a straightforward manner, maintaining a clear view of how components fit into larger systems .

• Assess Technical Feasibility: Support product decisions by providing reliable technical feasibility assessments and actively contributing to the refinement of requirements .

• Support Cross-Platform Integration: Apply basic knowledge of cloud platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP) to support seamless cross-platform integrations when necessary .

• Engage in Knowledge Sharing: Participate actively in organizational knowledge-sharing initiatives, including tech universities, conferences, and Communities of Practice (CoPs) .

Who you are:

• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical domain .

• Experienced Salesforce Developer: You bring 3+ years of progressive work experience as an active project contributor in software engineering, focusing on configuration and deployment within the Salesforce ecosystem .

• Full-Stack Technical Expert: You possess proven expertise using a combination of frontend, backend, and full-stack development tools, specifically LWC, Apex, and SOQL .

• Architectural Knowledge: You have a solid understanding of Salesforce architecture (including sharing models and security settings) and know how Sales, Service, and Community Clouds interact .

• Collaborative Problem Solver: You are highly adept at providing and seeking constructive feedback, communicating technical risks, and evaluating alternative ways to solve problems .

• Growth-Oriented Learner: You independently execute personal development plans, stay updated on current technological trends, and actively participate in professional communities .

Queste piattaforme e servizi sono consumati da altri per creare piattaforme, prodotti e servizi di business. L'obiettivo è quello di consentire ai team del prodotto di sviluppare le capacità aziendali in modo efficiente e conforme, riducendo al contempo il loro carico cognitivo e permettendo loro di concentrarsi sulla generazione del valore. Anche se lo sviluppo e le operazioni rimangono decentralizzate, il Salesforce CoE può offrire servizi aggiuntivi, in particolare alle organizzazioni più piccole che possono mancare determinate competenze specialistiche. Il team è incaricato di ridurre significativamente la personalizzazione indesiderata e la diversità tecnica, collaborando con le funzioni aziendali utilizzando i sistemi e la guida di riutilizzo, semplificazione e standardizzazione. • Contribuisci a Global Projects: Serve come contributore attivo di progetto all'interno di team di prodotti globali, operante principalmente a livello di progetto all'interno di un team distribuito a livello internazionale.
• Processi di consegna dell'esecuzione: implementare l'intero processo di consegna del software, gestire le transizioni dallo sviluppo della sandbox alla distribuzione di produzione utilizzando strumenti CI/CD e SFDX .
• Ottimizzare la qualità del software: migliorare la gestione della qualità del software esistente e metriche attraverso l'esecuzione robusta di Apex Unit Testing e le recensioni dettagliate del codice.
• Gestisci le comunicazioni degli stakeholder: Identificare e comunicare con gli stakeholder in modo semplice, mantenendo una chiara visione di come i componenti si adattano a sistemi più grandi .
• Valutare la fattibilità tecnica: sostenere le decisioni dei prodotti fornendo valutazioni di fattibilità tecniche affidabili e contribuire attivamente alla raffinatezza dei requisiti.
• Support Cross-Platform Integration: Applicare le conoscenze di base delle piattaforme cloud (come AWS, Azure o GCP) per supportare le integrazioni senza soluzione di continuità cross-platform quando necessario.

• Sviluppatore Salesforce esperto: Porti 3+ anni di esperienza di lavoro progressiva come contributore attivo del progetto nell'ingegneria del software, concentrandosi sulla configurazione e distribuzione all'interno dell'ecosistema Salesforce .
