descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Développeur logiciel personnalisé - Centre d'excellence Salesforce Description de la zone La fonction Plates-formes et services d'engagement des clients agit comme Centre d'excellence Salesforce (CoE) au sein de Roche Digital Technology . Ces plateformes et services sont consommés par d'autres pour créer des plateformes, des produits et des services face aux entreprises. L'objectif est d'habiliter les équipes de produits à développer leurs capacités d'affaires de manière efficace et conforme, tout en réduisant leur charge cognitive et en leur permettant de se concentrer sur la génération de valeur. Bien que le développement et les opérations restent décentralisés, le Conseil de Salesforce peut offrir des services supplémentaires, en particulier aux petites organisations qui peuvent manquer de certaines compétences spécialisées. L'équipe a pour mandat de réduire considérablement la personnalisation involontaire et la diversité technique en s'associant avec les fonctions d'affaires utilisant les systèmes et conduisant la réutilisation, la simplification et la normalisation. La possibilité :
• Soutenir l'ingénierie de Salesforce : Soutenir la conception, l'élaboration, la configuration, le déploiement et le maintien de solutions logicielles Salesforce (y compris LWC, Apex et Flow) adaptées aux besoins et aux objectifs opérationnels.
• Contribuer aux projets mondiaux : Servir de contributeur actif au sein des équipes de produits mondiaux, opérant principalement au niveau des projets au sein d'une équipe distribuée à l'échelle internationale.
• Mettre en oeuvre les processus de livraison : Mettre en oeuvre l'ensemble du processus de livraison des logiciels, gérer les transitions du développement des bacs à sable au déploiement de la production à l'aide des outils CI/CD et SFDX.
• Optimiser la qualité des logiciels: Améliorer la gestion de la qualité des logiciels existants et les mesures grâce à l'exécution robuste des tests d'unité Apex et des examens de code détaillés.
• Gérer les communications avec les intervenants : Identifier et communiquer avec les intervenants d'une manière simple, en maintenant une vision claire de la façon dont les composants s'intègrent dans les grands systèmes.
• Évaluer la faisabilité technique : Appuyer les décisions sur les produits en fournissant des évaluations de faisabilité technique fiables et en contribuant activement au perfectionnement des exigences.
• Prise en charge de l'intégration multiplateforme : Appliquer les connaissances de base des plates-formes cloud (comme AWS, Azure ou GCP) pour supporter les intégrations multiplateforme sans soudure si nécessaire.
• Participation au partage des connaissances : Participer activement aux initiatives de partage des connaissances organisationnelles, y compris les universités, les conférences et les communautés de pratique (CdP). Qui vous êtes :
• Professionnel formé: Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, technologie de l'information, ou un domaine technique connexe.
• Experienced Salesforce Developer: Vous apportez 3+ ans d'expérience de travail progressive en tant que contributeur de projet actif dans l'ingénierie logicielle, se concentrant sur la configuration et le déploiement au sein de l'écosystème Salesforce.
• Expert technique Full-Stack: Vous possédez une expertise éprouvée grâce à une combinaison d'outils de développement frontend, backend et full-stack, en particulier LWC, Apex et SOQL.
• Connaissance architecturale: Vous avez une solide compréhension de l'architecture Salesforce (y compris le partage des modèles et les paramètres de sécurité) et savez comment les ventes, le service et les clouds communautaires interagissent.
• Résolveur de problèmes collaboratifs : Vous êtes très habile à fournir et à rechercher des commentaires constructifs, à communiquer des risques techniques et à évaluer d'autres façons de résoudre des problèmes.
• Apprentis orienté croissance: Vous exécutez indépendamment des plans de développement personnel, restez informé des tendances technologiques actuelles et participez activement aux communautés professionnelles.

La position Description de la zone La fonction Customer Engagement Platforms and Services agit comme Centre d'excellence Salesforce (CoE) au sein de Roche Digital Technology . L'objectif est d'habiliter les équipes de produits à développer leurs capacités d'affaires de manière efficace et conforme, tout en réduisant leur charge cognitive et en leur permettant de se concentrer sur la génération de valeur. Bien que le développement et les opérations restent décentralisés, le Conseil de Salesforce peut offrir des services supplémentaires, en particulier aux petites organisations qui peuvent manquer de certaines compétences spécialisées. L'équipe a pour mandat de réduire considérablement la personnalisation involontaire et la diversité technique en s'associant avec les fonctions d'affaires utilisant les systèmes et conduisant la réutilisation, la simplification et la normalisation. La possibilité :
• Lead Custom Development: Agissez en tant qu'expert chevronné en conception, artisanat, déploiement et maintien de solutions logicielles complexes (cloud) au sein de notre écosystème technologique Salesforce en utilisant une solide expertise complète.
• Diriger les initiatives stratégiques : Prendre en main les tâches et les sujets dans la « zone grise » sans propriétaire défini, diriger et conduire avec succès des initiatives petites à moyennes.
• Optimiser les processus de livraison: Concevoir, gérer et améliorer en permanence l'ensemble du processus de livraison des logiciels, de la génération initiale de code aux environnements de production (SFDX).
• Maintenir les normes d'ingénierie: Formuler et mettre en œuvre des stratégies techniques tout en gardant les normes d'ingénierie de qualité de code les plus élevées, y compris Apex, SOQL, et Lightning Web Components (LWC).
• S'attaquer à la dette architecturale : identifier et résoudre de façon proactive la dette technique complexe, les goulets d'étranglement de performance et les défis structuraux de l'écosystème Salesforce.
• Appliquer la conformité et la sécurité : Assurer la gestion de la qualité des logiciels, la cybersécurité et les pratiques sécuritaires (comme l'analyse des codes automatisés à gauche et embarqués) correspondent aux attentes réglementaires comme GxP et ICFR.
• Favoriser le mentorat technique : agir en tant que mentor technique au sein d'une équipe distribuée à l'échelle internationale, partager activement les connaissances et donner des discours lors d'événements organisationnels tels que DevOps Days ou Tech Talks.
• Gérer la stratégie des intervenants : prioriser et communiquer efficacement l'information technique avec les intervenants, en assurant une vue d'ensemble où les composantes techniques s'harmonisent avec les stratégies organisationnelles mondiales. Qui vous êtes :
• Leader technique expérimenté: Vous apportez une expérience éprouvée de conduire avec succès des initiatives petites à moyennes à un niveau de Projet, Squad, ou Produit dans un contexte mondial .
• Ingénieur de Salesforce formé: Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, ou un domaine technique connexe, avec des certifications Salesforce Developer et Admin hautement préférées.
• Expert en écosystème complet: Vous possédez une expertise en développement mobile de frontend, backend, full-stack et Salesforce, y compris la maîtrise d'Apex, SOQL, LWC, Git, API et le script d'automatisation.
• Spécialiste de l'environnement réglementé : Vous apportez une solide expérience de travail dans des environnements réglementés, en maintenant une compréhension complète des pratiques de développement logiciel GxP, ICFR et sécurisé.

jobs.title: Field Service Implementation Representative

titleByLocale.it: Rappresentante per l'attuazione del servizio pubblico

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Field Service Implementation Representative
Location: For this position, we are looking for someone who lives in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) in Ontario and/or resides within 100 km of a major metropolitan airport.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success, and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

The Opportunity:

As the Field Support Implementation Representative, you are part of a team of experts who play a crucial role in supporting key hospitals and laboratories with the installation and smooth functioning of their clinical chemistry, immunoassay, molecular, pathology, urinalysis, and automation solutions.

You are an effective problem solver passionate about the healthcare environment and understand the importance of our solutions on the customer experience and patient care. Your passion for problem resolution and customer satisfaction is supported by your technical knowledge to deliver a stellar customer experience. You will provide timely, accurate and consistent support to our customers to minimize the disruption of their diagnostic service delivery.

• Building relationships with laboratory systems operators and managers for a dedicated customer base and use your strong communication and active listening skills to identify and diagnose customer issues and provide accurate and timely resolution.

• Participating in service, sales and customer meetings, where required.

• Collaborating with the Customer Support team on installations (pre-site inspections, technical installation), upgrades and issue resolution, where required.

• Performing preventative maintenance and technical service bulletin resolution to support regional teams, as needed.

• Working with local teams to install and configure instrument software and hardware components, as required.

• Working with local RIS application specialist and technical specialist teams to install, configure and support IT software and hardware components as needed.

• Supporting technical issues during the installation process to ensure installations are completed successfully.

• Acting as implementation crew team member or lead to ensure and maximize efficient completion of installations.

• Processing service activity close-outs at the end of each customer site visit. Able to manage day-to-day administrative activities.

Who you are:

• You hold a diploma of collegial studies in electronic technology or related education.

• You possess 5+ years of relevant field service experience, laboratory experience is considered a strong asset.

• You have prior customer support experience.

• You demonstrate knowledge of IT systems & Network infrastructure and Customer Centricity.

• In this position, you will be in contact with colleagues and customers across Canada. English and French bilingualism is preferred (written and spoken).

• You have a valid and complete driver's license in Canada.

• This position requires

Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Roche è una società di successo che può offrire interessanti opportunità di carriera. Incoraggiamo e sosteniamo il vostro sviluppo in aree di vostro interesse che vi preparerà per il prossimo livello nel vostro percorso di carriera. Il nostro impegno è quello di creare un ambiente di lavoro in cui sentirsi valorizzati, rispettati e potenziati è un'esperienza quotidiana. L'opportunità: In qualità di rappresentante per l'implementazione del supporto sul campo, fai parte di un team di esperti che svolgono un ruolo cruciale nel supportare ospedali e laboratori chiave con l'installazione e il funzionamento regolare della loro chimica clinica, immunoassay, molecola, patologia, soluzioni per l'analisi delle urine e l'automazione. Sei un efficace risolutore di problemi appassionato dell'ambiente sanitario e comprendere l'importanza delle nostre soluzioni sull'esperienza del cliente e sulla cura del paziente. La vostra passione per la risoluzione dei problemi e la soddisfazione del cliente è supportata dalla vostra conoscenza tecnica per offrire un'esperienza di cliente stellare. Fornirete un supporto tempestivo, accurato e coerente ai nostri clienti per ridurre al minimo la disgregazione della loro fornitura di servizi diagnostici.
• Costruire relazioni con gli operatori di sistemi di laboratorio e i manager per una base clienti dedicata e utilizzare le vostre forti capacità di comunicazione e ascolto attivo per identificare e diagnosticare i problemi dei clienti e fornire una risoluzione accurata e tempestiva.
• Partecipare a incontri di assistenza, vendita e clienti, ove richiesto.
• Collaborando con il team di assistenza clienti nelle installazioni (ispezione pre-sito, installazione tecnica), aggiornamenti e risoluzione dei problemi, se necessario.
• Performare la manutenzione preventiva e la risoluzione dei bollettini di servizio tecnico per sostenere le squadre regionali, come necessario.
• Lavorare con i team locali per installare e configurare i componenti hardware e software degli strumenti, come richiesto.
• Lavorare con i team specializzati nelle applicazioni RIS locali e specialisti tecnici per installare, configurare e supportare i componenti software e hardware IT come necessario.
• Sostenere i problemi tecnici durante il processo di installazione per garantire che gli impianti siano completati con successo.
• Agire come membro del team di implementazione o portare a garantire e massimizzare il completamento efficiente delle installazioni.
• L'attività di elaborazione del servizio si chiude alla fine di ogni visita del sito del cliente. In grado di gestire attività amministrative quotidiane. Chi sei:
• Lei ha un diploma di studi collegiali in tecnologia elettronica o formazione correlata.
• Possiedi 5+ anni di esperienza di servizio sul campo, l'esperienza di laboratorio è considerata un bene forte.
• Hai una precedente esperienza di assistenza clienti.
• Lei dimostra la conoscenza dei sistemi IT e dell'infrastruttura di rete e della centricità dei clienti.
• In questa posizione, sarete in contatto con colleghi e clienti in tutto il Canada. Il bilinguismo inglese e francese è preferito (scritto e parlato).
• Hai una patente valida e completa in Canada.

• Durchführung von vorbeugenden Wartungs- und technischen Service-Bulletin-Auflösungen zur Unterstützung regionaler Teams, je nach Bedarf.
• Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Teams zur Installation und Konfiguration von Instrumentensoftware und Hardwarekomponenten, je nach Bedarf.
• Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen RIS-Anwendungsspezialisten und technischen Fachteams zur Installation, Konfiguration und Unterstützung von IT-Software und Hardwarekomponenten nach Bedarf.
• Unterstützung technischer Probleme während des Installationsprozesses, um sicherzustellen, dass die Installationen erfolgreich abgeschlossen werden.
• Als Mitglied des Implementierungsteams fungieren oder führen, um den effizienten Abschluss von Installationen sicherzustellen und zu maximieren.
• Verarbeitungsservice-Aktivitäten schließen sich am Ende jedes Kundenbesuchs an. Kann die täglichen Verwaltungsaktivitäten verwalten. Wer du bist:
• Sie besitzen ein Diplom für Collegestudien in elektronischer Technologie oder verwandter Bildung.
• Sie verfügen über 5+ Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung im Außendienst, Laborerfahrung gilt als starker Vorteil.
• Sie haben bereits Erfahrung im Kundensupport.
• Sie demonstrieren Kenntnisse über IT-Systeme & Netzwerkinfrastruktur und Customer Centricity.
• In dieser Position sind Sie in Kontakt mit Kollegen und Kunden in ganz Kanada. Englisch und Französisch Zweisprachigkeit wird bevorzugt (geschrieben und gesprochen).
• Sie haben einen gültigen und vollständigen Führerschein in Kanada.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
The Enterprise Architecture Foundations team acts as the backbone of the architecture function at Roche . We focus on community engagement, modern ways of working, and capability enablement . As Roche Digital Technology (RDT) shifts to a "Federated by Design" model, our success relies entirely on transitioning from static architecture documents to dynamic, data-driven insights .
We connect and empower architects across our global, federated organization to design sustainable technology solutions using shared principles and active communities . To achieve our 2026 strategic goals, we need a visionary architect to build a resilient, fully integrated toolchain ecosystem that drives data-driven portfolio management and landscape consolidation .
The Role: What You Will Do
As the Solution Architect for the Integrated Toolchain , you will serve as the principal technical mind behind our core corporate platforms: ArchiMEDES (SAP LeanIX) , ArchiSense (our custom AI Co-Pilot) , and ITONICS (Innovation Management) . You will bridge the gap between architectural data and strategic execution .
Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Drive EAM Tooling Excellence: Serve as the technical owner for ArchiMEDES (SAP LeanIX) . You will configure core data models and drive advanced automated integrations with ServiceNow and cloud discovery tools to deliver a real-time, comprehensive view of our IT landscape .

• Advance AI-Driven Architecture: Lead the technical scaling of ArchiSense, maturing it from a proof-of-concept into a production-grade AI Co-Pilot . You will build custom AI agents to automate queries, execute tasks, and streamline technology standard navigation .

• Champion Data Democratization: Design, extract, and publish source-system-oriented data products directly into the Roche DataOne (Snowflake) environment and Data Marketplace (Collibra) to enable intuitive, self-service data consumption for downstream analytics .

• Lead Technology Foresight Integration: Maintain technical ownership and oversee the integration of the ITONICS platform to effectively map external market trends and emerging technology phases .

• Enable Data-Driven Portfolio Management: Architect a seamless toolchain that bridges corporate strategy and engineering execution, providing clear, transparent insights into dependencies, technical debt, and redundancies for senior leadership .

• Embed "Decisions Over Documents" Practices: Partner with Architecture Practice Leads to embed practical governance guardrails directly into the tooling ecosystem, reducing administrative friction for engineering teams .

Who You Are
Education & Experience

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or IT .

• You bring 5-7+ years of applied experience in solution architecture, integration engineering, or platform development within complex, matrixed global organizations .

Technical Skills & Expertise

• Python for Data & AI: Proficient in Python for developing data extraction pipelines and orchestrating custom AI workflows (equivalent open-source or advanced project experience is highly valued) .

• Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM): Hands-on experience configuring and adapting core data models within EAM platforms, specifically SAP LeanIX .

• Modern AI & Emerging Tech: Practical familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures . Experience with Model Co

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Who We Are The Enterprise Architecture Foundations team acts as the backbone of the architecture function at Roche . We focus on community engagement, modern ways of working, and capability enablement . As Roche Digital Technology (RDT) shifts to a "Federated by Design" model, our success relies entirely on transitioning from static architecture documents to dynamic, data-driven insights . We connect and empower architects across our global, federated organization to design sustainable technology solutions using shared principles and active communities . To achieve our 2026 strategic goals, we need a visionary architect to build a resilient, fully integrated toolchain ecosystem that drives data-driven portfolio management and landscape consolidation . The Role: What You Will Do As the Solution Architect for the Integrated Toolchain , you will serve as the principal technical mind behind our core corporate platforms: ArchiMEDES (SAP LeanIX) , ArchiSense (our custom AI Co-Pilot) , and ITONICS (Innovation Management) . You will bridge the gap between architectural data and strategic execution . Your primary responsibilities will include:
• Drive EAM Tooling Excellence: Serve as the technical owner for ArchiMEDES (SAP LeanIX) . You will configure core data models and drive advanced automated integrations with ServiceNow and cloud discovery tools to deliver a real-time, comprehensive view of our IT landscape .
• Advance AI-Driven Architecture: Lead the technical scaling of ArchiSense, maturing it from a proof-of-concept into a production-grade AI Co-Pilot . You will build custom AI agents to automate queries, execute tasks, and streamline technology standard navigation .
• Champion Data Democratization: Design, extract, and publish source-system-oriented data products directly into the Roche DataOne (Snowflake) environment and Data Marketplace (Collibra) to enable intuitive, self-service data consumption for downstream analytics .
• Lead Technology Foresight Integration: Maintain technical ownership and oversee the integration of the ITONICS platform to effectively map external market trends and emerging technology phases .
• Enable Data-Driven Portfolio Management: Architect a seamless toolchain that bridges corporate strategy and engineering execution, providing clear, transparent insights into dependencies, technical debt, and redundancies for senior leadership .
• Embed "Decisions Over Documents" Practices: Partner with Architecture Practice Leads to embed practical governance guardrails directly into the tooling ecosystem, reducing administrative friction for engineering teams . Who You Are Education & Experience
• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or IT .
• You bring 5-7+ years of applied experience in solution architecture, integration engineering, or platform development within complex, matrixed global organizations . Technical Skills & Expertise
• Python for Data & AI: Proficient in Python for developing data extraction pipelines and orchestrating custom AI workflows (equivalent open-source or advanced project experience is highly valued) .
• Enterprise Architecture Management (EAM): Hands-on experience configuring and adapting core data models within EAM platforms, specifically SAP LeanIX .
• Modern AI & Emerging Tech: Practical familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures . Experience with Model Co

良好的跨部门合作、沟通能力 成长型思维

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: （高级）治疗领域专员
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
TAM 治疗领域经理
Therapeutic Area Manager

治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Proven track record of working closely with senior leadership to inform and influence high-level strategic business decisions.

• Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing enterprise-wide data science frameworks and best practices.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, CHT, SHT etc. to contribute to project delivery.

• Support the initial development and optimization of logistic processes.

• Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, e.g. draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan.

• Trained and qualified on equipment operation and procedure.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:

• Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.

• Performing the following tasks: e.g. facility cleaning, cleanroom garments preparation, cleaning and sterilization of components.

• Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team.

• Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA.

• Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime.

• Support regular validation activities, such as autoclave requalification.

• Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area.

• Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone.

Qualification and Experience
Education/Qualifications

• College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies

• 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.

• Experienced in strategic projects of Aseptic Filling facility including design, commissioning & qualification is preferred.

• Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.

• Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities

Leadership & People Management

• ﻿﻿Build and retain an inclusive workforce and foster an environment where diversity of thought and perspective are valued.

• Maintain an inclusive team that values diversity of thought.

• Maintain strong partnerships with leaders to ensure alignment on strategic projects and daily operations.

• ﻿﻿Take the responsibility for department daily SHE management, implement site SHE procedure and program, and achieve site corporate /site SHE KPI. Promote SHE culture and improve employee safety behavior.

• ﻿﻿Manage performance and development team members to achieve organizational goals and employee personal and professional growth.

• Support manager to build a strong pipeline of talent and robust succession plans for key positions.

• ﻿﻿﻿﻿Maintain a culture of continuous improvement and model lean leadership principles.

• Maintain a culture of transparent, high performance, empowerment and innovation culture.

Technical

Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, equipment selection, URS review, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.

• As a key role, support to establish an effective operation system in alignment with the Roche’s standards, including manufacturing system, CCS strategy, people training and qualification system.

• Lead to establish the procedures related to aseptic techniques, good aseptic practices on the shop floor, and other relevant processes for aseptic production execution.

• Participate in CCS strategy implementation in operation to ensure a sustaining sterility assurance program setting up.

• Support the filling manager to establish the site aseptic training program and implement it, ensure only qualified people perform GMP lots’ manufacturing.

• Ensure team's competencies in performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, depyrogenating, filling and stoppering, crimping.

• Participate in tech transfer, collaboration with other functions to ensure the success of new product manufacturing.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:

• Ensure routine operation compliance with regulations, maintain sterile conditions, and achieve high-quality production standards .

• Ensure total readiness of manufacturing suites, including housekeeping, machine, materials, documents and other resources to ensure product delivery in time and within budget.

• Arrange the filling shifts in routine production, participate in operation as an aseptic SME and perform daily review of production batch record, deviation according to schedule.

• Lead annual aseptic operators’ qualification, provide on-the-job training to support formalized technical and GMP training.

• Oversee the daily operation, monitoring, and maintenance of filling equipment to ensure compliance with aseptic requirements .

• Supervise aseptic operations during production and intervene promptly in case of abnormalities .

• Participate in the response of regulator audit and global quality audit as SME during regulatory inspections and audits.

• Raise deviation and involve the root cause investigation, including appropriate escalation where needed to ensure closure of deviation within the set timeline.

• Raise change control and provide assessment.

• Execute regular validation activities, such as APS.

•

jobs.title: Design Operations Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Design Operations Lead within the Global Digital Hub, you will play a central role in enabling the seamless coordination of design workflows, resource capacity, and project execution within the dedicated scope. You will work closely with Design Project Coordinators (DPCs), Subchapter Leads, Creative Chapter Lead, Network Design Lead, and Service Delivery Lead to drive operational consistency, improve delivery efficiency, and support creative excellence at scale.

You will be accountable for orchestrating the operational aspects of the design function, from resource availability and team capacity to workflow standardization and delivery health monitoring. Your leadership will directly contribute to ensuring timely, high-quality output while enabling a well-supported and structured environment for both designers and project teams.

The Opportunity:

• Coordinate design workstreams across networks and time zones, ensuring seamless delivery.

• Balance team capacity, align resources, and manage workload distribution effectively across design teams.

• Establish and evolve standardized workflows to maintain consistent delivery processes across creative networks.

• Act as the first escalation point for workload conflicts, delivery risks, and process deviations.

• Track and analyze resource utilization and project data to inform planning and decision-making.

• Collaborate with leadership to uphold creative quality through stable and structured workflows.

• Support tool adoption, training, and continuous improvement to drive operational excellence.

Who you are:

• You have proven experience in design operations, creative workflow coordination, or project delivery in a creative or digital environment.

• You are proficient with project management and workflow tools (e.g., Adobe Workfront) and familiarity with digital asset production.

• You have experience in resource planning, capacity management, and delivery coordination.

• You possess strong understanding of creative processes, from intake to final delivery, across print, digital, video, or localization projects.

• You have excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.

• You are collaborative, structured, and proactive, with a high level of ownership over operational outcomes.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, deba

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Global Digital Hub è stato fondato all'interno di Roche Services & Solutions Center. Il nostro scopo principale è quello di rafforzare le capacità digitali di Roche a livello globale, supportando iniziative centrali con Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting e Creative Design. In qualità di Lead di Design Operations all'interno del Global Digital Hub, svolgerai un ruolo centrale nel consentire il coordinamento senza interruzioni dei flussi di lavoro di progettazione, della capacità delle risorse e dell'esecuzione del progetto all'interno del campo dedicato. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i coordinatori del progetto di progettazione (DPCs), i lead del subchapter, il piombo del capitolo creativo, il piombo di progettazione di rete e la consegna del servizio portano a guidare la coerenza operativa, migliorare l'efficienza della consegna e sostenere l'eccellenza creativa in scala. Sarete responsabili per l'orchestrazione degli aspetti operativi della funzione di progettazione, dalla disponibilità delle risorse e dalla capacità del team di standardizzazione del flusso di lavoro e monitoraggio della salute di consegna. La vostra leadership contribuirà direttamente a garantire una produzione tempestiva e di alta qualità, consentendo un ambiente ben supportato e strutturato per progettisti e team di progetto. L'opportunità:
• Coordinare i flussi di lavoro di progettazione attraverso reti e fusi orari, assicurando la consegna senza soluzione di continuità.
• Equilibrare la capacità del team, allineare le risorse e gestire la distribuzione del carico di lavoro in modo efficace attraverso i team di progettazione.
• Stabilire ed evolvere i flussi di lavoro standardizzati per mantenere i processi di consegna coerenti tra le reti creative.
• Agire come primo punto di escalation per conflitti di carico di lavoro, rischi di consegna e deviazioni di processo.
• Tracciare e analizzare l'utilizzo delle risorse e i dati del progetto per informare la pianificazione e il processo decisionale.
• Collabora con la leadership per sostenere la qualità creativa attraverso flussi di lavoro stabili e strutturati.
• Supporto strumento adozione, formazione e miglioramento continuo per guidare l'eccellenza operativa. Chi sei:
• Hai dimostrato esperienza nelle operazioni di progettazione, coordinamento del flusso di lavoro creativo, o la consegna del progetto in un ambiente creativo o digitale.
• Sei abile con gli strumenti di gestione e flusso di lavoro del progetto (ad esempio Adobe Workfront) e la familiarità con la produzione di asset digitali.
• Hai esperienza nella pianificazione delle risorse, nella gestione delle capacità e nel coordinamento delle consegne.
• Possiedi una forte comprensione dei processi creativi, dall'assunzione alla consegna finale, attraverso progetti di stampa, digital, video o localizzazione.
• Hai eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, organizzazione e gestione degli stakeholder.
• Sei collaborativo, strutturato e proattivo, con un alto livello di proprietà sui risultati operativi. In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.
• Una comunità globale inclusiva, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, deba

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Patient Journey Partner (PJP) – Singapore

T he Mission

• Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.

• The patient journey partner is directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organization, faster to deliver the triple win.

• The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

• This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)

• It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives

The PJP is the business owner solving for end-to-end patient journey constraints. This is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to develop the local disease area strategy and to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey while delivering commercial success.

The Opportunity

• You act as the end-to-end business owner for your assigned disease area, directly accountable for developing local strategies that improve healthcare outcomes and optimize the patient journey.

• You steward our innovative portfolio through its entire lifecycle, leveraging clinical insights and commercial acumen to maximize sustainable patient reach across the local ecosystem.

• You serve as the trusted, primary point of contact for Healthcare Professionals (HCPs), Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), and Patient Advocacy Groups (PAGs) to co-create meaningful solutions addressing gaps in the paitent journey and ecosystem.

• You lead and influence cross-functional, agile "swarm" teams without direct formal authority, aligning specialized experts toward a unified strategic direction.

• You leverage a deep understanding of the local healthcare environment, bringing external insights "outside-in" to shape our internal disease area strategies, decision-makings on directions and create the optimal end-to-end customer experience.

• You manage resource allocation and strategic prioritization, exercising the empowered authority to pull in specialized capabilities from local and global networks when required.

​ Who You Are

• Discover how our different ways of thinking power discovery, innovation, and breakthrough treatments for patients everywhere.

• You hold a University degree in Science, Business, Economics, or a related discipline (an MBA or advanced Life Science degree is highly preferred).

• You bring extensive experience leading cross-functional teams and formulating long-term strategies within a pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare environment.

• You possess a strong track record in product commercialization, market access, or customer experience excellence within the healthcare sector.

• You demonstrate deep scientific acumen, allowing you to engage credibly with clinical specialists and understand complex therapeutic landscapes.

• Si guida il nostro portafoglio innovativo attraverso il suo intero ciclo di vita, sfruttando intuizioni cliniche e acume commerciale per massimizzare la portata dei pazienti sostenibili in tutto l'ecosistema locale.
• Voi servite come punto di contatto affidabile e primario per i professionisti sanitari (HCP), gli esperti di area terapeutica (TAEs), e i gruppi di advocacy pazienti (PAGs) per co-creare soluzioni significative che affrontano lacune nel viaggio e nell'ecosistema del paziente.

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Partenaire de voyage patient (PJP) – Singapour Mission
• Les soins de santé changent : innovation radicale, ouverture accrue au changement, renforcement de l'autonomisation des patients, sources multiples d'information médicale et pression sur les dépenses publiques. Par conséquent, les besoins de nos intervenants continuent d'évoluer.
• Le partenaire du parcours patient est directement responsable d'obtenir de meilleurs résultats pour les patients, leur communauté, l'écosystème et l'organisation, plus rapidement pour obtenir la triple victoire.
• Le PJP est un leader et le visage local de Roche. Elle s'associe étroitement avec toutes les parties prenantes touchant directement le parcours du patient (dans un domaine thérapeutique ou de maladie donné), en acquérant une compréhension profonde de leurs besoins afin de relier les capacités de Roches pour co-créer des solutions significatives.
• Ce rôle est intégré localement dans l'écosystème, il est un rôle intégré, fonctionnellement agnostique, (c'est-à-dire qu'il ne s'inscrit pas dans les concepts traditionnels de commerce/vente ou affaires médicales)
• Elle n'a ni objectifs de rentabilité, ni incitations en matière de ventes. Le PJP est le propriétaire de l'entreprise qui résout les contraintes de bout en bout pour les patients. Il s'agit d'un rôle de haut niveau au sein de l'affilié, qui a le pouvoir décisionnel d'élaborer la stratégie locale de la région de la maladie et de demander des ressources à Roche (à la fois au sein de l'affilié et du réseau élargi) afin d'avoir un impact amélioré sur le cheminement des patients tout en assurant le succès commercial. L'opportunité
• Vous agissez en tant que propriétaire d'entreprise de bout en bout pour votre domaine de maladie assigné, directement responsable de l'élaboration de stratégies locales qui améliorent les résultats en matière de soins de santé et optimisent le cheminement du patient.
• Vous dirigez notre portefeuille innovateur tout au long de son cycle de vie, en tirant parti des connaissances cliniques et de l'acuité commerciale pour maximiser la portée durable des patients dans l'écosystème local.
• Vous êtes le principal point de contact de confiance pour les professionnels de la santé (PSS), les experts des domaines thérapeutiques (ETA) et les groupes de défense des patients (GAP) afin de co-créer des solutions significatives pour combler les lacunes dans le cheminement des patients et l'écosystème.
• Vous dirigez et influencez des équipes « chaudes » interfonctionnelles et agiles sans autorité formelle directe, en alignant les experts spécialisés vers une orientation stratégique unifiée.
• Vous tirez profit d'une compréhension approfondie de l'environnement de santé local, apportant des informations externes "en dehors" pour façonner nos stratégies internes de maladies, les prises de décision sur les directions et créer l'expérience client de bout en bout optimale.
• Vous gérez l'allocation des ressources et la hiérarchisation stratégique, en exerçant l'autorité habilitée à tirer des capacités spécialisées des réseaux locaux et mondiaux au besoin. Qui vous êtes
• Découvrez comment nos différentes façons de penser la découverte du pouvoir, l'innovation et les traitements révolutionnaires pour les patients partout.
• Vous détenez un diplôme universitaire en sciences, en affaires, en économie ou une discipline connexe (un MBA ou un diplôme avancé en sciences de la vie est hautement préféré).
• Vous apportez une vaste expérience de conduite d'équipes interfonctionnelles et de formulation de stratégies à long terme dans un environnement pharmaceutique, biotechnologique ou de santé.
• Vous possédez une solide expérience en matière de commercialisation de produits, d'accès au marché ou d'excellence en matière d'expérience client dans le secteur des soins de santé.
• Vous démontrez un sens scientifique profond, vous permettant d'engager de façon crédible avec des spécialistes cliniques et de comprendre des paysages thérapeutiques complexes.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Pharma-Vision
Wir wollen viel mehr Menschen in allen Teilen der Welt mit unseren Medikamenten helfen. Dazu wollen wir 3-5x mehr medizinische Fortschritte zu 50% geringeren Kosten für Patienten, der Gesellschaft zur Verfügung stellen.
Unsere Arbeit, unser täglicher Einsatz und unser Engagement bedeuten für sehr viele große Hoffnung und Zuversicht und deswegen müssen wir anders denken und arbeiten. Mit dem Patient im Fokus setzen wir auf eine neue Organisation und zwar #WIRGEMEINSAM in SDPM!

Wertströme
Mit der Organisation in Wertströme konzentrieren wir uns auf die wesentlichen, wertschöpfenden Tätigkeiten. Neben der Verringerung von doppelt oder unnötig durchgeführter Arbeit steht die Verbesserung von Schnittstellen und Prozessen zwischen den beteiligten Organisationseinheiten im Vordergrund.
Als Facharbeiter Ansatz/API Handling (m/w/d) bist Du für die Ansatzherstellung und API Handling, Durchführung und GMP-gerechte Dokumentation von Prozessen, Unterstützung von technischen Wartungen und Crossfunktionale Zusammenarbeit im Wertstrom verantwortlich.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Du bist für die Herstellung von Anatzlösungen zuständig. Ebenso unterstützt du beim Auftau und Einfrierprozess.

• Du führst mikrobiologische Umgebungskontrollen durch und bist verantwortlich für die Störungsbeseitigung auch von schwierigen Störungen

• Ein wichtiger Bestandteil Deiner Aufgabe besteht zudem in der GMP-gerechten Dokumentation und Kontrolle der durchgeführten Arbeiten in Herstellprotokollen (zukünftig elektronisch), elektronischen Logbüchern sowie Belegbüchern etc.

• Im Rahmen der Arbeitsvorbereitung reinigst, desinfizierst und sterilisierst Du komplexe Produktionsanlagen und Kleinteile

• Du bist für die kontinuierliche Pflege und Aktualisierung von SOPs im Arbeitsbereich zuständig und unterstützen bei der Erstellung von GMP-Dokumenten (SOPs, Formulare)

• Darüber hinaus engagierst Du dich im Rahmen unseres KVP-Prozesses zur Verbesserung unsere Arbeitsabläufe

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du bist eine positiv denkende, integre und selbstreflektierende Persönlichkeit mit starken kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Du hast ein offenes Ohr für die täglichen Herausforderungen Deiner Kolleg*innen und schaffst ein Klima der gegenseitigen Unterstützung. Du stellst Fragen um zu verstehen, sprichst kontroverse Themen offen und ehrlich an. Darüber hinaus motivierst Du alle mit deiner Can-Do-Einstellung. In diesem Sinne treibst du eine neue Denkweise und Mindset voran, die es für die erfolgreiche Arbeit in Wertströmen benötigt.
Als Facharbeiter Ansatz/API Handling hast du eine dreijährige Ausbildung erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Deine mindestens dreijährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion zeichnet Dich aus.

Darüber hinaus zeichnen Dich folgende Kompetenzen aus:

• Gute Kenntnisse über die Arbeit im Hygienebereich und den GMP-Richtlinien

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Dokumentationsarbeiten und der Umgang mit den gängigen DV-Anwendungen (u.a. MS Office, MES, Unilab) sind für Dich selbstverständlich

• Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis zur Bedienung von Maschinen und besitzt sehr gute Anlagenkenntnisse

• Zudem arbeitest Du gerne im Team und überzeugst durch deine zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

• Fähigkeit und Offenheit, die Chancen und die Vorteile von Veränderungen zu erkennen und das Warum zu vermitteln

• Du begegnest allen Mitarbeitenden offen mit Respekt und Wertschätzung

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Step into a transformative role with us as an Disease Area Partner, where you will be at the heart of the evolving landscape of healthcare. Driven by groundbreaking innovation, greater patient empowerment, and the expanding wealth of medical information, our ecosystem is adapting to new challenges and heightened demands on public resources.
As an Disease Area Partner, you will work locally, deeply integrated within the healthcare community, focusing exclusively on building meaningful stakeholder relationships without the constraints of sales targets or incentives. This allows you to focus entirely on delivering impactful, needs-based support for patients and healthcare providers.

Your Impact

• Steward Roche’s products through their lifecycle and support their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner

• Implement campaigns with customers and distribute promotional materials as per marketing plan and customer needs

• Organize group meetings in major hospitals

• Propose new ideas related to campaigns, promotional material to the pod and are responsible for the implementation after approval.

• Gathering Data & Insights from the market that would help the pod to make decisions.

• The DA partner focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

• Identifies important customers and keeps customer Personas up-to-date.

• Continuously revises and updates the customer list & no. of patients in cooperation with the pod.

• Positively participates in Internal meetings to review and discuss: achievements, Opportunities/challenges, Competitors activities.

• Reporting Adverse Events to the Local Safety Unite within Roche timelines.

• Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services.

Who you are

• You bring 1-2 years of experience within the pharmaceutical industry.

• You have good business acumen, with desired experience in commercialization, medical, and customer experience excellence, and can leverage digital tools effectively

• You demonstrate a personal commitment to improving the patient journey, with a strong drive to create value and impact on the ecosystem

• You embody a strategic vision to enhance patient journeys and embed this within your actions

• You possess an entrepreneurial mindset, continuously seeking opportunities to innovate and contribute

• You maintain a growth mindset, learning and unlearning rapidly, experimenting, and sharing insights within and beyond Roche

• You display integrity in every action, upholding honesty, ethics, and authenticity

• You bring excellent stakeholder engagement skills, effectively partnering with therapeutic area experts (TAEs), organizations, and ideally with patient advocacy groups (PAGs)

• You are fluent in the local language and proficient in English, facilitating collaboration across Roche’s broader enterprise.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Werde Teil von Roche Pharma (Schweiz) AG, der Schweizer Niederlassung von Roche, deren rund 190 Mitarbeitende dafür sorgen, dass Patientinnen und Patienten in der Schweiz Zugang zu Roches innovativen Medikamentenportfolio haben. Werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams im Bereich Health System (Policy & Governmental Affairs) und sammle wertvolle Praxiserfahrung in einem spannenden Umfeld! Als Praktikant:in Policy & Governmental Affairs, Health System spielst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Unterstützung unseres Policy & Governmental Affairs Team. In dieser spannenden und vielseitigen Rolle bist du ein Bestandteil unseres Teams und trägst dazu bei, unsere politischen Strategien und Kommunikationsmassnahmen mitzugestalten und umzusetzen.

Die Möglichkeit/ Deine Hauptaufgaben:

• Du überwachst relevante politische Entwicklungen, sichtest Sessionsprogramme und andere politische Agenden, um frühzeitig Chancen und Risiken für Roche zu identifizieren.

• Du bereitest prägnante Zusammenfassungen und Planungsdokumente für politische Sessionen vor und unterstützt bei der Priorisierung politischer Geschäfte hinsichtlich ihrer Dringlichkeit und Relevanz für Roche.

• Du entwickelst Materialien für die externe Kommunikation mit politischen Akteuren, darunter Positionspapiere, Faktenblätter und Präsentationen.

• Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung und Ausarbeitung konsistenter Botschaften und Storylines für die politische Kommunikation.

• Du führst nach Bedarf vertiefte Recherchen durch und unterstützt bei der Ausarbeitung von Policy-Initiativen im Gesundheitsbereich

Kommunikation und Stakeholdermanagement:

• Du verfasst und bereitest umfassende Briefings für den Line Manager und das Senior Management vor.

• Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung und Koordination von Antworten auf Vernehmlassungen.

• Du entwickelst und gestaltest Präsentationen für diverse interne und externe Zwecke wie Auftritte, Gespräche und Koordinationssitzungen

Unterstützung in Organisation und Events:

• Du unterstützt bei der Planung, Koordination und Durchführung von internen und externen Events und Besuchen auf dem Campus.

• Du unterstützt den Line Manager umfassend in administrativen und organisatorischen Angelegenheiten, wie der Terminplanung, der Vertretung bei Terminen und weiteren allgemeinen organisatorischen Aufgaben.

Wer Du bist:

• Du bist aktuell in einem Masterstudium eingeschrieben oder hast dieses kürzlich (innerhalb eines Jahres gemäss des Startdatums) in den Bereichen Public Affairs, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Volkswirtschaftslehre, Rechtswissenschaften, Politikwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Studienfach abgeschlossen.

• Du hast ein starkes Interesse an politischen Prozessen, insbesondere an der Schweizer Gesundheitspolitik.

• Du verfügst über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, politisches Gespür und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte prägnant darzustellen.

• Du besitzt exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift (Deutsch ist Voraussetzung, Französisch und/oder Englisch sind ein Plus).

• Deine Arbeitsweise ist proaktiv, eigenverantwortlich und sorgfältig; du zeigst Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen.

• Du bist ein Teamplayer mit einem hohen Mass an Eigeninitiative

Bewerbungsprozess:
Deine Bewerbung muss einen Lebenslauf und ein Motivationsschreiben enthalten.

Zusätzliche Information:

• ​Bitte beachte, aufgrund von Vorschriften müssen Nicht-EU/EFTA-Bürger als Teil der Bewerbungsunterlagen eine Bescheinigung der Universität vorlegen,

jobs.title: Ingénieur(e) Réseau Terrain -Région Ouest (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions
En tant qu' Ingénieur Réseau Terrain (Territoire Ouest), rattaché(e) à un Responsable Territorial des Equipes Services, vous serez amené(e) à collaborer avec les équipes supports et IT sur des missions liées à l'installation et à la maintenance des réseaux instruments Roche dans les laboratoires d'analyses médicales (privés et hospitaliers).

Localisation idéale: Poitiers / La Rochelle / Bordeaux

Vos principales responsabilités :

• Concevoir les schémas réseau, les matrices de flux et assurer leur déploiement. Gestion de son parc informatique et mise à jour des documents clients (Document d’Architecture Technique, Document d’Exploitation)

• Installer et maintenir le réseau IT Roche toutes gammes, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Ingénieur Service et Spécialiste IT et Workflow.

• Garantir les plans d'actions en lien avec la cybersécurité. Agir rapidement lors d’élaboration de PRI (Plan de Réponse aux Incidents)

• Effectuer les rétrofits hardware / software IT réseau Roche, la maintenance des réseaux instruments et les mises à jour des solutions chez nos clients.

• Installer et tester les solutions de télémaintenance Roche.

• Assurer la traçabilité et le reporting précis de vos interventions et des mises à niveau .

Votre profil :

• Formation niveau Bac +3 ou Master spécialisé en informatique et réseaux.

• Capacité à installer et configurer les différents composants (réseaux, pare-feu, accès) des infrastructures informatiques clients.

• Aisance à l’oral, levée d’objection étant identifié comme Interlocuteur privilégié des Directions des Services Informatiques (DSI) pour expliquer les pré requis d’installation des solutions digitales Roche et échanger sur les besoins clients.

• Anglais professionnel

• Permis B (mobilité territoriale indispensable).

• Sens du résultat, goût du challenge et sens des responsabilités.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Purpose

The Disease Level Partner (DLP) is at the centre of implementation of the strategy and objectives within our therapy areas balanced with truly focusing on patient outcomes. The DLP understands their business as if it were their own. Through deep understanding of patient pathways, our medicines across the portfolio and customer needs, the DLP aligns their objectives to both the disease area strategy and regional objectives across their local health economy. By effective utilisation of all available resources, they will be successful in securing appropriate access to key customers to deliver better outcomes for more patients, faster. As an expert of the region, the DLP will enjoy developing deep customer knowledge and generating insights that support our strategies and bring new customer partnerships to Roche.

Your Opportunity

• Have strong communication skills where you listen, partner and educate

• Gather actionable insights and elicit partnering opportunities that improve patient outcomes.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Lo scopo Il Partner di Livello Malattia (DLP) è al centro dell'implementazione della strategia e degli obiettivi all'interno delle nostre aree terapeutiche equilibrate con una vera attenzione ai risultati dei pazienti. Il DLP comprende la loro attività come se fosse loro. Attraverso la profonda comprensione delle vie del paziente, i nostri farmaci attraverso il portafoglio e le esigenze del cliente, il DLP allinea i loro obiettivi sia alla strategia della zona della malattia che agli obiettivi regionali attraverso la loro economia sanitaria locale. Con l'utilizzo efficace di tutte le risorse disponibili, saranno di successo nel garantire l'accesso appropriato ai clienti chiave per fornire migliori risultati per più pazienti, più veloce. In qualità di esperto della regione, il DLP sarà lieto di sviluppare una profonda conoscenza dei clienti e di generare approfondimenti che supportano le nostre strategie e portano nuove partnership con i clienti a Roche. La tua opportunità
• Avere forti capacità di comunicazione in cui si ascolta, partner ed educare
• Raccogliere intuizioni attuabili e suscitare opportunità di partner che migliorano i risultati dei pazienti.
• Costruisci, presente e d'accordo con la comunità di Therapy Area Team and Disease conduce gli obiettivi, la strategia e gli obiettivi per la regione.
• Essere pienamente responsabile per la consegna degli obiettivi all'interno del portafoglio Roche di prodotti attraverso un impegno efficace con i clienti, guidando l'esperienza positiva del cliente.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Purpose The Disease Level Partner (DLP) is at the centre of implementation of the strategy and objectives within our therapy areas balanced with truly focusing on patient outcomes. The DLP understands their business as if it were their own. Through deep understanding of patient pathways, our medicines across the portfolio and customer needs, the DLP aligns their objectives to both the disease area strategy and regional objectives across their local health economy. By effective utilisation of all available resources, they will be successful in securing appropriate access to key customers to deliver better outcomes for more patients, faster. As an expert of the region, the DLP will enjoy developing deep customer knowledge and generating insights that support our strategies and bring new customer partnerships to Roche. Your Opportunity
• Have strong communication skills where you listen, partner and educate
• Gather actionable insights and elicit partnering opportunities that improve patient outcomes.
• Construct, present and agree with the Therapy Area Team and Disease Community Leads the objectives, strategy and goals for the region.
• Be fully accountable for the delivery of the goals within the Roche portfolio of products through effective engagement with customers, driving positive customer experience.
• Leverage support for products, ideas and projects across a local health economy and to contribute to the development and mobilisation of local and national brand advocates
• Maintain a detailed knowledge of national policy objectives and drivers and apply this to identify opportunities for growing the business at a National and Regional level in collaboration with the cross functional extended Roche Teams
• Use agile methodology (e.g. sprint methodology, MVP and iterative approach) to deliver disease level projects and non-disease level projects with internal/external expertise
• Ensure that all knowledge management and CRM systems are maintained in accordance with Roche standards, possess a thorough understanding of the provisions of the ABPI Code of Practice, remaining compliant with Roche SOPs and policies.
• Act as a guardian for high standards of compliance, ethics and safety; putting patients at the center of all actions by consistent business behaviour that complies with applicable laws, industry codes and Roche’s Code of Conduct.
• Increasingly demonstrate a VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) approach, to develop personal skills and capabilities, to positively support colleagues Who you are
• University degree educated
• Multi-stakeholder engagement - Clinical and all stakeholders relevant to the commissioning of local services
• Previous experience in market access, commercial sales, or medical affairs within a healthcare (e xperience in Neurology, with Multiple Sclerosis knowledge is a huge plus )
• Specialised medicines sales and market access experience beneficial but not essential
• Advanced business acumen skills
• Superior prioritisation skills, with the capacity to manage multiple indications within a portfolio
• Competitive mindset
• Ability to demonstrate a growth mindset

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Der Zweck Der Disease Level Partner (DLP) steht im Mittelpunkt der Umsetzung der Strategie und Ziele in unseren Therapiebereichen und konzentriert sich dabei auf die Ergebnisse der Patienten. Die DLP versteht ihr Geschäft so, als wäre es ihr eigenes. Durch ein tiefes Verständnis der Patientenwege, unserer Medikamente im gesamten Portfolio und der Kundenbedürfnisse richtet das DLP seine Ziele sowohl auf die Strategie für das Krankheitsgebiet als auch auf regionale Ziele in der lokalen Gesundheitswirtschaft aus. Durch die effektive Nutzung aller verfügbaren Ressourcen wird es ihnen gelingen, einen angemessenen Zugang zu wichtigen Kunden zu sichern, um bessere Ergebnisse für mehr Patienten zu liefern, und zwar schneller. Als Experte der Region wird das DLP es genießen, tiefes Kundenwissen zu entwickeln und Erkenntnisse zu generieren, die unsere Strategien unterstützen und neue Kundenpartnerschaften zu Roche bringen. Ihre Chance
• Haben Sie starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, wo Sie zuhören, Partner und bilden
• Sammeln Sie umsetzbare Einblicke und gewinnen Sie Partnerchancen, die die Patientenergebnisse verbessern.

• Wettbewerbsorientierte Denkweise
• Fähigkeit, eine Wachstumsmentalität zu demonstrieren

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. • Avoir de solides compétences en communication où vous écoutez, partenaire et éduquer
• Recueillir des renseignements concrets et susciter des occasions de partenariat qui améliorent les résultats pour les patients.
• Bâtir, présenter et approuver l'équipe de la région thérapeutique et la communauté des maladies Dirige les objectifs, la stratégie et les buts de la région.
• Être pleinement responsable de la réalisation des objectifs du portefeuille de produits Roche grâce à un engagement efficace avec les clients, ce qui favorise une expérience client positive.
• Mobiliser le soutien aux produits, aux idées et aux projets dans une économie locale de la santé et contribuer au développement et à la mobilisation des défenseurs des marques locales et nationales
• Tenir à jour une connaissance détaillée des objectifs et des facteurs de politique nationale et l'appliquer pour identifier les possibilités de croissance de l'entreprise à l'échelle nationale et régionale en collaboration avec les équipes élargies interfonctionnelles Roche
• Utiliser une méthodologie agile (p. ex., méthode de sprint, MVP et approche itérative) pour réaliser des projets sur le niveau de la maladie et des projets sur le niveau de la non-maladie avec une expertise interne/externe
• S'assurer que tous les systèmes de gestion des connaissances et de CRM sont maintenus conformément aux normes Roche, possèdent une compréhension approfondie des dispositions du Code de pratique ABPI, tout en restant conformes aux SOP et aux politiques Roche.
• Agir en tant que gardien de normes élevées de conformité, d'éthique et de sécurité; placer les patients au centre de toutes les actions par un comportement commercial cohérent qui respecte les lois applicables, les codes de l'industrie et le code de conduite Roche.
• Démontrer de plus en plus une approche VACC (Visionnaire, Architecte, Catalyst, Coach) pour développer des compétences et des capacités personnelles, pour soutenir positivement les collègues Qui vous êtes
• Diplôme universitaire
• Engagement multipartite - clinique et toutes les parties prenantes pertinentes pour la mise en service des services locaux
• Expérience antérieure dans l'accès au marché, les ventes commerciales, ou les affaires médicales au sein d'un système de santé (e xperience en neurologie, avec la connaissance de la sclérose en plaques est un énorme plus )
• Ventes de médicaments spécialisés et expérience d'accès au marché bénéfique mais non essentielle
• Compétences avancées en affaires
• Compétences supérieures de hiérarchisation, avec capacité de gérer plusieurs indications au sein d'un portefeuille
• Un état d'esprit concurrentiel
• Aptitude à démontrer un état d'esprit de croissance
• Permis de conduire valide Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards
