Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Gerente de Comércio Exterior
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Gerente de Comércio Exterior, você atuará como um pilar fundamental na gestão da estratégia de comércio exterior e governança regulatória da Roche Diagnóstica Brasil (RDB), sendo responsável pela blindagem fiscal e aduaneira que mitiga riscos críticos de conformidade. Você deverá liderar a otimização do P&L logístico com foco rigoroso na redução de custos e lead times, além de coordenar a governança de parceiros globais e assegurar a eficiência end-to-end da cadeia de suprimentos internacional. Combinando liderança técnica e de pessoas, você irá desempenhar um papel decisivo na articulação cross-funcional com áreas como Finanças e Planejamento (S&OP) e na gestão de crises complexas, garantindo a sustentabilidade operacional e entregando valor agregado contínuo à Diagnóstica por meio de uma visão estratégica orientada a resultados e conformidade de alto padrão.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Garantir o compliance técnico das Declarações de Importação (DI) e processos aduaneiros junto à Receita Federal, Anvisa e demais órgãos reguladores, mitigando riscos de passivos fiscais e multas retroativas.

• Assegurar que o time tenha visibilidade em tempo real do fluxo de cargas, integrando dados logísticos com o planejamento operacional para mitigar rupturas de estoque governando a estratégia E2E de malha logística internacional da RDB.

• Gerenciar o P&L da operação de comércio exterior, com foco obsessivo na redução de Lead Time, custos de frete internacional e eliminação de despesas extraordinárias (como demurrage e armazenagens adicionais).

• Liderar, capacitar e reter os times de Compliance e Logística Internacional, mitigando riscos de turnover através de um plano robusto de gestão do conhecimento e matriz de competências.

• Atuar de maneira cross funcional com as lideranças da RDB e/ou One Roche de maneira consistente para comunicar temas estratégicos e reputacionais de relevante impacto antecipadamente.

• Liderar o monitoramento de atualizações nas legislações e normas aduaneiras do comércio exterior brasileiro e internacional, desenhando planos de ação imediatos para adaptação do negócio.

• Liderar os processos de concorrência (RFPs) e gerenciar a governança/SLAs de múltiplos parceiros críticos (freight forwarders, despachantes aduaneiros e recintos aduaneiros).

• Atuar como representante de relacionamento institucional e técnico com autoridades fiscais e aduaneiras durante processos de fiscalização ou pleitos de regimes especiais em parceria com outros times da RDB (taxes, finanças, etc)

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa em Direito (com foco tributário/aduaneiro), Comércio Exterior, Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Especialização, Pós-graduação ou MBA em Direito Aduaneiro, Gestão Fiscal ou Auditoria Fiscal será considerado um diferencial.

• Sólida experiência em gestão de processos de importação e visão de negócios com atuação em Comércio Exterior e/ou Gestão Aduaneira.

• Experiência prévia em empresas do segmento de saúde, farmacêuticas e/ou de diagnóstico in vitro.

• Experiência consolidada atuando na área de Trade Compliance, auditoria de comércio exterior ou consultoria aduaneira de grande porte, tendo atuado como representante em junto aos órgãos reguladores.

• Inglês avançado; desejável conhecimento de Espanhol.

• Disponibilidade para atuar com base em São Paulo no modelo híbrido.

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

jobs.title: Executive Operations Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Executive Operations Lead

Reporting to: General Manager/ Finance Manager
Subordinates: 4

Role Description
The Admin Manager / Chief of Staff is a dual-impact role, serving as a strategic partner to the General Manager and a functional leader for the organization’s administrative and business support infrastructure. Reporting to the Finance Manager, the role holder acts as a "bridge-builder" between the Enabling Team and business units, ensuring operational excellence across executive support, office management, and event logistics. As a leader of the Business Support team, they are responsible for optimizing administrative processes, fostering a high-performance service culture, and ensuring that the physical and logistical environment of the office empowers the team to deliver value to patients and stakeholders.

Summary of Main Responsibilities:

Executive Support & Strategic Coordination

• Act as the primary Executive Assistant to the General Manager, proactively managing complex calendars, domestic/international travel logistics, and migration/visa requirements.

• Handle confidential business and personal tasks for the GM to optimize their leadership capacity.

• Provide high-level administrative partnership to the Enabling Team, ensuring departmental priorities are supported.
People Leadership & Process Excellence

• Directly manage and coach a diverse team including Administrative and Business Support Coordinators and the Driver

• Standardize and continuously improve administrative business processes to increase organizational efficiency and simplify complex workflows.

• Distribute tasks among specialists based on their competencies and workload, providing daily mentorship on Roche systems, tools, and methods.

• Supervise Business Support Coordinators to ensure high-quality logistical assistance and event support is provided to all business-driving teams.

• Oversee the full lifecycle of vendor relations and documentation, from tendering and contract preparation to the control of invoices and financial closing.

• Control the organization of international congresses, speaker trainings, and internal events, including stakeholder (KOL) engagement and logistics.

• Ensure all administrative operations are executed with precision, maintaining high ethical standards and safeguarding confidential company information.
Office Operations & Fleet Management

• Oversee total office maintenance, including cleaning services, supply procurement (stationery, catering/food), and coordinating technical repairs.

• Manage the corporate car fleet, ensuring compliance, maintenance, and efficient logistics for the organization.

• Optimize the office environment to reflect the company’s culture and ensure a productive workspace for all employees.
Corporate Events & Stakeholder Hosting

• Provide essential support in the planning and execution of major corporate milestones, including Kick-off meetings, Cycle meetings, and internal team events.

• Serve as the lead host and coordinator for visits from Top Management and key external stakeholders, ensuring professional hospitality and seamless logistics.
Requirements:

• University degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in administrative management or executive support, preferably within an international environment.

• Proven experience in leading and developing a diverse administrative team.

• Exceptional organizational skills: ability to manage high-level

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position Executive Operations Lead Reporting to: General Manager/ Finance Manager Subordinates: 4 Role Description The Admin Manager / Chief of Staff is a dual-impact role, serving as a strategic partner to the General Manager and a functional leader for the organization’s administrative and business support infrastructure. Reporting to the Finance Manager, the role holder acts as a "bridge-builder" between the Enabling Team and business units, ensuring operational excellence across executive support, office management, and event logistics. As a leader of the Business Support team, they are responsible for optimizing administrative processes, fostering a high-performance service culture, and ensuring that the physical and logistical environment of the office empowers the team to deliver value to patients and stakeholders. Summary of Main Responsibilities: Executive Support & Strategic Coordination
• Act as the primary Executive Assistant to the General Manager, proactively managing complex calendars, domestic/international travel logistics, and migration/visa requirements.
• Handle confidential business and personal tasks for the GM to optimize their leadership capacity.
• Provide high-level administrative partnership to the Enabling Team, ensuring departmental priorities are supported. People Leadership & Process Excellence
• Directly manage and coach a diverse team including Administrative and Business Support Coordinators and the Driver
• Standardize and continuously improve administrative business processes to increase organizational efficiency and simplify complex workflows.
• Distribute tasks among specialists based on their competencies and workload, providing daily mentorship on Roche systems, tools, and methods.
• Supervise Business Support Coordinators to ensure high-quality logistical assistance and event support is provided to all business-driving teams.
• Oversee the full lifecycle of vendor relations and documentation, from tendering and contract preparation to the control of invoices and financial closing.
• Control the organization of international congresses, speaker trainings, and internal events, including stakeholder (KOL) engagement and logistics.
• Ensure all administrative operations are executed with precision, maintaining high ethical standards and safeguarding confidential company information. Office Operations & Fleet Management
• Oversee total office maintenance, including cleaning services, supply procurement (stationery, catering/food), and coordinating technical repairs.
• Manage the corporate car fleet, ensuring compliance, maintenance, and efficient logistics for the organization.
• Optimize the office environment to reflect the company’s culture and ensure a productive workspace for all employees. Corporate Events & Stakeholder Hosting
• Provide essential support in the planning and execution of major corporate milestones, including Kick-off meetings, Cycle meetings, and internal team events.
• Serve as the lead host and coordinator for visits from Top Management and key external stakeholders, ensuring professional hospitality and seamless logistics. Requirements:
• University degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in administrative management or executive support, preferably within an international environment.
• Proven experience in leading and developing a diverse administrative team.
• Exceptional organizational skills: ability to manage high-level

jobs.description:
Patient Journey Partner Ophthalmology — Roche, Basel.

Key details:
• Location: Basel, BS canton, Switzerland
• Employer: Roche — global pharma and diagnostics leader
• Apply on: Roche careers portal

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. The Position Paziente Viaggio Partner Ophthalmology Roche Nederland B.V., Woerden / Landelijke positie Voor ons multidisciplinaire team Oogheelkunde zijn wij op zoek naar een ervaren en ondernemende Paziente Viaggio Partner Oftalmologia. In deze rol ben je het centrale aanspreekpunt voor alle stakeholders die diretto betrokken zijn bij het zorgpad van mensen incontrato een oogaandoening. In questo caso, la Commissione ha adottato una decisione relativa alla conclusione di un accordo tra la Comunità economica europea e l'Unione europea. Je primaire doel è om de toegang tot onze innovatieve behandelingen te versnellen en zo de zorg en het leven van patiënten, bijvoorbeeld met maculadegeneratie, significativo te verbeteren. Dit è een unieke kans om incontrato jouw ervaring directe, tastbare impatto te maken op de patiëntenzorg in een competitieve markt. Als Paziente Viaggio Partner vorm jij de fondamentale verbinding tussen de behoeften van externe stakeholders, zoals oogartsen en assistenti medici, en de expertise binnen ons Ophthalmology team. Jij bent onze oren en ogen in het veld; een ondernemer die impatto maakt porta bestaande relaties te verdeepen en nieuwe samenwerkingen te ontsluiten. Porta pertinente waarde te bieden, bouw je aan duurzame partnerships die ervoor zorgen dat onze innovatieve geneesmiddelen op het juiste moment de juiste patiënt beiken. Wat ga je doen?
• Doorzien van het volledige zorgpad: Je brengt de volledige paziente viaggio in kaart, identificeert knelpunten en vertaalt deze inzichten van buiten naar binnen om onze landelijke strategie pragmatisch vorm te geven.
• Relaties bouwen en resultaten boeken: Als een ervaren netwerker bouw en onderhoud je duurzame relaties met oogartsen, assistenti medici en zorgmanagers. Je bent pas tevreden als jouw inspanningen leiden tot meetbare verbetering in de toegang tot zorg.
• Co-creëren van oplossingen: Je fungeert als volwaardig sparringpartner voor zorgprofessionals. Samen ha incontrato hen ontwikkel je praktische oplossingen die het ottimalee gebruik van onze innovaties ondersteunen.
• Realizzatori di impatto: Je bent een doener die de introductie van onze innovatieve geneesmiddelen en bijbehorende zorgoplossingen in het zorglandschap aanjaagt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige levenscyclus van deze therapieën en zorgt dat de waarde ervan wordt gezien en benut.
• Verbinden en coachen: Je werkt nauw samen ha incontrato il team multidisciplinare. Met jouw ervaring vervul je een natuurlijke voortrekkersrol waarin je collega's meeneemt en coacht om samen een geïntegreerde aanpak te garanderen. Wat breng je mee? Je bent een natuurlijke verbinder incontrato een sterke ondernemersgeest. Je hebt de passie om de zorg voor de patiënt te verbeteren en het vakmanschap om als strategisch partner Je brengt een flinke dosis levenservaring en senioriteit mee, waardoor je een gesprekspartner op niveau bent voor diversi stakeholders. La Commissione ha adottato un regolamento che modifica il regolamento (CEE) n.
• Een afgeronde hbo- di wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in een medische di gezondheidswetenschappelijke richting.
• Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar pertinentie ervaring in een commerciële di zorg-gerelateerde buitendienstfunctie binnen de farmaceutische industrie di dispositivi medici.
• Ervaring binnen de oogheelkunde en een bestaand netwerk is en sterke pré; ervaring met medische apparatuur (MedTech) binnen dit specials

jobs.title: Indirect Procurement Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras.

Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos.

Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Como Indirect Procurement Intern en Lima , te unirás a un equipo dinámico donde tu capacidad para interpretar datos impulsará decisiones estratégicas. En este rol, transformarás bases de datos en herramientas de gestión, apoyando la eficiencia de nuestra cadena de suministro en un entorno de aprendizaje continuo.

Oportunidad

• Gestionas y analizas bases de datos de Procurement para generar insights estratégicos.

• Elaboras dashboards y reportes periódicos utilizando Google Suite y Looker Studio.

• Soportas la selección y evaluación de proveedores mediante el análisis de indicadores.

• Realizas el seguimiento detallado de órdenes de compra y desempeño de proveedores.

• Brindas soporte a usuarios internos en procesos de compras y el uso de herramientas globales.

• Apoyas en la automatización de procesos y proyectos de mejora continua del área.

• Colaboras en proyectos regionales con un enfoque de análisis de datos y eficiencia.

Quien eres

• Eres estudiante universitario (7mo ciclo en adelante) de Ingeniería, Administración, Finanzas o afines.

• Manejas herramientas de análisis y visualización de datos como Google Suite y Looker Studio.

• Posees conocimientos en lenguajes de programación orientados a datos como Python o C++.

• Demuestras un nivel intermedio de inglés para interactuar en un entorno global.

• Destacas por tu capacidad analítica, proactividad y orientación al detalle.

• Conocimientos previos o manejo del sistema SAP es deseable pero no obligatorio.

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

This is a field-based role. The territory is within the San Diego area. Ideal candidate must reside in the territory.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $71,000 and $132,000 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law . A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits
*LI-MG1

Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an equal opportunity employer. titleByLocale.it: Engagement Marketing Manager - Oncologia e Nefrologia
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de marketing engagement - Oncologie et néphrologie

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Engagement Marketing Manager – Oncology & Nephrology
Roche Nederland B.V. – Woerden

Ben jij op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging op het vlak van omnichannel marketing in een leuk team van marketing & digital professionals? Ben jij een expert in marketingexecutie die energie krijgt van het vertalen van strategie naar tastbare impact? Bij Roche Nederland werk je in een agile omgeving aan onze missie: de beste zorg voor de patiënt in Nederland.

Functieomschrijving
Als Engagement Marketing Manager maak je deel uit van het Marketing & Digital Team en ben je de regisseur van onze marketingplannen. Je slaat de brug tussen strategie en uitvoering voor de teams Oncologie en Nefrologie & Reumatologie. Door slimme omnichannel-campagnes (zowel fysiek als digitaal) te lanceren en de impact daarvan direct te meten, optimaliseer je de klantervaring. Jouw doel? Met een mix van creativiteit en een resultaatgerichte mindset zet jij je in voor de beste zorgoplossingen voor de patiënt, de zorgverlener en Roche.

Wat ga je doen?

• Omnichannel Orchestratie : Je ontwerpt en optimaliseert de klanten-touchpoint-journey, waarbij je persoonlijke en niet-persoonlijke interacties integreert om onze klanten te overtuigen van de waarde van onze geneesmiddelen voor oncologie en nefrologie en reumatologie.

• Tactische Executie: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige 'pull-through' van het omnichannel marketingplan, inclusief de ontwikkeling van gepersonaliseerde content op basis van diepe klantinzichten.

• Content & Campaign Management : In afstemming met ons digital team creëer je impactvolle content die aansluit bij de klanten touchpoint-journey, waarbij je zorgt voor een snelle en compliant marktintroductie via o.a. Veeva PromoMats, rekening houdend met CGR.

• Impactmeting & Optimalisatie: Je kiest en monitort KPI’s en analyseert de effectiviteit van campagnes om datagedreven beslissingen te nemen en lopende tactieken continu te verbeteren.

• Cross-functionele samenwerking: Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van onder andere Medical, Access en Customer Engagement om ervoor te zorgen dat tactieken naadloos aansluiten op de behoeften in het regionale ecosysteem.

• Financieel Beheer: Je draagt bij aan het beheer van het marketingbudget en waarborgt een sterke financiële verantwoording van de uitgevoerde initiatieven.

Wat breng je mee?

• Ervaring: Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in digital/non-digital marketing binnen de farmaceutische industrie. Ervaring in een fieldfunctie is een plus.

• Omnichannel Expertise : Een diepgaande kennis van het executeren van omnichannel campagnes, meten van impact en het vertalen van strategie naar implementatie van taktieken.

• Data-gedrevenheid: Bewezen kennis en kunde in het faciliteren en nemen van beslissingen op basis van data en inzichten op tactisch en uitvoerend niveau.

• Technische & Analytische vaardigheden: Geavanceerde kennis van CRM-systemen (zoals Veeva/Salesforce), marketing automation, digitale tools en AI-oplossingen voor marketing.

• Mindset: Je hebt een passie voor digitale en persoonlijke interactie met onze klanten, een ondernemende 'can-do' mentaliteit, plezier in executie, een sterke focus op de klantervaring en het meten van impact plus het vermogen om te gedijen in een dynamische, agile- cross functionele omgeving.

• Opleiding & Taal: Een afgeronde HBO- of universitaire opleiding (bijv. Business of Science) en uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels bij het schrijven van teksten.

Waarom Roche?

jobs.title: Safety, Health, Environment (SHE) & Facility Officer

titleByLocale.fr: Agent de la sécurité, de la santé, de l'environnement et des installations

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Safety, Health and Environment (SHE), Security and Facilities Officer is responsible for overarching facility management, which includes managing the office building, security, space management, and company vehicles, all aimed at safeguarding company assets and ensuring a safe working environment. They are also responsible for managing local Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) systems, as well as business continuity management in compliance with local legislation and SHE policy. This role extends to leading the development and implementation of local SHE initiatives in collaboration with the One Roche Leadership Teams.

As a SHE Security and Facilities Officer, you will oversee SHE, facility, and business continuity operations across the Pharma, Diagnostics, and Diabetes Care business. You will report directly to the General Manager and be a crucial member of the Emergency Management Team, participating in Affiliate Governance Committee meetings as necessary.

What you will be working on:

• SHE Objectives and Goals: Promote SHE activities in alignment with local and global Roche SHE objectives, monitor legal compliance, and ensure corrective actions are reviewed and implemented.

• Advisory and Support: Advise and support site senior and line management on SHE-related topics and concerns, promoting compliance with local legal regulations and Roche SHE provisions.

• Emergency Management: Lead and facilitate the emergency management team, develop and manage the local (Roche internal) emergency management system, and advise external emergency response teams during incidents.

• Training and Documentation: Develop and provide SHE training for all employees, prepare and maintain the SHE handbook, and establish a system for receiving, documenting, and responding to SHE-related reports and complaints.

• Risk Analysis and Audits: Implement and document a risk analysis process, conduct periodic SHE inspections, and report critical SHE situations, accidents, incidents, and occupational injuries.

• Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor and document the implementation of SHE programs, emissions, energy and material use, and the progress of actions related to SHE goals, providing regular reports on SHE KPIs.

• Financial and External Relations: Manage financial provisions for health and environmental liabilities with the finance department, and establish and maintain contacts with local SHE authorities, professional organizations, and the public while leading the Business Continuity Management Team.

• Facility and Maintenance Management: Ensure the facility is fully operational with all utilities functioning properly, schedule and supervise maintenance and repair work, implement waste management, oversee office renovations, and ensure legally required documents and permits are available.

• Security Management: Support and advise senior management, line management, and employees on all security matters, ensure compliance with legal security regulations and Roche requirements, manage critical security situations, and establish contacts with law enforcement and professional organizations.

• Involvement in Projects: Participate in major projects, including design phases, to represent and integrate security considerations and requirements, and report critical security incidents to superiors and the Chief Security Officer.

• Fleet Management: Oversee fleet management, including planning, managing, coordinating, and supervising the acquisition, utilization, maintenance,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every patient deserves the best care possible. We are looking for a visionary Healthcare Systems Partner (HSP) to serve as a local face of Roche Philippines. In this function-agnostic role, you will be a catalyst for change, working at the heart of the healthcare ecosystem to shape a future where innovation is accessible to all.

• Subject matter expertise in developing Policy & Access

• Influence healthcare ecosystem shaping

• Patient focussed opportunity to make impact now

Role Purpose
As an Healthcare Systems (Policy & Access) Partner (HSP), you are an empowered leader dedicated to strengthening the Philippine healthcare system. You will move beyond traditional boundaries to identify shared purposes with government bodies, regulators, payers, and patient advocates. Your mission is to co-create sustainable solutions that dismantle barriers to care and deliver significantly better outcomes for patients and society.

What you will work on:
Key Responsibilities include but not limited to the following:

• Ecosystem Innovation: Drive transformative healthcare innovation by partnering with external stakeholders to create long-term value for the Philippine patient community.

• Trusted Partnership: Act as the primary, trusted point of contact for high-level system stakeholders, managing complex relationships with transparency and integrity.

• VACC Leadership: Embody the Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst (VACC) model to influence both internal strategies and external healthcare movements.

• Strategic Bridging: Connect Roche’s global expertise and internal networks with the local ecosystem to facilitate knowledge exchange and secure vital resources.

• Policy & Access: Influence healthcare policy development and infrastructure building to improve local models of care and patient journeys.

• System Shaping: Identify systemic roadblocks and co-develop solutions that enhance the efficiency and equity of the healthcare environment.

• Knowledge Leadership: Stay at the forefront of healthcare trends, providing deep insights into local governance, funding, and regulatory processes.

Who you are:

• Strategic System Thinker: You possess a "systems thinking" mindset with the ability to listen deeply to stakeholder needs and connect them to broader health goals.

• Experienced Leader: You bring a proven track record of leading cross-functional teams and managing complex, high-stakes projects within the healthcare sector.

• Healthcare Expert: You have a deep understanding of healthcare systems, governance, and the nuances of the Philippine regulatory and payer landscape.

• Policy Advocate: You ideally bring experience in policy-making or public affairs, with the ability to navigate and influence legislative or institutional frameworks. Experience and/or ability to review and write healthcare policy related documents preferred.

• Entrepreneurial & Self-Managed: You are a proactive self-starter who thrives in a networked environment and is comfortable with ambiguity.

• Educational Background: You hold a University degree in Science, Economics, or Business. An MBA or advanced Life Science degree is highly regarded.

• Bilingual Communicator: You are fluent in the local language and have a high proficiency in English to ensure seamless collaboration with our global teams.

• Technology Savvy: You effectively leverage AI and other advanced technologies to drive efficiency and generate strategic insights.

This field-based role may require

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
By combining our unique strengths, we’re redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. Discover what it’s like to work at Roche.

The Opportunity
Join Roche Digital Technology and make an impact on global healthcare. In this role, you will architect and implement robust Directory Services solutions (primarily Microsoft Active Directory) while driving operational excellence through tier 2-3 support, performance optimization, and continuous innovation. Collaborating with specialists across multiple initiatives and time zones, you'll ensure the identity and access infrastructure that powers our mission to help patients live longer, better lives.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate in technical teams to design end-to-end infrastructure solutions, produce comprehensive documentation, and interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters

• Evaluate promising solutions and technologies through Proofs of Concepts (PoCs) and feasibility studies to determine success criteria and drive innovation

• Provide tier 2-3 operational support, manage and implement Directory Services Infrastructure on-premises for manufacturing environments, and support associated applications and complements

• Proactively monitor systems for performance, availability, and capacity management to minimize escalations and ensure solution reliability

• Promptly respond to customer requests, resolve incidents, and implement changes while maintaining high levels of customer engagement and satisfaction

• Understand and implement relevant ITIL, GxP, and Project Management concepts including Request, Incident, Change, Problem, and Document Management, as well as Qualification and Validation

• Actively pursue self-development, create actionable improvement plans, provide 24x7 on-call support with schedule flexibility, and occasional international travel as required

Who you are

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline; or equivalent professional experience with 4+ years of hands-on Active Directory administration and advanced troubleshooting

• Robust experience working in a major global organization, preferably in a regulated industry, with proven interpersonal skills to interact effectively across multiple countries and cultures

• Strong design and hands-on technical expertise in Microsoft Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Services (LDAP), and desirable experience with Entra ID; proficiency in PowerShell scripting required

• Commitment to operational excellence with willingness to cross-train, continuously evolve technical and soft skills, and learn additional technical expertise

• Proactive, collaborative, and supportive approach with strong customer focus, highly responsive service delivery ethic, and adaptability to change in a large organization

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and documentation skills with strong spoken and written English proficiency

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The PTE (Pharma Technical Operations Digital Analytics & Operational Excellence) organization will catalyze the global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy to enable PT to realize our performance promises. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Die Organisation PTE (Pharma Technical Operations Digital Analytics & Operational Excellence) wird die globale Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Digital and Operational Excellence-Strategie von PT beschleunigen, damit PT unsere Leistungsversprechen umsetzen kann. Wir werden eine starke funktionsübergreifende und integrative Community aufbauen, die Macht der Daten in die Hände unserer Mitarbeiter legen, die Lean- und Digital-Fähigkeiten in der gesamten PT weiterentwickeln und unsere Digital- und Advanced Analytics-Lösungen zum Nutzen unserer Kollegen und Patienten erweitern. Das Digital Data Backbone Chapter von PTE ermöglicht diese Vision, indem es FAIR-Daten unternehmensweit verfügbar macht und einen dezentralen, wertorientierten und datenproduktzentrierten Ansatz etabliert. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The PT Digital & Operational Excellence (PTE) organization works in partnership across major global business functions, establishing and implementing an overall Digital / Technology strategy. Our goal is to drive the delivery and scale of key data and digital solutions in support of Roche’s vision.
As a Senior Data Engineer at Roche PT, you will play a pivotal role in developing and optimizing the data infrastructure that powers our pharmaceutical operations and data products. Working in multidisciplinary teams—alongside data scientists, subject matter experts, and fellow data engineers—you'll curate, transform, and construct features integral to our modeling approaches. This role calls for a collaborative, open-minded individual who values learning, thoughtfully challenges ideas, and prioritizes impactful work.

The Opportunity

• Design & Build Infrastructure: Design and build scalable data pipelines and storage solutions for real-time and batch processing, aligning them with Subject Matter Expert (SME) needs.

• Lead FAIR Data Product Creation: Lead the creation of FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) data products that enhance decision-making and maintain data integrity, availability, and performance across platforms.

• Data Acquisition & Processing: Acquire, ingest, and process data from diverse sources into Big Data platforms (e.g., Snowflake).

• Model Data Landscapes: Collaborate with process experts to model data landscapes, obtain extracts, define secure exchange methods, and shape data products, developing ERDs and reusable pipelines.

• Mentor & Coach: Coach junior data engineers, helping implement best practices and data engineering standards, and fostering a culture of innovation (DevOps, Data Streaming, etc.).

• Governance & Compliance: Uphold data governance standards to ensure regulatory compliance and secure sensitive data, addressing data quality issues to maintain asset accuracy and reliability.

• Technical Stewardship: Contribute to templates and best practices for the technology stack, collaborate with infrastructure teams, and apply innovative techniques to deliver impact.

Who You Are

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.

• Core Experience: 6+ years in data engineering with experience in designing large-scale systems and experience in leading junior data engineers across projects.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency with data quality and observability tools, including Ataccama and Monte Carlo.

• Communication & Collaboration: Proven ability to clearly communicate complex solutions to audiences of varied technical levels; strong organizational and interpersonal skills; and a drive to collaborate and prioritize impactful work.

• Preferred Qualifications: 3+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry, knowledge of regulatory requirements (e.g., GMP, FDA) and Quality systems, and experience with AI-driven data solutions and machine learning pipelines.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
By combining our unique strengths, we’re redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. Discover what it’s like to work at Roche.

ASPIRE is a multi-year program that will define, design, and deploy Future ERP solutions based on SAP S/4 HANA and other cloud/on-premise technology platforms. The program will enable simplified, standardized, and harmonized global business processes by capitalizing on SAP, Life Science Industry and Roche effective practices.

The opportunity:

• Preparation and leading of FIT-to-Template (assessment of the current business processes compared and aligned against the future Aspire Global Template) and scoping workshops for Financial Compliance

• Liaising with local affiliate Finance stakeholders for the implementation of Financial Compliance requirements

• Assessment of localization requirements for Authorization

• Execution of Testing Activities during the deployment (UT, SAT, UAT, REG)

• Go Live & Hyper care (incl. Month end closing ) support

• Ensure template governance within the project including change control management in line with the respective GBPMs/GBPOs and the overall Finance governance concept

Who you are

• You have a university degree in Business Administration, Accounting or a related field and proficiency in English.

• 5+ years related business experience or equivalent Project Management skills in the area of SAP Authorization

• Broad knowledge of business processes, policies and programs

• Strong Project Management , business partner management, communication and change management skills. Experience in Agile Project Methodologies is a plus

• Strong people skill s are required as the role is highly consultative, interacting with staff at all levels across an organization

Relocation benefits are not available for this job opportunity.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Die Gruppe fokussiert sich auf die Entwicklung und Anwendung anspruchsvoller spektrometrischer Verfahren zur Charakterisierung von Diagnostika- und Biochemika-Präparaten und liefert damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Qualität und Innovation unserer Produkte. Du berichtest direkt an den Gruppenleitenden. Du willst deine Entwicklung aktiv mitgestalten und suchst ein Unternehmen, das dir Freiraum über Funktionen und Standorte hinweg bietet, wo deine Stellenbezeichnung erst der Anfang ist. Hochmotiviert nimmst du die Dynamik eines führenden Entwicklungsbereichs an und leistest ab Tag eins einen produktiven Beitrag.

Deine wichtigsten Aufgaben

Du führst selbstständig anspruchsvolle, nicht-routinemäßige NMR- und q-NMR-spektroskopische Analysen an kleinen Molekülen durch. Dazu gehören insbesondere:

• Selbständige Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von NMR- und q-NMR-Analysen an kleinen Molekülen, inklusive Probenvorbereitung

• Eigenständige Optimierung und Entwicklung neuer NMR-Methoden sowie Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Methodenvalidierungen, Methodentransfers zu anderen Abteilungen und Stabilitätsuntersuchungen inkl. Reporting

• Selbständige Ergebnisauswertung mittels EDV (z. B. MestReNova, Bruker TopSpin, Delta), Erstellung von Plänen, Berichten, Vorschriften und SOPs sowie Präsentation der Ergebnisse in Besprechungen

• Dokumentation nach den gültigen Qualitätsrichtlinien (GMP)

• Arbeitsbesprechungen mit Vorgesetzten und Auftraggebern, Teilnahme an laborinternen Kolloquien

• Pflege und Wartung der NMR-Spektrometer (Jeol und Bruker), inklusive Durchführung kleinerer Reparaturen

• Engagierte Zusammenarbeit in multidisziplinären Teams

Hinweis: Diese Position erfordert die Bereitschaft zum Umgang mit Diagnostika- und Biochemika-Präparaten sowie S2 Arbeiten.

Dein Profil

• Du verfügst über einen erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Master in Chemie mit erster Berufserfahrung oder einen Bachelor in Chemie mit langjähriger Berufserfahrung, Analytischer Chemie oder einer verwandten Disziplin

• Du hast fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der NMR- und q-NMR-Spektroskopie an kleinen Molekülen

• Du besitzt Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Jeol- und Bruker-NMR-Spektrometern sowie mit den Auswertesoftware-Lösungen TopSpin, Delta und MestReNova

• Idealerweise bringst du Grundkenntnisse in weiteren spektrometrischen Methoden (UV-Vis, IR, MS) mit

• Du verfügst über Erfahrung im GMP-regulierten Umfeld sowie in Methodenentwicklung, Qualifizierung und Validierung

• Du überzeugst uns durch Zuverlässigkeit, Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit sowie lösungsorientiertes Denken, und arbeitest gerne im Team und zeigst interkulturelle Kompetenz

• Du bist fließend in Deutsch in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

Die Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung

Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse/Nachweise.

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.
Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Nach Sichtung deiner Unterlagen findet zunächst ein Telefoninterview statt. Bei gegenseitigem Interesse folgt als letzter Schritt ein persönliches Vorstellungsgespräch mit Präsentation am Standort Penzberg.

Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens 03.07.2026

• Manutenzione e manutenzione degli spettrometri NMR (Jeol e Bruker), comprese le riparazioni minori

• Hai la conoscenza nel trattare con gli spettrometri Jeol e Bruker NMR e con le soluzioni software di valutazione TopSpin, Delta e MestReNova
• Idealmente, porterà conoscenze di base in altri metodi spettrometrici (UV-Vis, IR, MS)
• Hai esperienza nell'ambiente GMP regolamentato e nello sviluppo dei metodi, nella qualificazione e nella validazione

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Your position and department You work within the sub-chapter/group Spectroscopy and Separation Science (DSRRIS) in the chapter Instrumental Analytics. The group focuses on the development and application of sophisticated spectrometric methods for the characterisation of diagnostic and biochemical preparations, thus making a significant contribution to the quality and innovation of our products. You report directly to the group leaders. You want to actively shape your development and are looking for a company that offers you freedom across functions and locations where your job title is only the beginning. Highly motivated, you take on the dynamism of a leading development area and make a productive contribution from day one. Your most important tasks You will independently perform challenging, non-routine NMR and q-NMR spectroscopic analyses on small molecules. These include in particular:
• Independent planning, implementation and documentation of NMR and q-NMR analyses on small molecules, including sample preparation
• Independent optimization and development of new NMR methods as well as planning, implementation and documentation of method validations, method transfers to other departments and stability investigations incl. Reporting
• Independent evaluation of results by computer (e.g. MestReNova, Bruker TopSpin, Delta), preparation of plans, reports, regulations and SOPs and presentation of results in meetings
• Documentation according to the valid quality guidelines (GMP)
• Working meetings with supervisors and clients, participation in internal laboratory colloquia
• Maintenance and maintenance of NMR spectrometers (Jeol and Bruker), including minor repairs
• Engaged collaboration in multidisciplinary teams Note: This position requires willingness to deal with diagnostic and biochemical preparations as well as S2 work. Your profile
• You have a successfully completed Master in Chemistry with initial professional experience or a Bachelor in Chemistry with many years of professional experience, Analytical Chemistry or a related discipline
• You have extensive practical experience in NMR and q-NMR spectroscopy on small molecules
• You have knowledge in dealing with Jeol and Bruker NMR spectrometers as well as with the evaluation software solutions TopSpin, Delta and MestReNova
• Ideally, you will bring basic knowledge in other spectrometric methods (UV-Vis, IR, MS)
• You have experience in the GMP-regulated environment as well as in method development, qualification and validation
• You convince us through reliability, care and accuracy as well as solution-oriented thinking, and enjoy working in a team and showing intercultural competence
• You are fluent in German in word and writing; English skills are beneficial The job is limited to 2 years. Your application We ask you for the following documents:
• Current CV
• Your official (educational) certificates / proofs. No further documents are currently required. Before submitting the application, please note that no further documents can be added afterwards. After viewing your documents, a telephone interview will first take place. In the event of mutual interest, the last step will be a personal interview with presentation at the Penzberg location. Application period until at least 03.07.2026 (Application)

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le groupe se concentre sur le développement et l'application de méthodes spectrométriques sophistiquées pour la caractérisation des préparations diagnostiques et biochimiques, apportant ainsi une contribution significative à la qualité et à l'innovation de nos produits. Vous vous adressez directement aux chefs de groupe. Vous voulez façonner activement votre développement et êtes à la recherche d'une entreprise qui vous offre la liberté à travers les fonctions et les lieux où votre titre de travail n'est que le début. Très motivé, vous prenez le dynamisme d'une zone de développement de premier plan et apportez une contribution productive dès le premier jour. Vos tâches les plus importantes Vous effectuerez indépendamment des analyses spectroscopiques spectroscopiques spectroscopiques spectroscopiques spectroscopiques spectrales spectrales non routines et non routinières sur de petites molécules. Il s'agit en particulier:
• Planification, mise en œuvre et documentation indépendantes des analyses RMN et q-RMN sur les petites molécules, y compris la préparation des échantillons
• Optimisation et développement indépendants de nouvelles méthodes de RMN ainsi que planification, mise en oeuvre et documentation des validations de méthodes, transferts de méthodes à d'autres départements et enquêtes de stabilité, y compris Rapports
• Évaluation indépendante des résultats par ordinateur (par exemple MestReNova, Bruker TopSpin, Delta), élaboration de plans, rapports, règlements et SOP et présentation des résultats lors des réunions
• Documentation conforme aux directives de qualité (BPF)
• Réunions de travail avec les superviseurs et les clients, participation à des colloques internes de laboratoire
• Entretien et entretien des spectromètres RMN (Jeol et Bruker), y compris des réparations mineures
• Collaboration engagée dans des équipes multidisciplinaires Remarque: Cette position exige la volonté de traiter les préparations diagnostiques et biochimiques ainsi que les travaux de S2. Votre profil
• Vous avez obtenu une maîtrise en chimie avec une expérience professionnelle initiale ou un baccalauréat en chimie avec de nombreuses années d'expérience professionnelle, Chimie analytique ou une discipline connexe
• Vous avez une vaste expérience pratique en RMN et en spectroscopie q-NMR sur de petites molécules
• Vous avez des connaissances sur les spectromètres Jeol et Bruker RMN ainsi que sur les solutions logicielles d'évaluation TopSpin, Delta et MestReNova
• Idéalement, vous apporterez des connaissances de base dans d'autres méthodes spectrométriques (UV-Vis, IR, MS)
• Vous avez une expérience dans l'environnement réglementé par les BPF ainsi que dans le développement, la qualification et la validation des méthodes
• Vous nous convainquez par la fiabilité, le soin et la précision ainsi que par la pensée orientée vers la solution, et aimez travailler en équipe et faire preuve de compétence interculturelle
• Vous maîtrisez couramment l'allemand en paroles et en écriture; les compétences en anglais sont bénéfiques L'emploi est limité à 2 ans. Votre demande Nous vous demandons les documents suivants :
• CV actuel
• Vos certificats/preuves officiels (éducatifs). Aucun autre document n'est actuellement requis. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Impacto Sostenible
Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones.

La Oportunidad
Como socio estratégico clave de la afiliada, liderarás la gestión de crédito y cobranza para maximizar el flujo de caja y mitigar riesgos financieros. Este rol combinará la visión de negocio con la innovación tecnológica, colaborando con equipos globales y centros de servicios compartidos (RSS) para garantizar la liquidez, el cumplimiento normativo (ICFR) y la excelencia operativa de las cuentas por cobrar.

Responsabilidades

• Asesorar a los líderes locales y equipos interfuncionales para asegurar el cobro oportuno de cuentas por cobrar mediante relaciones basadas en confianza y una ejecución de primer nivel.

• Liderar la evaluación del riesgo crediticio, formular políticas locales alineadas con el cumplimiento global y realizar due diligence periódicos para establecer límites de crédito y condiciones de pago.

• Maximizar la conversión de ventas en fondos líquidos mediante la reducción de saldos vencidos, el impulso de iniciativas de rendimiento de efectivo y la gestión estratégica de los ciclos de cobro.

• Evaluar e implementar estructuras financieras de cobertura como seguros de crédito comercial, titularizaciones, forfaiting o descuento de facturas junto a la Tesorería del Grupo.

• Monitorear y comunicar de forma transparente los indicadores clave de gestión de crédito (DSO, MAT DSO, morosidad) y preparar los informes financieros del área.

• Identificar e implementar sinergias de digitalización y flujos de trabajo automatizados apoyándose en herramientas analíticas avanzadas para optimizar procesos de alto volumen.

• Liderar los controles de auditoría interna y externa (incluyendo ICFR), gestionar la reserva para cuentas de cobro dudoso y coordinar con los centros de servicios compartidos (RSS) para la integridad de datos y procesos.

Quién Eres

• Profesional en Finanzas, Contabilidad, Administración, Economía o carreras afines, idealmente con estudios de posgrado.

• Más de 8 años de experiencia en gestión financiera o control de gestión, con un recorrido comprobado dentro de la industria farmacéutica o de ciencias de la vida (Life Sciences).

• Dominio experto de SAP y Excel, sumado al manejo de herramientas de visualización y analítica de datos como DataStudio, Tableau y SAC (SAP Analytics Cloud).

• Fluidez avanzada en inglés y español para conectar e influir eficazmente con equipos locales y globales.

Deseable:

• Certificaciones contables o financieras vigentes (CPA, CFA o equivalentes)

• MBA o título de posgrado en finanzas

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles para este puesto de trabajo.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Beheben von Störungen im Verantwortungsbereich

The Business Systems Analyst is an active and self-sufficient functional contributor within their project or product team. In this role, you will analyze business requirements independently and translate them into detailed functional system specifications, with a strong focus on utilizing ServiceNow . As a functional BA, you will provide direct consultation to users, create detailed documentation, support testing phases, and ensure seamless operations. You will leverage your strong communication skills and background in the healthcare or pharmaceutical domain to navigate validated environments (such as GxP) and regulatory frameworks effectively.
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / Content Leadership: Plays an active part within the project and/or product team. Provides constructive feedback, seeks feedback for self, reflects on own challenges and successes, and actively supports others.

• Accountability / Problem Solving: Analyzes business requirements and translates them into functional specifications. Maps out user needs to system capabilities, specifically utilizing ServiceNow. Plans and supports unit, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Able to assess and communicate functional and regulatory risks effectively.

• Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills are required. Identifies and communicates with stakeholders in a straightforward, clear manner. Considers both short-term and long-term implications in decision-making and adjusts rapidly in response to shifting priorities.

• Impact / Strategy: Executes an independent personal development plan and remains familiar with current functional and technological trends in Pharma R&D. Seeks best-fit trainings, gains external certificates if applicable, and actively takes part in knowledge-sharing initiatives (e.g., conferences, CoEs, CoPs).

• Complexity / Product Size: Operates at the Project level, making an impact on the workload of other chapter members through clear documentation and requirement gathering.

• Business / Functional Ability: Acts as the bridge between the business and IT. Provides functional assistance in resolving business systems issues and offers direct consultation to users. Creates meticulous, detailed system specifications and documentation. Understands how individual functional components fit into larger systems, identifies opportunities, suggests process improvements, consciously builds up a colleague network, and thinks of alternative ways to solve problems before asking for support.

• Proven track record of executing an independent development plan and participating in knowledge-sharing initiatives.

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Erfahrung - 4 bis 6 Jahre Standort - Pune Der Business Systems Analyst ist ein aktiver und autarker funktionaler Mitwirkender in seinem Projekt- oder Produktteam. In dieser Rolle analysieren Sie selbstständig Geschäftsanforderungen und übersetzen sie in detaillierte funktionale Systemspezifikationen, wobei Sie sich stark auf die Nutzung von ServiceNow konzentrieren. Als funktionaler BA beraten Sie die Benutzer direkt, erstellen eine detaillierte Dokumentation, unterstützen Testphasen und gewährleisten einen reibungslosen Betrieb. Sie werden Ihre starken Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Ihren Hintergrund im Gesundheitswesen oder in der Pharmaindustrie nutzen, um validierte Umgebungen (wie GxP) und regulatorische Rahmenbedingungen effektiv zu navigieren. Aufgabenbereich
• Scope / Content Leadership: Spielt eine aktive Rolle im Projekt- und / oder Produktteam. Bietet konstruktives Feedback, sucht Feedback für sich selbst, reflektiert eigene Herausforderungen und Erfolge und unterstützt aktiv andere.
• Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Analysiert Geschäftsanforderungen und übersetzt sie in funktionale Spezifikationen. Zeigt die Benutzeranforderungen den Systemfunktionen zu, insbesondere unter Verwendung von ServiceNow. Planet und unterstützt Unit-, Integrations- und Benutzerakzeptanztests (UAT). Fähigkeit, funktionale und regulatorische Risiken effektiv zu bewerten und zu kommunizieren.
• Stakeholder Management: Außergewöhnliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sind erforderlich. Identifiziert und kommuniziert mit Stakeholdern auf einfache und klare Weise. Berücksichtigt sowohl kurz- als auch langfristige Auswirkungen bei der Entscheidungsfindung und passt sich schnell als Reaktion auf sich ändernde Prioritäten an.

Sucht bestgeeignete Schulungen, erhält gegebenenfalls externe Zertifikate und nimmt aktiv an Initiativen zum Wissensaustausch teil (z. B. Konferenzen, CoEs, CoPs).
• Komplexität / Produktgröße: Funktioniert auf Projektebene und wirkt sich durch klare Dokumentation und Anforderungserfassung auf die Arbeitsbelastung anderer Kapitelmitglieder aus.
• Business / Functional Ability: Agiert als Brücke zwischen Business und IT. Bietet funktionale Unterstützung bei der Lösung von Geschäftssystemproblemen und bietet direkte Beratung für die Benutzer. • Zielerfahrung: Bachelor-Abschluss, mit 4-6 Jahren nachgewiesener Erfahrung als Business Analyst, speziell in funktionaler Funktion.
• Domain-Expertise: Starke Hintergrund im Gesundheitswesen oder Pharma-Bereich ist sehr bevorzugt.
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung als aktiver und unabhängiger Mitwirkender innerhalb von Projekt- oder Produktteams.
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Durchführung eines unabhängigen Entwicklungsplans und der Teilnahme an Initiativen zum Wissensaustausch. Core & Technical Skills (bevorzugt)
• ServiceNow Expertise: Spezifische Erfahrung und starke Fähigkeiten bei der Nutzung von ServiceNow für das Management von Geschäftssystemen.
• Regulierte Umgebungen: Erfahrung in einer validierten Umgebung, wie GxP (Good Practice) Vorschriften und ein solides Verständnis der pharmazeutischen regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen.

Fournir une assistance fonctionnelle pour résoudre les problèmes liés aux systèmes opérationnels et offrir une consultation directe aux utilisateurs. • Expertise du domaine : Une solide expérience dans le domaine des soins de santé ou des produits pharmaceutiques est hautement préférée.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:

•
• M.D. Required

• Therapeutic knowledge within metabolism, obesity, and diabetes with relevant clinical, scientific, and clinical trial/development experience required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is preferred

• Duration of Experience: 2 or more years of post-graduate academic or clinical experience

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Business Acumen: Has working knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process. Regularly leads development of disease strategies and plans

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills : Good interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority

• Writing: Strong written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Good business presentation skills; is comfortable and effective when presenting to others, internally or externally.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills : Good negotiation skills: knows how to complete deliverables by working effectively with others internally and externally

• Decision Making: Knows how to make trade-off decisions while balancing ethics and efficacy

• Teamwork: Strong orientation to teamwork

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
CDP Strategy and Planning

• Participates in development of the CD plan for assigned molecule(s)/indication(s)

• Gathers and analyzes data and information necessary to create the CD plan

• Works with other CST members and relevant sub-teams to develop CD plan components (e.g., analytics/data strategy, KOL development, publications strategy, etc.)

• Works with CST and other relevant teams to develop and provide information and input for budget/resource requirements necessary to implement and execute the CD plan

• Stays abreast of internal and external developments, trends and other dynamics relevant to the work of CD to maintain, at all times, a fully current view and perspective of internal/external influences and/or implications for the assigned therapeutic and disease area(s)

• As appropriate, participates in competitive intelligence and/or other market/industry assessment activities and projects

• Maintains the highest standards and levels of scientific and clinical knowledge in the specific therapeutic and disease area(s) of assignment

• Collaborates with a variety of internal and external partners and stakeholders, such as clinical investigators, clinicians, scientists and key opinion leaders (KOLs), as well as multidisciplinary internal groups, including other groups in PD, research, business development, commercial
